name: (+)-camphene

name: (+)-iridodial lactol
definition: An iridoid monoterpenoid that is 1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran substituted by methyl groups at positions 4 and 7 and a hydroxy group at position 1 (the 1R,4aS,7S,7aR-stereoisomer).

name: (R)-linalool

name: (+)-norephedrine

name: (+)-pinoresinol

name: (+)-piperitone

name: (+)-pronuciferine

name: (+)-syringaresinol

name: (−)-annonaine

name: (−)-chimonanthine

name: (S)-(−)-citronellol
definition: A citronellol that is oct-6-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1 and methyl groups at positions 3 and 7 (the 3S-enantiomer).

name: (−)-camphene
definition: A camphene (2,2-dimethyl-3-methylenebicyclo[2.2.1]heptane) that has S configuration at position 1 and R configuration at position 4.

name: (−)-epicatechin

name: (−)-hygrine

name: (S)-linalool

name: (−)-maackiain

name: (−)-medicarpin
definition: The (−)-enantiomer of medicarpin.

name: (−)-phaseolin
definition: A prenylated member of the class of pterocarpans and an organic heteropentacyclic compound that is 2,3,6b,12b-tetrahydro-1H,7H-chromeno[6',5':4,5]furo[3,2-c]chromen-10-ol in which both of the hydrogens at position 3 have been replaced by methyl groups (the R,R stereoisomer). It is found in found in the seeds of Phaseolus vulgaris (French bean) and in the stems of Erythrina subumbrans.

definition: A member of the class of hydroxyisoflavans that is (3R)-3,4-dihydro-2H,2'H-3,6'-bichromene substituted by two methyl groups at positions 2' and 2' and hydroxy groups at positions 5' and 7 respectively.

name: (S)-salsolinol

name: (−)-sativan

name: (−)-isodihydrocarvone

name: D-erythro-isocitric acid
definition: The D-erythro-stereoisomer of isocitric acid.

definition: A fenchone that has 1S,4R stereochemistry. A colourless, oily liquid found in fennel oil, it is used in perfumery and as flavour in foods.

name: (+)-isodihydrocarvone

name: (−)-dihydrocarvone

name: 1'-acetoxyeugenol acetate

name: 1,2,3,4-tetrakis-O-galloyl-α-D-glucose
definition: A gallate ester that is the tetraester obtained by the formal condensation of hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2, 3 and 4 of α-D-glucose with the carboxy group of four molecules of gallic acid respectively.

name: 1,2-campholide
definition: A δ-lactone that is 2-oxabicyclo[3.2.1]octan-3-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 8 and 8 respectively.

name: 1,2-epoxy-3-(4-nitrophenoxy)propane

name: 1,3,4,5-tetracaffeoylquinic acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by the formal condensation of hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, 4 and 5 of (−)-quinic acid with the carboxy group of four molecules of trans-caffeic acid respectively.

name: 1,3,4,6-tetrachlorocyclohexa-1,4-diene
definition: A chloroolefin that is cyclohexa-1,4-diene substituted by chloro groups at positions 1, 3, 4 and 6.

name: 1,3,5-trihydroxyxanthone
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is xanthone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 5. It has been isolated from Anaxagorea luzonensis.

name: 1,3-dicaffeoylquinic acid
definition: An alkyl caffeate ester obtained by the formal condensation of hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 3 of ()-quinic acid with two molecules of trans-caffeic acid.

name: 1,4-dithiane
definition: A dithiane that is cyclohexane in which the -CH2- units at positions 1 and 2 have been replaced by sulfur atoms.

name: 1-caffeoyl-β-D-glucose
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the 1-hydroxy group of β-D-glucopyranose with the carboxy group of trans-caffeic acid.

name: 1-carbapenem-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A carbapenemcarboxylic acid that is the 3-carboxy derivative of 2,3-didehydro-1-carbapenam.

name: 1-hydroxy-2-aminoethylphosphonic acid
definition: A phosphonic acid having a 1-hydroxy-2-aminoethyl group attached to the phosphorus.

name: 1-isomangostin
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 3,4-dihydro-2H,12H-pyrano[2,3-a]xanthen-12-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 9, a methoxy group at position 10, two methyl groups at position 2, a prenyl group at position 11 and an oxo group at position 12.

name: N-methyl-4-phenylpyridinium
definition: A pyridinium ion that is N-methylpyridinium having a phenyl substituent at the 4-position.

name: 2-methylhexano-6-lactone

name: 1-phenylethanol
definition: An aromatic alcohol that is ethanol substituted by a phenyl group at position 1.

name: 1-phenylethylamine
definition: A phenylethylamine that is ethylamine substituted by a phenyl group at position 1.

name: licarbazepine
definition: A dibenzoazepine that is 5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepine, reduced across the C-10,11 positions and carrying a carbamoyl substituent at the azepine nitrogen and a hydroxy function at C-10. A voltage-gated sodium channel blocker with anticonvulsant and mood-stabilizing effects, it is related to oxcarbazepine and is an active metabolite of oxcarbazepine.

name: 5β-dihydrocortisol
definition: A 17α-hydroxy-C21-steroid that is cortisol in which the 4-5 double bond has undergone formal hydrogenation to give the corresponding 5β- steroid.

name: pedilstatin
definition: A phorbol ester that is 4-deoxyphorbol in which the hydroxy groups at positions 12 and 13 have been replaced by octa-2,4-dienoyloxy and acetyloxy groups respectively.

name: 16-hydroxyphorbol 13-decanoate 12-palmitate
definition: A phorbol ester that consists of 16-hydroxyphorbol bearing O-hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) and O-decanoyl substituents at position 12 and 13 respectively.

name: 14-dihydroxycornestin
definition: A cyclic dicarboxylic anhydride that is 5,6,7,8,9,10-hexahydro-1H-cyclonona[c]furan-1,3(4H)-dione substituted by an ethylidene group at position 9, hydroxy groups at position 5 and 8, a propyl group at position 4 and an oxo group at position 6.

name: algestone
definition: A C21-steroid that is pregn-4-ene substituted by oxo groups at position 3 and 20 and hydroxy groups at positions 16 and 17.

name: estriol 16-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is estriol in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue.

name: 16-methoxytabersonine
definition: The 16-methoxy derivative of tabersonine.

name: 16α-hydroxypregnenolone
definition: A hydroxypregnenolone that is pregnenolone substituted by a α-hydroxy group at position 16.

name: 16α-hydroxyestrone
definition: The 16α-hydroxy derivative of estrone; a minor estrogen metabolite.

name: (20R)-17α,20-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 17 and 20 (the 20R-stereoisomer).

name: 17β-estradiol 17-glucosiduronic acid
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that consists of 17β-estradiol having a β-glucuronyl residue attached at position 17 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 19-hydroxytestosterone
definition: A 3-oxo Δ4-steroid that is testosterone which is substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 19.

name: 3,17-dioxoandrost-4-en-19-al
definition: An androstanoid that is androst-4-en-19-al substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 17.

name: 2'-deoxy-5-hydroxymethyl-CDP
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate that is 2'-deoxycytidine 5'-diphosphate (CDP) substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 5.

name: 2'-deoxy-5-hydroxymethyl-CTP
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate that is 2'deoxycytidine-5'-triphosphate substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 5.

name: 2'-norberbamunine
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is berbamunine in which the methyl group is replaced with a hydrogen on one of the tetrahydroisoquinolinol rings.

name: 2'-O-methylodoratol
definition: A member of the class of dihydrochalcones that is the 2'-O-methyl derivative of odoratol.

name: 2'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate
definition: An adenosine bisphosphate having monophosphate groups at the 2'- and 5'-positions and a sulfo group attached to the phosphate at position 5'.

name: 2,2'-(1-phenyl-1H-1,2,4-triazole-3,5-diyl)diphenol
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1-phenyl-1H-1,2,4-triazole substituted by 2-hydroxyphenyl groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: 2,2'-iminodipropanoic acid
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid that is 2,2'-iminodiacetic acid substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 2'.

name: (S)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinic acid
definition: The (2S)-stereoisomer of 2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinic acid.

name: 2,3-disulfanylpropane-1-sulfonic acid
definition: An alkanesulfonic acid that is propane-1-sulfonic acid substituted by sulfanyl groups at positions 2 and 3.

name: 2,4-diaminopentanoic acid
definition: A diamino acid consisting of pentanoic acid having the amino substituents placed in the 2- and 4-positions.

name: 2,4-dihydroxyhept-2-enedioic acid
definition: A heptenedioic acid having the C=C double bond at the 2,3-position and two hydroxy substituents at the 2- and 4-positions.

name: 2,4-dinitrotoluene
definition: A dinitrotoluene in which the methyl group is ortho to one of the nitro groups and para to the other. It is the most common isomer of dinitrotoluene.

name: 2,5-diamino-6-ribosylamino-4(3H)pyrimidinone 5'-triphosphate
definition: A ribose 5-triphosphate compound having a 2,5-diamino-6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyrimidin-4-ylamino substituent at the 1-position.

name: 2,6-dichlorobenzonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is benzonitrile which is substituted by chlorines at positions 2 and 6. A cellulose synthesis inhibitor, it is used as a pre-emergent and early post-emergent herbicide.

name: 2,6-dichloroindophenol
definition: A quinone imine that is indophenol substituted by chloro groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: (2,6-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid
definition: A dihydroxyphenylacetic acid having the two hydroxy substituents located at the 2- and 6-positions.

name: 2,6-dimethoxyphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol substituted by methoxy groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: 2,6-dinitrotoluene
definition: A dinitrotoluene carrying nitro substituents at positions 2 and 6.

name: 2,8-dihydroxy-3,4,7-trimethoxydibenzofuran
definition: A member of the class of dibenzofurans that is dibenzofuran substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3, 4 and 7 and hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 8.

name: 2-(2-chlorophenyl)-5-(5-methyl-2-thienyl)-1,3,4-oxadiazole
definition: A 1,3,4-oxadiazole substituted by a 2-chlorophenyl group at position 2 and a 5-methyl-2-thienyl group at position 5.

name: 2-(2-(4-methoxyphenyl)ethyl)chromone
definition: A member of the class of chromones that is chromone which is substituted by a 2-(4-methoxyphenyl)ethyl group at position 2. It is found in agarwood, a fragrant resinous heartwood from trees of the genus Aquilaria.

name: 2-(1-hydroxyethyl)thiamine diphosphate
definition: A thiamine phosphate having a 1-hydroxyethyl substituent at the 2-position on the thiazolium ring and an O-diphosphate moiety.

name: 2-amino-2-methylpropane-1,3-diol
definition: An aminodiol that is propane-1,3-diol substituted ny an amino and a methyl group at position 2.

name: cis,cis-2-amino-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioate
definition: The cis,cis-isomer of 2-amino-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioate.

name: cis,cis-2-amino-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioic acid
definition: The cis,cis-isomer of 2-amino-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioic acid.

name: 2-amino-5-oxohexanoate

name: N-(2-phosphonoethyl)cholamide

name: 6-chloro-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diol
definition: A dihydroxy-1,3,5-triazine that is 1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diol substituted by a chloro group at position 6.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabinonic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 2-oxopentanoic acid which is substituted at positions 4 and 5 by hydroxy groups (the 4S-enantiomer).

definition: A member of the class of catechols that is benzene-1,2-diol substituted by a (all-trans)-hexaprenyl group at position 3.

name: 2-hexaprenyl-6-methoxyphenol

name: 2-hexaprenylphenol

name: cis-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoic acid

name: 2-hydroxy-6-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-6-oxo-cis,cis-hexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is cis,cis-hexa-2,4-dienoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2, a 2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 6 and an oxo group at position 6.

name: 2-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: A hydroxybutyric acid having a single hydroxyl group located at position 2; urinary secretion of 2-hydroxybutyric acid is increased with alcohol ingestion or vigorous physical exercise and is associated with lactic acidosis and ketoacidosis in humans and diabetes in animals.

name: 2-hydroxyestrone
definition: A 2-hydroxy steroid that is estrone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: isethionic acid
definition: An alkanesulfonic acid in which the sulfo group is directly linked to a 2-hydroxyethyl group.

name: 2-hydroxyethylphosphonic acid
definition: A phosphonic acid consisting of ethanol with the phospho group at the 2-position.

name: 2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-dienedioic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is 2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-diene in which the two terminal methyl groups are replaced by carboxy groups (the 2Z,4E-geoisomer).

name: 2-hydroxypropylphosphonic acid
definition: A phosphonic acid consisting of propan-2-ol with the phospho group at the 1-position.

name: (2S)-2-isopropylmalate(2−)
definition: A 2-isopropylmalate(2−) with S-configuration at the chiral centre.

name: maleylacetic acid
definition: A 4-oxohex-2-enedioic acid with a Z-configuration.

name: 2-methoxyestrone
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is estrone in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a methoxy group.

name: 2-methylthio-1,3-benzothiazole
definition: An organic sulfide that is the methyl thioether of 1,3-benzothiazole-2-thiol.

name: 2-nitrofluorene
definition: A nitroarene that is fluorene substituted by a nitro group at position 2.

name: 2-O-methylswertianin
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is swertianin in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been replaced by a methoxy group.

name: sophorose

name: (20R,22R)-20,22-dihydroxycholesterol

name: 20-hydroxycholesterol

name: (22S)-22-hydroxycholesterol

definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is (9β)-24-methylene-9,19-cyclolanostane which carries a hydroxy group at position 3β. It is isolated from several plant species including Euphorbia, Epidendrum, Psychotria and Sideritis.

name: 3,3',4,4'-tetrachlorobiphenyl
definition: A tetrachlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which the hydrogens at position 3 and 4 on each phenyl group are replaced by chlorines.

name: 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylic acid
definition: A 1-pyrrolinecarboxylic acid that is 1-pyrroline in which one of the hydrogens at position 5 is replaced by a carboxy group.

name: 3,4-dihydroxyphenylethyleneglycol

definition: A member of the class of benzodioxoles that is 1,3-benzodioxole substituted by a 2-(methylamino)propyl group at position 5.

name: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is p-salicylic acid with bromo- substituents at C-3 and C-5 of the benzene ring.

name: 3,5-dimethoxy-1,6-dihydroxyxanthone

name: 3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid carrying a 3-hydroxyphenyl substituent at C-3.

name: 3-(methylthio)propionic acid
definition: A thia fatty acid acid consisting of propionic acid with a methylthio substituent at the 3-position; an intermediate in mammalian methionine metabolism in vitro. The simplest known phytotoxin, it is a blight-inducing toxin produced by the cassava pathogen Xanthomonas campestris manihotis.

name: 3-amino-2-oxopropyl phosphate
definition: A oxoalkyl phosphate having 3-amino-2-oxopropyl as the oxoalkyl group.

name: 3-aminopropanesulfonic acid
definition: An amino sulfonic acid that is the 3-amino derivative of propanesulfonic acid.

name: (Z)-3-butylidene-7-hydroxyphthalide
definition: A 2-benzofuran consisting of phthalide having a butylidene group at the 3-position.

name: 3-butynoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid consisting of acetylene carrying a carboxymethyl group.

name: 3-carboxy-1-hydroxypropylthiamine diphosphate
definition: A 1,3-thiazolium cation that is 1,3-thiazol-3-ium substituted by a methyl group at position 4, a (4-amino-2-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl group at position 3, a 3-carboxy-1-hydroxypropyl at position 2 and a 2-{[hydroxy(phosphonooxy)phosphoryl]oxy}ethyl group at position 5.

name: (2S)-2-isopropyl-3-oxosuccinic acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid that is 2-ketosuccinic acid (oxalacetic acid) in which the 3-pro-S hydrogen is substituted by an isopropyl group.

name: 3-chloro-cis,cis-muconic acid
definition: A 3-chloromuconic acid that is cis,cis-muconic acid substituted by a chloro substituent at position 3.

name: 3-fumarylpyruvic acid
definition: A 4,6-dioxohept-2-enedioic acid that is pyruvic acid substituted at position 3 by a fumaryl group.

name: 3-hydroxyhexobarbital
definition: A member of the class of barbiturates that is pyrimidine-2,4,6(1H,3H,5H)-trione substituted by a cyclohex-1-en-1-yl group at position 5, a hydroxy group at position 1 and methyl groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: 3-hydroxykynurenine
definition: A hydroxykynurenine that is kynurenine substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 3-methoxyapigenin
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is apigenin substituted by a methoxy group at position 3.

name: 3-methoxytyramine
definition: A monomethoxybenzene that is dopamine in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is replaced by a methoxy group. It is a metabolite of the neurotransmitter dopamine and considered a potential biomarker of pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas.

name: 3-methylgalangin
definition: A monomethoxyflavone that is galangin in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been replaced by a methoxy group.

name: 1-methyl-4-imidazoleacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a 1-methyl-1H-imidazol-4-yl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-octaprenylbenzoate
definition: A 4-hydroxy-3-polyprenylbenzoate in which the polyprenyl chain contains 8 prenyl units; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxohexobarbital
definition: An organic cation that is 1,2,4,6-tetraoxohexahydropyrimidin-1-ium substituted by a cyclohex-1-en-1-yl group at position 5 and methyl groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: 3-phospho-D-erythronic acid
definition: A phosphoerythronic acid that consists of D-erythronic acid bearing an O-phospho substituent at position 3.

name: 3-sulfinylpyruvic acid
definition: A pyruvic acid compound having a 3-sulfinyl substituent.

name: 3-ureidoisobutyric acid
definition: A ureidocarboxylic acid that is 2-methylpropanoic acid substituted by a carbamoylamino group at position 3.

name: 3α-hydroxy-5β-pregnan-20-one
definition: The 3α-stereoisomer of 3-hydroxy-5β-pregnan-20-one.

name: 4'-demethyldeoxypodophyllotoxin
definition: A member of the class of furonaphthodioxoles that is (5R,5aR,8aR)-5,8,8a,9-tetrahydro-2H-furo[3',4':6,7]naphtho[2,3-d][1,3]dioxol-6(5aH)-one substituted at position 5 by a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group.

name: 4'-demethylpodophyllotoxin
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is podophyllotoxin in which the methyl ether group at position 4 of the trimethoxyphenyl group has been cleaved to afford the corresponding phenol.

name: 4'-O-methylisoflavone
definition: The simplest member of the class of 4'methoxyisoflavones that is isoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 4'.

name: 4,5-methylenedioxy-6-hydroxyaurone
definition: A hydroxyaurone that is aurone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6 and a methylenedioxy group across positions 4 and 5 respectively.

name: chromotropic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 5.

name: (E)-4-(trimethylammonio)but-2-enoic acid
definition: A 4-(trimethylammonio)but-2-enoic acid with a (E)-configuration at the double bond.

name: biphenyl-4-amine
definition: An aminobiphenyl that is biphenyl substituted by an amino group at position 4.

name: 4-chloro-2-methylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is o-cresol in which the hydrogen para to the hydroxy group is replaced by a chlorine.

name: (4-chlorophenoxy)acetic acid
definition: A chlorophenoxyacetic acid that is phenoxyacetic acid carrying a chloro substituent at position 4.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-polyprenylbenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 4-hydroxybenzoic acid substituted at position 3 by any polyprenyl group.

name: 4-hydroxycyclophosphamide
definition: A phosphorodiamide that consists of 2-amino-1,3,2-oxazaphosphinan-4-ol 2-oxide having two 2-chloroethyl groups attached to the exocyclic nitrogen.

name: 4-hydroxyglucobrassicin
definition: An indolylmethylglucosinolic acid that is glucobrassicin bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the indole ring.

name: 2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)ethanol
definition: A phenol substituted at position 4 by a 2-hydroxyethyl group.

name: 4-hydroxystyrene
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is styrene carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 4.

name: 4-methoxyglucobrassicin
definition: An indolylmethylglucosinolic acid that is glucobrassicin bearing a methoxy substituent at position 4 on the indole ring.

name: 4-methyl-L-glutamate(1−)
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of 4-methyl-L-glutamic acid, having anionic carboxy groups and a cationic amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-methylbenzyl alcohol
definition: A methylbenzyl alcohol in which the methyl substituent is para to the hydroxymethyl group.

name: 4-methylumbelliferone β-D-glucuronide
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid having a 4-methylumbelliferyl substituent at the anomeric position. A hyaluronan synthesis inhibitor, it is anti-tumourigenic for various malignant tumours.

name: 4-methylumbelliferone sulfate
definition: A member of the class of coumarins that is umbelliferone sulfate which carries a methyl group at position 4. It is a metabolite of 4-methylumbelliferone.

name: 4-nitroanisole
definition: A member of the class of 4-nitroanisoles that is anisole in which one the hydrogen meta to the methoxy group is replaced by a nitro group.

name: 4-oxocyclohexanecarboxylic acid
definition: A 5-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is cyclohexanone in which one of the hydrogens at position 4 is substituted by a carboxylic acid group.

name: 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoic acid
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoate.

name: 4-p-coumaroylquinic acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-coumaric acid with the 4-hydroxy group of (−)-quinic acid.

name: 4α-methylzymosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is zymosterol substituted by a 4α-methyl group.

name: 5'-dehydroadenosine
definition: A member of the class of adenosines that is 5'-dehydro derivative of adenosine.

name: guanosine 5'-[β,γ-methylene]triphosphate
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate analogue that is guanosine substituted at position 5' by a (β,γ-methylene)triphosphate group.

name: (6R)-5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolic acid
definition: The (6R)-stereoisomer of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolic acid.

name: 5,6-dihydroxyindole-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A dihydroxyindole that is indole-2-carboxylic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 6.

name: 5-(2'-carboxyethyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinate
definition: An oxo carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-(2'-carboxyethyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinic acid.

name: 5-(2'-formylethyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinic acid
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is 1,6-dihydropyridine-2-carboxylic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4, a 2'-formylethyl group at position 5 and an oxo group at position 6 respectively.

name: 5-(3'-carboxy-3'-oxopropenyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinic acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid that is 4-hydroxy-6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyridine-2-carboxylic acid substituted by a 3-carboxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl group at position 5.

name: 5-(3'-carboxy-3'-oxopropyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinate
definition: An oxo carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-(3'-carboxy-3'-oxopropyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinic acid.

name: 5-(3-buten-1-ynyl)-2,2'-bithiophene
definition: A member of the class of 2,2'-bithiophenes that is 2,2'-bithiophene substituted by a 3-buten-1-ynyl group at position 5.

name: 5-(heptadec-12-enyl)resorcinol
definition: A resorcinol compound having a cis-heptadec-12-enyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: 5-acetamidopentanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of acetamides that is the acetyl derivative of 5-aminopentanoic acid.

name: 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide
definition: An aminoimidazole in which the amino group is at C-5 with a carboxamido group at C-4.

name: 5-azacytidine
definition: An N-glycosyl-1,3,5-triazine that is 4-amino-1,3,5-triazin-2(1H)-one substituted by a β-D-ribofuranosyl residue via an N-glycosidic linkage. An antineoplastic agent, it is used in the treatment of myeloid leukaemia.

name: (2Z,4E)-5-hydroxypenta-2,4-diene-1,2,5-tricarboxylic acid
definition: The (2Z,4E)-stereoisomer of 5-hydroxypenta-2,4-diene-1,2,5-tricarboxylic acid.

name: 5-hydroxy-N-formylkynurenine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is 5-hydroxykynurenine bearing an N-formyl substituent.

name: (E)-5-hydroxyferulic acid
definition: The E-isomer of 5-hydroxyferulic acid.

name: 5-hydroxykynurenine
definition: A hydroxykynurenine that is kynurenine bearing a hydroxy group at the position 5.

name: 5-hydroxyxanthotoxin
definition: A member of the class of psoralens that is xanthotoxin substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5.

name: 5-methoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine
definition: A tryptamine alkaloid that is N,N-dimethyltryptamine substituted by a methoxy group at position 5.

name: 5-methoxytryptamine
definition: A member of the class of tryptamines that is the methyl ether derivative of serotonin.

name: 5-[(E)-caffeoyl]shikimic acid
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (E)-caffeic acid with the 5-hydroxy group of shikimic acid.

name: cardol
definition: Resorcinol substituted at position 5 by a pentadecyl chain.

name: 5-pyridoxolactone
definition: A furopyridine that is furo[3,4-c]pyridin-3(1H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7 and a methoxy group at position 6. It is a metabolite of vitamin B6.

name: 5-methyl-3-isoxazolyl sulfate
definition: A heterocyclyl sulfate that is 1,2-oxazol-3-yl hydrogen sulfate substituted by a methyl group at position 5.

name: 5β-cyprinol sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is the sulfuric ester derivative of 5β-cyprinol.

name: 5β-dihydrotestosterone
definition: A 17β-hydroxyandrostan-3-one that has β- configuration at position 5. It is a metabolite of testosterone.

name: 6,8-di-(3,3-dimethylallyl)chrysin
definition: A dihydroxyflavone that is chrysin substituted by prenyl groups at positions 6 and 8 respectively.

name: 6,8-diprenylnaringenin
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that is (S)-naringenin substituted by prenyl groups at positions 6 and 8.

name: 6-(3,3-dimethylallyl)galangin
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is galangin substituted by a prenyl group at position 6.

name: 6-(3,3-dimethylallyl)chrysin
definition: A dihydroxyflavone that is chrysin substituted by a prenyl group at position 6.

name: 6-acetamido-3-aminohexanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of β-amino acids that is the N6-acetyl derivative of 3,6-diaminohexanoic acid.

name: 6-acetamido-3-oxohexanoic acid
definition: A 3-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 3-oxohexanoic acid substituted at position 6 by an acetamido group.

name: 6-acetylmorphine
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is morphine in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is replaced by an acetyloxy group. It is a metabolite of heroin.

name: D-fucopyranose
definition: The six-membered ring form of D-fucose.

name: L-fucopyranose
definition: The pyranose form of L-fucose.

name: 6-geranylchrysin
definition: A dihydroxyflavone that is chrysin substituted by a geranyl group at position 6.

name: 6-hydroxyluteolin
definition: A pentahydroxyflavone that is luteolin with an additional hydroxy group at position 6.

name: 6-hydroxymelatonin
definition: A member of the class of tryptamines that is melatonin with a hydroxy group substituent at position 6.

name: purine-6-thiol
definition: A thiol that is the tautomer of mercaptopurine.

name: 6-methoxyaromadendrin 3-O-acetate
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that is aromadendrin 3-O-acetate substituted by a methoxy group at position 6.

name: (R)-6-methoxymellein
definition: An optically active form of 6-methoxymellein having (R)-configuration.

name: 6-methoxytaxifolin
definition: A pentahydroxyflavanone that is (+)-taxifolin substituted by a methoxy group at position 6.

name: 6-methylergoline
definition: An ergoline alkaloid obtained by selective methylation of the N-6 position of ergoline.

name: 6-oxo-2-hydroxy-7-(4'-chlorophenyl)-3,8,8-trichloroocta-2E,4E,7E-trienoate
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 6-oxo-2-hydroxy-7-(4'-chlorophenyl)-3,8,8-trichloroocta-2E,4E,7E-trienoic acid.

name: 6-phospho-2-dehydro-D-gluconic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid phosphate that is the 6-phospho derivative of 2-dehydro-D-gluconic acid.

name: 6-phospho-β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose
definition: A 6-phospho-β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-D-glucose in which the anomeric centre at the reducing end has β-configuration.

name: 7,3'-dihydroxy-4'-methoxy-8-methylflavan
definition: A hydroxyflavan that is (2S)-flavan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 3', a methoxy group at position 4' and a methyl group at position 8.

name: 7,8-diaminononanoic acid
definition: An amino fatty acid carrying amino substituents at positions 7 and 8. Some of its isomers are naturally occurring intermediates of biotin synthesis, and targets of antimicrobial and herbicide development.

name: 7,8-dihydromethanopterin
definition: A member of the class of methanopterins resulting from the formal hydrogenation at the 7 and 8 positions of methanopterin.

name: 7β-aminocephalosporanic acid
definition: The α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is the active nucleus for the synthesis of cephalosporins and intermediates.

name: 7-deoxyloganic acid
definition: A cyclopentapyran that is 1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran-4-carboxylic acid substituted at positions 1 and 7 by β-D-glucosyloxy and methyl groups respectively (the 1S,4aS,7S,7aR-diatereomer).

name: 7-hydroxyflavone
definition: A hydroxyflavonoid in which the flavone nucleus is substituted at position 7 by a hydroxy group.

name: 7-(5-phospho-α-D-ribosyl)adenine
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate compound having 6-aminopurine as the nucleobase.

name: 7α,12α-dihydroxy-5β-cholestan-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo-5β-steroid that is 5β-cholestan-3-one bearing two additional hydroxy substituents at positions 7α and 12α.

name: 7α-hydroxy-5β-cholestan-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo-5β-steroid that is 5β-cholestan-3-one bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 7α .

name: 7α -hydroxytestosterone
definition: An androstanoid that is testosterone substituted by a α-hydroxy group at position 7. A natural product found in Daphnia magna exposed to the biocide tributyltin

name: 8-(1,1-dimethylallyl)kaempferide
definition: A 7-hydroxyflavonol that is kaempferide substituted by a 1,1-dimethylallyl group at position 8.

name: 8-(1,1-dimethylallyl)-3-methylgalangin
definition: A 7-hydroxyflavonol that is 3-methylgalangin substituted by a 1,1-dimethylallyl group at position 8.

name: 8-(1,1-dimethylallyl)galangin
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is galangin substituted by a 1,1-dimethylallyl moiety at position 8. It is isolated from the buds of Platanus acerifolia.

name: 3-O-methyl-8-prenylgalangin
definition: A 7-hydroxyflavonol that is 3-O-methylgalangin substituted by a prenyl group at position 8.

name: 8-(3,3-dimethylallyl)chrysin
definition: A dihydroxyflavone that is chrysin substituted by a prenyl group at position 8.

name: Oplophorus luciferin
definition: An imidazopyrazine that is imidazo[1,2-a]pyrazin-3(7H)-one in which positions 2, 6, and 8 are substituted by 4-hydroxybenzyl, 4-hydroxyphenyl, and benzyl groups, respectively.

name: 8-epiiridodial lactol
definition: A lactol that is (+)-iridodial lactol in which the configuration of the carbon at position 7 is inverted from S to R.

name: 8-geranylchrysin
definition: A dihydroxyflavone that is chrysin substituted by a geranyl group at position 8.

name: 4-hydroxy-8-methoxyquinaldic acid
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid that is kynurenic acid which is substituted by a methoxy group at position 8.

name: docebenone
definition: A member of the class of benzoquinones that is p-benzoquinone in which the hydrogens are substituted by three methyl groups and a 12-hydroxydodeca-5,10-diyn-1-yl group.

name: AACOCF3
definition: A fatty acid derivative that is arachidonic acid in which the OH part of the carboxy group has been replaced by a trifluoromethyl group

name: abacavir sulfate
definition: An azaheterocycle sulfate salt that is the sulfate salt of the HIV-1 reverse transcriptase inhibitor abacavir.

name: abrusoside A
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is (22S,24Z)-3β-hydroxy-26-oxo-22,26-epoxy-9β,19-cyclolanost-24-en-28-oic acid having a β-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 3 via a glycosidic bond.

name: (+)-abscisic acid
definition: The naturally occurring (1'S)-(+) enantiomer of abscisic acid. It is an important sesquiterpenoid plant hormone which acts as a regulator of plant responses to environmental stresses such as drought and cold.

name: absinthin
definition: A dimeric sesquiterpene lactone that is produced by the plant Artemisia absinthium (Wormwood). The bitter tasting constituent of Absinthe.

name: abyssinone I
definition: A monohydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-2',2'-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-2'H,4H-2,6'-bichromen-4-one carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 7.

name: abyssinone V
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 4' and prenyl groups at positions 3' and 5' respectively.

name: abyssinone VI
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is isolated from the stem of Erythrina abyssinica.

name: acalyphin
definition: A member of the class of tetrahydropyridines that is 2,3-dihydroxy-4-methoxy-1-methyl-6-oxo-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine-3-carbonitrile having a β-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 3 via a glycosidic bond.

name: acamelin
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 1-benzofuran-4,7-dione bearing additional methyl and methoxy substituents at positions 2 and 7 respectively.

name: acanthicifoline
definition: A 2,7-naphthyridine derivative that is 1,4-dihydro-2,7-naphthyridin-3(2H)-one which is substituted at positions 1 and 5 by methyl and methoxy groups, respectively.

name: (−)-syringaresinol O,O'-bis(β-D-glucoside)
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 4,4'-bis(β-D-glucosyl) derivative of (−)-syringaresinol.

name: acarbose
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of a dideoxy-4-{[4,5,6-trihydroxy-3-(hydroxymethyl)cyclohex-2-en-1-yl C7 cyclitol moiety [called valienol (or valienamine)] linked via nitrogen to isomaltotriose.

name: acebutolol
definition: An ether that is the 2-acetyl-4-(butanoylamino)phenyl ether of the primary hydroxy group of 3-(propan-2-ylamino)propane-1,2-diol.

name: acebutolol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of acebutolol, prepared using equimolar amounts of acebutolol and hydrogen chloride.

name: acerosin
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is 5,7,3'-trihydroxyflavone with methoxy substituents at positions 6, 8 and 4' respectively.

name: acetochlor
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is N-phenylacetamide carrying an ethyl and a methyl group at positions 2 and 6 respectively on the benzene ring while one of the methyl hydrogens as well as the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen atom have been replaced by a chloro and an ethoxymethyl group respectively.

name: acetophenazine
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is 10H-phenothiazine substituted by a 3-[4-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazin-1-yl]propyl group at the nitogen atom and an acetyl group at position 2.

name: acetophenazine dimaleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by combining acetophenazine with two molar equivalents of maleic acid.

name: acetosyringone
definition: A member of the class of acetophenones that is 1-phenylethanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4 and methoxy groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: 1-O-acetyl-α-maltose
definition: A 1-O-acetylmaltose in which the anomeric centre at the reducing end has α-configuration.

name: acetylagmatine
definition: A member of the class of guanidines that is agmatine acetylated at the N4-position.

name: acetylblasticidin S
definition: A member of the class of blasticidins that is blasticidin S in which the side-chain amino group is acetylated.

name: 14-O-acetylbrowniine
definition: An acetate ester obtained by acetylation of the O-14 position of browniine.

name: acetylcaranine
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is caranine in which the hydroxy group is acetylated.

name: acetylcholine chloride
definition: The chloride salt of acetylcholine, and a parasympatomimetic drug.

name: acetohydrazide
definition: A carbohydrazide that is hydrazine in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by an acetyl group.

name: acetylleucyl-leucyl-norleucinal
definition: A tripeptide composed of N-acetylleucyl, leucyl and norleucinal residues joined in sequence.

name: acetylpyruvic acid
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid that is pentanoic acid carrying two oxo groups at positions 2 and 4.

name: achillin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone that is (3R,3aS,9aS,9bS)-3,3a,4,5,9a,9b-hexahydroazuleno[4,5-b]furan-2,7-dione carrying three additional methyl substituents at positions 3, 6 and 9.

name: aconifine
definition: A diterpenoid that is aconitine bearing a 10-hydroxy substituent.

name: aconitine
definition: A diterpenoid that is 20-ethyl-3α,13,15α-trihydroxy-1α,6α,16β-trimethoxy-4-(methoxymethyl)aconitane-8,14α-diol having acetate and benzoate groups at the 8- and 14-positions respectively.

name: acremoauxin A
definition: An indolyl carboxylate ester obtained by formal condensation of one of the primary hydroxy groups of D-arabinitol with the carboxy group of (2R)-2-(indol-3-yl)propanoic acid.

name: acrifoline
definition: A quinolizidine alkaloid that is lycopodine having a C=C double bond at the 11-position, a keto substituent at the 8-position and the keto group at position 5 replaced by a β-hydroxy group.

name: acronidine
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 3H-furo[2,3-b]pyrano[3,2-f]quinoline carrying a gem-dimethyl group at position 3 as well as two methoxy substituents at positions 5 and 11.

name: acronycidine
definition: A quinoline alkaloid that is furo[2,3-b]quinoline bearing four methoxy substituents at positions 4, 5, 7 and 8.

name: acronycine
definition: An alkaloid antineoplastic agent isolated from Acronychia baueri.

name: acrophylline
definition: A quinoline alkaloid that is furo[2,3-b]quinolin-4-one bearing additional 3,3-dimethylallyl and methoxy substituents at positions 9 and 7 respectively.

name: acroptilin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone that is isolated from Acroptilon repens and displays anti-allergic properties.

name: acrovestone
definition: A polyphenol that is isolated from Acronychia pedunculata and exhibits moderate antioxidant and antityrosinase activities.

name: actinidine
definition: A member of the class of cyclopentapyridines that is 6,7-dihydrocyclopenta[c]pyridine bearing two methyl substituents at positions 4 and 7.

name: actinodaphnine
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound 6,7,7a,8-tetrahydro-5H-benzo[g][1,3]dioxolo[4',5':4,5]benzo[1,2,3-de]quinoline bering additional hydroxy and methoxy substituents at positions 10 and 11 respectively.

name: actinorhodin
definition: A member of the class of benzoisochromanequinone that is produced by Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2) and exhibits antibiotic activity.

name: aculeacin A
definition: A lipopeptide that is isolated from Aspergillus aculeatus and exhibits antifungal activity.

name: acyclovir
definition: An oxopurine that is guanine substituted by a (2-hydroxyethoxy)methyl substituent at position 9. Used in the treatment of viral infections.

name: adefovir
definition: A member of the class of phosphonic acids that is methylphosphonic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a 2-(6-amino-9H-purin-9-yl)ethoxy group. An inhibitor of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase, the bis(t-butoxycarbonyloxymethyl) ester (dipivoxil ester) prodrug is used to treat chronic hepatitis B viral infection.

name: adenosylcobinamide guanosyl diphosphate
definition: A cobalt corrinoid consisting of cobinamide guanosyl diphosphate having a 5'-adenosyl group attached to the central cobalt atom.

name: adenosylcobinamide
definition: A cobalt-corrinoid hexaamide comprising cobinamide having an adenosyl group attached to cobalt.

name: adenosylcobinamide phosphate
definition: An O-phosphocorrinoid that is cobinamide phosphate having a 5'-adenosyl group attached to the central cobalt atom.

name: adenosylcob(III)yrinic acid a,c-diamide
definition: A cobalt corrinoid that is cob(III)yrinic acid a,c-diamide having a 5'-adenosyl group attached to the central cobalt atom.

name: adenosylcobyric acid
definition: A cobalt corrinoid that is cobyric acid having a 5'-adenosyl group attached to the central cobalt atom.

name: adenylyl selenate
definition: The 5'-selenonooxyphosphate ester of adenosine.

name: 6-oxohexanoic acid
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid comprising hexanoic acid carrying an oxo group at position 6.

name: adrenosterone
definition: A 3-oxo Δ4-steroid that is androst-4-ene carrying three oxo-substituents at positions 3, 11 and 17.

name: aethusin
definition: A polyene that is tridecane carrying trans double bonds at positions 2, 8, and 10 and triple bonds at positions 4 and 6. It is a phytotoxin isolated from the plant, Aethusa cynapium.

name: aflatoxin B1
definition: An aflatoxin having a tetrahydrocyclopenta[c]furo[3',2':4,5]furo[2,3-h]chromene skeleton with oxygen functionality at positions 1, 4 and 11.

name: 8,9-dihydro-8-(S-glutathionyl)-9-hydroxyaflatoxin B1
definition: A member of the class of aflatoxins that is 8,9-dihydro-9-hydroxyaflatoxin B1 having an S-glutathionyl moiety attached at position 8.

name: afrormosin
definition: A 4'-methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 6 and 4' and a hydroxy group at position 7.

name: afzelechin
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavan that is (2S)-flavan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 7 and 4' respectively.

name: afzelechin-(4α→8)-afzelechin
definition: A biflavonoid consisting of two molecules of afzelechin joined by a (4α→8) linkage.

name: agarose
definition: A linear polysaccharide made up from alternating D-galactose and 3,6-anhydro-α-L-galactopyranose residues joined by α-(1→3)- and β-(1→4)-linkages.

name: agathisflavone
definition: A biflavonoid that is obtained by oxidative coupling of two molecules of apigenin resulting in a bond between positions C-6 and C-8 of the two chromene rings.

name: agavoside A
definition: A steroid saponin that consists of (25R)-5α-spirostan-3β-ol substituted by an oxo group at position 12 and a β-D-galactopyranosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: agnuside
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid with the primary hydroxy group of aucubin. It is an iridoid glycoside found in several Vitex plants including Vitex agnus-castus.

name: agroclavine
definition: An ergot alkaloid that is ergoline which contains a double bond between positions 8 and 9, and which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 6 and 8.

name: ajmalicine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C21H24N2O3, isolated from several Rauvolfia and Catharanthus species. It is a selective α1-adrenoceptor antagonist used for the treatment of high blood pressure.

name: alachlor
definition: An aromatic amide that is N-(2,6-diethylphenyl)acetamide substituted by a methoxymethyl group at at the nitrogen atom while one of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been replaced by a chlorine atom.

name: alamarine
definition: A member of the class of isoquinolinonaphthyridines that is 5,6-dihydroisoquinolino[2,1-b][2,7]naphthyridin-8-one bearing additional hydroxy, methoxy and 1-hydroxyethyl substituents at positions 2, 3 and 12.

name: alangicine
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is 1',2'-didehydroemetan bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 6' and 9 as well as three methoxy substituents at positions 7', 10 and 11.

name: alangimarckine
definition: A member of the class of β-carbolines that is tubulosan bearing methoxy groups at positions 10 and 11 as well as a hydroxy group at position 9.

name: alangimarine
definition: A member of the class of isoquinolinonaphthyridines that is 5,6-dihydroisoquinolino[2,1-b][2,7]naphthyridin-8-one bearing additional hydroxy, methoxy and vinyl substituents at positions 2, 3 and 12 respectively.

name: alangiside
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is an alkaloidal glycoside isolated from Alangium salviifolium.

name: alantolactone
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone that is 3a,5,6,7,8,8a,9,9a-octahydronaphtho[2,3-b]furan-2-one bearing two methyl substituents at positions 5 and 8a as well as a methylidene substituent at position 3.

name: alatolide
definition: A germacrane sesquiterpenoid laactone obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of isobutyric acid with the secondary hydroxy group of trihydroxygermaeranolide.

name: albafuran A
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 1-benzofuran substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6 and a 2-[(2E)-3,7-dimethylocta-2,6-dien-1-yl]-3,5-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 2.

name: albuterol
definition: A member of the class of phenylethanolamines that is 4-(2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl)-2-(hydroxymethyl)phenol having a tert-butyl group attached to the nirogen atom. It acts as a β-adrenergic agonist used in the treatment of asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

name: aldicarb
definition: The oxime carbamate resulting from the addition of 2-methyl-2-(methylsulfanyl)propanaldoxime to methyl isocyanate. A member of the class of oxime carbamate insecticides, aldicarb is a mixture of E and Z isomers; it is not known which isomer is more active.

name: aldrin
definition: An organochlorine compound resulting from the Diels-Alder reaction of hexachlorocyclopentadiene with norbornadiene. A proinsecticide (by epoxidation of the non-chlorinated double bond to give dieldrin), it was widely used as an insecticide before being banned in the 1970s as a persistent organic pollutant.

name: alendronate sodium trihydrate
definition: A hydride that is the trihydrate of alendronate sodium

name: alendronic acid
definition: A 1,1-bis(phosphonic acid) that is methanebis(phosphonic acid) in which the two methylene hydrogens are replaced by hydroxy and 3-aminopropyl groups.

name: alfentanil
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is piperidine having a 2-(4-ethyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-tetrazol-1-yl)ethyl group at the 1-position as well as N-phenylpropanamido- and methoxymethyl groups at the 4-position.

name: alliin
definition: An L-alanine derivative in which one of the methyl hydrogens of L-alanine has been replaced by an (S)-allylsulfinyl group.

name: methylcarbamoylcarbamate
definition: A carbamate ester obatined by the formal condensation of urea-1-carboxylic acid with methanol.

name: Aloe emodin
definition: A dihydroxyanthraquinone that is chrysazin carrying a hydroxymethyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from plant species of the genus Aloe.

name: alprazolam
definition: A member of the class of triazolobenzodiazepines that is 4H-[1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a][1,4]benzodiazepine carrying methyl, phenyl and chloro substituents at positions 1, 6 and 8 respectively. Alprazolam is only found in individuals that have taken this drug.

name: alstonine
definition: An indole alkaloid with formula C21H20N2O3, isolated from several Rauvolfia species and exhibits antipsychotic activity.

name: amabiline
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S,3S)-2,3-dihydroxy-2-isopropylbutanoic acid with the hydroxy group of (7aS)-2,3,5,7a-tetrahydropyrrolizin-7-ylmethanol.

name: amantadine
definition: A member of the class of adamantanes that is used as an antiviral and antiparkinson drug.

name: amantadine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining amantadine and hydrochloric acid in equimolar amounts.

name: amaralin
definition: An azulenofuran that is decahydrooxireno[1,2]azuleno[6,5-b]furan-5(1aH)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8, methyl groups at positions 2 and 7a and a methylidene group at position 6.

name: amaranthin
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is betanidin in which a β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucosyl moiety is attached at position 5.

name: amarogentin
definition: A secoiridoid glycoside that consists of (4aS,5R,6R)-5-ethenyl-6-hydroxy-4,4a,5,6-tetrahydro-1H,3H-pyrano[3,4-c]pyran-1-one having a 2-O-[(3,3',5-trihydroxybiphenyl-2-yl)carbonyl]-β-D-glucopyranosyl group attached at position 6 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: amaryllisine
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is 3,4,4a,5,6,10b-hexahydro-5,10b-ethanophenanthridin-9-ol bearing three additional methoxy substituents at positions 3, 7 and 8.

name: amastatin
definition: A tetrapeptide comprising (2S,3R)-3-amino-2-hydroxy-5-methylhexanoyl, L-valyl, L-valyl and L-aspartic acid units joined in sequence

name: amataine
definition: A polycyclic indole alkaloid that is obtained from the root bark of Voacanga africana.

name: ambenonium
definition: A symmetrical oxalamide-based bis-quaternary ammonium ion having ethyl and 2-chlorobenzyl groups attached to the nitrogens.

name: ambenonium chloride
definition: A symmetrical oxalamide-based bis-quaternary ammonium salt having ethyl and 2-chlorobenzyl groups attached to the nitrogens.

name: hydramethylnon
definition: A member of the class of hydrazones that is used as an insecticide for control of ants and cockroaches.

name: amentoflavone
definition: A biflavonoid that is obtained by oxidative coupling of two molecules of apigenin resulting in a bond between positions C-3 of the hydroxyphenyl ring and C-8 of the chromene ring. A natural product found particularly in Ginkgo biloba and Hypericum perforatum.

name: amifostine
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is the S-phospho derivative of 2-[(3-aminopropyl)amino]ethanethiol. A prodrug for the free thiol, WR-1065, which is used as a cytoprotectant in cancer chemotherapy and radiotherapy.

name: amikacin
definition: An amino cyclitol glycoside that is kanamycin A acylated at the N-1 position by a 4-amino-2-hydroxybutyryl group.

name: amikacin disulfate
definition: An aminoglycoside sulfate salt obtained by combining amikacin with two molar equivalents of sulfuric acid.

name: amiloride
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines resulting from the formal monoacylation of guanidine with the carboxy group of 3,5-diamino-6-chloropyrazine-2-carboxylic acid.

name: amiloride hydrochloride dihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate of amiloride hydrochloride.

name: aminocarb
definition: A carbamate ester that is phenyl methylcarbamate substituted by a dimethylamino group at position 4 and a methyl group at position 3.

name: aminoglutethimide
definition: A dicarboximide that is a six-membered cyclic compound having ethyl and 4-aminophenyl substituents at the 3-position.

name: aminophylline
definition: A mixture comprising of theophylline and ethylenediamine in a 2:1 ratio.

name: amiodarone
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 1-benzofuran substituted by a butyl group at position 2 and a 4-[2-(diethylamino)ethoxy]-3,5-diiodobenzoyl group at position 3. It is a cardiovascular drug used for the treatment of cardiac dysrhythmias.

name: amitraz
definition: A tertiary amino compound that is 1,3,5-triazapenta-1,4-diene substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and 2,4-dimethylphenyl groups at positions 1 and 5.

name: amitriptyline
definition: An organic tricyclic compound that is 10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[a,d][7]annulene substituted by a 3-(dimethylamino)propylidene group at position 5.

name: amlodipine
definition: A fully substituted dialkyl 1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarboxylate derivative, which is used for the treatment of hypertension, chronic stable angina and confirmed or suspected vasospastic angina.

name: amlodipine benzenesulfonate
definition: The benzenesulfonate salt of amlodipine.

name: ammodendrine
definition: A piperidine alkaloid that is piperidine substituted by a 1-acetyl-1,4,5,6-tetrahydropyridin-3-yl group at position 2 (the 2R-stereoisomer).

name: amobarbital
definition: A member of the class of barbiturates that is pyrimidine-2,4,6(1H,3H,5H)-trione substituted by a 3-methylbutyl and an ethyl group at position 5. Amobarbital has been shown to exhibit sedative and hypnotic properties.

name: amodiaquine
definition: A quinoline having a chloro group at the 7-position and an aryl amino group at the 4-position.

name: amoxapine
definition: A dibenzooxazepine compound having a chloro substituent at the 2-position and a piperazin-1-yl group at the 11-position.

name: amoxicillin
definition: A penicillin in which the substituent at position 6 of the penam ring is a 2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetamido group.

name: amphotericin B
definition: A macrolide antibiotic used to treat potentially life-threatening fungal infections.

name: amrinone
definition: A 3,4'-bipyridine substituted at positions 5 and 6 by an amino group and a keto function respectively. A pyridine phosphodiesterase 3 inhibitor, it is a drug that may improve the prognosis in patients with congestive heart failure.

name: amsacrine
definition: A sulfonamide that is N-phenylmethanesulfonamide substituted by a methoxy group at position 3 and an acridin-9-ylamino group at position 4. It exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: isoamyl nitrite
definition: A nitrite ester having isopentyl as the alkyl group.

name: anacardic acid
definition: A hydroxybenzoic acid that is salicylic acid substituted by a pentadecyl group at position 6. It is a major component of cashew nut shell liquid and exhibits an extensive range of bioactivities.

name: anandamide
definition: An N-acylethanolamine 20:4 resulting from the formal condensation of carboxy group of arachidonic acid with the amino group of ethanolamine.

name: anastrozole
definition: A 1,2,4-triazole compound having a 3,5-bis(2-cyano-2-propyl)benzyl group at the 1-position.

name: androst-5-ene-3β,17β-diol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-Δ5-steroid that is 3β-hydroxyandrost-5-ene carrying an additional hydroxy group at position 17β.

name: anethole
definition: A monomethoxybenzene that is methoxybenzene substituted by a prop-1-en-1-yl group at position 4.

name: angiotensin I
definition: A ten amino acid peptide formed by renin cleavage of angiotensinogen. Angiotensin I has no direct biological function except that high levels can stimulate catecholamine production. It is metabolized to its biologically active byproduct angiotensin II, a potent vasoconstrictor, by angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) through cleavage of the two terminal amino acids.

name: Ile5-angiotensin II
definition: An angiotensin II that acts on the central nervous system (PDB entry: 1N9V).

name: anisotropine methylbromide
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt resulting from the reaction of the amino group of anisotropine with methyl bromide.

name: ankorine
definition: A pyridoisoquinoline that is 1,3,4,6,7,11b-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[2,1-a]isoquinoline which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 8 by 2-hydroxyethyl, ethyl, and hydroxy groups, respectively, and by methoxy groups at positions 9 and 10 (the 2R,3R,11bS stereoisomer). It is a benzo[a]quinolizidine alkaloid isolated from the Indian medicinal plant Alangium lamarckii.

name: anthemis glycoside A
definition: An anthemis glycoside that is found in the cyanogenic achenes of Anthemis altissima.

name: anthemis glycoside B
definition: An anthemis glycoside that is found in the cyanogenic achenes of Anthemis altissima.

name: anthragallol
definition: A trihydroxyanthraquinone that is anthracene-9,10-dione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 3.

name: anthracene-1,8,9-triol
definition: An anthracenetriol that is anthracene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 8 and 9.

name: 3,4,5-trimethoxyphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3, 4 and 5.

name: dipotassium bis[μ-tartrato(4−)]diantimonate(2−) trihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the trihydrate form of dipotassium bis[μ-tartrato(4−)]diantimonate(2−).

name: antimycin A
definition: A nine-membered bis-lactone having methyl substituents at the 2- and 6-positions, an n-hexyl substituent at the 8-position, an acyloxy substituent at the 7-position and an aroylamido substituent at the 3-position. It is produced by Streptomyces bacteria and has found commercial use as a fish poison.

name: aphidicolin
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid that has an tetradecahydro-8,11a-methanocyclohepta[a]naphthalene skeleton with two hydroxymethyl substituents at positions 4 and 9, two methyl substituents at positions 4 and 11b and two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 9. An antibiotic with antiviral and antimitotical properties. Aphidicolin is a reversible inhibitor of eukaryotic nuclear DNA replication.

name: apigenin 7,4'-dimethyl ether
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is the 7,4'-dimethyl ether derivative of apigenin.

name: apocynin
definition: An aromatic ketone that is 1-phenylethanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4 and a methoxy group at position 3.

name: apraclonidine
definition: An imidazoline that is 2-amino 4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazoline in which one of the exocyclic amino hydrogens has been replaced by a 4-amino-2,6-dichlorophenyl group.

name: apraclonidine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of apraclonidine.

name: apramycin
definition: An aminoglycoside that is 2-deoxystreptamine that is substituted on the oxygen at position 4 by an (8R)-2-amino-8-O-(4-amino-4-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyl)-2,3,7-trideoxy-7-(methylamino)-D-glycero-α-D-allo-octodialdo-1,5:8,4-dipyranos-1-yl) group.

name: aprobarbital
definition: A member of the class of barbiturates that is pyrimidine-2,4,6(1H,3H,5H)-trione substituted by an isopropyl and a prop-1-en-3-yl group at position 5.

name: arbusculin A
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone isolated from Saussureae Radix and has been shown to exhibit inhibitory activity against melanogenesis.

name: arbutin 6-phosphate
definition: A β-D-glucoside compound having a phosphate group at the 6-position and a 4-hydroxyphenyl substituent at the 1-position.

name: arecoline
definition: A tetrahydropyridine that is 1,2,5,6-tetrahydropyridine with a methyl group at position 1, and a methoxycarbonyl group at position 3. An alkaloid found in the areca nut, it acts as an agonist of muscarinic acetylcholine.

name: aristolochic acid A
definition: An aristolochic acid that is phenanthrene-1-carboxylic acid that is substituted by a methylenedioxy group at the 3,4 positions, by a methoxy group at position 8, and by a nitro group at position 10. It is the most abundant of the aristolochic acids and is found in almost all Aristolochia (birthworts or pipevines) species. It has been tried in a number of treatments for inflammatory disorders, mainly in Chinese and folk medicine. However, there is concern over their use as aristolochic acid is both carcinogenic and nephrotoxic.

name: artabsin
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpene lactone found in wormwood.

name: artemorin
definition: A germacranolide isolated from Laurus nobilis L..

name: ascaridole
definition: A p-menthane monoterpenoid that is p-menth-2-ene with a peroxy group across position 1 to 4.

name: asebogenin
definition: A member of the class of dihydrochalcones that is the 4'-methyl ether derivative of phloretin.

name: asiatic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is ursane substituted by a carboxy group at position 28 and hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3 and 23 (the 2α,3β stereoisomer). It is isolated from Symplocos lancifolia and Vateria indica and exhibits anti-angiogenic activity.

name: aspartame
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the α-carboxy group of L-aspartic acid with the amino group of methyl L-phenylalaninate. Commonly used as an artificial sweetener.

name: asperuloside
definition: A iridoid monoterpenoid glycoside isolated from Galium verum.

name: astemizole
definition: A piperidine compound having a 2-(4-methoxyphenyl)ethyl group at the 1-position and an N-[(4-fluorobenzyl)benzimidazol-2-yl]amino group at the 4-position.

name: astragaloside III
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is cycloastragenol with a 2-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-xylopyranosyl moiety attached at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: trans-astringin
definition: A stilbenoid that is piceatannol substituted at position 3 by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: atenolol
definition: An ethanolamine compound having a (4-carbamoylmethylphenoxy)methyl group at the 1-position and an N-isopropyl substituent.

name: athyriol
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 6 and 7 and a methoxy group at position 3.

name: atisine
definition: A organic heterohexacyclic compound and diterpene alkaloid isolated from Aconitum anthora. In solution, it is a 2:1 mixture of readily interconvertible epimers at position 20 (the carbon attached to both the nitrogen and an oxygen atom).

name: atorvastatin calcium trihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the trihydrate form of atorvastatin calcium.

name: atracurium
definition: A diester compound consisting of pentane-1,5-diol with both hydroxyls bearing 3-[1-(3,4-dimethoxybenzyl)-6,7-dimethoxy-2-methyl-3,4-dihydroisoquinolinium-2(1H)-yl]propanoyl groups.

name: atracurium besylate
definition: The bisbenzenesulfonate salt of atracurium.

name: auranofin
definition: An S-glycosyl compound consisting of 2,3,4,6-tetra-O-acetyl-1-thio-β-D-glucopyranose with the sufur atom coordinated to (triethylphosphoranylidene)gold. It is administered orally for the treatment of active progressive rheumatoid arthritis.

name: auriculoside
definition: A flavan glycoside that is (2S)-flavan substituted by a methoxy group at position 4', hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 5' and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 3 respectively.

name: avadharidine
definition: A diterpenoid having an aconitane skeleton bearing multiple substituents.

name: avenacoside A
definition: A steroid saponin obtained from grain and leaves of oats (Avena sativa) that is nuatigenin in which the hydroxy group at position 26 is converted into its β-D-glucoside and in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is converted into its methyl α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1→2)-[β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→4)]-β-D-glucopyranoside derivative.

name: avenacoside B
definition: A steroid saponin obtained from grain and leaves of oats (Avena sativa) that is nuatigenin in which the hydroxy group at position 26 is converted to its β-D-glucoside and in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is converted into its methyl α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1→2)-[β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→4)]-β-D-glucopyranoside derivative.

name: axillarin
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is the 3,6-dimethyl ether derivative of quercetagetin.

name: azadirachtin A
definition: A member of the family of azadirachtins that is isolated from the neem tree (Azadirachta indica).

name: azafenidin
definition: A triazolopyridine that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro[1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a]pyridin-3(2H)-one which is substituted at position 2 by a 2,4-dichloro-5-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)phenyl group. A protoporphyrinogen oxidase inhibitor, it is used as a herbicide to control weeds in fruit crops such as pineapple, citrus, melons, and grapes. Not approved for use within the European Union.

name: azaleatin
definition: A monomethoxyflavone that is quercetin in which the hydroxy group at position 5 is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: azatadine
definition: A benzo[5,6]cyclohepta[1,2-b]pyridine having a 1-methylpiperidin-4-ylidene group at the 11-position.

name: azatadine maleate
definition: The dimaleate salt of azatadine.

name: azathioprine
definition: A thiopurine that is 6-mercaptopurine in which the mercapto hydrogen is replaced by a 1-methyl-4-nitroimidazol-5-yl group. It is a prodrug for mercaptopurine and is used as an immunosuppressant, prescribed for the treatment of inflammatory conditions and after organ transplantation and also for treatment of Crohn's didease and MS.

name: azelastine
definition: A phthalazine compound having an oxo substituent at the 1-position, a 1-methylazepan-4-yl group at the 2-position and a 4-chlorobenzyl substituent at the 4-position.

name: azelastine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of azelastine.

name: azinphos-methyl
definition: A member of the class of benzotriazines that is 1,2,3-benzotriazine substituted by an oxo group at position 4 and a [(dimethoxyphosphorothioyl)sulfanyl]methyl group at position 3.

name: azithromycin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic useful for the treatment of bacterial infections.

name: azlocillin
definition: A semisynthetic penicillin having a 6β-{(2R)-2-[(2-oxoimidazolidine-1-carbonyl)amino]-2-phenylacetyl}amino side-group. It is an antibiotic used in treating infections caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Escherichia coli and Haemophilus influenzae.

name: azocyclotin
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1,2,4-triazole substituted at position 1 by a tricyclohexylstannyl group.

name: kresoxim-methyl
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the methyl ester of (2E)-(methoxyimino){2-[(2-methylphenoxy)methyl]phenyl}acetic acid. A fungicide for the control of scab on apples and pears and other fungal diseases on a wide range of crops.

name: bacampicillin
definition: A penicillanic acid ester that is the 1-ethoxycarbonyloxyethyl ester of ampicillin. It is a semi-synthetic, microbiologically inactive prodrug of ampicillin.

name: bacampicillin hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of bacampicillin.

name: backebergine
definition: A member of the class of isoquinolines carrying two methoxy substituents at positions 6 and 7.

name: baclofen
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is butanoic acid substituted by an amino group at position 4 and a 4-chlorophenyl group at position 3. It acts as a central nervous system depressant, GABA agonist and muscle relaxant.

name: baicalein
definition: A trihydroxyflavone with the hydroxy groups at positions C-5, -6 and -7.

name: 5,6,7-trimethoxyflavone
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is the 5,6,7-trimethyl ether derivative of baicalein. It has been isolated from the plant Callicarpa japonica and has been shown to exhibit antiviral activity.

name: baicalin
definition: The glycosyloxyflavone which is the 7-O-glucuronide of baicalein. It is an active ingredient of Chinese herbal medicine Scutellaria baicalensis.

name: aloin A
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by a 4,5-dihydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)-10-oxo-9,10-dihydroanthracen-9-yl moiety (the 9S diastereoisomer).

name: barbinine
definition: A diterpene alkaloid that is a phytotoxin produced by several Delphinium species.

name: barringtogenol C
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 16, 21, 22 and 28 (the 3β,16α,21β,22α stereoisomer).

name: bayogenin 3-O-cellobioside
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is bayogenin substituted at the O-3 position by a cellobiosyl residue.

name: beauvericin
definition: A trimeric cyclodepsipeptide composed from alternating methylphenylalanyl and hydroxyvaleryl residues.

name: beclomethasone
definition: A 17α-hydroxy steroid that is prednisolone in which the hydrogens at the 9α and 16β positions are substituted by a chlorine and a methyl group, respectively.

name: beclomethasone dipropionate
definition: A steroid ester comprising beclomethasone having propionyl groups at the 17- and 21-positions.

name: belladine
definition: A phenethylamine alkaloid that is N-methyl-4-methoxyphenylethylamine carrying an additional N-(3,4-dimethoxybenzyl) substituent.

name: bellidifolin
definition: A member of the xanthone family that is bellidin substituted with a methyl group at O-3. A natural product found particularly in Swertia chirata and Gentianella campestris.

name: benazepril
definition: A benzazepine that is benazeprilat in which the carboxy group of the 2-amino-4-phenylbutanoic acid moiety has been converted to the corresponding ethyl ester. It is used (generally as its hydrochloride salt) as a prodrug for the angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor benazeprilat in the treatment of hypertension and heart failure.

name: benazepril hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of benazepril with 1 mol eq. of hydrogen chloride. It is used as a prodrug for angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor benazeprilat in the treatment of hypertension and heart failure.

name: bendroflumethiazide
definition: A sulfonamide consisting of 7-sulfamoyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-1,2,4-benzothiadiazine 1,1-dioxide in which the hydrogen at position 6 is substituted by a trifluoromethyl group and that at position 3 is substituted by a benzyl group.

name: benomyl
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is the methyl ester of [1-(butylcarbamoyl)-1H-benzimidazol-2-yl]carbamic acid. A foliar fungicide used to control a wide range of Ascomycetes and Fungi Imperfecti in a wide range of crops.

name: bensulfuron-methyl
definition: The methyl ester of bensulfuron. An acetolactate synthase inhibitor, it is used as a herbicide for the control of a variety of both annual and perennial weeds in crops, particularly wheat and rice. It is not licensed for use within the UK.

name: bentazone
definition: A benzothiadiazine that is 1H-2,1,3-benzothiadiazin-4(3H)-one 2,2-dioxide substituted by an isopropyl group at position 3.

name: benzbromarone
definition: 1-Benzofuran substituted at C-2 and C-3 by an ethyl group and a 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzoyl group respectively. An inhibitor of CYP2C9, it is used as an anti-gout medication.

name: benzenamine sulfate(1−)
definition: An organic sulfamate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfamate OH group of benzenamine sulfate.

name: benzonatate
definition: The ester obtained by formal condensation of 4-butylaminobenzoic acid with nonaethylene glycol monomethyl ether. Structurally related to procaine and benzocaine, it has an anaesthetic effect on the stretch sensors in the lungs, and is used as a non-narcotic cough suppressant.

name: benzphetamine
definition: Dextroamphetamine in which the the hydrogens attached to the amino group are substituted by a methyl and a benzyl group. A sympathomimetic agent with properties similar to dextroamphetamine, it is used as its hydrochloride salt in the treatment of obesity.

name: benzthiazide
definition: 7-Sulfamoyl-1,2,4-benzothiadiazine 1,1-dioxide in which the hydrogen at position 6 is substituted by chlorine and that at position 3 is substituted by a benzylsulfanylmethyl group. A diuretic, it is used to treat hypertension and edema.

name: benzatropine
definition: Tropane in which a hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a diphenylmethoxy group (endo-isomer). An acetylcholine receptor antagonist, it is used (particularly as its methanesulphonate salt) in the treatment of Parkinson's disease, and to reduce parkinsonism and akathisia side effects of antipsychotic treatments.

name: benzatropine mesylate
definition: The methanesulfonate salt of benzatropine. An acetylcholine receptor antagonist, it is used in the treatment of Parkinson's disease, and to reduce parkinsonism and akathisia side effects of antipsychotic treatments.

name: bepridil
definition: A tertiary amine in which the substituents on nitrogen are benzyl, phenyl and 3-(2-methylpropoxy)-2-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)propyl.

name: bestatin
definition: A dipeptide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S,3R)-3-amino-2-hydroxy-4-phenylbutanoic acid with the amino group of L-leucine.

name: betamethasone sodium phosphate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of betamethasone phosphate.

name: betavulgarin
definition: A hydroxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2', a methoxy group at position 5 and a methylenedioxy group across positions 6 and 7 respectively.

name: betaxolol
definition: A propanolamine that is 3-aminopropane-1,2-diol in which the hydrogen of the primary hydoxy is substituted by a 4-[2-(cyclopropylmethoxy)ethyl]phenyl group and one of the hydrogens attached to the amino group is substituted by isopropyl. It is a selective β1-receptor blocker and is used in the treatment of glaucoma as well as hypertension, arrhythmias, and coronary heart disease. It is also used to reduce non-fatal cardiac events in patients with heart failure.

name: bethanechol
definition: The carbamic acid ester of 2-methylcholine. A slowly hydrolysed muscarinic agonist with no nicotinic effects, it is used as its chloride salt to increase smooth muscle tone, as in the gastrointestinal tract following abdominal surgery, treatment of gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, and as an alternative to catheterisation in the treatment of non-obstructive urinary retention.

name: bethanechol chloride
definition: The chloride salt of bethanechol. A slowly hydrolysed muscarinic agonist with no nicotinic effects, it is used to increase smooth muscle tone, as in the gastrointestinal tract following abdominal surgery, treatment of gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, and as an alternative to catheterisation in the treatment of non-obstructive urinary retention.

name: betulin
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is lupane having a double bond at position 20(29) as well as 3β-hydroxy and 28-hydroxymethyl substituents.

name: betulinic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is lupane having a double bond at position 20(29) as well as 3β-hydroxy and 28-carboxy substituents. It is found in the bark and other plant parts of several species of plants including Syzygium claviflorum. It exhibits anti-HIV, antimalarial, antineoplastic and anti-inflammatory properties.

name: bilanafos
definition: A tripeptide comprising one L-phosphinothricyl and two L-alanyl units joined in sequence.

name: biapenem
definition: A carbapenem antibiotic in which the azetidine and pyrroline rings carry 1-hydroxymethyl and pyrazolo[1,2-a][1,2,4]triazolium-6-ylthio substituents respectively.

name: bicuculline
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is 6-methyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydro[1,3]dioxolo[4,5-g]isoquinoline which is substituted at the 5-pro-S position by a (6R)-8-oxo-6,8-dihydrofuro[3,4-e][1,3]benzodioxol-6-yl group. A light-sensitive competitive antagonist of GABAA receptors. It was originally identified in 1932 in plant alkaloid extracts and has been isolated from Dicentra cucullaria, Adlumia fungosa, Fumariaceae, and several Corydalis species.

name: bifenthrin
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of cis-3-(2-chloro-3,3,3-trifluoroprop-1-enyl)-2,2-dimethylcyclopropanecarboxylic acid and [(2-methyl-1,1'-biphenyl)-3-yl]methanol.

name: bikaverin
definition: A organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 10H-benzo[b]xanthene-7,10,12-trione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 6 and 11, methoxy groups at positions 3 and 8 and a methyl group at position 1.

name: bilobalide
definition: A terpenoid trilactone found in extracts of Ginkgo biloba.

name: biperiden
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is N-propylpiperidine in which the methyl hydrogens have been replaced by hydroxy, phenyl, and 5-norbornen-2-yl groups. A muscarinic antagonist affecting both the central and peripheral nervous systems, it is used in the treatment of all forms of Parkinson's disease.

name: bis(glycerophospho)glycerol
definition: A glycerol phosphate that consists of a linear array of three glycerol units connected by phosphodiester linkages.

name: bispyribac
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid substituted by (4,6-dimethoxypyrimidin-2-yl)oxy groups at positions 2 and 6. Its sodium salt is used as a broad spectrum post emergent herbicide for the control of grasses, sedges and broadleaf weeds in rice crops.

name: bithionol
definition: An aryl sulfide that is diphenyl sulfide in which each phenyl group is substituted at position 2 by hydroxy and at positions 3 and 5 by chlorine. A fungicide and anthelmintic, it was used in various topical drug products for the treatment of liver flukes, but withdrawn after being shown to be a potent photosensitizer with the potential to cause serious skin disorders.

name: bitolterol
definition: The di-4-toluate ester of (±)-N-tert-butylnoradrenaline (colterol). A pro-drug for colterol, a β2-adrenergic receptor agonist, bitolterol is used as its methanesulfonate salt for relief of bronchospasm in conditions such as asthma, chronic bronchitis and emphysema.

name: bitolterol mesylate
definition: The methanesulfonate salt of bitolterol. A β2-adrenergic receptor agonist, it is used for relief of bronchospasm in conditions such as asthma, chronic bronchitis and emphysema.

name: bixin
definition: A carotenoic acid that is the 6'-monomethyl ester of 9'-cis-6,6'-diapocarotene-6,6'-dioic acid.

name: Nα-t-butoxycarbonyl-L-asparagine
definition: The Nα-t-butoxycarbonyl derivative of L-asparagine

name: botrydial
definition: A cytotoxic fungal metabolite isolated from plant tissues infected by phytopathogen Botrytis cinerea.

name: bowdichione
definition: A hydroxyisoflavone with a quinone structure in ring B. Isolated from Dalbergia parviflora, it exhibits antineoplastic and anti-inflammatory activities.

name: bracteatin
definition: The 3,4,5-trihydrobenzylidene derivative of 4,6-dihydroxy-1-benzofuran-3(2H)-one. Its glucoside is a significant contributor to the yellow colour of Antirrhinum majus (snapdragon) flowers.

name: bradykinin
definition: A linear nonapeptide messenger belonging to the kinin group of proteins, with amino acid sequence RPPGFSPFR. Enzymatically produced from kallidin in the blood, it is a powerful vasodilator that causes smooth muscle contraction, and may mediate inflammation.

name: brassicasterol
