definition: A 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the 3-carboxy group of (3S)-3-carboxy-3-hydroxypropanoic acid.

name: citramalyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA having citramalyl as the S-acyl group.

name: (3S)-citryl-CoA
definition: An (S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA having (3S)-citryl as the S-acyl group

name: trans-tetradec-11-enoyl-CoA
definition: A Δ11-acyl-CoA having trans-tetradec-11-enoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: cis-tetradec-11-enoyl-CoA
definition: A Δ11-acyl-CoA having cis-tetradec-11-enoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: cinnamoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cinnamic acid.

name: (R)-methylmalonyl-CoA
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of methylmalonyl-CoA.

name: (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of methylmalonyl-CoA.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA where the 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl component has (S)-configuration.

name: 3'-dephospho-CoA
definition: An adenosine 5'-phosphate that is coenzyme A in which the phosphate group at position 3' has been replaced by a hydrogen atom. It is an intermediate metabolite in pantothenate and CoA biosynthesis.

name: 2,4-dichlorobenzoyl-CoA
definition: A dichlorobenzoyl-CoA having 2,4-dichlorobenzoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: trans-dodec-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA having trans-dodec-2-enoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: anthraniloyl-CoA
definition: A member of the class of benzoyl-CoAs having 2-aminobenzoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: crotonoyl-CoA
definition: The (E)-isomer of but-2-enoyl-CoA.

name: 2-furoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA having 2-furoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: 2-hydroxyphytanoyl-CoA
definition: A multi-methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA having 2-hydroxyphytanoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: 2-methylacetoacetyl-CoA
definition: A 3-oxoacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-methylacetoacetic acid.

name: 2-methylbutanoyl-CoA
definition: A short-chain, methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA having 2-methylbutanoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: isobutyryl-CoA
definition: A short-chain, methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA that is the S-isobutyryl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-(3-hydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)propanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxy-3-(3-hydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)propanoic acid.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-(4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl)glutaryl-CoA
definition: The S-3-hydroxy-3-(4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl)glutaryl derivative of CoA.

name: 3-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxybenzoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 3-hydroxybenzoic acid.

name: 3-hydroxypimeloyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxypimelic acid.

name: 3-methylbut-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-methylbut-2-enoic acid.

name: isovaleryl-CoA
definition: A methylbutanoyl-CoA is the S-isovaleryl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: trans-3-methylglutaconyl-CoA
definition: The S-(trans-3-methylglutaconyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 3-oxoadipyl-CoA
definition: The S-(3-oxoadipyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 3-oxopalmitoyl-CoA
definition: The S-(3-oxopalmitoyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 3-oxopimeloyl-CoA
definition: The S-(3-oxopimeloyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A cholestanoyl-CoA formed by thioester linkage between 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid and coenzyme A.

name: 3α,7α-dihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A cholestanoyl-CoA formed by thioester linkage between 3α,7α-dihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid and coenzyme A.

name: 4,8,12-trimethyltridecanoyl-CoA
definition: A multi-methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA that is the S-(4,8,12-trimethyltridecanoyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 4-aminobutanoyl-CoA
definition: An aminobutanoyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 4-aminobutanoic acid.

name: trans-4-carboxybut-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: The S-(trans-4-carboxybut-2-enoyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 4-chlorobenzoyl-CoA
definition: A chlorobenzoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 4-chlorobenzoic acid

name: 4-coumaroyl-CoA
definition: The S-(4-coumaroyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxybenzoyl-CoA that is the S-(4-hydroxybenzoyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 5-hydroxypentanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 5-hydroxypentanoic acid.

name: 5-hydroxythiophene-2-carbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that is the S-(5-hydroxythiophene-2-carbonyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 2,3-didehydropimeloyl-CoA
definition: The S-(2,3-didehydropimeloyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: pimeloyl-CoA
definition: An ω carboxyacyl-CoA that is the S-pimeloyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 6-hydroxycyclohex-1-ene-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: The S-(6-hydroxycyclohex-1-ene-1-carbonyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 7-methyl-3-oxooctanoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 7-methyl-3-oxooctanoic acid.

name: β-alanyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that is the S-(β-alanyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: γ-linolenoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecatrienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of γ-linolenic acid.

name: 4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-4-oxobutanoyl-CoA
definition: A member of the class of acyl-CoAs that is the S-[4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-4-oxobutanoyl] derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 5-hydroxy-2-furoyl-CoA
definition: The S-(5-hydroxy-2-furoyl) derivative of coenzyme A.

name: trans-feruloyl-CoA
definition: A feruloyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-feruloic acid.

name: L-3-aminobutanoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-aminobutyryl-CoA having that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of L-3-aminobutanoic acid.

name: acryloyl-CoA
definition: The S-acryloyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: arachidonoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of arachidononic acid.

name: benzoyl-CoA
definition: The simplest member of the class of benzoyl-CoAs that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of benzoic acid.

name: biotinyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of biotin.

name: butyryl-CoA
definition: A short-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of butyric acid.

name: caffeoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of caffeic acid.

name: choloyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cholic acid.

name: lauroyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of lauric (dodecanoic) acid.

name: formyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of formic acid.

name: cis-geranoyl-CoA
definition: A cis-2-enoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group nerolic acid.

name: glutaryl-CoA
definition: An ω-carboxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with one of the carboxy groups of glutaric acid.

name: palmitoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain fatty acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the thiol group of coenzyme A.

name: icosanoyl-CoA
definition: A very long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that is the S-icosanoyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: itaconyl-CoA
definition: The S-itaconyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: lactoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of lactic acid.

name: linoleoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of linoleic acid.

name: malonyl-CoA
definition: The S-malonyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: myristoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of myristic acid.

name: octanoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of octanoic acid.

name: oleoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecenoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of oleic acid.

name: oxalyl-CoA
definition: An ω-carboxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with one of the carboxy groups of oxalic acid.

name: pentanoyl-CoA
definition: A short-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of pentanoic acid.

name: phenylacetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of phenylacetic acid.

name: phytanoyl-CoA
definition: The S-phytanoyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: propionyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of propionic acid.

name: sinapoyl-CoA
definition: A trans-2-enoyl-CoA that is the S-sinapoyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: stearoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of stearic acid.

name: thiophene-2-carbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of thiophene-2-carboxylic acid.

name: vinylacetyl-CoA
definition: The S-vinylacetyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 13,14-dihydro-15-oxo-prostaglandin E2
definition: The 13,14-dihydro derivative of 15-oxo-prostaglandin E2.

name: prostaglandin E2
definition: Prostaglandin F2α in which the hydroxy group at position 9 has been oxidised to the corresponding ketone. Prostaglandin E2 is the most common and most biologically potent of mammalian prostaglandins.

name: prostaglandin F2α
definition: A prostaglandins Fα that is prosta-5,13-dien-1-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 9, 11 and 15. It is a naturally occurring prostaglandin used to induce labor.

name: prostaglandin D2
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins D that is prosta-5,13-dien-1-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 9 and 15 and an oxo group at position 11 (the 5Z,9α,13E,15S- stereoisomer).

name: 15-dehydro-prostaglandin D2
definition: The 15-dehydro derivative of prostaglandin D2.

name: 15(S)-HETE
definition: An optically active form of 15-HETE having 15(S)-configuration..

name: 15-oxo-ETE
definition: An oxoicosatetraenoic acid having (5Z,8Z,11Z,13E) double bond stereochemistry, and an oxo group in position 15.

name: D-threo-isocitrate(3−)
definition: The D-threo-form of isocitrate(3−).

name: D-erythro-isocitrate(3−)
definition: A isocitrate(3−) that is the conjugate base of D-erythro-isocitric acid.

name: D-alanine
definition: The D-enantiomer of alanine.

name: (2-aminoethyl)phosphonic acid
definition: A phosphonic acid in which the hydrogen attached to the phosphorus of phosphonic acid is substituted by a 2-aminoethyl group.

name: (2E,6E,10R,11S)-10,11-epoxy-3,7,11-trimethyltrideca-2,6-dienoic acid
definition: A C16 polyunsaturated fatty acid that is the (10R,11S)-epoxy derivative of trideca-2,6-dienoic acid.

name: juvenile hormone II

name: 15(S)-HPETE

name: 10-formyldihydrofolic acid

name: (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolic acid
definition: A derivative of folic acid in which the pteridine ring is fully reduced; it is the parent compound of a variety of coenzymes that serve as carriers of one-carbon groups in metabolic reactions.

name: 10-formyltetrahydrofolic acid

name: (6R)-5,10-methenyltetrahydrofolic acid

name: 5-formimidoyltetrahydrofolic acid

name: 5-formyltetrahydrofolic acid

definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid resulting from the formal oxidation of each of the terminal methyl groups of butane to the corresponding carboxy group. It is an intermediate metabolite in the citric acid cycle.

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-L-mannose

name: N-benzoyl-D-arginine-4-nitroanilide

A dense, non-flammible colourless liquid at room temperature (b.p. 40°C, d = 1.33) which is immiscible with water, it is widely used as a solvent, a paint stripper, and for the removal of caffeine from coffee and tea.

name: 3,5-diiodo-L-tyrosine

name: D-erythritol 4-phosphate

name: loganin

name: L-dopachrome

name: dTDP-β-L-rhamnose

name: viomycin
definition: A cyclic peptide antibiotic produced by the actinomycete Streptomyces puniceus, used in the treatment of tuberculosis.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate

name: 3-hydroxy-N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysine

name: 3,5-dichlorocatechol

name: malonate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy groups of malonic acid.

name: 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted at C-2 by an amine group and at C-3 by a hydroxy group. It is an intermediate in the metabolism of the amino acid tryptophan.

name: protoaphin aglucone

name: 1-(4-amino-2-methylpyrimidin-5-ylmethyl)-3-(2-hydroxyethyl)-2-methylpyridinium bromide

name: D-octopine

name: β-L-arabinose 1-phosphate

name: 12-dehydrotetracycline

name: dolichyl D-mannosyl phosphate

name: O-phospho-L-serine

name: dolichyl β-D-glucosyl phosphate

name: quinolin-4-ol

name: D-arginine

name: N6-(dimethylallyl)adenosine 5'-monophosphate

name: GDP-α-D-mannose

name: 4-phospho-L-aspartic acid

name: isoamylol

name: orotidine 5'-phosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having 6-carboxyuracil as the nucleobase.

name: keto-L-tagatose 6-phosphate
definition: The open chain form of L-tagatose 6-phosphate

name: NAD+
definition: The oxidised form of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide found in all living cells. In metabolism, NAD+ is involved in redox reactions, carrying electrons from one reaction to another.

name: 2-(α-D-mannosyl)-D-glyceric acid
definition: A D-mannosyl-D-glyceric acid where an α-D-mannosyl residue is attached at the 2-position.

name: 3-(uracil-1-yl)-L-alanine
definition: The 3-(uracil-1-yl) derivative of L-alanine.

name: quinine
definition: A cinchona alkaloid that is cinchonidine in which the hydrogen at the 6-position of the quinoline ring is substituted by methoxy.

name: UDP-6-sulfoquinovose
definition: A UDP-sugar having 6-sulfoquinovose as the sugar component.

name: N-carbamoyl-L-aspartic acid
definition: The L-enantiomer N-carbamoylaspartic acid.

name: ethylamine
definition: A two-carbon primary aliphatic amine.

name: 4-(4-deoxy-β-D-gluc-4-enosyluronic acid)-D-galacturonic acid
definition: A D-galacturonic acid having a 4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranosyluronic acid moiety attached at the 4-position.

name: luteolin
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone in which the four hydroxy groups are located at positions 3', 4', 5 and 7. It is thought to play an important role in the human body as an antioxidant, a free radical scavenger, an anti-inflammatory agent and an immune system modulator as well as being active against several cancers.

name: CDP-N-methylethanolamine
definition: A nucleotide-(amino alcohol) that is the N-methyl derivative of CDP-ethanolamine.

name: betaine aldehyde hydrate
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is the hydrate of betaine aldehyde.

name: α-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate
definition: A 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose 6-phosphate that has an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: 10-hydroxydihydrosanguinarine
definition: A benzophenanthridine alkaloid comprising dihydrosanguinarine carrying a hydroxy substituent at the 10-position.

name: S-methyl 3-phospho-1-thio-D-glycerate
definition: The methyl thiolester of 3-phospho-1-thio-D-glyceric acid.

name: 2-oxopropyl-CoM
definition: The S-(2-oxopropyl) derivative of coenzyme M.

name: phenol
definition: An organic hydroxy compound that consists of benzene bearing a single hydroxy substituent. The parent of the class of phenols.

name: P1,P4-bis(5'-guanosyl) tetraphosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-tetraphosphate compound having 5'-guanosyl residues at the P1- and P4-positions.

name: tropine
definition: A derivative of tropane having a hydroxy group at the 3-position.

name: L-2-amino-4-chloropent-4-enoic acid
definition: An α-amino acid having a 2-chloro-2-propenyl group at the α-position and L-configuration.

name: 5-aminopentanoic acid
definition: A δ-amino acid comprising pentanoic acid with an amino substituent at C-5; a methylene homologue of γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) that is a weak GABA agonist.

name: 5-oxohexanoic acid
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid comprising hexanoic acid carrying a 5-oxo group.

name: 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole
definition: A dimethylbenzimidazole carrying methyl substituents at positions 5 and 6.

name: taurine
definition: An amino sulfonic acid that is the 2-amino derivative of ethanesulfonic acid. It is a naturally occurring amino acid derived from methionine and cysteine metabolism. An abundant component of fish- and meat-based foods, it has been used as an oral supplement in the treatment of disorders such as cystic fibrosis and hypertension.

name: S-succinylglutathione
definition: The S-succinoyl derivative of glutathione.

name: 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate
definition: A 1-pyrrolinecarboxylate resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxy group of 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylic acid.

name: D-galactono-1,4-lactone
definition: A galactonolactone derived from D-galactonic acid.

name: 3,4-dihydroxy-9,10-secoandrosta-1,3,5(10)-triene-9,17-dione
definition: A seco-androstane that is 9,10-secoandrostane which is substituted by oxo groups at positions 9 and 17 and in which the A-ring is aromatic and bears hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4.

name: (R)-5-diphosphomevalonic acid
definition: The 5-diphospho derivative of (R)-mevalonic acid.

name: trans-2,3-epoxysuccinic acid
definition: The trans-2,3-epoxy derivative of succinic acid.

name: 5,6-dihydrouracil
definition: A pyrimidine obtained by formal addition of hydrogen across the 5,6-position of uracil.

name: α-D-xylose 1-phosphate
definition: A xylose phosphate that is α-D-xylose carrying a phosphate group at position 1.

name: β-D-glucose
definition: D-Glucopyranose with β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenic acid
definition: An amidoalkyl phosphate that is the 4-phosphate derivative of (R)-pantothenic acid.

name: demethylmacrocin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is tylonolide having mono- and diglycosyl moieties attached to two of its hydroxy groups..

name: L-threonic acid
definition: The L-enantiomer of threonic acid.

name: desulfoglucotropeolin
definition: A desulfoglucosinolic acid resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of N-hydroxy(phenyl)ethanethioamide with β-D-glucopyranose.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 2-amino-4-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A derivative of valeric acid having amino and oxo substituents at the 2- and 4-positions respectively.

name: ADP-L-glycero-D-manno-heptose
definition: An ADP-glycero-D-manno-heptose having L-glycero-configuration at the 6-position of the heptose portion.

name: serine phosphoethanolamine
definition: The O-phosphoethanolamine derivative of serine.

name: 2'-deoxycytosine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having cytosine as the nucleobase.

name: N6-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl)-AMP
definition: The N6-(1,2-dicarboxyethyl) derivative of adenosine 5'-monophosphate.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconic acid
definition: The 5-phospho derivative of 2-dehydro-D-gluconic acid.

name: N-ribosylnicotinamide
definition: A pyridine nucleoside consisting of nicotinamide with a β-D-ribofuranosyl moiety at the 1-position.

name: (−)-methyl jasmonate
definition: A jasmonate ester that is the methyl ester of jasmonic acid.

name: atrazine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is 1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a chloro group at position 6 while one of hydrogens of each amino group is replaced respectively by an ethyl and a propan-2-yl group.

name: 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-(4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranosyluronic acid)-4-O-sulfo-D-galactopyranose
definition: A (4-deoxygluc-4-enosyluronic acid)-(1→3)-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine sulfate in which the 4-deoxygluc-4-enosyluronic acid component has β-D configuration.

name: apiin
definition: A β-D-glucoside having a β-D-apiosyl residue at the 2-position and a 5,4'-dihydroxyflavon-7-yl moiety at the anomeric position.

name: UDP-D-apiose
definition: A UDP-sugar having D-apiose as the sugar portion.

name: 5-amino-6-(D-ribitylamino)uracil
definition: An aminouracil that is D-ribitol in which the hydroxy group at position 1 is substituted by the 6-amino group of 5,6-diaminouracil. Early intermediate in bacterial riboflavin synthesis.

name: trans-5-O-(4-coumaroyl)-D-quinic acid
definition: The 5-O-(4-coumaroyl) derivative of (−)-quinic acid.

name: glycyrrhizinic acid
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is the glucosiduronide derivative of 3β-hydroxy-11-oxoolean-12-en-30-oic acid.

name: nicotinic acid
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is pyridine in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a carboxy group.

name: 2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoic acid
definition: A cyclohexadienecarboxylic acid having the C=C bonds at the 1- and 3-positions, the carboxylic acid at the 1-position and two hydroxy substituents at the 5- and 6-positions.

name: 2-aminobenzenesulfonate
definition: An aminobenzenesulfonate that is the conjugate base of 2-aminobenzenesulfonic acid.

name: poly(glycerol phosphate) macromolecule
definition: A homopolymer macromolecule consisting of repeating glycerol-1-phosphate units.

name: 6-O-methylnorlaudanosoline
definition: The 6-O-methyl derivative of norlaudanosoline.

name: D-galactono-1,5-lactone
definition: A galactonolactone that is the D-enantiomer of galactono-1,5-lactone.

name: keto-D-fructose 6-phosphate
definition: The open chain form of D-fructose 6-phosphate.

name: lycopene
definition: An acyclic carotene commonly obtained from tomatoes and other red fruits.

name: diphthamide
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is the derivative of L-histidine having a 4-amino-4-oxo-3-(trimethylammonio)butyl group at the 2-position of the imidazole ring.

name: (S)-coclaurine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of coclaurine.

name: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose
definition: The 4-amino-4,6-dideoxy analogue of dTDP-D-glucose.

name: 6-imino-5-oxocyclohexa-1,3-dienecarboxylic acid
definition: A cyclohexadienecarboxylic acid having the C=C double bonds at the 1- and 3-positions, the carboxy group at the 1-position, an oxo group at the 5-position and an imino group at the 6-position.

name: aldehydo-D-glucose 6-phosphate
definition: The open-chain form of D-glucose 6-phosphate.

name: discadenine
definition: A 6-isopentenylaminopurine having a 3-amino-3-carboxypropyl group attached at the 3-position.

name: biotin
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that consists of 2-oxohexahydro-1H-thieno[3,4-d]imidazole having a valeric acid substituent attached to the tetrahydrothiophene ring. The parent of the class of biotins.

name: stipitatic acid
definition: A derivative of cyclohepta-1,3,5-triene having a carboxy group at position 1, an oxo group at position 5 and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6.

name: O-phospho-L-homoserine
definition: The L-enantiomer of O-phosphohomoserine.

name: ribitol
definition: A pentitol (five-carbon sugar alcohol) having meso-configuration, being derived from ribose by reduction of the carbonyl group. It occurs naturally in the plant Adonis vernalis.

name: cyclohexylsulfamic acid
definition: A member of the class of sulfamic acids that is sulfamic acid carrying an N-cyclohexyl substituent.

name: D-glutamic acid
definition: An optically active form of glutamic acid having D-configuration.

name: 3-guanidinopropanoic acid
definition: A guanidine compound bearing an N-(2-carboxyethyl) substituent. It is a creatine analogue that has been found to decreases plasma glucose levels

name: O-carbamoyl-L-serine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is the O-carbamoyl derivative of L-serine.

name: L-histidine
definition: The L-enantiomer of the amino acid histidine.

name: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose
definition: The 4-amino-4,6-dideoxy analogue of dTDP-D-galactose.

name: 1D-5-O-methyl-myo-inositol
definition: A member of the class of methyl myo-inositols that is cyclohexane-1,2,3,4,5-pentol substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 (the 1R,2S,3r,4R,5S,6r-stereoisomer).

name: cyclohex-2-enone
definition: A cyclohexenone having its C=C double bond at the 2-position.

name: sn-glycerol 3-phosphate
definition: An sn-glycerol 3-phosphate having unsubstituted hydroxy groups.

name: 1-benzyl-2-methyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline
definition: A benzyltetrahydroisoquinoline having the benzyl group at the 1-position and an N-methyl substituent.

name: heparan sulfate α-D-glucosaminide 3-sulfate
definition: A heparan sulfate having an 3-O-sulfo-α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the non-reducing end. The heparan sulfate part consists of a variably sulfated repeating disaccharide unit.

name: cob(I)alamin
definition: A cobalamin in which the central cobalt atom has an oxidation state of +1.

name: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 1-hydroxy-2-naphthoic acid.

name: 5α-androstane-3,17-dione
definition: The 5α-stereoisomer of androstane-3,17-dione.

name: 2-methylpropanamine
definition: An alkylamine having isobutyl as the alkyl group. It has been isolated from Sambucus nigra (Elderberry).

name: (2-amino-4-hydroxy-7,8-dihydropteridin-6-yl)methyl trihydrogen diphosphate
definition: A 7,8-dihydropterin having a diphosphomethyl substituent at the 6-position.

name: 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: ethanolamine
definition: A member of the class of ethanolamines that is ethane with an amino substituent at C-1 and a hydroxy substituent at C-2, making it both a primary amine and a primary alcohol.

name: 3-phospho-D-glyceroyl dihydrogen phosphate
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 3-phosphoglyceroyl dihydrogen phosphate.

name: D-glucaric acid
definition: The D-enantiomer of glucaric acid.

name: (R)-lactate
definition: An optically active form of lactate having (R)-configuration.

name: salicylaldehyde
definition: A hydroxybenzaldehyde carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 2.

name: 9-riburonosyladenine
definition: A purine nucleoside having adenine as the nucleobase and a carboxy group at C-5'.

name: 5-oxoproline
definition: An oxoproline having the oxo group placed at the 5-position. It is an intermediate metabolite in the glutathione cycle.

name: 2-ethylhexan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is hexan-1-ol substituted by an ethyl group at position 2.

name: L-glutamic acid
definition: An optically active form of glutamic acid having L-configuration.

name: dihydroxyacetone
definition: A ketotriose consisting of acetone bearing hydroxy substituents at positions 1 and 3. The simplest member of the class of ketoses and the parent of the class of glycerones.

name: 1-methyladenosine
definition: A methyladenosine carrying a methyl substituent at position 1.

name: oleandomycin 2'-O-phosphate
definition: The 2'-O-phospho derivative of oleandomycin.

name: CDP-ribitol
definition: A nucleotide-alditol having cytosine as the nucleobase and ribitol as the alditol portion.

name: LL-2,6-diaminopimelic acid
definition: A 2,6-diaminopimelic acid in which both chiral centres have S configuration. It is a component of bacterial cell wall.

name: adenosine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having adenine as the nucleobase.

name: L-2,4-diaminobutyrate
definition: An L-α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of L-2,4-diaminobutyric acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: Nα,Nα-dimethyl-L-histidine
definition: The Nα,Nα-dimethyl derivative of L-histidine.

name: indole-3-acetamide
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is acetamide substituted by a 1H-indol-3-yl group at position 2. It is an intermediate in the production of plant hormone indole acetic acid (IAA).

name: androsterone
definition: An androstanoid that is 5α-androstane having a hydroxy substituent at the 3α-position and an oxo group at the 17-position. It is a metabolite of dehydroepiandrosterone .

name: phosphoguanidinoacetic acid
definition: A guanidinoacetate having a phospho group attached to the primary amino part of the guanidine moiety.

name: 2'-hydroxy-2,3-dihydrodaidzein
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanone that is 2,3-dihydrodaidzein with an additonal hydroxy substituent at position 2'.

name: ethyl (S)-3-hydroxyhexanoate
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of ethyl 3-hydroxyhexanoate.

name: 2-nitropropane
definition: A secondary nitroalkane that is propane in which a hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a nitro group. Mainly used as a solvent (b.p. 120°C).

name: ITP
definition: The inosine phosphate that has a triphosphate group at the 5'-position. It is an intermediate in the metabolism of purine.

name: cytosine
definition: An aminopyrimidine that is pyrimidin-2-one having the amino group located at position 4.

name: 2-deoxy-D-glucose 6-phosphate
definition: A deoxyaldohexose phosphate comprising 2-deoxy-D-glucose having the phosphate group at the 6-position.

name: α-D-galactosyl undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate having α-D-galactopyranose as the glycosyl fragment.

name: FMNH2
definition: The reduced 1,5-dihydro form of flavin mononucleotide.

name: CDP-abequose
definition: A CDP-sugar having abequose as the sugar component.

name: N-acetylisatin
definition: An indoledione consisting of isatin carrying an N-acetyl substituent.

name: poly(ribitol phosphate)
definition: A polymeric compound composed of repeating ribose-1-phosphate units.

name: propene
definition: An alkene that is propane with a double bond at position 1.

name: 2-benzylsuccinic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid consisting of succinic acid carrying a 2-benzyl substituent.

name: aldehydo-L-rhamnose
definition: The acyclic form of L-rhamnose.

name: prenyl diphosphate
definition: A prenol phosphate that is a phosphoantigen comprising the O-pyrophosphate of prenol.

name: 10-deoxysarpagine
definition: An indole alkaloid that is sarpagan bearing a hydroxy group at position 17.

name: scopolin
definition: A member of the class of coumarins that is scopoletin attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 11-cis-retinal
definition: A retinal having 2E,4Z,6E,8E-double bond geometry.

name: 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5,6-tetrakisphosphate
definition: A myo-inositol tetrakisphosphate having the four phosphate groups at the 1-, 4-, 5- and 6-positions.

name: 2-(3,4-dihydroxybenzoyloxy)-4,6-dihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: The 2-(3,4-dihydroxybenzoyl) derivative of 2,4,6-trihydroxybenzoic acid. A metabolite of quercetin, an abundant flavonoid found in edible vegetables, grains and fruits which is used as an ingredient in supplements, beverages, or foods.

name: 1H-imidazole
definition: An imidazole tautomer which has the migrating hydrogen at position 1.

name: 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol
definition: An anhydro sugar of D-glucitol.

name: maleimide
definition: A cyclic dicarboximide in which the two carboacyl groups on nitrogen together with the nitogen itself form a 1H-pyrrole-2,5-dione structure.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl phospho oligosaccharide where N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl comprises the oligosaccharide component and the polyprenyl chain consists of eleven prenyl units.

name: 5β-cholestan-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo-5β-steroid that is 5β-cholestane substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: 11α-hydroxyprogesterone
definition: A 11α-hydroxy steroid that is pregn-4-ene-3,20-dione substituted by a hydroxy group at position 11.

name: D-glucopyranose 1-phosphate
definition: A D-glucose monophosphate in which the phosphate group is located at position 1.

name: benzyl 2-methyl-3-oxobutanoate
definition: A benzyl ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-methylacetoacetic acid with the hydroxy group of benzyl alcohol.

name: γ-amino-β-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: A γ-amino acid comprising 4-aminobutyric acid having a 2-hydroxy substituent.

name: dTDP-L-dihydrostreptose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having dihydrostreptose as the sugar component.

name: UDP-α-D-xylose
definition: A UDP-sugar having α-xylose as the sugar component. It is an important metabolite in the nucleotide sugar metabolism in animals, plants, fungi, and bacteria.

name: (S)-3-(indol-3-yl)-2-oxobutyric acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 3-(indol-3-yl)-2-oxobutyric acid.

name: β-D-fructofuranose 6-phosphate
definition: A D-fructofuranose 6-phosphate with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: mycothione
definition: The disulfide resulting from oxidative coupling of the thiol groups of two molecules of mycothiol.

name: isocitrate(3−)
definition: Propan-1-ol with a hydrogen at each of the 3 carbon positions substituted with a carboxylate group.

name: dolichol
definition: Any one of a group of prenol derivatives made up of varying numbers of cis-linked isoprene units, terminating in an α-saturated isoprenoid group containing an alcohol functional group, with the three isoprene units at the distal end trans-linked.

name: isoquinoline
definition: An ortho-fused heteroarene that is a benzopyridine in which the N atom not directly attached to the benzene ring.

name: 2-methylene-3-methylsuccinic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is succinic acid substituted by a methylene group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 3.

name: thiosulfate(2−)
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of both protons from thiosulfuric acid.

name: 1,6-dihydroxy-2-methylcyclohexa-2,4-dienecarboxylic acid
definition: A cyclohexadienecarboxylic acid that is cyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylic acid substituted by hydroxy group at positions 1 and 6 and a methyl group at position 2.

name: ethylbenzene
definition: An alkylbenzene carrying an ethyl substituent. It is a constituent of coal tar and petroleum.

name: 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 is substituted by a 2-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: 2,4-dichloro-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furylacetic acid
definition: An organochlorine compound that is 2,5-dihydro-2-furylacetic acid substituted by chloro groups at positions 2 and 4 and an oxo group at position 5.

name: dihydroxyacetone phosphate
definition: A member of the class of glycerone phosphates that consists of glycerone bearing a single phospho substituent.

name: propane-1,3-diol
definition: The simplest member of the class of propane-1,3-diols, consisting of propane in which one hydrogen from each methyl group is substituted by a hydroxy group. A colourless, viscous, water-miscible liquid with a high (210°C) boiling point, it is used in the synthesis of certain polymers and as a solvent and antifreeze.

name: nonane-4,6-dione
definition: A nonanone carrying oxo substituents at positions 4 and 6 respectively.

name: chlorogenic acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-caffeic acid with the 3-hydroxy group of quinic acid. It is an intermediate metabolite in the biosynthesis of lignin.

name: cholesterol
definition: A cholestanoid consisting of cholestane having a double bond at the 5,6-position as well as a 3β-hydroxy group.

name: medicarpin
definition: A member of the class of pterocarpans that is 3-hydroxyptercarpan with a methoxy substituent at position 9.

name: 3-hydroxy-4-methylanthranilic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is anthranilic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3 and a methyl group at position 4.

name: shikimic acid
definition: A cyclohexenecarboxylic acid that is cyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxylic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4 and 5 (the 3R,4S,5R stereoisomer). It is an intermediate metabolite in plants and microorganisms.

name: 5-oxopentanoate
definition: A 5-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-oxopentanoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 3-(4-hydroxy-3,5-diiodophenyl)lactic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is lactic acid substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3,5-diiodophenyl group at position 3.

name: hexadecan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is hexadecane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: 3-(4-deoxy-β-D-gluc-4-enosyluronic acid)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose as the sugar component. It is an intermediate in dTDP-rhamnose biosynthesis.

name: 17α-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)estradiol 3-glucosiduronic acid
definition: A derivative of 17α-estradiol having β-glucosiduronic acid and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl groups attached at the 3- and 17-positions respectively.

name: DDT
definition: A chlorophenylethane that is 1,1,1-trichloro-2,2-diphenylethane substituted by additional chloro substituents at positions 4 of the phenyl substituents. It is a commonly used organochlorine insecticide.

name: 4-(hydroxymethyl)phenylhydrazine
definition: A member of the class of phenylhydrazines that is phenylhydrazine substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 4.

name: 2-deoxy-D-ribose 5-phosphate
definition: The 5-O-phosphono derivative of 2-deoxy-D-ribose.

name: cyclopentanol
definition: The simplest member of the class of cyclopentanols bearing a single hydroxy substituent. The parent of the class of cyclopentanols.

name: ammonia
definition: An azane that consists of a single nitrogen atom covelently bonded to three hydrogen atoms.

name: isobutyric acid
definition: A branched fatty acid comprising propanoic acid carrying a methyl branch at C-2.

name: hydrogen sulfide
definition: A sulfur hydride consisting of a single sulfur atom bonded to two hydrogen atoms. A highly poisonous, flammable gas with a characteristic odour of rotten eggs, it is often produced by bacterial decomposition of organic matter in the absence of oxygen.

name: chondroitin D-glucuronate
definition: A mucopolysaccharide composed of repeating β-D-glucopyranuronosyl-(1→3)-β-D-N-acetylgalactosaminyl units.

name: 2-deoxy-D-gluconic acid
definition: A derivative of D-gluconic acid lacking the 2-hydroxy group.

name: undecaprenyl dihydrogen phosphate
definition: The all-trans-isomer of undecaprenyl phosphate.

name: 3-dehydro-L-gulonic acid
definition: A derivative of L-gulonic acid having a keto group at the 3-position.

name: 1-guanidino-1-deoxy-scyllo-inositol 4-phosphate
definition: A scyllo-inositol phosphate having the phosphate at the 4-position and a guanidino group in place of the hydroxyl at position 1.

name: selenophosphate
definition: A trivalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of all three protons from selenophosphoric acid.

name: maleamate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of maleamic acid.

name: 11-O-demethyl-17-O-deacetylvindoline
definition: A derivative of vindoline lacking the 11-O-methyl and 17-O-acetyl substituents.

name: heptadecane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 17 carbon atoms. It is a component of essential oils from plants like Opuntia littoralis and Annona squamosa.

name: benzoate

name: phloretate

name: D-xylulose 5-phosphate

name: quercetin 3,3',7-trissulfate

name: pyridoxine

name: codeine
definition: A morphinane alkaloid found in the opium poppy, Papaver somniferum var. album; has analgesic, anti-tussive and anti-diarrhoeal properties.

name: benzene
definition: A six-carbon aromatic annulene in which each carbon atom donates one of its two 2p electrons into a delocalised π system. A toxic, flammable liquid byproduct of coal distillation, it is used as an industrial solvent. Benzene is a carcinogen that also damages bone marrow and the central nervous system.

name: galactitol
definition: An optically inactive hexitol having meso-configuration.

name: dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is the 3-sulfooxy derivative of dehydroepiandrosterone.

name: N-benzoyl-D-arginine
definition: A member of the class of N-benzoyl-D-arginines that is D-arginine in which one of the hydrogens of attached to the α-amino group has been replaced by a benzoyl group.

name: 4-oxo-L-proline
definition: The L-enantiomer of 4-oxoproline.

name: choline sulfate
definition: An ammonium betaine that is the conjugate base of choline hydrogen sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfate OH group.

name: corticosterone
definition: A 21-hydroxy steroid that consists of pregn-4-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 11 and 21 and oxo groups at positions 3 and 20. Corticosterone is a 21-carbon steroid hormone of the corticosteroid type produced in the cortex of the adrenal glands.

name: L-tryptophan
definition: The L-enantiomer of tryptophan.

name: methylamine
definition: The simplest of the methylamines, consisting of ammonia bearing a single methyl substituent.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is glutaric acid in which one of the two hydrogens at position 3 is substituted by a hydroxy group, while the other is substituted by a methyl group. It has been found to accumulate in urine of patients suffering from HMG-CoA lyase (3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA lyase, EC 4.1.3.4) deficiency. It occurs as a plant metabolite in Crotalaria dura.

name: kievitone
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanone that is isoflavanone with hydroxy substituents at positions 5, 7, 2' and 4' and a prenyl group at position 8.

name: 4-nitrophenol
definition: A member of the class of 4-nitrophenols that is phenol in which the hydrogen that is para to the hydroxy group has been replaced by a nitro group.

name: polyphosphate
definition: The phosphorus oxoanion formed from polyphosphoric acid by proton loss from each of the phosphate units. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: formaldehyde
definition: An aldehyde resulting from the formal oxidation of methanol.

name: UDP-α-D-galactosamine
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having α-D-galactosamine as the amino-sugar component.

name: coenzyme γ-F420-2
definition: The amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of F420-0 with the amino group of L-γ-glutamyl-L-glutamic acid.

name: 1,2-dihydro-α-santonin
definition: A naphthofuran obtained by selective hydrogenation of the 1,2-position of α-santonin.

name: L-dopaquinone
definition: An L-phenylalanine derivative in which the phenyl group of L-phenylalanine is replaced by a 3,4-dioxocyclohexa-1,5-dien-1-yl group.

name: D-lysine
definition: The D-enantiomer of the α-amino acid lysine.

name: glutathione
definition: A tripeptide compound consisting of glutamic acid attached via its side chain to the N-terminus of cysteinylglycine.

name: L-threonine
definition: An optically active form of threonine having L-configuration.

name: oxaloacetic acid 4-methyl ester
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester comprising succinic acid having an oxo group at the 2-position and the methyl ester at the 4-position.

name: 3',4',5,7-tetrahydroxy-3-methoxyflavone
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone having the 4-hydroxy groups located at the 3'- 4'- 5- and 7-positions as well as a methoxy group at the 2-position.

name: 6-phospho-D-gluconate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of 6-phospho-D-gluconic acid.

name: D-ribofuranosyl-ADP
definition: An ADP-aldose having ribose as the aldose fragment.

name: γ-aminobutyric acid
definition: A γ-amino acid that is butanoic acid with the amino substituent located at C-4.

name: alizarin
definition: A dihydroxyanthraquinone that is anthracene-9,10-dione in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 1 and 2.

name: D-methionine
definition: An optically active form of methionine having D-configuration.

name: choline alfoscerate
definition: A member of the class of phosphocholines that is the choline ester of sn-glycero-3-phosphate. It is one of the major osmolyte in the renal medullary cells.

name: psychosine
definition: A glycosylsphingoid consisting of sphingosine having a β-D-galactosyl residue attached at the 1-position.

name: oxidized Watasenia luciferin
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines in which the pyrazine ring is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 5 by [4-(sulfooxy)phenyl]acetamido, benzyl, and 4-(sulfooxy)phenyl groups, respectively.

name: 1-kestose
definition: A trisaccharide found in vegetables consisting of β-D-fructofuranose having β-D-fructofuranosyl and α-D-glucopyranosyl residues attached at the 1- and 2-positions respectively.

name: 2-aminomuconic acid
definition: The 2-amino derivative of muconic acid.

name: trans-3-hydroxy-L-proline
definition: The (3S)-trans-diastereomer of 3-hydroxy-L-proline.

name: glyoxylic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid bearing an oxo group at the α carbon atom.

name: 4-amino-5-hydroxymethyl-2-methylpyrimidine
definition: An aminopyrimidine that is pyrimidine in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 4, and 5 are replaced by methyl, amino, and hydroxymethyl substituents, respectively.

name: sphinganine 1-phosphate
definition: A sphingoid 1-phosphate that is the monophosphorylated derivative of sphinganine.

name: 3-sulfopyruvic acid
definition: A carboxyalkanesulfonic acid comprising pyruvic acid with a sulfo group attached at the C-3 position.

name: S-methyl-5-thio-D-ribose
definition: D-ribose with the hydroxy group substituted for a methylthio group at position C-5.

name: pyrimidine
definition: The parent compound of the pyrimidines; a diazine having the two nitrogens at the 1- and 3-positions.

name: D-mannitol
definition: The D-enantiomer of mannitol.

name: fluoren-9-ol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyfluorenes that is 9H-fluorene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 9 (the non-aromatic carbon).

name: keto-D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate
definition: A ketohexose bisphosphate that is D-fructose substituted by phosphate groups at positions 1 and 6.

name: 4-nitroquinoline N-oxide
definition: A quinoline N-oxide carrying a nitro substituent at position 4.

name: NADH
definition: A coenzyme found in all living cells; consists of two nucleotides joined through their 5'-phosphate groups, with one nucleotide containing an adenine base and the other containing nicotinamide.

name: mandelonitrile
definition: A cyanohydrin that is phenylacetonitrile in which one of the methylene hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: N-methylphenylethanolamine
definition: An alkaloid that is ethanolamine having the phenyl group at the 1-position and a methyl group attached to the nitrogen. It has been isolated from Halostachys caspica.

name: salicylic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid with a hydroxy group at the ortho position. It is obtained from the bark of the white willow and wintergreen leaves.

name: gallate
definition: A trihydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of gallic acid.

name: creatine
definition: A glycine derivative having methyl and amidino groups attached to the nitrogen.

name: N-formyl-L-aspartate(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from deprotonation of both carboxy groups of N-formyl-L-aspartic acid.

name: 5-oxo-D-proline
definition: The D-enantiomer of 5-oxoproline.

name: 6-phospho-5-dehydro-2-deoxy-D-gluconic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid phosphate comprising 5-dehydro-2-deoxy-D-gluconic acid having the phosphate group at the 6-position.

name: L-saccharopine
definition: The N6-(1,3-dicarboxypropan-1-yl) derivative of L-lysine.

name: trans-cyclohexane-1,2-diol
definition: A cyclohexane-1,2-diol with trans-configuration. It is a metabolite of cyclohexene oxide and other such compounds.

name: ergosterol
definition: A phytosterol consisting of ergostane having double bonds at the 5,6-, 7,8- and 22,23-positions as well as a 3β-hydroxy group.

name: 3-cyano-L-alanine
definition: A cyanoamino acid that is the 3-cyano-derivative of L-alanine.

name: L-rhamnofuranose
definition: The furanose form of L-rhamnose.

name: 6-O-phosphono-D-glucono-1,5-lactone
definition: An aldonolactone phosphate comprising D-glucono-1,5-lactone having the phosphate group at the 6-position.

name: 3-amino-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid
definition: A β-amino acid comprising propionic acid having amino and 4-hydroxyphenyl groups attached at the 3-position.

name: lipid X
definition: An N-acyl-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate where the N-acyl group is (R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl and carrying an additional (R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl group at the 3-position.

name: (R)-2,4-dihydroxy-3-oxobutanoic acid
definition: The 3-dehydro derivative of L-threonic acid.

name: scytalone
definition: A cyclic ketone that is 3,4-dihydronaphthalen-1(2H)-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 6, and 8.

name: L-kynurenine
definition: A kynurenine that has L configuration.

name: citrate(3−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion, obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups of citric acid.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminic acid
definition: The N-acetyl derivative of D-glucosaminic acid.

name: 5-hydroxymethyldeoxycytidylic acid
definition: A 2'-deoxycytidine phosphate compound having the phosphate group at the 5'-position and a hydroxymethyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: N-acetyl-L-aspartate(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from deprotonation of both carboxy groups of N-acetyl-L-aspartic acid.

name: vitexin
definition: An apigenin flavone glycoside, which is found in the passion flower, bamboo leaves and pearl millet

name: GDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-mannose
definition: A GDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-mannose as the sugar portion.

name: β-alanine
definition: A naturally-occurring β-amino acid comprising propionic acid with the amino group in the 3-position.

name: ADP-D-ribose
definition: A nucleotide-sugar having ADP as the nucleotide fragment and D-ribofuranos-5-yl as the sugar component.

name: cortisone
definition: A C21-steroid that is pregn-4-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 17 and 21 and oxo group at positions 3, 11 and 20.

name: 5-hydroxymethyluracil
definition: A primary alcohol that is uracil bearing a hydroxymethyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: 2,3-dihydrogossypetin
definition: A member of the class of dihydroflavonols that is the 2,3-dihydro derivative of gossypetin.

name: (Z)-5-oxohex-2-enedioate
definition: An oxo dicarboxylate obtained by removal of a proton from both of the carboxylic acid groups of (Z)-5-oxohex-2-enedioic acid.

name: benzene-1,2,4-triol
definition: A benzenetriol carrying hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 4.

name: 11-deoxycorticosterone
definition: A mineralocorticoid that is progesterone substituted at position 21 by a hydroxy group.

name: imidazol-4-ylacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by an imidazol-4-yl group.

name: L-alanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of alanine.

name: leukotriene C4
definition: A leukotriene that is (5S,7E,9E,11Z,14Z)-5-hydroxyicosa-7,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid in which a glutathionyl group is attached at position 6 via a sulfide linkage.

name: geranial
definition: A monoterpenoid that is (2E,6E)-octa-2,6-dienal substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 7.

name: O-(3-O-D-galactosyl-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl)-L-serine
definition: A derivative of L-serine having a 3-O-D-galactosyl-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl moiety attached to the side-chain oxygen.

name: (R,R)-butane-2,3-diol
definition: The (R,R) diastereoisomer of butane-2,3-diol.

name: 5β-androstane-3,17-dione
definition: An androstane-3,17-dione with a 5β-configuration.

name: 1-piperideine-6-carboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of 1-piperideine-6-carboxylic acid.

name: bilirubin IXα
definition: A member of the class of biladienes that is a linear tetrapyrrole with the dipyrrole units being of both exovinyl and endovinyl type. A product of heme degradation, it is produced in the reticuloendothelial system by the reduction of biliverdin and transported to the liver as a complex with serum albumin.

name: 2-(carboxymethyl)-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furoic acid
definition: A 5-oxo-2-furylacetic acid having a carboxy group at the 2-position.

name: oxalic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is ethane substituted by carboxyl groups at positions 1 and 2.

name: L-histidinol phosphate
definition: The O-phospho derivative of L-histidinol.

name: propane-1,2-diol
definition: The simplest member of the class of propane-1,2-diols, consisting of propane in which a hydrogen at position 1 and a hydrogen at position 2 are substituted by hydroxy groups. A colourless, viscous, hygroscopic, low-melting (−59°C) and high-boiling (188°C) liquid with low toxicity, it is used as a solvent, emulsifying agent, and antifreeze.

name: D-phenylalanine
definition: The D-enantiomer of phenylalanine.

name: tropate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that results from the deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group of tropic acid.

name: 7,8-dihydroneopterin
definition: A neopterin where positions C-7 and C-8 have been hydrogenated.

name: 1-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)ethane-1,2-diol
definition: An ethanediol that is ethane-1,2-diol in which a hydrogen attached to a carbon is replaced by a 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl group.

name: GDP-L-fucose
definition: A GDP-fucose in which the fucosyl residue has L-configuration.

name: S-inosyl-L-homocysteine
definition: L-homocysteine substituted at sulfur by a 5'-deoxyinosin-5'-yl group.

name: 5-dehydro-D-fructose
definition: A hexose obtained by selective dehydration at the 5-position of D-fructose.

name: N-acetylneuraminic acid
definition: An N-acylneuraminic acid where the N-acyl group is specified as acetyl.

name: dTMP
definition: The neutral species of thymidine 5'-monophosphate (2'-deoxythymidine 5'-monophosphate).

name: riboflavin
definition: D-Ribitol in which the hydroxy group at position 5 is substituted by a 7,8-dimethyl-2,4-dioxo-3,4-dihydrobenzo[g]pteridin-10(2H)-yl moiety. It is a nutritional factor found in milk, eggs, malted barley, liver, kidney, heart, and leafy vegetables, but the richest natural source is yeast. The free form occurs only in the retina of the eye, in whey, and in urine; its principal forms in tissues and cells are as flavin mononucleotide and flavin-adenine dinucleotide.

name: (R)-amygdalin
definition: An amygdalin in which the stereocentre on the cyanohydrin function has R-configuration.

name: 2-hydroxyadipic acid
definition: An adipic acid derivative having a 2-hydroxy substituent.

name: (S)-dihydroorotic acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of dihydroorotic acid that is an intermediate in the metabolism of pyridine.

name: progesterone
definition: A C21-steroid hormone in which a pregnane skeleton carries oxo substituents at positions 3 and 20 and is unsaturated at C(4)-C(5). As a hormone, it is involved in the female menstrual cycle, pregnancy and embryogenesis of humans and other species.

name: allysine
definition: An α-amino acid consisting of lysine having an oxo group in place of the side-chain amino group.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-galactonic acid
definition: The 2-dehydro-3-deoxy derivative of D-galactonic acid.

name: chitin
definition: An aminoglycan consisting of β-(1→4)-linked N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues.

name: chelirubine
definition: A benzophenanthridine alkaloid that is sanguinarine bearing a methoxy substituent at position 10.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconic acid
definition: The 2-dehydro-3-deoxy derivative of D-gluconic acid.

name: biliverdin
definition: A linear tetrapyrrole produced in the reticuloendothelial system by the first step of heme degradation, catalysed by heme oxygenase.

name: (19E)-geissoschizine
definition: An indole alkaloid with formula C21H24N2O3. It is a biosynthetic precursor for a variety of monoterpenoid indole alkaloids.

name: fecosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol having a 5α-ergostane skeleton with a methylidene group at C-24 and double bonds at the C-8 and C-24(28) positions.

name: (carboxymethoxy)succinic acid
definition: The carboxymethoxy derivative of succinic acid.

name: (S)-N-methylcoclaurine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of N-methylcoclaurine.

name: tetrachlorohydroquinone
definition: A tetrachlorobenzene that is 1,2,4,5-tetrachlorobenzene in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 6 are replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: biphenyl-2-ol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls that is biphenyl substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2. It is generally used as a post-harvest fungicide for citrus fruits.

name: D-glucitol 6-phosphate
definition: The 6-O-phospho derivative of D-glucitol.

name: dinitrogen oxide
definition: A nitrogen oxide consisting of linear unsymmetrical molecules with formula N2O. While it is the most used gaseous anaesthetic in the world, its major commercial use, due to its solubility under pressure in vegetable fats combined with its non-toxicity in low concentrations, is as an aerosol spray propellant and aerating agent for canisters of 'whipped' cream.

name: all-trans-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: The all-trans-isomer of undecaprenyl diphosphate.

name: nororientaline
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid consisting of a tetrahydroisoquinoline core with 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzyl, methoxy and hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 6 and 7 respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-phosphoglyceric acid
definition: A monophosphoglyceric acid having the phospho group at the 3-position. It is an intermediate in metabolic pathways like glycolysis and calvin cycle.

name: L-aspartic acid
definition: The L-enantiomer of aspartic acid.

name: 1-carboxyvinyl carboxyphosphonate
definition: An organic phosphonate having O-1-carboxyvinyl and C-carboxy substituents.

name: cellobiose
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of two glucose units linked via a β(1→4) bond.

name: D-glutamine
definition: The D-enantiomer of glutamine.

name: L-erythrulose 1-phosphate
definition: The L-enantiomer of erythrulose 1-phosphate.

name: 4-nitroaniline
definition: A nitroaniline carrying a nitro group at position 4.

name: 3',5'-cyclic CMP
definition: A 3',5'-cyclic pyrimidine nucleotide having cytosine as the nucleobase.

name: (R)-3-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: The R-enantiomer of 3-hydroxybutyric acid. Involved in the synthesis and degradation of ketone bodies, it can be used as an energy source by the brain during hypoglycaemia, and for the synthesis of biodegradable plastics. It is a sex pheremone in the European spider Linyphia triangularis.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)propanoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxypropionyl-CoA having a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at the 3-position.

name: 3-hydroxybenzyl alcohol
definition: A hydroxybenzyl alcohol that is phenol substituted at position C-3 by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: glycolaldehyde
definition: The glycolaldehyde derived from ethylene glycol. The parent of the class of glycolaldehydes.

name: N-amidino-L-aspartic acid
definition: An aspartic acid derivative comprising L-aspartic acid carrying an N-amidino substituent.

name: streptomycin
definition: A amino cyclitol glycoside that consists of streptidine having a disaccharyl moiety attached at the 4-position. The parent of the streptomycin class

name: 2-carboxy-D-arabinitol
definition: The 2-carboxy derivative of D-arabinitol.

name: (S)-3'-hydroxy-N-methylcoclaurine
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid having a tetrahydroisoquinoline core with 3,4-dihydroxybenzyl, methoxy and hydroxy groups at the 1-, 6- and 7-positions respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dimethylmaleate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion that is obtained from dimethylmaleic acid by removal of a proton from each of the carboxylic acid groups.

name: 2-amino-6-(hydroxymethyl)-7,8-dihydropteridin-4-ol
definition: A dihydropterin that is 7,8-dihydropteridin-4-ol substituted at positions 2 and 6 by amino and hydroxymethyl groups respectively.

name: 2-hydroxyglutaric acid
definition: A 2-hydroxydicarboxylic acid that is glutaric acid in which one hydrogen α- to a carboxylic acid group is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: (1R,2R,3R)-prephytoene diphosphate
definition: The (1R,2R,3R)-diastereomer of prephytoene diphosphate.

name: 3-chloro-D-alanine
definition: A 3-chloroalanine that has S configutation at the chiral centre.

name: 2-dehydropantoic acid
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 2-oxobutanoic acid in which both of the hydrogens at position 3 are substituted by methyl groups and one of the hydrogens at position 4 is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: biphenyl
definition: A benzenoid aromatic compound that consists of two benzene rings connected by a single covalent bond. Biphenyl occurs naturally in coal tar, crude oil, and natural gas. Formerly used as a fungicide for citrus crops.

name: veratraldehyde
definition: A dimethoxybenzene that is benzaldehyde substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3 and 4. It is found in peppermint, ginger, raspberry, and other fruits.

name: macarpine
definition: A benzophenanthridine alkaloid that is sanguinarine bearing two methoxy substituents.

name: 6-hydroxyprotopine
definition: A dibenzazecine alkaloid that is protopine bearing a hydroxy substituent at the 6-position.

name: 7,8-dihydro-7,8-dihydroxykynurenic acid
definition: The 7,8-dihydro-7,8-dihydroxy derivative of kynurenic acid.

name: 1-guanidino-1-deoxy-scyllo-inositol
definition: A derivative of scyllo-inositol having a guanidino group in place of the 1-hydroxy group.

name: 5-O-phosphono-α-D-ribofuranosyl diphosphate
definition: A derivative of α-D-ribose having a phosphate group at the 5-position and a diphosphate at the 1-position.

name: erythritol
definition: The meso-diastereomer of butane-1,2,3,4-tetrol.

name: L-serine
definition: The L-enantiomer of serine.

name: 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronate
definition: The anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronic acid.

name: hexanoate
definition: A short-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of hexanoic acid (also known as caproic acid).

name: aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine
definition: An N-acetylmannosamine in open-chain aldehyde form with D-configuration.

name: 2-aminoacrylic acid
definition: A 2,3-dehydroamino acid that is alanine which has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond between positions 2 and 3.

name: carnitine
definition: An amino-acid betaine that is butanoate substituted with a hydroxy group at position C-3 and a trimethylammonium group at C-4.

name: glucotropeolin
definition: An aralkylglucosinolic acid that consists of 1-thio-β-D-glucopyranose attached to a 2-phenyl-N-(sulfooxy)ethanimidoyl group at the anomeric sulfur.

name: adipate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by the deprotonation of both the carboxy groups of adipic acid.

name: (S)-scoulerine
definition: A berberine alkaloid isolated from Corydalis saxicola.

name: 10-oxocapric acid
definition: A capric acid derivative carrying an oxo group at position 10.

name: (3,5-diiodo-4-hydroxyphenyl)pyruvic acid
definition: A derivative of pyruvic acid carrying a 3,5-diiodo-4-hydroxyphenyl group at the 3-position.

name: octopamine
definition: A member of the class of phenylethanolamines that is phenol which is substituted at the para- position by a 2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl group. A biogenic phenylethanolamine which has been found to act as a neurotransmitter, neurohormone or neuromodulator in invertebrates.

name: 2,8-dihydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone
definition: A hydroxyquinone that is the 2,8-dihydroxy derivative of 1,4-naphthoquinone.

name: glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate
definition: An aldotriose phosphate that is the 3-phospho derivative of glyceraldehyde. It is an important metabolic intermediate in several central metabolic pathways in all organisms.

name: D-xylulose
definition: The D-enantiomer of xylulose.

name: cysteamine
definition: An amine that consists of an ethane skeleton substituted with a thiol group at C-1 and an amino group at C-2.

name: urate D-ribonucleotide
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate consisting of 5'-xanthylic acid having an oxo group at the 8-position.

name: putrescine
definition: A four-carbon alkane-α,ω-diamine. It is obtained by the breakdown of amino acids and is responsible for the foul odour of putrefying flesh.

name: 2-phosphoglycolic acid
definition: The O-phospho derivative of glycolic acid.

name: xylitol
definition: A pentitol (five-carbon sugar alcohol) having meso-configuration, being derived from xylose by reduction of the carbonyl group.

name: propanal
definition: An aldehyde that consists of ethane bearing a formyl substituent. The parent of the class of propanals.

name: nicotinamide
definition: A pyridinecarboxamide that is pyridine in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a carboxamide group.

name: 1D-3-amino-1-guanidino-1,3-dideoxy-scyllo-inositol
definition: A derivative of scyllo-inositol where the 1- and 3-hydroxy groups are replaced by guanidino and amino groups respectively.

name: methylglyoxal
definition: A 2-oxo aldehyde derived from propanal.

name: 17α-estradiol
definition: An estradiol that is estra-1,3,5(10)-triene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 17 (the 17α stereoisomer).

name: O-demethylpuromycin
definition: A derivative of puromycin lacking the O-methyl group on the tyrosyl residue.

name: 2-oxooctadecanoate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxy group of 2-oxooctadecanoic acid (stearic acid). The major species at pH 7.3.

name: stachyose
definition: A tetrasaccharide consisting of sucrose having an α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-α-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 6-position of the glucose.

name: Photinus luciferin
definition: A 1,3-thiazolemonocarboxylic acid consisting of 3,5-dihydrothiophene-4-carboxylic acid having a 6-hydroxybenzothiazol-2-yl group at the 2-position.

name: N-methylputrescine
definition: An N-monosubstituted putrescine where the N-substituent is methyl.

name: (R)-lactaldehyde
definition: The (R)-stereoisomer of lactaldehyde.

name: 5α-cholest-7-en-3β-ol
definition: A cholestanoid that is (5α)-cholest-7-ene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3.

name: benzaldehyde
definition: An arenecarbaldehyde that consists of benzene bearing a single formyl substituent; the simplest aromatic aldehyde and parent of the class of benzaldehydes.

name: dimethylamine
definition: A secondary aliphatic amine where both N-substituents are methyl.

name: 2'-deoxyguanosine
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside having guanine as the nucleobase.

name: D-ribulose
definition: The D-stereoisomer of ribulose.

name: heparosan N-sulfate L-iduronic acid
definition: A heparan sulfate composed of a backbone of repeating α-L-iduronosyl-(1→4)-N-sulfonyl-α-D-glucosamine units joined by (1→4)-linkages.

name: guanidinoethyl methyl phosphate
definition: An organic phosphate that consists of phosphoethanolamine bearing N-amidino and O-methyl substituents.

name: cinnamyl alcohol
definition: A primary alcohol comprising an allyl core with a hydroxy substituent at the 1-position and a phenyl substituent at the 3-position (geometry of the C=C bond unspecified).

name: 3-hydroxypyruvate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that results from the deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group of 3-hydroxypyruvic acid.

name: 2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid having the two hydroxy groups at the 2- and 5-positions.

name: L-isoleucine
definition: The L-enantiomer of isoleucine.

name: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzonitrile
definition: A dibromobenzene that is 2,6-dibromophenol substituted by a cyano group at position 4.

name: bromochloromethane
definition: A halomethane that is chloromethane in which one of the hydrogens has been replaced by a bromine atom.

name: thiomorpholine-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A thiomorpholinemonocarboxylic acid having the carboxy group at the 3-position.

name: L-asparagine
definition: An optically active form of asparagine having L-configuration.

name: UDP-α-D-glucuronic acid
definition: A UDP-sugar having α-D-glucuronic acid as the sugar component.

name: glycylglycine
definition: A dipeptide formed from glycine residues.

name: IMP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having hypoxanthine as the nucleobase.

name: L-proline
definition: Pyrrolidine in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by a carboxylic acid group. L-Proline is the only one of the twenty DNA-encoded amino acids which has a secondary amino group α to the carboxyl group. It is an essential component of collagen and is important for proper functioning of joints and tendons. It also helps maintain and strengthen heart muscles.

name: 4,5-dioxopentanoic acid
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid consisting of a valeric acid core with the two oxo groups at the 4- and 5-positions.

name: 9,11α-epoxypregn-4-ene-3,20-dione
definition: An epoxy steroid that is pregn-4-ene-3,20-dione which has an epoxy group whose oxygen is attached to the 9α and 11α-positions.

name: 2-methylideneglutaric acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid comprising a glutaric acid core with a methylene group at the 2-position.

name: dihydrosanguinarine
definition: A benzophenanthridine alkaloid obtained by selective hydrogenation of the 13,14-position of sanguinarine.

name: geranyl diphosphate
definition: The diphosphate of the polyprenol compound geraniol.

name: 1,2-dihydroxydibenzothiophene
definition: Dibenzothiophene substituted at positions 1 and 2 by hydroxy groups.

name: D-lysopine
definition: The N2-(R)-1-carboxyethyl derivative of L-lysine.

name: (2S)-2-isopropyl-3-oxosuccinate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by removal of a proton from both carboxy groups of (2S)-2-isopropyl-3-oxosuccinic acid.

name: methyl L-tyrosinate
definition: An L-tyrosyl ester that is the methyl ester of L-tyrosine.

name: 2-butenoic acid
definition: A butenoic acid having the double bond at position C-2.

name: β-myrcene
definition: A monoterpene that is octa-1,6-diene bearing methylene and methyl substituents at positions 3 and 7 respectively.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-6-(D-galactose-1-phospho)-D-glucosamine
definition: A UDP-amino sugar that is UDP-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having an β-D-galactose-1-phospho moiety attached at position 6.

name: 4-methylumbelliferone
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is umbelliferone substituted by a methyl group at position 4.

name: salutaridine
definition: A morphinane alkaloid from the opium poppy, in which the 5,6,8,14-tetradehydromorphinan-7-one skeleton is substituted at position 4 by a hydroxyl group, positions 3 and 6 by methoxy groups and position N17 by a methyl group. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of narcotic analgesics such as morphine and codeine.

name: rosmarinic acid
definition: The 1-carboxy-2-(2,4-dihydroxyphenyl)ethyl ester of trans-caffeic acid.

name: taurocyamine
definition: The N-amidino derivative of taurine.

name: homocysteine
definition: A sulfur-containing amino acid consisting of a glycine core with a 2-mercaptoethyl side-chain.

name: m-cresol
definition: A cresol with the methyl substituent at position 3. It is a minor urinary metabolite of toluene.

name: L-glutamic 5-semialdehyde
definition: A glutamic semialdehyde arising from formal reduction of the side-chain carboxy group of L-glutamic acid.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A muconic semialdehyde having a hydroxy substituent at the 2-position.

name: CDP
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate having cytosine as the nucleobase.

name: itaconate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion that results from the deprotonation of both of the carboxylic acid groups of itaconic acid.

name: 1H-pyrazole
definition: The 1H-tautomer of pyrazole.

name: mono(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate
definition: The mono(2-ethylhexyl) ester of benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

name: carbon monoxide
definition: A one-carbon compound in which the carbon is joined only to a single oxygen. It is a colourless, odourless, tasteless, toxic gas.

name: poly(vinyl alcohol) macromolecule
definition: A homopolymer macromolecule obtained by polymerisation of vinyl alcohol.

name: N-isopropylammelide
definition: A dihydroxy-1,3,5-triazine consisting of ammelide bearing an N-isopropyl substituent.

name: D-nopaline
definition: An amino acid opine resulting from the formal reductive condensation of the amino group of L-arginine with the keto group of 2-oxopentanedioic acid.

name: 2-hydroxy-4-oxobutane-1,2,4-tricarboxylic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid that is the 2-oxo derivative of homocitric acid.

name: 17α-hydroxyprogesterone
definition: A 17α-hydroxy steroid that is the 17α-hydroxy derivative of progesterone.

name: 1,2-benzoquinone
definition: A benzoquinone resulting from the formal oxidation of catechol.

name: 4-methylcatechol
definition: A methylcatechol having a single methyl substituent at the 4-position. It has been isolated from Picea abies.

name: 2'-deoxyadenosine
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside having adenine as the nucleobase.

name: bis-γ-glutamylcystine
definition: The dimer obtained by formal oxidative coupling of γ-glutamylcystine.

name: 7H-purine
definition: The 7H-tautomer of purine.

name: CDP-3,6-dideoxy-D-mannose
definition: A CDP-sugar in which the sugar component is 3,6-dideoxy-D-mannose.

name: butanoyl dihydrogen phosphate
definition: An acyl monophosphate where the acyl groups is butanoyl.

name: N4-(β-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-L-asparagine
definition: An N4-glycosyl-L-asparagine having (β-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl as the glycosyl component.

name: dTDP-D-galacturonic acid
definition: A dTDP-sugar where the sugar component is D-galacturonic acid.

name: estrone
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is estra-1,3,5(10)-triene substituted by an hydroxy group at position 3 and an oxo group at position 17.

name: O-(1→4)-α-L-dihydrostreptosylstreptidine 6-phosphate
definition: A scyllo-inositol phosphate compound having the phosphate group at the 6-position, guanidino groups replacing hydroxy functions at the 1-position and an α-L-lyxofuranosyl residue at the 4-position.

name: myo-inositol
definition: An inositol having myo- configuration.

name: Latia luciferin
definition: An apo carotenoid sesquiterpenoid that consists of a cylohexene ring substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 6 and 6 and a (1E)-1-(formyloxy)-2-methylbut-1-en-4-yl group at position 2.

name: glycerol 2-phosphate
definition: A glycerol monophosphate having the phosphate group at the 2-position.

name: 3-phosphonatopyruvate(3−)
definition: A triply-charged monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phospho groups of 3-phosphonopyruvic acid.

name: propionate
definition: The conjugate base of propionic acid; a key precursor in lipid biosynthesis.

name: 2-isopropylmaleic acid
definition: The 2-isopropyl derivative of maleic acid.

name: phloretin
definition: A member of the class of dihydrochalcones that is dihydrochalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 2', 4' and 6'.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine
definition: UDP-glycopeptide having N-acetylmuramoyl as the glyco portion and L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine as the peptide portion (attached via an amide bond between the amino terminus and the muramoyl carboxy group).

name: N-succinyl-LL-2,6-diaminopimelic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid consisting of LL-2,6-diaminopimelic acid having a succinoyl group attached to one of the nitrogens.

name: 3-(indol-3-yl)lactate
definition: A 2-hydroxy carboxylate that is the conjugate base of 3-(indol-3-yl)lactic acid.

name: 5-phospho-D-ribosylamine
definition: A ribose monophosphate having the phosphate group at the 5-position and an amino group in place of hydroxy at the anomeric centre.

name: L-cysteic acid
definition: The L-enantiomer of cysteic acid.

name: deacetylisoipecoside
definition: Isoipecoside in which the acetyl group attaced to the nitrogen is replaced by hydrogen.

name: N-phosphocreatine
definition: A phosphoamino acid consisting of creatine having a phospho group attached at the primary nitrogen of the guanidino group.

name: homoserine lactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having an amino substituent at the 2-position.

name: (S)-3-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: The S-enantiomer of 3-hydroxybutyric acid; a normal human metabolite, that has been found elevated in geriatric patients remitting from depression.

name: 4,21-dehydrogeissoschizine
definition: An indole alkaloid that is the enol tautomer of geissoschizine, which is also dehydrogenated at the 4,21-position.

name: L-phenylalanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of phenylalanine.

name: aniline
