definition: A primary arylamine in which an amino functional group is substituted for one of the benzene hydrogens.

name: tetrachloroethene
definition: A chlorocarbon that is tetrachloro substituted ethene.

name: pentadecanal
definition: A long-chain fatty aldehyde that is pentadecane carrying an oxo substituent at position 1. It is a component of essential oils from plants like Solanum erianthum and Cassia siamea.

name: morphine
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is a highly potent opiate analgesic psychoactive drug. Morphine acts directly on the central nervous system (CNS) to relieve pain but has a high potential for addiction, with tolerance and both physical and psychological dependence developing rapidly. Morphine is the most abundant opiate found in Papaver somniferum (the opium poppy).

name: maltose
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of two D-glucopyranose units connected by an α-(1→4)-linkage.

name: 2-oxohexanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain fatty acid consisting of hexanoic acid having an oxo group at position 2.

name: pyridoxal
definition: A pyridinecarbaldehyde that is pyridine-4-carbaldehyde bearing methyl, hydroxy and hydroxymethyl substituents at positions 2, 3 and 5 respectively. The 4-carboxyaldehyde form of vitamin B6, it is converted into pyridoxal phosphate, a coenzyme for the synthesis of amino acids, neurotransmitters, sphingolipids and aminolevulinic acid.

name: N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysine
definition: An α-amino-acid cation that is the N6-trimethyl derivative of L-lysine.

name: N1-acetylspermine
definition: An acetylspermine carrying an acetyl group at position N1.

name: 13-hydroxydocosanoic acid
definition: A C22 hydroxy fatty acid with the hydroxy group at the 13-position and intermediate in the synthesis of sophorosyloxydocosanoate; a yeast glycolipid with potential medical and chemical engineering applications.

name: N-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)malonamate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)malonamic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 5'-deoxyadenosine
definition: A 5'-deoxyribonucleoside compound having adenosine as the nucleobase.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutarate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion that results from the removal of a proton from both of the carboxylic acid groups of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid.

name: phytol
definition: A diterpenoid that is hexadec-2-en-1-ol substituted by methyl groups at positions 3, 7, 11 and 15.

name: N-benzoylanthranilate
definition: A benzoate that is the conjugate base of N-benzoylanthranilic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: chorismic acid
definition: The (3R,4R)-stereoisomer of 5-[(1-carboxyethenyl)oxy]-6-hydroxycyclohexa-1,3-diene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: all-trans-retinol
definition: A retinol in which all four exocyclic double bonds have E- (trans-) geometry.

name: CDP-3,6-dideoxy-D-glucose
definition: A CDP-sugar having 3,6-dideoxy-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: cetraxate
definition: A cyclohexanecarboxylate ester that consists of 4-(2-carboxyethyl)phenyl cyclohexanecarboxylate bearing an aminomethyl substituent at the 4-position.

name: L-2-aminohexano-6-lactam
definition: A 2-aminohexano-6-lactam derived from L-lysine.

name: guanosine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having guanine as the nucleobase.

name: 4-chlorophenylacetonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acetonitrile in which one of the hydrogens has been replaced by a p-chlorophenyl group.

name: testosterone
definition: An androstanoid having 17β-hydroxy and 3-oxo groups, together with unsaturation at C-4‒C-5..

name: linoleic acid
definition: An octadecadienoic acid in which the two double bonds are at positions 9 and 12 and have Z (cis) stereochemistry.

name: (R)-mandelamide
definition: A mandelamide in which the stereocentre at position 2 has R-configuration.

name: 2-acetamidofluorene
definition: The parent of the class of 2-acetamidofluorenes, being an ortho-fused polycyclic arene that consists of 9H-fluorene bearing an acetamido substituent at position 2. It is a carcinogenic and mutagenic derivative of fluorene.

name: sulfite
definition: A sulfur oxoanion that is the conjugate base of hydrogen sulfite (H2SO3).

name: D-altronate
definition: Conjugate base of D-altronic acid.

name: cytidine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having cytosine as the nucleobase.

name: quinoline
definition: The simplest member of the quinoline class of compounds, comprising a benzene ring ortho fused to C-2 and C-3 of a pyridine ring.

name: D-ribulose 5-phosphate
definition: The D-enantiomer of ribulose 5-phosphate that is one of the end-products of the pentose phosphate pathway.

name: D-aspartic acid
definition: The D-enantiomer of aspartic acid.

name: hypoxanthine
definition: A purine nucleobase that consists of purine bearing an oxo substituent at position 6.

name: macrocin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is tylonolide having mono- and diglycosyl moieties attached to two of its hydroxy groups.

name: 1,2-dihydrovomilenine
definition: An indole alkaloid obtained by selective hydrogenation of the 1,2-position of vomilenine.

name: cystine
definition: A sulfur-containing amino acid obtained by the oxidation of two cysteine molecules which are then linked via a disulfide bond.

name: D-glyceraldehyde
definition: The D-enantiomer of glyceraldehyde.

name: isovitexin 2''-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is the 2"-O-β-D-glucosyl derivative of isovitexin .

name: porphobilinogen
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is pyrole bearing aminomethyl, carboxymethyl and 2-carboxyethyl substituents at positions 2, 3 and 4 respectively.

name: 17-O-acetylnorajmaline
definition: An indole alkaloid obtained by formal acetylation of the 17-hydroxy group of norajmaline.

name: 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)lactic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy carboxylic acid that is lactic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: (S)-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate
definition: A 1-pyrroline-5-carboxylate resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxy group of (S)-1-pyrroline-5-carboxylic acid.

name: N5-ethyl-L-glutamine
definition: A N5-alkylglutamine where the alkyl group is ethyl. It has been isolated from green tea.

name: cis-caffeic acid
definition: The cis-isomer of caffeic acid.

name: 3-methyloxindole
definition: A member of the class of oxindoles that is oxindole (1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one) in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: myo-inositol hexakisphosphate
definition: A myo-inositol hexakisphosphate in which each hydroxy group of myo-inositol is monophosphorylated.

name: 3-chloro-L-alanine
definition: A 3-chloroalanine that has R configutation at the chiral centre.

name: indan-1-one
definition: An indanone that consists of 2,3-dihydro-1H-indene substituted by an oxo group at position 1.

name: 4-pyridoxic acid
definition: A methylpyridine that is 2-methylpyridine substituted by a hydroxy group at C-3, a carboxy group at C-4, and a hydroxymethyl group at C-5. It is the catabolic product of vitamin B6 and is excreted in the urine.

name: 3-(imidazol-5-yl)pyruvic acid
definition: An oxo carboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by an imidazol-5-yl group.

name: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate
definition: The trans,trans-stereoisomer of farnesyl diphosphate.

name: 10-hydroxycapric acid
definition: A 10-carbon, ω-hydroxy fatty acid, shown to be the preferred hydroxylation product (together with the 9-OH isomer) of capric acid in biosystems, and used as a standard in lipid assays; reported to have cytotoxic effects.

name: aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine
definition: The open-chain form of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine.

name: 2-(hydroxymethyl)-4-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 4-oxobutanoic acid which is substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 2.

name: valeric acid
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid containing five carbon atoms.

name: P1,P4-bis(5'-adenosyl) tetraphosphate
definition: A diadenosyl tetraphosphate compound having the two 5'-adenosyl residues attached at the P1- and P4-positions.

name: 1-pyrroline-2-carboxylate
definition: The anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 1-pyrroline-2-carboxylic acid.

name: 3-ketosucrose
definition: A glycosyl glycoside which is an intermediate in the breakdown of sucrose. The structure is that of sucrose in which the glucosyl 3-hydroxy group has been reduced to a keto group.

name: trimethylsulfonium
definition: A sulfonium compound in which the substituents on sulfur are three methyl groups. It is found in the midgut gland of the sea hare, Aplysia brasiliana, and exhibits probable ability to inhibit cholinergic responses.

name: (R)-5-phosphomevalonic acid
definition: A carboxyalkyl phosphate that is mevalonic acid phosphorylated at position 5.

name: dimethyl sulfide
definition: A methyl sulfide in which the sulfur atom is substituted by two methyl groups. It is produced naturally by some marine algae.

name: cyanocob(III)alamin
definition: A complex cob(III)alamin in which cobalt is positioned in the centre of a planar corrin tetrapyrrole ring and bound axially to a 5,6-dimethylbenzimidazole moiety and a cyano group. It is one of several forms of the vitamin known as vitamin B12.

name: 4-nitrophenyl phosphate
definition: An aryl phosphate resulting from the mono-esterification of phosphoric acid with 4-nitrophenol.

name: L-homocitrulline
definition: A L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine having a carbamoyl group at the N6-position. It is found in individuals with urea cycle disorders.

name: 3-hydroxyphenylacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is phenylacetic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 on the benzene ring is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: geraniol
definition: A monoterpenoid consisting of two prenyl units linked head-to-tail and functionalised with a hydroxy group at its tail end.

name: cis-4-coumaric acid
definition: The cis-form of 4-coumaric acid.

name: methylmalonate(2−)
definition: A C4-dicarboxylate resulting from the removal of a proton from both carboxylic acid groups of methylmalonic acid.

name: UDP-L-rhamnose
definition: A UDP-rhamnose in which the rhamnose component has L-configuration.

name: dithioerythritol
definition: The meso-diastereomer of 1,4-dimercaptobutane-2,3-diol; a sulfur-containing sugar derived from the monosaccharide erythrose; and an epimer of dithiothreitol.

name: D-iditol
definition: The D-enantiomer of iditol.

name: lipoamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of lipoic acid with ammonia.

name: L-galactono-1,4-lactone
definition: A galactonolactone that is 3,4-dihydroxydihydrofuran-2(3H)-one substituted by a 1,2-dihydroxyethyl group at position 5 (the 3S,4S,5R-isomer).

name: phaseollidin hydrate
definition: A member of the class of pterocarpans that is phaseollidin in which the prenyl group is replaced by a 3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl group.

name: GDP-D-mannuronate
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of GDP-D-mannuronic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4-bromophenylsulfanyl)pyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (4-bromophenylsulfanyl)pyruvic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: estrone 3-sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is the 3-sulfate of estrone.

name: aminomalonic acid
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid that is malonic acid in which one of the methylene hydrogens has been replaced by an amino group.

name: uracil-5-carboxylic acid
definition: A pyrimidinemonocarboxylic acid that is uracil carrying a carboxy group at position 5.

name: enol-oxaloacetate
definition: A C4-dicarboxylate resulting from the removal of a proton from both carboxylic acid groups of enol-oxaloacetic acid.

name: L-cystathionine
definition: A modified amino acid generated by enzymic means from L-homocysteine and L-serine.

name: homocystine
definition: An organic disulfide obtained by oxidative dimerisation of homocysteine.

name: (S)-atropine
definition: An atropine with a 2S-configuration.

name: scopoletin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is umbelliferone bearing a methoxy substituent at position 6.

name: 3',5'-cyclic AMP
definition: A 3',5'-cyclic purine nucleotide having having adenine as the nucleobase.

name: O-palmitoyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine in which the acyl group is specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl).

name: glycolic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid where the methyl group has been hydroxylated.

name: 7α-hydroxycholesterol
definition: The 7α-hydroxy derivative of cholesterol.

name: 2-methylpropanal oxime
definition: An aldoxime derived from 2-methylpropanal.

name: α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-1D-myo-inositol
definition: An α-D-galactoside having a 1D-myo-inositol substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 7,8-dihydroxykynurenic acid
definition: A hydroxyquinoline that is kynurenic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 7 and 8 are replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: 5'-S-methyl-5'-thioadenosine
definition: Adenosine with the hydroxy group at C-5' substituted with a methylthio (methylsulfanyl) group.

name: cyanide
definition: A pseudohalide anion that is the conjugate base of hydrogen cyanide.

name: L-γ-glutamyl-L-cysteine
definition: A molecular entity formed when L-cysteine amino group binds to the γ-carbonyl of L-glutamic acid.

name: N-methyl-L-alanine
definition: A methyl-L-alanine in which one of the the amino hydrogen of L-alanine is replaced by a methyl group.

name: (−)-quinic acid
definition: The (−)-enantiomer of quinic acid.

name: alditol
definition: A carbohydrate that is an acyclic polyol having the general formula HOCH2[CH(OH)]nCH2OH (formally derivable from an aldose by reduction of the carbonyl group).

name: 1,2,3,6-tetrakis-O-galloyl-β-D-glucose
definition: A galloyl-β-D-glucose compound having four galloyl groups in the 1-, 2-, 3- and 6-positions.

name: kievitone hydrate
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanone that is isoflavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 2' and 4' and a 3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl group at position 8.

name: N-acetyl-L-glutamic acid
definition: An N-acyl-L-amino acid that is L-glutamic acid in which one of the amine hydrogens is substituted by an acetyl group.

name: L-arabinopyranose
definition: The six-membered ring form of L-arabinose.

name: allantoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of allantoic acid.

name: Tyr-Arg
definition: A dipeptide composed of L-tyrosine and L-arginine joined by a peptide linkage.

name: 9-cis,11-trans-octadecadienoate
definition: An octadeca-9,11-dienoate that is the conjugate base of 9-cis,11-trans-octadecadienoic acid, formed by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid functional group.

name: methyl β-D-galactoside
definition: A β-D-galactopyranoside having a methyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 1-phospho-α-D-galacturonic acid
definition: An uronic acid phosphate that is α-D-galacturonic acid carrying a phosphate group at position 1.

name: hydrogencarbonate
definition: The carbon oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from carbonic acid.

name: (E)-indol-3-ylacetaldehyde oxime
definition: An indol-3-ylacetaldehyde oxime in which the oxime moiety has E configuration.

name: (2Z)-5-isopropyl-2-methylhexa-2,5-dienal
definition: A hexadienal that is hexa-2,5-dienal substituted by a an isopropyl group at position 5 and a methy group at position 2 (the 2Z-stereoisomer).

name: alginic acid
definition: A linear copolymer macromolecule composed of homopolymeric blocks of 1→4-linked β-D-mannuronic acid and α-L-guluronic acid residues, covalently linked together in different sequences or blocks.

name: 5-aminolevulinic acid
definition: The simplest δ-amino acid in which the hydrogens at the γ position are replaced by an oxo group. It is metabolised to protoporphyrin IX, a photoactive compound which accumulates in the skin. Used (in the form of the hydrochloride salt)in combination with blue light illumination for the treatment of minimally to moderately thick actinic keratosis of the face or scalp.

name: GDP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group at the 5' position of guanosine with pyrophosphoric acid.

name: O-phosphoethanolamine
definition: The ethanolamine mono-ester of phosphoric acid, and a metabolite of phospholipid metabolism. This phosphomonoester shows strong structural similarity to the inhibitory neurotransmitter GABA, and is decreased in post-mortem Alzheimer's disease brain.

name: phaseollidin
definition: A member of the class of pterocarpans that is (6aR,11aR)-pterocarpan substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 9 and a prenyl group at position 10.

name: quercitrin
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin substituted by a α-L-rhamnosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: L-cysteine
definition: An optically active form of cysteine having L-configuration.

name: cytidine
definition: A pyrimidine nucleoside in which cytosine is attached to ribofuranose via a β-N1-glycosidic bond.

name: phthalate(2−)
definition: A phthalate that is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of both the carboxy groups of phthalic acid.

name: indole-3-acetonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acetonitrile where one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 1H-indol-3-yl group.

name: uracil
definition: A common and naturally occurring pyrimidine nucleobase in which the pyrimidine ring is substituted with two oxo groups at positions 2 and 4. Found in RNA, it base pairs with adenine and replaces thymine during DNA transcription.

name: biochanin A
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone which is substituted by an additional hydroxy group at position 5 and a methoxy group at position 4'. A phytoestrogen, it has putative benefits in dietary cancer prophylaxis.

name: toluene
definition: The simplest member of the class toluenes consisting of a benzene core which bears a single methyl substituent.

name: β-carotene
definition: A cyclic carotene obtained by dimerisation of all-trans-retinol. A strongly-coloured red-orange pigment abundant in plants and fruit and the most active and important provitamin A carotenoid.

name: linalool
definition: A monoterpenoid that is octa-1,6-diene substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 7 and a hydroxy group at position 3. It has been isolated from plants like Ocimum canum.

name: trans-hexadec-2-enal
definition: A hexadecenal containing a double bond at position 2 (the trans-stereoisomer).

name: CoA-glutathione
definition: An organic disulfide arising from oxidative coupling of the thiol functions of coenzyme A and glutathione.

name: L-gulono-1,4-lactone
definition: The furanose form of gulonolactone having L-configuration.

name: L-homocysteine
definition: A homocysteine that has L configuration.

name: octane
definition: A straight chain alkane composed of 8 carbon atoms.

name: N5-methyl-L-glutamine
definition: An N5-alkylglutamine where the alkyl group is specified as methyl.

name: hydroquinone
definition: A benzenediol comprising benzene core carrying two hydroxy substituents para to each other.

name: inosine
definition: A purine nucleoside in which hypoxanthine is attached to ribofuranose via a β-N9-glycosidic bond.

name: 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde
definition: A hydroxybenzaldehyde that is benzaldehyde substituted with a hydroxy group at position C-4.

name: 6,7-dimethyl-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine
definition: The pteridine that is lumazine substituted with methyl groups at C-6 and -7 and with a 1-D-ribityl group on N-8.

name: 4-aminophenol
definition: An amino phenol (one of the three possible isomers) which has the single amino substituent located para to the phenolic -OH group.

name: N6-methyl-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine in which one of the hydrogens attached to N6 is substituted by a methyl group.

name: 2-formylbenzoic acid
definition: An aldehydic acid which consists of benzoic acid substituted by a formyl group at position 2. Metabolite of ampicillin phthalidyl ester.

name: diiodine
definition: Molecule comprising two covalently bonded iodine atoms with overall zero charge..

name: 3-nitroacrylic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is acrylic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 is replaced by a nitro group.

name: (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetate
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: all-trans-heptaprenyl diphosphate
definition: An all-trans-polyprenyl diphosphate composed from seven isoprenyl units.

name: all-trans-retinyl palmitate
definition: An all-trans-retinyl ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic (hexadecanoic acid) with the hydroxy group of all-trans-retinol. It is used in cosmetic products to treat various skin disorders such as acne, skin aging, wrinkles, dark spots, and also protect against psoriasis.

name: L-fuculose
definition: A a deoxyketohexose comprising L-tagatose with the hydroxy group at position 6 replaced by hydrogen.

name: trans-ferulic acid
definition: A ferulic acid consisting of trans-cinnamic acid bearing methoxy and hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively on the phenyl ring.

name: FMN
definition: A flavin mononucleotide that is riboflavin (vitamin B2) in which the primary hydroxy group has been converted to its dihydrogen phosphate ester.

name: dUMP
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having uracil as the nucleobase.

name: cyclomaltodextrin
definition: A cyclic oligosaccharide comprising a ring of D-glucose units linked by α-(1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: dUTP
definition: A deoxyuridine phosphate having a triphosphate group at the 5'-position.

name: citraconic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid consisting of maleic acid having a methyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: ferroheme b
definition: Heme b in which the iron has oxidation state +2.

name: 2-aminoacetaldehyde
definition: An amino aldehyde that is acetaldehyde in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been replaced by an amino group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide composed of four D-mannose units, joined by α-linkages.

name: nitrate
definition: A nitrogen oxoanion formed by loss of a proton from nitric acid. Principal species present at pH 7.3.

name: guanosine 3',5'-bis(diphosphate)
definition: A guanosine bisphosphate having diphosphate groups at both the 3' and 5'-positions.

name: 6-methylsalicylic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is salicylic acid in which the hydrogen ortho to the carboxylic acid group is substituted by a methyl group.

name: 3-(indol-3-yl)pyruvate
definition: A indol-3-yl carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-(indol-3-yl)pyruvic acid

name: pentachlorophenol
definition: A chlorophenol that is phenol substituted by 5 chloro groups.

name: 4-acetamidobutanoic acid
definition: An N-acyl-γ-aminobutyric acid resulting from the monoacetylation of the nitrogen of GABA.

name: cortisol
definition: A 17α-hydroxy-C21-steroid that is pregn-4-ene substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 20 and hydroxy groups at positions 11, 17 and 21. Cortisol is a corticosteroid hormone or glucocorticoid produced by zona fasciculata of the adrenal cortex, which is a part of the adrenal gland. It is usually referred to as the "stress hormone" as it is involved in response to stress and anxiety, controlled by corticotropin-releasing hormone (CRH). It increases blood pressure and blood sugar, and reduces immune responses.

name: 3-hydroxy-L-glutamate(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged L-α-amino acid anion resulting from deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 3-hydroxy-L-glutamic acid.

name: (R)-mandelic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of mandelic acid.

name: tylosin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is tylonolide having mono- and diglycosyl moieties attached to two of its hydroxy groups. It is found naturally as a fermentation product of Streptomyces fradiae.

name: N6-dimethylallyladenine
definition: A 6-isopentenylaminopurine in which has the isopentenyl double bond is located between the 2 and 3 positions of the isopentenyl group.

name: (R)-3-[(R)-3-hydroxybutanoyloxy]butanoic acid
definition: A carboxylic ester arising from the formal condensation of the alcoholic hydroxy group of one molecule of (3R)-3-hydroxybutanoic acid with the the carboxylic acid group of another. It is a sex pheromone in the European spider Linyphia triangularis.

name: α-D-glucose 6-phosphate
definition: A D-glucopyranose 6-phosphate where α-D-glucose is the sugar component.

name: 2'-hydroxyformononetin
definition: A member of the class of 4'-methoxyisoflavones that is formononetin with a hydroxy group at the 2'position.

name: 5-hydroxybenzimidazolylcob(I)amide
definition: Cobamide in which 5-hydroxy-1H-benzimidazole is attached by a glycosyl link from its N-1 to the C-1 of the ribose moiety.

name: benzoin
definition: A ketone that consists of acetophenone bearing hydroxy and phenyl substituents at the α-position. The parent of the class of benzoins.

name: UDP-L-iduronic acid
definition: A UDP-sugar in which the sugar component is L-iduronic acid.

name: N-formyl-L-glutamate(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from deprotonation of both carboxy groups of N-formyl-L-glutamic acid.

name: glycocholic acid
definition: A bile acid glycine conjugate having cholic acid as the bile acid component.

name: (S)-nicotine
definition: A 3-(1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl)pyridine in which the chiral centre has S-configuration. The naturally occurring and most active enantiomer of nicotine, isolated from Nicotiana tabacum.

name: sphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphosphingolipid consisting of sphingosine having a phosphocholine moiety attached to its primary hydroxyl group.

name: casbene
definition: A diterpene comprising bicyclo[12.1.0]pentadeca-2,6,10-triene having three methyl substituents located at the 3-, 7- and 11-positions as well as gem-dimethyl groups at the 15-position.

name: isocyanuric acid
definition: The keto tautomer of cyanuric acid.

name: N-acetylserotonin
definition: An N-acylserotonin resulting from the formal condensation of the primary amino group of serotonin with the carboxy group of acetic acid.

name: chloramphenicol
definition: An organochlorine compound that is dichloro-substituted acetamide containing a nitrobenzene ring, an amide bond and two alcohol functions.

name: undecan-2-one
definition: A dialkyl ketone with methyl and nonyl as the two alkyl groups.

name: 26-hydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol substituted at position 26 by a hydroxy group.

name: aspulvinone E
definition: A 4-hydroxy-5-(4-hydroxybenzylidene)-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)furan-2(5H)-one in which the double bond adopts a Z-configuration. It is a marine metabolite isolated from the fungus Aspergillus terreus and exhibits antiviral activity.

name: N2-succinyl-L-arginine
definition: An N-acyl-L-arginine resulting from the formal condensation of the α-amino group of L-arginine with one of the carboxy groups of succinic acid

name: 5'-adenylyl sulfate
definition: An adenosine 5'-phosphate having a sulfo group attached to one the phosphate OH groups.

name: (R)-mevalonic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of mevalonic acid.

name: 9H-xanthine
definition: An oxopurine in which the purine ring is substituted by oxo groups at positions 2 and 6 and N-9 is protonated.

name: 2'-deoxyadenosine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having adenine as the nucleobase.

name: lactose
definition: A glycosylglucose disaccharide, found most notably in milk, that consists of D-galactose and D-glucose fragments bonded through a β-1→4 glycosidic linkage. The glucose fragment can be in either the α- or β-pyranose form, whereas the galactose fragment can only have the β-pyranose form.

name: β-D-glucose 6-phosphate
definition: A D-glucopyranose 6-phosphate in which the anomeric centre has β-configuration.

name: 2,3-bisphospho-D-glyceric acid
definition: The D-enantiomer of 2,3-bisphosphoglyceric acid.

name: (S,S,S)-nicotianamine
definition: The (S,S,S)-stereoisomer of nicotianamine.

name: N,N-dimethylglycine
definition: An N-methylglycine that is glycine carrying two N-methyl substituents.

name: α-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl residue attached to the galactose residue of N-acetyllactosamine via an α-(2→6)-linkage.

name: S-methyl-L-methionine
definition: A sulfonium compound that is the conjugate acid of S-methyl-L-methioninate.

name: quercetin 3-sulfate
definition: A quercetin sulfate with a sulfo group at position 3.

name: aldehydo-D-galactose 6-phosphate
definition: The ring-opened aldehydo-form of D-galactose 6-phosphate.

name: N,N-dimethylaniline N-oxide
definition: A member of the class of dimethylanilines that is N,N-dimethylaniline in which the tertiary amino group has been oxidised to give the corresponding N-oxide.

name: desmosterol
definition: A cholestanoid that is cholesta-5,24-diene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3. It is an intermediate metabolite obtained during the synthesis of cholesterol.

name: 3-oxoalanine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is serine in which the alcoholic hydroxy group has been formally oxidised to the corresponding formyl group.

name: N,N-dimethylformamide
definition: A member of the class of formamides that is formamide in which the amino hydrogens are replaced by methyl groups.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate(2−)
definition: An oxo dicarboxylate obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutaric acid.

name: coniferol
definition: A phenylpropanoid that is one of the main monolignols, produced by the reduction of the carboxy functional group in cinnamic acid and the addition of a hydroxy and a methoxy substituent to the aromatic ring.

name: bis(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate
definition: A phthalate ester that is the bis(2-ethylhexyl) ester of benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

name: thymidine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside having thymine as the nucleobase.

name: glycine betaine
definition: The amino acid betaine derived from glycine.

name: N6-acetyl-L-lysine
definition: An N6-acyl-L-lysine where the N6-acyl group is specified as acetyl.

name: glycerol
definition: A triol with a structure of propane substituted at positions 1, 2 and 3 by hydroxy groups.

name: cystathionine
definition: A modified amino acid generated by enzymic means from homocysteine and serine.

name: plastoquinone
definition: A polyprenylbenzoquinone that is 2,3-dimethylbenzoquinone with a polyprenyl side chain at position 5. There are several naturally-occurring plastoquinones with side chains of different length (containing between 6 and 9 isoprene units).

name: methyl sulfate
definition: An alkyl sulfate that is the monomethyl ester of sulfuric acid.

name: 5α-cholestan-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo-5α- steroid that is 5α-cholestane substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: 4-methylumbelliferyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester consiting of umbelliferone carrying a 7-O-acetyl group.

name: 2-O-(β-D-glucosyl)glycerol
definition: A glucosylglycerol consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 2 of glycerol via a glycosidic bond.

name: cyclohexane-1,3-dione
definition: A cyclohexanedione carrying oxo substituents at positions 1 and 3.

name: D-mannonate
definition: The D-enantiomer of mannonate.

name: N-acetylputrescine
definition: An N-monoacetylalkane-α,ω-diamine that is the N-monoacetyl derivative of putrescine.

name: 4-aminobutanal
definition: An ω-aminoaldehyde that is butanal in which one of the hydrogens of the terminal methyl group has been replaced by an amino group.

name: 1-hydroxy-2-(β-D-glucosyloxy)-9,10-anthraquinone
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is alizarin substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 2 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: trans-urocanate
definition: A urocanate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of trans-urocanic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-tetrahydrocolumbamine
definition: A berberine alkaloid consisting of columbamine having four extra hydrogens at positions 5, 8, 13 and 13a and (S)-configuration.

name: D-ribonate
definition: Conjugate base of D-ribonic acid.

name: pimelate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of pimelic acid.

name: 7,9-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6,8(3H)-trione
definition: An oxopurine in which the purine ring is substituted by oxo groups at positions 2, 6, and 8.

name: 5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan
definition: The L-enantiomer of 5-hydroxytryptophan.

name: lumichrome
definition: A compound showing blue fluorescence, formed by a photolysis of riboflavin in acid or neutral solution.

name: 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronic acid
definition: A hexuronic acid that results from hydrolytic ring cleavage of the hemiacetal group of 4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronic acid with subsequent tautomerisation of the resulting enol to the corresponding ketone.

name: 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-gluconic acid
definition: Hexanoic acid with four hydroxy groups at C-3, C-4, C-5, C-6, and an amino group at C-2.

name: N-acetyl-L-leucine
definition: The N-acetyl derivative of L-leucine.

name: dihydrochelirubine
definition: A benzophenanthridine alkaloid that is dihydrosanguinarine bearing a methoxy substituent at position 10.

name: methanol
definition: The primary alcohol that is the simplest aliphatic alcohol, comprising a methyl and an alcohol group.

name: calycosin
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone which is substituted by an additional hydroxy group at the 3' position and a methoxy group at the 4' position.

name: 3-phospho-D-glyceric acid
definition: The D-enantiomer of 3-phosphoglyceric acid

name: dihydroxyfumarate(2−)
definition: A C4-dicarboxylate resuting from deprotonation of both carboxy groups of dihydroxyfumaric acid.

name: L-idonate
definition: An optically active form of idonate having L-configuration; major species at pH 7.3.

name: aldehydo-D-ribose 5-phosphate
definition: The acyclic form of D-ribose 5-phosphate.

name: O-phosphoviomycin
definition: A derivative of viomycin having a phospho group attached to the side-chain OH group of one of the serine residues.

name: pseudouridine
definition: A C-glycosyl pyrimidine that consists of uracil having a β-D-ribofuranosyl residue attached at position 5. The C-glycosyl isomer of the nucleoside uridine.

name: dehydro-D-arabinono-1,4-lactone
definition: A γ-lactone that is 5-(hydroxymethyl)furan-2(5H)-one substituted at positions 3 and 4 by hydroxy groups (the 5R-stereoisomer).

name: dyspropterin
definition: A tetrahydropterin that is 2-amino-5,6,7,8-tetrahydropteridin-4(3H)-one substituted by a 2-oxopropanoyl group at position 6.

name: IDP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate having inosine as the nucleobase.

name: salicin
definition: An aryl β-D-glucoside that is salicyl alcohol in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-6-phenylhexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: Penta-2,4-dienoic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by hydroxy and one of the hydrogens at position 5 is substituted by a benzoyl group. It is a metabolic product of biphenyl from Pseudomonas putida.

name: thymine
definition: A pyrimidine nucleobase that is uracil in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by a methyl group.

name: serine
definition: An α-amino acid that is alanine substituted at position 3 by a hydroxy group.

name: calcitriol
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is calcidiol in which the pro-S hydrogen of calcidiol is replaced by a hydroxy group. It is the active form of vitamin D3, produced fom calciol via hydoxylation in the liver to form calcidiol, which is subsequently oxidised in the kidney to give calcitriol.

name: propan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is propane in which one of the hydrogens attached to the central carbon is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: methylarsonous acid
definition: A one-carbon compound that is arsonous acid in which the hydrogen attached to arsenic is replaced by a methyl group.

name: heparosan-N-sulfate D-glucuronic acid
definition: A heparan sulfate composed of a backbone of repeating β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→4)-N-sulfonyl-α-D-glucosamine units joined by (1→4)-linkages.

name: 2-phospho-D-glyceric acid
definition: A 2-phosphoglyceric acid in which the glyceric acid moiety has D (R) configuration.

name: 4-aminobenzoate
definition: An aromatic amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of 4-aminobenzoic acid.

name: 7,8-dihydropteroate
definition: A pteroate that is the conjugate base of 7,8-dihydropteroic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: indoxyl
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 2-amino-3-oxobutanoic acid
definition: An α-amino acid that is acetoacetic acid which is substituted by an amino group at position 2.

name: (S)-naringenin
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of naringenin.

name: p-cresol
definition: A cresol that consists of toluene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4. It is a metabolite of aromatic amino acid metabolism produced by intestinal microflora in humans and animals.

name: cyclohexanone
definition: A cyclic ketone that consists of cyclohexane bearing a single oxo substituent.

name: glutaric acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is a linear five-carbon dicarboxylic acid.

name: 4-chlorobenzoate
definition: A chlorobenzoate that is the conjugate base of 4-chlorobenzoic acid.

name: 3-dehydrosphinganine
definition: A 2-amino-1-hydroxyoctadecan-3-one that has S-configuration.

name: cellobiono-1,5-lactone
definition: A disaccharide consisting of D-glucono-1,5-lactone having a β-D-glucosyl residue at the 4-position.

name: taurolithocholic acid sulfate
definition: The steroid sulfate of taurolithocholic acid.

name: 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid.

name: UDP-2-acetamido-4-dehydro-2,6-dideoxy-β-D-glucose
definition: A UDP-amino sugar compound having 2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-β-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl-4-ulose as the sugar residue.

name: 6-hydroxyhexanoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid comprising hexanoic acid having a hydroxy group at the 6-position.

name: dihydrozeatin
definition: A 6-alkylaminopurine that is 7H-purin-6-amine where one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a 4-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl group. It is an intermediate in the zeatin biosynthesis.

name: quercetin 3,3'-bissulfate
definition: A quercetin bissulfate having sulfo groups at positions 3 and 3'.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoate
definition: The conjugate base of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid, comprising a 4-hydroxybenzoic acid core with a proton missing to give a charge of -1.

name: hydrogen chloride
definition: A mononuclear parent hydride consisting of covalently bonded hydrogen and chlorine atoms.

name: N2-phenylacetyl-L-glutamine
definition: An a N2-phenylacetylglutamine having L-configuration.

name: CDP-glycerol
definition: A nucleotide-alditol having cytidine-5'-diphosphate and glycerol as the nucleotide and alditol components respectively.

name: D-tagaturonate
definition: Conjugate base of D-tagaturonic acid.

name: 6-phospho-β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-D-glucose
definition: A disaccharide phosphate consisting of cellobiose having a monophosphate group at the 6'-position.

name: isopyridoxal
definition: A pyridinecarbaldehyde that is pyridine-5-carbaldehyde bearing methyl, hydroxy and hydroxymethyl substituents at positions 2, 3 and 4 respectively.

name: tryptophol
definition: An indolyl alcohol that is ethanol substituted by a 1H-indol-3-yl group at position 2.

name: L-rhamnulose 1-phosphate
definition: A deoxyketohexose phosphate consisting of L-rhamnulose having a monophosphate group at the 1-position.

name: L-tyrosine
definition: An optically active form of tyrosine having L-configuration.

name: L-rhamnulose
definition: A deoxyketohexose consisting of L-fructose lacking the 6-hydroxy group.

name: all-trans-retinal
definition: A retinal in which all four exocyclic double bonds have E- (trans-) geometry.

name: 7α-hydroxycholest-4-en-3-one
definition: A cholestanoid consisting of a cholesterol core having an oxo group at the 3-position, a C=C bond at the 4,5-position and an α-hydroxy group at the 7-position.

name: N-carbamoylputrescine
definition: An N-substituted putrescine where the N-substituent is a carbamoyl group.

name: coenzyme M
definition: An organosulfonic acid consisting of sulfonic acid having a 2-mercaptoethyl group attached to sulfur.

name: aminoacetone
definition: A propanone consisting of acetone having an amino group at the 1-position.

name: styrene oxide
definition: An epoxide that is oxirane in which one of the hydrogens has been replaced by a phenyl group.

name: 6-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1-phosphono)-D-mannose
definition: A mannose phosphate that is D-mannose phosphorylated at position 6 by a N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1-phosphono group. Found in the milk of giant pandas.

name: streptidine 6-phosphate
definition: A derivative of streptidine having a phosphate group at the 6-position.

name: 1,6-β-D-galactosylgalactogen
definition: A polysaccharide that is galactogen linked to a (1→6)-β-D-galactosyl unit.

name: hexano-6-lactone
definition: A ε-lactone that is oxepane substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: L-allysine
definition: An optically active form of allysine having L-configuration.

name: 3-mercapto-2-mercaptomethylpropanoic acid
definition: A sulfur-containing carboxylic acid consisting of isobutyric acid having mercapto substituents on both β-carbons.

name: fluoren-9-one
definition: The simplest member of the class fluoren-9-ones that is 9H-fluorene bearing an oxo substituent at position 9.

name: D-glucitol
definition: The D-enantiomer of glucitol (also known as D-sorbitol).

name: α-D-glucose
definition: D-Glucopyranose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: N1-acetylspermidine
definition: An acetylspermidine having the acetyl group at the N1-position.

name: 1-amino-1-deoxy-scyllo-inositol 4-phosphate
definition: A scyllo-inositol phosphate having a monophosphate group at the 4-position as well as the hydroxy group at the 1-position replaced by an amino group.

name: Nω,Nω-dimethyl-L-arginine
definition: A L-arginine derivative having two methyl groups both attached to the primary amino moiety of the guanidino group.

name: calcidiol
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is calciol in which the hydrogen at position 25 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. A prehormone resulting from the oxidation of calciol in the liver, it is further hydroxylated in the kidney to give calcitriol, the active form of vitamin D3.

name: octanal
definition: A saturated fatty aldehyde formally arising from reduction of the carboxy group of caprylic acid (octanoic acid).

name: L-rhamnono-1,4-lactone
definition: A five-membered rhamnonolactone having L-configuration.

name: puromycin
definition: An aminonucleoside antibiotic, derived from the Streptomyces alboniger bacterium, that causes premature chain termination during translation taking place in the ribosome.

name: D-allose 6-phosphate
definition: An allose phosphate consisting of D-allose having a monophosphate group at the 6-position.

name: N-cyclohexylformamide
definition: A member of the class of formamides that is cyclohexane substituted by a formamido group.

name: 3-dehydroquinic acid
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid derived from quinic acid by oxidation of the hydroxy group at position 3 to the corresponding keto group.

name: (+)-taxifolin
definition: A taxifolin that has (2R,3R)-configuration.

name: xanthopterin-B2
definition: A member of the class of pteridines that is 7,8-dihydropteridine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione carrying a lactoyl group at position 6.

name: 1-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate
definition: A galactosylglycerol phosphate compond having an α-D-galactosyl residue attached to the 1-position of an sn-glycerol 3-phosphate

name: 5-(2-hydroxyethyl)-4-methylthiazole
definition: A 1,3-thiazole that is thiazole substituted by a methyl group at position 4 and a 2-hydroxyethyl group at position 5.

name: oxidized Renilla luciferin
definition: An aromatic amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of phenylacetic acid with the exocyclic amino group of 4-(5-amino-6-benzylpyrazin-2-yl)phenol.

name: farnesyl triphosphate
definition: A polyprenol triphosphate where the polyprenol component is farnesol.

name: 1-methyl-4-phenyl-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine
definition: A tetrahydropyridine that is 1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine substituted by a methyl group at position 1 and a phenyl group at position 4.

name: pipecolic acid
definition: A piperidinemonocarboxylic acid in which the carboxy group is located at position C-2.

name: isoorientin
definition: A flavone C-glycoside consisting of luteolin having a β-D-glucosyl residue at the 6-position.

name: cyclohexyl isocyanide
definition: An isocyanide having a cyclohexyl group attached to nitrogen.

name: urethane
definition: A carbamate ester obtained by the formal condensation of ethanol with carbamic acid. It has been found in alcoholic beverages.

name: butyrate
definition: A short-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of butyric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: α-D-galactose 1-phosphate
definition: A D-galactopyranose 1-phosphate having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 5,10-(methanylylidene)tetrahydromethanopterin
definition: A tetrahydromethanopterin having a methanylylidene joined to the nitrogens at the 5- and 10-positions.

name: 1,4-benzosemiquinone
definition: A member of the class of benzosemiquinones which results from the removal of one hydrogen atom with its electron from hydroquinone (or from the addition of one hydrogen atom with its electron to p-benzoquinone).

name: aldehydo-L-xylose
definition: A xylose of ring-opened form having L-configuration.

name: 3'-phospho-5'-adenylyl sulfate
definition: An adenosine bisphosphate having monophosphate groups at the 3'- and 5'-positions and a sulfo group attached to the phosphate at position 5'.

name: O-acetyl-L-serine
definition: An acetyl-L-serine where the acetyl group is attached to the side-chain oxygen. It is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of the amino acid cysteine in bacteria.

name: UDP-L-arabinose
definition: A UDP-sugar having L-arabinose as the sugar component.

name: adenosine 3',5'-bismonophosphate
definition: An adenosine bisphosphate having two monophosphate groups at the 3'- and 5'-positions.

name: benzyl alcohol
definition: An aromatic alcohol that consists of benzene bearing a single hydroxymethyl substituent.

name: sucrose
definition: A glycosyl glycoside formed by glucose and fructose units joined by an acetal oxygen bridge from hemiacetal of glucose to the hemiketal of the fructose.

name: 3-(3,4-dihydroxypyridinium-1-yl)-L-alanine
definition: A pyridinium ion that is L-alanine in which a methyl hydrogen is replaced by a 3,4-dioxidopyridinium-1-yl group.

name: D-ribose 1,5-bisphosphate
definition: A ribose bisphosphate that consists of D-ribose having two monophosphate groups at the 1- and 5-positions.

name: chloride
definition: A halide anion formed when chlorine picks up an electron to form an an anion.

name: dinitrogen
definition: An elemental molecule consisting of two trivalently-bonded nitrogen atoms.

name: (−)-secologanin
definition: An iridoid monoterpenoid that is acetaldehyde in which on of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been replaced by a 2-(β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)-3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-4-yl group which is substituted at positions 3 and 5 by a vinyl and a methoxycarbonyl group, respectively (the 2S,3R,4S stereoisomer).

name: 2-hydroxy-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioic acid
definition: A carboxy-2-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde having the carboxy group at the 3-position.

name: D-hamamelose
definition: An aldopentose comprising D-ribose having a hydroxymethyl group at the 2-position.

name: keto-phenylpyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy group of keto-phenylpyruvic acid.

name: 3',4',5-trihydroxy-3,7-dimethoxyflavone
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that the 3,7-di-O-methyl derivative of quercetin.

name: fumaric acid
definition: A butenedioic acid in which the C=C double bond has E geometry. It is an intermediate metabolite in the citric acid cycle.

name: 4-O-feruloyl-D-quinic acid
definition: The 4-O-feruloyl derivative of D-quinic acid.

name: CMP-3-deoxy-α-D-manno-octulosonic acid
definition: A CMP-sugar having 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-octulosonic acid as the sugar component.

name: oxidized Latia luciferin
definition: A methyl ketone in which the keto group is attached to a 2-(2,6,6-trimethylcyclohex-1-en-1-yl)ethyl group.

name: 3',4',5-trihydroxy-3,6,7-trimethoxyflavone
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is the 3,6,7-trimethyl ether derivative of quercetagetin.

name: L-lysine
definition: An L-α-amino acid; the L-isomer of lysine.

name: phosphoenolpyruvate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resuting from selective deprotonation of the carboxy group of phosphoenolpyruvic acid.

name: thiocyanate
definition: A pseudohalide anion obtained by deprotonation of the thiol group of thiocyanic acid.

name: 2-hydroxypropyl dihydrogen phosphate
definition: A hydroxyalkyl phosphate consisting of propane-1,2-diol having a phosphate group at the 1-position.

name: 2,3-dihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3. It occurs naturally in Phyllanthus acidus and in the aquatic fern Salvinia molesta.

name: dihydromacarpine
definition: A benzophenanthridine alkaloid that is dihydrosanguinarine bearing two methoxy substituents.

name: quercetin 3,4'-bissulfate
definition: A quercetin bissulfate having the sulfo groups at the 3- and 4'-positions.

name: 4-amino-2-methyl-5-phosphooxymethylpyrimidine
definition: An aminopyrimidine having the amino group at the 4-position together with methyl and phosphooxymethyl groups at the 2- and 5-positions respectively.

name: 4-fumarylacetoacetate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resuting from removal of a proton from both carboxy groups of 4-fumarylacetoacetic acid.

name: GDP-L-galactose
definition: A GDP-galactose where the galactose moiety has L-configuration.

name: N-phospho-L-lombricine
definition: A phosphoramide consisting of L-lombricine having a phospho group attached to the guanidine.

name: erythro-5-hydroxy-L-lysine
definition: A 5-hydroxylysine consisting of L-lysine having an (R)-hydroxy group at the 5-position.

name: 4-carboxy-2-hydroxy-cis,cis-muconate 6-semialdehyde
definition: A carboxy-2-hydroxymuconate semialdehyde having the carboxy group at the 4-position and the aldehyde functijon at the 6-position.

name: dihydrolipoic acid
definition: A thio-fatty acid that is reduced form of lipoic acid. A potent antioxidant shown to directly destroy superoxide, hydroperoxy and hydroxyl radicals; also has neuroprotective and anti-tumour effects.

name: DIMBOA
definition: A lactol that is DIBOA in which the hydrogen at position 7 is replaced by a methoxy group. It has been isolated from the maize plants.

name: piperidine
definition: An azacycloalkane that is cyclohexane in which one of the carbons is replaced by a nitrogen. It is a metabolite of cadaverine, a polyamine found in the human intestine.

name: L-glutamine
definition: An optically active form of glutamine having L-configuration.

name: 1-aminocyclopropanecarboxylic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid consisting of cyclopropane having amino and carboxy substituents both at the 1-position.

name: diphthine
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion consisting of L-histidine with a 3-(trimethylammonio)-3-carboxypropyl group at the 2-position of the the imidazole ring.

name: vellosimine
definition: An indole alkaloid that is sarpagan in which the methyl group attached to position 16 has been oxidised to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: oxamic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of oxalic acid with ammonia.

name: 4-guanidinobutanamide
definition: A butanamide having a guanidino group at the 4-position.

name: 3-hydroxyisobutyric acid
definition: A 4-carbon, branched hydroxy fatty acid and intermediate in the metabolism of valine.

name: deacetylcephalosporin C
definition: A 3-hydroxymethylcephalosporin having a (5-amino-5-carboxypentanoyl)amino group at the 7-position.

name: UDP-D-glucose
definition: A UDP-sugar having D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: phylloquinone
definition: A member of the class of phylloquinones that consists of 1,4-naphthoquinone having methyl and phytyl groups at positions 2 and 3 respectively. The parent of the class of phylloquinones.

name: 8-phospho-3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid phosphate consisting of 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid having a phospho group at the 8-position.

name: (methylthio)acetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (methylthio)acetic acid.

name: 5-hydroxyisouric acid
definition: An oxopurine that is 5,7-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6,8(9H)-trione in which the hydrogen at position 5 is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: xanthoaphin
definition: The product from the treatment of protoaphin aglucone with protoaphin dehydratase (EC 4.2.1.73).

name: dTDP
definition: A thymidine phosphate having a diphosphate group at the 5'-position.

name: dTTP
definition: A thymidine phosphate having a triphosphate group at the 5'-position.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-L-rhamnonic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid that is rhamnonic acid which is lacking the 3-hydroxy group, has a keto group at the 2-position and L-configuration.

name: 5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furylacetic acid
definition: A 5-oxo-2-furylacetic acid having the C=C double bond at the 3,4-position.

name: 3-hexaprenyl-4,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid where the hydroxy groups are at the 4- and 5-positions together with a hexaprenyl group at the 3-position.

name: 1,2,3,4,6-pentakis-O-galloyl-β-D-glucose
definition: A galloyl-β-D-glucose compound having five galloyl groups in the 1-, 2-, 3-, 4- and 6-positions.

name: 1-methyladenine
definition: Adenine substituted with a methyl group at position N-1.

name: indol-3-ylacetaldehyde
definition: An indoleacetaldehyde that is acetaldehyde in which one of the methyl hydrogens are replaced by a indol-3-yl group. It is an intermediate metabolite in the metabolism of tryptophan.

name: formononetin
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 4'.

name: N-benzoylglycine
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as benzoyl.

name: 3-aminopropanal
definition: A propanal having an amino substituent at the 3-position

name: 17,21-dihydroxy-5β-pregnane-3,11,20-trione
definition: A 4,5-dihydrocortisone that has β- configuration at position 5.

name: 1,4-dihydroxy-2-naphthoic acid
definition: A naphthoic acid that is 2-naphthoic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 4.

name: trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline
definition: An optically active form of 4-hydroxyproline having L-trans-configuration.

name: CMP-N-glycoloyl-β-neuraminic acid
definition: A CMP-N-acyl-β-neuraminic acid in which the N-acyl group is glycoloyl.

name: cyclohexanol
definition: An alcohol that consists of cyclohexane bearing a single hydroxy substituent. The parent of the class of cyclohexanols.

name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: O-octanoyl-L-carnitine
definition: The L-enantiomer of an O-octanoylcarnitine.

name: L-tyrosine methyl ester 4-sulfate
definition: An O-sulfoamino acid consisting of methyl L-tyrosinate in which the hydrogen of the phenolic hydroxy group has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-fuconic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid comprising D-fuconic acid lacking the 3-hydroxy substituent and having a keto group at the 2-position.

name: keto-D-fructose 1-phosphate
definition: The open chain form of D-fructose 1-phosphate.

name: deacetylipecoside
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid consisting of β-D-glucose having a (2S,3R,4S)-3-ethenyl-4-{[(1R)-6,7-dihydroxy-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinolinium-1-yl]methyl}-5-(methoxycarbonyl)-3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-2-yl group attached at the anomeric centre.

name: xanthosine
definition: A purine nucleoside in which xanthine is attached to ribofuranose via a β-N9-glycosidic bond.

name: 3-phosphonatooxypyruvate(3−)
definition: A carboxyalkyl phosphate oxoanion resuting from deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate groups of 3-phosphooxypyruvic acid.

name: 2-aminophenol
definition: The aminophenol which has the single amino substituent located ortho to the phenolic -OH group.

name: 4-hydroxymandelonitrile
definition: A cyanohydrin that is obtained by the formal addition of hydrogen cyanide to the aldehyde group of 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde.

name: pseudouridine 5'-phosphate
definition: A C-nucleoside phosphate consisting of pseudouridine having a monophosphate group at the 5'-position.

name: 3-ADP-2-phosphoglyceric acid
definition: A 3-ADP-glyceric acid having a phosphate group at the 2-position of the glyceric acid moiety.

name: 5-aminopentanamide
definition: A fatty amide consisting of pentanamide having an amino substituent at the 5-position.

name: N-methylnicotinate
definition: An iminium betaine that is the conjugate base of N-methylnicotinic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: phosphonoacetaldehyde
definition: A phosphonic acid consisting of acetaldehyde with the phospho group at the 2-position.

name: trans-2-coumaric acid
definition: The trans-isomer of 2-coumaric acid.

name: cadaverine
definition: An alkane-α,ω-diamine comprising a straight-chain pentane core with amino substitutents at positions 1 and 5. A colourless syrupy liquid diamine with a distinctive unpleasant odour, it is a homologue of putresceine and is formed by the bacterial decarboxylation of lysine that occurs during protein hydrolysis during putrefaction of animal tissue. It is also found in plants such as soyabean.

name: luteolin 7-O-β-D-glucosiduronic acid
definition: A luteolin glucosiduronic acid consisting of luteolin having a β-D-glucosiduronic acid residue attached at the 7-position.

name: (S)-2-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: An optically active form of 2-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid having (S)-configuration.

name: (−)-5-oxo-1,2-campholide
definition: An optically active 5-oxo-1,2-campholide having (−)-(1R,5R)-configuration.

name: licodione
definition: A β-diketone that is acetylacetone in which a 4-hydroxyphenyl group and a 2,4-dihydroxyphenyl group replace the two methyl groups.

name: phosphocholine
definition: The phosphate of choline; and the parent compound of the phosphocholine family.

name: 3β-hydroxy-4β-methyl-5α-cholest-7-ene-4α-carboxylic acid
definition: A steroid acid consisting of 3β-hydroxy-4β-methyl-5α-cholest-7-ene having a carboxy group at the 4-position.

name: catechol
definition: A benzenediol comprising of a benzene core carrying two hydroxy substituents ortho to each other.

name: 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid carrying a 2,3-dihydroxyphenyl substituent at C-3; a microbial metabolite of quinoline.

name: heparan sulfate α-D-glucosaminide
definition: A heparan sulfate having an α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the non-reducing end. The heparan sulfate part consists of a variably sulfated repeating disaccharide unit.

name: biuret
definition: A member of the class of condensed ureas that is the compound formed by the condensation of two molecules of urea; the parent compound of the biuret group of compounds. Used as a non-protein nitrogen source in ruminant feed.

name: trimethylamine
definition: A tertiary amine that is ammonia in which each hydrogen atom is substituted by an methyl group.

name: N6'-acetylkanamycin B
definition: An N6'-acetylkanamycin derived from kanamycin B.

name: all-trans-nonaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A nonaprenyl diphosphate where all C=C double bonds have (E)-configuration.

name: (R,R,R)-α-tocopherol
definition: An α-tocopherol that has R,R,R configuration. The naturally occurring stereoisomer of α-tocopherol, it is found particularly in sunflower and olive oils.

name: (R)-canadine
definition: A canadine which has R configuration.

name: β-maltose
definition: A maltose that has β-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: α-D-glucose 1,6-bisphosphate
definition: A D-glucose 1,6-bisphosphate in which both phosphate groups are monophosphates.

name: aureusidin
definition: A hydroxyaurone that is aurone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 6, 3' and 4' respectively.

name: 7-phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabino-heptonic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid phosphate consisting of 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-arabino-heptonic acid having a phospho group at the 7-position.

name: menaquinol
definition: Any polyprenylhydroquinone having a polyprenyl moiety at position 2 and a methyl group at position 3..

name: myricetin
definition: A hexahydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 3', 4', 5, 5' and 7. It has been isolated from the leaves of Myrica rubra and other plants.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxyphytanic acid
definition: A 20-carbon, methyl-branched hydroxy fatty acid and intermediate in phytanic acid degradation; accumulates in patients with peroxisimal disorders.

name: α-maltose
definition: A maltose that has α-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: fluoroacetate
definition: A haloacetate(1−) resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of fluoroacetic acid.

name: 1D-5-O-methyl-chiro-inositol
definition: A cyclitol ether formed by etherification of the 5-hydroxy group of 1D-chiro-inositol.

name: 7-hydroxyisoflavone 7-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyisoflavone that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 2-coumaric acid
definition: A monohydroxycinnamic acid in which the hydroxy substituent is located at C-2 of the phenyl ring.

name: 5-oxo-L-proline
definition: An optically active form of 5-oxoproline having L-configuration.

name: γ-tocopherol
definition: A tocopherol in which the chroman-6-ol core is substituted by methyl groups at positions 7 and 8. It is found particularly in maize (corn) oil and soya bean (soybean) oils.

name: tyrosine
definition: An α-amino acid that is phenylalanine bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the phenyl ring.

name: α-D-ribofuranose 5-phosphate
definition: A D-ribofuranose 5-phosphate with an α-configuration at anomeric position.

name: α,α'-trehalose 6,6'-bismycolate
definition: A trehalose mycolate compound consisting of two mycolate groups attached to the 6- and 6'-positions of α,α'-trehalose.

name: ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: An undecaprenyl diphosphate in which the eight double bonds closest to the phosphate group have Z configuration, while the next two double bonds have E configuration.

name: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid comprising chorismic acid having its 4-hydroxy group replaced by an amino group.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine
definition: UDP-glycopeptide having N-acetylmuramoyl as the glyco portion and L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine as the peptide portion (attached via an amide bond between the amino terminus and the muramoyl carboxy group).

name: isoscoparin
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that consists of chrysoeriol substituted by a 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol moiety at position 6.

name: L-iditol
definition: The L-enantiomer of iditol.

name: α-D-mannose 1-phosphate
definition: A D-mannose 1-phosphate with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: 2-amino-5-oxocyclohex-1-enecarbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-amino-5-oxocyclohex-1-enecarboxylic acid.

name: N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 6-phosphate
definition: A galactosamine phosphate that is N-acetyl-D-galactosamine substituted at position 1 by a monophosphate group.

name: benzylpenicillin
definition: A penicillin in which the substituent at position 6 of the penam ring is a phenylacetamido group.

name: citrulline
definition: The parent compound of the citrulline class consisting of ornithine having a carbamoyl group at the N5-position.

name: syringetin
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3' and 5' have been replaced by methoxy groups.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of two D-galactose residues, linked α(1→3), and an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked β(1→4), at the reducing end.

name: ammonium hydroxide
definition: A solution of ammonia in water.

name: isoflavone
definition: A simplest member of the class of isoflavones that is 4H-chromen-4-one in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a phenyl group.

name: isoeugenol
definition: A phenylpropanoid that is an isomer of eugenol in which the allyl substituent is replaced by a prop-1-enyl group.

name: sterigmatocystin
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound whose skeleton comprises a xanthene ring system ortho-fused to a dihydrofuranofuran moiety. The parent of the class of sterigmatocystins.

name: arsenic acid
definition: An arsenic oxoacid comprising one oxo group and three hydroxy groups attached to a central arsenic atom.

name: D-galactosamine 6-phosphate
definition: A galactosamine phosphate that is D-galactosamine substituted at position 1 by a monophosphate group.

name: α,α'-trehalose 6-mycolate
definition: A trehalose monomycolate comprising α,α'-trehalose having the mycolate group attached to the 6-position.

name: glutamic acid
definition: An α-amino acid that is glutaric acid bearing a single amino substituent at position 2.

name: 4-hydroxy-L-proline
definition: The L-stereoisomer of 4-hydroxyproline.

name: dopamine
definition: Catechol in which the hydrogen at position 4 is substituted by a 2-aminoethyl group.

name: (1→4)-β-D-glucan
definition: A β-D-glucan in which the glucose units are connected by (1→4) linkages.

name: 5-amino-6-(5-phospho-D-ribitylamino)uracil
definition: 5-O-Phosphono-D-ribitol in which the hydroxy group at position 1 is substituted by the 6-amino group of 5,6-diaminopyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione.

name: iron atom
definition: An iron group element atom that has atomic number 26.

name: ergosta-5,7,22,24(28)-tetraen-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol having double bonds in the 5-, 7- and 22-positions and a methylene group at position 24.

name: chondroitin 4'-sulfate
definition: A chondroitin sulfate in which the site of sulfation is carbon 4 of the N-acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc) sugar.

name: UDP-D-galactofuranose
definition: A UDP-sugar having D-galactose as the sugar component.

name: nebularine
definition: A purine ribonucleoside that is 9H-purine attached to a β-D-ribofuranosyl residue at position 9 via a glycosidic (N-glycosyl) linkage.

name: ornithine
definition: An α-amino acid that is pentanoic acid bearing two amino substituents at positions 2 and 5.

name: 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine
definition: An iodothyronine compound having iodo substituents at the 3-, 3'- and 5-positions. Although some is produced in the thyroid, most of the 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine in the body is generated by mono-deiodination of L-thyroxine in the peripheral tissues. Its metabolic activity is about 3 to 5 times that of L-thyroxine. The sodium salt is used in the treatment of hypothyroidism.

name: N-carbamoyl-β-alanine
definition: A β-alanine derivative that is propionic acid bearing a ureido group at position 3.

name: dodecanoate
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of dodecanoic acid (lauric acid); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1D-4-O-methyl-myo-inositol
definition: A member of the class of methyl myo-inositols that is cyclohexane-1,2,3,4,5-pentol substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 (the 1R,2S,3S,4S,5S,6S-isomer).

name: 5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-2-furylacetic acid
definition: The 4,5-dihydro- derivative of 5-oxo-2-furylacetic acid.

name: (1→6)-α-D-glucan
definition: An α-D-glucan in which the glucose units are connected by (1→6) linkages.

name: N2-formyl-N1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)glycinamide
definition: A glycinamide ribonucleotide having a phosphate group at the 5-position and a formyl group on the glycine nitrogen.

name: dihydrogen
definition: An elemental molecule consisting of two hydrogens joined by a single bond.

name: N-(5-phosphonato-β-D-ribosyl)anthranilate
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from deprotonation of the phosphate and carboxy groups of N-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl)anthranilic acid.

name: phenylglyoxylic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is glyoxylic acid in which the aldehyde hydrogen is substituted by a phenyl group.

name: thiamine(1+) triphosphate(1−)
definition: An ammonium betaine that is the conjugate base of thiamine(1+) triphosphate arising from the deptoronation of one of the hydroxy groups of the terminal phosphate group.

name: (S)-stylopine
definition: A berberine alkaloid isolated from the plants of the family papaveraceae.

name: quinolin-2(1H)-one
definition: A quinolone that is 1,2-dihydroquinoline substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: thiamine(1+) diphosphate chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt of thiamine(1+) diphosphate.

name: jasmonic acid
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid that is (3-oxocyclopentyl)acetic acid substituted by a (2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl group at position 2 of the cyclopentane ring.

name: 5-methoxypsoralen
definition: A 5-methoxyfurocoumarin that is psoralen substituted by a methoxy group at position 5.

name: histamine
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole substituted at position C-4 by a 2-aminoethyl group.

name: chondroitin 6'-sulfate
definition: A chondroitin sulfate in which the site of sulfation is carbon 6 of the N-acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc) sugar.

name: 1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate
definition: An inositol having myo- configuration substituted at position 1 by a phosphate group.

name: maleic acid
definition: A butenedioic acid in which the double bond has cis- (Z)-configuration.

name: 1-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl)-5-[(5-phospho-β-D-ribosylamino)methylideneamino]imidazole-4-carboxamide
definition: A 1-(phosphoribosyl)imidazolecarboxamide that is the 5-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosylamino)methylidene derivative of 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)imidazole-4-carboxamide.

name: hydroquinone O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is hydroquinone attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 4 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: thiamine(1+) carboxylic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is thiamine(1+) which carries an oxo group at position 2.

name: UDP-D-galactose
definition: A UDP-sugar having D-galactose as the sugar component.

name: acrylic acid
definition: A α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is ethene substituted by a carboxy group.

name: L-2-aminopentanoic acid
definition: A 2-aminopentanoic acid that has S-configuration.

name: pyrroloquinoline quinone
definition: A pyrroloquinoline having oxo groups at the 4- and 5-positions and carboxy groups at the 2-, 7- and 9-positions.

name: 4-ethylamino-6-isopropylamino-1,3,5-triazin-2-ol
definition: A monohydroxy-1,3,5-triazine that is atrazine in which the chloro group has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: N-acetyl-LL-2,6-diaminopimelate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from removal of a proton from both carboxy groups of N-acetyl-LL-2,6-diaminopimelic acid.

name: SAICAR
definition: A 1-(phosphoribosyl)imidazolecarboxamide resulting from the formal condesation of the darboxy group of 5-amino-1-(5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranosyl)-1H-imidazole-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of L-aspartic acid.

name: 1,4-dithiothreitol
definition: The threo-diastereomer of 1,4-dimercaptobutane-2,3-diol.

name: 1-(sn-glycero-3-phospho)-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative that is 1D-myo-inositol substituted at position 1 by an sn-glycero-3-phospho group.

name: 6-oxohexanoate
definition: A straight-chain fatty acid anion and the conjugate base of 6-oxohexanoic acid, formed by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: anserine
definition: A dipeptide comprising of β-alanine and 3-methyl-L-histidine units.

name: N-formimidoyl-L-glutamate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid anion resuting from removal of a proton from both carboxy groups of N-formimidoyl-L-glutamic acid.

name: 5α-androstane-3β,17β-diol
definition: An androstane-3,17-diol that is 5α-androstane substituted by β-hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 17. It is a metabolite of dihydrotestosterone.

name: isovitexin
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that consists of apigenin substituted by a 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol moiety at position 6.

name: L-thyroxine
definition: The L-enantiomer of thyroxine.

name: D-arabinitol
definition: The D-enantiomer of arabinitol.

name: adenosine 5'-(pentahydrogen tetraphosphate)
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-tetraphosphate having adenine as the nucleobase.

name: pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate
definition: A vitamin B6 phosphate that is the phosphoric ester derivative of pyridoxamine.

name: 5-amino-6-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosylamino)uracil
definition: An N-glycosyl compound that consists of 5,6-diaminouracil in which one of the hydrogens on the 6-amino function is substituted by a 5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl residue.

name: thiamine(1+) monophosphate chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt of thiamine(1+) monophosphate.

name: kynurenic acid
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid that is quinoline-2-carboxylic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-4.

name: vanillin
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes carrying methoxy and hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively.

name: L-norleucine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid comprising hexanoic acid carrying an amino group at C-2. It does not occur naturally.

name: 4-hydroxyhexan-3-one
definition: A hexanone that is hexan-3-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: vanillyl alcohol
definition: A monomethoxybenzene that is 2-methoxyphenol substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 4.

name: 2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A 5-carbon, bis-unsaturated, α-hydroxy fatty acid metabolite of the proteobacterium substrate 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-6-phenylhexa-2,4-dienoic acid (HOPDA).

name: pyrroloquinoline quinol
definition: A pyrroloquinoline having hydroxy groups at the 4- and 5-positions and carboxy groups at the 2-, 7- and 9-positions.

name: (R)-noradrenaline
definition: The R-enantiomer of noradrenaline.

name: methoxsalen
definition: A member of the class of psoralens that is 7H-furo[3,2-g]chromen-7-one in which the 9 position is substituted by a methoxy group. It is a constituent of the fruits of Ammi majus. Like other psoralens, trioxsalen causes photosensitization of the skin. It is administered topically or orally in conjunction with UV-A for phototherapy treatment of vitiligo and severe psoriasis.

name: 17-O-deacetylvindoline
definition: A vinca alkaloid that is vindoline in which the acetate ester group at position 17 has been hydrolysed to give the corresponding secondary alcohol.

name: reticulinylium
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is obtained by selective dehydrogenation at the 1,2-position of reticuline.

name: 14-demethyllanosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol formed formally by loss of a methyl group from the 14-position of lanosterol.

name: naphthalene-1,3,6,8-tetrol
definition: A naphthalenetetrol that is naphthalene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, 6 and 8.

name: phosphate(3−)
definition: A phosphate ion that is the conjugate base of hydrogenphosphate.

name: 1-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl)-5'-AMP
definition: An AMP-sugar in which the hydrogen at position 1 of AMP is substituted by a 5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl group.

name: dermatan sulfate
definition: Any of a group of glycosaminoglycans with repeating units consisting of variously sulfated β1→4-linked L-iduronyl-(α1→3)-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine units.

name: 3-aminoalanine
definition: A diamino acid that is alanine in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is replaced by an amino group.

name: thiamine(1+)
definition: A primary alcohol that is 1,3-thiazol-3-ium substituted by (4-amino-2-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl, methyl and 2-hydroxyethyl groups at positions 3, 4 and 5, respectively.

name: quinaldic acid
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid having the carboxy group at the 2-position.

name: N-formimidoyl-L-aspartate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid anion resuting from removal of a proton from both carboxy groups of N-formimidoyl-L-aspartic acid.

name: apigenin
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4', 5 and 7. It induces autophagy in leukaemia cells.

name: D-gluconate
definition: A gluconate having D-configuration.

name: naphthalene-1,3,8-triol
definition: A naphthalenetriol that is naphthalene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 8.

name: 6-O-α-D-glucopyranosyl-D-fructofuranose
definition: A glycosylfructose that is D-fructofuranose attached to a α-D-glucopyranosyl unit at position 6 via a glycosidic linkage. It is found in honey and sugarcane.

name: 2-phenylethylamine
definition: A phenylethylamine having the phenyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: linear maltodextrin
definition: A maltodextrin in which the α-(1→4)-linked D-glucose units form a linear chain, typically from 3 to 17 glucose units long. (Cf. amylose, in which the chain length ranges from around 300 to several thousand glucose units).

name: 2-hydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone
