definition: The simplest member of the class of 2-hydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones, that is 1,4-benzoquinone in which a single hydrogen is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: phenylacetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of phenylacetic acid.

name: 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid
definition: A steroid acid that is 5β-cholestan-26-oic acid which is substituted by hydroxy groups as the 3α, 7α, and 12α positions.

name: L-arabinitol
definition: The L-enantiomer of arabinitol.

name: 3-methylcatechol
definition: A methylcatechol carrying a methyl substituent at position 3. It is a xenobiotic metabolite produced by some bacteria capable of degrading nitroaromatic compounds present in pesticide-contaminated soil samples.

name: pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
definition: The monophosphate ester obtained by condensation of phosphoric acid with the primary hydroxy group of pyridoxal.

name: AICA ribonucleotide
definition: A 1-(phosphoribosyl)imidazolecarboxamide that is acadesine in which the hydroxy group at the 5' position has been converted to its monophosphate derivative.

name: hydrogen cyanide
definition: A one-carbon compound consisting of a methine group triple bonded to a nitrogen atom

name: cobamamide
definition: A member of the class of cobalamins that is vitamin B12 in which the cyano group is replaced by a 5'-deoxyadenos-5'-yl moiety. It is one of the two metabolically active form of vitamin B12.

name: N-formylanthranilate
definition: An amidobenzoate consisting of anthranilate carrying an N-formyl group.

name: laminarabiose
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of D-glucose with undefined anomeric stereochemistry and a β-D-glucosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: Nω-phospho-L-arginine
definition: An arginine derivative that is L-arginine substituted by a phosphono group at Nω-position.

name: 2',4'-dihydroxyacetophenone
definition: A dihydroxyacetophenone that is acetophenone carrying hydroxy substituents at positions 2' and 4'.

name: lactaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of propanals obtained by the reduction of the carboxylic group of lactic acid (2-hydroxypropanoic acid).

name: 1D-myo-inositol 1,2-cyclic phosphate
definition: A myo-inositol cyclic phosphate that is the 1,2-cyclic phosphate derivative of 1D-myo-inositol.

name: 1D-1-O-methyl-myo-inositol
definition: A member of the class of methyl myo-inositols that is cyclohexane-1,2,3,4,5-pentol substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 (the 1R,2R,3S,4S,5R,6S-isomer).

name: dehydrovomifoliol
definition: A fenchane monoterpenoid that is substituted by methyl groups at positions 3, 5, and 5, and by both a hydroxy group and a 3-oxobut-1-en-1-yl group at position 4.

name: 7α,26-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 7α and 26 positions.

name: (+)-7-isojasmonic acid
definition: An oxylipin that is [(1S)-3-oxocyclopentyl]acetic acid substituted by a (2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl group at position 2 on the cyclopentanone ring.

name: (−)-11-hydroxy-9,10-dihydrojasmonic acid 11-β-D-glucoside
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is (−)-11-hydroxy-9,10-dihydrojasmonic acid attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 11 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 5α-campestan-3-one
definition: A brassinosteroid that is 5α-campestane bearing an oxo substituent at position 3.

name: (2Z)-hexenal
definition: A 2-hexenal in which the olefinic double bond has Z configuration.

name: (E)-1,3-dichloropropene
definition: A 1,3-dichloropropene with a (E)-configuration.

name: (R)-2-trans-abscisic acid
definition: A 2-trans-abscisic acid with (R)-configuration at the chiral centre.

name: (R)-3-chloro-1,2-propanediol
definition: The (R)-stereoisomer of 3-chloro-1,2-propanediol.

name: D-pipecolate
definition: The D-enantiomer of pipecolate.

name: epibromohydrin
definition: An epoxide that is oxirane substituted by a bromomethyl group at position 2.

name: 3-chloropropane-1,2-diol
definition: A chloropropane-1,2-diol that is propane-1,2-diol substituted by a chloro group at position 3.

name: (S)-2-trans-abscisic acid
definition: A 2-trans-abscisic acid with (S)-configuration at the chiral centre.

name: (S)-mevalonate
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of mevalonate.

name: (Z)-1,3-dichloropropene
definition: The (Z)-isomer of 1,3-dichloropropene.

name: (Z)-2-aminobutenoic acid
definition: A 2,3-dehydroamino acid resulting from the formal elimination of water from the side-chain of threonine.

name: (Z,Z,Z)-geranylgeraniol
definition: A geranylgeraniol in which all double bonds have Z- (cis-) geometry.

name: 1'-deoxyabscisic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is abscisic acid in which the tertiary hydroxy group is replaced by a hydrogen.

name: 1,1-dimethylhydrazine
definition: A member of the class of hydrazines that is hydrazine substituted by two methyl groups at position 1.

name: 1,2,3,4-tetrachlorobenzene
definition: A tetrachlorobenzene carrying chloro groups at positions 1, 2 , 3 and 4.

name: 1,3-dichloropropan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is isopropanol in which one hydrogen of each methyl group is substituted by a chlorine. A liquid at room temperature (melting point −4°C, boiling point 174°C at 760 mm Hg), it is used as a solvent for hard resins and nitrocellulose.

name: 1,3-dinitroglycerol
definition: A dinitroglycerol that is glycerol in which both of the primary hydroxy groups have been converted to the corresponding nitrate estes.

name: 1-(3-aminopropyl)pyrrolinium
definition: An organic cation that is 1-pyrroline bearing an N-(3-aminopropyl) substituent.

name: 1-aminopropan-2-ol
definition: Any amino alcohol that is propan-2-ol substituted by an amino group at position 1.

name: 1-bromo-2-chloroethane
definition: A haloalkane that is bromoethane substituted by chlorine at position 2.

name: 1-methylguanosine
definition: Guanosine substituted with a methyl group at position N-1.

name: 1-methylinosine
definition: Inosine carrying a methyl substituent at position 1 on the hypoxanthine ring.

name: 1-methylpseudouridine
definition: A methylpseudouridine in which the methyl group is located at position N-1 on the uracil ring.

name: 1-mononitroglycerol
definition: A mononitroglycerol that is glycerol in which the hydrogen atom of the hydroxy group at position 1 is replaced by a nitro group.

name: (13S)-12,13-epoxyoctadeca-9,11-dienoic acid
definition: A C18, polyunsaturated, epoxy fatty acid having double bonds at positions 9 and 11, and a (13S)-12,13-epoxy group.

name: 12-HETE
definition: A HETE that is icosa-5,8,10,14-tetraenoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 12. It is a metabolite of arachidonic acid.

name: 12-oxo-cis-dodec-9-enoic acid
definition: A C12, ω-oxo fatty acid with a double bond at position 9; found in soybean, a metabolite of both linolenic and linoleic acids.

name: 12-oxo-trans-10-dodecenoic acid
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid comprising dodecanoic acid having a trans-double bond at the 10-position and a 12-oxo group.

name: 1H-pyrrole
definition: A tautomer of pyrrole that has the double bonds at positions 2 and 4.

name: 2'-O-methyl-5-methyluridine
definition: A methyluridine that consists of uridine bearing two methyl substituents located at position C-5 on the uracil ring and position O-2' on the ribose ring.

name: 2'-O-methyluridine
definition: A methyluridine that consists of uridine bearing a single methyl substituent located at position O-2' on the ribose ring.

name: 2'-O-methylguanosine
definition: Guanosine with the hydrogen on the hydroxyl at position C-2' substituted with a methyl group.

name: 2'-O-methylpseudouridine
definition: A methylpseudouridine in which the methyl group is located at position O-2' on the ribose ring.

name: 2'-α-mannosyl-L-tryptophan
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is L-tryptophan in which the hydrogen at position 2 on the indole protion has been replaced by an α-mannosyl residue.

name: N2,N2-dimethylguanosine
definition: A guanosine where the hydrogens of the amine group at C-2 are substituted by methyl groups.

name: 2,22,25-trideoxyecdysone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is 5β-cholestane containing a double bond between positions 7 and 8, and substituted by an oxo group at position 6 and by hydroxy groups at the 3β and 14α positions.

name: (2,4,5-trichlorophenoxy)acetate
definition: A chlorophenoxyacetate anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (2,4,5-trichlorophenoxy)acetic acid.

name: 2,4,6-trichloroanisole
definition: A monomethoxybenzene that is 1,3,5-trichlorobenzene in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: 2,4-diamino-6-hydroxylaminotoluene
definition: A member of the class of aminotoluenes that is 2,4-diaminotoluene bearing an additional hydroxylamino substituent at position 6.

name: 2,4-diamino-6-nitrotoluene
definition: A member of the class of amino-nitrotoluenes that is 2,4-diaminotoluene bearing a nitro substituent at position 6.

name: 2,4-dichloro-3-oxoadipate(2−)
definition: An oxo dicarboxylate that is the conjugate base of 2,4-dichloro-3-oxoadipic acid arising from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (2,4-dichlorophenoxy)acetate
definition: A chlorophenoxyacetate anion that is the conjugate base of (2,4-dichlorophenoxy)acetic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 2,4-dihydroxylamino-6-nitrotoluene
definition: A member of the class of nitrotoluenes that is ortho-nitrotoluene bearing two additional hydroxylamino substituents located at the two positions meta to the nitro group.

name: 2,5-bis(aziridin-1-yl)-1,4-benzoquinone
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-benzoquinones that is p-benzoquinone in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 are replaced by aziridin-1-yl groups.

name: 2,5-dichloro-4-oxohex-2-enedioate(2−)
definition: An oxo dicarboxylate obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 2,5-dichloro-4-oxohex-2-enedioic acid.

name: 2,6-diamino-4-nitrotoluene
definition: A member of the class of amino-nitrotoluenes that is 2,6-diaminotoluene bearing a nitro substituent at position 4.

name: 2,6-dibromophenol
definition: A dibromophenol that is phenol in which both of the hydrogens that are ortho to the phenolic hydroxy group have been replaced by bromines.

name: 3-(acetamidomethylene)-2-(hydroxymethyl)succinate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by removal of a proton from both of the carboxylic acid groups of 3-(acetamidomethylidene)-2-(hydroxymethyl)succinic acid.

name: 2-amino-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioic acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid that is but-2-enedioic acid substituted by an amino group at position 2 and a 3-oxoprop-1-enyl group at position 3.

name: 2-amino-4,6-dinitrotoluene
definition: An amino-nitrotoluene that is 4,6-dinitrotoluene substituted at position 2 by an amino group.

name: 2-aminohexano-6-lactam
definition: An amino acid amide obtained by the intramolecular condensation of the terminal amino group with the carboxy group in lysine.

name: 2-aminopentanoic acid
definition: An α-amino acid that is valeric acid which is substituted at position 2 by an amino group.

name: 2-chloro-3-oxoadipic acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid that is adipic acid which is substituted by a chloro group at position 2 and by an oxo group at position 3.

name: propachlor
definition: An anilide that consists of 2-chloroacetanilide bearing an N-isopropyl substituent.

name: 2-deoxyecdysone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is 5β-cholestane containing a double bond between positions 7 and 8, and substituted by an oxo group at position 6 and by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 14α, 22 pro-R and 25 positions.

name: 2-fluorobenzoic acid
definition: A 2-halobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid carrying a fluoro substituent at position 2.

name: 2-hexenal
definition: A hexenal having the double bond at the 2-position.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-carboxybenzylidenepyruvic acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid consisting of pyruvic acid having a 2-hydroxy-3-carboxybenzylidene group at the 3-position.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylbenzylidenepyruvic acid
definition: An 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid consisting of pyruvic acid having a 2-hydroxy-3-methylbenzylidene group at the 3-position.

name: 2-hydroxy-4-hydroxymethylbenzylidenepyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that results from the formal aldol condensation of the methyl group of pyruvic acid with the aldehyde group of 2-hydroxy-4-(hydroxymethyl)benzaldehyde.

name: 2-hydroxyisobutyrate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxyisobutyric acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyisophthalic acid
definition: A hydroxybenzoic acid that is isophthalic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-hydroxylamino-4,6-dinitrotoluene
definition: A member of the class of nitrotoluenes that is 4,6-dinitrotoluene bearing an additional hydroxylamino substituent at position 2.

name: 2-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A long-chain fatty acid that is stearic (octadecanoic) acid substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-methyladenosine
definition: A methyladenosine in which the methyl group is located at position 2 on the adenine ring.

name: N2-methylguanosine
definition: Guanosine with the hydrogen on the amine at position N-2 substituted with a methyl group.

name: 2-mononitroglycerol
definition: A mononitroglycerol that is glycerol in which the hydrogen atom of the hydroxy group at position 2 is replaced by a nitro group.

name: (2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-en-1-yl)acetate
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of (2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-en-1-yl)acetic acid.

name: quinaldate
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylate that is the conjugate base of quinaldic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 24-methylenecholesterol
definition: A 3β-sterol having the structure of cholesterol with a methylene group at C-24.

name: 25-deoxyecdysone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is ecdysone in which the hydroxy group at position 25 is replaced by a hydrogen.

name: 3',4'-dihydroxyacetophenone
definition: A dihydroxyacetophenone that is acetophenone carrying hydroxy groups at positions 3' and 4'.

name: 3,4-dihydroxyphenylpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group.

name: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxybenzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides carrying two bromo substituents at positions 3 and 5 as well as a hydroxy substituent at position 4.

name: β-(Nπ-L-histidino)-L-tyrosine
definition: An L-tyrosine in which one of the β-hydrogens in L-tyrosine is replaced by a L-histidino group joined via the Nπ-position.

name: 3-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)uridine
definition: A derivative of uridine, bearing an additional 3-amino-3-carboxypropyl substituent at position 5 on the uracil ring.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy carboxylic acid that is 3-phenylpropionic acid in which one of the hydrogens β to the carboxy group is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 3-O-methylgallate
definition: A member of the class of benzoates that results from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 3-O-methylgallic acid.

name: 3-amino-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate
definition: A β-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-amino-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 3-chloroacrylic acid
definition: A chlorocarboxylic acid that is acrylic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 is substituted by chlorine.

name: 3-chlorobenzoate
definition: A chlorobenzoate that is the conjugate base of 3-chlorobenzoic acid.

name: 3-fluorobenzoic acid
definition: A fluorobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by a fluoro group at position 3.

name: 3-hexenal
definition: A hexenal carrying an unsaturation at position 3.

name: 3-hydroxy-5-oxohexanoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-hydroxy-5-oxohexanoic acid obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 3-hydroxy-5-oxohexanoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo- and hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA whose S-acyl component is derived from 3-hydroxy-5-oxohexanoic acid.

name: 3-hydroxy-L-proline
definition: The L-stereoisomer of 3-hydroxyproline.

name: 3-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: A straight-chain 3-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid comprising a butyric acid core with a single hydroxy substituent in the 3- position; a ketone body whose levels are raised during ketosis, used as an energy source by the brain during fasting in humans. Also used to synthesise biodegradable plastics.

name: 3-dehydrosphingosine
definition: A sphingoid that is the 3-keto analogue of sphingosine.

name: vanillylmandelic acid
definition: An aromatic ether that is the 3-O-methyl ether of 3,4-dihydroxymandelic acid.

name: 3-methoxyanthranilate
definition: An aminobenzoate that results from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 3-methoxyanthranilic acid.

name: 3-methylsalicylaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes that is salicylaldehyde in which the hydrogen ortho- to the hydroxy group is substituted by a methyl group.

name: 3-methylsalicylic acid

name: glutaramic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide that is formally derived from glutaric acid by conversion of one of the two carboxylic acid groups to the corresponding amide.

name: 2-phosphoglyceric acid
definition: A monophosphoglyceric acid having the phospho group at the 2-position.

name: 1,3,5-trinitro-1,3,5-triazinane
definition: An N-nitro compound that is 1,3,5-triazinane in which all three of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogens have been replaced by nitro groups. It is widely used in both industrial and military explosives.

name: cyclohexane-1,2-diol
definition: A diol that consists of a cyclohexane skeleton carrying two hydroxy substituents.

name: 1-hexene
definition: An alkene that is hexane carrying a double bond at position 1.

name: hycanthone mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of hycanthone and methanesulfonic acid. It was formerly used as a schistosomicide for individual or mass treatement of infection with Schistosoma haematobium and S. mansoni, but due to its toxicity and concern about possible carcinogenicity, it has been replaced by other drugs such as praziquantel.

name: proton
definition: Nuclear particle of charge number +1, spin ½ and rest mass of 1.007276470(12) u.

name: 4-hydroxyindole
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: 5'-hydroxystreptomycin
definition: A streptomycin bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at the 5'-position (on the furanose ring)

name: hypochlorous acid
definition: A chlorine oxoacid with formula HOCl; a weak, unstable acid, it is the active form of chlorine in water.

name: 3-(imidazol-5-yl)lactate
definition: The hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-(imidazol-5-yl)lactic acid.

name: iminodiacetate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the carboxy groups of iminodiacetic acid.

name: iminodiacetic acid
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid that is glycine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is substituted by a carboxymethyl group.

name: indolylmethylglucosinolate
definition: A glucosinolate that is the conjugate base of indolylmethylglucosinolic acid.

name: indole-3-carboxylic acid
definition: An indole-3-carboxylic acid carrying a carboxy group at position 3.

name: 3-(indol-3-yl)lactic acid
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is lactic acid substituted by a 1H-indol-3-yl group at position 3. It is a metabolite of tryptophan.

name: indole-3-methanol
definition: An indolyl alcohol carrying a hydroxymethyl group at position 3. It is a constituent of the cruciferous vegetables and had anticancer activity.

name: inositol
definition: Any cyclohexane-1,2,3,4,5,6-hexol.

name: iodine atom
definition: Chemical element with atomic number 53.

name: laballenic acid
definition: A C18, 5,6-allenic fatty acid.

name: lactate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of lactic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: lactosamine
definition: A disaccharide that consists of D-glucosamine having a β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: lanthionine
definition: An alanine derivative in which two alanine residues are linked on their β-carbons by a thioether linkage.

name: leucine
definition: A branched-chain amino acid that consists of glycine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the α-carbon is substituted by an isobutyl group.

name: lombricine
definition: A serine derivative that is serine in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group has been replaced by a (2-carbamimidamidoethoxy)(hydroxy)phosphoryl group.

name: lysine
definition: A diamino acid that is caproic (hexanoic) acid bearing two amino substituents at positions 2 and 6.

name: manganate
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of both protons from manganic acid.

name: manganese(4+)
definition: A manganese cation that is monoatomic and has a formal charge of +4.

name: mannobiose
definition: A glycosylmannose that is D-mannopyranose attached to a β-D-mannopyranosyl group at position 4 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: p-menthan-3-ol
definition: Any secondary alcohol that is one of the eight possible diastereoisomers of 5-methyl-2-(propan-2-yl)cyclohexan-1-ol.

name: 1,4-dimercaptobutane-2,3-diol
definition: A glycol that is butane-2,3-diol in which a hydrogen from each of the methyl groups is replaced by a thiol group.

name: meso-lanthionine
definition: The meso-isomer of lanthionine. It is a key constituent of bacterial peptidoglycan type A51 and A3δ.

name: mesobilirubin IXα
definition: A biladiene that is a homologue of bilirubin IXα (vinyl groups reduced to ethyl), a natural product of heme catabolism and the primary pigment of bile acid.

name: methacrylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of methacrylic acid.

name: methacrylic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is acrylic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by a methyl group.

name: methanesulfonate
definition: A 1,1-diunsubstituted alkanesulfonate that is the conjugate base of methanesulfonic acid.

name: methyl methanesulfonate
definition: A methanesulfonate ester resulting from the formal condensation of methanesulfonic acid with methanol.

name: 3-methylmalic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is succinic acid carrying hydroxy and methyl substituents at positions 2 and 3 respectively.

name: mugineic acid
definition: An azetidinecarboxylic acid that is the parent of the class of mugineic acids.

name: bis(2-chloroethyl) sulfide
definition: An ethyl sulfide that is diethyl sulfide in which a hydrogen from each of the terminal methyl groups is replaced by a chlorine. It is a powerful vesicant regulated under the Chemical Weapons Convention.

name: myrtenic acid
definition: A monoterpenoid that is 6,6-dimethylbicyclo[3.1.1]hept-2-ene substituted by a carboxy group at position 2.

name: myxothiazol
definition: A 2,4'-bi-1,3-thiazole substituted at the 4-position with a (1E,3S,4R,5E)-7-amino-3,5-dimethoxy-4-methyl-7-oxohepta-1,5-dien-1-yl] group and at the 2'-position with a (2S,3E,5E)-7-methylocta-3,5-dien-2-yl group. It is an inhibitor of coenzyme Q - cytochrome c reductase.

name: neoxanthin
definition: An epoxycarotenoid that is 6,7-didehydro-5,5',6,6'-tetrahydro-5',6'-epoxy-β,β-carotene which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3, 3', and 5 positions.

name: neuraminate
definition: A member of the class of neuraminates obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of keto-neuraminic acid.

name: nitrilotriacetate(3−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion resulting from the deprotonation of all three hydroxy groups of nitrilotriacetic acid.

name: 2-hydroxylaminobenzoic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substutited by a hydroxyamino group at position 2.

name: 2-nitrobenzoic acid
definition: A nitrobenzoic acid carrying the nitro substituent at position 2.

name: octadecanoate
definition: A fatty acid anion 18:0 that is the conjugate base of octadecanoic acid (stearic acid). Stearates have a variety of uses in the pharmaceutical industry.

name: octamethylcyclotetrasiloxane
definition: A cyclosiloxane that is the octamethyl derivative of cyclotetrasiloxane.

name: octanoate
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of octanoic acid (caprylic acid); believed to block adipogenesis.

name: Nω,N'ω-dimethyl-L-arginine
definition: A L-arginine derivative having two methyl groups at the Nω- and N'ω-positions

name: orotidine
definition: A nucleoside formed by attaching orotic acid to a ribose ring via a β‒N(1)-glycosidic bond.

name: ozone
definition: An elemental molecule with formula O3. An explosive, pale blue gas (b.p. −112°C) that has a characteristic, pungent odour, it is continuously produced in the upper atmosphere by the action of solar ultraviolet radiation on atmospheric oxygen. It is an antimicrobial agent used in the production of bottled water, as well as in the treatment of meat, poultry and other foodstuffs.

name: p-cumate
definition: A cumate that is the conjugate base of p-cumic acid.

name: 1,7-dimethylxanthine
definition: A dimethylxanthine having the two methyl groups located at positions 1 and 7. It is a metabolite of caffeine and theobromine in animals.

name: pelargonidin
definition: An anthocyanidin cation that is flavylium substituted by a hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 7 and 4'.

name: pentaerythritol dinitrate
definition: A pentaerythritol nitrate in which two of the hydroxy groups of pentaerythritol have been converted to the corresponding nitrate ester.

name: pentaerythritol tetranitrate
definition: A pentaerythritol nitrate in which all four hydroxy groups of pentaerythritol have been converted to the corresponding nitrate ester. It is a vasodilator with properties similar to those of glyceryl trinitrate, but with a more prolonged duration of action, and is used for treatment of angina pectoris. It is also one of the most powerful high explosives known and is a component of the plastic explosive known as Semtex.

name: dihydrotricetin
definition: A pentahydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 3', 4' and 5'.

name: peroxynitrite
definition: The nitrogen oxoanion formed by loss of a proton from peroxynitrous acid.

name: phenylacetonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acetonitrile where one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a phenyl group.

name: 3-phenyllactic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is lactic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a phenyl group.

name: phosphoric acid
definition: A phosphorus oxoacid that consists of one oxo and three hydroxy groups joined covalently to a central phosphorus atom.

name: phytochromobilin
definition: A member of the class of bilins which functions as the chromophore of light-sensing phytochromes in plants.

name: pinocarveol
definition: A pinane monoterpenoid that is a bicyclo[3.1.1]heptane substituted by two methyl groups at position 6, a methylidene group at position 2 and a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: polyprenol
definition: Any member of the class of prenols possessing the general formula H-[CH2C(Me)=CHCH2]nOH in which the carbon skeleton is composed of more than one isoprene units.

name: proline
definition: An α-amino acid that is pyrrolidine bearing a carboxy substituent at position 2.

name: prometryn
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is N,N'-di(propan-2-yl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a methylsulfanediyl group at position 6.

name: propionitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acrylonitrile in which the carbon-carbon double bond has been reduced to a single bond.

name: heme b
definition: A metalloprotoporphyrin in which the four pyrrole nitrogens of the protoporphyrin moiety are coordinated to iron. It is the most abundant of the heme compounds.

name: p-menth-4(8)-en-3-one
definition: A p-menthane monoterpenoid that is cyclohexan-1-one substituted by a methyl group at position 5 and a propan-2-ylidene group at position 2.

name: retinoic acid
definition: A retinoid consisting of 3,7-dimethylnona-2,4,6,8-tetraenoic acid substituted at position 9 by a 2,6,6-trimethylcyclohex-1-en-1-yl group (geometry of the four exocyclic double bonds is not specified).

name: selenocystathionine
definition: A member of the class of cystathionines derived from homoselenocysteine and serine residues joined by a selenide bond.

name: selenodiglutathione
definition: A thioselenide in which a selenium atom is attached to the sulfur atoms of two molecules of glutathione. It is an initial metabolite of selenite, SeO32−.

name: singlet dioxygen
definition: A reactive oxygen species that is the lowest excited state of the dioxygen molecule.

name: sodium hydrogensulfite
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having hydrogensulfite as the counterion.

name: sodium chloride
definition: An inorganic chloride salt having sodium(1+) as the counterion.

name: solanesol
definition: A nonaprenol that is hexatriaconta-2,6,10,14,18,22,26,30,34-nonaen-1-ol substituted by 9 methyl groups at positions 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, 31 and 35 (the all-trans0stereoisomer).

name: sphing-4-enine
definition: A sphingenine in which the C=C double bond is located at the 4-position.

name: sterculynic acid
definition: A long-chain, polyunsaturated fatty acid composed of 9-octadecenoic acid having a terminal alkyne group and a 9,10-cyclopropenyl group.

name: streptothricin
definition: An N-glycosyl compound consisting of 2-amino-4-O-carbamoyl-2-deoxy-N-[(3aS,7R,7aS)-7-hydroxy-4-oxooctahydro-2H-imidazo[4,5-c]pyridin-2-ylidene]-β-D-gulopyranosylamine in which the amino group at position 2 of the gulopyranosyl moiety is acylated by a peptide unit made up of between 1 and 7 Nε-linked units of β-lysine.

name: sulfolipid I
definition: The principal sulfolipid class of virulent human Mycobacterium tuberculosis strain H(37)Rv.

name: sulfuric acid
definition: A sulfur oxoacid that consists of two oxo and two hydroxy groups joined covalently to a central sulfur atom.

name: technetium dioxide
definition: A metal oxide with formula TcO2.

name: tetrachlorocatechol
definition: A chlorocatechol that is catechol in which all of the hydrogens attached to the benzene ring are replaced by chlorines.

name: oxolane
definition: A cyclic ether that is butane in which one hydrogen from each methyl group is substituted by an oxygen.

name: desmethyl tocotrienol
definition: A tocotrienol that is chroman-6-ol substituted by a methyl group at position 2 and a farnesyl group at position 2.

name: toluene-4-sulfonate
definition: An arenesulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of toluene-4-sulfonic acid.

name: cis,trans-muconate
definition: A muconate that is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of both the carboxy groups of cis,trans-muconic acid.

name: trans,trans-muconate
definition: A muconate that is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of both the carboxy groups of trans,trans-muconic acid.

name: trans,trans-muconic acid
definition: The trans,trans-isomer of muconic acid. It is metabolite of benzene in humans and serves as a biomarker of occupational exposure to benzene.

name: trans-2-carboxybenzylidenepyruvate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from removal of a proton from both carboxy groups of trans-2-carboxybenzylidenepyruvic acid.

name: (3S,4S)-3,4-dihydroxy-L-proline
definition: A L-proline derivative that is L-proline substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 (the 3S,4S diastereoisomer).

name: (2E)-5-isopropyl-2-methylhexa-2,5-dienal
definition: A hexadienal that is hexa-2,5-dienal substituted by a an isopropyl group at position 5 and a methy group at position 2 (the 2E-stereoisomer).

name: trans-2,6-dimethyl-5-methylenehept-2-enoic acid
definition: A 2,6-dimethyl-5-methylenehept-2-enoic acid having E-configuration.

name: trans-4-(3-hydroxy-1-benzothiophen-2-yl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate
definition: A 4-(3-hydroxy-1-benzothiophen-2-yl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate in which the acyclic double bond has E-geometry.

name: trehalose
definition: A disaccharide formed by a (1↔1)-glycosidic bond between two units of D-glucose.

name: triaziquone
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-benzoquinones that is 1,4-benzoquinone in which three of the ring hydrogens are replaced by aziridin-1-yl groups.

name: trimethylarsine
definition: An arsine that is arsane in which each of the hydrogens is substituted by a methyl group.

name: typhasterol
definition: A brassinosteroid that is ergostan-6-one bearing three additional hydroxy substituents at positions 3α, 22R and 23R.

name: uridin-5-yloxyacetic acid
definition: A derivative of uridine, bearing an additional carboxymethoxy substituent at position 5 on the uracil ring.

name: methyl uridin-5-yloxyacetate
definition: A methyl ester that is uridine which is substituted at position 5 on the uracil ring by a methoxycarbonylmethoxy group.

name: urocanate
definition: An monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of urocanic acid.

name: urocanic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is prop-2-enoic acid substituted by a 1H-imidazol-4-yl group at position 3. It is a metabolite of hidtidine.

name: valine
definition: A branched-chain amino acid that consists of glycine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the α-carbon is substituted by an isopropyl group.

name: 1D-chiro-inositol
definition: Belonging to the inositol family of compounds, D-chiro-inositol (DCI) is an isomer of glucose. It is an important secondary messenger in insulin signal transduction.

name: pantothenol
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is 3,3-dimethylbutanamide substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4 and a 3-hydroxypropyl group at the carbomyl nitrogen.

name: methanesulfonic acid
definition: An alkanesulfonic acid in which the alkyl group directly linked to the sulfo functionality is methyl.

name: 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-24-oxo-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A cholestanoyl-CoA formed by thioester linkage between 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-24-oxo-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid and coenzyme A.

name: 2,2',3-trihydroxydiphenyl ether
definition: Diphenyl ether in which the hydrogens at the 2, 3, and 2' positions are substituted by hydroxy groups.

name: 2-thienylacetonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acetonitrile where one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2-thienyl group.

name: 3-(4-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-5-yl)propanoic acid
definition: An imidazol-4-one having a 2-carboxyethyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: tetrachloromethane
definition: A chlorocarbon that is methane in which all the hydrogens have been replaced by chloro groups.

name: cinnamic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that consists of acrylic acid bearing a phenyl substituent at the 3-position. It is found in Cinnamomum cassia.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp-(1→6)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two α-D-galactopyranose residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: benzoylacetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of benzoylacetic acid.

name: 3-aminoisobutyric acid
definition: A β-amino-acid that is isobutyric acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by an amino group.

name: ω-aminoaldehyde
definition: An amino aldehyde that is an aliphatic aldehyde in which one of the hydrogens of the terminal methyl group has been replaced by an amino group. H2NCH2(CH2)nCHO, where n = 0, 1, 2, etc.

name: UDP-3-O-(3-hydroxytetradecanoyl)-D-glucosamine
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having 3-O-(3-hydroxytetradecanoyl)-D-glucosamine as the amino sugar component.

name: 1,2,6-tris-O-galloyl-β-D-glucose
definition: A galloyl-β-D-glucose compound having the galloyl groups in the 1-, 2- and 6-positions.

name: deisopropylatrazine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is N-ethyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a chloro group at position 6.

name: (S)-3-hydroxypalmitoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain (3S)-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (S)-3-hydroxypalmitic acid.

name: 3α,7α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A cholestanoyl-CoA formed by thioester linkage between 3α,7α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestanoic acid and coenzyme A.

name: streptidine
definition: An amino cyclitol that is scyllo-inositol in which the hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 3 are replaced by guanidino groups.

name: kinetin
definition: A member of the class of 6-aminopurines that is adenine carrying a (furan-2-ylmethyl) substituent at the exocyclic amino group.

name: manniflavanone
definition: A biflavonoid isolated from Garcinia buchananii and has been shown to exhibit antioxidant activity.

name: N-methyl-6-pyridone-3-carboxamide
definition: A pyridone that is 2-pyridone substituted with a carboxamide group at C-5 and a methyl group at N-1.

name: β-aminopropionitrile
definition: An aminopropionitrile carrying an amino group at the β-position.

name: p-xylene
definition: A xylene with methyl groups at positions 1 and 4.

name: 1,4-naphthoquinone
definition: The parent structure of the family of 1,4-naphthoquinones, in which the oxo groups of the quinone moiety are at positions 1 and 4 of the naphthalene ring. Derivatives have pharmacological properties.

name: dehydrodeoxycoformycin
definition: A coformycin that is dehydrocoformycin with the hydroxy group at position 2 replaced with a hydrogen.

name: 3-hydroxykynurenamine
definition: A hydroxykynurenamine that is kynurenamine carrying a hydroxy group at position 3. It is a metabolite of tryptophan that exhibits antiinflammatory and immunomodulatory properties.

name: (KDO)2-(lauroyl)-lipid IVA
definition: A lipid A comprising lipid IVA glycosylated with two 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues and carrying an additional dodecanoyl group.

name: 7-O-methylluteone
definition: A hydroxyisoflavone that is luteone in which the hydroxy group at position 7 is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: α-linolenic acid
definition: A linolenic acid with cis-double bonds at positions 9, 12 and 15. Shown to have an antithrombotic effect.

name: gibberellin A53
definition: A C20-gibberellin, initially identified in Vicia faba, that is gibberellin A12 in which a hydroxy substituent is present at the 7α- position.

name: o-tolualdehyde
definition: A tolualdehyde compound with the methyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: 1-methylpyrrolinium
definition: An organic cation that is 1-pyrroline bearing an N-methyl substituent.

name: methyltestosterone
definition: A 17β-hydroxy steroid that is testosterone bearing a methyl group at the 17α position.

name: (KDO)-lipid IVA
definition: Lipid IVA glycosylated with a single 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residue.

name: 3-methoxyanthranilic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is anthranilic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a methoxy group. It is a metabolite of kynurenine.

name: D-prephenyl lactate
definition: A carboxylic acid having D-lactic acid as the carboxylic acid component and a 3-hydroxycyclohexa-1,4-diene as the alcohol component.

name: β-D-fucose
definition: A D-fucopyranose with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: but-3-yn-1-ol
definition: A terminal acetylenic compound that is but-1-yne with one of the methyl hydrogens substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: maltohexaose
definition: A maltohexaose hexasaccharide in which the glucose residue at the reducing end is in the aldehydo open-chain form.

name: phenoxymethylpenicillin
definition: A penicillin compound having a 6β-(phenoxyacetyl)amino side-chain.

name: lutein 5,6-epoxide
definition: An epoxycarotenol derivative of lutein.

name: N-propanoylimidazole
definition: An N-acylimidazole compound having propanoyl as the acyl group.

name: N-3,5-dichloro-4-hydroxyphenyl-1,4-benzoquinone imine
definition: 1,4-benzoquinone imine having a 3,5-dichloro-4-hydroxyphenyl substituent attached to the nitrogen atom.

name: styrene
definition: A vinylarene that is benzene carrying a vinyl group. It has been isolated from the benzoin resin produced by Styrax species.

name: 1-chloro-2,2-bis(4'-chlorophenyl)ethylene
definition: A chlorophenylethylene that is chloroethene in which the methylene hydrogens are replaced by 4-chlorophenyl groups.

name: trichloroacetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that results from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of trichloroacetic acid.

name: undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetyl-(N-acetylglucosaminyl)muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-isoglutaminyl-(glycyl)5-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine
definition: An undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetylmuramoyl peptide in which the peptide moiety is L-alanyl-D-isoglutaminyl-N6-pentaglycyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine.

name: 3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A cholestanoyl-CoA formed by thioester linkage between 3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid and coenzyme A.

name: N-glycoloyl-D-glucosamine
definition: An N-glycoloylglucosamine of D configuration.

name: selenohomocystine
definition: A diselenide resulting from the dehydrogenation reaction between two units of 2-amino-4-selanylbutanoic acid.

name: (S)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain (3S)-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (S)-3-hydroxytetradecanoic acid.

name: 5,6-dihydrothymine
definition: A pyrimidone obtained by formal addition of hydrogen across the 5,6-position of thymine.

name: 2-dehydro-D-gluconic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid that is D-gluconic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been oxidised to a keto group.

name: folic acid
definition: An N-acyl-amino acid that is a form of the water-soluble vitamin B9. Its biologically active forms (tetrahydrofolate and others) are essential for nucleotide biosynthesis and homocysteine remethylation.

name: glycodeoxycholic acid
definition: A bile acid glycine conjugate of deoxycholic acid.

name: cyanidin 3-O-β-D-galactoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation that is cyanidin(1+) carrying a single β-D-galactosyl substituent at position 3.

name: β-D-ribopyranose
definition: A D-ribopyranose with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: D-valine
definition: The D-enantiomer of valine.

name: 2'-hydroxydaidzein
definition: A hydroxyisoflavone that is daidzein bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 2'.

name: phenylacetylglycine
definition: A N-acylglycine that is glycine substituted on nitrogen with a phenylacetyl group.

name: prostaglandin J2
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins J that consists of prosta-5,9,13-trien-1-oic acid substituted by an oxo group at position 11 and a hydroxy group at position 15 (the 5Z,13E,15S stereoisomer).

name: 16,17-didehydropregnenolone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-Δ5-steroid that is pregnenolone with a double bond between positions 16 and 17.

name: 3-(imidazol-5-yl)lactic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is lactic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by an imidazol-5-yl group.

name: 2-fluorobenzoyl-CoA
definition: A fluorobenzoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-fluorobenzoic acid.

name: leukotriene F4
definition: A leukotriene composed of (7E,9E,11Z,14Z)-icosa-7,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid having (5S)-hydroxy and (6R)-(L-γ-glutamyl-L-cystein-S-yl) substituents.

name: juvenile hormone III
definition: A member of the juvenile hormone family of compounds that is the methyl ester of (2E,6E)-9-[(2R)-3,3-dimethyloxiran-2-yl]-3,7-dimethylnona-2,6-dienoic acid. Juvenile hormone III is found in most insect species.

name: sophoraisoflavanone A
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanone that is isoflavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 4', a methoxy substituent at position 2' and a prenyl group at position 3'.

name: simazine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is N,N'-diethyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a chloro group at position 6.

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-3-methyl-2,6-dideoxy-β-L-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-3-methyl-2,6-dideoxy-β-L-glucose as the sugar component.

name: 4-aminobenzenesulfonic acid
definition: An aminobenzenesulfonic acid that is aniline sulfonated at the para-position.

name: aldehydo-D-mannosamine
definition: A D-mannosamine in open-chain aldehydo-form.

name: 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholest-24-en-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholest-24-en-26-oic acid.

name: neoglucobrassicin
definition: An indolyl carbohydrate that is glucobrassicin methoxy substituted at position 1 of the indole moiety.

name: cinchonine
definition: Cinchonan in which a hydrogen at position 9 is substituted by hydroxy (S configuration). It occurs in the bark of most varieties of Cinchona shrubs, and is frequently used for directing chirality in asymmetric synthesis.

name: umbelliferone
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is coumarin substituted by a hydroxy group ay position 7.

name: precorrin-6X
definition: The intermediate in the biosynthesis of vitamin B12 from uroporphyrinogen III in which six methyl groups have been introduced into the tetrapyrrole framework, together with ring contraction.

name: rutinose
definition: A glycosylglucose in which the glycosyl moiety is L-rhamnose linked α to C-6 of D-glucose.

name: 3-(6-hydroxyindol-3-yl)lactate
definition: The hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-(6-hydroxyindol-3-yl)lactic acid.

name: 2-fluoroaniline
definition: A derivative of aniline in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been substituted by fluorine. It is used as a pharmaceutical intermediate

name: P1,P2-bis(5'-adenosyl) triphosphate
definition: A diadenosyl triphosphate having the two 5'-adenosyl residues attached at the P1- and P2-positions.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxohexanoic acid
definition: A hydroxy- and oxo- fatty acid comprising hexanoic acid substituted at C-2 and C-4 with oxo and hydroxy groups respectively.

name: trans-oct-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-oct-2-enoic acid.

name: isatin
definition: An indoledione that is the 2,3-diketo derivative of indole.

name: hexanoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA having hexanoyl as the S-acyl group.

name: 3',5'-cyclic IMP
definition: A 3',5'-cyclic purine nucleotide having hypoxanthine as the nucleobase.

name: methyl oleate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with methanol.

name: 2,5-dichlorohydroquinone
definition: A dichlorohydroquinone that is hydroquinone substituted by chloro groups at positions 2 and 5 respectively.

name: O6-methyl-2'-deoxyguanosine
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside having O6-methylguanine as the nucleobase.

name: 5-methylcytosine
definition: A pyrimidine that is a derivative of cytosine, having a methyl group at the 5-position.

name: 4'-methoxy-5,7-dihydroxyflavanone
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and a methoxy group at position 4' (the 2S stereoisomer).

name: α-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-β-D-mannose
definition: The β-anomer of α-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-D-mannopyranose

name: prostaglandin C2
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins C that is prosta-5,11,13-trien-1-oic acid carrying oxo and hydroxy substituents at positions 9 and 15 respectively (the 5Z,13E,15S-stereoisomer).

name: oxirane
definition: A saturated organic heteromonocyclic parent that is a three-membered heterocycle of two carbon atoms and one oxygen atom.

name: 20-hydroxy-20-oxoleukotriene B4
definition: A member of the class of leukotrienes that is leukotriene B4 in which the terminal methyl group has undergone formal oxidation to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: 2-amino-3-methyl-3,7-dihydro-6H-purin-6-one
definition: A 3-methylguanine that is 3,7-dihydro-6H-purin-6-one substituted by an amino group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 3.

name: 4-aminosalicylic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is salicylic acid substituted by an amino group at position 4.

name: 6-prenylnaringenin
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone having a structure of naringenin prenylated at C-6.

name: histidine
definition: An α-amino acid that is propanoic acid bearing an amino substituent at position 2 and a 1H-imidazol-4-yl group at position 3.

name: 3'-ketolactose
definition: A keto-disaccharide that is β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the galactosyl moiety has been oxidised to the corresponding ketone.

name: adenosine 5'-[γ-thio]triphosphate
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate analogue that is ATP in which one of the oxygens attached to 3-phosphate group is replaced by sulfur.

name: α-amino-γ-cyanobutanoic acid
definition: An α-amino acid that is 2-aminobutanoic acid substituted at position 4 by a cyano group.

name: 5-ureidoimidazole-4-carboxylic acid
definition: An imidazole-4-carboxylic acid compound having a ureido substituent at the 5-position.

name: 7-hydroxy-6-methyl-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine
definition: The pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a methyl group at C-6, a hydroxy group at C-7 and a 1-D-ribityl group at N-8.

name: aldosterone
definition: A pregnane-based steroidal hormone produced by the outer-section (zona glomerulosa) of the adrenal cortex in the adrenal gland, and acts on the distal tubules and collecting ducts of the kidney to cause the conservation of sodium, secretion of potassium, increased water retention, and increased blood pressure. The overall effect of aldosterone is to increase reabsorption of ions and water in the kidney.

name: selenomethionine
definition: A selenoamino acid that is the selenium analogue of methionine.

name: β-L-rhamnopyranose
definition: The β-anomer of L-rhamnopyranose.

name: garbanzol
definition: A member of the class of dihydroflavonols that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 7 and 4'.

name: procyanidin B4
definition: A proanthocyanidin obtained by the condensation of (−)-epicatechin and (+)-catechin units.

name: 7-hydroxyflavanone 7-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A flavanone 7-O-β-D-glucoside that consists of 7-hydroxyflavanone attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: ectoine
definition: A carboxamidine heterocycle obtained by formal condensation of (2S)-2,4-diaminobutanoic acid with acetic acid.

name: 4-(2-amino-3-hydroxyphenyl)-2,4-dioxobutanoic acid
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid that is benzene in which the hydrogens at position 1, 2 and 3 are replaced by 3-carboxy-3-oxopropanoyl, amino and hydroxy groups, respectively. It is a by-product of tryptophan metabolism.

name: 11-epi-prostaglandin F2α
definition: The prostaglandin F that is the 11-epimer of prostaglandin F2α.

name: Nπ-methyl-L-histidine
definition: A L-histidine derivative that is L-histidine substituted by a methyl group at position 3 on the imidazole ring.

name: 3-(5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)pyruvic acid
definition: A hydroxyindole that is indole substituted by a 2-carboxy-2-oxoethyl group at position 2 and a hydroxy group at position 5.

name: 4-hydroxyphthalic acid
definition: A hydroxybenzoic acid that is phthalic acid in which the hydrogen at position 4 is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: O-α-D-glucosyl poly(glycerol phosphate) macromolecule
definition: A poly(glycerol phosphate) macromolecule having α-D-glucosyl residues at the secondary hydroxy groups on the repeating units.

name: 1F-α-D-galactosylraffinose
definition: A tetrasaccharide consisting of raffinose, to the furanose O-1 position of which is linked an α-D-galactosyl group.

name: D-psicose
definition: The D-enantiomer of psicose.

name: thymol
definition: A phenol that is a natural monoterpene derivative of cymene.

name: cyclohexa-2,5-diene-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cyclohexa-2,5-diene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: (2-naphthyl)methanol
definition: A naphthylmethanol that is methanol in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a (2-naphthyl) group.

name: psoralen
definition: The simplest member of the class of psoralens that is 7H-furo[3,2-g]chromene having a keto group at position 7. It has been found in plants like Psoralea corylifolia and Ficus salicifolia.

name: monensin A
definition: A spiroketal, monensin A is the major component of monensin, a mixture of antibiotic substances produced by Streptomyces cinnamonensis. An antiprotozoal, it is used as the sodium salt as a feed additive for the prevention of coccidiosis in poultry and as a growth promoter in cattle.

name: chalcone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is acetophenone in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a benzylidene group.

name: vanillylmandelate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of vanillylmandelic acid.

name: prostaglandin B1
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins B that is prosta-8(12),13-dien-1-oic acid carrying oxo and hydroxy substituents at positions 9 and 15 respectively (the 13E,15S-stereoisomer).

name: 4-isopropylbenzyl alcohol
definition: A member of the class of benzyl alcohols in which the hydrogen at position 4 on the phenyl ring of benzyl alcohol has been replaced by an isopropyl group.

name: precorrin-5
definition: The intermediate in the biosynthesis of vitamin B12 from uroporphyrinogen III in which five methyl groups have been introduced into the tetrapyrrole framework, together with ring contraction.

name: 5-hydroxyindoleacetylglycine
definition: An N-acylglycine resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetic acid with the amino group of glycine.

name: acetophenone
definition: A methyl ketone that is acetone in which one of the methyl groups has been replaced by a phenyl group.

name: 2,6-dichlorohydroquinone
definition: A dichlorohydroquinone that is hydroquinone substituted by chloro groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: 5,6α-epoxy-5α-cholestane
definition: The epoxy steroid formed from cholest-5-ene by formal addition of oxygen across the 5,6 double bond with α-configuration at both C-5 and C-6.

name: 3,4-dihydroxymandelic acid
definition: A catechol that is the 3,4-dihydroxy derivative of mandelic acid; a metabolite of L-dopa.

name: cobalt atom
definition: A cobalt group element atom that has atomic number 27.

name: (E)-2-benzylidenesuccinyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (E)-2-benzylidenesuccinic acid.

name: cycloheximide
definition: A dicarboximide that is 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperidine-2,6-dione in which one of the hydrogens attached to the carbon bearing the hydroxy group is replaced by a 3,5-dimethyl-2-oxocyclohexyl group. It is an antibiotic produced by the bacterium Streptomyces griseus.

name: methyl tert-butyl ether
definition: An ether having methyl and tert-butyl as the two alkyl components.

name: chlortetracycline
definition: A member of the class of tetracyclines with formula C22H23ClN2O8 isolated from Streptomyces aureofaciens.

name: dTDP-3-dehydro-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3-dehydro-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: 3-oxohexanoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 3-oxohexanoic acid.

name: isomaltotriose
definition: A glucotriose consisting of two α-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: 2',3'-cyclic CMP
definition: A 2',3'-cyclic pyrimidine nucleotide in which cytidine is the parent nucleoside.

name: davidigenin
definition: A member of the class of dihydrochalcones that is dihydrochalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 2', and 4' respectively.

name: camptothecin
definition: A pyranoindolizinoquinoline that is pyrano[3',4':6,7]indolizino[1,2-b]quinoline which is substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 14, and by an ethyl group and a hydroxy group at position 4 (the S enantiomer).

name: N-succinyl-L-glutamic 5-semialdehyde
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide obtained by the formal condensation of amino group of L-glutamic 5-semialdehyde with one of the carboxy groups of succinic acid.

name: convallatoxin
definition: A cardenolide glycoside that consists of strophanthidin having a 6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranosyl (L-rhamnosyl) group attached at position 3.

name: 2-oxocyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: A 3-oxoacyl-CoA having its S-acyl component derived from 2-oxocyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid.

name: β-D-galactose
definition: A D-galactopyranose having β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: (S)-3-hydroxylauroyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (S)-3-hydroxydodecanoic acid.

name: neoastilbin
definition: A flavanone glycoside that is (−)-taxifolin substituted by a α-L-rhamnosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: herbacetin
definition: A pentahydroxyflavone that is kaempferol substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8. It is a natural flavonoid from flaxseed which exerts antioxidant, anti-inflammatory and anticancer activities.

name: chlorohydroquinone
definition: A benzenediol that consists of hydroquinone bearing a single chloro substituent.

name: L-histidinal
definition: An amino aldehyde obtained by partial reduction of the carboxy group of L-histidine

name: 4-fluorobenzoyl-CoA
definition: A fluorobenzoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 4-fluorobenzoic acid.

name: dTDP-3-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: betagarin
definition: An extended flavonoid that is 6,7-methylenedioxyflavanone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 5 and 2' respectively.

name: (S)-2-acetyl-2-hydroxybutanoic acid
definition: A 3-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is butanoic acid in which the hydrogens at position 2 are replaced by an acetyl and a hydroxy group (the S enantiomer).

name: 2-hydroxy-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)prop-2-enoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is acrylic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by a hydroxy group and a hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: 3-deoxyleucocyanidin
definition: A leucoanthocyanidin that is the 3-deoxy derivative of (2R,3S,4S)-leucocyanidin.

name: flavonol 3-O-D-xylosyl-D-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that consists of flavonol attached to a D-xylosyl-D-glucosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 3-demethylubiquinone-8
definition: A polyprenylbenzoquinone that is fumigatin which is substituted by an all-trans-octaprenyl group at position 6.

name: decanoate
definition: A fatty acid anion 10:0 that is the conjugate base of decanoic acid.

name: lipid II
definition: An undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetyl-(N-acetylglucosaminyl)muramoyl peptide in which the peptide element is L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine.

name: sitosterol
definition: A member of the class of phytosterols that is stigmast-5-ene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3.

name: glutaurine
definition: A dipeptide resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of taurine with the γ-carboxy group of L-glutamic acid. It was initially found in the parathyroid in 1980 and later in the brain of mammals.

name: oxytetracycline
definition: A tetracycline used for treatment of infections caused by a variety of Gram positive and Gram negative microorganisms including Mycoplasma pneumoniae, Pasteurella pestis, Escherichia coli, Haemophilus influenzae (respiratory infections), and Diplococcus pneumoniae.

name: S-hexylglutathione
definition: An S-substituted glutathione that is glutathione in which the hydrogen of the thiol has been replaced by a hexyl group (PDB entry: 1PN9).

name: (+)-vernolic acid
definition: An optically active form of vernolic acid having (12S,13R)-configuration.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose linked via a (1→3)-glycosidic bond to N-acetyl-D-glucosamine.

name: diethyl hydrogen phosphate
definition: A dialkyl phosphate having ethyl as the alkyl group.

name: diethyl sulfide
definition: An ethyl sulfide compound having two ethyl groups attached to a sulfur atom.

name: precorrin-3B
definition: The intermediate in the biosynthesis of vitamin B12 from uroporphyrinogen III in which three methyl groups have been introduced at positions 2, 7 and 20 of the tetrapyrrole framework and in which the carboxymethyl group at position 2 has been oxidised to form a lactone ring.

name: thioetheramide PC
definition: A member of the class of 1-thio-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholines that is (2S)-2-amino-3-sulfanylpropyl 2-(trimethylazaniumyl)ethyl phosphate in which the amino group is substituted by a palmitoyl group and the thiol is substituted by a palmityl group. It is a reversible inhibitor of secretory phospholipase A2.

name: 6-acetyl-2-amino-3,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrimido[4,5-b][1,4]diazepin-4-one
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidodiazepine 3,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrimido[4,5-b][1,4]diazepin-4-one bearing amino and acetyl substituents at positions 2 and 6 respectively.

name: 3-chlorocatechol
definition: A chlorocatechol that is catechol in which the hydrogen adjacent to one of the hydroxy groups is replaced by a chlorine.

name: gibberellin A1
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi.

name: GDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-L-mannose
definition: A GDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-6-deoxy-L-mannose as the sugar component.

name: 2-methylbenzyl alcohol
definition: A methylbenzyl alcohol that is toluene in which one of the ortho hydrogens has been replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: butin
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone in which the three hydroxy substituents are located at positions 3', 4' and 7. It is found in Acacia mearnsii, Vernonia anthelmintica and Dalbergia odorifera and has a protective affect against oxidative stress-induced mitochondrial dysfunction.

name: digitonin
definition: A spirostanyl glycoside that is digitogenin in which the 3-hydroxy group is substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→2)-[β-D-xylopyranosyl-(1→3)]-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactopyranosyl group. It is a steroidal saponin isolated from the foxglove plant, Digitalis purpurea. It is used extensively as a mild non-ionic detergent for extracting proteins from membranes for structure and function studies.

name: D-isoleucine
definition: The D-enantiomer of isoleucine.

name: caffeine
definition: A trimethylxanthine in which the three methyl groups are located at positions 1, 3, and 7. A purine alkaloid that occurs naturally in tea and coffee.

name: γ-carotene
definition: A cyclic carotene obtained by the cyclisation of lycopene.

name: gibberellin A20
definition: A C19-gibberellin that is a pentacyclic diterpenoid responsible for promoting growth and development. Initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi, it differs from gibberellin A1 in lacking an OH group at C-2 (gibbane numbering).

name: glyphosate
definition: A phosphonic acid resulting from the formal oxidative coupling of the methyl group of methylphosphonic acid with the amino group of glycine. It is one of the most commonly used herbicides worldwide, and the only one to target the enzyme 5-enolpyruvyl-3-shikimate phosphate synthase (EPSPS).

name: L-homoarginine
definition: An L-lysine derivative that is the L-enantiomer of homoarginine.

name: D-ribosylnicotinic acid
definition: A pyridine nucleoside consisting of nicotinic acid with a β-D-ribofuranosyl moiety at the 1-position.

name: β-alanyl-L-lysine
definition: A dipeptide consisting of β-alanine and L-lysine units joined by a peptide linkage.

name: ethyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester formed between acetic acid and ethanol.

name: methacrylyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of methacrylic acid.

name: 4-chlorobiphenyl
definition: A monochlorobiphenyl carrying a chloro substituent at position 4.

name: 3,4-dihydroxybenzenesulfonic acid
definition: A benzene ring substituted with a sulphonic acid group at position C-1, and hydroxy groups at C-3 and C-4.

name: L-selenocystathionine
definition: An optically active form of selenocystathionine in which both amino acid residues have L-configuration.

name: (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate.

name: 3',4',5,6-tetrahydroxy-3,7-dimethoxyflavone
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is the 3,7-di-O-methyl derivative of quercetagetin.

name: 2',6'-dimethoxy-4'-hydroxyacetophenone
definition: A monohydroxyacetophenone that is acetophenone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 2' and 6' and a hydroxy group at position 4'.

name: nonanoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of nonanoic acid.

name: 4-chlorocatechol
definition: A chlorocatechol that is catechol substituted by a chloro group at position 4.

name: lubimin
definition: A vetispirane sesquiterpenoid that consists of (2R,5S,6S,8S,10R)-8-hydroxy-10-methyl-2-(prop-1-en-2-yl)spiro[4.5]decane bearing a formyl substituent at position 6.

name: P1,P3-bis(5'-adenosyl) triphosphate
definition: A diadenosyl triphosphate having the two 5'-adenosyl residues attached at the P1- and P3-positions.

name: geissospermine
definition: A indole alkaloid comprising two indole-derived polycyclic moieties joined by a cyclic ether linkage.

name: acetohydroxamic acid
definition: A member of the class of acetohydroxamic acids that is acetamide in which one of the amino hydrogens has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: griseofulvin
definition: An oxaspiro compound produced by Penicillium griseofulvum. It is used by mouth as an antifungal drug for infections involving the scalp, hair, nails and skin that do not respond to topical treatment.

name: myristoleic acid
definition: A tetradecenoic acid in which the double bond is at the 9-10 position and has Z configuration. Myristoleic acid has been isolated from Serenoa repens and has cytotoxic and apoptosis-inducing effects.

name: 3'-dehydro-ATP
definition: A ribonucleotide that is the 3'-dehydro derivative of adenosine 5'-triphosphate.

name: 1,2-dichloroethane
definition: A member of the class of chloroethanes substituted by two chloro groups at positions 1 and 2.

name: P1,P4-bis(uridin-5'-yl) tetraphosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-tetraphosphate compound having 5'-uridinyl residues at the P1- and P4-positions.

name: β-carotene 5,6-epoxide
definition: An epoxycarotenoid of β-carotene.

name: isoferulic acid
definition: A ferulic acid consisting of trans-cinnamic acid bearing methoxy and hydroxy substituents at positions 4 and 3 respectively on the phenyl ring.

name: β-erythroidine
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic indole alkaloid isolated from the seeds and other parts of Erythrina species. It differs from the α isomer in having the double bond of the dihydropyranone ring located β,γ- to the lactone carbonyl group instead of α,β-.

name: trimethobenzamide
definition: The amide obtained by formal condensation of 3,4,5-trihydroxybenzoic acid with 4-[2-(N,N-dimethylamino)ethoxy]benzylamine. It is used to prevent nausea and vomitting in humans.

name: nitrobenzene
definition: A nitroarene consisting of benzene carrying a single nitro substituent. An industrial chemical used widely in the production of aniline.

name: 2,3-dihydroxybenzenesulfonic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzenesulfonic acid in which the hydroxy groups are located at positions 2 and 3.

name: cyclohexanecarboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of cyclohexanecarboxylic acid.

name: heroin
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is morphine bearing two acetyl substituents on the O-3 and O-6 positions. As with other opioids, heroin is used as both an analgesic and a recreational drug. Frequent and regular administration is associated with tolerance and physical dependence, which may develop into addiction. Its use includes treatment for acute pain, such as in severe physical trauma, myocardial infarction, post-surgical pain, and chronic pain, including end-stage cancer and other terminal illnesses.

name: L-4-hydroxyglutamic semialdehyde
definition: A glutamic semialdehyde that is L-glutamic 5-semialdehyde substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: resorcinol
definition: A benzenediol that is benzene dihydroxylated at positions 1 and 3.

name: undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetyl-(N-acetylglucosaminyl)muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-isoglutaminyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine
definition: An undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetylmuramoyl peptide in which the peptide moiety is L-alanyl-D-isoglutaminyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine.

name: Se-methyl-L-selenocysteine
definition: An L-α-amino acid compound having methylselanylmethyl as the side-chain.

name: 12-dehydro-leukotriene B4
definition: A long-chain fatty acid consisting of leukotriene B4 having a 12-keto group in place of the 12-hydroxy group.

name: clavaldehyde
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that is clavulanic acid in which the allylic alcohol group has been oxidised to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: (S)-methylmalonaldehydic acid
definition: A 2-methyl-3-oxopropanoic acid that has S-configuration.

name: 2-aminobenzimidazole
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is benzimidazole in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by an amino group.

name: (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetic acid
definition: A member of the class of indole-3-acetic acids that is indole-3-acetic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at C-5.

name: thiamine(1+) aldehyde
definition: A heteroarenecarbaldehyde that is thiamine(1+) in which the 2-hydroxyethyl group has been replaced by a 2-oxoethyl group.

name: 3',5-dihydroxy-3,4',7-trimethoxyflavone
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is quercetin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4' and 7 have been replaced by methoxy groups.

name: (S)-4-hydroxymandelonitrile β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside consisting of (S)-prunasin carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the phenyl ring.

name: paraoxon
definition: An aryl dialkyl phosphate where both the alkyl groups are ethyl and the aryl group is 4-nitrophenyl.

name: N6,N6,O-tridemethylpuromycin 5'-phosphate
definition: A puromycin 5'-phosphate compound lacking three methyl substituents (two from the exocyclic amino function of the adenine moiety and one from the phenolic function).

name: pentostatin
definition: A member of the class of coformycins that is coformycin in which the hydroxy group at position 2' is replaced with a hydrogen. It is a drug used for the treatment of hairy cell leukaemia.

name: dodecanal
definition: A long-chain fatty aldehyde that is dodecane in which two hydrogens attached to a terminal carbon are replaced by an oxo group.

name: 2-cyanopyridine
definition: A cyanopyridine carrying the cyano group at position 2.

name: N-methyl-4-pyridone-3-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of 4-pyridones that is 4-pyridone substituted with a carboxamide group at C-3 and a methyl group at N-1.

name: 2,4-dimethylaniline
definition: A primary arylamine that is aniline in which the hydrogens at the 2- and 4-positions are replaced by methyl groups. A clear to yellow liquid, it is used in production of certain dyes, pesticides and other chemicals.

name: DDD
definition: A chlorophenylethane that is 2,2-bis(p-chlorophenyl)ethane substituted by two chloro groups at position 1. It is a metabolite of the organochlorine insecticide, DDT.

name: sulfoglucobrassicin
definition: An indolylmethylglucosinolic acid that is glucobrassicin bearing an additional sulfo group on the indole nitrogen.

name: cyanidin cation
definition: An anthocyanidin cation that is flavylium substituted at positions 3, 3', 4', 5 and 7 by hydroxy groups.

name: ditrans,polycis-polyprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenol diphosphate that contains two double bonds in trans-configuration and an unspecified chain-length with double bonds in cis-configuration.

name: 3-iodo-L-tyrosine
definition: The monoiodotyrosine that is L-tyrosine carrying an iodo-substituent at position C-3 of the benzyl group.

name: toluene-4-sulfonic acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is benzenesulfonic acid in which the hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by a methyl group.

name: keto-neuraminic acid
definition: The open-chain form of neuraminic acid.

name: 3,4-dihydroxymandelaldehyde
definition: A hydroxyaldehyde consisting of phenylacetaldehyde having three hydroxy substituents located at the α-, 3- and 4-positions. It is a metabolite of noradrenaline.

name: L-erythro-3-methylmalyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of L-erythro-3-methylmalic acid.

name: acetamide
definition: A member of the class of acetamides that results from the formal condensation of acetic acid with ammonia.

name: (1→4)-β-D-mannan
definition: A mannan composed from D-mannan residues joined by β-(1→4) linkages.

name: precorrin-6Y
definition: The intermediate in the biosynthesis of vitamin B12 from uroporphyrinogen III in which six methyl groups have been introduced into the tetrapyrrole framework, together with ring contraction and reduction.

name: castanospermine
definition: A tetrahydroxyindolizidine alkaloid that consists of octahydroindolizine having four hydroxy substituents located at positions 1, 6, 7 and 8 (the 1S,6S,7R,8R,8aR-diastereomer).

name: 2,6-dichloro-4-nitroaniline
definition: A nitroaniline that is 4-nitroaniline in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 6 are replaced by chlorines. An agricultural fungicide, it is not approved for use in the European Union.

name: fucosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol consisting of stigmastan-3β-ol with double bonds at positions 5 and 24(28).

name: (2,3,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-enyl)acetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2,3,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-enyl)acetic acid.

name: antheraxanthin
definition: An epoxycarotenol that is β-carotene-3,3'-diol in which one of the one of the endocyclic double bonds has been oxidised to the corresponding epoxide. It is a neutral yellow plant pigment found in Euglenophyta.

name: 3-oxolauroyl-CoA
definition: An oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 3-oxolauroic acid.

name: chloroacetic acid
definition: A chlorocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid carrying a 2-chloro substituent.

name: biocytin
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that results from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of biotin with the N6-amino group of L-lysine.

name: chloroacetaldehyde
definition: Acetaldehyde substituted at C-2 by chlorine.

name: 3-fluoroaniline
definition: A derivative of aniline in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been substituted by fluorine. It is used as a pharmaceutical intermediate.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl-CoA
definition: An S-alkyl-CoA having 3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl as the S-alkyl component.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysyl-D-alanine
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-glycosaminyl glycopeptide consisting of an N-acetyl-β-D-glycosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetylmuramoyl moiety attached to the amino terminus of the tetrapeptide L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysyl-D-alanine via an amide linkage.

name: 2-naphthylamine
definition: A naphthylamine carrying the amino group at position 2.

name: 6-methylpretetramide
definition: A member of the class of pretetramides in which the only additional substituent is a methyl group at position 6.

name: resveratrol
definition: A stilbenol that is stilbene in which the phenyl groups are substituted at positions 3, 5, and 4' by hydroxy groups.

name: (S)-colchicine
definition: A colchicine that has (S)-configuration. It is a secondary metabolite, has anti-inflammatory properties and is used to treat gout, crystal-induced joint inflammation, familial Mediterranean fever, and many other conditions.

name: GDP-6-deoxy-L-mannose
definition: A GDP-sugar having 6-deoxy-L-mannose as the sugar component.

name: S-sulfo-L-cysteine
definition: An S-substituted L-cysteine where the S-substituent is specified as a sulfo group.

name: 4-fluorobenzoate
definition: A fluorobenzoate that is the conjugate base of 4-fluorobenzoic acid.

name: tryptophan
definition: An α-amino acid that is alanine bearing an indol-3-yl substituent at position 3.

name: cisplatin
definition: A diamminedichloroplatinum compound in which the two ammine ligands and two chloro ligands are oriented in a cis planar configuration around the central platinum ion. An anticancer drug that interacts with, and forms cross-links between, DNA and proteins, it is used as a neoplasm inhibitor to treat solid tumours, primarily of the testis and ovary. Commonly but incorrectly described as an alkylating agent due to its mechanism of action (but it lacks alkyl groups).

name: tetracycline
definition: A broad-spectrum polyketide antibiotic produced by the Streptomyces genus of actinobacteria.

name: (2,4,5-trichlorophenoxy)acetic acid
definition: A chlorophenoxyacetic acid that is phenoxyacetic acid in which the ring hydrogens at postions 2, 4 and 5 are substituted by chlorines.

name: D-erythrose
definition: The D-enantiomer of erythrose.

name: phenyl hydrogen sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is phenol bearing an O-sulfo substituent.

name: ubiquinone-0
