definition: A derivative of benzoquinone carrying a 5-methyl substituent; and methoxy substituents at positions 2 and 3. The core structure of the ubiquinone group of compounds.

name: α-L-rhamnopyranose
definition: An L-rhamnopyranose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: paraldehyde
definition: A trioxane that is 1,3,5-trioxane substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 4 and 6.

name: 7-dehydrodesmosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol having the structure of desmosterol with an extra double bond at C-7—C-8.

name: N8-acetylspermidine
definition: An acetylspermidine that is 1,8-diamino-4-azaoctane in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group attached to C-8 is replaced by an acetyl group.

name: melamine
definition: A trimer of cyanamide, with a 1,3,5-triazine skeleton.

name: 2'-hydroxychalcone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2'.

name: luteone
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone substituted by additional hydroxy groups at positions 5, 2' and 4' and a prenyl group at position 6.

name: phenylhydrazine
definition: A phenylhydrazine that is the monophenyl derivative of hydrazine.

name: 2,5-dichlorophenol
definition: A dichlorophenol with the chloro substituents at positions 2 and 5.

name: indan-2-one
definition: An indanone with an oxo substituent at position 2. It is a metabolite of indane.

name: α-maltotriose
definition: A maltotriose trisaccharide in which the glucose residue at the reducing end is in the pyranose ring form and has α configuration at the anomeric carbon atom..

name: 3-methoxy-4-hydroxyphenylglycolaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of glycolaldehydes that is 3,4-dihydroxymandelaldehyde in which the hydroxy group at position 4 is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: chaulmoogric acid
definition: A monounsaturated long-chain fatty acid composed of tridecanoic acid having a 2-cyclopentenyl substituent at the 13-position.

name: harmalol
definition: A harmala alkaloid in which the harman skeleton is hydroxy-substituted at C-7 and has been reduced across the 3,4 bond.

name: isoflavanone
definition: Isoflavone in which the double bond between positions 2 and 3 has been reduced to a single bond.

name: D-histidine
definition: An optically active form of histidine having D-configuration.

name: dTDP-α-D-desosamine
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3-dimethylamino-3,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose (α-D-desosamine) as the sugar component.

name: (E)-sinapaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of cinnamaldehydes that is cinnamaldehyde substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4 and methoxy groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: (R)-3-hydroxy-2-oxo-4-phosphonooxybutanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 2-oxobutanoic acid which is substituted by a phosphonooxy group at position 4 and a hydroxy group at the 3-pro-R position.

name: streptamine
definition: An amino cyclitol consisting of scyllo-inositol with the hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 3 replaced by unsubstituted amino groups.

name: L-dehydroascorbic acid
definition: Dehydroascorbic acid having the L-configuration.

name: hydroxyacetone
definition: A propanone that is acetone in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: cocaine
definition: A tropane alkaloid obtained from leaves of the South American shrub Erythroxylon coca.

name: Nγ-nitro-L-arginine
definition: An L-arginine derivative that is L-arginine in which the terminal nitrogen of the guanidyl group is replaced by a nitro group.

name: conessine
definition: A steroid alkaloid that is con-5-enine substituted by a N,N-dimethylamino group at position 3. It has been isolated from the plant species of the family Apocynaceae.

name: mesaconyl-CoA
definition: An ω-carboxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the 1-carboxy group of mesaconic acid.

name: 2-aminoisobutyric acid
definition: A rare, non-protein amino acid and end-product of pyrimidine metabolism, excreted in urine and found in some antibiotics of fungal origin. With the exception of a few bacteria, it is non-metabolisable, and therefore used in bioassays.

name: estriol
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is estra-1,3,5(10)-trien-3-ol substituted by additional hydroxy groups at positions 16 and 17 (16α,17β-stereoisomer).

name: L-glyceraldehyde
definition: The L-enantiomer of glyceraldehyde.

name: 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetaldehyde
definition: A phenylacetaldehyde in which the 3 and 4 positions of the phenyl group are substituted by hydroxy groups.

name: all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoic acid.

name: 3,5-dinitro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 3,5-dinitro-4-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: (2-methylphenyl)acetonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acetonitrile where one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2-methylphenyl group.

name: 4,6-diamino-5-formamidopyrimidine
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is 4,6-diaminopyrimidine bearing an additional formamido substituent at position 5. A DNA lesion formed when DNA exposed to ionising radiation.

name: nitrosobenzene
definition: A nitroso compound that is the nitroso derivative of benzene; a diamagnetic hybrid of singlet O2 and azobenzene.

name: muco-inositol
definition: An inositol that is cyclohexane-1,2,3,4,5,6-hexol having a (1R,2R,3r,4R,5S,6r)-configuration.

name: UDP-2-deoxyglucose
definition: A UDP-sugar having 2-deoxyglucose as the sugar component.

name: 3-ethoxybenzoic acid
definition: An ethoxybenzoic acid carrying an ethoxy substituent at position 3.

name: benzonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is hydrogen cyanide in which the hydrogen has been replaced by a phenyl group.

name: trans-4-hydroxy-D-proline
definition: A 4-hydroxy-D-proline in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has S-configuration.

name: 1,2-di-O-sinapoyl-β-D-glucose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that is β-D-glucose carrying sinapoyl groups at the 1- and 2-positions.

name: luteolin 7-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is luteolin substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 3-methylbenzyl alcohol
definition: A methylbenzyl alcohol that is toluene in which one of the meta hydrogens has been replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: elaidic acid
definition: A 9-octadecenoic acid and the trans-isomer of oleic acid.

name: tolbutamide
definition: An N-sulfonylurea that consists of 1-butylurea having a tosyl group attached at the 3-position.

name: vancomycin
definition: A complex glycopeptide from Streptomyces orientalis. It inhibits a specific step in the synthesis of the peptidoglycan layer in the Gram-positive bacteria Staphylococcus aureus and Clostridium difficile.

name: (3Z,6Z)-dodecadienoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cis,cis-dodeca-3,6-dienoic acid.

name: cyclohex-1-ene-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: O,O-diethyl hydrogen thiophosphate
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is the diethyl ester of phosphorothioic O,O,O-acid.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 10-formyltetrahydrofolyl polyglutamate macromolecule
definition: A macromolecule consisting of 10-formyltetrahydrofolic acid with an arbitrary number of glutamate residues attached as a polypeptide to the single existent one.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxocyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: A 3-oxoacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy-6-oxocyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid.

name: β-D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate
definition: A D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: 3,5-dichloro-L-tyrosine
definition: A chloroamino acid that is L-tyrosine carrying chloro- substituents at positions C-3 and C-5 of the benzyl group.

name: 3,3',4',5,7-pentahydroxy-8-methoxyflavone
definition: A monomethoxyflavone that is the 8-O-methyl derivative of gossypetin .

name: 4-cyanopyridine
definition: A cyanopyridine carrying the cyano group at position 4.

name: plastoquinol-9
definition: A plastoquinol in which an all-E nonaprenyl group is attached to position 5 of 2,3-dimethylhydroquinone.

name: 2-hydroxy-5-methyl-cis,cis-muconic semialdehyde
definition: A muconic semialdehyde compound having a hydroxy substituent at the 2-position and a methyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: 6-hydroxy-2-oxohexanoic acid
definition: A hexanoic acid compound having an oxo substituent at the 2-position and a hydroxy substituent at the 6-position.

name: aldehydo-D-rhamnose
definition: The open-chain aldehyde form of D-rhamnose.

name: 4'-hydroxyacetophenone
definition: A monohydroxyacetophenone carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 4'.

name: 5,6β-epoxy-5β-cholestane
definition: The epoxide formed from cholest-5-ene by formal addition of oxygen across the 5,6 double bond with β-configuration at both C-5 and C-6.

name: N-acetyl-D-galactosamine
definition: The D-enantiomer of N-acetylgalactosamine.

name: 5-formyl-3-hydroxy-2-methylpyridine-4-carboxylic acid
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is pyridine-4-carboxylic acid substituted by a methyl group, hydroxy group and formyl group at positions 2,3 and 5, respectively.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-iodophenylpyruvic acid
definition: A phenylpyruvic acid derivative having an iodo substituent at the 3-position and a hydroxy substituent at positions 4.

name: gibberellin A29
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Pharbitis nil. It differs from gibberellin A1 in lacking a β-OH at C-2 but possessing one at C-3 (gibbane numberings).

name: 3-fluorobenzoyl-CoA
definition: A fluorobenzoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-fluorobenzoic acid.

name: 21-hydroxypregnenolone
definition: A hydroxypregnenolone that is pregnenolone which has been substituted by a hydroxy group at position 21.

name: phenylalanine
definition: An aromatic amino acid that is alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a phenyl group.

name: (2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-en-1-yl)acetic acid
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-en-1-yl group.

name: homocarnosine
definition: A histidine derivative that is histidine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the α-amino group has been replaced by a 4-aminobutanoyl group.

name: acetohexamide
definition: An N-sulfonylurea that is urea in which a hydrogen attached to one of the nitrogens is replaced by a p-acetylphenylsulfonyl group, while a hydrogen attached to the other nitrogen is replaced by a cyclohexyl group.

name: melibiose
definition: A glycosylglucose formed by an α-(1→6)-linkage between D-galactose and D-glucose.

name: o-cresol
definition: A cresol that is phenol substituted by a methyl group at position 2. It is a minor urinary metabolite of toluene.

name: aminoparathion
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is 4-aminophenol in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a (diethoxyphosphorothioyl)oxy group. It is a metabolite of parathion.

name: cis-1,2-dithiane-4,5-diol
definition: The cyclic form of dithioerythritol.

name: α-D-galactose
definition: D-Galactopyranose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 2-deoxy-2,3-dehydro-N-acetylneuraminic acid
definition: N-Acetylneuraminic acid reduced across the 2,3-bond with loss of the hydroxy group at C-2; it is a minor component of body fluids although abundant in sialuria.

name: o-xylene
definition: A xylene substituted by methyl groups at positions 1 and 2.

name: cyanidin 3-O-rutinoside
definition: A rutinoside consisting of cyanidin having the rutinosyl group at the 3-position.

name: gentiobiose
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of two D-glucopyranose units connected by a β-(1→6)-linkage.

name: all-trans-ζ-carotene
definition: The all-trans-isomer of ζ-carotene.

name: uridine 2'-phosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 2'-monophosphate having uracil as the nucleobase

name: guanosine 3'-monophosphate
definition: A guanosine 3'-phosphate compound with a monophosphate group at the 3'-position.

name: chromium atom
definition: A chromium group element atom that has atomic number 24.

name: rifampicin
definition: A member of the class of rifamycins that is a a semisynthetic antibiotic derived from Amycolatopsis rifamycinica (previously known as Amycolatopsis mediterranei and Streptomyces mediterranei).

name: 4-chlorophenol
definition: A monochlorophenol substituted at the pare position by a chlorine atom.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxymuconate(2−)
definition: A hexadienedioate compound having a 2-hydroxy substituent.

name: β-mannobiose
definition: The β-isomer of mannobiose.

name: gossypetin 8-rhamnoside
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that consists of gossypetin substituted by a 6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranosyl moiety at position 8 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: genistein
definition: A 7-hydroxyisoflavone with additional hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 4'. It is a phytoestrogenic isoflavone with antioxidant properties.

name: N-hydroxytyrosine
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative obtained by replacement of one of the amino hydrogen by a hydroxy group.

name: 6-hydroxycyanidin
definition: An anthocyanidin cation that is cyanidin substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6.

name: 1-hydroxy-2-naphthaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of naphthaldehydes that is naphthalene-2-carbaldehyde substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: γ-glutamyl-β-aminopropiononitrile
definition: A nitrile that is L-glutamine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the amide nitrogen is replaced by a 2-cyanoethyl group.

name: borneol
definition: A bornane monoterpenoid that is 1,7,7-trimethylbicyclo[2.2.1]heptane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 2-amino-3-oxoadipic acid
definition: A 1,6-dicarboxylic acid compound having an amino substituent at the 2-position and an oxo substituent at the 3-position.

name: chlorobenzene
definition: The simplest member of the class of monochlorobenzenes, that is benzene in which a single hydrogen has been substituted by a chlorine.

name: (1→3)-α-D-glucan
definition: An α-D-glucan in which the glucose units are connected by (1→3) linkages.

name: amylose
definition: A glucan composed of unbranched chains of D-glucopyranose residues in α(1→4) glycosidic linkage. The number of repeated glucose subunits (n) is usually in the range of 300 to 3000, but can be many thousands. One of the two components of starch (the other, 70-80%, being amylopectin). Cf. linear maltodextrin, in which the chain length is typically between 3 and 17 glucose units.

name: pinobanksin
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone in which the three hydroxy substituents are located at positions 3, 5 and 7.

name: isobavachalcone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 2' and 4' and a prenyl group at position 3'.

name: 2-isopropylmalate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the carboxylic acid groups of 2-isopropylmalic acid.

name: nickel atom
definition: Chemical element (nickel group element atom) with atomic number 28.

name: 24,25-dihydrolanosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol formed from lanosterol by reduction across the C-24‒C-25 double bond.

name: 5-guanidino-2-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 2-oxopentanoic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a carbamimidamido group.

name: (+)-catechin 7-O-β-D-xyloside
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is (+)-catechin substituted by a β-D-xylopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: harmine
definition: A harmala alkaloid in which the harman skeleton is methoxy-substituted at C-7.

name: p-cumic acid
definition: A cumic acid that consists of benzoic acid substituted by an isopropyl group at position 4.

name: diethanolamine
definition: A member of the class of ethanolamines that is ethanolamine having a N-hydroxyethyl substituent.

name: 4,4'-methylene-bis-(2-chloroaniline)
definition: A chloroaniline that consists of two 2-chloroaniline units joined by a methylene bridge.

name: all-cis-docosa-4,7,10,13,16,19-hexaenoic acid
definition: A docosahexaenoic acid having six cis-double bonds at positions 4, 7, 10, 13, 16 and 19.

name: 5,6,7-trimethoxycoumarin
definition: A member of the class of coumarins that is coumarin substituted by methoxy groups at positions 5, 6 and 7.

name: 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 3,5-dibromo-4-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: all-trans-phytofluene
definition: The all-trans-isomer of phytofluene.

name: 13,14-dihydro-Δ12-prostaglandin J2
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins J that is prosta-5,9,12-trien-1-oic acid carrying oxo and hydsroxy substituents at positions 11 and 15 respectively (the 5Z,12E,15S-stereoisomer).

name: UDP-3-O-(3-hydroxytetradecanoyl)-N-acetyl-β-glucosamine
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having 3-O-(3-hydroxytetradecanoyl)-N-acetyl-β-glucosamine as the sugar component.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine 6-sulfate
definition: An amino monosaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine substituted at position 6 by a sulfo group.

name: undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetyl-(N-acetylglucosaminyl)muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine
definition: An undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetylmuramoyl peptide in which the peptide element is L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine and in which the muramoyl residue is glucosaminyl-substituted at O-4.

name: bis(4-chlorophenyl)acetic acid
definition: A organochlorine compound comprising acetic acid having two 4-chlorophenyl substituents attached at the 2-position.

name: chloral hydrate
definition: An organochlorine compound that is the hydrate of trichloroacetaldehyde.

name: dibenzofuran
definition: A mancude organic heterotricyclic parent that consists of a furan ring flanked by two benzene rings ortho-fused across the 2,3- and 4,5-positions.

name: sodium stibogluconate
definition: A D-gluconate adduct of indefinite composition containing between 30 and 34% of antimony(V), calculated with reference to dried and methanol-free substance. It is used as a treatment for leishmaniasis.

name: 2',4',6'-trihydroxy-3'-formyldihydrochalcone

name: pinocembrin

name: 6-oxoprostaglandin F1α

name: D-asparagine

name: β-D-xylose

name: 3-(indol-3-yl)propyl phosphate

name: cholesterol β-epoxide
definition: 5,6β-epoxy-5β-cholestan-3β-ol

name: quercetin 3,4',7-trissulfate

name: 6-oxocyclohex-1-ene-1-carbonyl-CoA

name: 2-hydroxycyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA

name: 5-hydroxytryptophan

name: harmaline

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-2,6-dideoxy-β-L-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-2,6-dideoxy-β-L-glucose as the sugar component.

name: theophylline
definition: A dimethylxanthine having the two methyl groups located at positions 1 and 3. It is structurally similar to caffeine and is found in green and black tea.

name: benzamide
definition: An aromatic amide that consists of benzene bearing a single carboxamido substituent. The parent of the class of benzamides.

name: but-3-ynal
definition: A butynal which has a monosubstituted triple bond.

name: 2',3'-cyclic GMP
definition: A 2',3'-cyclic purine nucleotide in which guanosine is used as the parent nucleoside.

name: imidazole-4-methanol
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 4.

name: fustin 3-O-β-D-galactoside
definition: A flavanone glycoside that consists of fustin attached to a β-D-galactosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 7-ethoxycoumarin
definition: A member of the class of coumarins that is umbelliferone in which the hydroxy group at position 7 is replaced by an ethoxy group.

name: α-(hydroxymethyl)serine
definition: A serine derivative in which the α-hydrogen of serine is replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: 3-methylbut-3-enoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-methylbut-3-enoic acid.

name: isomaltose
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of two D-glucopyranose units connected by an α-(1→6)-linkage.

name: 6-α-maltosylglucose
definition: A glucotriose consisting of two α-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: lupanine
definition: The δ-lactam obtained by formal oxidation at the 2-position of sparteine. The major alkaloid from the seeds of Lupinus exaltatus, L. mexicanus and L. rotundiflorus, it is among the most important of the tetracyclic quinolizidine alkaloids.

name: petroselinic acid
definition: The cis-isomer of octadec-6-enoic acid, a long-chain fatty acid.

name: 3α-hydroxy-5β-androstan-17-one
definition: An androstanoid that is 5β-androstane substituted by an α-hydroxy group at position 3 and an oxo group at position 17. It is a metabolite of testosterone in mammals.

name: erythromycin B
definition: An erythromycin that consists of erythronolide B having 2,6-dideoxy-3-C-methyl-3-O-methyl-α-L-ribo-hexopyranosyl and 3,4,6-trideoxy-3-(dimethylamino)-β-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl residues attahced at positions 4 and 6 respectively.

name: daidzein
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone substituted by an additional hydroxy group at position 4'.

name: ferrienterobactin(3−)
definition: Iron (Fe3+) siderophore

name: 2-chloroethanol
definition: A chloroethanol carrying a chloro substituent at position 2.

name: rotenone
definition: A member of the class of rotenones that consists of 1,2,12,12a-tetrahydrochromeno[3,4-b]furo[2,3-h]chromen-6(6aH)-one substituted at position 2 by a prop-1-en-2-yl group and at positions 8 and 9 by methoxy groups (the 2R,6aS,12aS-isomer). A non-systemic insecticide, it is the principal insecticidal constituent of derris (the dried rhizome and root of Derris elliptica).

name: [hydroxy(phenyl)methyl]succinyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of [hydroxy(phenyl)methyl]succinic acid.

name: D-galactosamine 1-phosphate
definition: A galactosamine phosphate that is D-galactosamine substituted at position 1 by a monophosphate group.

name: 5(S)-HETE
definition: A HETE having a (5S)-hydroxy group and (6E)-, (8Z)-, (11Z)- and (14Z)-double bonds.

name: gibberellin A44

name: deethylatrazine
definition: A chloro-1,3,5-triazine that is 6-chloro-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a propan-2-yl group.

name: acrylonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is hydrogen cyanide in which the hydrogen has been replaced by an ethenyl group.

name: 2,6-dihydroxypseudooxynicotine

name: 1,2,4-trichlorobenzene

name: D-leucine
definition: The D-enantiomer of leucine.

name: Nω-methyl-L-arginine
definition: A L-arginine derivative with a Nω-methyl substituent.

name: hesperetin
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone having the three hydroxy gropus located at the 3'-, 5- and 7-positions and an additional methoxy substituent at the 4'-position.

name: 2,4,6-trihydroxybenzophenone
definition: A benzenetriol that is benzophenone in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted at by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 4, and 6.

name: (+)-(3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-3,4-dihydrofluorene
definition: A fluorene derivative obtained by formal dihydroxylation across the 3,4-position of fluorene (the 3S,4R-diastereomer).

name: p-methoxybenzaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes consisting of benzaldehyde itself carrying a methoxy substituent at position 4.

name: indole-3-carbaldehyde
definition: A heteroarenecarbaldehyde that is indole in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a formyl group.

name: dichloroacetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of dichloroacetic acid.

name: papaverine
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is isoquinoline substituted by methoxy groups at positions 6 and 7 and a 3,4-dimethoxybenzyl group at position 1. It has been isolated from Papaver somniferum.

name: octacosan-1-ol
definition: An ultra-long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is octacosane in which a hydrogen attached to one of the terminal carbons is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 11β-hydroxyprogesterone
definition: A 11β-hydroxy steroid that is progesterone substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 11.

name: 2-deoxystreptidine
definition: An amino cyclitol that is streptidine in which the hydroxy group between the two guanidino groups is replaced by hydrogen.

name: 2-hydroxy-5-methyl-cis,cis-muconic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is cis,cis-muconic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 are substituted by hydroxy and methyl groups, respectively.

name: 3-carboxymethylmuconic acid
definition: Muconic acid (stereochemistry of C=C bonds unspecified) substituted at the 3-position by a carboxymethyl group.

name: N-acetyl-L-phenylalanyl-L-diiodotyrosine
definition: A dipeptide composed of N-acetyl-L-phenylalanine and 3,5-diiodo-L-tyrosine joined together by a peptide linkage. It is a synthetic substrate for pepsin.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methyloxindole
definition: A methylindole that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one substituted by methyl and a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: vomifoliol
definition: A fenchane monoterpenoid that is 3,5,5-trimethylcyclohex-2-en-1-one substituted by a hydroxy and a (1E)-3-hydroxybut-1-en-1-yl group at position 4.

name: (S)-3-hydroxyisobutyryl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (S)-3-hydroxyisobutyric acid.

name: (+)-α-pinene
definition: The (+)-enantiomer of α-pinene.

name: dimethyl sulfoxide
definition: A 2-carbon sulfoxide in which the sulfur atom has two methyl substituents.

name: 2,3,5-trichlorobenzene-1,4-diol
definition: A member of the class of chlorohydroquinones that is hydroquinone in which three of the four hydrogens attached to the benzene ring have been replaced by chlorines.

name: 3-oxooctanoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 3-oxooctanoic acid.

name: coenzyme F430
definition: A nickel tetrapyrrole found only in methanogenic Archaea. It is the prosthetic group of the enzyme methyl coenzyme M reductase which catalyses the release of methane in the final step of methanogenesis.

name: fluorene
definition: An ortho-fused tricyclic hydrocarbon that is a major component of fossil fuels and their derivatives

name: 6-oxoprostaglandin E1
definition: A prostaglandin E that is prostaglandin E1 bearing a keto substituent at the 6-position.

name: aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate
definition: An aldehydo-N-acyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate that has acetyl as the acyl group.

name: 3,5-dinitro-L-tyrosine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-tyrosine substituted by nitro groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: (S)-3-hydroxyhexanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (S)-3-hydroxyhexanoyl-CoA.

name: 6-methylthiopurine
definition: A thiopurine that is 9H-purine substituted by a methylsulfanyl group at position 6.

name: 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxylic acid
definition: An imidazole-4-carboxylic acid compound having an amino substituent at the 5-position.

name: 5-methoxyindole-3-acetic acid
definition: A member of the class of indole-3-acetic acids in which the hydrogen at position 5 of indole-3-acetic acid has been replaced by a methoxy group.

name: N-benzyloxycarbonyl-L-leucine
definition: A L-leucine derivative obtained by the substitution of a benzyloxycarbonyl group on the nitrogen atom.

name: capsidiol
definition: An eremophilane sesquiterpenoid that is (+)-5-epi-aristolochene bearing additional 1β- and 3α-hydroxy substituents. It is a phytoalexin produced in Nicotiana and Capsicum plant species in response to pathogen attack.

name: N6,N6-dimethyladenosine
definition: A methyladenosine compound with two methyl groups attached to N6 of the adenine nucleobase.

name: oligomycin A
definition: An oligomycin with formula C45H74011. An inhibitor of mitochondrial F1FO ATP synthase that induces apoptosis in a variety of cell types and exhibits antifungal, antitumour, and nematicidal activities, but its clinical application has been limited by poor solubility in water and other biocompatible solvents.

name: cyclohexane-1,4-dione
definition: A cyclohexanedione with oxo substituents at positions 1 and 4.

name: 5-chloro-3-methylcatechol
definition: A chlorocatechol that iscatechol in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 5 have been replaced by methyl and chlorine, respectively.

name: 3-hydroxyisovaleryl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxyisovaleric acid.

name: dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: 2-deoxystreptamine

name: hydantoin-5-propionic acid
definition: A imidazolidine-2,4-dione that is hydantoin substituted by a 2-carboxyethyl group at position 4.

name: quercetin 3-O-β-D-glucofuranoside

name: glutamine
definition: An α-amino acid that consists of butyric acid bearing an amino substituent at position 2 and a carbamoyl substituent at position 4.

name: 2-chlorobenzoate

name: semicarbazide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is urea where one of the amino groups has been replaced with hydrazine.

name: precorrin-3A
definition: The intermediate in the biosynthesis of vitamin B12 from uroporphyrinogen III in which three methyl groups have been introduced at positions 2, 7 and 20 of the tetrapyrrole framework.

name: xylobiose
definition: A glycosylxylose that is D-xylopyranose having a β-D-xylopyranosyl residue attached at position 4 via a glycosidic bond.

name: 1D-3-O-methyl-myo-inositol
definition: A member of the class of methyl myo-inositols that is cyclohexane-1,2,3,4,5-pentol substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 (the 1S,2R,3R,4S,5S,6R-isomer).

name: indol-3-ylacetaldehyde oxime
definition: An aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of the aldehyde moiety of indol-3-ylacetaldehyde with hydroxylamine.

name: (S)-nornicotine
definition: A pyridine alkaloid that is nicotine lacking the methyl group on the pyrrolidine nitrogen.

name: 6-methoxyluteolin 7-α-L-rhamnoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is luteolin substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 and an α-L-rhamnosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: alloxanthine
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine substituted by oxo groups at positions 4 and 6.

name: 3-aminobutyryl-CoA
definition: An aminobutanoyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-aminobutanoic acid.

name: 3,6-dichlorocatechol
definition: A dichlorocatechol in which the two chloro groups are located at positions 3 and 6.

name: flavonol 3-O-D-xylosyl-D-galactoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that consists of flavonol attached to a D-xylosyl-D-galactosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: (+)-coniine
definition: A 2-propylpiperidine that has S-configuration.

name: 3,4-dihydroxycinnamaldehyde
definition: A cinnamaldehyde that is (E)-cinnamaldehyde substituted at positions 3 and 4 on the phenyl ring by hydroxy groups.

name: 11-deoxycortisol
definition: A deoxycortisol that is cortisol in which the hydroxy group at position 11 has been replaced by a hydrogen.

name: (S)-3-hydroxydecanoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxydecanoic acid.

name: naringenin 7-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A flavanone 7-O-β-D-glucoside that is (S)-naringenin substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: trioxsalen
definition: 7H-Furo[3,2-g]chromen-7-one in which positions 2, 5, and 9 are substituted by methyl groups. Like other psoralens, trioxsalen causes photosensitization of the skin. It is administered orally in conjunction with UV-A for phototherapy treatment of vitiligo. After photoactivation it creates interstrand cross-links in DNA, inhibiting DNA synthesis and cell division, and can lead to cell injury; recovery from the cell injury may be followed by increased melanisation of the epidermis.

name: 4-hydroxy-L-threonine
definition: A hydroxy-amino acid consisting of L-threonine having a hydroxy substituent at the 4-position.

name: scilliroside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is scillirosidin in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is substituted by a β-D-glucopyranoside group. It is a rodenticide extracted from the bulb of the Mediterranean squill plant and was used for the control of Norway rats, black rats, house mice, long-tailed field mice, and field voles.

name: malonamoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of malonamic acid.

name: 3,5-dibromo-L-tyrosine
definition: A bromoamino acid that is L-tyrosine carrying bromo- substituents at positions C-3 and C-5 of the benzyl group.

name: lactose 6'-phosphate
definition: A lactose phosphate in which a single monophosphate substituent is placed at position 6 on the galactose ring of lactose.

name: 2-hydroxyacetophenone
definition: A monohydroxyacetophenone that is acetophenone in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: pyridine-3-carbaldehyde
definition: A pyridinecarbaldehyde that is pyridine substituted by a formyl group at position 3.

name: mescaline
definition: A phenethylamine alkaloid that is phenethylamine substituted at positions 3, 4 and 5 by methoxy groups.

name: 4-hydroxycinnamaldehyde
definition: A cinnamaldehyde that is (E)-cinnamaldehyde substituted at position 4 on the phenyl ring by a hydroxy group.

name: (−)-β-pinene
definition: The (1S,5S)-enantiomer of β-pinene.

name: 2-heptyl-4-hydroxyquinoline N-oxide
definition: An inhibitor of the mitochondrial respiratory chain at cytochrome bc1 and of photosynthetic electron flow immediately before cytochrome b559.

name: all-cis-5,8,11,14,17-icosapentaenoic acid
definition: An icosapentaenoic acid having five cis-double bonds at positions 5, 8, 11, 14 and 17.

name: 4,5-leukotriene A4
definition: A leukotriene whose structure comprises leukotriene A4 having a (4R,5R)-epoxy group.

name: novobiocin
definition: A coumarin-derived antibiotic obtained from Streptomyces niveus.

name: 6-pyruvoyl-7,8-dihydropterin
definition: A 7,8-dihydropterin compound having an amino substituent at the 2-position, an oxo substituent at the 4-position and a pyruvoyl group at the 6-position.

name: dTDP-3-amino-3,4,6-trideoxy-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3-amino-3,4,6-trideoxy-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: 6-acetamido-2-oxohexanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of acetamides that is the acetyl derivative of 6-amino-2-oxohexanoic acid.

name: plastoquinone-9
definition: A plastoquinone in which the number of isoprene units in the side chain is 9.

name: (R)-3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acid.

name: 4-hydroxycinnamyl alcohol
definition: A primary alcohol being cinnamyl alcohol hydroxylated at C-4 of the phenyl ring.

name: (2-trans,6-cis)-dodeca-2,6-dienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2-trans,6-cis)-dodeca-2,6-dienoic acid.

name: 2-amino-3-phosphonopropanoic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenc α-amino acid that is alanine in which one of the hydrogens of the terminal methyl group has been replaced by a dihydroxy(oxido)-λ5-phosphanyl group.

name: [3-(3,4-methylenedioxyphenyl)-2-(mercaptomethyl)-1-oxoprolyl]glycine
definition: A dipeptide consisting of a modified L-proline residue attached to glycine via a peptide linkage.

name: β-D-glucosamine
definition: A 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose that is D-glucosamine having a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: enol-oxaloacetic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is butenedioic acid in which the hydrogen at the 2-position is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: cis-4-hydroxy-L-proline
definition: L-Proline in which a hydrogen at the 4-position of the pyrrolidine ring is substituted by a hydroxy group (S-configuration).

name: butan-2-one
definition: A dialkyl ketone that is a four-carbon ketone carrying a single keto- group at position C-2.

name: 1D-3-amino-1-guanidino-1,3-dideoxy-scyllo-inositol 6-phosphate
definition: A scyllo-inositol phosphate that is 1D-3-amino-1-guanidino-1,3-dideoxy-scyllo-inositol carrying a single phospho substituent at position 6.

name: P1,P4-bis(5'-xanthosyl) tetraphosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-tetraphosphate compound having 5'-xanthosyl residues at the P1- and P4-positions.

name: 4-de(dimethylamino)-4-oxoanhydrotetracycline
definition: A member of the class of tetracyclines that is anhydrotetracycline in which the dimethylamino group at position 4 has been replaced by a keto group.

name: triacontan-1-ol
definition: An ultra-long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is triacontane in which one of the terminal methyl hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 2,2-bis(4-chlorophenyl)ethanol
definition: A organochlorine compound that is 4,4'-dichlorodiphenylmethane in which one of the methylene hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: eriodictyol
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 3' and 4' respectively.

name: hexacosan-1-ol
definition: A very long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is hexacosane in which a hydrogen attached to one of the terminal carbons is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 5-hydroxyimidazole-4-acetic acid
definition: A hydroxyimidazole that is 5-hydroxyimidazole in which the hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by a carboxymethyl group.

name: 6-methoxy-2-octaprenyl-1,4-benzoquinone
definition: A polyprenylbenzoquinone that is 1,4-benzoquinone carrying 2-octaprenyl and 6-methoxy substituents; a precursor of E. coli K12 ubiquinones.

name: α-carotene
definition: A cyclic carotene with a β- and an ε-ring at opposite ends respectively.

name: cyanidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation that is a cyanidin cation linked to a β-D-glucosyl moiety at position 3.

name: β-hexachlorocyclohexane
definition: The β-isomer of hexachlorocyclohexane.

name: (+)-dihydromyricetin
definition: An optically active form of dihydromyricetin having (2R,3R)-configuration.

name: 2,6-dichlorobenzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is benzamide substituted by chloro groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: delphinidin
definition: An anthocyanidin cation consisting of benzopyrylium with hydroxy substituents at the 3-, 5- and 7-positions and a 3,4,5-trihydroxyphenyl group at the 2-position. It is a plant pigment responsible for the colours of the plants of the genera Viola and Delphinium.

name: GDP-3,6-dideoxy-D-galactose
definition: A GDP-sugar having 3,6-dideoxy-D-galactose as the sugar component.

name: (2,6-dihydroxyphenyl)acetate
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (2,6-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 15-oxoprostaglandin F2α
definition: A prostaglandin Fα obtained by formal oxidation of the 15-hydroxy group of prostaglandin F2α.

name: cyclohexa-1,4-diene-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cyclohexa-1,4-diene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: vincristine
definition: A vinca alkaloid with formula C46H56N4O10 found in the Madagascar periwinkle, Catharanthus roseus. It is used (commonly as the corresponding sulfate salt)as a chemotherapy drug for the treatment of leukaemia, lymphoma, myeloma, breast cancer and head and neck cancer.

name: 3'-phosphoadenylyl selenate
definition: An organoselenium compound that is adenylyl selenate with the hydroxy at position 3' replaced by a phosphate group.

name: 3-selenino-L-alanine
definition: An α-amino acid consisting of L-alanine having a selenino group attached at the 3-position.

name: L-threo-3-methylmalic acid
definition: A threo-3-methylmalic acid that has (2S,3S)-configuration.

name: 2,6-dichlorophenol

name: maltotetraose

name: 4-amino-4-de(dimethylamino)anhydrotetracycline
definition: A member of the class of tetracyclines that is anhydrotetracycline in which the two methyl groups attached to the nitrogen have both been replaced by hydrogen.

name: ajmaline
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid that consists of ajmalan substituted at positions 17 and 21 by hydroxy groups.

name: aspidospermine
definition: An indole alkaloid having the structure of aspirospermidine methoxylated at C-17 and acetylated at N-1.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-methylpretetramide
definition: A member of the class of pretetramides that is 6-methyltetracene-2-carboxamide carrying six hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 3, 4, 10, 11 and 12.

name: acetaldehyde oxime
definition: An aldoxime derived from acetaldehyde.

name: 1-O-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: An sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine compound having a palmitoyl substituent at the 1-hydroxy position

name: proanthocyanidin A2
definition: A proanthocyanidin obtained by the condensation of (−)-epicatechin units.

name: γ-amino-γ-cyanobutanoic acid
definition: A γ-amino acid that is GABA in which one of the hydrogens at position 4 is replaced by a cyano group.

name: phosphoglycolohydroxamic acid
definition: The hydroxamate of phosphoglycolic acid.

name: m-tolualdehyde
definition: A tolualdehyde compound with the methyl substituent at the 3-position.

name: (2-hydroxyphenyl)acetic acid
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2-hydroxyphenyl group. It is a metabolite of phenylalanine and is excreted in the urine of patients suffering from diseases like phenylketonuria.

name: D-tyrosine
definition: An optically active form of tyrosine having D-configuration.

name: aldehydo-L-lyxose
definition: An L-lyxose in open-chain aldehyde form.

name: aldehydo-L-iduronic acid
definition: The open-chain aldehydo-form of L-iduronic acid.

name: N-acetylhistamine
definition: A member of the class of acetamides that is acetamide comprising histamine having an acetyl group attached to the side-chain amino function.

name: isovaleric acid
definition: A C5, branched-chain saturated fatty acid.

name: reserpine
definition: An alkaloid found in the roots of Rauwolfia serpentina and R. vomitoria.

name: m-xylene
definition: A xylene carrying methyl groups at positions 1 and 3.

name: 2-chloromaleylacetic acid
definition: An organochlorine compound that is maleylacetic acid substituted by a chloro group at position 2.

name: L-methionine sulfoximine
definition: A methionine sulfoximine in which the amino group has S-stereochemistry.

name: decanoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of decanoic acid.

name: N-[(5S)-5-amino-5-carboxypentanoyl]-L-cysteinyl-D-valine
definition: A tripeptoid arising from cleavage of both rings of a penicillin derivative.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine
definition: An N-acetyl-D-galactosamine having β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: acadesine
definition: A 1-ribosylimidazolecarboxamide in which the carboxamide group is situated at position 4 of the imidazole ring, which is further substituted at position 5 by an amino group. A purine nucleoside analogue and activator of AMP-activated protein kinase, it is is used for the treatment of acute lymphoblastic leukemia and is reported to have cardioprotective effects.

name: kaempferol
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone in which the four hydroxy groups are located at positions 3, 5, 7 and 4'. Acting as an antioxidant by reducing oxidative stress, it is currently under consideration as a possible cancer treatment.

name: tolazoline
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazole substituted by a benzyl group.

name: gitoxin
definition: A cardenolide glycoside that is gitoxigenin in which the 3β-hydroxy group has been glycosylated with tridigitoxose.

name: arsonoacetic acid
definition: An organoarsonic acid that is methylarsonic acid in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is replaced by a carboxy group.

name: cytidine 2'-phosphate
definition: A cytidine phosphate compound having the phosphate group at the 2'-position.

name: 2,5-dihydroxybenzaldehyde
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde carrying hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 5.

name: chloroethene
definition: A monohaloethene that is ethene in which one of the hydrogens has been replaced by a chloro group.

name: pelargonidin chloride
definition: An anthocyanidin chloride that has pelargonidin as the cationic counterpart.

name: dTDP-3,4-didehydro-2,6-dideoxy-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3,4-didehydro-2,6-dideoxy-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: Se-methyl-L-selenomethionine
definition: A Se-methylselenomethionine that has L-configuration.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysine
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-glycosaminyl glycopeptide consisting of an N-acetyl-β-D-glycosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetylmuramoyl moiety attached to the amino terminus of the tripeptide L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysine via an amide linkage.

name: acetoacetamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide of acetoacetic acid.

name: 1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol
definition: A member of the class of naphthalenediols that is 1,2-dihydronaphthalene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively.

name: α-D-xylose
definition: A D-xylopyranose in with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: 2,4,5-trichlorophenol
definition: A trichlorophenol carrying chloro groups at positions 2, 4 and 5.

name: kolaflavanone
definition: A biflavonoid isolated from the seeds of Garcinia kola that has been shown to exhibit hepatoprotective activity.

name: 4-hydroxybutyryl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 4-hydroxybutyric acid.

name: 2',6'-dihydroxy-4'-methoxydihydrochalcone
definition: A member of the class of dihydrochalcones that is dihydrochalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 6' and a methoxy group at position 4' respectively.

name: α-D-galactose 6-sulfate
definition: A D-galactose 6-sulfate that has α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: (KDO)2-lipid IVA
definition: Lipid IVA glycosylated with two 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues.

name: rutin
definition: A rutinoside that is quercetin with the hydroxy group at position C-3 substituted with glucose and rhamnose sugar groups.

name: 3-oxodecanoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 3-oxodecanoic acid.

name: quercetin 7-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside in which a glucosyl residue is attached at position 7 of quercetin via a β-glycosidic linkage.

name: GDP-4-dehydro-L-fucose
definition: A GDP-hexose compound having 6-deoxy-L-xylo-hexopyranosyl-4-ulose as the hexose fragment.

name: 3α,7α-dihydroxy-24-oxo-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A cholestanoyl-CoA formed by thioester linkage between 3α,7α-dihydroxy-24-oxo-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid and coenzyme A.

name: 1,2-dibromoethane
definition: A bromoalkane that is ethane carrying bromo substituents at positions 1 and 2. It is produced by marine algae.

name: 3-hydroxyindolin-2-one
definition: An oxindole that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: all-trans-dehydroretinal
definition: A retinal which contains an additional double bond between the 3 and 4 positions of the six-membered ring, and in which all of the double bonds in the side chain have the E-configuration.

name: 2-deoxy-D-ribofuranose 1-phosphate
definition: A 2-deoxyribose 1-phosphate with D-ribofuranose as the sugar. An intermediate in the metabolism of pyrimidine.

name: α-D-lyxopyranose
definition: A D-lyxopyranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: digitoxin
definition: A cardenolide glycoside in which the 3β-hydroxy group of digitoxigenin carries a 2,6-dideoxy-β-D-ribo-hexopyranosyl-(1→4)-2,6-dideoxy-β-D-ribo-hexopyranosyl-(1→4)-2,6-dideoxy-β-D-ribo-hexopyranosyl trisaccharide chain.

name: valinomycin
definition: A twelve-membered cyclodepsipeptide composed of three repeating D-α-hydroxyisovaleryl-D-valyl-L-lactoyl-L-valyl units joined in sequence. An antibiotic found in several Streptomyces strains.

name: 4-fluoroaniline
definition: A primary arylamine that is the derivative of aniline in which the hydrogen at position 4 has been substituted by fluorine. It is used as an intermediate in the manufacture of pharmaceuticals, herbicides and plant growth regulators.

name: D-glucuronate 1-phosphate
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion arising from selective deprotonation of the carboxy function of D-glucuronic acid 1-phosphate.

name: D-pinitol
definition: The D-enantiomer of pinitol.

name: 3-(indol-3-yl)-2-oxobutyric acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 2-oxobutyric acid which is substituted at position 3 by an indol-3-yl group.

name: α-D-ribulose
definition: A D-ribulose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: ajugose
definition: A hexasaccharide that is verbascose which has an additional unit of α-D-galactopyranose attached by a 1→6 glycosidic linkage to the terminal galactosyl residue.

name: biochanin A 7-O-(6-O-malonyl-β-D-glucoside)
definition: A glycosyloxyisoflavone that is biochanin A 7-O-β-D-glucoside in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the glucosyl moiety has been acylated by one of the carboxy groups of malonic acid.

name: cyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid.

name: farnesoyl-CoA
definition: A multi-methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of farnesoic acid.

name: β-D-mannose
definition: A D-mannopyranose in which the anomeric centre has β configuration.

name: 1,2-dihydroxyfluorene
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyfluorenes that is 9H-fluorene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 2.

name: piperazine
definition: An azacycloalkane that consists of a six-membered ring containing two nitrogen atoms at opposite positions.

name: 4,4'-dihydroxy-3,5-dimethoxydihydrostilbene
definition: A stilbenoid that is ethane in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group and one of the hydrogens of the remaining methyl group is replaced by a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group.

name: (R)-3-hydroxyoctanoyl-CoA
definition: An (R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (R)-3-hydroxyoctanoic acid.

name: L-glutamate methyl ester
definition: A L-glutamyl ester that is the α-methyl ester derivative of L-glutamic acid.

name: 2,6-dihydroxycyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2,6-dihydroxycyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid.

name: 2-hydroxyglutaryl-CoA
definition: A hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxyglutaric acid.

name: ε-caprolactam
definition: A member of the class of caprolactams that is azepane substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: 3-mercaptolactic acid
definition: A (2R)-2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid consisting of lactic acid having a sulfanyl group at the 3-position.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-D-mannosaminouronic acid
definition: A UDP-N-acetyl-mannosaminouronic acid in which the N-acetyl-mannosaminouronic acid fragment has D-configuration.

name: 4-carboxy-4'-sulfoazobenzene
definition: A member of the class of azobenzenes that is azobenzene in which the para position of one of the phenyl groups is substituted by a carboxy group, whilst that of the other phenyl group is substituted by a sulfo group.

name: verbascose
definition: A pentasaccharide that is stachiose which has an additional unit of α-D-galactopyranose attached by a 1→6 glycosidic linkage to the terminal galactosyl residue.

name: D-threose
definition: The D-stereoisomer of threose.

name: guaiacol
definition: A monomethoxybenzene that consists of phenol with a methoxy substituent at the ortho position.

name: ricinoleic acid
definition: A (9Z)-12-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid in which the 12-hydroxy group has R-configuration..

name: quinidine
definition: A cinchona alkaloid consisting of cinchonine with the hydrogen at the 6-position of the quinoline ring substituted by methoxy.

name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetylglycine
definition: Phenylacetylglycine hydroxylated at the phenyl C-4 position.

name: isoorientin 2''-O-rhamnoside
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone that consists of isoorientin substituted by a rhamnosyl moiety at position 2".

name: farnesol
definition: A farnesane sesquiterpenoid that is dodeca-2,6,10-triene substituted by methyl groups at positions 3, 7 and 11 and a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: β-D-fructofuranose 2,6-bisphosphate
definition: A D-fructofuranose 2,6-bisphosphate with a β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: isofucosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol consisting of stigmastan-3β-ol with double bonds at positions 5 and 24(28). The double bond at postion 24(28) adopts a Z-configuration.

name: N-benzoyl-4-methoxyanthranilic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that results from the formal condensation of benzoic acid with the amino group of 4-methoxyanthranilic acid.

name: 1-O-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: An oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group at position 1 is (9Z)-octadecenoyl (oleoyl) and the hydroxy group at position 2 is unsubstituted.

name: carbamic acid
definition: A one-carbon compound that is ammonia in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a carboxy group. Although carbamic acid derivatives are common, carbamic acid itself has never been synthesised.

name: p-tolualdehyde
definition: A tolualdehyde compound with the methyl substituent at the 4-position.

name: 1,4-dichlorobenzene
definition: A dichlorobenzene carrying chloro groups at positions 1 and 4.

name: acrylamide
definition: A member of the class of acrylamides that results from the formal condensation of acrylic acid with ammonia.

name: licoisoflavone A
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone substituted by additional hydroxy groups at positions 5, 2' and 4' and a prenyl group at position 3'.

name: triethanolamine
definition: A tertiary amino compound that is ammonia in which each of the hydrogens is substituted by a 2-hydroxyethyl group.

name: tetrahydrofolyl-poly(glutamic acid) macromolecule
definition: A tetrahydrofolyl glutamate consisting of a tetrahydrofolyl group linked via an amide bond to a poly(γ-glutamyl chain)

name: precorrin-8X
definition: The intermediate in the biosynthesis of vitamin B12 from uroporphyrinogen III in which eight methyl groups have been introduced into the tetrapyrrole framework, together with ring contraction and decarboxylation.

name: 3-phenylpropionic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid substituted at position 3 by a phenyl group.

name: (S)-3-hydroxyoctanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (S)-3-hydroxyoctanoic acid.

name: 2-isopropylmalic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is malic acid (2-hydroxysuccinic acid) in which the hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by an isopropyl group.

name: 2',3'-cyclic UMP
definition: A 2',3'-cyclic pyrimidine nucleotide in which uridine is the parent nucleoside.

name: isobutyronitrile
definition: An aliphatic nitrile that is acetonitrile in which two of the hydrogens have been replaced by methyl groups.

name: 2,6-diamino-4-hydroxy-5-(N-methylformamido)pyrimidine
definition: A pyrimidine derivative having amino substituents in the 2- and 6-positions, a hydroxy substituent at the 4-position and an N-methylformamido group at the 5-position.

name: 2-oxopentanoate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-oxopentanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 3-O-methylgallic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is gallic acid in which the phenolic hydroxy group at position 3 is converted into the corresponding methyl ether.

name: 2-propylmalic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is malic acid (2-hydroxysuccinic acid) in which the hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by a propyl group.

name: 3-methyl-2-oxovalerate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-linolenic acid
definition: A C18, ω-6 acid fatty acid comprising a linolenic acid having cis- double bonds at positions 6, 9 and 12.

name: galactitol 1-phosphate
definition: The 1-O-phospho derivative of galactitol.

name: 2-amino-7-methyl-1,7-dihydro-6H-purin-6-one
definition: A 7-methylguanine that is 1,7-dihydro-6H-purin-6-one substituted by an amino group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 7.

name: leukotriene D4
definition: A leukotriene that is (7E,9E,11Z,14Z)-icosa-7,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5 (5S) and a L-cysteinylglycinyl group at position 6 (6R).

name: 11-dehydro-thromboxane B2
definition: A thromboxane obtained by formal oxidation of the hemiacetal hydroxy function of thromboxane B2.

name: cuminaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes that is benzaldehyde substituted by an isopropyl group at position 4. It is a component of essential oils from Cumin and exhibits insecticidal activities.

name: 3-oxopropanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA thioester that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-oxopropanoic acid.

name: α-cellobiose
definition: A cellobiose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: 5-hydroxy-2,4-dioxopentanoic acid
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid that is acetylpyruvic acid in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: cytarabine
definition: A pyrimidine nucleoside in which cytosine is attached to D-arabinofuranose via a β-N1-glycosidic bond. Used mainly in the treatment of leukaemia, especially acute non-lymphoblastic leukaemia, cytarabine is an antimetabolite antineoplastic agent that inhibits the synthesis of DNA. It also has antiviral and immunosuppressant properties.

name: N,N'-diacetylchitobiose
definition: The N,N'-diacetylated derivative of chitobiose, but with no stereodesignation for the anomeric carbon atom.

name: kynurenine
definition: A ketone that is alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2-aminobenzoyl group.

name: 4-acetamidobutanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 4-acetamidobutanoic acid.

name: podecdysone B
definition: A phytoecdysteroid that consists of 5β-cholesta-8,14-dien-6-one bearing five hydroxy substituents at positions 2, 3, 20, 22 and 25.

name: dehydroepiandrosterone
definition: An androstanoid that is androst-5-ene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3 and an oxo group at position 17. It is a naturally occurring steroid hormone produced by the adrenal glands.

name: 21-deoxycortisol
definition: A deoxycortisol that is 17ξ-pregn-4-ene-3,20-dione substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 11 and an α-hydroxy group at position 17. It is a marker of virilizing adrenal hyperplasia caused by 21-hydroxylase deficiency.

name: chenodeoxycholoyl-CoA
definition: A choloyl-CoA formed by thioester linkage between chenodeoxycholic acid and coenzyme A.

name: N(α)-t-butoxycarbonyl-L-leucine
definition: A L-leucine derivative obtained by the substitution of a t-butoxycarbonyl group on the nitrogen atom.

name: narirutin
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is (S)-naringenin substituted by a 6-O-(6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: trans-hex-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-hex-2-enoic acid.

name: 3-isopropylcatechol
definition: A member of the class of catechols that is catechol in which one of the hydrogens that is ortho to a hydroxy group has been replaced by an isopropyl group.

name: eriocitrin
definition: A disaccharide derivative that consists of eriodictyol substituted by a 6-O-(α-L-rhamnopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxylated derivative of 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acid.

name: S-butyl-DL-homocysteine (S,R)-sulfoximine
definition: A sulfoximide that is the sulfoximine derivative of an analogue of DL-methionine in which the S-methyl group is replaced by S-butyl.

name: 5-hydroxykynurenamine
definition: A hydroxykynurenamine where the hydroxy group is located at the 5-position.

name: palmitoleic acid
definition: A hexadec-9-enoic acid in which the double bond at position C-9 has cis configuration.

name: O-decanoyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine that is L-carnitine having decanoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: L-allothreonine
definition: The L-enantiomer of allothreonine.

name: 3'-dehydro-AMP
definition: A secondary α-hydroxy ketone that is adenosine 5'-monophosphate in which the hydroxy group at position 3' is replaced by an oxo group.

name: D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate
definition: D-glycero-D-manno-heptose in which the hydrogen of the primary hydroxy group is substituted by a dihydrogen phosphate group.

name: 9,10-dihydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A hydroxy-fatty acid formally derived from octacecanoic (stearic) acid by hydroxy substitution at positions 9 and 10.

name: trans-vaccenic acid
definition: The trans- isomer of vaccenic acid.

name: thromboxane B2
definition: A member of the class of thromboxanes B that is (5Z,13E)-thromboxa-5,13-dien-1-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 9, 11 and 15.

name: α-D-mannose
definition: D-Mannopyranose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: gibberellin A19
definition: A C20-gibberellin.

name: 1-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A lysophosphatidylcholine 18:2 in which the acyl group at position 1 is (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl.

name: 4-nitroacetophenone
definition: A member of the class of acetophenones that is acetophenone substituted at the para-position by a nitro group.

name: formyl-5-hydroxykynurenamine
definition: A hydroxykynurenamine that is 5-hydroxykynurenamine with the hydrogen on the aryl amine replaced by a formyl group.

name: 2,6-dimethylaniline
definition: A primary arylamine that is aniline in which the hydrogens at the 2- and 6-positions are replaced by methyl groups. It is used in the production of some anasthetics and other chemicals. It is a drug metabolite of lidocaine (local anasthetic).

name: sodium fluoride
definition: A metal fluoride salt with a Na(+) counterion.

name: 2-hydroxy-17β-estradiol
definition: A 2-hydroxy steroid that consists of 17β-estradiol having an additional hydroxy group at position 2.

name: picolinic acid
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid in which the carboxy group is located at position 2. It is an intermediate in the metabolism of tryptophan.

name: 17α-hydroxypregnenolone
definition: A hydroxypregnenolone carrying an α-hydroxy group at position 17.

name: biochanin A 7-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyisoflavone that is biochanin A attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkage.

name: 3,4-dihydroxyfluorene
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyfluorenes that is 9H-fluorene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4.

name: 3-demethylubiquinone-6
definition: A polyprenylbenzoquinone that is fumigatin which is substituted by an all-trans-hexaprenyl group at position 6.

name: 2,4,6-trichlorophenol
definition: A trichlorophenol with phenolic substituents on positions 2, 4 and 6.

name: 2',6'-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyacetophenone
definition: A member of the class of acetophenones that is 2',4',6'-trihydroxyacetophenone in which the hydroxy group at position 4' is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: 1D-6-O-methyl-myo-inositol
definition: A member of the class of methyl myo-inositols that is cyclohexane-1,2,3,4,5-pentol substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 ( the 1R,2R,3R,4R,5S,6R-isomer).

name: 4,4'-dichlorodiphenylmethane
definition: A chlorophenylmethane that is methane in which two of the hydrogens have been replaced by p-chlorophenyl groups.

name: p-cymene
definition: A monoterpene that is toluene substituted by an isopropyl group at position 4.

name: α-licanic acid
definition: A trienoic fatty acid comprising α-eleostearic acid having a 4-oxo substituent.

name: hesperidin
definition: A disaccharide derivative that consists of hesperetin substituted by a 6-O-(α-L-rhamnopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: γ-glutamyl-Se-methylselenocysteine
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the γ-carboxy group of glutamic acid with the amino group of Se-methylselenocysteine.

name: liquiritigenin
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone compound having the two hydroxy substituents at the 4'- and 7-positions. Isolated from the root of Glycyrrhizae uralensis, it is a selective agonist for oestrogen receptor β.

name: 1-S-hexadecyl-2-O-[hexadecyl(hydroxy)phosphoryl]-1-thio-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-thio-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine compound having 1-S-hexadecyl- and 2-O-hexadecylphosphono substituents.

name: gentianose
definition: A trisaccharide composed of β-D-glucopyranose, α-D-glucopyranose and β-D-fructofuranose units.

name: nitroglycerin
definition: A nitroglycerol that is glycerol in which the hydrogen atoms of all three hydroxy groups are replaced by nitro groups. It acts as a prodrug, releasing nitric oxide to open blood vessels and so alleviate heart pain.

name: L-glucitol
definition: The L-enantiomer of glucitol.

name: serotonin
definition: A primary amino compound that is the 5-hydroxy derivative of tryptamine.

name: isoglutamic acid
definition: A 1,5-dicarboxylic acid compound having a 3-amino substituent. It has been isolated from the extracts of the algae, Chondria armata.

name: erucic acid
definition: A docosenoic acid having a cis- double bond at C-13. It is found particularly in brassicas - it is a major component of mustard and rapeseed oils and is produced by broccoli, Brussels sprouts, kale, and wallflowers.

name: coumarin
definition: A chromenone having the keto group located at the 2-position.

name: m-toluate
definition: A toluate that is the conjugate base of m-toluic acid.

name: D-α-aminobutyric acid
definition: An optically active form of α-aminobutyric acid having D-configuration.

name: rubber particle
definition: A polymer consisting of cis-linked prenyl units.

name: quinoline-4,6-diol
definition: Quinoline substituted by hydroxy groups at the 4- and 6-positions. It is the product of 5-hydroxytryptophan metabolism, via monoamine oxidase catalysed conversion of 5-hydroxykynurenamine.

name: stearolic acid
definition: An octadecynoic acid having its triple bond at position 9.

name: D-2-aminopentanoic acid
definition: A 2-aminopentanoic acid that has R-configuration.

name: 2'-deoxyinosine-5'-monophosphate
definition: A deoxyinosine phosphate that is 5'-inosinic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 2' by a hydrogen atom.

name: dITP
definition: A deoxyinosine phosphate compound having a triphosphate group at the 5'-position.

name: (1S,2S)-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol
definition: The (1S,2S)-isomer of trans-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol.

name: (aminomethyl)phosphonic acid
definition: A member of the class of phosphonic acids that is phosphonic acid substituted by an aminomethyl group. It is a metabolite of the herbicide glyphosate.

name: sinapyl alcohol
definition: A primary alcohol, being cinnamyl alcohol hydroxylated at C-4 and methoxylated at C-3 and -5.

name: piceatannol
definition: A stilbenol that is trans-stilbene in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4, while the other phenyl group is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: 2-deoxy-D-ribose
definition: A deoxypentose that is D-ribose in which the hydroxy group at position C-2 is replaced by hydrogen.

name: dodecane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 12 carbon atoms. It has been isolated from the essential oils of various plants including Zingiber officinale (ginger).

name: naringin
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is (S)-naringenin substituted by a 2-O-(α-L-rhamnopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 9-phenanthrol
definition: A phenanthrol that is phenanthrene in which a hydrogen attached to a carbon in the central ring has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: piperine
definition: A N-acylpiperidine that is piperidine substituted by a (1E,3E)-1-(1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl)-5-oxopenta-1,3-dien-5-yl group at the nitrogen atom. It is an alkaloid isolated from the plant Piper nigrum.

name: icosanoic acid
definition: A C20 striaght-chain saturated fatty acid which forms a minor constituent of peanut (L. arachis) and corn oils. Used as an organic thin film in the production of liquid crystals for a wide variety of technical applications.

name: 2'-deoxyinosine-5'-diphosphate
definition: A deoxyinosine phosphate compound having a diphosphate group at the 5'-position.

name: stigmasterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that consists of 3β-hydroxystigmastane having double bonds at the 5,6- and 22,23-positions.

name: β-alanine betaine
definition: A β-alanine derivative arising from quaternisation of the nitrogen of β-alanine with three methyl groups and removal of the proton attached to the carboxy group. It is an osmoprotective compound accumulated by most members of the highly stress-tolerant Plumbaginaceae family.

name: fluoromethane
definition: A member of the class of fluoromethanes that is methane in which a single hydrogen is substituted by a fluorine atom.

name: ethyl N-acetyl-L-tyrosinate
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is the ethyl ester of N-acetyltyrosine.

name: chlorambucil
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is butanoic acid substituted at position 4 by a 4-[bis(2-chloroethyl)amino]phenyl group. A chemotherapy drug that can be used in combination with the antibody obinutuzumab for the treatment of chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

name: propan-1-ol
definition: The parent member of the class of propan-1-ols that is propane in which a hydrogen of one of the methyl groups is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: androsterone 3-glucosiduronic acid
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid having androsterone as the steroid component.

name: gibberellin A3
definition: A C19-gibberellin that is a pentacyclic diterpenoid responsible for promoting growth and elongation of cells in plants. Initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi,it differs from gibberellin A1 in the presence of a double bond between C-3 and C-4.

name: deoxycholic acid
definition: A bile acid that is 5β-cholan-24-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 12 respectively.

name: testosterone 17-glucosiduronic acid
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic that is testosterone carrying a glucosiduronic acid residue at position 17.

name: octanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid that is heptane in which one of the hydrogens of a terminal methyl group has been replaced by a carboxy group. Octanoic acid is also known as caprylic acid.

name: 3-disulfanyl-L-alanine
definition: An S-substituted L-cysteine where the S-substituent is specified as sulfanyl.

name: octadecanoic acid
definition: A C18 straight-chain saturated fatty acid component of many animal and vegetable lipids. As well as in the diet, it is used in hardening soaps, softening plastics and in making cosmetics, candles and plastics.

name: dCDP
definition: A 2'-deoxycytidine phosphate that is the 2'- deoxy derivative of cytidine 5'-diphosphate (CDP).

name: naphthazarin
definition: A naphthoquinone that is 1,4-naphthoquinone in which the hydrogens at positions 5 and 8 are replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: phenanthrene
definition: A polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon composed of three fused benzene rings which takes its name from the two terms 'phenyl' and 'anthracene.'

name: 2,4-D
definition: A chlorophenoxyacetic acid that is phenoxyacetic acid in which the ring hydrogens at postions 2 and 4 are substituted by chlorines.

name: enterobactin
definition: A macrotriolide produced by certain members of Enterobacteriaceae, e.g. Escherichia coli and Salmonella.

name: p-toluate
definition: A toluate that is the conjugate base of p-toluic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (Z)-hex-3-en-1-ol
definition: A hex-3-en-1-ol in which the double bond adopts a Z-configuration. Also known as leaf alcohol, it is emitted by green plants upon mechanical damage. Used as a flavourant in tea.

name: 5α-androstane
definition: The 5α-stereoisomer of androstane.

name: β-D-glucuronic acid
definition: A D-glucopyranuronic acid in which the anomeric centre has β-configuration.

name: gibberellin A8
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Phaseolus coccineus. It differs from gibberellin A1 in the presence of an extra β-OH group at C-3 (gibbane numbering).

name: dGDP
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate having guanine as the nucleobase.

name: tobramycin
definition: A amino cyclitol glycoside that is kanamycin B lacking the 3-hydroxy substituent from the 2,6-diaminoglucose ring.

name: taurocholic acid
definition: A bile acid taurine conjugate of cholic acid that usually occurs as the sodium salt of bile in mammals.

name: tetracosanoic acid
definition: A C24 straight-chain saturated fatty acid.

name: O-propanoylcarnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine compound having propanoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: menadione
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-naphthoquinones that is 1,4-naphthoquinone which is substituted at position 2 by a methyl group. It is used as a nutritional supplement and for the treatment of hypoprothrombinemia.

name: 1-O-all-trans-retinoyl-β-glucuronic acid
definition: A retinoid that is retinoic acid in which the carboxy proton has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue.

name: 6-methyladenine
definition: A methyladenine that is 9H-purin-6-amine substituted by a methyl group at the amino nitrogen.

name: o-toluate
definition: A toluate that is the conjugate base of o-toluic acid.

name: cis-2-coumaric acid
definition: The cis-isomer of 2-coumaric acid.

name: tetradecanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain, fourteen-carbon, long-chain saturated fatty acid mostly found in milk fat.

name: melphalan
definition: A phenylalanine derivative comprising L-phenylalanine having [bis(2-chloroethyl)amino group at the 4-position on the phenyl ring.

name: dodecan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is dodecane in which a hydrogen from one of the methyl groups is replaced by a hydroxy group. It is registered for use in apple and pear orchards as a Lepidopteran pheromone/sex attractant, used to disrupt the mating behaviour of certain moths whose larvae destroy crops.

name: 9-O-acetylneuraminic acid
definition: The acetate ester of the primary hydroxy group of neuraminic acid.

name: (S)-mevalonic acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of mevalonic acid.

name: (S)-2-benzoylsuccinyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (S)-2-benzoylsuccinic acid.

name: N-phenylacetamide
definition: A member of the class of acetamides that is acetamide in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is substituted by a phenyl group.

name: butan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is butane in which a hydrogen of one of the methyl groups is substituted by a hydroxy group. It it produced in small amounts in humans by the gut microbes.

name: dimethyl ether
definition: An ether in which the oxygen atom is connected to two methyl groups.

name: 3'-UMP
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 3'-monophosphate having uracil as the nucleobase.

name: pentadecane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 15 carbon atoms. It is a component of volatile oils isolated from plants species like Scandix balansae.

name: P1,P5-bis(5'-adenosyl) pentaphosphate
definition: A diadenosyl pentaphosphate having the two 5'-adenosyl residues attached at the P1- and P5-positions.

name: busulfan
definition: A methanesulfonate ester that is butane-1,4-diol in which the hydrogens of the hydroxy groups are replaced by methanesulfonyl groups. An alkylating antineoplastic agent, it is used for the treatment of chronic myeloid leukemia (although it has been largely replaced by newer drugs). It is also used as an insect sterilant.

name: N-phenylhydroxylamine
