definition: An N-substituted amine that is a derivative of aniline in which one of the amino hydrogen atoms is replaced with a hydroxy substituent.

name: decan-1-ol
definition: A fatty alcohol consisting of a hydroxy function at C-1 of an unbranched saturated chain of ten carbon atoms.

name: N-formylisoglutamic acid
definition: A 1,5-dicarboxylic acid compound having a 3-formamido substituent.

name: prop-2-yn-1-ol
definition: A terminal acetylenic compound that is prop-2-yne substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: 2,3-bisphosphoglyceric acid
definition: A bisphosphoglyceric acid that is glyceric acid carrying two phospho substituents at positions 2 and 3.

name: bambermycin
definition: A glycophospholipid antibiotic compound with the lipid portion conjugated to a pentasaccharide fraction via a phosphate linkage.

name: iprodione
definition: An imidazolidine-2,4-dione in which the nitrogen at position 1 is substituted by an N-(isopropyl)carboxamide group while that at position 3 is substituted by a 3,5-dichlorophenyl group. A contact fungicide, it blocks the growth of the fungal mycelium and inhibits the germination of fungal spores. It is used on fruit and vegetable crops affected by various fungal diseases. It is also used as a nematicide.

name: cob(III)alamin
definition: A cobalamin in which the central cobalt atom has an oxidation state of +3.

name: (2E)-hexenal
definition: A 2-hexenal in which the olefinic double bond has E configuration. It occurs naturally in a wide range of fruits, vegetables, and spices.

name: fosfomycin
definition: A phosphonic acid having an (R,S)-1,2-epoxypropyl group attached to phosphorus.

name: dihydromyricetin
definition: A hexahydroxyflavanone that is the 2,3-dihydro derivative of myricetin.

name: (R)-adrenaline
definition: The R-enantiomer of adrenaline. It is a hormone secreted by the adrenal glands resulting in the 'fight-or-flight' response.

name: estrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: The 3-β-D-glucuronide of estrone.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanine
definition: A glyco-amino acid compound consisting of an N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl group attached to L-alanine via an amide linkage.

name: 7-methyladenine
definition: Adenine substituted with a methyl group at position N-7.

name: prostaglandin F2β
definition: A prostaglandins Fα that is prosta-5,13-dien-1-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 9, 11 and 15. It is the 9β-hydroxy epimer of prostaglandin F2α.

name: 3-aminophenol
definition: An aminophenol that is one of three amino derivatives of phenol which has the single amino substituent located meta to the phenolic -OH group.

name: sakuranetin
definition: A flavonoid phytoalexin that is (S)-naringenin in which the hydroxy group at position 7 is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: 3'-AMP
definition: An adenosine 3'-phosphate with a monophosphate group at the 3'-position.

name: laetisaric acid
definition: A C18, straight-chain, hydroxy fatty acid composed of linoleic acid having an (R)-hydroxy group at the 8-position.

name: (25R)-5β-spirostan-3β-ol
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is(5β,25R)-spirostan substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3.

name: vitamin D2
definition: A vitamin D supplement and has been isolated from alfalfa.

name: (E)-hexadec-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: A hexadec-2-enoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (E)-hexadec-2-enoic acid.

name: (−)-abscisic acid
definition: The (1'R)-(−) enantiomer of abscisic acid, which does not occur naturally.

name: ammonium
definition: An onium cation obtained by protonation of ammonia.

name: N-acetyl-L-cysteine
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino acid that is the N-acetylated derivative of the natural amino acid L-cysteine.

name: calciol
definition: A hydroxy seco-steroid that is (5Z,7E)-9,10-secocholesta-5,7,10(19)-triene in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is the inactive form of vitamin D3, being hydroxylated in the liver to calcidiol (25-hydroxyvitamin D3), which is then further hydroxylated in the kidney to give calcitriol (1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3), the active hormone.

name: docosanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain, C22, long-chain saturated fatty acid.

name: CDP-α-D-glucose
definition: A CDP-D-glucose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: theobromine
definition: A dimethylxanthine having the two methyl groups located at positions 3 and 7. A purine alkaloid derived from the cacao plant, it is found in chocolate, as well as in a number of other foods, and is a vasodilator, diuretic and heart stimulator.

name: (5-oxo-2-sulfo-2,5-dihydrofuran-2-yl)acetic acid
definition: An organosulfonic acid that consists of 5-oxo-2-furylacetic acid bearing a sulfo group at position 2.

name: gramine
definition: An aminoalkylindole that is indole carrying a dimethylaminomethyl substituent at postion 3.

name: N-methyl-N-picrylnitramine
definition: A nitramine that is methylamine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is substituted by a nitro group while the other is substituted by a 2,4,6-trinitrophenyl group. A yellow crystalline powder, it is a high explosive, capable of being detonated by friction, shock, or a spark.

name: 5α-pregnane-3,20-dione
definition: A C21-steroid hormone that is 5α-pregnane substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 20. It is a metabolite of progestrone.

name: 2-methoxy-17β-estradiol
definition: A 17β-hydroxy steroid, being 17β-estradiol methoxylated at C-2.

name: 3-methyl-cis,cis-muconic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is cis,cis-muconic acid in which the hydrogens at position 3 is substituted by a methyl group.

name: phenoxyacetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of phenoxyacetic acid.

name: N,N-dimethyltryptamine
definition: A tryptamine derivative having two N-methyl substituents on the side-chain.

name: biphenyl-2,2'-diol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls carrying hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 2'.

name: ampicillin
definition: A penicillin in which the substituent at position 6 of the penam ring is a 2-amino-2-phenylacetamido group.

name: strychnine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid that is strychnidine bearing a keto substituent at the 10-position.

name: (1S,2R)-3-(4-chlorophenyl)cyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol
definition: A cyclohexenediol that has cis hydroxy groups at C-1 and C-2, double bonds at C-3 and C-5, and a 4-chlorophenyl substituent at C-3, the configurations at C-1 and C-2 being S and R respectively.

name: 2,5-dichloro-2,5-cyclohexadiene-1,4-diol
definition: A cyclohexadienediol that is cyclohexa-2,5-diene-1,4-diol in which positions 2 and 5 are substituted by chlorines.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-carboxylato-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 2-hydroxy-3-carboxy-6-oxo-7-methylocta-2,4-dienoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,4Z)-6-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid formed by biodegradative cleavage of the dihydroxylated aromatic ring of 2,3-dihydroxybiphenyl.

name: 4'-chlorobiphenyl-2,3-diol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls that is catechol in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a p-chlorophenyl group.

name: anabasine
definition: A pyridine alkaloid that is pyridine substituted by a piperidin-2-yl group at position 3.

name: abietic acid
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is abieta-7,13-diene substituted by a carboxy group at position 18.

name: 2-hydroxychromene-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A chromenemonocarboxylic acid that consists of chromene bearing carboxy and hydroxy substituents at the 2-position.

name: cis-acetylacrylic acid
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is (Z)-pent-2-enoic acid in which the 4-position has been oxidised to the corresponding ketone.

name: 2,4-dichlorobenzoate
definition: A chlorobenzoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2,4-dichlorobenzoic acid.

name: pinocarvone
definition: A bridged compound resulting from rearrangement of carvone.

name: 2'-deoxyinosine
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside that is inosine in which the hydroxy group at position 2' is replaced by a hydrogen.

name: (3R)-3-isopropenyl-6-oxoheptanoate
definition: An optically active form of 3-isopropenyl-6-oxoheptanoate having (3R)-configuration.

name: L-citramalic acid
definition: The L-enantiomer of citramalic acid.

name: (3R)-3-isopropenyl-6-oxoheptanoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of 3-isopropenyl-6-oxoheptanoic acid.

name: cyclohexane
definition: An alicyclic hydrocarbon comprising a ring of six carbon atoms; the cyclic form of hexane, used as a raw material in the manufacture of nylon.

name: N-acetyl-4-O-acetylneuraminate
definition: Conjugate base of N-acetyl-4-O-acetylneuraminic acid.

name: ceftriaxone
definition: A third-generation cephalosporin compound having 2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetylamino and [(2-methyl-5,6-dioxo-1,2,5,6-tetrahydro-1,2,4-triazin-3-yl)sulfanyl]methyl side-groups.

name: Nτ-methylhistamine
definition: A primary amino compound that is the Nτ-methyl derivative of histamine.

name: fusidic acid
definition: A steroid antibiotic that is isolated from the fermentation broth of Fusidium coccineum.

name: arginine
definition: An α-amino acid that is glycine in which the α-is substituted by a 3-guanidinopropyl group.

name: nonanoic acid
definition: A C9 straight-chain saturated fatty acid which occurs naturally as esters of the oil of pelargonium. Has antifungal properties, and is also used as a herbicide as well as in the preparation of plasticisers and lacquers.

name: neral
definition: An enal that is 3,7-dimethyloctanal with unsaturation at positions C-2 and C-6. It has been isolated form the essential oils of plant species like lemon.

name: hexane
definition: An unbranched alkane containing six carbon atoms.

name: N-benzyladenine
definition: A member of the class of 6-aminopurines that is adenine in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a benzyl group.

name: 4-methyl-3-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A branched-chain fatty acid that is 4-methylpentanoic acid carrying an oxo substituent at C-3.

name: urobilinogen
definition: A member of the class of bilanes that is a colourless product formed in the intestine by the reduction of bilirubin.

name: glucobrassicin
definition: An indolylmethylglucosinolic acid that is 1-thio-β-D-glucopyranose having a 2-(1H-indol-3-yl)-N-(sulfooxy)ethanimidoyl group attached to the anomeric sulfur.

name: phosphinic acid
definition: A phosphorus oxoacid that consists of a single pentavalent phosphorus covalently bound via single bonds to two hydrogens and a hydroxy group and via a double bond to an oxygen. The parent of the class of phosphinic acids.

name: (R)-pantothenate
definition: A pantothenate that is the conjugate base of (R)-pantothenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: manganese(2+)
definition: A divalent metal cation in which the metal is manganese.

name: copper(2+)
definition: An ion of copper carrying a double positive charge.

name: α-D-glucose 1-phosphate
definition: A D-glucopyranose 1-phosphate in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: maleamic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide of maleamic acid.

name: 3,4-dihydroxyphenylpyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that results from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 3,4-dihydroxyphenylpyruvic acid.

name: lipid IVA
definition: A tetra-acylated lipid A produced by E. coli as an intermediate in the lipid A biosynthetic pathway.

name: α-pinene oxide
definition: An epoxide of α-pinene.

name: L-mimosine
definition: An L-α-amino acid that is propionic acid substituted by an amino group at position 2 and a 3-hydroxy-4-oxopyridin-1(4H)-yl group at position 3 (the 2S-stereoisomer). It a non-protein plant amino acid isolated from Mimosa pudica.

name: phthalic acid
definition: A benzenedicarboxylic acid cosisting of two carboxy groups at ortho positions.

name: L-ascorbic acid
definition: The L-enantiomer of ascorbic acid and conjugate acid of L-ascorbate.

name: dolichyl palmitate
definition: An acyldolichol obtained by formal condensation of the hydroxy group of dolichol with the carboxy group of palmitic (hexadecanoic) acid.

name: synephrine
definition: A phenethylamine alkaloid that is 4-(2-aminoethyl)phenol substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1 and a methyl group at the amino nitrogen.

name: N-methyl-L-glutamate(1−)
definition: An L-α-amino acid anion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy groups and protonation of the secondary amino group of N-methyl-L-glutamic acid.

name: (2→1)-β-D-fructan
definition: A fructan in which the D-fructose building blocks are connected by β-(2→1) linkages.

name: 3-hydroxy-5,9,17-trioxo-4,5:9,10-disecoandrosta-1(10),2-dien-4-oic acid
definition: A seco-androstane that is hexahydro-1H-indene-1,5(4H)-dione which is substituted at the 7a position by a methyl group and at the 4 position by a 1-carboxy-1-hydroxy-4-methyl-5-oxohepta-1,3-dien-7-yl group (the S,S,S-diastereoisomer).

name: sodium(1+)
definition: A monoatomic monocation obtained from sodium.

name: potassium(1+)
definition: A monoatomic monocation obtained from potassium.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of a linear chain of four α-linked D-mannose residues, with an N-acetyl glucosamine residue joined to residue 3, also via an α-linkage.

name: 1-(2-carboxyphenylamino)-1-deoxy-D-ribulose 5-phosphate
definition: A deoxyribulose phosphate that is D-ribulose 5-phosphate in which the hydroxy group at position 1 is replaced by a 2-carboxyphenylamino group.

name: 6-dehydrotestosterone
definition: A 17β-hydroxy steroid that is testosterone that contains an additional double bond between positions 6 and 7.

name: (2E,4Z)-deca-2,4-dienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2-trans,4-cis)-deca-2,4-dienoic acid.

name: oxidonitrogen(1+)
definition: A monovalent inorganic cation resulting from the removal of the unpaired electron from nitric oxide.

name: oxidonitrate(1−)
definition: An inorganic anion resulting from the addition of an electron to nitric oxide.

name: arsenate(3−)
definition: An arsenate ion resulting from the removal of three protons from arsenic acid.

name: trans-dec-3-enoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-dec-3-enoic acid.

name: 2,3-didehydrosparteine
definition: A quinolizidine alkaloid obtained by formal dehydrogenation at the 2,3-position of sparteine.

name: pyridine N-oxide
definition: The pyridine N-oxide derived from the parent pyridine. It is a drug metabolite of the antihypertensive agent pinacidil.

name: cis-dec-4-enoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cis-dec-4-enoic acid.

name: phosphinate
definition: A phosphorus oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from the hydroxy group of phosphinic acid.

name: thiocyanic acid
definition: A hydracid that is cyanic acid in which the oxygen is replaced by a sulfur atom.

name: isocyanic acid
definition: A colourless, volatile, poisonous inorganic compound with the formula HNCO; the simplest stable chemical compound that contains carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen, the four most commonly-found elements in organic chemistry and biology.

name: 3-hydroxy-2-methylquinolin-4(1H)-one
definition: A quinolin-4-one having methyl and hydroxy substituents at the 2- and 3-positions respectively.

name: hydrogen fluoride
definition: A diatomic molecule containing covalently bonded hydrogen and fluorine atoms.

name: iodite
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of iodous acid.

name: hypoiodite
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of hypoiodous acid.

name: deuteron
definition: Nucleus of the 2H atom.

name: triton
definition: Nucleus of the 3H atom.

name: protium atom
definition: The stable isotope of hydrogen with relative atomic mass 1.007825 and a natural abundance of 99.9885 atom percent (from Greek πρωτοσ, first).

name: deuterium atom
definition: The stable isotope of hydrogen with relative atomic mass 2.014102 and a natural abundance of 0.0115 atom percent (from Greek δευτερον, second).

name: tritium atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of hydrogen with relative atomic mass 3.016049 and half-life of 12.33 years (from Greek τριτοσ, third).

name: hydride
definition: The general name for the hydrogen anion H−, to be used without regard to the hydrogen nuclear mass (either for hydrogen in its natural abundance or where it is not desired to distinguish between the isotopes).

name: arsenite(1−)
definition: An arsenite ion resulting from the removal of a proton from one of the hydroxy groups of arsenous acid.

name: arsenite(2−)
definition: An arsenite ion resulting from the removal of a proton from two of the hydroxy groups of arsenous acid.

name: hypomanganate
definition: A trivalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of all three protons from hypomanganic acid.

name: perbromate
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of perbromic acid.

name: bromite
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of bromous acid.

name: hypobromite
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of hypobromous acid.

name: dihydrogenphosphite
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of phosphorous acid.

name: hydrogenphosphite
definition: A divalent inorganic anion resulting from the removal of a proton from two of the hydroxy groups of phosphorous acid.

name: diphosphonate(2−)
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of both protons from diphosphonic acid.

name: peroxyphosphate
definition: A trivalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of all three protons from peroxyphosphoric acid.

name: thionyl chloride
definition: A sulfinyl halide in which both of the halide atoms are chorines.

name: oxalonitrile
definition: A dinitrile that is ethane substituted by two cyano groups.

name: sodium nitroprusside
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of nitroprusside.

name: oxidooxomethyl
definition: An organic radical anion obtained from carbon dioxide. It is a metabolite of carbon tetrachloride.

name: oxomethyl
definition: An organic radical derived from formaldehyde.

name: hydridonitrate(2−)
definition: A divalent inorganic anion resulting from the removal of two protons from ammonia.

name: phosgene
definition: An acyl chloride obtained by substitution of both hydrogens of formaldehyde by chlorine.

name: sulfamide
definition: The simplest of the sulfamic acids consisting of a single sulfur atom covalently bound by single bonds to two amino groups and by double bonds to two oxygen atoms.

name: cyclooctasulfur
definition: A homomonocyclic compound composed of eight sulfur atoms. It has been isolated from Ganoderma lucidum, a mushroom commonly used in Chinese medicine.

name: silane
definition: The simplest silane, consisting of a single silicon atom carrying four hydrogens.

name: nerol
definition: The (2Z)-stereoisomer of 3,7-dimethylocta-2,6-dien-1-ol. It has been isolated from the essential oils from plants like lemon grass.

name: (5Z,7E,9E,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoic acid
definition: The (5Z,7E,9E,14Z,17Z)-isomer of icosapentaenoic acid.

name: 10-deoxymethynolide
definition: A macrolide that consists of oxacyclododec-9-ene-2,8-dione bearing four methyl substituents at positions 3, 5, 7 and 11 as well as a hydroxy group at position 4 and an ethyl substituent at position 12. The aglycone of the macrolide antibiotic 10-deoxymethymycin.

name: 2,3-didehydro-gibberellin A9
definition: A C19-gibberellin obtained by formal dehydrogenation across the 2,3-position of gibberellin A9.

name: 2,6-diamino-7-hydroxy-azelaic acid
definition: A α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is azelaic acid substituted by amino groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: 2-heptyl-3-hydroxy-4-quinolone
definition: A quinolone consisting of quinolin-4(1H)-one carrying a heptyl substituent at position 2 and a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 2-hydroxy-4-isopropenylcyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy-4-isopropenylcyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid.

name: (S)-3,5-dihydroxyphenylglycine
definition: A glycine derivative that is L-α-phenylglycine substituted at positions 3 and 5 on the phenyl ring by hydroxy groups.

name: 3-amino-4-hydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 4-hydroxybenzoic acid carrying an additional amino substitutent at position 3.

name: methyl 3-hydroxypalmitate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester of 3-hydroxypalmitic acid.

name: (S)-4,5-dihydroxypentane-2,3-dione
definition: Pentane substituted at the 2- and 3-positions by oxo groups, at the 4- and 5-positions by hydroxy groups and with S stereoconfiguration at C-4.

name: 4-isopropenyl-2-oxocyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: A 3-oxoacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 4-isopropenyl-2-oxocyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid.

name: 5-O-β-D-mycaminosyltylactone
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is tylactone having a β-D-mycaminosyl residue attached at position 5.

name: 4',7-dihydroxyflavone
definition: A dihydroxyflavone in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at positions 4' and 7.

name: A47934
definition: A cyclic peptide antibiotic produced by a strain of Streptomyces toyocaensis.

name: cethromycin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic which displays in vitro activity against both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria and is currently under investigation for the treatment of community-acquired pneumonia. The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) have also granted orphan drug designation to cethromycin for the treatment of anthrax prophylaxis, tularemia, and plague (PDB entry: 1NWX).

name: 3-amino-5-hydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 3-hydroxybenzoic acid carrying an additional amino substitutent at position 4.

name: abietal
definition: A derivative of abieta-7,13-diene having an oxo group on one of the gem-dimethyl groups.

name: abietol
definition: An abietane diterpenoid having the skeleton of abietane with double bonds at C-7 and C-13 and a hydroxy function at C-18.

name: 5-amino-5-deoxy-3-dehydroshikimic acid
definition: A γ-amino acid that is shikimic acid in which the 3- and 5-hydroxy groups are replaced by oxo and amino groups respectively.

name: ansamitocin P3
definition: A polyketide antibiotic that is isolated from Actinosynnema pretiosum and also exhibits antitumour activity.

name: chloroeremomycin
definition: A complex glycopeptide antibiotic that is isolated from Amycolatopsis orientalis.

name: cyanidin 3-O-(6-O-(E)-4-coumaroyl-β-D-glucoside)
definition: An anthocyanin cation that is cyanidin substituted at position 3 by a 6-O-(trans-4 coumaryl)-β-D-glucosyl residue

name: cyclo(ΔAla-L-Val)
definition: A 2,5-diketopiperazine where the substituents are methylidene and (S)-isopropyl at positions 3 and 6 respectively.

name: dehydroabietic acid
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is abieta-8,11,13-triene substituted at position 18 by a carboxy group.

name: demethyllactenocin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is tylonolide having 6-deoxy-β-D-allopyranosyl and β-D-mycaminosyl residues attached to two of its hydroxy groups..

name: epothilone D
definition: An epithilone that is epithilone C in which the hydrogen at position 13 of the oxacyclohexadec-13-ene-2,6-dione macrocycle has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: ascomycin
definition: A macrolide that is produced by the fermentation of Streptomyces hygroscopicus and exhibits strong immunosuppressant properties.

name: 5-aminocyclohexa-1,3-diene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is cyclohexa-1,3-diene-1-carboxylic acid carrying an amino group at position 5.

name: gibberellin A14
definition: A C20-gibberellin, initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi. It differs from gibberellin A12 in the presence of a β-OH at C-2 (gibbane numbering).

name: gibberellin A14 aldehyde
definition: A C20-gibberellin obtained by selective reduction of the 10β-carboxy group of gibberellin A14.

name: gibberellin A5
definition: A C19-gibberellin initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi and differing from gibberellin A1 by the absence of the OH at C-2 and the presence of a double bond between C-3 and C-3 (gibbane numbering).

name: gibberellin A51-catabolite
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid obtained by catabolism of gibberellin A51.

name: gibberellin A53 aldehyde
definition: A C20-gibberellin obtained by selective reduction of the 10β-carboxy group of gibberellin A53.

name: gibberellin A6
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Phaseolus coccineus and differing from gibberellin A1 by the conversion of the OH at C-2 (gibbane numbering) into an epoxide across C-2 and C-3.

name: gibberellin A8-catabolite
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid obtained by catabolism of gibberellin A8.

name: gibberellin A9
definition: A C19-gibberellin that is a pentacyclic diterpenoid responsible for promoting growth and elongation of cells in plants. Initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi it differs from gibberellin A1 in the absence of OH groups at C-2 and C-7 (gibbane numberings).

name: isoformononetin
definition: A methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted at positions 4' and 7 by hydroxy and methoxy groups respectively.

name: 3-O-(α-L-oleandrosyl)oleandolide
definition: A macrolide that is oleandolide having a 2,6-dideoxy-3-O-methyl-α-Larabino-hexopyranosyl (α-L-oleandrosyl) residue attached at position 3.

name: 3-O-(α-L-olivosyl)oleandolide
definition: A macrolide that is oleandolide having a 2,6-dideoxy-α-L-arabino-hexopyranosyl (α-L-olivosyl) residue attached at position 3.

name: luteoliflavan
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavan in which the four hydroxy groups are located at positions 3', 4', 5 and 7.

name: manumycin A
definition: A polyketide with formula C31H38N2O7 initially isolated from Streptomyces parvulus as a result of a random screening program for farnesyl transferase (FTase) inhibitors. It is a natural product that exhibits anticancer and antibiotic properties.

name: methymycin
definition: A twelve-membered macrolide antibiotic that is biosynthesised by Streptomyces venezuelae.

name: N-(3-oxododecanoyl)homoserine lactone
definition: A N-acyl homoserine lactone that is the monocarboxylic acid amide arising from formal condensation of homoserine lactone with 3-oxododecanoic acid.

name: N-(3-oxohexanoyl)homoserine lactone
definition: A N-acyl homoserine lactone that is the monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-oxohexanoic acid with the amino group of homoserine lactone.

name: N-butyryl-L-homoserine lactone
definition: An N-acyl-L-homoserine lactone having butyryl as the acyl substituent.

name: narbomycin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is narbonolide having a 3,4,6-trideoxy-3-(dimethylamino)-β-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl residue attached at position 6. It is biosynthesised by Streptomyces venezuelae.

name: narbonolide
definition: A 14-membererd macrolide containing seven stereocentres carrying one ethyl, one hydroxy and five methyl substituents. It is the aglycone of the antibiotic narbonomycin and an intermediate in the biosynthesis of pikromycin.

name: neoabietadiene
definition: An abietadiene in which the two double bonds are located at the 8(14)- and 13(15)-positions.

name: neocarzinostatin chromophore
definition: A naphthoate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy-7-methoxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoic acid with the 5-hydroxy group of (1aS,5R,6R,6aE,9aR)-5-hydroxy-1a-[(4R)-2-oxo-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl]-2,3,8,9-tetradehydro-1a,5,6,9a-tetrahydrocyclopenta[5,6]cyclonona[1,2-b]oxiren-6-yl 2,6-dideoxy-2-(methylamino)-α-D-galactopyranoside. The chromophoric part of neocarzinostatin, it is tightly and non-covelently bound to a 113-membered apoprotein, which serves to protect it and release it to the target DNA.

name: neomethymycin
definition: A twelve-membered macrolide antibiotic that is biosynthesised by Streptomyces venezuelae.

name: oleandolide
definition: A 14-membererd macrolide containing ten stereocentres carrying one epoxymethano, three hydroxy and five methyl substituents. It is the aglycone of the antibiotic oleandomycin.

name: pikromycin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is biosynthesised by Streptomyces venezuelae.

name: pyochelin
definition: A member of the class of thiazolidines that is (4R)-3-methyl-1,3-thiazolidine-4-carboxylic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a (4R)-2-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-4,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazol-4-yl group. A siderophore that is produced by Pseudomonas aeruginosa (via condensation of salicylic acid and two molecules of cysteine) as a mixture of two easily interconvertible diastereoisomers, pyochelin I (major) and pyochelin II (minor). The enantiomeric compounds, enant-pyochelin, are produced by Pseudomonas fluorescens.

name: resorcinol monoacetate
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is resorcinol in which one of the phenolic hydroxy groups has been converted into its acetate ester. It has keratolytic properties and has been used for the treatment of acne.

name: rifamycin SV
definition: A member of the class of rifamycins that exhibits antibiotic and antitubercular properties.

name: sodium arsenite
definition: An inoganic sodium salt with formula with formula NaAsO2.

name: thiostrepton
definition: A heterodetic cyclic peptide, in which the cyclisation step involves a formal lactonisation between the carboxy group of a quinaldic acid-based residue and a secondary alcohol. An antibiotic that inhibits bacterial protein synthesis. Also acts as an antitumor agent.

name: thiotropocin
definition: A thiocarbonyl compound that is 3,8-dihydrocyclohepta[c][1,2]oxathiole substituted at positions 3, 4 and 8 by oxo, hydroxy, and thiocarbonyl groups, respectively. It is an antibiotic first isolated in 1984 from the fermentation broth of Pseudomonas sp. CB104.

name: tylactone
definition: A 16-membererd macrolide that is the aglycone of the antibiotic 5-O-β-D-mycaminosyltylactone.

name: tyrocidine A
definition: A homodetic cyclic decapeptide consisting of D-Phe, L-Pro, L-Phe, D-Phe, L-Asn, L-Gln, L-Tyr, L-Val, L-Orn, and L-Leu residues coupled in sequence and cyclised head-to-tail.

name: undecylprodigiosin
definition: A member of the class of tripyrroles that is 1H-pyrrole substituted by (4'-methoxy-1H,5'H-[2,2'-bipyrrol]-5'-ylidene)methyl and undecyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a pigment produced by Stveptomyces coelicolor.

name: validamycin A
definition: A member of the class of validamycins that is (1R,2S,3S,4S,6R)-4-amino-6-(hydroxymethyl)cyclohexane-1,2,3-triol in which the hydroxy group at position 1 has been converted to its β-D-glucoside and in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a (1R,4R,5R,6S)-4,5,6-trihydroxy-3-(hydroxymethyl)cyclohex-2-en-1-yl group. It is the major validamycin produced by Streptomyces hygroscopicus.

name: valiolone
definition: A cyclitol that is cyclohexanone which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3, 4, and 5, and by a hydroxymethyl group at position 5 (the 2R,3S,4S,5S stereoisomer).

name: 10-deoxymethymycin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is the 3,4,6-trideoxy-3-(dimethylamino)-β-D-xylo-hexoside of 10-deoxymethynolide.

name: yersiniabactin
definition: A member of the class of thiazolidines that is (4S)-4-methyl-4,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazole-4-carboxylic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a (1S)-1-hydroxy-1-{(4R)-2-[(4R)-2-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-4,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazol-4-yl]-1,3-thiazolidin-4-yl}-2-methylpropan-2-yl group. A siderophore found in the gram-negative bacterium species, Yersinia enterocolitica and Yersinia pestis.

name: cis-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienoyl-CoA
definition: The cis-isomer of 2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienoyl-CoA.

name: dTDP-6-deoxy-α-D-allose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 6-deoxy-α-D-allose as the sugar portion.

name: dTDP-α-D-mycaminose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3,6-dideoxy-3-dimethylamino-α-D-glucose (α-D-mycaminose) as the sugar component.

name: 4-amino-L-phenylalanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 4-aminophenylalanine.

name: 5α,9β,10α-labda-8(20),13-dien-15-yl diphosphate
definition: The 5α,9β,10α-diastereomer of copalyl diphosphate.

name: trans-2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienoyl-CoA
definition: The trans-isomer of 2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienoyl-CoA.

name: lithocholate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of lithocholic acid.

name: barbiturate
definition: Conjugate base of barbituric acid.

name: glycocholate
definition: A cholanic acid conjugate anion that is the conjugate base of glycocholic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cholate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of cholic acid.

name: trans-ferulate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group of ferulic acid.

name: 3-(indol-3-yl)pyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid substituted by a 1H-indol-3-yl group at position 3. It has been found in Lycopersicon esculentum

name: (−)-quinate
definition: A quinate that is the conjugate base of (−)-quinic acid.

name: aminoxyl
definition: The parent compound of the aminoxyl group of radicals.

name: hydroxyazanide
definition: An inorganic anion that is the conjugate base of hydroxylamine, arising from deprotonation of the amino function.

name: glycolate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is acetate where the methyl group has been hydroxylated.

name: fumarate(2−)
definition: A C4-dicarboxylate that is the E-isomer of but-2-enedioate(2−)

name: glycyrrhizinate(3−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion that is the conjugate base of glycyrrhizinic acid.

name: fulminic acid
definition: A nitrile oxide resulting from the oxidation of hydrogen cyanide.

name: perylene
definition: An ortho- and peri-fused polycyclic arene comprising of five benzene rings that is anthracene in which the d,e and k,l sides are fused to benzene rings.

name: coronene
definition: A ortho- and peri-fused polycyclic arene that consists of six peri-fused benzene rings.

name: benzo[a]pyrene
definition: An ortho- and peri-fused polycyclic arene consisting of five fused benzene rings.

name: arsenite(3−)
definition: An arsenite ion resulting from the removal of all three protons from the hydroxy groups of arsenous acid.

name: diphosphoric acid
definition: An acyclic phosphorus acid anhydride obtained by condensation of two molecules of phosphoric acid.

name: (1s,4s)-prephenate(2−)
definition: A prephenate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of (1s,4s)-prephenic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-glutamate(1−)
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of L-glutamic acid, having anionic carboxy groups and a cationic amino group

name: D-glutamate(1−)
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of D-glutamic acid, having anionic carboxy groups and a cationic amino group

name: glutamate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion that is the conjugate base of glutamate(1−).

name: L-glutamate(2−)
definition: An L-α-amino acid anion that is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of the both the carboxy groups of L-glutamic acid.

name: D-aspartate(1−)
definition: An aspartate(1−) that is the conjugate base of D-aspartic acid.

name: L-aspartate(1−)
definition: An aspartate(1−) that is the conjugate base of L-aspartic acid.

name: L-aspartate(2−)
definition: An aspartate(2−) that is the conjugate base of L-aspartate(1−).

name: D-aspartate(2−)
definition: An aspartate(2−) that is the conjugate base of D-aspartate(1−).

name: aspartate(2−)
definition: A C4-dicarboxylate that is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of both the carboxy groups of aspartic acid.

name: L-selenomethionine
definition: The L-enantiomer of selenomethionine.

name: D-selenomethionine
definition: The D-enantiomer of selenomethionine.

name: trans-sinapate
definition: A member of the class of cinnamates that is the conjugate base of trans-sinapic acid.

name: hexaamminecobalt(3+)
definition: A cobalt coordination entity consisting of six amino groups bound to a central cobalt atom.

name: succinate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the carboxy groups of succinic acid.

name: taxa-4,11-diene
definition: A diterpene consisting of taxane having two C=C double bonds at the 4(5)- and 11(12)-positions.

name: taxa-4(20),11-dien-5α,13α-diol
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that is taxane which contains double bounds at the 4-20 and 11-12 positions and which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 5α and 13α positions.

name: taxa-4(20),11-dien-5α-yl acetate
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that is taxane which contains double bounds at the 4-20 and 11-12 positions and which is substituted by an acetoxy group at the 5α position.

name: terephthalate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy groups of terephthalic acid.

name: gold monochloride
definition: A gold salt in which the counterion is chloride

name: dicarbide(2−)
definition: The dianion formed by loss of the two protons from acetylene (ethyne).

name: gibberellin A12
definition: A C20-gibberellin, initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi, in which the gibbane skeleton carries 1β- and 4aα-methyl groups, 1α- and 10β-carboxy substituents, and a methylene group at C-8 (all gibbane numberings).

name: acetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of acetic acid.

name: 4α-methyl-5α-ergosta-8,14,24(28)-trien-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is methyl-5α-ergosta-8,14,24(28)-trien-3β-ol carrying an additional 4α-methyl substituent.

name: lithium hydride
definition: An alkali metal hydride where the metal is specified as lithium.

name: borane
definition: The simplest borane, consisting of a single boron atom carrying three hydrogens.

name: 5β-pregnane-3,20-dione
definition: A C21-steroid that is 5β-pregnane with oxo groups at positions 3 and 20.

name: diboron trioxide
definition: A boron oxide with formula B2O3.

name: 5-diphospho-1D-myo-inositol pentakisphosphate
definition: A myo-inositol pentakisphosphate that consists of 1D-myo-inositol having the five phospho groups located at positions 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 as well as a diphospho group at position 5.

name: tetraethyllead
definition: An organolead compound consisting of four ethyl groups joined to a central lead atom.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside in which a glucosyl residue is attached at position 3 of kaempferol via a β-glycosidic linkage.

name: α-particle
definition: Nucleus of the 4He atom.

name: helium-3 atom
definition: The stable isotope of helium with relative atomic mass 3.016029. The least abundant (0.000137 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring helium.

name: helium-4 atom
definition: The stable isotope of helium with relative atomic mass 4.002603. The most abundant (99.99 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring helium.

name: helion
definition: Nucleus of the 3He atom.

name: hypofluorite
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of hypofluorous acid.

name: linoleate
definition: An octadecadienoate with cis- double bonds at the 9- and 12- positions; the conjugate base of linoleic acid.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: A tetrasaccharide comprising residues of galactose, N-acetylglucosamine, galactose and glucose in a linear sequence, all joined by β-linkages.

name: terbutylazine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is N-tert-butyl-N'-methyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a chloro group at position 6.

name: simeton
definition: A methoxy-1,3,5-triazine that is 6-methoxy-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine in which one of the hydrogens of each amino group has been replaced by an ethyl group.

name: phosphane
definition: The simplest phosphine, consisting of a single phosphorus atom with three hydrogens attached.

name: phosphorane
definition: A phosphorus hydride consisting of a single pentavalent phosphorus carrying five hydrogens. The parent hydride of the phosphorane class.

name: tetraphenylstibonium
definition: A polyatomic cation consisting of four phenyl groups attached to stibonium.

name: (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)(triphenyl)arsonium
definition: An arsonium ion consisting of tetraphenylarsonium having two hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 on one of the phenyl rings.

name: antimonate(3−)
definition: A trivalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of all three protons from antimonic acid.

name: antimonite
definition: A trivalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of all three protons from antimonous acid.

name: N-methylanthraniloyl-CoA
definition: An aroyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of N-methylanthranilic acid.

name: Nα-γ-L-glutamylhistamine
definition: Histamine having a γ-L-glutamyl group attached to the side-chain nitrogen.

name: meso-2,6-diaminopimelate(2−)
definition: The meso-isomer of 2,6-diaminopimelate.

name: lipoate
definition: A thia fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of lipoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-lipoic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of lipoic acid. A vitamin-like, C8 thia fatty acid with anti-oxidant properties.

name: dihydrolipoate
definition: The conjugate base of dihydrolipoic acid.

name: (S)-dihydrolipoic acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of dihydrolipoic acid.

name: phosphorus trichloride
definition: A phosphorus halide with formula Cl3P.

name: ethylenediamine
definition: An alkane-α,ω-diamine in which the alkane is ethane.

name: 2,2'-bipyridine
definition: A bipyridine in which the two pyridine moieties are linked by a bond between positions C-2 and C-2'.

name: isopentane
definition: An alkane that is butane substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: isobutane
definition: An alkane that is propane substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: cyclopropane
definition: A cycloalkane composed of three carbon atoms to form a ring.

name: imidazolide
definition: An organic nitrogen anion that is the conjugate base of 1H-imidazole.

name: 4-phospho-L-aspartate
definition: An L-α-amino acid anion arsing from deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of 4-phospho-L-aspartic acid.

name: iron-sulfur-molybdenum cofactor
definition: A molybdenum coordination entity consisting of a {Mo:7Fe:9S:C]:homocitrate cluster, having carbide(4−) at its centre. Active site of the enzyme nitrogenase (EC 1.18.6.1).

name: tetramethyltin
definition: An organotin compound carrying four methyl groups.

name: indium atom
definition: A metallic element first identified and named from the brilliant indigo (Latin indicum) blue line in its flame spectrum.

name: thallium atom
definition: A metallic element first identified and named from the brilliant green line in its flame spectrum (from Greek θαλλοσ, a green shoot).

name: validamine
definition: An amino cyclitol consisting of 1D-chiro-inositol lacking the 6-hydroxy group and having those at positions 1 and 5 replaced by amino and hydroxymethyl groups respectively.

name: fentin hydroxide
definition: An organotin compound that is triphenylstannane in which the hydrogen attached to tin is replaced by a hydroxy group. A fungicide used to control a variety of infections including blight on potatoes, leaf spot on sugar beet and alternaria blight on carrots.

name: sulfur hexafluoride
definition: A sulfur coordination entity consisting of six fluorine atoms attached to a central sulfur atom. It is the most potent greenhouse gas currently known, with a global warming potential of 23,900 times that of CO2 over a 100 year period (SF6 has an estimated lifetime in the atmosphere of between 800 and 3,000 years).

name: beryllium atom
definition: Alkaline earth metal atom with atomic number 4.

name: 1-aminocyclopropanecarboxylate
definition: An α-amino-acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 1-aminocyclopropanecarboxylic acid.

name: pimelic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is pentane with two carboxylic acid groups at positions C-1 and C-5.

name: silicon dioxide
definition: A silicon oxide made up of linear triatomic molecules in which a silicon atom is covalently bonded to two oxygens.

name: γ-aminobutyrate
definition: An γ-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of γ-aminobutyric acid.

name: D-glucarate(2−)
definition: Dicarboxylate anion of D-glucaric acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ATP(4−)
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate(4−) obtained by global deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of ATP; major species present at pH 7.3.

name: 2,4-divinyl protochlorophyllide a
definition: A protochlorophyllide compound having vinyl substituents at the 2- and 4-positions.

name: diarsenic trioxide
definition: An arsenic oxide in which arsenic and oxygen atoms are present in the ratio 2:3.

name: oxalate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of oxalic acid.

name: propylenediamine
definition: A diamine that is propane substituted by amino groups at positions 1 and 2. Propylenediamine is commonly used as a bidentate ligand in the formation of coordination complexes.

name: loganic acid
definition: A cyclopentapyran that is 1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran-4-carboxylic acid substituted at positions 1, 6 and 7 by β-D-glucosyloxy, hydroxy and methyl groups respectively

name: L-pipecolate
definition: A pipecolate that is the conjugate acid of L--pipecolic acid.

name: homoserine
definition: An α-amino acid that is glycine substituted at the α-position by a 2-hydroxyethyl group.

name: D-homoserine
definition: The D-enantiomer of homoserine.

name: L-homoserine lactone
definition: The L-enantiomer of homoserine lactone.

name: D-homoserine lactone
definition: The D-enantiomer of homoserine lactone.

name: D-thyroxine
definition: The D-enantiomer of thyroxine.

name: thyroxine
definition: An iodothyronine compound having iodo substituents at the 3-, 3'-, 5- and 5'-positions.

name: thyronine
definition: A tyrosine derivative where the phenolic hydrogen of tyrosine is substituted by 4-hydroxyphenyl.

name: ferrocene
definition: A bis(η5-cyclopentadienyl)metal(II) having Fe(II) as the metal(II) species. The parent of the class of ferrocenes.

name: citraconate(2−)
definition: The dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of citraconic acid.

name: nicotine N1'-oxide
definition: A tertiary amine oxide resulting from the oxidation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen of nicotine.

name: ethylferrocene
definition: Ferrocene substituted on one of the cyclopentadienyl rings by an ethyl group.

name: ethylene glycol bis(2-aminoethyl)tetraacetic acid
definition: A diether that is ethylene glycol in which the hydrogens of the hydroxy groups have been replaced by 2-[bis(carboxymethyl)amino]ethyl group respectively.

name: ethylene glycol
definition: A 1,2-glycol compound produced via reaction of ethylene oxide with water.

name: oxaloacetic acid
definition: An oxodicarboxylic acid that is succinic acid bearing a single oxo group.

name: phenylacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is toluene in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been replaced by a carboxy group.

name: benzoic acid
definition: A compound comprising a benzene ring core carrying a carboxylic acid substituent.

name: 4-chlorobenzoic acid
definition: A monochlorobenzoic acid carrying a chloro substituent at position 4.

name: 2,4-dichlorobenzoic acid
definition: A chlorobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid in which the ring hydrogens at positions 2 and 4 are substituted by chloro groups.

name: 4-chlorophenylacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 4-chlorophenyl group.

name: formic acid
definition: The simplest carboxylic acid, containing a single carbon. Occurs naturally in various sources including the venom of bee and ant stings, and is a useful organic synthetic reagent. Principally used as a preservative and antibacterial agent in livestock feed. Induces severe metabolic acidosis and ocular injury in human subjects.

name: 4-aminobenzoic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid in which the amino group is para to the carboxy group.

name: anthranilic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid having a single amino substituent located at position 2. It is a metabolite produced in L-tryptophan-kynurenine pathway in the central nervous system.

name: salicylate
definition: A monohydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of salicylic acid.

name: 4-hydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid carrying a hydroxy substituent at C-4 of the benzene ring.

name: 3-hydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It has been isolated from Taxus baccata. It is used as an intermediate in the synthesis of plasticisers, resins, pharmaceuticals, etc.

name: tropic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 is substituted by a phenyl group, and one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: propionic acid
definition: A short-chain saturated fatty acid comprising ethane attached to the carbon of a carboxy group.

name: citric acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid that is propane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 2. It is an important metabolite in the pathway of all aerobic organisms.

name: butyric acid
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid that is butane in which one of the terminal methyl groups has been oxidised to a carboxy group.

name: fluoroacetic acid
definition: A haloacetic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by fluorine.

name: hexanoic acid
definition: A C6, straight-chain saturated fatty acid.

name: gallic acid
definition: A trihydroxybenzoic acid in which the hydroxy groups are at positions 3, 4, and 5.

name: succinate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from one of the carboxy groups of succinic acid.

name: maleate(2−)
definition: A C4-dicarboxylate that is the Z-isomer of but-2-enedioate(2−)

name: butynedioic acid
definition: An acetylenic compound that is acetylene in which the hydrogens are replaced by carboxy groups.

name: acetylenedicarboxylate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of butynedioic acid.

name: 4-sulfobenzoic acid
definition: A sulfobenzoic acid in which the sulfonic acid and carboxylic acid groups are in a para-relationship.

name: 2-chlorobenzoic acid
definition: A monochlorobenzoic acid having the chloro group at the 2-position.

name: malonic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid in which the two carboxy groups are separated by a single methylene group.

name: (R)-malic acid
definition: An optically active form of malic acid having (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-malic acid
definition: An optically active form of malic acid having (S)-configuration.

name: phthalate(1−)
definition: A phthalate that is the conjugate base of phthalic acid.

name: isophthalic acid
definition: A benzenedicarboxylic acid that is benzene substituted by carboxy groups at position 1 and 3. One of three possible isomers of benzenedicarboxylic acid, the others being phthalic and terephthalic acids.

name: isophthalate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of isophthalic acid.

name: dodecanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain, twelve-carbon medium-chain saturated fatty acid with strong bactericidal properties; the main fatty acid in coconut oil and palm kernel oil.

name: tetradecanoate
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of myristic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: decanoic acid
definition: A C10, straight-chain saturated fatty acid.

name: moronic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-18-ene substituted at position 3 by an oxo group and position 28 by a carboxy group.

name: vanillic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 4-hydroxybenzoic acid substituted by a methoxy group at position 3.

name: trans-urocanic acid
definition: A urocanic acid in which the double bond of the carboxyethene moiety has E configuration.

name: cis-urocanic acid
definition: A urocanic acid in which the double bond of the carboxyethene moiety has Z configuration.

name: 2-oxooctadecanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is octadecanoic acid (stearic acid) in which the hydrogens at position 2 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: oleate
definition: A C18, long straight-chain monounsaturated fatty acid anion; and the conjugate base of oleic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: octadec-1-ene
definition: An octadecene with unsaturation at C-1.

name: elaidate
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of elaidic acid; shown to exert detrimental effects on mitochondrial lipid composition and function.

name: cis-vaccenate(1−)
definition: A vaccenate(1−) that is the conjugate base of cis-vaccenic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: trans-vaccenate(1−)
definition: A vaccenate(1−) having a trans- double bond.

name: petroselaidic acid
definition: The trans-isomer of octadec-6-enoic acid, a long-chain fatty acid.

name: 4-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: A 4-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is butyric acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 4 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is the 2-oxo derivative of butanoic acid.

name: adipic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is the 1,4-dicarboxy derivative of butane.

name: adipate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of adipic acid.

name: allantoic acid
definition: A member of the class of ureas that consists of acetic acid in which the two methyl hydrogens are replaced by carbamoylamino groups respectively.

name: itaconic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is methacrylic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a carboxylic acid group.

name: 3-hydroxypyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a hydroxy group. It is an intermediate involved in the glycine and serine metabolism.

name: 2-furoic acid
definition: A furoic acid having the carboxylic acid group located at position 2.

name: 3-furoic acid
definition: A furoic acid carrying the carboxy group at position 3.

name: 3-propylmalic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is malic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 is substituted by a propyl group.

name: keto-phenylpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 3-phenylpropanoic acid substituted by an oxo group at position 2. It is an intermediate metabolite in the phenylalanine pathway.

name: galactaric acid
definition: A hexaric acid resulting from formal oxidative ring cleavage of galactose.

name: glycyrrhetinic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3, an oxo group at position 11 and a carboxy group at position 30.

name: indole-3-acetate
definition: An indol-3-yl carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of indole-3-acetic acid.

name: thiophene
definition: A monocyclic heteroarene that is furan in which the oxygen atom is replaced by a sulfur.

name: selenophene
definition: A five-membered monocyclic heteroarene composed of four CH units and one selenium atom. The parent of the class of selenophenes.

name: tellurophene
definition: A five-membered monocyclic heteroarene composed of four CH units and one tellurium atom. The parent of the class of tellurophenes.

name: methylmalonic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is malonic acid in which one of the methylene hydrogens is substituted by a methyl group.

name: methylmalonate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from one of the carboxylic acid groups of methylmalonic acid.

name: (S)-dihydroorotate
definition: A dihydroorotate that is the conjugate base of (S)-dihydroorotic acid.

name: dihydroorotic acid
definition: A pyrimidinemonocarboxylic acid that results from the base-catalysed cyclisation of Nα-carbethoxyasparagine.

name: dihydroorotate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of dihydroorotic acid.

name: isocitric acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid that is propan-1-ol with a hydrogen at each of the 3 carbon positions replaced by a carboxy group.

name: L-threo-isocitric acid
definition: The (1S,2R)-stereoisomer of isocitric acid.

name: L-threo-isocitrate(3−)
definition: An isocitrate(3−) that is the conjugate base of L-threo-isocitric acid.

name: L-erythro-isocitrate(3−)
definition: An isocitrate(3−) that is the conjugate base of L-erythro-isocitric acid.

name: naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid in which the sulfo groups are attached to positions 2 and 7 of the naphthalene ring.

name: dTDP-3-dehydro-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3-dehydro-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: L-pipecolic acid
definition: The L-enantiomer of pipecolic acid. It is a metabolite of lysine.

name: 2-oxoglutaric acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid that consists of glutaric acid bearing an oxo substituent at position 2. It is an intermediate metabolite in Krebs cycle.

name: 2-oxoglutarate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion resulting from selective deprotonation of the 1-carboxy group of 2-oxoglutaric acid.

name: 3-dehydroshikimic acid
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is shikimic acid in which the allylic hydroxy group has been oxidised to the corresponding keto group.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutarate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from one of the carboxylic acid groups of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid.

name: glutarate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both the carboxy groups of glutaric acid.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutaric acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid comprising glutaric acid having oxo- and hydroxy substituents at the 2- and 4-positions respectively.

name: 2,3-dihydroxybutanedioate
definition: A tartaric acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-carboxy-2,3-dihydroxypropanoate.

name: 3-phosphonooxypyruvic acid
definition: A carboxyalkyl phosphate that is pyruvic acid substituted at position 3 by a 3-phosphonooxy group.

name: D-citramalate(2−)
definition: A citramalate(2−) that is the conjugate base of D-citramalic acid.

name: 3-phosphonopyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid substituted at position 3 by a phospho group.

name: L-citramalate(2−)
definition: A citramalate(2−) that is the conjugate acid of L-citramalic acid.

name: 5α,9α,10β-labda-8(20),13-dien-15-yl diphosphate
definition: The 5α,9α,10β-diastereomer of copalyl diphosphate.

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-2,6-dideoxy-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-2,6-dideoxy-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: potassium thiocyanate
definition: A potassium salt which is the monopotassium salt of thiocyanic acid.

name: sodium thiocyanate
definition: An organic sodium salt which is the monosodium salt of thiocyanic acid.

name: pyrazine
definition: A diazine that is benzene in which the carbon atoms at positions 1 and 4 have been replaced by nitrogen atoms.

name: trichloroacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which all three methyl hydrogens are substituted by chlorine.

name: 4-pyridoxate
definition: A pyridoxate that is the conjugate base of 4-pyridoxic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 5-pyridoxate
definition: A pyridoxate that is the conjugate base of 5-pyridoxic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: pyridoxine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of pyridoxine.

name: oxetane
definition: A saturated organic heteromonocyclic parent that is a four-membered ring comprising of three carbon atoms and an oxygen atom.

name: 4,4'-bipyridine
definition: A bipyridine in which the two pyridine moieties are linked by a bond between positions C-4 and C-4'.

name: frequentin
definition: An antibiotic produced by Penicillium frequentans Westling.

name: 1-aminocyclopropylphosphonic acid
definition: A member of the class of phosphonic acids that is phosphonic acid in which the hydrogen attached to the phosphorus is substituted by a 1-aminocyclopropyl group.

name: 1-aminocyclopropylphosphonate(2−)
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of two protons from the phosphonic acid group of 1-aminocyclopropylphosphonic acid.

name: levoglucosan
definition: A anhydrohexose that is the 1,6-anhydro-derivative of β-D-glucopyranose.

name: docosan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is docosane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1. It is a non-prescription medicine approved by the FDA to shorten healing time of cold sores.

name: octacosanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid that is octacosane in which one of the terminal methyl groups has been oxidised to the corresponding carboxy group.

name: octacosanoate
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion and the conjugate base of octacosanoic acid (montanic acid), arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: triacontanoic acid
definition: A C30, very long straight-chain, saturated fatty acid.

name: triacontanoate
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of melissic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: triacontane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 30 carbon atoms.

name: octafluorocyclobutane
definition: A fluorocarbon that is cyclobutane in which all eight hydrogens are replaced by fluorines.

name: hexacosanoic acid
definition: A 26-carbon, straight-chain, saturated fatty acid.

name: valerate
definition: A short-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of valeric acid; present in ester form as component of many steroid-based pharmaceuticals.

name: noviose
definition: A deoxyhexose derivative that is 5-methylhexanal which has been substituted at position 4 by a methoxy group and at positions 2, 3, and 5 by hydroxy groups (the 2R,3S,4R stereoisomer).

name: cerotate
definition: The conjugate base of cerotic acid.

name: tetracosanoate
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of tetracosanoic acid (lignoceric acid), formed by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (+)-gallocatechin
definition: A gallocatechin that has (2R,3S)-configuration. It is found in green tea and bananas.

name: (−)-epiafzelechin
definition: A catechin derivative having (2R,3R)-configuration.

name: (−)-tortuosamine
definition: 5,6,7,8-Tetrahydroquinoline in whith the hydrogens at position 6 are substituted by a 3-azabutyl group and a 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl group. (S configuration). It is found in the herb kanna (Sceletium tortuosum).

name: (13S)-13-dihydrodaunorubicin
definition: The (13S)-diastereomer of 13-dihydrodaunorubicin.

name: (S)-DNPA
definition: A member of the class of naphthopyrans that is 4,10-dihydro-3H-naphtho[2,3-c]pyran-3-yl]acetic acid bearing additional methyl, hydroxy and oxo substituents at positions 1, 9 and 10 respectively.

name: 1,3,5-trimethoxybenzene
definition: A methoxybenzene carrying methoxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 5. It has been found to be a biomarker of flavonoid consumption in humans.

name: 1,3-dimethylisoquinoline-6,8-diol
definition: Isoquinoline in which the hydrogens at positions 6 and 8 are substituted by hydroxy groups, and those at positions 1 and 3 are substituted by methyl groups.

name: 4-(1-hydroxyethyl)phenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol substituted by a 1-hydroxyethyl group at position 4.

name: 10-carboxy-13-deoxycarminomycin
definition: An anthracycline antibiotic that is 13-deoxycarminomycin substituted at position 10 by a carboxy group.

name: 13-deoxycarminomycin
definition: A cytotoxic anthracycline antibiotic that is produced by Streptomyces peucetius var. carminatus (a biochemical mutant of Streptomyces peucetius var. caesius), and is active against P-388 murine leukemia.

name: 13-deoxydaunorubicin
definition: An aminoglycoside antibiotic that is (1S,3S)-3-ethyl-3,5,12-trihydroxy-10-methoxy-6,11-dioxo-1,2,3,4,6,11-hexahydrotetracene having a 3-amino-2,3,6-trideoxy-α-L-lyxo-hexopyranosyl residue attached at position 1 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: (13R)-13-dihydrocarminomycin
definition: A anthracycline antibiotic that is a cardiotoxic metabolite of carminomycin obtained by formal reduction of the carbonyl group.

name: 13-dihydrodaunorubicin
definition: An aminoglycoside antibiotic that is (1S,3S)-3,5,12-trihydroxy-3-(1-hydroxyethyl)-10-methoxy-6,11-dioxo-1,2,3,4,6,11-hexahydrotetracene having a 3-amino-2,3,6-trideoxy-α-L-lyxo-hexopyranosyl residue attached at position 1 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 2'-hydroxybiochanin A
definition: A methoxyisoflavone in which the methoxy group is located at position 4' together with three additional hydroxy substituents at positions 2' 5 and 7.

name: 2,3,9,10-tetrahydroxyberbine
definition: A berberine alkaloid that is berbine substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3, 9 and 10.

name: 2,5-dichloro-4-oxohex-2-enedioic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is hexanedioic acid containing a double bond between positions 2 and 3, an oxo group at position 4, and two chlorine atoms (at positions 2 and 5).

name: 2-hydroxy-2,3-dihydrogenistein
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanone that is 2,3-dihydrogenistein with a hydroxy substituent at position 2.

name: 2-phytyl-1,4-naphthoquinone
definition: A phylloquinone that consists of 1,4-naphthoquinone bearing a phytyl group at position 2.

name: 3,5-dihydroxyphenylacetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3,5-dihydroxyphenylacetic acid.

name: 3,5-dihydroxyphenylglyoxylic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is glyoxylic acid in which the aldehyde hydrogen is substituted by a 3,5-dihydroxyphenyl group.

name: 3-amino-4,7-dihydroxycoumarin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is 4,7-dihydroxycoumarin bearing an additional amino substituent at positions 3.

name: 3-dimethylallyl-4-hydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 4-hydroxybenzoic acid bearing an additional dimethylallyl substituent at position 3.

name: 3-dimethylallyl-4-hydroxymandelic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is mandelic acid carrying dimethylallyl and hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively.

name: 3-dimethylallyl-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 3-dimethylallyl-4-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: methyl {2-[(1R)-1-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)-4-oxocyclohex-2-en-1-yl]ethyl}methylcarbamate
definition: A member of the class of cyclohexenones that is cyclohex-2-en-1-one in which the hydrogens at position 4 have been replaced by a 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl and a 2-[(methoxycarbonyl)(methyl)amino]ethyl group. The compound has been used in enantioselective syntheses of Scleretium alkaloids.

name: 4-hydroxyphenyl acetate
definition: A phenyl acetate obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of hydroquinone.

name: 5-aminopentanal
definition: An ω-aminoaldehyde that is pentanal which is substituted at position 5 by an amino group. It is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of L-lysine derived alkaloids.

name: 5-hydroxybisphenol A
definition: A bisphenol (methylenediphenol) having hydroxy functions at C-3, C-4 and C-4', and gem-dimethyl groups on the methylene bridge.

name: (E)-5-hydroxyconiferyl alcohol
definition: A 5-hydroxyconiferyl alcohol in which the double bond has E geochemistry.

name: 5-hydroxyferuloyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 5-hydroxyferulic acid.

name: 7-O-methylvitexin 2''-O-α-L-rhamnoside
definition: A derivative of vitexin having a α-L-rhamnosyl residue attached at the 2''-position of the glucitol moiety and a methyl group attached at the O-7 position of the chromene.

name: 8-demethyltetracenomycin C
definition: A member of the class of tetracenes that is tetracenomycin C in which the methoxy group at position 3 is replaced by a phenolic OH.

name: aceclofenac
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is the carboxymethyl ester of diclofenac. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug related to diclofenac, it is used in the management of osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis.

name: acemetacin
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the carboxymethyl ester of indometacin. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, it is used in the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, and low back pain, as well as for postoperative pain and inflammation. Its activity is due to both acemetacin and its major metabolite, indometacin.

name: spiramycin II
definition: A macrolide antibiotic produced by various Streptomyces species.

name: N-acetylsulfamethoxazole
definition: A sulfonamide compound having a 4-acetamidophenyl group attached to the sulfur atom and a 1,2-oxazol-3-yl group attached to the nitrogen atom.

name: O-acetyltropine
definition: An O-acyltropine in which the acyl group is acetyl.

name: adapalene
definition: A naphthoic acid that is CD437 in which the phenolic hydroxy group has been converted to its methyl ether.

name: adefovir pivoxil
definition: An organic phosphonate that is the dipivoxil ester of adefovir. A prodrug for adefovir, an HIV-1 reverse transcriptase inhibitor, adefovir pivoxil is used to treat chronic hepatitis B viral infection.

name: adipiodone
definition: An organoiodine compound that is 3-amino-2,4,6-triiodobenzoic acid in which one of the amino hydrogens is substituted by a 6-(3-carboxy-2,4,6-triiodoanilino)-6-oxohexanoyl group. It is a water-soluble radiographic contrast media for cholecystography and intravenous cholangiography.

name: aklanonic acid
definition: An anthraquinone that is anthracene-9,10-dione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 5, a carboxymethyl group at position 2 and a 3-oxopentanoyl group at position 3.

name: alclofenac
definition: An aromatic ether in which the ether oxygen links an allyl group to the 4-position of (3-chlorophenyl)acetic acid.A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, it was withdrawn from the UK market in 1979 due to concerns with its association with vasculitis and rash.

name: alclometasone dipropionate
definition: A prednisolone compound having an α-chloro substituent at the 7-position, an α-methyl substituent at the 16-position and O-propanoyl groups at the 17- and 21-positions.

name: alcuronium chloride
definition: Chloride salt of alcuronium.

name: alfacalcidol
definition: A member of the class of D3 vitamins that is calciol in which the hydrogen at the 1α position is replaced by a hydroxy group. It is an active metabolite of cholecalciferol, which performs important functions in regulation of the calcium balance and the bone metabolism.

name: alminoprofen
definition: A substituted aniline that is ibuprofen in which the isobutyl group is replaced by a (2-methylprop-2-en-1-yl)amino group. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, it is used for treatment of inflammatory and rheumatic disorders.

name: amezinium metilsulfate
definition: An azaheterocycle sulfate salt of amezinium. It is a sympathomimetic drug which suppresses noradrenaline reuptake and thereby elevating blood pressure. It is used for the treatment of low blood pressure in patients undergoing dialysis.

name: amfenac sodium hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate of the sodium salt of amfenac.

name: sodium p-aminohippurate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of p-aminohippuric acid.

name: amlexanox
definition: A pyridochromene-derived monocarboxylic acid having an amino substituent at the 2-position, an oxo substituent at the 5-position and an isopropyl substituent at the 7-position.

name: ammonium chloride
definition: An inorganic chloride having ammonium as the counterion.

name: ampiroxicam
definition: A benzothiazine that is the 1-[(ethoxycarbonyl)oxy]ethyl ether of piroxicam. A prodrug for piroxicam, it is used for the relief of pain and inflammation in musculoskeletal disorders such as rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis.

name: antipyrine
definition: A pyrazolone derivative that is 1,2-dihydropyrazol-3-one substituted with methyl groups at N-1 and C-5 and with a phenyl group at N-2.

name: apigenin 7-O-neohesperidoside
definition: An apigenin derivative having an α-(1→2)-L-rhamnopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety attached to the 7-hydroxy group.

name: aripiprazole
definition: An N-arylpiperazine that is piperazine substituted by a 4-[(2-oxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinolin-7-yl)oxy]butyl group at position 1 and by a 2,3-dichlorophenyl group at position 4. It is an antipsychotic drug used for the treatment of Schizophrenia, and other mood disorders.

name: azosemide
definition: A sulfonamide that is benzenesulfonamide which is substituted at positions 2, 4, and 5 by chlorine, (2-thienylmethyl)amino and 1H-tetrazol-5-yl groups, respectively. It is a diuretic that has been used in the management of oedema and hypertension.

name: azulene
definition: A mancude carbobicyclic parent consisting of a cycloheptatriene and cyclopentadiene rings.

name: 5,5-diethylbarbituric acid
definition: A member of the class of barbiturates, the structure of which is that of barbituric acid substituted at C-5 by two ethyl groups. Formerly used as a hypnotic (sleeping aid).

name: bendazac
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is glycolic acid in which the hydrogen attached to the 2-hydroxy group is replaced by a 1-benzyl-1H-indazol-3-yl group. Although it has anti-inflammatory, antinecrotic, choleretic and antilipidaemic properties and has been used for the treatment of various inflammatory skin disorders, its principal effect is to inhibit the denaturation of proteins. Its lysine salt is used in the management of cataracts.

name: oxybuprocaine hydrochloride
definition: The monohydrochloride salt of oxybuprocaine.

name: benserazide hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride salt of benserazide. An aromatic-L-amino-acid decarboxylase inhibitor (DOPA decarboxylase inhibitor) that does not enter the central nervous system, it is used as an adjunct to levodopa in the treatment of parkinsonism. By preventing the conversion of levodopa to dopamine in the periphery, it causes an increase in the amount of levodopa reaching the central nervous system and so reduces the required dose. Benserazide hydrochloride has no antiparkinson actions when given alone.

name: bentiromide
definition: The dipeptide obtained by condensation of N-benzoyl-L-tyrosine with 4-aminobenzoic acid. Used as a noninvasive screening test for exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and to monitor the adequacy of supplemental pancreatic therapy, it is given by mouth: the amount of 4-aminobenzoic acid and its metabolites excreted in the urine is taken as a measure of the chymotrypsin-secreting activity of the pancreas.

name: benzethonium chloride
definition: A (synthetic) quaternary ammonium salt that is benzyldimethylamine in which the nitrogen is quaternised by a 2-{2-[p-(2,4,4-trimethylpentan-2-yl)phenoxy]ethoxy}ethyl group, with chloride as the counter-ion. An antiseptic and disinfectant, it is active against a broad spectrum of bacteria, fungi, moulds and viruses.

name: benzyl nicotinate
definition: A benzyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of nicotinic acid with benzyl alcohol. It has been used as a rubefacient.

name: beraprost sodium
definition: The organic sodium salt of beraprost. It is used in the treatment of chronic arterial occlusive disease and primary pulmonary hypertension in Japan.

name: betamethasone dipropionate
definition: A steroid ester that is betamethasone in which the hydroxy hydrogens at positions 17 and 21 are replaced by propanoyl groups. It is used in combination with calcipotriene hydrate, a synthetic vitamin D analogue, for the topical treatment of plaque psoriasis in adult patients.

name: betamethasone valerate
definition: A steroid ester that is betamethasone in which the hydroxy group at the 17α position has been converted to the corresponding pentanoate ester.

name: betazole dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of betazole.

name: bepotastine besylate
definition: An organosulfonate salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of bepotastine and benzenesulfonic acid. A topical, selective and non-sedating histamine (H1) receptor antagonist used for treatment of itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis.

name: bevantolol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of bevantolol.

name: bolandiol dipropionate
definition: A steroid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of propanoic acid with the 3β and 17β hydroxy groups of bolandiol.

name: bromhexine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of bromhexine and hydrogen chloride. It is used as a mucolytic for the treatment of respiratory disorders associated with productive cough (i.e. a cough characterised by the production of sputum).

name: brotizolam
