definition: A thienotriazolodiazepine that is 6H-thieno[3,2-f][1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a][1,4]diazepine substituted by bromo, 2-chlorophenyl, and methyl groups at positions 2, 4, and 9, respectively. It is used as a hypnotic in the management of insomnia.

name: bufexamac
definition: A hydroxamic acid derived from phenylacetamide in which the benzene moiety is substituted at C-4 by a butoxy group. It has anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties.

name: bufogenin
definition: A steroid lactone of Chan su (toad venom), a Chinese medicine obtained from the skin venom gland of toads. A specific Na/K-ATPase protein inhibitor, it is used as a cardiotonic and central nervous system (CNS) respiratory agent, an analgesic and anesthetic, and as a remedy for ulcers.

name: bupivacaine hydrochloride (anhydrous)
definition: A racemate composed of equimolar amounts of dextrobupivacaine hydrochloride and levobupivacaine hydrochloride. The monohydrate form is commonly used as a local anaesthetic.

name: butenafine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of butenafine. An inhibitor of squalene epoxidase, an enzyme responsible for the creation of sterols needed in fungal cell membranes, it is used for treatment of dermatological fungal infections.

name: butropium bromide
definition: An organic bromide salt of butropium. It is a drug which suppresses spasm of smooth muscles of internal organs, inhibits gastric acid secretion and relieves abdominal pain. It is used in the treatment of spasmodic pains associated with gastritis, gastric ulcers and cholelithiasis.

name: butyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of butanol.

name: (E)-caffeyl alcohol
definition: A caffeyl alcohol in which the double bond has E geochemistry.

name: calcium glycerophosphate
definition: An organic calcium salt having glycerol 2-phosphate(2−) as the counterion.

name: calcium oxide
definition: A member of the class of calcium oxides of calcium and oxygen in a 1:1 ratio.

name: camostat mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate (mesylate) salt prepared from equimolar amounts of camostat and methanesulfonic acid. It is a serine protease inhibitor approved and marketed in Japan in 1985 for the alleviation of acute symptoms associated with chronic pancreatitis. In 1994, it was approved for the treatment of postoperative reflux esophagitis.

name: capecitabine
definition: A carbamate ester that is cytidine in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by fluorine and in which the amino group attached to position 4 is converted into its N-(penyloxy)carbonyl derivative. Capecitabine is a antineoplastic agent used in the treatment of cancers.

name: carbinoxamine maleate
definition: The maleic acid salt of carbinoxamine. An ethanolamine-type antihistamine, used for treating hay fever, as well as mild cases of Parkinson's disease.

name: carboplatin
definition: A platinum coordination entity with cis square-planar geometry in which platinum(II) is coordinated to two ammonia ligands and a bidentate cyclobutane-1,1-dicarboxylate ligand.

name: carminomycin
definition: A toxic anthracycline antibiotic that is produced by Actinomadura carminata and also has potent antineoplastic activity.

name: carpronium chloride
definition: The chloride salt of carpronium. It is a hair growth stimulant used for the treatment of alopecia.

name: carumonam sodium
definition: The disodium salt of carumonam.

name: cefepime hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrate of the dihydrochloride salt of cefepime.

name: cefmenoxime hydrochloride
definition: The hemihydrochloride salt of cefmenoxime.

name: cefminox sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt of cefminox.

name: cefotiam hexetil dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of cefotiam 1-(cyclohexyloxycarbonyloxy)ethyl ester. It is used as a prodrug for cefotiam.

name: cefotiam dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of cefotiam.

name: cefpiramide sodium
definition: The sodium salt of cefpiramide.

name: cefroxadine
definition: A first-generation cephalosporin antibiotic having methoxy and [(2R)-2-amino-2-(cyclohexa-1,4-dien-1-yl)acetyl]amino side groups located at positions 3 and 7 respectively.

name: cefuzonam sodium
definition: The sodium salt of cefuzonam.

name: cetrorelix acetate
definition: The acetic acid salt of cetrorelix. A gonadotrophin-releasing hormone (GnRH) antagonist, it is used for treatment of infertility and of hormone-sensitive cancers of the prostate and breast.

name: ciclopirox olamine
definition: The ethanolamine salt of ciclopirox. A broad spectrum antigfungal agent, it also exhibits antibacterial activity against many Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, and has anti-inflammatory properties. It is used a a topical treatment of fungal skin and nail infections.

name: cilnidipine
definition: A diesterified 1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarboxylic acid. A calcium channel blocker, it is used as an antihypertensive.

name: cilostazol
definition: A lactam that is 3,4-dihydroquinolin-2(1H)-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is substituted by a 4-(1-cyclohexyl-1H-tetrazol-5-yl)butoxy group.

name: cinnamyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of cinnamyl alcohol with acetic acid. Found in cinnamon leaf oil.

name: clenbuterol hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride salt of clenbuterol.

name: clobazam
definition: 7-Chloro-1H-1,5-benzodiazepine-2,4(3H,5H)-dione in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen at position 1 is substituted by a methyl group, whilst that attached to the other nitrogen is substituted by a phenyl group. It is used for the short-term management of acute anxiety and as an adjunct in the treatment of epilepsy in association with other antiepileptics.

name: clobetasol propionate
definition: The 17-O-propionate ester of clobetasol. A potent corticosteroid, it is used to treat various skin disorders, including exzema and psoriasis.

name: colforsin daropate hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of colforsin daropate. It is a drug used for the treatment of acute heart failure. It directly stimulates adenylate cyclase and produces positive inotropic and vasodilator effects accompanied by the increase in cellular cAMP.

name: conivaptan hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of conivaptan. It is an antagonist for two of the three types of arginine vasopressin (AVP) receptors, V1a and V2, and is used for the treatment of hyponatraemia (low blood sodium levels) caused by syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone (SIADH).

name: corynebactin
definition: A crown compound that is enterobactin in which the pro-R hydrogens at positions 2, 6 and 10 of the trilactone backbone are replaced by methyl groups, and in which a glycine spacer separates the trilactone backbone from each of the catecholamide arms. It is the endogenous siderophore of Bacillus subtilis, used for the acquisition of iron.

name: crotamiton
definition: An enamide resulting from the formal condensation of crotonic acid with N-ethyl-2-methylaniline. A colourless or pale yellow oily liquid, it is used in the treatment of pruritus (itching) by producing a counter-irritation: as it evaporates from the skin, it produces a cooling effect that diverts attention away from the itching. It has also been used as an acaricide in the treatment of scabies, though more effective drugs are usually preferred.

name: copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate
definition: The pentahydrate of copper(2+) sulfate. A bright blue crystalline solid.

name: fluticasone propionate
definition: A trifluorinated corticosteroid that consists of 6α,9-difluoro-11β,17α-dihydroxy-17β-{[(fluoromethyl)sulfanyl]carbonyl}-16-methyl-3-oxoandrosta-1,4-diene bearing a propionyl substituent at position 17; has anti-inflammatory, anti-asthmatic and anti-allergic activity.

name: cyanidin 3-O-(6-O-malonyl-β-D-glucoside)
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of cyanidin having a 6-O-malonyl-β-D-glucosyl residue attached at the 3-hydroxy position.

name: cyclic ADP-β-D-ribose
definition: A cyclic purine nucleotide that is synthesised from NAD+ by ADP-ribosyl cyclase; acts as an agonist at ryanodine receptors.

name: cyclothiazide
definition: 3,4-Dihydro-2H-1,2,4-benzothiadiazine 1,1-dioxide substituted at positions 3, 5 and 6 by a 2-norbornen-5-yl group, chlorine, and a sulfonamide group, respectively. A thiazide diuretic, it has been used in the management of hypertension and oedema.

name: darifenacin hydrobromide
definition: The hydrobromide salt of darifenacin. A selective antagonist for the M3 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor, which is primarily responsible for bladder muscle contractions, it is used in the management of urinary incontinence.

name: decanal
definition: A saturated fatty aldehyde formally arising from reduction of the carboxy group of capric acid (decanoic acid).

name: 3,7,12-trioxo-5β-cholanic acid
definition: An oxo-5β-cholanic acid in which three oxo substituents are located at positions 3, 7 and 12 on the cholanic acid skeleton.

name: desferrioxamine B mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate salt obtained by reaction of desferrioxamine B with one molar equivalent of methanesulfonic acid. It is an iron-chelating medicine used to remove excess iron from the body. It binds to iron in the blood, which is then passed out in the urine.

name: delphinidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of delphinidin having a β-D-glucosyl residue attached at the 3-hydroxy position.

name: 2-deoxyribose 5-triphosphate
definition: A 2-deoxyribose triphosphate in which the triphosphate group is located at position 5.

name: dequalinium chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt that is the dichloride salt of dequalinium.

name: descarbamoylnovobiocin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is novobiocin lacking the carbamoyl group from position 3 on the hexose ring.

name: deslanoside
definition: A cardenolide glycoside that is lanatoside C with the acetoxy group replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: desmethyldescarbamoylnovobiocin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is novobiocin lacking the 3-O-carbamoyl and 4-O-methyl groups from the hexose ring.

name: sodium dibunate
definition: The sodium salt of dibunic acid. It is used as a cough suppressant.

name: diflorasone diacetate
definition: The 17,21-diacetate derivative of diflorasone. It is used topically for its anti-inflammatory and antipruritic properties in the treatment of various skin disorders.

name: dihydro-nogalonic acid methyl ester
definition: A dihydroxyanthraquinone that is chrysazin which is substituted by a 3-hydroxybutanoyl group at position 2 and by a 2-methoxy-2-oxoethyl at position 3.

name: dihydro-α-ergocryptine mesylate
definition: The methanesulfonic acid salt of dihydro-α-ergocryptine.

name: dihydroergocristine mesylate
definition: The methanesulfonic acid salt of dihydroergocristine. It has been used as the for the symptomatic treatment of mental deterioration associated with cerebrovascular insufficiency and in peripheral vascular disease. It is also a component of ergoloid mesylate (codergocrine mesilate), a mixture of ergot alkaloid derivatives that is used as a vasodilator and has shown mild benefits in the treatment of vascular dementia.

name: dilazep dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of dilazep. It inhibits adenosine uptake, ischemic damage, platelet aggregation, and membrane transport of nucleosides.

name: dilevalol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of dilevalol.

name: dimethicone macromolecule
definition: A polydimethylsiloxane macromolecule, composed of dimethylsiloxane repeating units.

name: dioncopeltine A
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is the biaryl resulting from substitution of the hydrogen at the 7-position of (1R,3R)-1,3-dimethyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinolin-8-ol by a 1-hydroxy-6-(hydroxymethyl)-8-methoxynaphthalen-5-yl group. It is a naphthylisoquinoline alkaloid found in Triphyophyllum peltatum.

name: dioncophylline A
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is the biaryl resulting from substitution of the hydrogen at the 7-position of (1R,3R)-1,3-dimethyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinolin-8-ol by a 4,5-dimethoxy-2-methylnaphthalen-1-yl group. It is a naphthylisoquinoline alkaloid isolated from the roots and stem barks of Triphyophyllum peltatum and exhibits antifungal, antimalarial, antineoplastic and molluscicidal activites.

name: dioncophylline C
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is the biaryl resulting from substitution of the hydrogen at the 5-position of (1R,3R)-1,3-dimethyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinolin-8-ol by a 5-hydroxy-4-methoxy-2-methylnaphthalen-1-yl group. It is a naphthylisoquinoline alkaloid isolated from the roots and stem barks of Triphyophyllum peltatum and exhibits antimalarial activity.

name: diphenylpyraline hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of diphenylpyraline. A sedating antihistamine, it is used as the hydrochloride for the symptomatic relief of allergic conditions including rhinitis and hay fever, and in pruritic skin disorders.

name: distigmine bromide
definition: An organic bromide salt of distigmine. It is an anticholinesterase drug used for the treatment of myasthenia gravis and postoperative urinary retention.

name: domperidone
definition: 1-[3-(Piperidin-1-yl)propyl]-1,3-dihydro-2H-benzimidazol-2-one in which the 4-position of the piperidine ring is substituted by a 5-chloro-1,3-dihydro-2H-benzimidazol-2-on-1-yl group. A dopamine antagonist, it is used as an antiemetic for the short-term treatment of nausea and vomiting, and to control gastrointestinal effects of dopaminergic drugs given in the management of parkinsonism. The free base is used in oral suspensions, while the maleate salt is used in tablet preparations.

name: doxapram hydrochloride monohydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of doxapram hydrochloride. A central and respiratory stimulant with a brief duration of action, it is used as a temporary treatment of acute respiratory failure, particularly when superimposed on chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and of postoperative respiratory depression. It has also been used for treatment of postoperative shivering.

name: doxifluridine
definition: A pyrimidine 5'-deoxyribonucleoside that is 5-fluorouridine in which the hydroxy group at the 5' position is replaced by a hydrogen. It is an oral prodrug of the antineoplastic agent 5-fluorouracil. Designed to circumvent the rapid degradation of 5-fluorouracil by dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase in the gut wall, it is converted into 5-fluorouracil in the presence of pyrimidine nucleoside phosphorylase.

name: droxidopa
definition: A serine derivative that is L-serine substituted at the β-position by a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group. A prodrug for noradrenalone, it is used for treatment of neurogenic orthostatic hypotension

name: (S)-duloxetine hydrochloride
definition: A duloxetine hydrochloride in which the duloxetine moiety has S configuration.

name: ecgonine methyl ester
definition: The O-debenzoyl analogue of cocaine.

name: edaravone
definition: A pyrazolone that is 2,4-dihydro-3H-pyrazol-3-one which is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by phenyl and methyl groups, respectively.

name: emtricitabine
definition: An organofluorine compound that is 5-fluorocytosine substituted at the 1 position by a 2-(hydroxymethyl)-1,3-oxathiolan-5-yl group (2R,5S configuration). It is used in combination therapy for the treatment of HIV-1 infection.

name: epalrestat
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is 1,3-thiazolidine which is substituted on the nitrogen by a carboxymethyl group, at positions 2 and 4 by thioxo and oxo groups, respectively, and at position 5 by a 2-methyl-3-phenylprop-2-en-1-ylidene group. It is an inhibitor of aldose reductase (which catalyses the conversion of glucose to sorbitol) and is used for the treatment of some diabetic complications, including neuropathy.

name: epidihydrocholesterin
definition: A 5α-chloestane compound having a 3α-hydroxy substituent.

name: epothilone A
definition: An epithilone that is epothilone C in which the double bond in the macrocyclic lactone ring has been oxidised to the corresponding epoxide (the 13R,14S diastereoisomer).

name: epothilone B
definition: An epithilone that is epithilone D in which the double bond in the macrocyclic ring has been oxidised to the corresponding epoxide (the S,S stereoisomer).

name: eprazinone hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining eprazinone with two molar equivalents of hydrochloric acid.

name: ergometrine maleate
definition: A maleate salt resulting form the reaction of equimolar amounts of maleic acid and ergometrine. It is used in the active management of the third stage of labour, and to prevent or treat postpartum of postabortal haemorrhage caused by uterine atony: by maintaining uterine contraction and tone, blood vessels in the uterine wall are compressed and blood flow reduced.

name: erythromycin ethylsuccinate
definition: A erythromycin derivative that is erythromycin A in which the hydroxy group at position 3R is substituted by a (4-ethoxy-4-oxobutanoyl)oxy group. It is used for the treatment of a wide variety of bacterial infections.

name: esatenolol
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of atenolol.

name: estramustine sodium phosphate
definition: An organic sodium salt which is the disodium salt of estramustine phosphate.

name: profenamine hydrochloride
definition: The monohydrochloride salt of profenamine. An antimuscarinic, it is used for the symptomatic treatment of Parkinson's disease.

name: ethyl isovalerate
definition: The fatty acid ethyl ester of isovaleric acid.

name: ethyl linoleate
definition: A long-chain fatty acid ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of linoleic acid with the hydroxy group of ethanol.

name: ethylparaben
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid with ethanol,

name: ethylestrenol
definition: A 17β-hydroxy steroid that is estrane containing a double bond between positions 4 and 5 and substituted by an ethyl group and a hydroxy group at the 17α and 17β positions, respectively. It is an anabolic steroid that has little androgenic effect and only slight progestational activity. It has been used to promote growth in boys with delayed bone growth.

name: exalamide
definition: An benzamide that is salicylamide in which the phenolic hydroxy group has been converted into the corresponding hexyl ether. It has been used as a topical antifungal agent.

name: fabesetron
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 8,9-dihydropyrido[1,2-a]indol-6(7H)-one substituted by a (5-methyl-1H-imidazol-4-yl)methyl group at position 7R and a methyl group at position 10. It is a dual 5-HT3 and 5-HT4 receptors antagonist whose clinical development was terminated in phase II. It was being developed for the treatment of chemotherapy-induced emesis and irritable bowel syndrome.

name: fasudil hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of fasudil with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: febuxostat
definition: A 1,3-thiazolemonocarboxylic acid that is 4-methyl-1,3-thiazole-5-carboxylic acid which is substituted by a 3-cyano-4-(2-methylpropoxy)phenyl group at position 2. It is an orally-active, potent, and selective xanthine oxidase inhibitor used for the treatment of chronic hyperuricaemia in patients with gout.

name: biphenyl-4-ylacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid in which one of the α-hydrogens is substituted by a biphenyl-4-yl group. An active metabolite of fenbufen, it is used as a topical medicine to treat muscle inflammation and arthritis.

name: fenoterol hydrobromide
definition: The hydrobromide salt of fenoterol. A β2-adrenergic agonist, it is used as a bronchodilator in the management of reversible airway obstruction.

name: fentanyl citrate
definition: The citric acid salt of fentanyl, comprising equimolar amounts of citric acid and fentanyl. A μ-opioid receptor agonist, it is a potent opioid analgesic used in the management of labour pain, postoperative pain, and chronic intractable cancer pain. It is also widely used as the analgesic component of balanced anaesthesia.

name: flunitrazepam
definition: A 1,4-benzodiazepinone that is nitrazepam substituted by a methyl group at position 1 and by a fluoro group at position 2'. It is a potent hypnotic, sedative, and amnestic drug used to treat chronic insomnia.

name: fluocinolone acetonide
definition: A fluorinated steroid that is flunisolide in which the hydrogen at position 9 is replaced by fluorine. A corticosteroid with glucocorticoid activity, it is used (both as the anhydrous form and as the dihydrate) in creams, gels and ointments for the treatment of various skin disorders.

name: fluorescein (lactone form)
definition: A xanthene dye that is highly fluorescent, detectable even when present in minute quantities. Used forensically to detect traces of blood, in analytical chemistry as an indicator in silver nitrate titrations and in microscopy.

name: fluorometholone
definition: A member of the class of glucocorticoids that is Δ1-progesterone substituted at positions 11β and 17 by hydroxy groups, at position 6α by a methyl group and at position 9 by a fluoro group. Used for the treatment of corticosteroid-responsive inflammation of the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva, cornea and anterior segment of the globe.

name: flutropium bromide
definition: The organic bromide salt of flutropium. It is used in Japan for the treatment asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: fondaparinux sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt, being the decasodium salt of fondaparinux.

name: fulvestrant
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is 17β-estradiol in which the 7α hydrogen has been replaced by a nonyl group in which one of the hydrogens of the terminal methyl has been replaced by a (4,4,5,5,5-pentafluoropentyl)sulfinyl group. An estrogen receptor antagonist, it is used in the treatment of breast cancer.

name: gadodiamide hydrate
definition: The hydrate of gadodiamide.

name: gadoteridol
definition: A non-ionic gadolinium chelate having a macrocyclic tetraamine framework. It is used as a paramagnetic contrast agent in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

name: gadoversetamide
definition: A gadolinium coordination entity that consists of Gd3+ coordinated to 3,6,9-triazaundecadiamide in which each of the amide nitrogens is substituted by a 2-methoxyethyl group and in which the nitrogens at positions 3, 6, and 9 are each substituted by carboxylatomethyl group. The gadolinium is coordinated to the three tertiary amino groups as well as to the carboxylate groups. A white odourless powder that is freely soluble in water, gadoversetamide has paramagnetic properties and is used as a contrast agent in magnetic resonance imaging. It distributes mainly in extracellular fluid, but does not cross the blood-brain barrier. It is used particularly in imaging the brain, spine and liver.

name: gemcitabine hydrochloride
definition: A 2'-deoxycytidine hydrochloriode having geminal fluoro substituents in the 2'-position. An inhibitor of ribonucleotide reductase, gemcitabine hydrochloride is used in the treatment of various carcinomas, including non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic cancer, bladder cancer and breast cancer.

name: (E)-geranyl formate
definition: The formate ester of geraniol.

name: teprenone
definition: A terpene ketone in which a (9E,13E)-geranylgernayl group is bonded to one of the α-methyls of acetone (it is a mixture of 5E- and 5Z-geoisomers in a 3:2 ratio).

name: glafenine
definition: A carboxylic ester that is 2,3-dihydroxypropyl anthranilate in which the amino group is substituted by a 7-chloroquinolin-4-yl group. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, glafenine and its hydrochloride salt were used for the relief of all types of pain, but high incidence of anaphylactic reactions resulted in their withdrawal from the market.

name: glymidine sodium
definition: The organic sodium salt of glymidine. It is a hypoglycemic drug used for the treatment of diabetes mellitus.

name: hydralazine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of hydralazine; a direct-acting vasodilator that is used as an antihypertensive agent.

name: cortisol 17-butyrate
definition: Cortisol esterified with butyric acid at the 17-hydroxy group.

name: hydrocortisone caproate
definition: The 21-O-hexanoyl derivative of hydrocortisone.

name: hydrocortisone succinate
definition: A derivative of succinic acid in which one of the carboxy groups is esterified by the C-21 hydroxy group of cortisol (hydrocortisone).

name: idebenone
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-benzoquinones which is substituted by methoxy groups at positions 2 and 3, by a methyl group at positions 5, and by a 10-hydroxydecyl group at positions 6. Initially developed for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, benefits were modest; it was subsequently found to be of benefit for the symptomatic treatment of Friedreich's ataxia.

name: imatinib methanesulfonate
definition: A methanesulfonate (mesylate) salt that is the monomesylate salt of imatinib. Used for treatment of chronic myelogenous leukemia and gastrointestinal stromal tumours.

name: indigo carmine
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal condensation of indigo carmine (acid form) with two equivalents of sodium hydroxide. It is an indicator at pH 11.5-14, changing from blue to yellow.

name: indolin-2-one
definition: An indolinone carrying an oxo group at position 2.

name: iobitridol
definition: A benzenedicarboxamide compound having N-substituted carbamoyl groups at the 1- and 3-positions, iodo substituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions and a 3-hydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)propanimido at position 5.

name: iodamide
definition: A benzoic acid compound having iodo substituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions, an acetamido substituent at the 3-position and an acetamidomethyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: iodipamide dimeglumine
definition: An organoammonium salt obtained by reaction of adipiodone with two equivalents of 1-deoxy-1-(methylamino)-D-glucitol. It is a contrast agent used in diagnostic imaging.

name: iodixanol
definition: A dimeric, non-ionic, water-soluble, radiographic contrast agent, used particularly in coronary angiography.

name: iohexol
definition: A benzenedicarboxamide compound having N-(2,3-dihydroxypropyl)carbamoyl groups at the 1- and 3-positions, iodo substituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions and an N-(2,3-dihydroxypropyl)acetamido group at the 5-position.

name: iomeprol
definition: A benzenedicarboxamide compound having N-substituted carbamoyl groups at the 1- and 3-positions, iodo substituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions and a glycoloyl(methyl)amino group at the 5-position.

name: iopamidol
definition: A benzenedicarboxamide compound having N-substituted carbamoyl groups at the 1- and 3-positions, iodo substituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions and a (2S)-2-hydroxypropanamido group at the 5-position.

name: ioxaglic acid
definition: A benzenedicarboxamide compound having N-substituted carbamoyl groups at the 1- and 3-positions, iodo substituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions and an acetyl(methyl)amino group at the 5-position.

name: ipriflavone
definition: A member of the class of isoflavones that is isoflavone in which the hydrogen at position 7 is replaced by an isopropoxy group. A synthetic isoflavone, it was formerly used for the treatment of osteoporosis, although a randomised controlled study failed to show any benefit. It is still used to prevent osteoporosis in post-menopausal women.

name: isoamyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of isoamylol.

name: isoamyl formate
definition: The formate ester of isoamylol.

name: isopropyl unoprostone
definition: The isopropyl ester of unoprostone.

name: jadomycin B
definition: A jadomycin that is jadomycin A in which the phenolic hydroxy group at position 12 has been converted to the corresponding 2,6-dideoxy-α-L-ribo-hexopyranoside, isolated from Streptomyces venezuelae. It exists as a diastereoisomeric mixture consisting of both 3aS and 3aR isomers.

name: josamycin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic produced by certain strains of Streptomyces narbonensis var. josamyceticus.

name: kaempferol 3-O-[6-(4-coumaroyl)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside]
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is kaempferol substituted at position 3 by a 6-(4-coumaroyl)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucosyl moiety via a glycosidic linkage.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-galactoside
definition: A β-D-galactoside compound with a 4',5,7-trihydroxychromen-3-yl group at the anomeric position.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside
definition: A sophoroside that is kaempferol attached to a β-D-sophorosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside that is kaempferol attached to a β-D-sophorotriosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: aldehydo-D-kanosamine
definition: The acyclic form of D-kanosamine.

name: 3-amino-3-deoxy-6-O-phosphono-D-glucopyranose
definition: An amino sugar phosphate that is the 6-O-phosphate of 3-amino-3-deoxy-D-glucopyranose.

name: kebuzone
definition: A pyrazolidine that is phenylbutazone in which the two methylene hydrogens at postion 3 on the butyl chain are replaced by an oxo group.

name: ketotifen fumarate
definition: An organoammonium salt consisting of equimolar amounts of ketotifen(1+) and fumarate(1−) ions. A blocker of histamine H1 receptors with a stabilising action on mast cells, it is a non-bronchodilator anti-asthmatic drug.

name: kinobscurinone
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 10,11-dihydro-5H-benzo[b]fluorene substituted by a methyl group at position 1, hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 9, and oxo groups at positions 5, 10 and 11.

name: leucomycin V
definition: A macrolide antibiotic produced by Streptomyces kitasatoensis, showing activity against a wide spectrum of pathogens.

name: L-4-hydroxyphenylglycine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 4-hydroxyphenylglycine.

name: lanperisone hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of lanperisone. It is a muscle relaxant.

name: laricitrin
definition: A monomethoxyflavone that is the 3'-O-methyl derivative of myricetin.

name: lead diacetate
definition: A lead coordination entity in which a central lead(2+) atom is coordinated to two acetate ions.

name: levobupivacaine hydrochloride (anhydrous)
definition: The monohydrochloride salt of levobupivacaine.

name: lopinavir
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide that is amphetamine is substituted on nitrogen by a (2,6-dimethylphenoxy)acetyl group and on the carbon α- to nitrogen by a (1S,3S)-1-hydroxy-3-{[(2S)-3-methyl-2-(2-oxotetrahydropyrimidin-1-yl)butanoyl]amino}-4-phenylbutyl group. An antiretroviral of the protease inhibitor class, it is used against HIV infections as a fixed-dose combination with another protease inhibitor, ritonavir.

name: lornoxicam
definition: A thienothiazine-derived monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 6-chloro-4-hydroxy-2-methylthieno[2,3-e][1,2]thiazine-3-carboxylic acid 1,1-dioxide with the amino group of 2-aminopyridine. Used for the treatment of pain, primarily resulting from inflammatory diseases of the joints, osteoarthritis, surgery, sciatica and other inflammations.

name: loxoprofen sodium hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of loxoprofen sodium. The parent acid, loxoprofen, is a prodrug that is rapidly converted into its active trans-alcohol metabolite following oral administration.

name: luteolin 7-O-neohesperidoside
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is luteolin substituted by a 2-O-(α-L-rhamnopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: magnesium carbonate
definition: A magnesium salt with formula CMgO3. Its hydrated forms, particularly the di-, tri-, and tetrahydrates occur as minerals.

name: magnesium sulfate heptahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the heptahydrate form of magnesium sulfate.

name: malvidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of malvidin having a β-D-glucosyl residue attached at the 3-hydroxy position.

name: fleroxacin
definition: A fluoroquinolone antibiotic that is 4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline which is substituted at positions 1, 3, 6, 7 and 8 by 2-fluoroethyl, carboxy, fluoro, 4-methylpiperazin-1-yl and fluoro groups, respectively. It is active against many Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.

name: meglumine amidotrizoate
definition: The N-methylglucamine salt of amidotrizoic acid. Both the sodium and the meglumine salts of amidotrizoic acid have been widely used as water-soluble radioopaque media in diagnostic radiography. The use of a mixture of the two salts is often preferred, as adverse effects can be reduced.

name: mercury dichloride
definition: A mercury coordination entity made up of linear triatomic molecules in which a mercury atom is bonded to two chlorines. Water-soluble, it is highly toxic. Once used in a wide variety of applications, including preserving wood and anatomical specimens, embalming and disinfecting, as an intensifier in photography, as a mordant for rabbit and beaver furs, and freeing gold from lead, its use has markedly declined as less toxic alternatives have been developed.

name: methoxyphenamine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of methoxyphenamine, a β-adrenergic receptor agonist that regulates norephinephrine and ephinephrinein concentrations.

name: methyl salicylate
definition: A benzoate ester that is the methyl ester of salicylic acid.

name: methylparaben
definition: A 4-hydroxybenzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid with methanol. It is the most frequently used antimicrobial preservative in cosmetics. It occurs naturally in several fruits, particularly in blueberries.

name: metiazinic acid
definition: Phenothiazine substituted at nitrogen by a methyl group and at C-2 by a carboxymethyl group.

name: mianserin hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of mianserin, a tetracyclic compound with antidepressant effects.

name: midodrine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the combination of equimolar amounts of midodrine and hydrogen chloride. Midodrine is a direct-acting sympathomimetic with selective α-adrenergic agonist activity. The hydrochloride salt is used as a peripheral vasoconstrictor in the treatment of certain hypotensive states. The main active moiety is its major metabolite, deglymidodrine.

name: militarinone A
definition: A pyridine alkaloid that is 1,4-dihydroxypyridin-2(1H)-one substituted by a cis-1,4-dihydroxycyclohexyl group at position 5 and a (2E,4E,6E,8R,10R)-6,8,10-trimethyldodeca-2,4,6-trienoyl moiety at position 3. It is isolated from the mycelium of the entomogenous fungus, Paecilomyces militaris and has been found to induce pronounced neurite sprouting.

name: molsidomine
definition: A member of the class of oxadiazoles that is 1,2,3-oxadiazole substituted by morpholin-4-yl and (ethoxycarbonyl)azanidyl groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is used as a vasodilator drug for the treatment of myocardial ischemic syndrome and congestive heart failure.

name: N-methyl-D-aspartic acid
definition: An aspartic acid derivative having an N-methyl substituent and D-configuration.

name: N-oleoyldopamine
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the amino group of dopamine. Synthesised in catecholaminergic neurons, it crosses the blood-brain barrier and might be considered as a carrier of dopamine into the brain. It is a transient receptor potential vanilloid type 1 (TRPV1) receptor agonist.

name: N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipic acid
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino acid consisting of L-2-aminoadipic acid carrying an N-acetyl substituent.

name: N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipic acid 6-phosphate
definition: An aminoacyl phosphate consisting of N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipic acid having the phosphate group located at the 6-position.

name: naloxone hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of naloxone and hydrogen chloride. A specific opioid antagonist, it is used to reverse the effects of opioids, both following their use of opioids during surgery and in cases of known or suspected opioid overdose.

name: nateglinide
definition: An N-acyl-D-phenylalanine resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of D-phenylalanine with the carboxy group of trans-4-isopropylcyclohexanecarboxylic acid. An orally-administered, rapidly-absorbed, short-acting insulinotropic agent, it is used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

name: neticonazole hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of neticonazole and hydrogen chloride. An inhibitor of P450-dependent C-14α-demethylation of lanosterol (preventing conversion to ergosterol and inhibiting cell wall synthesis in fungi), it is used in Japan as an antifungal drug for the treatment of superficial skin infections.

name: nicorandil
definition: A pyrimidinecarboxamide that is nicotinamide in which one of the hydrogens attached to the carboxamide nitrogen is replaced by a 2-(nitrooxy)ethyl group. It has both nitrate-like and ATP-sensitive potassium channel activator properties, and is used for the prevention and treatment of angina pectoris.

name: nimetazepam
definition: A nitrazepam which is substituted at positions 1 by a methyl group. It is used as an anticonvulsant and as a hypnotic for the short-term management of insomnia.

name: nogalonic acid
definition: A dihydroxyanthraquinone that is 1,8-dihydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone which is substituted a position 2 by a 3-oxobutanoyl group and at position 3 by a carboxymethyl group. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of nogalamycin.

name: novobiocic acid
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is the aglycone of novobiocin.

name: oxaliplatin
definition: A platinum coordination entity that is a commonly used chemothrepeutic drug for treatment of colorectal cancer.

name: oxatomide
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-benzimidazol-2-one substituted by a 3-[4-(diphenylmethyl)piperazin-1-yl]propyl group at position 1. It is an anti-allergic drug.

name: pantethine
definition: An organic disulfide that consists of two molecules of pantothenic acid linked by amide bonds to a cysteamine disulfide bridging group.

name: pelargonidin 3-O-(6-O-malonyl-β-D-glucoside)
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of pelargonidin having a 6-O-malonyl-β-D-glucosyl residue attached at the 3-hydroxy position.

name: pelargonidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of pelargonidin having a β-D-glucosyl residue attached at the 3-hydroxy position.

name: pelargonidin 3-O-rutinoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of pelargonidin having a rutinosyl [6-deoxy-α-L-mannosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl] residue attached at the 3-hydroxy position.

name: pelargonidin 3-O-rutinoside 5-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of pelargonidin having a rutinosyl [6-deoxy-α-L-mannosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl] residue attached at the 3-hydroxy position and a β-D-glucosyl residue at the 5-hydroxy position.

name: octafluoropropane
definition: A fluorocarbon that is propane in which all of the hydrogens have been replaced by fluorines.

name: periciazine
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is 10H-phenothiazine substituted by a 3-(4-hydroxypiperidin-1-yl)propyl group at the nitrogen atom and a carbonitrile group at position 2. Periciazine is a first generation antipsychotic.

name: pethidine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of pethidine. An analgesic used for the treatment of postoperative and labour pain.

name: petunidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation that is petunidin substituted at position 3 by a β-D-glucosyl residue

name: phenethyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of 2-phenylethanol.

name: phenol red
definition: 3H-2,1-Benzoxathiole 1,1-dioxide in which both of the hydrogens at position 3 have been substituted by 4-hydroxyphenyl groups. A pH indicator changing colour from yellow below pH 6.8 to bright pink above pH 8.2, it is commonly used as an indicator in cell cultures and in home swimming pool test kits. It is also used in the (now infrequently performed) phenolsulfonphthalein (PSP) test for estimation of overall blood flow through the kidney.

name: N,N-dimethylethanolamine phosphate
definition: The N,N-dimethyl derivative of ethanolamine phosphate.

name: pibutidine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of pibutidine. It is a H2 receptor antagonist which was developed for the treatment of peptic ulcers and duodenal ulcers. It was in phase III clinical trials in Japan (now discontinued).

name: pipamperone dihydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the reaction of pipamperone with 2 mol eq. of hydrogen chloride. It is used as an antipsychotic.

name: pirfenidone
definition: A pyridone that is 2-pyridone substituted at positions 1 and 5 by phenyl and methyl groups respectively. An anti-inflammatory drug used for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

name: piroheptine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of piroheptine.

name: piromidic acid
definition: A pyridopyrimidine that is 5-oxo-5,8-dihydropyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidine-6-carboxylic acid, substituted at position 2 by a pyrrolidin-1-yl group and at position 8 by an ethyl group. A synthetic antibacterial which is used for the treatment of urinary tract and intestinal infections.

name: pitavastatin
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is (6E)-7-[2-cyclopropyl-4-(4-fluorophenyl)quinolin-3-yl]hept-6-enoic acid in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 3 and 5 (the 3R,5S-stereoisomer). Used as its calcium salt for treatment of hypercholesterolemia (elevated levels of cholesterol in the blood) on patients unable to sufficiently lower their cholesterol levels by diet and exercise.

name: plaunotol
definition: A diterpenoid that is geranylgeraniol carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 18.

name: polyoxyl 40 stearate
definition: An octadecanoate ester composed of repeating 8-40 ethyleneoxy units. It is an ingredient used in cosmetics and beauty products primarily as a surfactant and emulsifier.

name: potassium acetate
definition: A potassium salt comprising equal numbers of potassium and acetate ions

name: potassium bromide
definition: A metal bromide salt with a K(+) counterion.

name: potassium 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonate
definition: An organic potassium salt having 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonate as the counterion. Commonly used as an expectorant.

name: potassium bitartrate
definition: An organic potassium salt of L-tartaric acid. It is a by-product of winemaking and occurs naturally in grapes, the major fruit used to produce wine.

name: pralidoxime iodide
definition: An organic iodide salt that has pralidoxime as the cation.

name: prednisolone sodium succinate
definition: The organic sodium salt of prednisolone succinate.

name: premithramycin A2'
definition: A tetracenomycin that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of the antitumour drug mithramycin by Streptomyces argillaceus.

name: premithramycin A3'
definition: A tetracenomycin that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of the antitumour drug mithramycin by Streptomyces argillaceus.

name: prilocaine hydrochloride
definition: The monohydrochloride salt of prilocaine.

name: proglumetacin dimaleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by combining proglumetacin with two molar equivalents of maleic acid. Used to control pain and inflammation associated with musculoskeletal and joint disorders. Following oral adminitration, it is metabolied to indometacin and proglumide, a drug with antisecretory effects that helps prevent injury to the stomach lining.

name: proglumide
definition: A racemate composed of equal amounts of (R)- and (S)-proglumide. A non-selective CCK antagonist that was used primarily for treatment of stomach ulcers, but has been replaced by newer drugs.

name: propylparaben
definition: The benzoate ester that is the propyl ester of 4-hydroxybenzoic acid. Preservative typically found in many water-based cosmetics, such as creams, lotions, shampoos and bath products. Also used as a food additive.

name: pyrrolnitrin
definition: A member of the class of pyrroles carrying chloro and 3-chloro-2-nitrophenyl substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively.

name: quercetin 3-O-(6-O-malonyl-β-D-glucoside)
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin attached to a 6-O-malonyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: quercetin 3-O-[β-D-xylosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside]
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin attached to a β-D-sambubiosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidc linkage.

name: quercetin 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin attached to a β-D-sophorosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: quercetin 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin attached to a β-D-sophorotriosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: remifentanil hydrochloride
definition: The monohydrochloride salt of remifentanil.

name: rhodomycin D
definition: An anthracycline that is aklavinone having a 3-amino-2,3,6-trideoxy-α-L-lyxo-hexopyranosyl residue attached at position 4 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: (Z)-roxithromycin
definition: A minor geometrical isomer of roxithromycin.

name: saccharin
definition: A 1,2-benzisothiazole having a keto-group at the 3-position and two oxo substituents at the 1-position. It is used as an artificial sweetening agent.

name: salicylamide
definition: The simplest member of the class of salicylamides derived from salicylic acid.

name: sapropterin dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of sapropterin. It is used for the diagnosis and treatment of variant forms of phenylketonuria (hyperphenylalaninaemia) associated with tetrahydrobiopterin deficiency. Natural cofactor for phenylalanine hydroxylase, tyrosine hydroxylase, tryptophan hydroxylase, and nitric oxide synthetase.

name: butylscopolamine bromide
definition: An organic bromide salt of butylscopolamine. It is an antispasmodic drug which can relieve painful stomach cramps (including those linked with irritable bowel syndrome), bladder and menstrual cramps.

name: soblidotin
definition: A tetrapeptide derivative of dolastatin 10. It is an inhibitor of tubulin polymerization which exhibits potent antitumor activity.

name: egualen sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt having 3-ethyl-7-isopropylazulene-1-sulfonate as the counterion. Used for treatment of gastric ulcers.

name: sodium caffeine benzoate
definition: A mixture of caffeine and sodium benzoate. It is used for the treatment of acute respiratory depression associated with overdosage of CNS depressant drugs and also used in combination with ergotamine to prevent vascular headaches.

name: sodium citrate dihydrate
definition: The dihydrate of trisodium citrate.

name: sodium hypochlorite
definition: An inorganic sodium salt in which hypochlorite is the counterion. It is used as a bleaching and disinfecting agent and is commonly found in household bleach.

name: sodium thiosulfate pentahydrate
definition: A hydrate consisting of sodium thiosulfate with 5 mol eq. of water.

name: stealthin C
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 10H-benzo[b]fluorene substituted by a methyl group at position 1, hydroxy groups at positions 4, 5 and 9, oxo group at position 10, and an amino group at position 11.

name: octadecan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol consisting of a hydroxy function at C-1 of an unbranched saturated chain of 18 carbon atoms.

name: stigmatellin A
definition: A member of the class of chromones that is isolated from Stigmatella aurantiaca Sg a15.

name: sucralose
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of 4-chloro-4-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose and 1,6-dichloro-1,6-dideoxy-β-D-fructofuranose units linked by a glycosidic bond.

name: sulfadimethoxine
definition: A sulfonamide consisting of pyrimidine having methoxy substituents at the 2- and 6-positions and a 4-aminobenzenesulfonamido group at the 4-position.

name: sulfisomidine
definition: A sulfonamide consisting of pyrimidine having methyl substituents at the 2- and 6-positions and a 4-aminobenzenesulfonamido group at the 4-position.

name: sulpiride
definition: A member of the class of benzamides obtained from formal condensation between the carboxy group of 2-methoxy-5-sulfamoylbenzoic acid and the primary amino group of (1-ethylpyrrolidin-2-yl)methylamine.

name: suxibuzone
definition: A pyrazolidine that is phenylbutazone which is substituted by a 3-carboxypropanoylmethyl group at the 4-position. Suxibuzone is a prodrug for phenylbutazone and is commonly used as an anti-inflammatory drug in horses.

name: tacalcitol
definition: A hydroxy seco-steroid that is calciol which carries hydroxy groups at positions 1S and 24R. It is a vitamin D3 analog which is used for the treatment of psoriasis vulgaris in adults, especially on the scalp.

name: tamibarotene
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide resulting from the condensation of one of the carboxy groups of terephthalic acid with the amino group of 5,5,8,8-tetramethyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydronaphthalen-2-amine.

name: tandospirone citrate
definition: A citrate salt of tandospirone , comprising equimolar amounts of citric acid and tandospirone. It is an anxiolytic drug used in the treatment of anxiety disorders.

name: tazarotene
definition: The ethyl ester of tazarotenic acid. A prodrug for tazarotenic acid, it is used for the treatment of psoriasis, acne, and sun-damaged skin.

name: tenoxicam
definition: A thienothiazine-derived monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-hydroxy-2-methylthieno[2,3-e][1,2]thiazine-3-carboxylic acid 1,1-dioxide with the amino group of 2-aminopyridine. Used for the treatment of pain and inflammation in osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis. It is also indicated for short term treatment of acute musculoskeletal disorders including strains, sprains and other soft-tissue injuries.

name: tetracenomycin D3
definition: A tetracenomycin that is 1-methyl-6,11-dioxo-6,11-dihydrotetracene-2-carboxylic acid bearing four hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 8, 10 and 12.

name: tetracenomycin F1
definition: A tetracenomycin that is 1-methyl-11-oxo-6,11-dihydrotetracene-2-carboxylic acid bearing four hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 8, 10 and 12.

name: tetrangomycin
definition: An angucycline antibiotic that is 3,4-dihydrotetraphene-1,7,12(2H)-trione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 8 and a methyl group at position 3 (the 3R stereoisomer) ring system. It is an antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces sp.

name: tetrangulol
definition: A member of the class of tetraphenes that is tetraphene-7,12-dione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 8 and a methyl group at position 3.

name: tiaprofenic acid
definition: An aromatic ketone that is thiophene substituted at C-2 by benzoyl and at C-4 by a 1-carboxyethyl group.

name: tibolone
definition: Estran-3-one with a double bond between positions 5 and 10, and bearing both an ethynyl group and a hydroxy group at position 17 (R-configuration). name: D-valinate
definition: The D-enantiomer of valinate.

name: D-valinium
definition: The D-enantiomer of valinium.

name: L-prolinate
definition: An optically active form of prolinate having L-configuration.

name: L-prolinium
definition: An optically active form of prolinium having L-configuration.

name: D-prolinate
definition: An optically active form of prolinate having D-configuration.

name: D-prolinium
definition: An optically active form of prolinium having D-configuration.

name: prolinate
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of proline, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: prolinium
definition: An α-amino-acid cation that is the conjugate acid of proline, arising from protonation of the amino group.

name: nonane
definition: A straight chain alkane composed of 9 carbon atoms.

name: baccatin III
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid isolated from plant species of the genus Taxus.

name: gibberellin A4
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi and differing from gibberellin A1 by the substitution of the OH at C-7 (gibbane numbering) by H.

name: gibberellin A7
definition: A C19-gibberellin that is a pentacyclic diterpenoid responsible for promoting growth and development in plants. Initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi, it differs from gibberellin A1 in lacking the OH at C-7 (gibbane numbering).

name: gibberellin A24
definition: A C20-gibberellin that consists of a tetracyclic skeleton bearing two carboxy and a formyl group.

name: cetylpyridinium chloride
definition: A pyridinium salt that has N-hexadecylpyridinium as the cation and chloride as the anion. It has antiseptic properties and is used in solutions or lozenges for the treatment of minor infections of the mouth and throat.

name: 1-naphthaleneacetic acid
definition: A naphthylacetic acid substituted by a carboxymethyl group at position 1.

name: octadecane
definition: A straight-chain alkane carrying 18 carbon atoms.

name: nonadecane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 19 carbon atoms. It has been found as a component of essential oils isolated from Artemisia armeniaca.

name: henicosane
definition: An alkane that has 21 carbons and a straight-chain structure. It has been isolated from plants like Periploca laevigata and Carthamus tinctorius.

name: tricosane
definition: A straight chain alkane containing 23 carbon atoms.

name: tetracosane
definition: A straight-chain alkane containing 24 carbon atoms.

name: pentacosane
definition: An alkane consisting of an unbranched chain of 25 carbon atoms.

name: hexacosane
definition: A straight-chain alkane comprising of 26 carbon atoms.

name: heptacosane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 27 carbon atoms.

name: octacosane
definition: A straight-chain alkane containing 28 carbon atoms.

name: (R)-nonacosan-10-ol
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of nonacosan-10-ol.

name: (S)-nonacosan-10-ol
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of nonacosan-10-ol.

name: β-D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: A D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate(4−) that is the conjugate base of β-D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate.

name: α-D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: A D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate(4−) that is the conjugate base of α-D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate.

name: 2-aminoethanesulfonate
definition: A 1,1-diunsubstituted alkanesulfonate that is ethanesulfonate substituted by an amino group at position 2.

name: 2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinic acid
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid consisting of 2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipyridine having two carboxy groups at the 2- and 6-positions.

name: (R)-3-phenyllactic acid
definition: A 3-phenyllactic acid that has (R)-configuration at the 2 position.

name: (S)-3-phenyllactate
definition: A (2S)-2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of (S)-3-phenyllactic acid.

name: phloretic acid
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid consisting of propionic acid having a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at the 3-position.

name: N4-{β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc}-Asn
definition: An N4-glycosyl-L-asparagine in which the glycosyl component is specified as β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc.

name: diphosphate(1−)
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of one of the phosphate OH groups in diphosphoric acid.

name: diphosphate(3−)
definition: A trivalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of all three protons from diphosphoric acid.

name: 2-oxopentanoic acid
definition: An oxopentanoic acid carrying an oxo group at position 2.

name: 1H-inden-1-ylidene
definition: A carbene that is derived from 1H-indene.

name: s-indacene
definition: An indacene that consists of a benzene ring having two fused cyclopentane rings in a rectilinear arrangement.

name: 1H-indol-5-amine
definition: An indolamine carrying an amino group at position 5.

name: indole-3-butyric acid
definition: A indol-3-yl carboxylic acid that is butanoic acid carrying a 1H-indol-3-yl substituent at position 1.

name: D-mannonic acid
definition: The D-stereoisomer of mannonic acid.

name: triphenylene
definition: An ortho-fused polycyclic arene consisting of four fused benzene rings.

name: acenaphthylene
definition: A ortho- and peri-fused tricyclic hydrocarbon that occurs in coal tar.

name: fluoranthene
definition: An ortho- and peri-fused polycyclic arene consisting of a naphthalene and benzene unit connected by a five-membered ring.

name: picene
definition: An ortho-fused polycyclic arene consisting of five fused benzene rings. It is obtained during the distillation of petroleum.

name: 2-nitrotoluene
definition: A mononitrotoluene that is toluene carrying a nitro substituent at position 2.

name: tetraethylarsonium
definition: An arsonium ion consisting of four ethyl groups attached to a central arsonium.

name: diarsene
definition: An arsenic hydride that consists of two arsenic atoms joined by a double bond with each carrying a single hydrogen.

name: apholate
definition: A member of the class of aziridines that is 1,3,5,2,4,6-triazatriphosphinine substituted by aziridin-1-yl groups at positions 2,2,4,4,6, and 6. It is an insect sterilant.

name: 1H-arsole
definition: That one of the three tautomers of arsole that has the double bonds at positions 2 and 4.

name: pyrrolidine
definition: A cyclic amine whose five-membered ring contains four carbon atoms and one nitrogen atom; the parent compound of the pyrrolidine family.

name: pyrazolidine
definition: An azacycloalkane that is the 1,2-diaza derivative of cyclopentane

name: dichromate(2−)
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of both protons from dichromic acid.

name: hydrogen dichromate
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of one of the two OH groups in dichromic acid.

name: hydrogenchromate
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of one of the two OH groups in chromic acid.

name: pentacene
definition: An acene that consists of five ortho-fused benzene rings in a rectilinear arrangement.

name: hexacene
definition: An acene that consists of six ortho-fused benzene rings in a rectilinear arrangement.

name: heptacene
definition: An acene that consists of seven ortho-fused benzene rings in a rectilinear arrangement.

name: cis-obtusilate
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid anion and the conjugate base of obtusilic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: dec-9-enoate
definition: A medium-chain, unsaturated, straight-chain fatty acid anion and the conjugate base of dec-9-enoic acid (caproleic acid), arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: sodium iodide
definition: A metal iodide salt with a Na(+) counterion.

name: nonacene
definition: An acene that consists of nine ortho-fused benzene rings in a rectilinear arrangement.

name: octogen
definition: A tetrazocane that is 1,3,5,7-tetrazocane in which the hydrogen atom attached to each of the nitrogens is replaced by a nitro group.

name: malononitrile
definition: A dinitrile that is methane substituted by two cyano groups.

name: potassium cyanide
definition: A cyanide salt containing equal numbers of potassium cations and cyanide anions.

name: sodium cyanide
definition: A cyanide salt containing equal numbers of sodium cations and cyanide anions.

name: 1H-tetrazole
definition: A tetrazole tautomer where the proton is located on the 1st position.

name: 2H-tetrazole
definition: A tetrazole tautomer where the proton is located on the 2 position.

name: (3R)-3-hydroxy-L-aspartate(2−)
definition: A C4-dicarboxylate obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 3-hydroxy-L-aspartic acid.

name: (R)-10-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is octadecanoic acid (stearic acid) in which the pro-R hydrogen has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: D-gluconic acid
definition: A gluconic acid having D-configuration.

name: propynoic acid
definition: A terminal acetylenic compound that is a 3-carbon, straight-chain, monounsaturated fatty acid having one acetylenic bond.

name: 2-thiobarbituric acid
definition: A barbiturate, the structure of which is that of barbituric acid in which the oxygen at C-2 is replaced by sulfur.

name: bisphenol A
definition: A bisphenol that is 4,4'-methanediyldiphenol in which the methylene hydrogens are replaced by two methyl groups.

name: 3,3',5,5'-tetrabromobisphenol A
definition: A bromobisphenol that is 4,4'-methanediyldiphenol in which the methylene hydrogens are replaced by two methyl groups and the phenyl rings are substituted by bromo groups at positions 2, 2', 6 and 6'. It is a brominated flame retardant.

name: corrin
definition: A tetrapyrrole fundamental parent that is the core macrocycle of vitamin B12.

name: corrole
definition: A tetrapyrrole fundamental parent that is the octadehydro drivative of corrin.

name: chromane
definition: A benzopyran consisting of a pyran ring having a benzene ring ortho-fused across positions 2 and 3.

name: (E)-cinnamyl alcohol
definition: The E (trans) stereoisomer of cinnamyl alcohol.

name: vitamin D4
definition: It is present in mushrooms.

name: α-tocotrienol
definition: A tocotrienol that is chroman-6-ol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 5, 7 and 8 and a farnesyl chain at position 2. It has been found in palm oil derived from Elaeis guineensis.

name: β-tocotrienol
definition: A tocotrienol that is chroman-6-ol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 5 and 8 and a farnesyl chain at position 2. It has been isolated from various cultivars of wheat.

name: δ-tocotrienol
definition: A tocotrienol that is chroman-6-ol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 8 and a farnesyl chain at position 2.

name: γ-tocotrienol
definition: A tocotrienol that is chroman-6-ol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 7 and 8 and a farnesyl chain at position 2. A vitamin E family member that has potent anti-cancer properties against a wide-range of cancers.

name: didesmethyl tocotrienol
definition: A tocotrienol that is chroman-6-ol substituted by a farnesyl chain at position 2.

name: vitamin D5
definition: A vitamin D in which the side-chain at position 17 consists of a (5R)-5-ethyl-6-methylheptan-2-yl group.

name: polonium atom
definition: A radioactive metallic element discovered in 1898 by Marie Sklodowska Curie and named after her home country, Poland (Latin Polonia).

name: rhodium atom
definition: A cobalt group element atom of atomic number 45.

name: palladium
definition: Chemical element (nickel group element atom) with atomic number 46.

name: roentgenium atom
definition: A copper group element atom with atomic number 111. The the ninth member of the 6d series of transition metals, it is an extremely radioactive, synthetic element. Average mass is around 281.

name: L-serine zwitterion
definition: A serine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-serine.

name: 3-hydroxypropionic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the hydrogens attached to the terminal carbon is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: barban
definition: A carbamate ester that is 4-chlorobut-2-yn-1-yl ester of N-(3-chlorophenyl)carbamic acid. A herbicide, it is no longer approved for use within the European Community.

name: (R)-S-adenosyl-L-methionine
definition: An S-adenosyl-L-methionine that has R-configuration.

name: orthoperiodate(1−)
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of one of the six OH groups in orthoperiodic acid acid.

name: orthoperiodate(2−)
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of two of the five protons from orthoperiodic acid

name: orthoperiodate(3−)
definition: A trivalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of three protons from orthoperiodic acid

name: phosphonate(1−)
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of one of the two OH groups in phosphonic acid.

name: diphosphonate(1−)
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of one of the two OH groups in diphosphoniic acid.

name: glyceric acid
definition: A trionic acid that consists of propionic acid substituted at positions 2 and 3 by hydroxy groups.

name: L-arabinonic acid
definition: The L-enantiomer of arabinonic acid.

name: copernicium atom
definition: A zinc group element atom with a symbol Cn and atomic number 112. All its isotopes are intensely radioactive. Prior to its discovery, it had the placeholder name ununbium (in accordance with IUPAC recommendations). Following its discovery (in Darmstadt, 1996) and subsequent confirmation, the name copernicium was adopted in 2010.

name: hydrogentellurite
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of a proton from H2TeO3

name: sulfonate
definition: The sulfur oxoanion formed by deprotonation of sulfonic acid.

name: noradrenaline
definition: A catecholamine in which C-1 of the aminoethyl side-chain is hydroxy-substituted.

name: (S)-noradrenaline
definition: The S-enantiomer of noradrenaline.

name: 4-methylthio-2-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid derived from L-methionine via the action of methionine transaminase.

name: phenosafranine
definition: An organic chloride salt having 3,7-diamino-5-phenylphenazin-5-ium as the counterion. It is commonly used for staining Gram negative bacteria red in smears to contrast with the blue Gram positive organisms.

name: 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-gluconate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-gluconic acid.

name: (18O)water
definition: A form of water consisting of two hydrogen atoms covalently bonded to an oxygen-18 atom.

name: oxygen-18 atom
definition: The stable isotope of oxygen with relative atomic mass 17.999160 and 0.205 atom percent natural abundance.

name: oxygen-16 atom
definition: The stable isotope of oxygen with relative atomic mass 15.994914. The most abundant (99.76 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring oxygen.

name: oxygen-17 atom
definition: The stable isotope of oxygen with relative atomic mass 16.999131. The least abundant (0.038 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring oxygen.

name: anthrone
definition: A member of the class of anthracenes that is 9,10-dihydroanthracene carrying an oxo group at C-9.

name: glycerate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of glyceric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: α-D-galacturonic acid
definition: The α-anomer of D-galacturonic acid.

name: (−)-catechin
definition: The (−)-enantiomer of catechin.

name: (1R,2S)-naphthalene 1,2-oxide
definition: A naphthalene 1,2-oxide (the 1R,2S-stereoisomer).

name: (1S,2R)-naphthalene 1,2-oxide
definition: A naphthalene 1,2-oxide (the 1S,2R-stereoisomer).

name: (9R,13R)-12-oxophytodienoic acid
definition: The (9R,13R)-diastereomer of 12-oxophytodienoic acid.

name: (R)-3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid.

name: (S)-ATPA
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 5-tert-butyl-3-hydroxy-isooxazol-4-yl group.

name: 1,1-dichloroethene
definition: A member of the class of chloroethenes that is ethene in which both of the hydrogens attached to one of the carbons are replaced by chlorines.

name: tert-butyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of benzoic acid with tert-butanol.

name: 1,2,3-trimethylbenzene
definition: A trimethylbenzene carrying methyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 3. It has been found in Centaurium erythraea.

name: 1,2,4-trimethylbenzene
definition: A trimethylbenzene carrying methyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 4.

name: 1,2-phenylenediamine
definition: A phenylenediamine in which the two amino groups are ortho to each other.

name: 1,2-didodecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-cytidine 5'-diphosphate
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as dodecanoyl.

name: 1,2-dihydrostilbene
definition: A diphenylethane that is the 1,2-dihydro derivative of stilbene.

name: 1,2-dimethylnaphthalene
definition: A dimethylnaphthalene carrying methyl groups at positions 1 and 2.

name: 1,2-naphthoquinone
definition: The parent structure of the family of 1,2-naphthoquinones, in which the oxo groups of the quinone moiety are at positions 1 and 2 of the naphthalene ring. It is a metabolite of naphthalene and is found in diesel exhaust particles.

name: 1-arachidonoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycerol where arachidonoyl forms the 1-acyl group.

name: Δ1-progesterone
definition: A 3-oxo Δ4-steroid that is progesterone which has been oxidised to introduce a double bond between positions 1 and 2.

name: 1-dodecanoyl-2-hexadecanoyl-3-octadecanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A triacylglycerol 46:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 3 are specified as dodecanoyl, hexadecanoyl and octadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as palmitoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: {1-O-hexadecanoyl-2-O-[(Z)-octadec-9-enoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho}serine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine compound with a palmitoyl group at the 1-position and an oleoyl group at the 2-position.

name: 1-O-hexadecanoyl-2-O-[(Z)-octadec-9-enoyl]-sn-glycerol 3-diphosphate
definition: An optically active 1,2-diacylglycerol 3-diphosphate compound having a 1-hexadecanoyl substituent at the O-1 position and a (Z)-octadec-9-enoyl substituent at the O-2 position.

name: 1-nitronaphthalene
definition: A mononitronaphthalene substituted by a nitro group at position 1.

name: 1-nitropyrene
definition: A nitroarene that is pyrene substituted at the 1-position by a nitro group. A by-product of combustion, it is the predominant nitrated polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon emitted in a diesel engine.

name: 1-O-hexadecyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine (O-16:0/18:1) in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1-O-hexadecyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1-n-hexadecyl analogue of an optically active alkylglycerol compound.

name: batilol
definition: An alkylglycerol that is glycerol in which one of the primary hydroxy groups has been converted into the corresponding octadecyl ether. It is used in cosmetics as a stabilising ingredient and skin-conditioning agent.

name: oct-1-en-3-ol
definition: An alkenyl alcohol with a structure based on a C8 unbranched chain with the hydroxy group at C-2 and unsaturation at C-1‒C-2. It is a major volatile compound present in many mushrooms and fungi.

name: tridecan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is tridecane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: 11(R)-HETE
definition: An 11-HETE in which the chiral centre at position 11 has R-configuration.

name: 11,12-EET
definition: An EET obtained by formal epoxidation of the 11,12-double bond of arachidonic acid.

name: 11,14,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,12E)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: A trihydroxyicosatrienoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,12E)-icosatrienoic acid in which the three hydroxy groups are located at positions 11, 14 and 15.

name: 11-oxotestosterone
definition: A 3-oxo Δ4-steroid that is testosterone carrying an additional oxo substituent at position 11.

name: 12(R)-HETE
definition: A HETE having a (12R)-hydroxy group and (5Z)-, (8Z)-, (10E)- and (14Z)-double bonds.

name: 12(R)-HPETE
definition: A HPETE that is (5Z,8Z,10E,12R,14Z)-icosa-5,8,10,14-tetraenoic acid with the hydroperoxy group located at position 12 (the R-enantiomer).

name: 12(S)-HETE
definition: A HETE having a (12S)-hydroxy group and (5Z)-, (8Z)-, (10E)- and (14Z)-double bonds.

name: 12-oxo-ETE
definition: An oxoicosatetraenoic acid having a 12-oxo group; and (5Z)-, (8Z), (10E)- and (14Z)-double bonds.

name: 13(S)-HODE
definition: An HODE (hydroxyoctadecadienoic acid) in which the double bonds are at positions 9 and 11 (E and Z geometry, respectively) and the hydroxy group is at position 13 (with S-configuration).

name: 14,15-EET
definition: An EET obtained by formal epoxidation of the 14,15-double bond of arachidonic acid.

name: 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2
definition: A prostaglandin J derivative comprising prostaglandin J2 lacking the 15-hydroxy group and having C=C double bonds at the 12- and 14-positions.

name: 15α-hydroxytestosterone
definition: An androstanoid that is testosterone substituted by a α-hydroxy group at position 15. A natural product found in Daphnia magna exposed to the biocide tributyltin.

name: 16(R)-HETE
definition: A 16-HETE in which the chiral centre at position 16 has R-configuration.

name: 16α,17α-dihydroxyprogesterone acetophenide
definition: A 20-oxo steroid that is the cyclic ketal resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy groups of algestone with acetophenone.

name: 16α-hydroxytestosterone
definition: A C19-steroid that is testosterone in which the hydrogen at the 16α position has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 19(S)-HETE
definition: A HETE having a (19S)-hydroxy group and all-cis double bonds at positions 5, 8, 11 and 14.

name: 2',3',4',5'-tetrachlorobiphenyl-3-ol
definition: An organochlorine compound formed formally by chlorination of biphenyl-3-ol at C-2', -3', -4' and -5'.

name: 2',5'-dichlorobiphenyl-3-ol
definition: An member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls formed formally by chlorination of biphenyl-3-ol at C-2' and -5'.

name: 2,2',3,3',5,5'-hexachlorobiphenyl
definition: A hexachlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which the hydrogens at the 2, 3, and 5 positions of each of the benzene rings are replaced by chlorines.

name: 2,2',4,4',6,6'-hexachlorobiphenyl
definition: A hexachlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which both of the phenyl rings are substituted at positons 2, 4, and 6 by chlorines.

name: 2,2',4,4'-tetrachlorobiphenyl
definition: A tetrachlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which each of the phenyl groups is substituted at positions 2 and 4 by chlorines.

name: 2,2',4,5-tetrachlorobiphenyl
definition: A tetrachlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 4, 5, and 2' are replaced by chlorines.

name: 2,2',5,5'-tetrachlorobiphenyl
definition: A tetrachlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which the hydrogens at the 2 and 5 position of each benzene ring are replaced by chlorines.

name: 2,3',5-trichlorobiphenyl
definition: A trichlorobiphenyl that is 1,4-dichlorobenzene in which one of the hydrogens has been replaced by a 3-chlorophenyl group.

name: 2,3,4,4'-tetrachlorobiphenyl
definition: A tetrachlorobiphenyl in which the chlorines are positions at positions 2, 3, 4, and 4'.

name: 2,3,4-trichlorobiphenyl
definition: A trichlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 3, and 4 on one of the benzene rings are replaced by chlorines.

name: 2,3,5,6-tetrachloro-1,1'-biphenyl-4,4'-diol
definition: A tetrachlorobenzene formed formally by chlorination of biphenyl-4,4'-diol at C-2, -3, -5 and -6.

name: 2,3,5,6-tetrachlorobiphenyl
definition: A tetrachlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted by chlorines at positions 2, 3, 5, and 6.

name: 2,3,6-trichlorobiphenyl
definition: A trichlorobiphenyl that is 1,2,4-trichlorobenzene in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a phenyl group.

name: 2,3-di-O-phytanyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A dialkylglycerol that is glycerol alkylated at positions 1 and 2 by phytanyl groups with (R)-configuration at position 2.

name: 2,3-dinor-8-epi-prostaglandin F1α
definition: A prostanoid that is prostaglandin F1α lacking two methylenes in the carboxyalkyl chain and having inverted stereochemistry at the 8-position.

name: 2,4'-dichlorobiphenyl
definition: A dichlorobiphenyl that is chlorobenzene in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a 4-chlorophenyl group.

name: 2,4,4',6-tetrachlorobiphenyl
definition: A tetrachlorobiphenyl that is 1,3,5-trichlorobenzene in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a p-chlorophenyl group.

name: 2,4-diaminotoluene
definition: An aminotoluene that is para-toluidine with an additional amino group at position 2.

name: 2,4-dibromophenol
definition: A bromophenol that is phenol in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 4 have been replaced by bromines.

name: 2,4-xylenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that phenol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 4.

name: 2,4-dinitroaniline
definition: A nitroaniline consisting of an aniline core having two nitro substituents located at the 2- and 4-positions.

name: 2,5-dichloroaniline
definition: A dichloroaniline carrying chloro groups at positions 2 and 5.

name: 2,5-dichlorobiphenyl
definition: A dichlorobiphenyl that is p-dichlorobenzene in which one of the hydrogens has been replaced by a phenyl group.

name: 2,6-di-tert-butyl-4-methylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is 4-methylphenol substituted by tert-butyl groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: 2,6-dichloro-4'-biphenylol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls that is biphenyl-4-ol with chlorine atoms substituted at positions 2 and 6.

name: 2,6-dichlorobiphenyl
definition: A dichlorobiphenyl that is 1,3-dichlorobenzene in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a phenyl group.

name: anthraflavic acid
definition: A dihydroxyanthraquinone that is anthracene substituted by hydroxy groups at C-3 and C-7 and oxo groups at C-9 and C-10.

name: 2,6-dimethylnaphthalene
definition: A dimethylnaphthalene carrying methyl groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: 2-chloro-1,1'-biphenyl-4,4'-diol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls that is biphenyl-4,4'-diol in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a chlorine.

name: 2-chlorobiphenyl
definition: A monochlorobiphenyl carrying a single chloro substituent at position 2.

name: 1-chloro-2-nitrobenzene
definition: A C-nitro compound that is nitrobenzene in which one of the ortho- hydrogens has been replaced by chlorine.

name: 1-ethyl-2-methylbenzene
