definition: A member of the class of toluenes carrying an ethyl group at the ortho-position.

name: oxybenzone
definition: A hydroxybenzophenone that is benzophenone which is substituted at the 2- and 4-positions of one of the benzene rings by hydroxy and methoxy groups respectively.

name: 2-hydroxyethyl methacrylate
definition: An enoate ester that is the monomethacryloyl derivative of ethylene glycol.

name: 1,3-benzothiazole-2-thiol
definition: 1,3-Benzothiazole substituted at the 2-position with a sulfanyl group.

name: 2-methoxyhexadecanoic acid
definition: A long chain fatty acid consisting of hexadecanoic (palmitic) acid carrying a methoxy substituent at position 2; naturally occurring only in the phospholipids of sponges.

name: 2-naphthoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA thioester that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-naphthoic acid..

name: 2-oxodecanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is decanoic acid carrying an oxo group at position 2.

name: 2-sec-butylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol carrying a butan-2-yl group at position 2.

name: fenobucarb
definition: A carbamate ester obtained by the formal condensation of 2-sec-butylphenol with methylcarbamic acid.

name: 20-HETE
definition: A HETE that consists of arachidonic acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 20.

name: (24S)-24-hydroxycholesterol
definition: A 24-hydroxycholesterol that has S configuration at position 24. It is the major metabolic breakdown product of cholesterol in the brain.

name: 27-O-demethylrifamycin SV
definition: A member of the class of rifamycins that is rifamycin SV lacking the O-methyl group at position 27.

name: 3,3',4,4',5-pentachlorobiphenyl
definition: A pentachlorobiphenyl in which the chlorines are located at the 3, 4, 5, 3', and 4' positions.

name: 3,5-dichlorobiphenyl
definition: A dichlorobiphenyl that is 1,3-dichlorobenzene in which the hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a phenyl group.

name: (2Z)-3-bromohept-2-enoic acid
definition: A hept-2-enoic acid carrying a bromo- substituent at C-3.

name: 3-formylsalicylic acid
definition: A hydroxybenzoic acid that is salicylic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a formyl group.

name: biphenyl-3-ol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls that is phenol in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a phenyl group.

name: 3-methylcholanthrene
definition: A pentacyclic ortho- and peri-fused polycyclic arene consisting of a dihydrocyclopenta[ij]tetraphene ring system with a methyl substituent at the 3-position.

name: 3-nitrophenol
definition: A member of the class of 3-nitrophenols that is phenol in which one of the hydrogens that is meta to the hydroxy group has been replaced by a nitro group.

name: 3α,17α-dihydroxy-5β-pregnan-20-one
definition: A 17α-hydroxy steroid that is 3α-hydroxy-5β-pregnan-20-one carrying an additional hydroxy group at position 17α.

name: 4',5,6,7-tetramethoxyflavone
definition: A tetramethoxyflavone that is the tetra-O-methyl derivative of scutellarein.

name: 4',6-dihydroxyflavone
definition: A dihydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4' and 6.

name: 4'-hydroxychalcone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4'.

name: 4,4'-dichlorobiphenyl
definition: A dichlorobiphenyl carrying chloro groups at positions 4 and 4' respectively.

name: biphenyl-4,4'-diol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls that is biphenyl with hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 4'.

name: 4,4'-sulfonyldiphenol
definition: A sulfone that is diphenyl sulfone in which both of the para hydrogens have been replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: gaboxadol
definition: A member of the class of oxazolopyridines that is 2,3,4,5,6,7-hexahydro[1,2]oxazolo[5,4-c]pyridine substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: monobenzone
definition: The monobenzyl ether of hydroquinone. It is used as a topical drug for medical depigmentation.

name: 4-aminopyridine
definition: An aromatic amine that is pyridine bearing a single amino substituent at position 4. An orphan drug in the US, it is used to improve walking in adults with multiple sclerosis.

name: 4-chloro-3,5-dimethylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is 3,5-xylenol which is substituted at position 4 by chlorine. It is bactericidal against most Gram-positive bacteria but less effective against Staphylococci and Gram-negative bacteria, and often inactive against Pseudomonas species. It is ineffective against bacterial spores.

name: 4-chloro-m-cresol
definition: A hydroxytoluene that is 3-methylphenol which is substituted by a chlorine at position 4. A ryanodine receptor agonist.

name: 4-chlorochalcone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by a chloro group at position 4.

name: 4-ethyl-7-hydroxy-3-(p-methoxyphenyl)coumarin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is coumarin substituted by an ethyl group at position 4, a hydroxy group at position 7 and a p-methoxyphenyl group at position 3 respectively.

name: 4-hydroxy-2,2',3',4',6'-pentachlorobiphenyl
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls that is phenol substituted in the 3-position by chlorine and in the 4-position by a 2,3,4,6-tetrachlorophenyl group.

name: biphenyl-4-ol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls that is biphenyl carrying a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: 4-hydroxychalcone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: 4-octylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol which is substituted at the para- position by an octyl group.

name: toluene-4-sulfonamide
definition: A sulfonamide that is benzenesulfonamide bearing a methyl group at position 4.

name: 4-nonylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol which is para-substituted with a nonyl group.

name: 4-tert-butylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol substituted with a tert-butyl group at position 4.

name: (Z,Z,Z)-octadeca-4,7,10-trienenitrile
definition: The nitrile obtained by formal condensation of (Z,Z,Z)-octadeca-4,7,10-trienoic acid with ammonia.

name: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-2-naphthoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalene which is substituted at position 6 by a carboxylic acid group.

name: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-2-naphthol
definition: A member of the class tetralins that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalene which is substituted at position 6 by a hydroxy group.

name: 5,6-EET
definition: An EET obtained by formal epoxidation of the 5,6-double bond of arachidonic acid.

name: 6-bromo-2-naphthol
definition: A member of the class of naphthols that is 2-naphthol carrying an additional bromo substituent at position 6.

name: 6-hydroxyflavanone
definition: A monohydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6.

name: 6β-hydroxytestosterone
definition: A 17β-hydroxy steroid that is testosterone bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at the 6β-position.

name: 7,8-dihydro-7-hydroxy-8S-glutathionylbenzo[a]pyrene
definition: A glutathione derivative in which the hydrogen of the side-chain thiol function of glutathione is substituted by a 7-hydroxy-7,8-dihydrobenzo[pqr]tetraphen-8-yl group.

name: 7-hydroxyflavanone
definition: A monohydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7.

name: 8(R)-HETE
definition: A HETE having an (8R)-hydroxy group and (5Z)-, (9E)-, (11Z)- and (14Z)-double bonds.

name: 8(R)-HPODE
definition: The 8(R)-isomer of HPODE.

name: 8(S)-HETE
definition: A HETE having an (8S)-hydroxy group and (5Z)-, (9E)-, (11Z)- and (14Z)-double bonds.

name: 8(S)-HPETE
definition: A HPETE in which the hydroperoxy group is located at position 8S and the four double bonds at position 5, 9, 11 and 14 (the 5Z,9E,11Z,14Z-geoisomer).

name: 8,9-EET
definition: An EET obtained by formal epoxidation of the 8,9-double bond of arachidonic acid.

name: 9(10)-EpOME
definition: An EpOME obtained by formal epoxidation of the 9,10-double bond of octadeca-9,12-dienoic acid (the 12Z-geoisomer).

name: 9(S)-HETE
definition: A HETE having a (9S)-hydroxy group and (5Z)-, (7E)-, (11Z)- and (14Z)-double bonds.

name: 9(S)-HODE
definition: A 9-HODE in which the 9-hydroxy group has S-stereochemistry.

name: 9(S)-HPETE
definition: A 9-HPETE in which the 9-hydroxy group has S stereochemistry.

name: 9(S)-HPODE
definition: An HPODE (hydroperoxy-octadecadienoic acid) in which the double bonds are at positions 10 and 12 (E and Z geometry, respectively) and the hydroperoxy group is at position 9 (S configuration). It is an intermediate in the metabolic pathway for linoleic acid.

name: 9,10,13-TriHOME
definition: A TriHOME that is (11E)-octadec-11-enoic acid in which the three hydroxy substituents are located at positions 9, 10 and 13.

name: dihydroergocornine mesylate
definition: The methanesulfonic acid salt of 9,10-dihydroergocornine. It is a component of ergoloid mesylate (codergocrine mesilate), a mixture of ergot alkaloid derivatives that is used as a vasodilator and has shown mild benefits in the treatment of vascular dementia.

name: 8-epi-prostaglandin F2α
definition: An isoprostane that is prostaglandin F2α having inverted stereochemistry at the 8-position.

name: pinellic acid
definition: A trihydroxyoctadecenoic acid with hydroxy groups at positions C-9, -12, and 13, and an E (cis) double bond at position 10.

name: 9-anthroic acid
definition: An anthroic acid carrying the carboxy substituent at position 9.

name: acephate
definition: A phosphoramide that is methamidophos in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by an acetyl group.

name: adipoyl-CoA
definition: An α,ω dicarboxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with one of the carboxy groups of adipic acid.

name: argipressin
definition: The predominant form of mammalian vasopressin (antidiuretic hormone). It is a nonapeptide containing an arginine at residue 8 and two disulfide-linked cysteines at residues of 1 and 6.

name: benzo[b]fluoranthene
definition: An ortho- and peri-fused polycyclic arene that consists of a benzene ring fused with a acephenanthrylene ring.

name: benzo[e]pyrene
definition: An ortho- and peri-fused polycyclic arene consisting of five fused benzene rings. It is listed as a Group 3 carcinogen by the IARC.

name: bisphenol F
definition: A bisphenol that is methane in which two of the hydrogens have been replaced by 4-hydroxyphenyl groups.

name: bisphenol A dimethacrylate
definition: A bisphenol that is bisphenol A condensed with two molecules of methacrylic acid.

name: boldenone
definition: An 3-oxo-Δ1,Δ4-steroid substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and a β-hydroxy group at position 17. It is an anabolic androgenic steroid that has been developed for veterinary use.

name: bromobutide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide having a 2-phenylpropan-2-yl substituent attached to the amide nitrogen and a 1-bromo-2,2-dimethylpropyl group attached to the carbonyl carbon.

name: bromodichloromethane
definition: A halomethane that is dichloromethane in which oneof the hydrogens has been replaced by a bromine atom. It occurs as a contaminant in drinking water.

name: bornane-2,3-dione
definition: A bornane monoterpenoid that is bicyclo[2.2.1]heptane substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 7 and 7 and oxo groups at positions 2 and 3.

name: captan
definition: A dicarboximide that is 3a,4,7,7a-tetrahydrophthalimide in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a trichloromethyl group. A non-systemic fungicide introduced in the 1950s, it is widely used for the control of fungal diseases in fruits, vegetables, and ornamental crops.

name: cefaloglycin
definition: A cephalosporin antibiotic containing at the 7β-position of the cephem skeleton an (R)-amino(phenyl)acetamido group.

name: cefamandole sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the sodium salt of cefamandole.

name: cefotetan disodium
definition: The disodium salt of cefotetan.

name: ceftibuten dihydrate
definition: The dihydrate of ceftibuten. It is used as an orally administered treatment for urinary-tract and respiratory-tract infections.

name: quinomethionate
definition: A dithioloquinoxaline that results from the formal condensation of 6-methylquinoxaline-2,3-dithiol with phosgene. It has been used as a fungicide and acaricide for the control of mites and powdery mildew on citrus, vegetables, and walnuts, but is not approved for use in the EU.

name: chlorpropham
definition: A carbamate ester that is the isopropyl ester of 3-chlorophenylcarbamic acid.

name: chlorpyrifos
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is O,O-diethyl hydrogen phosphorothioate in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group has been replaced by a 3,5,6-trichloropyridin-2-yl group.

name: chlorpyrifos-methyl
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is O,O-dimethyl hydrogen phosphorothioate in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group has been replaced by a 3,5,6-trichloropyridin-2-yl group.

name: clofibric acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is isobutyric acid substituted at position 2 by a p-chlorophenoxy group. It is a metabolite of the drug clofibrate.

name: compactin diol lactone
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is ML-236C substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8S. It is a fungal metabolite isolated from Penicillium citrinum and exhibits anticholesteremic activity.

name: Congo Red
definition: An indicator dye that is blue-violet at pH 3.0 and red at pH 5.0.

name: cumene
definition: An alkylbenzene that is benzene carrying an isopropyl group.

name: cyclopropylamine
definition: A primary aliphatic amine that consists of cyclopropane bearing a single amino substituent.

name: decachlorobiphenyl
definition: A polychlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which all of the hydrogens are replaced by chlorines.

name: devapamil
definition: A nitrile that acts as an L-type calcium channel blocker.

name: bis(2-ethylhexyl) adipate
definition: A diester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy groups of adipic acid with 2-ethylhexan-1-ol. It is used as a plasticiser in the preparation of various polymers.

name: diheptyl phthalate
definition: The diheptyl ester of benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

name: dipentyl phthalate
definition: A phthalate ester that is the dipentyl ester of benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

name: diazinon
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine carrying an isopropyl group at position 2, a methyl group at position 6 and a (diethoxyphosphorothioyl)oxy group at position 4.

name: dibutyl phthalate
definition: A phthalate ester that is the diester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy groups of phthalic acid with two molecules of butan-1-ol. Although used extensively as a plasticiser, it is a ubiquitous environmental contaminant that poses a risk to humans.

name: dichloroacetyl chloride
definition: The acyl chloride obtained by displacement of the hydroxy group of dichloroacetic acid by chloride.

name: dichlorvos
definition: An alkenyl phosphate that is the 2,2-dichloroethenyl ester of dimethyl phosphate.

name: dicofol
definition: A tertiary alcohol that is DDT in which the benzylic hydrogen has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: dieldrin
definition: An organochlorine compound resulting from the epoxidation of the double bond of aldrin. It is the active metabolite of the proinsecticde aldrin.

name: diethyl phthalate
definition: The diethyl ester of benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

name: diethyl sulfate
definition: The diethyl ester of sulfuric acid.

name: diflubenzuron
definition: A benzoylurea insecticide that is urea in which a hydrogen attached to one of the nitrogens is replaced by a 4-chlorophenyl group, and a hydrogen attached to the other nitrogen is replaced bgy a 2,6-difluorobenzoyl group.

name: dihydro-β-ergocryptine mesylate
definition: The methanesulfonic acid salt of dihydro-β-ergocryptine.

name: dihydro-β-erythroidine
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound resulting from the partial hydrogenation of the 1,3-diene moiety of β-erythroidine to give the corresponding 2-ene.

name: dihydrogenistein
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanone comprising isoflavanone carrying three hydroxy substituents at positions 5, 7 and 4'.

name: dimethoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is N-methylacetamide in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group attached to the carbonyl moiety is replaced by a (dimethoxyphosphorothioyl)sulfanediyl group.

name: 1-chloro-2,4-dinitrobenzene
definition: A C-nitro compound that is chlorobenzene carrying a nitro substituent at each of the 2- and 4-positions.

name: diphenhydramine salicylate
definition: The salicylic acid salt of diphenhydramine.

name: diphenyl carbonate
definition: A carbonate ester that is the diphenyl ester of carbonic acid.

name: dizocilpine
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1-methyl-8-azabicyclo[3.2.1]octane ortho-fused to two benzene rings at positions 2-3 and 6-7 (the 5S,10R-stereoisomer). It is a non-competitive antagonist of the N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor and affects cognitive function, learning, and memory.

name: dodecanamide
definition: A fatty amide of lauric acid.

name: domoic acid
definition: An L-proline derivative that is L-proline substituted by a carboxymethyl group at position 3 and a 6-carboxyhepta-2,4-dien-2-yl group at position 4. It is produced by the diatomic algal Pseudo-nitzschia. It is an analogue of kainic acid and a neurotoxin which causes amnesic shellfish poisoning (ASP).

name: dopamine 4-O-sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is dopamine in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: doxycycline hyclate
definition: The hemiethanolate hemihydrate of doxycycline hydrochloride. A semi-synthetic tetracycline antibiotic, it is used to inhibit bacterial protein synthesis and treat non-gonococcal urethritis and cervicitis, exacerbations of bronchitis in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and adult periodontitis.

name: edifenphos
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is the O-ethyl-S,S-diphenyl ester of phosphorodithioic acid. Used to control a variety of fungal diseases on rice including blast, ear blight and stem rot. Edifenphos is moderately toxic to mammals and fish but poses more of a risk to aquatic invertebrates.

name: equilenin
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is estrone which carries two double bonds at positions 6 and 8. It is found in the urine of pregnant mare's and extensively used for estrogen replacement therapy in postmenopausal women.

name: ethisterone
definition: A 17β-hydroxy steroid that is testosterone in which the 17β hydrogen is replaced by an ethynyl group. Ethisterone was the first orally active progestin and is a metabolite of danazol.

name: fenamic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is the N-phenyl derivative of anthranilic acid. It acts as a parent skeleton for the synthesis of several non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs.

name: fenitrothion
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is O,O-dimethyl O-phenyl phosphorothioate substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and a nitro group at position 4.

name: fenpiclonil
definition: A member of the class of pyrroles carrying cyano and 2,3-dichlorophenyl substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively. A fungicide used mainly to control seed-borne pathogens in cereal crops.

name: fenthion
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is O,O-dimethyl hydrogen phosphorothioate in which the hydrogen atom of the hydroxy group is replaced by a 3-methyl-4-(methylsulfanyl)phenyl group. It exhibits acaricidal and insecticidal activities.

name: furfural
definition: An aldehyde that is furan with the hydrogen at position 2 substituted by a formyl group.

name: glycitein
definition: A methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 and hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 4'. It has been isolated from the mycelia of the fungus Cordyceps sinensis.

name: glyoxal
definition: The dialdehyde that is the smallest possible and which consists of ethane having oxo groups on both carbons.

name: hepoxilin B3
definition: A hepoxilin having (5Z,9E,14Z) double bond stereochemistry, a 10-hydroxy substituent and an (11S,12S)-epoxy group.

name: heptachlor
definition: A cyclodiene organochlorine insecticide that is 3a,4,7,7a-tetrahydro-1H-4,7-methanoindene substituted by chlorine atoms at positions 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 8. Formerly used to kill termites, ants and other insects in agricultural and domestic situations.

name: heptanal
definition: An n-alkanal resulting from the oxidation of the alcoholic hydroxy group of heptan-1-ol to the corresponding aldehyde. An endogenous aldehyde coming from membrane lipid oxidation, it is found in the blood of lung cancer patients and has been regarded as a potential biomarker of lung cancer.

name: histrionicotoxin
definition: An azaspiro compound that is 1-azaspiro[5.5]undecane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8, a but-1-en-3-yn-1-yl group at position 7 and a pent-3-en-1-yn-5-yl group at position 2 (the 2S,6R,7S,8S stereoisomer).

name: isophorone
definition: A cyclic ketone, the structure of which is that of cyclohex-2-en-1-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 3, 5 and 5.

name: isoxathion
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is O,O-diethyl hydrogen phosphorothioate in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group is replaced by a 5-phenyl-1,2-oxazol-3-yl group.

name: lactobacillic acid
definition: An 11,12-methyleneoctadecanoic acid having (11R,12S)-configuration.

name: 1,3,5-trimethylbenzene
definition: A trimethylbenzene carrying methyl substituents at positions 1, 3 and 5.

name: methyl methacrylate
definition: An enoate ester having methacrylic acid as the carboxylic acid component and methanol as the alcohol component.

name: metipranolol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of metipranolol. A non-cardioselective beta-blocker, it is used to lower intra-ocular pressure in the management of open-angle glaucoma.

name: metribuzin
definition: A member of the class of 1,2,4-triazines that is 1,2,4-triazin-5(4H)-one substituted by an amino group at position 4, tert-butyl group at position 6 and a methylsulfanyl group at position 3.

name: mevastatin
definition: A carboxylic ester that is pravastatin that is lacking the allylic hydroxy group. A hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) isolated from Penicillium citrinum and from Penicillium brevicompactum, its clinical use as a lipid-regulating drug ceased following reports of toxicity in animals.

name: mibolerone
definition: An androgen that is nalandrone carrying two methyl substituents at positions 7α and 17.

name: morpholine
definition: An organic heteromonocyclic compound whose six-membered ring contains four carbon atoms and one nitrogen atom and one oxygen atom that lies opposite to each other; the parent compound of the morpholine family.

name: mupirocin calcium hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of mupirocin calcium. It is an antibacterial drug used for the treatment of skin infections such as impetigo caused by Staphylococcus aureus and meticillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA).

name: N,N'-diphenyl-1,4-phenylenediamine
definition: An N-substituted diamine that is 1,4-phenylenediamine in which one hydrogen from each amino group is replaced by a phenyl group.

name: N-(30-(9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyloxy)-tricontanoyl)-sphing-4-enine
definition: An N-acylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 30-[(9Z,12Z)-octadeca-9,12-dienoyloxy]triacontanoyl.

name: N-nitrosodiethylamine
definition: A nitrosamine that is N-ethylethanamine substituted by a nitroso group at the N-atom.

name: NS 1619
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-benzimidazol-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 5 are replaced are replaced by 2-hydroxy-5-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl and trifluoromethyl groups, respectively. It is an opener/activator of the large-conductance calcium-activated potassium channel (Bkca).

name: naphthyl-2-methyl-succinyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA thioester that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the 2-carboxy group of naphthyl-2-methyl-succinic acid.

name: nickel dichloride
definition: A compound of nickel and chloride in which the ratio of nickel (in the +2 oxidation state) to chloride is 1:2.

name: nocodazole
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is benzimidalole which is substituted at position 2 by a (methoxycarbonyl)amino group and at position 5 by a 2-thienoyl group. It is an antineoplastic agent that exerts its effect by depolymerising microtubules.

name: octadecanamide
definition: A fatty amide of stearic acid.

name: paraquat
definition: An organic cation that consists of 4,4'-bipyridine bearing two N-methyl substituents loctated at the 1- and 1'-positions.

name: paxilline
definition: An indole diterpene alkaloid with formula C27H33NO4 isolated from Penicillium paxilli. It is a potent inhibitor of large conductance Ca2+- and voltage-activated K+ (BK)-type channels.

name: pentachloronitrobenzene
definition: A C-nitro compound that is nitrobenzene in which every hydrogen has been replaced by a chlorine. A fungicide used on a variety of crops, including cotton, rice and seed grains, it is no longer approved for use within the European Union.

name: pentetrazol
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that is 1H-tetrazole in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 5 are replaced by a pentane-1,5-diyl group. A central and respiratory stimulant, it was formerly used for the treatment of cough and other respiratory tract disorders, cardiovascular disorders including hypotension, and pruritis.

name: permethrin
definition: A cyclopropanecarboxylate ester in which the esterifying alcohol is 3-phenoxybenzyl alcohol and the cyclopropane ring is substituted with a 2,2-dichlorovinyl group and with gem-dimethyl groups.

name: phenthoate
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is ethyl mandelate in which the hydroxy group has been replaced by a (dimethoxyphosphorothioyl)sulfanediyl group.

name: phenyl salicylate
definition: A benzoate ester that is the phenyl ester of salicylic acid. Also known as salol, it can be formed by heating salicylic acid with phenol and is used in the manufacture of some polymers, lacquers, adhesives, waxes and polishes.

name: phthalocyanine
definition: A tetrapyrrole fundamental parent that consists of four isoindole-type units, with the connecting carbon atoms in the macrocycle replaced by nitrogen.

name: picloram
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is pyridine-2-carboxylic acid which is substituted by a chloro group at positions 3,5 and 6, and by an amino group at position 4. It is a systemic herbicide used to control deeply rooted herbaceous weeds and woody plants in rights-of-way, forestry, range lands, pastures, and small grain crops.

name: prometon
definition: A methoxy-1,3,5-triazine that is 6-methoxy-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine in which the one of the hydrogens of each amino group is substituted by an isopropyl group.

name: propyzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,5-dichlorobenzoic acid with the amino group of 2-methylbut-3-yn-2-amine. It is used as a systemic post-emergent herbicide for the control grass and broadleaf weeds in a wide range of in a wide variety of fruit and root crops.

name: propanil
definition: An anilide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of propanoic acid with the amino group of 3,4-dichloroaniline. It is a herbicide used for the treatment of numerous grasses and broad-leaved weeds in rice, potatoes, and wheat.

name: propoxur
definition: A carbamate ester that is phenyl methylcarbamate substituted at position 2 by a propan-2-yloxy group.

name: prostaglandin D3
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins D that is prosta-5,13,17-trien-1-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 9 and 15 and an oxo group at position 11 (the 5Z,13E,15S,17Z-stereoisomer).

name: 5'-phosphopyridoxal-6-azobenzene-2,4-disulfonic acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is pyridoxal 5'-phosphate carrying an additional 2,4-disulfophenylazo substituent at position 6.

name: (S)-ropivacaine hydrochloride hydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of (S)-ropivacaine hydrochloride.

name: rimonabant
definition: A carbohydrazide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-(4-chlorophenyl)-1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-4-methyl-1H-pyrazole-3-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 1-aminopiperidine. It is a potent and selective cannabinoid receptor 1 (CB1R) antagonist. Besides its antagonistic properties, numerous studies have shown that, at micromolar concentrations rimonabant behaves as an inverse agonist at CB1 receptors. The drug was the first selective CB1 antagonist/inverse agonist introduced into clinical practice to treat obesity and metabolic-related disorders. It was later withdrawn from market due to CNS-related adverse effects including depression and suicidal ideation.

name: saxitoxin
definition: An alkaloid isolated from the marine dinoflagellates and cyanobacteria that causes paralytic shellfish poisoning.

name: sennoside
definition: A diastereoisomeric mixture containing sennoside A and sennoside B that is used as a laxative and cathartic. Its components are found in senna (Senna alexandrina, also known as Cassia angustifolia), where sennoside A and sennoside B are present in equal amounts, and in rhubarbs (Rheum rhabarbarum), where sennoside A predominates.

name: sennoside B
definition: A member of the class of sennosides that is (9R,9'S)-9,9',10,10'-tetrahydro-9,9'-bianthracene-2,2'-dicarboxylic acid which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 4', by β-D-glucopyranosyloxy groups at positions 5 and 5', and by oxo groups at positions 10 and 10'.

name: simetryn
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is N,N'-diethyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a methylthio group at position 6.

name: sulmazole
definition: An imidazopyridine that is 1H-imidazo[4,5-b]pyridine which is substituted at position 2 by a 2-methoxy-4-(methylsulfinyl)phenyl group. An A1 adenosine receptor antagonist, it was formerly used as a cardiotonic agent.

name: teicoplanin A2-1
definition: A teicoplanin A2 that has (4Z)-dec-4-enoyl as the variable N-acyl group.

name: teicoplanin A2-3
definition: A teicoplanin A2 that has decanoyl as the variable N-acyl group.

name: teicoplanin A2-4
definition: A teicoplanin A2 that has 8-methyldecanoyl as the variable N-acyl group.

name: teicoplanin A2-5
definition: A teicoplanin A2 that has 9-methyldecanoyl as the variable N-acyl group.

name: teicoplanin A3-1
definition: A glycopeptide consisting of a macropolycyclic heptapeptide in which a phenolic hydroxy group has been converted to its α-D-mannoside while a secondary alcohol group has been converted to the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucoside.

name: tetralin
definition: An ortho-fused bicyclic hydrocarbon that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydro derivative of naphthalene.

name: thiophanate-methyl
definition: A member of the class of thioureas that is the dimethyl ester of (1,2-phenylenedicarbamothioyl)biscarbamic acid. A fungicide effective against a broad spectrum of diseases in fruit, vegetables, turf and other crops including eyespot, scab, powdery mildew and grey mould.

name: trenbolone
definition: A 3-oxo-Δ4 steroid that is estra-4,9,11-triene carrying an oxo group at position 3 and a hydroxy group at position 17β. It is a synthetic anabolic steroid used for muscle growth in livestock.

name: tributyl phosphate
definition: A trialkyl phosphate that is the tributyl ester of phosphoric acid.

name: tributyrin
definition: A triglyceride obtained by formal acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol by butyric acid.

name: triethylamine
definition: A tertiary amine that is ammonia in which each hydrogen atom is substituted by an ethyl group.

name: trifluralin
definition: A substituted aniline that is N,N-dipropylaniline substituted by a nitro groups at positions 2 and 6 and a trifluoromethyl group at position 4. It is an agrochemical used as a pre-emergence herbicide.

name: trioxilin B3
definition: A trioxilin having (all-cis 5,8,14) double bond configuration; and 10-, (11S)- and (12R)-hydroxy substituents.

name: triphenyl phosphate
definition: An aryl phosphate resulting from the formal condensation of phosphoric acid with 3 mol eq. of phenol.

name: triphenylsilanol
definition: An organosilanol in which silicon is bonded to a single hydroxy function and to three phenyl groups.

name: fentin chloride
definition: An organotin compound that is triphenylstannane in which the hydrogen attached to tin is replaced by a chloro group. A fungicide used to control blights on potatoes, leaf spot diseases on sugar beet and anthracnose on beans.

name: tris(2-chloroethyl) phosphate
definition: A trialkyl phosphate that is the tris(2-chloroethyl) ester of phosphoric acid.

name: tris(2-butoxyethyl) phosphate
definition: A trialkyl phosphate in which the alkyl group specified is 2-butoxyethyl.

name: UCL 1684
definition: A quinolinium ion that is the dication which results from the joining of two molecules of 4-aminoquinolinium via a 1,3-dimethylbenzene linker at positions 1 and 4, thus forming a cyclic structure. It is a potent blocker of Ca2+-activated K+ channels in rats.

name: 10-undecenoic acid
definition: An undecenoic acid having its double bond in the 10-position. It is derived from castor oil and is used for the treatment of skin problems.

name: xanthomicrol
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is flavone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 6, 7 and 8 and hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 4'.

name: ZAPA
definition: An imidothiocarbamic ester that is (2Z)-prop-2-enoic acid with a carbamimidoylsulfanyl group at position 3.

name: cis-1,2-diphenylcyclobutane
definition: A 1,2-diphenylcyclobutane that has cis-configuration.

name: sec-butylbenzene
definition: An alkylbenzene that is benzene substituted by a butan-2-yl group.

name: hydrogen manganate
definition: A manganese oxoanion that consists of manganic acid where one of the two OH groups has been deprotonated.

name: dihydroxidodioxidomanganate(1−)
definition: A manganese oxoanion that consists of hypomanganic acid where one of the three OH groups has been deprotonated.

name: hydroxidotrioxidomanganate(2−)
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of two protons from hypomanganic acid.

name: (2S)-2-isopropylmalic acid
definition: An optically active form of 2-isopropylmalic acid having S-configuration.

name: D-glucuronic acid 1-phosphate
definition: A uronic acid phosphate consisting of D-glucuronic acid having a phosphate group attached at the 1-position.

name: (S)-3-methyl-2-oxovalerate
definition: The conjugate base of (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid.

name: 2,4'-dihydroxyacetophenone
definition: A dihydroxyacetophenone that is ethanone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2 and a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at position 1.

name: hydrogenvanadate
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of two protons from vanadic acid.

name: dihydrogenvanadate
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion that consists of vanadic acid where one of the three OH groups has been deprotonated.

name: zinc sulfate
definition: A metal sulfate compound having zinc(2+) as the counterion.

name: 2-oxohexanoate
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-oxohexanoic acid.

name: 4-amino-4-deoxychorismate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 4-amino-4-deoxychorismic acid.

name: isoprene
definition: A hemiterpene with the formula CH2=C(CH3)CH=CH2; the monomer of natural rubber and a common structure motif to the isoprenoids, a large class of other naturally occurring compounds.

name: apratoxin A
definition: An aprotoxin having the common aprotoxin cyclodepsipeptide skeleton where the isoleucyl residue carries an N-methyl substituent and the side-chain adjacent to the lactone is tert-butyl.

name: 4-nitrotoluene
definition: A mononitrotoluene that consists of toluene bearing a nitro substituent at the 4-position.

name: serine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of serine.

name: D-serine zwitterion
definition: A serine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of D-serine.

name: chloroform
definition: A one-carbon compound that is methane in which three of the hydrogens are replaced by chlorines.

name: 1-benzofuran
definition: A benzofuran consisting of fused benzene and furan rings. It is the parent compound of the class of 1-benzofurans.

name: L-2-succinylamino-6-oxoheptanedioic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid consisting of L-2-amino-6-oxoheptanedioic acid having a succinoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: L-proline betaine
definition: An amino acid betaine that is L-proline zwitterion in which both of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen are replaced by methyl groups.

name: all-trans-violaxanthin
definition: The all-trans-stereoisomer of violaxanthin.

name: 1,2,3-trichlorobenzene
definition: A trichlorobenzene carrying chloro substituents at positions 1, 2 and 3.

name: 1,2-dichlorobenzene
definition: A dichlorobenzene carrying chloro substituents at positions 1 and 2.

name: all-trans-retinoate
definition: A retinoate that is the conjugate base of all-trans-retinoic acid.

name: acene
definition: A polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon consisting of fused benzene rings in a rectilinear arrangement.

name: anthracene
definition: An ortho-fused tricyclic hydrocarbon comprising three fused benzene rings.

name: 9-cis-violaxanthin
definition: The 9-cis-stereoisomer of violaxanthin.

name: 9'-cis-neoxanthin
definition: A neoxanthin in which all of the double bonds have trans geometry except for that at the 9' position, which is cis.

name: (1S)-1-phenylethanamine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 1-phenylethanamine.

name: (1R)-1-phenylethanamine
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 1-phenylethanamine.

name: tunaxanthin
definition: A carotenol isolated from the white tuna, or albacore tuna (Thunnus albacares).

name: astacene
definition: A carotenone that consists of β,β-carotene bearing four oxo substituents at positions 2, 2', 4 and 4'.

name: spirilloxanthin
definition: A carotenoid ether that is (3E,3'E)-1,1'-dihydroxy-3,3',4,4'-tetradehydro-1,1',2,2'-tetrahydro-ψ,ψ-carotene in which both hydroxyl hydrogens are replaced by methyl groups.

name: spheroidene
definition: The cartenoid ether that is the methyl ether of 3,4-didehydro-1,2,7',8'-tetrahydro-ψ,ψ-caroten-1-ol.

name: rhodopin
definition: A carotenol having the structure of 1,2-dihydro-ψ,ψ-carotene with a hydroxy function at C-1.

name: rhodopinol
definition: A carotenol that consists of 1,2-dihydro-ψ,ψ-carotene bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 1 and 20.

name: luteoxanthin
definition: An epoxycarotenol that consists of 5,6,5',8'-tetrahydro-β,β-carotene-3,3'-diol having epoxy groups at the 5,6- and 5',8'-positions.

name: auroxanthin
definition: An epoxycarotenol that consists of 5,6,5',8'-tetrahydro-β,β-carotene-3,3'-diol having epoxy groups at the 5,8- and 5',8'-positions.

name: methamphetamine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride having methamphetamine as the base component.

name: D-fuconate
definition: The conjugate base of D-fuconic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-mannose 1-phosphate
definition: A mannose phosphate that is D-mannose carrying a phosphate group at position 1.

name: galactarate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of galactaric acid.

name: aspartate(1−)
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of aspartic acid.

name: chromate(2−)
definition: A chromium oxoanion resulting from the removal of two protons from chromic acid.

name: alkane-α,ω-diamine
definition: A primary diamine that is ethane or a higher alkane in which a hydrogen of each of the terminal methyl groups has been replaced by an amino group. H2NCH2(CH2)nCH2NH2, where n = 0, 1, 2, etc.

name: N-monoacetylalkane-α,ω-diamine
definition: An acetamide obtained by acetylation of one of the amino groups of any alkane-α,ω-diamine. AcNHCH2(CH2)nCH2NH2, where n = 0, 1, 2, etc.

name: N-acetylneuraminate
definition: A ketoaldonate that is the conjugate base of N-acetylneuraminic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: lithocholic acid sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is lithocholic acid in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: 4-nitrophenyl hydrogen sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate the mono 4-nitrophenyl ester of sulfuric acid.

name: D-ribose 1-phosphate
definition: A ribose monophosphate that is D-ribose substituted at position 1 by a phosphate group.

name: 3,3',5,5'-tetrachlorobiphenyl-4,4'-diol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybiphenyls formed formally by chlorination of biphenyl-4,4'-diol at C-3, -3', -5 and -5'.

name: 4'-aminobiphenyl-4-ol
definition: An aminobiphenyl whose amino group is at C-4 and is hydroxylated at C-4'.

name: 3,3',5,5'-tetrachlorobiphenyl
definition: A tetrachlorobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which both phenyl groups are substituted by chlorines at positions 3 and 5.

name: 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucarate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion obtained by removal of a proton from one of the carboxylic acid groups of 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucaric acid.

name: cadmium dichloride
definition: A cadmium coordination entity in which cadmium(2+) and Cl− ions are present in the ratio 2:1. Although considered to be ionic, it has considerable covalent character to its bonding.

name: diisononyl phthalate
definition: The diisononyl ester of benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

name: dimethyl maleate
definition: A maleate ester resulting from the formal condensation of both carboxy groups of maleic acid with methanol. It is commonly used as a dienophile for Diels-Alder-type cycloaddition reactions in organic synthesis.

name: (Z)-hexadec-11-enoic acid
definition: A C16, monounsaturated fatty acid with a double bond at position 11; a key intermediate in silkworm pheromone biosynthesis.

name: (Z)-hexadec-7-enoic acid
definition: A C16 fatty acid having a (Z)-double bond at the 7-position; marker of early life stage mortality in trout and of physiologically active autotrophic bacteria in complex microbial communities.

name: trypanothione disulfide
definition: An organic disulfide resulting from the formal oxidative coupling of the thiol groups of N1,N8-bis(glutathionyl)-spermidine from the insect-parasitic trypanosomatid Crithidia fasciculata.

name: cystine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion that is the tautomer of cystine.

name: D-cystine
definition: The D-enantiomer of cystine.

name: 5α-cholestane
definition: The 5α-stereoisomer of cholestane.

name: perfluorodecanoic acid
definition: A fluoroalkanoic acid that is perfluorinated decanoic acid.

name: perfluoroheptanoic acid
definition: A fluoroalkanoic acid that is perfluorinated heptanoic acid.

name: perfluorooctanoic acid
definition: A fluoroalkanoic acid that is perfluorinated octanoic acid.

name: 3H-pyrrole
definition: That one of the three tautomers of pyrrole which has the double bonds at positions 1 and 4.

name: 2H-pyrrole
definition: That one of the three tautomers of pyrrole which has the double bonds at positions 1 and 3.

name: furan
definition: A monocyclic heteroarene with a structure consisting of a 5-membered ring containing four carbons and one oxygen, with formula C4H4O. It is a toxic, flammable, low-boiling (31°C) colourless liquid.

name: 1H-purine
definition: The 1H-tautomer of purine.

name: 3H-purine
definition: The 3H-tautomer of purine.

name: 9H-purine
definition: The 9H-tautomer of purine.

name: isoxazole
definition: A monocyclic heteroarene with a structure consisting of a 5-membered ring containing three carbon atoms and an oxygen and nitrogen atom adjacent to each other. It is the parent of the class of isoxazoles.

name: (+)-pulegone
definition: The (5R)-enantiomer of p-menth-4(8)-en-3-one.

name: 1,3-oxazole
definition: A five-membered monocyclic heteroarene that is an analogue of cyclopentadiene with O in place of CH2 at position 1 and N in place of CH at position 3.

name: 2H-chromene
definition: A simplest member of the class of chromene in which the heterocyclic pyran ring has a double bond between positions 3 and 4.

name: 4H-chromene
definition: A simplest member of the class of chromene in which the heterocyclic pyran ring has a double bond between positions 2 and 3.

name: trisodium vanadate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt of formula Na3VO4 containing the tetrahedral VO43−

name: trans-anethole
definition: The trans-stereoisomer of anethole.

name: L-α-aminobutyric acid
definition: An optically active form of α-aminobutyric acid having L-configuration.

name: α-aminobutyric acid
definition: An α-amino acid that is butyric acid bearing a single amino substituent located at position 2.

name: 4-methylthiazole
definition: A 1,3-thiazole substituted by a methyl group at position 4.

name: (6-methoxy-2-naphthyl)acetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid consisting of 2-naphthylacetic acid having a methoxy substituent at the 6-position. The active metabolite of the prodrug nabumetone.

name: aporphine
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is the N-methyl derivative of 5,6,6a,7-tetrahydro-4H-dibenzo[de,g]quinoline.

name: cevine
definition: A steroid consisting of cevane having an oxygen bridge between positions 4 and 9 and carrying seven additional hydroxy substituents.

name: carane
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is bicyclo[4.1.0]heptane substituted by methyl groups at positions 3, 7 and 7.

name: (4R)-limonene 1,2-epoxide
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of limonene 1,2-epoxide.

name: betahistine
definition: An aminoalkylpyridine that is pyridine substituted by a 2-(methylamino)ethyl group at position 2. It acts as a histamine agonist and a vasodilator, and is thought to improve the microcirculation of the labyrinth, resulting in reduced endolymphatic pressure. It is used (generally as the hydrochloride or mesylate salt) to reduce the symptoms of vertigo, tinnitus, and hearing loss associated with Ménière's disease.

name: butan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is butane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: cobalt dichloride
definition: A cobalt salt in which the cobalt metal is in the +2 oxidation state and the counter-anion is chloride. It is used as an indicator for water in desiccants.

name: trans-cinnamic acid
definition: The E (trans) isomer of cinnamic acid

name: cis-cinnamic acid
definition: The Z (cis) isomer of cinnamic acid

name: diethyl ether
definition: An ether in which the oxygen atom is linked to two ethyl groups.

name: N2-acetyl-L-lysine
definition: An acetyl-L-lysine where the acetyl group is located at the N2-posiiton.

name: pinane
definition: A monoterpene that is bicyclo[3.1.1]heptane substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 6 and 6.

name: enrofloxacin
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid that is 1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid substituted by an oxo group at position 4, a fluoro group at position 6, a cyclopropyl group at position 1 and a 4-ethylpiperazin-1-yl group at position 7. It is a veterinary antibacterial agent used for the treatment of pets.

name: 2-prenyl-1,4-benzoquinone
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-benzoquinones that is 1,4-benzoquinone in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a prenyl group.

name: 3-carboxy-2-(carboxymethyl)-2-hydroxypropanoate
definition: A citrate(1−) that is the conjugate acid of 2-(carboxymethyl)-2-hydroxysuccinate.

name: 3,4-dicarboxy-3-hydroxybutanoate
definition: A citrate(1−) that is the conjugate acid of 2-(carboxymethyl)-2-hydroxysuccinate.

name: 2-(carboxymethyl)-2-hydroxysuccinate
definition: A citrate(2−) that is the conjugate base of 3,4-dicarboxy-3-hydroxybutanoate.

name: 3-carboxy-3-hydroxypentanedioate
definition: A citrate(2−) that is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of the terminal carboxy groups of citric acid.

name: 2-endo-hydroxy-1,8-cineole
definition: A cineole in which the 1,8-cineole skeleton is substituted at C-2 with a hydroxy group oriented endo (R configuration).

name: oxfendazole
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is fenbendazole in which the sulfur has been oxidised to the corresponding sulfoxide.

name: roxarsone
definition: An organoarsonic acid where the organyl group is 4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl.

name: mandelic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which two of the methyl hydrogens are substituted by phenyl and hydroxyl groups.

name: transplatin
definition: A diamminedichloroplatinum compound in which the two ammine ligands and two chloro ligands are oriented in a trans planar configuration around the central platinum ion. Unlike its cis-isomer, cisplatin, it does not exhibit any useful pharmacological effect and is toxic.

name: 1-methylphenanthrene
definition: A member of the class of phenanthrenes that is phenanthrene substituted by a methyl group at position 1.

name: bacitracin A
definition: A homodetic cyclic peptide consisting of (4R)-2-[(1S,2S)-1-amino-2-methylbutyl]-4,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazole-4-carboxylic acid attached head-to-tail to L-leucyl,D-glutamyl, L-lysyl, D-ornityl, L-isoleucyl, D-phenylalanyl, L-histidyl. D-aspartyl and L-asparaginyl residues coupled in sequence and cyclised by condensation of the side-chain amino group of the L-lysyl residue with the C-terminal carboxylic acid group. It is the major component of bacitracin.

name: monosodium aurothiomalate
definition: An organic monosodium salt of gold thiomalic acid, comprising a sodium cation and a monovalent aurothiomalate anion.

name: disodium aurothiomalate
definition: An organic sodium salt which is the disodium salt of gold thiomalic acid, with a basic unit comprising two sodium cations and a divalent aurothiomalate anion.

name: diphosphane
definition: The simplest of the diphosphanes, consisting of two covelently linked phosphorus atoms each carrying two hydrogens.

name: S-(2-hydroxyethyl)glutathione
definition: A Glu-Cys-Gly tripeptide derivative of glutathione containing a 2-hydroxyethyl substituent on the S of the Cys residue.

name: but-3-enoic acid
definition: That isomer of butenoic acid having the double bond at position C-3.

name: crotonate
definition: The conjugate base of crotonic acid; used by some bacterial species as a carbon and energy source.

name: but-3-enoate
definition: A butenoate having the double bond at the 3-position.

name: 4-(3-hydroxy-1-benzothiophen-2-yl)-2-oxobut-3-enoate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of a 4-(3-hydroxy-1-benzothiophen-2-yl)-2-oxobut-3-enoic acid.

name: glutarate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of glutaric acid.

name: glutaramate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of glutaramic acid.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide consisting of D-galactose having an α-L-fucosyl residue at the 2-position and an N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl residue at the 3-position.

name: 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is valeric acid carrying oxo- and methyl substituents at C-2 and C-3, respectively. An α-keto acid analogue and metabolite of isoleucine in man, animals and bacteria. Used as a clinical marker for maple syrup urine disease (MSUD).

name: pent-4-enoate
definition: A pentenoate having the double bond at the 4-position.

name: pent-4-enoic acid
definition: A pentenoic acid having the double bond at position 4.

name: pent-2-enoic acid
definition: A pentenoic acid having the double bond at position 2.

name: protirelin
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-pyroglutamyl, L-histidyl and L-prolinamide residues joined in sequence.

name: sorbic acid
definition: A hexadienoic acid with double bonds at C-2 and C-4; it has four geometrical isomers, of which the trans,trans-form is naturally occurring.

name: penta-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A pentadienoic acid with the double bonds at positions 2 and 4.

name: (2-trans,6-cis)-farnesol
definition: The (2E,6Z)-stereoisomer of farnesol.

name: hentriacontan-16-ol
definition: A fatty alcohol consisting of a hydroxy function at C-16 of an unbranched saturated chain of 31 carbon atoms.

name: nonan-1-ol
definition: A nonanol that is nonane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1. It has been isolated as a component of volatile oils from plants like Hordeum vulgare.

name: penam
definition: Compound comprising a beta-lactam ring fused to a saturated 5-membered ring containing one sulfur atom.

name: cepham
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that consists of (6R)-5-thia-1-azabicyclo[4.2.0]octane bearing an 8-keto substituent. The parent of the class of cephams.

name: penem
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that consists of (5R)-4-thia-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]hept-2-ene bearing a 7-keto substituent. The parent of the class of penems.

name: tridecane
definition: A straight chain alkane containing 13 carbon atoms. It forms a component of the essential oils isolated from plants such as Abelmoschus esculentus.

name: cis-resveratrol

name: pseudooxynicotine
definition: An aminoacylpyridine that is pyridine substituted at position 3 by a 4-(methylamino)butanoyl group.

name: 6-hydroxypseudooxynicotine
definition: The 6-hydroxy derivative of pseudooxynicotine.

name: 4-(methylamino)butyric acid
definition: A γ-amino acid comprising that is GABA in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a methyl group.

name: disulfur dinitride
definition: An inorganic heterocyclic compound with formula N2S2 and consisting of alternating sulfur and nitrogen atoms making up a 4-membered ring structure that is virtually square and planar. It is shock-sensitive and decomposes explosively above 30°C.

name: cycloartane
definition: A triterpene that is lanostane in which there is a methylene bridge between the 5- and 9-positions.

name: O4-phospho-L-tyrosine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-tyrosine phosphorylated at the phenolic hydroxy group.

name: thallium-203
definition: The stable isotope of thallium with relative atomic mass 202.9723. The least abundant (29.524 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring thallium.

name: thallium-205
definition: The stable isotope of thallium with relative atomic mass 204.9744. The most abundant (70.476 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring thallium.

name: thallium-201
definition: The radioactive isotope of thallium with relative atomic mass 200.9708 and half-life of 72.912 hours.

name: thallium-199
definition: The radioactive isotope of thallium with relative atomic mass 198.9698 and half-life of 7.42 hours.

name: penicillanic acid
definition: A penam that consists of 3,3-dimethyl-7-oxo-4-thia-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptane bearing a carboxy group at position 2 and having (2S,5R)-configuration.

name: butane
definition: A straight chain alkane composed of 4 carbon atoms.

name: trans-dec-3-enoic acid
definition: A decenoic acid having a trans- double bond at position 3.

name: dodeca-2,10-diyne
definition: An alkadiyne that isdodecane which has been which has been formally dehydrogenated to introduce triple bonds at the 2-3 and 10-11 positions.

name: 3-chloro-p-toluidine
definition: A monochloroaniline that is p-toluidine in which one of the hydrogens that is meta to the amino group is replaced by a chlorine.

name: p-toluidine
definition: An aminotoluene in which the amino substituent is para to the methyl group.

name: pentane
definition: A straight chain alkane consisting of 5 carbon atoms.

name: P,P-diphenylphosphinimidic amide
definition: A phosphinamidine having two phenyl groups attached to the phosphorus.

name: 2-naphthylacetic acid
definition: A naphthylacetic acid carrying a carboxy group at position 2.

name: octan-2-ol
definition: An octanol carrying the hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 5α-androst-16-en-3-one
definition: An androstanoid that is 5α-androst-16-ene substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It is a steroid pheromone found in high concentrations in the saliva of male pigs,.

name: indane
definition: An ortho-fused bicyclic hydrocarbon consisting of a benzene ring fused to a cyclopentane ring; a high-boiling (176 oC) colourless liquid.

name: fluorescein 5-isothiocyanate
definition: The 5-isomer of fluorescein isothiocyanate. Acts as a fluorescent probe capable of being conjugated to tissue and proteins; used as a label in fluorescent antibody staining procedures as well as protein- and amino acid-binding techniques.

name: arbekacin
definition: A kanamycin that is kanamycin B bearing an N-(2S)-4-amino-2-hydroxybutyryl group on the aminocyclitol ring.

name: astromicin
definition: An amino cyclitol glycoside that is L-chiro-inositol in which the hydroxy groups at positions 1, 4, and 6 are replaced by aminoacetyl)methylamino, amino, and methoxy groups, respectively, and in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is converted to the corresponding 2,6-diamino-2,3,4,6,7-pentadeoxy-β-L-lyxo-heptopyranoside. The major component of fortimicin, obtained from Micromonospora olivasterospora. It is administered (as the sulfate salt) by intramuscular injection or intravenous infusion for the treatment of severe systemic infections due to sensitive Gram-negative organisms.

name: atazanavir
definition: A heavily substituted carbohydrazide that is an antiretroviral drug of the protease inhibitor (PI) class used to treat infection of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).

name: androst-16-ene
definition: A steroid comprising androstane having a C=C double bond at the 16(17)-position.

name: fluorescein 6-isothiocyanate
definition: The 6-isomer of fluorescein isothiocyanate.

name: 10H-phenothiazine
definition: The 10H-tautomer of phenothiazine.

name: clopidogrel
definition: A thienopyridine that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydrothieno[3,2-c]pyridine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by an o-chlorobenzyl group, the methylene hydrogen of which is replaced by a methoxycarbonyl group (the S enantiomer). A P2Y12 receptor antagonist, it is used to inhibit blood clots and prevent heart attacks.

name: dibekacin
definition: A kanamycin that is kanamycin B lacking the 3- and 4-hydroxy groups on the 2,6-diaminosugar ring.

name: dopamine 3-O-sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is dopamine in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: 2H-pyran-2-one
definition: The simplest member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran with an oxo substituent at position 2.

name: 4H-pyran-4-one
definition: A pyranone that is 4H-pyran substituted by an oxo group at position 4.

name: aluminium-27 atom
definition: The stable isotope of aluminium with relative atomic mass 26.98153 and nuclear spin 5/2.

name: aluminium-26 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of aluminium with relative atomic mass 25.986892 and half-life of 717,000 years.

name: aluminium-28 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of aluminium with relative atomic mass 27.981910 and half-life of 2.25 min.

name: phosphorus-31 atom
definition: The stable isotope of phosphorus with relative atomic mass 30.973762 and nuclear spin 1/2.

name: phosphorus-32 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of phosphorus with relative atomic mass 31.973907 and half-life of 14.26 days.

name: phosphorus-33 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of phosphorus with relative atomic mass 32.971725, half-life of 25.34 days and nuclear spin 1/2.

name: silicon-29 atom
definition: The stable isotope of silicon with relative atomic mass 28.9764947, 4.683 atom percent natural abundancy, and nuclear spin 1/2.

name: silicon-28 atom
definition: The stable isotope of silicon with relative atomic mass 27.9769265. The most abundant (92.23 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring silicon.

name: silicon-30 atom
definition: The stable isotope of silicon with relative atomic mass 29.9737702. The least abundant (3.09 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring silicon.

name: silicon-31 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of silicon with relative atomic mass 30.975363, half-life of 2.62 hours and nuclear spin 3/2.

name: silicon-32 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of silicon with relative atomic mass 31.974148. The longest-lived silicon radionuclide with half-life of 172 years.

name: sulfur-32 atom
definition: The stable isotope of sulfur with relative atomic mass 31.972071. The most abundant (95.02 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring sulfur.

name: sulfur-33 atom
definition: The stable isotope of sulfur with relative atomic mass 32.9714585, 0.75 atom percent natural abundance, and nuclear spin 3/2.

name: sulfur-34 atom
definition: The stable isotope of sulfur with relative atomic mass 33.9678668 and 4.21 atom percent natural abundance.

name: sulfur-36 atom
definition: The stable isotope of sulfur with relative atomic mass 35.9670809. The least abundant (0.02 atom percent) isotope of naturally occurring sulfur.

name: sulfur-35 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of sulfur with relative atomic mass 34.9690322 and nuclear spin 3/2. The longest-lived sulfur radionuclide with half-life of 87.5 days.

name: sulfur-37 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of sulfur with relative atomic mass 36.9711257 and half-life of 5.05 min.

name: sulfur-38 atom
definition: The radioactive isotope of sulfur with relative atomic mass 37.97116 and half-life of 170.3 min.

name: glycolithocholic acid
definition: The glycine conjugate of lithocholic acid.

name: apazone
definition: A member of the class of benzotriazines that is 1,2-dihydro-1,2,4-benzotriazine bearing a dimethylamino substitutent at position 3 and a methyl substituent at position 7 and in which the nitrogens at positions 1 and 2 are both acylated by a carboxy group of propylmalonic acid.

name: cyanin chloride
definition: A member of the class of anthocyanin chlorides that has cyanin cation as the cationic counterpart.

name: 3-sulfolactic acid
definition: The C-sulfonato derivaive of lactic acid.

name: cyanuric acid
definition: The enol tautomer of isocyanuric acid.

name: L-mannitol
definition: The L-enantiomer of mannitol.

name: Cy5-bifunctional dye
definition: An iminium betaine derived from a Cy5 dye.

name: 1,3,5-trioxane
definition: A saturated organic heteromonocyclic parent that is cyclohexane in which the carbon atoms at positions 1, 3 and 5 are replaced by oxygen atoms.

name: Cy3-monofunctional dye(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion derived from a Cy3 dye.

name: Cy3-bifunctional dye(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of Cy3-bifunctional dye zwitterion.

name: α-hydroxyglycine
definition: A hydroxy-amino acid that is glycine substituted by a hydroxy group at the α-position.

name: propazine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is N,N'-di(propan-2-yl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a chloro group at position 6.

name: cyanazine
definition: A chloro-1,3,5-triazine that is 2-chloro-1,3,5-triazine substituted by an ethyl amino and a (2-cyanopropan-2-yl)amino group at positions 6 and 4 respectively.

name: 2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one
definition: A γ-lactone that is 1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran in which the hydrogens at position 1 are replaced by an oxo group.

name: benzenesulfinate
definition: An organosulfinate that is the conjugate base of benzenesulfinic acid obtained by deprotonation of the sulfinic acid group.

name: azetidine-2-carboxylic acid
definition: An azetidinecarboxylic acid that is azetidine substituted by a carboxy group at position 2. It is a plant non-protein amino acid.

name: (1-naphthyl)methanol
definition: A naphthylmethanol that is methanol in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is replaced by a naphthalen-1-yl group.

name: (1S,2R)-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol
definition: A cis-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol with a (1S,2R)-configuration.

name: (1R,2R)-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol
definition: A trans-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol with a (1R,2R)-configuration.

name: 1,2-dihydronaphthalene
definition: A dihydronaphthalene hydrogenated at C-1 and C-2.

name: ferrienterobactin
definition: An iron chelate that is (3S,7S,11S)-3,7,11-triamino-1,5,9-trioxacyclododecane-2,6,10-trione in which each nitrogen has been acylated by a 2,3-dihydroxybenzoyl group, the six phenolic oxygen atoms being coordinated to Fe(III).

name: (−)-11-hydroxy-9,10-dihydrojasmonic acid
definition: A dihydrojasmonic acid that is 9,10-dihydrojasmonic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 11 (the 1R,2R-stereoisomer).

name: 3-hydroxymugineic acid
definition: A mugineic acid derivative consisting of mugineic acid having hydroxy group at the 3-position.

name: physcion
definition: A dihydroxyanthraquinone that is 9,10-anthraquinone bearing hydroxy substituents at positions 1 and 8, a methoxy group at position 3, and a methyl group at position 6. It has been widely isolated and characterised from both terrestrial and marine sources.

name: picolinate
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylate resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of picolinic acid.

name: isonicotinate
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of isonicotinic acid.

name: astilbin
definition: A flavanone glycoside that is (+)-taxifolin substituted by a α-L-rhamnosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: methapyrilene hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride salt of methapyrilene.

name: monuron
definition: A member of the class of 3-(3,4-substituted-phenyl)-1,1-dimethylureas that is urea in which one of the nitrogens is substituted by a p-chlorophenyl group while the other is substituted by two methyl groups.

name: fumonisin B1
definition: A diester that results from the condensation of the 1-carboxy groups of two molecules of propane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid with hydroxy groups at positions 14 and 15 of (2S,3S,5R,10R,12S,14S,15R,16R)-2-amino-12,16-dimethylicosane-3,5,10,14,15-pentol.

name: fumonisin B2
definition: A fumonisin that is (2S,3S,12S,14S,15R,16R)-2-amino-12,16-dimethylicosane-3,14,15-triol in which the hydroxy groups at positions 14 and 15 have each been esterified by condensation with the 1-carboxy group of 3-carboxyglutaric acid (giving a 3-carboxyglutarate ester group with R configuration in each case).

name: macrophomic acid
definition: A methoxybenzoic acid having a single methoxy group at the 3-position together with acetyl and methyl substituents at the 4- and 5-positions respectively.

name: macrophomate
definition: A methoxybenzoate having a single methoxy group at the 3-position together with acetyl and methyl substituents at the 4- and 5-positions respectively.

name: prosolanapyrone I
definition: A prosolanapyrone bearing a methyl substituent at position 3 of the pyrone ring.

name: prosolanapyrone II
definition: A prosolanapyrone that is prosolanapyrone I in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl substituent at position 3 of the pyrone ring is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: (1S,4R)-1-hydroxylimonen-2-one
definition: An optically active form of 1-hydroxylimonen-2-one having (1S,4R)-configuration.

name: phorbine
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole that consists of porphyrin that has a cyclopentane ring fused to one of the pyrrole rings and the adjacent methine group. The parent of the class of phorbines.

name: 2-amino-3-hydroxybutanoic acid
definition: An α-amino acid that is butanoic acid substituted by an amino group at position 2 and a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 2-amino-3-methylpentanoic acid
definition: A branched chain amino acid that consists of 3-methylpentanoic acid bearing an amino substituent at position 2.

name: carvone
definition: A p-menthane monoterpenoid that consists of cyclohex-2-enone having methyl and isopropenyl substituents at positions 2 and 5, respectively.

name: O-β-D-glucosyl-trans-zeatin
definition: The trans-isomer of O-β-D-glucosylzeatin.

name: boronic acid
definition: The simplest boronic acid, consisting of borane with two of the hydrogens substituted by hydroxy groups.

name: borinic acid
definition: The simplest borinic acid, consisting of borane with one of the hydrogens substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: L-ascorbate
definition: The L-enantiomer of ascorbate and conjugate base of L-ascorbic acid, arising from selective deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group. Required for a range of essential metabolic reactions in all animals and plants.

name: vernolic acid
definition: A monounsaturated epoxy fatty acid composed of cis-9-octadecenoic acid having a 12,13-epoxy group.

name: (−)-vernolic acid
definition: An optically active form of vernolic acid having (12R,13S)-configuration.

name: usnic acid
definition: A member of the class of dibenzofurans that is dibenzo[b,d]furan-1(9bH)-one substituted by acetyl groups at positions 2 and 6, hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 7 and methyl groups at positions 8 and 9b.

name: mesotrione
definition: An aromatic ketone that is cyclohexa-1,3-dione in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 is substituted by a 4-(methanesulfonyl)-2-nitrobenzoyl group.

name: 11-tetradecenoic acid
definition: A tetradecenoic acid having its double bond in the 11-position.

name: L-sorbose 1-phosphate
definition: The L-stereoisomer of sorbose 1-phosphate.

name: 7-[(2,4-diamino-6-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl]-7,8-dicarba-nido-undecaborane(11)
definition: An aminopyrimidine that consists of 7,8-dicarba-nido-undecaborane(11) bearing a (2,4-diamino-6-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl substituent at position 7.

name: (7R)-7-[(2,4-diamino-6-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl]-7,8-dicarba-nido-undecaborane(11)
definition: An optically active form of 7-[(2,4-diamino-6-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl]-7,8-dicarba-nido-undecaborane(11) that has (7R)-configuration.

name: (7S)-7-[(2,4-diamino-6-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl]-7,8-dicarba-nido-undecaborane(11)
definition: An optically active form of 7-[(2,4-diamino-6-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl]-7,8-dicarba-nido-undecaborane(11) that has (7S)-configuration.

name: hex-4-enoic acid
definition: A hexenoic acid with the double bond at position 4.

name: (2E,4E)-hexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A sorbic acid having trans-double bonds at positions 2 and 4; a food preservative that can induce cutaneous vasodilation and stinging upon topical application to humans. It is the most thermodynamically stable of the four possible geometric isomers possible, as well as the one with the highest antimicrobial activity.

name: (2Z,4Z)-hexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: One of four possible geometric isomers of sorbic acid, having cis-double bonds at positions 2 and 4.

name: (2Z,4E)-hexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: One of four possible geometric isomers of sorbic acid, having cis- and trans-double bonds at positions 2 and 4 respectively.

name: (2E,4Z)-hexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: One of four possible geometric isomers of sorbic acid, having trans- and cis-double bonds at positions 2 and 4 respectively.

name: tariric acid
definition: An octadecynoic acid having its triple bond at position 6.

name: hept-6-enoic acid
definition: A heptenoic acid with the double bond at position 6.

name: (E)-hept-2-enoic acid
definition: A 2-heptenoic acid having the trans configuration.

name: cis-2-heptenoic acid
definition: A 2-heptenoic acid having the cis configuration.

name: trans-pent-2-enoic acid
definition: A pent-3-enoic acid in trans- configuration.

name: cis-pent-2-enoic acid
definition: A pent-3-enoic acid in cis- configuration.

name: pent-3-enoic acid
definition: A pentenoic acid having the double bond at position 3.

name: cis-pent-3-enoic acid
definition: A pent-3-enoic acid in cis- configuration.

name: trans-pent-3-enoic acid
definition: A pent-3-enoic acid in trans- configuration.

name: 2-dodecenoic acid
definition: A dodecenoic acid having its double bond at position 2.

name: cis-2-dodecenoic acid
definition: The cis isomer of 2-dodecenoic acid.

name: 3-dodecenoic acid
definition: A dodecenoic acid having its double bond at position 3.

name: trans-3-dodecenoic acid
definition: The trans-isomer of 3-dodecenoic acid.

name: 9-dodecenoic acid
definition: A dodecenoic acid having its double bond in the 9-position.

name: trans-dodec-9-enoic acid
definition: A 9-dodecenoic acid having trans-configuration.

name: cis-9-dodecenoic acid
definition: A 9-dodecenoic acid having cis-configuration.

name: trans-10-dodecenoic acid
definition: The trans isomer of 10-dodecenoic acid.

name: 10-dodecenoic acid
definition: A dodecenoic acid having its double bond at position 10.

name: cis-10-dodecenoic acid
definition: The cis-isomer of 10-dodecenoic acid.

name: 9,11,13-octadecatrienoic acid
definition: Any octadecatrienoic acid with three fully-conjugated double bonds at positions 9, 11 and 13.

name: (E,Z,E)-octadeca-9,11,13-trienoic acid
definition: A 9,11,13-octadecatrienoic acid having its double bonds in trans, cis and trans configurations, respectively.

name: all-trans-octadeca-9,11,13-trienoic acid
definition: The all-trans isomer of 9,11,13-octadecatrienoic acid.

name: 11,13,15-octadecatrienoic acid
definition: Any octadecatrienoic acid with three fully-conjugated double bonds at positions 11, 13 and 15.

name: 9,11,15-octadecatrienoic acid
definition: Any octadecatrienoic acid with three double bonds at positions 9, 11 and 15.

name: 9,11,14-octadecatrienoic acid
definition: Any octadecatrienoic acid with three double bonds at positions 9, 11 and 14

name: 9,11,15-octadecatrienoate
definition: Any octadecatrienoate having double bonds at positions 9, 11 and 15.

name: 9,11,14-octadecatrienoate
definition: Any octadecatrienoate having double bonds at positions 9, 11 and 14.

name: 11-octadecynoic acid
definition: An octadecynoic acid having its triple bond at position 11.

name: lamenallenic acid
definition: An allenic octadecatrienic acid having the allenic group at position 5 and a trans double bond at the 16-position.

name: perfluorononanoic acid
definition: A fluoroalkanoic acid that is nonanoic acid in which all of the hydrogens in the alkyl chain are replaced by fluorines.

name: (R)-laballenic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of laballenic acid.

name: (S)-laballenic acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of laballenic acid.

name: (R)-lamenallenic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of lamenallenic acid.

name: flavonol 3-O-D-galactoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is flavonol substituted by a β-D-galactopyranosyl moiety at position 3 vis a glycosidic linkage.

name: 4-nitrophenyl N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminide having a 4-nitrophenyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: muconic acid
definition: A hexadienedioic acid with unsaturation at positions 2 and 4.

name: (S)-lamenallenic acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of lamenallenic acid.

name: 3-chloromuconic acid
definition: A monochloromuconic acid carrying a chloro group at position 3.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-acetyl-D-glucosaminic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-D-galactosaminic acid
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative comprising D-galactonic acid having the 2-hydroxy group replaced by acetamido.

name: methoxyfenozide
definition: A carbohydrazide that is hydrazine in which the amino hydrogens have been replaced by 3-methoxy-2-methylbenzoyl, 3,5-dimethylbenzoyl, and tert-butyl groups respectively.

name: tebufenozide
definition: A carbohydrazide that is hydrazine in which the amino hydrogens have been replaced by tert-butyl, 3,5-dimethylbenzoyl and 4-ethylbenzoyl groups respectively. It is an insecticide used widely against caterpillars.

name: azadirachtin B
definition: A member of the class of azadirachtin found in the neem tree, Azadirachta indica.

name: acetonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is hydrogen cyanide in which the hydrogen has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: formamidine
definition: The smallest member of the class of carboxamidines being formic acid with the O and OH groups from the carboxy function replaced by NH and NH2 groups respectively. The parent of the class of formamidines.

name: ergoline
definition: An indole alkaloid whose structural skeleton is found in many naturally occurring and synthetic ergolines which are known to bind to neurotransmitter receptors, such as dopamine, noradrenaline and serotonin receptors and function as unselective agonists or antagonists at these receptors.

name: 2-isopropylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols carrying an isopropyl group at position 2.

name: methiocarb
definition: A carbamate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the phenolic group of 3,5-dimethyl-4-(methylsulfanyl)phenol with the carboxy group of methylcarbamic acid.

name: dimethylcarbamic acid
definition: An amino acid consisting of carbamic acid having two methyl substituents both attached to the nitrogen.

name: rosuvastatin
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is (6E)-7-{4-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-[methyl(methylsulfonyl)amino]-6-(propan-2-yl)pyrimidin-5-yl} hept-6-enoic acid carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 5 (the 3R,5S-diastereomer).

name: fluvastatin
definition: A racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (3R,5S)- and (3S,5R)-fluvastatin. An HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor, it is used (often as the corresponding sodium salt) to reduce triglycerides and LDL-cholesterol, and increase HDL-chloesterol, in the treatment of hyperlipidaemia.

name: (6E)-7-[3-(4-fluorophenyl)-1-(propan-2-yl)-1H-indol-2-yl]-3,5-dihydroxyhept-6-enoic acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is N-isopropylindole which is substituted at position 3 by a p-fluorophenyl group and at position 2 by a 6-carboxy-3,5-dihydroxyhex-1-en-1-yl group. It has four possible diastereoisomers.

name: (3R,5S)-fluvastatin
definition: A (6E)-7-[3-(4-fluorophenyl)-1-(propan-2-yl)-1H-indol-2-yl]-3,5-dihydroxyhept-6-enoic acid diastereoisomer in which the stereocentres β- and δ- to the carboxy group have R and S configuration, respectively. The drug fluvastatin is an equimolar mixture of this compound and its enantiomer.

name: (3R,5R,6E)-7-[3-(4-fluorophenyl)-1-(propan-2-yl)-1H-indol-2-yl]-3,5-dihydroxyhept-6-enoic acid
