definition: An alanine derivative that is L-alanine bearing a 5-fluorouracil-1-yl substituent at position 3. A more potent and selective AMPA receptor agonist (at hGluR1 and hGluR2) than AMPA itself (Ki = 14.7, 25.1, and 1820 nM for hGluR1, hGluR2 and hGluR5 respectively).

name: α-D-fucose
definition: A D-fucopyranose having α-configuration at its anomeric centre.

name: fisetin
definition: A 7-hydroxyflavonol with additional hydroxy groups at positions 3, 3' and 4'.

name: 4-(trifluoromethyl)phenol
definition: A member of the class of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes that is p-cresol in which the methyl group is perfluorinated. It is a metabolite of the drug fluoxetine.

name: 4-hydroxyphenyl retinamide
definition: A retinoid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of all-trans retinoic acid and the anilino group of 4-hydroxyaniline. Synthetic retinoid agonist. Antiproliferative, antioxidant and anticancer agent with a long half-life in vivo. Apoptotic effects appear to be mediated by a mechanism distinct from that of 'classical' retinoids.

name: β-L-fucose
definition: A L-fucopyranose with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: L-fucitol
definition: The L-enantiomer of fucitol. It is found in nutmeg.

name: 3-{[(5-nitrofuran-2-yl)methylidene]amino}-1,3-oxazol-2-one
definition: An oxazoline derivative having an oxo group at the 2-position and an N-{[(5-nitro-2-furyl)methylene]amino} substituent.

name: α-D-quinovopyranose
definition: The pyranose form of D-quinovose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position .

name: glycyl-AMP zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the glycyl amino group of glycyl-AMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: propylbenzene
definition: An alkylbenzene that is benzene having one of its aromatic hydrogens substituted by a propyl group.

name: flufenamic acid
definition: An aromatic amino acid consisting of anthranilic acid carrying an N-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl substituent. An analgesic and anti-inflammatory, it is used in rheumatic disorders.

name: γ-butyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide that is tetrahydrofuran substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: flaviolin
definition: A hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone that is 1,4-naphthoquinone having three hydroxy substituents placed at the 2-, 5- and 7-positions.

name: GDP-β-L-galactose
