definition: A 3-naphthalen-2-ylalanine that has L-confliguration.

name: butylbenzene
definition: An alkylbenzene that is benzene substituted by a butyl group at position 1.

name: (1R,4S)-norcamphor
definition: A norcamphor that has 1R,4S-stereoconfiguration.

name: N-methyl-L-valine
definition: An optically active form of N-methylvaline having L-configuration.

name: (4S)-2-methylpentane-2,4-diol
definition: A glycol that is the (S)-enantiomer of 2-methylpentane-2,4-diol.

name: naphthalene-2-sulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid in which the sulfo group is linked to position 2 of the naphthalene ring.

name: 6-(α-D-glucosaminyl)-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A D-glucosaminide consisting of 2-aminoglucosamine attached to 1D-myo-inositol at the 6-position via an α-linkage.

name: 4-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-2-oxo-3-phosphonooxypropyl]nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide
definition: A nicotinamide dinucleotide consisting of NADP zwitterion lacking the 2'-phsopho group and having a (1R)-1-hydroxy-2-oxo-3-phosphonooxypropyl group at position 4 of the nicotinamide fragment.

name: 3-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propanoic acid substituted by a 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 3.

name: (S)-NADHX
definition: A tetrahydronicotinamide adenine dinucleotide obtained by formal stereo- and regioselective hydration across the 5,6-double bond in the nicotinyl ring of NADH, with the hydroxy group located at position 6, having (S)-configuration.

name: N-butylbenzenesulfonamide
definition: A sulfonamide that is benzenesulfonamide substituted by a butyl group at the nitrogen atom. It has been isolated from the plant Prunus africana and has been shown to exhibit antiandrogenic activity.

name: metyrapone
definition: An aromatic ketone that is 3,3-dimethylbutan-2-one in which the methyl groups at positions 1 and 4 are replaced by pyridin-3-yl groups. A steroid 11β-monooxygenase (EC 1.14.15.4) inhibitor, it is used in the diagnosis of adrenal insufficiency.

name: menaquinone-7
definition: A menaquinone whose side-chain contains seven isoprene units in an all-trans-configutation.

name: (15Z)-tetracosenoic acid
definition: A tetracosenoic acid having a cis-double bond at position 15.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine
definition: An N-acetyl-D-glucosamine that has α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: N-cyclohexyl-2-aminoethanesulfonic acid
definition: An alkanesulfonic acid that is cyclohexanamine in which one of the amino hydrogens is substituted by a 2-sulfoethyl group. It is used as a buffer (pH range of 8.6-10.0) for studying pH-dependent processes in enzymology.

name: L-m-tyrosine
definition: A hydroxyphenylalanine that is L-phenylalanine with a substituent hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 3-amino-5-phenylpentane
definition: A phenylalkylamine that is benzene in which one of the hydrogens is substituted by a 3-aminopentyl group.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine 1-phosphate
definition: The α-anomer of N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 1-phosphate.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-Galp joined by a (1→4) glycosidic bond to 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopranose.

name: N-acetyl-L-glutamate(2−)
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from deprotonation of both carboxy groups of N-acetyl-L-glutamic acid.

name: (1R,2S)-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol
definition: The cis-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol with a (1R,2S)-configuration.

name: N-tris(hydroxymethyl)methyl-2-aminoethanesulfonic acid
definition: A Good's buffer substance, pKa = 7.5 at 20 °C.

name: nitrofurazone
definition: A semicarbazone resulting from the formal condensation of semicarbazide with 5-nitrofuraldehyde. A broad spectrum antibacterial drug, although with little activity against Pseudomonas species, it is used as a local application for burns, ulcers, wounds and skin infections.

name: duvoglustat
definition: An optically active form of 2-(hydroxymethyl)piperidine-3,4,5-triol having 2R,3R,4R,5S-configuration.

name: N-methyl urea
definition: A member of the class of ureas that is urea substituted by a methyl group at one of the nitrogen atoms.

name: L-2-aminopimelic acid
definition: A 2-aminopimelic acid that has S-configuration.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine 4-sulfate
definition: A galactosamine sulfate that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into its sulfate derivative.

name: m-trimethylammonio(2,2,2-trifluoro-1,1-dihydroxyethyl)benzene
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is the N,N,N-trimethyl derivative of 3-(2,2,2-trifluoro-1,1-dihydroxyethyl)aniline.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine 6-sulfate
definition: A galactosamine sulfate that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into its sulfate derivative.

name: 2-iminiopropionate
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the nitrogen of 2-iminopropionic acid.

name: lawsone
definition: 1,4-Naphthoquinone carrying a hydroxy function at C-2. It is obtained from the leaves of Lawsonia inermis.

name: hydroxyurea
definition: A member of the class of ureas that is urea in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group. An antineoplastic used in the treatment of chronic myeloid leukaemia as well as for sickle-cell disease.

name: nimesulide
definition: An aromatic ether having phenyl and 2-methylsulfonamido-5-nitrophenyl as the two aryl groups.

name: 3-nitro-L-tyrosine
definition: A 3-nitrotyrosine comprising L-tyrosine having a nitro group at the 3-position on the phenyl ring.

name: N,N,N-trimethyl-N-(4-oxopentyl)ammonium
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion in which the substituents on nitrogen are methyl (three) and 4-oxopentyl.

name: 4-nitrophenyl (4-carboxybutyl)phosphonate
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion that is a nitrophenyl phosphonate hapten and transition-state analogue derived from pentanoic acid, with affinity for the germline precursor to catalytic antibody 48G7.

name: N-oxalylglycine
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid that is iminodiacetic acid with an oxo substituent. It is used as an inhibitor of α-ketoglutarate dependent (EC 1.14.11.*) enzymes.

name: N-ethylmaleimide
definition: A member of the class of maleimides that is the N-ethyl derivative of maleimide.

name: 4-({5-[(2-aminoethyl)amino]-2,4-dinitrophenyl}amino)-TEMPO
definition: A C-nitro compound that is the 4-({5-[(2-aminoethyl)amino]-2,4-dinitrophenyl}amino) derivative of TEMPO (PDB entry: 1BAF).

name: methyl nonanoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester obtained from the formal condensation of methanol and nonanoic acid; a colourless liquid with a fruity odour, used in perfumes and flavours, and for medical research.

name: nogalamycin
definition: An anthracycline antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces nogalater. It is a DNA intercalator and exhibits anticancer properties.

name: (S)-2-hydroxy-4-methylpentanoic acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-hydroxy-4-methylpentanoic acid. Derived from the metabolism of the branched-chain amino acids, it belongs to the 2-hydroxycarboxylic acid group of amino acid metabolites.

name: O-methyl-L-threonine
definition: An L-threonine derivative that is L-threonine with a methyl group replacing the hydrogen on the hydroxy side chain.

name: 6-[(4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetamido]caproate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 6-[(4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetamido]caproic acid, formed ny proton loss from the carboxy group.

name: (10E,12Z)-octadecadienoic acid
definition: An octadeca-10,12-dienoic acid having (10E,12Z)-configuration.

name: N-(3-oxododecanoyl)-L-homoserine lactone
definition: An N-acyl-L-homoserine lactone having 3-oxododecanoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: 4-amino-5-aminomethyl-2-methylpyrimidine
definition: An aminopyrimidine compound having its amino substituent at the 4-position together with methyl and aminomethyl substituents at the 2- and 5-positions respectively.

name: 1-ethenyl-1H-imidazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole substituted by an ethenyl group at position 1. It is a reactive diluent in UV cured coatings.

name: 2'-hydroxybiphenyl-2-sulfinic acid
definition: An organosulfinic acid that is benzenesulfinic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a 2-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: 9-(2-carboxyethyl)-10-methylanthracene endoperoxide
definition: A peroxide-bridged anthracene substituted at the bridgeheads with methyl and carboxyethyl groups.

name: all-trans-4-oxoretinol
definition: A retinoid that is all-trans-retinol in which the hydrogens at position 4 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: 5-({4-[2-(1-oxidopiperidin-1-yl)ethyl]phenyl}amino)-5-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide of glutaric acid containing benzene and oxidopiperidine moieties; a transition state analogue hapten used to elicit catalytic antibodies 5C8 and 14B9.

name: (Z)-PUGNAc
definition: The (Z)-isomer of PUGNAc.

name: 6-[(4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetamido]caproic acid
definition: An N-acylamino acid consisting of 6-aminohexanoic acid bearing an N-(4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetyl substituent.

name: 8-oxoguanine
definition: An oxopurine that is guanine which is substituted by an oxo group at position 8.

name: (4S)-4-(2-propylisonicotinoyl)nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide
definition: A nicotinamide dinucleotide comprising NADH having an (S)-2-propylisonicotinoyl group at the 4-position on the dihydronicotinamide ring.

name: 3-oxo-N-[(3S)-2-oxopyrrolidin-3-yl]dodecanamide
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones that is pyrrolidin-2-one in which a hydrogen at the 3 pro-S position is replaced by a 3-oxododecanamido group.

name: afimoxifene
definition: A tertiary amino compound that is tamoxifen in which the phenyl group which is in a Z- relationship to the ethyl substituent is hydroxylated at the para- position. It is the active metabolite of tamoxifen.

name: 2'-O-methylguanosine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A guanosine 5'-phosphate that is the 2'-O-methyl derivative of guanosine 5'-monophosphate.

name: tert-butylamine
definition: A primary aliphatic amine that is ethylamine substituted by two methyl groups at position 1.

name: 2'-O-methyluridine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A uridine 5'-phosphate that is the 2'-O-methyl derivative of uridine 5'-monophosphate.

name: okadaic acid
definition: A polycyclic ether that is produced by several species of dinoflagellates, and is known to accumulate in both marine sponges and shellfish. A polyketide, polyether derivative of a C38 fatty acid, it is one of the primary causes of diarrhetic shellfish poisoning (DSP). It is a potent inhibitor of specific protein phosphatases and is known to have a variety of negative effects on cells.

name: olomoucine
definition: A 9H-purine that is substituted by a (2-hydroxyethyl)nitrilo, benzylnitrilo and a methyl group at positions 2,6 and 9, respectively. It is a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor.

name: 1-ethoxy-2-(2-ethoxyethoxy)ethane
definition: A polyether that consists of undecane in which the carbon atoms at positions 3, 6 and 9 are replaced by oxygen atoms.

name: 2'-O-methylcytidine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is CMP monomethylated at position O-2'

name: L-ornithinium(2+)
definition: The L-enantiomer of ornithinium(2+).

name: 3'-phosphate-adenosine-5'-diphosphate
definition: An adenosine 3'-phosphate that is ADP carrying a phospate group at the 3'-position. It is potent inhibitor of bovine pancreatic ribonuclease A.

name: N5-acetyl-L-ornithine
definition: An N5-acyl-L-ornithine in which the the acyl group is specified as acetyl.

name: α-D-glucosamine
definition: A 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: 3-oxooctanoic acid
definition: A derivative of octanoic acid carrying a β-oxo group; a possible metabolite of 2-octynoic acid.

name: phosphonoacetohydroxamic acid
definition: The hydroxamate of phosphonoacetic acid.

name: 1-O-dodecanoyl-2-O-pentacosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine having a dodecanoyl group at the 1-position and a pentacosanoyl group at the 2-position.

name: 4-benzoyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a benzoyl group at position 4 of the phenyl ring. It is a photoreactive unnatural amino acid that acts as a photo cross-linking probe when incorporated into proteins.

name: lutidinic acid
definition: A pyridinedicarboxylic acid carrying carboxy groups at positions 2 and 4.

name: N-(5'-phosphopyridoxyl)-D-alanine
definition: A D-alanine derivative arising from reductive N-alkylation of D-alanine by pyridoxal-5-phosphate.

name: homogentisic acid
definition: A dihydroxyphenylacetic acid having the two hydroxy substituents at the 2- and 5-positions.

name: formylmethyl hexaethylene glycol
definition: A hydroxypolyether aldehyde comprising hexaethylene glycol having one of the terminal hydroxy groups substituted by formylmethoxy.

name: N2-(5'-phosphopyridoxyl)-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative arising from reductive alkylation of the N2-position of L-lysine by pyridoxal-5-phosphate.

name: hexaethylene glycol monophosphate
definition: A hydroxypolyether phosphate consisting of hexaethylene glycol carrying a single O-phospho group.

name: N-(5'-phosphopyridoxyl)-L-alanine
definition: An alanine derivative arising from reductive N-alkylation of L-alanine by pyridoxal-5-phosphate.

name: oregon green 488
definition: A xanthene dye having two fluoro substituents at the 2- and 7-positions and a 2,4-dicarboxyphenyl group at the 9-position.

name: tetradecaethylene glycol
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) containing 14 ethyleneoxy units.

name: (2R,4S)-2-methyltetrahydrofuran-2,3,3,4-tetrol
definition: A tetrahydroxytetrahydrofuran in which the hydroxy groups are located at positions 2, 3, 4, and 4 and which is substituted by a methyl group at position 2 (the 2R,4S diastereoisomer).

name: 2-O-acetyl-1-O-hexadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acetyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine betaine which has hexadecyl as the alkyl group. PAF is a potent phospholipid activator and mediator of many leukocyte functions, including platelet aggregation, inflammation, and anaphylaxis.

name: 4-phenylbutylamine
definition: A phenylalkylamine that is benzene in which one of the hydrogens is substituted by a 4-aminobutyl group.

name: 2-(2-methoxyethoxy)ethanol
definition: A hydroxypolyether that is the monomethyl ether derivative of diethylene glycol.

name: 2-amino-6-(hydroxymethyl)-7,8-dihydropteridin-4-one
definition: A dihydropterin that is 7,8-dihydropteridin-4-one substituted at positions 2 and 6 by amino and hydroxymethyl groups respectively.

name: triglyme
definition: A polyether that consists of dodecane in which the carbon atoms at positions 2, 5, 8 and 11 are replaced by oxygen atoms.

name: 3-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 3-acyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−) in which the acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl); major species at pH 7.3.

name: propane-1,3-dithiol
definition: A dithiol that is propane substituted by thiol groups at positions 1 ans 3.

name: tetraphenylphosphonium
definition: A polyatomic cation consisting of four phenyl groups attached to a central phosphonium.

name: pentan-1-ol
definition: A short-chain primary fatty alcohol that is pentane in which a hydrogen of one of the methyl groups is substituted by a hydroxy group. It has been isolated from Melicope ptelefolia.

name: (S)-1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolaminium
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of (S)-1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine, arising from protonation of the amino group.

name: phosphoenolpyruvic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acrylic acid substituted by a phosphonooxy group at position 2. It is a metabolic intermediate in pathways like glycolysis and gluconeogenesis.

name: 2,3,4,5,6-pentafluorobenzyl alcohol
definition: An organofluorine compound that is benzyl alcohol substituted by fluoro groups at positions 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6.

name: 4-fluorophenyl-L-alanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine in which the hydrogen at position 4 on the benzene ring is replaced by a fluoro group.

name: propofol
definition: A phenol resulting from the formal substitution of the hydrogen at the 2 position of 1,3-diisopropylbenzene by a hydroxy group.

name: 4-(phosphonomethyl)-L-phenylalanine
definition: A 4-(phosphonomethyl)phenylalanine that has L-configuration.

name: triethylene glycol
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) that is octane-1,8-diol in which the carbon atoms at positions 3 and 6 have been replaced by oxygen atoms.

name: N-(p-nitrophenylphosphobutanoyl)glycine
definition: A C-nitro compound that is the N-(p-nitrophenylphosphobutyryl) derivative of glycine; a cognate transition state analogue of the esterase-like catalytic antibody D2.3.

name: acepromazine
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is 10H-phenothiazine substituted by an acetyl group at position 2 and a 3-(dimethylamino)propyl group at position 10.

name: 2,2'-piperazine-1,4-diylbisethanesulfonic acid
definition: A Good's buffer substance, pKa = 6.8 at 20 °C.

name: p-nitrobenzyl glutaryl glycinic acid
definition: A glycine derivative in which a glycine core carries an N-{5-[(4-nitrobenzyl)amino]-5-oxopentanoyl} substituent.

name: 4-nitrophenyl methylphosphonate
definition: A C-nitro compound that is a phosphonate transition state analogue with affinity for catalytic antibody (esterase) CNJ206.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-[(11Z)-octadec-9-enoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) and (11Z)-octadec-9-enoyl respectively.

name: dioxidophosphate(1−)
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of hydroxyphosphanone.

name: D-α-phenylglycine
definition: The R stereoisomer of α-phenylglycine.

name: 4-iodo-L-phenylalanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 4-iodophenylalanine.

name: phosphonic acid
definition: A phosphorus oxoacid that consists of a single pentavalent phosphorus covalently bound via single bonds to a single hydrogen and two hydroxy groups and via a double bond to an oxygen. The parent of the class of phosphonic acids.

name: N-[4-(4-nitrophenylphospho)butanoyl]-D-alanine
definition: An N-[4-(4-nitrophenylphospho)butanoyl]alanine that has R at the chiral carbon.

name: 1-O-(1-O,2-O-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphono)-1D-myo-inositol 4,5-bis(phosphate)
definition: A glycerophosphoinositol phosphate having a 1-O,2-O-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho moiety attached at the 1-position of 1D-myo-inositol 4,5-bis(phosphate).

name: (2S,3S,4R,5R)-2-(4-aminophenyl)-5-hydroxymethylpyrrolidine-3,4-diol
definition: A dihydroxypyrrolidine that consists of 5-hydroxymethylpyrrolidine-3,4-diol bearing a 4-aminophenyl substituent at position 2 (the 2S,3S,4R,5R-diastereomer).

name: 2-phospho-L-lactic acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-phospholactic acid.

name: 3-phenylpropylamine
definition: A phenylalkylamine that is benzene in which one of the hydrogens is substituted by a 3-aminopropyl group.

name: 5-(2-ethoxyethyl)-5-[4-(4-fluorophenoxy)phenoxy]barbituric acid
definition: A member of the class of barbiturates that is barbituric acid in which the hydrogens at position 5 are replaced by 2-ethoxyethyl and 4-(4-fluorophenoxy)phenoxy groups. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of matrix MMP-13 (metalloproteinase-13, collagenase 3).

name: phosphite(3−)
definition: A trivalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of all three protons from phosphorous acid.

name: 6-{4-[hydroxy-(4-nitrophenoxy)phosphoryl]butyrylamino}hexanoic acid
definition: An organic phosphonate and derivative of hexanoic acid and cognate transition state analogue of the esterase-like catalytic antibody D2.3.

name: 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7-deazaguanine substituted at position 7 by a cyano group.

name: pentamidine
definition: A diether consisting of pentane-1,5-diol in which both hydroxyl hydrogens have been replaced by 4-amidinophenyl groups. A trypanocidal drug that is used for treatment of cutaneous leishmaniasis and Chagas disease.

name: L-phenylalaninol
definition: An amino alcohol resulting from the formal reduction of the carboxy group of L-phenylalanine to the corresponding alcohol.

name: (4S,10Z,16R)-phycourobilin
definition: A urobilin that consists of 3,18-diethyl-2,7,13,17-tetramethyl-1,4,5,15,16,19,22,24-octahydro-21H-biline-8,12-dipropanoic acid bearing two oxo substituents at positions 1 and 19 (the 4S,10Z,16R-iseomer).

name: Ro 320-1195
definition: An organofluorine compound that is 4-benzoylpyrazole in which the phenyl is substituted at position 3 by a (2,3-dihydroxypropyl)oxy group and in which the pyrazole moiety is substituted at positions 1 and 5 by a 4-fluorophenyl group and an amino group, respectively.

name: 1-O-(1-O-hexadecanoyl-2-O-heptadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphono)-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A phosphatidylinositol where the 1- and 2-O-acyl groups are hexadecanoyl and heptadecanoyl respectively.

name: 7-aminomethyl-7-deazaguanine
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7-deazaguanine bearing an aminomethyl substituent at the 7 position.

name: methylphosphonic acid
definition: A one-carbon compound that is phosphonic acid in which the hydrogen attached to the phosphorus is substituted by a methyl group.

name: pivalic acid
definition: A branched, short-chain fatty acid composed of propanoic acid having two methyl substituents at the 2-position.

name: pyroquilon
definition: A pyrroloquinoline that is 1,2,5,6-tetrahydro-4H-pyrrolo[3,2,1-ij]quinoline in which the hydrogens at position 4 are replaced by an oxo group. A fungicide used to control rice blast, it is not approved wof use within the European Union.

name: pyromellitic acid
definition: A tetracarboxylic acid that is benzene substituted by four carboxy groups at positions 1, 2, 4 and 5 respectively.

name: L-thioproline
definition: An optically active version of thioproline having L-configuration.

name: 1,2-dilauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-2-dodecanoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate in which the 1-acyl group is also dodecanoyl (lauroyl).

name: diphosphate(2−)
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of both protons from diphosphoric acid.

name: 3-pyridinemethanol
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine which is substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 3 .

name: pyridine-2-thiol
definition: Pyridine substituted at C-2 by a sulfanyl group.

name: 4-nitro-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a nitro group at position 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: (R)-dihydrolipoic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer and bioactive form of dihydrolipoic acid.

name: 1,2-di-O-myristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine where the two phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as tetradecanoyl (myristoyl).

name: ribostamycin
definition: An amino cyclitol glycoside that is 4,6-diaminocyclohexane-1,2,3-triol having a 2,6-diamino-2,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 1 and a β-D-ribosyl residue attached at position 2. It is an antibiotic produced by Streptomyces ribosidificus (formerly S. thermoflavus).

name: 6-deoxyinosine 5'-phosphate
definition: The 5'-monophosphate of 6-deoxyinosine.

name: 1-[4-carboxy-2-(3-pentylamino)phenyl]-5,5-bis(hydroxymethyl)pyrrolidin-2-one
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 4 have been replaced by pentan-2-ylamino and 2,2-bis(hydroxymethyl)-5-oxopyrrolidin-1-yl groups, respectively.

name: pyrazinecarboxamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of pyrazinoic acid (pyrazine-2-carboxylic acid) with ammonia. A prodrug for pyrazinoic acid, pyrazinecarboxamide is used as part of multidrug regimens for the treatment of tuberculosis.

name: hexadecane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 16 carbon atoms. It is a component of essential oil isolated from long pepper.

name: (5Z)-5-(quinoxalin-6-ylmethylidene)-1,3-thiazolidine-2,4-dione
definition: A quinoxaline derivative that is quinoxaline in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a (2,4-dioxo-1,3-thiazolidin-5-ylidene)methyl group. It is a potent inhibitor of the PI3Kγ, with an IC50 of 8 nM and inhibits the progression of joint inflammation and damage in both lymphocyte-independent and dependent mouse models of rheumatoid arthritis.

name: seliciclib
definition: 2,6-Diaminopurine carrying benzylamino, (2R)-1-hydroxybutan-2-yl and isopropyl substituents at C-6, C-2-N and N-9 respectively. It is an experimental drug candidate in the family of pharmacological cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) inhibitors.

name: adenine arabinoside
definition: A purine nucleoside in which adenine is attached to arabinofuranose via a β-N9-glycosidic bond.

name: 3β-hydroxy-5β-pregnan-20-one hemisuccinate
definition: A sterol ester that is the O-succinoyl derivative of 3β-hydroxy-5β-pregnan-20-one.

name: phosphoramidon
definition: A dipeptide isolated from the cultures of Streptomyces tanashiensis.

name: tetramethylrosamine
definition: An iminium ion that is the 6-dimethylamino derivative of N,N-dimethyl-9-phenyl-3H-xanthen-3-iminium. Used in the form of its chloride salt as a red-orange fluorescent dye.

name: 6-{[(4R,5R)-4-(hydroxymethyl)thymin-5-yl]methyl}thymine
definition: A pyrimidone that is thymine which is substituted at position 6 by a [(4R,5R)-4-(hydroxymethyl)thymin-5-yl]methyl group.

name: sulfanilamide
definition: A sulfonamide in which the sulfamoyl functional group is attached to aniline at the 4-position.

name: methylcarbamic acid
definition: An amino acid consisting of carbamic acid having an N-methyl substituent.

name: (R)-styrene oxide
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of styrene oxide.

name: TMP
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate in which the pyrimidine element is 5-methyluracil. Derived from breakdown of an RNA molecule, typically a tRNA modified at position 54 (U to T).

name: pyrithiamine pyrophosphate
definition: A pyridinium ion that is the O-pyrophosphoryl derivative of pyrithiamine.

name: ritonavir
definition: An L-valine derivative that is L-valinamide in which α-amino group has been acylated by a [(2-isopropyl-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)methyl]methylcarbamoyl group and in which a hydrogen of the carboxamide amino group has been replaced by a (2R,4S,5S)-4-hydroxy-1,6-diphenyl-5-{[(1,3-thiazol-5-ylmethoxy)carbonyl]amino}hexan-2-yl group. A CYP3A inhibitor and antiretroviral drug from the protease inhibitor class used to treat HIV infection and AIDS, it is often used as a fixed-dose combination with another protease inhibitor, lopinavir. Also used in combination with dasabuvir sodium hydrate, ombitasvir and paritaprevir (under the trade name Viekira Pak) for treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus genotype 1 infection as well as cirrhosis of the liver.

name: (S)-2-hydroxypropylphosphonic acid
definition: 2-Hydroxypropylphosphonic acid with S configuration at the chiral centre.

name: 2-{[(R)-{[4-(aminomethyl)phenyl]amino}{[(1R)-1-phenylethyl]amino}methyl]amino}ethane-1,1-diol
definition: An optically active tetramine epitope consisting of three separate amino substituents attached to a central carbon.

name: propionamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by the formal condensation of propionic acid with ammonia.

name: 5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranose
definition: A D-ribofuranose 5-phosphate with an β-configuration at anomeric position.

name: N-acetyl-L-serine
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino acid in which the amino acid specified is L-serine. Metabolite observed in cancer metabolism.

name: sinefungin
definition: An adenosine that is the the δ-(5'-adenosyl) derivative of ornithine.

name: 5-[(4,6-diamino-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl)amino]-4-hydroxy-3-[(2-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid
definition: A triamino-1,3,5-triazine having a polysubstituted naphthalene group attached to one of the exocyclic nitrogens.

name: ricinelaidic acid
definition: A straight-chain, 18:1, long-chain fatty acid having a trans- double bond at position 9 and an R-oriented hydroxy group at position 12.

name: 13-cis-retinal
definition: A retinal in which the double bond α- to the aldehyde group has cis configuration, whilst the remaining acyclic double bonds have trans configuration.

name: ribavirin 5'-monophosphate
definition: A 1-ribosyltriazole that is ribavirin in which the hydroxy group at the 5'-position is replaced by a phosphonooxy group. It is the active metabolite of the antiviral agent ribavirin.

name: 11α-hydroxyprogesterone hemisuccinate
definition: A steroid ester that is the O-succinoyl derivative of 11α-hydroxyprogesterone.

name: (R)-2-methylbutyric acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2-methylbutanoic acid.

name: L-rhamnitol
definition: A hexitol that is 1-deoxy derivative of L-mannitol.

name: Reactive Red 6 hapten
definition: A bis(azo) compound that consists of a 1,3,5-triazine core having two (5-hydroxy-1,3-disulfo-2naphthyl)amino groups at positions 2 and 6, each of which is further substituted with a 2-hydroxy-5-sulfophenylazo group.

name: 5-hydroxypentanoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid consisting of pentanoic acid carrying a hydroxy group at C-5.

name: heptanoic acid
definition: A C7, straight-chain fatty acid that contributes to the odour of some rancid oils. Used in the preparation of esters for the fragrance industry, and as an additive in cigarettes.

name: 4-(4-styrylphenylcarbamoyl)butyric acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxyl groups of glutaric acid with the amino group of 4-aminostilbene.

name: ribavirin 5'-triphosphate
definition: A 1-ribosyltriazole that is ribavirin in which the hydroxy group at the 5'-position is replaced by a triphosphate group. It is the active metabolite of the antiviral agent ribavirin.

name: 1-[(1S,3S,4R,5S)-3-hydroxy-4-(hydroxymethyl)bicyclo[3.1.0]hexan-1-yl]thymine
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is bicyclo[3.1.0]hexane which is substituted at the 1-pro-S, 3-pro-S, and 4-pro-R positions by thymin-1-yl, hydroxy, and hydroxymethyl groups, respectively.

name: salicylhydroxamic acid
definition: A hydroxamic acid that is N-hydroxybenzamide carrying a phenolic hydroxy group at position 2.

name: (R)-1-phenylethanol
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 1-phenylethanol.

name: (R)-monothioglycerol
definition: A monothioglycerol that has R configuration.

name: 3-deoxy-D-arabino-hexonic acid
definition: A hexonic acid that is 6-hydroxyhexanoic acid carrying a hydroxy group at positions 2S, 4S and 5R.

name: 4-oxopentanoic acid
definition: An oxopentanoic acid with the oxo group in the 4-position.

name: {3-[(1,3,2-dioxaborolan-2-yl)oxy]propyl}guanidine
definition: A member of the class of guanidines obtained by replacement of one of the amino hydrogens of guanidine itself by a (1,3,2-dioxaborolan-2-yl)oxypropyl group.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-stearoylsphingosine
definition: A N-acyl-β-D-galactosylsphingosine having a sulfo group at the 3-position on the galactose ring and stearoyl as the N-acyl group.

name: succinylcholine
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is the bis-choline ester of succinic acid.

name: 13-cis-spheroidene
definition: The cartenoid ether that is the methyl ether of (3E,13cis)-3,4-didehydro-1,2,7',8'-tetrahydro-ψ,ψ-caroten-1-ol

name: S-methylcysteine
definition: A cysteine derivative that is L-cysteine in which the hydrogen attached to the sulfur is replaced by a methyl group.

name: N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucose
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetylneuraminic acid, D-galactopyranose and α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (2→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: (2S,3R)-2-[(3S,6R)-3-amino-6-hydroxy-2-oxopiperidinyl]-3-hydroxybutanoic acid
definition: A piperidone that consists of 3-hydroxybutanoic acid substituted at position 2 by a 3-amino-6-hydroxy-2-oxopiperidin1-yl group.

name: SDZ 35-682
definition: An aromatic ether that consists of glycerol in which the hydrogen of the 1-hydroxy group is substituted by a 4-cyclohexylphenyl moiety and the 3-hydroxy function is substituted by a 4-(pyridin-2-yl)piperazin-1-yl group.

name: N5-sulfo-FADH2
definition: A flavin adenine dinucleotide that is FADH2 bearing an N-sulfo substituent at position 5 of the flavin ring system..

name: 3,4-dihydrospheroidene
definition: A carotenoid ether that is the 3,4-dihydro derivative of the tetraterpenoid spheroidene.

name: trans-resveratrol
definition: A resveratrol in which the double bond has E configuration.

name: vorinostat
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide comprising suberic (octanedioic) acid coupled to aniline and hydroxylamine. A histone deacetylase inhibitor, it is marketed under the name Zolinza for the treatment of cutaneous T cell lymphoma (CTCL).

name: 3,3,3-tetramine
definition: A polyazaalkane consisting of a 13-membered straight chain alkane with aza-groups at the 1-, 5-, 9- and 13-positions.

name: spermine(4+)
definition: An ammonium ion obtained by the protonation of all four amino groups of spermine.

name: troleandomycin
definition: A semi-synthetic macrolide antibiotic obtained by acetylation of the three free hydroxy groups of oleandomycin. Troleandomycin is only found in individuals that have taken the drug.

name: 5-S-methyl-5-thio-α-D-ribofuranose
definition: An 5-S-methyl-5-thio-D-ribose that has the 1α-D-ribofuranose configuration.

name: N-acetyl-β-neuraminic acid
definition: N-Acetylneuraminic acid with β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: (4R)-4-methyl-L-glutamate(1−)
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of (4R)-4-methyl-L-glutamic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the α-carboxy group. It is a potent agonist of the kainate receptors GluK1 and GluK2.

name: (5S)-5-(carboxymethyl)-L-proline
definition: A L-proline derivative that is L-proline substituted at position 5 by a carboxymethyl group.

name: dipropyl disulfide
definition: An organic disulfide where the alkyl groups specified are propyl. It is a component of the essential oils obtained from Allium.

name: streptolydigin
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is a broad-spectrum antibiotic produced by Streptomyces lydicus.

name: imatinib
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]benzoic acid with the primary aromatic amino group of 4-methyl-N3-[4-(pyridin-3-yl)pyrimidin-2-yl]benzene-1,3-diamine. Used (as its mesylate salt) for treatment of chronic myelogenous leukemia and gastrointestinal stromal tumours.

name: triethylammonium ion
definition: An organoammonium cation having three ethyl substituents on the nitrogen atom.

name: β-D-tagatofuranose 6-phosphate
definition: A D-tagatofuranose 6-phosphate with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: 2-thienylacetic acid
definition: A thiophene compound having a carboxymethyl group at the 2-position.

name: N-octanoylsphingosine
definition: An N-acylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octanoyl.

name: methyl syringate
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of carboxy group of syringic acid with methanol.

name: N-acetyl-L-threonine
definition: A N-acetyl-L-amino acid that is the N-acetyl derivative of L-threonine.

name: trans-2-hexadecenoyl-(N-acetylcysteamine)-thioester
definition: A thioester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (E)-hexadec-2-enoic acid with the thiol group of N-acetylcysteamine.

name: p-Ts-L-Lys-Me
definition: A methyl ketone that is L-lysine with an α-amine hydrogen substituted with a 4-methylbenzenesulfonamide (tosyl) group and a methyl group replacing the hydroxy of the carboxylic acid.

name: paclitaxel
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid isolated originally from the bark of the Pacific yew tree, Taxus brevifolia. It is a mitotic inhibitor used in cancer chemotherapy. Note that the use of the former generic name 'taxol' is now limited, as Taxol is a registered trade mark.

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-β-L-rhamnose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-β-L-rhamnose as the sugar component. It is an intermediate in dTDP-rhamnose biosynthesis.

name: estriol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is the 3-β-D-glucuronide of estriol; a steroid hormone ligand recognised by the monoclonal antibody 4155.

name: trifluoroacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is the trifluoro derivative of acetic acid.

name: tert-butanol
definition: A tertiary alcohol alcohol that is isobutane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1-naphthol
definition: 1-naphthol hydrogenated at C-5, -6, -7 and -8.

name: suramin
definition: A member of the class of phenylureas that is urea in which each of the amino groups has been substituted by a 3-({2-methyl-5-[(4,6,8-trisulfo-1-naphthyl)carbamoyl]phenyl}carbamoyl)phenyl group. An activator of both the rabbit skeletal muscle RyR1 and sheep cardiac RyR2 isoform ryanodine receptor channels, it has been used for the treatment of human African trypanosomiasis for over 100 years.

name: 6-benzyl-1-(benzyloxymethyl)-5-isopropyluracil
definition: A pyrimidone that is uracil which is substituted at positions 1, 5, and 6 by benzyloxymethyl, isopropyl, and benzyl groups, respectively.

name: tridecanoic acid
definition: A C13 straight-chain saturated fatty acid.

name: trimethoprim
definition: An aminopyrimidine antibiotic whose structure consists of pyrimidine 2,4-diamine and 1,2,3-trimethoxybenzene moieties linked by a methylene bridge.

name: triethyl phosphate
definition: A trialkyl phosphate that is the triethy ester derivative of phosphoric acid.

name: thiamine(1+) diphosphate(1−)
definition: An ammonium betaine that is the conjugate base of thiamine(1+) diphosphate arising from the deprotonation of one of the hydroxy groups of the terminal phosphate group.

name: trifluoperazine
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is phenothiazine having a trifluoromethyl subsitituent at the 2-position and a 3-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)propyl group at the N-10 position.

name: tristearoylglycerol
definition: A triglyceride that is glycerol in which all three hydroxy groups have been formally esterified with stearic acid.

name: 2-(acetylamino)naphthalene-1,5-disulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalene-1,5-disulfonic acid with an acetamido group at the 2-position.

name: tricarballylic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid that is glutaric acid in which one of the β-hydrogens is substituted by a carboxy group.

name: thiabendazole
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles carrying a 1,3-thiazol-4-yl substituent at position 2. A mainly post-harvest fungicide used to control a wide range of diseases including Aspergillus, Botrytis, Cladosporium and Fusarium.

name: tacrine
definition: A member of the class of acridines that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroacridine substituted by an amino group at position 9. It is used in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

name: 5-hydroxymethyl-5,6-dihydrofolic acid
definition: A 5,6-dihydrofolic acid that is (6S)-5,6-dihydrofolic acid substituted at position 5 by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: benzothiazole
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that is a fusion product between benzene and thiazole. The parent of the class of benzothiazoles.

name: ribothymidine
definition: A methyluridine having a single methyl substituent at the 5-position on the uracil ring.

name: tetramethylammonium
definition: The simplest quaternary ammonium cation, comprising a central nitrogen linked to four methyl groups.

name: 1-[(1S,2S,4S,5R)-4-hydroxy-5-(hydroxymethyl)bicyclo[3.1.0]hexan-2-yl]thymine
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is bicyclo[3.1.0]hexane which is substituted at the 2-pro-S, 4-pro-S and 5-pro-R positions by thymin-1-yl, hydroxy, and hydroxymethyl groups, respectively.

name: benzene-1,3,5-tricarboxylic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid that consists of benzene substituted by carboxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 5.

name: docosane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 22 carbon atoms.

name: 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene
definition: A trinitrotoluene having the nitro groups at positions 2, 4 and 6.

name: fluconazole
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is propan-2-ol substituted at position 1 and 3 by 1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl groups and at position 2 by a 2,4-difluorophenyl group. It is an antifungal drug used for the treatment of mucosal candidiasis and for systemic infections including systemic candidiasis, coccidioidomycosis, and cryptococcosis.

name: 6-[(4-aminobenzyl)amino]-2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridinium
definition: A carboxamidinium ion consisting of 2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridinium having a (4-aminobenzyl)amino group at the 2-position.

name: (S,S)-trans-1-isopropyl-2,3,3,5-tetramethyl-6-succinylindane
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is a synthetic musk fragrance and hydrophobic hapten with an indane core.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamic acid
definition: A UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate in which the muramoyl fragment has α-configuration at its anomeric centre

name: (1S)-1-amino-2-(1H-indol-3-yl)ethanol
definition: A tryptamine derivative in which a hydroxy group attached to the same carbon as the primary amino group (the S-enantiomer).

name: picric acid
definition: A C-nitro compound comprising phenol having three nitro substtituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions.

name: N-(trans-4'-nitro-4-stilbenyl)-N-methyl-5-aminopentanoic acid
definition: A C-nitro compound that is a stilbene derivative having an N-methyl,N-5-carboxypentylamino group at the 4-position and a nitro substituent at the 4'-position.

name: 4-acetamidobenzoic acid
definition: A amidobenzoic acid that consists of benzoic acid bearing an acetamido substituent at position 4.

name: paracetamol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is 4-aminophenol in which one of the hydrogens attached to the amino group has been replaced by an acetyl group.

name: undecanal
definition: A saturated fatty aldehyde formally arising from reduction of the carboxylic acid group of undecanoic acid. It is a component of essential oils from citrus plants like Citrus reticulata.

name: L-tyrosinal
definition: An amino aldehyde that is L-tyrosine in which the carboxy group has undergone formal redution to give the corrresponding aldehyde

name: O4'-sulfo-L-tyrosine
definition: An O-sulfoamino acid that is L-tyrosine in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: UDP-α-D-glucose
definition: The α-anomer of UDP-α-D-glucose. It is used in nucleotide sugars metabolism.

name: ubiquinone-1
definition: A compound composed of the standard 2,3-dimethoxy-5-methylbenzoquinone nucleus common to ubiquinones; and a side chain of a single isoprenoid unit.

name: U100313
definition: A pyranone that is 4-hydroxy-3-methyl-2H-pyran-2-one in which two of the hydrogens of the methyl group are replaced by a cycloprop-2-en-1-yl group and a 3-{[N-(tert-butoxycarbonyl)-β-alanyl]amino}phenyl group (S-configuration) and in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 1-phenylbutan-2-yl group (R-configuration).

name: coenzyme Q10
definition: A ubiquinone having a side chain of 10 isoprenoid units. In the naturally occurring isomer, all isoprenyl double bonds are in the E- configuration.

name: 5,6-diaminouracil
definition: An aminouracil in which the ring hydrogens at positions 5 and 6 on uracil have been replaced by amino groups.

name: N-phenylthiourea
definition: A member of the class of thioureas that is thiourea in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a phenyl group. Depending on their genetic makeup, humans find it either very bitter-tasting or tasteless. This unusual property resulted in N-phenylthiourea being used in paternity testing prior to the advent of DNA testing.

name: β-D-4-deoxy-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine having a 4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: vardenafil
definition: The sulfonamide resulting from formal condensation of the sulfo group of 4-ethoxy-3-(5-methyl-7-propylimidazo[5,1-f][1,2,4]triazin-4(1H)-one-2-yl)benzenesulfonic acid and the secondary amino group of 4-ethylpiperazine.

name: 6-azauridine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A N-glycosyl-1,2,4-triazine that is the 6-aza analogue of uridine 5'-monophosphate.

name: 2'-deoxyuridine 3'-monophosphate
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 3'-monophosphate having uracil as the nucleobase.

name: trimethyl phosphate
definition: A trialkyl phosphate that is the trimethyl ester of phosphoric acid.

name: ubiquinone-5
definition: A compound composed of the 2,3-dimethoxy-5-methylbenzoquinone nucleus common to ubiquinones; and a side chain of five isoprenoid units.

name: undecane
definition: A straight-chain alkane with 11 carbon atoms.

name: 5-fluorouracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by fluorine. It is an antineoplastic agent which acts as an antimetabolite - following conversion to the active deoxynucleotide, it inhibits DNA synthesis (by blocking the conversion of deoxyuridylic acid to thymidylic acid by the cellular enzyme thymidylate synthetase) and so slows tumour growth.

name: uracil-6-ylacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid comprising uracil having a carboxymethyl substituent at the 6-position.

name: ubiquinone-2
definition: A compound composed of the 2,3-dimethoxy-5-methylbenzoquinone nucleus common to ubiquinones; and a side chain of two isoprenoid units.

name: UTP(4−)
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate(4−) obtained by global deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of UTP; major species present at pH 7.3.

name: N-s-butyl-N-[(2R,3S)-3-({[(3aS,5R,6aR)-hexahydro-2H-cyclopenta[b]furan-5-yloxy]carbonyl}amino)-2-hydroxy-4-phenylbutyl]-4-(hydroxymethyl)benzenesulfonamide
definition: An N,N-disubstituted toluene-p-sulfonamaide, with a structure close to that of darunavir. It is found to inhibit dimerization of HIV-1 protease subunits.

name: (R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyric acid
definition: The R-enantiomer of 2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyric acid.

name: virginiamycin S1
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide that is N-(3-hydroxypicolinoyl)-L-threonyl-D-α-aminobutyryl-L-prolyl-N-methyl-L-phenylalanyl-4-oxo-L-pipecoloyl-L-2-phenylglycine in which the carboxy group of the 2-phenylglycine moiety has undergone formal intramolecular condensation with the hydroxy group of the N-(3-hydroxypicolinoyl)-L-threonyl to give the corresponding 19-membered ring lactone. It is one of the two major components of the antibacterial drug virginiamycin, produced by Streptomyces virginiae, S. loidensis, S. mitakaensis, S. pristina-spiralis, S. ostreogriseus, and others.

name: (S,S,S)-α-tocopherol
definition: The (S,S,S)-stereoisomer of α-tocopherol.

name: β-D-xylofuranose
definition: A D-xylose that is the furanose form of xylose which has β- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: vanadate(3−)
definition: A vanadium oxoanion that is a trianion with formula VO4 in which the vanadium is in the +5 oxidation state and is attached to four oxygen atoms.

name: ubiquinone-7
definition: A compound whose structure comprises a 2,3-dimethoxy-5-methylbenzoquinone nucleus, common to ubiquinones; and a side chain of seven isoprenoid units.

name: methyl vanillate
definition: A benzoate ester that is the methyl ester of vanillic acid.

name: (3R,5R)-5-amino-3-methyl-D-proline
definition: An aminopyrrolidine that is D-proline substituted by a amino group at position 5 and a methyl group at position 3.

name: tungstate
definition: A divalent inorganic anion obtained by removal of both protons from tungstic acid.

name: ethanethiol
definition: An alkanethiol that is ethane substituted by a thiol group at position 1. It is added to odorless gaseous products such as liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) to provide a garlic scent which helps warn of gas leaks.

name: 9-β-D-xylofuranosyladenine
definition: A purine nucleoside in which adenine is attached to xylofuranose via a β-N9-glycosidic bond.

name: zardaverine
definition: A pyridazinone derivative in which pyridazin-3(2H)-one is substituted at C-6 with a 4-(difluoromethoxy)-3-methoxyphenyl group. It is a phosphodiesterase inhibitor, selective for PDE3 and 4.

name: 3-fluoro-5-morpholin-4-yl-N-[1-(2-pyridin-4-ylethyl)-1H-indol-6-yl]benzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-fluoro-5-morpholin-4-ylbenzoic acid with the amino group of 1-[2-(pyridin-4-yl)ethyl]indol-6-amine

name: zoledronic acid
definition: An imidazole compound having a 2,2-bis(phosphono)-2-hydroxyethane-1-yl substituent at the 1-position.

name: cis-zeatin
definition: The cis-isomer of zeatin.

name: wybutosine
definition: A nucleoside analogue having methyl (2S)-4-(4,6-dimethyl-9-oxo-4,9-dihydro-3H-imidazo[1,2-a]purin-7-yl)-2-[(methoxycarbonyl)amino]butanoate as the modified nucleobase.

name: dextrofloxacin
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of ofloxacin.

name: clonidine (amino form)
definition: A clonidine that is 4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-amine in which one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by a 2,6-dichlorophenyl group.

name: 2,4-dichloroaniline
definition: A dichloroaniline carrying chloro substituents at positions 2 and 4.

name: D-galactosaminic acid
definition: The D-stereoisomer of galactosaminic acid.

name: D-galactosaminate
definition: A galactosaminate that is the conjugate base of D-galactosaminic acid.

name: D-altronic acid
definition: The D-enantiomer of altronic acid.

name: isobutanol
definition: An alkyl alcohol that is propan-1-ol substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: S-(1,2-dichlorovinyl)-L-cysteine
definition: An L-α-amino acid that is L-cysteine in which the hydrogen attached to the sulfur is replaced by a 1,2-dichlorovinyl group.

name: S-(trans-1,2-dichlorovinyl)-L-cysteine
definition: An S-(1,2-dichlorovinyl)-L-cysteine in which the dichlorovinyl group has trans- (E-) geometry.

name: S-(cis-1,2-dichlorovinyl)-L-cysteine
definition: An S-(1,2-dichlorovinyl)-L-cysteine in which the dichlorovinyl group has cis- (Z-) geometry.

name: ipratropium bromide
definition: The anhydrous form of the bromide salt of ipratropium. An anticholinergic drug, ipratropium bromide blocks the muscarinic cholinergic receptors in the smooth muscles of the bronchi in the lungs. This opens the bronchi, so providing relief in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and acute asthma.

name: 2-keto-D-xylose
definition: A 2-keto-xylose having D-threo configuration; a degradation product of D-ascorbic acid.

name: eritoran tetrasodium
definition: An organic sodium salt which is the tetrasodium salt of eritoran.

name: (−)-geosmin
definition: The (−)-stereoisomer of geosmin, having 4S,4aS,8aR configuration.

name: 1-octene
definition: An octene with an unsaturation C-1.

name: (1E,4S,5E,7R)-germacra-1(10),5-dien-11-ol
definition: A germacrane sesquiterpenoid obtained from germacrane by hydroxylation at C(11) together with dehydrogenation across the C(1)‒C(10) and C(5)‒C(6) bonds.

name: (S)-oct-1-en-3-ol
definition: An oct-1-en-3-ol that has S-configuration.

name: DDT-2,3-dihydrodiol
definition: The cyclohexadienediol formed by dearomatization of 2,3-dihydroxy-DDT by reduction at the C(2) and C(3) positions.

name: L-3-aminosuccinimide
definition: A 3-aminosuccinimide that has S-configuration.

name: hygrine
definition: A 1-(1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl)acetone that has R configuration. It is a pyrrolidine alkaloid found in the coca plant, Erythroxylum coca.

name: quinolizidine
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that is the octahydro derivative of 2H-quinolizine. The parent of the class of quinolizidines.

name: 2-[4-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazin-4-ium-1-yl]ethanesulfonate
definition: A HEPES that is ethanesulfonate substituted by a 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazin-4-ium-1-yl group at position 2.

name: (E,E,E)-geranylgeraniol
definition: A geranylgeraniol in which all four double bonds have E- (trans-) geometry.

name: carbapenem
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that consists of (5R)-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]hept-2-ene bearing a 7-keto substituent. The parent of the class of carbapenems.

name: diglyme
definition: A polyether that is the dimethyl ether derivative of diethylene glycol.

name: 2-ethoxyethanol
definition: A hydroxyether that is the ethyl ether derivative of ethylene glycol.

name: 2-methoxyethanol
definition: A hydroxyether that is ethanol substituted by a methoxy group at position 2.

name: poly(ethylene glycol)
definition: A polymer composed of repeating ethyleneoxy units.

name: thioglycine
definition: A monothiocarboxylic acid that is the thiolacid analogue of glycine. The parent of the class of thioglycines.

name: quinolinate(1−)
definition: A carboxypyridinecarboxylate that is the conjugate base of quinolinic acid.

name: 3-carboxypyridine-2-carboxylate
definition: A quinolinate(1−) that is the tautomer of 2-carboxypyridine-3-carboxylate.

name: 2-carboxypyridine-3-carboxylate
definition: A quinolinate(1−) that is the tautomer of 3-carboxypyridine-2-carboxylate.

name: dipicolinate(1−)
definition: A carboxypyridinecarboxylate that is the conjugate base of dipicolinic acid.

name: dipicolinic acid
definition: A pyridinedicarboxylic acid carrying two carboxy groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: sarcosinium
definition: An α-amino-acid cation that is the conjugate acid of sarcosine, arising from protonation of the amino group.

name: 11-cis-retinoic acid
definition: The 11-cis-isomer of retinoic acid.

name: polidocanol
definition: A hydroxypolyether that is nonaethylene glycol in which one of the terminal hydroxy functions is substituted by a lauryl (dodecyl) group.

name: isocinchomeronic acid
definition: A pyridinedicarboxylic acid carrying carboxy groups at positions 2 and 5.

name: isocinchomeronate(2−)
definition: A pyridinedicarboxylate that is the conjugate base of isocinchomeronate(1−).

name: acetyl
definition: An organic radical derived from acetaldehyde.

name: S-[2,3-bis(palmitoyloxy)propyl]-Cys-Ser-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys
definition: A triacyl lipopeptide that is the pentapeptide Cys-Ser-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys in which the side-chain thiol hydrogen on the Cys residue has been replaced by a 2,3-bis(palmitoyloxy)propyl group.

name: 2-amino-3-methyl-3,9-dihydro-6H-purin-6-one
definition: A 3-methylguanine that is 3,9-dihydro-6H-purin-6-one substituted by an amino group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 3.

name: 2-imino-3-methyl-1,2,3,9-tetrahydro-6H-purin-6-one
definition: A 3-methylguanine that is 1,2,3,9-tetrahydro-6H-purin-6-one substituted by an imino group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 3.

name: 2-imino-7-methyl-1,2,3,7-tetrahydro-6H-purin-6-one
definition: A 7-methylguanine that is 1,2,3,7-tetrahydro-6H-purin-6-one substituted by an imino group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 7.

name: 2-amino-7-methyl-7H-purin-6-ol
definition: A 7-methylguanine that is 7H-purine substituted by an amino group at position 2, a methyl group at position 7 and a hydroxy group at position 6.

name: cholesteryl oleate
definition: The (Z)-stereoisomer of cholesteryl octadec-9-enoate.

name: oxalate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of oxalic acid.

name: (R)-pantothenic acid
definition: A pantothenic acid having R-configuration.

name: L-ornithinium(1+)
definition: A polar amino acid zwitterion of L-ornithine.

name: L-ornithinate
definition: An L-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of L-ornithine.

name: sarcosinate
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of sarcosine, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: nonivamide
definition: A capsaicinoid that is the carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzylamine with the carboxy group of nonanoic acid. It is the active ingredient in many pepper sprays.

name: oxane
definition: A saturated organic heteromonocyclic parent that is cyclohexane in which one of the carbon atoms has been replaced by an oxygen atom.

name: 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoate
definition: The conjugate base of 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid.

name: 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is obtained by removal of a proton from the carbosylic acid group of 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid.

name: 2-aminooctadec-4-ene-1,3-diol
definition: A 2-aminooctadecene-1,3-diol having its double bond at position 4.

name: (2R,3S)-2-aminooctadec-4-ene-1,3-diol
definition: A 2-aminooctadec-4-ene-1,3-diol having (2R,3S)-configuration.

name: L-erythro-sphingosine
definition: A (2R,3S)-2-aminooctadec-4-ene-1,3-diol in which the double bond has E geochemistry.

name: 2-aminooctadecane-1,3-diol
definition: An aminodiol that is octadecane bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 1 and 3 as well as an amino substituent at position 2.

name: phytosphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A phosphosphingolipid that is phytosphingosine bearing a phospho group at position 1.

name: premnaspirodiene
definition: A spiro compound that is vetispirane that has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond position 6-7 and in which the isopropyl subsbstituent has been replaced by a prop-1-en-2-yl group (the 2R,5S,10R isomer).

name: N-acetylsphingosine
definition: A N-acylsphingosine that has an acetamido group at position 2.

name: N-acetylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A N-acylsphingosine 1-phosphate in which the N-acyl group is specified as acetyl.

name: α-L-arabinopyranose
definition: A L-arabinopyranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: D-arabinopyranose
definition: D-Arabinose in its pyranose form.

name: α-D-arabinopyranose
definition: A D-arabinopyranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: β-D-arabinopyranose
definition: A D-arabinopyranose with β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: L-ribofuranose
definition: An ribofuranose having L-configuration.

name: β-D-ribose
definition: A D-ribofuranose in which the anomeric centre has β-configuration.

name: D-ribopyranose
definition: A D-ribose and the D-enantiomer of ribopyranose.

name: α-D-ribopyranose
definition: A D-ribopyranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: L-ribopyranose
definition: The L-stereoisomer of ribopyranose.

name: α-L-ribopyranose
definition: A L-ribopyranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: β-L-ribopyranose
definition: A L-ribopyranose with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: D-ribofuranose
definition: A ribofuranose having D-configuration.

name: UDP-4-amino-4-deoxy-β-L-arabinopyranose
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having 4-amino-4-deoxy-β-L-arabinopyranose as the amino sugar component.

name: 1,4-dioxane
definition: A dioxane with oxygen atoms at positions 1 and 4.

name: [8]annulene
definition: An antiaromatic annulene that is cyclooctane having four double bonds at positions 1, 3, 5 and 7.

name: 4-chloro-L-phenylalanine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-phenylalanine in which the meta-hydrogen of the phenyl group has been replaced by a chlorine.

name: dibromomethane
definition: A member of the class of bromomethanes that is methane substituted by two bromo groups. It is produced by marine algae.

name: lonafarnib
definition: A 4-{2-[4-(3,10-dibromo-8-chloro-6,11-dihydro-5H-benzo[5,6]cyclohepta[1,2-b]pyridin-11-yl)piperidin-1-yl]-2-oxoethyl}piperidine-1-carboxamide that has R configuration. It is used as oral farnesyltransferase inhibitor.

name: 1-bromopropane
definition: A bromoalkane that is propane carrying a bromo substituent at position 1.

name: (3-chloro-4-hydroxyphenyl)acetic acid
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 3-chloro-4-hydroxyphenyl group. It is a major chlorinated metabolite of chlorotyrosine.

name: 3-chloropropanol
definition: A member of the class of propan-1-ols that is propan-1-ol substituted by a chloro group at position 3.

name: 4-bromo-L-phenylalanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 4-bromophenylalanine.

name: 1‐bromopentane
definition: A bromoalkane that is pentane carrying a bromo substituent at position 1.

name: 5-bromouridine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having 5-bromouracil as the pyrimidine component.

name: pentachlorobenzene
definition: A member of the class of pentachlorobenzenes that is benzene in which five of the hydrogens are replaced by chlorines. Now classed as a persistent organic pollutant under the Stockholm Convention.

name: N-cyclopropyl-4-[4-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(1-methylpiperidin-4-yl)-1-propylimidazol-5-yl]pyrimidin-2-amine
definition: A member of the class of piperidinylimidazoles that is 1-methyl-4-(1-propylimidazol-2-yl)piperidine carrying additional 3,4-dichlorophenyl and 2-(cyclopropylamino)pyrimidin-4-yl substituents at positions 4 and 5 respectively.

name: diadenosine 5',5'-diphosphate
definition: A diadenosyl diphosphate having two 5'-adenosyl residues attached at the P1- and P2-positions of the diphosphate.

name: α-Kdo-(2→4)-α-Kdo
definition: A disaccharide consisting of two 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl units joined via an α-(2→4)-linkage.

name: 1‐bromobutane
definition: A bromoalkane that is butane carrying a bromo substituent at position 1.

name: bromoethane
definition: A bromoalkane that is ethane carrying a bromo substituent. It is an alkylating agent used as a chemical intermediate in various organic syntheses.

name: 6-bromohexan-1-ol
definition: An organobromine compound that is hexan-1-ol substituted by a bromo group at position 6.

name: 4-bromophenol
definition: A bromophenol containing only hydroxy and bromo substituents that are para to one another.

name: 1-(3-tert-butyl-1-methylpyrazol-5-yl)-3-(4-chlorophenyl)urea
definition: A member of the class of phenylureas that is urea which is substituted at position 1 by a 3-tert-butyl-1-methylpyrazol-5-yl group and at position 3 by a p-chlorophenyl group.

name: 4-bromoanisole
definition: A monomethoxybenzene carrying a bromo substituent at position 4.

name: 2-bromoethanol
definition: A member of the class of ethanols that is ethanol substituted by a bromo group at position 2.

name: bromoacetic acid
definition: A haloacetic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is replaced by a bromine atom.

name: hydrogen bromide
definition: A diatomic molecule containing covalently bonded hydrogen and bromine atoms.

name: 5-(5-chloro-2,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-N-ethyl-4-(4-methoxyphenyl)pyrazole-3-carboxamide
definition: An aromatic amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-(5-chloro-2,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-4-(4-methoxyphenyl)pyrazole-3-carboxylic acid with the amino group of ethylamine.

name: L-6'-bromotryptophan
definition: A bromoamino acid that is L-tryptophan in which the hydrogen at position 6 of the indole ring is substituted by bromine.

name: brivudine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside that is 2'-deoxyuridine in which the hydrogen at position 5 of the uracil ring is substituted by a 2-bromoethenyl group. It is an antiviral drug used for the treatment of herpes zoster (shingles).

name: 3-chloro-D-alanine zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of 3-chloro-D-alanine having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: chlorimuron-ethyl
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of chlorimuron with ethanol. A proherbicide for chloimuron, it is used as herbicide for the control of broad-leaved weeds in peanuts, soya beans, and other crops.

name: N-(2-aminoethyl)-5-chloroisoquinoline-8-sulfonamide
definition: A member of the class of isoquinolines that is isoquinoline-8-sulfonamide which is substituted by chlorine at position 5 and in which the sulfonamide nitrogen is substituted by a 2-aminoethyl group. It is an inhibitor of casein kinase I.

name: α-N-dichloroacetyl-p-aminophenylserinol
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of (1R,2R)-2-amino-1-(4-aminophenyl)propane-1,3-diol with the carboxy group of dichloroacetic acid. It is an intermediate used in the biosynthesis pathway of the antibiotic, chloramphenicol.

name: alvocidib
definition: A synthetic dihydroxyflavone that is 5,7-dihydroxyflavone which is substituted by a 3-hydroxy-1-methylpiperidin-4-yl group at position 8 and by a chlorine at the 2' position (the (−)-3S,4R stereoisomer). A cyclin-dependent kinase 9 (CDK9) inhibitor, it has been studied for the treatment of acute myeloid leukaemia, arthritis and atherosclerotic plaque formation.

name: 7-chloro-L-tryptophan
definition: An L-tryptophan derivative having a chloro substituent at the 7-position.

name: N-acetyl-L-phenylalanyl-4-[difluoro(phosphono)methyl]-L-phenylalaninamide
definition: A substituted L-phenylalanyl-L-phenylalaninamide dipeptide. It is a potent inhibitor of protein tyrosine phosphatase.

name: diclofenac
definition: A monocarboxylic acid consisting of phenylacetic acid having a (2,6-dichlorophenyl)amino group at the 2-position.

name: devancoaminyl vancomycin
definition: A glycopeptide that is vancomycin lacking the vancoaminyl residue.

name: 1,7,8,9,10,10-hexachloro-4-methyl-4-azatricyclo[5.2.1.0(2,6)]dec-8-ene-3,5-dione
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound arising from formal [4+2]-cycloaddition of hexachlorocyclopentadiene to N-methylmaleimide.

name: Fe(CO)(CN)2
definition: An iron coordination entity consisting of two cyano and one carbonyl group coordinated to a central iron atom.

name: μ-oxodiiron
definition: An iron coordination entity consisting of two iron atoms coordinated to a central oxygen.

name: (Z)-3',5'-dibromo-2',4,4',6'-tetrahydroxyaurone
definition: A hydroxyaurone that is aurone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2', 4, 4' and 6' and bromo groups at positions 3' and 5' respectively.

name: N2-carbamimidoyl-N-{2-[4-(3-{4-[(5-carboxyfuran-2-yl)methoxy]-2,3-dichlorophenyl}-1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-5-yl)piperidin-1-yl]-2-oxoethyl}-D-leucinamide
definition: A leucine derivative obtained by fpormal condensation of the secondary amino group of 5-({2,3-dichloro-4-[1-methyl-5-(piperidin-4-yl)-1H-pyrazol-3-yl]phenoxy}methyl)-2-furoic acid and the carboxy group of N-amidino-L-leucylglycine

name: furosemide
definition: A chlorobenzoic acid that is 4-chlorobenzoic acid substituted by a (furan-2-ylmethyl)amino and a sulfamoyl group at position 2 and 5 respectively. It is a diuretic used in the treatment of congestive heart failure.

name: haloxyfop-P
definition: A 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoic acid that has R configuration. It is the most active enantiomer of the (racemic) herbicide haloxyfop and is used (particularly as the corresponding methyl and ethoxyethyl ester proherbicides (haloxyfop-P-methyl and haloxyfop-P-etotyl, respectively) to control annual and perrenial grasses in a variety of crops.

name: saracatinib
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline substituted by (5-chloro-2H-1,3-benzodioxol-4-yl)amino, (oxan-4-yl)oxy and 2-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)ethoxy groups at positions 4, 5 and 7, respectively. It is a dual inhibitor of the tyrosine kinases c-Src and Abl (IC50 = 2.7 and 30 nM, respectively). Saracatinib was originally developed by AstraZeneca for the treatment of cancer but in 2019 it was granted orphan drug designation by the US Food and Drug Administration for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), a type of lung disease that results in scarring (fibrosis) of the lungs.

name: cis-heme d hydroxychlorin γ-spirolactone
definition: A metallochlorin that is heme d in which the hydroxy group and the carboxy group of the 6-carboxyethyl substituent have undergone intramolecular condensation to afford the corresponding γ-spirolactone.

name: N-[2-(4-bromocinnamylamino)ethyl]isoquinoline-5-sulfonamide
definition: A member of the class of isoquinolines that is the sulfonamide obtained by formal condensation of the sulfo group of isoquinoline-5-sulfonic acid with the primary amino group of N1-[3-(4-bromophenyl)prop-2-en-1-yl]ethane-1,2-diamine. It is a protein kinase A inhibitor.

name: imipramine
definition: A dibenzoazepine that is 5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepine substituted by a 3-(dimethylamino)propyl group at the nitrogen atom.

name: (2S,4R)-ketoconazole
definition: A cis-1-acetyl-4-(4-{[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(1H-imidazol-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl]methoxy}phenyl)piperazine which dioxolane moiety has (2S,4R)-configuration.

name: (2S,4S)-1-acetyl-4-(4-{[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(1H-imidazol-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl]methoxy}phenyl)piperazine
definition: A 1-acetyl-4-(4-{[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(1H-imidazol-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl]methoxy}phenyl)piperazine in which the dioxolane ring has S configuration at positions 2 and 4.

name: licofelone
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolizines that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-pyrrolizine substituted by methyl, methyl, carboxymethyl, 4-chlorophenyl, and phenyl groups at positions 2, 2, 5, 6, and 7, respectively. It is a dual inhibitor of cyclooxygenase isoforms and 5-lipoxygenase and is under development for treatment of osteoarthritis.

name: L-glucaric acid
definition: The L-enantiomer of glucaric acid.

name: loracarbef
definition: A synthetic "carba" analogue of cefaclor, with carbon replacing sulfur at position 1. Used to treat a wide range of infections caused by both gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria.

name: chloroethane
definition: The simplest and least toxic member of the class of chloroethanes, that is ethane in which a single hydrogen is substituted by a chlorine. A colourless gas at room temperature and pressure (boiling point 12°C), it is used as a mild topical anaesthetic to numb the skin prior to ear piercing, skin biopsies, etc., and is also used in the treatment of sports injuries. It was formerly used in the production of tetraethyllead.

name: dioxo(sulfanyl)molybdenum
definition: A molybdenum coordination entity consisting of a cntral molybdenum in the +5 oxidation state coordinated to two oxygens and one sulfanyl group.

name: ABT-737
definition: A biphenyl that is 4-chloro-1,1'-biphenyl substituted by a (4-{4-[(4-{[(2R)-4-(dimethylamino)-1-(phenylsulfanyl)butan-2-yl]amino}-3-nitrobenzene-1-sulfonyl)carbamoyl]phenyl}piperazin-1-yl)methyl group at position 2'. It is a BH3-mimetic drug which targets the anti-apoptotic B-cell lymphoma-2 (BCL-2) family proteins, including BCL-2, BCL-xL, and BCL-w, and induces apoptosis in cancer cells.

name: bezafibrate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-chlorobenzoic acid with the amino group of 2-[4-(2-aminoethyl)phenoxy]-2-methylpropanoic acid. Benafibrate is used for the treatment of hyperlipidaemia.

name: 4,5,6,7-tetrachloro-2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one
definition: A member of the class of 2-benzofurans that is 2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one in which all or the hydrogens attached to the benzene ring are replaced by chlorines. A fungicide used for the control of rice blast, it is not approved for use within the European Union.

name: piclamilast
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(cyclopentyloxy)-4-methoxybenzoic acid with the primary amino group of 3,5-dichloropyridin-4-amine.

name: 8-(2-chloro-3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl)-2-fluoro-9-pent-4-yn-1-yl-9H-purin-6-amine
definition: A member of the class of 6-aminopurines that is 2-fluoroadenine carrying additional 2-chloro-3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl and pent-4-yn-1-yl substituents at positions 8 and 9 respectively.

name: GS-8373
definition: A furofuran that consists of hydroxymethylphosphonic acid where the alcoholic OH group is carrying a ({4-[(2S,3R)-2-({[(3R,3aS,6aR)-hexahydrofuro[2,3-b]furan-3-yloxy]carbonyl}amino)-3-hydroxy-4-[(4-methoxyphenyl)sulfonyl](2-methylpropyl)amino}butyl]phenyl group.

name: roflumilast
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(cyclopropylmethoxy)-4-(difluoromethoxy)benzoic acid with the amino group of 3,5-dichloropyridin-4-amine. Used for treatment of bronchial asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: 8-chloro-3-methyl-11-[1-(4-pyridylacetyl)piperidin-4-ylidene]-6,11-dihydro-5H-benzo[5,6]cyclohepta[1,2-b]pyridine
definition: A benzocycloheptapyridine that consists of 8-chloro-3-methyl-6,11-dihydro-5H-benzo[5,6]cyclohepta[1,2-b]pyridine bearing a 1-(pyridin-4-ylacetyl)piperidin-4-ylidene group at position 11.

name: O-(4-trifluoroacetamidobenzylphosphonyl)chloramphenicol
definition: A C-nitro compound that is a chloramphenicol phosphonate hapten which acts as a transition state analogue for the hydrolysis of chloramphenicol esters mediated by the catalytic antibody 7C8.

name: keto-D-tagatose
definition: The straight-chain keto form of D-tagatose.

name: 2,4,6-tribromophenol
definition: A bromophenol that is phenol in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 4 and 6 have been replaced by bromines. It is commonly used as a fungicide and in the preparation of flame retardants.

name: vancomycin aglycone
definition: A peptide antibiotic that is vancomycin lacking the disaccharide moiety.

name: 5-{5-[2-chloro-4-(4,5-dihydro-1,3-oxazol-2-yl)phenoxy]pentyl}-3-methylisoxazole
definition: An isoxazole compound having a methyl substituent at the 3-position and a 5-[2-chloro-4-(4,5-dihydro-1,3-oxazol-2-yl)phenoxy]pentyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: NiFe4S4 cluster
definition: A nickel-iron-sulfur cluster in which the nickel and iron atoms are linked by bridging sulfur atoms with the ratio Ni:Fe:S = 1:4:4.

name: phosphoethanolamine-Kdo2-lipid A
definition: A derivative of Kdo2-lipid A having a phosphoethanolamine at position 7 of one of the Kdo residues.

name: 1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine in which the phosphatidyl acyl group at C-1 and C-2 is stearoyl.

name: (R)-1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine
definition: An optically active form of 1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine having (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine
definition: An optically active form of 1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine having (S)-configuration.

name: 1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of 1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine.

name: 1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolaminium
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 1,2-distearoylphosphatidylethanolamine, arising from protonation of the amino group.

name: phytantriol
definition: A triol that consists of 3,7,11,15-tetramethylhexadecane bearing three hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 2 and 3.

name: β-tocopherol
definition: A tocopherol in which the chroman-6-ol core is substituted by methyl groups at positions 5 and 8. While it is found in low concentrations in many vegetable oils, only cottonseed oil contains significant amounts.

name: δ-tocopherol
definition: A tocopherol in which the chroman-6-ol core is substituted by a methyl group at position 8. It is found particularly in maize (corn) oil and soya bean (soybean) oils.

name: clomipramine
definition: A dibenzoazepine that is 10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepine which is substituted by chlorine at position 3 and in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a 3-(dimethylamino)propyl group. One of the more sedating tricyclic antidepressants, it is used as the hydrochloride salt for the treatment of depression as well as obsessive-compulsive disorder and phobias.

name: desipramine
definition: A dibenzoazepine consisting of 10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepine substituted on nitrogen with a 3-(methylamino)propyl group.

name: phenylacetaldehyde oxime
definition: An aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of the aldehyde moiety of phenylacetaldehyde with hydroxylamine.

name: (E)-phenylacetaldehyde oxime
definition: A phenylacetaldehyde oxime in which the oxime moiety has E configuration.

name: (R)-dihydrocamalexic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of dihydrocamalexic acid.

name: epi-progoitrin(1−)
definition: A ξ-progoitrin(1−) that is the conjugate base of epi-progoitrin.

name: ξ-progoitrin(1−)
definition: A glucosinolate resulting from the removal of a proton from the oxime hydrogen sulfate moiety of ξ-progoitrin.

name: 5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepine
definition: A mancude organic heterotricyclic parent that consists of a seven-membered nitrogen hetrocycle fused with two benzene rings.

name: sulforaphane
definition: An isothiocyanate having a 4-(methylsulfinyl)butyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: (R)-sulforaphane
definition: A sulforaphane in which the sulfinyl group has R configuration. Naturally occurring compound found in brocolli that acts as a potent inducer of phase II detoxification enzymes.

name: (S)-sulforaphane
