name: D-sorbofuranose
definition: The D-stereoisomer of sorbofuranose.

name: α-D-sorbofuranose
definition: A D-sorbofuranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric center.

name: β-D-sorbofuranose
definition: A D-sorbofuranose with a β-configuration at the anomeric center.

name: D-sorbopyranose
definition: The D-stereoisomer of sorbopyranose.

name: α-D-sorbopyranose
definition: A D-sorbopyranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric center.

name: β-D-sorbopyranose
definition: A D-sorbopyranose with a β-configuration at the anomeric center.

name: 4-(1-methyleneallyl)-1,5,5-trimethylcyclopentene
definition: A cycloalkene consisting of cyclopentene having a buta-1,3-dien-2-yl group at the 4-position a methyl group at the 1-position and gem-dimethyl groups at the 5-position.

name: α-campholenaldehyde
definition: An aldehyde that is acetaldehyde in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2,2,3-trimethylcyclopent-3-en-1-yl group. It is a constituent of the essential oil extracted from Angasomyrtus salina.

name: 2-nitroanisole
definition: A member of the class of 2-nitroanisoles that is anisole in which one of the hydrogens ortho to the methoxy group is replaced by a nitro group.

name: (−)-lobeline
definition: An optically active piperidine alkaloid having a 2-oxo-2-phenylethyl substituent at the 2-position and a 2-hydroxy-2-phenylethyl group at the 6-position.

name: β-phellandrene
definition: One of a pair of phellandrene cyclic monoterpene double-bond isomers in which one double bond is exocyclic (cf. α-phellandrene, where both of them are endoocyclic).

name: dimethylarsinic acid
definition: The organoarsenic compound that is arsenic acid substituted on the central arsenic atom with two methyl groups.

name: ethyl(trimethyl)silane
definition: An organosilicon compound that is silane in which the hydrogens have been replaced by three methyl and one ethyl group.

name: 1'-(dimethylcarbamoyl)ferrocene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A ferrocene inhibitor of the synthetic exo Diels-Alderase catalytic antibody 13G5, where the (dimethylamino)carbonyl group represents the dienophile and the carboxyl group represents the side chain of the diene.

name: iron-sulfur-molybdenum cluster
definition: An iron-sulfur cluster containing 7 iron atoms, 9 sulfur atoms and a molybdenum atom.

name: trichloroacetaldehyde
definition: An organochlorine compound that consists of acetaldehyde where all the methyl hydrogens are replaced by chloro groups.

name: 7α,12α,26-trihydroxycholest-4-en-3-one
definition: A cholestanoid that is cholest-4-en-3-one which has been substituted by hydroxy groups at the 7α, 12α, and 26 positions. It is an intermediate in bile acid metabolism.

name: disodium selenite
definition: An inorganic sodium salt composed of sodium and selenite ions in a 2:1 ratio.

name: roxithromycin
definition: Semisynthetic derivative of erythromycin A.

name: eseroline
definition: A pyrroloindole that is 1,2,3,3a,8,8a-hexahydropyrrolo[2,3-b]indole substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 3a and 8 and a hydroxy group at position 5. It is a metabolite of physostigmine and causes neuronal cell death by a mechanism involving loss of cell ATP.

name: 2-trans,6-trans,10-trans-geranylgeranyl diphosphate
definition: The all-trans-isomer of geranylgeranyl diphosphate.

name: phycocyanobilin
definition: A bilin that consists of 8,12-bis(2-carboxyethyl)-18-ethyl-3-ethylidene-2,7,13,17-tetramethyl-2,3-dihydrobilin bearing two oxo substituents at positions 1 and 19.

name: thionylimide
definition: An imide in which an imino group and an oxo group are both attached to an atom of sulfur.

name: (R)-atropine
definition: An atropine with a 2R-configuration.

name: (9Z,11E,13S,15Z)-13-hydroperoxyoctadeca-9,11,15-trienoic acid
definition: A lipid hydroperoxide, obtained by the formal substitution of a hydrogen at position 9 of (9Z,11E,15Z)-octadeca-9,11,15-trienoic acid by a hydroperoxy group (the 13S-stereoisomer). Biochemically, it is an 18-C rearrangement and primary peroxidation product of α-linolenic acid, an intermediate in prostaglandin and leukotriene metabolism, and the substrate of the lyase enzyme hydroperoxide dehydratase.

name: (9Z,11E,15Z)-octadeca-9,11,15-trienoic acid
definition: A 9,11,15-octadecatrienoic acid in which the configuration of the double bonds at positions 9 and 15 is Z, while that of the double bond at position 11 is E.

name: S-(hydroxymethyl)glutathione
definition: An S-substituted glutathione that is glutathione in which the mercapto hydrogen has been replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: 6-phospho-D-gluconic acid
definition: A gluconic acid phosphate having the phosphate group at the 6-position. It is an intermediate in the pentose phosphate pathway.

name: 3-carboxy-2,3-dihydroxypropanoate
definition: A tartaric acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2,3-dihydroxybutanedioic acid.

name: piperitone
definition: A p-menthane monoterpenoid that is cyclohex-2-en-1-one substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and an isopropyl group at position 6.

name: (E)-roxithromycin
definition: A major geometrical isomer of roxithromycin.

name: (25R)-3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-al
definition: The (25R)-diastereomer of 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-al.

name: (25S)-3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-al
definition: The (25S)-diastereomer of 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-al.

name: isovalerate
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of isovaleric acid; reported to improve ruminal fermentation and feed digestion in cattle.

name: isobutyraldehyde
definition: A member of the class of propanals that is propanal substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: isobutyrate
definition: A branched, short-chain, saturated fatty acid anion; the conjugate base of isobutyric acid, formed by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: 2-methylbutan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is isopentane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: clavulanic acid
definition: Antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces clavuligerus. It acts as a suicide inhibitor of bacterial β-lactamase enzymes.

name: L-2,4-diaminobutyric acid
definition: A 2,4-diaminobutyric acid that has S-configuration.

name: 5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranosyl diphosphate
definition: A 5-O-phosphono-D-ribofuranosyl diphosphate with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: trans-chalcone
definition: The trans-isomer of chalcone.

name: cis-chalcone
definition: The cis-stereoisomer of chalcone.

name: trans-2',3,4,4',6'-pentahydroxychalcone
definition: A 2',3,4,4',6'-pentahydroxychalcone with a trans configuration.

name: (2S,3S)-2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoic acid
definition: The (2S,3S)-diastereomer of 2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoic acid.

name: 3-nitroanisole
definition: A member of the class of 3-nitroanisoles that is anisole in which one of the hydrogens meta to the methoxy group is replaced by a nitro group.

name: 4-methoxy-2-nitroaniline
definition: A substituted aniline that is 3-nitroanisole in which the hydrogen para to the methoxy group is replaced by an amino group.

name: acetoxysulfonic acid
definition: An acyl sulfate where the acyl group is specified as acetyl.

name: quinolin-7-ol
definition: A monohydroxyquinoline carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 7.

name: quinolin-8-ol
definition: A monohydroxyquinoline that is quinoline substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8. Its fungicidal properties are used for the control of grey mould on vines and tomatoes.

name: 4-methylquinoline
definition: A methylquinoline carrying a methyl substituent at position 4.

name: 8-methylquinoline
definition: A methylquinoline carrying a methyl substituent at position 8.

name: 4-methylquinolin-2(1H)-one
definition: A quinolone that is quinolin-2(1H)-one substituted by a methyl group at position 4.

name: 7-methylxanthine
definition: An oxopurine that is xanthine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen at position 7 is replaced by a methyl group. It is an intermediate metabolite in the synthesis of caffeine.

name: quinolin-6-ol
definition: A monohydroxyquinoline that is quinoline substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6.

name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid.

name: 2-phenylethanol
definition: A primary alcohol that is ethanol substituted by a phenyl group at position 2.

name: N-acetyl-L-citrulline
definition: The L-enantiomer of N-acetylcitrulline.

name: 4-phospho-D-erythronic acid
definition: The D-enantiomer of 4-phosphoerythronic acid.

name: deferasirox
definition: A member of the class of triazoles, deferasirox is 1,2,4-triazole substituted by a 4-carboxyphenyl group at position 1 and by 2-hydroxyphenyl groups at positions 3 and 5. An orally active iron chelator, it is used to manage chronic iron overload in patients receiving long-term blood transfusions.

name: N-acetylcitrulline
definition: An N-acetyl-amino acid that is the Nα-acetyl derivative of citrulline.

name: (1R,6S)-1,6-dihydroxy-4-methylcyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: The (1R,6S)-diastereomer of 1,6-dihydroxy-4-methylcyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: (S)-1-piperideine-6-carboxylic acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 1-piperideine-6-carboxylic acid.

name: 1-piperideine-6-carboxylic acid
definition: A tetrahydropyridine that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine having a carboxy group at the 2-position.

name: 3-(methylthio)propionate
definition: A thia fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-(methylthio)propionic acid.

name: 3-methylthiopropanol
definition: An alkyl sulfide that is propan-1-ol substituted by a methylsulfanyl group at position 3. It is a volatile compound found in wines and produced during fermentation.

name: N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid
definition: N-Acetylneuraminic acid with α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: acetimidic acid
definition: A carboximidic acid that is acetic acid in which the carbonyl oxygen is replaced by an imino group.

name: N-hydroxyacetimidic acid
definition: A carbohydroximic acid consisting of acetimidic acid having a hydroxy group attached to the imide nitrogen.

name: (R)-2-(carboxymethyl)-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furoic acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2-(carboxymethyl)-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furoic acid.

name: L-methionine (S)-S-oxide
definition: The (S)-oxido diastereomer of L-methionine S-oxide.

name: L-methionine (R)-S-oxide
definition: The (R)-oxido diastereomer of L-methionine S-oxide.

name: methionine S-oxide
definition: The S-oxide derivative of methionine. It is a biomarker of oxidative stress.

name: 3-dehydro-L-gulonic acid 6-phosphate
definition: A ketoaldonic acid derivative that is the 6-(dihydrogen phosphate) derivative of 3-dehydro-L-gulonic acid.

name: ezetimibe
definition: A β-lactam that is azetidin-2-one which is substituted at 1, 3, and 4 by p-fluorophenyl, 3-(p-fluorophenyl)-3-hydroxypropyl, and 4-hydroxyphenyl groups, respectively (the 3R,3'S,4S enantiomer).

name: 3-nitropropan-1-ol
definition: The nitro compound formed from propan-1-ol by nitration at C-3.

name: 3-oxo-3-ureidopropanoic acid
definition: The ureido derivative of malonic acid.

name: 4-phospho-D-threonic acid
definition: A 4-phosphothreonic acid derived from D-threonic acid.

name: 2-formylglutaric acid
definition: The 2-formyl derivative of glutaric acid.

name: 2-hydroxymethylglutaric acid
definition: The 2-hydroxymethyl derivative of glutaric acid.

name: D-tagatofuranose
definition: The furanose form of D-tagatose.

name: β-D-tagatofuranose
definition: A D-tagatofuranose with a β-configuration at the anomeric center.

name: α-D-tagatofuranose
definition: A D-tagatofuranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric center.

name: α-D-tagatopyranose
definition: A D-tagatopyranose with an α-configuration at the anomeric center.

name: β-D-tagatopyranose
definition: A D-tagatopyranose with a β-configuration at the anomeric center.

name: 3-aminoisobutyrate
definition: A β-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-aminoisobutyric acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: N-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)malonamic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide that is the mono-(3,4-dichloroanilide) of malonic acid.

name: thiamine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining thiamine chloride with one molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: oxepane
definition: A saturated organic heteromonocyclic parent that is cycloheptane in which one of the methylene groups is replaced by oxygen.

name: thiamine(2+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of thiamine(1+) resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group.

name: D-dopachrome
definition: The D-enantiomer of dopachrome.

name: 2-deoxy-2-fluorohexopyranose
definition: The pyranose form of a 2-deoxy-2-fluorohexose.

name: 1,5,5-trimethylcyclopentene
definition: A cycloalkene consisting of cyclopentene having a methyl group at the 1-position and gem-dimethyl groups at the 5-position.

name: cyclopentene
definition: A cycloalkene that is cyclopentane having one endocyclic double bond.

name: 6-fluoro-L-dopa
definition: A non-proteinognic L-α-amino acid that is L-alanine in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been replaced by a 2-fluoro-4,5-dihydroxyphenyl group.

name: (6S,9R)-vomifoliol
definition: A (6S)-vomifoliol with a R configuration for the hydroxy group at position 9.

name: dopa
definition: A hydroxyphenylalanine carrying hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 of the benzene ring.

name: D-dopa
definition: The D-enantiomer of dopa.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylhexadecanoyl-CoA
definition: The 2-hydroxy-3-methylhexadecanoyl derivative of coenzyme A.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylhexadecanoic acid
definition: A branched, α-hydroxy fatty acid comprising a C16 chain carrying a methyl branch at position 3.

name: (6R)-dehydrovomifoliol
definition: A dehydrovomifoliol that has R-configuration at the chiral centre.

name: 2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoyl-CoA
definition: An aroyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2,3-dihydroxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoic acid.

name: 2-methylpentadecanal
definition: A 2-methyl-branched fatty aldehyde that is pentadecanal in which a hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: 2-O-sinapoyl-D-glucaric acid
definition: The 2-O-sinapoyl derivative of D-glucaric acid.

name: (R)-β-himachalene
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of β-himachalene.

name: syringaresinol
definition: A lignan that is 7,9':7',9-diepoxylignane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 4' and methoxy groups at positions 3, 3', 5 and 5' respectively.

name: (−)-syringaresinol
definition: The (7β,7'β,8β,8'β)-stereoisomer of syringaresinol.

name: (1R,6S)-α-himachalene
definition: The (1R,6S)-stereoisomer of cis-α-himachalene.

name: (3Z)-4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoic acid
definition: The (Z)-isomer of 4-(2-carboxyphenyl)-2-oxobut-3-enoic acid.

name: (Z)-α-bisabolene
definition: The (Z)-stereoisomer of α-bisabolene.

name: β-bisabolene
definition: A bisabolene that is cyclohexene substituted by a methyl group at position 1 and a 6-methylhepta-1,5-dien-2-yl group at position 4.

name: (9S,10S)-10-hydroxy-9-(phosphonooxy)octadecanoic acid
definition: An optically active 9-(phosphonooxy)-10-hydroxy derivative of stearic acid with (9S,10S)-configuration.

name: (S,S)-9,10-dihydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A 9,10-dihydroxyoctadecanoic acid diastereoisomer in which both stereocentres have S configuration.

name: N-(6-aminohexanoyl)-6-aminohexanoic acid
definition: The N-(6-aminohexanoyl) derivative of 6-aminohexanoic acid

name: (R)-3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate
definition: The conjugate base of (R)-3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid and R enantiomer of 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate.

name: (2S)-2-[(R)-1-carboxyethylamino]pentanoic acid
definition: The (2S)-2-[(R)-1-carboxyethylamino] derivative of pentanoic acid.

name: 4-(L-γ-glutamylamino)butanoic acid
definition: An N-acyl-γ-aminobutyric acid resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of 4-aminobutanoic acid with the γ-carbxy group of L-glutamic acid.

name: 3-hydroxycyclohexa-1,5-diene-1-carbonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxycyclohexa-1,5-diene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: (S)-β-bisabolene
definition: A β-bisabolene which has (1S)-configuration.

name: 8-[(1R,2R)-3-oxo-2-{(Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl}cyclopentyl]octanoic acid
definition: A 8-{3-oxo-2-[(2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl]cyclopentyl}octanoic acid that has 1R,2R-configuration.

name: 5-amino-2-oxopentanoic acid
definition: The 2-oxo-5-amino derivative of valeric acid.

name: 12α-hydroxy-3-oxochola-4,6-dien-24-oic acid
definition: A 3-oxo Δ4-steroid that is 3-oxochola-4,6-dien-24-oic acid carrying an additional hydroxy group at the 12α-position.

name: (5ξ,7ξ,10ξ)-eudesma-4(14),11-diene
definition: A selinene that is decahydronaphthalene substituted by a isopropenyl group at position 7, a methyl group at position 4a and a methylidene group at position 1.

name: (−)-β-selinene
definition: The (4aS,7S,8aR)-stereoisomer of β-selinene.

name: 6-hydroxyhex-3-enoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 6-hydroxyhex-3-enoic acid.

name: 3-hexenoic acid
definition: A hexenoic acid with the double bond at position 3.

name: cis-hex-3-enoic acid
definition: A 3-hexenoic acid having the cis configuration.

name: trans-hex-3-enoic acid
definition: A 3-hexenoic acid having the trans configuration.

name: 6-hydroxyhex-3-enoic acid
definition: A medium-chain hydroxy fatty acid comprising 3-hexenoic acid carrying a 6-hydroxy substituent.

name: trans-2,3-didehydroadipoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-2,3-didehydroadipic acid.

name: trans-2-hexenedioic acid
definition: A 6-carbon, monounsaturated dicarboxylic acid having a trans-double bond at C-2; a possible metabolite of adipic acid.

name: D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by removal of all four protons from the phosphate OH groups of D-fructofuranose 1,6-bisphosphate.

name: hydrindane
definition: An ortho-fused bicyclic hydrocarbon comprising of a cyclohexane ring fused onto a cyclopentane ring.

name: 2-hydroxyadipoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the 1-carboxy group of 2-hydroxyadipic acid.

name: 5-oxo-furan-2-acetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 5-oxo-furan-2-acetic acid.

name: (R,R)-hydrindane
definition: A trans-hydrindane with (R,R)-configuration.

name: (1E,4Z)-germacrene B
definition: A germacrene B with a (1E,4Z)-configuration.

name: algestone acetonide
definition: A cyclic ketal that is the 16α,17α-acetonide derivative of algestone.

name: O-methyl-L-tyrosine
definition: The L-enantiomer of O-methyltyrosine .

name: methyl L-phenylalaninate
definition: An α-amino acid ester that is the methyl ester of L-phenylalanine.

name: 7-hydroxy-L-tryptophan
definition: An optically active form of 7-hydroxytryptophan having L-configuration.

name: dasatinib (anhydrous)
definition: An aminopyrimidine that is 2-methylpyrimidine which is substituted at position 4 by the primary amino group of 2-amino-1,3-thiazole-5-carboxylic acid and at position 6 by a 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazin-1-yl group, and in which the carboxylic acid group has been formally condensed with 2-chloro-6-methylaniline to afford the corresponding amide. A multi-targeted kinase inhibitor, it is used, particularly as the monohydrate, for the treatment of chronic, accelerated, or myeloid or lymphoid blast phase chronic myeloid leukemia. Note that the name 'dasatinib' is used to refer to the monohydrate (USAN) as well as to anhydrous dasatinib (INN).

name: D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptopyranose
definition: The D-glycero-diastereomer of α-D-manno-heptopyranose; a key structural component of the outer cell membrane in Gram-negative bacteria, found in the conserved core oligosaccharide region.

name: dodecane-1,12-diamine
definition: An alkane-α,ω-diamine that is dodecane substituted by amino groups at positions 1 and 12.

name: bacterioruberin
definition: A C50 carotenoid that is a red-coloured pigment found in several Halobacterium and Haloarcula species.

name: 3,4-dichlorobenzoic acid
definition: A chlorobenzoic acid carrying chloro substituents at positions 3 and 4.

name: 2-methyl-1H-indole
definition: A methylindole that is 1H-indole substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: 3-chlorobenzoic acid
definition: A monochlorobenzoic acid carrying a chloro substituent at position 3.

name: nickel(3+)
definition: A nickel cation in which the nickel carries a triple positive charge.

name: 5-hydroxyectoine
definition: A carboxamidine heterocycle which is obtained by formal condensation of 4-amino-L-allothreonine with acetic acid.

name: 3,7:6,10:9,14-trianhydro-2,5,11,12,13-pentadeoxy-4-O-(methoxymethyl)-L-arabino-L-allo-tetradec-12-enonic acid
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound comprising a decahydropyrano[2',3':5,6]pyrano[3,2-b]oxepin ring system having hydroxy, methoxymethyl and carboxymethyl substituents.

name: aluminium(3+)
definition: An aluminium cation that has a charge of +3.

name: AZD7545
definition: A sulfone that is benzene substituted by [4-(dimethylcarbamoyl)phenyl]sulfonyl, chloro and [(2R)-3,3,3-trifluoro-2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanoyl]amino groups at positions 1, 3 and 4, respectively. It is a potent and non-ATP-competitive inhibitor of pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 2 (PDHK2) with IC50 of 6.4 nM and exhibits glucose-lowering activity. Also inhibits PDHK1 at higher levels (IC50 = 36.8 nM).

name: beryllium difluoride
definition: The fluoride salt of beryllium (+2 oxidation state). In the solid state it exists as a glass, with four-coordinate Be2+ tetrahedral centres and two-coordinate fluoride centres. As a gas it adopts a linear triatomic structure and in the liquid state a fluctuating tetrahedral structure. In protein crystallography it is used as a mimic of phosphate.

name: 2',6'-dichlorobiphenyl-2,3-diol
definition: A hydroxybiphenyl that is catechol in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a 2,6-dichlorophenyl group.

name: 2'-chlorobiphenyl-2,3-diol
definition: A hydroxybiphenyl that is catechol in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a 2-chlorophenyl group.

name: 3-(2,2'-bipyridin-5-yl)-L-alanine
definition: A L-alanine derivative that is L-alanine substituted by a [2,2'-bipyridin]-5-yl group at position 3.

name: 12-bromododecanoic acid
definition: A bromo fatty acid consisting of lauric acid having a single bromo-substituent at the 12-position.

name: β-D-cellohexaose
definition: A D-cellohexaose in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: β-cellopentaose
definition: A cellopentaose in which the anomeric centre at the reducing end has β-configuration.

name: c-di-GMP
definition: A cyclic purine dinucleotide that is the 3',5'-cyclic dimer of MP.

name: cellooctaose
definition: A glucooctaose consisting of 8 β-D-glucose residues joined in a linear sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: 4-chloro-L-threonine
definition: A chloroamino acid that is L-threonine in which one of the hydrogens of the terminal methyl group has been replaced by a chlorine.

name: copper(II) chloride
definition: An inorganic chloride of copper in which the metal is in the +2 oxidation state.

name: cloxacillin
definition: A semisynthetic penicillin antibiotic carrying a 3-(2-chlorophenyl)-5-methylisoxazole-4-carboxamido group at position 6.

name: diazepam
definition: A 1,4-benzodiazepinone that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-1,4-benzodiazepin-2-one substituted by a chloro group at position 7, a methyl group at position 1 and a phenyl group at position 5.

name: 4-ethylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols carrying an ethyl substituent at position 4.

name: 3-chloro-L-phenylalanine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-phenylalanine in which one of the meta-hydrogens of the phenyl group has been replaced by a chlorine.

name: N-(3-cyanophenyl)-2'-methyl-5'-(5-methyl-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-yl)biphenyl-4-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of biphenyls that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2'-methyl-5'-(5-methyl-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-yl)[1,1'-biphenyl]-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 3-cyanoaniline.

name: gallium atom
definition: A metallic element predicted as eka-aluminium by Mendeleev in 1870 and discovered by Paul-Emile Lecoq de Boisbaudran in 1875. Named in honour of France (Latin Gallia) and perhaps also from the Latin gallus cock, a translation of Lecoq.

name: mercury dibromide
definition: A mercury coordination entity composed of mercury and bromine with the formula HgBr2.

name: mercury diiodide
definition: A mercury coordination entity composed of mercury and iodine with formula HgI2.

name: indometacin
definition: A member of the class of indole-3-acetic acids that is indole-3-acetic acid in which the indole ring is substituted at positions 1, 2 and 5 by p-chlorobenzoyl, methyl, and methoxy groups, respectively. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, it is used in the treatment of musculoskeletal and joint disorders including osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, bursitis and tendinitis.

name: gefitinib
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline which is substituted by a (3-chloro-4-fluorophenyl)nitrilo group, 3-(morpholin-4-yl)propoxy group and a methoxy group at positions 4,6 and 7, respectively. An EGFR kinase inhibitor used for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer.

name: 4,5,6,7-tetrabromobenzimidazole
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by bromo groups at positions 4, 5, 6, and 7. It is an ATP competitive casein kinase 2 inhibitor.

name: latrunculin B
definition: A macrolide consisting of a 14-membered bicyclic lactone attached to the rare 2-thiazolidinone moiety. It is obtained from the Red Sea sponge Latrunculia magnifica.

name: perchlorate
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of perchloric acid.

name: chlorate
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of chloric acid.

name: β-D-mannose 6-phosphate
definition: A D-mannopyranose 6-phosphate with a β-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: L-threo-neopterin
definition: A neopterin that has 1S,2S-configuration.

name: methyl red
definition: An azo dye consisting of benzoic acid substituted at position 2 by a 4-[(dimethylamino)phenyl]diazenyl group.

name: D-erythro-neopterin
definition: A neopterin that has 1S,2R-configuration.

name: nickel(2+)
definition: A nickel cation in which the nickel carries a double positive charge.

name: platinum dichloride
definition: A platinum coordination entity consisting of platinum(II) bound to two chlorine atoms.

name: 2,2',5,5'-tetrachloro-4,4'-bis(methylsulfonyl)biphenyl
definition: An member of the class of biphenyls that is 2,2',5,5'-tetrachlorobiphenyl in which the 4 and 4' positions are substituted by methylsulfonyl groups.

name: periodate
definition: A monovalent inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of periodic acid.

name: 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)methanamine
definition: An aralkylamino compound that is benzylamine substituted by a methoxy group at the para position.

name: 5,6-dichloro-1-β-D-ribofuranosyl-1H-benzimidazole
definition: A 1-ribosylbenzimidazole that is 5,6-dichloro-1H-benzimidazole attached to a β-D-ribofuranosyl residue at position 1 via a glycosidic (N-glycosyl) linkage. It is an inhibitor for RNA polymerase II transcription.

name: BI-2536
definition: A member of the class of tetrahydropterins that is 7,8-dihydropteridin-6(5H)-one substituted by {2-methoxy-4-[(1-methylpiperidin-4-yl)carbamoyl]phenyl}amino, methyl, ethyl, and cyclopentyl groups at positions 2, 5, 7R, and 8, respectively. It is a polo-like kinase 1 (PLK1) inhibitor with antineoplastic activity.

name: tetra-μ3-sulfido-tetrairon
definition: An Fe4S4 iron-sulfur cluster in which each sulfur is attached to three of the iron atoms.

name: samarium(3+)
definition: A metal cation comprising samarium in the +3 oxidation state.

name: arsenous acid
definition: An arsenic oxoacid consisting of three hydroxy groups attached to a central arsenic atom.

name: 1,3,5-trichlorobenzene
definition: A trichlorobenzene carrying chloro substituents at positions 1, 3 and 5.

name: 3-amino-L-tyrosine
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is L-tyrosine substituted by an amino group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: hydrazinecarbothioamide
definition: A member of the class of thioureas that is thiourea in which a hydrogen of one of the amino groups is replaced by an amino group.

name: vandetanib
definition: A quinazoline that is 7-[(1-methylpiperidin-4-yl)methoxy]quinazoline bearing additional methoxy and 4-bromo-2-fluorophenylamino substituents at positions 6 and 4 respectively. Used for the treatment of symptomatic or progressive medullary thyroid cancer in patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic disease.

name: zinc dichloride
definition: A compound of zinc and chloride ions in the ratio 1:2. It exists in four crystalline forms, in each of which the Zn2+ ions are trigonal planar coordinated to four chloride ions.

name: radon(0)
definition: A monoatomic radon that has an oxidation state of zero.

name: 4,4'-bis({4-anilino-6-[bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amino]-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl}amino)stilbene-2,2'-disulfonic acid
definition: An organosulfonic acid comprising stilbene having 4-anilino-6-[bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amino]-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl}amino groups at the 4 and 4'-positions and sulfo groups at the 2- and 2'-positions.

name: 4,4'-bis({4-anilino-6-[bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amino]-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl}amino)stilbene-2,2'-disulfonate
definition: An arenesulfonate arising from deprotonation of the sulfo groups of 4,4'-bis({4-anilino-6-[bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amino]-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl}amino)stilbene-2,2'-disulfonic acid.

name: β-pinene
definition: An isomer of pinene with an exocyclic double bond. It is a component of essential oils from many plants.

name: sabinene
definition: A thujene that is a bicyclic monoterpene isolated from the essential oils of various plant species.

name: α-thujene
definition: A thujene that has a bicyclo[3.1.0]hex-2-ene skeleton which is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by methyl and isopropyl groups, respectively.

name: α-phellandrene
definition: One of a pair of phellandrene cyclic monoterpene double-bond isomers in which both double bonds are endocyclic (cf. α-phellandrene, where one of them is exocyclic).

name: (6aS,11aS)-4-dimethylallyl-3,6a,9-trihydroxypterocarpan
definition: A member of the class of pterocarpans that is (6aS,11aS)-3,6a,9-trihydroxypterocarpan in which the hydrogen atom at position 4 is substituted by a 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group.

name: N-benzoylanthranilic acid
definition: An amidobenzoic acid comprising benzoic acid having a benzamido group at the 2-position.

name: deoxyhypusine
definition: An L-lysine derivative in which the N6 of the lysine is substituted with a 4-aminobutyl group.

name: thujone
definition: A thujane monoterpenoid that is thujane substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: (+)-α-thujone
definition: The (1R,4S,5S)-stereoisomer of α-thujone.

name: imidazolium cation
definition: An imidazolium ion that is the cation resulting from protonation at the 3-position of 1H-imidazole.

name: ascopyrone M
definition: A 3-pyranone with a 4,5-double bond carrying a hydroxy group at position 4 and a hydroxymethyl group at position 6.

name: ascopyrone P
definition: A 4-pyranone with a 2,3-double bond carrying a hydroxy group at position 3 and a hydroxymethyl group at position 6.

name: chromium-51
definition: A synthetic radioactive isotope of chromium having a half-life of 27.7 days and decaying by electron capture with emission of γ rays (0.32 MeV); it is used to label red blood cells for measurement of mass or volume, survival time, and sequestration studies, for the diagnosis of gastrointestinal bleeding, and to label platelets to study their survival.

name: S-nitrosoglutathione
definition: A glutathione derivative that is glutathione in which the hydrogen attached to the sulfur has been replaced by a nitroso group.

name: bucladesine
definition: A 3',5'-cyclic purine nucleotide that is the 2'-butanoate ester and 6-N-butanoyl derivative of 3',5'-cyclic AMP.

name: (4-chloro-2-methylphenoxy)acetic acid
definition: A chlorophenoxyacetic acid that is (4-chlorophenoxy)acetic acid substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: N-methyl-N-nitrosourea
definition: A member of the class of N-nitrosoureas that is urea in which one of the nitrogens is substituted by methyl and nitroso groups.

name: TNP-ATP
definition: A sprioketal resulting from the formal condensation of the 2'- and 3'- hydroxy groups of ATP with picric acid.

name: TNP-ATP5−
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of TNP-ATP.

name: deoxycholoyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of deoxycholic acid.

name: phenylglyoxylyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of phenylglyoxylic acid.

name: (6aS,11aS)-2-dimethylallyl-3,6a,9-trihydroxypterocarpan
definition: A member of the class of pterocarpans that is (6aS,11aS)-3,6a,9-trihydroxypterocarpan in which the hydrogen atom at position 2 is substituted by a 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group.

name: 2-hydroxyisobutyric acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is isobutyric acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 2. It is a metabolite of methyl tertiary-butyl ether.

name: monacolin L
definition: A polyketide that is 1-ethyl-2,6-dimethyl-1,2,6,7,8,8a-hexahydronaphthalene in which one of the methyl hydrogens from the ethyl group is replaced by a 4-hydroxy-6-ketopyran-2-yl group.

name: lonidamine
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 1H-indazole that is substituted at positions 1 and 3 by 2,4-dichlorobenzyl and carboxy groups, respectively.

name: heptan-3-one
definition: A dialkyl ketone with butyl and ethyl as the two alkyl groups.

name: (S)-fenpropimorph
definition: A 4-[3-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-methylpropyl]-2,6-dimethylmorpholine in which the methyl substituents on the morpholine ring are in a cis relationship to each other and in which the remaining stereocentre has S configuration.

name: (R)-fenpropimorph
definition: A 4-[3-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-methylpropyl]-2,6-dimethylmorpholine in which the methyl substituents on the morpholine ring are in a cis relationship to each other and in which the remaining stereocentre has R configuration.

name: 4-[3-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-methylpropyl]-2,6-dimethylmorpholine
definition: A member of the class of morpholines that is 2,6-dimethylmorpholine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a 3-(p-tert-butylphenyl)-2-methylpropyl group.

name: (2R,6R)-[3-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-methylpropyl]-2,6-dimethylmorpholine
definition: A trans-[3-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-methylpropyl]-2,6-dimethylmorpholine in which both of the stereocentres in the morpholine ring have R configuration.

name: (2S,6S)-[3-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-methylpropyl]-2,6-dimethylmorpholine
definition: A trans-[3-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-methylpropyl]-2,6-dimethylmorpholine in which both of the stereocentres in the morpholine ring have S configuration.

name: 1,1-bis(2-aminoethyl)-2-hydroxy-3-oxotriazane
definition: A nitroso compound that is triazane in which the the nitrogen at position 1 is substituted by two 2-aminoethyl groups, that at position 2 is substituted by a hydroxy group, and that at position 3 is substituted by an oxo group.

name: (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetaldehyde
definition: An aldehyde that is acetaldehyde substituted by a 5-hydroxyindol-3-yl group.

name: chavicol
definition: A phenylpropanoid that is phenol substituted by a prop-2-enyl group at position 4.

name: 3-hydroxypregnan-20-one
definition: A C21-steroid that is pregnane substituted by an oxo group at position 20 and a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: brexanolone
definition: A 3-hydroxy-5α-pregnan-20-one in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has α-configuration. It is a metabolite of the sex hormone progesterone and used for the treatment of postpartum depression in women.

name: 3-hydroxy-5β-pregnan-20-one
definition: The 5β-stereoisomer of 3-hydroxypregnan-20-one.

name: acitretin
definition: A retinoid that consists of 3,7-dimethylnona-2,4,6,8-tetraenoic acid having a 4-methoxy-2,3,6-trimethylphenyl group attached at position 9.

name: deptropine
definition: An azabicycloalkane that is the 10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[a,d]cyclohepten-5-yl ether of tropine.

name: deptropine citrate
definition: A citrate salt that is the dihydrogen citrate salt of deptropamine.

name: 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde that is resorcinol which has been substituted by a formyl group para to one of the hydroxy groups.

name: pefloxacin
definition: A quinolone that is 4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline which is substituted at positions 1, 3, 6 and 7 by ethyl, carboxy, fluorine, and 4-methylpiperazin-1-yl groups, respectively.

name: (R)-naringenin
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of naringenin.

name: naringenin
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 6 and 4'.

name: sophoraflavanone B
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that is (S)-naringenin having a prenyl group at position 8.

name: leachianone G
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone having the hydroxy groups at the 2'-, 4'-, 5- and 7-positions and a prenyl group at 8-position.

name: sophoraflavanone G
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone having a structure of naringenin bearing an additional hydroxyl substituent at position 2' as well as a (2R)-5-methyl-2-(prop-1-en-2-yl)hex-4-en-1-yl (lavandulyl) substituent at position 8'.

name: retinol
definition: A retinoid consisting of 3,7-dimethylnona-2,4,6,8-tetraen-1-ol substituted at position 9 by a 2,6,6-trimethylcyclohex-1-en-1-yl group (geometry of the four exocyclic double bonds is not specified).

name: pizotifen
definition: A benzocycloheptathiophene that is 9,10-dihydro-4H-benzo[4,5]cyclohepta[1,2-b]thiophene 4-ylidene)-1-methylpiperidine which is joined from the 4 position to the 4 position of an N-methylpiperidine moiety by a double bond. It is a sedating antihistamine, with strong serotonin antagonist and weak antimuscarinic activity. It is generally used as the malate salt for the treatment of migraine and the prevention of headache attacks during cluster periods.

name: pizotifen malate
definition: A malate salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of pizotifen and malic acid. A sedating antihistamine with strong serotonin antagonist and weak antimuscarinic activity, it is used for the treatment of migraine and the prevention of headache attacks during cluster periods.

name: pizotifen maleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by reaction of pizotifen with one equivalent of maleic acid.

name: dihydrocarveol
definition: A p-menthane monoterpenoid that is the dihydro derivative of carveol.

name: (+)-neoisodihydrocarveol
definition: The (1R,2S,5R)-stereoisomer of dihydrocarveol.

name: (+)-isodihydrocarveol
definition: The (1S,2S,4R)-stereoisomer of dihydrocarveol.

name: (+)-dihydrocarveol
definition: A dihydrocarveol with (1S,2S,4S)-stereochemistry.

name: 4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: A ε-lactone that is oxepan-2-one substituted by an isoprenyl group at position 4 and a methyl group at position 7.

name: 7-isopropyl-4-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: An ε-lactone that is oxepan-2-one which is substituted at positions 4 and 7 by methyl and isopropyl groups, respectively.

name: (1R,4S)-1-hydroxylimonen-2-one
definition: An optically active form of 1-hydroxylimonen-2-one having (1R,4S)-configuration.

name: 1-hydroxylimonen-2-one
definition: A limonene monoterpenoid that consists of cyclohexanone bearing hydroxy and methyl substituents at position 2 as well as an isopropenyl substituent at position 5.

name: (4R,7S)-7-isopropyl-4-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: A 7-isopropyl-4-methyloxepan-2-one that has 4R,7S configuration.

name: (4R,7R)-7-isopropyl-4-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: A 7-isopropyl-4-methyloxepan-2-one in which both stereocentres have R configuration.

name: 2-(2-methylthioethyl)malic acid
definition: The 2-(2-methylthioethyl) derivative of malic acid.

name: 2-(3-methylthiopropyl)malic acid
definition: The 2-(3-methylthiopropyl) derivative of malic acid.

name: (R,R)-chrysanthemyl diphosphate
definition: The (R,R)-diastereoisomer of chrysanthemyl diphosphate.

name: esomeprazole
definition: A 5-methoxy-2-{[(4-methoxy-3,5-dimethylpyridin-2-yl)methyl]sulfinyl}-1H-benzimidazole that has S configuration at the sulfur atom. An inhibitor of gastric acid secretion, it is used (generally as its sodium or magnesium salt) for the treatment of gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, dyspepsia, peptic ulcer disease, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

name: lavandulol
definition: A monoterpenoid alcohol that is hepta-1-5-diene which is substituted at positions 2 and 6 by methyl groups and at position 3 by a hydroxymethyl group. It is commonly found in lavender oil.

name: lavandulyl diphosphate
definition: The O-diphospho derivative of lavandulol.

name: 1,9-dideoxyforskolin
definition: A labdane diterpenoid that is the 1,9-dideoxy derivative of forskolin.

name: terpentedienyl diphosphate
definition: The O-diphospho derivative of terpentedienol.

name: podophyllotoxin
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that has a furonaphthodioxole skeleton bearing a 3,4,5-trimethoxyphenyl substituent. It is found in the roots and rhizomes of Podophyllum species and is used for the topical treatment of genital warts.

name: esomeprazole magnesium
definition: A magnesium salt resulting from the formal reaction of magnesium hydroxide with 2 mol eq. of esomeprazole. An inhibitor of gastric acid secretion, it is used for the treatment of gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, dyspepsia, peptic ulcer disease, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

name: pizotifen(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion that results in the protonation of the nitrogen atom of pizotifen.

name: (R)-rosmarinic acid
definition: A stereoisomer of rosmarinic acid having (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-rosmarinic acid
definition: The (S)-stereoisomer of rosmarinic acid.

name: nitisinone
definition: A cyclohexanone that is cyclohexane-1,3-dione substituted at position 2 by a 2-nitro-4-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl group. It is used in the treatment of hereditary tyrosinemia type 1.

name: miglustat
definition: A hydroxypiperidine that is deoxynojirimycin in which the amino hydrogen is replaced by a butyl group.

name: hemin
definition: It is used as a prescription medication to relieve repeated attacks of acute intermittent porphyria related to the menstrual cycle in affected women.

name: tuberculosinyl diphosphate
definition: A diterpenyl phosphate that is the O-diphospho derivative of tuberculosinol.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three molecules of α-D-glucopyranose joined in a linear sequence by 1→6 glycosidic linkages.

name: succinamic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide of succinic acid.

name: 3',4',7-trihydroxyisoflavone
definition: A 7-hydroxyisoflavone that is daidzein substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3'.

name: 2-methylpyridine
definition: A methylpyridine carrying a methyl substituent at position 2.

name: 4-hydroxyphenylglycine
definition: A glycine molecule carrying a 4-hydroxyphenyl substituent.

name: indophenol
definition: A quinone imine obtained by formal condensation of one of the keto groups of benzoquinone with the amino group of 4-hydroxyaniline.

name: (Z)-glutaconic acid
definition: The (Z)-stereoisomer of glutaconic acid.

name: desferrioxamine E
definition: A cyclic hydroxamic acid siderophore that is produced by several bacterial species and exhibits antitumour activity.

name: phenprocoumon
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is 4-hydroxycoumarin which is substituted at position 3 by a 1-phenylpropyl group.

name: 1-naphthylamine
definition: A naphthylamine that is naphthalene substituted by an amino group at position 1.

name: 6-hydroxy-3,7-dimethyloctanoic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that consists of caprylic acid bearing two additional methyl substituents at positions 3 and 7 as well as a hydroxy substituent at position 6.

name: 6-hydroxy-3-isopropenylheptanoic acid
definition: A branched-chain hydroxy fatty acid consisting of heptanoic acid with an isopropenyl group at the 3-position and the hydroxy group at the 6-position.

name: desferrioxamine D1
definition: An acyclic desferrioxamine that is the N-acetyl derivative of desferrioxamine B.

name: 2,5-diphenylfuran
definition: A diphenylfuran in the the phenyl groups are located at positions 2 and 5 on the furan ring.

name: 2,4-diphenylfuran
definition: A diphenylfuran in the the phenyl groups are located at positions 2 and 4 on the furan ring.

name: citronellol
definition: A monoterpenoid that is oct-6-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1 and methyl groups at positions 3 and 7.

name: cis-vaccenic acid
definition: The cis isomer of vaccenic acid.

name: 2-decenoic acid
definition: A decenoic acid having its double bond in position 2.

name: cis-2-decenoic acid
definition: A 2-decenoic acid having its double bond in the cis configuration.

name: trans-2-decenoic acid
definition: A 2-decenoic acid having its double bond in the trans configuration. It is an intermediate metabolite in the fatty acid synthesis.

name: vaccenate(1−)
definition: An unsaturated long-chain fatty acid anion and the conjugate base of vaccenic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: lidocaine hydrochloride
definition: The anhydrous form of the hydrochloride salt of lidocaine.

name: 24-hydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 24.

name: (24R)-24-hydroxycholesterol
definition: A 24-hydroxycholesterol that has R configuration at position 24.

name: (24R)-7α,24-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: A 7α,24-dihydroxycholesterol in which has R configuration at position 24.

name: sulfoacetic acid
definition: A carboxyalkanesulfonic acid that is the C-sulfo derivative of acetic acid.

name: N-methylnicotinic acid
definition: A pyridinium ion consisting of nicotinic acid having a methyl substituent on the pyridine nitrogen.

name: catecholate(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of catechol.

name: phenolate
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of phenol obtained by deprotonation of the OH group.

name: (R)-β-alanopine
definition: The N-(2-carboxyethyl) derivative of L-alanine.

name: butyl isothiocyanate
definition: An isothiocyanate having a butyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: N-methyl-α-berbine
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion resulting from the methylation of the nitrogen atom of α-berbine.

name: menthofuran
definition: A monoterpenoid that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1-benzofuran substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 6.

name: trans-isoeugenol
definition: The trans-stereoisomer of isoeugenol.

name: isobutyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of isobutanol.

name: trans-2-octadecenoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecenoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-2-octadecenoic acid.

name: 3-oxooctadecanoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-oxooctadecanoic acid.

name: trans-octadec-2-enoic acid
definition: An octadec-2-enoic acid having a trans- double bond.

name: octadec-2-enoic acid
definition: An octadecenoic acid with the double bond at position 2.

name: cis-octadec-2-enoic acid
definition: An octadec-2-enoic acid having a cis- double bond.

name: 3-oxooctadecanoic acid
definition: A 3-oxo fatty acid derived from stearic acid.

name: (S)-3-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid in which the chiral centre has S configuration.

name: 3-hydroxyoctadecanoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 2-methylbutyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of 2-methylbutan-1-ol.

name: 4β-methylzymosterol-4α-carboxylic acid
definition: A 3β-sterol that consists of 4β-methylzymosterol in which the 4α-hydrogen is replaced by a carboxy group.

name: 3-dehydro-4-methylzymosterol
definition: A 3-oxo-5α- steroid that is zymosterol which has been substituted by a methyl group at C-4, and in which the 3-hydroxy function has been oxidised to an oxo group.

name: Nτ-methyl-L-histidine
definition: A L-histidine derivative in which the methyl group is at Nτ-position.

name: Nα-methyl-L-histidine
definition: A Nα-methyl-L-histidines that is L-histidine bearing a single methyl substituent at the Nα-position.

name: precorrin-2
definition: The second intermediate in the biosynthesis of vitamin B12 from uroporphyrinogen III, in which methyl groups have been introduced at positions 2 and 7 of the tetrapyrrole framework.

name: N-formyl-L-tyrosine
definition: An N-formyl amino acid that is L-tyrosine in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group has been replaced by a formyl group.

name: dityrosine
definition: A biphenyl compound comprising two tyrosine residues linked at carbon-3 of their benzene rings.

name: (R)-2-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: An optically active form of 2-hydroxybutyric acid having (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-2-hydroxybutyric acid
definition: An optically active form of 2-hydroxybutyric acid having (S)-configuration.

name: iminoaspartic acid
definition: A succinic acid derivative having an imino group at the 2-position.

name: γ-Glu-Ala
definition: A γ-glutamylalanine obtained by formal condensation of the γ-carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of L-alanine.

name: (S)-2-methylbutan-1-ol
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-methylbutan-1-ol.

name: 2-hydroxyhexadecanal
definition: A hydroxy fatty aldehyde that is hexadecanal in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-nitronaphthalene
definition: A mononitronaphthalene carrying a nitro group at position 2.

name: 1,5-dinitronaphthalene
definition: A dinitronaphthalene carrying nitro groups at positions 1 and 5.

name: 1,8-dinitronaphthalene
definition: A dinitronaphthalene carrying nitro groups at positions 1 and 8.

name: 9-cis-retinoic acid
definition: A retinoic acid in which the exocyclic double bonds have 7E,9Z,11E,13E geometry.

name: exiguamine A
definition: An alkaloid isolated from the marine sponge Neopetrosia exigua which acts as a potent inhibitor of indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase.

name: dronedarone
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans used for the treatment of cardiac arrhythmias.

name: marimastat
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the foraml condensation of the carboxy group of (2R)-2-[(1S)-1-hydroxy-2-(hydroxyamino)-2-oxoethyl]-4-methylpentanoic acid with the α-amino group of N,3-dimethyl-L-valinamide.

name: mercaptopurine
definition: A member of the class of purines that is 6,7-dihydro-1H-purine carrying a thione group at position 6. An adenine analogue, it is used in the treatment of acute lymphocytic leukemia (ALL), chronic myeloid leukemia (CML), Crohn's disease, and ulcerative colitis.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An N,N'-diacetylchitobiose having β-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: methimazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that it imidazole-2-thione in which a methyl group replaces the hydrogen which is attached to a nitrogen.

name: β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosamine
definition: A β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-D-glucosamine having β-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: methotrexate disodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of methotrexate.

name: atorvastatin calcium
definition: An organic calcium salt composed of calcium cations and atorvastatin anions in a 1:2 ratio.

name: metronidazole hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the mixture of equimolar amounts of metronidazole and hydrogen chloride.

name: metronidazole benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of benzoic acid with the hydroxy group of metronidazole.

name: milrinone
definition: A member of the class of bipyridines that is 2-pyridone which is substituted at positions 3, 5, and 6 by cyano, pyrid-4-yl, and methyl groups, respectively. It is used (particularly intravenously, as the lactate) for the short-term management of severe heart failure.

name: minocycline
definition: A tetracycline analogue having a dimethylamino group at position 7 and lacking the methyl and hydroxy groups at position 5.

name: 5-(methylsulfanyl)pentanal oxime
definition: An aliphatic aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of 5-(methylsulfanyl)pentanal with hydroxylamine.

name: 6-(methylsulfanyl)hexanal oxime
definition: An aliphatic aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of 6-(methylsulfanyl)pentanal with hydroxylamine.

name: 7-(methylsulfanyl)heptanal oxime
definition: An aliphatic aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of 7-(methylsulfanyl)heptanal with hydroxylamine.

name: 8-(methylsulfanyl)octanal oxime
definition: An aliphatic aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of 8-(methylsulfanyl)octanal with hydroxylamine.

name: 9-(methylsulfanyl)nonanal oxime
definition: An aliphatic aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of 9-(methylsulfanyl)nonanal with hydroxylamine.

name: 4-(methylsulfanyl)butanal oxime
definition: An aliphatic aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of 4-(methylsulfanyl)butanal with hydroxylamine.

name: 3-(methylsulfanyl)propanal oxime
definition: An aliphatic aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of 3-(methylsulfanyl)propanal with hydroxylamine.

name: dihomomethionine
definition: A sulfur-containing amino acid consisting of 2-aminohexanoic acid having a methylthio substituent at the 6-position.

name: trihomomethionine
definition: A sulfur-containing amino acid consisting of 2-aminoheptanoic acid having a methylthio substituent at the 7-position.

name: tetrahomomethionine
definition: A sulfur-containing amino acid consisting of 2-aminooctanoic acid having a methylthio substituent at the 8-position.

name: pentahomomethionine
definition: A sulfur-containing amino acid consisting of 2-aminononanoic acid having a methylthio substituent at the 9-position.

name: hexahomomethionine
definition: A sulfur-containing amino acid consisting of 2-aminodecanoic acid having a methylthio substituent at the 10-position.

name: (methylsulfanyl)acetaldehyde oxime
definition: An aliphatic aldoxime resulting from the formal condensation of 2-(methylsulfanyl)acetaldehyde with hydroxylamine.

name: 1-methylnaphthalene
definition: A methylnaphthalene carrying a methyl substituent at position 1.

name: (E)-acetaldehyde oxime
definition: The (E)-stereoisomer of acetaldehyde oxime.

name: (Z)-acetaldehyde oxime
definition: The (Z)-stereoisomer of acetaldehyde oxime.

name: 2-methylnaphthalene
definition: A methylnaphthalene carrying a methyl substituent at position 2.

name: (Z)-phenylacetaldehyde oxime
definition: A phenylacetaldehyde oxime in which the oxime moiety has Z configuration.

name: butanamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of butanoic acid and ammonia.

name: 2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)-sn-glycerol 1-phosphate
definition: The 2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)- derivative of sn-glycerol 1-phosphate.

name: CDP-2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)-sn-glycerol
definition: A nucleotide conjugate consisting of CDP joined at the 1-position of 2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)-sn-glycerol via a diphosphate linkage.

name: mitoxantrone
definition: A dihydroxyanthraquinone that is 1,4-dihydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone which is substituted by 6-hydroxy-1,4-diazahexyl groups at positions 5 and 8.

name: 4-carbamoylbenzoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of terephthalic acid with ammonia.

name: raloxifene hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of raloxifene and hydrogen chloride.

name: cyproterone acetate
definition: A steroid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetic acid with the 17-hydroxy group of cyproterone. It is an antiandrogenic drug which has recently been recognized to promote the occurrence and growth of intracranial meningiomas.

name: calcipotriol
definition: A seco-cholestane that is 26,27-cyclo-9,10-secocholesta-5,7,10,22-tetraene carrying additional hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 3 and 24. It is used (as its hydrate) in combination with betamethasone dipropionate, a corticosteroid, for the topical treatment of plaque psoriasis in adult patients.

name: acridone
definition: A member of the class of acridines that is 9,10-dihydroacridine substituted by an oxo group at position 9.

name: N-hydroxydihomomethionine
definition: An N-hydroxy-α-amino acid bearing a 5-thiahexyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N-hydroxytrihomomethionine
definition: An N-hydroxy-α-amino acid having a 6-thiaheptyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N-hydroxytetrahomomethionine
definition: An N-hydroxy-α-amino acid having a 7-thiaoctyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N-hydroxypentahomomethionine
definition: An N-hydroxy-α-amino acid having a 8-thianonyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N-hydroxyhexahomomethionine
definition: An N-hydroxy-α-amino acid having a 9-thiadecyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N,N-dihydroxyhexahomomethionine
definition: An N,N-dihydroxy-α-amino acid having a 9-thiadecyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N,N-dihydroxydihomomethionine
definition: An N,N-dihydroxy-α-amino acid having a 5-thiahexyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N,N-dihydroxytrihomomethionine
definition: An N,N-dihydroxy-α-amino acid having a 6-thiaheptyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N,N-dihydroxytetrahomomethionine
definition: An N,N-dihydroxy-α-amino acid having a 7-thiaoctyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: N,N-dihydroxypentahomomethionine
definition: An N,N-dihydroxy-α-amino acid having a 8-thianonyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: 3-demethylubiquinone-10
definition: A polyprenylbenzoquinone that is fumigatin which is substituted by an all-trans-decaprenyl group at position 6.

name: 2-decaprenyl-6-methoxy-3-methyl-1,4-benzoquinone
definition: A polyprenylbenzoquinone that is 2-decaprenyl-1,4-benzoquinone carrying additional methyl and methoxy substituents at positions 3 and 6 respectively.

name: 3-decaprenyl-4,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid that is 3,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid in which the hydrogen at position 5 is substituted by a decaprenyl group.

name: 3-decaprenyl-4-hydroxy-5-methoxybenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 4-hydroxybenzoic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 5 are substituted by a methoxy and a decaprenyl group.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-asparagine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is the (3S)-hydroxy-derivative of L-asparagine.

name: norflurazon
definition: A pyridazinone that is pyridazin-3(2H)-one which is substituted at positions 2, 4, and 5 by m-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl, chloro, and methylamino groups, respectively. A pre-emergence herbicide used to control grasses and broad-leafed weeds in a variety of crops. Not approved for use within the European Union.

name: doxycycline
definition: Tetracycline in which the 5β-hydrogen is replaced by a hydroxy group, while the 6α-hydroxy group is replaced by hydrogen. A semi-synthetic tetracycline antibiotic, it is used to inhibit bacterial protein synthesis and treat non-gonococcal urethritis and cervicitis, exacerbations of bronchitis in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and adult periodontitis.

name: penicillamine
definition: An α-amino acid having the structure of valine substituted at the β position with a sulfanyl group.

name: L-penicillamine
definition: The L-enantiomer of penicillamine.

name: 3-cyclopentylpropionic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a cyclopentyl group.

name: dextronorgestrel
definition: The (+)-enantiomer of norgestrel.

name: PP121
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine which is substituted by a cyclopentyl, 1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridin-5-yl, and amino groups at positions 1, 3 and 4, respectively. It is a dual inhibitor of tyrosine and phosphoinositide kinases and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: eletriptan
definition: An N-alkylpyrrolidine, that is N-methylpyrrolidine in which the pro-R hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a {5-[2-(phenylsulfonyl)ethyl]-1H-indol-3-yl}methyl group.

name: 5-deoxy-D-glucuronic acid
definition: The 5-deoxygenated analogue of D-glucuronic acid.

name: sorafenib
definition: A member of the class of phenylureas that is urea in which one of the nitrogens is substituted by a 4-chloro-3-trifluorophenyl group while the other is substituted by a phenyl group which, in turn, is substituted at the para position by a [2-(methylcarbamoyl)pyridin-4-yl]oxy group.

name: (Z)-chlorprothixene
definition: A chlorprothixene in which the double bond adopts a (Z)-configuration.

name: (E)-chlorprothixene
definition: A chlorprothixene in which the double bond adopts an (E)-configuration.

name: mitorubrin
definition: An azaphilone that is 7,8-dihydro-6H-2-benzopyran substituted by a methyl group at position 7, oxo groups at positions 6 and 8, a propenyl group at position 3 and a (2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylbenzoyl)oxy group at position 7.

name: (−)-mitorubrin
definition: The (7R)-enantiomer of mitorubrin.

name: (2S,3S)-2-methylcitric acid
definition: The (2S,3S)-diastereomer of 2-methylcitric acid.

name: titanocene
definition: A bis(η5-cyclopentadienyl)metal(II) having Ti(II) as the metal(II) species. The parent of the class of titanonocenes.

name: 7,8-dihydro-D-neopterin 2',3'-cyclic phosphate
definition: The 2',3'-cyclic phosphate derivative of 7,8-dihydro-D-neopterin.

name: 1,3-thiazolidine-2,4-dione
definition: A thiazolidenedione carrying oxo substituents at positions 2 and 4.

name: zirconocene
definition: A bis(η5-cyclopentadienyl)metal(II) having Zr(II) as the metal(II) species. The parent of the class of zirconocenes.

name: 3-ethenylcyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol
definition: A diol that is cyclohexa-3,5-diene-1,2-diol in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a vinyl group.

name: (S)-styrene oxide
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of styrene oxide.

name: guanethidine monosulfate
definition: A organic sulfate salt obtained from guanethidine and sulfuric acid in a 1:1 ratio.

name: guanethidine sulfate
definition: A organic sulfate salt composed of two molecules of guanethidine and one of sulfuric acid.

name: epinastine
definition: A benzazepine that is 6,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,e]azepine in which the azepine ring is fused to the e side of 4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-amine.

name: R-epinastine
definition: An epinastine that has R configuration at the chiral centre.

name: S-epinastine
definition: An epinastine that has S configuration at the chiral centre.

name: acamprosate
definition: An organosulfonic acid that is propane-1-sulfonic acid substituted by an acetylamino group at position 3.

name: cyclizine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt consisting of equimolar amounts of cyclizine and hydrogen chloride.

name: N-(3-acetamidopropyl)-4-aminobutanal
definition: The N-(3-acetamidopropyl)-derivative of 4-aminobutanal.

name: lucanthone
definition: A thioxanthen-9-one compound having a methyl substituent at the 1-position and a 2-[(diethylamino)ethyl]amino substituent at the 4-position. Formerly used for the treatment of schistosomiasis. It is a prodrug, being metabolised to hycanthone.

name: (S)-idazoxan
definition: An idazoxan that has S configuration.

name: (R)-idazoxan
definition: An idazoxan that has R configuration.

name: 9H-thioxanthene
definition: A thioxanthene that consists of a xanthene skeleton in which the oxygen atom is replaced by a sulfur atom.

name: 3-phenylpropionate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-phenylpropionic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (R)-colchicine
definition: A colchicine that has (R)-configuration.

name: 13-sophorosyloxydocosanoate 6',6''-diacetate
definition: A sophorolipid that is the diacetylated sophoroside of 13-hydroxydocosanoic acid. It is a major extracellular lipid.

name: GS26575
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is 1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a methylsulfanyl group at position 6 and a tert-buty group at the amino nitrogen atom.

name: copper(II) sulfide
definition: A copper sulfide in which the metal is in the +2 oxidation state.

name: copper(I) sulfide
definition: A copper sulfide in which the metal is in the +1 oxidation state.

name: nitroethene
definition: A nitroalkene having ethenyl as the alkene portion.

name: mianserin
definition: A dibenzoazepine (specifically 1,2,3,4,10,14b-hexahydrodibenzo[c,f]pyrazino[1,2-a]azepine) methyl-substituted on N-2. Closely related to (and now mostly superseded by) the tetracyclic antidepressant mirtazapinean, it is an atypical antidepressant used in the treatment of depression throughout Europe and elsewhere.

name: pramipexole hydrochloride
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate of the dihydrochloride salt of pramiprexole.

name: pramipexole hydrochloride anhydrous
definition: A hydrochloride that is the anhydrous dihydrochloride salt of pramipexole.

name: decasilsesquioxane cage
definition: A silsesquioxane cage consisting of two ten-membered rings of alternating silicon and oxygen atoms, with each silicon atom in one ring joined to a silicon in the second ring by a bridging oxygen atom and with a hydrogen atom attached to all ten silicon atoms.

name: dextropropoxyphene
definition: The (1S,2R)-(+)-diastereoisomer of propoxyphene.

name: histamine phosphate
definition: A phosphate salt that is the diphosphate salt of histamine.

name: cyclopropene
definition: A cycloalkene that consists of cyclopropane having a double bond in the ring. The parent of the class of cyclopropenes.

name: penicillin O
definition: A penicillin where the side-chain N-acyl group is specified as allylmercaptoacetyl. Antibiotic isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: mecillinam
definition: A penicillin in which the 6β substituent is [(azepan-1-yl)methylidene]amino; an extended-spectrum penicillin antibiotic that binds specifically to penicillin binding protein 2 (PBP2), and is only considered to be active against Gram-negative bacteria.

name: pseudoephedrine
definition: A member of the class of the class of phenylethanolamines that is (1S)-2-(methylamino)-1-phenylethan-1-ol in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a methyl group.

name: pivmecillinam
definition: A penicillanic acid ester that is the [(2,2-dimethylpropanoyl)oxy]methyl ester and prodrug of mecillinam.

name: alprenolol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is propan-2-ol substituted by a 2-allylphenoxy group at position 1 and an isopropylamino group at position 3. It is a β-adrenergic antagonist used as a antihypertensive, anti-arrhythmia and a sympatholytic agent.

name: Yo-Pro-1
definition: An unsymmetrical C1 cyanine dye having 1,3-benzoxazol-2-yl and quinolinium-4-yl substituents.

name: epicocconone
definition: A natural cell-permeable fluorescent compound isolated from the fungus Epicoccum nigrum.

name: carfenazine
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is 10H-phenothiazine which carries a propanoyl group at position 2 and a 3-[4-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazin-1-yl]propyl group at position N-10. It is an antipsychotic drug that is used for the treatment of chronic schizophrenia.

name: carphenazine maleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by combining carphenazine with two molar equivalents of maleic acid.

name: Alexa Fluor 594 meta-isomer
definition: The 5-succinimidyloxycarbonyl isomer of Alexa Fluor 594.

name: Alexa Fluor 594 para-isomer
definition: The 6-succinimidyloxycarbonyl isomer of Alexa Fluor 594.

name: amoxicillin trihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the trihydrate form of amoxicillin; a semisynthetic antibiotic, used either alone or in combination with potassium clavulanate (under the trade name Augmentin) for treatment of a variety of bacterial infections.

name: amoxicillin sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of amoxicillin.

name: 1,2,4-triazolidine
definition: A triazolidine that is cyclopentane in which the methylene groups at positions 1, 2 and 4 are replaced by NH groups

name: 2-amino-2,3,7-trideoxy-D-lyxo-hept-6-ulosonic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid derivative derivative that is a seven-membered ketoaldonic acid having an amino substituent at the 2-position and the 3- and 7-positions deoxygenated.

name: hydroxypyruvaldehyde phosphate
definition: A 2-oxo aldehyde consisting of pyruvaldehyde having a phosphooxy group at the 3-position.

name: 1-deoxy-D-threo-hexo-2,5-diulose 6-phosphate
definition: A ketohexose monophosphate having keto groups at the 2- and 5-positions, hydroxy groups at the 3- and 4-positions and the phosphate group at the 6-position.

name: anthracene-9,10-dinitrile
definition: An anthracenedinitrile carrying cyano groups at positions 9 and 10.

name: N2-succinyl-L-citrulline
definition: The N2-succinoyl derivative of L-citrulline.

name: dehypoxanthine futalosine
definition: An analogue of futalosine lacking the hypoxanthine moiety.

name: 1-vinylaziridine
definition: A vinylaziridine that consists of aziridine having a single vinyl group located at position 1.

name: 2-vinylaziridine
definition: A vinylaziridine that consists of aziridine having a single vinyl group located at position 2.

name: 2-vinylnaphthalene
definition: A vinylnaphthalene carrying a vinyl group at position 2.

name: esoxybutynin
definition: A 4-(diethylamino)but-2-yn-1-ol yhat has S configuration. In contrast to the (R)- enantiomer, esoxybutynin exhibits essentially no anticholinergic activity.

name: pristanic acid
definition: A branched, long-chain saturated fatty acid composed of pentadecanoic acid having methyl substituents at the 2-, 6-, 10- and 14-positions.

name: pristanoyl-CoA
definition: A multi-methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of pristanic acid.

name: tetraphene
definition: An angular ortho-fused polycyclic arene consisting of four fused benzene rings.

name: benzylpenicillin benzathine
definition: A benzathine(2+) salt in which the counter anions are benzylpenicillin(1−). Drug-of-choice when prolonged low concentrations of benzylpenicillin are required and appropriate.

name: zuclopenthixol
definition: The (Z)-isomer of clopenthixol.

name: 1,3-dinitrobenzene
definition: A dinitrobenzene that is benzene disubstituted at positions 1 and 3 with nitro groups.

name: 1,4-dinitrobenzene
definition: A dinitrobenzene carrying nitro groups at positions 1 and 4.

name: 1,4-phenylenediamine
definition: A phenylenediamine in which the amino functions are at positions 1 and 4 of the benzene nucleus.

name: (S)-carnitinium
definition: A carnitinium that is the conjugate acid of (S)-carnitine.

name: albaflavenone
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is (+)-epi-isozizaene in which the hydrogens at position 5 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: SYBR Green I
definition: A benzothiazolium ion resulting from the methylation of the nitrogen of the benzothiazole group of N-[4-(1,3-benzothiazol-2-ylmethylene)-1-phenyl-1,4-dihydroquinolin-2-yl]-N',N'-dimethyl-N-propylpropane-1,3-diamine. A cationic unsymmetrical cyanine dye that binds to double-stranded DNA and is used as a nucleic acid stain in molecular biology.

name: PicoGreen
definition: A cyanine dye that is 1-phenylquinoline which is substituted at position 2 by a bis[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]amino group and at position 4 by a (3-methyl-1,3-benzothiazol-3-ium-2-yl)methylene group. The counter ion is not stated. A fluorochrome that selectively binds double-stranded DNA and has characteristics similar to that of SYBR-Green I.

name: FUN-1
definition: Halogenated cyanine compound that binds nucleic acids.

name: ethynyllithium
definition: An alkynyllithium compound resulting from the replacement of one of the hydrogens of acetylene by lithium.

name: (CS)2Ir(μ-Cl)2Ir(CS)2
definition: μ-chloro-bridged dimer of iridium(III) bis [3-(benzothiazol-2-yl)-7-(diethylamino)coumarin)]

name: benzil
definition: An α-diketone that is ethane-1,2-dione substituted by phenyl groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively.

name: 1,2-benzoxazole
definition: A benzoxazole in which the benzene ring is fused to a 1,2-oxazole ring across positions 4 and 5.

name: 2,1-benzoxazole
definition: A benzoxazole in which the benzene ring is fused to a 1,2-oxazole ring across positions 3 and 4.

name: 3-bromopyridine
definition: A monobromopyridine in which the bromo substituent is located at position 3.

name: biphenylacetylene
definition: An arylacetylene that is acetylene in which the hydrogens are replaced by phenyl groups.

name: subphthalocyanine
definition: A cyclic tripyrrole derivative that consists of three isoindole-type units, with the connecting carbon atoms replaced by nitrogen. The parent of the class of subphthalocyanines.

name: superphthalocyanine
definition: A cyclic pentapyrrole derivative that consists of five isoindole-type units, with the connecting carbon atoms replaced by nitrogen. The parent of the class of superphthalocyanines.

name: 2-methylbenzoxazole
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-benzoxazoles that is 1,3-benzoxazole substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: Yo-Pro-3
definition: An unsymmetrical C3 cyanine dye having 1,3-benzoxazol-2-yl and quinolinium-4-yl substituents.

name: yakima yellow phosphoramidite
definition: A fluorescent dye having an absorption wavelength of 530 nm and an emission wavelength of 550 nm, derived from fluorescein.

name: 5-carboxy-X-rhodamine
definition: An X-rhodamine compound having a carboxy substituent at the 5-position.

name: 5-carboxy-X-rhodamine triethylammonium salt
definition: An X-rhodamine triethylammonium salt having a carboxy substituent at the 5-position.

name: 5-carboxytetramethylrhodamine
definition: A tetramethylrhodamine compound having a carboxy substituent at the 5-position

name: 9,10-diphenylanthracene
definition: A member of the class of anthracenes that is anthracene in which both of the hydrogens on the central ring are substituted by phenyl groups.

name: 4-methyl-2,3-dihydrofuran
definition: A dihydrofuran that is 2,3-dihydrofuran substituted by a methyl group at position 4.

name: haematoxylin
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound 7,11b-dihydroindeno[2,1-c]chromene carrying five hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 4, 6a, 9 and 10. The most important and most used dye in histology, histochemistry, histopathology and in cytology.

name: chrysene
definition: An ortho-fused polycyclic arene found commonly in the coal tar.

name: dodecaboride(2−)
definition: An inorganic anion that is a polyboron cluster made up from twelve boron atoms with a net charge of -2.

name: acridine orange
definition: Fluorescent dye useful for cell cycle determination. It is cell-permeable, and interacts with DNA and RNA by intercalation or electrostatic attractions respectively.

name: ethyl propiolate
definition: The ethyl ester of prop-2-ynoic acid.

name: Alexa Fluor 405
definition: A fluorescent dye of absorption wavelength 401 nm and emission wavelength 421 nm derived from tris(triethylammonium)-8-hydroxypyrene-1,3,6-trisulfonate.

name: Alexa Fluor 480
definition: A fluorescent dye derived from a 3,6-diaminoxanthenium-4,5-disulphate.

name: cellocidin
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide resulting from the formal condensation of both of the carboxy groups of butynedioic acid with ammonia. An antibacterial agent produced by Streptomyces chibaensis.

name: Alexa Fluor 568 para-isomer
definition: The 6-succinimidyloxycarbonyl isomer of Alexa Fluor 568.

name: Alexa Fluor 568 ortho-isomer
definition: The 5-succinimidyloxycarbonyl isomer of Alexa Fluor 568.

name: (1S,2R)-1-C-(indol-3-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate
definition: The (1S,2R)-diastereomer of 1-C-(indol-3-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate.

name: 4H-imidazole
definition: Imidazole tautomer which has the migrating hydrogen at position 4.

name: temocillin
definition: A penicillin compound having a 6α-methoxy and 6β-[2-carboxy(thiophen-3-yl)acetamido side-groups.

name: 3,7-dideoxy-D-threo-hepto-2,6-diuolosonic acid
definition: The D-threo-isomer of a ketoaldonic acid compound.

name: N-(3-aminopropyl)-4-aminobutanal
definition: The N-(3-aminopropyl) derivative of 4-aminobutanal.

name: microthecin
definition: A metabolite isolated from morels (e.g. Morchella costata) and red algae (e.g. Gracilariopsis lemaneiformis).

name: 3,3'-biflaviolin
definition: A ring assembly compound consisting of two flaviolin units joined by a 3,3'-linkage.

name: 3,8'-biflaviolin
definition: A ring assembly compound consisting of two flaviolin units joined by a 3,8'-linkage.

name: bromoacetone
definition: An α-bromoketone that is acetone in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a bromine atom. A poweful lachrymator, it was formerly used as a chemical weapon.

name: phenacyl bromide
definition: An α-bromoketone that is acetophenone substituted by a bromo group at position 2.

name: methyl pyruvate
definition: A pyruvate ester resultinf grom the formal condensation of the carboxy group of pyruvic acid with the hydroxy group of methanol.

name: methyl (S)-phenyl[(S)-piperidin-2-yl]acetate

name: cis-azoxybenzene

name: auramine O

name: tetrahydroasterriquinone

name: C5-indocyanine

name: C7-indocyanine

name: C7-oxacyanine

name: calcein red-orange

name: ethyl phenylcyanoacetate

name: butyronitrile

name: tetrabutylammonium bromide

name: fulvalene

name: fulvene

name: Cy3B dye NHS ester

A histamine H1 antagonist, it is used to relieve the symptoms of hay fever, rhinitis, urticaria, and asthma.
