name: phenylacetone

name: eosin YS dye
definition: An organic sodium salt that is 2',4',5',7'-tetrabromofluorescein in which the carboxy group and the phenolic hydroxy group have been deprotonated and the resulting charge is neutralised by two sodium ions.

definition: A penicillin compound having a 6β-(2R)-2-(methylideneamino)-2-phenylacetamido side-group.

name: ethyl eosin
definition: An organic potassium salt having 2,4,5,7-tetrabromo-9-{2-[(ethyloxy)carbonyl]phenyl}-3-oxo-3H-xanthen-6-olate as the counterion.

name: parbenate
definition: A benzoate ester that is ethyl benzoate substituted by a dimethylamino group at position 4.

name: FM 4-64 dye
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt A liphophilic dye consisting of a dication that is N,N-dibutyl-4-[6-(pyridin-4-yl)hexa-1,3,5-trien-1-yl]aniline in which the nitrogen of the pyridine moiety is substituted by a 3-(triethylammonio)propyl group and two bromide ions. It is used to selectively stain yeast vacuolar membranes with red fluorescence.

name: N-acetyl-D-hexosamine 1-phosphate
definition: A hexosamine phosphate having the phospho group at the 1-position.

name: fura red
definition: A 1-benzofuran substituted at position 2 by a (5-oxo-2-thioxoimidazolidin-4-ylidene)methyl group, and at C-5 and C-6 by heavily substituted oxygen and nitrogen functionalities respectively.

name: glyceollin III

name: methoxide

name: ethoxide

name: sodium ethoxide

name: lissamine rhodamine
definition: An organic sodium salt having 4-[3,6-bis(diethylamino)xanthenium-9-yl]benzene-1,3-disulfonate as the counterion.

name: biotin-valyl-alanyl-aspartyl-fluoromethyl ketone
definition: A cell permeable inhibitor for caspase proteases.

name: benethamine

name: 2-diethylaminoethanol

name: procaine(1+)

name: 7-nitrobenzoxadiazole-6-aminohexanoic acid
definition: A benzoxadiazole that is 2,1,3-benzoxadiazole which is substituted at positions 4 and 7 by (5-carboxypentyl)amino and nitro groups, respectively.

name: nile blue A
definition: An organic chloride salt having 5-amino-9-(diethylamino)benzo[a]phenoxazin-7-ium as the couterion. fluorescent dye which is also a potent photosensitiser for photodynamic therapy.

name: nile blue(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is 6a,12a-dihydrobenzo[a]phenoxazin-7-ium substituted by amino and dimethylamino groups at positions 5 and 9 respectively. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'nile blue A'

name: nile red

name: p-quaterphenyl

name: 1,4-diphenylbenzene

name: platinum(II) 5,10,15,20-tetrakis-(2,3,4,5,6-pentafluorophenyl)porphyrin
definition: A platinum(II) porphyrin compound having four pentafluorophenyl substituents in the 5-, 10-, 15-, and 20-positions.

name: QPYMe2 fluorescent dye
definition: A pyridinium ion that is the dimethyl derivative of 6-(dimethylamino)-2,10-bis(pyridine-4-yl)imidazo[1,5-a:3,4-a']dipyridin-5-ium.

name: quinine sulfate
definition: A organic sulfate salt obtained from guanethidine and sulfuric acid in a 2:1 ratio.

name: rose bengal
definition: An organic potassium salt that is the dipotassium salt of 2,3,4,5-tetrachloro-6-(2,4,5,7-tetraiodo-6-hydroxy-3-oxoxanthen-9-yl)benzoic acid.

name: sodium-binding benzofuran isophthalate
definition: A crown compound that is 1,4,10-trioxa-7,13-diazacyclopentadecane in which the hydrogens of the amino groups at position 7 and 13 are replaced by 2-(2,4-dicarboxyphenyl)-5-methoxy-1-benzofuran-6-yl groups. It is a cell-impermeant fluorescent sodium indicator.

name: squarylium dye III

name: 1D-myo-inositol 2-amino-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranoside

name: 1D-myo-inositol 2-(L-cysteinylamino)-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A 2-deoxy-α-D-glucoside having an L-cysteinylamino group at the 2-position and an inosityl group attached at the 1-position.

name: norbornene

name: thiazole orange

name: thionine
definition: An organic chloride salt composed of 3,7-diaminophenothiazin-5-ium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio. A strongly metachromatic dye, useful for the staining of acid mucopolysaccharides. It is also a common nuclear stain and can be used for the demonstration of Nissl substance in nerve cells of the CNS.

name: To-Pro-1
definition: A C1 cyanine dye having benzothiazolium-2-yl and quinolinium-4-yl substituents.

name: To-Pro-3
definition: An unsymmetrical C3 cyanine dye having benzothiazolium-2-yl and quinolinium-4-yl substituents.

name: ethyl formate
definition: A formate ester resulting from the formal condensation of formic acid with ethanol.

name: 3-hydroxyicosanoic acid
definition: A long-chain fatty acid that is icosanoic acid carrying a 3-hydroxy substituent.

name: 3-hydroxytetracosanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acid that is the 3-hydroxy derivative of tetracosanoic (lignoceric) acid.

name: 3-oxoicosanoic acid

name: 3-oxodocosanoic acid
definition: The 3-oxo monocarboxylic acid which has docasanoic (behenic) acid as the parent acid.

name: chlorine perchlorate
definition: A chlorine oxide that is the chloro derivative of perchloric acid.

name: tris(2,2'-bipyridine)ruthenium(II) dichloride
definition: A ruthenium coordination entity consisting of ruthenium(II) chloride bound to three 2,2'-bipyridine units.

name: tris(4,4'-diphenyl-2,2'-bipyridine)ruthenium(II) chloride
definition: A ruthenium coordination entity consisting of ruthenium(II) chloride bound to three 4,4'-diphenyl-2,2'-bipyridine units.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1+)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both oleoyl.

name: 1-naphthaldehyde

name: 2-naphthaldehyde
definition: A naphthaldehyde that is naphthalene substituted by a formyl group at position 2.

name: N-(2-hydroxytetracosanoyl)sphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytetracosanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanyl)-(4R)-phytosphingosine
definition: An N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl)phytosphingosine in which the 4-hydroxy group on the phytosphingosine portion has R-configuration.

name: hexadec-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: A hexadecenoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of hexadec-2-enoic acid.

name: hexanitroplatinate(2−)
definition: A nitrometallate anion that consists of six nitro groups covalently bound to a central Pt2− species.

name: 4-hydroxymethylzymosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is zymosterol which carries a hyroxymethyl group at position 4.

name: 2-arachidonoylglycerol

name: tetracyanoquinodimethane

definition: A norterpene that is an acyclic saturated hydrocarbon derived from phytane by loss of its C-16 terminal methyl group.

name: (C5Me5)2U[=N-2,6-(i-Pr)2C6H3](SePh)
definition: A uranium coordination entity consisting of uranium(V) bound to two pentamethylcyclopentadienyl groups, a 2,6-diisopropylanilino group (via a U=N bond) and a phenylselenyl group.

name: (C5Me5)2U[=N-2,6-(i-Pr)2C6H3](SPh)
definition: A uranium coordination entity consisting of uranium(V) bound to two pentamethylcyclopentadienyl groups, a 2,6-diisopropylanilino group (via a U=N bond) and a phenylthio group.

name: phenyl N-(methylsulfonyl)imidoformate
definition: An N-sulfonylimidate compound having S-methyl and O-phenyl substituents.

name: N-chlorosuccinimide
definition: A five-membered cyclic dicarboximide compound having a chloro substituent on the nitrogen atom.

name: N-iodosuccinimide
definition: A five-membered cyclic dicarboximide compound having an iodo substituent on the nitrogen atom.

name: cis-tetradec-7-enoic acid
definition: A tetradecenoic acid having a cis-double bond at the 7-position.

name: all-trans-1,6-seco-1,2-didehydroretinal
definition: A seco retinoid formed by fission of the cyclohexene ring with addition of a hydrogen atom at each terminal group thus created.

name: S-2-(dimethylamino)ethyl thiosulfate
definition: An S-alkyl thiosulfate having 2-(dimethylamino)ethyl as the alkyl group.

name: tetrapropylammonium perruthenate
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt having tetrapropylammonium as the cation and perruthenate as the anion.

name: O-propanoyl-L-carnitine
definition: An optically active O-acylcarnitine compound having propanoyl as the acyl substituent and (R)-configuration at the 3-position.

name: O-propanoyl-D-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-D-carnitine in which the acyl group specified is propanoyl.

name: isophorone diisocyanate
definition: A diisocyanate in which the two isocyanate groups are linked by an isophorone substituent.

name: semi-β-carotenone
definition: A carotenone compound arising from oxidative cleavage of the 5',6'-double bond.

name: dicyclohexylmethane-4,4'-diisocyanate
definition: A diisocyanate consisting of dicyclohexylmethane with two isocyanate groups at the 4- and 4'-positions.

name: citranaxanthin
definition: An apo carotenoid compound arising from oxidative degradation of the β,β-carotene skeleton at the 1'- and 6'-positions.

name: diphenylmethane-4,4'-diisocyanate
definition: A diisocyanate consisting of diphenylmethane with two isocyanate groups at the 4- and 4'-positions.

name: 6'-apo-β-carotenal
definition: An apo carotenoid compound arising from oxidative degradation of the β,β-carotene skeleton at the 6'-position.

name: 1-(2,6,6-trimethylcyclohex-2-en-1-yl)but-2-enone
definition: An enone with a trimethylcyclohexenyl substituent at C-1.

name: 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide
definition: The bromide salt of 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium.

name: captopril disulfide
definition: An organic disulfide in which the disulfide bond links two units of captopril. It is a secondary metabolite of captopril.

name: 4-sulfanilamidobenzoic acid
definition: A sulfonamide that is sulfanilamide substituted at the sulfonamide nitrogen by a 4-carboxyphenyl group.

name: 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium
definition: An organic cation that is tetrazolium substituted with a dimethylthiazolyl group and two phenyl groups. The cation exists in two resonance forms.

name: dibenzothiazol-2-yl disulfide
definition: An organic disulfide resulting from the formal oxidative coupling of the thiol groups of two molecules of 1,3-benzothiazole-2-thiol. It is used as an accelerator in the rubber industry.

name: sodium citrate
definition: The trisodium salt of citric acid.

name: poly(propylene glycol) macromolecule
definition: A macromolecule composed of repeating propyleneoxy units.

name: esperamicin A1
definition: A naturally occurring antibiotic and antitumor agent isolated from Actinomadura verrucosopora. Its chemical structure consists of a core bicyclo[7.3.1]tridecadiynene moiety containing a 1,5-diyn-3-ene as part of a ten-membered ring, a α,β-unsaturated ketone with a bridgehead double bond and an attached allylic trisulfide. This ring system is attached at one end by a trisaccharide moiety and at the opposite end by a 2-deoxy-L-fucose-anthranilate moiety. The trisaccharide consists of a hydroxyamino sugar which is connected to a isopropylamino sugar through a glycosidic linkage and a thiomethyl sugar through an NH‒O linkage.

name: ethyl glyoxylate
definition: The ethyl ester of glyoxylic acid.

name: donepezil
definition: A racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-donepezil. A centrally acting reversible acetylcholinesterase inhibitor, its main therapeutic use is in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease where it is used to increase cortical acetylcholine.

name: (S)-donepezil
definition: A 2-[(1-benzylpiperidin-4-yl)methyl]-5,6-dimethoxyindan-1-one that has S configuration.

name: (R)-donepezil
definition: A 2-[(1-benzylpiperidin-4-yl)methyl]-5,6-dimethoxyindan-1-one that has R configuration.

name: sodium alginate
definition: A copolymer macromolecule composed of homopolymeric blocks of 1→4-linked homopolymeric blocks of 1→4-linked sodium β-D-mannuronate and sodium α-L-guluronate residues, covalently linked together in different sequences or blocks. The sodium salt of alginic acid.

name: 6-azido-6-deoxycellulose
definition: A (1→4)-β-D-glucan compound composed of repeating β-(1→4)-linked 6-azido-6-deoxyglucose units.

name: nitrocellulose
definition: A (1→4)-β-D-glucan compound formed by nitrating cellulose through exposure to nitric acid or another powerful nitrating agent.

name: 3,4-dihydroxymandelate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3,4-dihydroxymandelic acid.

name: tetraoxacalix[2]arene[2]triazine
definition: A heterocalix[4]aromatic compound composed of alternating 1,3-phenylene and 1,3,5-triazin-2,6-yl groups connected by ether linkages.

name: tetraazacalix[2]arene[2]triazine
definition: A heterocalix[4]aromatic compound composed of alternating 1,3-phenylene and 1,3,5-triazin-2,6-yl groups connected by amine linkages.

name: anthra[2,3-b]benzo[d]thiophene
definition: A heteroacene compound consisting of benzothiophene fused to anthracene in a rectilinear arrangement.

name: 2,9-diamino-5,7-bis(trimethylsilyl)benzo[a]pyrimido[2,1,6-cd]pyrrolizine-3,4,8-tricarbonitrile
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound consisting of a benzo[a]pyrimido[2,1,6-cd]pyrrolizine ring system having amino substituents at the 2- and 9-positions, trimethylsilyl substituents at the 5- and 7-positions and cyano substituents at the 3-, 4- and 8-postions.

name: (S)-3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid
definition: The S enantiomer of 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate
definition: The conjugate base of 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid.

name: sodium 2,4-dinitrobenzenesulfonate
definition: The organic sodium salt of 2,4-dinitrobenzenesulfonic acid.

name: chromium(3+) trichloride
definition: A chromium chloride with the chromium cation in the +3 oxidation state.

name: poly(ethylene glycol) methyl ether methacrylate
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) compound having a methacrylate group at the α-terminus and a methyl group at the ω-terminus.

name: 1-benzyl-2-chloromethylimidazole hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of 1-benzyl-2-chloromethylimidazole.

name: ω-hydroxypoly(furan-2,5-diylmethylene) macromolecule
definition: A macromolecule composed of repeating 2-methylfuran units and terminated with a hydroxy group at the methylene end.

name: γ-poly(glutamic acid) macromolecule
definition: A macromolecule composed of repeating 2-amino-5-oxopentanoic acid units.

name: γ-poly(L-glutamic acid) macromolecule
definition: A macromolecule composed of repeating γ-linked L-glutamyl units.

name: γ-poly(D-glutamic acid) macromolecule
definition: A biomacromolecule comprised of repeating D-glutamic acid residues linked by peptidic bonds between the amino and γ-carboxy groups.

name: poly(ethylene glycol dimethacrylate)
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) compound terminated with methacrylate groups.

name: poly(ethylene glycol diacrylate)
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) compound terminated with acrylate groups.

name: cis-1,4-polyisoprene
definition: A polymer composed of repeating cis-2-methylbut-2-ene units.

name: polysorbate 40
definition: A polymer composed of PEG-ylated sorbitan, where the total number of poly(ethylene glycol) units is 20 (w + x + y + z = 20) and a single terminal is capped by a palmitoyl group.

name: polysorbate 20
definition: A polymer composed of PEG-ylated sorbitan, where the total number of poly(ethylene glycol) units is 20 (w + x + y + z = 20) and a single terminal is capped by a dodecanoyl group.

name: polysorbate 60
definition: A polymer composed of PEG-ylated sorbitan, where the total number of poly(ethylene glycol) units is 20 (w + x + y + z = 20) and a single terminal is capped by a stearate group.

name: polysorbate 80
definition: A polymer composed of PEG-ylated sorbitan, where the total number of poly(ethylene glycol) units is 20 (w + x + y + z = 20) and a single terminal is capped by an oleoyl group.

name: 1-benzyl-2-chloromethylimidazole
definition: An imidazole derivative containing benzyl and chloromethyl substituents at positions 1 and 2, respectively.

name: palladium(II) chloride
definition: A palladium coordination entity consisting of palladium(II) bound to two chlorine atoms.

name: ethylene glycol dimethacrylate
definition: The enoate ester that is the 1,2-bis(methacryloyl) derivative of ethylene glycol.

name: nickel sulfate hexahydrate

name: iron(3+) sulfate
definition: A compound of iron and sulfate in which the ratio of iron(3+) to sulfate ions is 3:2.

name: 2-hydroxypropyl methacrylate
definition: An enoate ester that is the 1-methacryloyl derivative of propane-1,2-diol.

name: chromium(3+) trichloride hexahydrate
definition: The hexahydrate of chromium(3+) trichloride.

name: potassium dichromate
definition: A potassium salt that is the dipotassium salt of dichromic acid.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of two D-mannopyranose residues joined via an α-(1→6)-linkage.

name: methyl cellulose
definition: A (1→4)-β-D-glucan compound formed by methylating cellulose through exposure to NaOH/CH3Cl.

name: methoxypoly(ethylene glycol)
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) derivative that is poly(ethylene glycol) in which one of the terminal hydroxy groups has been converted into the corresponding methyl ether.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of two D-mannopyranose residues joined via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: N-(1-naphthyl)ethylenediamine dihydrochloride
definition: An ethylenediamine dihydrochloride compound having an N-(1-naphthyl) substituent.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose consisting of a mannose residue having two further mannose residues attached via α-(1→3)- and α-(1→6)-linkages.

name: 5,8,11-icosatriynoic acid
definition: A C20 polyunsaturated fatty acid having three triple bonds in the 5-, 8- and 11-positions.

name: D-xylopyranose
definition: D-Xylose in its pyranose form.

name: α-L-Fuc-(1→3)-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)]-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched pentasaccharide consisting of an D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a β-D-Xyl(1→2)-β-D-Man(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and a D-Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched pentasaccharide consisting of a D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with an α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4) linkage.

name: hydroxycitronellal
definition: The tertiary alcohol arising from addition of water across the C=C double bond of citronellal.

name: all-cis-icosa-11,14,17-trienoic acid
definition: An icosatrienoic acid having three cis- double bonds at positions 11, 14 and 17.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched heptasaccharide derivative consisting of a GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a Man-α(1→6)-[Xyl-β(1→2)-Man-α(1→3)]-Man-β(1→4)-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and a Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→6)-linkage.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide compound consisting of the linear trisaccharide β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine in which the mannosyl residue has a β-D-xylosyl residue attached at position 2 as well as two α-D-mannosyl residues at positions 3 and 6.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide compound consisting of a GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a Man-α(1→3)-[Man-α(1→6)]-Man-β(1→4)-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and a Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched heptasaccharide derivative consisting of a D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with an α-D-Man-(1→6)-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)]-[α-D-Man-(1→3)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a (1→4)-linkage and an L-Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide consisting of a GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a Man-α(1→6)-[Xyl-β(1→2)]-Man-β(1→4)-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and a Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: cobalt(2+) sulfate
definition: A compound of cobalt and sulfate in which the ratio of cobalt (+2 oxidation state) to sulfate is 1:1.

name: chromium(III) sulfate
definition: A compound of chromium and sulfate in which the ratio of chromium (in the +3 oxidation state) to sulfate is 2:3

name: copper(I) chloride
definition: An inorganic chloride of copper in which the metal is in the +1 oxidation state.

name: beryllium sulfate
definition: A metal sulfate in which the metal is beryllium (in the +2 oxidation state) and the ratio of beryllium to sulfate is 1:1.

name: lithium sulfate
definition: A metal sulfate in which the counterion is lithium and the ratio of lithium to sulfate is 2:1.

name: zirconyl chloride
definition: A zirconium coordination entity consisting of zirconium(IV) bound to oxygen via a double bond and to two chlorines.

name: N-acetyl-D-galactosaminitol
definition: A 2-deoxyhexitol derivative that is galactitol in which the 2-hydroxy substituent is replaced by an acetamido group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc having β-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: 2-O-(N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl)-L-fucitol
definition: A 2-deoxy-D-galactoside consisting of N-acetyl-D-galactosamine attached to L-fucitol via an α-(1→2)-linkage.

name: 3-O-(N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl)-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminitol
definition: A 2-deoxy-D-glucoside consisting of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine attached to N-acetyl-D-galactosaminitol via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-(N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl)-(1→3)-N-acetyl-D-galactosaminitol
definition: An amino disaccharide compound consisting of N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine attached to N-acetyl-D-galactosaminitol via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoic acid
definition: An icosatrienoic acid having three cis double bonds at positions 8, 11 and 14.

name: all-cis-docosa-7,10,13,16-tetraenoic acid
definition: The all-cis-isomer of a C22 polyunsaturated fatty acid having four double bonds in the 7-, 10-, 13- and 16-positions. One of the most abundant fatty acids in the early human brain.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoic acid
definition: The all-cis-isomer of a C22 polyunsaturated fatty acid having five double bonds in the 7-, 10-, 13-, 16- and 19-positions.

name: D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[D-GalNAc-(1→4)]-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-D-GalNAc-ol
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[D-GalNAc-(1→4)]-D-GalNAc moiety attached to N-acetyl-D-galactosaminitol via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: N-formyl-L-methionyl-L-leucyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-Met, L-Leu and L-Phe in a linear sequence with a formyl group at the amino terminus. It acts as a potent inducer of leucocyte chemotaxis and macrophage activator as well as a ligand for the FPR receptor.

name: poly(D,L-lactic acid-co-glycolic acid)
definition: A copolymer composed of 2-hydroxypropanoyl and 2-hydroxyacetyl units.

name: D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[D-GalNAc-(1→2)-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-D-GalNAc-ol
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide compound consisting of a D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[D-GalNAc-(1→2)-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-D-GlcNAc moiety attached to N-acetyl-D-galactosaminitol via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: D-GalNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[D-GalNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalNAc-ol
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative consisting of -D-GalNAc-ol at the reducing end with two D-GalNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc moities attached via (1→3)- and (1→6)-linkages.

name: triacetylcellulose
definition: A (1→4)-β-D-glucan compound formed by total acetylation of cellulose.

name: D-GalNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)-[D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[L-Fuc-(1→3)]-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)]-D-GalNAc-ol
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative consisting of -D-GalNAc-ol at the reducing end with a D-GalNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a (1→6)-linkage and a [D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[L-Fuc-(1→3)]-D-GlcNAc] moiety attached via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[L-Fuc-(1→3)]D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[L-Fuc-(1→3)]-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalNAc-ol
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative consisting of -D-GalNAc-ol at the reducing end with two[D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[L-Fuc-(1→3)]-D-GlcNAc] moieties attached via (1→3)- and (1→6)-linkages.

name: D-GalNAc-(1→3)-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[D-GalNAc-(1→2)-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[L-Fuc-(1→6)]-D-GalNAc-ol

name: beryllium sulfate tetrahydrate

name: cobalt chloride hexahydrate
definition: A hydrate of cobalt chloride containing cobalt (in +2 oxidation state), chloride and water moieties in the ratio 1:2:6.

name: nickel sulfate heptahydrate
definition: A hydrate of nickel sulfate containing nickel (in +2 oxidation state), sulfate and water moieties in the ratio 1:1:7.

name: 2-methoxypropane
definition: An ether compound having methyl and isopropyl as the two alkyl groups.

name: 2,4,5-trinitrobenzenesulfonic acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is benzene with a sulfo group at position 1 and three nitro substituents in the 2-, 4- and 5-positions.

name: thyroxine sulfate
definition: An iodothyronine having iodo substituents in the 3-, 3'-, 5- and 5'-positions and a sulfate group attached to the phenol function.

name: erlotinib hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of erlotinib.

name: N-(1-naphthyl)ethylenediamine
definition: An N-substituted ethylenediamine compound having 1-naphthyl as the substituent.

name: pluronic P-123
definition: A triblock copolymer composed of a central hydrophobic chain of poly(propylene oxide) (70 units) flanked by two hydrophilic chains of poly(ethylene oxide) (20 units each). A polymer with the formula HO[CH2CH2O]2O[CH2CH(CH3)O]70[CH2CH2O]2OH.

name: poly(styrene-co-methacrylic acid)
definition: A copolymer composed of 2-methylpropanoic acid and ethylbenzene units.

name: α-tritiated thymidine
definition: A tritiated thymidine having the tritium label on the methyl group of the nucleobase.

name: (E,E)-2-methyl-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienol
definition: The 7-hydroxy derivative of (3E)-6-methylhepta-3,5-dien-2-one.

name: diamino-poly(ethylene glycol)
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) terminated with -NH2 groups.

name: nickel chloride hexahydrate
definition: A hydrate of nickel chloride containing nickel (in the +2 oxidation state), chloride and water moeities in the ratio 1:2:6.

name: methyl 3-({2-[(2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-β-D-galactopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl)oxy]ethyl}sulfanyl)propanoate
definition: A tripartite compound comprising an α-D-Gal unit linked to β-D-GlcNAc, which is in turn linked to a CETE (2-[(2-carbomethoxyethylthio)]ethyl; 2-{[2-(methoxycarbonyl)ethylsulfanyl]}ethyl) moiety.

definition: A branched pentasaccharide comprising a linear chain of α-L-fucosyl, β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and α-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4), to the glucosaminyl residue of which is also linked (1→3) an α-D-galactosyl residue.

name: 2-(chloromethyl)-4,5-dihydroimidazole
definition: An imidazoline that is 4,5-dihydroimidazole bearing a chloromethyl substituent at position 2.

name: 2-(chloromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazole hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt having 2-(chloromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazole as the basic component.

name: 4,4'-azodibenzenearsonic acid
definition: The monoazo compound formed from arsanilic acid. It is used as an immunologic research tool.

name: toluene 2,4-diisocyanate

name: toluene 2,6-diisocyanate
definition: A toluene meta-diisocyanate in which the isocyanato groups are at positions 2 and 6 relative to the methyl group on the benzene ring.

name: D-lysine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of D-lysine.

name: (R)-gatifloxacin

name: (S)-gatifloxacin
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of gatifloxacin.

name: pyrimidine-2-thiol
definition: Pyrimidine substituted at C-2 by a sulfanyl group.

name: pyrimidin-2-ol

name: hexamethylene diisocyanate
definition: A diisocyanate compound with the two isocyanates linked by a hexane-1,6-diyl group.

name: pholcodine
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is a derivative of morphine with a 2-morpholinoethyl group at the 3-position.

name: 4-(ethoxymethylene)-2-(2-furyl)oxazol-5-one
definition: A 1,3-oxazole compound having a 2-furyl substituent at the 2-position, an ethoxymethylene group at the 4-position, and an oxo group at the 5-position.

name: cetyltrimethylammonium chloride

name: quaternium-52

name: O-(N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl)-L-serine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-amino acid that is N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine linked via an α glycosidic bond to the O at position 3 of L-serine.

name: O-(N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl)-L-threonine
definition: A L-threonine derivative that is N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine linked via an α glycosidic bond to the O at position 3 of L-threonine.

name: O-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl]-L-serine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine linked via an α glycosidic bond to the O at position 3 of L-serine.

name: O-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl]-L-threonine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine linked via an α glycosidic bond to the O at position 3 of L-threonine.

name: squaric acid dibutyl ester
definition: A cyclic ketone and diether that is a dibutyl ether derivative of squaric acid.

name: 2,5-dimethyl-p-phenylenediamine
definition: A primary arylamine that is p-xylene substituted at the 2 and 5 positions by amino groups. It is formally a reduction product of 2,5-dimethyl-1,4-benzoquinonediimine.

name: 2-methyl-2-oxazoline
definition: A 5-membered heterocyclic compound, which is substituted in the 2-position with a methyl group and which is often used as a monomer in polymerisation reactions.

name: Bismark brown Y
definition: A hydrochloride that is the dihydrochloride of 4,4'-[1,3-phenylenebis(diazene-2,1-diyl)]di(benzene-1,3-diamine). Bismarck brown Y is a metachromatic dye which stains acid mucins yellow. It is also a constituent of Papanicolaou's EA solutions, used for cervical, and other smears.

name: 4,4'-diaminoazobenzene
definition: Azobenzene substituted at each of the phenyl 4-positions by an amino group.

name: 4-(2-hydroxy-5-methylphenylazo)acetanilide
definition: An azo dye with a structure consisting of acetanilide substituted on the 4-position of the phenyl group with a 6-hydroxy-m-tolylazo group.

name: 2-methyl-1,4-phenylenediamine
definition: A diamine in which the two amino groups are substituted into toluene at the 2- and 5-positions.

name: methylisothiazolinone
definition: A 1,2-thazole that is 4-isothiazolin-3-one bearing a methyl group on the nitrogen atom. It is a powerful biocide and preservative and is the minor active ingredient in the commercial product KathonTM.

name: chloromethylisothiazolinone
definition: A 1,2-thiazole that is 4-isothiazolin-3-one bearing a methyl group on the nitrogen atom and a chlorine at C-5. It is a powerful biocide and preservative and is the major active ingredient in the commercial product KathonTM.

name: sodium aurothiosulfate
definition: An inorganic salt of sodium, the anion of which is the aurothiosulfate(3−) linear coordination complex.

name: aurothiosulfate(3−)
definition: An inorganic anion that is a linear coordination complex of gold(I) bound to two thiosulfate ligands.

name: ethylenediamine dihydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride that is the dihydrochloride of ethylenediamine.

name: agatharesinol
definition: A major heartwood norlignan characterised by a core trans-3-p-hydroxyphenyl-1-phenylpropene structural unit.

name: L-lysine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of L-lysine

name: neomycin C
definition: A tetracyclic antibacterial agent derived from neomycin, being a glycoside ester of neamine and neobiosamine C.

name: neamine sulfate
definition: An aminoglycoside sulfate salt that is the sulfate salt of neamine; a component of neomycin sulfate.

name: neomycin B sulfate
definition: The aminoglycoside sulfate salt that is the sulfate salt of neomycin B; a component of neomycin sulfate.

name: neomycin C sulfate
definition: The aminoglycoside sulfate salt that is the sulfate salt of neomycin C; a component of neomycin sulfate.

name: phyllocladan-16α-ol
definition: A kaurane diterpenoid compound having a 16α-hydroxy substituent.

name: sequirin C
definition: A norlignan that is a derivative of agatharesinol in which the aromatic ring B has an additional hydroxy substituent ortho to the one present in the parent compound.

name: sugiresinol
definition: A norlignan that is an isomer of agatharesinol in which the dihydroxypentene side chain is cyclised.

name: hydroxysugiresinol
definition: A norlignan that is a derivative of sugiresinol in which the aromatic ring B has an additional hydroxy substituent.

name: dehydroglycine
definition: A dehydroamino acid derived from glycine.

name: 3,5-dinitrosalicylic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid consisting of 2-hydroxybenzoic acid having nitro substituents at the 3- and 5-positions. It is used in colorimetric testing for the presence of free carbonyl groups (C=O) in reducing sugars.

name: N-(2,4-dinitro-6-carboxy)phenyl-1.6-diaminohexane
definition: An N-substituted diamine that consists of 1,6-hexanediamine bearing a 2,4-dinitro-6-carboxyphenyl substituent.

name: guaiacylglycerol-β-guaiacyl ether
definition: A glycerol ether in which guaiacyl and guaiacylglycerol subunits are joined by an arylglycerol-β-aryl (β-O-4) linkage.

name: α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-D-galactose
definition: A galactobiose comprising an α-D-galactopyranose residue and a D-galactopyranose residue joined via an α-(1→3) linkage.

name: cefamandole(1−)
definition: A cephalosporin carboxylate anion having (R)-mandelamido and N-methylthiotetrazole side-groups.

name: 4-(aminomethyl)octane-1,8-diamine
definition: A primary amine comprising an octane skeleton with amino substituents at carbon positions 1 and 8; and an aminomethyl substituent at position 5.

name: O-formylcefamandole
definition: A cephalosporin compound having (R)-O-formylmandelamido and N-methylthiotetrazole side groups. It is used (as the sodium salt) as a progrug for cefamandole.

name: cefoxitin(1−)
definition: A cephalosporin carboxylic acid anion having methoxy, 2-thienylacetamido and carbamoyloxymethyl side-groups, formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of the semisynthetic cephamycin antibiotic cefoxitin.

name: cefazolin(1−)
definition: A cephalosporin carboxylic acid anion having [(5-methyl-1,3,4-thiadiazol-2-yl)sulfanyl]methyl and (1H-tetrazol-1-ylacetyl)amino side-groups, formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of cefazolin.

name: ceftriaxone(1−)
definition: A cephalosporin carboxylis acid anion having 2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetylamino and [(2-methyl-5,6-dioxo-1,2,5,6-tetrahydro-1,2,4-triazin-3-yl)sulfanyl]methyl side-groups, formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of ceftriaxone.

name: 4-chlorophenylhydrazine
definition: Phenylhydrazine substituted at the para position by a chloro group.

name: alexidine
definition: An amphipathic bisbiguanide with a structure consisting of two (2-ethylhexyl)guanide units linked by a hexamethylene bridge.

name: guaiacylglycerol
definition: A compound made up of a guaiacyl core with an α-glyceryl substituent para to the aromatic hydroxy group.

name: dehydroglycinate
definition: The carboxylate anion of 1,2-didehydroglycine.

name: cefadroxil monohydrate
definition: The hydrate that is the monohydrate of the cephalosporin cefadroxil.

name: 3-bromo-L-tyrosine
definition: A bromoamino acid comprising an L-tyrosine core with a bromo- substituent ortho to the hydroxy group on the benzene ring.

name: cefadroxil(1−)
definition: A cephalosporin carboxylic acid anion having a 7β-[(2R)-2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetyl]amino side-chain, formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of the cephalosporin cefadroxil.

name: cefotaxime(1−)
definition: A cephalosporin carboxylic acid anion having acetoxymethyl and [2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]amino side-groups, formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of the cephalosporin cefotaxime.

name: ceftazidime sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the nmonosodium salt of ceftazidime, a cephalosporin having 7β-[(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-{[(2-carboxypropan-2-yl)oxy]imino}acetyl]amino and 3-pyridinium-1-ylmethyl side-groups.

name: ceftazidime(1−)
definition: A cephalosporin carboxylic acid anion formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of ceftazidime, a cephalosporin having 7β-[(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-{[(2-carboxypropan-2-yl)oxy]imino}acetyl]amino and 3-pyridinium-1-ylmethyl side-groups.

name: 3-chloro-L-tyrosine
definition: A chloroamino acid comprising a tyrosine core with a chloro- substituent ortho to the phenolic hydroxy group.

name: N-acetyldichloro-L-tyrosine
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative in which an L-tyrosine core has two chloro substituents at each position ortho to the benzyl hydroxy group and an acetyl substituent on the nitrogen atom.

name: 3,5-dichloro-4-hydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A derivative of p-salicylic acid with chloro- substituents at C-3 and C-5 of the benzene ring.

name: 3,5-dichloro-4-hydroxybenzoate
definition: The conjugate base of 3,5-dichlorohydroxybenzoic acid. Comprising a 3,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid core with the carboxylic acid proton missing, giving a charge of -1.

name: β-(1→4)-galactotetraose
definition: A galactotetraose composed of four β-D-galactose units joined by (1→4)-linkages.

name: methyl β-D-glucuronoside
definition: A derivative of β-D-glucuronic acid in which a methyl group is present at the anomeric position.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-α-D-GalpA-(1→2)-L-Rhap
definition: A linear trisaccharide comprising D-glucuronic acid, D-galacturonic acid and L-rhamnose residues, linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→2).

name: amidotrizoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid having iodo substituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions and acetamido substituents at the 3- and 5-positions. It is used, mainly as its N-methylglucamine and sodium salts, as an X-ray contrast medium in gastrointestinal studies, angiography, and urography.

name: sodium amidotrizoate
definition: The sodium salt of a benzoic acid having iodo substituents at the 2-, 4- and 6-positions and acetamido substituents at the 3- and 5-positions. It is used, often as a mixture with the meglumine salt, as an X-ray contrast medium in gastrointestinal studies, angiography, and urography.

name: 2,5-diiodo-L-histidine
definition: An iodoamino acid that is L-histidine in which the imidazole ring is substituted by iodine at positions 2- and 5(4).

name: 5-iodo-L-histidine
definition: An iodoamino acid that is L-histidine derivative in which the imidazole ring is substituted by iodine at position 5.

name: disodium L-tyrosinate
definition: The disodium salt of L-tyrosine.

name: tyrosine-4-azobenzenearsonate
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative having a 4-arsonophenyldiazenyl group at the 3-position of the benzene ring.

name: N-(2,4-dinitrophenyl)aminohexanoic acid
definition: A C-nitro compound comprising hexanoic acid with a (2,4-dinitrophenyl)amino substituent at position C-6.

name: quinoline yellow
definition: A quinoline derivative with a 1,3-dioxoindan-2-yl substituent at C-2.

name: poly(ethylene glycol monomethacrylate)
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) derivative that is poly(ethylene glycol) in which one of the terminal hydroxy groups has been acylated by formal condensation with methacrylic acid.

name: hexa-L-lysine monohydrobromide
definition: A compound comprising six covalently linked L-lysine residues ionically bound to hydrogen bromide.

name: oleylanilide
definition: The fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of oleic acid and aniline.

name: linoleylanilide
definition: A fatty amide conjugate of linoleic acid and aniline.

name: procion red MX-5B
definition: A 2,4-dichloro-1,3,5-triazine with a multi-substituted napthalen-1-ylamino substituent at the 6-position.

name: sulfamethoxydiazine
definition: A sulfonamide consisting of pyrimidine having a methoxy substituent at the 5-position and a 4-aminobenzenesulfonamido group at the 2-position.

name: 2-[(2-{[2-({2,4-dinitro-5-[2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-1-(ylooxy)piperidin-4-ylamino]phenyl}amino)ethyl]amino}-2-oxoethoxy)acetamido]ethyl 1,2-dipalmitoylglycero-3-phosphate
definition: An aminoxyl (nitroxide) free radical dipalmitoyl glycerophosphoethanolamine derivative used as a hapten in immunological investigations.

name: divinyl sulfone
definition: A sulfone compound having two S-vinyl substituents.

name: remazole orange-3R
definition: An azo compound having a ({[(2-sulfonatooxy)ethyl]sulfonyl}phenyl)diazenyl moiety attached at position 2 of a multi-substituted naphthalene.

name: remazole black-GR
definition: A bis(azo) compound with two aryldiazenyl moieties placed at positions 2 and 7 of a multi-substituted naphthalene.

name: 4-tolyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate comprising a benzene core with isocyanato and methyl substituents para to each other.

name: remazole orange-3R(2−)
definition: The organosulfonate oxoanion that is the dianionic form of the azo dye remazole orange-3R.

name: remazole black-GR (4−)
definition: The organosulfonate oxoanion that is the tetraanionic form of the azo dye remazole black-GR.

name: N-acetyltyrosine-4-azobenzenearsonic acid
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative having an Nα-acetyl substituent and a 4-arsonophenyldiazenyl group at the 3-position of the benzene ring.

name: α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-2-α-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide compound consisting of a branched pentasaccharide attached to the dolichyl chain via a diphosphate linkage.

name: 2-(p-nitrophenyl)-4-ethoxymethyleneoxazol-5-one
definition: A 1,3-oxazolone derivative having a nitrophenyl substituent at the 2-position, an ethoxymethylene group at the 4-position, and an oxo group at the 5-position.

name: 6-azauracil
definition: A 1,2,4-triazine compound having oxo-substituents at the 3- and 5-positions.

name: 3-[(4-arsonophenyl)diazenyl]-AcTyrGlyGly
definition: A tripeptide consisting of AcTyrGlyGly with a (4-arsonophenyl)diazenyl group at the 3-position on the tyrosine phenyl ring.

name: 3-[(4-arsonophenyl)diazenyl]-AcTyrGlyGlyNHNHBoc
definition: A tripeptide consisting of AcTyrGlyGlyNHNHBoc with a (4-arsonophenyl)diazenyl group at the 3-position on the tyrosine phenyl ring.

name: gemifloxacin mesylate
definition: The mesylate salt of gemifloxacin.

name: vinorelbine D-tartrate
definition: The D-(−)-tartrate salt of vinorelbine.

name: linolenic acid anilide
definition: A fatty amide conjugate of α-linolenic acid and aniline.

name: 1-oleyl-2-linoleyl-PAP
definition: A carboxylic ester that is a modified acyl glycerol with oleyl and linoleyl entities at C-1 and C-2, respectively, and an aniline moiety at C-3.

name: triolein
definition: A triglyceride formed by esterification of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol with oleic acid. Triolein is one of the two components of Lorenzo's oil.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-linolenoyl-PAP
definition: A carboxylic ester that is a modified acyl glycerol with oleoyl and linolenoyl entities at C-1 and C-2, respectively, and an aniline moiety at C-3.

name: 1-linolenyl-2-linoleyl-PAP
definition: A carboxylic ester that is a modified acyl glycerol with linolenyl and linoleyl entities at C-1 and C-2, respectively; and an anilino moiety at C-3.

name: ziprasidone mesylate trihydrate
definition: The methanesulfonate trihydrate salt of ziprasidone.

name: PAP
definition: A glycol that is a derivative of glycerol in which one of the hydroxy groups is replaced by an anilino group.

name: trielaidin
definition: A triglyceride formed by esterification of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol with elaidic acid.

name: eszopiclone
definition: The (5S)- (active) enantiomer of zopiclone. Unlike almost all other hypnotic sedatives, which are approved only for the relief of short-term (6-8 weeks) insomnia, eszopiclone is approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for long-term use.

name: (5R)-zopiclone
definition: The (5R)-enantiomer of zopiclone.

name: 3-methylthiofentanyl
definition: A piperidine compound having a (2-thienyl)ethyl substituent at the 1-position, a methyl group at the 3-position and an N-phenylpropanamido group at the 4-position.

name: (3R)-methylthiofentanyl
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 3-methylthiofentanyl.

name: (3S)-methylthiofentanyl
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 3-methylthiofentanyl.

name: acenocoumarol
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is warfarin in which the hydrogen at position 4 of the phenyl substituent is replaced by a nitro group.

name: chloramine T
definition: An organic sodium salt derivative of toluene-4-sulfonamide with a chloro substituent in place of an amino hydrogen.

name: (R)-acenocoumarol
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of acenocoumarol.

name: (S)-acenocoumarol
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of acenocoumarol.

name: aceprometazine
definition: A phenothiazine compound having an acetyl group at the 2-position and a 2-(dimethylamino)-1-propyl group at the 10-position.

name: (R)-aceprometazine
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of aceprometazine.

name: (S)-aceprometazine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of aceprometazine.

name: 3'''-O-acetyldigitoxin
definition: A cardenolide glycoside compound consisting of digitoxin having an acetyl substituent at the 3-position on the D-ribo-hexopyranosyl residue at the non-reducing end.

name: tergitol
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) derivative that is poly(ethylene glycol) in which one of the terminal hydroxy groups has been converted into the corresponding p-nonylphenyl ether.

name: tergitol NP-9
definition: A tergitol polymer consisting of nonylbenzene with a nine-membered poly(ethylene glycol) moiety attached at position 4.

name: alclometasone
definition: A prednisolone compound having an α-chloro substituent at the 7-position and an α-methyl substituent at the 16-position.

name: aliskiren fumarate
definition: The hemifumarate salt of aliskiren.

name: almitrine
definition: A triamino-1,3,5-triazine compound having allylamino substituents at the 2- and 4-positions and a 4-(bis(p-fluorophenyl)methyl)-1-piperazinyl group at the 6-position.

name: almitrine dimesylate
definition: The dimethanesulfonate salt of almitrine.

name: almotriptan malate
definition: The malate salt of almotriptan.

name: N-chlorotoluene-p-sulfonamide
definition: Toluene-p-sulfonamide chlorinated at nitrogen.

name: alosetron hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of alosetron.

name: alverine citrate
definition: The citrate salt of alverine, resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of alvarine and citric acid. An antispasmodic that acts directly on intestinal and uterine smooth muscle, it is used in the treatment of irritable bowel syndrome.

name: alverine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of alverine.

name: (R)-aminoglutethimide
definition: The (3R)-enantiomer of aminoglutethimide.

name: (S)-aminoglutethimide
definition: The (3R)-enantiomer of aminoglutethimide.

name: (4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (R)-amlodipine
definition: The (4R)-enantiomer of amlodipine.

name: (S)-amlodipine
definition: The (4S)-enantiomer of amlodipine.

name: (4-hydroxy-3-iodo-5-nitrophenyl)acetic acid
definition: A member of the class of phenylacetic acids that is phenylacetic acid in which the phenyl group is substituted by iodo, hydroxy and nitro groups at positions 3, 4 and 5 respectively.

name: (4-hydroxy-5-iodo-3-nitrophenyl)acetate
definition: An acetate derivative carrying a 4-hydroxy-5-iodo-3-nitrophenyl substituent at C-2.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxohexanoate
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid anion comprising hexanoate substituted at C-2 and C-4 with oxo and hydroxy groups respectively.

name: phenyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate composed of a benzene ring bearing a single isocyanato substituent.

name: diphenylmethane monoisocyanate
definition: An isocyanate that is the 4-isocyanato derivative of diphenylmethane.

name: alcuronium
definition: An indole alkaloid of the curare family. A neuroblocker, it is often used in chloride form as an anesthesia adjuvant.

name: acetylcholine bromide
definition: The bromide salt of acetylcholine.

name: tetramethylammonium bromide
definition: The bromide salt of tetramethylammonium.

name: tetrapropylammonium bromide
definition: A quarternary ammonium bromide salt in which the cation has four propyl substituents around the central nitrogen.

name: tetrapropylammonium
definition: A quarternary ammonium cation with four propyl substituents around the central nitrogen.

name: ethyltrimethylammonium iodide
definition: A quarternary ammonium salt whose basic unit comprises an ethyltrimethylammonium cation and an iodide anion.

name: octyltrimethylammonium ion
definition: A quarternary ammonium cation having one octyl and three methyl substituents around the central nitrogen.

name: decyltrimethylammonium ion
definition: A quarternary ammonium cation having one decyl and three methyl substituents around the central nitrogen.

name: pentolinium tartrate
definition: The bitartrate salt of pentolinium.

name: aci-nitroethane(1−)
definition: A nitrogen oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the hydroxy group of nitroethane.

name: 16-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid that is hexadecanoic acid (also known as palmitic acid) which is substituted at position 16 by a hydroxy group. It is a key monomer of cutin in the plant cuticle.

name: 16-hydroxyhexadecanoate
definition: An ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 16-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid (also known as 16-hydroxypalmitic acid or juniperic acid).

name: 16-feruloyloxypalmitic acid
definition: The O-feruloyl derivative of 16-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid.

name: 16-feruloyloxypalmitate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 16-feruloyloxypalmitic acid obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-L-rhamnose
definition: A glycosylrhamnose having a galactosyl residue attached to rhamnose via a β-(1→4)-linkage.

name: delphinidin 3-O-(6''-O-malonyl)-β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside having a malonyl group at the 6-position and a 3-O-delphinidin moiety at the anomeric position.

name: ternatin C5
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of delphinidin with β-D-glucosyl groups at the 3-, 3'- and 5'-positions.

name: delphinidin 3-O-(6''-O-malonyl)-β-D-glucoside-3'-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of delphinidin with β-D-glucosyl groups at the 3- and 3'-positions.

name: all-trans-polyprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenol diphosphate of unspecified chain-length with all double bonds having (E)-configuration.

name: morphine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of morphine.

name: 1-((4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetoxy)pyrrolidine-2,5-dione
definition: The ester formed between N-hydroxysuccinimide and (4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetic acid.

name: 1-((4-hydroxy-5-iodo-3-nitrophenyl)acetoxy)pyrrolidine-2,5-dione
definition: The ester formed between N-hydroxysuccinimide and (4-hydroxy-5-iodo-3-nitrophenyl)acetic acid.

name: n-pentyl nitrite
definition: A nitrite ester having n-pentyl as the alkyl group.

name: anagrelide hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of anagrelide.

name: anidulafungin
definition: A semisynthetic echinocandin anti-fungal drug. It is active against Aspergillus and Candida species and is used for the treatment of invasive candidiasis.

name: morphine hydrochloride trihydrate
definition: The trihydrate of morphine hydrochloride.

name: deacetyllaurenobiolide
definition: A germacranolide derived from laurenobiolide by deacetylation.

name: (R)-atenolol
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of atenolol.

name: (2E)-but-2-ene-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid compound consisting of but-2-ene having carboxy substituents at the 1-, 2- and 3-positions.

name: 7-chlorotryptophan
definition: A tryptophan derivative having a chloro substituent at the 7-position of the indole ring.

name: 7-chloro-D-tryptophan
definition: A 7-chlorotryptophan in which the chiral centre has D- (R-) configuration.

name: (R)-piperazine-2-carboxamide
definition: A piperazine-2-carboxamide having (R)-configuration.

name: (R)-piperazine-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A piperazine-2-carboxylic acid having (R)-configuration.

name: (R)-piperazine-2-carboxylate
definition: Conjugate base of (R)-piperazine-2-carboxylic acid.

name: (R)-N-tert-butylpiperazine-2-carboxamide
definition: An N-tert-butyl substituted piperazine-2-carboxamide having (R)-configuration.

name: β-alaninamide
definition: An amino acid amide compound consisting of propionamide having a 3-amino substituent.

name: verlotorin
definition: A germacranolide isolated from Laurus nobilis L.

name: (R)-azelastine
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of azelastine.

name: (S)-azelastine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of azelastine.

name: ABA diazonium
definition: The aromatic diazonium ion corresponding to (p-aminophenyl)arsonic acid (arsanilic acid).

name: α-hexylcinnamaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of cinnamaldehydes carrying a hexyl substituent at the α-position.

name: mechlorethamine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of mechlorethamine.

name: ferriheme b(1−)
definition: Ferriheme b carrying an overall charge of −1, caused by loss of a proton from each of the two carboxy groups.

name: β-hematin
definition: A dimer of hematin in which an iron-oxygen bond links the central iron of one hematin to the oxygen of one of the carboxylates of the adjacent hematin.

name: camphorsulfonic acid
definition: A sulfonic acid containing the camphorsulfonate anion.

name: diacetone alcohol
definition: A β-hydroxy ketone formed by hydroxylation of 4-methylpentan-2-one at the 4-position. It has been isolated from Achnatherum robustum.

name: camphorsulfonate anion
definition: The conjugate base of camphorsulfonic acid.

name: monosodium acetylide
definition: The salt formed from the acetylide monoanion and a single sodium cation.

name: disodium acetylide

name: 1,1-dihydroxy-3-ethoxy-2-butanone
definition: A butanone derivative having two hydroxy substituents at the 1-position and an ethoxy substituent at the 3-position.

name: N-cyclohexyl-N'-(2-(4-morpholinyl)ethyl)carbodiimide
definition: A carbodiimide having cyclcohexyl and 2-(4-morpholinyl)ethyl as the two N-substituents.

name: N-methylisatoic anhydride
definition: A 3,1-benzoxazin-1,4-dione having an N-methyl substituent.

name: (S)-1-(4-bromoacetamidobenzyl)EDTA
definition: A tetracarboxylic acid consisting of ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid having a 4-bromoacetamidobenzyl group at the C1-position and (S)-configuration.

name: EDTA methidiumpropylamide
definition: A combined intercalating and chelating reagent. The iron chelate, prepared by adding Fe(NH4)2(SO4)2, effects random oxidative cleavage of DNA in the presence of O2 and a reducing agent. This activity is useful as a footprinting probe.

name: sulfachloropyridazine
definition: A sulfonamide antimicrobial used for urinary tract infections and in veterinary medicine.

name: hexyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate in which a single isocyanato substituent is located at C-1 of a hexane molecule; found to be immunogenic in guinea pigs.

name: methyl isocyanate
definition: The isocyanate that is methane modified by a single isocyanato substituent.

name: 6-methyleugenol
definition: A phenylpropanoid consisting of eugenol having a methyl substituent at the 6-position.

name: N2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-N-(7-{[(2,4-dichlorophenyl)amino]sulfonyl}-1-oxo-1,2-dihydronaphthalen-2-yl)glycinamide
definition: A naphthalen-1-one having an N-2,4-dichlorophenylglycinamido group at the 2-position and a [(2,4-dichlorophenyl)amino]sulfonyl group at the 7-position.

name: polymyxin B2
definition: A polymyxin having a 6-methylheptanoyl group at the amino terminus.

name: colistin A
definition: A polymyxin having a (6R)-6-methyloctanoyl group at the amino terminus.

name: 3,3,5-trimethylcyclohexanol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is cyclohexanol substituted by two methyl groups at the 3-position and one methyl group at the 5-position. It exhibits inhibitory activity against HMG-CoA reductase ( EC 1.1.1.34/EC 1.1.1.88).

name: oxolinate
definition: Conjugate base of oxolinic acid.

name: penotonium bromide
definition: A carboxylic ester having diphenylacetic acid as the carboxylic acid component and a 2-(trialkylammonium)ethanol as the alcohol component.

name: penotonium cation
definition: A carboxylic ester having diphenylacetic acid as the carboxylic acid component and a 2-(trialkylammonium)ethanol as the alcohol component.

name: 2-cyanocinnamic acid
definition: A cinnamic acid derivative having a cyano substituent at the 2-position of the phenyl ring.

name: 2-cyanocinnamate
definition: Conjugate base of 2-cyanocinnamic acid.

name: homofenazine
definition: A phenothiazine derivative having a trifluoromethyl subsitituent at the 2-position and a 3-[4-(2-hydroxyethyl)diazepin-1-yl]propyl group at the N-10 position.

name: 5-methyleugenol
definition: A phenylpropanoid consisting of eugenol having a methyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: 3-methyleugenol
definition: A phenylpropanoid consisting of eugenol having a methyl substituent at the 3-position.

name: 4-allyl-2-isopropoxyphenol
definition: A phenylpropanoid that is an analogue of eugenol in which an isopropoxy group replaces the methoxy group.

name: 6-methylisoeugenol
definition: An isoeugenol derivative carrying a 6-methyl substituent.

name: 5-methylisoeugenol
definition: An isoeugenol derivative carrying a 5-methyl substituent.

name: α-Gal-(1→3)-α-Glc-(1→3)-α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→3)-[α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→3)-[α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→6)]-α-Man-(1→6)]-β-Man-(1→4)-β-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide intermediate involved in post-translational modification of proteins.

name: 3-methylisoeugenol
definition: An isoeugenol derivative carrying a 3-methyl substituent.

name: α-D-Man-(1→6)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide intermediate involved in post-translational modification of proteins.

name: 2-isopropoxy-4-propenylphenol
definition: An analogue of isoeugenol in which an isopropoxy group replaces the methoxy group.

name: α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→3)-[α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→3)-α-Man-(1→6)]-β-Man-(1→4)-β-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide intermediate involved in post-translational modification of proteins.

name: α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→3)-[α-Man-(1→6)-[α-Man-(1→2)-α-Man-(1→3)]-α-Man-(1→6)]-β-Man-(1→4)-β-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide intermediate involved in post-translational modification of proteins.

name: α-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-D-mannose
definition: A D-glucosyl-D-mannose with the two components joined by an α-(1→2)-linkage

name: 3,5,6-trimethyleugenol
definition: A derivative of eugenol with methyl substituents at ring positions 3, 5 and 6.

name: tetrachlorophthalic anhydride
definition: A cyclic dicarboxylic anhydride that is phthalic anhydride chlorinated at the 4-, 5-, 6- and 7-positions.

name: 1,3,5-tris(6-isocyanatohexyl)-1,3,5-triazin-2,4,6-trione
definition: A triisocyanate being a derivative of isocyanuric acid with a 6-isocyanatohexyl group at each of the 1-, 3- and 5-positions.

name: 9,9,9-trimethylisoeugenol
definition: A derivative of isoeugenol with three methyl substituents at position 9.

name: 1,3,5-tris(6-isocyanatohexyl)biuret
definition: A derivative of biuret having three 6-isocyanatohexyl groups at the 1-, 3- and 5-positions.

name: (7R)-7-isopropenyl-4-methyl-1-oxaspiro[2.5]oct-4-ene
definition: A spirocyclic epoxide obtained by formal addition of a methylene group to the carbonyl moiety of 5-isopropenyl-2-methylcyclohex-2-en-3-one.

name: (4S)-4-isopropenyl-1-methyl-2-methylene-7-oxabicyclo[4.1.0]heptane
definition: A bicyclic epoxide derived from (4S)-limonene.

name: 5,6-dimethyl-3-pentadecylcatechol
definition: Catechol substituted at positions 5 and 6 (3 and 4) with methyl groups and at position 6 (3) with a pentadecyl group.

name: 4,5,6-trimethyl-3-pentadecylcatechol
definition: Catechol substituted at positions 3, 4 and 5 (4, 5 and 6) with methyl groups and at position 6 (3) with a pentadecyl group.

name: 3-pentadecylcatechol
definition: Catechol substituted at position 3 with a pentadecyl group.

name: 3-heptadecylcatechol
definition: Catechol substituted at position 3 with a heptadecyl group.

name: 3-heptadecylveratrole
definition: A dimethoxybenzene that is veratrole substituted at position 3 with a heptadecyl group.

name: veratrole
definition: A dimethoxybenzene with the methoxy groups at ortho-positions.

name: clopenthixol
definition: A thioxanthene derivative having a chloro substituent at the 2-position and an alkylidene group at the 10-position with undefined double bond stereochemistry.

name: metofenazate
definition: A phenothiazine derivative having a chloro subsitituent at the 2-position and a 4-substituted 3-(piperazin-1-yl)propyl group at the N-10 position.

name: pacatal
definition: A phenothiazine derivative in which 10H-phenothiazine has an N-methylpiperidin-4-ylmethyl substituent at the N-10 position.

name: perazine
definition: A phenothiazine derivative in which 10H-phenothiazinecarries a 3-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)propyl substituent at the N-10 position.

name: thiopropazate
definition: A phenothiazine derivative in which 10H-phenothiazine has a chloro subsitituent at the 2-position and a 3-[4-(2-acetoxyethyl)piperazin-1-yl]propyl group at N-10.

name: thioproperazine
definition: A phenothiazine derivative in which the phenothiazine tricycle has a dimethylaminosulfonyl substituent at the 2-position and a 3-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)propyl group at N-10.

name: 2-iodobenzoate
definition: An iodobenzoate with a single iodo substituent placed at the 2-position.

name: thiosalicylic acid
definition: A sulfanylbenzoic acid that is the 2-sulfanyl derivative of benzoic acid.

name: fosinopril(1−)
definition: The anion formed by deprotonating fosinopril at the carboxyl proton.

name: thiosalicylate(1−)
definition: Conjugate base of thiosalicylic acid.

name: O-methylsalicylate
definition: Conjugate base of O-methylsalicylic acid.

name: mono(p-azobenzenearsonic acid)-L-tyrosylglycerophosphorylethanolamine
definition: The deacylated homologue of mono(p-azobenzenearsonic acid)-L-tyrosylphosphatidylethanolamine.

name: 5-chlorosalicylate
definition: Conjugate base of 5-chlorosalicylic acid.

name: 4-isocyanato-4'-methyldiphenylmethane
definition: An isocyanate that is diphenylmethane with a isocyanato substituent at the 4-position of one phenyl ring and a methyl group at the 4-position of the other.

name: 1-isocyanatomethyl-1,3,3-trimethylcyclohexane
definition: An isocyanate that is 1,1,3,3-tetramethylcyclohexane in which one of the methyl groups carries a isocyanato substituent.

name: (8ξ)-cinchonan
definition: Cinchonan or its (8S)-epimer.

name: (8S)-cinchonan
definition: The (8S)-epimer of cinchonan.

name: phanquone
definition: An orthoquinone that is the 5,6-diketo derivative of 4,7-phenanthroline.

name: 3-chloromethyl-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a chloromethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-bromomethyl-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a bromomethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-mesyloxymethyl-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a mesyloxymethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-tosyloxymethyl-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a tosyloxymethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-[(4-methoxyphenylsulfonyloxy)methyl]-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a (4-methoxyphenylsulfonyloxy)methyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-[(phenylsulfonyloxy)methyl]-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a (phenylsulfonyloxy)methyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-[(4-chlorophenylsulfonyloxy)methyl]-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a (4-chlorophenylsulfonyloxy)methyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-[(4-nitrophenylsulfonyloxy)methyl]-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a (4-nitrophenylsulfonyloxy)methyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-thiocyanatomethyl-5,5-dimethylbutyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a thiocyanatomethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: (4R,7R)-7-isopropenyl-4-methyl-1-oxaspiro[2.5]octane
definition: A spirocyclic epoxide arising from epoxidation of (1R,4R)-4-isopropenyl-1-methyl-2-methylidenecyclohexane

name: (1R,4R)-4-isopropenyl-1-methyl-2-methylenecyclohexane
definition: An alicyclic compound consisting of cyclohexane carrying methyl, methylidene and isopropenyl groups at positions 1-, 2- and 4 respectively.

name: 6-isopropyl-1-oxaspiro[2.5]octane
definition: A spirocyclic epoxide derived from p-menthane.

name: 4-isopropyl-1-methylenecyclohexane
definition: A monoterpene consisting of methylenecyclohexane having an isopropyl substituent at the 4-position.

name: (+)-trans-2-menthene
definition: A chiral monoterpene consisting of cyclohexene having isopropyl and methyl substitents at the 3- and 6-positions respectively.

name: β-terpinene
definition: One of three isomeric monoterpenes differing in the positions of their two double bonds (α- and γ-terpinene being the others). In β-terpinene the double bonds are at the 1(7)- and 3-positions of the p-menthane skeleton. β-Terpinene has no known natural source.

name: (Z)-2-methyl-6-methyleneoct-4-ene
definition: An acyclic monoterpene resulting from fission of the C-4‒C-5 bond in α-terpinene.

name: balsalazide disodium
definition: The dihydrate of the disodium salt of balsalazide. A prodrug, releasing the anti-inflammatory 5-aminosalicylic acid (mesalazine) in the large intestine, it is used in the treatment of ulcerative colitis.

name: balsalazide(2−)
definition: The dianion of balsalazide.

name: bambuterol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of bambuterol. A long acting beta-adrenoceptor agonist used in the treatment of asthma, it is a prodrug for terbutaline.

name: nonaethylene glycol monomethyl ether
definition: Nonaethylene glycol in which one of the hydroxy groups is substituted by methoxy.

name: benzphetamine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of benzphetamine. A sympathomimetic agent with properties similar to dextroamphetamine, it is used in the treatment of obesity.

name: betazole
definition: Pyrazole in which a hydrogen adjacent to one of the nitrogen atoms is substituted by a 2-aminoethyl group. It is a histamine H2-receptor agonist used clinically to test gastric secretory function.

name: biperiden hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of biperiden. A muscarinic antagonist affecting both the central and peripheral nervous systems, it is used in the treatment of all forms of Parkinson's disease.

name: bivalirudin
definition: A synthetic peptide of 20 amino acids, comprising D-Phe, Pro, Arg, Pro, Gly, Gly, Gly, Gly, Asn, Gly, Asp, Phe, Glu, Glu, Ile, Pro, Glu, Glu, Tyr, and Leu in sequence. A congener of hirudin (a naturally occurring drug found in the saliva of the medicinal leech), it a specific and reversible inhibitor of thrombin, and is used as an anticoagulant.

name: bromfenac(1−)
definition: The anion formed by deprotonating bromfenac at the carboxyl proton.

name: bromfenac sodium salt sesquihydrate
definition: The sesquihydrate of the sodium salt of bromfenac. It is used for the management of ocular pain and treatment of postoperative inflammation in patients who have undergone cataract extraction.

name: bromazine
definition: A tertiary amino compound that is the 4-bromobenzhydryl ether of 2-(dimethylamino)ethanol. An antihistamine with antimicrobial properties, it is used in the control of cutaneous allergies.

name: bromazine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of bromazine. An antihistamine with antimicrobial properties, it is used in the control of cutaneous allergies.

name: (R)-bambuterol
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of bambuterol.

name: (S)-bambuterol
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of bambuterol.

name: (R)-bambuterol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of (R)-bambuterol.

name: (S)-bambuterol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of (S)-bambuterol.

name: (R)-bevantolol
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of bevantolol.

name: (S)-bevantolol
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of bevantolol.

name: (R)-bevantolol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of (R)-bevantolol.

name: (S)-bevantolol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of (S)-bevantolol.

name: (R)-bitolterol
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of bitolterol.

name: (S)-bitolterol
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of bitolterol.

name: (R)-bitolterol mesylate
definition: The methanesulfonate salt of (R)-bitolterol.

name: (S)-bitolterol mesylate
definition: The methanesulfonate salt of (S)-bitolterol.

name: 2-iminio-3-(indol-3-yl)propanoate
definition: Zwitterionic imine tautomer of α,β-didehydrotryptophan.

name: 2-iminio-3-(7-chloroindol-3-yl)propionate
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the nitrogen of the imino tautomer of 7-chloro-α,β-didehydrotryptophan.

name: 7-chloro-α,β-didehydrotryptophan
definition: A 2,3-dehydroamino acid derived from 7-chlorotryptophan.

name: dichlorochromopyrrolic acid
definition: A pyrrole-2,5-dicarboxylic acid having 7-chloroindol-3-yl groups at the 3- and 4-positions.

name: dichlorochromopyrrolate
definition: Dicarboxylate anion of dichlorochromopyrrolic acid.

name: calcium acetate monohydrate
definition: The monohydrate of calcium acetate.

name: (2ξ)-D-gluco-heptonate
definition: The monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxy groups of (2ξ)-D-gluco-heptonic acid.

name: (2ξ)-D-gluco-heptonic acid
definition: An unspecified mixture of (2R)- and 2(S)-D-gluco-heptonic acid.

name: carbetocin
definition: Oxytocin in which the hydrogen on the phenolic hydroxy group is substituted by methyl, the amino group on the cysteine residue is substituted by hydrogen, and the sulfur of the cysteine residue is replaced by a methylene group. A synthetic carba-analogue of oxytocin, it is used to control bleeding after giving birth. Like oxytocin, it causes contraction of the uterus.

name: carboprost(1−)
definition: The anion formed by deprotonating carboprost at the carboxyl proton.

name: (R)-carprofen
definition: The (R)-(−)-enantiomer of carprofen.

name: (S)-carprofen
definition: The (S)-(+)-enantiomer of carprofen.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of the linear sequence β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc having a Neu5Ac residue attached to the inner galactose via an α-(2→3) linkage. The oligosaccharide of ganglioside GM1a.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide consisting of the linear sequence α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc having a Neu5Ac residue attached to a galactose via an α-(2→3) linkage. The oligosaccharide of ganglioside GD1a.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide consisting of two sialyl, one galactose and one glucose residue (at the reducing end) connected by sequential α-(2→8)-, α-(2→3)- and β-(1→4)-linkages. The oligosaccharide of ganglioside GD3.

name: cefotiam hexetil ester
definition: The 1-(cyclohexyloxycarbonyloxy)ethyl ester of cefotiam. It is used as its dihydrochloride salt as a prodrug for cefotiam.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched octasaccharide derivative consisting of four sialyl residues, two galactose residues, one N-acetylglucosamine and a glucose residue at the reducing end.

name: cefpiramide
definition: A third-generation cephalosporin antibiotic with [(1-methyl-1H-tetrazol-5-yl)sulfanyl]methyl and (R)-2-{[(4-hydroxy-6-methylpyridin-3-yl)carbonyl]amino}-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetamido groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively, of the cephem skeleton. It has a broad spectrum of antibacterial activity.

name: cefpiramide(1−)
definition: The anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of cefpiramide.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched heptasaccharide derivative consisting of three sialyl residues, two galactose residues, one N-acetylglucosamine and a glucose residue at the reducing end. The oligosaccharide of ganglioside GT1a.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, β-D-galactose and β-D-glucose residues in a linear (1→3), (1→4), (1→4) sequence. It is the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GA1.

name: cephapirin(1−)
definition: The anion of cephapirin obtained by removal of a proton form the carboxylic acid group.

name: β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of two α-sialyl residues, a β-D-galactosyl residue and an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue linked respectively (2→8), (2→8) and (1→4), to the galactosyl residue of which is also linked (1→4) an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue. It is the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GD2.

name: ceruletide
definition: A decapeptide comprising 5-oxoprolyl, glutamyl, aspartyl, O-sulfotyrosyl, threonyl, glycyl, tryptopyl, methionyl, aspartyl and phenylalaninamide residues in sequence. Found in the skins of certain Australian amphibians, it is an analogue of the gastrointestinal peptide hormone cholecystokinin and stimulates gastric, biliary, and pancreatic secretion. It is used in cases of paralysis of the intestine (paralytic ileus) and as a diagnostic aid in pancreatic malfunction.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of the linear sequence β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc having a Neu5Ac residue attached to the galactose via an α-(2→3) linkage. Corresponds to the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GM2.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino hexasaccharide that is the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GalNAc-GD1a.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-p-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose disaccharide, the galactosyl residue of which carries β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl and N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→8)-N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl disaccharide units through (2→4) and (2→3) linkages respectively. It is the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GD1b.

name: ceruletide diethylamine
definition: The diethylamine salt of ceruletide.

name: cetrorelix
definition: A synthetic ten-membered oligopeptide comprising N-acetyl-3-(naphthalen-2-yl)-D-alanyl, 4-chloro-D-phenylalanyl, 3-(pyridin-3-yl)-D-alanyl, L-seryl, L-tyrosyl, N5-carbamoyl-D-ornithyl, L-leucyl, L-arginyl, L-prolyl, and D-alaninamide residues coupled in sequence. A gonadotrophin-releasing hormone (GnRH) antagonist, it is used for treatment of infertility and of hormone-sensitive cancers of the prostate and breast.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide comprising a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose disaccharide, the galactosyl residue of which carries an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl trisaccharide unit and an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→8)-N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl disaccharide unit through (2→4) and (2→3) linkages respectively. It corresponds to the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GT1b.

name: N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GM3. It comprises a linear sequence of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and β-D-glucose residues linked (2→3) and (1→4).

name: mellitic acid hexaanion
definition: The hexacarboxylate anion of mellitic acid.

name: PCM 2477 oligosaccharide
definition: The eleven-membered core polysaccharide derivative from Yokenella regensburgei strain PCM 2477.

name: PCM 2476 oligosaccharide
definition: The eleven-membered core polysaccharide derivitive from Yokenella regensburgei strain PCM 2476.

name: methoxy mycolic acid
definition: A mycolic acid produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Its structure is that of tetracosanoic acid substituted at position 2 by a 1-hydroxy-18-[2-(17-methoxy-18-methylhexatriacontyl)cyclopropyl]octadecyl group.

name: keto mycolic acid
definition: A mycolic acid produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Its structure is that of tetracosanoic acid substituted at position 2 by a 1-hydroxy-18-[2-(18-methyl-17-oxohexatriacontyl)cyclopropyl]octadecyl group.

name: α-mycolic acid
definition: A mycolic acid produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Its structure is that of hexacosanoic acid substituted at position 2 by a 1-hydroxy-16-{2-[14-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)tetradecyl]cyclopropyl}hexadecyl group.

name: 4-(18,20-dihydroxy-26-methoxy-25-methyloctacosyl)phenyl 3,6-di-O-methyl-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-2,3-di-O-methyl-α-L-Rha-(1→2)-3-O-methyl-α-L-Rha
