definition: An aromatic heptaketide produced by rhubarb (Rheum palmatum, Polygonaceae).

name: (24E)-3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholest-24-en-26-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: Tetraanion of (24E)-3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholest-24-en-26-oyl-CoA arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups.

name: encainide hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of encainide. A class Ic antiarrhythmic, it was used for the treatment of severe or life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias, but it was associated with increased death rates in patients who had asymptomatic heart rhythm abnormalities after a recent heart attack and was withdrawn from the market.

name: keto-D-fructuronate
definition: The straight-chain keto form of D-fructuronate.

name: α-D-fructuronate
definition: The α-anomer of D-fructuronate.

name: β-D-fructuronate
definition: The β-anomer of D-fructuronate.

name: XDP(3−)
definition: Trianion of xanthosine 5'-diphosphate arising from deprotonation of all three OH groups of the diphosphate.

name: XTP(3−)
definition: Trianion of xanthosine 5'-triphosphate arising from deprotonation of three of the four free triphosphate OH groups.

name: 2-imino-3-(7-chloroindol-3-yl)propionate(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of 2-iminio-3-(7-chloroindol-3-yl)propionate arising from deprotonation of the iminio function.

name: γ-aminobutyric acid zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of γ-aminobutyric acid having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated amino group.

name: ureidoperacrylic acid
definition: The peracid of ureidoacrylic acid where the acidic ‒OH group has been replaced by an ‒OOH group.

name: ureidoacrylic acid
definition: The (Z)-3-ureido derivative of acrylic acid.

name: ureidoacrylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of ureidoacrylic acid. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: (Z)-3-aminoperacrylic acid
definition: The peracid of (Z)-3-aminoacrylic acid where the acidic ‒OH group has been replaced by an ‒OOH group.

name: (Z)-3-aminoacrylic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid comprising acrylic acid carrying a 3-amino substituent and having (Z)-stereochemistry.

name: (Z)-3-aminoacrylate
definition: The conjugate base of (Z)-3-aminoacrylic acid - major species at pH 7.3.

name: glutathione amide zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of glutathione amide having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: glutathione amide disulfide dizwitterion
definition: Dizwitterionic form of glutathione amide disulfide having both carboxy groups in anionic form and both amino groups protonated; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-iodo-L-tyrosine zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of 3-iodo-L-tyrosine having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-nitropropanoate
definition: The conjugate base of 3-nitropropanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: caspofungin acetate
definition: The diacetate salt of caspofungin. It is used for the treatment of invasive candidiasis, and of aspergillosis in patients who are refractory to, or intolerant of, other therapy.

name: entecavir hydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of entecavir. A synthetic analogue of 2'-deoxyguanosine, entecavir is a nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor with selective antiviral activity against hepatitis B virus. It is phosphorylated intracellularly to the active triphosphate form, which competes with deoxyguanosine triphosphate, the natural substrate of hepatitis B virus reverse transcriptase, inhibiting every stage of the enzyme's activity, although it has no activity against HIV. Enteclavir is used for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B.

name: thermosperminium(4+)
definition: Tetraanion of thermospermine arising from protonation of all four amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin(1−)
definition: Conjugate base of 7,8-didemethyl-8-hydroxy-5-deazariboflavin arising from deprotonation at the 3-position of the pyrimidoquinoline ring system; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dopaminium(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of dopamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-phosphonato-L-lactate(3−)
definition: A triply-charged organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and phosphate groups of 2-phospho-L-lactic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: F420-0(3−)
definition: Trianion of F420-0 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and phosphate functions as well as the 3-position on the pyrimidinoquinoline ring system; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ecgoninium methyl ester(1+)
definition: The conjugate acid of ecgonine methyl ester arising from protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dihydroergocornine
definition: Ergocornine in which a single bond replaces the double bond between positions 9 and 10.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-D-glucosaminium(1+)
definition: The conjugate acid of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-D-glucosamine.

name: N-formylmaleamate
definition: The conjugate base of N-formylmaleamic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: dihydroergocristine
definition: Ergocristine in which a single bond replaces the double bond between positions 9 and 10. It is used as the mesylate salt for the symptomatic treatment of mental deterioration associated with cerebrovascular insufficiency and in peripheral vascular disease.

name: methylmalonyl-CoA(5−)
definition: Pentaanion of methylmalonyl-CoA arising from deprotonation of carboxy, phosphate and diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-O-phosphohygromycin B(1+)
definition: The conjugate acid of 4-O-phosphohygromycin B having an anionic phosphate group and all three amino groups protonated; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dihydro-α-ergocryptine
definition: α-Ergocryptine in which a single bond replaces the double bond between positions 9 and 10.

name: coenzyme F420-1(4−)
definition: The tetraanion of coenzyme F420-1 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and phosphate functions as well as the 3-position on the pyrimidinoquinoline ring system; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-ergocryptine
definition: α-Ergocryptine in which the isobutyl (2-methylpropyl) substituent is replaced by sec-butyl (1-methylpropyl). It is a natural ergot alkaloid. Note that ergocryptine discussed in the literature prior to 1967, when β-ergocryptine was separated from α-ergocryptine, is now referred to as α-ergocryptine.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-D-glucosamine
definition: A chitobiose consisting of D-glucosamine having an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at the 4-position.

name: coenzyme α-F420-3(6−)
definition: The hexaanion of coenzyme α-F420-3 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and phosphate functions as well as the 3-position on the pyrimidinoquinoline ring system; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrosarcinapterin(4−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate groups of 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrosarcinapterin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dihydro-β-ergocryptine
definition: β-Ergocryptine in which a single bond replaces the double bond between positions 9 and 10.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosamine
definition: The α-anomer of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-D-glucosamine.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosamine
definition: The β-anomer of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-D-glucosamine.

name: N-formylmaleamic acid
definition: The N-formyl derivative of maleamic acid.

name: 2,5-bis(5-carboxy-3-ethyl-4-methylpyrrol-2-ylmethyl)-3,4-diethylpyrrole
definition: A polyalkyl-substituted tripyrrane dicarboxylic acid, a precursor of a porphyrin system.

name: ciprofloxacin hydrochloride hydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of ciprofloxacin monohydrochloride.

name: ciprofloxacin dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of ciprofloxacin.

name: 9',9'-bis{4-[bis(2-hydroxyethyl)amino]phenyl}-9,9,9'',9''-tetrahexyl-9H,9'H,9''H-2,2':7',2''-terfluorene
definition: An amphipholic trifluorene having hexyl and N,N-bis(2-hydroxyethyl)aminophenyl side-chains.

name: β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-[β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→3)]-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-α-D-Araf-OMe
definition: A hexasaccharide derivative that is a hexaarabinofuranoside corresponding to part of the arabinomannanan portion of the lipoarabinomannan from Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

name: β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-α-D-Araf-OMe
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative that is a methyl tetraarabinofuranoside corresponding to part of the arabinomannanan portion of the lipoarabinomannan from Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

name: β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→3)-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-α-D-Araf-OMe
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative that is a methyl tetraarabinofuranoside corresponding to part of the arabinomannanan portion of the lipoarabinomannan from Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

name: (S)-2-ureidoglycine
definition: The (2S)-enantiomer of 2-ureidoglycine.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-α-Kdo
definition: A branched hexasaccharide corresponding to part of the lipooligosaccharide from N. gonorrhoeae L8.

name: (S)-2-ureidoglycine zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the α-amino group of (S)-2-ureidoglycine.

name: columbianetin
definition: The angular furanocoumarin analogue of the linear furanocoumarin marmesin.

name: N. meningiditis L7 lipoundecasaccharide
definition: A branched undecasaccharide corresponding to part of the lipooligosaccharide of N. meningiditis type L7

name: neopinone(1+)
definition: The trialkylammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of neopinone.

name: pentosidine
definition: An imidazopyridine having norleucine and ornithine residues attached via their side-chains at the 4- and 2-positions respectively.

name: 4-azabenzimidazole
definition: The [4,5-b]-fused isomer of imidazopyridine.

name: thebaine(1+)
definition: The trialkylammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of thebaine.

name: β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: A β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine in which the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate(2−)
definition: The dianion obtained by removal of two protons from the phosphate group of D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate.

name: 2-methyl-β-carbolinium-6-ol
definition: An organic cation consisting of beta-carboline having methyl and hydroxy substituents at the 2- and 6-positions respectively.

name: D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: The tetra-anion obtained by removal of all of the protons from the phosphate groups of D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate.

name: (3S,6E)-nerolidol
definition: A (6E)-nerolidol in which the hydroxy group at positon 3 adopts an S-configuration.

name: (3R,6E)-nerolidol
definition: A (6E)-nerolidol in which the hydroxy group at positon 3 adopts an R-configuration. It is a fertility-related volatile compound secreted by the queens of higher termites from the subfamily Syntermitinae.

name: α-selinene
definition: An isomer of selinene where the double bond in the octahydronaphthalene ring system is endocyclic (2R,4aR,8aR)-configuration..

name: argpyrimidine
definition: A member of the class of hydroxypyrimidines obtained by cyclocondensation of L-arginine and methylglyoxal; a methyl glyoxal-derived advanced glycation end-product (AGE) in familial amyloidotic polyneuropathy and human cancers.

name: methylglyoxal-lysine dimer
definition: An imidazolium ion formed via cyclo-dimerisation of L-lysine and methylglyoxal.

name: glyoxal-lysine dimer
definition: An imidazolium ion formed via cyclo-dimerisation of L-lysine and glyoxal.

name: ADP-D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose
definition: The β-anomer of ADP-D-glycero-D-manno-heptose.

name: ADP-D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose(2−)
definition: Dianion of ADP-D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose arising from deprotonation of both free OH groups of the diphosphate.

name: 1-(5-carboxypentyl)pyrraline
definition: A pyrrole formed via Maillard reaction of ε-aminocaproic acid with glucose.

name: GDP-D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose
definition: A GDP-sugar in which the sugar component is D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose.

name: 1-butylpyrraline
definition: An N-substituted pyrraline that is pyrraline in which the hydrogen attached to the pyrrole nitrogen has been replaced by a butyl group.

name: GDP-D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose(2−)
definition: Dianion of GDP-D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose arising from deprotonation of both free OH groups of the diphosphate.

name: 1-propylpyrraline
definition: An N-substituted pyrraline that is pyrraline in which the hydrogen attached to the pyrrole nitrogen has been replaced by a propyl group.

name: 1-(L-norleucin-6-yl)pyrraline
definition: An N-substituted pyrraline formed via Maillard reaction of L-lysine with glucose.

name: 1-neopentylpyrraline
definition: An N-substituted pyrraline that is pyrraline in which the hydrogen attached to the pyrrole nitrogen has been replaced by a neopentyl (2,2-dimethylpropyl) group.

name: 3'-O-methyltricetin
definition: The 3'-O-methyl ether of tricetin.

name: neopentyl glycosyl pyrrole
definition: A pyrrole having neopentyl-, formyl- and 1,2,3-trihydroxypropyl groups at positions 1-, 2- and 3- respectively.

name: pyrrole-2-carboxaldehyde
definition: A pyrrole carrying a formyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: 3',5'-di-O-methyltricetin
definition: The 3',5'-di-O-methyl ether of tricetin. Known commonly as tricin, it is a constituent of rice bran and has been found to potently inhibit colon cancer cell growth.

name: 1-propyl-2-hydroxyacetylpyrrole
definition: A pyrrole carrying propyl and hydroxyacetyl groups at the 1- and 2-positions respectively.

name: 2-acetylpyrrole
definition: A pyrrole carrying an acetyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: 1-methyl-2-acetylpyrrole
definition: A pyrrole carrying methyl and acetyl substituents at the 1- and 2-positions respectively.

name: 2-acetylfuran
definition: A furan carrying an acetyl substituent at the 2-position. Used in the production of the antibiotic cefuroxime (CHEBI:3515).

name: 2,5-furandimethanol
definition: A furan carrying two hydroxymethyl substituents at the 2- and 5-positions.

name: β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate(2−)
definition: The dianion resulting from the removal of the two protons from the diphosphate group of β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate.

name: Nα-formyl-Nε-fructosyllysine
definition: A glyco-amino acid consisting of a D-fructosyl residue attached to the ε-amino group of Nα-formyl-L-lysine.

name: α-tyvelopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-mannopyranose
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of β-D-mannopyranose having a tyvelopyranosyl residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage

name: α-tyvelopyranose
definition: The α-anomer of the pyranose form of tyvelose.

name: α-paratopyranosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannopyranose
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of α-D-mannopyranose having a paratopyranosyl residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: N,N-dimethyl-4-nitrosoaniline
definition: A member of the class of dimethylanilines that is N,N-dimethylaniline having a nitroso group at the 4-position.

name: 4-(hydroxylamino)-N,N-dimethylaniline
definition: A member of the class of dimethylanilines that is N,N-dimethylaniline having a hydroxylamino substituent at the 4-position.

name: α-abequopyranose
definition: The α-anomer of the pyranose form of abequose.

name: α-D-paratopyranose
definition: The α-anomer of the pyranose form of D-paratose.

name: 6-O-(1-O-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphono)-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A glycerophosphoinositol antigen having a 1-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho moiety attached at the 6-position of 1D-myo-inositol.

name: 1-(4-sulfophenyl)-3-carboxy-4-amino-5-oxopyrazole
definition: A 4,5-dihydropyrazole having p-sulfophenyl-, carboxy-, amino- and oxo substituents at the 1-, 3-, 4- and 5-positions respectively.

name: pelargonidin 3-O-rutinoside 5-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: The conjugate base of pelargonidin 3-O-rutinoside 5-O-β-D-glucoside; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: Dianion of D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate arising from deprotonation of both phosphate OH groups.

name: 3-amino-4-hydroxybenzoate
definition: The conjugate base of 3-amino-4-hydroxybenzoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: laricitrin(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of laricitrin arising from deprotonation of the 3-OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: sulfoglycolithocholate(2−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion and N-acylglycinate that is the dianion of sulfoglycolithocholic acid arising from deprotonation of carboxylic acid and sulfate functions; major species at pH 7.3.

name: glycolithocholate
definition: A N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of glycolithocholic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-6-sulfoquinovose(3−)
definition: Trianion of UDP-6-sulfoquinovose arising from deprotonation of diphosphate and sulfonate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: vitexin 2''-O-α-L-rhamnoside(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of vitexin 2''-O-α-L-rhamnoside arising from deprotonation of the OH group at position 7 on the chromene.

name: 3'-O-methyltricetin(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of 3'-O-methyltricetin arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-OH position; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3',5'-di-O-methyltricetin(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of 3',5'-di-O-methyltricetin arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-OH position; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3',4',5'-O-trimethyltricetin(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of 3',4',5'-O-trimethyltricetin arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-OH position; major species at pH 7.3.

name: CoA-glutathione(5−)
definition: A pentaanionic form of coenzyme A-glutathione mixed disulfide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,7E,9E,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoate
definition: The conjugate base of (5Z,7E,9E,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: undecaprenyldiphosphonato-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine(3−)
definition: The ion of overall charge −3 formed from undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine at pH 7.3.

name: lipid II(3−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion of overall charge −3 formed from lipid II [undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetyl-(N-acetylglucosaminyl)muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine] at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-epitaxifolin(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of (+)-epitaxifolin arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-proline zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion formed from L-proline by proton transfer from the carboxy group to the ring nitrogen. It is the predominant species at physiological pH.

name: α-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of α-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function of the α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue.

name: cis-3-hydroxy-L-proline zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion formed from cis-3-hydroxy-L-proline by proton transfer from the carboxy group to the ring nitrogen. It is the predominant species at physiological pH.

name: tricetin(1-)
definition: The conjugate base of tricetin arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-OH position; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol(2−)
definition: The dianion resulting from the removal of two protons from the diphosphate group of N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol.

name: pelargonidin 3-O-rutinoside betaine
definition: The conjugate base of pelargonidin 3-O-rutinoside; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cobalt-sirohydrochlorin(8−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of cobalt-sirohydrochlorin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: estrone 3-sulfate(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of estrone 3-sulfate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-formyl-D-kynurenine zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of N-formyl-D-kynurenine having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: siroheme(8−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of siroheme; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cobalt-precorrin-2(8−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of cobalt-precorrin-2; major species at pH 7.3.

name: clinolamide
definition: The amide obtained by formal condensation of linoleic acid with cyclohexylamine.

name: dermatan 6'-sulfate anion
definition: Anionic form of dermatan 6'-sulfate arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and sulfate groups of the repeating units; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cocaine(1+)
definition: The conjugate base of cocaine arising from protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate(2−)
definition: The dianion resulting from the removal of two protons from the diphosphate group of N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate.

name: dermatan anion
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion obtained from dermatan by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid groups of the repeating units; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: cobalt-precorrin-3(8−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of cobalt-precorrin-3; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cobalt-precorrin-4(7−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of cobalt-precorrin-4; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cobalt-precorrin-5A(7−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of cobalt-precorrin-5A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cobalt-precorrin-5B(8−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of cobalt-precorrin-5B; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cobalt-precorrin-6A(7−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of cobalt-precorrin-6A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methoxy-4-nitrophenyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate having a 2-methoxy-4-nitrophenyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 2-phenylethyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate having a 2-phenylethyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: dipropyl phthalate
definition: A phthalate ester that is the dipropyl ester of benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

name: ertapenem sodium
definition: The monosodium salt of ertapenem. It is used for the treatment of moderate to severe susceptible infections including intra-abdominal and acute gynaecological infections, pneumonia, and infections of the skin and of the urinary tract. It is more stable to renal dehydropeptidase I tham imipenem, and so unlike imipenem, its use with cilastatin, which inhibits the enzyme, is not required.

name: ertapenem(1−)
definition: The mono-anion resulting from the removal of a proton from one of the carboxyic acid groups of ertapenem.

name: erythrityl tetranitrate
definition: Erythritol in which each of the hydroxy groups has been converted to the corresponding nitrate ester. It is a vasodilator with properties similar to nitroglycerin. It is usually used diluted with lactose or other suitable inert excipients, in order to minimise the risk of explosion; undiluted erythrityl tetranitrate can be exploded by percussion or excessive heat.

name: (R)-esmolol
definition: A methyl 3-{4-[2-hydroxy-3-(propan-2-ylamino)propoxy]phenyl}propanoate that has R configuration. The drug esmolol is a racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-esmolol. While the S enantiomer possesses all of the heart rate control, both the R and the S enantiomer contribute to lowering blood pressure.

name: (S)-esmolol
definition: A methyl 3-{4-[2-hydroxy-3-(propan-2-ylamino)propoxy]phenyl}propanoate that has S configuration. The drug esmolol is a racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-esmolol. While the S enantiomer possesses all of the heart rate control, both the R and the S enantiomer contribute to lowering blood pressure.

name: 6-O-sinapoyl-D-glucono-1,5-lactone
definition: The 6-O-sinapoyl derivative of D-glucono-1,5-lactone.

name: luteolin-7-O-[β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucuronide]
definition: The glycosyloxyflavone resulting from the condensation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of luteolin with the 1 position of 2-O-β-D-glucopyranuronosyl-β-D-glucopyranosiduronic acid.

name: 4-O-feruloyl-D-quinate
definition: The conjugate base of 4-O-feruloyl-D-quinic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: O-phosphoviomycin(1+)
definition: O-phosphoviomycin protonated to pH 7.3.

name: viomycin(3+)
definition: Viomycin protonated to pH 7.3

name: galactitol 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: Dianion of D-galactitol 1-phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-glucitol 6-phosphate(2−)
definition: Dianion of D-glucitol 1-phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: phosphoethanolamine-Kdo2-lipid A(6−)
definition: Hexaanion of phosphoethanolamine-Kdo2-lipid A having anionic carboxy and phosphate groups and a protonated primary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-(cis-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl)propanoate
definition: The anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 3-(cis-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl)propanoic acid.

name: 3-[(5R,6S)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]propanoate
definition: The anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 3-[(5R,6S)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]propanoic acid.

name: 3-[(5S,6R)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]propanoate
definition: The anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 3-[(5S,6R)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]propanoic acid.

name: α,α-trehalose-2-sulfate(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of α,α-trehalose-2-sulfate arising from deprotonation of the sulfate group.

name: SL659
definition: The 2-O-sulfonato-2'-O-hexadecanoyl derivative of α,α-trehalose.

name: SL1278
definition: A derivative of α,α-trehalose having an O-sulfo group at the 2 position and two long chain fatty acyl substituents at the 2'- and 3'-positions.

name: sulfolipid-1(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of sulfolipid-1 arising from deprotonation of the sulfate OH group.

name: S881
definition: Anionic form of a sulfated menaquinone-type compound arising from deprotonation of the sulfate OH; a metabolite from Mycobacterium tuberculosis lipid extracts.

name: 2,5-dimethylphenyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate that consists of phenyl isocyanate bearing two additional methyl substituents at positions 2 and 5.

name: 3,4-dimethylphenyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate that consists of phenyl isocyanate bearing two additional methyl substituents at positions 3 and 4.

name: 2-tolyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate comprising a benzene core with isocyanato- and methyl substituents ortho to each other.

name: alanyl poly(glycerol phosphate)(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of alanyl poly(glycerol phosphate); major species at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-β-L-arabino-hex-4-ulose(2−)
definition: Dianion of UDP-2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-β-L-arabino-hex-4-ulose arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Mo(VI)(=O)(=S)(OH)-molybdopterin cofactor(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of Mo(VI)(=O)(=S)(OH)-molybdopterin cofactor; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-cysteinyl sulfurated eukaryotic molybdenum cofactor(2−)
definition: MoCo in eukaryotic sulfite oxidase.

name: streptidine 6-phosphate zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of streptidine 6-phosphate having an anionic phosphate group and protonated guanidino groups; major species at pH 7.3

name: N5-[(hydroxyamino)(imino)methyl]-L-ornithinium(1+)
definition: Conjugate acid of N5-[(hydroxyamino)(imino)methyl]-L-ornithine having an anionic carboxy group and protonated amiino and guanidino groups. It is the principal microspecies present at pH 7.3.

name: 3-[(5S,6R)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]acrylate
definition: The conjugate base of 3-[(5S,6R)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]acrylic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-[(5R,6S)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]acrylate
definition: The conjugate base of 3-[(5R,6S)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]acrylic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N5-[amino(hydroxyimino)methyl]-L-ornithine zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of N5-[amino(hydroxyimino)methyl]-L-ornithine having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated α-amino group.

name: (R)-nipecotamide
definition: The (3R)-enantiomer of nipecotamide.

name: α,α-trehalose-2-sulfate
definition: The 2-O-sulfo derivative of α,α-trehalose.

name: (S)-nipecotamide
definition: The (3S)-enantiomer of nipecotamide.

name: nipecotamide
definition: The amide resulting from the formal condensation of nipecotic acid with ammonia.

name: (R)-nipecotamide(1+)
definition: The cation resulting from the protonation of the piperidine nitrogen of (R)-nipecotamide.

name: sphingosine 1-phosphate(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of sphingosine 1-phosphate having an anionic phosphate group and a protonated amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-nipecotic acid zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of (R)-nipecotic acid.

name: ammonium hexachloropalladate
definition: A salt comprising separate ammonium cations and octahedral [PdCl6]2− anions.

name: N6-(1-carboxyethyl)-L-lysine
definition: A L-lysine derivative formed during the reaction between methylglyoxal and protein. CEL is a homologue of Nε-(carboxymethyl)lysine (CML), an advanced glycation end-product that is formed on reaction of glyoxal or glycolaldehyde with protein and on oxidative cleavage of fructoselysine, the Amadori adduct formed on glycation of protein by glucose.

name: hexachloropalladate(2−)
definition: A perchlorometallate anion having six chlorines and palladium(IV) as the metal component.

name: ammonium hexachlororhodate(III)
definition: A salt comprising separate ammonium cations and octahedral [RhCl6]3− anions.

name: (1R,6S)-1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate
definition: The (1R,6S)-enantiomer of cis-1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-dienecarboxylate.

name: hexachlororhodate(3−)
definition: A perchlorometallate anion having six chlorines and rhodium(III) as the metal component.

name: (1S,6R)-1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-diene-1-carboxylate
definition: The (1S,6R)-enantiomer of cis-1,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,4-dienecarboxylate.

name: ammonium hexachloroiridate
definition: A salt comprising separate ammonium cations and octahedral [IrCl6]2− anions.

name: hexachloroiridate(2−)
definition: A perchlorometallate anion having six chlorines and rhodium(IV) as the metal component.

name: ammonium hexachlororuthenate
definition: A salt comprising separate ammonium cations and octahedral [RuCl6]2− anions.

name: hexachlororuthenate(2−)
definition: A perchlorometallate anion having six chlorines and ruthenium(IV) as the metal component.

name: ammonium hexachlororhodate
definition: A salt comprising separate ammonium cations and octahedral [RhCl6]3− anions.

name: hexachlororhodate(2−)
definition: A perchlorometallate anion having six chlorines and rhodium(IV) as the metal component.

name: ammonium tetrachloroplatinate
definition: A salt comprising separate ammonium cations and square planar [PtCl4]2− anions.

name: ammonium tetrachloropalladate
definition: A salt comprising separate ammonium cations and square planar [PdCl4]2− anions.

name: tetrachloropalladate(2−)
definition: A perchlorometallate anion having four chlorines and palladium(II) as the metal component.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A disaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose linked via a (1→4)-glycosidic bond to N-acetyl-D-glucosamine.

name: (E)-4,8-dimethyl-1,3,7-nonatriene
definition: An alkatriene consisting of 4,8-dimethylnonane having the three double bonds in the 1-, 3- and 7-positions.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-α-D-Gal-OMe
definition: A disaccharide derivative comprising methyl α-D-galactoside having an α-D-galactosyl residue at the 3-position.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→6)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1↔2)-Fru
definition: A tetrasaccharide with no free anomeric centre consisting of two galactosyl residues, one glucosyl residue and one fructosyl residue in a liner sequence, linked as shown.

name: PNCMB
definition: An arylmercury compound consisting of benzylpenicillenic acid conjugated via its mercapto group to 4-carboxyphenylmercury.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide made up from three galactose residues, two glucosamine residues and one glucose residue (at the reducing end); a constituent of human breast milk.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide, which is a constituent of human breast milk.

name: 5-hydroxylysine
definition: A hydroxylysine that is lysine substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide consisting of three galactosyl residues, one N-acetylglucosaminyl residue and one glucosyl residue (at the reducing end), linked as shown.

name: benzylpenicilloyl-cysteine
definition: A compound obtained from nucleophilic cleavage of the β-lactam ring of benzylpenicillin by the amino group of L-cysteine.

name: α-D-galactosyl-(1→2)-α-D-galactose
definition: An α-D-galactosyl-(1→2)-D-galactose in which the reducing end anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: α-(1→3)-galactobiose
definition: A glycosylgalactose comprising two α-D-galactose units joined via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Gal
definition: A galactotriose in which the three D-galactosyl residues are connected via sequential α-(1→3)- and β-(1→4)-linkages.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A galactotetraose comprised of four D-galactose residues connected sequentially by α(1→3), β(1→4) and α(1→3) linkages.

name: 4-(4-deoxy-α-D-gluc-4-enosyluronic acid)-D-galacturonate(2−)
definition: The dianion obtained by removal of a proton from both carboxyic acid groups of 4-(4-deoxy-α-D-gluc-4-enosyluronic acid)-D-galacturonic acid.

name: queuosine
definition: A nucleoside found in tRNA that has an additional cyclopentenyl ring added via an NH group to the methyl group of 7-methyl-7-deazaguanosine. The cyclopentenyl ring may carry other substituents.

name: D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate
definition: The 1-β-anomer of D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate.

name: D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate(2−)
definition: The dianion obtained by removal of two protons from the phosphate group of D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate.

name: D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate(2−)
definition: The dianion obtained by removal of two protons from the phosphate group of D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate.

name: D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate
definition: D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose in which the hydrogens of the hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 7 are substituted by dihydrogen phosphate groups.

name: D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate
definition: D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose in which the hydrogens of the hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 7 are substituted by dihydrogen phosphate groups.

name: D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: The tetra-anion obtained by removal of all of the protons from the phosphate groups of D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate.

name: D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: The tetra-anion obtained by removal of all of the protons from the phosphate groups of D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate.

name: benzylpenicillenic acid
definition: A penicillenic acid having a benzyl substituent at the 2-position on the oxazolone ring.

name: precursor Z hydrate
definition: A linear-fused organic heterotetracyclic compound consisting of a [1,3,2]dioxaphosphinane fused to a pyran ring which is in turn fused to a pteridine ring system. Molybdenum cofactor biosynthesis intermediate. Dehydrated derivative known as precursor Z.

name: compound Z
definition: A pterin phosphate that is an oxidation product of cPMP.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1↔2)-Fru
definition: A trisaccharide composed of D-galactose, D-fructose, and D-glucose, linked as shown.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-D-Ara
definition: A glycosylarabinose consisting of D-arabinose having a β-D-galactosyl residue at the 3-position.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)-D-Gal
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine flanked by two D-galactose residues in a linear sequence with (1→4) and (1→4) linkages.

name: N-acetyl-Asp-N6-[lipoyl]-Lys-Ala-Thr-Ile-Gly-Phe-Glu-Val-Gln-Glu-Glu
definition: A twelve-membered oligopeptide comprising AcAsp, N6-[lipoyl]-Lys, Ala, Thr, Ile, Gly, Phe, Glu, Val, Gln, Glu and Glu residues joined in sequence.

name: benzylpenillic acid
definition: A penillic acid having a benzyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-D-Glc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising residues of galactose, N-acetylglucosamine, galactose and glucose in a linear sequence, all joined by β-(1→3)-linkages.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[2-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A polypeptide mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a 2-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[3-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a 3-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[4-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a 4-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[2,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a 2,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-(4-bromobenzoyl)-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a 4-bromobenzoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[(2-iodophenyl)carbonyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a 2-iodobenzoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-(6-bromohexanoyl)-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a 6-bromohexanoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-(5-chloropentanoyl)-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a 5-chloropentanoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-(chloroacetyl)-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a chloroacetyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-(octanoyl)-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising an octanoyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)acetyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a (2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)acetyl group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-{(2E)-3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]prop-2-enoyl}-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a (2E)-3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]prop-2-enoyl- group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-{(2E)-3-[3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]prop-2-enoyl}-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a {(2E)-3-[3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]prop-2-enoyl}- group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-{(2E)-3-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]prop-2-enoyl}-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a {(2E)-3-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]prop-2-enoyl}-group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[(2E)-3-(4-chlorophenyl)prop-2-enoyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a [(2E)-3-(4-chlorophenyl)prop-2-enoyl]-group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[(2E)-3-(m-tolyl)prop-2-enoyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a [(2E)-3-(m-tolyl)prop-2-enoyl]- group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-[(2E)-3-(3-nitrophenyl)prop-2-enoyl]-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a [(2E)-3-(3-nitrophenyl)prop-2-enoyl]- group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: Ac-Asp-N6-{3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propanoyl}-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A mimotope of the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 component (PDC-E2) comprising a {3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propanoyl} group linked to the lipoated PDC-E2 core dodecapeptide (DKATIGFEVQEE) at N-6 of lysine.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising residues of galactose, N-acetylglucosamine, galactose and glucose in a linear sequence, all joined by β-linkages.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-α-D-GalNAc-OBn
definition: A β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminide disaccharide consisting of benzyl 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactoside having a β-D-galactosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: An L-Fucp-(1→2)-[D-Galp-(1→3)]-D-Galp in which the both the L-fucosyl group at position 2 and the D-galactosyl groups at position 3 have α- configuration.

name: Ac-Asp-Lys-Ala-Thr-Ile-Gly-Phe-Glu-Val-Gln-Glu-Glu
definition: A twelve-membered oligopeptide comprising AcAsp, Lys, Ala, Thr, Ile, Gly, Phe, Glu, Val, Gln, Glu and Glu residues joined in sequence.

name: α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-D-Gal
definition: A glycosylgalactose derivative consisting of D-galactose having an α-D-N-acetylgalactosaminyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: (3R)-3-(tert-butylcarbamoyl)piperazin-1-ium
definition: The cation resulting from the protonation of the amino group at the 4 position of (R)-N-tert-butylpiperazine-2-carboxamide.

name: puromycin(1+)
definition: Puromycin monoprotonated at the amino nitrogen. It is the predominant species at pH 7.3.

name: (4R)-N-(2,3-dihydroxytetracosanoyl)-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide having (2S,3R)-2,3-dihydroxytetracosanoyl as the N-acyl group.

name: Nω-methyl-L-arginine zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion obtained from Nω-methyl-L-arginine by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the α-amino group.

name: Nω-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-arginine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of Nω-(ADP-D-ribosyl)-L-arginine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: phosphonatoformate
definition: The trianion resulting from the removal of three protons from phosphonoformic acid.

name: trisodium phosphonoformate hexahydrate
definition: The hexahydrate form of trisodium phosphonoformate. It is used as an antiviral agent in the treatment of cytomegalovirus retinitis (CMV retinitis, an inflamation of the retina that can lead to blindness) and as an alternative to ganciclovir for AIDS patients who require concurrent antiretroviral therapy but are unable to tolerate ganciclovir due to haematological toxicity.

name: 1,2-dilauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1+)
definition: A A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1+) that is the dilauroyl diester of phosphatidiylcholine.

name: 1,2-dicaproyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1+) that is the dicaproyl diester of phosphatidiylcholine.

name: 3-bromo-4-(dimethylamino)benzaldehyde
definition: Benzaldehyde substituted at the 4-position by an N,N-dimethylamino group and at C-3 by bromine.

name: 5-[3-bromo-4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]-2,2-dimethyl-2,3,5,6-tetrahydrobenzo[a]phenanthridin-4(1H)-one
definition: A partially hydrogenated benzophenanthridine carrying an oxo group at C-4, geminal methyl groups at C-2 and a 3-bromo-4-(dimethylamino)phenyl group at C-5.

name: N6,N6-dimethyladenine
definition: A tertiary amine that is adenine substituted at N-6 by geminal methyl groups.

name: α-N-acetyllysine-N6,N6-dimethyladenosine 5'-phosphomorpholidate
definition: A phosphorodiamidate ester of N,N-dimethyladenosine in which the NR2 groups on phosphorus are morpholino and N2-acetyl-N5-L-lysino.

name: N6-isopentenyladenosine
definition: A hydrocarbyladenosine in which adenosine is substituted at N-6 by an isopentenyl group.

name: dioleoyl phosphatidylethanolamine
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both oleoyl.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl phosphatidylethanolamine
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at C-1 and C-2 are palmitoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1-oleoyl phosphatidylethanolamine
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine in which the phosphatidyl acyl group at C-1 is oleoyl.

name: D-glucuronic acid 3-sulfate
definition: A monosaccharide sulfate that is D-glucuronic acid esterified at O-3 by sulfuric acid.

name: α-Δ4,5HexpUA2S-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpUA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpUA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpUA-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative that is a derivative of an octasaccharide consisting of GlcUAβ1-3GalNAc(6-O-sulfate) disaccharide units with a Δ4,5HexUA(2-O-sulfate)α1-3GalNAc(6-O-sulfate) disaccharide unit at the non-reducing end. It has been isolated from a partial chondroitinase ABC digest of a commercial shark cartilage chondroitin sulfate (CS-C) preparation.

name: α-Δ4,5HexpUA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpUA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpUA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpUA2S-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative that is an octasaccharide derivative consisting of an irregular string of NHAcetyl-substituted and O-sulfated monosaccharide residues with a Δ4,5HexUAα1-3GalNAc(6-O-sulfate) disaccharide unit at the non-reducing end. It has been isolated from a partial chondroitinase ABC digest of a commercial shark cartilage chondroitin sulfate (CS-C) preparation.

name: testosterone (E)-3-(O-carboxymethyl)oxime
definition: The E (anti) isomer of testosterone 3-(O-carboxymethyl)oxime.

name: testosterone (Z)-3-(O-carboxymethyl)oxime
definition: The Z (anti) isomer of testosterone 3-(O-carboxymethyl)oxime.

name: 2-octynoic acid
definition: An acetylenic fatty acid that is octanoic acid (caprylic acid) which has been doubly dehydrogenated at positions 2 and 3 to give the corresponding alkynoic acid. It is widely used in perfumes, lipstick, and many common food flavourings.

name: 2-phenyloxazol-5(4H)-one
definition: A 1,3-oxazole having a phenyl substituent at the 2-position and an oxo group at the 5-position. Note that phenyloxazolone is commonly used as a synonym for 4-(ethoxymethylene)-2-phenyloxazol-5-one (PhOx).

name: testosterone 3-(O-carboxymethyl)oxime
definition: The oxime O-ether formed from testosterone and (aminooxy)acetic acid.

name: β-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-D-Gal
definition: A glycosylgalactose derivative consisting of D-galactose having a β-D-N-acetylgalactosaminyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-D-Gal
definition: A glycosylgalactose derivative consisting of D-galactose having a β-D-N-acetylgalactosaminyl residue attached at the 4-position.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc in which the 2-acetamidogalactosyl group (attached to position 3 of the 2-acetamidogalactose moiety) has α- configuration.

name: L-thyroxine(1−)
definition: The α-amino-acid anion resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxylic acid group of L-thyroxine.

name: testosterone-3-CMO-Hist
definition: An oxime O-ether that is the histamine derivative of testosterone 3-(O-carboxymethyl)oxime.

name: (E)-testosterone-3-CMO-Hist
definition: The E (anti) isomer of testosterone-3-CMO-Hist.

name: (Z)-testosterone-3-CMO-Hist
definition: The Z (syn) isomer of testosterone-3-CMO-Hist.

name: 8-hydroxy-2-oxabicyclo[3.3.1]non-6-ene-3,5-dicarboxylate
definition: Transition state of the chorismate mutase catalyzed Claisen rearrangement of chorismate to prephenate.

name: α-D-GalNAc-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-(1→6)-α-D-GlcNGly-(1→4)-[α-LD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)]-α-D-GalA-(1→3)-[α-LD-Hep-(1→7)]-α-LD-Hep6PEtn-(1→3)-[β-D-Glc-(1→4)]-α-LD-Hep-(1→5)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)][β-L-Arap4N-(1→8)]-α-Kdo
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative that is a tridecasaccharide derivative, the oligosaccharide portion of the Proteus penneri strain 8 (O67) lipopolysaccharide (LPS) core region.

name: 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyroninate
definition: The anion resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxylic acid group of 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine.

name: 4-nitrophenyl N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminide having a 4-nitrophenyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose
definition: The pyranose form of D-galactosamine.

name: aldehydo-D-galactosamine
definition: The open-chain form of D-galactosamine.

name: methyl N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminide having a methyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: L-homocysteine thiolactone
definition: A thiolactone arising from formal condensation of the mercapto (sulfanyl) and carboxylic acid groups of L-homocysteine.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→8)-α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-D-GlcNAc
definition: A tetrasaccharide composed of three α-D-Kdo residues and one acetylated glucosamine residue. It is a partial structure of chlamydial lipopolysaccharide (LPS).

name: 1-O-palmitoyl-2-O-(5-oxovaleryl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1+)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine having palmitoyl and 5-oxovaleryl groups at the 1- and 2-positions respectively.

name: 1-O-palmitoyl-2-O-(epoxyisoprostanoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine having palmitoyl and epoxyisoprostanoyl groups at the 1- and 2-positions respectively.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→2)-[α-D-Tyvp-(1→3)]-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→2)-[α-D-Tyvp-(1→3)]-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap
definition: A branched octasaccharide consisting of two repeating tetrasaccharide units; part of the O-specific polysaccharide from S. enteritidis .

name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a 3-O-sulfo-β-D-glucuronic acid residue, a D-galactosyl residue and an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue (at the reducing end) in a linear sequence.

name: XMD8-92
definition: A dimethylpyrimido[4,5-b][1,4]benzodiazepin-6-one carrying at C-2 on the pyrimidine ring a [2-ethoxy-4-(4-hydroxypiperidin-1-yl)phenyl]amino substituent. It is an inhibitor of the BMK1 kinase pathway.

name: ganglioside GM2 (18:0)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is octadecanoyl. A constituent of natural ganglioside GM2.

name: 8-hydroxy-2-oxabicyclo[3.3.1]non-6-ene-3,5-dicarboxylic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid comprising 8-hydroxy-2-oxabicyclo[3.3.1]non-6-ene having carboxy groups placed at the 3- and 5-positions.

name: D-tryptophan polyoxin C
definition: Polyoxin C in which the primary amino group has been condensed with D-tryptophan to form a peptide bond.

name: 2-methyl-2-(methylsulfanyl)propanal oxime
definition: The oxime resulting from the formal condensation of 2-methyl-2-(methylsulfanyl)propanal with hydroxylamine. Addition of the oxime group to methyl isocyanate forms the final step in the synthesis of the systemic insecticide aldicarb.

name: 2-O-(6-phospho-α-D-mannosyl)-D-glycerate
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion derived from 2-O-(6-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl)-D-glyceric acid by removal of the two protons from the phosphate group and the proton from the carboxylic acid group.

name: α-D-mannose 6-phosphate(2−)
definition: Dianion of α-D-mannose 6-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dipyrromethane cofactor(4−)
definition: Tetracarboxylate anion of dipyrromethane cofactor; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-methyl-7-nitroisatoic anhydride
definition: A 3,1-benzoxazin-1,4-dione having an N-methyl substituent and a nitro group at the 7-position.

name: ferroheme b(2−)
definition: Dicarboxylate anion of ferroheme b; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Kdo-(2→8)-α-Kdo-OAll
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of two 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl units joined via an α-(2→8)-linkage with an O-allyl group at the anomeric centre.

name: α-Kdo-(2→4)-α-Kdo-OAll
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of two 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl units joined via an α-(2→4)-linkage with an O-allyl group at the anomeric centre.

name: (R)-profenamine
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of profenamine.

name: (S)-profenamine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of profenamine.

name: α-Kdo-(2→8)-α-Kdo-(2→4)-α-Kdo-OAll
definition: A trisaccharide derivative consisting of three 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl units in a linear sequence with an O-allyl group at the anomeric centre.

name: 3'-O-salicyl-AMP
definition: An adenosine 5'-monophosphate having a salicyl group at the 3'-position; intermediate in mycobactin biosynthesis.

name: (R)-ethosuximide
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of ethosuximide.

name: (S)-ethosuximide
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of ethosuximide.

name: tetraoleyl cardiolipin
definition: A cardiolipin derivative in which all four of the phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as oleoyl.

name: iron-sulfur-vanadium cofactor
definition: A 7Fe-V-9S-X-homocitryl cluster, the structure of which is assumed to be analogous to the 7Fe-Mo-9S-X-homocitryl cluster. The identity of the X atom is not known, possibly carbon or oxygen.

name: (R)-ethotoin
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of ethotoin.

name: (S)-ethotoin
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of ethotoin.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-tetracosanoylsphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine having a sulfo group at the 3-position on the galactose ring and tetracosanoyl as the N-acyl group.

name: (KDO)3-lipid IVA
definition: Lipid IVA glycosylated with three 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues.

name: (KDO)4-lipid IVA
definition: Lipid IVA glycosylated with four 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues.

name: (KDO)-lipid IVA(5−)
definition: (KDO)-lipid IVA deprotonated at both phosphono groups and at the uronic acid carboxy group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: (KDO)2-lipid IVA(6−)
definition: (KDO)2-lipid IVA deprotonated at both phosphono groups and at the uronic acid carboxy groups. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-palmitoylsphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine having a sulfo group at the 3-position on the galactose ring and palmitoyl as the N-acyl group.

name: (KDO)3-lipid IVA(7−)
definition: (KDO)3-lipid IVA deprotonated at both phosphono groups and at the uronic acid carboxy groups. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: (KDO)4-lipid IVA(8−)
definition: (KDO)4-lipid IVA deprotonated at both phosphono groups and at the uronic acid carboxy groups. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans,poly-cis-decaprenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: Trianion of trans,poly-cis-decaprenyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-etodolac
definition: The R-enantiomer of etodolac. It is inactive, in contrast to the enantiomer, (S)-etodolac, which is a preferential inhibitor of cyclo-oxygenase 2 and a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory. The racemate is commonly used for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis, and for the alleviation of postoperative pain.

name: (S)-etodolac
definition: The S-enantiomer of etodolac. It is a preferential inhibitor of cyclo-oxygenase 2 and a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory, whereas the enantiomer, (R)-etodolac, is inactive. The racemate is commonly used for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis, and for the alleviation of postoperative pain.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)sphingosine
definition: A sulfoglycosphingolipid that is sphingosine substituted on O-1 by a 3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl group; sulfatide in which one acyl chain has been removed by ozonolysis.

name: 2-cis,6-cis-farnesyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: Trianion of 2-cis,6-cis-farnesyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Kdo-(2→8)-α-7-O-Me-Kdo
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl residue and a 3-deoxy-7-O-methyl-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl joined via an α-(2→8)-linkage.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN-4P-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-1P
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide antigen consisting of two 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residues and two glucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a linear sequence, with two phosphate groups attached.

name: cytidine 5'-monophosphate(2−)
definition: A pyrimidine nucleoside 5'-monophosphate(2−) that results from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of cytidine 5'-monophosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→8)-α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcNAc-4P-(1→6)-α-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide epitope consisting of three 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a linear sequence, with one phosphate group attached.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcNAc-4P-(1→6)-α-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide epitope consisting of three 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a linear sequence, with one phosphate group attached.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→8)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo
definition: A brached tetrasaccharide epitope consisting of four 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl residues, linked as shown.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→8)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN-4P-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-1P
definition: A six-membered oligosaccharide phosphate antigen consisting of four 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residues and two glucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a branched sequence, with two phosphate groups attached.

name: N-(2,3-dihydroxyhexacosanoyl)-(4R)-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide having (2S,3R)-2,3-dihydroxyhexacosanoyl as the N-acyl group.

name: ditrans,polycis-tridecaprenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of ditrans,polycis-tridecaprenyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ditrans,polycis-tetradecaprenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of ditrans,polycis-tetradecaprenyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tri-trans,poly-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: Trianion of tri-trans,poly-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-galactose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: Dianion of α-L-galactose 1-phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-alanyl-D-serine zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of D-alanyl-D-serine arising from migration of a proton from the OH of the carboxy terminus to the amino terminus.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→8)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcNAc4P-(1→6)-α-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino hexasaccharide epitope consisting of three 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a branched sequence, with one phosphate group attached.

name: ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate(2−)
definition: Dianion of ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Kdo-(2→8)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-Kdo

name: Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/2-OH-24:0)

definition: A phosphatidic acid in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both oleoyl.

name: dioleoyl phosphatidylcholine

definition: A dodecasaccharide comprising two branched hexasaccharide units joined via a β-(1→2) linkage. Part of the lipopolysaccharide obtained from Salmonella serogroup C1.

definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphoceramide compound having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/26:0)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphoceramide compound having a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/2-OH-24:0)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide compound having an inositol 1-phosphoryl group attached to the mannose residue and a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, with no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 of the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/2-OH-26:0)

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/24:0)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphoceramide compound having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and no additional hydroxylation of the very-long-chain fatty acid.
