definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphoceramide compound having a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 and C-3 of the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: mannose-1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate
definition: A phosphorylated mannosylinositol compound which constitutes the head group of some mannosylinositol phosphorylceramides (the MIPCs), and is a product of their catabolism.

name: mannose-(1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate)2
definition: A phosphorylated mannosylinositol compound which constitutes the head group of some mannosylinositol phosphorylceramides (the M(IP)2Cs), and is a product of their catabolism.

name: 2-O-oleoyl-3-O-palmitoyl-1-O-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-1-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 2- and 3-positions are oleoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: Fe-coproporphyrin III
definition: A metalloporphyrin consisting of coproporphyrin III with a central iron atom.

name: 1-O-linoleoyl-2-O-oleoyl-3-O-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are linoleoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(1R)-1-phenylethyl]-1H-imidazole-5-carboxylic acid
definition: Ethylbenzene in which the pro-R α-hydrogen is substituted by the nitrogen at the 1 position of 1H-imidazole-5-carboxylic acid. Its ethyl ester, etomidate, is used as an intravenous anaesthetic.

name: trans,poly-cis-decaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A decaprenyl diphosphate having (Z)-stereochemistry in all but one of the double bonds.

name: ditrans,polycis-tridecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A tridecaprenyl diphosphate having two (E)- and ten (Z)-double bonds.

name: ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A dodecaprenyl diphosphate having two (E)- and nine (Z)-double bonds.

name: ditrans,polycis-tetradecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A tetradecaprenyl diphosphate having two (E)- and eleven (Z)-double bonds.

name: 4-amino-4-deoxy-α-L-arabinopyranosyl ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of 4-amino-4-deoxy-α-L-arabinopyranosyl ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate having an anionic phosphate group and a protonated amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tri-trans,poly-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A tridecaprenyl diphosphate having three (E)- and seven (Z)-double bonds.

name: α-L-galactose 1-phosphate
definition: A L-galactose 1-phosphate compound having β-configuration about the anomeric centre.

name: D-alanyl-D-serine
definition: A dipeptide comprising D-serine with a D-alanyl residue attached to the α-nitrogen.

name: ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate
definition: An undecaprenyl phosphate having two (E)- and eight (Z)-double bonds.

name: 6-hydroxy-FAD(3−)
definition: The trianion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate hydroxy groups and the imide nitrogen of 6-hydroxy-FAD.

name: dUDP(3−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of 2'-deoxyuridine 5'-diphosphate (dUDP).

name: 4-amino-4-deoxy-α-L-arabinopyranosyl ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate having eleven prenyl units and 4-amino-4-deoxy-α-L-arabinopyranosyl as the glycosyl moiety.

name: 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate polyglutamate macromolecule
definition: An ionic macromolecule consisting of (6R)-5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate(2−) with an arbitrary number of glutamate residues attached as a polypeptide to the single existent one.

name: 1,2-di-O-[1-14C]-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 14C-modified compound that is the 1,2-di-O-palmitoyl-derivative of sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine where both palmitoyl groups have 14C labels at the C-1 position.

name: 1-O-palmitoyl-2-O-[1-14C]-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-acyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine where the 1-O-acyl group is specified as palmitoyl and the linoleoyl group has 14C labels at the C-1 position.

name: 1-O-(α-D-glucopyranuronosyl)-N-tetradecanoyldihydrosphingosine
definition: A glycodihydroceramide having an α-D-glucuronic acid residue at the O-1 position and a tetradecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannose
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of an β-D-galactosyl residue attached to α-D-mannose at the 3-position.

name: [3)α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap(1→]4
definition: The amino hexadecasaccharide obtained when four molecules of the repeating tetrasacchride unit from Shigella dysenteriae O-specific polysaccharide are joined via α-(1→3) linkages.

name: 3-methyl-1,2,4-triazolo[3,4-a]phthalazine
definition: A 1,2,4-triazolo[3,4-a]phthalazine having a methyl substituent at the 3-position.

name: N',N'',N'''-triacetylfusarinine C
definition: An hydroxamate siderophore produced by several fungal species.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→8)-α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide epitope consisting of three 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a linear sequence.

name: adenosylcobinamide guanosyl diphosphate(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the anion of adenosylcobinamide guanosyl diphosphate with overall charge −1, arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cob(I)alamin(1−)
definition: Monoanion of cob(I)alamin arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: magnesium 131-hydroxyprotoporphyrin 13-monomethyl ester(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of magnesium 131-hydroxyprotoporphyrin 13-monomethyl ester, formed by deprotonation of the carboxyethyl group at C-17. It is the principal species at pH 7.3.

name: magnesium 131-oxoprotoporphyrin 13-monomethyl ester(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of magnesium 131-oxoprotoporphyrin 13-monomethyl ester, formed by deprotonation of the carboxyethyl group at C-17. It is the principal species at pH 7.3.

name: magnesium protoporphyrin 13-monomethyl ester(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of magnesium protoporphyrin 13-monomethyl ester, formed by deprotonation of the carboxyethyl group at C-17. It is the principal species at pH 7.3.

name: magnesium protoporphyrin(2−)
definition: The conjugate base of magnesium protoporphyrin, formed by deprotonation of the carboxyethyl groups at C-13 and C-17. It is the principal species at pH 7.3.

name: adenosylcobalamin 5'-phosphate(2−)
definition: The conjugate base of adenosylcobalamin 5'-phosphate, formed by loss of two protons from the 5'-phosphate group.

name: 5-hydroxybenzimidazolylcob(I)amide(1−)
definition: The anion of 5-hydroxybenzimidazolylcob(I)amide, formed by loss of a proton from the phosphate OH group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-methyl-7-oxo-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine (2-oxo tautomer)(1−)
definition: The anion formed from 6-methyl-7-oxo-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine by removal of a proton from the nitrogen at position 3 (i.e. between the oxo groups). It is the major species at physiological pH.

name: iron-sulfur-iron cofactor
definition: P-cluster from Mo-independent nitrogenases, deprotonated to pH 7.3. Unfortunately, there are no structures available, and one of the O ligands of Fe has actually not been confirmed (hence the X in the name)

name: Fe4S2O2 iron-sulfur-oxygen cluster
definition: A hybrid iron-sulfur-oxygen cluster in which four iron atoms are linked by two sulfur and two oxygen bridging ligands

name: O-(cyclohexanecarbonyl)lysergol
definition: Lysergol esterified with cyclohexanecarboxylic acid.

name: lysergol
definition: An alkaloid of the ergoline family that occurs as a minor constituent in some species of fungi and in the morning glory family of plants. Its structure is that of ergoline with a methyl group at N-6 and a β-hydroxymethyl substituent at C-8.

name: ferroheme o(2−)
definition: The cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is ferroheme o protonated to pH 7.3.

name: ferriheme a(1−)
definition: Ferriheme a protonated to pH 7.3.

name: molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide protonated to pH 7.3.

name: molybdopterin cytosine dinucleotide(3−)
definition: Molybdopterin cytosine dinucleotide protonated to pH 7.3

name: oxotungsten-bis(molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide)(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of oxotungsten-bis(molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide); major species at pH 7.3.

name: Mo(V)-molybdopterin cytosine dinucleotide(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the two diphosphate OH groups of Mo(V)-molybdopterin cytosine dinucleotide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Mo(=O)-bis(molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide)(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of molybdate-bis(molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide); major species at pH 7.3.

name: coenzyme F430(4−)
definition: The penta-anion resulting from the removal of a proton from each of the carboxylic acid groups of coenzyme F430. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: benzylpenicillenate
definition: The conjugate base of benzylpenicillenic acid.

name: benzylpenilloaldehyde
definition: Degradation product of benzylpenicillin in which the thiolamino acid penicillamine and carbon dioxide from the labile carboxyl group have been lost, leaving a phenylacetylamino-acetaldehyde.

name: m-azobenzenesulfonate
definition: The conjugate base of m-azobenzenesulfonic acid.

name: m-azobenzenesulfonic acid
definition: Azobenzene derivative carrying a single sulfonate substituent at the meta-position.

name: ferroheme d1(4−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion arising from deprotonation of the four carboxy groups of ferroheme d1; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Kdo-4P-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN-4P-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-1P
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residue and two glucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a linear sequence, with three phosphate groups attached. Isolated from the lipopolysaccharide obtained from Haemophilus influenzae.

name: α-D-Kdo-5P-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN-4P-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-1P
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residue and two glucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a linear sequence, with three phosphate groups attached. Isolated from the lipopolysaccharide obtained from Haemophilus influenzae.

name: D-Glcp-(1→3)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-6-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-Kdo
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide corresponding to part of the lipooligosaccharide from Neisseria meningitidis.

name: ferroheme c
definition: A ferroheme coordination complex bearing 1-sulfanylethyl substituents at the 8- and 13-positions.

name: D-α-D-Hepp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose where the glycosyl component is D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptopyranose attached via an α-(1→6)-linkage; the epitope of the lipooligosaccharide isolated from Haemophilus ducreyi strain ITM 2665.

name: felypressin
definition: A synthetic nonapeptide comprising cysteinyl, phenylalanyl, phenylalanyl, glutaminyl, asparaginyl, cysteinyl, prolyl, lysyl, and glycinamide residues in sequence, with a disulfide bridge joining the two cysteine residues. Its antidiuretic effects are less than those of vasopressin. It is used as a vasoconstrictor in local anaesthetic injections for dental use, and is an ingredient of preparations that have been used for treatment of pain and inflammation of the mouth.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-1P
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of two 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residues and two glucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a linear sequence, with a phosphate group at the reducing end. Corresponds to the core oligosaccahride isolated from Salmonella minnesota strain R 595.

name: fenoprofen(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of fenoprofen.

name: p-azophenyltrimethylammonium
definition: An azobenzene derivative carrying two para-trimethylammonium substituents.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl L-serine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both oleoyl.

name: α-D-Kdo-4P-(2→6)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 3-deoxy-4-O-phosphono-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residue attached to β-glucosamine via an α-(2→6)-linkage.

name: α-D-Kdo-5P-(2→6)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 3-deoxy-5-O-phosphono-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residue attached to β-glucosamine via an α-(2→6)-linkage.

name: α-D-Kdo-4P-(2→6)-β-D-GlcNAc-OAll
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 3-deoxy-4-O-phosphono-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residue attached to β-glucosamine via an α-(2→6)-linkage with an O-allyl group at the anomeric centre.

name: α-D-Kdo-5P-(2→6)-β-D-GlcNAc-OAll
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 3-deoxy-5-O-phosphono-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residue attached to β-glucosamine via an α-(2→6)-linkage with an O-allyl group at the anomeric centre.

name: α-D-Kdo-5P-OAll
definition: The 1-O-allyl-5-phospho derivative of 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid.

name: α-D-Kdo-4P-OAll
definition: The 1-O-allyl-4-phospho derivative of 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid.

name: calcium oxalate
definition: The calcium salt of oxalic acid, which in excess in the urine may lead to formation of oxalate calculi (kidney stones).

name: bicozamycin
definition: A commercially important azabicyclic antibiotic obtained from Streptomyces sapporonensis. It inhibits the Rho protein of E. coli.

name: 3,6-diamino-10-methylacridinium
definition: The cation obtained from 3,6-diaminoacridine by methylation of the nitrogen at position 10.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising lacto-N-neotetraose having an α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue attached at the 6-position of the galactosyl residue at the non-reducing end.

name: eosin 5-isothiocyanate
definition: The 2',4',5',7'-tetrabromo-5-isothiocyanato derivative of fluorescein; exhibits phosphorescence with an emission maximum at ~680 nm.

name: 4-diazoniophenylphosphorylcholine
definition: A phosphocholine carrying an O-(4-diazoniophenyl) substituent.

name: metalaxyl-M
definition: A methyl N-(2,6-dimethylphenyl)-N-(methoxyacetyl)alaninate that is the more active R-enantiomer of metalaxyl. A systemic fungicide, it is active against phytopathogens of the order Peronosporales and is used to conrtrol Pythium in a number of vegetable crops.

name: rhodamine B 5-isothiocyanate
definition: The 5-isomer of rhodamine B isothiocyanate.

name: rhodamine B 6-isothiocyanate
definition: The 6-isomer of rhodamine B isothiocyanate.

name: 4-(trimethylammonium)benzenediazonium
definition: An aromatic diazonium ion consiting of a benzene core with diazonium and trimethylammonium groups para to one another.

name: 2-hydroxypentanoate
definition: The pentanoate anion substituted at the α-carbon by a hydroxy group. The conjugate base of 2-hydroxypentanoic acid, it is the predominant species at physiological pH.

name: (S)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyric acid
definition: The S-enantiomer of 2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyric acid. It is used as a chiral building block for peptide synthesis.

name: tetraethyl [(3-hydroxy-2-pyridyl)amino]methanediphosphonate
definition: The tetraethyl ester of [[(3-hydroxypyridin-2-yl)amino]methylene]bisphosphonic acid

name: lefradafiban
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones that is pyrrolidin-2-one in which the 3-pro-S-hydrogen is substituted by a 2-methoxy-2-oxoethyl group, while the 5-pro-S-hydrogen is substituted by a ({4'-[N-(methoxycarbonyl)carbamimidoyl]biphenyl-4-yl}oxy)methyl group. It is an orally active prodrug of fradafiban, a figrinogen receptor antagonist.

name: 2-nitro-1-(2-trifluoromethoxyphenyl)ethanone
definition: Ethanone substituted at C-1 by a (2-trifluoromethoxyphenyl group and at C-2 by a nitro group.

name: (+)-(1R)-1-[4-(4-fluorophenyl)-2,6-diisopropyl-5-propylpyridin-3-yl]ethanol
definition: A 4-aryl-5-(2-hydroxyalkyl)pyridine derivative used as a glucagon receptor antagonist.

name: amoxicillin diketopiperazine
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines obtained via autoaminolysis of amoxicillin.

name: methyl 5-aminolevulinate hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of methyl 5-aminolevulinate. A prodrug, it is metabolised to protoporphyrin IX, a photosensitizer, and is used in the photodynamic treatment of non-melanoma skin cancer (including basal cell carcinoma). Topical application results in an accumulation of protoporphyrin IX in the skin lesions to which the cream has been applied. Subsequent illumination with red light results in the generation of toxic singlet oxygen that destroys cell membranes and thereby kills the tumour cells.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyric acid
definition: A valine derivative that is valine in which the amino group has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-hydroxypentanoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is valeric (pentanoic) acid substituted at the α-position by a hydroxy group.

name: doxycycline monohydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of doxycycline. A semi-synthetic tetracycline antibiotic, it is used to inhibit bacterial protein synthesis and treat non-gonococcal urethritis and cervicitis, exacerbations of bronchitis in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and adult periodontitis.

name: α-D-Abep-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap
definition: A linear trisaccharide, which forms part of the repeating unit of the Salmonella serogroup B oligosaccharide.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1+)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are stearoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: valproate
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of valproic acid.

name: 6-methoxy-2-octaprenylhydroquinone
definition: A polyprenylhydroquinone in which the polyprenyl substituent is octaprenyl at C-2; a methoxy group is also present at C-6.

name: 5-methoxy-2-methyl-3-octaprenylhydroquinone
definition: A polyprenylhydroquinone in which the polyprenyl substituent is octaprenyl at C-3; methoxy and methyl groups are also present at C-5 and C-2 respectively.

name: 1,2-di-O-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both arachidonoyl.

name: 4,6-O-[(1R)-1-carboxyethylidene]-α-D-galactose
definition: A 4,6-O-[(1R)-1-carboxyethylidene]-D-galactose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: cembrane
definition: A 14-membered macrocyclic diterpene carrying an isopropyl group at C-1 and three symmetrically disposed methyl groups at C-4, -8 and -12.

name: 2-(trifluoromethyl)benzoic acid
definition: A benzoic acid carrying a trifluoromethyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: 3-(trifluoromethyl)benzoic acid
definition: A benzoic acid carrying a trifluoromethyl substituent at the 3-position.

name: 4-(trifluoromethyl)benzoic acid
definition: A benzoic acid carrying a 4-trifluoromethyl substituent.

name: 2,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)benzoic acid
definition: A benzoic acid carrying trifluoromethyl substituents at the 2- and 5-positions.

name: 4-bromobenzoic acid
definition: A bromobenzoic acid carrying a single bromo subsituent at the 4-position.

name: 6-bromohexanoic acid
definition: An organobromine compound comprising hexanoic acid having a bromo substituent at the 6-position.

name: 5-chloropentanoic acid
definition: An organochlorine compound comprising pentanoic acid with a 5-chloro substituent.

name: (2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)acetic acid
definition: An organofluorine compound consisting of acetic acid carrying a 2-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy) substituent.

name: (E)-2-(trifluoromethyl)cinnamic acid
definition: A member of the class of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes consisting of trans-cinnamic acid having a trifluoromethyl substituent at the ortho-position.

name: (E)-3-(trifluoromethyl)cinnamic acid
definition: A member of the class of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes consisting of trans-cinnamic acid having a trifluoromethyl substituent at the meta-position.

name: (E)-4-(trifluoromethyl)cinnamic acid
definition: A member of the class of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes consisting of trans-cinnamic acid having a trifluoromethyl substituent at the para-position.

name: 3-nitrocinnamic acid
definition: A C-nitro compound comprising trans-cinnamic acid having a nitro group at position 3 on the phenyl ring.

name: 3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid comprising propionic acid having a 2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl group at the 3-position.

name: 4-chlorobenzoyl chloride
definition: An acyl chloride consisting of benzoyl chloride having a chloro substituent in the para-position.

name: 2-chlorobenzoyl chloride
definition: An acyl chloride consisting of benzoyl chloride having a chloro substituent in the ortho-position.

name: sodium silicate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having silicate as the counterion.

name: all-trans-decaprenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion which is obtained from all-trans-decaprenyl diphosphate by removal of the three protons from the diphosphate group. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: dilinoleoyl phosphatidylglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both linoleoyl.

name: ditetradecanoyl phosphatidylglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both tetradecanoyl (myristoyl).

name: dipalmitoyl phosphatidylglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both palmitoyl.

name: dilauroyl phosphatidylglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both lauroyl.

name: procainamide 4-hydroxylamine
definition: A benzamide obtained via formal condensation of 4-hydroxylaminobenzoic acid and 2-(diethylamino)ethylamine; a metabolite in liver microsomes.

name: N-acetylprocainamide
definition: A benzamide obtained via formal condensation of 4-acetamidobenzoic acid and 2-(diethylamino)ethylamine.

name: 4-nitrosoprocainamide
definition: A benzamide obtained via formal condensation of 4-nitrosobenzoic acid and 2-(diethylamino)ethylamine.

name: β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-α-D-Araf
definition: An arabinotetraose in which the four arabinofuranose residues are in a β(1→2), α(1→5) and α(1→5) linear sequence (with α-configuration at the reducing end). Corresponds to part of the lipoarabinomannam from Mycobacterium leprae and M. tuberculosis.

name: 2-thiouridine
definition: A thiouridine in which the oxygen replaced by sulfur is that at C-2.

name: guanosine 3'-monophosphate(2−)
definition: A nucleoside 3'-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of guanosine 3'-monophosphate (GMP); mjor species at pH 7.3.

name: GPL P-II
definition: A glycopeptidolipid antigen isolated from Mycobacterium peregrinum.

name: N-Ac-Asp-N6-lipoyl-KATIGFEVQEE
definition: A polypeptide comprising the 12-amino acid sequence KATIGFEVQEE where the N-terminal lysyl (K) residue has an acetyl group at the Nα-position and a lipoyl group on the side-chain. A component of the inner lipoyl domain of the second enzyme of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex (PDC-E2), to which antibodies are raised in the autoimmune disease primary biliary cirrhosis.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-N-stearoylsphingosine
definition: A sialotetraosylceramide consisting of a linear pentasaccharide made up from one sialyl residues, two galactose residues, one N-acetylglucosamine residue and a glucose residue at the reducing end attached to N-stearoylsphingosine via a β-linkage.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-icosa-11,14-dienoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an icosa-11,14-dienoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-[8-(4-fluorophenyl)octanoyl]phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 8-(4-fluorophenyl)octanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: floxuridine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside compound having 5-fluorouracil as the nucleobase; used to treat hepatic metastases of gastrointestinal adenocarcinomas and for palliation in malignant neoplasms of the liver and gastrointestinal tract.

name: 5-chlorouracil
definition: An organochlorine compound consisting of uracil having an chloro substituent at the 5-position.

name: 5-nitrouracil
definition: A C-nitro compound consisting of uracil having a nitro group at the 5-position.

name: (2R,21S)-8-ethenyl-21,22-bis(methoxycarbonyl)-17-(3-methoxy-3-oxopropyl)-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13-propanoic acid
definition: The 21,22,17-trimethyl ester of (2R,21S)-21,22-dicarboxy-8-ethenyl-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13,17-dipropanoic acid.

name: (2S,21R)-8-ethenyl-21,22-bis(methoxycarbonyl)-17-(3-methoxy-3-oxopropyl)-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13-propanoic acid
definition: The 21,22,17-trimethyl ester of (2S,21R)-21,22-dicarboxy-8-ethenyl-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13,17-dipropanoic acid.

name: 3-deoxyglucosone
definition: A deoxyketohexose comprising the open-chain form of D-glucose lacking the -OH group at the 3-position and having the keto group at the 2-position.

name: (2R,21S)8-ethenyl-21,22-bis(methoxycarbonyl)-13-(3-methoxy-3-oxopropyl)-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-17-propanoic acid
definition: The 21,22,13-trimethyl ester of (2R,21S)-21,22-dicarboxy-8-ethenyl-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13,17-dipropanoic acid.

name: (2S,21R)-8-ethenyl-21,22-bis(methoxycarbonyl)-13-(3-methoxy-3-oxopropyl)-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-17-propanoic acid
definition: The 21,22,13-trimethyl ester of (2S,21R)-21,22-dicarboxy-8-ethenyl-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13,17-dipropanoic acid.

name: (2R,21S)-21,22-dicarboxy-8-ethenyl-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13,17-dipropanoic acid
definition: 2,21-Dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13,17-dipropanoic acid substituted by carboxy groups at positions 21 and 22, an ethenyl group at position 8, and methyl groups at positions 2, 7, 12 and 18 (the 2R,21S-enantiomer).

name: (2S,21R)-21,22-dicarboxy-8-ethenyl-2,7,12,18-tetramethyl-2,21-dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13,17-dipropanoic acid
definition: 2,21-Dihydrobenzo[b]porphyrin-13,17-dipropanoic acid substituted by carboxy groups at positions 21 and 22, an ethenyl group at position 8, and methyl groups at positions 2, 7, 12 and 18 (the 2S,21R-enantiomer).

name: fluprostenol
definition: An organofluorine compound that is racemic prostaglandin F2α in which the pentyl group is replaced by a 3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxymethyl group. A synthetic analogue of prostaglandin F2α, ophthalmic solutions of its isopropyl ester prodrug, travoprost, are used as a topical medication for controlling the progression of open-angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension, by reducing intraocular pressure. The isopropyl ester group of travoprost is hydrolysed to the biologically active free acid by esterases in the cornea.

name: 3'-UMP(2−)
definition: A nucleoside 3'-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of uridine 3'-monophosphate (UMP). It is the predominant species at physiological pH.

name: 2-keto-L-xylose
definition: A 2-keto-xylose having L-threo configuration; a degradation product of L-ascorbic acid.

name: (S)-timolol hemihydrate
definition: A hydrate, which is the hemihydrate form of the (S)-(−) (more active) enantiomer of timolol.

name: bupivacaine hydrochloride hydrate
definition: A racemate composed of equimolar amounts of dextrobupivacaine hydrochloride hydrate and levobupivacaine hydrochloride hydrate. A piperidinecarboxamide-based local anaesthetic, it has a slow onset and long duration of action.

name: dextrobupivacaine
definition: The (R)-(+)-enantiomer of bupivacaine.

name: lidocaine hydrochloride monohydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of lidocaine hydrochloride.

name: methohexital(1−)
definition: The anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the N3 position of methohexital.

name: esketamine
definition: The S- (more active) enantiomer of ketamine.

name: esketamine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of esketamine.

name: ropivacaine
definition: The piperidinecarboxamide obtained by the formal condensation of N-propylpipecolic acid and 2,6-dimethylaniline.

name: (S)-ropivacaine hydrochloride (anhydrous)
definition: The anhydrous form of (S)-ropivacaine hydrochloride.

name: rolicyclidine
definition: Pyrrolidine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is substituted by a 1-phenylcyclohex-1-yl group.

name: gentiobiose octaacetate
definition: An acetate ester formed by total acetylation of gentiobiose.

name: diphenyl phthalate
definition: The diphenyl ester of benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

name: 1-C-(indol-3-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting the from removal of two protons from the phosphate group of 1-C-(indol-3-yl)glycerol 3-phosphate.

name: streptothricin F
definition: A streptothricin in which the peptide side-chain consists of a single unit of β-lysine.

name: streptothricin F(3+)
definition: A primary aliphatic ammonium ion which is obtained from streptothricin F by protonation of the guanidino and amino groups.

name: streptothricin F acid
definition: The streptothricin acid obtained by hydrolysis of the lactam group of streptothricin F.

name: 1-(L-norvalin-5-yl)pyrraline
definition: An N-substituted pyrraline formed via Maillard reaction of L-ornithine with glucose.

name: streptothricin acid
definition: Any δ-amino acid obtained by the formal hydrolysis of the lactam group of a streptothricin.

name: streptothricin D
definition: A streptothricin in which the peptide side-chain consists of 3 units of β-lysine.

name: streptothricin D(5+)
definition: A primary aliphatic ammonium ion which is obtained from streptothricin D by protonation of the guanidino and amino groups.

name: streptothricin D acid
definition: The streptothricin acid obtained by hydrolysis of the lactam group of streptothricin D.

name: naptalam
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide which results from addition of one equivalent of 1-naphthylamine to phthalic anhydride.

name: phytochelatin
definition: A family of peptides related to glutathione and composed of (γ-Glu-Cys)n-Gly where n is in the range 2-11.

name: 2',3'-cyclic GMP(1−)
definition: A 2',3'-cyclic nucleotide(1−) which is obtained from 2',3'-cyclic GMP by removal of a proton from the cyclic phosphate group.

name: streptothricin F acid (pH 7.3)
definition: A primary aliphatic ammonium ion which is obtained from streptothricin F by protonation of the guanidino and amino groups and deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: streptothricin D acid (pH 7.3)
definition: A primary aliphatic ammonium ion which is obtained from streptothricin D by protonation of the guanidino and amino groups and deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: (2R,3S)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid
definition: A 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid in which the stereocentre attached to the amino group has R-configuration, whilst that attached to the hydroxy group has S-configuration.

name: 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid
definition: An amino alcohol which is 2,3-dihydranthranilic acid in which a hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: (2S,3R)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid
definition: A 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid in which the stereocentre attached to the amino group has S-configuration, whilst that attached to the hydroxy group has R-configuration.

name: (2R,3R)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid
definition: A 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid in which both stereocentres have R-configuration.

name: (2S,3S)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid
definition: A 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid in which both stereocentres have S-configuration.

name: (2R,3S)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion
definition: A 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of (2R,3S)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid.

name: (2S,3R)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion
definition: A 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of (2S,3R)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid.

name: 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid.

name: (2R,3R)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion
definition: A 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of (2R,3R)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid.

name: (2S,3S)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion
definition: A 2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of (2S,3S)-2,3-dihydro-3-hydroxyanthranilic acid.

name: 6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A cyclic ketone consisting of cyclohex-3-en-1-one substituted at position 5 by a carboxy group and position 6 by an amino group.

name: (1R,6R)-6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A 6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid in which both stereocentres have R-configuration.

name: (1S,6S)-6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A 6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid in which both stereocentres have S-configuration.

name: (1R,6S)-6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A 6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid in which stereocentre attached to the carboxylic acid group has R-configuration, while that attached to the amino group has S-configuration.

name: (1S,6R)-6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A 6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid in which stereocentre attached to the carboxylic acid group has S-configuration, while that attached to the amino group has R-configuration.

name: (1R,6R)-6-ammonio-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylate
definition: An amino acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of (1R,6R)-6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: 6-ammonio-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylate
definition: An amino acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of 6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid zwitterion.

name: (1R,6S)-6-ammonio-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylate
definition: An amino acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of (1R,6S)-6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: (1S,6R)-6-ammonio-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylate
definition: An amino acid zwitterion, obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of (1S,6R)-6-amino-5-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: DOSPA trifluoroacetate
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt in which the quaternary nitrogen is substituted by a 2,3-dioleyloxypropyl group, a [2-(sperminecarboxamido)ethyl group, and two methyl groups, and in which the positive charged is balanced by a trifluoroacetate anion.

name: (3-aminopropyl)(L-aspartyl-1-amino)phosphoryl-5'-adenosine
definition: An organic phosphoramidate that is 5'-O-[amino(3-aminopropoxy)phosphoryl]adenosine in which the nitrogen of the phosphoramidite is acylated by a (2S)-2-amino-3-carboxypropanoyl group.

name: selenium(2+)
definition: The selenium ion with two positive charges.

name: leucodopachrome
definition: A 5,6-dihydroxyindoline-2-carboxylic acid with S stereochemistry at C-2.

name: 2',3'-cyclic UMP(1−)
definition: A 2',3'-cyclic nucleotide(1−) which is obtained from 2',3'-cyclic UMP by removal of a proton from the cyclic phosphate group.

name: phenylacetylglycine(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of phenylacetylglycine. The major species of phenylacetylglycine at pH 7.3.

name: 3'-CMP(2−)
definition: A nucleoside 3'-phosphate(2−) which results from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of 3'-CMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose
definition: A glycosylglucose comprising β-D-glucose having a D-galactosyl residue at the 4-position.

name: 2',3'-cyclic CMP(1−)
definition: A 2',3'-cyclic nucleotide(1−) which is obtained from 2',3'-cyclic CMP by removal of a proton from the cyclic phosphate group.

name: 3-geranyl-4-hydroxybenzoate(1−)
definition: A hydroxybenzoate having the hydroxy group at the 4-position together with a geranyl group at the 3-position; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2',3'-cyclic AMP(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion which is obtained from 2',3'-cyclic AMP by removal of a proton from the cyclic phosphate group.

name: 3'-AMP(2−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion which results from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of 3'-AMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,4E)-6-(2-aminophenyl)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate
definition: A 6-(2-aminophenyl)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate in which the two double bonds adopt E,E-configuration.

name: (2E)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate
definition: A 2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate in which the double bond between positions 2 and 3 has E- (cis-) geometry.

name: 3-hydroxy-D-aspartic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxyaspartic acid that has R configuration at the carbon bearing the amino group.

name: BAPTA
definition: A polyamino carboxylic acid in which bis(carboxymethyl)nitrilo groups are bonded to C-2 and C-2' of 1,1'-[ethane-1,2-diylbis(oxy)]dibenzene.

name: 5,5'-dimethyl-BAPTA
definition: A polyamino carboxylic acid, the structure of which is that of BAPTA carrying methyl substituents at C-5 and C-5'.

name: 5,5'-dibromo-BAPTA
definition: A polyamino carboxylic acid, the structure of which is that of BAPTA carrying bromine substituents at C-5 and C-5'.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxy-D-aspartic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy-D-aspartic acid in which the carbon bearing the hydroxy substituent has S configuration.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxy-D-aspartate(1−)
definition: A D-α-amino acid anion which is obtained from (3S)-3-hydroxy-D-aspartic acid by formal deprotonation of both carboxyl groups and protonation of the amino group.

name: (3R)-3-hydroxy-D-aspartic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy-D-aspartic acid in which the carbon bearing the hydroxy substituent has R configuration.

name: (3R)-3-hydroxy-D-aspartate(1−)
definition: A D-α-amino acid anion which is obtained from (3R)-3-hydroxy-D-aspartic acid by formal deprotonation of both carboxyl groups and protonation of the amino group.

name: ubiquinol-0
definition: The ubiquinol corresponding to ubiquinone-0.

name: 6-methyl-7-oxo-8-(1-D-ribityl)lumazine (2-oxo tautomer)
definition: A D-ribityl derivative of pteridine that is a potent inhibitor of riboflavin synthetase.

name: orphenadrine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride comprising equimolar amounts of ophenadrine and hydrogen chloride.

name: N-(4-aminobenzoyl)-L-glutamate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion which results from the removal of a proton from each of the carboxylic acid groups of N-(4-aminobenzoyl)-L-glutamic acid.

name: 4-hydroxy-L-threonine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 4-hydroxy-L-threonine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: metoclopramide dihydrochloride monohydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of metoclopramide dihydrochloride.

name: (S)-ethylmalonyl-CoA

name: scopolamine hydrobromide trihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the trihydrate form of scopolamine hydrobromide.

name: ciguatoxin IJKLM cyclic acetal
definition: A polycyclic ether comprising a linear sequence of sequence of five trans-fused oxacycles and one spiro-fused tetrahydrofuran ring.

name: (4Z)-2,8:7,12:11,15:14,18:17,22-pentaanhydro-1,3-O-(2-carboxyethylidene)-4,5,6,9,10,13,19,20,21-nonadeoxy-L-arabino-L-allo-L-allo-docosa-4,9,20-trienitol
definition: A polycyclic ether comprising a linear sequence of sequence of six trans-fused six-, seven- and eight-membered oxacycles.

name: scopolamine methobromide
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt resulting from the reaction of the amino group of scopolamine with methyl bromide.

name: ciguatoxin CTX3C
definition: A ciguatoxin comprising a sequence of twelve trans-fused six-, seven-, eight- and nine-membered oxacycles and a spiro-fused tetrahydrofuran.

name: scutellarin
definition: The glycosyloxyflavone which is the 7-O-glucuronide of scutellarein.

name: 51-hydroxy ciguatoxin CTX3C
definition: A ciguatoxin comprising a sequence of twelve trans-fused six-, seven-, eight- and nine-membered oxacycles and a spiro-fused hydroxytetrahydrofuran ring.

name: 5-nitroanthranilic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid in which the the amino group is ortho- to the carboxylic acid group, and which is substituted para- to the amino group by a nitro group.

name: 5-nitrosalicylic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid in which the hydroxy group is ortho- to the carboxylic acid group and which has a nitro substituent para- to the phenolic hydroxy group.

name: wogonin 7-O-β-D-glucuronide
definition: The glycosyloxyflavone which is the 7-O-glucuronide of wogonin.

name: baicalin(1−)
definition: The carbohydrate acid derivative anion that is the conjugate base of baicalin.

name: scutellarin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of scutellarin.

name: wogonin 7-O-β-D-glucuronate
definition: The monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of wogonin 7-O-β-D-glucuronide.

name: (S)-2-O-sulfonatolactate(2−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the sulfo and carboxy groups of (S)-2-O-sulfolactic acid.

name: 5-hydroxymethyl-2'-deoxyuridine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside composed of 2'-deoxyuridine having a 5-hydroxymethyl substituent.

name: (S)-3-sulfonatolactate(2−)
definition: An optically active form of (S)-3-sulfonatolactate having (S)-configuration.

name: (R)-4-phosphopantoic acid
definition: A carboxyalkyl phosphate that is the 4-phosphate derivative of (R)-pantoic acid.

name: (R)-4-phosphonatopantoate(3−)
definition: Trianion of (R)-5-phosphopantoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3

name: germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-oate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that results from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-oic acid.

name: cerebronic acid
definition: A very long-chain hydroxy fatty acid composed of lignoceric acid having a 2-hydroxy substituent.

name: germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-oic acid
definition: A germacrane sesquiterpenoid derived from germacrane by dehydrogenation between the 1-10, 4-5, and 11-13 positions, and by oxidation of the methyl group at position 12 to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A linear mannotriose consisting of three D-mannose units joined by α-(1→3)- and α-(1→2)-linkages

name: solavetivol
definition: A spiro compound that is spiro[4.5]dec-6-ene which is substituted at positions 2, 6, 8, and 10 by isopropenyl, methyl, hydroxy, and methyl groups, respectively (the (2R,5S,8S,10R)-diastereoisomer).

name: carbonyl dihydrazine
definition: A carbohydrazide obtained by formal condensation between hydrazinecarboxylic acid and hydrazine.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A linear mannopentaose composed of five D-mannose units, connected in sequence by one α-(1→3) and three α-(1→2) linkages.

name: Reactive Blue 5
definition: Anthraquinone carrying amino, sulfo and [3-({4-chloro-6-[(3-sulfophenyl)amino]-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl}amino)-4-sulfophenyl]amino substituents at positions 1, 2 and 4 respectively.

name: 5-hydroxypseudobaptigenin
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is pseudobaptigenin substituted by hydroxy group at position 5.

name: C21-steroid
definition: A steroid that has a structure based on a 21-carbon (pregnane) skeleton. Note that individual examples may have ring substituents at other positions and/or contain double bonds, aromatic A-rings, expanded/contracted rings etc., so the formula and mass may vary from that given for the generic structure.

name: XTP(4−)
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate(4−) obtained by global deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of XTP; major species present at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-D-Manp
definition: A mannopentaose consisting of D-mannose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 6 have each been glycosylated by an α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannopyranosyl group.

name: (3Z)-hex-3-en-1-yl acetate
definition: An acetate ester that results from the formal condensation of acetic acid with (Z)-hex-3-en-1-ol.

name: cyanidin 3-O-(2-O-β-D-glucuronosyl)-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine that is the conjugate base of cyanidin 3-O-(2-O-β-D-glucuronosyl)-β-D-glucoside, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyanidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine that is the conjugate base of cyanidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside, arising from selective deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group on the chromene ring; major species at pH 7.3.

name: bistriflylimide anion
definition: An imide anion in which the substituents on the negatively charged nitrogen are triflyl groups.

name: 1,3-dimethylimidazolium
definition: A 1-alkyl-3-methylimidazolium in which the alkyl substituent at C-1 is methyl.

name: pratensein(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that results from the removal of a proton from the hydroxy group at position 7 of pratensein.

name: 1,3-dimethylimidazolium iodide
definition: An organic iodide salt in which the cationic component is 1,3-dimethylimidazolium.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A six-membered glucosamine oligosaccharide consisting of two repeating units of β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc joined by a (1→3)-linkage.

name: 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium
definition: A 1-alkyl-3-methylimidazolium in which the alkyl substituent at C-1 is ethyl.

name: 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt in which the cationic component is 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp with configuration α at the anomeric centre of the galactose residue at the reducing end.

name: Reactive Blue 5(3−)
definition: The organosulfonate oxoanion that is the trianion of Reactive Blue 5, formed by loss of a proton from each of the sulfo groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched heptasaccharide derivative consisting of two repeating units of β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc (joined by a (1→3)-linkage) with an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at the 2-position of the galactose residue at the non-reducing end.

name: 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium
definition: A 1-alkyl-3-methylimidazolium in which the alkyl substituent at C-1 is butyl.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising one fucose, two galactose, one glucosamine and one glucose unit (at the reducing end), linked as shown.

name: 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium iodide
definition: An organic iodide salt in which the cationic component is 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium.

name: 1-hexyl-3-methylimidazolium
definition: A 1-alkyl-3-methylimidazolium in which the alkyl substituent at C-1 is hexyl.

name: bacillithiol
definition: A thiol that is the α-anomeric glycoside of L-cysteinyl-D-glucosamine with L-malic acid.

name: 5-hydroxypseudobaptigenin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that results from the removal of a proton from the hydroxy group at position 7 of 5-hydroxypseudobaptigenin.

name: 1-hexyl-3-methylimidazolium chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt in which the cationic component is 1-hexyl-3-methylimidazolium.

name: 3-methyl-1-octylimidazolium
definition: A 1-alkyl-3-methylimidazolium in which the alkyl substituent at C-1 is octyl.

name: 3-methyl-1-octylimidazolium chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt in which the cationic component is 3-methyl-1-octylimidazolium.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide made up from two fucose, two galactose, one glucosamine and one glucose unit (at the reducing end).

name: (S)-β-macrocarpene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is 1,1'-bi(cyclohexane)-1,3'-diene substituted at positions 4', 5, and 5 by methyl groups (the S- enantiomer).

name: chrysobactin
definition: A catechol-type siderophore with a structure of D-lysyl-L-serine substituted on N2 of the lysyl residue by a 2,3-dihydroxybenzoyl group. It is produced by the Gram-negative bacillus Dickeya dadantii (previously known as Erwinia chrysanthem). Only the catecholate hydroxyl groups participate in metal coordination, so chrysobactin cannot provide full 1:1 coordination of Fe(III); at neutral pH and concentrations of about 0.1 mM, ferric chrysobactin exists as a mixture of bis and tris complexes.

name: achromobactin
definition: A citrate siderophore possessing four carboxylate groups suitable for iron coordination.

name: 1-decyl-3-methylimidazolium
definition: A 1-alkyl-3-methylimidazolium in which the alkyl substituent at C-1 is decyl.

name: 1-decyl-3-methylimidazolium chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt in which the cationic component is 1-decyl-3-methylimidazolium.

name: 1-dodecyl-3-methylimidazolium
definition: A 1-alkyl-3-methylimidazolium in which the alkyl substituent at C-1 is dodecyl.

name: 1-dodecyl-3-methylimidazolium tetrafluoroborate
definition: An organic tetrafluoroborate salt in which the cationic component is 1-dodecyl-3-methylimidazolium.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of D-glucose at the reducing end having an α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 4-position.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising two fucose, two galactose, one glucosamine and one glucose unit (at the reducing end), linked as shown.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising one fucose, two galactose, one glucosamine and one glucose unit (at the reducing end), linked as shown.

name: 2-tetradecenoic acid
definition: A tetradecenoic acid having its double bond in the 2-position.

name: 7-tetradecenoic acid
definition: A tetradecenoic acid having its double bond in the 7-position.

name: ferric-vibriobactin
definition: An iron coordination entity consisting of iron(III) coordinated to each of the hydroxy oxygens in the three catecholate units of vibriobactin.

name: TDP
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate in which the pyrimidine element is 5-methyluracil.

name: 2'-(5-triphosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA(6−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the hexaanion formed from 2'-(5-triphosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA by global loss of protons from the di- and tri-phospho groups.

name: D-mannitol 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-mannitol.

name: dITP(4−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate(4−) that is the tetraanion of 2'-deoxyinosine 5'-triphosphate(dITP), arising from deprotonation of the four free OH groups of the triphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose.

name: UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-D-glucosamine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-D-glucosamine.

name: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alaninate(4−)
definition: Tetranion of UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine having anionic diphosphate and carboxy groups and a cationic amino group.

name: undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine(4−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion of overall charge −4 formed from undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine at pH 7.3.

name: undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetyl-(N-acetylglucosaminyl)muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine(4−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion of overall charge −4 being the major microspecies of undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetyl-(N-acetylglucosaminyl)muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine present at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-chaulmoogric acid
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of chaulmoogric acid.

name: afatinib
definition: A quinazoline compound having a 3-chloro-4-fluoroanilino group at the 4-position, a 4-dimethylamino-trans-but-2-enamido group at the 6-position, and an (S)-tetrahydrofuran-3-yloxy group at the 7-position. Used (as its dimaleate salt) for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.

name: (S)-chaulmoogric acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of chaulmoogric acid.

name: fructoselysine 6-phosphate(1−)
definition: An L-α-amino acid anion comprising fructoselysine 6-phosphate having deprotonated carboxy and phosphate groups and both amino groups protonated; major species at pH 7.3.

name: fructosyllysine(1+)
definition: An amino-acid cation comprising fructosyllysine having a deprotonated carboxy group and both amino groups protonated; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-alanyl-D-glutamate(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of L-alanyl-D-glutamic acid, arising from deprotonation of the the two carboxy groups and protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-alanyl-L-glutamate(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of L-alanyl-L-glutamic acid, arising from deprotonation of the the two carboxy groups and protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: neratinib
definition: A quinoline compound having a cyano group at the 3-position, a 3-chloro-4-(2-pyridylmethoxy)anilino group at the 4-position, a 4-dimethylamino-trans-but-2-enoylamido group at the 6-position, and an ethoxy group at the 7-position.

name: canertinib
definition: A quinazoline compound having a 3-chloro-4-fluoroanilino group at the 4-position, a propenamido group at the 6-position, and a 3-morpholinopropoxy group at the 7-position.

name: WZ4002
definition: A pyrimidine compound having a 2-methoxy-4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)anilino group at the 2-position, a 3-(acryloylamino)phenoxy group at the 4-position, and a chloro substituent at the 5-position.

name: L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-diaminopimelate(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-diaminopimelic acid, arising from deprotonation of the the three carboxy groups and protonation of both amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ITP(4−)
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate(4−) obtained by global deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of ITP; major species present at pH 7.3.

name: psicosyllysine(1+)
definition: An amino-acid cation comprising psicosyllysine having a deprotonated carboxy group and both amino groups protonated; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dATP(4−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate(4−) that is the tetraanion of 2'-deoxyadenosine 5'-triphosphate (dATP), arising from deprotonation of the four triphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-tetradec-2-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of trans-tetradec-2-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-dec-2-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of trans-dec-2-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: TDP(3−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of TDP arising from deprotonation of the two diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: psicosyllysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative having a psicosyl group attached to the side-chain amino group.

name: dGTP(4−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate(4−) that is the tetraanion of 2'-deoxyguanosine 5'-triphosphate (dGTP), arising from deprotonation of the four triphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: decanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) species arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of decanoyl-CoA.

name: fructoselysine 6-phosphate
definition: An L-lysine derivative having a 6-phosphofructosyl group attached to the side-chain amino group.

name: UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-D-glucosamine
definition: A UDP-amino sugar consisting of UDP-D-glucosamine having a (3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl group attached at the 3-position of the glucosamine ring.

name: isopropyl β-D-thiogalactopyranoside
definition: An S-glycosyl compound consisting of β-D-1-thiogalactose having an isopropyl group attached to the anomeric sulfur.

name: (2E,4Z)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate(2−)
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate having (2E,4Z)-configuration.

name: (2E,4Z,7E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4,7-trienedioate(2−)
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4,7-trienedioate having (2E,4Z,7E)-configuration.

name: (E)-3-[(5S,6R)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]acrylate
definition: The (E)-isomer of 3-[(5S,6R)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]acrylate.

name: GDP-β-L-galactose(2−)
definition: A GDP-L-galactose(2−) having β-configuration at the anomeric centre of the L-galactose fragment.

name: UDP-β-L-arabinopyranose
definition: A UDP-L-arabinose in which the arabinose has the arabinopyranose form with β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 11,12-methyleneoctadecanoic acid
definition: A C18, saturated fatty acid composed of octadecanoic acid having an 11,12-methylene substituent forming a cyclopropane.

name: UDP-β-L-arabinopyranose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion resulting from the removal of two protons from the diphosphate group of UDP-β-L-arabinopyranose.

name: UDP-β-L-arabinofuranose
definition: A UDP-sugar having β-L-arabinose as the sugar component.

name: (E)-3-[(5S,6R)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]acrylic acid
definition: The (E)-isomer of 3-[(5S,6R)-5,6-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,3-dienyl]acrylic acid.

name: UDP-β-L-arabinofuranose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion resulting from the removal of two protons from the diphosphate group of UDP-β-L-arabinofuranose.

name: (2E,4Z,7E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4,7-trienedioic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4,7-trienedioic acid having (2E,4Z,7E)-configuration.

name: (2E,4Z)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioic acid having (2E,4Z)-configuration.

name: (2Z,4E)-4-carboxylato-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienedioate(3−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion resulting from deprotonation of the three carboxy groups of (2Z,4E)-4-carboxy-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienedioic acid.

name: all-trans-6-methoxy-2-hexaprenylhydroquinone
definition: A polyprenylhydroquinone in which the polyprenyl substituent is hexaprenyl at C-2; an additional methoxy group is also present at C-6.

name: all-trans-5-methoxy-2-methyl-3-hexaprenylhydroquinone
definition: A polyprenylhydroquinone in which the polyprenyl substituent is hexaprenyl at C-3; methoxy and methyl groups are also present at C-5 and C-2 respectively.

name: germacrene C
definition: A sesquiterpenoid derived from germacrane by dehydrogenation at the 1,2- 3,4- and 7,8-positions.

name: dCTP(4−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate(4−) arising from deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of 2'-deoxycytidine 5'-triphosphate (dCTP); major species at pH 7.3.

name: thiopental(1−)
definition: A thiolate anion resulting from the removal of a proton from one of the nitrogens of thiopental and tautomerisation.

name: (2Z,4E)-4-carboxy-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienedioic acid
definition: A 4-carboxy-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienedioic acid having (2Z,4E)-configuration about the C=C double bonds.

name: UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-N-acetylglucosamine(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-N-acetylglucosamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-ManNAcA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of β-D-ManNAcA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-FucNAc4-(1→4)-β-D-ManNAcA-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-undecaprenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of α-D-FucNAc4-(1→4)-β-D-ManNAcA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: heptosyl-(KDO)2-lipid A(6−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion obtained via deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of L-α-D-Hep-(1→5)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-Kdo-(2→6)-lipid A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyanidin 3-O-(2-O-β-D-glucuronosyl)-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation comprising cyanidin(1+) having a β-D-glucopyranuronosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: ADP-L-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of ADP-L-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (heptosyl)2-(KDO)2-lipid A(6−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion obtained via deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of L-α-D-Hep-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hep-(1→5)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-Kdo-(2→6)-lipid A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-glutamyl-γ-aminobutyraldehyde zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of γ-glutamyl-γ-aminobutyraldehyde; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipate(2−)
definition: An N-acetyl-L-α-amino acid anion arising from deprotonation of both carboxy groups of N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipate 6-phosphate(3−)
definition: An N-acetyl-L-α-amino acid anion arising from deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipic acid 6-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipate semialdehyde
definition: An N-acetyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipic semialdehyde; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N2-acetyl-L-lysine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of N2-acetyl-L-lysine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-butyrobetainyl-CoA(3−)
definition: A triply charged acyl-CoA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of γ-butyrobetainyl-CoA.

name: N1,N5,N10-tri-p-coumaroyl spermidine
definition: A spermidine hydroxycinnamic acid conjugate in which each nitrogen of spermidine has entered into amide bond formation with a molecule of 4-coumaric acid.

name: N-acetyl-L-2-aminoadipic acid semialdehyde
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino acid, where the amino acid is L-2-aminoadipic acid (6-oxo-L-norleucine).

name: N1,N5-dihydroxyferuloyl-N10-sinapoyl spermidine
definition: A spermidine hydroxycinnamic acid conjugate in which N-1 and N-5 of spermidine have formed amide bonds with a molecule each of 5-hydroxyferulic acid and N-10 has formed an amide bond with sinapic acid.

name: γ-butyrobetainyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 4-trimethylammoniobutanoic acid.

name: D-psicose 6-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-psicose 6-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (KDO)2-(palmitoleoyl)-lipid IVA(6−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion obtained via deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of (KDO)2-(palmitoleoyl)-lipid IVA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-glutamyl-γ-aminobutyraldehyde
definition: An L-glutamine derivative that is L-glutamine in which a hydrogen attached to the amide nitrogen is replaced by a 4-oxobutyl group.

name: (KDO)2-(palmitoleoyl-myristoyl)-lipid A(6−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion obtained via deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of (KDO)2-(palmitoleoyl-myristoyl)-lipid A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (heptosyl)2-(KDO)2-lipid A
definition: A lipid A derivative having an L-α-D-Hep-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hep-(1→5)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-Kdo attached to the free primary hydroxy group of lipid A.

name: (KDO)2-(lauroyl)-lipid IVA(6−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion obtained via deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of (KDO)2-(lauroyl)-lipid IVA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E)-hexadec-2-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A hexadecenoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (E)-hexadec-2-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-fructofuranose 6-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-fructofuranose 6-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: heptosyl-(KDO)2-lipid A
definition: A lipid A derivative having an L-α-D-Hep-(1→5)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-Kdo moiety attached to the free primary hydroxy group of lipid A.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of β-D-galactose having an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at the 2-position.

name: ADP-L-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose
definition: An ADP-L-glycero-D-manno-heptose having β-configuration at the anomeric centre of the heptose.

name: 3-(2-chloroethyl)-5,5-dimethyldihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a 2-chloroethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: α-D-FucNAc4-(1→4)-β-D-ManNAcA-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl phospho oligosaccharide where α-D-FucNAc4-(1→4)-β-D-ManNAcA-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc comprises the oligosaccharide component and is linked via a diphosphate to a polyprenyl chain consisting of eleven prenyl units.

name: UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-N-acetyl-α-glucosamine
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having 3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-N-acetyl-α-glucosamine as the amino sugar component.

name: 3-(2-bromoethyl)-5,5-dimethyldihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a 2-bromoethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: palmitoleoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A hexadecenoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of palmitoleoyl-CoA.

name: 3-[[(methylsulfonyl)oxy]ethyl]-5,5-dimethyldihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a 1-[(methylsulfonyl)oxy]ethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-(3-bromopropyl)-5,5-dimethyldihydro-2-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a 3-bromopropyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine
definition: An undecaprenyldiphospho-N-acetylmuramoyl peptide in which the peptide element is L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimeloyl-D-alanyl-D-alanine.

name: 5,5-dimethyl-3-[2-(tosyloxy)ethyl]dihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a 2-(tosyloxy)ethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-{[2-(4-methoxyphenylsulfonyl)oxy]ethyl}-5,5-dimethyldihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a 2-[(4-methoxyphenylsulfonyl)oxy]ethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-[2-(phenylsulfonyloxy)ethyl]-5,5-dimethyldihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a 2-(phenylsulfonyloxy)ethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 3-{[1-(4-chlorophenylsulfonyl)oxy]ethyl}-5,5-dimethyldihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a [1-(4-chlorophenylsulfonyl)oxy]ethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: D-glucopyranose 6-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-glucopyranose 6-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5,5-dimethyl-3-{[1-(4-nitrophenylsulfonyl)oxy]ethyl}-dihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a [1-(4-nitrophenylsulfonyl)oxy]ethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: 5,5-dimethyl-3-(1-thiocyanatoethyl)dihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide having a 1-thiocyanatoethyl group at the 3-position and two methyl substituents at the 5-position.

name: (5R)-5-isopropyl-2-methyl-2-cyclohexen-1-one
definition: A dihydrocarvone compound having the exocyclic isopropenyl double bond reduced and (R)-configuration.

name: (5R)-2,3-dimethyl-5-isopropenyl-2-cyclohexene-1-one
definition: A carvone compound comprising (R)-carvone having a 3-methyl substituent.

name: D-fructofuranose 6-phosphate
definition: The five-membered ring form of D-fructose 6-phosphate.

name: dUTP(4−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate(4−) resulting from deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of 2'-deoxyuridine-5'-triphosphate (dUTP); major species at pH 7.3.

name: (KDO)2-(palmitoleoyl-myristoyl)-lipid A
definition: A lipid A derivative, comprising lipid A glycosylated with two 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues and having the dodecanoyl group replaced by palmitoleoyl.

name: (KDO)2-(palmitoleoyl)-lipid IVA
definition: A lipid A comprising lipid IVA glycosylated with two 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues and carrying an additional palmitoleoyl group.

name: D-psicose 6-phosphate
definition: A ketohexose monophosphate consisting of D-psicose having a phosphate group located at the 6-position.

name: β-D-ManNAcA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl phospho oligosaccharide where β-D-ManNAcA-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc comprises the oligosaccharide component and is linked via a diphosphate to a polyprenyl chain consisting of eleven prenyl units.

name: dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose(2−)
definition: The nucleotide-sugar oxoanion which is the dianion formed from dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose by deprotonation of the two phosphate OH groups.

name: farnesyl triphosphate(4−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion that is the tetra-anion arising from deprotonation of all four free triphosphate OH groups of farnesyl triphosphate.

name: L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-meso-diaminopimelic acid
definition: A tripeptide comprising L-alanyl, γ-D-glutamyl and meso-diaminopimelic acid residues in a linear sequence. It is a breakdown product of bacterial peptidoglycan and a NOD1 agonist.

name: L-alanyl-L-glutamic acid
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-glutamic acid having an L-alanyl attached to its α-amino group

name: L-alanyl-D-glutamic acid
definition: A dipeptide consisting of D-glutamic acid having an L-alanyl attached to its α-amino group

name: D-hexopyranose 6-phosphate(2−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion formed from D-hexopyranose 6-phosphate by loss of two protons from the phosphate group; principal species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-epi-Kdo
definition: A ketoaldonic acid comprising a 3-deoxyoctulosonic acid having β-L-gulo-configuration.

name: α-3,4-dehydro-3,4,5-trideoxy-Kdo-(2→8)-α-Kdo
definition: A disaccharide comprising an α-3,4-dehydro-3,4,5-trideoxy-Kdo residue joined via a (2→8)-linkage to 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid (Kdo)

name: 5-deoxy-4-epi-2,3-dehydro-Kdo-(4→8)-α-Kdo
definition: A carbohydrate acid comprising 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid (Kdo) having a 5-deoxy-4-epi-2,3-dehydro-Kdo moiety attached via an unusual (4→8) non-glycosidic linkage.

name: α-Kdo-(2→4)-α-Kdo-CH2OH
definition: A disaccharide comprising 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranose (Kdo-CH2OH) having a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl (Kdo) residue attached at the 4-position.

name: α-D-galactosyl-N-tetradecanoylsphinganine
definition: A glycodihydroceramide having α-D-galactosyl component and the ceramide N-acyl group specified as tetradecanoyl.

name: D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate(2−) with α-configuration at the anomeric carbon atom.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalNAc
definition: A amino tetrasaccharide comprising D-GalNAc having a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the 6-position and a α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal residue at the 3-position.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising an α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue (2→3)-linked to a β-D-galactosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→3) to N-acetyl-D-galactosamine.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-D-galactosamine having a N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at the 6-position.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalNAc
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide comprising N-acetyl-D-galactose having a β-D-galactosyl residue at the 3-position and a N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue at the 6-position.

name: 5-amino-4-oxo-2-tetradecylnonadecanamide
definition: A fatty amide comprising nonadecanamide having tetradecyl, oxo and amino substituents at the 2-, 4- and 5-positions respectively.

name: 6-O-(2-amino-2-deoxy-α-D-glucosyl)-1D-myo-inositol 1-(6-mercaptohexyl)phosphate
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative consisting of 1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol having a 2-amino-2-deoxy-α-D-glucosyl residue at the 6-position.

name: (α-D-Man)-(1→4)-(α-D-GlcN)-(1→6)-1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative consisting of 1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol having an α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the 6-position.

name: S-(hydroxymethyl)mycothiol
definition: A 2-deoxy-α-D-glucoside, being mycothiol substituted on sulfur by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: [α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-α-D-GlcN-(1→6)]-1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative consisting of 1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol having an α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the 6-position.

name: [α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-α-D-GlcN-(1→6)]-1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative consisting of 1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol having an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the 6-position.

name: 4-phospho-(KDO)-lipid IVA(7−)
definition: The lipid IVA oxoanion that is (KDO)-lipid IVA(5−) phosphorylated at the 4 position on the KDO moiety; protonated to pH 7.3.

name: [6-O-(2-aminoethylphosphono)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-α-D-GlcN-(1→6)]-1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative consisting of 1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol having a 6-O-(2-aminoethylphosphono)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the 6-position.

name: [α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-α-D-GlcN-(1→6)]-1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative consisting of 1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol having an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the 6-position.

name: [α-D-Man-(1→2)-6-PEA-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-α-D-GlcN-(1→6)]-1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative consisting of 1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol having an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-6-O-(2-aminoethylphosphono)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the 6-position.

name: D-glycero-β-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: D-glycero-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate(2−) with β-configuration at the anomeric carbon atom.

name: β-D-galactosyl-N-(nonadecanoyl)sphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine where the ceramide N-acyl group is nonadecanoyl.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-D-Gal
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of D-galactose having an α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue attached at the 3-position

name: [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]6
definition: An N-acetylated α-(2→8)-linked homosialopolysaccharide consisting of six α-D-N-acetylneuraminyl residues joined by (2→8) linkages (i.e. [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]n where n = 6).

name: [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]n
definition: An amino oligosaccharide consisting of repeating units of N-acetylneuraminic acid that are joined via α-(2→8)-linkages. Commonly known as polysialic acid or PSA,

name: [8)-α-Neu5Pr-(2→]6
definition: An N-propionylated α-(2→8)-linked homosialopolysaccharide consisting of six α-D-N-propionylneuraminyl residues joined by (2→8) linkages (i.e. [8)-α-Neu5Pr-(2→]n where n = 6).

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
