definition: A glucosamine oligosaccharide comprising N-acetylglucosamine at the reducing end having an α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl group attached at the 3-position.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap
definition: A ten-membered glucosamine oligosaccharide comprising eight α-L-rhamnosyl residues (one at the reducing end) and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues in a linear sequence.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→6)-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose in which the glycosyl moiety is L-rhamnose linked α to C-6 of D-glucose.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of α-D-mannose having an α-D-mannosyl residue attached at the 2-position

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose consisting of three α-(1→6)-linked D-mannopyranose units with undefined stereochemistry at the reducing end.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A linear trisaccharide consisting of three D-mannose units joined by α-(1→2)- and α-(1→6)-linkages

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A linear trisaccharide consisting of three D-mannose units joined by α-(1→2)-linkages

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A mannotetrose comprising four D-mannose residues joined by α-(1→2)-, α-(1→6)- and α-(1→6)-linkages.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide in which four mannopyranose residues are joined by α-(1→2)-, α-(1→2)- and α-(1→6)-linkages.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A linear mannopentaose comprising five D-mannose residues joined by sequential α-(1→2)-, α-(1→2)-, α-(1→2)- and α-(1→6)-linkages.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A mannopentaose consisting of five D-mannopyranose residues linked by four α-(1→2)-linkages.

name: fluoroacetyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion that results from the removal of four protons from the phosphate groups of fluoroacetyl-CoA. Protonated to pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A linear pentasaccharide comprising one glucose (at the reducing end) and four mannose residues joined by sequential α-(1→6)-, α-(1→2)-, α-(1→2)- and α-(1→2)-linkages.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A D-glucosyl-D-mannose with the two components joined by an α-(1→6)-linkage.

name: L-alanyl-γ-D-glutamyl-L-lysyl-D-alanine
definition: A tetrapeptide comprising L-alanyl, γ-D-glutamyl, L-lysyl and D-alanine residues coupled in sequence.

name: phenyl N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminide having phenyl as the anomeric substituent.

name: phenyl N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide having phenyl as the anomeric substituent.

name: cholesteryl 6-O-oleoyl-β-D-galactoside
definition: A cholesteryl 6-O-acyl-β-D-galactoside having oleoyl as the 6-O-acyl group.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-D-galactosamine at the reducing end with a N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising the linear sequence α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal with an additional β-D-Glc residue attached to the GlcNAc at the 6-position.

name: N,S-isopropylidene-D-penicillamine
definition: A thiazolidinemonocarboxylic acid having the carboxy group at the 4-position and four additional methyl substituents at positions 2, 2, 5 and 5.

name: L-seryl-AMP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is adenosine 5'-monophosphate in which one of the hydroxy groups of the phosphate has been condensed with the carboxylic acid group of L-serine.

name: fluoroacetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of Co-A with the carboxylic acid group of fluoroacetic acid.

name: cholesteryl 6-O-palmitoyl-β-D-galactoside
definition: A cholesteryl 6-O-acyl-β-D-galactoside having palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) as the 6-O-acyl group.

name: cholesteryl 6-O-decanoyl-β-D-galactoside
definition: A cholesteryl 6-O-acyl-β-D-galactoside having decanoyl as the 6-O-acyl group.

name: cholesteryl 6-O-hexanoyl-β-D-galactoside
definition: A cholesteryl 6-O-acyl-β-D-galactoside having hexanoyl as the 6-O-acyl group.

name: cholesteryl 6-O-acetyl-β-D-galactoside
definition: A cholesteryl 6-O-acyl-β-D-galactoside having acetyl as the 6-O-acyl group.

name: cholesteryl 6-O-[15-(ethyldisulfanyl)pentadecanoyl]-β-D-galactoside
definition: A cholesteryl 6-O-acyl-β-D-galactoside having 15-(ethyldisulfanyl)pentadecanoyl as the 6-O-acyl group.

name: methyl 6-O-[15-(ethyldisulfanyl)pentadecanoyl]-β-D-galactoside
definition: A β-D-galactoside comprising methyl β-D-galactoside having a 15-(ethyldisulfanyl)pentadecanoyl group attached at the 6-position.

name: phenyl 6-O-[15-(ethyldisulfanyl)pentadecanoyl]-β-D-galactoside
definition: A β-D-galactoside comprising phenyl β-D-galactoside having a 15-(ethyldisulfanyl)pentadecanoyl group attached at the 6-position.

name: dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose as the sugar portion.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of two α-D-mannopyranose residues joined via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: 3-O-(6-O-α-D-xylosylphospho-α-D-mannopyranosyl)-α-D-mannopyranose
definition: A xylose phosphate that is 3-O-(6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannopyranosyl)-α-D-mannopyranose in which the dihydrogen phosphate group is condensed with the anomeric hydroxy group of α-D-xylose.

name: 3-O-(6-O-α-D-xylosylphospho-α-D-mannopyranosyl)-α-D-mannopyranose(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that results from the removal of a proton from the phosphate group of 3-O-(6-O-α-D-xylosylphospho-α-D-mannopyranosyl)-α-D-mannopyranose.

name: D-hexopyranose 6-phosphate
definition: Any D-hexose 6-phosphate in which the hexose is in the pyranose form.

name: oroxylin A
definition: A dihydroxy- and monomethoxy-flavone in which the hydroxy groups are positioned at C-5 and C-7 and the methoxy group is at C-6.

name: 2-methylbutanenitrile
definition: A nitrile formed formally by substitution of a cyano group at C-2 of butane.

name: oroxylin A 7-O-β-D-glucuronide
definition: The glycosyloxyflavone which is the 7-O-glucuronide of oroxylin A.

name: hydnocarpic acid
definition: A cyclopentenyl fatty acid consisting of undecanoic acid having a cyclopent-2-enyl group at the 11-position.

name: 13-cyclopent-2-en-1-yltridec-6-enoic acid
definition: A cyclopentenyl fatty acid composed of 6-tridecenoic acid having a 2-cyclopentenyl ring at position 13.

name: oroxylin A 7-O-β-D-glucuronate
definition: The monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of oroxylin A 7-O-β-D-glucuronide.

name: (R)-hydnocarpic acid
definition: An optically active form of hydnocarpic acid having (R)-configuration.

name: gorlic acid
definition: A 13-cyclopent-2-en-1-yltridec-6-enoic acid having R-configuration and a cis-double bond at position 6.

name: (+)-α-santalene
definition: A sesquiterpene consisting of a tricyclo[2.2.1.02,6]heptane skeleton substituted by methyl groups at positions 1 and 7 and by a 4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl group at position 7 (the 1S,2R,4S,6R,7R diastereoisomer).

name: (+)-endo-β-bergamotene
definition: A sesquiterpene consisting of a bicyclo[3.1.1]heptane skeleton substituted at position 2 by a methylidene group and at position 6 by methyl and 4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl groups (the all-S diastereoisomer).

name: (−)-endo-α-bergamotene
definition: A cis-α-bergamotene that has (S,S,S)-configuration.

name: (1S,4aS)-1,4a-dimethyl-1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalene
definition: An ortho-fused bicyclic hydrocarbon with a structure consisting of decalin hydrogenated across C(7)‒C(8) and with methyl groups at C(1) and C(4a) which both have S configuration.

name: ubiquinol-8
definition: A ubiquinol in which the polyprenyl substituent is octaprenyl.

name: ubiquinone-8
definition: A ubiquinone whose structure comprises a 2,3-dimethoxy-5-methylbenzoquinone nucleus (common to all ubiquinones) and a side chain of eight isoprenoid units.

name: menaquinol-8
definition: A menaquinol whose structure comprises a 2-methylbenzohydroquinone nucleus and a side chain of eight isoprenoid units.

name: (+)-cubenene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is 1,6-dimethyl-4-(propan-2-yl)naphthalene in which the naphthalene ring has been hydrogenated at the 1, 2, 3, 4, 4a and 7 positions (the 1S,4R,4aS diastereoisomer).

name: (+)-epicubenol
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is cis-decalin substituted by a propan-2-yl group at position 1, methyl groups at position 4 and 7, and a hydroxy group at position 4a, and containing a double bond between positions 7 and 8 (the 1R,4S,4aR,8aS diastereoisomer).

name: cis-muurola-3,5-diene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is 1,2,3,4,4a,5-hexahydronaphthalene which is substituted at position 1 by a propan-2-yl group and at positions 4 and 7 by methyl groups (the 1R,4R,4aS-diastereoisomer).

name: cis-muurola-4(14),5-diene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is 1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,7-octahydronaphthalene which is substituted at positions 1, 4, and 7 by a propan-2-yl, methyl and methylidene groups, respectively (the 1R,4R,4aS-diastereoisomer).

name: (+)-α-barbatene
definition: A carbotricyclic compound and sesquiterpene that is 1,2,3,3a,4,5,8,8a-octahydro-4,8-methanoazulene that is substituted by methyl groups at the 3a, 4, 7 and 8a positions (the 3aR,4R,8R,8aS-diastereoisomer).

name: benzenamine sulfate
definition: A sulfamic acid having a phenyl group attached to nitrogen.

name: L-cysteinylglycine zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion of L-cysteinylglycine resulting from the transfer of a proton from the hydroxy group of glycine to the amino group of cysteine. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: L-prolylglycine
definition: A dipeptide consisting of glycine having an L-prolyl group attached to its α-amino nitrogen.

name: L-prolinylglycine zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion of L-prolinylglycine resulting from the transfer of a proton from the hydroxy group of glycine to the amino group of proline. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: L-ascorbate 6-phosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion formed from L-ascorbic acid 6-phosphate by deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group and of both hydroxy groups of the phosphate function; principal species at pH 7.3.

name: (−)-α-gurjunene
definition: A carbotricyclic compound and sesquiterpene that is 1a,2,3,4,4a,5,6,7b-octahydro-1H-cyclopropa[e]azulene which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 1, 4 and 7 (the 1aR,4R,4aR,7bS- diastereoisomer). It has been isolated from several plant species such as Anaphalis nubigena and Jatropha ribifolia.

name: (+)-valencene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound and sesquiterpene that is 1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,7-octahydronaphthalene which is substituted a prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 3 and by methyl groups at positions 4a and 5 (the 3R,4aS,5R- diastereoisomer).

name: L-ascorbic acid 6-phosphate
definition: An aldonolactone phosphate that is the 6-phosphate ester of L-ascorbic acid.

name: dinoflagellate luciferin
definition: A member of the class of bilenes that is 1,2,3,21-tetrahydro-5,7-ethanobilene-a-19(16H),52-dione which is substituted at positions 2, 8, 13 and 18 by methyl groups and at positions 1, 3, 12 and 17 by carboxy, 2-carboxyethyl, ethyl and vinyl groups, respectively (the 1S,2S,3S diastereoisomer).

name: 3-demethylubiquinol-8
definition: A 3-demethylubiquinol in which the polyprenyl chain contains 8 prenyl units.

name: dinoflagellate luciferin(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion that results from the removal of a proton from each of the carboxylic acid groups of dinoflagellate luciferin.

name: oxidized dinoflagellate luciferin
definition: A member of the class of bilenes that is 1,2,3,21-tetrahydro-5,7-ethanobilene-a-19(16H),51,52-trione which is substituted at positions 2, 8, 13 and 18 by methyl groups and at positions 1, 3, 12 and 17 by carboxy, 2-carboxyethyl, ethyl and vinyl groups, respectively (the 1S,2S,3S diastereoisomer).

name: oxidized dinoflagellate luciferin(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion that results from the removal of a proton from each of the carboxylic acid groups of oxidized dinoflagellate luciferin.

name: 4-{[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]diazenyl}phenyl-β-lactoside
definition: A glycoside comprising β-lactose having a p-(p-dimethylaminophenylazo)phenyl group at the 1-position.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a sialyl residue, linked (2→3) to a galactosyl residue that in turn is linked (1→4) to a glucosaminyl residue, which is also carrying a fucosyl residue at the 3-position.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose at the reducing end having a β-D-glucosyl residue at the 4-position and an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosyl moiety at the 3-position.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp
definition: A amino pentasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose at the reducing end having a β-D-glucosyl residue at the 4-position and an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety at the 3-position.

name: α-D-Kdo-(2→8)-α-D-Kdo-(2→4)-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN-4P-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-1P
definition: A six-membered oligosaccharide phosphate antigen consisting of three 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose residues and two glucosamine residues (one at the reducing end) in a linear sequence, with two phosphate groups attached.

name: ferroheme a(2−)
definition: The porphyrin carboxylic acid anion that is ferroheme a protonated to pH 7.3.

name: α-Kdo-CH2OH-(2→4)-α-Kdo
definition: A disaccharide comprising 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranose (Kdo) having a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosyl (Kdo-CH2OH) residue attached at the 4-position.

name: ferroheme c(2−)
definition: The cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is ferroheme c protonated to pH 7.3.

name: p-aminophenylphosphocholine
definition: A phosphocholine that is the 4-aminophenyl ester of choline phosphate.

name: bacteriochlorophyll a(1−)
definition: The cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is bacteriochlorophyll a protonated to pH 7.3.

name: chlorophyll b(1−)
definition: The cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is chlorophyll b protonated to pH 7.3.

name: 2-pentenal
definition: An enal consisting of pent-2-ene having an oxo group at the 1-position

name: D-pantetheine 4'-phosphate(2−)
definition: Pantetheine 4'-phosphate(2−) with D (R) configuration at the 2' position. The dianion formed from D-pantetheine 4'-phosphate by deprotonation of the phosphate group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: hept-2-enal
definition: An enal consisting of hept-2-ene having an oxo group at the 1-position.

name: oct-2-enal
definition: An enal consisting of oct-2-ene having an oxo group at the 1-position.

name: non-2-enal
definition: An enal consisting of non-2-ene having an oxo group at the 1-position.

name: 2-decenal
definition: A decenal in which the C=C bond is located at the 2-3 position.

name: 5-methyl-dCTP(4−)
definition: The 2'-deoxyribonucleoside triphosphate oxoanion that is 5-methyl-dCTP protonated to pH 7.3.

name: lipid IIA(3−)
definition: The lipid oxoanion formed from lipid IIA by deprotonation of the phosphate hydroxy groups.

name: lipid IIA
definition: A lipid A derivative in which the phospho group at the anomeric carbon is esterified with a 4-amino-4-deoxy-β-L-arabinopyranosyl group.

name: (+)-thujopsene
definition: A thujopsene that has (R,R,R)-configuration.

name: 4,6-pyr-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-L-Rhap
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-L-rhamnose at the reducing end having a 4,6-O-[(1S)-1-carboxyethylidene]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-α-D-galactosyl group attached at the 4-position.

name: aureobasidin A
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide antibiotic, which is isolated from the filamentous fungus Aureobasidium pullulans R106 and is toxic to yeast at low concentrations (0.1-0.5 ug/ml).

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide consisting of four α-L-rhamnose units joined by sequential (1→2)-, (1→3)- and (1→2)-linkages.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of α-L-rhamnose having an N-acetyl β-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at the 2-position.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→3)-α-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of an β-D-galactofuranosyl residue attached to α-D-mannopyranose at the 3-position.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→6)-α-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of an β-D-galactofuranosyl residue attached to α-D-mannopyranose at the 6-position.

name: β-chamigrene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound and sesquiterpene that is spiro[5.5]undec-2-ene which is substituted by a methylidene group at position 11 and by methyl groups at positions 3, 7 and 7.

name: 4,6-O-[(1R)-1-carboxyethylidene]-β-D-galactose
definition: A 4,6-O-[(1R)-1-carboxyethylidene]-D-galactose having β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: (+)-β-chamigrene
definition: The (6S)-enantiomer of β-chamigrene.

name: 4,6-O-[(1R)-1-carboxyethylidene]-D-galactose
definition: A monosaccharide derivative consisting of D-galactose having a 1-carboxyethylidene group masking the 4-and 6-positions.

name: (E)-oct-2-enal
definition: The (E)-isomer of oct-2-enal.

name: enfumafungin
definition: A triterpene glycoside and hemiacetal isolated from a fermentation of Hormonema sp. and which specifically inhibits glucan synthesis in fungal cells.

name: 3,4-O-[(1S)-1-carboxyethylidene]-β-D-galactose
definition: A carbohydrate derivative consisting of β-D-galactose having a 1-carboxyethylidene group masking the 3-and 4-positions.

name: 5-[2-(2-oxoethoxy)ethoxy]-diclofenac
definition: A member of the class of phenylacetic acids that is phenylacetic acid having a (2,6-dichlorophenyl)amino group at the 2-position and a 2-(2-oxoethoxy)ethoxy group at the 5-position.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-α-L-Rhap-OPr
definition: A branched glycoside consiting of propyl α-L-rhamnoside having α-L-rhamnosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues at the 2- and 2-positions respectively.

name: β-L-Ara4N-(KDO)2-lipid IVA
definition: A lipid A comprising lipid IVA glycosylated with two 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues and carrying an additional 4-amino-4-deoxy-β-L-arabinopyranosyl esterifying group.

name: β-L-Ara4N-(KDO)2-lipid IVA(4−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion formed from β-L-Ara4N-(KDO)2-lipid IVA by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate groups. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-glucose at the reducing end having an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl group attached at the 4-position.

name: 2-acetamido-4-amino-2,4,6-trideoxy-D-galactose
definition: A trideoxyhexose comprising D-galactopyranose having the hydroxy groups at positions 2- and 4- replaced by acetamido and amino groups respectively and also deoxygenated at the 6-position.

name: D-mannosyl ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate in which the glycosyl moiety is D-mannosyl and the polyprenyl group is di-trans,poly-cis-undecaprenyl.

name: D-mannosyl ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate(1−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion formed by deprotonation of the phosphate OH in D-mannosyl ditrans,polycis-undecaprenyl phosphate. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three D-glucose units joined by β-(1→2)-linkages

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap
definition: A linear trisaccharide consisting of three L-rhamose units joined by α-(1→2)-linkages

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide composed of α-L-rhamnose, α-D-galactose, N-acetyl β-D-glucosamine and α-L-rhamnose units joined by sequential (1→3)-, (1→3)- and (1→4)-linkages.

name: β-(1→6)-galactotriose
definition: A galactotriose composed of three β-D-galactose units joined by (1→6)-linkages.

name: 5-methyl-dCTP
definition: A 2'-deoxycytidine phosphate having 5-methylcytosine as the nucleobase.

name: 4-O-Me-β-D-GlcpA-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: A pentasaccharide derivative composed of a 4-O-methyl-β-D-glucuronic acid (at the non-reducing end) and four β-D-galactose units all joined via (1→6)-linkages.

name: β-(1→6)-galactotetraitol
definition: A glycoside composed of three β-D-galactosyl residues and one galactitol unit all joined via (1→6)-linkages.

name: β-(1→6)-galactotriitol
definition: A glycoside composed of two β-D-galactosyl residues and one galactitol unit all joined via (1→6)-linkages.

name: β-(1→6)-galactobiose
definition: A glycosylgalactose comprising two β-D-galactose units joined via a (1→6)-linkage.

name: β-(1→3)-galactotriose
definition: A galactotriose composed of three β-D-galactopyranose units joined by (1→3)-linkages.

name: β-(1→3)-galactobiose
definition: A glycosylgalactose comprising two β-D-galactose units joined via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: α-L-Araf-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: A linear trisaccharide composed of D-galactose having a α-L-arabinosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 6-position

name: β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf
definition: A galactotetraose composed of four β-D-galactofuranose units joined by (1→5)-linkages.

name: α,α-trehalose dicarboxylic acid bis-N,N-dioctadecylamide
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide obtained by formal condensation of one molecule of α,α-trehalose dicarboxylic acid and two molecules of dioctadecylamine.

name: tripalmitoyl-S-glyceryl-cysteinyl-seryl-serine
definition: A triacyl lipopeptide consisting of the tripeptide L-cysteinyl-L-seryl-L-serine with the cysteinyl residue carrying N-palmitoyl and S-2,3-bis(palmitoyloxy)propyl groups.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose consisting of three D-mannose units joined by sequential β-(1→2)- and α-(1→2)-linkages.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of α-D-galactose having an α-L-rhamnosyl attached at the 3-position.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-D-glucitol
definition: An α-L-rhamnoside consisting of D-glucitol having an α-L-rhamnosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: 2,3,4-tri-O-methyl-α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnose
definition: A glycosylrhamnose derivative consisting of α-L-rhamnose having a 2,3,4-tri-O-methyl-α-L-fucosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A disaccharide composed of two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose residues joined by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of a β-D-galactosyl residue linked (1→3) to an N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→3) to N-acetyl-D-glucosamine at the reducing end.

name: 2,3,4-tri-O-methyl-α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-2-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnose
definition: A linear trisaccharide derivative consisting of 2-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnose having a 2,3,4-tri-O-methyl-α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: β-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-D-Man
definition: A mannotetraose in which the four mannose units are joined by sequential β-(1→2)-, α-(1→2)- and α-(1→2)-linkages.

name: N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-D-glucosamine
definition: The monosaccharide sulfate formed by sulfating N-acetyl-D-glucosamine at O6.

name: β-anthropyranosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnopyranose
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising β-anthrose at the non-reducing end and two α-L-rhamnose units joined by sequential (1→3)- and (1→2)-linkages.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a sialyl residue, linked (2→3) to a galactosyl residue that in turn is linked (1→3) to a glucosaminyl residue, which is also carrying a fucosyl residue at the 4-position.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp
definition: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-D-Manp with α configuration at the anomeric centre of the mannose residue at the reducing end.

name: dinoflagellate luciferin(1−)
definition: The linear tetrapyrrole anion that is dinoflagellate luciferin protonated to pH 7.3.

name: Galp-α-(1→4)-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide formed of α-D-galactopyranose in (1→4)-linkage with 2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucopyranose.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of an α-Gal residue at the non-reducing end linked (1→4) to a β-GalNAc residue which is in turn linked (1→4) to α-Gal.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide comprising three successive D-galactosyl residues and a glucosyl residue at the reducing end joined by sequential α-(1→4)-, β-(1→3)- and β-(1→4)-linkages.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap
definition: An α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-L-Rhap in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has α configuration.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of an β-D-glucose residue having an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at the 2-position.

name: β-D-mannosyl C32-phosphomycoketide
definition: A mannose phosphate consisting of β-D-mannose having a (4S,8S,12S,16S,20S)-4,8,12,16,20-pentamethylheptacosyl)phosphate group at position 1.

name: 6-(O-phosphocholine)oxyhexanoic acid
definition: A phosphocholine linked to 6-hydroxyhexanoic acid via a phosphodiester linkage.

name: 6-(O-phosphocholine)oxyhexanoate
definition: An ammonium betaine formed by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group of 6-(O-phosphocholine)oxyhexanoic acid.

name: 6-(O-phosphocholine)oxyhexanoic acid betaine
definition: An ammonium betaine formed by deprotonation of the phosphoric acid group of 6-(O-phosphocholine)hydroxyhexanoic acid.

name: 6-(O-phosphocholine)oxyhexanoate(1−)
definition: A dialkyl phosphate anion formed by deprotonation of both the phosphoric and carboxylic acid groups of 6-(O-phosphocholine)hydroxyhexanoic acid.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched hexasaccharide consisting of α-D-Man at the reducing end having α-D-Gal-(1→2)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-α-D-Gal and α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man groups attached at the 3- and 6-positions respectively.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Sph
definition: A lysoganglioside β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc as the sialoglycosyl component; GM1 lacking the side acyl chain.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp-(1→6)-[α-D-Galp-(1→2)]-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched heptasaccharide consisting of α-D-Man at the reducing end having α-D-Gal-(1→2)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-[α-D-Gal-(1→2)]-α-D-Gal and α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man groups attached at the 3- and 6-positions respectively.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-azelaoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine having palmitoyl and azelaoyl groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively.

name: N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine
definition: An N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has α configuration.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→6)-[α-D-Galp-(1→2)]-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched hexasaccharide consisting of α-D-Man at the reducing end having α-D-Gal-(1→6)-[α-D-Gal-(1→2)]-α-D-Gal and α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man groups attached at the 3- and 6-positions respectively.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-α-D-GalNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide composed of D-galactose and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl residues in β-(1→3) linkage.

name: 2-O-glutaroyl-1-O-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine having palmitoyl and glutaroyl groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine at the reducing end having a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl group attached at the 6-position.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galf-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpN-(1→6)-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A glycoside comprising the linear pentasaccharide α-Galp(1→3)-β-Galf-(1→3)-α-Manp-(1→3)-α-Manp-(1→4)-α-GlcpN in (1→6)-linkage with myo-inositol.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide having β-D-galactose at the reducing end with a β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety at the 3-position.

name: β-melibiose
definition: A melibiose that has β-configuration at the anomeric hydroxy group.

name: 5α-cholest-8(14)-en-3β,15β-diol
definition: A 3β-hydroxysteroid consisting of 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholest-8(14)-ene having an additional hydroxy group at the 15β-position.

name: 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholest-8(14)-en-15-one
definition: A 3β-hydroxysteroid consisting of 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholest-8(14)-ene having an additional oxo group at the 15-position.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galf-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpN-(1→6)-myo-inositol
definition: A glycoside comprising the linear hexasaccharide derivative α-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galf-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpN in (1→6)-linkage with myo-inositol.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising galactose at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl group attached at the 3-position.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc which has β-configuration at the epimeric hydroxy group.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide composed of the linear tetrasaccharide α-Fuc-(1→2)-α-Fuc-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-GlcNAc having an α-Fuc-(1→2)-α-Fuc moiety attached at the 3-position of the terminal β-GlcNAc.

name: 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholestan-15-one
definition: A 3β-hydroxysteroid consisting of 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholestane having an additional oxo group at the 15-position.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide composed of D-galactose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl residues in (α-1→4) linkage.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising β-D-glucose at the reducing end with a β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucosyl group attached at the 4-position.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising β-D-galactose at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: 5α-cholestan-3β,15β-diol
definition: A 3β-hydroxysteroid consisting of 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholestane having an additional hydroxy group at the 15β-position.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl group attached at the 4-position and a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl moiety at the 6-position.

name: 2,3-dipalmitoyl-S-glycerylcysteine
definition: An L-cysteine thioether that is L-cysteine in which the hydrogen of the thiol group is substituted by a 2,3-bis(palmitoyloxy)propyl group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAcp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: The β anomer of β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc.

name: [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]14
definition: A polysaccharide derivative consisting of fourteen α-D-N-acetylneuraminyl residues joined by (2→8) linkages.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched aminopentasaccharide comprising β-D-glucose at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety at the 4-position.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising β-D-glucose at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety at the 4-position.

name: β-D-ribosyl-(1→1)-D-ribitol-5-phosphate
definition: A glycoside phosphate comprising D-ribitol-5-phosphate having a β-D-ribosyl residue attached at the 1-position.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide having β-D-galactose at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety at the 3-position.

name: 3-hydroxy-2-{[(2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoyl]amino}octadecyl α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-(1→4)-α-D-GlcA
definition: A neutral glycosphingolipid comprising a tetrasaccharide unit, α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-(1→4)-α-D-GlcA, attached to a 3-hydroxy-2-{[(2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoyl]amino}octadecyl lipid group.

name: (13Z)-3-hydroxy-2-{[(2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoyl]amino}icos-13-en-1-yl α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-(1→4)-α-D-GlcA
definition: A neutral glycosphingolipid comprising a tetrasaccharide unit, α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-(1→4)-α-D-GlcA, attached to a (13Z)-3-hydroxy-2-{[(2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoyl]amino}icos-13-en-1-yl lipid group.

name: 12-(2-hexylcyclopropyl)-3-hydroxy-2-{[(2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoyl]amino}dodecyl α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-(1→4)-α-D-GlcA
definition: A neutral glycosphingolipid comprising a tetrasaccharide unit, α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Gal-(1→6)-α-D-GlcN-(1→4)-α-D-GlcA, attached to a 12-(2-hexylcyclopropyl)-3-hydroxy-2-{[(2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoyl]amino}dodecyl lipid group.

name: β-L-Rhap-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide composed of a β-L-rhamnosyl residue linked (1→4) to a β-D-glucosyl residue which is in turn linked (1→4) to β-D-galactose.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising N-acetylglucosamine at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl group at the 4-position and a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl moiety at the 6-position.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched aminopentasaccharide comprising β-D-glucose at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety at the 4-position.

name: β-D-Glc-(1→4)-[α-L-Rha-(1→2)]-3-O-(2-glycerylphospho)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-L-Rha
definition: A tetrasaccharide consisting of β-L-rhamnose having a α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→2)-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)]-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 4-position with an additional 2-glycerylphosphate group attached to the galactosyl residue.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide comprising two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine tetrasaccharide units connected via a (1→3) linkage.

name: 3-O-(H2O3P)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp
definition: An oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of β-D-galactose having 3-O-phosphono-β-D-glucosyl and α-L-rhamnosyl residues attached at positions 4 and 2 respectively.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprising an acetamido-β-D-galactose and an α-L-fucose attached to an acetamidoglucose by 1→4 and 1→3 linkages, respectively.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched glucosamine oligosaccharide comprising three β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine tetrasaccharide units connected via (1→3) head-to-tail linkages.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-L-Rhap
definition: A trisaccharide composed of an α-L-rhamnosyl residue linked (1→2) to a β-D-galactosyl residue which is in turn linked (1→4) to β-L-rhamnose.

name: 3-O-(H2O3P)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-L-Rhap
definition: A branched tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of β-L-rhamnose having a 3-O-phosphono-β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-[α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 4-position.

name: N6-L-homocysteinyl-L-lysine
definition: An N6-acyl-L-lysine derivative in which the acyl group is L-homocysteinyl.

name: Lys-Ala
definition: A dipeptide formed from L-lysyl and L-alanyl residues.

name: 2-demethylmenaquinol-8
definition: A 2-demethylmenaquinol whose structure comprises a benzohydroquinone nucleus and a side chain of eight isoprenoid units.

name: N6-(L-homocysteinyl)-L-lysyl-L-alanine
definition: A tripeptide formed between L-Hcy, L-Lys and L-Ala in a linear sequence, with the peptide bond between Hcy and Lys being from the carboxy group of the Hcy to the ε-nitrogen of the lysine.

name: N6-L-homocysteinyl-N2-acetyl-L-lysine
definition: A dipeptide in which the carboxy group of L-homocysteine forms an amide bond with the ε-nitrogen of Nα-acetylated L-lysine

name: L-homocysteinyl-N6-acetyl-L-lysine
definition: A dipeptide in which the carboxy group of L-homocysteine forms an amide bond with the α-nitrogen of Nε-acetylated L-lysine.

name: N6-(L-homocysteinyl)-L-lysyl-L-leucine
definition: A tripeptide formed between L-Hcy, L-Lys and L-Leu in a linear sequence, with the peptide linkage between Hcy and Lys being from the carboxy group of the Hcy to the ε-nitrogen of the lysine.

name: N6-L-homocysteinyl-N2-L-valyl-L-lysine
definition: A branched tripeptide in which L-homocysteine and L-valine are linked via peptide bonds to the ε- and α-nitrogens respectively of L-lysine.

name: N6-(L-homocysteinyl)-L-lysyl-L-lysyl-L-lysyl-L-lysine
definition: A pentapeptide in which L-homocysteine is connected to tetralysine via a peptide bond to the ε-nitrogen of the N-terminal lysine residue.

name: N-methyl-L-phenylalanine zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of N-methyl-L-phenylalanine arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-methyl-L-methionine zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of N-methyl-L-methionine arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-acetylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Nα-acetyl-L-argininate
definition: An N-acetyl-L-α-amino acid anion arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group of Nα-acetyl-L-arginine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-6'-bromotryptophan zwitterion
definition: The L-α-amino acid zwitterion that results from the transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the α-amino group of L-6'-bromotryptophan. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man1GlcNAc2 linear trisaccharide β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man2GlcNAc2 linear tetrasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man3GlcNAc2 branched pentasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man5GlcNAc2 branched heptasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: isethionate
definition: The alkanesulfonate that is the anion formed from isethionic acid by loss of a proton from the sulfo group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man6GlcNAc2 branched octasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: ethanesulfonate
definition: An alkanesulfonate in which the alkyl group directly linked to the sulfonate functionality is ethyl.

name: butane-1-sulfonate
definition: An alkanesulfonate in which the alkyl group directly linked to the sulfonate functionality is butyl.

name: Nω,N'ω-dimethyl-L-arginine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained from Nω,N'ω-dimethyl-L-arginine by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the α-amino group.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man7GlcNAc2 branched nonasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: (R)-thalidomide
definition: A 2-(2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl)-1H-isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione that has R-configuration at the chiral centre.

name: (S)-thalidomide
definition: A 2-(2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl)-1H-isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione that has S-configuration at the chiral centre.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man8GlcNAc2 branched decasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man9GlcNAc2 branched undecasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: N-carboxy-L-methionine(2−)
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion derived from N-carboxy-L-methionine(2−) by removal of a proton from each of the carboxy groups. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man9GlcNAc2Glc branched dodecasaccharide α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: A dolichyl diphosphooligosaccharide in which the oligosaccharide moiety is the Man9Glc2GlcNAc2 branched tridecasaccharide α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: glycerol 1-phosphoserine(1−)

definition: The N-glycosyl compound formed from the deoxy trisaccharide 6-deoxy-α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc by replacement of the OH at the anomeric centre of the glucose residue by an acetylamino group.

name: butane-2,3-diol
definition: A butanediol in which hydroxylation is at C-2 and C-3.

name: chondroitin 6'-sulfate anion
definition: A polysaccharide acid oxoanion arising from global deprotonation of the carboxylic and sulfonic acid groups of the repeating units in chondroitin 6'-sulfate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-Rhap
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of an α-D-rhamnos residue having an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at the 4-position.

name: α-D-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap
definition: A glycosylrhamnose consisting of α-D-rhamnose having an α-D-rhamnosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: phaseic acid anion
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of phaseic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: nalidixic acid anion
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of nalidixic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-cis-abscisate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of cis-abscisic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: naptalamate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of naptalam; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-chloroacrylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that results from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 3-chloroacrylic acid.

name: (S)-3-hydroxyhexanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (S)-3-hydroxyhexanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-hex-2-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of trans-hex-2-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-Neu5Ac
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of two N-acetylneuraminic acid residues joined by an (α-2→8)-linkage.

name: propane-2-sulphonic acid
definition: An alkanesulfonic acid in which the sulfonic acid group is attached to a propan-2-yl group.

name: propane-2-sulfonate
definition: An alkanesulfonate that is obtained by removal of a proton from the sulfonic acid group of propane-2-sulfonic acid .

name: N-glycoloyl-β-neuraminic acid
definition: An N-acylneuraminic acid in which the acyl substituent on nitrogen is glycolyl and which has β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: dimyristoyl phosphatidic acid
definition: A phosphatidic acid in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both myristoyl.

name: metamizole(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from the sulfonic acid group of metamizole.

name: 1,2-dimyristoyl phosphatidyl-L-serine
definition: A phosphatidyl-L-serine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both myristoyl.

name: metamizole
definition: A pyrazole that is antiipyrine substituted at C-4 by a methyl(sulfomethyl)amino group, the sodium salt of which, metamizole sodium, was widely used as a powerful analgesic and antipyretic, but withdrawn from many markets from the 1970s due to a risk of causing risk of causing agranulocytosis.

name: germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-ol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid resulting formally from germacrane by hydroxylation at C(12) together with dehydrogenation across the C(1)‒C(10), C(4)‒C(5) and C(11)‒C(13) bonds.

name: germacra-1(10),4,11(13)-trien-12-al
definition: A sesquiterpenoid resulting formally from germacrane by oxidation at C(12) together with dehydrogenation across the C(1)‒C(10), C(4)‒C(5) and C(11)‒C(13) bonds.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear pentasaccharide consisting of two galactosyl residues, an N-acetylglucosaminyl residue, a further galactosyl residue and a glucosyl residue (at the reducing end), linked in sequence as shown.

name: α-NeupAc-(2→8)-α-NeupAc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprising two α-N-acetylneuraminyl residues joined by a (2→8)-linkage and attached in turn by a (2→3)-linkage to β-D-galactose.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac
definition: α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-Neu5Ac in which the configuration at the anomeric carbon atom of the residue at the reducing end is α

name: N4-{α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc}-Asn
definition: A glucosaminoglycan consisting of L-asparagine having the pentasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc attached at the N4-position

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide with a structure consisting of an α-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetylglucosamine backbone, to the subterminal galactose of which is α(1→2)-linked a fucosyl residue.

name: acebutolol(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion that results from the protonation of the amine nitrogen of acebutolol.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of D-galactose having a β-D-galactosyl residue attached at the 6-position.

name: α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-α,α-trehalose
definition: A trisaccharide with a structure in which a galactosyl residue is linked α(1→6) to α,α-trehalose.

name: β-D-glucosyl-N-(docosanoyl)sphingosine
definition: A β-D-glucosylceramide where the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as docosanoyl.

name: β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-(docosanoyl)sphingosine
definition: A β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosylceramide where the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as docosanoyl.

name: 17-hydroxyprogesterone 3-O-(carboxymethyl)oxime
definition: An oxime O-ether consisting of progesterone having an O-(carboxymethyl)oxime group at the 3-position and a hydroxy group at the 17α-position.

name: 6-O-acetyl-β-D-glucose
definition: 6-O-Acetyl-D-glucose in which the configuration at the anomeric centre is β.

name: 11-deoxycorticosterone-21-hemisuccinate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester that is the 21-(hydrogen succinate) derivative of 11-deoxycorticosterone.

name: 3-O-hydroxyphthioceranoyl-2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with a hydroxyphthioceranoic acid (an octamethyl-branched dextrogyre C32 long chain where the stereochemistry at all methyl branches is L).

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of a β-D-glucose residue linked (1→3) to a β-D-glucuronosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→4) to a β-D-glucose at the reducing end. Trisaccharide form of serotype 3 pneumococcal capsular polysaccharide.

name: 2,3-dipalmitoyl-2'-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is diacylated at the 2- and 3-positions with palmitic acid.

name: 6β-hydroxyprogesterone hemisuccinate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester that is the hydrogen succinate ester of 6β-hydroxyprogesterone.

name: 6β-hydroxyprogesterone
definition: A 3-oxo-Δ4-steroid that is progesterone in which the hydrogen at the 6β-position is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: 3-O-(16-hydroxyhexadecanoyl)-2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with 16-hydroxypalmitic acid.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: A galactosamine oligosaccharide consisting of three (1→6)-linked N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine units with two β-D-glucuronosyl residues attached at the 3- and 3'-positions.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-3-O-triacontanoyl-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with triacontanoic acid.

name: 3-O-(2-methyloctadecanoyl)-2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with 2-methyloctadecanoic acid.

name: 3-O-[(2S,4S)-2,4-dimethyldocosanoyl]-2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2S,4S)-2,4-dimethyldocosanoic acid.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-3-O-[(2S,4S,6S)-2,4,6-trimethyltetracosanoyl]-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2S,4S,6S)-2,4,6-trimethyltetracosanoic acid.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by methoxy.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-3-O-[(2S,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltetracosanoyl]-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2S,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltetracosanoic acid.

name: 3-O-[(2E)-2-methylicos-2-enoyl]-2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E)-2-methylicos-2-enoic acid.

name: 3-O-[(2E,4S)-2,4-dimethyldocos-2-enoyl]-2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E,4S)-2,4-dimethyldocos-2-enoic acid.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising residues of galactose, N-acetylglucosamine, galactose and N-acetylglucosamine in a linear sequence, joined by β-(1→4)-, β-(1→3)-, and β-(1→4)-linkages, respectively.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-3-O-[(2E,4S,6S)-2,4,6-trimethyltetracos-2-enoyl]-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E,4S,6S)-2,4,6-trimethyltetracos-2-enoic acid.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of D-mannose having a β-D-xylosyl residue attached at the 2-position.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-3-O-[(2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltetracos-2-enoyl]-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltetracos-2-enoic acid.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by a β-methoxy.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-3-O-[(2E,4S,6S,8S,10S)-2,4,6,8,10-pentamethylhexacos-2-enoyl]-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E,4S,6S,8S,10S)-2,4,6,8,10-pentamethylhexacos-2-enoic acid.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside derived from a hexasaccharide consisting of three units N-acetyllactosamine coupled in a linear sequence by β-(1→3') linkages.

name: 2-O-octanoyl-2'-O-sulfo-3-O-[(2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltetracos-2-enoyl]-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with octanoic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethylteracos-2-enoic acid.

name: 2'-O-sulfo-2-O-tetracosanoyl-3-O-[(2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltetracos-2-enoyl]-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with tetracosanoic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltetracos-2-enoic acid.

name: 2-O-[(2E,4S)-2,4-dimethyldocos-2-enoyl]-3-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with (2E,4S)-2,4-dimethyldocos-2-enoic acid, and at the 3-position with palmitoic acid.

name: 3-O-[(2E,4R)-2,4-dimethyldocos-2-enoyl]-2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E,4R)-2,4-dimethyldocos-2-enoic acid.

name: S-[(2E,6E)-farnesyl]-L-cysteine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of S-[(2E,6E)]-farnesyl-L-cysteine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A tetrasaccharide consisting of two (1→5)-linked β-D-galactofuranose units, which are in turn linked (1→6) to α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-D-mannopyranose.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A pentasaccharide composed of four (1→5)-linked β-D-galactofuranose units, which are joined (1→6)-linkage to a D-mannopyranose at the reducing end.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→2)-α-D-Manp6Ac-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp
definition: A heptasaccharide derivative in which a backbone of one glucuronic acid, one 6-O-acetyl and three mannose residues is branched at each of the two non-terminal mannoses with a xylose residue, linked α(1→2).

name: β-D-Galf-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of D-mannose at the reducing end having a β-D-galactofuranosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannosyl moiety attached at the 6-position.

name: α-L-Fucp2Me-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a 2-O-methyl-L-fucosyl residue at the non-reducing end linked (1→2) to an β-D-galactosyl residue which is in turn linked (1→3) to an N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine.

name: α-L-Fucp2Me-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a 2-O-methyl-L-fucosyl residue at the non-reducing end linked (1→2) to an β-D-galactosyl residue which is in turn linked (1→3) to an N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine.

name: α-L-Fucp2Me-(1→2)-β-D-Galp4Me
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of a 2-O-methylfucosyl residue joined by an α-(1→2)-linkage to a 4-O-methyl-β-D-galactose.

name: (3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)methanol
definition: A member of the class of benzyl alcohols that is benzyl alcohol in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 4 of the phenyl group are substituted by methoxy groups.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and N-acetyl-α-D-galactopyranosamine residues joined in sequence with a (1→2)- and a (1→3)-linkage, respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and N-acetyl-β-D-galactopyranosamine residues joined in sequence with a (1→2)- and a (1→3)-linkage, respectively; α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc in which the configuration at the reducing-end anomeric centre is β.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-α-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of two D-galactose residues, linked α(1→3), and an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked α(1→4), at the reducing end.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→4)-D-ribitol-5-phosphate
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of D-ribitol-5-phosphate having an α-L-rhamnosyl residue attached at the 4-position.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: The trisaccharide β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalNAc with α configuration at the anomeric centre of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→4)-D-ribitol-(5-P-2)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide phosphate consisting of α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-α-D-glucose having a α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→4)-D-ribitol-5-phosphate moiety attached at the 2-position of the galactose via a phosphodiester linkage.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide in which two galactose residues, linked α(1→4), are linked β(1→3) to an N-acetylgalactosamine residue.

name: D-ribitol-(5-P-2)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide phosphate consisting of α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-α-D-glucose having a D-ribitol-5-phosphate moiety attached at the 2-position of the galactose via a phosphodiester linkage.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide in which an N-acetylglucosamine residue is linked β(1→6) to the residue at the reducing end of a linear chain of two galactose residues and an N-acetylglucosamine residue.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate
definition: An N-acetyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: DCC-2036
definition: A member of the class of ureas that is urea in which one of the nitrogens bears a 3-tert-butyl-1-(quinolin-6-yl)-1H-pyrazol-5-yl substituent, while the other bears a 2-fluoro-4-{[2-(methylcarbamoyl)pyridin-4-yl]oxy}phenyl substituent.

name: TAMe
definition: An L-arginine ester that is methyl L-argininate in which one of the hydrogens attached to the α-nitrogen is substituted by a tosyl group.

name: N-acetyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate
definition: An N-acyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate having the N-acyl specified as acetyl.

name: α-D-ManpAc-(1-P-6)-α-D-ManpAc
definition: A phosphate-linked oligosaccharide analogue consisting of two N-acetyl-α-D-mannosamine units joined by a (1→6)-phosphodiester linkage.

name: DP-987
definition: A member of the class of phenylureas that is urea in which one of the nitrogens bears a 3-tert-butyl-1-[(3S)-3-carboxy-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinolin-6-yl]-1H-pyrazol-5-yl substituent, while the other bears a 2,3-dichlorophenyl group.

name: α-D-ManpNAc-(1-P-6)-α-D-ManpNAc-(1-P-6)-α-D-ManpNAc
definition: A phosphate-linked oligosaccharide analogue consisting of three N-acetyl-α-D-mannosamine units joined by (1→6)-phosphodiester linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: β-anthropyranosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnopyranose
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of α-L-rhamnopyranose having a β-anthropyranosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: β-anthropyranose
definition: An amino monosaccharide consisting of D-glucose having a 3-hydroxy-3-methylbutanamido group at the 4-position, a 2-O-methyl group and lacking the 6-hydroxy group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide that consists of a galactopyranose residue attached by a β-(1→4)-linkage to an N-acetylglucosamine residue, that is in turn attached to a second galactopyranose by a β-(1→6)-linkage.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide in which a galactose residue is linked β(1→3) to the residue at the reducing end of a linear chain of one galactose residue, one N-acetylglucosamine residue and one N-acetylgalactosamine residue, sequentially linked β(1→4) and β(1→6).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide that consists of a galactopyranose residue attached by a β-(1→4)-linkage to an N-acetylglucosamine residue, that is in turn attached to a mannopyranose by a (1→6)-linkage.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide in which a galactose residue is linked β(1→3) to the residue at the reducing end of a linear chain of two galactose residues, one N-acetylglucosamine residue and one N-acetylgalactosamine residue, sequentially linked α(1→4), β(1→4) and β(1→6).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-Galp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of two units of β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-N-acetamido-β-D-glucosamine, attached by (1→3)- and (1→6)-linkages to a D-galactopyranose.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: A linear hexasaccharide consisting of D-mannosyl residues connected sequentially by β-(1→2)-, β-(1→2)-, α-(1→3)-, α-(1→2)- and α-(1→2)-linkages.

name: plastoquinol
definition: A prenyl- or polyprenyl-hydroquinone that results from the reduction of a plastoquinone to the corresponding hydroquinone.

name: biotin sulfoxide
definition: A sulfoxide that is the S-oxide of biotin.
