A high-melting (decomposes above 280°C) white solid which is very soluble in water (70.6 g/100 g water at 0°C; 103.8 g/100 g water at 100°C), it is widely used as a fertilizer for alkaline soils.

name: ammonium acetate
definition: An ammonium salt obtained by reaction of ammonia with acetic acid. A deliquescent white crystalline solid, it has a relatively low melting point (114°C) for a salt. Used as a food acidity regulator, although no longer approved for this purpose in the EU.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of L-fucose linked α(1→2') to a β-lactose unit.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Galp that has β-configuration at the anomeric hydroxy group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-β-D-Galp
definition: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-Galp in which the configuration of the D-galactosyl residue at the reducing end is β.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-α-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-(CH2)5CO2H
definition: A glycoside that consists of α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine in which the hydrogen at the reducing end is substituted by a carboxypentyl group.

name: aminocyclopyrachlor
definition: An organochlorine herbicide, the structure of which is that of pyrimidine-4-carboxylic acid substituted at positions 2, 5 and 6 by cyclopropyl, chloro and amino groups respectively.

name: aminocyclopyrachlor-potassium
definition: The potassium salt of aminocyclopyrachlor.

name: aminocyclopyrachlor(1−)
definition: The monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of aminocyclopyrachlor formed by loss of a proton from thecarboxy group.

name: sodium 2-(N-morpholino)ethanesulfonate
definition: The organic sodium salt that is the sodium salt of 2-(N-morpholino)ethanesulfonic acid.

name: sodium dimethylarsinate
definition: The organic sodium salt of dimethylarsinate.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl diphosphate having N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine as the glycosyl fragment.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol(2−)
definition: The dianion resulting from the removal of two protons from the diphosphate group of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol.

name: clopyralid
definition: An organochlorine pesticide having a 3,6-dichlorinated picolinic acid structure.

name: aminopyralid
definition: An organochlorine pesticide having a 3,6-dichlorinated 4-aminopicolinic acid structure.

name: magnesium acetate
definition: The magnesium salt of acetic acid.

name: sodium formate
definition: An organic sodium salt which is the monosodium salt of formic acid.

name: polygalacturonic acid
definition: An oligosaccharide of more than twenty D-galacturonic acid residues joined by α(1→4) glycosidic linkages. In the diagram, n > 18.

name: arabinotetraose
definition: A tetrasaccharide comprised of four D-arabinose residues connected by α(1→5) linkages.

name: xylotetraose
definition: A tetrasaccharide comprised of four D-xylose residues connected by β(1→4) linkages.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-D-Manp
definition: A tetrasaccharide comprised of four D-mannose residues connected by β(1→4) linkages.

name: cellotetraose
definition: A glucotetrose comprised of four D-glucose residues connected by β(1→4) linkages.

name: cellopentaose
definition: A pentasaccharide comprised of five D-glucose residues connected by β(1→4) linkages.

name: 4-hydroxyprolinate
definition: The α-amino-acid anion formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy group of 4-hydroxyproline.

name: 5-hydroxylysinate
definition: The α-amino-acid anion formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of 5-hydroxylysine.

name: homoserinate
definition: An α-amino-acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of homoserine.

name: 4-hydroxy-L-prolinate
definition: The L-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of 4-hydroxy-L-proline, formed by proton loss from the carboxy group. It is the major microspecies present at pH > 10.6.

name: ammonium dihydrogen phosphate
definition: The ammonium salt of phosphoric acid (molar ratio 1:1).

name: sodium malonate
definition: The organic sodium salt formed between sodium and malonic acid (molar ratio 2:1).

name: zinc acetate
definition: An acetate salt in which the cationic component is zinc(2+).

name: 5-triphospho-1D-myo-inositol 1,2,3,4,6-pentakisphosphate
definition: A myo-inositol pentakisphosphate that consists of myo-inositol having the five phospho groups located at positions 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 as well as a triphospho group at position 5.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of the linear trisaccharide N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having α-L-fucosyl residues attached at position 2 of the galactose and position 4 of the glucosamine. Corresponds to a partial structure of blood group A type 1 oligosaccharide.

name: chenodeoxycholoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate groups of chenodeoxycholoyl-CoA. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of the linear trisaccharide N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having α-L-fucosyl residues attached at position 2 of the galactose and position 3 of the glucosamine. Corresponds to a partial structure of blood group A type 2 oligosaccharide.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: A tetrasaccharide comprising residues of galactose, N-acetylglucosamine, galactose and N-acetylglucosamine units in a linear sequence, all joined by β-linkages.

name: 2-methylpentane-2,4-diol
definition: A glycol in which the two hydroxy groups are at positions 2 and 4 of 2-methylpentane (isopentane).

name: α-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)]-[α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-α-D-Glc-(1→2)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-α-D-Glc-(1→5)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-Lipid A
definition: A lipid A derivative that consists of a branched decasaccharide made up from two galactose, give glucose, one N-acetylglucosamine and two Kdo (one at the reducing end) units connected to lipid A via an α-(2→6)-linkage.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-α-D-Glc-(1→2)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)]-[α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-α-D-Glc-(1→2)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-α-D-Glc-(1→5)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-Lipid A
definition: A lipid A derivative that consists of a branched dodecasaccharide made up from four galactose, six glucose and two Kdo (one at the reducing end) units connected to lipid A via an α-(2→6)-linkage.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)]-[α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-α-D-Glc-(1→2)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-α-D-Glc-(1→5)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-Lipid A
definition: A lipid A derivative that consists of a branched dodecasaccharide made up from four galactose, five glucose, one N-acetylglucosamine and two Kdo (one at the reducing end) units connected to lipid A via an α-(2→6)-linkage.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: A galactotetraose in which the four D-galactose units are connected by three β-(1→6)-linkages.

name: 1-O-(α-D-glucopyranosyl)-N-icosa-11,14-dienoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-glucopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an icosa-11,14-dienoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) that is the tetraanion of 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions.

name: 1-O-(3-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-hexacosanoylsphinganine
definition: A glycodohydroceramide having a 3-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(4-deoxy-α-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl)-N-hexacosanoylsphinganine
definition: A glycodohydroceramide having a 4-deoxy-α-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: sodium bromide
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having bromide as the counterion.

name: sodium nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of sodium.

name: magnesium formate dihydrate
definition: The magnesium salt of formic acid, which exists in the solid state as a dihydrate.

name: 1-O-(4-deoxy-α-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl)-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an 4-deoxy-α-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-hexacosanoylsphinganine
definition: A glycodihydroceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-glucopyranosyl)-N-tetracosanylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-glucopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an tetracosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide consisting of D-glucose at the reducing end having an N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 4-position.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-O(CH2)2S(CH2)2CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose having a 2-(2-methoxycarbonylethylthio)ethyl (CETE) moiety attached to the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-O(CH2)2S(CH2)2CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactose having a 2-(2-methoxycarbonylethylthio)ethyl (CETE) moiety attached to the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: sodium L-tartrate
definition: The organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of L-tartaric acid.

name: potassium L-tartrate
definition: The potassium salt of L-tartaric acid.

name: potassium sodium L-tartrate
definition: The organic sodium and potassium salt of L-tartaric acid (mol ratio 1:1:1).

name: yttrium chloride
definition: The inorganic chloride salt of yttrium(III)

name: hexaamminecobalt(III) chloride
definition: A cobalt coordination entity consisting of a hexaamminecobalt(III) cation in association with three chloride anions as counterions.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-SC6H4-p-NH2
definition: An S-glycosyl compound that consists of 4-aminothiophenol having a β-lactosyl moiety attached to the sulfur via a thioglycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→4)-α-D-Gal-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that consists of methyl α-D-galactoside having an α-D-galactosyl residue at the 4-position.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-OEt
definition: A glycoside that consists of ethyl β-D-galactoside having an α-D-galactosyl residue at the 4-position.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-OEt
definition: A glycoside that consists of ethyl N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide having an α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl group attached at the 4-position.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-O(CH2)2S(CH2)2CONH2
definition: A glycoside that consists of α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose having a 2-(2-aminocarbonylethylthio)ethyl moiety attached to the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-O(CH2)2S(CH2)2CONH2
definition: A glycoside that consists of α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 2-(2-aminocarbonylethylthio)ethyl moiety attached to the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-O(CH2)2S(CH2)2CONH2
definition: A glycoside that consists of α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactose having a 2-(2-aminocarbonylethylthio)ethyl moiety attached to the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: p-aminophenyl α-D-mannoside
definition: An α-D-mannoside having 4-aminophenyl as the anomeric substituent.

name: 1,2-di-O-myristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphosulfocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphosulfocholine where the two phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as tetradecanoyl (myristoyl).

name: sulfocholine
definition: A sulfonium compound that is mercaptoethanol bearing two S-methyl substituents.

name: potassium dihydrogen phosphate
definition: A potassium salt in which dihydrogen phosphate(1−) is the counterion.

name: triammonium citrate
definition: A citrate salt in which all three carboxy groups are deprotonated and associated with ammonium ions as counter-cations.

name: ammonium nitrate
definition: The ammonium salt of nitric acid.

name: caesium chloride
definition: The inorganic chloride salt of caesium; each caesium ion is coordinated by eight chlorine ions.

name: ammonium iodide
definition: The iodide salt of ammonia.

name: manganese(II) chloride
definition: An inorganic chloride in which manganese(II) is coordinated to two chloride ions. In its anhydrous state manganese(II) chloride is a polymeric solid, which adopts a layered cadmium chloride-like structure.

name: lithium bromide
definition: A lithium salt in which the counterion is bromide. The anhydrous salt forms cubic crystals similar to common salt.

name: potassium nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of potassium.

name: jeffamine monoamine
definition: Any one of a class of diblock copolymers with a structure consisting of a primary amino group attached to the end of a polyether backbone based on blocks of propylene oxide and ethylene oxide. Molecular weights are typically of the order of 600-2000. The compounds are used in protein crystallisation.

name: lithium acetate
definition: An acetate salt comprising equal numbers of acetate and lithium ions.

name: pentaerythritol ethoxylate (3/4 EO/OH)
definition: A hydroxypolyether in which a hydroxy-poly(ethylene oxide) chain is connected to each of the methyl groups of neopentane. It is commonly used to crystallise proteins.

name: ammonium formate
definition: The ammonium salt of formic acid.

name: diammonium hydrogen phosphate
definition: An inorganic phosphate, being the diammonium salt of phosphoric acid. The commercially available fertilizer has an analysis of 18-46-0 (N-P2O5-K2O) and is marketed under the name diammonium phosphate or DAP.

name: Jeffamine ED-2001
definition: A diamine in which two primary amino groups are at either end of what is essentially a poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG)backbone, consisting of blocks of ethylene oxide and propylene oxide. In the diagram, m ~ 39,; (l + n) ~ 6. The compound is one of a series of related compounds commonly used to crystallise proteins.

name: purmorphamine
definition: A member of the class of purines that is purine substituted at C-2 by a 1-naphthyloxy group, at C-4 by a 4-morpholinophenylamino group, and at N-9 by a cyclohexyl group.

name: disodium PIPES
definition: An organic salt, being the disodium salt of 2,2'-piperazine-1,4-diylbisethanesulfonic acid (PIPES), a buffering agent.

name: (2R,3S)-EHNA
definition: EHNA of absolute configuration 2R,3S. Selective inhibitor of cGMP-stimulated phosphodiesterase (PDE2) (IC50 = 0.8 - 4 mM). Also a potent inhibitor of adenosine deaminase.

name: (2S,3R)-EHNA
definition: EHNA of absolute configuration 2S,3R.

name: UDP-rhamnose
definition: A UDP-sugar in which the sugar component is rhamnose.

name: 1,1'-dihydroxy-1,1',2,2'-tetrahydrolycopene
definition: A carotenol having the structure of 1,1',2,2'-tetrahydro-ψ,ψ-carotene with hydroxy functions at the 1 and 1' positions.

name: zeaxanthin bis(β-D-glucoside)
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is zeaxanthin in which both hydroxy groups have been converted to the corresponding glucosides. It is one of the most polar carotenoids found in nature (solubility in water is 800 ppm, compared with only 12.6 ppm for zeaxanthin itself).

name: neurosporaxanthin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of neurosporaxanthin. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-alaninate
definition: A β-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of β-alanine.

name: 2-nitro-6,7-dihydro-5H-imidazo[2,1-b][1,3]oxazine
definition: A member of the class of imidazo[2,1-b][1,3]oxazines in which the hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by a nitro group and in which the oxazine ring is fully saturated.

name: L-homocysteinate
definition: An L-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of L-homocysteine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 5H-imidazo[2,1-b][1,3]oxazine
definition: A member of the class of imidazo[2,1-b][1,3]oxazines resulting from the fusion of the bond between positions 2 and 1 of 1H-imidazole with the bond between positions 2 and 3 of 3,4-dihydro-2H-1,3-oxazine.

name: diammonium L-tartrate
definition: An organic salt that is the diammonium salt of L-(+)-tartaric acid.

name: diammonium citrate
definition: A citrate salt in which two of the three carboxy groups are deprotonated and associated with ammonium ions as counter-cations.

name: monosodium PIPES
definition: An organic salt that is the monosodium salt of 2,2'-piperazine-1,4-diylbisethanesulfonic acid (PIPES), a buffering agent.

name: praseodymium acetate
definition: A praseodymium molecular entity in which a praseodymium(3+) cation is associated with three acetate anions. Used as a heavy atom in protein crystallography experiments (multiple-wavelength anomalous dispersion, multiple isomorphous replacement).

name: 7-amino-1-(5-nitro-2-furyl)-1,8-dioxo-11,14,17,20,23-pentaoxa-2-azahexacosan-26-amide
definition: A furan having a nitro group at position 5 and a carboxamido group in turn bearing a long-chain multifunctional N-alkyl group at position 2.

name: 1-O-(6-acetamido-6-deoxy-α-D-galactosyl)-N-[(15Z)-tetracos-15-enoyl]phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide that consists of phytosphingosine having a 6-acetamido-6-deoxy-α-D-galactosyl attached at the O-1 position via a glycosidic linkage and a (Z)-tetracos-15-enoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: (S,S)-formoterol
definition: An N-[2-hydroxy-5-(1-hydroxy-2-{[1-(4-methoxyphenyl)propan-2-yl]amino}ethyl)phenyl]formamide in which both of the stereocentres have S configuration.

name: N-[2-hydroxy-5-(1-hydroxy-2-{[1-(4-methoxyphenyl)propan-2-yl]amino}ethyl)phenyl]formamide
definition: A phenylethanoloamine having 4-hydroxy and 3-formamido substituents on the phenyl ring and an N-(4-methoxyphenyl)propan-2-yl substituent.

name: N-purin-6-oyl-ε-aminocaproic acid
definition: A purine derivative that consists of 6-aminohexanoic acid having a purin-6-oyl group attached to the amino function via an amide bond.

name: N-purin-6-oylglycine
definition: A purine derivative that consists of glycine having a purin-6-oyl group attached to the amino function via an amide bond.

name: purine-6-caboxamide
definition: An aromatic amide that is purine bearing a carboxamido substituent at position 6.

name: 9-methylpurine
definition: Purine bearing a methyl substituent at position 6.

name: methyl purine-6-carboxylate
definition: A methyl ester that is purine bearing a methoxycarbonyl substituent at position 6.

name: purine-6-carboxylic acid
definition: A purinemonocarboxylic acid that consists of purine having the carboxy group located at position 6.

name: N2-{[2-(2-{[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]acetyl}arginyl-N1-{2-[(5-sulfo-1-naphthyl)amino]ethyl}aspartamide
definition: A dipeptide derivative that consists of arginylaspartamide having a 2-[(5-sulfo-1-naphthyl)amino]ethyl group attached to the amide nitrogen at the carboxy terminus and a [2-(2-{[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]acetyl group attached to the amino terminus.

name: N-{1-amino-6-[(5-nitro-2-furoyl)amino]-1-oxohexan-2-yl}-23-(indol-3-yl)-20-oxo-4,7,10,13,16-pentaoxa-19-azatricosan-1-amide
definition: A furan having a nitro group at position 5 and a carboxamido group in turn bearing a long-chain multifunctional N-alkyl group at position 2.

name: N-{1-amino-6-[(5-nitro-2-furoyl)amino]-1-oxohexan-2-yl}-26-(indol-3-yl)-23-oxo-4,7,10,13,16,19-hexaoxa-22-azahexacosan-1-amide
definition: A furan having a nitro group at position 5 and a carboxamido group in turn bearing a long-chain multifunctional N-alkyl group at position 2.

name: N-{1-amino-6-[(5-nitro-2-furoyl)amino]-1-oxohexan-2-yl}-32-(indol-3-yl)-29-oxo-4,7,10,13,16,19,22,25-octaoxa-28-azadotriacontan-1-amide
definition: A furan having a nitro group at position 5 and a carboxamido group in turn bearing a long-chain multifunctional N-alkyl group at position 2.

name: N-{1-amino-6-[(5-nitro-2-furoyl)amino]-1-oxohexan-2-yl}-80-(indol-3-yl)-77-oxo-4,7,10,13,16,19,22,25,28,31,34,37,40,43,46,49,52,55,58,61,64,67,70,73-tetracosaoxa-76-azaoctacontan-1-amide
definition: A polyether that consists of a poly(ethylene glycol) chain with an indol-3-yl-butanamido group at one end and a multifunctionalised alkyl group, in turn containing nitrofuran and amido moieties, at the other.

name: N6-(N6-{6-[(5-nitro-2-furoyl)amino]hexanoyl}lysyl)lysyl-N6-[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]lysinamide
definition: A tripeptide that consists of N6-lysyl-lysyl-lysinamide where the two side-chain amino functions are acylated by 4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl and 6-[(5-nitro-2-furoyl)amino]hexanoyl groups.

name: N6-[N6-(N6-{6-[(5-nitro-2-furoyl)amino]hexanoyl}lysyl)lysyl]lysyl-N6-[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]lysinamide
definition: A tetrapeptide that consists of [(N6-lysyl)-N6-lysyl]-lysyl-lysinamide where the two side-chain amino functions are acylated by 4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl and 6-[(5-nitro-2-furoyl)amino]hexanoyl groups.

name: N2-{3-[2-(2-{[(1-{3-[2-(2-{[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]propanoyl}piperidin-4-yl)carbonyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]propanoyl}-N6-(5-nitro-2-furoyl)lysinamide
definition: A furan having a nitro group at position 5 and a carboxamido group in turn bearing a long-chain polyether-based multifunctional N-alkyl group at position 2.

name: N2-{3-[2-(2-{[(1-{N-[(1-{3-[2-(2-{[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]propanoyl}piperidin-4-yl)carbonyl]glycyl}piperidin-4-yl)carbonyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]propanoyl}-N6-(5-nitro-2-furoyl)lysinamide
definition: A tripeptide that consists of a glycine residue flanked by two piperidine-4-carboxylic acid units (connected via amide linkages) where the amino terminus is acylated by a 3-[2-(2-{[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]propanoyl group and the carboxy terminus is formally condensed with the amino group of 3-[2-(2-aminoethoxy)ethoxy]propanoic acid, the carboxy group of which is in turn formally condensed with the α-amino group of N6-5-nitrofuroyllysine.

name: NSDB 211
definition: An ammonium betaine derivative of propanesulfonic acid. One of a group of non-detergent sulfobetaines having a sulfobetaine hydrophilic group and a short hydrophobic group that cannot aggregate to form micelles.

name: 1,1,1,3,3,3-hexafluoropropan-2-ol
definition: An organofluorine compound formed by substitution of all the methyl protons in propan-2-ol by fluorine. It is a metabolite of inhalation anesthetic sevoflurane.

name: N2-[3-(2-{2-[({1-[(1-{3-[2-(2-{[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]propanoyl}piperidin-4-yl)carbonyl]piperidin-4-yl}carbonyl)amino]ethoxy}ethoxy)propanoyl]-N6-(5-nitro-2-furoyl)lysinamide
definition: A dipeptide that consists of two piperidine-4-carboxylic acid units (connected via amide linkages) where the amino terminus is acylated by a 3-[2-(2-{[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]propanoyl group and the carboxy terminus is formally condensed with the amino group of 3-[2-(2-aminoethoxy)ethoxy]propanoic acid, the carboxy group of which is in turn formally condensed with the α-amino group of N6-5-nitrofuroyllysine.

A tetrapeptide that consists of four piperidine-4-carboxylic acid units (connected via amide linkages) where the amino terminus is acylated by a 3-[2-(2-{[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]amino}ethoxy)ethoxy]propanoyl group and the carboxy terminus is formally condensed with the amino group of 3-[2-(2-aminoethoxy)ethoxy]propanoic acid, the carboxy group of which is in turn formally condensed with the α-amino group of N6-5-nitrofuroyllysine bearing a polyether moiety at its carboxy terminus.

name: arformoterol(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the non-formylated amino group of arformoterol.

name: arformoterol fumarate
definition: A fumarate salt prepared from arformoterol by reaction of one molecule of fumaric acid for every two molecules of arformoterol.

name: (S,S)-formoterol fumarate
definition: A fumarate salt prepared from (S,S)-formoterol by reaction of one molecule of fumaric acid for every two molecules of (S,S)-formoterol.

name: (S,S)-formoterol(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the non-formylated amino group of (S,S)-formoterol.

name: fingolimod hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of 2-amino-2-[2-(4-octylphenyl) ethyl]-1,3-propanediol (fingolimod).

name: fingolimod(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of fingolimod.

name: fingolimod
definition: An aminodiol that consists of propane-1,3-diol having amino and 2-(4-octylphenyl)ethyl substituents at the 2-position. It is a sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor modulator used for the treatment of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis. A prodrug, fingolimod is phosphorylated by sphingosine kinase to active metabolite fingolimod-phosphate, a structural analogue of sphingosine 1-phosphate.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of two D-galactose residues, linked α(1→3), and an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked β(1→3), at the reducing end.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-3-deoxy-D-GlcNAc
definition: A three-membered deoxy oligosaccharide which has a 2-acetamido-2,3-dideoxy-D-ribo-hexose unit at the reducing end with an α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl group attached at the 4-position.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-6-deoxy-D-GlcNAc
definition: A three-membered deoxy oligosaccharide which has a 6-deoxy-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine unit at the reducing end with an α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl group attached at the 4-position.

name: N-[6-(DNCP-amino)hexanoyl]-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An N-acyl-β-D-glucosamine where the N-acyl group is specified as 6-[(2-carboxy-4,6-dinitrophenyl)amino]hexanoyl.

name: N1,N5-bis(2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranos-2-yl)-N2-(N3-DNCP-β-alanyl)glutaminamide
definition: A dipeptide that consists of β-alanyl-L-glutamine amide bearing a 2-carboxy-4,6-dinitrophenyl (DNCP) substituent at the amino terminus while the amides at the carboxy terminus and side-chain are substituted by β-D-glucopyranos-2-yl groups.

name: N1,N6-bis-DNCP-1,6-hexanediamine
definition: An N-substituted diamine that consists of 1,6-hexanediamine bearing two 2-carboxy-4,6-dinitrophenyl (DNCP) substituents at the N1- and N6-positions.

name: EDTA trisodium salt
definition: The organic sodium salt of ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) in which three sodium cations are associated with one trianion of EDTA.

name: IleΨ[(E)-CH=CH]Ala-Gly-Phe-Lys(5-GalO)-Gly-Glu-Gln-Gly-Pro-Lys-Gly-Glu-Thr
definition: A glycopeptide that consists of glycyl, phenylalanyl, (5R)-5-(β-D-galactopyranosyloxy)lysyl, glycyl. α-glutamyl, glutaminyl, glycyl, prolyl, lysyl, glycyl, α-glutamyl and threonine residues coupled in sequence with an isostere-modified IleΨ[(E)-CH=CH]Ala group attached to the amino terminus.

name: IleΨ(CH2CH2)Ala-Gly-Phe-Lys(5-GalO)-Gly-Glu-Gln-Gly-Pro-Lys-Gly-Glu-Thr
definition: A glycopeptide that consists of glycyl, phenylalanyl, (5R)-5-(β-D-galactopyranosyloxy)lysyl, glycyl. α-glutamyl, glutaminyl, glycyl, prolyl, lysyl, glycyl, α-glutamyl and threonine residues coupled in sequence with an isostere-modified IleΨ(CH2CH2)Ala group attached to the amino terminus.

name: Ile-AlaΨ[(E)-CH=CH]Gly-Phe-Lys(5-GalO)-Gly-Glu-Gln-Gly-Pro-Lys-Gly-Glu-Thr
definition: A glycopeptide that consists of phenylalanyl, (5R)-5-(β-D-galactopyranosyloxy)lysyl, glycyl. α-glutamyl, glutaminyl, glycyl, prolyl, lysyl, glycyl, α-glutamyl and threonine residues coupled in sequence with an isostere-modified Ile-AlaΨ[(E)-CH=CH]Gly tripeptoid unit attached to the amino terminus.

name: Ile-AlaΨ(CH2CH2)Gly-Phe-Lys(5-GalO)-Gly-Glu-Gln-Gly-Pro-Lys-Gly-Glu-Thr
definition: A glycopeptide that consists of phenylalanyl, (5R)-5-(β-D-galactopyranosyloxy)lysyl, glycyl. α-glutamyl, glutaminyl, glycyl, prolyl, lysyl, glycyl, α-glutamyl and threonine residues coupled in sequence with an isostere-modified Ile-AlaΨ(CH2CH2)Gly tripeptoid unit attached to the amino terminus.

name: EDTA(3−)
definition: A tetracarboxylic acid anion formed by deprotonation of three of the four carboxy groups in ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA).

name: Ile-Ala-GlyΨ[(E)-CH=CH]Phe-Lys(5-GalO)-Gly-Glu-Gln-Gly-Pro-Lys-Gly-Glu-Thr
definition: A glycopeptide that consists of (5R)-5-(β-D-galactopyranosyloxy)lysyl, glycyl. α-glutamyl, glutaminyl, glycyl, prolyl, lysyl, glycyl, α-glutamyl and threonine residues coupled in sequence with an isostere-modified Ile-Ala-GlyΨ[(E)-CH=CH]Phe tetrapeptoid unit attached to the amino terminus.

name: Ile-Ala-GlyΨ(CH2CH2)Phe-Lys(5-GalO)-Gly-Glu-Gln-Gly-Pro-Lys-Gly-Glu-Thr
definition: A glycopeptide that consists of (5R)-5-(β-D-galactopyranosyloxy)lysyl, glycyl. α-glutamyl, glutaminyl, glycyl, prolyl, lysyl, glycyl, α-glutamyl and threonine residues coupled in sequence with an isostere-modified Ile-Ala-GlyΨ(CH2CH2)Phe tetrapeptoid unit attached to the amino terminus.

name: Gly-L-Ala-L-Ala-D-Ala-D-Ala
definition: A pentapeptide that consists of one glycyl, two L-alanyl and two D-alanyl residues coupled in sequence.

name: 4,6-dideoxy-4-(3-deoxy-L-glycero-tetronamido)-α-D-Manp2Me-(1→2)-4,6-dideoxy-4-(3-deoxy-L-glycero-tetronamido)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-4,6-dideoxy-4-(3-deoxy-L-glycero-tetronamido)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-4,6-dideoxy-4-(3-deoxy-L-glycero-tetronamido)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that consists of 4,6-dideoxy-4-(3-deoxy-L-glycero-tetronamido)-2-Me-α-D-Man residue at the non-reducing end coupled to three 4,6-dideoxy-4-(3-deoxy-L-glycero-tetronamido)-2-Me-α-D-Man in a linear sequence, connected by (11→2)-linkages.

name: 4-hydroxyproline zwitterion
definition: The amino acid zwitterion formed from 4-hydroxyproline.

name: D-galactal
definition: A glycal derived from D-galactopyranose

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear trisaccharide comprising D-glucose (at the reducing end) having a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl moiety at the 4-position.

name: β(1→3)-D-galactopentaose
definition: A galactopentaose in which the linkages between the five D-galactosyl residues are β(1→3).

name: β(1→4)-D-galactopentaose
definition: A galactopentaose in which the linkages between the five D-galactosyl residues are β(1→4).

name: β(1→6)-D-galactopentaose
definition: A galactopentaose in which the linkages between the five D-galactosyl residues are β(1→6).

name: penta-O-acetyl-α-D-galactose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that consists of α-D-galactopyranose bearing five O-acetyl substituents.

name: β(1→3)-D-galactohexaose
definition: A galactohexaose in which the linkages between the six D-galactosyl residues are β(1→3).

name: β(1→4)-D-galactohexaose
definition: A galactohexaose in which the linkages between the six D-galactosyl residues are β(1→4).

name: β(1→6)-D-galactohexaose
definition: A galactohexaose in which the linkages between the six D-galactosyl residues are β(1→6).

name: D-rhamnopyranose
definition: The pyranose ring form of D-rhamnose.

name: α-D-rhamnose
definition: A D-rhamnopyranose having α-configuration at its anomeric centre.

name: N-acetyl-D-mannosamine
definition: An N-acetylmannosamine having D-configuration.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-mannosamine
definition: An N-acetyl-D-mannosamine having β-configuration at its anomeric centre.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose having an α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue attached at the 3-position

name: L-cystine anion
definition: The L-α-amino acid anion that is a conjugate base of L-cystine, formed by loss of a proton from each of the carboxy groups. It is the major microspecies at pH > 9.4.

name: prosolanapyrone III
definition: A prosolanapyrone that is prosolanapyrone II in which the hydroxy group has been oxidised to afford the corresponding aldehyde.

name: leukotriene D4(1−)
definition: The leukotriene anion that is the monoanion of leukotriene D4 arising from deprotonation of the two carboxy groups and protonation of the cysteinyl α-amino group.

name: raucaffrinoline
definition: An indole alkaloid having a ajmalan-type skeleton and characterised by a 17α-acetoxy group, a 21β-methyl group, loss of the 1-methyl group with associated unsaturation at N(1)=C(2), and a 20α-hydroxymethyl group in place of the 20β-ethyl side-chain.

name: perakine
definition: An indole alkaloid having a ajmalan-type skeleton and characterised by a 17α-acetoxy group, a 21β-methyl group, loss of the 1-methyl group with associated unsaturation at N(1)=C(2), and a 20α-formyl group in place of the 20β-ethyl side-chain.

name: N-succinyl-Leu-Tyr-7-amido-4-methylcoumarin
definition: Coumarin carrying a methyl group at C-4 and a succinyl-leucyl-tryrosyl side-chain at C-7.

name: succinimidyl 4-(N-maleimidomethyl)cyclohexane-1-carboxylate
definition: An N-hydroxysuccinimide ester derived from 4-(N-maleimidomethyl)cyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid.

name: methyl 9-(α-D-galactosyloxy)nonanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of 9-(α-D-galactosyloxy)nonanoic acid and methanol.

name: 11α-hydroxy-β-amyrin
definition: The pentacyclic triterpenoid that is the 11α-hydroxy derivative of β-amyrin.

name: (13R)-edaxadiene
definition: An edaxadiene in which the carbon bearing the hydroxy group has R configuration.

name: N-butyl-N2-[(2Z)-2-(2-furyl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]-L-alaninamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-alaninamide and (2Z)-2-(2-furyl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetic acid.

name: (13S)-edaxadiene
definition: An edaxadiene in which the carbon bearing the hydroxy group has S configuration.

name: N-butyl-N2-[(2Z)-2-(2-furyl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]-L-serinamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-serinamide and (2Z)-2-(2-furyl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetic acid.

name: N-butyl-N2-[(2Z)-2-(2-furyl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]-L-cysteinamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-cysteinamide and (2Z)-2-(2-furyl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetic acid.

name: N-butyl-N2-[(2Z)-2-(2-furyl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]-3,3-dimethoxyalaninamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-3,3-dimethoxyalaninamide and (2Z)-2-(2-furyl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetic acid.

name: 11-oxo-β-amyrin
definition: The pentacyclic triterpenoid that is the 11-oxo derivative of β-amyrin.

name: N2-[(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]-N-butyl-L-alaninamide
definition: An amino acid amide that is a carboxamide obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-alaninamide and (2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetic acid.

name: N2-[(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]-N-butyl-L-serinamide
definition: An amino acid amide that is a carboxamide obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-serinamide and (2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetic acid.

name: N2-[(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]-N-butyl-L-cysteinamide
definition: An amino acid amide that is a carboxamide obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-cysteinamide and (2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetic acid.

name: N2-[(2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]-N-butyl-3,3-dimethoxyalaninamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-3,3-dimethoxyalaninamide and (2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetic acid.

name: N-butyl-N2-(2-thienylacetyl)-L-alaninamide
definition: An L-alanine derivative obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-alaninamide and 2-thienylacetic acid.

name: (+)-β-caryophyllene
definition: A β-caryophyllene in which the stereocentre adjacent to the exocyclic double bond has R configuration while the remaining stereocentre has S configuration. It is the enantiomer of (−)-β-caryophyllene, which occurs much more widely than the (+)-form.

name: β-caryophyllene
definition: A sesquiterpene with a [7.2.0]-bicyclic structure comprising fused 9- and 4-membered rings, with a trans-ring junction, a trans-double bond between the 4- and 5-positions of the 9-membered ring, a methylidene group at position 9, and methyl groups at positions 3, 11, and 11. The most commonly occurring form is the (1R,9S)-(−)-enantiomer, which is found in many essential oils, particularly clove oil.

name: N-butyl-N2-(2-thienylacetyl)-L-serinamide
definition: A L-serine derivative obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-serinamide and 2-thienylacetic acid.

name: N-butyl-N2-(2-thienylacetyl)-L-cysteinamide
definition: A cysteine derivative obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-cysteinamide and 2-thienylacetic acid.

name: D-ravidosamine
definition: A hexosamine having a 3-dimethylamino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactose structure, the amino sugar constituent of ravidomycin and other antibiotics.

name: N2-[(R)-2-amino-2-phenylacetyl]-N-butyl-L-alaninamide
definition: A dipeptide consisting of N-butyl-L-alaninamide having an (R)-2-amino-2-phenylacetyl residue attached to its α-amino nitrogen.

name: (+)-caryolan-1-ol
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is tricyclo[6.3.1.02,5]dodecane which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1 and by methyl groups at positions 4, 4, and 8 (the 1S,2R,5S,8R-diastereoisomer).

name: N2-[(R)-2-amino-2-phenylacetyl]-N-butyl-L-serinamide
definition: A dipeptide consisting of N-butyl-L-serinamide having an (R)-2-amino-2-phenylacetyl residue attached to its α-amino nitrogen.

name: N2-[(R)-2-amino-2-phenylacetyl]-N-butyl-L-cysteinamide
definition: A dipeptide consisting of N-butyl-L-cysteinamide having an (R)-2-amino-2-phenylacetyl residue attached to its α-amino nitrogen.

name: N2-[(R)-2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetyl]-N-butyl-L-alaninamide
definition: A dipeptide consisting of N-butyl-L-alaninamide having an (R)-2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetyl residue attached to its α-amino nitrogen.

name: N2-[(R)-2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetyl]-N-butyl-L-serinamide
definition: A dipeptide consisting of N-butyl-L-serinamide having an (R)-2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetyl residue attached to its α-amino nitrogen. A synthetic determinant of cefadroxil, it is a promising tool for determining in vitro cross-reactivity to cefadroxil in amoxicillin-allergic patients.

name: N2-[(R)-2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetyl]-N-butyl-L-cysteinamide
definition: A dipeptide consisting of N-butyl-L-cysteinamide having an (R)-2-amino-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetyl residue attached to its α-amino nitrogen.

name: dTDP-D-ravidosamine
definition: A dTDP-sugar having D-ravidosamine as the sugar component.

name: (−)-γ-cadinene
definition: A member of the cadinene family of sesquiterpenes in which the isopropyl group is cis to the hydrogen at the adjacent bridgehead carbon (the 1R,4aS,8aS enantiomer).

name: N-butyl-N2-[(R)-2-hydroxy-2-phenylacetyl]-L-alaninamide
definition: An alanine derivative obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-alaninamide and (R)-2-hydroxy-2-phenylacetic acid.

name: (+)-γ-cadinene
definition: A member of the cadinene family of sesquiterpenes in which the isopropyl group is cis to the hydrogen at the adjacent bridgehead carbon (the 1S,4aR,8aR enantiomer).

name: N-butyl-N2-[(R)-2-hydroxy-2-phenylacetyl]-L-serinamide
definition: A L-serine derivative obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-serinamide and (R)-2-hydroxy-2-phenylacetic acid.

name: mycinamicin III
definition: A mycinamicin composed of a 16-membered ring macrolactone core, an N,N-dimethylated deoxysugar desosamine and a 2-O-methylated 6-deoxysugar javose.

name: 2-hydroxy-dATP
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate in which the 2'-deoxyribonucleoside moiety is 2'-deoxy-2-hydroxyadenosine.

name: 2-hydroxy-dATP(3−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside triphosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of 2'-deoxy-2-hydroxyadenosine 5'-triphosphate, arising from deprotonation of three of the four triphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-butyl-N2-[(R)-2-hydroxy-2-phenylacetyl]-L-cysteinamide
definition: A cysteine derivative obtained by formal condensation between N-butyl-L-cysteinamide and (R)-2-hydroxy-2-phenylacetic acid.

name: 2-hydroxy-dAMP
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate in which the purine moiety is 2-hydroxyadenine.

name: 2-hydroxy-dAMP(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the dianion of 2'-deoxy-2-hydroxyadenosine 5'-monophosphate arising from deprotonation of both OH groups of the phosphate.

name: TCEP
definition: A tertiary phosphine in which phosphane is substituted with three 2-carboxyethyl groups. It is a commonly used reducing agent.

name: cefodizime
definition: A cephalosporin compound having 5-(carboxymethyl)-4-methyl-1,3-thiazol-2-yl]sulfanyl}methyl and [2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]amino side groups located at positions 3 and 7 respectively.

name: aminocyclopyrachlor-methyl
definition: A pyrimidinecarboxylate ester that is the methyl ester of aminocyclopyrachlor.

name: 5(S),8(R)-DiHODE
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is the (5S,8R)-dihydroxy derivative of linoleic acid.

name: 5(S),8(R)-DiHODE(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 5(S),8(R)-DiHODE. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: pramipexole(2+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of two most basic nitrogens of pramipexole.

name: 8-oxo-dGTP
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate having 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanine as the nucleobase.

name: N-benzoylampicillin
definition: A penicillin that is the N-benzoyl derivative of ampicillin.

name: 8-oxo-dGTP(3−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside triphosphate oxoanion that is a trianion of 8-oxo-dGTP arising from partial deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups.

name: 8-oxo-dGMP
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanine as the nucleobase.

name: 8-oxo-dGMP(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of 8-oxo-dGMP.

name: N-(8-carboxy-3-oxooctanoyl)-L-homoserine lactone
definition: An N-acyl-L-homoserine lactone having 8-carboxy-3-oxooctanoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: hapten GNL
definition: An azabicycloalkane that consists of ecgonine having phenylphosphonyl and alkyl groups attached to the hydroxy and carboxy groups respectively. Used as a transition state analogue of cocaine.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of D-glucose at the reducing end having an N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 4-position.

name: α-D-GalNpAc-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by methoxy.

name: α-D-GalNpAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by methoxy.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of a galactosyl residue at the non-reducing end linked β-(1→3) to an N-acetylgalactosaminyl residue, which is in turn linked β-(1→3) to a β-galactose unit at the reducing end.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine having a β-D-galactosyl residue attached at the 3-position and an α-N-acetylneuraminosyl residue attached at the 6-position.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide that consists of a galactose residue attached by a β-(1→3)-linkage to an N-acetylglucosamine residue, that is in turn attached to a second galactose by a β-(1→6)-linkage.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of the linear trisaccharide α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having α-L-fucosyl residues attached at position 2 of the galactose and position 4 of the glucosamine.

name: pacific blue
definition: A hydroxycoumarin having the hydroxy group located at position 7 and bearing two fluoro substituents at positions 6 and 8 as well as a carboxy group at position 3. A fluorescent dye of excitation wavelength 403 nm and emission wavelength 455 nm.

name: (9R,10E,12Z,15Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12,15-trienoic acid
definition: A (10E,12Z,15Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12,15-trienoic acid which has R-configuration at the chiral centre.

name: (10E,12Z,15Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12,15-trienoic acid
definition: A lipid hydroperoxide, obtained by the formal substitution of a hydrogen at position 9 of (10E,12Z,15Z)-octadeca-10,12,15-trienoic acid by a hydroperoxy group.

name: (10E,12Z,15Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12,15-trienoate
definition: The monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of (10E,12Z,15Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12,15-trienoic acid.

name: pacific blue succinimidyl ester
definition: An N-hydroxysuccinimide ester derived from 6,8-difluoro-7-hydroxycoumarin-3-carboxylic acid (pacific blue). A fluorescent dye of excitation wavelength 403 nm and emission wavelength 455 nm.

name: (9R,10E,12Z,15Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12,15-trienoate
definition: A (10E,12Z,15Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12,15-trienoate that has R configuration at the chiral centre.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc with β configuration at the anomeric carbon of the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end.

name: pentalen-13-ol
definition: A tricyclic triterpenoid that is pentalenene in which one of the hydrogens of the allylic methyl group is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: pentalen-13-al
definition: An enal that is pentalen-13-ol in which the primary hydroxy group hax been oxidised to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: 3-hydroxy-9,10-secoandrosta-1,3,5(10)-triene-9,17-dione
definition: A seco-androstane that is 9,10-secoandrostane which is substituted by oxo groups at positions 9 and 17 and in which the A-ring is aromatic and bears a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: DY-732(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by selective deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of DY-732.

name: (Z)-2-methylureidoperacrylic acid
definition: The peracid of (Z)-2-methylureidoacrylic acid where the acidic ‒OH group has been replaced by an ‒OOH group.

name: (Z)-2-methyl-3-aminoperacrylic acid
definition: The peracid of aminoacrylic acid where the acidic ‒OH group has been replaced by an ‒OOH group.

name: 2-oxepin-2(3H)-ylideneacetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-oxepin-2(3H)-ylideneacetic acid.

name: 2-oxepin-2(3H)-ylideneacetyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 2-oxepin-2(3H)-ylideneacetyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxo-5,6-dehydrosuberyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-oxo-5,6-dehydrosuberic acid.

name: β-D-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp(1−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid anion that results from the deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group of β-D-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxo-5,6-dehydrosuberyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxy groups of 3-oxo-5,6-dehydrosuberyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,8-dioxooct-5-enoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3,8-dioxooct-5-enoic acid.

name: 3,8-dioxooct-5-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3,8-dioxooct-5-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-D-glucopyranosyl, α-L-rhamnopyranosyl and β-D-glucopyranosyl residues connected in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) links, respectively.

name: dTDP-α-D-desosamine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dTDP-α-D-desosamine, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group.

name: dTDP-3-azaniumyl-3,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dTDP-3-amino-3,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group.

name: β-D-4-deoxy-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of β-D-4-deoxy-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc.

name: dTDP-3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: dTDP-3-azaniumyl-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dTDP-3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group.

name: 4-deoxy-Δ4-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: A 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-(4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranosyluronic acid)-6-O-sulfo-D-galactopyranose in which the galactose residue has β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-4-deoxy-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S(2−)
definition: A 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-(4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranosyluronate)-6-O-sulfonato-D-galactopyranose(2−) in which the galactose moiety has β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: dTDP-α-D-mycaminose(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dTDP-α-D-mycaminose, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group.

name: dTDP-3-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-3-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine 6-sulfate(1−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from the sulfate group of N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine 6-sulfate.

name: 4-deoxy-Δ4-β-D-GlcpA2S-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-(4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl)-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the 4-deoxy-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl moiety is converted to the corresponding sulfate derivative.

name: UDP-2-acetamido-4-amino-2,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having 2-acetamido-4-amino-2,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: 4-deoxy-Δ4-β-D-GlcpA2S-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc(2−)
definition: A organosulfate oxoanion and monocarboxylic acid anion that results from the removal of a proton from both the carboxy group and the sulfate group of 4-deoxy-Δ4-β-D-GlcpA2S-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-2-O-sulfo-D-glucuronic acid
definition: A carbohydrate sulfate that is the 2-O-sulphate derivative of 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronic acid.

name: UDP-2-acetamido-4-azaniumyl-2,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of UDP-2-acetamido-4-amino-2,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-2-O-sulfo-D-glucuronic acid(2−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is 5-dehydro-4-deoxy-2-O-sulfo-D-glucuronic acid in which a proton has been removed from both the carboxy and the sulfate group.

name: β-D-4-deoxy-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of β-D-4-deoxy-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc.

name: pseudaminic acid
definition: A nine-membered ketoaldonic acid derivative that is 5,7-diacetamido-3,5,7,9-tetradeoxynon-2-ulopyranosonic acid having L-glycero-α-L-manno-configuration.

name: pseudaminate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group of pseudaminic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,4-diacetamido-2,4,6-trideoxy-β-L-altrose
definition: An amino sugar that consists of β-L-altropyranose having the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4 replaced by acetamido groups.

name: mycinamicin IV
definition: A mycinamicin composed of a 16-membered ring macrolactone core, an N,N-dimethylated deoxysugar desosamine and a 2,3-di-O-methylated 6-deoxysugar mycinose.

name: mycinamicin VI
definition: A mycinamicin composed of a 16-membered ring macrolactone core, an N,N-dimethylated deoxysugar desosamine and a 6-deoxysugar 6-deoxyallose.

name: dTDP-3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose (3-amino-3-deoxy-α-D-fucopyranose) as the sugar component.

name: 3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose
definition: A hexosamine having a 3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactose structure.

name: 3-O-(α-L-olivosyl)erythronolide B
definition: A macrolide that is erythronolide B having a 2,6-dideoxy-α-L-arabino-hexopyranosyl (α-L-olivosyl) residue attached at position 3.

name: 3-O-(α-L-oleandrosyl)erythronolide B
definition: A macrolide that is erythronolide B having a 2,6-dideoxy-3-O-methyl-α-Larabino-hexopyranosyl (α-L-oleandrosyl) residue attached at position 3.

name: Alexa Fluor 405(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 8-[2-(4-{[(2,5-dioxopyrrolidin-1-yl)oxy]carbonyl}piperidin-1-yl)-2-oxoethoxy]pyrene-1,3,6-trisulfonic acid.

name: DY-632(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 2-tert-butyl-4-{-3-[3-(3-carboxypropyl)-3-methyl-5-sulfo-1-(3-sulfopropyl)-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-ylidene]prop-1-en-1-yl}-7-[ethyl(3-sulfopropyl)amino]chromenium

name: DY-634(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 7-[bis(3-sulfopropyl)amino]-2-tert-butyl-4-{3-[1-(3-carboxypropyl)-3-methyl-5-sulfo-3-(3-sulfopropyl)-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-ylidene]prop-1-en-1-yl}chromenium.

name: DY-652(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 2-tert-butyl-4-{3-[3-(3-carboxypropyl)-3-methyl-5-sulfo-1-(3-sulfopropyl)-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-ylidene]prop-1-en-1-yl}-6,8,8-trimethyl-9-(3-sulfopropyl)-8,9-dihydropyrano[3,2-g]quinolin-1-ium

name: DY-677(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 4-{3-[3-(3-carboxypropyl)-3-methyl-5-sulfo-1-(3-sulfopropyl)-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-ylidene]prop-1-en-1-yl}-6,8,8-trimethyl-2-phenyl-9-(3-sulfopropyl)-8,9-dihydropyrano[3,2-g]quinolin-1-ium

name: DY-678(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 4-{3-[3-(3-carboxypropyl)-3-methyl-5-sulfo-1-(3-sulfopropyl)-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-ylidene]prop-1-en-1-yl}-8,8-dimethyl-2-phenyl-6-(sulfomethyl)-9-(3-sulfopropyl)-8,9-dihydropyrano[3,2-g]quinolin-1-ium

name: DY-682(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 4-tert-butyl-2-{-3-[3-(3-carboxypropyl)-3-methyl-5-sulfo-1-(3-sulfopropyl)-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-ylidene]prop-1-en-1-yl}-7-[ethyl(3-sulfopropyl)amino]chromenium.

name: DY-734(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 7-[bis(3-sulfopropyl)amino]-2-tert-butyl-4-{5-[3-(3-carboxypropyl)-3-methyl-5-sulfo-1-(3-sulfopropyl)-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-ylidene]penta-1,3-dien-1-yl}chromenium.

name: lucifer yellow carbohydrazide dye(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of 6-amino-2-[(hydrazinocarbonyl)amino]-1,3-dioxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-benzo[de]isoquinoline-5,8-disulfonic acid.

name: dTDP-3-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-galactose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 6-deoxy-α-D-galact-3-ulose (3-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-xylo-hexose) as the sugar component.

name: dTDP-3-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-galactose(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arsing from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-3-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-galactose; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-D-ravidosamine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dTDP-D-ravidosamine arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and protonation of the tertiary amino group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of dTDP-3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 10-deoxymethymycin(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of 10-deoxymethymycin. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: mycinamicin III(1+)
definition: A mycinamicin cation that is the conjugate acid of mycinamicin III, obtained by protnation of the tertiary amino group.

name: mycinamicin IV(1+)
definition: A mycinamicin cation that is the conjugate acid of mycinamicin IV, obtained by protnation of the tertiary amino group.

name: mycinamicin VI(1+)
definition: A mycinamicin cation that is the conjugate acid of mycinamicin VI, obtained by protnation of the tertiary amino group.

name: O-benzoylecgonine 5-carboxypentyl ester
definition: An azabicycloalkane that consists of ecgonine having benzoyl and 5-carboxypentyl groups attached to the hydroxy and carboxy functions respectively.

name: 1,5-dihydrocoenzyme F420-6
definition: The 1,5-dihydro derivative of coenzyme F420-6. Species of coenzyme F420(red.) specific to Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

name: coenzyme F420-6
definition: A coenzyme variant specific to Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

name: lithium nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of lithium.

name: potassium formate
definition: The potassium salt of formic acid.

name: barium chloride
definition: The inorganic dichloride salt of barium.

name: NDSB 221
definition: An ammonium betaine derivative of 3-(piperidin-1-yl)propane-1-sulfonic acid. One of a group of non-detergent sulfobetaines having a sulfobetaine hydrophilic group and a short hydrophobic group that cannot aggregate to form micelles.

name: D-erythritol 1-phosphate
definition: The alditol 1-phosphate that is the 1-O-phospho derivative of erythritol with D configuration.

name: 3-dehydro-L-erythrose 4-phosphate
definition: The ketoaldose phosphate that is the 4-phosphate of 3-dehydro-L-erythrose.

name: (S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxo-4-(phosphonooxy)butanoic acid
definition: The ketoaldonic acid phosphate formed formally from L-erythronic acid by oxidation of the 3-hydroxy group to an oxo group and phosphorylation at the 1-hydroxy group.

name: 9(R)-HPODE(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 9(R)-HPODE.

name: (8E,10R,12Z)-10-hydroperoxy-8,12-octadecadienoate
definition: The hydroperoxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of hydroperoxy fatty acid anion, formed by deprotonation of the carboxy group; principal microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (2R,3S)-2,4',7-trihydroxyisoflavanone
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanones that is isoflavanone bearing hydroxy groups at the 2, 7 and 4' positions, with R and S configurations at C-2 and C-3 respectively.

name: 3'-methoxyflavone
definition: The parent member of the class of 3'-methoxyflavones that is flavone which carries a methoxy group at the 3'-position.

name: 4'-methoxyflavanone
definition: The parent member of the class of 4'-methoxyflavanones that is flavanone which is substituted by a methoxy group at the 4'-position.

name: 9(R)-HPODE
definition: An HPODE (hydroperoxy-octadecadienoic acid) in which the double bonds are at positions 10 and 12 (E and Z geometry, respectively) and the hydroperoxy group is at position 9 (R configuration).

name: L-arginyl-L-glutamic acid monoacetate
definition: The acetate salt of L-arginyl-L-glutamic acid.

name: rolitetracycline
definition: A derivative of tetracycline in which the amide function is substituted with a pyrrolidinomethyl group.

name: L-arginyl-L-glutamic acid
definition: A dipeptide comprising L-arginine with a L-glutamic acid residue attached to the N1 nitrogen.

name: UDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-L-N-acetyl-β-L-altrosamine(1−)
definition: Monoanion of UDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-L-N-acetyl-β-L-altrosamine arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate and protonation of the amino function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-amino-5-ammoniomethyl-2-methylpyrimidine
definition: The ammonium ion formed from 4-amino-5-aminomethyl-2-methylpyrimidine by protonation of the primary amino group; principle microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-2,4-diacetamido-2,4,6-trideoxy-β-L-altrose(2−)
definition: Dianion of UDP-4-amino-UDP-2,4-diacetamido-2,4,6-trideoxy-β-L-altrose arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: benzylpenicilloate(2−)
definition: The penicilloate(2−) species that is the dianion formed from benzylpenicilloic acid by deprotonation of both carboxy groups. It is the major microspecies present at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-L-N-acetyl-β-L-altrosamine
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having 4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-L-N-acetyl-β-L-altrosamine as the amino sugar component.

name: β-L-altrose
definition: Pyranose form of altrose in β-L configuration

name: UDP-2,4-diacetamido-2,4,6-trideoxy-β-L-altrose
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having 2,4-diacetamido-2,4,6-trideoxy-β-L-altrose as the amino sugar component.

name: α-guaiene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound and sesquiterpene that is 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8-octahydroazulene which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 1 and 4 and by a (prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 7 (the 1S,4S,7R enantiomer).

name: viridiflorene
definition: A carbotricyclic sesquiterpene obtained from several natural sources, including Australian Tea Tree oil (Melaleuca alternifolia.)

name: 5-epi-α-selinene
definition: An isomer of selinene where the double bond in the octahydronaphthalene ring system is endocyclic with (2R,4aR,8aS)-configuration. It has been isolated from termites.

name: (−)-cubebol
definition: A tertiary alcohol resulting from the formal addition of water to the double bond of α-cubebene.

name: δ-guaiene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound and sesquiterpene that is 1,2,3,3a,4,5,6,7-octahydroazulene which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 8 and by a (prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 5 (the 3S,3aS,5R enantiomer).

name: PD173074
definition: A member of the class of ureas that is 1-tert-butylurea in which one of the hydrogens attached to N3 is substituted by a pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidin-7-yl group, which is itself substituted at positions 2 and 6 by a 4-(diethylamino)butyl]amino group and a 3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group, respectively. It is a FGF/VEGF receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor.

name: SU5402
definition: An oxindole that is 3-methyleneoxindole in which one of the hydrogens of the methylene group is substituted by a 3-(2-carboxyethyl)-4-methyl-1H-pyrrol-2-yl group. It is an ATP-competitive inhibitor of the tyrosine kinase activity of fibroblast growth factor receptor 1.

name: masitinib
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is the carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]benzoic acid with the primary amino group of 4-methyl-N3-[4-(pyridin-3-yl)-1,3-thiazol-2-yl]benzene-1,3-diamine. It is a highly selective oral tyrosine kinase inhibitor.

name: BGJ-398
definition: A member of the class of phenylureas that is urea in which a hydrogen attached to one of the nitrogens is replaced by a 2,6-dichloro-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group, while the hydrogens attached to the other nitrogen are replaced by a methyl group and a 6-{[4-(4-ethylpiperazin-1-yl)phenyl]amino}pyrimidin-4-yl group. It is a potent and selective fibroblast growth factor receptor inhibitor.

name: midostaurin
definition: An organic heterooctacyclic compound that is the N-benzoyl derivative of staurosporine.

name: AZD4547
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is a carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-(cis-3,5-dimethylpiperazin-1-yl)benzoic acid with the amino substituent of 5-[2-(3,5-dimethoxyphenyl)ethyl]-1H-pyrazol-3-amine. It is an inhibitor of the fibroblast growth factor receptor (FGFR).

name: 2-(1,2-epoxy-1,2-dihydrophenyl)acetyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 2-(1,2-epoxy-1,2-dihydrophenyl)acetyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: shionone
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is perhydrochrysene which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 4bβ, 6aα, 8β, 10aβ and 12a positions, by a 4-methylpent-3-enyl group at the 8α position, and with an oxo group at position 2.

name: parkeol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid comprised of a lanostane skeleton which is 3β-hydroxylated and has double bonds at the 9(11)- and 24-positions.

name: achilleol B
definition: A tricyclic triterpenoid formed probably by cyclisation of (3S)-2,3-epoxy-2,3-dihydrosqualene to form an olean-13-yl cation with subsequent cleavage of the 8-14 and 9-10 bonds.

name: glutinol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is picene which has been fully hydrogenated except for a double bond between the 4a and 5 positions and is substituted by methyl groups at the 4, 4, 6bβ, 8aβ, 11, 11, 12bα and 14bβ positions, and by a hydroxy group at the 3β position.

name: baccharis oxide
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is perhydrochrysene which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 1, 4bβ, 6aα, 8β and 10aβ positions, by a 4-methylpent-3-enyl group at the 8α position, and with a β-oxygen bridge between the 2 and the 4a positions.

name: α-seco-amyrin
definition: A triterpenoid that is (2S)-1,2,3,4,4a,5,8,8a-octahydronaphthalen-2-ol substituted by methyl groups at the 1, 1, 4a, and 6 positions and substituted at position 5 by a 2-[(4aR,7R,8S,8aR)-2,4a,7,8-tetramethyl-3,4,4a,5,6,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalen-1-yl]ethyl group.

name: marneral
definition: A triterpenoid and aldehyde that is 3-cyclohexylpropanal in which the cyclohexyl group is substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 3, by an (E,E)-4,8,12-trimethyltrideca-3,7,11-trien-1-yl group at position 2, and by a propan-2-ylidene group at position 6 (the 1S,2R,3R-enantiomer).

name: β-seco-amyrin
definition: A triterpenoid that is (2S)-1,2,3,4,4a,5,8,8a-octahydronaphthalen-2-ol substituted by methyl groups at the 1, 1, 4a, and 6 positions and substituted at position 5 by a 2-[(4aR,8aR)-2,4a,7,7-tetramethyl-3,4,4a,5,6,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalen-1-yl]ethyl group.

name: δ-amyrin
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is oleanane which has a double bond between positions 13 and 18, and in which the hydrogen at the 3β position is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: tirucalla-7,24-dien-3β-ol
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is tirucalla-7,24-diene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionic acid.

name: arsonoacetic acid anion
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of arsonoacetic acid.

name: ectoinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of ectoine.

name: 4-carboxylato-4'-sulfonatoazobenzene
definition: A benzenesulfonate resulting from the deprotonation of both the carboxy group and the sulfo group of 4-carboxy-4'-sulfoazobenzene; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-{[4-({hydroxy[(4-nitrophenyl)amino]phosphoryl}methyl)phenyl]amino}-5-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide obtained by formal condensation of the anilino group of P-(4-aminobenzyl)-N-(4-nitrophenyl)phosphonamidic acid with one of the carboxy groups of glutaric acid.

name: (3-bromo-4-hydroxy-5-nitrophenyl)acetic acid
definition: A member of the class of phenylacetic acids in which the phenyl group is substituted by bromo, hydroxy, and nitro groups at position 3, 4, and 5 respectively.

name: (3-bromo-4-hydroxy-5-nitrophenyl)acetyl azide
definition: An azide carrying a (3-bromo-4-hydroxy-5-nitrophenyl)acetyl substituent.

name: 6-[(3-bromo-4-hydroxy-5-nitrophenyl)acetamido]caproic acid
definition: An N-acylamino acid that consists of 6-aminohexanoic acid bearing an N-(3-bromo-4-hydroxy-5-nitrophenyl)acetyl substituent.

name: glyphosine
definition: A tertiary amino compound that consists of glycine bearing two N-phosphonomethyl substituents.

name: N-(phosphonomethyl)iminodiacetic acid
definition: A tertiary amino compound that consists of iminodiacetic acid bearing an N-phosphonomethyl substituent.

name: 8-azaguanine
definition: A triazolopyrimidine that consists of 3,6-dihydro-7H-[1,2,3]triazolo[4,5-d]pyrimidine bearing amino and oxo substituents at positions 5 and 7 respectively.

name: 1,3,6,8-tetraazatricyclo[6.2.1.13,6]dodecane
definition: An azatricycloalkane that is tricyclo[6.2.1.13,6]dodecane in which the four bridgehead CH groups are replaced by nitrogen atoms. It is a small-molecule BAX agonist.

name: [1,3]dithiolo[4,5-b]quinoxaline-2,2-diamine
definition: A dithioloquinoxaline that is [1,3]dithiolo[4,5-b]quinoxaline in which both the hydrogens at position 2 are substituted by amino groups.

name: 9-thia-1,3,6,8-tetraazatricyclo[4.3.1.13,8]undecane 9,9-dioxide
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the S,S-dioxide of 9-thia-1,3,6,8-tetraazatricyclo[4.3.1.13,8]undecane.

name: digoxigenin monodigitoxoside
definition: A steroid saponin that consists of digoxigenin having a digitoxosyl residue attached at position 3.

name: 3-epi-digoxigenin
definition: A hydroxy steroid that consists of 5β-cardanolide having a double bond at the 20(22)-position as well as hydroxy groups at the 3α,- 12β- and 14β-positions.

name: digoxigenin 3,12-diacetate
definition: A steroid ester that is the 3,12-diacetyl derivative of digoxigenin.

name: gitoxigenin 3-acetate
definition: A steroid ester that is the 3-acetyl derivative of gitoxigenin.

name: oleandrigenin monodigitoxoside
definition: A steroid saponin that consists of oleandrigenin having a digitoxosyl residue attached at position 3.

name: oleandrigenin
definition: A steroid ester that is the 16-acetyl derivative of gitoxigenin.

name: erysimoside
definition: A cardenolide glycoside that consists of strophanthidin having a β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→4)-2,6-dideoxy-β-D-ribo-hexopyranosyl moiety attached at position 3.

name: 3-(hexadecylsulfonyl)-2-[(hexadecylsulfonyl)methyl]propyl α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactoside
definition: A glycoside that consists of α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactose where the hydrogen of the anomeric OH group is substituted by a 3-(hexadecylsulfonyl)-2-[(hexadecylsulfonyl)methyl]propyl group.

name: 3-(hexadecylsulfonyl)-2-[(hexadecylsulfonyl)methyl]propyl α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucoside
definition: A glycoside that consists of α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose where the hydrogen of the anomeric OH group is substituted by a 3-(hexadecylsulfonyl)-2-[(hexadecylsulfonyl)methyl]propyl group.

name: fructosyllysinate
definition: The glyco-amino-acid anion formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy group of fructosyllysine.

name: 5-hydroxyectoinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of 5-hydroxyectoine.

name: TTP(4−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion that is the tetraanion of TTP arising from deprotonation of the three triphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dTMP(2−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of dTMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: histrelin acetate
definition: An acetate salt obtained by combining histrelin with acetic acid. The amount of acetic acid present can vary and a variable amount of water may be present. Histrelin acetate is used as a subcutaneous hydrogel implant for the treatment of prostate cancer and for the suppression of gonadal sex hormone production in children with central precocious puberty.

name: 3-(hexadecylsulfonyl)-2-[(hexadecylsulfonyl)methyl]propyl β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucoside
definition: A glycoside that consists of β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose where the hydrogen of the anomeric OH group is substituted by a 3-(hexadecylsulfonyl)-2-[(hexadecylsulfonyl)methyl]propyl group.

name: GM3 lactam
definition: A lactam obtained via formal condensation of the carboxy group of an N-acetylneuraminyl residue and the amino group of the adjacent galactosamine residue in the ganglioside (2S,3R,4E)-3-hydroxy-2-(stearoylamino)octadec-4-en-1-yl N-acetylneuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucoside.

name: 5-[(2-aminobenzimidazol-6-yl)amino]-5-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide obtained by formal condensation of the 6-amino group of 2,6-diaminobenzimidazole with one of the carboxy groups of glutaric acid.

name: 5-[(2-aminobenzimidazol-6-yl)amino]-5-oxopentanoic acid zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to position 3 of the benzimidazole ring of 5-[(2-aminobenzimidazol-6-yl)amino]-5-oxopentanoic acid.

name: (Z)-4-glutaramidostilbene
definition: A stilbenoid obtained by formal condensation of the amino group of (Z)-4-aminostilbene with one of the carboxy groups of glutaric acid.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoic acid. It is a member of n-3 PUFA and by-product of α-linolenic acid metabolism.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosahexaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosahexaenoic acid. It is a member of n-3 PUFA and a product of α-linolenoic acid metabolism.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoic acid. It is a member of n-3 PUFA and a product of α-linolenic acid metabolism

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoic acid. It is a member of the n-3 PUFA and is the product of α-linolenic acid metabolism.

name: (9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosapentaenoic acid. It is a member of the n-3 PUFA and is the product of α-linolenic acid metabolism.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatetraenoic acid. It is a member of the n-6 PUFA and is the product of linoleic acid metabolism.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoic acid. It is a member of the n-3 PUFA and is the product of α-linolenic acid metabolism.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z)-tetracosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z)-tetracosapentaenoic acid. It is a member of the n-6 PUFA and is the product of linoleic acid metabolism.

name: 2-(1,2-epoxy-1,2-dihydrophenyl)acetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-(1,2-epoxy-1,2-dihydrophenyl)acetic acid.

name: (9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z)-tetracosatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z)-tetracosatetraenoic acid. It is a member of the n-6 PUFA and is the product of linoleic acid metabolism.

name: TTP
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate in which the pyrimidine element is 5-methyluracil.

name: 1-phenyl-1,2-propanedione
definition: An α-diketone that consists of 1-phenylpropane bearing keto substituents at positions 1 and 2. It is found in coffee.

name: 2-hydroxy-1-phenyl-1-propanone
definition: An α-oxyketone that consists of propiophenone bearing an α-hydroxy substituent.

name: lauramidopropyl betaine
definition: An ammonium betaine in which the the ammonium nitrogen is substituted by two methyl groups and a lauramidopropyl group. It is the major (>50%) component of cocamidopropyl betaine.

name: Disperse Red 1
definition: An azo dye with a structure consisting of nitrobenzene substituted on the 4-position of the phenyl group with a 4-[N-ethyl-N-(2-hydroxyethyl)]phenylazo group.

name: DIBOA
definition: A lactol that consists of 1,4-benzoxazine bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 2 and 4 as well as a keto group at position 3.

name: HBOA
definition: A benzoxazine bearing hydroxy and oxo substituents at positions 2 and 3 respectively.

name: tixocortol
definition: A steroid sulfide in which the sulfanyl group is at C-21 of a polyoxygenated derivative of pregn-4-ene.

name: tixocortol pivalate
definition: The pivalate thioester of tixocortol.

name: N-isopropyl-N'-phenyl-p-phenylenediamine
