definition: The N-substituted diamine that is 1,4-phenylenediamine substituted at one N with an isopropyl group and at the other with a phenyl group.

name: phenyl N-formyl-L-methioninate
definition: The α-amino acid ester that is the phenyl ester of N-formylated L-methionine.

name: phenyl N-formyl-L-norleucinate
definition: The α-amino acid ester that is the phenyl ester of N-formylated L-norleucine.

name: maltose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of maltose 1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: lamivudine
definition: A monothioacetal that consists of cytosine having a (2R,5S)-2-(hydroxymethyl)-1,3-oxathiolan-5-yl moiety attached at position 1. An inhibitor of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase, it is used as an antiviral in the treatment of AIDS and hepatitis B.

name: iopromide
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide that consists of N-methylisophthalamide bearing three iodo substituents at positions 2, 4 and 6, a methoxyacetyl substituent at position 5 and two 2,3-dihydroxypropyl groups attached to the amide nitrogens. A water soluble x-ray contrast agent for intravascular administration.

name: 18-HETE
definition: A HETE that consists of arachidonic acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 18.

name: ribavirin
definition: A 1-ribosyltriazole that is the 1-ribofuranosyl derivative of 1,2,4-triazole-3-carboxamide. A synthetic guanosine analogue, it is an inhibitor of HCV polymerase and possesses a broad spectrum of activity against DNA and RNA viruses.

name: stavudine
definition: A nucleoside analogue obtained by formal dehydration across positions 2 and 3 of thymidine. An inhibitor of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase

name: 1-palmitoylglycerol 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-palmitoylglycerol 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cabazitaxel
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid that is 10-deacetylbaccatin III having O-methyl groups attached at positions 7 and 10 as well as an O-(2R,3S)-3-[(tert-butoxycarbonyl)amino]-2-hydroxy-3-phenylpropanoyl group attached at position 13. Acts as a microtubule inhibitor, binds tubulin and promotes microtubule assembly and simultaneously inhibits disassembly.

name: eribulin
definition: A fully synthetic macrocyclic ketone analogue of marine sponge natural products. Inhibits growth phase of microtubules via tubulin-based antimitotic mechanism, which leads to G2/M cell-cycle block, disruption of mitotic spindles, and, ultimately, apoptotic cell death after prolonged mitotic blockage

name: etravirine
definition: An aminopyrimidine that consists of 2,6-diaminopyrimidine bearing a bromo substituent at position 5, a 4-cyano-2,6-dimethylphenoxy substituent at position 4 and having a 4-cyanophenyl substituent attached to the 2-amino group. NNRTI of HIV-1, binds directly to RT and blocks RNA-dependent and DNA-dependent DNA polymerase activities

name: 18-HETE(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 18-hydroxyarachidonic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: maltose 1-phosphate
definition: A maltose phosphate having the phosphate group located at the 1-position.

name: 5-{N-[4-(4-cyanostyryl)phenyl]-N-methylamino}pentanoic acid
definition: A tertiary amino compound in which nitrogen is substituted by a methyl group, a 5-carboxypentyl group and a 4-[2-(4-cyanophenyl)vinyl]phenyl group.

name: 5-[(1-phenylcyclohexyl)amino]pentanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid derivative consisting of valeric acid substituted at C-5 with an N-(1-phenylcyclohexyl)amino group.

name: leuprolide acetate
definition: An acetate salt obtained by combining the nonapeptide leuprolide with acetic acid. A long lasting GnRH analog, LH-Rh agonist. It is a synthetic nonapeptide analogue of gonadotropin-releasing hormone, and is used as a subcutaneous hydrogel implant for the treatment of prostate cancer and for the suppression of gonadal sex hormone production in children with central precocious puberty.

name: levofloxacin
definition: An optically active form of ofloxacin having (S)-configuration; an inhibitor of bacterial topoisomerase IV and DNA gyrase.

name: fludarabine phosphate
definition: A purine arabinonucleoside monophosphate having 2-fluoroadenine as the nucleobase. A prodrug, it is rapidly dephosphorylated to 2-fluoro-ara-A and then phosphorylated intracellularly by deoxycytidine kinase to the active triphosphate, 2-fluoro-ara-ATP. Once incorporated into DNA, 2-fluoro-ara-ATP functions as a DNA chain terminator. It is used for the treatment of adult patients with B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) who have not responded to, or whose disease has progressed during, treatment with at least one standard alkylating-agent containing regimenas.

name: ixabepilone
definition: A macrocycle that is a lactam analogue of epothilone B. Binds directly to beta-tubulin subunits on microtubules, leading to suppression of microtubule dynamics.

name: (6S)-5-formyltetrahydrofolic acid
definition: The pharmacologically active (6S)-stereoisomer of 5-formyltetrahydrofolic acid.

name: linezolid
definition: An organofluorine compound that consists of 1,3-oxazolidin-2-one bearing an N-3-fluoro-4-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl group as well as an acetamidomethyl group at position 5. A synthetic antibacterial agent that inhibits bacterial protein synthesis by binding to a site on 23S ribosomal RNA of the 50S subunit and prevents further formation of a functional 70S initiation complex.

name: maraviroc
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4,4-difluorocyclohexanecarboxylic acid and the primary amino group of (1S)-3-[(3-exo)-3-(3-isopropyl-5-methyl-4H-1,2,4-triazol-4-yl)-8-azabicyclo[3.2.1]oct-8-yl]-1-phenylpropylamine. An antiretroviral drug, it prevents the interaction of HIV-1 gp120 and chemokine receptor 5 (CCR5) necessary for CCR5-tropic HIV-1 to enter cells.

name: moxifloxacin
definition: A quinolone that consists of 4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid bearing a cyclopropyl substituent at position 1, a fluoro substitiuent at position 6, a (4aS,7aS)-octahydro-6H-pyrrolo[3,4-b]pyridin-6-yl group at position 7 and a methoxy substituent at position 8. A member of the fluoroquinolone class of antibacterial agents.

name: nelarabine
definition: A purine nucleoside in which O-methylguanine is attached to arabinofuranose via a β-N9-glycosidic bond. Inhibits DNA synthesis and causes cell death; a prodrug of 9-β-D-arabinofuranosylguanine (ara-G).

name: nevirapine
definition: A dipyridodiazepine that is 5,11-dihydro-6H-dipyrido[3,2-b:2',3'-e][1,4]diazepine which is substituted by methyl, oxo, and cyclopropyl groups at positions 4, 6, and 11, respectively. A non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor with activity against HIV-1, it is used in combination with other antiretrovirals for the treatment of HIV infection.

name: olsalazine sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 3,3'-azobis(6-hydroxybenzoic acid) (olsalazine). Effective in the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease and ulcerative colitis. Mechanism of action unknown, but appears to be topical

name: pemetrexed
definition: An N-acylglutamic acid in which the N-acyl group is specified as 4-[2-(2-amino-4-oxo-4,7-dihydro-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-5-yl)ethyl]benzoyl. Inhibits thymidylate synthase (TS), 421 dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), and glycinamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase (GARFT).

name: pergolide
definition: A diamine that is ergoline in which the β-hydrogen at position 8 is replaced by a (methylthio)methyl group and the hydrogen attached to the piperidine nitrogen (position 6) is replaced by a propyl group. A dopamine D2 receptor agonist which also has D1 and D2 agonist properties, it is used as the mesylate salt in the management of Parkinson's disease, although it was withdrawn from the U.S. and Canadian markets in 2007 due to an increased risk of cardiac valve dysfunction.

name: pravastatin
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of (S)-2-methylbutyric acid with the hydroxy group adjacent to the ring junction of (3R,5R)-7-[(1S,2S,6S,8S,8aR)-6,8-dihydroxy-2-methyl-1,2,6,7,8,8a-hexahydronaphthalen-1-yl]-3,5-dihydroxyheptanoic acid. Derived from microbial transformation of mevastatin, pravastatin is a reversible inhibitor of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-coenzyme A (HMG-CoA). The sodium salt is used for lowering cholesterol and preventing cardiovascular disease. It is one of the lower potency statins, but has the advantage of fewer side effects compared with lovastatin and simvastatin.

name: propafenone
definition: An aromatic ketone that is 3-(propylamino)propane-1,2-diol in which the hydrogen of the primary hydroxy group is replaced by a 2-(3-phenylpropanoyl)phenyl group. It is a class 1C antiarrhythmic drug with local anesthetic effects, and is used as the hydrochloride salt in the management of supraventricular and ventricular arrhythmias.

name: rasagiline
definition: An indane that consists of 1-aminoindane bearing an N-propargyl substituent. A selective, irreversible monoamine oxidase-B inhibitor.

name: saquinavir
definition: An aspartic acid derivative obtained by formal condensation of the primary amino group of (2S,3R)-4-[(3S,4aS,8aS)-3-(tert-butylcarbamoyl)octahydroisoquinolin-2(1H)-yl]-3-hydroxy-1-phenylbutan-2-ylamine with the carboxy group of N2(-quinolin-2-ylcarbonyl)-L-asparagine. An inhibitor of HIV-1 protease.

name: sotalol
definition: A sulfonamide that is N-phenylmethanesulfonamide in which the phenyl group is substituted at position 4 by a 1-hydroxy-2-(isopropylamino)ethyl group. It has both β-adrenoreceptor blocking (Vaughan Williams Class II) and cardiac action potential duration prolongation (Vaughan Williams Class III) antiarrhythmic properties. It is used (usually as the hydrochloride salt) for the management of ventricular and supraventricular arrhythmias.

name: succimer
definition: A sulfur-containing carboxylic acid that is succinic acid bearing two mercapto substituents at positions 2 and 3. A lead chelator used as an antedote to lead poisoning.

name: telbivudine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside that is the L-enantiomer of thymine. A synthetic thymidine nucleoside analogue with activity against HBV DNA polymerase.

name: tenofovir (anhydrous)
definition: A member of the class of phosphonic acids that is methylphosphonic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a [(2R)-1-(6-amino-9H-purin-9-yl)propan-2-yl]oxy group. An inhibitor of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase, the bis(isopropyloxycarbonyloxymethyl) ester (disoproxil ester) prodrug is used as the fumaric acid salt in combination therapy for the treatment of HIV infection.

name: tesamorelin
definition: A polypeptide that is a synthetic analogue of human GRF (Growth Releasing Factor) comprised of the 44 amino-acid sequence of human GRF with a hex-3-enoyl moiety attached to the tyrosine residue at the N-terminal part of the molecule. It is used to stimulate human GRF receptors.

name: tinidazole
definition: 1H-imidazole substituted at C-1 by a (2-ethylsulfonyl)ethyl group, at C-2 by a methyl group and at C-5 by a nitro group. It is used as an antiprotozoal, antibacterial agent.

name: tipranavir
definition: A pyridine-2-sulfonamide substituted at C-5 by a trifluoromethyl group and at the sulfonamide nitrogen by a dihydropyrone-containing m-tolyl substituent. It is an HIV-1 protease inhibitor.

name: tizanidine
definition: 2,1,3-Benzothiadiazole substituted at C-4 by a Δ1-imidazolin-2-ylamino group and at C-4 by a chloro group. It is an agonist at α2-adrenergic receptor sites.

name: tolcapone
definition: Benzophenone substituted on one of the phenyl rings at C-3 and C-4 by hydroxy groups and at C-5 by a nitro group, and on the other phenyl ring by a methyl group at C-4. It is an inhibitor of catechol O-methyltransferase.

name: topiramate
definition: A hexose derivative that is 2,3:4,5-di-O-isopropylidene-β-D-fructopyranose in which the hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding sulfamate ester. It blocks voltage-dependent sodium channels and is used as an antiepileptic and for the prevention of migraine.

name: topotecan
definition: A pyranoindolizinoquinoline used as an antineoplastic agent. It is a derivative of camptothecin and works by binding to the topoisomerase I-DNA complex and preventing religation of these 328 single strand breaks.

name: triptorelin
definition: An oligopeptide comprising pyroglutamyl, histidyl, tryptophyl, seryl, tyrosyl, D-tryptophyl, leucyl, arginyl, prolyl and glycinamide residues joined in sequence. It is an agonist analogue of gonadotropin-releasing hormone.

name: valdecoxib
definition: A member of the class of isoxazoles that is isoxazole which is substituted at positions 3, 4 and 5 by phenyl, p-sulfamoylphenyl and methyl groups, respectively. A selective cyclooxygenase 2-inhibitor, it used as a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) for the treatment of arthritis from 2001 until 2005, when it was withdrawn following concerns of an associated increased risk of heart attack and stroke.

name: valganciclovir
definition: The L-valinyl ester of ganciclovir, into which it is rapidly converted by intestinal and hepatic esterases. It is a synthetic analogue of 2'-deoxyguanosine.

name: vemurafenib
definition: A pyrrolopyridine that is 1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridine which is substituted at position 5 by a p-chlorophenyl group and at positions 3 by a 3-amino-2,6-difluorobenzoyl group, the amino group of which has undergone formal condensation with propane-1-sulfonic acid to give the corresponding sulfonamide. An inhibitor of BRAF and other kinases.

name: vigabatrin
definition: A γ-amino acid having a γ-vinyl GABA structure. It is an irreversible inhibitor of γ-aminobutyric 664 acid transaminase

name: tetrasulfocyanine
definition: An organic sodium salt which is the trisodium salt of tetrasulfocyanine acid. It is an in vivo near-IR fluorescent probe for tumour imaging.

name: 26-hydroxycholest-4-en-3-one
definition: A cholestanoid that consists of 3-oxocholest-4-ene bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 26.

name: 9α-hydroxyandrosta-1,4-diene-3,17-dione
definition: A steroid that consists of androstane having double bonds at positions 1 and 4, two keto groups at positions 3 and 17 and a hydroxy group at position 9.

name: 2β-hydroxy-ent-isokaurene
definition: An ent-kaurane diterpenoid in which the ent-kaurane skeleton has a double bond at C-15 and carries a β-configured hydroxy group at C-2.

name: (S)-2-(4-(2-bromoacetamido)benzyl)-DOTA
definition: An optically active twelve-membered tetraazamacrocycle having a carboxymethyl group attached to each of the nitrogens and a 4-(2-bromoacetamido)benzyl group at the 2-position.

name: sotalol(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen of the secondary amino group of sotalol.

name: propafenone(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen of propafenone.

name: (3R,5R)-7-[(1S,2S,6S,8S,8aR)-6,8-dihydroxy-2-methyl-1,2,6,7,8,8a-hexahydronaphthalen-1-yl]-3,5-dihydroxyheptanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy carboxylic acid that is (3R,5R)-3,5-dihydroxyheptanoic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a (1S,2S,6S,8S,8aR)-6,8-dihydroxy-2-methyl-1,2,6,7,8,8a-hexahydronaphthalen-1-yl group.

name: 9β-pimara-7,15-dien-19-ol
definition: A pimarane diterpenoid that is pimarane which has been dehyrogenated to introduce double bonds at positions 7-8 and 15-16, which has a β-hydrogen in place of an α-hydrogen at position 9, and in which one of the hydrogens of the β-methyl group at position 4 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 9β-pimara-7,15-dien-19-al
definition: A pimarane diterpenoid resulting from the oxidation of primary alcohol group of 9β-pimara-7,15-dien-19-ol to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: 9β-pimara-7,15-dien-19-oate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of 9β-pimara-7,15-dien-19-oic acid; the major species at pH 7.3

name: pravastatin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group of pravastatin.

name: 11α-hydroxy-ent-cassa-12,15-diene
definition: A diterpenoid that is the 11α-hydroxy-derivative of ent-cassa-12,15-diene.

name: 10β,14β-dihydroxytaxa-4(20),11-dien-5α-yl acetate
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that is taxa-4(20),11-diene in which the 5α hydrogen has been replaced by an acetoxy group and the 10β and 14β hydrogens by hydroxy groups.

name: taxusin
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that is taxa-4(20),11-diene in which the 5α, 9α, 10β and 13α hydrogens have been replaced by acetoxy groups. It is a prominent secondary metabolite of yew heartwood.

name: 7β-hydroxytaxusin
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that is taxusin in which the hydrogen at the 7β position is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: abieta-7,13-dien-18,18-diol
definition: An aldehyde hydrate resulting from the addition of water to the aldehyde group of abietal.

name: DIBOA β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside having (R)-2,4-dihydroxy-2H-1,4-benzoxazin-3(4H)-one as the anomeric substituent.

name: TRIBOA β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside having (R)-2,4,7-trihydroxy-2H-1,4-benzoxazin-3(4H)-one as the anomeric substituent.

name: 3-methoxy-4',5-dihydroxy-trans-stilbene
definition: A stilbenoid that is trans-resveratrol in which one of the meta-hydroxy groups is converted to the corresponding methyl ether.

name: sodium succinate (anhydrous)
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of succinic acid. The hexahydrate form is used as an ingredient of topical preparations for the treatment of cataract.

name: dTDP-3-acetamido-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arsing from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-3-acetamido-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: erythromycin D(1+)
definition: An erythromycin cation resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of erythromycin D; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: [4)-β-D-GlcA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcA2(or 3)Ac-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal3(or 2)OHb-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-α-DGlc2(or 3)Ac-(1→]n
definition: A branched polysaccharide acid oxoanion comprised of an octasaccharide repeating unit consisting of a backbone of two glucose and two glucuronate residues, and a side chain of three glucose and one galactose residues. The octasaccharide is modified by two non-stoichiometric O-acetyl groups and one non-stoichiometric hydroxybutanoyl group. Note that the structure shown and its molfile represent only one of the possible substitution patterns.

name: [4)-β-D-GlcA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcA2(or 3)Ac-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-[(R)-4,6-CH3(COO−)C-β-D-Gal3(or 2)OHb-(1→3)-(S)-4,6-CH3(COO−)C-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-α-DGlc2(or 3)Ac-(1→]n
definition: A branched polysaccharide acid oxoanion comprised of an octasaccharide repeating unit consisting of a backbone of two glucose and two glucuronic acid residues, and a side chain of three glucose and one galactose residues. The octasaccharide is modified by two pyruvyl and two non-stoichiometric O-acetyl groups, and one non-stoichiometric hydroxybutanoyl group. Note thet the structure shown and its molfile represent only one of the possible substitution patterns.

name: CMP-pseudaminate
definition: A doubly-charged nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and phosphate functions of CMP-pseudaminic acid.

name: [2,8-bis(trifluoromethyl)quinolin-4-yl]-(2-piperidyl)methanol
definition: An organofluorine compound that consists of quinoline bearing trifluoromethyl substituents at positions 2 and 8 as well as a (2-piperidinyl)hydroxymethyl substituent at position 4.

name: (5S,9S,10S,13E)-labda-7,13-dien-15-yl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of (5S,9S,10S,13E)-labda-7,13-dien-15-yl diphosphate.

name: (13E)-labda-7,13-dien-15-ol
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at C-7 and C-13 (the latter with E-stereochemistry) and carries a hydroxy group at the terminal C-15 atom.

name: (+)-(11R,2'S)-erythro-mefloquine
definition: An optically active form of [2,8-bis(trifluoromethyl)quinolin-4-yl]-(2-piperidyl)methanol having (+)-(11R,2'S)-erythro-configuration. An antimalarial agent, used in racemic form, which acts as a blood schizonticide; its mechanism of action is unknown.

name: sodium succinate hexahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hexahydrate form of sodium succinate. It is used as an ingredient of topical preparations for the treatment of cataract.

name: (−)-(11S,2'R)-erythro-mefloquine
definition: An optically active form of [2,8-bis(trifluoromethyl)quinolin-4-yl]-(2-piperidyl)methanol having (−)-(11S,2'R)-erythro-configuration. An antimalarial agent, used in racemic form, which acts as a blood schizonticide; its mechanism of action is unknown.

name: P1,P6-bis(5'-adenosyl)hexaphosphate
definition: A diadenosyl hexaphosphate in which the two adenosin-5'-yl groups are attached at the P1 and P6 positions.

name: (1E,2Z)-3-hydroxy-5,9,17-trioxo-4,5:9,10-disecoandrosta-1(10),2-dien-4-oate
definition: A 3-hydroxy-5,9,17-trioxo-4,5:9,10-disecoandrosta-1(10),2-dien-4-oate that has 1E,2Z geometry.

name: methyl (13E)-11,16-dihydroxy-16-methyl-9-oxoprost-13-en-1-oate
definition: A β-hydroxyketone that is 3-hydroxycyclopentanone in which a hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by a (1E)-4-hydroxy-4-methyloct-1-en-1-yl group and a hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by a 7-methoxy-7-oxoheptyl group.

name: 9,17-dioxo-1,2,3,4,10,19-hexanorandrostan-5-oate
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9,17-dioxo-1,2,3,4,10,19-hexanorandrostan-5-oic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2Z,4Z)-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of (2Z,4Z)-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienoic acid.

name: D-synephrine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of D-synephrine, arising from protonation of the secondary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (11R,16S)-misoprostol
definition: A methyl (13E)-11,16-dihydroxy-16-methyl-9-oxoprost-13-en-1-oate that has 8S,11S,12S,16R-configuration. It is the pharmacologically active diastereoisomeric component of misoprostol.

name: γ-curcumene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is cyclohexa-1,3-diene which is substituted by a methyl group at position 1 and a 6-methylhept-5-en-2-yl group at position 4 (the R enantiomer).

name: (11S,16R)-misoprostol
definition: A methyl (13E)-11,16-dihydroxy-16-methyl-9-oxoprost-13-en-1-oate that has 8S,11S,12S,16R-configuration. It is the enantiomer of the pharmacologically active diastereoisomeric component of misoprostol.

name: moxifloxacinium(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of moxifloxacin.

name: (11S,16S)-misoprostol
definition: A methyl (13E)-11,16-dihydroxy-16-methyl-9-oxoprost-13-en-1-oate that has 8S,11S,12S,16S-configuration. It is a pharmacologically inactive diastereoisomeric component of misoprostol.

name: (−)-α-cuprenene
definition: A sesquiterpene that consists of cyclohexa-1,3-diene bearing a methyl substituent at position 1 and an (S)-1,2,2-trimethylcyclopent-1-yl group at position 4.

name: avermitilol
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that consists of decahydro-1H-1H-cyclopropa[a]naphthalene bearing four methyl substituents at position 1, 1, 3a and 7 as well as a hydroxy substituent at position 4 (the (1aR,3aS,4S,7R,7aS,7bR)-diastereomer).

name: (−)-δ-cadinene
definition: A member of the cadinene family of sesquiterpenes in which the double bonds are located at the 4-4a and 7-8 positions, and in which the isopropyl group at position 1 is cis to the hydrogen at the adjacent bridgehead carbon (the 1R,8aS-enantiomer).

name: (+)-Τ-muurolol
definition: A cadinane sesquiterpenoid that consists of 4-isopropyl-1,6-dimethyl-1,2,3,4,4a,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalene having a hydroxy substituent at position 1 and (1R,4R,4aS,8aR)-configuration.

name: (11R,16R)-misoprostol
definition: A methyl (13E)-11,16-dihydroxy-16-methyl-9-oxoprost-13-en-1-oate that has 8R,11R,12R,16R-configuration. It is a pharmacologically inactive diastereoisomeric component of misoprostol.

name: pergolide(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the piperidine nitrogen of pergolide.

name: syn-labda-8(17),12E,14-triene
definition: A diterpene derived from labdane by dehydrogenation across the C(8)‒C(17), C(12)‒C(13) and C(14)‒C(15) bonds.

name: isopimara-8(14),15-diene
definition: A diterpene derived from pimarane by dehydrogenation across the C(8)‒C(14) and C(15)‒C(16) bonds

name: bicyclogermacrene
definition: A sesquiterpene derived from germacrane by dehydrogenation across the C(1)‒C(10) and C(4)‒C(5) bonds and cyclisation across the C(8)‒C(9) bond.

name: 7-epi-sesquithujene
definition: A sesquiterpene that consists of (1S,5R)-2-methylbicyclo[3.1.0]hex-2-ene having a (2R)-6-methylhept-5-en-2-yl group attached at position 5.

name: sesquithujene
definition: A sesquiterpene that consists of (1S,5R)-2-methylbicyclo[3.1.0]hex-2-ene having a (2S)-6-methylhept-5-en-2-yl group attached at position 5.

name: baruol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is chrysene which has been fully hydrogenated except for a double bond between the 12 and 12a positions and which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 1, 4b, 6a, 8 and 10a positions, and by a 4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl group at position 8 (the 2S,4aS,4bR,6aS,8R,10aR,10bS-diastereoisomer). It has been isolated from the root bark of the Panamanian tree Maytenus blepharodes.

name: 7-methylguanosine 5'-diphosphate(2−)
definition: A doubly-charged organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the three diphosphate OH groups of 7-methylguanosine 5'-diphosphate(1+); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-oxo-dGDP(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the three diphosphate OH groups of 8-oxo-dGDP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tenofovir hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of anhydrous tenovir.

name: tenofovir disoproxil
definition: An organic phosphonate that is the disoproxil ester of tenofovir. A prodrug for tenofovir, an HIV-1 reverse transcriptase inhibitor, tenofovir disoproxil is used as the fumaric acid salt in combination therapy for the treatment of HIV infection.

name: tenofovir disoproxil fumarate
definition: A fumarate salt prepared from equimolar amounts of tenofovir disoproxil and fumaric acid. It is used in combination therapy for the treatment of HIV infection.

name: olsalazine(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 3,3'-azobis(6-hydroxybenzoic acid) (olsalazine).

name: pemetrexed disodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of N-{4-[2-(2-amino-4-oxo-4,7-dihydro-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-5-yl)ethyl]benzoyl}-L-glutamic acid. Inhibits thymidylate synthase (TS), 421 dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), and glycinamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase (GARFT).

name: pemetrexed disodium heptahydrate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the heptahydrate form of pemetrexed disodium. Inhibits thymidylate synthase (TS), 421 dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), and glycinamide ribonucleotide formyltransferase (GARFT).

name: pemetrexed(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of pemetrexed.

name: cis-4-hydroxy-L-proline zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group cis-4-hydroxy-L-proline; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-oxo-dGDP
definition: A purine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate having 8-oxoguanine as the nucleobase.

name: 7-methylguanosine 5'-diphosphate
definition: A guanosine 5'-phosphate that consists of guanosine 5'-diphosphate bearing a 7-methyl substituent and having a negatively charged diphosphate group.

name: 7-methylguanosine 5'-diphosphate(1+)
definition: A guanosine 5'-phosphate that consists of guanosine 5'-diphosphate bearing a 7-methyl substituent.

name: 9β-pimara-7,15-dien-19-oic acid
definition: A pimarane diterpenoid resulting from the oxidation of primary alcohol group of 9β-pimara-7,15-dien-19-ol to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: (2Z,4Z)-2-hydroxyhexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is (2Z,4E)-hexa-2,4-dienoic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: P1,P6-bis(5'-adenosyl)hexaphosphate(6−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by global deprotonation of the hexaphosphate OH groups of P1,P6-bis(5'-adenosyl)hexaphosphate

name: 9,17-dioxo-1,2,3,4,10,19-hexanorandrostan-5-oic acid
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid that consists of hydrindane bearing two oxo substituents at positions 1 and 5, a methyl substituent at position 7a and a 2-carboxyethyl substituent at position 4 (3aS,4S,7aS-diastereomer).

name: (1E,2Z)-3-hydroxy-5,9,17-trioxo-4,5:9,10-disecoandrosta-1(10),2-dien-4-oic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy-5,9,17-trioxo-4,5:9,10-disecoandrosta-1(10),2-dien-4-oic acid that has 1E,2Z geometry.

name: dTDP-3-acetamido-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 3-acetamido-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactopyranose (3-amino-3-deoxy-α-D-fucopyranose) as the sugar component.

name: N-[5-(p-nitrobenzyloxy)-5-oxopentanoyl]glycine
definition: A glycine derivative whose structure comprises a glycine core carrying an N-[5-(p-nitrobenzyloxy)-5-oxopentanoyl] substituent.

name: N-[5-(p-nitrophenoxy)-5-oxopentanoyl]glycine
definition: A glycine derivative whose structure comprises a glycine core carrying an N-[5-(p-nitrophenoxy)-5-oxopentanoyl] substituent.

name: TRIBOA
definition: A cyclic hydroxamic acid that consists of 1,4-benzoxazine bearing three hydroxy substituents at positions 2, 4 and 7 as well as an oxo group at position 3.

name: 6-{[5-(p-nitrophenoxy)-5-oxopentanoyl]amino}hexanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide compound having an N-(5-carboxypentyl) substituent and a C-[4-(4-nitrophenoxy)-4-oxobutyl)] substituent.

name: N-[4-(4-nitrobenzylphosphono)butanoyl]glycine
definition: An N-acylglycine whose structure comprises a glycine core carrying an N-(4-{hydroxy[(4-nitrobenzyl)oxy]phosphoryl}butanoyl) substituent.

name: (+)-artemisinic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is prop-2-enoic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a 4,7-dimethyl-1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalen-1-yl group (the 1S,4R,4aS,8aR diastereoisomer). It is a sesquiterpenoid precursor of artemisinin, obtained from sweet wormwood, Artemisia annua.

name: (5S,9S,10S,13E)-labda-7,13-dien-15-yl diphosphate
definition: A diterpenyl phosphate that is the O-diphospho derivative of (5S,9S,10S,13E)-labda-7,13-dien-15-ol.

name: 1,2-dipalmitoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are both palmitoyl.

name: 1-(4-carboxybutanamido)-1'-(dimethylcarbamoyl)ferrocene
definition: A ferrocene complex in which one of the cyclopentadienyl rings is substituted with a dimethylcarbamoyl group while the other carries a 4-carboxybutanamido group.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are both oleoyl.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are palmitoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are oleoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: 2,3-dipalmitoyl-1-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-1-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 2- and 3-positions are both palmitoyl.

name: 2,3-dioleoyl-1-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-1-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 2- and 3-positions are both oleoyl.

name: 1-α-D-galactosyl-2-oleoyl-3-palmitoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-1-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are palmitoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: O3-(2-L-lysino-2-oxoethyl)-O1-[4-(trifluoroacetamido)benzylcarbonyl]chloramphenicol
definition: A carboxylic ester derivative of chloroamphenicol incorporating an L-lysino group linked via a 2-oxoethyl group to the oxygen at C-3.

name: 1,2-distearoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are both stearoyl.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-palmitoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are stearoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: 1-palmitoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1-acyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol where the 1-acyl group is specified as palmitoyl.

name: necrosulfonamide
definition: A sulfonamide that is a 3-methoxypyrazin-2-yl derivative of (E)-N-(4-(N-(4,6-dimethylpyrimidin-2-yl)sulfamoyl)phenyl)-3-(5-nitrothiophene-2-yl)acrylamide. Necrosulfonamide specifically blocks necrosis downstream of the activation of RIP3 (the receptor-interacting serine-threonine kinase 3), a key signalling molecule in the programmed necrosis (necroptosis) pathway.

name: 1-oleoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1-acyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol where the 1-acyl group is specified as oleoyl.

name: 4-[4-(3,5-dioxohexyl)phenylcarbamoyl]butyric acid
definition: A carbamoyl derivative of butyric acid which includes a 1,3-diketone functionality.

name: 1,2-dipalmitoyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are both palmitoyl.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are both oleoyl.

name: 2-aminohexadecanoic acid
definition: An α-amino fatty acid of chain length C16.

name: 6-O-butyryl-N-acetylmuramyl-L-alanyl-D-isoglutamine N-hydroxy-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylmidyl ester
definition: A glycopeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 6-O-butyrylated muramyl dipeptide with the hydroxy group of N-hydroxy-5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylmide.

name: CMP-pseudaminic acid
definition: A CMP-sugar having pseudaminic acid as the sugar component.

name: (S,S)-traseolide
definition: Traseolide in (S,S)-trans configuration.

name: traseolide
definition: An indane derivative in which the indane skeleton is substituted by geminal methyl groups at C-1, by single methyl groups at C-2 and C-6, by an isopropyl group at C-3 and by an acetyl group at C-6. It is a constituent of musk odorant.

name: (R)-1-isopropyl-3,3,5-trimethyl-6-succinylindane
definition: An indane derivative in which the indane skeleton is substituted by geminal methyl groups at C-1, by a single methyl group at C-6, by an isopropyl group at C-3 and by a 3-carboxypropanoyl group at C-6.

name: (S,S)-trans-2-ethyl-1-isopropyl-3,3,5-trimethyl-6-succinylindane
definition: An indane derivative in which the indane skeleton is substituted by an ethyl group at C-2, geminal methyl groups at C-1, by a single methyl group at C-6, by an isopropyl group at C-3 and by a 3-carboxypropanoyl group at C-6.

name: N-(3-oxohexanoyl)-L-homoserine lactone
definition: An N-acyl-L-homoserine lactone having 3-oxohexanoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: lenalidomide
definition: A dicarboximide that consists of 1-oxoisoindoline bearing an amino substituent at position 4 and a 2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl group at position 2. Inhibits the secretion of TNF-α.

name: epoxyqueuosine
definition: A 7-deazaguanine ribonucleoside obtained by formal epoxidation of the cyclohexene moiety of queuosine.

name: all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of all-trans-retinoic acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the cyclohexenyl ring.

name: Nα-citryl-Nε-acetyl-Nε-hydroxylysine(3−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups of Nα-citryl-Nε-acetyl-Nε-hydroxylysine.

name: 3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoate
definition: A monohydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoic acid
definition: A methoxybenzoic acid that is 4-methoxybenzoic acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 3.

name: 4-hydroxytolbutamide
definition: A urea that consists of 1-butylurea having a 4-hydroxymethylbenzenesulfonyl group attached at the 3-position.

name: 4-hydroxydebrisoquin
definition: An isoquinoline that is 3,4-dihydroisoquinoline bearing amidino and hydroxy substituent at positions 2 and 4 respectively.

name: Nα-citryl-Nε-acetyl-Nε-hydroxylysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative that is Nα-citryl-L-lysine having hydroxy and acetyl substituents attached to the side-chain amino group.

name: 9-cis-4-hydroxyretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of 9-cis-retinoic acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the cyclohexenyl ring.

name: (E)-2,3-didehydropristanoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (E)-2,3-didehydropristanic acid.

name: 4-hydroxyphenytoin
definition: A imidazolidine-2,4-dione that consists of hydantoin bearing phenyl and 4-hydroxyphenyl substituents at position 5.

name: adenosine 5'-pentaphosphate(6−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the removal of all six protons from the phosphate groups of adenosine 5'-pentaphosphate; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-methyl-7,8-dihydroguanosine-5'-diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of 7-methyl-7,8-dihydroguanosine-5'-diphosphate.

name: 4-acetamidobenzoate
definition: An amidobenzoate that is the conjugate base of 4-acetamidobenzoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-acetamidosalicylic acid
definition: A amidobenzoic acid that consists of salicylic acid bearing an acetamido substituent at position 4.

name: 4-acetamidosalicylate
definition: An amidobenzoate that is the conjugate base of 4-acetamidosalicylic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-hexadecyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate
definition: A 1-alkyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the 1-alkyl group is specified as hexadecyl.

name: (24S)-3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid
definition: 3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid with S configuration at C-24.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-3-oxodocosatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-3-oxodocosatetraenoic acid.

name: 3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oate
definition: The steroid acid anion formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of 3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid; major micro-species at pH 7.3.

name: (24S)-3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oate
definition: 3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oate with S configuration at C-24; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: tamoxifen N-oxide
definition: A tertiary amine oxide resulting from the formal oxidation of the amino group of tamoxifen.

name: bromosulfophthalein sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of bromosulfophthalein.

name: methimazole S-oxide
definition: The S-oxide of methimazole.

name: (24S)-7α,24-dihydroxy-5β-cholestan-3-one
definition: 7α,24-Dihydroxy-5β-cholestan-3-one with S configuration at C-24.

name: (24S)-7α,12α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-3-one
definition: 7α,12α,24-Trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-3-one with S-configuration at C-24.

name: (24S)-5β-cholestane-3α,7α,24-triol
definition: 5β-Cholestane-3α,7α,24-triol with S-configuration at C-24.

name: bromosulfophthalein(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of both sulfonyl groups of bromosulfophthalein.

name: (24S)-5β-cholestane-3α,7α,24,26-tetrol
definition: 5β-Cholestane-3α,7α,24,26-tetrol with S-configuration at C-24.

name: (24S)-5β-cholestane-3α,7α,12α,24-tetrol
definition: 5β-Cholestane-3α,7α,12α,24-tetrol with S-configuration at C-24.

name: (24S)-5β-cholestane-3α,7α,12α,24,26-pentol
definition: 5β-Cholestane-3α,7α,12α,24,26-pentol with S-configuration at C-24.

name: bromosulfophthalein
definition: An organosulfonic acid that consists of phthalide bearing four bromo substituents at positions 4, 5, 6 and 7 as well as two 4-hydroxy-3-sulfophenyl groups both located at position 1.

name: pregn-5-ene-3,20-dione
definition: A C21-steroid that is pregnane which contains a double bond between positions 5 and 6 and is substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 20.

name: (24S)-7α,24-dihydroxycholest-4-en-3-one
definition: 7α,24-Dihydroxycholest-4-en-3-one with S-configuration at C-24.

name: (24S)-7α,12α,24-trihydroxycholest-4-en-3-one
definition: 7α,12α,24-trihydroxycholest-4-en-3-one with S-configuration at C-24.

name: 5'-hydroxyomeprazole
definition: A sulfoxide that is omeprazole in which one of the methyl hydrogens at position 5 on the pyridine ring is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: 4-methylzymosterol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid, the 4-methyl derivative of zymosterol.

name: 4-carboxy-4-methylzymosterol
definition: A steroid acid, the 4-carboxy-4-methyl derivative of zymosterol.

name: 17α-hydroxypregn-5-ene-3,20-dione
definition: A C21-steroid that is pregnane which contains a double bond between positions 5 and 6 and is substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 20 as well as a hydroxy group at position 17.

name: 4-carboxyzymosterol
definition: A steroid acid, the 4-carboxy derivative of zymosterol.

name: sulfacetamide
definition: A sulfonamide that is sulfanilamide acylated on the sulfonamide nitrogen.

name: β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide comprised of two N-acetylated glucosamine residues sulfated on O-6, and three galactosyl residues, one of which (at the non-reducing end) is sulfated on O-6 while another of which is at the reducing end. It is an intermediate in the keratan sulfate degradation pathway.

name: (24S)-3α,7α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-al
definition: 3α,7α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-al with S-configuration at C-24.

name: (24S)-3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-al
definition: 3α,7α,12α,24-tetrahydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-al with S-configuration at C-24.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide comprised of two N-acetylated glucosamine residues sulfated on O-6, and three galactosyl residues, of which one is at the reducing end and another is at the non-reducing end. It is an intermediate in the keratan sulfate degradation pathway.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprised of two N-acetylated glucosamine residues sulfated on O-6, of which one is at the non-reducing end, and two galactosyl residues, of which one is at the reducing end. It is an intermediate in the keratan sulfate degradation pathway.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprised of two N-acetylated glucosamine residues, of which one is sulfated on O-6, and two galactosyl residues, of which one is at the reducing end. It is an intermediate in the keratan sulfate degradation pathway.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprised of an N-acetylated glucosamine residue, sulfated on O-6, between two galactosyl residues. It is an intermediate in the keratan sulfate degradation pathway.

name: β-L-IdopA2S-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprised of an L-iduronic acid residue, sulfated on O-2, a glucuronic acid residue, and two N-acetylated galactosamine residues, one of which is at the reducing end and both of which are sulfated on O-4. It is an intermediate in the chondroitin sulfate degradation pathway.

name: β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprised of a glucuronic acid residue between two N-acetylated galactosamine residues, both of which are sulfated on O-4. It is an intermediate in the dermatan sulfate degradation pathway.

name: 4,8-dimethylnonanoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 4,8-dimethylnonanoic acid.

name: sulfacetamide(1−)
definition: An organic nitrogen anion that is the conjugate base of sulfacetamide arising from deprotonation of the N-acylsulfonamide function.

name: sulfacetamide sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monohydrate form of sulfacetamide sodium.

name: 6-hydroxypaclitaxel
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that consists of paclitaxel bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at the 6α-position.

name: (S)-nicotinium N-α-D-glucosiduronate
definition: An N-glycosylpyridine that is the N-α-D-glucosiduronyl derivative of (S)-nicotine.

name: 2-methylthioethanol
definition: A primary alcohol that is the S-methyl derivative of mercaptoethanol. It is found as a volatile component in Cucumis melo Var. cantalupensis.

name: 3'-N-debenzoyltaxol
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that is paclitaxel which is lacking the N-benzoyl group. It is a biosynthetic precursor of paclitaxel.

name: 3'-N-debenzoyltaxol(1+)
definition: The organic cation formed by protonation of the amino group in 3'-N-debenzoyltaxol. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 4,8-dimethylnonanoic acid
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid, nonanoic acid with methyl branches at C-4 and C-8.

name: N-[3-({[N-{2-[(β-Ala-Leu-Ala)NH]ethyl}-N-(indol-3-ylacetyl)Gly]amino}methyl)benzoyl]-Leu-Thr-Val
definition: An oligopeptide composed of the tripeptide unit β-alanyl-L-leucyl-L-alanyl which is attached via an amide bond to the amino terminus of the pseudopeptide fragment 3-({[N-(2-aminoethyl)-N-(indol-3-ylacetyl)glycyl]amino}methyl)benzoyl, which is in turn attached via an amide bond to the amino terminus of the tripeptide unit L-leucyl-L-threonyl-L-valine.

name: octadecan-1-amine
definition: An 18-carbon primary aliphatic amine.

name: N-(hexanoyl)sphing-4-enine
definition: An N-acylsphingosine consisting of sphing-4-enine bearing a hexanoyl group on nitrogen.

name: β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Xylp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide comprising an N-acetylated galactosamine residue, sulfated on O-4, a glucuronic acid residue and two galactose residues, linked to a xylose residue at the reducing end. It is an intermediate in the chondroitin sulfate degradation pathway.

name: N-[3-({[N-{2-[(α-Glu-Leu-Ala)NH]ethyl}-N-(indol-3-ylacetyl)Gly]amino}methyl)benzoyl]-Leu-Thr-Val
definition: An oligopeptide composed of the tripeptide unit L-α-glutamyl-L-leucyl-L-alanyl which is attached via an amide bond to the amino terminus of the pseudopeptide fragment 3-({[N-(2-aminoethyl)-N-(indol-3-ylacetyl)glycyl]amino}methyl)benzoyl, which is in turn attached via an amide bond to the amino terminus of the tripeptide unit L-leucyl-L-threonyl-L-valine.

name: N-(3-{[(N-{2-[(α-Glu-Leu-Ala)NH]ethyl}-Trp)amino]methyl}benzoyl)-Leu-Thr-Val
definition: An oligopeptide composed of the tripeptide unit L-α-glutamyl-L-leucyl-L-alanyl which is connected via an aminoethyl spacer to the amino terminus of the pseudopeptide fragment N-{3-[(L-tryptophylamino)methyl]benzoyl}-L-leucyl-L-threonyl-L-valine

name: N-(3-{[(N-{2-[(β-Ala-Leu-Ala)NH]ethyl}-Trp)amino]methyl}benzoyl)-Leu-Thr-Val
definition: An oligopeptide composed of the tripeptide unit β-alanyl-L-leucyl-L-alanyl which is connected via an aminoethyl spacer to the amino terminus of the pseudopeptide fragment N-{3-[(L-tryptophylamino)methyl]benzoyl}-L-leucyl-L-threonyl-L-valine.

name: 4-[(1S,2S)-3-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-hydroxy-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)propyl]benzonitrile
definition: A triazole that is benzonitrile substituted by a (1S,2S)-3-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-hydroxy-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)propyl group at position 4.

name: β-D-IdopA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Xylp
definition: An amino hexasaccharide comprising an iduronic acid residue, an acetylated galactosamine residue, sulfated on O-4, a glucuronic acid residue, and two galactose residues, linked to a xylose residue at the reducing end. It is an intermediate in the dermatan sulfate degradation pathway.

name: O-(4,8-dimethylnonanoyl)carnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine compound having 4,8-dimethylnonanoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: 4-[(5-oxo-2-phenyl-1,3-oxazol-4-ylidene)methylamino]but-2-enoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is but-2-enoic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 4 is substituted by a [(E)-(5-oxo-2-phenyl-1,3-oxazol-4(5H)-ylidene)methyl]amino moiety.

name: diethanolammonium nitrate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of nitric acid and diethanolamine.

name: ethanolammonium nitrate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of nitric acid and ethanolamine.

name: ethylammonium acetate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of acetic acid and ethylamine.

name: ethylammonium formate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of formic acid and ethylamine.

name: ethylammonium methanesulfonate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of methanesulfonic acid and ethylamine.

name: ethylammonium nitrate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of nitric acid and ethylamine. First prepared in 1914, it was one of the first ionic liquids found that had a melting point below room temperature (m.p. 12°C).

name: ethylammonium pivalate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of pivalic acid and ethylamine.

name: ethylammonium propionate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of propanoic acid and ethylamine.

name: ethylammonium trifluoroacetate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of trifluoroacetic acid and ethylamine.

name: Reactive red 120
definition: A bis(azo) compound that consists of a benzene core having two (4-amino-6-chloro-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl)amino groups attached at positions 1 and 4 and which in turn have 5-hydroxy-6-[(2-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]-2,7-disulfonaphthalen-4-yl groups attached to their 4-amino functions.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-3-β-D-galactosylglycerol
definition: A β-D-galactopyranosyl diglyceride in which the acyl groups at the 1- and 2-positions are both oleoyl.

name: 3-oxopristanic acid
definition: A 3-oxo monocarboxylic acid comprised of pristanic acid with an oxo group at C-3.

name: zerumbone
definition: A sesquiterpenoid and cyclic ketone that is (1E,4E,8E)-α-humulene which is substituted by an oxo group at the carbon atom attached to two double bonds. It is obtained by steam distillation from a type of edible ginger, Zingiber zerumbet Smith, grown particularly in southeast Asia.

name: 8-hydroxy-α-humulene
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (1E,4E,8E)-α-humulene which is substituted by a hydroxy group at the carbon atom attached to two double bonds (position 8).

name: pivalate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of pivalic acid.

name: toluene 2,4-diisothiocyanate
definition: A toluene meta-diisothiocyanate in which the isothiocyanato groups are at positions 2 and 4 relative to the methyl group on the benzene ring.

name: toluene 2,6-diisothiocyanate
definition: A toluene meta-diisothiocyanate in which the isothiocyanato groups are at positions 2 and 6 relative to the methyl group on the benzene ring.

name: 2,3-dimethylphenyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate that consists of phenyl isocyanate bearing two additional methyl substituents at positions 2 and 3.

name: 3,16-dihydroxyhexadecanoic acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that consists of palmitic acid bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 16.

name: (+)-thujan-3-ol
definition: A thujane monoterpenoid in which which a (1R,4S,5S)-thujane skeleton is substituted at C-3 with a hydroxy group, with the new asymmetric centre at C-3 having R-configuration.

name: 3,16-dihydroxyhexadecanoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3,16-dihydroxyhexadecanoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-methyleneindolenine
definition: An indole that consists of 3H-indole bearing a methylene substituent at position 3.

name: cholest-5-en-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo Δ5-steroid that is cholesterol in which the alcoholic hydroxy group has been oxidised to the corresponding ketone.

name: 5-methyltetrahydrofolyl polyglutamate macromolecule
definition: A macromolecule consisting of 5-methyltetrahydrofolic acid with an arbitrary number of glutamate residues attached as a polypeptide to the single existent one.

name: 4-methylpentan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is pentan-1-ol bearing an additional methyl substituent at position 4.

name: (24S)-1α,24,25-trihydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that consists of vitamin D3 (calciol) bearing additional hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 24 and 25 (with 1S,24S-configuration).

name: 19-hydroxyprostaglandin H2
definition: A prostaglandin H that consists of prostaglandin H2 bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 19.

name: 3-hydroxypristanoyl-CoA
definition: A multi-methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxypristanic acid.

name: iloprost
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is prostaglandin I2 in which the endocyclic oxygen is replaced by a methylene group and in which the (1E,3S)-3-hydroxyoct-1-en-1-yl side chain is replaced by a (3R)-3-hydroxy-4-methyloct-1-en-6-yn-1-yl group. A synthetic analogue of prostacyclin, it is used as the trometamol salt (generally by intravenous infusion) for the treatment of peripheral vascular disease and pulmonary hypertension.

name: symphytine oxide
definition: A pyrrolizine that is the N-oxido derivative of symphytine. Isolated from extracts of comfrey root.

name: artesunate
definition: An artemisinin derivative that is the hemisuccinate ester of the lactol resulting from the reduction of the lactone carbonyl group of artemisinin. It is used, generally as the sodium salt, for the treatment of malaria.

name: 3,3,4,4,5,5,6,6,7,7,8,8,9,9,10,10,10-heptadecafluoro-1-decanol
definition: A fluorotelomer alcohol that is ethanol substituted at position 2 by a perfluorooctyl group.

name: 2-butoxyethanol
definition: A primary alcohol that is ethanol in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a butoxy group. A high-boiling (171°C) colourless liquid, it is used as a solvent for paints and inks, as well as in some dry cleaning solutions.

name: riddelliine
definition: A macrodiolide that is 13,19-didehydrosenecionan bearing two additional hydroxy substituents at positions 12 and 18 as well as two additional oxo groups at positions 11 and 16.

name: latanoprost free acid
definition: A prostaglandin Fα that is an analogue of prostaglandin F2α in which the pentyl group has been replaced by 2-phenylethyl and where the the 13,14-double bond has undergone formal hydrogenation. Its isopropyl ester prodrug, latanoprost, is used in the treatment of open-angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension.

name: cinidon ethyl
definition: A carboxylic ester and organochlorine compound that is the ethyl ester of cinidon.

name: menadione sodium sulfonate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of menadione sulfonate. A synthetic naphthoquinone without the isoprenoid side chain and biological activity, but can be converted into active vitamin K2, menaquinone, after alkylation in vivo.

name: menadione sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of menadione sulfonic acid, arising from deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: menadione sulfonic acid
definition: An organosulfonic acid obtained by formal hydrosulfonation across the 2 and 3 positions of menadione.

name: L-erythro-biopterin
definition: A biopterin in which the 1,2-dihydroxypropyl group has (1R,2S)-configuration; naturally occurring form.

name: bathocuproine disulfonic acid
definition: A phenanthroline that consists of 1,10-phenanthroline bearing two methyl groups at position 2 and 9 as well as two 4-sulfophenyl groups at positions 4 and 7.

name: cyclazosin hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride composed of equimolar amounts of cyclazosin and hydrogen chloride.

name: cyclazosin
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of furoic acid with the secondary amino group of 6,7-dimethoxy-2-[(4aR,8aS)-octahydroquinoxalin-1-yl]quinazolin-4-amine.

name: cadmium dichloride hemipentahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hemipentahydrate form of cadmium dichloride.

name: sodium tungstate dihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of sodium tungstate. Combines with hydrogen peroxide for the oxidation of secondary amines to nitrones

name: sodium tungstate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having tungstate as the counterion. Combines with hydrogen peroxide for the oxidation of secondary amines to nitrones.

name: 22,23-dihydroavermectin B1a
definition: A macrocyclic lactone that is avermectin B1a in which the double bond present in the spirocyclic ring system has been reduced to a single bond. It is the major component of ivermectin.

name: ferrozine monosodium salt
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of 4,4'-[3-(pyridin-2-yl)-1,2,4-triazine-5,6-diyl]dibenzenesulfonic acid.

name: 22,23-dihydroavermectin B1b
definition: A macrocyclic lactone that is avermectin B1b in which the double bond present in the spirocyclic ring system has been reduced to a single bond. It is the minor component of ivermectin.

name: ferrozine(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of 4,4'-[3-(pyridin-2-yl)-1,2,4-triazine-5,6-diyl]dibenzenesulfonic acid.

name: ferrozine free acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is the 4,4'-disulfo derivative of 5,6-diphenyl-3-(pyridin-2-yl)-1,2,4-triazine.

name: 2,2'-disulfoazobenzene
definition: Azobenzene substituted at C-2 of each phenyl group by a sulfo group.

name: trimethyltin
definition: An organotin compound that consists of stannane in which three of the four hydrogens are substituted by methyl groups.

name: 2,3-bis(4-hydroxyphenyl)propionitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acetonitrile in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group while a second hydrogen is replaced by a 4-hydroxybenzyl group. It is a specific agonist for estrogen receptor β (ERβ).

name: 2,2'-disulfonatoazobenzene
definition: The arenesulfonate that is the dianion formed by proton loss from each of the sulfo groups in 2,2'-disulfoazobenzene; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: arsenic trichloride
definition: A arsenic molecular entity that consists of a single arsenic atom bearing three chloro substituents.

name: 2-amino-6-chloro-4-(3-sulfoanilino)-1,3,5-triazine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine with the amino groups situated at C-2 and C-4 and with a chloro group at C-6; the amino group at C-4 is substituted with a 2-sulfophenyl group.

name: ionomycin
definition: A very long-chain fatty acid that is docosa-10,16-dienoic acid which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 4, 6, 8, 12, 14, 18 and 20, by hydroxy groups at positions 11, 19 and 21, and by a (2',5-dimethyloctahydro-2,2'-bifuran-5-yl)ethanol group at position 21. An ionophore produced by Streptomyces conglobatus, it is used in research to raise the intracellular level of Ca2+ and as a research tool to understand Ca2+ transport across biological membranes.

name: 2-amino-6-chloro-4-(3-sulfonatoanilino)-1,3,5-triazine
definition: The arenesulfonate formed from 2-amino-6-chloro-4-(3-sulfoanilino)-1,3,5-triazine by loss of a proton from the 3-sulfoanilino moiety.

name: isoxaben
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,6-dimethoxybenzoic acid and the amino group of 3-(3-methylpentan-3-yl)-1,2-oxazol-5-amine.

name: celastrol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is 24,25,26-trinoroleana-1(10),3,5,7-tetraen-29-oic acid bearing an oxo substituent at position 2, a hydroxy substituent at position 3 and two methyl groups at positions 9 and 13. An antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent. Potently inhibits lipid peroxidation in mitochondria and inhibits TNF-α-induced NFκB activation. Also shown to inhibit topoisomerase II activity in vitro (IC50 = 7.41 μM).

name: triethanolammonium nitrate
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the mixing of equimolar amounts of nitric acid and triethanolamine.

name: glycyl-glycyl-glycine
definition: A tripeptide in which three glycine units are linked via peptide bonds in a linear sequence.

name: N6-acetimidoyl-L-lysine dihydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt prepared from N6-acetimidoyl-L-lysine and two equivalents of hydrogen chloride. A selective inhibitor of inducible nitric oxide synthase.

name: 7-chlorokynurenic acid
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid that is quinaldic acid which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4 and by a chlorine at position 7. It is a potent NMDA glutamate receptor antagonist which antagonizes the strychnine-insensitive glycine site of the NMDA receptor. It also prevents neurodegeneration produced by quinolinic acid.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A DHET obtained by formal dihydroxylation across the 14,15-double bond of arachidonic acid.

name: N6-acetimidoyl-L-lysinium(2+)
definition: An α-amino-acid cation obtained by protonation of the α-amino and imine functions of N6-acetimidoyl-L-lysine

name: (5Z,8Z,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A DHET obtained by formal dihydroxylation across the 11,12-double bond of arachidonic acid.

name: (5Z,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A DHET obtained by formal dihydroxylation across the 8,9-double bond of arachidonic acid.

name: N6-acetimidoyl-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine in which one of the hydrogens attached to N6 is substituted by an acetimidoyl group

name: 5,6-DHET
definition: A DHET obtained by formal dihydroxylation across the 5,6-double bond of arachidonic acid.

name: 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin A2
definition: A prostaglandin A derivative that is prostaglandin A2 lacking the 15-hydroxy group and having C=C double bonds at positions 12(13) and 14(15).

name: 13,14-dihydro-15-keto-PGF2α
definition: A prostaglandin Fα obtained by formal oxidation of the 15-hydroxy group and hydrogenation of the 13,14-double bond of prostaglandin F2α.

name: 12S-HHTrE
definition: A trienoic fatty acid that consists of (5Z,8E,10E)-heptadeca-5,8,10-trienoic acid bearing an additional 12S-hydroxy substituent.

name: N-allyl-1-phenyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol hydrobromide
definition: A hydrobromide salt prepared from N-allyl-1-phenyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol and one equivalent of hydrogen bromide. Selective dopamine D1-like receptor partial agonist (IC50 values are 19.7 and 2425 nM for binding to D1-like and D2-like receptors respectively). Centrally active following systemic administration in vivo.

name: 20-oxoleukotriene B4
definition: A leukotriene that is leukotriene B4 bearing an additional oxo substituent at position 20.

name: 18-hydroxy-18-oxo-dinorleukotriene B4
definition: An octadecatetraenedioic acid obtained by oxidative degradation of leukotriene B4, a process that results in the removal of C19 and C20 with concomitant dioxygenation of C18.

name: 6-trans-leukotriene B4
definition: A leukotriene that is the 6-trans-isomer of leukotriene B4.

name: Δ6-trans-12-epi-leukotriene B4
definition: A leukotriene that is the 6-trans,12S-isomer of leukotriene B4.

name: eoxin A4
definition: An oxylipin that is the (14S,15S)-epoxy derivative of (5Z,8Z,10E,12E)-icosa-5,8,10,12-tetraenoic acid.

name: eoxin C4
definition: A leukotriene that is the 14R-(S-glutathionyl),15S-hydroxy derivative of (5Z,8Z,10E,12E)-icosa-7,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid.

name: eoxin D4
definition: A leukotriene that is the 14R-(S-cysteinylglycyl),15S-hydroxy derivative of (5Z,8Z,10E,12E)-icosa-7,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid.

name: eoxin E4
definition: A leukotriene that is the 14R-(S-cysteinyl),15S-hydroxy derivative of (5Z,8Z,10E,12E)-icosa-7,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid.

name: N-allyl-1-phenyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepinium-7,8-diol(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino function of N-allyl-1-phenyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol.

name: N-allyl-1-phenyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol
definition: A benzazepine that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine bearing a phenyl substituent at position 1, an allyl substituent at position 3 and two hydroxy substituents at positions 7 and 8. Selective dopamine D1-like receptor partial agonist (IC50 values are 19.7 and 2425 nM for binding to D1-like and D2-like receptors respectively). Centrally active following systemic administration in vivo.

name: 15(R)-HETE
definition: An optically active form of 15-HETE having 15(R)-configuration.

name: 6-epi-lipoxin A4
definition: A C20 hydroxy fatty acid having (5S)-, (6S)- and (15S)-hydroxy groups as well as (7E)- (9E)-, (11Z)- and (13E)-double bonds.

name: 15-epi-lipoxin B4
definition: A C20 hydroxy fatty acid having (5S)-, (14R)- and (15R)-hydroxy groups as well as (6E)- (8Z)-, (10E)- and (12E)-double bonds.

name: 15-oxolipoxin A4
definition: A C20 hydroxy fatty acid having (5S)- and (6R)- -hydroxy groups as well as a 15-oxo group and (7E)- (9E)-, (11Z)- and (13E)-double bonds.

name: 13,14-dihydro-15-oxolipoxin A4
definition: A C20 hydroxy fatty acid obtained by formal hydrogenation across the 13,-14-double bond of 15-oxolipoxin A4.

name: 16-HETE
definition: A HETE that consists of arachidonic acid bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 16.

name: 17-HETE
definition: A HETE that consists of arachidonic acid bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 17.

name: N-methyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol hydrobromide
definition: A hydrobromide salt prepared from N-methyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol and one equivalent of hydrogen bromide. Dopamine D1-like receptor partial agonist (Ki values are 1.18, 7.56, 920 and 399 nM for rat D1, D5, D2 and D3 receptors respectively). May act as an antagonist in vivo, producing anti-Parkinsonian effects and antagonising the behavioral effects of cocaine.

name: 19-HETE
definition: A HETE that consists of arachidonic acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 19.

name: 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin D2
definition: A prostaglandin D derivative that is prostaglandin D2 lacking the 15-hydroxy group and having C=C double bonds at positions 12(13) and 14(15).

name: N-methyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepinium-7,8-diol(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino function of N-methyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepinium-7,8-diol.

name: N-methyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol
definition: A benzazepine that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine bearing a 3-methylphenyl substituent at position 1, a methyl substituent at position 3, a chloro substituent at position 6 and two hydroxy substituents at positions 7 and 8. Dopamine D1-like receptor partial agonist (Ki values are 1.18, 7.56, 920 and 399 nM for rat D1, D5, D2 and D3 receptors respectively). May act as an antagonist in vivo, producing anti-Parkinsonian effects and antagonising the behavioral effects of cocaine.

name: N-allyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol hydrobromide
definition: A hydrobromide salt prepared from N-allyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine-7,8-diol and one equivalent of hydrogen bromide. High affinity, selective dopamine D1-like receptor agonist. Ki values are 3.2, 3.1, 186, 66, 335, 1167, 1251 and 1385 nM at recombinant D1, D5, D2, D3, D4, 5-HT2A, α1A and α1B receptors respectively. Stimulates adenylyl cyclase (EC50 = 65 nM) but not phosphoinositide hydrolysis. Induces extreme arousal and hyperlocomotion following subcutaneous administration in monkeys.

name: N-allyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepinium-7,8-diol(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino function of N-allyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepinium-7,8-diol.

name: N-allyl-6-chloro-1-(3-methylphenyl)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepinium-7,8-diol
definition: A benzazepine that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine bearing a 3-methylphenyl substituent at position 1, an allyl substituent at position 3, a chloro substituent at position 6 and two hydroxy substituents at positions 7 and 8. High affinity, selective dopamine D1-like receptor agonist. Ki values are 3.2, 3.1, 186, 66, 335, 1167, 1251 and 1385 nM at recombinant D1, D5, D2, D3, D4, 5-HT2A, α1A and α1B receptors respectively. Stimulates adenylyl cyclase (EC50 = 65 nM) but not phosphoinositide hydrolysis. Induces extreme arousal and hyperlocomotion following subcutaneous administration in monkeys.

name: (8E,10R,12Z)-10-hydroperoxy-8,12-octadecadienoic acid
definition: (8E,12Z)-10-hydroperoxy-8,12-octadecadienoic acid with R-configuration at C-10.

name: (8E,12Z)-10-hydroperoxy-8,12-octadecadienoic acid
definition: A C18 long-chain hydroperoxy fatty acid having E and Z double bonds at C-8 and C-12, respectively, and a hydroperoxy group at C-10.

name: (3Z)-2-oxohex-3-enedioate
definition: 2-Oxohex-3-enedioate in which the C=C double bond has Z configuration; principal microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8Z,10E,12E)-icosatetraenoic acid
definition: An icosatetraenoic acid in which the four double bonds are located at positions 5, 8, 10 and 12 (the 5Z,8Z,10E,12E-isomer).

name: (2E,4Z)-2-hydroxymuconate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion comprising cis,cis-muconate substituted at C-2 by a hydroxy group.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,13E)-15-HETE
definition: A HETE that is (5Z,8Z,11Z,13E)-15-hydroxyicosa-5,8,11,13-tetraenoic acid bearing a hydroxy substituent at position 15.

name: 2,2'-iminobis[1-(6-fluoro-3,4-dihydro-2H-chromen-2-yl)ethanol]
definition: A member of the class of chromanes that is 2,2'-iminodiethanol in which one hydrogen attached to each hydroxy-bearing carbon is replaced by a 6-fluorochroman-2-yl group.

name: (R,S,S,S)-nebivolol
definition: A 2,2'-iminobis[1-(6-fluoro-3,4-dihydro-2H-chromen-2-yl)ethanol] that has (1S,1'S,2R,2'S)-configuration.

name: (S,R,R,R)-nebivolol
definition: A 2,2'-iminobis[1-(6-fluoro-3,4-dihydro-2H-chromen-2-yl)ethanol] that has (1R,1'R,2R,2'S)-configuration.

name: 1-palmitoylglycerol 3-phosphate
definition: A monoacylglycerol phosphate having palmitoyl as the acyl group on O-1 and with the phosphate group on O-3.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having a β-D-glucuronosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having an N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)- β-D-glucuronosyl moiety attached at position 3.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising two β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-D-GlcNAc units connected via a β-(1→4)-linkage.

name: 9,10-dimethoxy-3-isobutyl-1,3,4,6,7,11b-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[2,1-a]isoquinolin-2-one
definition: A benzoquinolizine that is 1,2,3,4,4a,9,10,10a-octahydrophenanthrene in which the carbon at position 10a is replaced by a nitrogen and which is substituted by an isobutyl group at position 2, an oxo group at position 3, and methoxy groups at positions 6 and 7.

name: (3R,11bR)-9,10-dimethoxy-3-isobutyl-1,3,4,6,7,11b-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[2,1-a]isoquinolin-2-one
definition: A 9,10-dimethoxy-3-isobutyl-1,3,4,6,7,11b-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[2,1-a]isoquinolin-2-one in which both stereocentres have R configuration.

name: (3S,11bS)-9,10-dimethoxy-3-isobutyl-1,3,4,6,7,11b-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[2,1-a]isoquinolin-2-one
definition: A 9,10-dimethoxy-3-isobutyl-1,3,4,6,7,11b-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[2,1-a]isoquinolin-2-one in which both stereocentres have S configuration.

name: (3E)-2-oxohex-3-enedioic acid
definition: 2-Oxohex-3-enedioic acid in which the C=C double bond has E configuration.

name: linoleoyl ethanolamide
definition: An N-acylethanolamine 18:2 that is the ethanolamide of linoleic acid.

name: threo-5-hydroxy-L-lysine
definition: A 5-hydroxylysine consisting of L-lysine having an (S)-hydroxy group at the 5-position.

name: (2E,4Z)-2-hydroxymuconic acid
definition: A hexadienedioic acid compound having a 2-hydroxy substituent and with configuration (2E,4Z); 2-hydroxylated cis,cis-muconic acid

name: (3Z)-2-oxohex-3-enedioic acid
definition: 2-Oxohex-3-enedioic acid in which the C=C double bond has Z configuration.

name: (2S)-pristanoyl-CoA
definition: Pristanoyl-CoA in which C-2 of the pristanoyl group has S-configuration.

name: N-octylhomovanillamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is the N-octyl amide of homovanillic acid.

name: 3-aminobenzamide
definition: A substituted aniline that is benzamide in which one of the meta- hydrogens is replaced by an amino group.

name: desmethyl loperamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is the methylamide of 4-[4-(4-chlorophenyl)-4-hydroxypiperidin-1-yl]-2,2-diphenylbutanoic acid.

name: isoquinoline-1,5-diol
definition: An isoquinolinol that is isoquinoline in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 5 are replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: amisulpride
definition: A member of the class of benzamides resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-amino-5-(ethylsulfonyl)-2-methoxybenzoic acid with the primary amino group of 2-(aminomethyl)-1-ethylpyrrolidine. It is a potent, selective dopamine D2 and D3 receptor antagonist. It is an atypical antipsychotic/antischizophrenic agent with limited extrapyrimidal side effects.

name: α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide consisting of one D-glucosyl residue, eight D-mannosyl residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues, one of which is at the reducing end.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched ten-membered mannooligosaccharide derivative consisting of eight D-mannosyl residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues, one of which is at the reducing end.

name: N-desmethylclozapine
definition: A dibenzodoazepine substituted with chloro and piperazino groups which is a major metabolite of clozapine; a potent and selective 5-HT2C serotonin receptor antagonist.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched ten-membered mannooligosaccharide derivative consisting of eight D-mannosyl residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues, one of which is at the reducing end.

name: 4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)-7-(trifluoromethyl)pyrrolo[1,2-a]quinoxaline dimaleate
definition: A maleate salt that is the dimaleate salt of 4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)-7-(trifluoromethyl)pyrrolo[1,2-a]quinoxaline. A 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 1B (5-HT1B) full agonist, 10-fold selective over 5-HT1A and 1000-fold selective over 5-HT2C receptors. Centrally active following systemic administration.

name: 4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)-7-(trifluoromethyl)pyrrolo[1,2-a]quinoxaline
definition: A pyrroloquinoxaline that is pyrrolo[1,2-a]quinoxaline bearing additional 4-methylpiperazin-1-yl and trifluoromethyl substituents at positions 4 and 7 respectively. A 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 1B (5-HT1B) full agonist, 10-fold selective over 5-HT1A and 1000-fold selective over 5-HT2C receptors. Centrally active following systemic administration.

name: 3-[4-(3-chlorophenyl)piperazin-1-yl]-1,1-diphenylpropan-2-ol hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride salt of 3-[4-(3-chlorophenyl)piperazin-1-yl]-1,1-diphenylpropan-2-ol. A selective h5-HT1D antagonist, displaying 60-fold selectivity over h5-HT1B, and exhibiting little or no affinity for a range of other receptor types.

name: 4-(3-chlorophenyl)-1-(2-hydroxy-3,3-diphenylpropyl)piperazin-1-ium(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 3-[4-(3-chlorophenyl)piperazin-1-yl]-1,1-diphenylpropan-2-ol, arising from selective protonation of one of the piperazine nitrogens.

name: 3-[4-(3-chlorophenyl)piperazin-1-yl]-1,1-diphenylpropan-2-ol
definition: An N-alkylpiperazine that is 1-(3-chlorophenyl)piperazine carrying a 3,3-diphenyl-2-hydroxyprop-1-yl group at position 4. A selective h5-HT1D antagonist, displaying 60-fold selectivity over h5-HT1B, and exhibiting little or no affinity for a range of other receptor types.

name: CGP 78608
definition: A phosphonic acid in which the hydrogen attached to phosphorous is substituted by a 1-{[(7-bromo-2,3-dioxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoxalin-5-yl)methyl]amino}ethyl group. Potent and selective NMDA antagonist that acts through the glycine site (IC50 = 5 nM). Displays >500-fold selectivity over kainate and AMPA receptors (IC50 values are 2.7 and 3 μM respectively). Anticonvulsant in vivo following systemic administration.

name: (R)-salmeterol
definition: 2-(Hydroxymethyl)-4-(1-hydroxy-2-{[6-(4-phenylbutoxy)hexyl]amino}ethyl)phenol in which the stereocentre has R configuration.

name: (S)-salmeterol
definition: 2-(Hydroxymethyl)-4-(1-hydroxy-2-{[6-(4-phenylbutoxy)hexyl]amino}ethyl)phenol in which the stereocentre has S configuration.
