name: tatiopterin(5−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion and tetracarboxylic acid anion formed from tatiopterin by loss of a proton from the phospho group and from each of the four carboxy groups; major microspecies present at pH 7.3.

name: tryptophan zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of tryptophan; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-p-coumaryl alcohol
definition: 4-Hydroxycinnamyl alcohol with E-configuration of the propenyl double bond. It is one of the main monolignols.

name: trans-sinapyl alcohol
definition: Sinapyl alcohol in which the configuration of the propenyl double bond is E. It is one of the main monolignols.

name: methionine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of methionine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-thioproline
definition: An optically active version of thioproline having D-configuration.

name: thioproline
definition: A sulfur-containing amino acid that is proline in which the methylene group at position 4 is replaced by a sulfur atom.

name: 1-(3,5-dichloro-2,6-dihydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)hexan-1-one
definition: A differentiation-inducing factor that is hexaphenone bearing two chloro substituents at positions 3 and 5, two hydroxy substituents at positions 2 and 6 as well as a single methoxy substituent at position 4. A secreted, chlorinated molecule that controls cell fate during development of Dictyostelium cells.

name: 4-amino-3-isothiazolidinone
definition: A thiazolidinone that is 1,2-thiazolidin-3-one bearing an amino substituent at position 4.

name: tenocyclidine
definition: A tertiary amino compound that consists of cyclohexane having piperidin-1-yl and thiophen-2-yl groups attached at position 1. A dissociative anaesthetic drug with halluccinogenic and stimulant effects. Its effects are similar to those of phencyclidine (PCP, an analogue with the thienyl group replaced by phenyl), but it is rather more potent.

name: microcin B17
definition: A 43-membered microcin composed of Val, Gly, Ile, Gly, Gly, Gly, Gly, Gly, Gly, Gly, Gly, Gly, Gly, Ser, Cys, Gly, Gly, Gln, Gly, Gly, Gly, Cys, Gly, Gly, Cys, Ser, Asn, Gly, Cys, Ser, Gly, Gly, Asn, Gly, Gly, Ser, Gly, Gly, Ser, Gly, Ser, His and Ile residues joined in sequence.

name: somatostatin
definition: A fourteen-membered heterodetic cyclic peptide comprising the sequence Ala-Gly-Cys-Lys-Asn-Phe-Phe-Trp-Lys-Thr-Phe-Thr-Ser-Cys cyclised by a disulfide bridge between the two Cys residues at positions 3 and 14.

name: 2-(4-iodo-2,5-dimethoxyphenyl)-1-methylethylamine
definition: An organoiodine compound that is amphetamine bearing two methoxy substituents at positions 2 and 5 as well as an iodo substituent at position 4.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide that consists of the linear trisaccharide α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at the 2-position of the central galactose.

name: 5-nitroimidazole
definition: A C-nitro compound that is imidazole bearing a nitro substituent at position 5.

name: (3R)-3-methyl-D-ornithine(1+)
definition: An amino-acid cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the two amino groups of (3R)-3-methyl-D-ornithine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N6-[(3R)-3-methyl-D-ornithyl]-L-lysine(2+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the three amino groups of N6-[(3R)-3-methyl-D-ornithyl]-L-lysine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: amyloid-β polypeptide 40
definition: A β-amyloid that is a 40 amino acid polypeptide of sequence Asp Ala Glu Phe Arg His Asp Ser Gly Tyr Glu Val His His Gln Lys Leu Val Phe Phe Ala Glu Asp Val Gly Ser Asn Lys Gly Ala Ile Ile Gly Leu Met Val Gly Gly Val Val.

name: amyloid-β polypeptide 42
definition: A β-amyloid that ia a 42 amino acid polypeptide of sequence Asp Ala Glu Phe Arg His Asp Ser Gly Tyr Glu Val His His Gln Lys Leu Val Phe Phe Ala Glu Asp Val Gly Ser Asn Lys Gly Ala Ile Ile Gly Leu Met Val Gly Gly Val Val Ile Ala.

name: enniatin B
definition: An enniatin obtained from formal cyclocondensation of three N-[(2R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutanoyl]-N-methyl-L-valine units.

name: enniatin B4
definition: An enniatin obtained from formal cyclocondensation of one N-[(2R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutanoyl]-N-methyl-L-leucine and two N-[(2R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutanoyl]-N-methyl-L-valine units.

name: enniatin A
definition: An enniatin obtained from formal cyclocondensation of three N-[(2R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutanoyl]-N-methyl-L-isoleucine units.

name: enniatin A1
definition: An enniatin obtained from formal cyclocondensation of one N-[(2R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutanoyl]-N-methyl-L-valine and two N-[(2R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutanoyl]-N-methyl-L-isoleucine units.

name: geranylgeranyl-chlorophyll a
definition: A chlorophyll that is the ester obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of chlorophyllide a and the hydroxy group of geranylgeraniol.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyrate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyric acid, formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy group.

name: fumigaclavine C
definition: An ergot alkaloid produced by the fungus Aspergillus fumigatus that is ergoline which is substituted by a 2-methylbut-3-en-2-yl group at position 2, methyl groups at the 6 and 8β positions, and by an acetoxy group at the 9β position.

name: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoate
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: CDP-N,N-dimethylethanolamine
definition: A nucleotide-(amino alcohol) that is the N,N-dimethyl derivative of CDP-ethanolamine.

name: daunorubicin(1+)
definition: An anthracycline cation that is the conjugate acid of daunorubicin, arising from protonation of the amino group.

name: O-(α-D-mannose-1-phosphoryl)-L-serine
definition: A mannose phosphate in which in which the phosphate group of α-D-mannose 1-phosphate is esterified by the alcoholic hydroxy group of L-serine.

name: phenol O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid that is the glucuronide conjugate of phenol.

name: metronidazole(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the addition of a proton to metronidazole.

name: 7-formamidino-7-deazaguanine(1+)
definition: A carboxamidinium ion that is the conjugate acid of 7-formamidino-7-deazaguanine, arising from selective protonation of the imino nitrogen; major species at pH 7.3.

name: methylselenol
definition: An organoselenium compound that is a selenium analogue of methanol, comprising a methyl group covalently bound to a selenol group.

name: 7-formamidino-7-deazaguanine
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7-deazaguanine bearing a carboxamidine substituent at the 7 position.

name: 2,6-dioxo-6-phenylhexa-3-enoic acid
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid that is 6-phenylhexa-3-enoic acid bearing oxo substituents at positions 2 and 6.

name: artemisinic aldehyde
definition: A sesquiterpenoid aldehyde, an intermedediate in the biosynthesis of artemisinin from artemisinic alcohol in Artemisia annua.

name: mycophenolic acid O-acyl-glucuronide
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of mycophenolic acid with the anomeric hydroxy group of β-D-glucuronic acid.

name: (11R)-dihydroartemisinic aldehyde
definition: A sesquiterpenoid aldehyde, an intermedediate and reduction product from artemisinic aldehyde in the biosynthesis of artemisinin from artemisinic alcohol in Artemisia annua.

name: N6-[(3R)-3-methyl-D-ornithyl]-L-lysine
definition: A dipeptide formed by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (3R)-3-methyl-D-ornithine with the side-chain amino group of L-lysine.

name: (3R)-3-methyl-D-ornithine
definition: A D-α-amino acid that is D-isoleucine bearing an amino substituent at position 5.

name: 3,4-dihydroxy-5-polyprenylbenzoate
definition: The dihydroxybenzoate anion formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy group of 3,4-dihydroxy-5-polyprenylbenzoic acid. The major species present at pH 7.3, it is an intermediate in the formation of ubiquinone.

name: pyripyropene A
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that consists of (3S,4R,4aR,6S,6aS,12R,12aS,12bS)-4-(acetoxymethyl)-12-hydroxy-4,6a,12b-trimethyl-11-oxo-9-(pyridin-3-yl)-1,3,4,4a,5,6,6a,12,12a,12b-decahydro-2H,11H-benzo[f]pyrano[4,3-b]chromene-3,6-diol in which the hydrogens of the 3- and 6-hydroxy functions are substituted by acetyl groups.

name: trimethylamine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt formed by reaction of equimolar amounts of trimethylamine and hydrogen chloride.

name: cadaverine dihydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the reaction of cadaverine with 2 mol eq. of hydrogen chloride.

name: p-aminohippurate
definition: A hippurate that is the conjugate base of p-aminohippuric acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: aspyridone A
definition: 2-Pyridone carrying as substituents a branched dimethylhexanoyl group, a hydroxy group and a p-hydroxyphenyl group at C-3, -4 and -5 respectively. Secondary metabolite produced by Aspergillus spp.

name: aspyridone B
definition: 2-Pyridone carrying as substituents a branched dimethylhexanoyl group, a hydroxy group and a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at C-3, -4 and -5 respectively. Secondary metabolite produced by Aspergillus spp.

name: decarboxytiaprofenic acid
definition: A thiophene substituted at C-2 by benzoyl and at C-4 by an ethyl group.

name: decarboxysuprofen
definition: A thiophene substituted at C-2 by a 4-ethylbenzoyl group.

name: sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−)
definition: A glycerophosphoglycerol(1−) having (R,S)-configuration.

name: glutathioselenol
definition: A glutathione derivative that is glutathione in which the hydrogen attached to the sulfur is replaced by a selenol group.

name: potassium citrate (anhydrous)
definition: The anhydrous form of the tripotassium salt of citric acid.

name: EDTA disodium salt (anhydrous)
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the anhydrous form of the disodium salt of ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA).

name: lithium citrate (anhydrous)
definition: A lithium salt that is the anhydrous form of the trilithium salt of citric acid. The tetrahydrate form is used as a source of lithium for the treatment of anxiety disorders, bipolar disorder, and depression.

name: magnesium nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of magnesium.

name: phytochelatin 2
definition: A phytochelatin that is a pentapeptide consisting of 2 units of γ-Glu-Cys, with a glycyl unit at the C-terminus.

name: phytochelatin 3
definition: A phytochelatin that is a heptapeptide consisting of 3 units of γ-Glu-Cys, with a glycyl unit at the C-terminus.

name: potassium citrate monohydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of potassium citrate.

name: phytochelatin 4
definition: A phytochelatin that is a nonapeptide consisting of 4 units of γ-Glu-Cys, with a glycyl unit at the C-terminus.

name: lithium citrate tetrahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the tetrahydrate form of lithium citrate. It is used as a source of lithium for the treatment of anxiety disorders, bipolar disorder, and depression.

name: EDTA(2−)
definition: A tetracarboxylic acid anion formed by deprotonation of two of the four carboxy groups in ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA).

name: 3-palmitoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 3-acyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl group is specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl).

name: EDTA disodium salt dihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of EDTA disodium salt.

name: propyl octadecanoate
definition: An octadecanoate ester obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of octadecanoic (stearic) acid and the hydroxy group of propanol.

name: dehydroergosterol
definition: A phytosterol consiting of ergostane having double bonds at the 5,6-, 7,8- 9,11- and 22,23-positions as well as a 3β-hydroxy group.

name: sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A glycerol 1-phosphoserine(1−) in which the glycero portion has R-configuration and the serine moiety has L-configuration.

name: N-carbamoyl-L-cysteinate(1−)
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion that is the anion formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy group of N-carbamoyl-L-cysteine; major species present at pH 7.3.

name: L-2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid
definition: A 2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid that has R configuration.

name: D-2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid
definition: A 2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid that has S configuration.

name: 2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid
definition: A 1,3-thiazole that is 4,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazole which is substituted at positions 2 and 4 by an amino and a carboxy group, respectively.

name: D-2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid zwitterion
definition: A 2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid zwitterion that has S-configuration. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained from 2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid by the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the thiazoline nitrogen. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid zwitterion
definition: A 2-amino-Δ2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid zwitterion that has R-configuration. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-heptaprenyl-sn-glycero-1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid obtained by deprotonation of both phosphate OH groups of 3-heptaprenyl-sn-glycero-1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-artemisinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of (+)-artemisinic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-artemisinic alcohol
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is prop-2-en-1-ol acid which is substituted at position 2 by a 4,7-dimethyl-1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalen-1-yl group (the 1S,4R,4aS,8aR diastereoisomer). It is a sesquiterpenoid precursor of artemisinin, obtained from sweet wormwood, Artemisia annua.

name: [(1R)-2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-enyl]acetyl-CoA(4−)
definition: The acyl-CoA oxoanion resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate groups of [(1R)-2,2,3-trimethyl-5-oxocyclopent-3-enyl]acetyl-CoA. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: [(2R)-3,3,4-trimethyl-6-oxo-3,6-dihydro-1H-pyran-2-yl]acetyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of [(2R)-3,3,4-trimethyl-6-oxo-3,6-dihydro-1H-pyran-2-yl]acetyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-6-exo-hydroxycamphor
definition: A 6-hydroxycamphor that is (+)-camphor bearing a 6-exo-hydroxy substituent.

name: (+)-6-endo-hydroxycamphor
definition: A 6-hydroxycamphor that is (+)-camphor bearing a 6-endo-hydroxy substituent.

name: 3,4-dihydro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3,4-dihydro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-(4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-ylidene)pyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-(4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-ylidene)pyruvic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tetrahydro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of tetrahydro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tetrahydrotyrosine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of tetrahydrotyrosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-oxospirilloxanthin
definition: A carotenoid ether that is (3E,3'E)-1,1'-dihydroxy-3,3',4,4'-tetradehydro-1,1',2,2'-tetrahydro-ψ,ψ-carotene-2-one in which both hydroxyl hydrogens are substituted by methyl groups.

name: 2,2'-dioxospirilloxanthin
definition: A carotenoid ether that is (3E,3'E)-1,1'-dihydroxy-3,3',4,4'-tetradehydro-1,1',2,2'-tetrahydro-ψ,ψ-carotene-2,2'-dione in which both hydroxyl hydrogens are substituted by methyl groups.

name: salicin-6-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of both phosphate OH groups of salicin-6-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: phytosphingosine 1-phosphate(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of phytosphingosine 1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-deoxy-scyllo-inosose
definition: A tetrahydroxycyclohexanone that is cyclohexanone having four hydroxy groups located at positions 2, 3, 4 and 5 (the 2S,3R,4S,5R-diastereomer).

name: α-muurolene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is 1,2,4a,5,6,8a-hexahydronaphthalene which is substituted at position 1 by an isopropyl group and at positions 4 and 7 by methyl groups (the 1S,4aS,8aR-diastereoisomer).

name: γ-muurolene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is 1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalene which is substituted at positions 1, 4 and 7 respetively by isopropyl, methylene and methyl groups (the 1S,4aS,8aR-diastereoisomer).

name: β-copaene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is tricyclo[4.4.0.02,7]decane bearing methyl, isopropyl and methylene substituents at positions 1, 8 and 3 respectively (the 1S,6S,7S,8S-diastereomer)

name: (−)-sativene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is octahydro-1H-1,4-methanoindene bearing methyl, isopropyl and methylidene substituents at positions 4, 7 and 8 respectively (the 1R,3aS,4R,7R,7aR-isomer).

name: (R)-tetraprenyl-β-curcumene
definition: A sesquarterpene that is 1,4-cyclohexadiene bearing a methyl substituent at position 1 and a 6,10,14,18,22-pentamethyltricosa-5,9,13,17,21-pentaen-2-yl group at position 4.

name: L-histidinal(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of L-histidinal, arising from protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-(2-hydroxyphenyl)ethanol
definition: A phenol that is 2-phenylethanol in which the phenyl ring is substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-demethylmenaquinol-7
definition: A 2-demethylmenaquinol having a side chain composed of seven isoprenoid units.

name: tetrahydrotyrosine
definition: An α-amino acid that is alanine substituted at position 3 by a 4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-yl group

name: tetrahydro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid substituted at position 3 by a 4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-yl group

name: 2,4-dimethylbenzoic acid
definition: A dimethylbenzoic acid in which the two methyl groups are located at positions 2 and 4.

name: 2,4-dimethylbenzoate

definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is mandelic acid in which positions 3 and 4 on the benzene ring are substituted by a methylenedioxy group.

name: 3-methylbutane-1,2-diol
definition: A glycol in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 1 and 2 of isopentane.

name: docosanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A saturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of docosanoyl-CoA (behenoyl-CoA); major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z)-myristoleoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of myristoleoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyclo(L-tyrosyl-L-tyrosyl)
definition: A cyclo(tyrosyl-tyrosyl) in which both stereocentres have L-configuration. Synthesized by Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

name: trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-arabinofuranose(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-arabinofuranose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-erythro-pentofuranosid-2-ulose(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-erythro-pentofuranosid-2-ulose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6'''-oxoneomycin C(5+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of all five free amino groups of 6'''-oxoneomycin C; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-deoxystreptamine(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the two free amino groups of 2-deoxystreptamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: carboxynorspermidine(2+)
definition: The α-amino-acid cation formed from carboxynorspermidine by zwitterion formation between the carboxy and α-amino groups and protonation of the nitrogen atoms at positions 5 and 9; the major structure of carboxynorspermidine at pH 7.3.

name: 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxyparomamine(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the two free amino groups of 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxyparomamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: carboxyspermidine(2+)
definition: The α-amino-acid cation formed from carboxyspermidine by zwitterion formation between the carboxy and α-amino groups and protonation of the nitrogen atoms at positions 5 and 10; the major structure of carboxyspermidine at pH 7.3.

name: C20 3-dehydrosphinganine(1+)
definition: A cationic sphingoid that is the conjugate acid of C20 3-dehydrosphinganine, obtained by protonation of the primary amino function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-hexacosanoyl-C20-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-hexacosanoyl derivative of C20 phytosphingosine.

name: 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxyparomamine
definition: An amino cyclitol glycoside that is 4α,6α-diaminocyclohexane-1β,2α,3β-triol (2-deoxystreptamine) in which the pro-R hydroxy group is substituted by an α-D-glucosyl residue.

name: neamine(4+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the four free amino groups of neamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: neomycin C(6+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the six free amino groups of neomycin C; major species at pH 7.3.

name: isopentenyl phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of isopentenyl phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans,polycis-decaprenyl phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of trans,polycis-decaprenyl phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-trans,polycis-decaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-trans,polycis-decaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-oxo-3-(5-oxofuran-2-ylidene)propanoate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-oxo-3-(5-oxofuran-2-ylidene)propanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5''-phosphoribostamycin(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the four free amino groups and deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 5''-phosphoribostamycin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-deoxypyridoxine
definition: A pyridine ring substituted with methyl groups at positions 2 and 4, a hydroxyl at position 3, and a hydroxymethyl group at position 5.

name: 2-hydroxyoctadecanal
definition: A long-chain aldehyde that is octadecanal in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: butirosin B(4+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the four free amino groups of butirosin B; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-L-glutamylbutirosin B(3+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion obtained by protonation of the four amino groups and deprotonation of the carboxy group of γ-L-glutamylbutirosin B; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z)-myristoleoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (9Z)-myristoleic acid.

name: docosanoyl-CoA
definition: A very long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of docosanoic (behenic) acid.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/26:0)(1−)
definition: A anionic ceramide phosphoinositol compound having a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen and no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base or at C-2 or C-3 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/24:0)(1−)
definition: An anionic ceramide phosphoinositol compound having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen and no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, or at C-2 or C-3 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/2-OH-26:0)(1−)
definition: An anionic ceramide phosphoinositol compound having a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/2-OH-24:0)(1−)
definition: An anionic ceramide phosphoinositol compound having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-arabinofuranose
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of β-D-arabinofuranose attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate.

name: 2-hydroxyhexadecanoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxypalmitic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6'''-oxoneomycin C
definition: An amino cyclitol glycoside derived from neomycin and consisting of neamine substituted at position 3 by a 3-O-(2-amino-2-deoxy-α-D-gluco-hexodialdo-1,5-pyranosyl)-β-D-ribofuranosyl group.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-β-Neup5Ac
definition: α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-Neu5Ac in which the configuration at the anomeric carbon atom of the residue at the reducing end is β.

name: trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-erythro-pentofuranosid-2-ulose
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of β-D-erythro-pentofuranosid-2-ulose attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate.

name: 2-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid comprising a C16 straight chain carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 2.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-β-Neup5Ac
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-Neup5Ac in which the sialyl residue at the reducing end has β anomeric configuration.

name: N-hexadecanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A phytoceramide compound having a hexadecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen atom.

name: γ-L-glutamylbutirosin B
definition: A butirosin that is butirosin B in which a γ-L-glutamyl is attached to the amino group of the (S)-4-amino-2-hydroxybutyrate side-chain.

name: butirosin B
definition: A butirosin that consists of neamine in which is substituted at position 2 by a β-D-ribofuranosyl and at position 4 by an (S)-2-hydroxy-4-aminobutyryl group.

name: butirosin A
definition: A butirosin that consists of neamine in which is substituted at position 2 by a β-D-xylofuranosyl and at position 4 by an (S)-2-hydroxy-4-aminobutyryl group.

name: 5''-phosphoribostamycin
definition: A glycoside phosphate that is ribostamycin (vistamycin) in which the ribofuranosyl residue is substituted at position 5 by a phosphate group.

name: 2-oxo-3-(5-oxofuran-2-ylidene)propanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid substituted at position 3 by a 5-oxofuran-2-ylidene group.

name: 3-oxoicosanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-oxoacyl-CoA(4-) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate groups of 3-oxoicosanoyl-CoA: major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-trans,polycis-decaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate.

name: CDP-N,N-dimethylethanolamine(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of CDP-N,N-dimethylethanolamine, obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: C20 3-dehydrosphinganine
definition: A sphingoid obtained by formal oxidation of the 3-hydroxy group of C20 sphinganine.

name: 2-hydroxy-ATP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate that is ATP in which position 2 on the adenine moiety is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc6S-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprised of an 6-sulfated N-acetylglucosamine residue linked β(1→3) to a galactose residue, which is itself linked β(1→4) to an N-acetylglucosamine residue.

name: isopentenyl phosphate
definition: A monoalkyl phosphate that is isopentenyl alcohol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen is substituted by a phosphate group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising two galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetylglucosaminyl units linked β(1→3) and β(1→6) to an α-D-galactose residue; β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc with α configuration at the reducing-end anomeric centre.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising five N-acetylglucosaminyl residues linked β(1→4).

name: hydroxyallysine
definition: An α-amino acid, comprised of norleucine hydroxylated at C-5 and with an aldehydic oxygen at C-6.

name: erythro-L-hydroxyallysine
definition: Hydroxyallysine in which the configuration at the α-carbon is L and that at C-5 is R.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide comprising six N-acetylglucosaminyl residues linked β(1→4).

name: 2-hydroxy-AMP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is the 2-hydroxylated form of AMP.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-3-hydroxytetracosahexaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-3-hydroxytetracosahexaenoic acid. It is a member of n-3 PUFA and a product of α-linolenoic acid metabolism.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-3-oxotetracosahexaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-3-oxotetracosahexaenoic acid. It is a member of n-3 PUFA and a product of α-linolenoic acid metabolism.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid. It is a member of n-3 PUFA and a product of α-linolenoic acid metabolism.

name: 4-[4-(dimethylamino)styryl]-N-methylpyridinium iodide
definition: An organic iodide salt consisting of pyridinium iodide having a methyl substituent at the 1-position and a 4-dimethylaminostyryl substituent at the 4-position.

name: 8-oxo-GDP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate that is the 8-oxo derivative of GDP.

name: 8-oxo-GMP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is the 8-oxo form of GMP.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosa-4,7,10,13,16-pentaenoic acid
definition: The all-cis-isomer of a C22 polyunsaturated fatty acid having five double bonds in the 4-, 7-, 10-, 13- and 16-positions. It is a member of n-6 PUFA and a product of linoleic acid metabolism.

name: N-hydroxydebrisoquine O-glucuronide
definition: A glucosiduronic acid that is the O-β-D-glucuronide conjugate of N-hydroxydebrisoquine.

name: E-3810
definition: A hydrochloride salt obtained by reaction of 6-({7-[(1-aminocyclopropyl)methoxy]-6-methoxyquinolin-4-yl}oxy)-N-methyl-1-naphthamide with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. E-3810 is a dual VEGFR and FGFR inhibitor

name: (2E,6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosaheptaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosaheptaenoic acid. It is a member of n-3 PUFA and a product of α-linolenoic acid metabolism.

name: α-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Xyl-(1→3)-L-Ser
definition: An O-glycosyl-L-serine having the linear heptasaccharide α-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Xyl as the glycosyl component. An intermediate glycan in the synthesis of heparan

name: α-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcA
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative that consists of D-glucuronic acid having an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at position 4. An intermediate glycan in the degradation of heparan sulfate.

name: α-D-GlcNAc6S-(1→4)-D-GlcA
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative that consists of D-glucuronic acid having a 6-O-sulfo-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at position 4. An intermediate glycan in the degradation of heparan sulfate.

name: β-D-GlcA2S-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc6S-(1→4)-D-GlcA
definition: A linear trisaccharide derivative that consists of 2-sulfated β-D-glucuronic acid, 6-sulfated N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine and β-D-glucuronic acid units connected in sequence by (1→4)-linkages. An intermediate glycan involved in the degradation of heparan sulfate.

name: β-D-GlcA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc6S-(1→4)-D-GlcA
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide that consists of a 6-sulfated N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamyl residue flanked by two β-D-glucuronic acid units connected by (1→4)-linkages. An intermediate glycan involved in the degradation of heparan sulfate.

name: 3',4'-O-disulfo-N-acetyllactosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 3,4-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: 3,6-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-6-O-sulfo-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of 6-O-sulfo-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 3,6-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: 3,6-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 3,6-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: 3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactose
definition: A monosaccharide sulfate that is β-D-galactose bearing a single sulfo substituent at position 3; sulfatide in which both acyl chains have been removed by treatment with ceramide glycanase.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp3S-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetylglucosamine having a fucosyl residue attached at the 4-position via an α-linkage and a 3-sulfated galactosyl residue attached at the 3-position via a β-linkage.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→3-)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide composed of 3-sulfated β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl residues in β-(1→3) linkage.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→3-)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide composed of 3-sulfated β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues in β-(1→3) linkage.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp6S
definition: A glycosylglucose derivative that is β-lactose bearing two sulfo substituents at position 3 of the galactosyl residue and position 6 of the glucose.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-Glcp6S
definition: A trisaccharide derivative that consists of 6-sulfated D-glucose having an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at position 3 and a 3-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/24:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphophytoceramide(1−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/26:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphophytoceramide(1−) having a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/24:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, with no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base or on the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/26:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a hexacosanoyl group amide-linked to a C20 sphinganine base, with no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base or on the C26 very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/2-OH-24:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, with hydroxylation at C-2 of the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/2-OH-26:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a hexacosanoyl group amide-linked to a C18 sphinganine base, with hydroxylation at C-2 of the C26 very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/24:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, with hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base.

name: Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/26:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a hexaacosanoyl group amide-linked to a C18 phytosphingosine base, with no hydroxylation of the C26 very long chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2-OH-24:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphophytoceramide(1−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 of the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2-OH-24:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 of the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2-OH-26:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphophytoceramide(1−) having a 2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2-OH-26:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a hexacosanoyl group amide-linked to a C18 phytosphingosine base, with hydroxylation at C-2 of the C26 very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2,3-OH-24:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphophytoceramide(1−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 and C-3 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2,3-OH-24:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 and C-3 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2,3-OH-26:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphophytoceramide(1−) having a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 and C-3 of the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2,3-OH-26:0)(1−)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide(1−) having a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the C18 sphingoid base, and hydroxylation at C-2 and C-3 of the C26 very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide derivative that consists of D-glucose having an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at position 3 and a 3-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at position 3 and a 3-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4; β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc in which the configuration at the anomeric centre of the reducing-end residue is β.

name: ximelagatran
definition: A member of the class of azetidines that is melagatran in which the carboxylic acid group has been converted to the corresponding ethyl ester and in which the amidine group has been converted into the corresponding amidoxime. A prodrug for melagatran, ximelagatran was the first orally available direct thrombin inhibitor to be brought to market as an anticoagulant, but was withdrawn in 2006 following reports of it causing liver damage.

name: iloperidone
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is the 4-acetyl-2-methoxyphenyl ether of 3-(piperidin-1-yl)propan-1-ol which is substituted at position 4 of the piperidine ring by a 6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl group. A member of the group of second generation antipsychotics (also known as an atypical antipsychotics), it is used for the treatment of schizophrenia.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of 6-sulfated N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 3-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino trisaccharide that consists of 6-sulfated N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at position 3 and a 3-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at position 3 and a 3-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 3-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose derivative that consists of β-D-glucose having a 3-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: GDP(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of two of the the three diphosphate OH groups of guanosine 5'-diphosphate.

name: 4,6-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 4,6-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-β-D-glucosamine having a 6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp6S
definition: A glycosylglucose derivative that consists of 6-sulfated β-D-glucose having a 6-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose derivative that consists of β-D-glucose having a 6-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4.

name: 9-deoxy-9-acetamido-N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid
definition: An N-acetylneuraminic acid that is N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid in which the 9-hydroxy group has been replaced by an acetamido group.

name: 9-deoxy-9-acetamido-α-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a 9-deoxy-9-acetamido-N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl residue attached to the galactose residue of N-acetyllactosamine via an α-(2→6)-linkage.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalNAc
definition: A seven-membered branched galactosamine oligosaccharide that consists of a branched tetrasaccharide unit α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc, attached by a glycosidic linkage to position 6 of the GalNAc residue of the trisaccharide α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-D-GalNAc.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/24:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/26:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having an inositol 1-phosphoryl group linked at the 6-position to the mannose residue and a hexacosanoyl group amide-linked to a C18 sphinganine base, with no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base or on the C26 very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear trisaccharide derivative that consists of α-L-fucose, 6-sulfated β-D-galactose and D-glucose units connected in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) links, respectively.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/2-OH-24:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having an inositol 1-phosphoryl group attached to the mannose residue and a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, with no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-D-Glcp6S
definition: A linear trisaccharide derivative that consists of α-L-fucose, 6-sulfated β-D-galactose and 6-sulfated D-glucose units connected in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) links, respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide that consists of α-L-fucose, 6-sulfated β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine units connected in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) links, respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A thirteen-membered glucosamine oligosaccharide that consists of the linear trisaccharide β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc to which two α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man units are attached at positions 3 and 6 of the mannosyl residue.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/2-OH-26:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having an inositol 1-phosphinato group linked to the mannose residue (at the 6-position) and a hexacosanoyl group amide-linked to a C18 sphinganine base, with no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base and hydroxylation at C2 of the C26 very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/24:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and no additional hydroxylation of the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/26:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having an inositol 1-phosphoryl group linked to the mannose residue (at the 6-position) and a hexacosanoyl group amide-linked to a C18 phytosphingosine base, with no hydroxylation of the C26 very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2-OH-24:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2,3-OH-24:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having a tetracosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base, and hydroxylation at C-2 and C-3 of the very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2,3-OH-26:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having an inositol 1-phosphoryl group attached to the mannose residue (at the 6-position) and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, hydroxylation at C-4 of the C18 sphingoid base, and hydroxylation at C-2 and C-3 of the C26 very-long-chain fatty acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-6-Man-β1-3-Ins-1-P-Cer(t18:0/2-OH-26:0)(2−)
definition: An inositol phosphomannosylinositol phosphophytoceramide(2−) having a 2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: E-3810(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the primary amino function of 6-({7-[(1-aminocyclopropyl)methoxy]-6-methoxyquinolin-4-yl}oxy)-N-methyl-1-naphthamide

name: E-3810 free base
definition: A naphthalenecarboxamide obtained from formal condensation of the carboxy group of aminocyclopropyl)methoxy]-6-methoxyquinolin-4-yl}oxy)-1-naphthoic acid with methylamine.

name: (2E,6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosaheptaenoic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid that is tetracosanoic acid having seven double bonds at positions 2, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 and 21 (the 2E,6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z-isomer).

name: 1,2-dilauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 24:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as lauroyl (dodecanoyl).

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol(1−)
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: C8 β-D-glucosyl N-acylsphingosine
definition: A β-D-glucosylceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octanoyl.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2-dilauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1,2-dilauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of α-L-fucose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine and α-D-galactose residues joined in sequence with (1→2)-, (1→3)- and (1→3)-linkages, respectively.

name: 3-hydroxyphenyl propanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of propionic acid with one of the phenol groups of resorcinol.

name: Man-1-6-Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/26:0)
definition: A mannosylinositol phosphorylceramide having a hexacosanoyl group attached to the ceramide nitrogen, with no hydroxylation at C-4 of the long-chain base or on the very-long-chain fatty acid.

name: 2-(pentylsulfanyl)acetic acid
definition: A C7 sulfur-containing carboxylic acid.

name: sodium chlorate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt that has chlorate as the counter-ion. An oxidising agent, it is used for bleaching paper and as a herbicide. It is also used in the manufacture of dyes, explosives and matches.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the two phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as octanoyl.

name: zeinoxanthin
definition: A carotenol, the structure of which is (6'R)-β,ε-carotene hydroxy-substituted at C-3 with R-stereochemistry.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino hexasaccharide consisting of α-L-fucose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine, α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose and β-D-glucose residues joined in sequence with (1→2)-, (1→3)-, (1→3)-, (1→4)- and (1→4)-linkages, respectively.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine in which the two phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as octanoyl.

name: 1,2-dilauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine in which the two phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as lauroyl (dodecanoyl).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc in which the configuration at the GalNAc anomeric carbon is α.

name: L-pyrrolysinium
definition: An α-amino-acid cation that is the conjugate acid of L-pyrrolysine, obtained by deprotonation of the α-amino group.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide in which two tetrasaccharide branches, each formed from fucose, galactose, N-acetylglucosamine and mannose residues linked α(1→2), β(1→3) and β(1→2) respectively, are linked α(1→3) and α(1→6) to the mannose residue of a trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose and two N-acetylglucosamine residues all linked β(1→4) with a β-configuration of the anomeric carbon of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp in which the configuration at the anomeric carbon of the glucose residue is β.

name: dihydroascorbigen 5'-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A dihydroascorbigen hexoside in which the hexoside component is a β-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 5 via a glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)}-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising two fucosyl residues, three galactose residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues, with a glucose residue at the reducing end.

name: corticotropin-releasing hormone (ovine)
definition: A corticotropin-releasing hormone from sheep composed of Ser, Gln, Glu, Pro, Pro, Ile, Ser, Leu, Asp, Leu, Val, Phe, His, Leu, Leu, Arg, Glu, Val, Leu, Glu, Met, Thr, Lys, Ala, Asp, Gln, Leu, Ala, Gln, Gln, Ala, His, Ser, Asn, Arg, Lys, Leu, Leu, Asp, Ile and Ala-NH2 residues joined in sequence.

name: thionitrous acid
definition: A nitroso compound that is hydrogen sulfide in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a nitroso group.

name: triciribine
definition: A nucleoside analogue in which the nucleobase portion is a 1,4,5,6,8-pentaazaacenaphthylene ring system substituted with an amino group at position 3, and a methyl group at position 5 and is bound to the β-D-ribofuranosyl moiety by an N1-glycosidic linkage.

name: corticotropin-releasing hormone (human)
definition: A corticotropin-releasing hormone from human/rat composed of Ser, Glu, Glu, Pro, Pro, Ile, Ser, Leu, Asp, Leu, Val, Phe, His, Leu, Leu, Arg, Glu, Val, Leu, Glu, Met, Ala, Arg, Ala, Glu, Gln, Leu, Ala, Gln, Gln, Ala, His, Ser, Asn, Arg, Lys, Leu, Met, Glu, Ile and Ile-NH2 residues joined in sequence.

name: α-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-[(2→6)-β-D-fructosyl]n
definition: A polysaccharide composed of an α-D-glucosyl residue joined to a [(2→6)-β-D-fructosyl]n moiety by an α-(1→2) linkage.

name: alvespimycin
definition: A 19-membered macrocyle that is geldanamycin in which the methoxy group attached to the benzoquinone moiety has been replaced by a 2-(N,N-dimethylamino)ethylamino group.

name: pictrelisib
definition: A sulfonamide composed of indazole, morpholine, and methylsulfonyl-substituted piperazine rings bound to a thienopyrimidine ring.

name: LY294002
definition: A chromone substituted with a phenyl group at position 8 and a morpholine group at position 2.

name: (3-aminopropyl)(L-aspartyl-1-amino)phosphoryl-5'-adenosine(1−)
definition: A β-amino-acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (3-aminopropyl)(L-aspartyl-1-amino)phosphoryl-5'-adenosine.

name: 2'-(5''-phosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the tetraanion formed from 2'-(5"-phosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA by global deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate groups. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: acetyl-2'-(5''-phosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion that is the tetraanion formed from acetyl-2'-(5"-phosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA by global deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate groups. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2'-(5''-phosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA
definition: An adenosine 5'-phosphate derivative that has the structure of coenzyme A dephosphorylated at C-3' and with a 5''-phospho-D-ribosyl substituent at C-2'.

name: 5-formyltetrahydrofolate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 5-formyltetrahydrofolic acid.

name: 5-HETE(1−)
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-hydroxy-6E,8Z,11Z,14Z-icosatetraenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 5-oxo-ETE(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-oxo-ETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: acetyl-2'-(5''-phosphoribosyl)-3'-dephospho-CoA
definition: An adenosine 5'-phosphate derivative that has the structure of acetyl-coenzyme A dephosphorylated at C-3' and with a 5''-phospho-D-ribosyl substituent at C-2'.

name: aclidinium bromide
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt that is the bromide salt of aclidinium. A muscarinic acetylcholine M3 receptor antagonist, for the long-term maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

name: PX-866
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is obtained from wortmanin via aminolysis of its furan ring by diallyl amine.

name: aclidinium
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy(di-2-thienyl)acetic acid and the hydroxy group of N-(3-phenoxypropyl)-3-quinuclidinol. Used as its bromide salt for the long-term maintenance treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

name: carfilzomib
definition: A synthetic tetrapeptide consisting of morpholin-4-acetyl, L-2-amino-4-phenylbutanoyl, L-leucyl and L-phenylalanyl residues joined in sequence with the C-terminus connected to the amino group of (2S)-2-amino-4-methyl-1-[(2R)-2-methyloxiran-2-yl]-1-oxopentan-1-one via an amide linkage. Used for the treatment of patients with multiple myeloma

name: mirabegron
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-ylacetic acid with the anilino group of (1R)-2-{[2-(4-aminophenyl)ethyl]amino}-1-phenylethanol. Used for the treatment of overactive bladder syndrome.

name: lorcaserin hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of lorcaserin with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. Used as an anti-obesity drug.

name: lorcaserin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate base of lorcaserin, obtained by protonation of the endoc yclic amino group.

name: achromobactin free acid
definition: A tetracarboxylic acid obtained by protonation of the four carboxylate groups of achromobactin. A siderophore biosynthesized by prokaryotes.

name: lorcaserin
definition: A benzazepine that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepine substituted at position 1 by a methyl group and a t position 6 by a chloro group.

name: abacopterin A
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound resulting from cyclocondensation of the 4- and 5-hydroxy groups of (2S,4S)-2-(4-methoxyphenyl)-6,8-dimethylchromane-4,5,7-triol across the 1- and 2-positions of 6-O-acetyl-1,2-didehydro-D-glucose. A natural product found in Abacopteris penangiana.

name: abacopterin B
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound resulting from cyclocondensation of the 4- and 5-hydroxy groups of (2S,4S)-2-(4-methoxyphenyl)-6,8-dimethylchromane-4,5,7-triol across the 1- and 2-positions of 3-O-acetyl-1,2-didehydro-D-glucose. A natural product found in Abacopteris penangiana.

name: abacopterin C
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound resulting from cyclocondensation of the 4- and 5-hydroxy groups of (2S,4S)-2-(4-methoxyphenyl)-6,8-dimethylchromane-4,5,7-triol across the 1- and 2-positions of 1,2-didehydro-D-glucose. A natural product found in Abacopteris penangiana.

name: abacopterin D
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is (2R,3S,4S,4aR,8R,10S,13aS)-3,4,8-trihydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)-10-(4-methoxyphenyl)-12-methyl-3,4,4a,9,10,13a-hexahydro-2H,6H,8H-pyrano[3',2':2,3][1,4]dioxepino[6,5-g]chromen-7-ol substituted at position 7 by a β-D-glucosyl group. A natural product found in Abacopteris penangiana.

name: abyssinone A
definition: A chromenol that is 2,2-dimethyl-2H-chromen-8-ol substituted by a 3-(2,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl group at position 6 (the E-isomer). It is isolated from the stems of Erythrina abyssinica and displays moderate cytotoxic effect against human colorectal cancer cell line.

name: abyssinone C
definition: A chromenol that is 2,2-dimethyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-chromene-3,4,8-triol substituted by a 3-(2,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl moiety at position 6 (the E-isomer). It is isolated from the stems of Erythrina abyssinica and displays moderate cytotoxic effect against human colorectal cancer cell line.

name: abyssinone D
definition: A chalcone having hydroxy substituents at positions 4, 2' and 4', a methoxy substituent at position 3 and a 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group at position 5. It is isolated from the stems of Erythrina abyssinica and displays moderate cytotoxic effect against human colorectal cancer cell line.

name: acacetin-7-O-β-D-galactopyranoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is the 7-O-β-D-galactopyranosyl derivative of acacetin. It is isolated from the flowering heads of Chrysanthemum morifolium and has been found to possess potent anti-HIV activity.

name: 3-acetamino-6-isobutyl-2,5-dioxopiperazine
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is 2,5-diketopiperazine substituted by an (aminocarbonyl)methyl group at position 3 and an isobutyl group at position 6. It is isolated from the fungus Cordyceps sinensis and exhibits significant cytotoxicity against L-929, A375 and HeLa cell lines.

name: 8-acetoxy-4,10-dihydroxy-2,11(13)-guaiadiene-12,6-olide
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone and an organic heterotricyclic compound that is 2,3,3a,4,5,6,6a,9,9a,9b-decahydroazuleno[4,5-b]furan substituted by an acetoxy group at position 4, hydroxy groups at positions 6 and 9, methyl groups at positions 6 and 9, a methylidene group at position 3 and an oxo group at position 2. It is a guaianolide isolated from Chrysanthemum boreale and has been shown to exhibit cytotoxic activity against human cancer cell lines.

name: 15-acetoxyorbiculin G
definition: A dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid that is the 15-acetoxy derivative of orbiculin G. It is isolated from Microtropis japonica and exhibits antitubercular activity.

name: 1-O-acetyl-4R,6S-britannilactone
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone that is (3aS,4R,7aR)-3a,4,7,7a-tetrahydro-1-benzofuran-2(3H)-one with a methylidene at position C-3, a hydroxy at C-4, a methyl at C-6, and a (2S)-5-(acetyloxy)pentan-2-yl group at position C-5. A natural product found in Inula britannica var chinensis and Inula japonica.

name: 12-O-acetyl-16-O-deacetyl-16-epi-scalarobutenolide
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid isolated from the marine sponge Hyrtios erectus that exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: 8-acetoxyheterophyllisine
definition: A diterpene alkaloid isolated from the roots of Delphinium denudatum that exhibits antifungal activity.

name: aculeatol E
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is 1,7-dioxadispiro[5.1.5.2]pentadec-9-en-11-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 13 and a tridecyl group at position 2 (the (2R,4R,6S,8R,13S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Amomum aculeatum and exhibits toxicity against some cancer cell lines like human lung carcinoma, hormone-dependent lung carcinoma and human breast carcinoma.

name: acumitin
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 3, a 2-hydroxybenzyl group at position 2 and a 3-phenylpropanoyl group at position 4. It is isolated from the roots of Uvaria acuminata and exhibits potent cytotoxicity against human promyelocytic leukemia HL-60 cells.

name: acutoside A
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is oleanolic acid substituted by a 2-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position O-3. A natural product found in Luffa acutangula and Viola hondoensis.

name: adxanthromycin A
definition: An organic peroxide, which is the 3-α-D-galactopyranosyl substituted derivative of the dimer obtained by oxidation at the 10-hydroxy position of (10S)-3,8,10-trihydroxy-1,7,10-trimethyl-9-oxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2-carboxylic acid. It is isolated from the fermentation broth of Streptomyces.

name: adxanthromycin B
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is adxanthromycin A in which the galactosyl moiety has an additional α-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 4. It is isolated from the fermentation broth of Streptomyces.

name: ageladine A
definition: An imidazopyridine that is 1H-imidazo[4,5-c]pyridin-2-amine substituted by a 4,5-dibromo-1H-pyrrol-2-yl group at position 4. It is an alkaloid isolated from a marine sponge Agelas nakamurai and acts as an inhibitor of the matrix metalloproteinases, the key enzymes involved in tumour growth, migration, angiogenesis, invasion and metastasis.

name: aglafolin
definition: A heterotricyclic compound based on a 2,3,3a,8b-tetrahydro-1H-benzo[b]cyclopenta[d]furan framework substituted by hydroxy groups at positions C-1 and C-8b, a methoxycarbonyl group at C-2, a phenyl group at C-3, a 4-methoxyphenyl group at C-3a and methoxy groups at C-6 and C-8. A platelet aggregation inhibitor found in Aglaia elliptifolia and Aglaia odorata.

name: agrochelin
definition: A member of the class thiazolidines that is (3S)-3-hydroxy-2,2-dimethyl-3-[(4R)-3-methyl-1,3-thiazolidin-4-yl]propanoic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a (4R)-2-(2-hydroxy-6-pentylphenyl)-4,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazol-4-yl group. A cytotoxic antibiotic, it is produced by the fermentation of Agrobacterium.

name: ainsliadimer A
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone isolated from the whole plants of Ainsliaea macrocephala; exhibits inhibitory activity against production of nitric oxide (NO).

name: aiphanol
definition: A lignan that is (2R)-2,3-dihydro-1,4-benzodioxin-2-ylmethanol which is substituted by a 2-(3,5-dihydroxyphenyl)ethenyl group at position 6 and a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 3. It is a stilbenolignan isolated from the seeds of Aiphanes aculeata and exhibits potent inhibitory efficacy against cyclooxygenase-1 and -2 (COX-1 and COX-2).

name: albibrissinoside A
definition: A disaccharide derivative isolated from the stems of Albizia julibrissin that exhibits antioxidant activity.

name: albizoside A
definition: A triterpenoid saponin isolated from the stem bark of Albizia chinensis that exhibits cytotoxic activity against a small panel of human tumour cell lines.

name: albizoside B
definition: A triterpenoid saponin isolated from the stem bark of Albizia chinensis that exhibits cytotoxic activity against a small panel of human tumour cell lines.

name: albizoside C
definition: A triterpenoid saponin isolated from the stem bark of Albizia chinensis that exhibits cytotoxic activity against a small panel of human tumour cell lines.

name: alisiaquinone A
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound comprising (2aS,5aR,8aR,8bS)-8a-hydroxy-2a,5a-dimethyldecahydro-8H-naphtho[1,8-bc]furan-8-one ortho-fused to C-6 and C-7 of 1,4-naphthoquinone. An antiplasmodial drug isolated from New Caledonian deep water sponge.

name: alisiaquinone B
definition: A heteropentacyclic compound that is the 9-methoxy derivative of alisiaquinone A. An antiplasmodial drug isolated from New Caledonian deep water sponge.

name: alisiaquninone C
definition: An organic heterohexacyclic compound that is isolated from New Caledonian deep water sponge and exhibits antiplasmodial properties.

name: alisiaquinol
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound comprising (2aS,5aR,8aR,8bS)-8a-hydroxy-2a,5a-dimethyldecahydro-8H-naphtho[1,8-bc]furan-8-one ortho-fused to C-6 and C-7 of naphthalene-1,4-diol. An antiplasmodial drug isolated from New Caledonian deep water sponge.

name: alismorientol A
definition: A guaiane sesquiterpenoid that is 1,5-cis-guaiane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 6, 7 and 10. It is isolated from the rhizomes of Alisma orientale and exhibits antihepatitis B activity.

name: allanxanthone C
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 3,6,8-trihydroxy-1H-xanthene-2,9-dione substituted by geminal prenyl groups at position 1 and a single prenyl group at position 7. It is isolated from the stem barks of Allanblackia monticola and exhibits antiplasmodial activity. It also shows weak cytotoxicity against human melanoma cells.

name: Aloe C-glucosylchromone
definition: A C-glycosyl compound consisting of 2-[(2R)-2-hydroxypropyl]-7-methoxy-5-methyl-4H-chromen-4-one substituted by a β-D-[2-O-(E)-cinnamoyl]glucopyranosyl residue at position 8 via a C-glycosidic linkage. It is isolated from the leaves of Aloe barbadensis and exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: alvaradoin E
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8-dihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9(10H)-one substituted by a (1-O-acetyl)-α-L-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin F
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8-dihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9(10H)-one substituted by a (1-O-acetyl)-α-L-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10R stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin G
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8-dihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9(10H)-one substituted by a 1-O-acetyl-3-O-senecioyl-α-L-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10R stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin H
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8-dihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9(10H)-one substituted by a 1-O-acetyl-3-O-senecioyl-α-L-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin I
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8,10-trihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9-one substituted by a 1-O-acetyl-3-O-senecioyl-α-L-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10R stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin J
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8,10-trihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9-one substituted by a 1-O-acetyl-3-O-senecioyl-α-L-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin K
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8-dihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9(10H)-one substituted by a 2-O-senecioyl-α-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10R stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin L
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8-dihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9(10H)-one substituted by a 2-O-senecioyl-α-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin M
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8-dihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9(10H)-one substituted by a 3-O-senecioyl-α-L-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: alvaradoin N
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,8,10-trihydroxy-3-methylanthracen-9(10H)-one substituted by a 1-O-acetyl-α-L-lyxopyranosyl moiety at position 10 via a C-glycosidic linkage (the 10S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the leaves of Alvaradoa haitiensis and exhibits cytotoxicity against human oral epidermoid carcinoma.

name: ambiguine H
definition: An ambiguine which is a (6aS,9R,10R,10aS)-9-ethenyl-10-isocyano-6,6,9-trimethyl-1-(2-methylbut-3-en-2-yl) substituted derivative of 2,6,6a,7,8,9,10,10a-octahydronaphtho[1,2,3-cd]indole. An antimicrobial agent isolated from the cyanobacterium strain, Fischerella.

name: ambiguine I
definition: An ambiguine that consists of a 5,5,7,10,10-pentamethyl-4,5,5a,6a,6b,7,8,9,9a,10-decahydro-10dH-6-oxa-4-azacyclopropa[6,7]cyclohepta[1,2,3,4-mno]aceanthrylen-10d-ol skeleton with an ethenyl substituent at position 7 and an isocyano group at position 6b (the 5aS,6aR,6bR,7R,9aR,10dR stereoisomer). An antimicrobial agent isolated from the cyanobacterium strain Fischerella.

name: amburoside A
definition: A β-D-glucoside in which a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue is attached at position 4 of 4-hydroxybenzyl 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate via a glycosidic linkage. It is isolated from the trunk barks of Amburana cearensis and exhibits antimalarial, neuroprotective, hepatoprotective and antioxidant activities.

name: amomol A
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is 1-oxaspiro[4.5]deca-6,9-dien-8-one substituted by a (2R)-2-hydroxyheptadecyl moiety and a methoxy group at position 2. It is isolated from the leaves of Amomum aculeatum and exhibits anticancerous efficacy against human lung carcinoma, hormone-dependent human prostate carcinoma and human breast carcinoma.

name: amomol B
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is 1-oxaspiro[4.5]deca-6,9-dien-8-one substituted by a (2R)-2-hydroxyheptadecyl moiety and a methoxy group at position 2. A natural product found in Amomum aculeatum.

name: ancistrotanzanine A
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is (3S)-6,8-dimethoxy-1,3-dimethyl-3,4-dihydroisoquinoline substituted by a 1-hydroxy-8-methoxy-3-methylnaphthalen-2-yl group at position 5. It is isolated from the leaves of Ancistrocladus tanzaniensis and exhibits antiplasmodial, antileishmanial and antitrypanocidal activities.

name: ancistrotanzanine B
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is (3S)-6,8-dimethoxy-1,3-dimethyl-3,4-dihydroisoquinoline substituted by a 4,5-dimethoxy-7-methylnaphthalen-1-yl group at position 5. It is isolated from the leaves of Ancistrocladus tanzaniensis and exhibits antiplasmodial, antileishmanial and antitrypanocidal activities.

name: andrographolide
definition: A labdane diterpenoid isolated from the leaves and roots of Andrographis paniculata that exhibits anti-HIV, anti-inflammatory and antineoplastic properties.

name: annomontine
definition: An alkaloid that is β-carboline substituted at position C-1 by a 2-aminopyrimidin-4-yl moiety. An antiparasitic agent found in Annona montana and Annona foteida.

name: anolignan A
definition: A lignan that consists of buta-1,3-diene substituted by a 2,4-dihydroxybenzyl group at position 2 and a 1,3-benzodioxol-5-ylmethyl group at position 3. It is isolated from the ground stems of Anogeissus acuminata and exhibits anti-HIV activity by inhibiting HIV-1 reverse transcriptase enzyme.

name: anolignan B
definition: A lignan that consists of buta-1,3-diene substituted by 4-hydroxybenzyl groups at positions 2 and 3. It is isolated from the ground stems of Anogeissus acuminata and exhibits anti-HIV activity by inhibiting HIV-1 reverse transcriptase enzyme.

name: ansaetherone
definition: An eleven-membered macrocyclic lactam that consists of (2S,3E,5Z,14S,15R)-5-ethylidene-11,14-dihydroxy-3,7,15-trimethyl-2,5-dihydro-2,13-ethano-1,9-benzoxazacycloundecine-6,8-dione in which the 14-hydroxy group is substituted by a (2R,5R,6R)-5-hydroxy-6-methyltetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-yl moiety. It is a radical scavenger isolated from Streptomyces.

name: antimycin A9
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-formamido-2-hydroxybenzoic acid with the amino group of 3-amino-8-butyl-2,6-dimethyl-4,9-dioxo-1,5-dioxonan-7-yl phenylacetate. It is a microbial metabolite isolated from Streptomyces.

name: antrocapmphin A
definition: A methoxybenzene that is 1,2,5-trimethoxy-3-methylbenzene substituted by a 3-methylbut-3-en-1-yn-1-yl group at position 4. It is isolated from Antrodia camphorata and exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: antroquinonol
definition: An enone that is cyclohex-2-en-1-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4, methoxy groups at positions 2 and 3, a methyl group at position 6 and a (2E,6E)-3,7,11-trimethyldodeca-2,6,10-trien-1-yl group at position 5 (the 4R,5R,6R stereoisomer). It is isolated from the solid-state fermented mycelium of the fungus Antrodia camphorata and has been found to exhibit potent cytotoxicity against a number of human cancer cell lines. However, a synthesis-enabled biological re-examination published in 2016, revealed minimal in vitro and in vivo antitumour activity in preclinical models.

name: aplysiallene
definition: A furofuran that is hexahydrofuro[3,2-b]furan which is substituted at position 2 by a (1E,3E)-4-bromohexa-1,3-dien-1-yl group and at position 5 by a (1R)-3-bromopropadienyl group (the 2R,3aS,5R,6aS diastereoisomer). A natural product first isolated from the red alga Laurencia okamurai Yamada and subsequently found in the sea hare Aplysia kurodai, aplysiallene is an inhibitor of sodium-potassium adenosine triphosphatase.

name: (+)-aplysinillin
definition: An alklaoid obtained from the marine sponge Aplysinella.

name: aplysinoplide A
definition: A sesterterpenoid isolated from the marine sponge Aplysinopsis digitata that exhibits cytotoxicity against P388 mouse leukemia cells.

name: aplysinoplide B
