name: morellic acid
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid derived from morellin by oxidation of the aldehyde group to the corresponding carboxy group. Isolated from Garcinia morella and Garcinia hanburyi, it exhibits antineoplastic, antibacterial and anti-HIV activity.

name: 8,8a-epoxymorellic acid
definition: An epoxide that is the 8,8a-epoxy derivative of morellic acid. Isolated from Garcinia hanburyi it exhibits cytotoxic and anti-HIV activity..

name: moromycin A
definition: An angucycline antibiotic that consists of a tetrangomycin skeleton linked to deoxy sugars through C-glycosidic and O-glycosidic bonds at positions 9 and 3 respectively. It is isolated from Streptomyces sp.KY002 and exhibits cytotoxicity against human lung cancer and MCF-7 human breast cancer cells.

name: moromycin B
definition: An angucycline that consists of tetrangomycin linked to a deoxy sugar moiety at position 9 via a C-glycosidic bond. It is isolated from Streptomyces sp.KY002 and exhibits cytotoxicity against human lung cancer and MCF-7 human breast cancer cells.

name: motualevic acid A
definition: An enamide obtained by the formal condensation of the amino group of glycine with the carboxy group of 14,14-dibromotetradeca-2,13-dienoic acid (the 2E stereoisomer). It is isolated from the marine sponge Siliquariaspongia sp. and exhibits antibacterial properties.

name: motualevic acid F

name: multicaulin

name: 12-demethylmulticaulin
definition: A diterpenoid that is multicaulin in which the methoxy group at position 12 is replaced by a hydroxy group. A norabietane derivative, it is isolated from the roots of Salvia multicaulis and exhibits antitubercular activity.

name: multiorthoquinone
definition: A diterpenoid that is phenanthrene-3,4-dione substituted by a methoxy group at position 6, a methyl groups at positions 7 and 8 and an isopropyl group at position 2. A norabietane derivative, it is isolated from Salvia multicaulis and exhibits antitubercular activity.

name: 12-demethylmultiorthoquinone
definition: A diterpenoid that is multiorthoquinone in which the methoxy group at position 12 is replaced by a hydroxy group. A norabietane derivative, it is isolated from Salvia multicaulis and exhibits antitubercular activity.

name: multiplolide A
definition: A 10-membered lactone obtained from 10-methyl-9,10-dihydro-2H-oxecin-2-one by the epoxidation of the double bond at position 3-4 and cis-dihydroxylation of the double bond at position 7-8. name: multiplolide B
definition: A 10-membered lactone obtained from 10-methyl-9,10-dihydro-2H-oxecin-2-one by the epoxidation of the double bond at position 3-4 and cis-dihydroxylation of the double bond at position 7-8, with further acylation of the hydroxy group at position 8 by a but-2-enoyl group. name: sigmoidin B

name: silvestrol

name: epi-silvestrol

name: simalikalactone D

name: YM-47142

name: zaluzanin D

name: zarzissine

name: zerumboneoxide

name: zhankuic acid A

name: zhankuic acid B
definition: A steroid acid that is ergosta-8,24(28)-dien-26-oic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3, a methyl group at position 4 and oxo groups at positions 7 and 11 (the 3α,4α,5α stereoisomer). Isolated from Antrodia cinnamomea and Antrodia camphorata, it exhibits cytotoxic, anticholinergic and antiserotonergic activities.

name: zhankuic acid C

name: zinolol

definition: A quinone imine that is 1,4-benzoquinone imine substituted by a methoxy group at position 3 and a (phenylacetyl)nitrilo group attached to the nitrogen atom. Isolated from the fermentation broth of Penicillium minioluteum, it exhibits neurotrophic effect of NGF.

name: nidulalin A
definition: A member of the class xanthones which consists of a dihydroxanthone skeleton substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 8, a methyl group at position 6 and a methoxycarbonyl group at position 4a (the 4R,4aS stereoisomer). It is isolated from Emericella nidulans var lata and Penicillium and exhibits potent antitumour activity against both human and murine tumour cell lines.

name: nigranoic acid
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 3,4-secocycloarta-4(28),24-(Z)-diene substituted by carboxy groups at positions 3 and 26. Isolated from Schisandra henryi and Schisandra propinqua, it exhibits cytotoxic and anti-HIV activities.

name: niruriside
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that consists of β-D-fructofuranosyl β-D-glucopyranoside in which the hydroxy protons are replaced by acetyl and trans-cinnamoyl groups. Isolated from Phyllanthus niruri, it exhibits anti-HIV activity.

name: nitensidine E
definition: An alkaloid that is 1,4,5,6-tetrahydropyrimidine substituted by an amino group at position 2 and by a methyl group and a 4-methylpenta-1,3-dien-1-yl group at position 6. Isolated from the leaves of Pterogyne nitens, it exhibits cytotoxicity against a panel of human cancer cell lines.

name: NK154183A
definition: A 24-membered macrolide antibiotic isolated from the fermentation broth of Streptomyces sp.NK154183. It exhibits antifungal and antitumour activity against the human colon adenocarcinoma.

name: NK154183B
definition: A 24-membered macrolide antibiotic isolated from the fermentation broth of Streptomyces sp.NK154183. It exhibits antifungal and antitumour activity against the human colon adenocarcinoma.

name: NK372135A
definition: A dinitrile that is butanedinitrile substituted by 4-methoxybenzyl and 4-methoxybenzylidene groups at positions 2 and 3 respectively. Isolated from the culture broth of the fungus Neosartorya fischeri, it exhibits antifungal activity.

name: NK372135B
definition: A dinitrile that is butanedinitrile substituted by 4-methoxybenzyl and 3,4-dimethoxybenzylidene groups at positions 3 and 2 respectively. Isolated from the culture broth of the fungus Neosartorya fischeri, it exhibits antifungal activity.

name: NK372135C
definition: A dinitrile that is butanedinitrile substituted by 3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzylidene and 4-methoxybenzyl groups at positions 2 and 3 respectively. Isolated from the culture broth of the fungus Neosartorya fischeri, it exhibits antifungal activity.

name: nocardione A
definition: A naphthofuran that is 2,3-dihydronaphtho[1,2-b]furan-4,5-dione substitutd by a hydroxy group at position 6 and a methyl group at position 2. It is isolated from Norcardia sp.TC-A0248 and acts as a protein tyrosine phosphatase inhibitor.

name: 14-norpseurotin A
definition: An alkaloid that is the 14-nor derivative of pseurotin A. Isolated from Aspergillus sydowii, it exhibits antibacterial, antileishmanial and anticancer activities.

name: nostocarboline
definition: A member of the class of β-carbolines that is 9H-β-carbolin-2-ium substituted by a chloro group at position 6 and a methyl group at position 2. It is isolated from a fresh water cyanobacterium Nostoc 78-12A and acts as an inhibitor of butyrylcholinesterase.

name: nothramicin
definition: An anthracycline antibiotic isolated from the culture broth of Nocardia sp. MJ896-43F17. It exhibits significant antimycobacterial activity against several drug-resistant Mycobacterium smegmatis strains.

name: NP-101A
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is benzamide substituted by an acetylamino group at position 2. It is an antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces aurantiogriseus and has been shown to exhibit antifungal activity.

name: nymphaeol A
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy group at positions 5, 7, 3' and 4' and a geranyl group at position 6. Isolated from Macaranga tanarius and propolis collected in Okinawa, it exhibits radical scavenging activity.

name: nymphaeol B
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy group at positions 5, 7, 3' and 4' and a geranyl group at position 2'. Isolated from Macaranga tanarius and propolis collected in Okinawa, it exhibits radical scavenging activity.

name: nymphaeol C
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy group at positions 5, 7, 3' and 4', a geranyl group at position 2' and a prenyl group at position 6. Isolated from Macaranga tanarius and propolis collected in Okinawa, it exhibits radical scavenging activity.

name: maackiaflavanone A
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 2', a methoxy group at position 7, a prenyl group at position 8 and a 6,6-dimethyl-3,6-dihydro-2H-pyran ring fused across positions 4' and 5'. Isolated from the stem barks of Maackia amurensis, it exhibits cytotoxicity against human cancer cell lines.

name: maackiaflavanone B
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7, prenyl groups at positions 8 and 3' and a 6,6-dimethyl-3,6-dihydro-2H-pyran ring fused across positions 4' and 5'. Isolated from the stem barks of Maackia amurensis, it exhibits cytotoxicity against human cancer cell lines.

name: maackiapterocarpan A
definition: A member of the class of pterocarpans that is pterocarpan substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3, a methylenedioxy group across positions 8 and 9 and a 2,2-dimethyltetrahydro-2H-pyran ring fused across positions 1 and 2 (the 8aR,14aR stereoisomer). Isolated from the stem barks of Maackia amurensis,it exhibits cytotoxicity against human cancer cell lines.

name: macabarterin
definition: A ellagitannin isolated from the stem bark of Macaranga barteri and has been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory activity.

name: macaflavanone G
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 4', a prenyl group at position 6 and a (2S)-2-methyl-2-(4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl)tetrahydro-2H-pyran ring fused across positions 2' and 3'. Isolated from the leaves of Macaranga tanarius, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: macaranone A
definition: A pentahydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 7, 3' and 4', a geranyl group at position 2' and a prenyl group at position 5'. Isolated from the leaves of Macaranga sampsonii, it exhibits cytotoxicity against several human cancer cell lines.

name: macluraxanthone B
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, 6 and 7, a dimethylallyl group at position 2 and a prenyl group at position 4. Isolated from Maclura tinctoria and Cudrania tricuspidata, it exhibits anti-HIV and antineoplastic activity.

name: macluraxanthone C
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, 5 and 6, a dimethylallyl group at position 2 and a prenyl group at position 4. Isolated from Maclura tinctoria and Cudrania tricuspidata, it exhibits anti-HIV and antineoplastic activity.

name: madecassoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is a trisaccharide derivative of madecassic acid. Isolated from Centella asiatica, it exhibits anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and antirheumatic activities.

name: madhucoside A
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that consists of protobassic acid as the aglycone moiety. Isolated from the barks of Madhuca indica, it exhibits radical scavenging activity.

name: madhucoside B
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that consists of protobassic acid as the aglycone moiety. Isolated from the barks of Madhuca indica, it exhibits radical scavenging activity.

name: (+)-makassaric acid
definition: A meroterpenoid isolated from the marine sponge Acanthodendrilla sp. It exhibits inhibitory activity against the enzyme mitogen-activated protein kinase-activated protein kinase 2 (EC 2.7.11.1).

name: mallotophilippen A
definition: A chromenol that is 2H-chromene-5,7-diol substituted by geminal methyl groups at position 2, a 2-methylbutanoyl group at position 8 and a 2,4,6-trihydroxy-3-methyl-5-(2-methylpropanoyl)benzyl group at position 6. Isolated from Mallotus philippensis, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: mallotophilippen B
definition: A chromenol that is 2H-chromene-5,7-diol substituted by geminal methyl groups at position 2, a 2-methylbutanoyl group at position 8 and a 3-acetyl-2,4,6-trihydroxy-5-methylbenzyl group at position 6. Isolated from Mallotus philippensis, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: mallotophilippen C
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 2' and 4', a geranyl group at position 3' and a 6,6-dimethyl-3,6-dihydro-2H-pyran ring fused across positions 5' and 6'. Isolated from the fruits of Mallotus philippensis, it exhibits anti-inflammatory and immunoregulatory activities.

name: mallotophilippen D
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4, 2' and 4', a geranyl group at position 3' and a 6,6-dimethyl-3,6-dihydro-2H-pyran ring fused across positions 5' and 6'. Isolated from the fruits of Mallotus philippensis, it exhibits anti-inflammatory and immunoregulatory activities.

name: (RS)-mallotophilippen E
definition: A racemate composed of equimolar quantities of R- and S- mallotophilippen E. Isolated from the fruits of Mallotus philippensis, it exhibits anti-inflammatory and immunoregulatory activities.

name: 6-[1'-oxo-3'(R)-hydroxy-butyl]-5,7-dimethoxy-2,2-dimethyl-2H-1-benzopyran
definition: A member of the class of chromenes that is 2H-chromene substituted by geminal methyl groups at position 2, methoxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and a (3R)-3-hydroxybutanoyl group at position 6. Isolated from the leaves of Mallotus apelta, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: 6-[1'-oxo-3'(R)-methoxy-butyl]-5,7-dimethoxy-2,2-dimethyl-2H-1-benzopyran
definition: A member of the class of chromenes that is 2H-chromene substituted by geminal methyl groups at position 2, methoxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and a (3R)-3-methoxybutanoyl group at position 6. Isolated from the leaves of Mallotus apelta, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: 6α-malonyloxymanoyl oxide
definition: The malonate ester of a labdane diterpenoid. Isolated from the aerial parts of Stemodia foliosa, it exhibits antibacterial activity.

name: manassantin A
definition: A lignan isolated from Saururus cernuus and Saururus chinensis and has been shown to exhibit antineoplastic activity.

name: manassantin B
definition: A lignan isolated from Saururus cernuus and Saururus chinensis and has been shown to exhibit antineoplastic activity.

name: mannioside A
definition: A steroid saponin that consists of pennogenin attached to α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycoidic linkage. Isolated from Dracaena mannii, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: manoalide
definition: A sesterterpenoid isolated from the marine sponge Luffariella variabilis and which has been shown to exhibit inhibitory activity towards phospholipase A2.

name: manzamine A
definition: An alkaloid of the class of β-carbolines isolated from Haliclona and Acanthostrongylophora. It exhibits inhibitory activity against Glycogen Synthase Kinase-3 (EC 2.7.11.26).

name: 6-hydroxymanzamine A
definition: An alkaloid that is manzamine A with a hydroxy substituent at position 6. Isolated from Haliclona and Acanthostrongylophora, it exhibits inhibitory activity against Glycogen Synthase Kinase-3 (EC 2.7.11.26).

name: 8-hydroxymanzamine A
definition: An alkaloid that is manzamine A with a hydroxy substituent at position 8. Isolated from Pachypellina and Acanthostrongylophora, it exhibits inhibitory activity against Glycogen Synthase Kinase-3 (EC 2.7.11.26).

name: maoecrystal Z
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid isolated from the leaves of a Chinese medicinal herb Isodon eriocalyx and has been shown to exhibit cytotoxicity towards human tumour cells.

name: 1β-hydroxymaprounic acid 3-p-hydroxybenzoate
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is the benzoate ester obtained by the condensation of the 3-hydroxy group of 1β-hydroxymaprounic acid with p-hydroxybenzoic acid. Isolated from Maprounea africana, it exhibits inhibitory activity against HIV-1 reverse transcriptase.

name: 2α-hydroxymaprounic acid 2,3-bis-p-hydroxybenzoate
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is the diester obtained by the condensation of the hydroxy groups of 2α-hydroxymaprounic acid with p-hydroxybenzoic acid. Isolated from Maprounea africana, it exhibits inhibitory activity against HIV-1 reverse transcriptase.

name: marianine
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is lanost-8-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 25, a methylidene group at position 24 and an oxo group at position 7. Isolated from the whole plant of Silybum marianum, it exhibits inhibitory activity against chymotrypsin.

name: marianoside A
definition: A triterpene glycoside that is lanost-8-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 25 and 28, a methylidene group at position 24 and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 3. Isolated from the whole plant of Silybum marianum, it exhibits inhibitory activity against chymotrypsin.

name: marianoside B
definition: A triterpene glycoside that is lanost-8-ene substituted by a methylidene group at position 24 and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 3. Isolated from the whole plant of Silybum marianum, it exhibits inhibitory activity against chymotrypsin.

name: marineosin A
definition: A macrocycle isolated from a marine sediment-derived actinomycete, Streptomyces sp. It exhibits cytotoxicity against colon tumour cell lines.

name: marineosin B
definition: A macrocycle isolated from a marine sediment-derived actinomycete, Streptomyces sp. A stereoisomer of marineosin A, it exhibits cytotoxicity against colon tumour cell lines.

name: (−)-marinopyrrole A
definition: A member of the class of pyrroles that is 1'H-1,3'-bipyrrole substituted by four chloro groups at positions 4, 4', 5 and 5' and two 2-hydroxybenzoyl moieties at positions 2 and 2'. It is isolated from Streptomyces sp.CNQ-418 and exhibits cytotoxic and antibacterial activities.

name: (−)-marinopyrrole B
definition: A member of the class of pyrroles that is 1'H-1,3'-bipyrrole substituted by a bromo group at position 3, four chloro groups at positions 4, 4', 5 and 5' and two 2-hydroxybenzoyl moieties at positions 2 and 2'. It is isolated from Streptomyces sp.CNQ-418 and exhibits cytotoxic and antibacterial activities.

name: marsupsin
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 1-benzofuran-3(2H)-one, substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 6, a 4-hydroxybenzyl group at position 2 and a methoxy group at position 4. Isolated from the heartwood of Pterocarpus marsupium, it exhibits antihyperglycemic and antihyperlipidemic activities.

name: martefragin A
definition: An indole alkaloid isolated from the red alga Martensia fragilis and has been shown to inhibit lipid peroxidation.

name: maslinic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 and a carboxy group at position 28 (the 2α,3β stereoisomer). It is isolated from Olea europaea and Salvia canariensis and exhibits anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and antineoplastic activity.

name: epi-maslinic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is 3α-hydroxy epimer of maslinic acid. Isolated from Prunella vulgaris and Isodon japonicus, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: massadine(2+)
definition: A guanidinium ion that is a conjugate acid of massadine.

name: matsudone A
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is 5,3',4'-trihydroxyflavone substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 3 and a 2'',2''-dimethylpyrano ring fused across positions 7 and 8. Isolated from the leaves of Salix matsudana, it acts as a cyclooxygenase 2 inhibitor.

name: maytenfolone A
definition: A hexacyclic triterpenoid that is a lactone of friedelin. Isolated from Celastrus hindsii, it exhibits anti-HIV and antineoplastic activities.

name: mediomycin A
definition: A polyene antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces mediocidicus ATCC23936 and has been shown to exhibit a broad spectrum of antifungal activity.

name: mediomycin B
definition: A polyene antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces mediocidicus ATCC23936 and has been shown to exhibit a broad spectrum of antifungal activity.

name: megathyrin A
definition: A cyclic terpene ketone that is ent-7α,20-epoxy-kaur-16-en-15-one substituted with hydroxy groups at positions 1, 7 and 14 (the 1α,7β,14β stereoisomer). Isolated from the leaves of Isodon megathyrsus, it exhibits cytotoxic activity.

name: melemeleone B
definition: A sesquiterpenoid with a quinone and taurine functionality. It is isolated from the sponge Dysidea avara, and exhibits inhibitory activity against tyrosine kinase.

name: melophlin P
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones that is 1,5-dimethylpyrrolidine-2,4-dione substituted by a 1-hydroxyhexadecylidene moiety at position 3. Isolated from the marine sponge Melophlus sarasinorum and other species of genus Melophlus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against murine leukemia cell line.

name: melophlin Q
definition: A pyrrolidinone that is 1,5-dimethylpyrrolidine-2,4-dione substituted by a 1-hydroxy-13-methyltetradecylidene moiety at position 3. Isolated from the marine sponge Melophlus sarasinorum and other species of genus Melophlus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against murine leukemia cell line.

name: melophlin R
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones that is 1,5-dimethylpyrrolidine-2,4-dione substituted by a 1-hydroxy-12-methyltetradecylidene moiety at position 3. Isolated from the marine sponge Melophlus sarasinorum and other species of genus Melophlus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against murine leukemia cell line.

name: melophlin S
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones that is 1,5-dimethylpyrrolidine-2,4-dione substituted by a 1-hydroxy-5-methyltetradecylidene moiety at position 3. Isolated from the marine sponge Melophlus sarasinorum and other species of genus Melophlus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against murine leukemia cell line.

name: metachromin S
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is 5-amino-2-hydroxy-3-methyl-1,4-benzoquinone in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is replaced by a 2-methyl-4-[(1R,2S)-1,2,3-trimethylcyclohex-3-en-1-yl]but-1-en-1-yl group and one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a 3-methylbutyl group. It is isolated from an Okinawan sponge Spongia sp.SS-1037 and exhibits moderate cytotoxicity against L1210 murine leukemia and KB human epidermoid carcinoma cells.

name: metachromin T
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is 6,8-dimethoxy-2,2-dimethyl-2H-chromen-5-ol in which the hydrogen of one of the methyl groups at position 2 is replaced by a [(1R,2S)-1,2,3-trimethylcyclohex-3-en-1-yl]methyl group. It is isolated from an Okinawan sponge Spongia sp.SS-1037 and shows moderate cytotoxicity against L1210 murine leukemia and KB human epidermoid carcinoma cells.

name: 5-methoxy-8-(2'-hydroxy-3'-buthoxy-3'-methylbutyloxy)psoralen
definition: A member of the class of psoralens that is psoralen substituted by a methoxy group at position 4 and a [(2R)-3-butoxy-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl]oxy group at position 9. Isolated from the roots of Angelica dahurica, it exhibits inhibitory activity against COX-2 and 5-lipooxygenase.

name: (3R,4R)-(−)-6-methoxy-1-oxo-3-n-pentyl-3,4-dihydro-1H-isochromen-4-yl-acetate
definition: A member of the class of isochromanes that is 3,4-dihydroisocoumarin substituted by an acetoxy group at position 4, a methoxy group at position 6 and a pentyl group at position 3. Isolated from Xyris pterygoblephara, it exhibits activity against dermatophyte fungi.

name: 9-methoxycanthin-6-one
definition: An indole alkaloid that is the 9-methoxy derivative of canthin-6-one. Isolated from Eurycoma longifolia and Simaba multiflora, it exhibits cytotoxic activity towards human cancer cell lines.

name: 1-methoxycanthinone
definition: An indole alkaloid that is the 1-methoxy derivative of canthinone. Isolated from Ailanthus altissima and Leitneria floridana, it exhibits anti-HIV activity.

name: (+)-N-(methoxycarbonyl)-N-norboldine
definition: An aporphine alkaloid that is laurolistine with a N-methoxycarbonyl group. Isolated from the aerial parts of Litsea cubeba, it exhibits antimicrobial activities.

name: 25-O-methoxycimigenol 3-O-α-L-arabinopyranoside
definition: A triterpene glycoside that consists of 25-O-methoxycimigenol attached to a α-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage. Isolated from the rhizomes of Cimicifuga racemosa, it exhibits cytotoxic activities.

name: (R)-4''-methoxydalbergione
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-benzoquinones that is p-benzoquinone substituted by a methoxy group at position 2 and a 1-phenylallyl group at position 5. Isolated from the heartwood of Dalbergia louveli, it exhibits antiplasmodial activity.

name: 7-methoxydeoxymorellin
definition: An organic heterohexacyclic compound that is deoxymorellin substituted by a methoxy group at position 7. Isolated from Garcinia hanburyi, it exhibits cytotoxic activity.

name: 4-methoxymagnaldehyde B
definition: A lignan that consists of cinnamaldehyde substituted by a methoxy group at position 2 and a 4-allylphenolic group at position 5. Isolated from Magnolia obovata, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: 7-methoxypraecansone B
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is chalcone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 2', 6' and 7 and a dimethylpyrano ring substituted across positions 3' and 4'. Isolated from Pongamia pinnata, it has been found to induce quinone reductase.

name: 6-methoxyspirotryprostatin B
definition: An indole alkaloid isolated from a marine-derived fungal strain Aspergillus sydowii PFW1-13 and has been shown to exhibit cytotoxic activity.

name: methyl 3,5-di-O-caffeoyl quinate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,5-di-O-caffeoyl quinic acid with methanol. Isolated from Suaeda glauca and Dichrocephala bicolor, it exhibits hepatoprotective activity.

name: methyl 3,4-dihydroxy-5-(3'-methyl-2'-butenyl)benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester that is methyl benzoate substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 and a prenyl group at position 5. Isolated from Piper glabratum and Piper acutifolium, it exhibits antileishmanial activity.

name: methyl 4-amino-2-(2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutyl)benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester that is methyl 4-aminobenzoate substituted by a 2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutyl group at position 2. It is isolated from the wood-decayed fungus Xylaria sp.BCC9653 and exhibits potent cytotoxicity against African green monkey kidney fibroblast (Vero) cells.

name: methyl brevifolincarboxylate
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 1,2,3,5-tetrahydrocyclopenta[c]isochromene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 7, 8 and 9, oxo groups at positions 3 and 5 and a methoxycarbonyl group at position 1. Isolated from Phyllanthus urinaria and Phyllanthus niruri, it exhibits vasorelaxant activity.

name: 3'-(3-methyl-2-butenyl)-4'-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-4,2'-dihydroxychalcone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that consists of trans-chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 2', a prenyl group at position 3' and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 4'. Isolated from the stem barks of Maclura tinctoria, it exhibits antioxidant activity.

name: palau'amide
definition: A 24-membered cyclodepsipeptide isolated from the cyanobacterium, Lyngbya sp. It exhibits strong cytotoxicity against KB human nasopharyngeal carcinoma cells.

name: pancixanthone B
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is a tetracyclic compound 1,2-dihydro-6H-furo[2,3-c]xanthen-6-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 10 and methyl groups at positions 1,1 and 2. It has been isolated from Calophyllum pauciflorum and Garcinia vieillardii.

name: papyriflavonol A
definition: A pentahydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted with hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 7, 3' and 4' and prenyl groups at positions 6 and 5'. Isolated from Broussonetia papyrifera, it exhibits inhibitory activity against phospholipase A2 and tyrosinase.

name: PF 1163A
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is 4,10-dimethyl-1-oxa-4-azacyclotridecane-2,5-dione substituted by a 4-(2-hydroxyethoxy)benzyl group at position 3 and a (2R)-2-hydroxypentyl group at position 13 (the 3S,10R,13S stereoisomer). It is isolated from Penicillium sp.PF1163 and exhibits antifungal activity against the pathogenic fungal strain Candida albicans TIMM1768.

name: PF 1163B
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is 4,10-dimethyl-1-oxa-4-azacyclotridecane-2,5-dione substituted by a 4-(2-hydroxyethoxy)benzyl group at position 3 and a pentyl group at position 13 (the 3S,10R,13S stereoisomer). It is isolated from Penicillium sp.PF1163 and exhibits antifungal activity against the pathogenic fungal strain Candida albicans TIMM1768.

name: phakellistatin 14
definition: A homodetic cyclic peptide isolated from a marine sponge Phakellia sp. It exhibits cytotoxic activity against murine P388 lymphocytic leukemia cells and moderate cancer cell growth inhibitory activity against a panel of human cancer cells.

name: phelligridimer A
definition: A macrocycle isolated from the fungus Phellinus igniarius and has been shown to exhibit antioxidant activity.

name: phelligridin G
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound isolated from the fruiting bodies of the fungus Phellinus igniarius.

name: phomacin A
definition: A cytochalasin isolated from a fungus Phoma sp. that has been shown to possess potent inhibitory activity against HT-29 colonic adenocarcinoma cells.

name: phomacin B
definition: A cytochalasin isolated from a fungus Phoma sp. that has been shown to possess potent inhibitory activity against HT-29 colonic adenocarcinoma cells.

name: phomacin C
definition: A cytochalasin isolated from a fungus Phoma sp. that has been shown to possess potent inhibitory activity against HT-29 colonic adenocarcinoma cells.

name: phomoxanthone A
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is a dimer isolated from Phomopsis. It exhibits cytotoxic, antimalarial and antitubercular activities.

name: phomoxanthone B
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is a dimer isolated from Phomopsis. It exhibits cytotoxic, antimalarial and antitubercular activities.

name: phosphatoquinone A
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound resulting from the formal epoxidation of the 2-3 double bond of the 1,4-naphthoquinone moiety of phosphatoquinone B. It is isolated from the culture broth of Streptomyces sp.TC-0363 and exhibits inhibitory activity against the enzyme protein tyrosine phosphatase.

name: phosphatoquinone B
definition: A hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone that is 1,4-naphthoquinone substituted by a (2E)-3,7-dimethylocta-2,6-dien-1-yl group at position 2, a methyl group at position 3, and hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7. It is isolated from the culture broth of Streptomyces sp.TC-0363 and exhibits inhibitory activity against the enzyme protein tyrosine phosphatase.

name: phoyunbene A
definition: A stilbenoid that is trans-stilbene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 3' and methoxy groups at positions 2', 4' and 5. Isolated from Pholidota yunnanensis, it exhibits inhibitory effects on production of nitric oxide.

name: phoyunbene B
definition: A stilbenoid that is trans-stilbene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4' and methoxy groups at positions 2', 3' and 5. Isolated from Pholidota yunnanensis, it exhibits inhibitory effects on production of nitric oxide.

name: phoyunbene C
definition: A stilbenoid that is trans-stilbene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 3' and methoxy groups at positions 2' and 5. Isolated from Pholidota yunnanensis, it exhibits inhibitory activity on nitric oxide production.

name: phoyunbene D
definition: A stilbenoid that is trans-stilbene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3 and methoxy groups at positions 2', 3' and 5. Isolated from Pholidota yunnanensis, it exhibits inhibitory effects on production of nitric oxide.

name: pleosporone
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroanthracene-9,10-dione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2, 3 and 8 and a methyl group at position 6. It is isolated from a pleosporalean ascomycete (MF7028), an endophytic fungus from Anthyllis vulneraria and exhibits modest antibacterial activity against a number of bacterial strains. Additionally it exhibits cytotoxicity against HeLa cells.

name: PM-94128
definition: A a monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by the formal condensation of the amino group of 3-[(1S)-1-amino-3-methylbutyl]-8-hydroxy-3,4-dihydro-1H-isochromen-1-one with the carboxy group of 4-amino-2,3-dihydroxy-6-methylheptanoic acid (the 2S,3S,4S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the culture broth of Bacillus sp.PhM-PHD-090 and exhibits potent antitumour activity.

name: polyketomycin
definition: A carbohydrate-containing antibiotic isolated from the culture broth of Streptomyces sp.MK277-AF1. It exhibits potent antibacterial activity against several Gram-positive bacterial strains and is also found to be cytotoxic against a number of tumour cell lines.

name: (2S)-poncirin
definition: A flavanone glycoside that is 4'-methoxy-5,7-dihydroxyflavanone attached to a neohesperidose (α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucopyranose) residue via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the fruits of Poncirus trifoliata and exhibits inhibitory activity against liopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced prostaglandin E2 and interleukin-6 (IL-6) production.

name: 1,5,6-trihydroxy-6',6'-dimethyl-2H-pyrano(2',3':3,4)-2-(3-methylbut-2-enyl)xanthone
definition: A member of the class of pyranoxanthones that is 3H,7H-pyrano[2,3-c]xanthen-7-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 6, 10 and 11, geminal methyl groups at position 3 and a prenyl group at position 5. Isolated from Garcinia lancilimba, it exhibits inhibitory effects on human cancer cell line.

name: 1,6,7-trihydroxy-6',6'-dimethyl-2H-pyrano(2',3':3,2)-4-(3-methylbut-2-enyl)xanthone
definition: A member of the class of pyranoxanthones that is 2H,6H-pyrano[3,2-b]xanthen-6-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 8 and 9, geminal methyl groups at position 2 and a prenyl group at position 12. Isolated from Garcinia lancilimba, it exhibits inhibitory effects on human cancer cell line.

name: pyripyropene I
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that consists of a heterotetracyclic system linked to a pyridine moiety. Isolated from the fungus, Aspergillus fumigatus, it exhibits inhibitory activity against acyl-CoA:cholesterol acyltransferase 2.

name: pyripyropene J
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that consists of a heterotetracyclic system linked to a pyridine moiety. Isolated from the fungus, Aspergillus fumigatus, it exhibits inhibitory activity against acyl-CoA:cholesterol acyltransferase 2.

name: pyripyropene K
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that consists of a heterotetracyclic system linked to a pyridine moiety. Isolated from the fungus, Aspergillus fumigatus, it exhibits inhibitory activity against acyl-CoA:cholesterol acyltransferase 2.

name: pyripyropene L
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that consists of a heterotetracyclic system linked to a pyridine moiety. Isolated from the fungus, Aspergillus fumigatus, it exhibits inhibitory activity against acyl-CoA:cholesterol acyltransferase 2.

name: oblonganoside A
definition: A triterpenoid saponin thatr is the β-D-glucopyranosyl ester of 3,23-O-hydroxyethylidene-3β,23-dihydroxyurs-12,19(20)-dien-28-oic acid. Isolated from Ilex oblonga, it exhibits activity against TMV.

name: obochalcolactone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones isolated from the trunk barks of Cryptocarya obovata and has been shown to exhibit cytotoxicity against the KB cell line.

name: obolactone
definition: A pyranone isolated from the trunk barks of Cryptocarya obovata and has been shown to exhibit cytotoxicity against the KB cell line.

name: obtusafuran
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5, a methoxy group at position 6, a methyl group at position 3 and a phenyl group at position 2. Isolated from Dalbergia louveli, it exhibits antiplasmodial activity.

name: obyanamide
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide isolated from Lyngbya confervoides and has been shown to exhibit antineoplastic activity.

name: oceanalin A
definition: A glycosphingolipid isolated from a marine sponge Oceanapia sp. that exhibits antifungal activity against fluconazole-resistant yeast Candida glabrata with an MIC value of 30 μg/ml.

name: ochracenomicin A
definition: An angucycline antibiotic that is 3,4,4a,12b-tetrahydrotetraphene-1,7,12(2H)-trione substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4a, 8 and 12b and a methyl group at position 3. It is isolated from the culture broth of Amycolatopsis sp.MJ950-89F4 and exhibits a broad spectrum of antibacterial potential.

name: ochrocarpinone A
definition: A β-diketone isolated from Ochrocarpos punctatus and has been shown to exhibit antineoplastic activity.

name: ochrocarpinone B
definition: A β-diketone isolated from Ochrocarpos punctatus and has been shown to exhibit antineoplastic activity.

name: ochrocarpinone C
definition: A β-diketone isolated from Ochrocarpos punctatus and has been shown to exhibit antineoplastic activity.

name: ochrocarpin A
definition: A furanocoumarin that is 2H-furo[2,3-h]chromen-2-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5, 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl group at position 8, a 2-methylbutanoyl group at position 6 and a phenyl group at position 4. Isolated from the bark of Ochrocarpos punctatus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against the A2780 ovarian cancer cell line.

name: ochrocarpin B
definition: A furanocoumarin that is 2H-furo[2,3-h]chromen-2-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5, 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl group at position 8, a 3-methylbutanoyl group at position 6 and a phenyl group at position 4. Isolated from the bark of Ochrocarpos punctatus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against the A2780 ovarian cancer cell line.

name: ochrocarpin C
definition: A furanocoumarin that is 2H-furo[2,3-h]chromen-2-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5, 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl group at position 8, a 2-methylpropanoyl group at position 6 and a phenyl group at position 4. Isolated from the bark of Ochrocarpos punctatus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against the A2780 ovarian cancer cell line.

name: ochrocarpin D
definition: A furanocoumarin that is 2H-furo[2,3-h]chromen-2-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5, 2-methoxypropan-2-yl group at position 8, a 2-methylbutanoyl group at position 6 and a phenyl group at position 4. Isolated from the bark of Ochrocarpos punctatus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against the A2780 ovarian cancer cell line.

name: ochrocarpin E
definition: A furanocoumarin that is 2,3-dihydro-7H-furo[2,3-f]chromen-7-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4, a 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl group at position 2, a 2-methylpropanoyl group at position 5 and a phenyl group at position 9. Isolated from the bark of Ochrocarpos punctatus, it exhibits cytotoxicity against the A2780 ovarian cancer cell line.

name: oleanolic acid 3-O-[O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→4)-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-O-α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-L-arabinopyranoside]
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is the tetrasaccharide derivative of oleanolic acid. Isolated from the roots of Pulsatilla chinensis, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: oleoyl danshenxinkun A
definition: A diterpenoid with a fatty acyl side chain isolated from Salvia miltiorrhiza and has been shown to inhibit platelet aggregation induced by arachidonic acid.

name: oleoyl neocryptotanshinone
definition: A diterpenoid with a fatty acyl side chain isolated from Salvia miltiorrhiza and has been shown to inhibit platelet aggregation induced by arachidonic acid.

name: onosmin A
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is anthranilic acid in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a 4-methylbenzyl group. Isolated from Onosma hispida, it exhibits inhibitory activity against lipoxygenase.

name: onosmin B
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by the fromal condensation of the carboxy group of onosmin A with methanol. Isolated from Onosma hispida, it exhibits inhibitory activity against lipoxygenase.

name: ophioglonin
definition: A homoflavonoid that is isochromeno[4,3-b]chromen-7(5H)-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4, 8 and 10. Isolated from Ophioglossum petiolatum, it exhibits anti-HBV activity.

name: orbiculin A
definition: A dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid that consists of dihydro-β-agarofuran substituted by an acetoxy groups at positions 1 and 2 and benzoyloxy groups at positions 6 and 9 (the 1β,2β,6α,9α stereoisomer). Isolated from Celastrus orbiculatus, it exhibits inhibition of both NF-κB activation and nitric oxide production.

name: orbiculin D
definition: A dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid that consists of dihydro-β-agarofuran substituted by acetoxy group at position 1 and furoyloxy groups at positions 6 and 9 (the 1β,6α,9α stereoisomer). Isolated from Celastrus orbiculatus, it exhibits inhibition of both NF-κB activation and nitric oxide production.

name: orbiculin E
definition: A dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid that consists of dihydro-β-agarofuran substituted by acetoxy group at positions 1 and 2, a benzoyloxy group at position 9 and furoyloxy groups at position 6 (the 1β,2β,9α,6α). Isolated from Celastrus orbiculatus, it exhibits inhibition of both NF-κB activation and nitric oxide production.

name: orbiculin F
definition: A dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid that consists of dihydro-β-agarofuran substituted by acetoxy group at position 1, benzoyloxy group at position 9 and furoyloxy groups at positions 2 and 6 (the 1β,9α,2β,6α stereoisomer). Isolated from Celastrus orbiculatus, it exhibits inhibition of both NF-κB activation and nitric oxide production.

name: orbiculin G
definition: A dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid that consists of dihydro-β-agarofuran substituted by an acetoxy group at position 1 and benzoyloxy groups at positions 2, 6 and 9 (the 1β,2β,6α,9α stereoisomers). Isolated from the roots of Celastrus orbiculatus and Microtropis fokienensis and exhibits cytotoxic and antitubercular properties.

name: orbiculin H
definition: A dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid that consists of dihydro-β-agarofuran substituted by acetoxy groups at positions 1 and 8 and furoyloxy groups at positions 6 and 9 (the 1β,8β,6α,9α stereoisomer). Isolated from Celastrus orbiculatus and exhibits inhibition of both NF-κB activation and nitric oxide production.

name: orbiculin I
definition: A dihydroagarofuran sesquiterpenoid that consists of dihydro-β-agarofuran substituted by an acetoxy group at position 1 and furoyloxy groups at positions 2, 6 and 9 (the 1β,2β,6α,9α stereoisomer). Isolated from Celastrus orbiculatus, it exhibits inhibition of both NF-κB activation and nitric oxide production.

name: oriciacridone C
definition: An alkaloid of the class of acridone derivatives that is 1,11-dihydrofuro[2,3-c]acridin-6(2H)-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 10 and a prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 2. Isolated from Oriciopsis glaberrima, it exhibits radical scavenging and α-glucosidase inhibitory activity.

name: oriciacridone F
definition: An alkaloid of the class of acridone derivatives isolated from Oriciopsis glaberrima and has been shown to exhibit radical scavenging and α-glucosidase inhibitory activity.

name: oryzafuran
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 1-benzofuran substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 6, a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 2 and a methoxy carbonyl at position 3. Isolated from black colored rice bran of Oryza sativa, it exhibits antioxidant activity.

name: 7-oxo-10α-cucurbitadienol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is the 7-oxo derivative of cucurbitadienol. Isolated from Trichosanthes kirilowii, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: 7-oxo-3,8,9-trihydroxy staurosporine
definition: A indolocarbazole alkaloid that is staurosporine substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 8 and 9 and an oxo group at position 7. Isolated from Cystodytes solitus, it exhibits cytotoxic activity.

name: 7-oxo-8,9-dihydroxy-4'-N-demethyl staurosporine
definition: A indolocarbazole alkaloid that is 4'-N-demethyl staurosporine substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 8 and 9 and an xo group at position 7. Isolated from Cystodytes solitus, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: 7-oxohernangerine
definition: An oxoaporphine alkaloid that is 7H-dibenzo[de,g]quinolin-7-one substituted by a methylenedioxy group across positions 1 and 2, a methoxy group at position 11 and a hydroxy group at position 10. Isolated from Hernandia nymphaeifolia and Lindera chunii, it exhibits activity against HIV-1 integrase.

name: 18-oxotryprostatin A
definition: An indole alkaloid that is tryprostatin A substituted by an oxo substituent at position 18. Isolated from Aspergillus sydowii, it exhibits cytotoxicity.

name: oxypeucedanin hydrate acetonide
definition: A furanocoumarin that is 7H-furo[3,2-g]chromen-7-one substituted by a (2,2,5,5-tetramethyl-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl)methoxy moiety at position 4. Isolated from Peucedanum turcomanicum and Angelica dahurica, it exhibits cytotoxic activity.

name: lorcaserin hydrochloride hemihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hemihydrate form of lorcaserin hydrochloride. Used as an anti-obesity drug.

name: trans,polycis-decaprenyl phosphate
definition: A polyprenol phosphate having ten prenyl units in the chain (the 2Z,6Z,10Z,14Z,18Z,22Z,26Z,30Z,34E-isomer)

name: carboxyspermidine
definition: An L-α-amino acid that is spermidine (1,5,10-triazadecane) carboxylated with S-configuration at the 2-position.

name: tris acetate
definition: An acetate salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of tris and acetic acid.

name: sodium dithionite
definition: An inorganic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of dithionous acid.

name: ammonium fluoride
definition: A fluoride salt having ammonium (NH4+) as the counterion.

name: potassium fluoride
definition: A fluoride salt having K+ as the counterion.

name: carnosinate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of carnosine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: α-D-GalpN-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide consisting of D-galactose having an α-L-fucosyl residue at the 2-position and an α-D-galactosaminyl residue at the 3-position.

name: avanafil
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(3-chloro-4-methoxybenzyl)amino]-2-[(2S)-2-(hydroxymethyl)pyrrolidin-1-yl]pyrimidine-5-carboxylic acid with the amino group of pyrimidin-2-ylmethylamine. Used for treatment of erectile dysfunction.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: A linear trisaccharide comprised of mannose, rhamnose and galactose residues linked α(1→4) and α(1→3), respectively, with α configuration at the anomeric centre of the galactose residue.

name: pseudooxynicotinium(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of pseudooxynicotine, obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-oxo-4-(pyridin-3-yl)butanal
definition: A member of the class of butanals that is succinic semialdehyde in which the hydroxy group of the carboxylic acid function is replaced by a pyridin-3-yl group.

name: florbetapir F-18
definition: An aromatic ether consisting of a pyridine ring substituted at position 2 by a 2-{2-[2-(18F)fluoroethoxy]ethoxy}ethoxy group and at position 5 and a 2-(4-methylaminophenyl)vinyl group. A positron emission tomography imaging ligand for the detection of amyloid aggregation associated with Alzheimer disease.

name: trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-ribofuranose(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-ribofuranose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-(methylamino)butyric acid zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of 4-(methylamino)butyric acid.

name: α-Tyvp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide comprised of tyvelose, mannose, rhamnose and galactose residues linked α(1→3, α(1→4) and α(1→3), respectively, with α configuration at the anomeric centre of the galactose residue.

name: [3)-α-D-Galp-(1→2)-[α-Tyvp-(1→3)]-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→]3
definition: An oligosaccharide of 12 residues, comprising three (1→3)-linked α-D-Gal-(1→2)-[α-Tyv-(1→3)]-α-D-Man-(1→4)-α-L-Rha units.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate(2−)
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioate having (2Z,4E)-configuration.

name: (2Z,4E,7E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4,7-trienedioate(2−)
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4,7-trienedioate having (2Z,4E,7E)-configuration.

name: α-Parp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: A tetrasaccharide comprising paratose, D-mannose, L-rhamnose and D-galactose residues linked α(1→3), α(1→4) and α(1→3) respectively.

name: 5-nitro-o-toluidine
definition: A C-nitro compound in which the nitro compound is meta to the amino group and para to the methyl group of o-toluidine.

name: o-toluidine
definition: An aminotoluene in which the amino substituent is ortho to the methyl group.

name: 4-(6-hydroxypyridin-3-yl)-4-oxobutyrate
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 4-(6-hydroxypyridin-3-yl)-4-oxobutyric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-5-oxo-1,2-campholide
definition: An optically active 5-oxo-1,2-campholide having (+)-(1S,5S)-configuration.

name: (3R)-11-cis-3-hydroxyretinal
definition: A retinal that is 11-cis-retinal substituted at position 3 on the cyclohexenyl ring by a hydroxy group (the R-enantiomer).

name: tafluprost
definition: A prostaglandin Fα that is prostaglandin F2α in which the carboxylic acid function has been converted to the corresponding isopropyl ester and the 3-hydroxy-1-octenyl side-chain is substituted by 3,3-difluoro-4-phenoxybut-1-enyl. Used for treatment of elevated intraocular pressure in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension.

name: ivacaftor
definition: An aromatic amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 5-amino-2,4-di-tert-butylphenol. Used for the treatment of cystic fibrosis.

name: vismodegib
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid and the anilino group of 4-chloro-3-(pyridin-2-yl)aniline. Used for the treatment metastatic basal cell carcinoma.

name: 2',3,4,4',6'-pentahydroxychalcone 4'-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside in which a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue is attached at position 4' of 2',3,4,4',6'-pentahydroxychalcone via a glycosidic linkage.

name: aureusidin 6-O-β-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside in which a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue is attached at position 6 of aureusidin via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 2',4,4',6'-tetrahydroxychalcone 4'-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside in which a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue is attached at position 4' of 2',4,4',6'-tetrahydroxychalcone via a glycosidic linkage.

name: bracteatin 6-O-β-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside in which a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue is attached at position 6 of bracteatin via a glycosidic linkage.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-L-Rhap
definition: A glycosylrhamnose consisting of L-rhamnose having an α-D-glucosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: axitinib
definition: An indazole substituted at position 3 by a 2-(pyridin-2-yl)vinyl group and at position 6 by a 2-(N-methylaminocarboxy)phenylsulfanyl group. Used for the treatment of advanced renal cell carcinoma after failure of a first line systemic treatment.

name: α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-1-diphosphodecaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-1-diphosphodecaprenol.

name: α-D-abequosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-1-diphosphodecaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of α-D-abequosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-1-diphosphodecaprenol.

name: ingenol mebutate
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2Z)-2-methylbut-2-enoic (angelic) acid with the 3-hydroxy group of ingenol. Used for the topical treatment of actinic keratosis.

name: UDP-α-D-galactose(2−)
definition: A UDP-D-galactose(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the galactose moiety has α-configuration.

name: UDP-α-D-galactofuranose(2−)
definition: A UDP-D-galactofuranose(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the galactofuranose moiety has α-configuration.

name: alanine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of alanine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ruxolitinib phosphate
definition: A phosphate salt obtained by reaction ruxolitinib with one equivalent of phosphoric acid. Used for the treatment of patients with intermediate or high-risk myelofibrosis, including primary myelofibrosis, post-polycythemia vera myelofibrosis and post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis.

name: ergosta-5,7-dien-3β-ol
definition: A phytosterol consiting of ergostane having double bonds at the 5,6- and 7,8-positions as well as a 3β-hydroxy group.

name: ruxolitinib
definition: A pyrazole substituted at position 1 by a 2-cyano-1-cyclopentylethyl group and at position 3 by a pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-yl group. Used as the phosphate salt for the treatment of patients with intermediate or high-risk myelofibrosis, including primary myelofibrosis, post-polycythemia vera myelofibrosis and post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis.

name: 2-nitro-p-toluidine
definition: A C-nitro compound in which the nitro compound is ortho to the amino group and meta to the methyl group of p-toluidine.

name: citrullinate
definition: An α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of citrulline, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (2-nitrophenoxy)acetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid comprising acetic acid substituted at the α carbon with a 2-nitrophenoxy group.

name: creatinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of creatine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 2-amino-5-nitrobenzenesulfonic acid
definition: The arenesulfonic acid that is benzenesulfonic acid substituted at the ortho position by an amino group and at the para posiion

name: 4-nitrobenzaldehyde
definition: A C-nitro compound that is benzaldehyde substituted at the para-position with a nitro group.

name: 2-nitrobenzaldehyde
definition: Benzaldehyde substituted at the ortho-position with a nitro group.

name: 4-nitrobenzohydrazide
definition: A C-nitro compound in which the nitro group is substituted into the 4-position of benzohydrazide.

name: trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-ribofuranose
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of β-D-ribose attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate.

name: 4-(4-nitrophenylazo)resorcinol
definition: An azobenzene in which the phenyl rings are 4-nitro- and 2,4-dihydroxy-substituted respectively.

name: 4-nitrophenylhydrazine
definition: A member of the class of phenylhydrazines that is phenylhydrazine substituted at the 4-position by a nitro group.

name: 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine
definition: A C-nitro compound that is phenylhydrazine substituted at the 2- and 4-positions by nitro groups.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienedioic acid having (2Z,4E)-configuration.

name: trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-ribofuranose 5-phosphate(3−)
definition: Needed for the new reaction: trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate = trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-beta-D-ribofuranose 5-phosphate + diphosphate

name: (2Z,4E,7E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4,7-trienedioic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4,7-trienedioic acid having (2Z,4E,7E)-configuration.

name: fructosylglycinate
definition: A glyco-amino-acid anion formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy group of fructosylglycine.

name: ecgononium methyl ester(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of ecgonone methyl ester arising from protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-oxo-4-(pyridin-3-yl)butanoate
definition: A carboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of 4-oxo-4-(pyridin-3-yl)butanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,4Z)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate having (2E,4Z)-configuration.

name: 2,6-dihydroxypseudooxynicotinium(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 2,6-dihydroxypseudooxynicotine, obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-nitro-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienedioate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 4-nitro-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-(6-hydroxypyridin-3-yl)-4-oxobutyric acid
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is succinic acid in which one of the carboxyl hydroxy groups is substituted by a 6-hydroxypyridin-3-yl group.

name: (2E,4Z)-4-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate
definition: A 6-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (2E,4Z)-4-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: isoglutamate(1−)
definition: A β-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of isoglutamic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups and protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: olivetolate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of olivetolic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-oxo-4-(pyridin-3-yl)butanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is succinic acid in which the hydroxy group of one of the carboxy groups is replaced by a pyridin-3-yl group. A byproduct of tobacco-specific N-nitrosamines generated by cytochrome P-450 which catalyzes methylnitrosaminopyridylbutanone hydroxylation, this nicotine metabolite is commonly found in the urine of smokers.

name: homocysteinate
definition: An α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of homocysteine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 5-oxo-1,2-campholide
definition: A bridged compound that is 1,2-campholide substituted at position 5 by an oxo group.

name: olivetolic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is salicylic acid in which the hydrogens ortho- and para- to the carboxy group are replaced by a pentyl and a hydroxy group, respectively.

name: 3,5,7-trioxododecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3,5,7-trioxododecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-pentylpyran-2-one
definition: A pyranone that is 2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 4 and 6 are substituted by hydroxy and pentyl groups respectively.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(2-oxoheptyl)pyran-2-one
definition: A pyranone that is 2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 4 and 6 are substituted by hydroxy and 2-oxoheptyl groups respectively.

name: olivetol
definition: A member of the class of resorcinols that is resorcinol in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by a pentyl group.

name: cannabinerolate
definition: A dihydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of cannabinerolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: cannabigerolate
definition: A dihydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of cannabigerolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinolate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol
definition: A diterpenoid that is 6a,7,8,10a-tetrahydro-6H-benzo[c]chromene substituted at position 1 by a hydroxy group, positions 6, 6 and 9 by methyl groups and at position 3 by a pentyl group. The principal psychoactive constituent of the cannabis plant, it is used for treatment of anorexia associated with AIDS as well as nausea and vomiting associated with cancer chemotherapy.

name: mycophenolic acid O-acyl-glucuronide(1−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion that is the conjugate base of mycophenolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(2-hydroxydocosanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-2-hydroxydocosanoyl derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(docosanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-docosanoyl derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(docosanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-docosanoyl derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxydocosanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxydocosanoyl) derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-(tetracosanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-tetracosanoyl derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxytetracosanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxytetracosanoyl) derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(tetracosanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-tetracosanoyl derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxytetracosanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxytetracosanoyl) derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-hexacosanoylicosasphinganine
definition: A C20 dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexacosanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl) derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl) derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-(eicosanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-eicosanoyl derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxyeicosanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxyeicosanoyl) derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(eicosanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-eicosanoyl derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: hypusinate
definition: A L-α-amino acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group of hypusine.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-Neup5Ac-(2→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine having a β-D-galactosyl residue attached at the 3-position and a β-N-acetylneuraminosyl residue attached at the 6-position.

name: N-(2-hydroxyeicosanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxyeicosanoyl) derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-(octadecanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-stearoyl (octadecanoyl) derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxyoctadecanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxyoctadecanoyl) derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(octadecanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-stearoyl (octadecanoyl) derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxyoctadecanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxyoctadecanoyl) derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: kynureninate
definition: An α-amino-acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group of kynurenine.

name: S-adenosyl-L-homocysteinate
definition: A L-α-amino acid anion obtained by deprotonation of S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine.

name: L-kynureninate
definition: A L-α-amino acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group of L-kynurenine .

name: L-dopa(1−)
definition: A L-α-amino acid anion which is the conjugate base of L-dopa, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group: major species at pH 7.3.

name: Nω-methyl-L-argininate
definition: A L-α-amino acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of Nω-methyl-L-arginine.

name: N-(hexadecanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl)eicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl) derivative of eicosasphinganine.

name: N-(hexadecanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A ceramide that is the N-(2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl) derivative of 4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine.

name: N-docosanoylsphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as docosanoyl (behenoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxydocosanoyl)sphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxydocosanoyl.

name: N-docosanoyl-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as docosanoyl (behenoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxydocosanoyl)-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxydocosanoyl.

name: lipoxin A4(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy function of lipoxin A4: major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-eicosanoylsphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as eicosanoyl

name: N-(2-hydroxyeicosanoyl)sphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyeicosanoyl.

name: N-eicosanoyl-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as eicosanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxyeicosanoyl)-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyeicosanoyl.

name: lipoxin B4(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group of lipoxin B4: major species at pH 7.3.

name: O-phosphonatooxyserine(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the dianionic form of O-phosphoserine having anionic phosphate and carboxy functions and a protonated amino group.

name: N-octodecanoylsphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxyoctadecanoyl)sphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyoctadecanoyl.

name: N-octadecanoyl-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl).

name: O-(N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphonatooxy)-L-serine(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy and phospho groups and protonation of the amino group of O-(N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphoryl)-L-serine: major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-octopine(1−)
definition: An D-α-amino acid anion arising from deprotonation of the carboxy groups and protonation of the guanidino group of D-octopine.

name: S-adenosyl-L-methioninate
definition: A sulfonium betaine that is a conjugate base of S-adenosyl-L-methionine obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: N-(2-hydroxyoctadecanoyl)-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyoctadecanoyl

name: N-hexadecanoylsphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl)sphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl)-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl

name: N-tetradecanoylsphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tetradecanoyl (myristoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxytetradecanoyl)sphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytetradecanoyl.

name: N-tetradecanoyl-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tetradecanoyl (myristoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxytetradecanoyl)-4-hydroxysphinganine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytetradecanoyl.

name: Nα,Nα,Nα-trimethyl-L-histidinium(1+)
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion obtained by the protonation of the carboxy function of Nα,Nα,Nα-trimethyl-L-histidine.

name: S-methyl-L-methioninate
definition: A sulfonium betaine that is a conjugate base of S-methyl-L-methionine obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: glyphosate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy and one of the phosphate OH groups of glyphosate.

name: Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinolic acid
definition: A diterpenoid that is 6a,7,8,10a-tetrahydro-6H-benzo[c]chromene substituted at position 1 by a hydroxy group, positions 6, 6 and 9 by methyl groups and at position 3 by a pentyl group. A biosynthetic precursor to Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol, the principal psychoactive constituent of the cannabis plant.

name: cannabinerolic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid that is olivetolic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a neryl group. A biosynthetic precursor to Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol, the principal psychoactive constituent of the cannabis plant.

name: cannabigerolic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid that is olivetolic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a geranyl group. A biosynthetic precursor to Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol, the principal psychoactive constituent of the cannabis plant.

name: 3,5,7-trioxododecanoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3,5,7-trioxododecanoic acid.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide that consists of the linear trisaccharide α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine in which an α-L-fucosyl residue is attached at position 3 of the glucoamine.

name: heptane-1,2,3-triol
definition: A triol comprising heptane substituted with hydroxy groups at C-1, -2 and -3.

name: ytterbium(III) chloride
definition: The trichloride salt of ytterbium(III).

name: decyl β-D-maltopyranoside
definition: A glycoside resulting from attachment of a decyl group to the reducing-end anomeric centre of a β-maltose molecule.

name: tris phosphate
definition: A phosphate salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of tris and phosphoric acid.

name: potassium 2-(N-morpholino)ethanesulfonate
definition: The organic potassium salt that is the potassium salt of 2-(N-morpholino)ethanesulfonic acid.

name: tris maleate
definition: A maleate salt resulting from the reaction of tris and maleic acid in the molar ratio tris:maleic acid = 2:1.

name: pentaerythritol propoxylate (5/4 PO/OH)
definition: A hydroxypolyether in which a hydroxy-poly(propylene oxide) chain is connected to each of the methyl groups of neopentane. It is commonly used to crystallise proteins. In the diagram, a + b + c + d ~ 5.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucose,N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues joined in sequence by (1→3)- and (1→4)-linkages respectively.

name: (2E,4Z)-4-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A muconic semialdehyde that is hexa-2,4-dienoic acid substituted at positions 4 and 6 by hydroxy and oxo groups respectively (the 2E,4Z-isomer).

name: 4-nitro-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienedioic acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid that is 6-oxohepta-2,4-dienedioic acid substituted at position 4 by a nitro group.

name: 1-deoxysphinganine
definition: A bioactive sphingoid, sphinganine, in which the terminal hydroxy group has been replaced by a hydrogen.

name: dimethylmyleran
definition: A methanesulfonate ester that is hexane-2,5-diol in which the hydrogens of the hydroxy groups are replaced by methanesulfonyl groups.

name: 1-deoxymethylsphinganine(1+)
definition: A cationic sphingoid obtained by the protonation of the amino group of 1-deoxymethylsphinganine.

name: 1-deoxysphinganine(1+)
definition: A cationic sphingoid obtained by protonation of the amino group of 1-deoxysphinganine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,4Z)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid having (2E,4Z)-configuration.

name: chlorantraniliprole
definition: A carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of 3-bromo-1-(3-chloropyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-5-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 2-amino-5-chloro-N,3-dimethylbenzamide. The first of the anthranilic diamide insecticides, it is a ryanodine receptor activator and is used to protect a wide variety of crops, including corn, cotton, grapes, rice and potatoes.

name: ecgonone methyl ester
definition: The methyl ester of (1R,2R,5S)-8-methyl-3-oxo-8-azabicyclo[3.2.1]octane-2-carboxylic acid (ecgonone).

name: 4-nitro-1,2-phenylenediamine
definition: The primary amino compound that is 1,2-phenylenediamine (o-phenylenediamine) substituted at the 4- (para-) position by a nitro group.

name: trans,octacis-decaprenylphospho-β-D-ribofuranose 5-phosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of β-D-ribose-5-phosphate attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate via a glycosyl phosphate linkage.

name: UDP-α-D-galactofuranose
definition: A UDP-D-galactofuranose in which the anomeric centre of the galactofuranose moiety has α-configuration.

name: UDP-α-D-galactose
definition: A UDP-D-galactose in which the anomeric centre of the galactose moiety has α-configuration.

name: 4-nitrotoluene-2-sulfonic acid
definition: The arenesulfonic acid that is toluene-2-sulfonic acid bearing a nitro substituent at C-4.

name: nitroxoline
definition: A monohydroxyquinoline in which the hydroxy group is positioned at C-8 with a nitro group trans to it at C-5.

name: α-D-abequosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-1-diphosphodecaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of α-D-abequosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactose attached at the 1-position to decaprenyl phosphate.

name: 1-iodo-3-nitrobenzene
definition: A C-nitro compound that is nitrobenzene bearing an iodine substituent at C-3.

name: α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-1-diphosphodecaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactose attached at the 1-position to decaprenyl phosphate.

name: 2-acetyl-1-pyrroline
definition: A pyrroline that is 1-pyrroline in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by an acetyl group. It is an aroma and flavour compound present in jasmine rice and basmati rice. It is responsible for the 'popcorn' aroma in a large variety of cereal and food products. It is one of the key odourants of the crust of bread and considered to be responsible for the cracker-like odour properties. In bread, it is primarily generated during baking but amounts are influenced by ingredient composition and fermentation conditions.

name: 2,2'-dinitrobiphenyl
definition: Biphenyl substituted with nitro groups at the 2- and 2'-positions.

name: 2,4-dinitro-1-naphthol
definition: A naphthol in which the hydroxy substituent is at C-1 with nitro groups at C-2 and -4.

name: phenetole
definition: An aromatic ether in which the ether oxygen is bonded to an ethyl and a phenyl group.

name: 2,4-dinitrophenetole
definition: An aromatic ether comprised of phenetole substituted at C-2 and C-4 by nitro groups.

name: ditrans,polycis-polyprenol
definition: A polyprenol in which all linkages of the isoprene units are cis, except for the two furthest from the hydroxy group which are trans.

name: UDP-2-acetamido-4-azaniumyl-2,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of UDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine.

name: UDP-N,N'-diacetylbacillosamine(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of UDP-N,N'-diacetylbacillosamine, having an anionic diphosphate function; major microspecies present at pH 7.3.

name: 2-nitroimidazole
definition: An imidazole that is 1H-imidazole substituted at position 2 by a nitro group.

name: cannabidiolate
definition: A dihydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of cannabidiolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine(2−)
definition: A UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the galactosamine moiety has α-configuration; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate(2−)
definition: The dicarboxylic acid dianion formed from (2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinic acid by proton loss from both carboxy groups; major species present at pH 7.3.

name: hycanthone(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of lycanthone.

name: pppA2'p5'A2'p5'A
definition: An oligonucleotide comprised of three adenosine residues linked 2'→5' and with a triphosphate group at the 5' terminus.

name: 2-(morpholin-4-yl)ethanol
definition: A primary alcohol that is ethanol in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a morpholin-4-yl group.

name: fumigaclavine A(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion obtained by the protonation of the tertiary amino group of fumigaclavine A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: fumigaclavine B(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion obtained by the protonation of the tertiary amino group of the fumigaclavine B; major species pH 7.3.

name: fumigaclavine C(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion obtained by the protonation of the tertiary amino group of fumigaclavine C; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA(4−)
