definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) that is the tetraanion of 2-hydroxybenzoyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2Z)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate
definition: A 2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate in which the double bond between positions 2 and 3 has Z- (trans-) geometry.

name: (+)-larreatricin
definition: An antiviral lignan isolated from the creosote bush, Larrea tridentata, which consists of a 3,4-dimethyltetrahydrofuran skeleton substituted by 4-hydroxyphenyl groups at positions 2 and 5 (the 2R,3R,4S,5R stereoisomer).

name: (+)-3'-hydroxylarreatricin
definition: An antiviral lignan isolated from Larrea tridentata, which consists of a 3,4-dimethyltetrahydrofuran skeleton substituted by a dihydroxybenzyl and hydroxyphenyl groups at position 2 and 5 respectively (the 2R,3S,4R,5R stereoisomer).

name: mycophenolate sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the sodium salt of mycophenolic acid. An immunosuppressant, it is widely used to prevent tissue rejection following organ transplants and for the treatment of certain autoimmune diseases.

name: fumigaclavine B
definition: An ergot alkaloid produced by the fungus Aspergillus fumigatus that consists of ergoline substituted by two methyl groups at the 6 and 8β positions, and by a hydroxy group at the 9β position.

name: α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide comprising 4 fucose, 2 galactose, 4 N-acetyl glucosamine and 3 mannose residues arranged as two α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man brached chains linked (1→3) and (1→6)to a β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc trisaccaride chain.

name: (R)-3-ammonio-3-phenylpropanoate
definition: An optically active form of 3-ammonio-3-phenylpropanoate having (R)-configuration.

name: fumigaclavine A
definition: An ergot alkaloid produced by the fungus Aspergillus fumigatus that is ergoline which is substituted by methyl groups at the 6 and 8β positions, and by an acetoxy group at the 9β position.

name: α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of three repeating units of β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc joined by (1→3)-linkages with an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at the 2-position of the galactose residue at the non-reducing end.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp6S
definition: A linear trisaccharide derivative that consists of α-L-fucose, β-D-galactose and 6-sulfated D-glucose units connected in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) links, respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino trisaccharide in which an α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-D-galactosyl unit is linked (1→4) to a 6-sulfated N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear heptasaccharide derivative comprising a fucose residue linked α(1→2) to a chain of three β(1→3)-linked galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetylglucosamine units.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising one fucose, two galactose and two glucosamine residues, one of which is at the reducing end.

name: α-L-Fuc-(1→3)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative that is an undecasaccharide in which two tetrasaccharide branches, each formed from α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose, are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose and two N-acetylglucosamine residues all linked β(1→4) with a β-configuration of the anomeric carbon of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: β-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a β-L-fucosyl residue attached to N-acetyl-β-Dglucosamine by a (1→3)-glycosidic linkage.

name: α-L-fucosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of an α-L-fucosyl residue attached to N-acetyl-β-Dglucosamine by a (1→4)-glycosidic linkage.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine
definition: A UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine in which the anomeric centre of the galactosamine moiety has α-configuration.

name: cortistatin A
definition: A member of the class of cortistatins that is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 2, a dimethylamino group at the 3α position and an isoquinolin-7-yl group at the 17 position, with double bonds at the 9-11 and 10-19 positions (the 1R,2R,17β enantiomer).

name: (R)-3-amino-3-phenylpropanoic acid
definition: An optically active form of 3-amino-3-phenylpropanoic acid having R-configuration.

name: cortistatin B
definition: A member of the class of cortistatins that is cortistatin A in which the hydrogen at the 16β position has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: cortistatin C
definition: A member of the class of cortistatins that is cortistatin A in which the hydrogens at position 16 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: cortistatin D
definition: A member of the class of cortistatins that is cortistatin C in which the hydrogen at position 17 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 1-deoxy-3-dehydrosphinganine
definition: A sphingoid consisting of 3-dehydrosphinganine in which the terminal hydroxy group is replaced by a hydrogen.

name: 1-deoxymethyl-3-dehydrosphinganine(1+)
definition: A cationic sphingoid obtained by the protonation of the amino group of 1-deoxymethyl-3-dehydrosphinganine.

name: UDP-N,N'-diacetylbacillosamine
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having 2,4-diacetamido-2,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucopyranose as the amino sugar component.

name: cortistatin E
definition: A member of the class of cortistatins that is substituted by a dimethylamino group at the 3α position and a (2R)-4-(1,3-dimethylpiperidin-4-yl)butan-2-yl group at the 17 position, with double bonds at the 1-10 and 9-19 positions (the 3R,5R,17β enantiomer).

name: sporulenol
definition: A pentacyclic sesquarterpene isolated from Bacillus subtilis and formed by cyclisation of (R)-tetraprenyl-β-curcumene (CHEBI:64801).

name: pyochelin I
definition: A pyochelin that has R-stereochemistry at the thioaminal centre; the diastereoisomer with S-stereochemistry at this centre is pyochelin II. Pseudomonas aeruginosa produces a mixture of pyochelin I (major) and pyochelin II (minor) via condensation of salicylic acid and two molecules of cysteine. The enantiomeric compounds, enant-pyochelin I and II, are produced by Pseudomonas fluorescens.

name: pyochelin II
definition: A pyochelin that has S-stereochemistry at the thioaminal centre; the diastereoisomer with R-stereochemistry at this centre is pyochelin I. Pseudomonas aeruginosa produces a mixture of pyochelin I (major) and pyochelin I (minor) via condensation of salicylic acid and two molecules of cysteine. The enantiomeric compounds, enant-pyochelin I and II, are produced by Pseudomonas fluorescens.

name: 1-deoxymethyl-3-dehydrosphinganine
definition: A sphingoid which is the 1-deoxymethylated derivative of 3-dehydrosphinganine.

name: 1-deoxymethylsphinganine
definition: A bioactive sphingoid which is the 1-deoxymethyl derivative of sphinganine.

name: 9-cis-β-carotene
definition: A carotenoid having the structure of β-carotene but with a cis double bond at the 9,10-position.

name: carlactone
definition: A γ-lactone that is furan-2(5H)-one which is substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and by a [(1Z,3E)-2-methyl-4-(2,6,6-trimethylcyclohex-1-en-1-yl)buta-1,3-dien-1-yl]oxy group at position 5.

name: (2E,4E,6E)-7-hydroxy-4-methylhepta-2,4,6-trienal
definition: A hydroxyaldehyde in which the hydroxy group is at C-7 of (2E,4E,6E)-4-methylhepta-2,4,6-trienal.

name: 9-cis-10'-apo-β-carotenal
definition: An enal that is the 9-cis-isomer of 10'-apo-β-carotenal.

name: 4-methylheptane
definition: A branched C8 alkane, comprising heptane with a methyl group attached at C-4. It has been found in Amaranth seeds.

name: N,N'-(p-xylylidene)bis(aminoguanidine) dihydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of N,N'-(p-xylylidene)bis(aminoguanidine) [ratio HCl : N,N'-(p-xylylidene)bis(aminoguanidine) = 2:1].

name: N,N'-(p-xylylidene)bis(aminoguanidine)
definition: A guanidine derivative comprised of two carbamimidamido (guanidino) groups, each linked via one of their amino nitrogens to the imino nitrogens of 1,4-phenylenedimethanimine.

name: carboxynorspermidine
definition: The non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is norspermidine (1,5,9-triazanonane) carboxylated with S-configuration at the 2-position.

name: (2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinic acid
definition: The dicarboxylic acid that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinic acid hydroxylated at C-4 and with configuration 2S,4S.

name: geranyl acetone
definition: A monoterpene ketone in which an (E)-geranyl group is bonded to one of the α-methyls of acetone. It is a component of essential oils from various plants including Nelumbo nucifera.

name: pseudoionone
definition: A terpene ketone derived from ring cleavage of the apo carotenoid β-ionone.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→6)]14-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of [β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→6)]14-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxyneamine(3+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the three amino groups of 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxyneamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxy-6'-dehydroparomamine(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the two amino groups of 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxy-6'-dehydroparomamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-{4-[(2-hydroxyethyl)carbamoyl]benzyl}-1-methylpiperidinium
definition: Benzamide substituted on nitrogen by a 2-hydroxyethyl group and at the 4-position by an (N-methylpiperidinio)methyl group.

name: 1-{4-[(2-hydroxyethyl)carbamoyl]benzyl}-1-methylpiperidinium chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt in which the cationic component is 1-{4-[(2-hydroxyethyl)carbamoyl]benzyl}-1-methylpiperidinium.

name: conduritol
definition: A tetrol that is cyclohexene in which a hydrogen attached to each of the carbons at positions 3, 4, 5, and 6 is replaced by a hydroxy group. The group consists of six possible diastereoisomers, known as conduritols A to F, some of which can exist as two distinct enantiomers.

name: 3-(4-carboxybutanamido)-1-{4-[(2-hydroxyethyl)carbamoyl]benzyl}-1-methylpiperidinium
definition: A piperidinium ion that is benzamide substituted on nitrogen by a 2-hydroxyethyl group and at the 4-position by a [3-(4-carboxybutanamido)-N-methylpiperidinio]methyl group.

name: α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-{α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tridecasaccharide derivative in which two pentasaccharide branches, each formed from N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose, are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose and two N-acetylglucosamine residues all linked β(1→4) with a β-configuration of the anomeric carbon of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: conduritol A
definition: A conduritol in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3, and 4 are in a trans,trans,cis- relationship to that at position 1.

name: 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxyneamine
definition: An amino cyclitol glycoside that is 2-deoxystreptamine in which the pro-R hydroxy group is substituted by a 6-amino-6-deoxy-α-D-glucosyl residue.

name: (+)-conduritol B
definition: A conduritol which has 1S,2R,3R,4S configuration.

name: 2'-deamino-2'-hydroxy-6'-dehydroparomamine
definition: An amino cyclitol glycoside that is 2-deoxystreptamine in which the pro-R hydroxy group is substituted by a 6-dehydro-α-D-glucosyl residue.

name: (−)-conduritol B
definition: A conduritol which has 1R,2S,3S,4R configuration.

name: β-carotene 15,15'-epoxide
definition: An epoxycarotenoid obtained by epoxidation across the 15,15'-double bond of β-carotene.

name: 15,15'-dihydroxy-β-carotene
definition: A carotenol obtained by formal dihydroxylation across the 15,15'-double bond of β-carotene.

name: 1-D-1,2-anhydro-myo-inositol
definition: A conduritol epoxide resulting from the formal epoxidation of the double bond of (+)-conduritol B.

name: 1-L-1,2-anhydro-myo-inositol
definition: A conduritol epoxide resulting from the formal epoxidation of the double bond of (−)-conduritol B.

name: conduritol epoxide
definition: An epoxide resulting from the epoxidation of the double bond of a conduritol.

name: attenoside
definition: An acyclic diterpene glycoside consisting of a 20-hydroxygeranyllinalool skeleton conjugated to two disaccharide units at C-3 and C-20.

name: (22R)-22-hydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is the 22R-hydroxy derivative of cholesterol.

name: (S)-(+)-4-(5-carboxypentyl)methamphetamine
definition: A monocarboxylic acid comprised of hexanoic acid substituted on C-6 by a 4-[(2S)-2-(methylamino)propyl]phenyl group.

name: lyciumoside IV
definition: An acyclic diterpene glycoside consisting of a 20-hydroxygeranyllinalool skeleton conjugated to a glucosyl residue at C-20 and a rhamnosylglucosyl moiety at C-3.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of β-D-galactofuranosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate.

name: nicotianoside I
definition: An acyclic diterpene glycoside consisting of a 20-hydroxygeranyllinalool skeleton conjugated to a malonylglucosyl residue at C-20 and a rhamnosylglucosyl moiety at C-3.

name: nicotianoside II
definition: An acyclic diterpene glycoside consisting of a 20-hydroxygeranyllinalool skeleton conjugated to a malonylglucosyl residue at C-20 and a rhamnosyl(malonyl)glucosyl moiety at C-3.

name: (−)-lariciresinol
definition: A lignan that is tetrahydrofuran substituted at positions 2, 3 and 4 by 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl, hydroxymethyl and 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzyl groups respectively (the 2R,3S,4S-diastereomer).

name: (−)-pinoresinol
definition: An enantiomer of pinoresinol having (−)-1R,3aS,4R,6aS-configuration.

name: (+)-lariciresinol
definition: A lignan that is tetrahydrofuran substituted at positions 2, 3 and 4 by 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl, hydroxymethyl and 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzyl groups respectively (the 2S,3R,4R-diastereomer).

name: (+)-secoisolariciresinol
definition: An enantiomer of secoisolariciresinol having (+)-(2S,3S)-configuration.

name: 4-(3-methylbut-2-enyl)-L-abrine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 4-(3-methylbut-2-enyl)-L-abrine.

name: N-acetylcarnosine
definition: A dipeptide that is the N-acetyl derivative of carnosine.

name: β-damascenone
definition: A cyclic monoterpene ketone that is 2,6,6-trimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene substituted at position 1 by a crotonoyl group.

name: farnesyl acetone
definition: A terpene ketone in which an (E,E)-farnesyl group is bonded to one of the α-methyls of acetone.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate.

name: 3-(2-methoxyethoxy)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propanoic acid substituted at C-3 by a 2-methoxyethoxy group.

name: 2-(2-methoxyethoxy)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propanoic acid substituted at C-2 by a 2-methoxyethoxy group.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of β-D-galactofuranosyl-(1→5)-β-D-galactofuranosyl-(1→4)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate.

name: N-(ethoxycarbonyl)-4-hydroxyproline
definition: A 4-hydroxyproline substituted at N-1 by an ethoxycarbonyl group.

name: 2,3-epoxygerianial
definition: An epoxide resulting from the formal epoxidation of the double bond between positions 2 and 3 of geranial.

name: N-(methoxyacetyl)-4-hydroxyproline
definition: A 4-hydroxyproline substituted at N-1 by an methoxyacetyl group.

name: geranate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of geranic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (Z)-2,3-dehydroadipyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid functions of 2,3-dehydroadipyl-CoA.

name: dihydrocurcumin
definition: A β-diketone that is curcumin in which one of the double bonds has been reduced to a single bond.

name: tetrahydrocurcumin
definition: A β-diketone that is curcumin in which both of the double bonds have been reduced to single bonds.

name: geranic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid that is octa-2,6-dienoic acid bearing two methyl substituents at positions 3 and 7 (the 2E-isomer).

name: 3-hydroxy-α-ionone
definition: An apo carotenoid monoterpenoid that is α-ionone with a hydroxy substituent at position 3.

name: cyclo(L-leucyl-L-leucyl)
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione in which one hydrogen at position 3 and one hydrogen at position 6 are replaced by isobutyl groups (the 3S,6S-diastereomer).

name: glucoheptonic acid
definition: A carbohydrate acid that is heptanoic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at C-2, C-3, C-4, C-5, C-6, and C-7.

name: MK-2206
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is [1,2,4]triazolo[3,4-f][1,6]naphthyridin-3(2H)-one substituted by 4-(1-aminocyclobutyl)phenyl and phenyl groups at positions 8 and 9, respectively. It is an allosteric Akt inhibitor.

name: perifosine
definition: A phospholipid consisting of 1,1-dimethylpiperidinium-4-yl hydrogen phosphate in which the hydrogen is replaced by a stearyl (octadecyl) group.

name: β-D-QuiN4Fm-(1→4)-α-D-GalNAcAN-(1→4)-α-D-GalNAcAN-(1→3)-β-D-QuiNAc-(1→4)-[α-D-GalN-(1→2)]-[α-D-Glc-(1→3)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-[β-D-Glc-(1→2)]-α-D-Man-(1→5)-α-Kdo
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched decasaccharide derivative comprised of a mannose residue to which is linked an N-acetylgalactosaminyl residue at O-2, a glucosyl residue at O-3 and a β-D-QuiN4Fm-(1→4)-α-D-GalNAcAN-(1→4)-α-D-GalNAcAN-(1→3)-β-D-QuiNAc tetrasaccharide chain at O-4, all linked to an [α-D-Glc-(1→2)]-α-D-Man-(1→5)-α-Kdo branched trisaccharide unit.

name: azadiradione
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 4,4,8-trimethylandrosta-1,14-diene substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 16, an acetoxy group at position 7 and a furan-3-yl group at position 17. Isolated from Azadirachta indica, it exhibits antimycobacterial and anti-inflammatory activities.

name: nimbocinol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 4,4,8-trimethylandrosta-1,14-diene substituted by a oxo groups at positions 3 and 16, a hydroxy group at position 7 and a furan-3-yl group at position 17. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 7-benzoylnimbocinol
definition: A limonoid that is the benzoate ester of nimbocinol. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 15-hydroxyazadiradione
definition: A limonoid that is azadiradione substituted by a hydroxy group at position 15. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 17-hydroxyazadiradione
definition: A limonoid that is azadiradione substituted by a hydroxy group at position 17. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: epoxyazadiradione
definition: A limonoid that is azadiradione with an epoxy group across positions 14 and 15. Isolated from Azadirachta indica it exhibits insecticidal activitry against mosquitoes.

name: 7-deacetyl-7-benzoylepoxyazadiradione
definition: A limonoid that is epoxyazadiradione in which the acetyl group has been replaced by a benzoyl group. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 17-epiazadiradione
definition: A limonoid that is the C-17 epimer of azadiradione. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 17-epi-17-hydroxyazadiradione
definition: A limonoid that is 17-epiazadiradione substituted by a hydroxy group at position 17. Isolated from Azadirachta indica, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: 7-acetyl-16,17-dehydro-16-hydroxyneotrichilenone
definition: A limonoid that is 4,4,8-trimethylandrosta-1,16-diene substituted by a furan-3-yl group at position 17, oxo groups at positions 3 and 15, a hydroxy group at position 16 and an acetoxy group at position 7. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: azadiradionolide
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 4,4,8-trimethylandrosta-1,14-diene substituted by a oxo groups at positions 3 and 16, an acetoxy group at position 7 and a 2-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-3-yl group at position 17. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 20,21,22,23-tetrahydro-23-oxoazadirone
definition: A limonoid that is 20,21,22,23-tetrahydroazadirone substituted by an additional oxo group at position 23. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: desfuranoazadiradione
definition: A limonoid that is azadiradione in which the furanyl group at position 17 is replaced by a hydrogen. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 1,3-diacetylvilasinin
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: 3-acetyl-7-tigloylvilasinin lactone
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: 7-deacetylgedunin
definition: A limonoid that is the 7-deacetyl derivative of gedunin. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 7-deacetyl-7-benzoylgedunin
definition: A limonoid that is gedunin in which the acetoxy group at position 7 is replaced by a benzoyloxy group. Isolated from Azadirachta indica, it exhibits cytotoxic activity against HL60 leukemia cells.

name: nimolicinol
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: 7-deacetyl-17-epinimolicinol
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: vepaol
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: 23-epivepaol
definition: A limonoid that is the C-23 epimer of vepaol. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 3-acetyl-11-methoxy-1-tigloylazadirachtinin
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: nimbin
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: 6-deacetylnimbin
definition: A limonoid that is nimbin in which the acetyloxy group at position 6 is replaced by a hydroxy hroup. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 6-acetylnimbandiol
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: 28-deoxonimbolide
definition: A limonoid isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: ohchinin acetate
definition: A natural product found in Azadirachta indica.

name: salannin
definition: A limonoid with insecticidal activity isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 2',3'-dihydrosalannin
definition: A limonoid that is the 2',3'-dihydro derivative of salannin. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 3-deacetylsalannin
definition: A limonoid that is salannin in which the acetyloxy group at position 6 is replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been isolated from Azadirachta indica.

name: 17-defurano-17-oxosalannin
definition: A limonoid that is salannin in which the furanyl group at position 17 is replaced by an oxo group. Isolated from Azadirachta indica, it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: β-nimolactone
definition: A limonoid found in Azadirachta indica.

name: tephrocandidin A
definition: A monomethoxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by a methoxy group at position 5, a hydroxy group at position 7 and a 3-hydroxy-3-methylbut-1-en-1-yl group at position 8. It has been isolated from the aerial parts of Tephrosia candida.

name: tephrocandidin B
definition: A monomethoxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by a methoxy group at position 5, hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 4' and a 3-hydroxy-3-methylbut-1-en-1-yl group at position 8. It has been isolated from the aerial parts of Tephrosia candida.

name: candidachalcone

definition: An enyne that is (4E,15Z,28E)-dotriaconta-4,15,28-triene-1,31-diyne substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 30 (the 3R,30R-stereoiosmer). It has been isolated from the marine sponge Petrosia.

name: (−)-duryne D
definition: An enyne that is (4E,13Z,19Z,30E)-tetratriaconta-4,13,19,30-tetraene-1,33-diyne substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 32 (the 3R,32R-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the marine sponge Petrosia.

name: (−)-duryne E
definition: An enyne that is (4E,15Z,21Z,32E)-hexatriaconta-4,15,21,32-tetraene-1,35-diyne substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 34 (the 3R,34R-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the marine sponge Petrosia.

name: (−)-duryne F

name: brugunin A
definition: A lignan isolated from the stems of Sinocalamus affinis.

name: zorbamycin
definition: A glycopeptide antibiotic found in Streptomyces flavoviridis.

name: lichexanthone
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1, a methyl group at position 8 and methoxy groups at positions 3 and 6. It has been isolated from the bark of Cupania cinerea.

name: 17β,21β-epoxyhopan-3-one
definition: A hopanoid that is hopan-3-one substituted by an epoxy group across positions 17 and 21. It has been isolated from the bark of Cupania cinerea.

name: austocystin D
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound isolated from Aspergillus and Aspergillus ustus and has been shown to exhibit cytotoxic activity.

name: marinoquinoline A
definition: A pyrroloquinoline that is 3H-pyrrolo[2,3-c]quinoline substituted by a methyl group at position 4. It is a natural product found in Ohtaekwangia kribbensis and Rapidithrix thailandica.

name: marinoquinoline B
definition: A pyrroloquinoline that is 3H-pyrrolo[2,3-c]quinoline substituted by an isobutyl group at position 4. It is a natural product found in Ohtaekwangia kribbensis.

name: (R)-mevalonolactone
definition: A 4-hydroxy-4-methyloxan-2-one that has (R)-configuration. It is a natural product found in Phomopsis archeri.

name: cudraflavone B
definition: An extended flavonoid that consists of a pyranochromane skeleton that is 2H,6H-pyrano[3,2-g]chromen-6-one substituted by geminal methyl groups at position 2, a 2,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 8, a hydroxy group at position 5 and a prenyl group at position 7. Isolated from Morus alba and Morus species it exhibits anti-inflammatory activity.

name: pedunculosumoside A
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is ophioglonol substituted by a prenyl group at position 5' as well as 2-O-(β-D-glucopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl and β-D-glucopyranosyl residues at positions 7 and 4' respectively via glycosidic linkages. Isolated from the whole plants of Ophioglossum pedunculosum, it exhibits anti-HBV activity.

name: pedunculosumoside B
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is 5'-prenylophioglonol attached to β-D-glucopyranosyl residues at positions 7 and 4' respectively via glycosidic linkages. It has been isolated from the whole plants of Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: pedunculosumoside C
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is 5'-prenylophioglonol attached to 2-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the whole plant of Ophioglossum pedunculosum and exhibits anti-HBV activity.

name: pedunculosumoside D
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is 5'-prenylophioglonol attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the whole plants of Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: pedunculosumoside E
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is ophioglonol attached to a 2-O-(β-D-glucopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl and β-D-glucopyranosyl residues at positions 7 and 4' respectively via glycosidic linkages. It has been isolated from the whole plants of Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: pedunculosumoside F
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is ophioglonol attached to β-D-glucopyranosyl residues at positions 7 and 4' respectively via glycosidic linkages. It has been isolated from the whole plants of Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: pedunculosumoside G
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is ophioglonol attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: 23-hydroxyursolic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is ursolic acid substituted by an additional hydroxy group at position 23. It has been isolated from Lagerstroemia speciosa and Juglans sinensis.

name: rel-2α,3β,23-trihydroxy-19-oxo-18,19-seco-12,17-dien-28-norursane
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid of the 8,19-seco-ursane-type skeleton isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: rel-2α,3β,23-trihydroxy-12,17-dien-28-norursane
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid based on a ursane-type nortriterpene skeleton isolated from the leaves of found in Rosa laevigata.

name: rel-2α,3α,23-trihydroxy-19-oxo-18,19-seco-urs-11,13(18)-dien-28-oic acid
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid of the 8,19-seco-ursane-type skeleton isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: 3β-[(α-L-arabinopyranosyl)oxy]-20β-hydroxyursan-28-oic acid δ-lactone
definition: A triterpenoid saponin based on a ursane-skeleton isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: 2α,3β-dihydroxyolean-13(18)-en-28-oic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-13(18)-en-28-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 (the 2α,3β-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: rel-2α,3α,19α,23-tetrahydroxyolean-12-en-28-oic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-en-28-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3, 19 and 23 respectively. It has been isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: 2α,3α,23-trihydroxyolean-12-en-28-oic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-en-28-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3 and 23 respectively (the 2α,3α-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: euscaphic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is urs-12-en-28-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3 and 19 respectively (the 2α,3α-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: 19α-hydroxyasiatic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is asiatic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 19. It has been isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: 2α,3β,23-trihydroxylup-20(29)-en-28-oic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is lup-20(29)-en-28-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3 and 23 respectively (the 2α,3β-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: 19α-hydroxyasiatic acid-28-O-β-D-glucopyrannoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is 19α-hydroxyasiatic acid attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 28 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the leaves of Rosa laevigata.

name: 2''-acetylastragalin
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside that is the 2''-acetyl derivative of astragalin (kaempferol 3-O-glucoside). Isolated from the aerial parts of Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity.

name: astragalin heptaacetate
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside that is the hepta acetate ester derivative of astragalin. Isolated from the aerial parts of Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity.

name: 2''-acetylpaeonoside
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside that is the 2''-acetyl derivative of kaempferol-3-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-7-O-β-D-glucopyranoside (paeonoside). Isolated from Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity.

name: paeonoside decaacetate
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside that is the decaacetate ester derivative of paeonoside. Isolated from the aerial parts of Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity.

name: petiolaroside
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin attached to β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkages. Isolated from the aerial parts of Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity.

name: 2''-acetylpetiolaroside
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is the 2''-acetyl derivative of petiolaroside. Isolated from the aerial parts of Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity.

name: petiolaroside decaacetate
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is the decaacetate ester derivative of petiolaroside. Isolated from the aerial parts of Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity.

name: ophioglonol
definition: A hydroxy homoflavonoid that is 2-phenyl-4H-chromen-4-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 3' and 4' and a hydroxymethyl group at position 3. It is isolated from the whole plant of Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: ophioglonol 4'-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is ophioglonol attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 4' via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: ophioglonin 7-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A homoflavonoid glycoside that is ophioglonin attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: 3-O-methylquercetin-7-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is 3-O-methylquercetin attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from Ophioglossum pedunculosum and Lepisorus contortus.

name: 3-O-methylquercetin 7-O-β-glucopyranosyl-4'-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is 3-O-methylquercetin attached to β-D-glucopyranosyl residues at positions 7 and 4' respectively via glycosidic linkages. It has been isolated from Ophioglossum pedunculosum.

name: erythrodiol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is β-amyrin in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group at position 28 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a plant metabolite found in olive oil as well as in Rhododendron ferrugineum and other Rhododendron species.

name: 1-oxo-3β,23-dihydroxyolean-12-en-28-oic acid 28-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is olean-12-ene attached to hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 23, oxo groups at positions 1 and 28 and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 28. It has been isolated from the leaves and twigs of Juglans sinensis.

name: 1-oxo-3β-hydroxyolean-18-ene
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-18-ene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3 and oxo group at position 1. It has been isolated from the leaves and twigs of Juglans sinensis.

name: 3β,23-dihydroxyurs-12-en-28-oic acid 28-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is 28-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl derivative of 23-hydroxyursolic acid. It has been isolated from the leaves and twigs of Juglans sinensis.

name: 3β,22α-dihydroxyurs-12-en-28-oic acid 28-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is urs-12-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 22, an oxo group at position 28 and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 28. It has been isolated from the leaves and twigs of Juglans sinensis.

name: virgatic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene substituted by a carboxy group at position 28, a β-hydroxy group at position 3 and an oxo group at position 1. It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: 1-oxo-3β,23-dihydroxyolean-12-en-28-oic acid
definition: A natural product found in Juglans sinensis.

name: hederagenin 28-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is the carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hederagenin with β-D-glucopyranose. It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: 2α,3β,23-trihydroxyolean-12-en-28-oic acid 28-O-β-D-glucopynoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is the carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of arjunolic acid with β-D-glucopyranose. It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: 3β-acetoxyolean-18-en-28-oic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-18-ene substituted by an acetyloxy group at position 3 and a carboxy group at position 28. It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: 2α,3α,23-trihydroxyurs-12-en-28-oic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is urs-12-ene substituted by a carboxy group at position 28 and hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3 and 23 (the 2α,3α stereoisomer). It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: 3-oxo-23-hydroxyurs-12-en-28-oic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is urs-12-ene substituted by an oxo group at position 3, a carboxy group at position 28 and a hydroxy group at position 23. It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: 2α,3β,23α-trihydroxyurs-12-en-28-oic acid 28-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is the carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of asiatic acid with β,23α-trihydroxyurs-12-en-28-oic acid 28-O-β-D-glucopyranose. It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: 3β-hydroxyurs-20-en-28-oic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is urs-20-ene substituted by a carboxy group at position 28 and a β-hydroxy group at position 3. It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: 2α,3β-dihydroxylup-20(29)-ene
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is lup-20(29)-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 (the 2α,3β stereoisomer). It has been isolated from Juglans sinensis.

name: rel-hopan-27-al-6β,11α,22-triol
definition: A hopanoid that is hopan-27-al substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 6, 11 and 22 (the 6β,11α-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from Conoideocrella tenuis.

name: hopane-6β,11α,22,27-tetraol
definition: A hopanoid that is hopane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 6, 11, 22 and 27 respectively (the 6β,11α-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the mycelium of Conoideocrella tenuis.

name: hopane-6β,7β,22-triol
definition: A hopanoid that is hopane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 6, 7 and 22 (the 6β,7β-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from Conoideocrella tenuis.

name: zeorin
definition: A hopanoid that is hopane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 6 and 22 (the (6α)-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the fungi Aschersonia and Hypocrella.

name: ginsenoside Rf
definition: A ginsenoside found in Panax ginseng and Panax japonicus var. major that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 6α, 12β and 20 pro-S positions, in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucopyranoside, and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position.

name: ginsenoside Rg1
definition: A ginsenoside found in Panax ginseng and Panax japonicus var. major that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 6α, 12β and 20 pro-S positions, in which the hydroxy groups at positions 6 and 20 have been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosides, and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position.

name: ginsenoside Rd
definition: A ginsenoside found in Panax ginseng and Panax japonicus var. major that is (20S)-ginsenoside Rg3 in which the hydroxy group at position 20 has been converted to its β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: ginsenoside Rb1
definition: A ginsenoside found in Panax ginseng and Panax japonicus var. major that is ginsenoside Rd in which the β-D-glucopyranoside group at position 20 is replaced by a β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranoside group.

name: (20R)-ginsenoside Rg3
definition: A ginsenoside found in Panax japonicus var. major that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 12β and 20 pro-R positions, in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranoside, and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position.

name: (20S)-ginsenoside Rg3
definition: A ginsenoside found in Panax ginseng and Panax japonicus var. major that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 12β and 20 pro-S positions, in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranoside, and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position.

name: lehualide E
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3 and 4, a methyl group at position 5 and a (2E)-3-methyl-9-phenylnon-2-en-1-yl group at position 6. It has been isolated from the marine sponge of the genus Plakortis.

name: lehualide F
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one substituted by a methoxy group at position 3, a hydroxy group at position 4, a methyl group at position 5 and a (2E)-3-methyl-9-phenylnon-2-en-1-yl group at position 6. Isolated from the marine sponge of the genus Plakortis, it exhibits cytotoxicity against human promyeloid leukemic HL-60 cells.

name: lehualide G
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one substituted by a methoxy group at position 3, a hydroxy group at position 4, a methyl group at position 5 and a (2E)-3-methyl-11-phenylundec-2-en-1-yl group at position 6. Isolated from the marine sponge of the genus Plakortis, it exhibits cytotoxicity against human promyeloid leukemic HL-60 cells.

name: lehualide H
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3 and 4, a methyl group at position 5 and a 10-(acetylsulfanyl)decyl group at position 6. Isolated from the marine sponge of the genus Plakortis, it exhibits cytotoxicity against human promyeloid leukemic HL-60 cells.

name: lehualide I
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3 and 4, a methyl group at position 5 and a 10-(methylsulfanyl)decyl group at position 6. Isolated from the marine sponge of the genus Plakortis, it exhibits cytotoxicity against human promyeloid leukemic HL-60 cells.

name: lehualide J
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3 and 4, a methyl group at position 5 and a 10-(methylsulfinyl)decyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from the marine sponge of the genus Plakortis.

name: lehualide K
definition: An organic disulfide that is didecyl disulfide in which the hydrogens of the terminal methyl groups are replaced by 3,4-dimethoxy-5-methyl-2H-pyran-2-ones groups respectively. It has been isolated from the marine sponge of the genus Plakortis.

name: nigrasin A
definition: An extended flavonoid that is 3,4,6a,11b-tetrahydro-2H,6H-[1]benzofuro[3,2-b]pyrano[3,2-g]chromene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 6a and 9, geminal methyl groups at positions 2, an oxo group at position 6 and a prenyl group at position 11b. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra.

name: nigrasin B
definition: An extended flavonoid that is the 3S*-diastereomer of nigrasin A. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra.

name: nigrasin C
definition: An extended flavonoid that is 2,3,5a,10b-tetrahydro-5H-[1]benzofuro[3,2-b]furo[3,2-g]chromene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 5a and 8, a 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl group at position 2, a prenyl group at position 10b and an oxo group at position 5. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra.

name: nigrasin D
definition: An extended flavonoid that is the 2R*-diastereomer of nigrasin C. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra.

name: nigrasin E
definition: An extended flavonoid that is 1,2,6a,11b-tetrahydro-6H-[1]benzofuro[3,2-b]furo[2,3-h]chromene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 6a and 9, a prenyl group at position 11b, a prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 2 and an oxo group at position 6. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra.

name: nigrasin F
definition: An extended flavonoid that is the 2S*-diastereomer of nigrasin E. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra.

name: nigrasin G
definition: An extended flavonoid that is 5a,10a-dihydro-11H-[1]benzofuro[3,2-b]chromen-11-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, 8 and 10a and a 3-hydroxy-2,6,10-trimethyldodeca-1,6,10-trien-12-yl group at position 5a. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra.

name: nigrasin H
definition: A furochromene that is 8,9-dihydro-4H-furo[2,3-h]chromen-4-one substituted by a 2,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 2, a hydroxy group at position 5, methyl groups at positions 8, 9 and 9 and a prenyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra and has been found to promote adipogenesis.

name: nigrasin I
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 2' and 4', a prenyl group at position 3 and a 3-methylbut-1-en-3-yl group at position 8. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra and has been found to promote adipogenesis.

name: nigrasin j
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 4', a methoxy group at position 3 and a 6-hydroxy-2-methylhept-2-en-6-yl substituted tetrahydrofuran ring across positions 5' and 6'. It has been isolated from Morus nigra.

name: sanggenol H
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 5a,10a-dihydro-11H-[1]benzofuro[3,2-b]chromen-11-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3, 8 and 10a and a triprenyl group at position 5a. It has been isolated from Morus nigra.

name: cudraflavone C
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 2' and 4' and prenyl groups at positions 3 and 6. Isolated from Morus nigra, it exhibits antibacterial and cytotoxic activities.

name: macaranone B
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone that is flavonol substituted by additional hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 3', a methoxy group at position 4' and a geranyl group at position 2'. It has been isolated from the twigs of Morus nigra.

name: 12-epi-19-O-methylscalarin
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid that is 12-epi-scalarin in which the hydorxy group at position 19 is replaced by a methoxy group. It has been isolated from the sponge, Hyattella species.

name: 12-O-deacetyl-12-epi-19-deoxy-21-hydroxyscalarin
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid that is 12-O-deacetyl-12-epi-19-deoxy-scalarin substituted by an additional hydroxy group at position 21. It has been isolated from the sponge, Hyattella species.

name: 12-O-acetyl-16-O-methylhyrtiolide
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid isolated from the sponge, Hyattella species.

name: 12-O-deacetyl-19-O-methyl-12-epi-deoxoscalarin
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid that is 12-epi-deoxoscalarin in which the acetoxy group at position 12 is replaced by a hydroxy group while the hydroxy group at position 19 is replaced by a methoxy group. It has been isolated from the sponge, Hyattella species.

name: 12-epi-deoxoscalarin
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid that is the deoxo derivative of 12-epi-scalarin. It has been isolated from the sponge,Hyattella species.

name: 23-acetoxy-12-epi-deoxoscalarin
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid that is 12-epi-deoxoscalarin with an additional acetoxy group at position 23. It has been isolated from the sponge, Hyattella species.

name: 23-acetoxy-12-O-deacetyl-12-epi-deoxoscalarin
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid that is 23-acetoxy-12-epi-deoxoscalarin in which the acetoxy group at position 12 is replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been isolated from the sponge, Hyattella species.

name: 12-epi-19-O-methyldeoxoscalarin
definition: A scalarane sesterterpenoid that is 12-epi-deoxoscalarin in which the hydroxy group at position 19 is replaced by a methoxy group. It has been isolated from the sponge,Hyattella species.

name: pierreione A
definition: A methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 5 and 3', a 2R,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutoxyl group at position 4' and a dimethylpyran ring fused across positions 6 and 7. Isolated from Antheroporum pierrei, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: pierreione B
definition: A methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 3', a 2R,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutoxyl group at position 4' and a dimethylpyran ring fused across positions 6 and 7. Isolated from Antheroporum pierrei, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: pierreione C
definition: A methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by methoxy groups at positions 5 and 3', a prenyloxy group at position 4' and a dimethylpyran ring fused across positions 6 and 7. Isolated from Antheroporum pierrei, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: pierreione D
definition: A methoxyisoflavone that is isoflavone substituted by a methoxy group at position 3', a prenyloxy group at position 4' and a dimethylpyran ring fused across positions 6 and 7. Isolated from Antheroporum pierrei, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: 9α,11α-dihydroxyergosta-4,6,8(14),22-tetraen-3-one
definition: An ergostanoid that is ergosta-4,6,8(14),22-tetraene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 9 and 11 and an oxo group at position 3. Isolated from a myxobacterial strain Sorangiineae, it exhibits activity against colon adinocarcinoma cells.

name: protuboxepin A
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 10,11-dihydro-6H-oxepino[2,3-d]pyrazino[1,2-a]pyrimidine-6,9(8H)-dione substituted by a benzyl group at position 8 and a butan-2-yl group at position 11. It has been isolated from Aspergillus species.

name: protuboxepin B
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 10,11-dihydro-6H-oxepino[2,3-d]pyrazino[1,2-a]pyrimidine-6,9(8H)-dione substituted by a benzyl group at position 8 and an isopropyl group at position 11. It has been isolated from Aspergillus species.

name: protubonine A
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 6,10b,11,11a-tetrahydro-H-pyrazino[1',2':1,5]pyrrolo[2,3-b]indole-,4(3H,5aH)-dione substituted by an acetyl group at position 6, a hydroxy group at position 10b and a 2-methylpropyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from in Aspergillus species.

name: protubonine B
definition: An acetate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of the fungal metabolite protubonine A with acetic acid. It has been isolated from Aspergillus species.

name: chrysogeside A
definition: A glucosylceramide isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: chrysogeside B
definition: A glucosylceramide isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: chrysogeside C
definition: A glucosylceramide isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: chrysogeside D
definition: A glucosylceramide isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: chrysogeside E
definition: A glucosylceramide isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: chrysogedone A
definition: A pyridone that is pyridin-2(1H)-one substituted by a methyl group at position 6 and a 1-hydroxybutyl group at position 5. It has been isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: chrysogedone B
definition: A pyridone that is pyridin-2(1H)-one substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 6 and a 1-hydroxybutyl group at position 5. It has been isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: pyrrole-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A pyrrolecarboxylic acid that is 1H-pyrrole substituted by a carboxy group at position 3. It has been isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: 3-(hydroxymethyl)-6-[4-(3-methylbut-2-enyloxy)benzyl]piperazine-2,5-dione
definition: A piperazinone that is piperazine-2,5-dione substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 3 and a benzyl group at position 6 which in turn is substituted by a prenyloxy group at position 4. It has been isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: methyl 2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid with methanol. It has been isolated from Penicillium chrysogenum.

name: blazein
definition: An ergostanoid that is (22E)-ergosta-7,22-diene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5 and a methoxy group at position 6 (the 3β,5α stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the fungus, Xylaria species.

name: ganodesterone
definition: An ergostanoid that is (22E)-ergosta-4,7,22-triene substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 6. It has been isolated from the fungus, Xylaria species.

name: cerevisterol
definition: An ergostanoid that is (22E)-ergosta-7,22-diene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5 and 6 (the 3β,5α,6β stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the fungus, Xylaria species.

name: 16-α-D-mannopyranosyloxyisopimar-7-en-19-oic acid
definition: A diterpene glycoside that is isopimar-7-en-19-oic acid attached to a α-D-mannopyranosyloxy residue at position 16. It has been isolated from the fungus, Xylaria species.

name: 16-hydroxyisopimar-7-en-19-oic acid
definition: A diterpenoid that is isopimar-7-ene substituted by a carboxy group at position 19 and a hydroxy group at position 16. It has been isolated from the fungus, Xylaria species.

name: penipanoid A
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid substituted by a 1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl group at position 2 which in turn is substituted by a 4-hydroxybenzyl group at position 5. It has been isolated from Penicillium paneum.

name: penipanoid B
definition: An alkaloid that is 3a,4-dihydroimidazo[1,5-a]quinazolin-5(3H)-one substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from Penicillium paneum.

name: penipanoid C
definition: A quinazoline alkaloid that is quinazolin-4(3H)-one substituted by a 4-hydroxybenzoyl group at position 2. It has been isolated from Penicillium paneum.

name: 2-(4-hydroxybenzyl)quinazolin-4(3H)-one
definition: A quinazoline alkaloid that is quinazolin-4(3H)-one substituted by a 4-hydroxybenzyl group at position 2. It has been isolated from Penicillium paneum and Isaria farinosa.

name: 3S-hydrangenol 4'-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoysl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A member of the class of dihydroisocoumarins that is hydrangenol attached to a 3-O-(6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 4' via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: thunberginol F 7-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: An isobenzofuranone that is thunberginol F attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl group at position 4 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica .

name: 2-hydroxy-6-[2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2-oxo-ethyl]benzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 2-hydroxybenzoic acid substituted by a 2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2-oxoethyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-[2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-2-oxo-ethyl]benzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2 and a 2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-2-oxoethyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-[2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl-5-methoxy)-2-oxoethyl]benzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2 and a 2-(3,4-dihydroxy-5-methoxyphenyl)-2-oxoethyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: hydrangeic acid 4'-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6 and a 2-phenylethenyl group at position 2 which in turn is attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 4. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: (E)-3-(3,4-dihydroxybenzylidene)-5-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)dihydrofuran-2-one
definition: A butan-4-olide that is dihydrofuran-2(3H)-one substituted by a 3,4-dihydroxybenzylidene group at position 3 and a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 5. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: (Z)-3-(3,4-dihydroxybenzylidene)-5-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butenolide that is furan-2(3H)-one substituted by a 3,4-dihydroxybenzylidene group at position 3 and a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 5. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: 4β-[(β-D-glucopyranosyl)hydroxy]-pinoresinol
definition: A lignan that is pinoresinol attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 4. It has been isolated from the roost of Scorzonera judaica.

name: hydrangenol 8-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A member of the class of dihydroisocoumarins that is hydrangenol attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 8 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: hydrangenol 4'-O-β-D-apiofuranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A member of the class of dihydroisocoumarins that is hydrangenol attached to a β-D-apiofuranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 4' via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: hydramacrophyllol B
definition: An isobenzofuranone that is 2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7 and a (R)-hydroxy(4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: hydramacrophyllol A
definition: An isobenzofuranone that is 2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7 and a (S)-hydroxy(4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: 4α-hydroxypinoresinol
definition: A lignan that is pinoresinol substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: hydrangenol 4'-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A member of the class of dihydroisocoumarins that is hydrangenol attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 4' via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: thunberginol F
definition: An isobenzofuranone that is 2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7 and a 3,4-dihydroxybenzylidene group at position 3. It has been isolated from the roots of Scorzonera judaica.

name: (+)-(7''S,8S,8'R,8''R)-4,4''-dihydroxy-3,3',3'',5'-tetramethoxy-4',8''-oxy-8,8'-sesquineolignan-7''-ol
definition: A neolignan isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(7''S,8S,8'R,8''S)-4,4''-dihydroxy-3,3',3'',5'-tetramethoxy-4',8''-oxy-8,8'-sesquineolignan-7''-ol
definition: A neolignan isolated from the barks of Machilus robusta.

name: (−)-(7'S,7''S,8R,8'S,8''R)-4,4''-dihydroxy-3',3'',5-trimethoxy-4',8''-oxy-2,7'-cyclo-8,8'-sesquineolignan-7''-ol
definition: A neolignan isolated from the barks of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(8S,8'R)-4-hydroxy-5-methoxy-1',2',3',4',5',6'-hexanor-2,7'-cyclolignan-7'-one
definition: A lignan that is 3,4-dihydronaphthalen-1(2H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7, a methoxy group at position 6 and methyl groups at positions 2 and 3 (the 2R,3S-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(8R,8'R)-4-hydroxy-5-methoxy-1',2',3',4',5',6'-hexanor-2,7'-cyclolignan-7'-one
definition: A lignan that is 3,4-dihydronaphthalen-1(2H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7, a methoxy group at position 6 and methyl groups at positions 2 and 3 (the 2R,3R-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the barks of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(7'S,8S,8'S)-3',4,4'-trihydroxy-5,5'-dimethoxy-2,7'-cyclolignan
definition: A lignan that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalene substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 3, a methoxy group at position 6, a hydroxy group at position 7 and a 3,4-dihydroxy-5-methoxyphenyl group at position 1. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(7'S,8S,8'S)-3',4,4'-trihydroxy-5-methoxy-2,7'-cyclolignan
definition: A lignan that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalene substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 3, a hydroxy group at position 7, a methoxy group at position 6 and a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 1. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: rel-(+)-(7'S,8S,8'S)-4,4'-dihydroxy-3',5,5'-trimethoxy-2,7'-cyclolignan
definition: A lignan that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalene substituted by methyl groups at positions 6 and 7, a hydroxy group at position 2, a methoxy group at position 3 and a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 8. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(8S,8'R)-3',4,4'-trihydroxy-5,5'-dimethoxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 2,3-dimethylbutane substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group a position 4 and a 3,4-dihydroxy-5-methoxyphenyl group at position 1. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(8S,8'R)-4,4'-dihydroxy-3,3',5'-trimethoxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 2,3-diemthylbutane substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 4 and a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 1. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(8S,8'R)-4-hydroxy-3,3',4',5'-tetramethoxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 2,3-diemthylbutane substituted by a 3,4,5-trimethoxyphenyl group at position 1 and a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 4. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(8S,8'R)-9-acetoxy-4,4'-dihydroxy-3,3',5'-trimethoxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 2,3-dimethylbutyl acetate substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 1 and a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 4. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(8S,8'R)-9'-acetoxy-4,4'-dihydroxy-3,3',5'-trimethoxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 2,3-dimethylbutyl acetate substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 4 and a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 1. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-(8S,8'R)-4,4'-dihydroxy-3-methoxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 2,3-dimethylbutane substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 1 and a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at position 4 respectively. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: rel-(−)-(7S,7'R,8S,8'R)-4,4'-dihydroxy-3,3',5'-trimethoxy-7,7'-epoxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 3,4-dimethyloxolane substituted by a 2-methoxyphenol group at position 5 and a 2,6-dimethoxyphenol group at 2. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (−)-(7R,8R,8'R)-4,4'-dihydroxy-3,3',5'-trimethoxy-7,9'-epoxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 3-methyloxolane substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 5 and a (4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl)methyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (+)-lyoniresinol
definition: A lignan that is tetralin substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxy group at position 4, hydroxymethyl groups at positions 2 and 3, methoxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and a hydroxy group at position 6. Isolated from Machilus robusta and Sinocalamus affinis, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: meso-dihydroguaiaretic acid
definition: A lignan that is 2,3-dimethylbutane substituted by 2-methoxyphenol groups at positions 1 and 4 respectively. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: (−)-(8R,8'S)-3,3',4-trimethoxy-4'-hydroxylignan
definition: A lignan that is 2,3-dimethylbutane substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 1 and a 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 4. It has been isolated from the bark of Machilus robusta.

name: echinulin
definition: An indole alkaloid with formula C29H39N3O2. It is a fungal metabolite found in several Aspergillus species.

name: 5,7-dihydroxy-4-methylphthalide
definition: A member of the class of 2-benzofurans that is 1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran substituted by oxo, methyl, hydroxy and hydroxy groups at positions 1,4,5, and 7, respectively. It is a natural product found in several genera of fungi including Eurotium repens.

name: asperaculin A
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone isolated from Aspergillus aculeatus.

name: asperparaline A
definition: An alkaloid isolated from Aspergillus aculeatus.

name: BU-4704
definition: An aryl sulfate that is phenyl hydrogen sulfate substituted by a (1Z,3Z)-2,3-diisocyano-4-(4-methoxyphenyl)buta-1,3-dien-1-yl group at position 4. An Aspergillus metabolite isolated from Aspergillus and Aspergillus fumigatus.

name: aspergillusene A
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is phenol substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 5 and a (2E)-6-methylhept-2-en-2-yl group at position 2. An Aspergillus metabolite isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: aspergillusene B
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is 1-benzofuran substituted by a methyl group at position 3, a 3-methylbutyl group at position 2 and a carboxy group at position 6. An Aspergillus metabolite isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: (+)-(7S)-7-O-methylsydonic acid
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is the 7-O-methyl derivative of (+)-(7S)-sydonic acid. An Aspergillus metabolite isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: aspergillusone A
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is methyl (1S)-2,9-dihydro-1H-xanthene-1-carboxylate substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 8, a methyl group at position 6 and an oxo group at position 9. It has been isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: aspergillusone B
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is methyl (1R)-2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-xanthene-1-carboxylate substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 8, a hydroxymethyl group at position 6 and an oxo group at position 9. It has been isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: (+)-(7S)-sydonic acid
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is benzoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3 and a (2S)-2-hydroxy-6-methylheptan-2-yl group at position 4. It has been isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: (7R,8R)-AGI-B4
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is methyl (1S)-2,9-dihydro-1H-xanthene-1-carboxylate substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 8, a hydroxymethyl group at position 6 and an oxo group at position 9. It has been isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: (7R,8R)-α-diversonolic ester
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is methyl 2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-xanthene-1-carboxylate substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 8, a methyl group at position 6 and an oxo group at position 9 (the 1R,2R stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: methyl 8-hydroxy-6-methyl-9-oxo-9H-xanthene-1-carboxylate
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8. a methyl group at position 6, an oxo group at position 9 and a methoxy carbonyl at position 1. It has been isolated from the fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: sydowinin A
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is methyl 9-oxo-9H-xanthene-1-carboxylate substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8 and a hydroxymethyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: sydowinin B
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is methyl 9H-xanthene-1-carboxylate substituted by hydroxy group at positions 2 and 8, a hydroxymethyl group at position 6 and an oxo group at position 9. It has been isolated from the sea fan derived fungus Aspergillus sydowii.

name: pinselin
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is methyl 9H-xanthene-1-carboxylate substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 8, a methyl group at position 6 and an oxo group at position 9. It has been isolated from Aspergillus sydowii.

name: (Z)-3-butylidenephthalide
definition: A γ-lactone that is phthalide substituted by a butylidene group at position 3. Isolated from Ligusticum porteri, it exhibits hypoglycemic activity.

name: platensimycin
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by the formal condensation of the amino group of 3-amino-2,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid with the carboxy group of the oxatetracyclic cage component. It is an antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces platensis and exhibits inhibitory activity against fatty acid synthase.

name: platensimycin methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage compound that is methyl ester derivative of platensimycin. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensimycin B1
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the benzamide derivative of platensimycin. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensimycin B4
definition: A monosaccharide derivative of platensimycin isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensimycin B4 methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the methyl ester derivative of platensimycin B4. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platencin
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by the formal condensation of the amino group of 3-amino-2,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid with the carboxy group of the polycyclic cage component. It is an antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces platensis and exhibits inhibitory activity against fatty acid synthase.

name: platensimycin A1
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the 5-hydroxy derivative of platensimycin. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensimycin A1 methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the methyl ester derivative of platensimycin A1 . It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensimycin B2
definition: A polycyclic cage that is platensimycin with a 1,3-oxazinane ring fused onto the aromatic ring. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensimycin B3
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the decarboxy derivative of platensimycin. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensimide A
definition: A polycyclic cage compound that is a carboxamide obtained by the formal condensation of the amino group of 4-(acetylamino)-2-aminobutanoic acid with the carboxy group of the oxatetracyclic cage component. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: homoplatensimide A
definition: A polycyclic cage compound isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: homoplatensimide A methyl ester
definition: A carboxylic ester of homoplatensimide A isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platencin A1
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the 9-hydroxy derivative of platencin. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platencin A1 methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the methyl ester derivative of platencin A1. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platencin A2
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the 3-hydroxy derivative of platencin. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platencin A2 methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the methyl ester derivative of platencin A2. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platencin A3
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the 4-hydroxy derivative of platencin. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platencin A3 methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the methyl ester derivative of platencin A3. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensin A4
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the 3-hydroxy derivative of platencin. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensic acid
definition: A polycyclic cage attached to a 2-carboxyethyl side chain. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: platensic acid methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the methyl ester derivative of platensic acid. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: 14-hydroxyplatensic acid
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the 14-hydroxy derivative of platensic acid. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: 14-hydroxyplatensic acid methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage that is the methyl ester derivative of 14-hydroxyplatensic acid. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.

name: 13-hydroxyplatencinic acid methyl ester
definition: A polycyclic cage with a 3-methoxy-3-oxopropyl side chain. It is isolated from Streptomyces platensis.
