name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprised of two β(1→4)-linked galactose residues linked β(1→3) to N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine.

name: maltitol
definition: An α-D-glucoside consisting of D-glucitol having an α-D-glucosyl residue attached at the 4-position. Used as a sugar substitute.

name: α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-{α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-DMan-(1→6)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched tridecasaccharide in which two α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man pentasaccharide units are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannoose residue of a β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc trisaccharide chain.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino hexasaccharide in which an α-L-fucosyl residue is linked (1→2) to the mannosyl residue furthest from the reducing end of an α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc linear pentasaccharide.

name: topaquinone zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of topaquinone; major structure at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide in which an α-L-fucosyl residue is linked (1→2) to the mannosyl residue furthest from the reducing end of an α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc linear heptasaccharide.

name: γ-Glu-Leu
definition: A glutamyl-L-amino acid obtained by formal condensation of the γ-carboxy group of glutamic acid with the amino group of leucine.

name: γ-Glu-Ile
definition: A glutamyl-L-amino acid having L-isoleucine as the L-amino acid component.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-D-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide in which an α-L-fucosyl residue is linked (1→2) to the middle galactosyl residue of an N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide in which an N-acetyl-D-galactosamine and an L-fucose link β(1→3) and α(1→2) respectively to β-D-galactose.

name: 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid anion arising from deprotonation of both carboxylic acid functions of 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolic acid; major structure at pH 7.3

name: Fe-coproporphyrin III(4−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion obtained by the deprotonation of the four carboxy functions of Fe-coproporphyrin III.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide comprised of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine having an N-acetyl-D-galactosaminyl residue attached at the 3-position via a β-linkage.

name: 2-methylnicotinamide
definition: A pyridinecarboxamide that is nicotinamide substituted by a methyl group at C-2.

name: 1-methyluric acid
definition: An oxopurine that is 7,9-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6,8(3H)-trione substituted by a methyl group at N-1. It is one of the metabolites of caffeine found in human urine.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide composed of N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine units joined by sequential (1→3)-, (1→4)- and (1→4)-linkages.

name: 1-methyl-7H-xanthine
definition: A 1-methylxanthine tautomer where the imidazole proton is located at the 7-position.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino hexasaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine, α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, and β-D-glucose residues joined in sequence with (1→3)-, (1→4)-, (1→4)-, (1→3)- and (1→4)-linkages, respectively.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprising an acetamido-β-D-galactose and an α-L-fucose attached to an acetamidoglucose by 1→4 and 1→3 linkages, respectively. β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc with β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 1,3-dimethyluric acid
definition: An oxopurine that is 7,9-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6,8(3H)-trionesubstituted by methyl groups at N-1 and N-3.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc with β configuration at the reducing-end anomeric centre.

name: 1,7-dimethyluric acid
definition: An oxopurine that is 7,9-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6,8(3H)-trione substituted by methyl groups at N-1 and N-7. It is a metabolite of caffeine and is often found in human urine samples.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide in which two N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl units are linked α(1→3) and α(1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucose trisaccharide.

name: α-hydroxyhippuric acid
definition: An N-acyl-amino acid that is N-benzoylglycine substituted by a hydroxy group at C-2.

name: 2-ethyloctanedioic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is suberic (octanedioic) acid bearing an ethyl substituent at position 2.

name: 2-hydroxy-2-methylbutyric acid
definition: A branched-chain fatty acid that is 2-methylbutyric acid substituted at C-2 by a hydroxy group.

name: o-methylhippuric acid
definition: An N-acylglycine that is the ortho-methyl derivative of hippuric acid.

name: 2-pyridylacetylglycine
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as 2-pyridylacetyl.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-Abep-(1→3)]-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched pentasaccharide comprised of an α-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose tetrasaccharide chain, on to the non-reducing mannosyl residue of which is attached an abequosyl residue via a (1→3) linkage.

name: 2,2-dimethylglutaric acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is pentanedioic acid with two methyl groups substituted at position C-2.

name: α-D-Abep-(1→3)-α-D-Manp2Me-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative comprised of abequose, mannose and two glucose residues in linear sequence, connected by α-linkages (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4), respectively, and with β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: aldehydo-D-talose
definition: D-Talose in its acyclic form.

name: D-talopyranose
definition: D-Talose in its pyranose ring form.

name: α-D-Talp-(1→2)-[α-D-Abep-(1→3)]-α-D-Manp
definition: A trisaccharide comprised of α-D-abequose and α-D-talose residues linked (1→3) and (1→2), respectively, to α-D-mannose.

name: 4-(3-methylbut-2-enyl)-L-abrine
definition: A methy-amino acid that is L-tryptophan substituted at the Nα-position by a methyl group and at the 4-position by a 3-methylbut-2-enyl group.

name: 2,6-dihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid having the two hydroxy groups at the C-2 and C-6 positions.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-{α-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tridecasaccharide derivative in which two pentasaccharide branches, each formed from α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose, are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose and two N-acetylglucosamine residues all linked β(1→4) with a β-configuration of the anomeric carbon of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: 2'-O-methylinosine
definition: Inosine carrying a methyl substituent on the hydroxy group at position 2' on the ribose ring.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-{α-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tridecasaccharide derivative in which two pentasaccharide branches, each formed from α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose, are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose and two N-acetylglucosamine residues all linked β(1→4) with a β-configuration of the anomeric carbon of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: tetrahydrofolyl-poly(L-glutamate) macromolecule
definition: A tetrahydrofolyl-poly(glutamate) macromolecule in which the glutamate residues all have L-configuration.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-{α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tridecasaccharide derivative in which two pentasaccharide branches, each formed from α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose, are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose and two N-acetylglucosamine residues all linked β(1→4) with a β-configuration of the anomeric carbon of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: (Z)-2,3-dehydroadipoyl-CoA
definition: A cis-2-enoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the enoic carboxy group of (Z)-hex-2-enedioic acid.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched pentasaccharide derivative consisting of an α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide backbone onto which are linked two α-α-L-fucosyl residues, one (1→2) onto the central galactose residue and the other (1→3) onto the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched tetrasaccharide with a structure consisting of an α-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-galactosyl-(1→4)-glucose backbone, to the subterminal galactose of which is α(1→2)-linked a fucosyl residue.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising an α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopsyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine linear trisaccharide, the central galactoside residue of which is linked to a further α-D-galactose residue via an α(1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-D-GlcNAc with β-configuration at the GlcNAc anomeric centre.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprised of an L-α-fucosyl residue linked (1→3) to the GlcNAc residue of α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: everolimus
definition: A macrocyclic lactone that is rapamycin in which the hydroxy group attached to the cyclohexyl moiety has been converted into the corresponding 2-hydroxyethyl ether. It is an immunosuppressant and antineoplastic agent.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a undecasaccharide derivative in which two tetrasaccharide branches, each formed from α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose, are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose and two N-acetylglucosamine residues all linked β(1→4) with a β-configuration of the anomeric carbon of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide in which an α-L-fucosyl residue is linked (1→2) to the middle galactosyl residue of an α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-3-O-(1-carboxylatovinyl)-α-D-glucosamine(3−)
definition: A UDP-N-acetyl-3-O-(1-carboxylatovinyl)-D-glucosamine(3−) in which the anomeric centre of the glucosamine fragment has α-configuration.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-DGlcp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, and β-D-glucose residues joined in sequence with ((1→4)-, (1→4)-, (1→3)- and (1→4)-linkages, respectively.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp with β-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: 3-indole carboxylic acid glucuronide
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of indole-3-carboxylic acid with the anomeric hydroxy group of β-D-glucuronic acid.

name: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactose(1−)
definition: A dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose(1−) in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactose(2−)
definition: A dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: 3-methoxysalicylic acid
definition: Benzoic acid substituted with a hydroxy group at position C-2 and a methoxy group at position C-3.

name: 3-methylcrotonyl glycine
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as 3-methylbut-2-enoyl.

name: m-methylhippuric acid
definition: An N-acylglycine that is the 3-methyl derivative of hippuric acid.

name: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose(1−)
definition: A dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose(1−) in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: 3,3-dimethylglutaric acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is glutaric acid substituted by two methyl groups at the C-3 position.

name: 3-methyladipic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is adipic acid substituted with a methyl group at position C-3.

name: pyrocatechol sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is catechol with one of the two hydroxy groups substituted by a sulfo group.

name: (S)-3-ammonio-3-phenylpropanoate
definition: An optically active form of 3-ammonio-3-phenylpropanoate having (S)-configuration.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-3-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-α-D-glucosamine
definition: A UDP-N-acetyl-3-O-(1-carboxyvinyl)-D-glucosamine in which the anomeric centre of the glucosamine fragment has α-configuration.

name: diethyl maleate
definition: A maleate ester resulting from the formal condensation of both carboxy groups of maleic acid with ethanol. A colourless liquid at room temperature (m.p. -10°C) with boiling point 220°C at 1 atm., it is commonly used as a dienophile for Diels-Alder-type cycloaddition reactions in organic synthesis.

name: tetrahydrofolyl-poly(L-glutamic acid) macromolecule
definition: A tetrahydrofolyl-poly(glutamic acid) macromolecule in which the glutamic acid residues all have L-configuration.

name: 3,4-dihydroxy-4-methylhexadecanoic acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that consists of palmitic acid bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 and a methyl substituent at position 4.

name: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactose
definition: A dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: 17β(H),21β(H)-bishomohopanol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is hopane in which a hydrogen attached to C-29 is replaced by a 2-hydroxyethyl group.

name: dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-galactose
definition: A dTDP-4-acetamido-4,6-dideoxy-D-galactose in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: 17α(H),21β(H)-bishomohopanol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is hopane in which a hydrogen attached to C-29 is replaced by a 2-hydroxyethyl group and in which the stereochemistry at C-17 is inverted to 17αH.

name: dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-4-amino-4,6-dideoxy-D-glucose in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-cis-vaccenoyl-3-α-D-glucosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: An α-D-Glc-(1→3')-1,2-diacylglycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and cis-vaccenoyl [(11Z)-octadec-11-enoyl] respectively. Found in Streptococcus pneumoniae.

name: (S)-3-amino-3-phenylpropanoic acid
definition: An optically active form of 3-amino-3-phenylpropanoic acid having S-configuration.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-cis-vaccenoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and cis-vaccenoyl [(11Z)-octadec-11-enoyl] respectively.

name: 3-ammonio-3-phenylpropanoate
definition: An amino-acid zwitterion arising form transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 3-amino-3-phenylpropanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-amino-3-phenylpropanoic acid
definition: A β-amino acid that is β-alanine substituted at position 3 by a phenyl group.

name: 2-palmitoyl-1-cis-vaccenoyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-α-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are cis-vaccenoyl [(11Z)-octadec-11-enoyl] and palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) respectively.

name: [β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→6)]14-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-1-diphospho-trans,octacis-decaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of the 32-membered glycosyl moiety, [β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→6)]14-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc attached at the 1-position to trans,octacis-decaprenyl phosphate.

name: 3,7-dimethyluric acid
definition: An oxopurine that is 7,9-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6,8(3H)-trione substituted by methyl groups at N-3 and N-7.

name: 2-palmitoyl-1-cis-vaccenoyl-3-α-D-glucosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: An α-D-Glc-(1→3')-1,2-diacylglycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are cis-vaccenoyl [(11Z)-octadec-11-enoyl] and palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) respectively.

name: bosutinib hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of anhydrous bosutinib.

name: enzalutamide
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-{3-[4-cyano-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-5,5-dimethyl-4-oxo-2-thioxoimidazolidin-1-yl}-2-fluorobenzoic acid with methylamine. Used for the treatment of of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

name: 1,2-di-cis-vaccenoyl-3-α-D-glucosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: An α-D-Glc-(1→3')-1,2-diacylglycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both cis-vaccenoyl [(11Z)-octadec-11-enoyl].

name: 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoyl-3-α-D-glucosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: An α-D-Glc-(1→3')-1,2-diacylglycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are oleoyl [(9Z)-octadec-9-enoyl] and palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) respectively.

name: N-desmethylenzalutamide
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-{3-[4-cyano-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-5,5-dimethyl-4-oxo-2-thioxoimidazolidin-1-yl}-2-fluorobenzoic acid with ammonia.

name: 2-oleoyl-1-palmitoyl-3-α-D-glucosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: An α-D-Glc-(1→3')-1,2-diacylglycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are palmitoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: teriflunomide
definition: An enamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2Z)-2-cyano-3-hydroxybut-2-enoic acid with the anilino group of 4-(trifluoromethyl)aniline. Used for the treatment of relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis and rheumatoid arthritis.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose comprised of two β-D-galactose residues linked (1→2).

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-DMan-(1→3)-{β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-DMan-(1→6)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a dodecasaccharide derivative in which two tetrasaccharide branches, each formed from α-L-fucosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose, are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a branched tetrasaccharide chain consisting of mannose linked β(1→4) to an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue to which is also linked (1→6) an α-L-fucosyl residue, the whole being linked β(1→4) to an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: linaclotide
definition: A fourteen-membered heterodetic cyclic peptide consisting of Cys, Cys, Glu, Tyr, Cys, Cys, Asn, Pro, Ala, Cys, Thr, Gly, Cys and Tyr residues joined in sequence and cyclised by three disulfide bonds: between Cys1 and Cys6, between Cys2 and Cys10, and between Cys5 and Cys13. Used for treatment of irritable bowel syndrome accompanied by constipation.

name: p-methylhippuric acid
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as 4-methylbenzoyl.

name: deferiprone
definition: A member of the class of 4-pyridones that is pyridin-4(1H)-one substituted at positions 1 and 2 by methyl groups and at position 3 by a hydroxy group. A lipid-soluble iron-chelator used for treatment of thalassaemia.

name: 5-sulfosalicylic acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by a hydroxy at position C-2 and a sulfo group at C-5.

name: icatibant
definition: A ten-membered synthetic oligopeptide consisting of D-Arg, Arg, Pro, Hyp, Gly, Thi, Ser, D-Tic, Oic, and Arg residues joined in sequrence. A bradykinin receptor antagonist used as its acetate salt for the treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema in adult patients.

name: ticagrelor
definition: A triazolopyrimidine that is an adenosine isostere; the cyclopentane ring is similar to ribose and the nitrogen-rich [1,2,3]triazolo[4,5-d]pyrimidine moiety resembles the nucleobase adenine. A platelet aggregation inhibitor which is used for prevention of thromboembolic events in patients with acute coronary syndrome.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-DMan-(1→3)-{β-D-Gal-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-DMan-(1→6)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a dodecasaccharide derivative in which two tetrasaccharide branches, each formed from α-L-fucosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose, are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a linear trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose linked β(1→4) to an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue which is itself linked β(1→4) to an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-6-(α-D-galactose-1-phosphonato)-α-D-glucosamine(3−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of UDP-N-acetyl-6-(α-D-galactose-1-phosphonato)-α-D-glucosamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyltyrosine
definition: An N-acetyl-amino acid that is tyrosine with an amine hydrogen substituted by an acetyl group.

name: PIM2
definition: A phosphatidylinositol dimannoside having the phosphatidyl moiety (with acyl groups palmitoyl and tuberculostearoyl at the 1- and 2-positions respectively) at the 1-position, and with two single mannosyl residues at the 2- and 6-positions of the inositol ring.

name: icatibant acetate
definition: An acetate salt obtained by combining icatibant with acetic acid. Used for the treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema in adult patients.

name: tuberculostearic acid
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acid, the structure of which is that of stearic acid carrying a methyl group at C-10.

name: 3-methylglutaric acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is glutaric acid substituted at position 3 by a methyl group.

name: 2-methylglutaric acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is glutaric acid substituted at position 2 by a methyl group.

name: O-adipoylcarnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine compound having adipoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: 2-aminonicotinic acid
definition: An aminonicotinic acid in which the amino group is situated at position 2 of the pyridine ring.

name: indacaterol maleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by reaction of indacaterol with one equivalent of maleic acid. Used for treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: indacaterol(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of indacaterol, obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group.

name: indacaterol
definition: A monohydroxyquinoline that consists of 5-[(1R)-2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl]-8-hydroxyquinolin-2-one having a 5,6-diethylindan-2-yl group attached to the amino function. Used as the maleate salt for treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: dTDP-6-deoxy-β-L-talose(2−)
definition: A dTDP-6-deoxy-L-talose(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has β-configuration.

name: 4-aminonicotinic acid
definition: An aminonicotinic acid in which the amino group is situated at position 4 of the pyridine ring.

name: 5-aminonicotinic acid
definition: An aminonicotinic acid in which the amino group is situated at position 5 of the pyridine ring.

name: rivaroxaban
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-chlorothiophene-2-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 4-{4-[(5S)-5-(aminomethyl)-2-oxo-1,3-oxazolidin-3-yl]phenyl}morpholin-3-one. An anticoagulant used for prophylaxis of venous thromboembolism in patients with knee or hip replacement surgery.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising a linear chain of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetylβ-D-glucosamine, all linked (1→3), with an α-L-fucose residue (1→4)-linked to each N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising a linear chain of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, linked (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4) respectively, with an α-L-fucose residue linked to each N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue, (1→3)-linked to the reducing-end GlcNAc and (1→4)-linked to the GlcNAc at the non-reducing end.

name: 6-aminonicotinic acid
definition: An aminonicotinic acid in which the amino group is situated at position 6 of the pyridine ring.

name: ezogabine
definition: A substituted aniline that is benzene-1,2,4-triamine bearing ethoxycarbonyl and 4-fluorobenzyl substituents at positions N-1 and N-4 respectively. An anticonvulsant used to treat seizures associated with epilepsy in adults.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear chain of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, linked (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4) respectively, with an α-L-fucose residue (1→4)-linked to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the non-reducing end.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a β-D-galactose residue (1→3)-linked to the reducing-end GalNAc residue of a linear chain of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked (1→4) and (1→6) respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc with β-configuration at the anomeric centre of the reducing-end GalNAc residue.

name: 5-aminosalicyluric acid
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as 5-amino-2-hydroxybenzoyl.

name: fidaxomicin
definition: An 18-membered macrolide that is a fermentation product obtained from the Actinomycete Dactylosporangium aurantiacum. A narrow spectrum antibiotic used for treatment of Clostridium difficile-related infections.

name: eurysterol A sulfonic acid
definition: A steroid sulfate that is 5α-cholestane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 6, a bridged oxolane at positions 8 and 19 pand a sulfate group at position 3.

name: eurysterol A(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by the deprotonation of the sulfate group of eurysterol A sulfonic acid.

name: eurysterol B(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by the deprotonation of the sulfate group of eurysterol B hydrogen sulfate.

name: eurysterol B sulfonic acid
definition: A steroid sulfate that is 5α-cholestane with a double bond at position 22, hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 6, a bridged oxolane between positions 8 and 19 and a sulfate group at position 3.

name: telaprevir
definition: An oligopeptide consisting of N-(pyrazin-2-ylcarbonyl)cyclohexylalanyl, 3-methylvalyl, octahydrocyclopenta[c]pyrrole-1-carboxy, and 3-amino-N-cyclopropyl-2-oxohexanamide residues joined in sequence. Used for treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus genotype 1 infection.

name: α-Asp-Leu
definition: A dipeptide that is the N-(L-α-aspartyl) derivative of L-leucine.

name: clathsterol(2−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion which is a dianion obtained by the deprotonation of both the sulfate groups of clathsterol disulfonic acid.

name: clathsterol disulfonic acid
definition: A steroid sulfate which is 16-hydroxystigmastane-2,3-diyl disulfonic acid that is substituted by a acetyloxy group at position 15 and by butanoyloxy groups at positions 22 and 23.

name: α-Asp-Ile
definition: A dipeptide that is the N-(L-α-aspartyl) derivative of L-isoleucine.

name: β-Asp-Leu
definition: A dipeptide that is the N-(L-β-aspartyl) derivative of L-leucine.

name: β-Asp-Ile
definition: A dipeptide that is the N-(L-β-aspartyl) derivative of L-isoleucine.

name: rilpivirine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of rilpivirine with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. Used for treatment of HIV.

name: betamethasone phosphate
definition: A steroid phosphate that is the 21-O-phospho derivative of betamethasone.

name: betamethasone phosphate(2−)
definition: A steroid phosphate oxoanion which is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of betamethasone phosphate.

name: rilpivirine(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the addition of a proton to rilpivirine.

name: rilpivirine
definition: An aminopyrimidine that is pyrimidine-2,4-diamine in which the amino groups at positions 2 and 4 are substituted by 4-cyanophenyl and 4-[(E)-2-cyanovinyl]-2,6-dimethylphenyl groups respectively. Used for treatment of HIV.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-{α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)}-D-GalNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide chain consisting of α-neuraminic acid, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-D-glucosamine, and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues, linked sequentially (2→3), (1→4), and (1→6), with an α-L-fucosyl residue linked (1→3) to the N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue and a D-galactose residue linked (1→3) to the reducing-end N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue.

name: eritoran
definition: A lipid A derivative used for the treatment of severe sepsis.

name: linagliptin
definition: A xanthine that is 7H-xanthine bearing (4-methylquinazolin-2-yl)methyl, methyl, but-2-yn-1-yl and 3-aminopiperidin-1-yl substituents at positions 1, 3, 7 and 8 respectively (the R-enantiomer). Used for treatment of type II diabetes.

name: eritoran(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the tetraanion obtained by the deprotonation of all the phosphate OH groups of eritoran.

name: aurothiomalate(2−)
definition: A C4-dicarboxylate which is a dianion obtained by the deprotonation of the two carboxy OH groups of aurothiomalic acid.

name: N-cinnamoylglycine
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as (2E)-3-phenylprop-2-enoyl (cinnamoyl).

name: eosin b(2−)
definition: A phenolate anion which is a dianion obtained by the deprotonation of both the phenolic OH groups of eosin b diphenol.

name: eosin b diphenol
definition: A C-nitro compound which consists of a fluorescein skeleton substituted by bromo groups at positions 4 and 5 and nitro groups at positions 2 and 7.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear sequence of α-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactosamine and β-D-glucosamine residues linked (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), with an N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid residue linked (2→6) to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue.

name: boceprevir
definition: A synthetic tripeptide consisting of N-(tert-butylcarbamoyl)-3-methyl-L-valyl, a cyclopropyl-fused prolyl and 3-amino-4-cyclobutyl-2-oxobutanamide residues joined in sequence. Used for treatment of chronic hepatitis C virus genotype 1 infection.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of N-acetylneuraminic acid, β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxygalactoyranose residues joined in sequence by (2→3), (1→4), and (1→6) glycosidic bonds in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose moiety bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding β-D-galactopyranoside.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-mannosamine(2−)
definition: A UDP-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: cis-abienol
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at C-12 and C-14 (the former with Z-stereochemistry) and carries a hydroxy group at position C-8.

name: valerena-4,7(11)-diene
definition: A bicyclic sesquiterpene that is 2,4,5,6,7,7a-hexahydro-1H-indene substituted at positions 3 and 7 by methyl groups and at position 4 by a 3,3-dimethylallyl group (the 4S,7R,7aR-stereoisomer).

name: valerenate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of valerenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tartrazine(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion which is also a monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo and carboxy groups of tartrazine acid.

name: tartrazine acid
definition: A pyrazoles which is pyrazole-3-carboxylic acid substituted by an oxo group at position 5, a 4-sulfophenyl group at position 1 and (4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl group at position 4.

name: tetrasulfocyanine(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion which is the trianion obtained by the deprotonation of the sulfo groups of tetrasulfocyanine acid.

name: tetrasulfocyanine acid
definition: A arenesulfonic acid in which two sulfonated indole moieties are linked via a 4-methylhepta-1,3,5-triene-1,7-diyl chain.

name: cortisol phosphate(2−)
definition: A steroid phosphate oxoanion which is the dianion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of cortisol phosphate.

name: cortisol phosphate
definition: A steroid phosphate that is the 21-O-phospho derivative of cortisol.

name: trisodium guanosine 5'-[β,γ-methylene]triphosphate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the trisodium salt of guanosine 5'-(β,γ-methylene)triphosphate.

name: p-hydroxyphenylbut-3-ene-2-one
definition: An enone in which a 4-hydroxyphenyl group is attached to the β-carbon atom of but-3-en-2-one.

name: dexamethasone phosphate
definition: A steroid phosphate that is the 21-O-phospho derivative of dexamethasone.

name: dexamethasone phosphate(2−)
definition: A steroid phosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of dexamethasone phosphate.

name: abiraterone acetate
definition: A sterol ester obtained by formal condensation of the 3-hydroxy group of abiraterone with the carboxy group of acetic acid. A prodrug that is converted in vivo into abiraterone. Used for treatment of metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer.

name: (−)-cotinine
definition: An N-alkylpyrrolidine that consists of N-methylpyrrolidinone bearing a pyridin-3-yl substituent at position C-5 (the 5S-enantiomer). It is an alkaloid commonly found in Nicotiana tabacum.

name: abiraterone
definition: A 3β-sterol that is androsta-5,16-dien-3β-ol substituted at position 17 by a 3-pyridyl group. Administered as the O-acetate, it is used for treatment of metastatic castrate-resistant prostate cancer.

name: estramustine phosphate
definition: A steroid phosphate which is the 17-O-phospho derivative of estramustine.

name: estramustine phosphate(2−)
definition: A steroid phosphate oxoanion which is the dianion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of estramustine phosphate.

name: 2,4-diacetamido-2,4,6-trideoxy-α-D-mannopyranose
definition: An amino sugar that consists of 6-deoxy-α-D-mannose having the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4 replaced by acetamido groups.

name: regorafenib hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of anhydrous regorafenib. Used for for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer in patients who have previously received chemotherapy, anti-EGFR or anti-VEGF therapy.

name: regorafenib
definition: A pyridinecarboxamide obtained by condensation of 4-[4-({[4-chloro-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]carbamoyl}amino)-3-fluorophenoxy]pyridine-2-carboxylic acid with methylamine. Used for for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer in patients who have previously received chemotherapy, anti-EGFR or anti-VEGF therapy.

name: dimethyl ditelluride
definition: An organotellurium compound that is ditellane in which the two hydrogens are replaced by methyl groups.

name: pentalenate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of pentalenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-deoxypentalenate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 1-deoxypentalenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-N,N'-diacetyl-α-D-bacillosaminyl-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-N,N'-diacetyl-α-D-bacillosaminyl-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]4-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of [α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]4-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]2-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)]-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]2-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of [α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]2-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)]-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]2-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Δ6-protoilludene
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpene that is 2,4,4a,5,6,7,7a,7b-octahydro-1H-cyclobuta[e]indene bearing four methyl substituents at positions 3, 6, 6 and 7b.

name: raspberry ketone
definition: A ketone that is 4-phenylbutan-2-one in which the phenyl ring is substituted at position 4 by a hydroxy group. It is found in a variety of fruits including raspberries, blackberries and cranberries, and is used in perfumery and cosmetics.

name: zingerone
definition: A methyl ketone that is 4-phenylbutan-2-one in which the phenyl ring is substituted at positions 3 and 4 by methoxy and hydroxy groups respectively. The major pungent component in ginger.

name: (+)-epi-α-bisabolol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is bisabolane having double bonds at positions 2 and 9 as well as a hydroxy substituent at position 7.

name: FR901469(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by the protonation of the amino group of FR901469.

name: FR901469
definition: A 40-membered macrocyclic cyclodepsipeptide that consists of a 3-hydroxypalmitoyl moiety linked to a peptide sequence of 12 amino acids and cyclised head-to-tail. It is isolated from an unidentified Fungus and exhibits antifungal activity.

name: S-ethylhomocysteine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is methionine in which the S-methyl group is replaced by an S-ethyl group.

name: D-ethionine
definition: An S-ethylhomocysteine that has R-configuration at the chiral centre.

name: pentalenic acid
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpenoid that is pentalenene in which the 13-methyl group is oxidsed to the carboxylic acid and position 1 is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: (−)-α-isocomene
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpene that is 1,2,3,3a,5a,6,7,8-octahydrocyclopenta[c]pentalene bearing four methyl substituents at positions 1, 3a, 4 and 5a.

name: (E)-2-epi-β-caryophyllene
definition: A sesquiterpene with a [7.2.0]-bicyclic structure comprising fused 9- and 4-membered rings, with a cis-ring junction, a methylidene group at position 9, and methyl groups at positions 3, 11, and 11.

name: legionaminate(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of legionaminic acid obtained by protonation of both amino groups and deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N,N-diacetyllegionaminate
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion that is the conjugate base of N,N-diacetyllegionaminic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: CMP-N,N-diacetyllegionaminate(2−)

definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the triphosphate and phosphonate OH groups of α-D-ribose 1-methylphosphonate 5-triphosphate.

name: α-D-ribose 1-methylphosphonate 5-triphosphate
definition: A ribose triphosphate that is α-D-ribose having a triphosphate group at position 5 as well as a methylphosphonate group at position 1.

name: N,N'-diacetyl-α-D-bacillosaminyl-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of N,N'-diacetyl-α-D-bacillosamine linked via a diphospho group to tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenol.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-N,N'-diacetyl-α-D-bacillosaminyl-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-N,N'-diacetyl-α-D-bacillosamine linked via a diphospho group to tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenol.

name: α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of the trisaccharide α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac linked via a diphospho group to tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenol.

name: 1-deoxy-3-dehydrosphinganine(1+)
definition: A cationic sphingoid obtained by the protonation of the amino group of 1-deoxy-3-dehydrosphinganine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]4-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of the hexasaccharide [α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]4-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac linked via a diphospho group to tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenol.

name: O-decanoylcarnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine compound having decanoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: [α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]2-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)]-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]2-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac-tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl phosphate consisting of the heptasaccharide [α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]2-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)]-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]2-α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-diNAcBac linked via a diphospho group to tritrans,heptacis-undecaprenol.

name: 1-deoxypentalenic acid
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpenoid that is pentalenene in which the 13-methyl group is oxidsed to the carboxylic acid.

name: dehydroisoandrosterone 3-glucuronide
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid having dehydroepiandrosterone as the steroid component.

name: gabapentin enacarbil
definition: A carbamate ester that is the N-[1-(isobutyryloxy)ethoxy]carbonyl derivative of [1-(aminomethyl)cyclohexyl]acetic acid. The prodrug for gabapentin, used for treatment of neuropathic pain and restless legs syndrome.

name: gadobutrol
definition: A gadolinium coordination entity consisting of a central Gd(III) atom bound to a macrocyclic tetraamine framework. It is used as a paramagnetic contrast agent in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprised of a linear sequence of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, all linked (1→3).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A tetrasaccharide comprising residues of galactose, N-acetylglucosamine, galactose and N-acetylglucosamine units in a linear sequence, joined sequentially via β(1→3), β(1→3), and β(1→4) linkages. β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc with β-configuration at the anomeric centre of the reducing-end N-acetylglucosamine residue.

name: azilsartan medoxomil
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of azilsartan with the hydroxy group of 4-(hydroxymethyl)-5-methyl-1,3-dioxol-2-one. A prodrug for azilsartan, it is used for treatment of hypertension.

name: Glu-Val
definition: A glutamyl-L-amino acid that is the N-(L-α-glutamyl) derivative of L-leucine.

name: azilsartan kamedoxomil
definition: An organic potassium salt that is the monopotassium salt of azilsartan medoxomil. A prodrug for azilsartan, it is used for treatment of hypertension.

name: γ-Glu-Val
definition: A glutamyl-L-amino acid that is the N-(L-γ-glutamyl) derivative of L-leucine.

name: azilsartan medoxomil(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the oxadiazolone ring of azilsartan medoxomil.

name: azilsartan
definition: A benzimidazolecarboxylic acid that is benzimidazole-7-carboxylic acid substituted at position 2 by a methoxy group and at position 1 by a 2'-[(5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1,2,4-oxadiazol-3-yl)biphenyl-4-yl]methyl group. Used (as the prodrug, azilsartan medoxomil) for treatment of hypertension.

name: poly(glycerol phosphate) anion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by global deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of poly(glycerol phosphate).

name: all-trans-polyprenol phosphate(2−)
definition: Major structure at pH 7.3 of all-trans-polyprenol phosphate.

name: polyprenyl D-glucosyl phosphate(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of polyprenyl D-glucosyl phosphate, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate group; major structure at pH 7.3.

name: all-cis-polyprenol phosphate(2−)
definition: Major structure at pH 7.3 of all-cis-polyprenyl phosphate.

name: ioflupane I123
definition: An azabicycloalkane that is ecgonine methyl ester in which the N-methyl group is replaced by 3-fluoropropyl and the 3β-hydroxy group is replaced by 4-(123I)iodophenyl. Used for the imaging of dopamine transporters in the brain of adult patients with potential Parkinsonian Syndromes.

name: arugosin B
definition: A dibenzooxepine that is dibenzo[b,e]oxepin-11(6H)-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 6 and 10, a methyl group at position 8, a prenyl group at position 4 and a prenyloxy group at position 7. Isolated from Aspergillus, it exhibits antibacterial activity.

name: arugosin C
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1,12a-dihydrochromeno[4,5-bc][1]benzoxepin-7(2H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8, a 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl group at position 1, a methyl group at position 4 and a prenyl group at position 9. Isolated from Aspergillus, it exhibits inhibitory activity against hepatitis C protease.

name: variecoxanthone C
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by a (3,3-dimethyoxiran-2-yl)methyl group at position 5, a hydroxy group at position 8, a hydroxymethyl group at position 1, a methyl group at position 3 and a prenyloxy group at position 2. It has been isolated from Aspergillus.

name: rel-(−)-(1R,4R,10R)-4-methoxycembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide substituted by a methoxy group at position 4. It has been isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(−)-(1S,4R,10R)-1-hydroxy-4-methoxycembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1 and a methoxy group at position 4. It has been isolated from the leaves of natural product found in Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(−)-(1S,4R,10R)-1,4-dihydroxycembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 4. It has been isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(−)-(1S,4S,10R)-1,4-dihydroxycembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 4. It has been isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(+)-(1R,4S,10R)-4-hydroxycembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-2E,7E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4. It has been isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(+)-(10R)-cembra-1E,3E,7E,11Z,15-pentaen-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(+)-(10R)-cembra-1Z,3Z,7E,11Z,15-pentaen-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(+)-(5R,10R)-5-methoxycembra-1E,3E,7E,11Z,15-pentaen-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-1E,3E,7E,11Z,15-pentaen-20,10-olide substituted by a methoxy group at position 5. It has been isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(+)-(1S,4S,7R,10R)-1,4,7-trihydroxycembra-2E,8-(19),11Z-trien-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-2E,8-(19),11Z-trien-20,10-olide substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 4 and 7. It has been isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(−)-(1S,4S,7S,10R)-1,4,7-trihydroxycembra-2E,8-(19),11Z-trien-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-2E,8-(19),11Z-trien-20,10-olide substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 4 and 7. It has been isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(+)-(1S,4R,8S,10R)-1,4,8-trihydroxycembra-2E,6E,11Z-trien-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid that is cembra-2E,8-(19),11Z-trien-20,10-olide substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 4 and 8. It has been isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: rel-(+)-(1R,10R)-cembra-2E,4E,7E,11Z-tetraen-20,10-olide
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid isolated from the leaves of Croton gratissimus.

name: quercetin 3-O-[α-L-rhamnopyranosyl(1→2)-β-D-galactopyranosyl]-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl(1→2)-β-D-galactopyranosyl residue at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkages. It has been isolated from Vicia faba and Lotus edulis.

name: kaempferol 3-O-(5-O-acetyl-α-D-apiofuranosyl)-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol attached to a 5-O-acetyl-α-D-apiofuranosyl residue at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkages. Isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis, it exhibits inhibitory activity against topoisomerse I and II.

name: kaempferol 3-O-α-L-arabinopyranosyl-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol attached to a α-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkages. Isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis, it exhibits inhibitory activity against topoisomerase I and II.

name: kaempferol 3-O-[α-L-rhamnopyranosyl(1→2)-β-D-glucopyranosyl]-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside that is kaempferol attached to a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl(1→2)-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7. Isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis, it exhibits inhibitory activity against topoisomerase I.

name: kaempferol 3-O-[α-L-rhamnopyranosyl(1→2)-β-D-galactopyranosyl]-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol attached to a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl(1→2)-β-D-galactopyranosyl residue at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkages. Isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis, it exhibits inhibitory activity against topoisomerase I.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-galactopyranosyl-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol attached to a β-D-galactopyranosyl residue at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkages. Isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis, it exhibits inhibitory activity against topoisomerase I.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside that is kaempferol attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7 via glycosidic linkages. Isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis, it exhibits inhibitory activity against topoisomerase I and II.

name: kaempferol 3,7-di-O-α-L-rhamnoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol attached to α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residues at positions 3 and 7 respectively via glycosidic linkages. It has been isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-apiofuranosyl-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol attached to a β-D-apiofuranosyl group at position 3 and a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. Isolated from the aerial parts of Vicia faba and Lotus edulis, it exhibits inhibitory activity against topoisomerase II.

name: hydroxytyrosol
definition: A member of the class of catechols that is benzene-1,2-diol substituted by a 2-hydroxyethyl group at position 4. Isolated from Olea europaea, it exhibits antioxidant and antineoplastic activities.

name: 24-ethylcholesta-4,22-dien-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo steroid that is cholesta-4,22-dien-3-one substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It has been isolated from Croton gratissimus.

name: calysolin I
definition: A resin glycoside that is the tetrasaccharide derivative of jalapinolic acid. It has been isolated from Calystegia soldanella.

name: calysolin II
definition: A resin glycoside that is the pentasaccharide derivative of jalapinolic acid. It has been isolated from Calystegia soldanella.

name: calysolin III
definition: A resin glycoside that is the pentasaccharide derivative of jalapinolic acid. It has been isolated from Calystegia soldanella.

name: calysolin IV
definition: A resin glycoside that is the hexasaccharide derivative of jalapinolic acid. It has been isolated from Calystegia soldanella.

name: (16α,20S,22S,23S)-16,23:22,25-diepoxy-2,22,23-trihydroxycucurbita-1,5-diene-3,11-dione 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin of the class of cucurbitane glycosides isolated from the roots of Machilus yaoshansis.

name: (16α,20R,22S,23S)-16,23:22,25-diepoxy-2,20,22,23-tetrahydroxycucurbita-1,5-diene-3,11-dione 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin of the class of cucurbitane glycosides isolated from the roots of Machilus yaoshansis. It has been shown to exhibit inhibitory activity against protein tyrosine phosphatase.

name: (16α,20R,24R)-24N,25-carbamoyloxy-2,16,20-trihydroxycucurbita-1,5-diene-3,11,22-trione 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin of the class of cucurbitane glycosides isolated from the roots of Machilus yaoshansis. It has been shown to exhibit inhibitory activity against protein tyrosine phosphatase.

name: (16α,20R,24S)-2,16,20,25-tetrahydroxy-24-methoxycucurbita-1,5-diene-3,11,22-trione 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is cucurbita-1,5-diene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 16, 20 and 25, a methoxy group at position 24, oxo groups at positions 3, 11 and 22 and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy residue at position 2. It has been isolated from the roots of Machilus yaoshansis.

name: cucurbitacin K 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin of the type of cucurbitane glycosides isolated from Machilus yaoshansis.

name: cucurbitacin J 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is the β-D-glucopyranosyl derivative of cucurbitacin J. It has been isolated from Machilus yaoshansis.

name: (16α,20R)-20,24-epoxy-2,16-dihydroxy-25,26,27-trinorcucurbita-1,5,23-triene-3,11,22-trione 2-O-β-Dglucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin of the class of cucurbitane glycosides isolated from Machilus yaoshansis.

name: 2-hydroxy-(22-27)-hexanorcucurbita-1,5,16-triene-3,11,20-trione 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin of the class of cucurbitane glycosides isolated from Machilus yaoshansis.

name: cucurbitacin E 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is cucurbitacin E attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 2 via a glycosidic linkage. Isolated from Machilus yaoshansis it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: cucurbitacin I 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is cucurbitacin I attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 2 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from Machilus yaoshansis.

name: khekadaengoside K
definition: A triterpenoid saponin isolated from Machilus yaoshansis.

name: bruceolline H
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydrocyclopenta[b]indole substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6, geminal-methyl groups at position 3 and oxo groups at positions 1 and 2. It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceolline I
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydrocyclopenta[b]indole substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 6, geminal-methyl groups at position 3 and an oxo group at position 1. It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceolline J
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydrocyclopenta[b]indole substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2, geminal-methyl groups at position 3 and an oxo group at position 1. It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceolline K
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydrocyclopenta[b]indole substituted by geminal-methyl groups at position 3, an oxo group at position 1 and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 2.It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceolline L
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 1H-indole substituted by a (2R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutanoyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceolline M
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 1H-indole substituted by a 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-oxobutyl group at position 3 and a β-D-glucopyranosyl group attached to the indolic nitrogen. It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceolline N
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-indole substituted by hydroxy group at position 3, a 2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutyl group at position 3, an oxo group at position 2 and a β-D-glucopyranosyl group attached to the indolic nitrogen. It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceolline E
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydrocyclopenta[b]indole substituted by geminal-methyl groups at position 3 and oxo groups at positions 1 and 2. It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceolline F
definition: An indole alkaloid that is 1H-indole substituted by a (2S)-2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylbutyl group at position 3 and a β-D-glucopyranosyl group attached to the indolic nitrogen. It has been isolated from the ethanol extract of the stems of Brucea mollis.

name: yadanziolide T
definition: A quassinoid that is picras-3-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 11, 12, 15 and 21 and oxo groups at positions 2 and 16. Isolated from the ethanol extract of the stem of Brucea mollis, it exhibits cytotoxic activity.

name: yadanziolide U
definition: A quassinoid that is picras-3-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 11, 12 and 15, oxo groups at positions 2 and 16 and a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy residue at position 21. It has been isolated from he ethanol extract of the stem of Brucea mollis.

name: yadanziolide V
definition: A quassinoid isolated from he ethanol extract of the stem of Brucea mollis.

name: bruceine D
definition: A quassinoid that is 13,20-epoxypicras-3-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 11, 12, 14 and 15 and oxo groups at positions 2 and 16. Isolated from the ethanol extract of the stem of Brucea mollis, it exhibits cytotoxic activity.

name: yadanziolide B
definition: A quassinoid that is 13,20-epoxypicras-3-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 6, 11, 12, 14, 15 and 21 and oxo groups at positions 2 and 16. Isolated from the ethanol extract of the stem of Brucea mollis, it exhibits cytotoxic activity.

name: (±)-chartaceone A
definition: A racemate composed of equimolar concentrations of chartaceone A1, A2, A3 and A4. It has been isolated from the barks of Cryptocarya chartacea.

name: (±)-chartaceone B
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and a 6-carboxy-1-phenylhex-1-en-1-yl group at position 6. It has been isolated as a racemate from the bark of Cryptocarya chartacea.

name: (±)-chartaceone C
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and 6-carboxy-1-phenylhex-2-en-1-yl groups at positions 6 and 8 respectively. It has been isolated as a racemate from the bark of Cryptocarya chartacea and exhibits inhibitory activity against dengue virus NS5 polymerase.

name: (±)-chartaceone D
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7, 6-carboxy-1-phenylhex-2-en-1-yl group at positions 6 and a 6-carboxy-1-phenylhex-1-en-3-yl group at position 8. It has been isolated as a racemate from the bark of Cryptocarya chartacea and exhibits inhibitory activity against dengue virus NS5 polymerase.

name: (±)-chartaceone E
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7, a 6-carboxy-1-phenylhex-2-en-1-yl group at position 8 and 6-carboxy-1-phenylhex-2-en-3-yl groups at position 6. It has been isolated as a racemate from the bark of Cryptocarya chartacea and exhibits inhibitory activity against dengue virus NS5 polymerase.

name: (±)-chartaceone F
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 and 6-carboxy-1-phenylhex-1-en-3-yl groups at positions 6 and 8 respectively. It has been isolated as a racemate from the bark of Cryptocarya chartacea and exhibits inhibitory activity against dengue virus NS5 polymerase.

name: 13-oxo-9Z,11E-ODE
definition: An oxooctadecadienoic acid that consists of 9Z,11E-octadecadienoic acid bearing an additional 13-keto substituent. In addtion it has been found as a natural product found in Carthamus oxyacantha.

name: klymollin A
definition: An eunicellin diterpenoid isolated from the soft coral Klyxum molle.

name: klymollin B
definition: An eunicellin diterpenoid isolated from the soft coral Klyxum molle. It is the C-7 epimer of Klymollin A.

name: klymollin C
definition: An eunicellin diterpenoid isolated from the soft coral Klyxum molle.

name: klymollin D
definition: An eunicellin diterpenoid isolated from the soft coral Klyxum molle.

name: klymollin E
definition: An eunicellin diterpenoid isolated from the soft coral Klyxum molle.

name: klymollin F
definition: An eunicellin diterpenoid isolated from the soft coral Klyxum molle.

name: klymollin G
definition: An eunicellin diterpenoid isolated from the soft coral Klyxum molle.

name: klymollin H
definition: An eunicellin diterpenoid isolated from the soft coral Klyxum molle.

name: longirostrerone A
definition: An azaphilone that is 9,9a-dihydro-6H-furo[2,3-h]isochromene-6,8(6aH)-dione substituted by a 4-hydroxy-2-methyl-6-oxocyclohexyl group at position 3, a methyl group at position 6a and a 4,6,8-trimethyldeca-2,4-dienoyl group at position 9. Isolated from Chaetomium longirostre, it exhibits cytotoxic and antimalarial activities.

name: longirostrerone B
definition: An azaphilone that is 7,8-dihydro-6H-isochromen-6-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7, a 4-hydroxy-2-methyl-6-oxocyclohexyl group at position 3, a methyl group at position 7 and a 5,7,9-trimethyl-2-oxoundeca-3,5-dien-1-yl group at position 8.
