name: combretanone G
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is 9β,19-cyclolanost-25-ene substituted by an oxo group at position 3, a hydroxy group at position 7 and a methoxy group at position 25. It has been isolated from the leaves of Combretum quadrangulare.

name: combretic acid A
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is 9β,19-cyclolanostan-28-oic acid substituted by an acetyloxy group at position 7 and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 25. It has been isolated from the leaves of Combretum quadrangulare.

name: combretic acid B
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is 9β,19-cyclolanost-25-en-28-oic acid substituted by an acetyloxy group at position 7 and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 24. It has been isolated from the leaves of Combretum quadrangulare.

name: 5,7,3',5'-tetrahydroxy-3,4'-dimethyoxyflavone
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4' are replaced by methoxy groups. It has been isolated from Combretum quadrangulare.

name: combretol
definition: A pentamethoxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3, 7, 3', 4' and 5' have been replaced by methoxy groups. It has been isolated from Combretum quadrangulare.

name: 3',5-dihydroxy-3,4',5',7-tetramethoxyflavone
definition: A tetramethoxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3, 7, 4' and 5' have been replaced by methoxy groups. It has been isolated from Combretum quadrangulare.

name: pachypodol
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is quercetin in which the hydroxy groups at position 3, 7 and 3' are replaced by methoxy groups. It has been isolated from Combretum quadrangulare and Euodia elleryana.

name: quercetin 3,4'-dimethyl ether
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is the 3,4'-dimethyl ether derivative of quercetin. Isolated from Combretum quadrangulare, it exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: 3',5,7-trihydroxy-3,4',5'-trimethoxyflavone
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at position 3, 4' and 5' have been replaced by methoxy groups. It has been isolated from Combretum quadrangulare.

name: comazaphilone A
definition: An azaphilone that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1H-isochromene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6, a methyl group at position 7, an oxo group at position 8, a propyl group at position 3 and a (4-hydroxy-2-methoxy-6-methylbenzoyl)oxy group at position 7. It has been isolated from Penicillium commune.

name: comazaphilone B
definition: An azaphilone that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1H-isochromene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6, a methyl group at position 7, an oxo group at position 8, a propyl group at position 3 and a (3,4-dihydroxy-2-methoxy-6-methylbenzoyl)oxy group at position 7. It has been isolated from Penicillium commune.

name: comazaphilone C
definition: An azaphilone that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1H-isochromene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6, a methyl group at position 7, an oxo group at position 8, a prop-1-en-1-yl group at position 3 and a (3,4-dihydroxy-2-methoxy-6-methylbenzoyl)oxy group at position 7. Isolated from Penicillium commune, it exhibits antibacterial activity.

name: comazaphilone D
definition: An azaphilone that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1H-isochromene substituted by a hydroxy and methyl group at position 7, an oxo group at position 8, a prop-1-en-1-yl group at position 3 and a (2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylbenzoyl)oxy group at position 6.Isolated from Penicillium commune, it exhibits antibacterial and antineoplastic activities.

name: comazaphilone E
definition: An azaphilone that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1H-isochromene substituted by a hydroxy group and a methyl group at position 7, an oxo group at position 8, a prop-1-en-1-yl group at position 3 and a (3,4-dihydroxy-2-methoxy-6-methylbenzoyl)oxy group at position 6. Isolated from Penicillium commune, it exhibits antibacterial and antineoplastic activities.

name: comazaphilone F
definition: An azaphilone that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1H-isochromene substituted by a hydroxy group and a methyl group at position 7, an oxo group at position 8, a propyl group at position 3 and a (3,4-dihydroxy-2-methoxy-6-methylbenzoyl)oxy group at position 6. Isolated from Penicillium commune, it exhibits antibacterial and antineoplastic activities.

name: (22E,24R)-ergosta-7,22-diene-3,6-dione
definition: A 3-oxo Δ7-steroid that is (22E)-ergosta-7,22-diene substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 6. It has been isolated from Penicillium commune.

name: asperamide B
definition: A glucosylceramide found in Penicillium commune.

name: (2S)-5,7,3'-trihydroxy-4'-methoxy-8-(3''-methylbut-2''-enyl)-flavonone
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that is hesperetin substituted by a prenyl group at position 8. Isolated from Macaranga conifera, it exhibits inhibitory activity against breast cancer resistance protein.

name: (S)-2-(3,5-dihydroxyphenyl)-5,7-dihydroxy-6,8-bis(3-methylbut-2-enyl)chroman-4-one
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 3' and 5' and prenyl groups at positions 6 and 8 respectively. It has been isolated from natural product found in Macaranga conifera.

name: (2S)-5,7,3',5'-tetrahydroxy-8-[3'',8''-dimethylocta-2''(E),7''-dienyl]flavonone
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 3' and 5' and a geranyl group at position 8. Isolated from Macaranga bicolor, it exhibits inhibitory activity against breast cancer resistance protein.

name: (S)-5,7-dihydroxy-2-(4-methoxyphenyl)-8-(3-methylbut-2-enyl)chroman-4-one
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7, a methoxy group at position 4' and a prenyl group at position 8. It has been isolated from Macaranga bicolor.

name: macarangin
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 7 and 4' and a geranyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from Macaranga bicolor.

name: sophoraflavanone A
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that is (S)-naringenin substituted by a geranyl group at position 8. Isolated from Macaranga bicolor, it exhibits antibacterial and antineoplastic activities.

name: quercetin 7,3',4'-trimethyl ether
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is the 7,3',4'-trimethyl ether derivative of quercetin. It has been isolated from Euodia confusa.

name: 5,7,3'-trihydroxy-3,5'-dimethoxy-2'-(3'-methylbut-2-enyl)flavone
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 3', methoxy groups at positions 3 and 5' and a prenyl group at position 2'. Isolated from Tabernaemontana macrocarpa, it exhibits inhibitory activity against breast cancer resistance protein.

name: 5-hydroxy-3-(4-hydroxy-3-methyl-but-2-enyl)-8,8-dimethyl-2-(2,4,5-trihydroxy-phenyl)-8H-pyrano[2,3-f]chromen-4-one
definition: An extended flavonoid that is flavone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 2', 4' and 5', a 3-(hydroxymethyl)but-2-en-1-yl group at position 3 and a 6,6-dimethyl-3,6-dihydro-2H-pyran group across positions 7 and 8. It has been isolated from Artocarpus odoratissimus.

name: luteolin-7-O-α-L-rhamnoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is luteolin substituted by a α-L-rhamnosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It has been isolated from Crotalaria lachnophora.

name: 2'-hydroxygenistein
definition: A hydroxyisoflavone that is genistein substituted by an additional hydroxy group at position 2'. It has been isolated from Crotalaria lachnophora.

name: 3'-O-methylorobol
definition: A hydroxyisoflavone that is orobol in which the hydroxy group at position 3' has been replaced by a methoxy group. It has been isolated from Crotalaria lachnophora.

name: 7-O-methyltectorigenin
definition: A methoxyisoflavone that is tectorigenin in which the hydroxy group at position 7 has been replaced by a methoxy group. It has been isolated from Crotalaria lachnophora.

name: cajanol
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanone that is (3S)-isoflavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 4' and methoxy groups at positions 7 and 2' respectively. It has been isolated from Crotalaria lachnophora.

name: 4-hydroxycordoin
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at position 4 and 2' and a (3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl)oxy group at position 4'. It has been isolated from Lonchocarpus neuroscapha.

name: myricitrin
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that consists of myricetin attached to a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage. Isolated from Myrica cerifera, it exhibits anti-allergic activity.

name: N-trans-sinapoyltyramine
definition: A N-sinapoyltyramine in which the double bond adopts trans-configuration. It is a natural product found in several plant species including Piper boehmeriaefolium.

name: cornusalterin A
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S,23E)-lanosta-7,23-diene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 25. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin B
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S,23E)-lanosta-23-ene substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 25. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin C
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S,23E)-lanosta-23-ene substituted by β-hydroxy group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 25. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin D
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S,23E)-lanosta-7,23,25-triene substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin E
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S)-lanosta-1,7-diene substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin F
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S)-lanosta-2,7-dien-1-one substituted by an oxo group at position 1. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin G
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S)-lanosta-7,24-diene substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 23. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin H
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S)-lanosta-7,24-diene substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 23 (the 23S stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin I
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S)-lanosta-7,9(11),24-triene substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 23. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin J
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S)-lanosta-7,24-diene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 23. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: cornusalterin K
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S)-lanost-5-ene substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and a β-hydroxy group at position 1.

name: cornusalterin L
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S,23S)-21,23-epoxylanosta-7,24-diene substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: deoxyflindissone
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S,23R)-21,23-epoxylanosta-7,24-diene substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: (−)-leucophyllone
definition: A tirucallane triterpenoid that is (13α,14β,17α,20S,23E)-lanosta-7,23-diene substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 25. It has been isolated from the stem and stem barks of Cornus walteri.

name: smenospongines C
definition: A sesquiterpenoid isolated from the marine sponge Dactylospongia elegans.

name: robustaside E
definition: A β-glucoside having 4-hydroxyphenoxy residue as the anomeric substituent and a [(2E)-3-(1,4-dihydroxy-6-oxocyclohex-2-en-1-yl)prop-2-enoyl]oxy residue at position 6. Isolated from Grevillea, it exhibits antimalarial activity.

name: robustaside F
definition: A β-D-glucoside in which the anomeric position is substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenoxy residue and the positions 2 and 6 are substituted by [(2Z)-3-(2-hydroxy-5-methoxyphenyl)prop-2-enoyl]oxy residues. Isolated from Grevillea, it exhibits antimalarial activity.

name: robustaside G
definition: A β-D-glucoside in which the anomeric position is substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenoxy residue and the positions 2 and 6 by [(2E)-3-(1-hydroxy-4-oxocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-yl)prop-2-enoyl]oxy residues. Isolated from Grevillea, it exhibits antimalarial activity.

name: robustaside D
definition: A β-D-glucoside in which the anomeric position is substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenoxy residue and at position 6 by [(2E)-3-(1-hydroxy-4-oxocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-yl)prop-2-enoyl]oxy residue. Isolated from Grevillea, it exhibits antimalarial activity.

name: quercetin-7-O-[α-L-rhamnopyranosyl(1→6)-β-D-galactopyranoside]
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that consists of quercetin substituted by a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl(1→6)-β-D-galactopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. Isolated from Grevillea, it exhibits antimalarial activity.

name: (+)-(S)-ar-turmerone
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is 2-methylhept-2-en-4-one substituted by a 4-methylphenyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from Peltophorum dasyrachis.

name: (+)-(S)-dihydro-ar-turmerone
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is 2-methylheptan-4-one substituted by a 4-methylphenyl group at position 6. It has been isolated from Peltophorum dasyrachis.

name: eutypoid B
definition: A butenolide that is furan-2(5H)-one substituted by a 4-hydroxybenzyl group at position 4 and a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from Penicillium species.

name: eutypoid C
definition: A butenolide that is furan-2(5H)-one substituted by a 3,4-dihydroxybenzyl group at position 4 and a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from Penicillium species.

name: eutypoid D
definition: A butenolide that is furan-2(5H)-one substituted by a 3,5-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 3 and a 4-hydroxybenzyl group at position 4. It has been isolated from Penicillium species.

name: eutypoid E
definition: A butenolide that is furan-2(5H)-one substituted by a 3,5-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 3 and a 3,4-dihydroxybenzyl group at position 4. It has been isolated from Penicillium species.

name: fellutanine
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione substituted by 1H-indol-3-ylmethyl groups at positions 3 and 6 respectively. Isolated from Penicillium species, it exhibits antibacterial activity.

name: (3S,4R)-4' hydroxy-6,3' dimethoxyisoflavan-4-ol
definition: A methoxyisoflavan that is (S)-isoflavan substituted by methoxy groups at positions 6 and 3' and hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 4'. It has been isolated from Taxus yunnanensis and exhibits inhibitory activity against CYP3A4.

name: 2,3-bis(hydroxymethyl)-7-hydroxy-6-methoxy-1-tetralone
definition: A member of the class of tetralins that is 3,4-dihydronaphthalen-1(2H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7, two hydroxymethyl groups at positions 2 and 4 and a methoxy group at position 6. It has been isolated from Taxus yunnanensis.

name: (7R)-7-hydroxytaxiresinol
definition: A lignan that consists of tetrahydrofuran substituted by a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 2, a hydroxymethyl group at position 3 and a hydroxy(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)methyl group at position 4. It has been isolated from Taxus yunnanensis.

name: isotaxiresinol
definition: A lignan that consists of 1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7, hydroxymethyl groups at positions 2 and 3, a methoxy group at position 6 and a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 1. It has been isolated from Taxus yunnanensis.

name: (7R)-7-hydroxylariciresinol
definition: A lignan that consists of a tetrahudrofuran substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 5, a hydroxymethyl group at position 4 and a hydroxy(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)methyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from Taxus yunnanensis.

name: tanegool
definition: A lignan that consists of tetrahydrofuran ring substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 5, a hydroxyphenyl group at position 4 and a hydroxy(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)methyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from Taxus yunnanensis.

name: taxiresinol
definition: A lignan that consists of tetrahydrofuran substituted by a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group at position 2, a hydroxymethyl group at position 3 and a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzyl group at position 4. It has been isolated from Taxus yunnanensis.

name: (7S,8S)-methoxy-3',7-epoxy-8,4'-oxyneolignan-4,9,9'-triol
definition: A neolignan that consists of a 2,3-dihydro-1,4-benzodioxine ring substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 3, a 3-hydroxypropyl group at position 7 and a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 2. It has been isolated from Taxus yunnanensis.

name: 8-C-α-L-arabinopyranosyl-7-O-β-D-glucopyranosylnaringenin
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone and a flavone C-glycoside that is (S)-naringenin substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage and a α-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 8. It has been isolated from the roots and leaves of Petrorhagia velutina.

name: 6-C-[2'-O-α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1''→2')]-α-L-arabinopyranosylluteolin
definition: A flavone C-glycoside that is luteolin substituted by a 2'-O-α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1''→2')-α-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 6. It has been isolated from the leaves and roots of Petrorhagia velutina.

name: 6-C-[2-O-α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1''→2')]-β-D-xylopyranosylluteolin
definition: A flavone C-glycoside that is luteolin substituted by a 2-O-α-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1''→2')]-β-D-xylopyranosyl residue at positon 6. It has been isolated from the leaves and roots of Petrorhagia velutina.

name: 2''-O-α-L-rhamnosylisoorietin
definition: The α-stereoisomer of isoorientin 2''-O-rhamnoside . It has been isolated from Petrorhagia velutina.

name: 2''-O-rhamnosylscoparin
definition: A flavone C-glycoside that is 5,7,4'-trihydroxy-3'-methoxyflavone substituted by a 2-O-(6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 8. It has been isolated from the leaves and roots of Petrorhagia velutina.

name: cassiaoccidentalin B
definition: A flavone C-glycoside that is luteolin substituted by a 6-deoxy-2-O-(6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranosyl)-β-L-ribo-hexopyranos-3-ulosyll residue at position 6. It has been found in Petrorhagia velutina and Cassia occidentalis.

name: maysin
definition: A flavone C-glycoside that is luteolin attached to a disaccharide residue at position 6. It has been isolated from natural product Petrorhagia velutina and Zea mays and exhibits insecticidal and neuroprotective activities.

name: dichotomide III
definition: A β-carboline alkaloid isolated from Stellaria dichotoma var. lanceolata. S

name: dichotomide IV
definition: A β-carboline alkaloid found in Stellaria dichotoma var. lanceolata.

name: dichotomide V
definition: A β-carboline alkaloid isolated from Stellaria dichotoma var. lanceolata.

name: dichotomide VI
definition: A β-carboline alkaloid that is 9H-β-carboline substituted by acetyl group at position 1, a hydroxy group at position 8 and an aminocarbonyl at position 3. It has been isolated from Stellaria dichotoma var. lanceolata.

name: phenazine-1,6-dicarboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of phenazines carrying carboxy substituents at positions 1 and 6. A natural product found in Streptomyces species.

name: (−)-epicatechin-3-O-gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3R)-hydroxy group of epicatechin. A natural product found in Parapiptadenia rigida.

name: aglaiabbreviatin A
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from the stems of Aglaia abbreviata.

name: aglaiabbreviatin F
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid (dammarane type) isolated from the stems of Aglaia abbreviata.

name: cabralealactone
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from the stems of Aglaia abbreviata.

name: cabraleahydroxylactone
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from the stems of Aglaia abbreviata.

name: cabraleahydroxylactone acetate

name: ocotillone

name: cabraleadiol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from Aglaia abbreviata.

name: cabraleadiol monoacetate
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from Aglaia abbreviata.

name: 20S,24S-dihydroxydammer-25-en-3-one
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is dammer-25-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 20 and 24 and an oxo group at position 3 (the 24S-stereoisomer). It has been isolated from the stems of Aglaia abbreviata.

name: 24,25-dihydroxydammar-20-en-3-one
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is dammar-20-ene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 24 and 25 and an oxo group at position 3. It has been isolated from the stems of Aglaia abbreviata.

name: chloromonilicin
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 5-chloro-10-hydroxy-8-methyl-1H-oxepino[4,3-b]chromene-3,11-dione which is substituted at positions 1, 5, 8, and 10 by methoxycarbonyl, chlorine, methyl, and hydroxy groups, respectively (the 1S enantiomer). Found in Monilia fructicola and in the mycoherbicide Alternaria sonchi.

name: zhankuic acid A methyl ester
definition: An ergostanoid that is the methyl ester of zhankuic acid A. It has been isolated from the fruiting bodies of Taiwanofungus camphoratus.

name: eburicol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 24,25-dihydrolanosterol carrying an additional methylene substituent at position 24. A natural product found in Taiwanofungus camphoratus.

name: ipomotaoside A
definition: A resin glycoside that is the tetrasaccharide derivative of jalapinolic acid. Isolated from Ipomoea batatas, it exhibits inhibitory activity against COX-1 and COX-2.

name: ipomotaoside B
definition: A resin glycoside that is the tetrasaccharide derivative of jalapinolic acid. It has been isolated from Ipomoea batatas.

name: ipomotaoside D

name: (+)-volkensiflavone
definition: A natural product found in Rheedia edulis and Garcinia livingstonei.

name: (+)-morelloflavone
definition: A biflavonoid found in Rheedia edulis and Garcinia livingstonei.

name: 7-nor-ergosterolide
definition: A steroid lactone that is a derivative of ergostanoid, isolated from the culture extract of Aspergillus ochraceus.

name: 3β,11α-dihydroxyergosta-8,24(28)-dien-7-one
definition: An ergostanoid that is (5α)-ergosta-8,24(28)-diene substituted by hydroxy groups a positions 3 and 11 and an oxo group at position 7 (the 3β,11α stereoisomer). It has been isolated from Aspergillus ochraceus.

name: 3β-hydroxyergosta-8,24(28)-dien-7-one
definition: An ergostanoid that is (5α)-ergosta-8,24(28)-diene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3 and an oxo group at position 7. It has been isolated from Aspergillus ochraceus.

name: (22E,24R)-3β,5α,9α-trihydroxyergosta-7,22-dien-6-one
definition: An ergostanoid that is (22E)-ergosta-7,22-diene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5 and 9 and an oxo group at position 6 (the 3β,5α stereoisomer). It has been isolated from Aspergillus ochraceus.

name: (22E,24R)-3β,5α-dihydroxyergosta-7,22-dien-6-one
definition: An ergostanoid that is (22E)-ergosta-7,22-diene substituted by hydroxy groups at position 3 and 5 and an oxo group at position 6 (the 3β,5α stereoisomer). It has been isolated from Aspergillus ochraceus.

name: eribulin mesylate

name: eribulin(1+)

name: ceftaroline fosamil

It is used for the treatment of adults with acute bacterial skin and skin structure infections.

name: cis,cis-tetradeca-5,8-dienoic acid
definition: A straight-chain, diunsaturated, 14-carbon long-chain fatty acid with cis-double bonds at positions C-5 and C-8.

name: clethodim

definition: An ether that is (S)-(4-chlorophenyl)(pyridin-2-yl)methanol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen is substituted by a 1-(3-carboxypropyl)piperidin-4-yl group. A topical, selective and non-sedating histamine (H1) receptor antagonist used (as its benzenesulfonate salt) for treatment of itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the configuration of the anomeric centre of the reducing-end N-acetylglucosamine residue is β.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprised of a linear sequence of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine linked (1→4) and (1→6); β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc with α anomeric configuration at the reducing-end.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid in which the double bonds at positions 2 and 4 have Z- and E-configuration respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprised of a linear sequence of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked (1→4), (1→6) and (1→4).

name: N-(cyanomethyl)glycine
definition: A nitrile that is the N-cyanomethyl derivative of glycine.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide consisting of β-D-glucuronic acid linked (1→3) to a β-D-galactose residue.

name: (4-coumaroyl)acetyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (4-coumaroyl)acetyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxocyclopentanecarboxylic acid
definition: An alicyclic ketone that is oxocyclopentanone substituted at position 3 by a carboxy group.

name: 4-methoxy-4-oxo-3-phenylbutanoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester that is methyl succinate substituted at position 2 by a phenyl group.

name: (4-coumaroyl)acetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (4-coumaroyl)acetic acid.

name: flavan-3,3',4,4',5,5',7-heptol
definition: A flavanol that is 3,4-dihydro-2H-chromene which is substituted at positions 3, 4, 5, and 7 by hydroxy groups, and at position 2 by a 3,4,5-trihydroxyphenyl group.

name: pazopanib hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt prepared from equimolar amounts of pazopanib and hydrochloric acid. Used for treatment of kidney cancer.

name: pazopanib(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of pazopanib.

name: pazopanib
definition: A pyrimidine that is 5-(pyrimidin-2-yl}amino-2-methylbenzenesulfonamide substituted at position 4 by a (2,3-dimethylindazol-6-yl)(methyl)amino group. Used as its hydrochloride salt for treatment of kidney cancer.

name: feruloylacetyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of feruloylacetyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: pralatrexate
definition: A pteridine that is the N-4-[1-(2,4-diaminopteridin-6-yl)pent-4-yn-2-yl]benzoyl derivative of L-glutamic acid. Used for treatment of Peripheral T-Cell Lymphoma, an aggressive form of non-Hodgkins lymphoma.

name: flavan-3,3',4',5,5',7-hexol
definition: A hydroxyflavan that is 3,4-dihydro-2H-chromene which is substituted at positions 3, 5, and 7 by hydroxy groups, and at position 2 by a 3,4,5-trihydroxyphenyl group.

name: (−)-gallocatechin
definition: A a gallocatechin that has (2S,3R)-configuration.

name: telavancin hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining telavancin and hydrochloric acid. The composition of the compound is telavancin.nHCl where n = 1-3. Used for treatment of adults with complicated skin and skin structure infections caused by bacteria.

name: (+)-epigallocatechin
definition: A flavan-3,3',4',5,5',7-hexol that has (2S,3S)-configuration.

name: telavancin
definition: A glycopeptide that is vancomycin substituted at position N-3'' by a 2-(decylamino)ethyl group and at position C-29 by a (phosphonomethyl)aminomethyl group. Used as its hydrochloride salt for treatment of adults with complicated skin and skin structure infections caused by bacteria.

name: dihydrochalcone
definition: A member of the class of dihydrochalcones that is acetophenone in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is replaced by a benzyl group.

name: 3-nitrotyramine
definition: Tyramine substituted at position 3 by a nitro group.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenylacetaldehyde
definition: A C-nitro compound that is phenylacetaldehyde substituted at positions 3 and 4 by nitro and hydroxy groups respectively.

name: feruloylacetyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of feruloylacetic acid.

name: thiophene-2-carboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of thiophene-2-carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2Z)-4-carboxylato-2-sulfanylbut-2-enoyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxy groups of (2Z)-4-carboxy-2-sulfanylbut-2-enoyl-CoA.

name: sodium diphosphate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt comprised of a diphosphate(4−) anion and four sodium(1+) cations. More commonly known as tetrasodium pyrophosphate, it finds much use in the food industry as an emulsifier and in dental hygiene as a calcium-chelating salt.

name: thiophene-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A thiophenecarboxylic acid in which the carboxy group is located at position 2.

name: malonyl-CoA methyl ester(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of malonyl-CoA methyl ester; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2Z)-4-carboxy-2-sulfanylbut-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the 1-carboxy group of (2Z)-2-sulfanylpent-2-enedioic acid.

name: malonyl-CoA methyl ester
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of malonic acid monomethyl ester.

name: (R,R)-asenapine maleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of (R,R)-asenapine and maleic acid.

name: (S,S)-asenapine maleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of (S,S)-asenapine and maleic acid.

name: (R,R)-asenapine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of (R,R)-asenapine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group.

name: (S,S)-asenapine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of (S,S)-asenapine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group.

name: N6-(glycylglycyl)-L-lysine
definition: An L-α-amino acid consisting of L-lysine, to the ε amino group of which is attached a glycylglycine dipeptide through an isopeptide bond.

name: 5-chloro-2-methyl-2,3,3a,12b-tetrahydrodibenzo[2,3:6,7]oxepino[4,5-c]pyrrole
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 2,3,3a,12b-tetrahydrodibenzo[2,3:6,7]oxepino[4,5-c]pyrrole bearing methyl and chloro substituents at positions 2 and 5 respectively.

name: (R,R)-asenapine
definition: A 5-chloro-2-methyl-2,3,3a,12b-tetrahydrodibenzo[2,3:6,7]oxepino[4,5-c]pyrrole in which both of the stereocentres have R configuration.

name: (S,S)-asenapine
definition: A 5-chloro-2-methyl-2,3,3a,12b-tetrahydrodibenzo[2,3:6,7]oxepino[4,5-c]pyrrole in which both of the stereocentres have S configuration.

name: pitavastatin calcium
definition: The calcium salt of pitavastatin. Used for treatment of hypercholesterolemia (elevated levels of cholesterol in the blood) on patients unable to sufficiently lower their cholesterol levels by diet and exercise.

name: selenodiglutathione(2−)
definition: A carboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of all four carboxy groups and the protonation of both of the primary amino groups of selenodiglutathione. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: pitavastatin(1−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of pitavastatin, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (3β,16α)-13,28-epoxyoleanane-3,16,30-triol
definition: A hexacyclic triterpenoid that consists of oleanane substituted by hydroxy groups at 3β, 16α and C-30 positions and an oxolane bridge across positions 13 and 28.

name: 4-pyridylacetylglycine
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as 4-pyridylacetyl.

name: glutathioselenol(1−)
definition: An carboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of both carboxy groups and the protonation of the primary amino group of glutathione. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: pyrazine-2-carboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of pyrazine-2-carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: resorcinol sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is resorcinol with one of the two hydroxy groups substituted by a sulfo group.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of β-D-galactose substituted on O-6 with a β-D-glucopyranuronosyl (β-D-glucopyranosyluronic acid) group.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→4).

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→3).

name: saxagliptin hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of anhydrous saxagliptin. Used for the treatment of Type II diabetes.

name: saxagliptin
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-amino(3-hydroxyadamantan-1-yl)acetic acid with the amino group of (1S,3S,5S)-2-azabicyclo[3.1.0]hexane-3-carbonitrile. Used in its monohydrate form for the treatment of Type II diabetes.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→3).

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues all linked sequentially (1→4).

name: 4-carboxylato-2-thioxobutanoyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxy groups of 4-carboxy-2-thioxobutanoyl-CoA

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising β-D-glucose at the reducing end with an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl moiety at the 4-position.

name: 3-nitrotyramine zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phenol to the amino group of 3-nitrotyramine; major species at pH 7.3

name: 4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenylacetaldehyde(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of 4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenylacetaldehyde; major species at pH 7.3

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine at the reducing end with an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety at the 4-position.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionic acid.

name: feruloylacetate(1−)
definition: A 3-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of feruloylacetic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Mo(VI)O2(OH)-molybdopterin cofactor(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the OH groups of Mo(VI)O2(OH)-molybdopterin cofactor.

name: feruloylacetic acid
definition: A 3-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 3-oxopent-4-enoic acid substituted at position 5 by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group.

name: W(VI)O2(OH)-molybdopterin cofactor(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the OH groups of W(VI)O2(OH)-molybdopterin cofactor.

name: Mo(VI)O2(OH)-molybdopterin cofactor
definition: An Mo-molybdopterin cofactor in which the coordinated molybdenum species is MoO2(OH).

name: W(VI)O2(OH)-molybdopterin cofactor
definition: A W-molybdopterin cofactor in which the coordinated tungsten species is WO2(OH).

name: Mo(VI)-molybdopterin cytosine dinucleotide(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and deprotonation of the OH group directly attached to Mo in Mo(VI)-molybdopterin cytosine dinucleotide.

name: Mo(VI)-molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and deprotonation of the OH group directly attached to Mo in Mo(VI)-molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide.

name: pyrazine-2-carboxylic acid
definition: The parent compound of the class of pyrazinecarboxylic acids, that is pyrazine bearing a single carboxy substituent. The active metabolite of the antitubercular drug pyrazinamide.

name: 4-carboxy-2-thioxobutanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the 1-carboxy group of 4-carboxy-2-thioxobutanoic acid.

name: cycloastragenol
definition: A sapogenin that is the aglycone derivative of astragaloside IV, a major saponin extracted from the root of Astragalus membranaceus.

name: N'-monoacetylchitobiose-6'-phosphate(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of N-monoacetylchitobiose-6-phosphate, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups and protonation of the free amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2R,4S)-2-methyl-2,4-dihydroxydihydrofuran-3-one
definition: A tetrahydrofuranone that is tetrahydrofuran-3-one substituted at positions 2 and 4 by hydroxy groups and at position 2 by a methyl group.

name: N'-monoacetylchitobiose-6'-phosphate
definition: A disaccharide phosphate that is N'-monoacetylchitobiose substituted at position 6' by a phospho group.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide comprised of a sequence of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked (1→4), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4), with α-L-fucosyl residues linked (1→3) both to the N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end and the one proximal to it in the sequence.

name: cyclopeptine
definition: A 1,4-benzodiazepinone that is 3,4-dihydro-1,4-benzodiazepine-2,5-dione substituted at position 4 by a methyl group and at position 3 by a benzyl group.

name: fusidate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of fusidic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dehydrocyclopeptine
definition: A 1,4-benzodiazepinone that is 3,4-dihydro-1,4-benzodiazepine-2,5-dione substituted at position 4 by a methyl group and at position 3 by a benzylidene group.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→6) and (1→4).

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2) and (1→3).

definition: An amino heptasaccharide consisting of two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose disaccharide units linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide. The anomer of β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the configuration at the anomeric centre of the reducing-end N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue is β.

name: callysponginol sulfate A(1−)
definition: A organosulfate oxoanion that is the monoanion obtained by the deprotonation of the sulfate function of callysponginol sulfonic acid A.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man groups and the reducing-end N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue is substituted at position 6 by an α-L-fucosyl group.

name: callysponginol sulfonic acid A
definition: A carboxyalkyl sulfate that is tetracos-17-en-3-ynoic acid substituted by a sulfooxy group at position 2 (the 2R,17Z stereoisomer).

name: (Z)-dehydrocyclopeptine
definition: A geoisomer of dehydrocyclopeptine in which the C=C bond of the benzylidene substituent has Z-configuration.

name: (E)-dehydrocyclopeptine
definition: A geoisomer of dehydrocyclopeptine in which the C=C bond of the benzylidene substituent has E-configuration.

name: (3-nitro-4-oxidophenyl)acetate
definition: The dianion obtained by deprotonation of the phenol and carboxy functions of (4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetic acid.

name: (S)-cyclopeptine
definition: An optically active form of cyclopeptine having S-configuration.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino nonasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-Neu5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: (3R)-7,2'-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyisoflavanol
definition: A 7,2'-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyisoflavanol that has R configuration at position 3.

name: 3'-O-(N-methylanthraniloyl)adenosine 5'-diphosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate that is ADP substituted at position 3' by an N-methylanthraniloyl group.

name: minocycline(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of minocycline, obtained by deprotonation of the two enolic hydroxy groups and protonation of the non-aromatic tertiary amino group.

name: novobiocin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of novobiocin.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide in which three N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues are linked (1→3), (1→4) and (1→6) to an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue with unspecified configuration at its anomeric centre.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide comprising an N -acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue at the reducing end, to which are (1→3)- and (1→6)-linked two N -acetyl-α-D-glucosamine residues.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine disaccharide, to the galactosyl residue of which are (1→3)- and (1→6)-linked two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues.

name: Mo(VI)-molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide
definition: A molybdopterin dinucleotide in which the other nucleobase is guanine and the coordinated molybdenum species is MoO2(OH).

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide comprising an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue linked (1→3) to an N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: norsolorinate anthrone(2−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 2- and 7-hydroxy groups of norsolorinic acid anthrone.

name: norsolorinate(2−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 2- and 7-hydroxy groups of norsolorinic acid.

name: anagalligenin A
definition: A hexacyclic triterpenoid that is an oleanane substituted by an epoxy group between positions 13 and 28 and by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 16, 22 and 28 respectively (the 3β,16α,22α stereoisomer). It is isolated from the whole plant of Anagallis arvensis.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide comprising N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine linked (1→3) to a β-D-galactose residue.

name: 2-oxoglutaryl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxy groups of 2-oxoglutaryl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprised of a (1→3)-linked sequence of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residues.

name: Mo(VI)-molybdopterin cytosine dinucleotide
definition: A molybdopterin dinucleotide in which the other nucleobase is cytosine and the coordinated molybdenum species is MoO2(OH).

name: 3-phosphonatopyruvate(2−)

name: β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-MDP-Lys(L18)

name: 3-hydroxyoctadecanoyl-CoA(4−)

name: (β-L-Ara4N)2-(KDO)2-lipid A

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc

name: nitrofurantoin
definition: An imidazolidine-2,4-dione that is hydantoin substituted at position 1 by a [(5-nitro-2-furyl)methylene]amino group. An antibiotic that damages bacterial DNA.

name: phenazopyridine
definition: A diaminopyridine that is 2,6-diaminopyridine substituted at position 3 by a phenylazo group. A local anesthetic that has topical analgesic effect on mucosa lining of the urinary tract. Its use is limited by problems with toxicity (primarily blood disorders) and potential carcinogenicity.

name: procarbazine
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(2-methylhydrazino)methyl]benzoic acid with the amino group of isopropylamine. An antineoplastic chemotherapy drug used for treatment of Hodgkin's lymphoma. Metabolism yields azo-procarbazine and hydrogen peroxide, which results in the breaking of DNA strands.

name: triamcinolone acetonide
definition: A synthetic glucocorticoid that is the 16,17-acetonide of triamcinolone. Used to treat various skin infections.

name: phenazopyridine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining phenazopyridine with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. A local anesthetic that has topical analgesic effect on mucosa lining of the urinary tract. Its use is limited by problems with toxicity (primarily blood disorders) and potential carcinogenicity.

name: phenazopyridine(1+)

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp

name: isoheptadecanoyl-CoA(4−)

name: (E)-isoheptadec-2-enoyl-CoA(4−)

name: all-cis-8,11,14,17-icosatetraenoic acid
definition: An icosatetraenoic acid having four cis double bonds at positions 8, 11, 14 and 17.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: precorrin-7(6−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion that is the hexaanion of precorrin-7.

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-3-oxoicosatetraenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-3-oxoicosa-8,11,14,17-tetraenoyl-CoA.

name: (2R)-3-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)lactate
definition: A (2R)-2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (2R)-3-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)lactic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (R)-rosmarinate
definition: A stereoisomer of rosmarinate having (R)-configuration.

name: cis-trans-nepetalactol
definition: A cyclopentapyran that is 1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran substituted at position 1 by a hydroxy group and at positions 4 and 7 by methyl groups (the 4aS,7S,7aR-diastereomer)

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched pentasaccharide that is α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the anomeric configuration of the reducing-end GlcNAc residue is β.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide comprised of a sequence of α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues linked (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannose of which is (1→6)-linked a tetrasaccharide branch comprising N-acetyl-α-neuraminose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→4) and (1→2).

definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide comprised of a chain of α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues, linked sequentially (1→6), (1→4) and (1→4), to the α-D-mannose residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) respectively an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose unit and an α-D-mannose residue, and to the β-D-mannose residue is linked another α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose unit.

name: 1-O-(4-coumaroyl)-β-D-glucose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that is β-D-glucose bearing a 4-coumaroyl substituent at position 1.

name: cyanidin 3-O-{6-O-[6-O-(4-coumaroyl)-β-D-glucosyl]-2-O-β-D-xylosyl-β-D-galactoside}
definition: A trisaccharide derivative that is cyanidin substituted at position 3 by a 6-O-[6-O-(4-coumaroyl)-β-D-glucosyl]-2-O-β-D-xylosyl-β-D-galactosyl moiety.

name: cyclic di-AMP(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of cyclic di-AMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: c-GMP-AMP(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of c-GMP-AMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp

name: fluvirucin A1
definition: A lactam that is 4-hydroxyazacyclotetradecan-2-one substituted by an ethyl group at position 11, methyl groups at position 3 and 7 and a 3-amino-3,6-dideoxy-α-L-talopyranosyl moiety at position 4 via a glycosyl linkage (the 3R,4S,7R,11S stereoisomer). It is isolated from the fermentation broth of an unidentified actinomycete species and exhibits potent inhibitory activity against influenza A virus.

name: cyanin betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine that is the conjugate base of cyanin, arising from regioselective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group. Major structure at pH 7.3

name: 1-O-vanilloyl-β-D-glucose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that is β-D-glucose bearing a vanilloyl substituent at position 1.

name: cyanidin 3,7-di-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine that is the conjugate base of cyanidin 3,7-di-O-β-D-glucoside, arising from regioselective deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group. Major structure at pH 7.3

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→6), (1→4) and (1→4), to the α-D-mannose residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two further α-D-mannose residues and to the β-D-mannose residue of which is (1→3)-linked also an α-D-mannose residue.

name: cyanidin 3-O-β-D-galactoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine that is the conjugate base of cyanidin 3-O-β-D-galactoside, arising from regioselective deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group. Major structure at pH 7.3

name: cyanidin 3-O-[β-D-xylosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactoside](1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the 5 and 7 positions of cyanidin 3-O-[β-D-xylosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactoside].

name: 2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid that is the conjugate base of 2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→6), (1→4) and (1→4), to the α-D-mannose residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two further α-D-mannose residues and to the β-D-mannose residue of which is (1→3)-linked an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannose unit.

name: paxanthonin
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by a 2,2-dimethyl-4-(prop-1-en-2-yl)cyclopentyl group at position 2, hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 6 and a methoxy group at position 5. It is isolated from the callus of Hypericum perforatum and exhibits antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.

name: N-[2-(2-aminoethoxy)ethyl]-4-(2-hydroxy-4-phenylcyclohexyl)benzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides in which benzamide is substituted on nitrogen by a 2-(2-aminoethoxy)ethyl group and at the para-position by a 2-hydroxy-4-phenylcyclohexyl group.

name: {[(1r,7r)-4-(4-acetamidophenyl)-3,5-dioxo-4-azatricyclo[5.2.2.02,6]undec-1-yl]carbamoyloxy}acetic acid
definition: A dicarboximide of bicyclo[2.2.2]octene, in which the nitrogen is substituted by a 4-acetamidophenyl group and one bridgehead is substituted by a 1-(carboxymethoxy)carboxamido group.

name: 5'-O-{[3-(benzoyloxy)-3-oxopropyl]carbamoyl}thymidine
definition: A carbamate ester of thymidine in which the 5'-hydroxy group has been esterified with [3-(benzoyloxy)-3-oxopropyl]carbamic acid,

name: 7,8-dimethylisoalloxazine-10-carbaldehyde
definition: A flavin carrying a formyl group at C-10.

name: N-[4-(1,3,3a,4,7,7a-hexahydro-2H-isoindol-2-ylcarbonyl)benzoyl]-β-alanine
definition: A benzenedicarboxamide in which one nitrogen forms the β-nitogen of β-alanine and the other is the N of 2,3,3a,4,7,7a-hexahydro-1H-isoindole.

name: 5-[(2-methoxyphenyl)(methyl)phosphoryl]pent-4-ynoic acid
definition: A phosphine oxide in which the substituents on phosphorus are 4-carboxybut-1-yn-1-yl, methyl and 2-methoxyphenyl.

name: 6-[4-(5,5-dimethyltetrahydrofuran-3-yl)phenoxy]hexanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is caproic (hexanoic) acid substituted at C-6 by a 4-(5,5-dimethyltetrahydrofuran-3-yl)phenoxy group.

name: 16α-hydroxygypsogenic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene substituted by carboxy groups at positions 23 and 28 and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 16 ( the 3β,16α stereoisomer).

name: 4-({[(1S,3S,4R)-3-(dimethylcarbamoyl)bicyclo[2.2.2]oct-1-yl]carbamoyloxy}methyl)benzoic acid
definition: A carbamate ester, the structure of which is that of carbamic acid esterified with 4-carboxybenzyl alcohol and substituted on nitrogen by a 3-(dimethylcarbamoyl)bicyclo[2.2.2]oct-1-yl group.

name: gypsogenic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene substituted by carboxy groups at positions 23 and 28 and a hydroxy group at position 3 (the 3β stereoisomer).

name: N2-[acetamido(1H-imidazol-4-yl)acetyl]-L-Glu-L-Ser-Gly-L-Pro-L-Val-NH2
definition: A pentapeptide comprised of N2-[acetamido(1H-imidazol-4-yl)acetyl]-L-glutamine, L-serine, glycine, L-proline and L-valinamide residues coupled in sequence.

name: norsolorinate(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 2-hydroxy group of norsolorinic acid.

name: (S)-averantin
definition: An optically active form of averantin having S-configuration.

name: (1'S,5'S)-5'-hydroxyaverantin
definition: A tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is 1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone bearing a 1,5-dihydroxyhexyl substituent at position 2 (the 1'S,5'S-diastereomer).

name: (1'S,5'R)-5'-hydroxyaverantin
definition: A hydroxyanthraquinone that is 1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone bearing a 1,5-dihydroxyhexyl substituent at position 2 (the 1'S,5'R-diastereomer).

name: (1'S,5'S)-averufin
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is 3,4,5,6-tetrahydro-2H-2,6-epoxyanthra[2,3-b]oxocine-8,13-dione substituted at position 2 by a methyl group and at positions 7, 9 and 11 by hydroxy groups (the S,S-diastereomer)

name: lipid A-core 1-diphosphate
definition: A lipid A that is lipid A-core in which the anomeric phosphate is replaced by a diphosphate.

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-3-oxoicosa-8,11,14-trienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (8Z,11Z,14Z)-3-oxoicosa-8,11,14-trienoic acid.

name: isoheptadecanoyl-CoA
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA obtained from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of isoheptadecanoic acid.

name: (25S)-Δ4-dafachronate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (25S)-Δ4-dafachronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (25S)-Δ7-dafachronate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (25S)-Δ7-dafachronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E)-isopentadec-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA obtained from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (E)-isopentadec-2-enoic acid.

name: 2-endo-amino-2-exo-benzoyl-3-exo-phenylnorbornane
definition: An aromatic ketone that is norbornane with 2-endo-amino, 2-exo-benzoyl and 3-exo-phenyl substituents.

name: norbornane
definition: A cyclic hydrocarbon consisting of cyclohexane with a methylene bridge linking positions 1 and 4.

name: dihydroagarofuran
definition: A eudesmane sesquiterpenoid that is octahydro-2H-3,9a-methano-1-benzoxepine substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 2, 5a and 9 (the 3R,5aS,9R,9aS stereoisomer).

name: 4-{[6-endo-amino-6-exo-benzoyl-5-exo-phenylnorbornan-2-yl]oxy}-4-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester that is succinic acid monoesterified with 6-endo-amino-6-exo-benzoyl-5-exo-phenylnorbornan-2-ol

name: lathosterone
definition: A cholestanoid that is 5α-cholest-7-ene substituted at position 3 by an oxo group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-β-D-Manp
definition: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp in which the anomeric configuration at the reducing end is β.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide comprising a β-D-mannose residue linked (1→4) to an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: (25S)-Δ7-dafachronic acid
definition: A Δ7-dafachronic acid that has S configuration at position 25 (the carbon attached to the carboxy group).

name: N-acetyl-β-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide composed of N-acetylneuraminic acid and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked (2→6).

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprised of a trisaccharide chain of N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid, 6-O-sulfo-β-D-glactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→4), to the GlcNAC residue of which is also linked (1→3) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: cyclic N6-threonylcarbamoyladenosine
definition: An oxazolidinone that is the N6-(4S)-4-[(1R)-1-hydroxyethyl]-5-oxo-1,3-oxazolidin-2-ylidene derivative of adenosine. Obtained by cyclocondensation of N6-threonylcarbamoyladenosine.

name: (25S)-Δ4-dafachronic acid
definition: A Δ4-dafachronic acid that has S configuration at position 25 (the carbon attached to the carboxy group). Found in Caenorhabditis elegans.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprised of a trisaccharide chain of N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→4), to the galactose residue of which is also linked (1→4) an N-acetyl-β-L-galactosamine residue.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide in which two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl residues are linked (2→3) and (2→6) to an N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue.

name: all-cis-8,11,14,17-icosatetraenoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of all-cis-8,11,14,17-icosatetraenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide comprised of an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl residue linked (2→3) to N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprised of α-neuraminic acid, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→4).

name: precorrin-7
definition: A precorrin containing seven C-methyl groups introduced into the tetrapyrrole framework.

name: (25S)-cholestenoate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (25S)-cholestenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (25S)-dafachronate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (25S)-dafachronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (25R)-Δ7-dafachronate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (25R)-Δ7-dafachronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (25R)-Δ4-dafachronate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (25R)-Δ4-dafachronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2R)-3-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)lactic acid
definition: A (2R)-2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is (R)-lactic acid substituted at position 3 by a 3,4-dihydroxyphenyl group.

name: UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-α-D-glucosamine(1−)
definition: A UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-D-glucosamine(1−) in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-3-oxoicosatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-3-oxoicosatetraenoic acid.

name: friedelane
definition: A triterpene that is docosahydropicene substituted by 8 methyl groups at positions 2, 2, 4a, 6a, 8a, 9, 12b and 14a.

name: 30-hydroxy-11-oxo-β-amyrin
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is β-amyrin carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 30 as well as an oxo group at position 11.

name: glycyrrhetaldehyde
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is β-amyrin carrying two oxo substituents at positions 11 and 30.

name: cyclic di-AMP
definition: A cyclic purine dinucleotide that is the 3',5'-cyclic dimer of AMP.

name: methyl red(1−)
definition: A benzoate that is the conjugate base of methyl red, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: c-GMP-AMP
definition: A cyclic purine dinucleotide that consists of AMP and GMP units cyclised via 3',5'-linkages.

name: 4α-methyl-5α-cholest-8(14)-en-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8(14)-en-3β-ol bearing an α-methyl substituent at position 4.

name: cyanidin 3,7-di-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation that is cyanidin(1+) carrying two β-D-glucosyl residues at positions 3 and 7.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-GlcpNAc6S
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→3).

name: (3E,5Z)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3E,5Z)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA.

name: cyanidin 3-O-[β-D-xylosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactoside]
