name: 3-(3-amino-3-carboxypropyl)-5,6-dihydrouridine
definition: A uridine that is 5,6-dihydrouridine substituted at position 3 by a 3-amino-3-carboxypropyl group.

name: all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (3E,5Z)-tetradecadienoate
definition: A long-chain unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (3E,5Z)-tetradecadienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A glycerophosphoserine that is sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine in which positions 1 and 2 are substituted by gernylgeranyl groups

name: filicinic acid
definition: An enone that is cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5 and geminal methyl groups at position 4.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl units linked (1→3) and (1→4) to an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprised of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues linked (2→3) and (1→3), to the N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue of which is also linked (1→6) a linear trisaccharide sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues linked (2→3) and (1→4).

name: mycocyclosin
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound obtained via intramolecular oxidative aromatic coupling of cyclo(L-tyrosyl-L-tyrosyl).

name: pulcherriminic acid
definition: A pyrazine N-oxide that is pyrazine-1,4-dioxide substituted at positions 2 and 5 by hydroxy groups and at positions 3 and 6 by isobutyl groups. Formed by oxidative aromatisation of cyclo(L-leucyl-L-leucyl).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked (2→3) and (1→6), to the N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue of which is also linked (2→6) another α-neuraminyl residue.

name: pulcherrimin
definition: A iron chelate in which the four oxygen atoms from pulcherriminic acid are coordinated with two iron atoms. A red extracellular pigment formed by a number of species of bacteria and some species of yeast after growth in media enriched in iron(III).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc in which the anomeric configuration of the reducing-end N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue is α.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→3).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising an α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue (2→3)-linked to a β-D-galactosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→3) to N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-DD-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-DD-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→3), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→3).

name: salvianin(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the two carboxy groups and the 7-hydroxy group of salvianin.

name: (5α,25S)-3-oxocholestan-26-oic acid
definition: A (5α)-3-oxocholestan-26-oic acid that has S configuration at position 25 (the carbon attached to the carboxy group).

name: cyclo(L-phenylalanyl-L-leucyl)
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione in which one hydrogen at position 3 and one hydrogen at position 6 are replaced by benzyl and isobutyl groups (the 3S,6S-diastereomer).

name: albonoursin
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione in which the two hydrogen at position 3 and those at position 6 are replaced by benzylidene and isobutylidene groups (the 3Z,6Z-geoisomer).

name: cyclo(L-phenylalanyl-L-phenylalanyl)
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione in which one hydrogen at position 3 and one hydrogen at position 6 are replaced by benzyl groups (the 3S,6S-diastereomer).

name: cyclo(L-tyrosyl-L-phenylalanyl)
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione in which one hydrogen at position 3 and one hydrogen at position 6 are replaced by benzyl and 4-hydroxybenzyl groups (the 3S,6S-diastereomer).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc with β configuration at the anomeric position of the reducing-end N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue.

name: (25R)-Δ4-dafachronic acid
definition: A cholestanoid that is (5α,25R)-cholest-4-en-26-oic acid substituted at position 3 by an oxo group.

name: (25R)-Δ7-dafachronic acid
definition: A cholestanoid that is (5α,25R)-cholest-7-en-26-oic acid substituted at position 3 by an oxo group.

name: cyclo(L-leucyl-L-methionyl)
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione in which one hydrogen at position 3 and one hydrogen at position 6 are replaced by isobutyl and 2-(methylsulfanyl)ethyl groups (the 3S,6S-diastereomer).

name: (25S)-cholestenoic acid
definition: A cholestanoid that is (25S)-cholest-5-en-26-oic acid bearing a 3β-hydroxy substituent.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and 6-sulfated N-acetyl-β-D-gluosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→4).

name: cyclo(dehydrophenylalanyl-L-leucyl)
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione in which two hydrogen at position 3 and one hydrogen at position 6 are replaced by benzylidene and isobutyl groups respectively.

name: UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-α-D-glucosamine
definition: A UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoyl]-D-glucosamine in which the anomeric centre of the pyranose fragment has α-configuration.

name: cardenolide
definition: A steroid lactone that is a C23 steroid with methyl groups at C-10 and C-13 and a butenolide ring at C-17.

name: bacilysocin
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of 12-methyltetradecanoic acide with one of the primary alcoholic hydroxy groups of glycerophosphoglycerol. An antibiotic obtained from Bacillus subtilis 168, it has particular activity against certain fungi. The stereochemistries of the hydroxy groups at positions C-2 and C-2' and the methyl group at position C-12 have not been determined.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc in which the anomeric configuration of the reducing-end N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue is β.

name: bacillaene
definition: A polyene antibiotic obtained from Bacillus subtilis 168 that is active against a broad spectrum of bacteria. It is notoriously unstable.

name: methanetelluronate(1−)
definition: A tellurium oxoanion that is the conjugate base of methanetelluronic acid.

name: sarmentologenin
definition: A steroid lactone that is card-20(22)-enolide substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, 11, 14 and 19.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a sialyl residue, linked (2→3) to a galactosyl residue that in turn is linked (1→4) to a glucosaminyl residue, which is sulfated at O-6 and is also carrying a fucosyl residue at the 3-position.

name: nisin
definition: A type-A lantibiotic containing 34 amino acid residues (including lanthionine (Lan), methyllanthionine (MeLan), didehydroalanine (Dha) and didehydroaminobutyric acid (Dhb)) and five thioether bridges. It is obtained by fermentation of the bacterium Lactococcus lactis and shows particular activity against Clostridium botulinum. It is used in the production of various processed foods to suppress Gram-positive spoilage and pathogenic bacteria and so extend shelf life.

name: octyl α-D-glucopyranoside
definition: An α-D-glucoside in which the anomeric hydrogen of α-D-glucopyranose is substituted by an octyl group.

name: octyl 6-O-β-D-galactofuranosyl-α-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is the octyl glycoside of the disaccharide β-D-galactofuranosyl-(1→6)-α-D-glucose.

name: hydroxyversicolorone
definition: An anthrafuran that is 2,3-dihydroanthra[2,3-b]furan-5,10-dione substituted at positions 2, 4, 6 and 8 by hydroxy groups and at position 3 by a 3-oxobutyl group.

name: versicolorone(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of versicolorone, obtained by selective deprotonation of the 2-hydroxy group.

name: versiconol acetate(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of versiconol acetate, obtained by selective deprotonation of the 2-hydroxy group.

name: versiconal hemiacetal acetate
definition: An anthrafuran that is 2,3-dihydroanthra[2,3-b]furan-5,10-dione substituted at positions 2, 4, 6 and 8 by hydroxy groups and at position 3 by a 2-acetoxyethyl group. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of aflatoxin.

name: versiconal hemiacetal
definition: An anthrafuran that is 2,3-dihydroanthra[2,3-b]furan-5,10-dione substituted at positions 2, 4, 6 and 8 by hydroxy groups and at position 3 by a 2-hydroxyethyl group. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of aflatoxin.

name: versiconol
definition: A polyphenol that is 9,10-anthraquinone substituted at positions 1, 3, 6 and 8 by hydroxy groups and at position 2 by a 1,4-dihydroxybutan-2-yl group.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and β-D-galactosyl residues, linked (2→3), (1→4) and (1→3), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue of which is also linked (1→3) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues, linked (2→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4), to the non-terminal N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue of which is also linked (1→3) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino decasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues linked respectively (2→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4), to each N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue of which is linked (1→3) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannosyl and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are (1→3)- and (1→6)-linked two identical branches consisting of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and α-D-mannosyl residues linked in a (2→3), (1→4) and (1→2) sequence.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannosyl and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are (1→3)- and (1→6)-linked two branches consisting of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and α-D-mannosyl residues linked respectively in (2→3), (1→4), (1→2) and (2→6), (1→4), (1→2) sequences.

name: (S)-5'-oxoaverantin
definition: A hydroxyanthraquinone that is 1,3,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone bearing a 1-hydroxy-5-oxohexyl substituent at position 2 (the S-enantiomer).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked in a (2→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→3) sequence.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the anomeric configuration of the reducing-end N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue is β.

name: versicolorone tricyclic form
definition: The tricyclic anthraquinone form of versicolorone.

name: versicolorone tetracyclic form
definition: The tetracyclic anthrafuran form of versicolorone.

name: versiconol acetate
definition: An acetate ester that is the O-acetyl derivative of versiconol. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of aflatoxin.

name: mersacidin
definition: A type-B lantibiotic containing 3-methyllanthionine and S-(2-aminovinyl)-3-methylcysteine residues and four intra-chain thioether bridges. It is obtained from Bacillus sp. HIL Y-85,54728 and is active in vivo against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA).

name: epidermin
definition: A type A lantibiotic that is a tetracyclic 21-amino-acid peptide which contains meso-lanthionine, 3-methyllanthionine, and S-(2-aminovinyl)-D-cysteine. It is obtained from Staphylococcus epidermidis Tü 3298 and exhibits antibiotic activity against many Gram-positive bacteria.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide consisting of the tetrasaccharide β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having an α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue attached at the 3-position of the galactosyl residue at the non-reducing end and an α-L-fucosyl residue attached at the 3-position of the N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl residue at the reducing end.

name: versiconal hydroxyaldehyde form
definition: The tricyclic anthraquinone-hydroxyaldehyde form of versicolorone.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino heptasaccharide comprising α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues connected via (2→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4) linkages.

name: (S)-versiconol
definition: An optically active form of versiconol having S-configuration.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising α-neuraminyl, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→6) and (1→4).

name: N-acetyl-L-methionine(1−)
definition: An L-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-L-methionine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: aldonate(1−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid anion obtained by deprotonation of any aldonic acid. Major structure at pH 7.3 of aldonate compounds.

name: N-(indole-3-acetyl)-L-alanine
definition: An N-acyl-L-amino acid that is the N-indole-3-acetyl derivative of L-alanine.

name: N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 6-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 6-phosphate.

name: D-galactosamine 6-phosphate(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of D-galactosamine 6-phosphate, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups and protonation of the 2-amino group. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: N-(indole-3-acetyl)-L-leucine
definition: An N-acyl-L-amino acid that is the N-indole-3-acetyl derivative of L-leucine.

name: esculeogenin A
definition: A sapogenin that is spirosolane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 23 and 27 (the 3β,5α,22α,23S,25S stereoisomer).

name: (2S)-2-hydroxy-3,4-diketopentyl phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of (S)-4-hydroxy-2,3-pentanedione-5-yl phosphate. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: N6-(dimethylallyl)adenosine 5'-diphosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate that is ADP substituted at position N-6 by a dimethylallyl (isopentenyl) group.

name: N6-(dimethylallyl)adenosine 5'-triphosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate that is ATP substituted at position N-6 by a dimethylallyl (isopentenyl) group.

name: D-ribulose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-ribulose 5-phosphate. Major structute at pH 7.3.

name: D-γ-glutamyl-D-glutamate(2−)
definition: A peptide anion arising from deprotonation of the three carboxy groups and protonation of the primary amino group of D-γ-glutamyl-D-glutamic acid.

name: cyanidin(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 3- and 5-hydroxy groups of cyanidin(1+).

name: D-γ-glutamyl-D-glutamic acid
definition: A dipeptide consisting of a D-γ-glutamyl residue attached to D-glutamic via a peptide linkage.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxy-3,4-diketopentyl phosphate
definition: A monoalkyl phosphate that is pentane substituted at positions 3 and 4 by oxo groups, at position 2 by a hydroxy group and at position 1 by a phosphooxy group (the S-enantiomer).

name: L-4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate(2−)
definition: An optically active form of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutarate(2−) having L-configuration.

name: α-D-GlcN-(1→2)-α-D-Glc-(1→2)-α-D-Glc-(1→3)-[α-D-Gal-(1→6)]-α-D-Glc-(1→3)-[L-α-D-Hep-(1→7)]-L-α-D-Hep4P-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hep4P-(1→5)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN4P-(1→6)-α-D-Glc1P
definition: A twelve-membered branched glucosamine oligosaccharide made up from three α-D-glucose residues, one α-D-glucosamine residue, one α-D-galactose residue, three L-α-D-Hep residues (two of which are monophosphorylated), two α-Kdo residues and two monophosphorylated α-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end). Corresponds to the dodecasaccharide of E. coli R2 lipopolysaccharide (LPS).

name: D-ribulose 1-phosphate
definition: A ribulose 1-phosphate in which ribulose has D-configuration.

name: 7-epi-zingiberene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is 2-methylcyclohexa-1,3-diene in which a hydrogen at the 5 position is substituted (R configuration) by a 6-methyl-hept-5-en-2-yl group (R configuration). 7-Epizingiberene is a specific sesquiterpene with toxic and repellent properties that is produced and stored in glandular trichomes.

name: L-4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutaric acid
definition: An optically active form of 4-hydroxy-2-oxoglutaric acid having L-configuration.

name: staphyloxanthin
definition: A xanthophyll that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 6 have been acylated by an all-trans-2,6,10,15,19,23-hexamethyltetracosa-2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16,18,22-decaenoyl group and a 12-methyltetradecanoyl group, respectively. Staphyloxanthin is responsible for the characteristic yellow-golden colour which gives the bacterium Staphylococcus aureus its name.

name: α-D-Glc-(1→3)-[L-α-D-Hep-(1→7)]-L-α-D-Hep4P-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hep4P-(1→5)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN4P-(1→6)-α-D-Glc1P
definition: An amino octasaccharide made up from one α-D-glucose residue, three L-α-D-Hep residues (two of which are monophosphorylated), two α-Kdo residues and two monophosphorylated α-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end).

name: 9-ribosyl-trans-zeatin
definition: A 9-ribosylzeatin having trans-zeatin as the nucleobase.

name: α-D-Glc-(1→3)-[L-α-D-Hep-(1→7)]-L-α-D-Hep-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hep4P-(1→5)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN4P-(1→6)-α-D-Glc1P
definition: An amino octasaccharide made up from one α-D-glucose residue, three L-α-D-Hep residues (one of which is monophosphorylated), two α-Kdo residues and two monophosphorylated α-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end).

name: α-D-Glc-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hep4P-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hep4P-(1→5)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-β-D-GlcN4P-(1→6)-α-D-Glc1P
definition: An amino octasaccharide made up from one α-D-glucose residue, two monophosphorylated L-α-D-Hep residues, two α-Kdo residues and two monophosphorylated α-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-D-Galp in which the anomeric configuration of the reducing-end D-galactose residue is β. A 5-aminopentyl linker may be attached to the oxygen at position 1 of the reducing-end galactose residue.

name: 9-ribosyl-trans-zeatin 5'-monophosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is AMP substituted at position N-6 by a (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group.

name: pennogenin
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is spirost-5-en substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 17 (3β,25R stereoisomer).

name: 9-ribosyl-trans-zeatin 5'-diphosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-diphosphate that is ADP substituted at position N-6 by a (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group.

name: 9-ribosyl-trans-zeatin 5'-triphosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate that is ATP substituted at position N-6 by a (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group.

name: tadalafil
definition: A pyrazinopyridoindole that is 2,3,6,7,12,12a-hexahydropyrazino[1',2':1,6]pyrido[3,4-b]indole-1,4-dione substituted at position 2 by a methyl group and at position 6 by a 1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl group (the 6R,12aR-diastereomer). A phosphodiesterase V inhibitor inhibitor, currently marketed in pill form for treating erectile dysfunction under the name Cialis; and under the name Adcirca for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension.

name: tolmetin
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is (1-methylpyrrol-2-yl)acetic acid substituted at position 5 on the pyrrole ring by a 4-methylbenzoyl group. Used in the form of its sodium salt dihydrate as a nonselective nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of sialyl, β-D-galactosyl and β-D-glucose residues connected sequentially by (2→6) and (1→4) linkages.

name: β-NeupNAc-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of an N-acetyl-β-neuraminyl residue attached to the galactose residue of N-acetyllactosamine via an α-(2→6)-linkage.

name: [3)-α-L-Araf-(1→3)-6d-α-L-gulo-Hepp-(1→]n
definition: A polysaccharide composed of a backbone of α-L-arabinofuranosyl-(1→3)-6-deoxy-α-L-gulo-heptopyranosyl repeating units that are joined to each other via (1→3)-linkages.

name: tyrocidine B
definition: A homodetic cyclic decapeptide consisting of D-Phe, L-Pro, L-Trp, D-Phe, L-Asn, L-Gln, L-Tyr, L-Val, L-Orn, and L-Leu residues coupled in sequence and cyclised head-to-tail.

name: tyrocidine C
definition: A homodetic cyclic decapeptide consisting of D-Phe, L-Pro, L-Trp, D-Trp, L-Asn, L-Gln, L-Tyr, L-Val, L-Orn, and L-Leu residues coupled in sequence and cyclised head-to-tail.

name: tyrocidine D
definition: A homodetic cyclic decapeptide consisting of D-Phe, L-Pro, L-Trp, D-Trp, L-Asn, L-Gln, L-Trp, L-Val, L-Orn, and L-Leu residues coupled in sequence and cyclised head-to-tail.

name: dactolisib
definition: An imidazoquinoline that is 3-methyl-2-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-imidazo[4,5-c]quinoline substituted at position 1 by a 4-(1-cyanoisopropyl)phenyl group and at position 8 by a quinolin-3-yl group. A dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor used in cancer treatment.

name: BGT226
definition: The maleate salt of 8-(6-methoxypyridin-3-yl)-3-methyl-1-[4-(piperazin-1-yl)-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-1,3-dihydro-2H-imidazo[4,5-c]quinolin-2-one. A dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor.

name: BKM120
definition: An aminopyridine that is 4-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-amine substituted at position 5 by a 2,6-di(morpholin-4-yl)pyrimidin-4-y group. A selective PI3K inhibitor with anti-tumour properties.

name: GSK1059615
definition: A thiazolidinone that is the 5-{[4-(pyridin-4-yl)quinolin-6-yl]methylene} derivative of 1,3-thiazolidine-2,4-dione. A PI3K inhibitor

name: retaspimycin hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride salt of retaspimycin. A semi-synthetic water-soluble analogue of geldanamycin used in cancer treatment.

name: XL147
definition: A sulfonamide that is the N-4-toluenesulfonyl (N-tosyl) derivative of N-(2,1,3-benzothiadiazol-5-yl)quinoxaline-2,3-diamine. A selective PI3K inhibitor used in cancer treatment.

name: XL765
definition: A sulfonamide obtained by formal condensation of the sulfonic acid group of 4-[(3-methoxy-4-methylbenzoyl)amino]benzenesulfonic acid with the primary aromatic amino group of N-(3,5-dimethoxyphenyl)quinoxaline-2,3-diamine. A dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor used in cancer treatment.

name: 3-amino-5-hydroxybenzoate
definition: A monohydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 3-amino-5-hydroxybenzoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: lividomycin A
definition: A member of the class of lividomycins that is lividomycin B in which position 4 of the diamino-L-idopyranosyl moiety has been converted into its α-D-mannopyranoside.

name: lividomycin B
definition: A member of the class of lividomycins that is paromomycin in which the 2-amino-2-deoxyglucopyranosyl moiety is lacking the hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 5-amino-5-deoxy-3-dehydroshikimic acid zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 5-amino-5-deoxy-3-dehydroshikimic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-α-D-kanosamine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of UDP-α-D-kanosamine, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group.

name: UDP-3-keto-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion resulting from the removal of two protons from the diphosphate group of UDP-3-keto-α-D-glucose

name: BGT226(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group of 8-(6-methoxypyridin-3-yl)-3-methyl-1-[4-(piperazin-1-yl)-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-1,3-dihydro-2H-imidazo[4,5-c]quinolin-2-one.

name: BGT226 free base
definition: An imidazoquinoline that is 3-methyl-2-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-imidazo[4,5-c]quinoline substituted at position 1 by a 3-trifluoromethyl-4-(piperazin-1-yl)phenyl group and at position 8 by a 6-methoxypyridin-3-yl group. A dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor.

name: proansamycin X
definition: A 26-membered macrocylic polyketide incorporating a quinone ring as well as lactam and enone functionality. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of rifamycin.

name: 4-phenylcoumarin
definition: The simplest member of the class of neoflavones that is coumarin substituted by a phenyl group at position 4.

name: retaspimycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of retaspimycin.

name: retaspimycin
definition: An ansamycin that is tanespimycin in which the benzoquinone moiety has been reduced to the corresponding hydroquinone. A semi-synthetic analogue of geldanamycin, it is used (generally as the hydrochloride salt) in cancer treatment.

name: surfactin A
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide that is N-[(3R)-3-hydroxy-11-methyldodecanoyl]-L-α-glutamyl-L-leucyl-D-leucyl-L-valyl-L-α-aspartyl-D-leucyl-L-leucine in which the C-terminal carboxy group has been lactonised by condensation with the alcoholic hydroxy group.

name: surfactin B
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide that is N-[(3R)-3-hydroxy-12-methyltridecanoyl]-L-α-glutamyl-L-leucyl-D-leucyl-L-valyl-L-α-aspartyl-D-leucyl-L-leucine in which the C-terminal carboxy group has been lactonised by condensation with the alcoholic hydroxy group.

name: surfactin C
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide that is N-[(3R)-3-hydroxy-13-methyltetradecanoyl]-L-α-glutamyl-L-leucyl-D-leucyl-L-valyl-L-α-aspartyl-D-leucyl-L-leucine in which the C-terminal carboxy group has been lactonised by condensation with the alcoholic hydroxy group.

name: surfactin D
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide that is N-[(3R)-3-hydroxy-14-methylpentadecanoyl]-L-α-glutamyl-L-leucyl-D-leucyl-L-valyl-L-α-aspartyl-D-leucyl-L-leucine in which the C-terminal carboxy group has been lactonised by condensation with the alcoholic hydroxy group.

name: N-retinylidene-N-retinylethanolamine
definition: A pyridinium ion obtained by formal condensation between two molecules of retinol and one the amino group of ethanolamine. A major constituent of retinal pigment epithelium lipofuscin

name: β-D-glucosylsphingosine
definition: D-Glucosylsphingosine in which the anomeric configuration of the glucosyl moiety is β.

name: C20 sphingosine
definition: A sphingoid that is the C20 analogue of sphingosine.

name: C20 sphingosine(1+)
definition: A cationic sphingoid that is the conjugate acid of C20 sphingosine, obtained by protonation of the primary amino function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: curamycin A
definition: A polyketide antibiotic produced by Streptomyces curacoi.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino heptasaccharide comprising a sequence of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→6), (1→4), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino heptasaccharide comprising a sequence of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→6), (1→4), (1→2), (1→6), (1→4) and (1→4).

name: fisetin(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of fisetin.

name: flavonol(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of flavonol.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide comprising a sequence of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→6), (1→4), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannosyl residue of which is also linked (1→6) a further α-D-mannosyl residue.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide comprising a sequence of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→6), (1→4), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannosyl residue of which is also linked (1→6) an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-β-D-α-D-mannosyl branch.

name: rifamycin-undecaketide carboxylic acid
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of rifamycin.

name: α-NeupNAc-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of a sialyl residue linked (2→6) to a galactosyl residue that in turn is linked (1→4) to an O-6-sulfated glucosaminyl residue at the reducing end.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino decasaccharide comprising a sequence of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→6), (1→4), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannosyl residue of which is also linked (1→6) a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-β-D-α-D-mannosyl branch.

name: (3E,5Z)-tetradecadienoic acid
definition: A long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid that is tetradecanoic acid containing two double bonds at positions 3 and 5 (the 3E,5Z-geoisomer).

name: (3E,5Z)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3E,5Z)-tetradecadienoic acid.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide (an undecasaccharide derivative) comprising a sequence of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→3), (1→4), (1→2), (1→6), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannosyl residue of which is also linked (1→3) an α-sialyl-(2→6)- β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-β-D-α-D-mannosyl branch.

name: 3-hydroxyisoheptadecanoyl-CoA
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA obtained from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxyisoheptadecanoic acid

name: hexadec-9-enoic acid
definition: A hexadecenoic acid in which the double bond is located at position 9.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide (undecasaccharide derivative) in which the α-D-mannosyl residue of a linear α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine sequence has linked to it (1→3) and (1→6) two branches each comprising α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and α-D-mannosyl residues in a (2→6), (1→4) and (1→2) sequence.

name: (E)-isoheptadec-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA obtained from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (E)-isoheptadec-2-enoic acid.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl,N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues connected sequentially by (2→6), (1→4), (1→3 and (1→4)) linkages.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino nonasaccharide comprising a sequence of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues connected by (2→6), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→3) linkages respectively, to the reducing-end and proximal N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues of which are also (1→3)-linked α-L-fucosyl residues.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprising α-sialyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine linked in a (2→6) and (1→4) sequence.

name: chromone
definition: The simplest member of the class of chromones that is 4H-chromene with an oxo group at position 4.

name: tolmetin sodium dihydrate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the dihydrate form of tolmetin sodium. Used as a nonselective nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug.

name: N-tetradecanoylicosasphinganine
definition: A C20 dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tetradecanoyl (myristoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxytetradecanoyl)icosasphinganine
definition: A C20 dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytetradecanoyl.

name: N-tetradecanoylicosaphytosphingosine
definition: A C20 phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tetradecanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxytetradecanoyl)icosaphytosphingosine
definition: A C20 phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytetradecanoyl.

name: N-octacosanoylsphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide that is the N-(octacosanoyl) derivative of sphinganine.

name: N-(2-hydroxyoctacosanoyl)sphinganine
definition: A dihydrooceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyoctacosanoyl.

name: N-octacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octacosanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxyoctacosanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyoctacosanoyl.

name: N-triacontanoylsphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tricontanoyl.

name: N-octacosanoylicosasphinganine
definition: A C20 dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octacosanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxytriacontanoyl)sphinganine
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytriacontanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxyoctacosanoyl)icosasphinganine
definition: A C20 dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyoctacosanoyl.

name: N-triacontanoyphytosphingosine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as triacontanoyl.

name: N-octacosanoyl-4-hydroxyicosasphinganine
definition: A C20 phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octacosanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxytricontanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytriacontanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxyoctacosanoyl)-4-hydroxyicosasphinganine
definition: A C20 phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxyoctacosanoyl.

name: N-tricontanoylicosasphinganine
definition: A C20 dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tricontanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxytricontanoyl)icosasphinganine
definition: A C20 dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytricontanoyl.

name: N-tricontanoyl-4-hydroxyicosasphinganine
definition: A C20 phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tricontanoyl.

name: N-(2-hydroxytricontanoyl)-4-hydroxyeicosasphinganine
definition: A C20 phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytricontanoyl.

name: tolmetin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of tolmetin, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: elvitegravir
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid that is 7-methoxy-4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid substited at position 1 by a 1-hydroxy-3-methylbutan-2-yl group and at position 6 by a 3-chloro-2-fluorobenzyl group (the S-enantiomer). It is used in combination therapy for the treatment of HIV-1 infection.

name: pyrithiamine
definition: A pyridinium ion that is 3-(2-hydroxyethyl)-2-methylpyridine substituted at position 1 by a (4-amino-2-methylpyrimidin-5-yl)methyl group.

name: cobicistat
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-2-({[(2-isopropyl-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)methyl](methyl)carbamoyl}amino)-4-(morpholin-4-yl)butanoic acid with the amino group of 1,3-thiazol-5-ylmethyl [(2R,5R)-5-amino-1,6-diphenylhexan-2-yl]carbamate. Acts as a pharmacoenhancer in treatment of HIV-1 by inhibiting P450 enzymes that metabolise other medications..

name: bedaquiline
definition: A quinoline-based antimycobacterial drug used (as its fumarate salt) for the treatment of pulmonary multi-drug resistant tuberculosis by inhibition of ATP synthase, an enzyme essential for the replication of the mycobacteria.

name: bedaquiline fumarate
definition: A fumarate salt prepared from equimolar amounts of bedaquiline and fumaric acid. It is used in combination therapy for the treatment of pulmonary multi-drug resistant tuberculosis by inhibition of ATP synthase, an enzyme essential for the replication of the mycobacteria.

name: apixaban
definition: A pyrazolopyridine that is 7-oxo-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-c]pyridine-3-carboxamide substituted at position 1 by a 4-methoxyphenyl group and at position 6 by a 4-(2-oxopiperidin-1-yl)phenyl group. It is used for the prevention and treatment of thromboembolic diseases.

name: lomitapide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4'-(trifluoromethyl)biphenyl-2-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 9-[4-(4-aminopiperidin-1-yl)butyl]-N-(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl)-9H-fluorene-9-carboxamide. Used (as its mesylate salt) as a complement to a low-fat diet and other lipid-lowering treatments in patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: lomitapide mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate (mesylate) salt prepared from equimolar amounts of lomitapide and methanesulfonic acid. Used as a complement to a low-fat diet and other lipid-lowering treatments in patients with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia.

name: globostellatate A(1−)
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxylic group of globostellatic acid A.

name: globostellatic acid A
definition: A tricyclic triterpenoid of the isomalabaricane group.

name: lomitapide(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen of the tertiary amino group of lomitapide.

name: globostellatate B(1−)
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxylic group of globostellatic acid B.

name: globostellatic acid B
definition: A tricyclic triterpenoid of the isomalabaricane group.

name: teduglutide
definition: A 33-membered polypeptide consisting of His, Gly, Asp, Gly, Ser, Phe, Ser, Asp, Glu, Met, Asn, Thr, Ile, Leu, Asp, Asn, Leu, Ala, Ala, Arg, Asp, Phe, Ile, Asn, Trp, Leu, Ile, Gln, Thr, Lys, Ile, Thr and Asp residues joined in sequence. A glucagon-like peptide-2 receptor agonist used for the treatment of short-bowel syndrome.

name: globostellatate C(1−)
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxylic group of globostellatic acid C.

name: Reactive Red 6 hapten copper complex
definition: The copper coordination entity formed from Reactive Red 6 hapten by coordination to copper of the two hydroxy groups of each phenylazo-2-naphthyl substituent.

name: globostellatic acid C
definition: A tricyclic triterpenoid of the isomalabaricane group.

name: globostellatate D(1−)
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group of globostellatic acid D.

name: globostellatic acid D
definition: A tricyclic triterpenoid of the isomalabaricane group.

name: pasireotide
definition: A six-membered homodetic cyclic peptide composed from L-phenylglycyl, D-tryptophyl, L-lysyl, O-benzyl-L-tyrosyl, L-phenylalanyl and modified L-hydroxyproline residues joined in sequence. A somatostatin analogue with pharmacologic properties mimicking those of the natural hormone somatostatin; used (as its diaspartate salt) for treatment of Cushing's disease.

name: pasireotide aspartate
definition: An aspartate salt that is the diaspartate salt of pasireotide. A somatostatin analogue with pharmacologic properties mimicking those of the natural hormone somatostatin; used for treatment of Cushing's disease.

name: pasireotide(2+)
definition: A cyclic peptide cation obtained by protonation of the two side-chain primary amino groups of pasireotide.

name: cabozantinib
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide that is N-phenyl-N'-(4-fluorophenyl)cyclopropane-1,1-dicarboxamide in which the hydrogen at position 4 on the phenyl ring is substituted by a (6,7-dimethoxyquinolin-4-yl)oxy group. A multi-tyrosine kinase inhibitor, used (as its malate salt) for the treatment of progressive, metastatic, medullary thyroid cancer.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising an α-sialyl residue, two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues and an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue linked in a (2→6), (1→4) and (1→4) sequence.

name: cabozantinib malate
definition: A malate salt that is the mono-(S)-malate salt of cabozantinib. A multi-tyrosine kinase inhibitor, used for the treatment of progressive, metastatic, medullary thyroid cancer.

name: 11C-choline chloride
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt that is the chloride salt of 11C-choline. An intravenous radioactive diagnostic agent used as a tracer during positron emission tomography scans to help detect sites of recurrent prostate cancer.

name: 11C-choline
definition: A choline in which one of the methyl carbons is replaced by an 11C isotope. An intravenous radioactive diagnostic agent used (in the form of its chloride salt) as a tracer during positron emission tomography scans to help detect sites of recurrent prostate cancer.

name: alogliptin
definition: A piperidine that is 3-methyl-2,4-dioxo-3,4-dihydropyrimidine carrying additional 2-cyanobenzyl and 3-aminopiperidin-1-yl groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively (the R-enantiomer). Used in the form of its benzoate salt for treatment of type 2 diabetes.

name: alogliptin benzoate
definition: A benzoate salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of alogliptin and benzoic acid. Used for treatment of type 2 diabetes.

name: alogliptin(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the primary amino function of alogliptin.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-Neup5Ac
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprising two α-sialyl residues joined by a (2→8)-linkage and attached in turn by a (2→8)-linkage to a third sialyl residue of unspecified anomeric configuration.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-Neup5Ac in which the sialyl residue at the reducing end has α anomeric configuration.

name: guanosine-5'-phosphate-2',3'-cyclic phosphate
definition: A 2',3'-cyclic purine nucleotide that is GMP in which the hydroxy groups at the 2' and 3' positions have been converted into the corresponding cyclic phosphate.

name: (22S)-22-hydroxycampest-4-en-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo Δ4-steroid that is campest-4-en-3-one bearing an additional 22S-hydroxy substituent.

name: (22S)-22-hydroxycampesterol
definition: A brassinosteroid that is campesterol bearing an additional 22S-hydroxy substituent.

name: (R)-8-[(dimethylamino)methyl]-1-[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]-1,7,8,9-tetrahydrochromeno[5,6-d]imidazol-2-amine
definition: An imidazochromene that is 1,7,8,9-tetrahydrochromeno[5,6-d]imidazol-2-amine bearing additional 3-(dimethylamino)propyl and (dimethylamino)methyl substituents at positions 1 and 8 respectively (the R-enantiomer).

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-pamitoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 2,6-diamino-2,3,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: A trideoxyhexose derivative that is α-D-glucose in which the 2 and 6-hydroxy groups are replaced by amino groups while the 3-hydroxy group is replaced by hydrogen.

name: 1-(3,6-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-lauroylsphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine having sulfo groups at the 3- and 6-positions on the galactose ring and lauroyl (dodecanoyl) as the N-acyl group.

name: α-Kdo-(2→4)-5,6-dehydro-α-Kdo-OAll
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl unit joined via an α-(2→4)-linkage to a 5,6-dehydro-3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosyl unit with an O-allyl group at the anomeric centre.

name: 2,6-diamino-2,3,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the amino groups of 2,6-diamino-2,3,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose.

name: (1S,2S,3R,5S)-3,5-diaminocyclohexane-1,2-diol
definition: An aminodiol that is cyclohexane-1,2-diol substituted at positions 3 and 5 by amino groups (the 1S,2S,3R,5S-diastereomer)

name: O-(2-aminoethyl)-L-serine
definition: An L-α-amino acid that is L-serine in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is converted to the corresponding 2-aminoethyl ether. An antimetabolic antibiotic obtained from Streptomyces reseoviridofuscus.

name: (1S,2S,3R,5S)-3,5-diammoniocyclohexane-1,2-diol
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the amino groups of (1S,2S,3R,5S)-3,5-diaminocyclohexane-1,2-diol

name: α-D-kanosamine
definition: A 3-amino-3-deoxy-D-glucopyranose that has α-configuration at the anomeric position.

name: α-D-kanosamine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the amino group of α-D-kanosamine.

name: 6-chloroguanine
definition: An organochlorine compound that is 7H-purin-2-amine substituted by a chloro group at position 6.

name: roseoflavin
definition: A benzopteridine that is riboflavin in which the methyl group at position 8 is substituted by a dimethylamino group.

name: 6-O-(carboxymethyl)fluorescein ethyl ester
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the ethyl ester of fluorescein in its ring-opened acid form and substituted on one of the oxygen functions of the xanthene nucleus by a carboxymethyl group.

name: englerin A
definition: A guaiane sesquiterpenoid that is isolated from the bark of Phyllanthus engleri, a plant native to Tanzania and Zimbabwe. It acts as a potent and specific inhibitor of renal cancer cell growth.

name: sapintoxin D
definition: A phorbol ester consisting of phorbol that is acylated at positions 12 and 13 by 2-(methylamino)benzoyl and acetyl groups respectively.

name: tetramethylrosamine chloride
definition: The chloride salt of tetramethylrosamine. Used as a red-orange fluorescent dye.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide consisting of a chain of three α-sialyl residues, a β-D-galactosyl residue and a β-D-glucose residue linked sequentially (2→8), (2→8), (2→3) and (1→4).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide consisting of a chain of three α-sialyl residues, a β-D-galactosyl residue and a β-D-glucose residue linked sequentially (2→8), (2→8), (2→3) and (1→4), to the galactosyl residue of which is also linked (1→4) an N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl residue. The carbohydrate moiety of ganglioside GT2.

name: 2-deoxystreptamine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of one of the two free amino groups of 2-deoxystreptamine.

name: 6-aminohexyl phosphate
definition: A monoalkyl phosphate in which the alkyl group is specified as 6-aminohexyl.

name: malachite green
definition: An organic chloride salt that is the monochloride salt of malachite green cation. Used as a green-coloured dye, as a counter-stain in histology, and for its anti-fungal properties in aquaculture.

name: hexaammineiridium(3+)
definition: An iridium coordination entity consisting of six amino groups bound to a central iridium atom.

name: β-L-idopyranose
definition: The β-anomer of L-idopyranose.

name: 2-fluoroadenine
definition: An organofluorine compound that is adenine in which the hydrogen at position 2 (the carbon between the two nitrogens of the pyrimidine ring) is replaced by a fluorine.

name: oxythiamine(1+) pyrophosphate
definition: A 1,3-thiazolium cation that is the cationic form of oxythiamine pyrophosphate

name: Dig-Cy5
definition: A cyanine conjugate in which digitoxigenin is connected to Cy5 via a 6-[(2-acetamidoethyl)amino]-6-oxohexyl linker.

name: β-Neup5Gc-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising an N-glycoloyl-β-neuraminyl residue (2→6)-linked to a β-D-galactosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→4) to N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAcp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising an α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl residue (2→3)-linked to a β-D-galactosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→3) to N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAcp
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→3), to the galactosyl residue of which is also linked (1→4) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAcp
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→4), to the galactosyl residue of which is also linked (1→3) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAcp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising an α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl residue (2→3)-linked to a β-D-galactosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→4) to N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp in which the anomeric configuration of the reducing-end glucose is β.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: α-Neup5Gc-(2→6)-D-GalpNAc in which the anomeric configuration at the reducing end is α.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising an N-glycoloyl-α-neuraminyl residue (2→6)-linked to a β-D-galactosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→4) to N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: α-Neup5,9Ac2-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising an N,9-O-diacetyl-α-neuraminyl residue (2→3)-linked to a β-D-galactosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→3) to N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: α-Neup5,9Ac2-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising an N,9-O-diacetyl-α-neuraminyl residue (2→3)-linked to a β-D-galactosyl residue, which is in turn linked (1→4) to N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: 5-azacytosine
definition: A monoamino-1,3,5-triazine that is cytosine in which the aromatic CH at position 5 is replaced by a nitrogen.

name: acetoguanamine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is 1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine carrying an additional methyl substituent at position 6.

name: halistanol sulfate F(3−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of halistanol sulfonic acid F.

name: halistanol sulfonic acid F
definition: A steroid sulfate with anti-HIV activity.

name: halistanol sulfate G(3−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of halistanol sulfonic acid G.

name: halistanol sulfonic acid G
definition: A steroid sulfate that is 5α-ergostane substituted by sulfate groups at positions 2, 3 and 6 (the (2β,3α,6α stereoisomer).

name: 6-bromoharminium(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 6-bromoharmine

name: 6-bromoharmine
definition: A member of the class of β-carbolines that is 9H-β-carboline substituted by a bromo group at position 6, a methoxy group at position 7 and a methyl group at position 1. It is semisynthetic derivative of harmine and has been shown to exhibit significant anti-HIV activity.

name: Dnp-Thr-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-threonine substituted on nitrogen by a 2,4-dinitrophenyl group and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: N,O-(Dnp)2-Tyr-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-tyrosine substituted on nitrogen and oxygen by 2,4-dinitrophenyl groups and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: Dnp-Asn-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-asparagine substituted on the α-nitrogen by a 2,4-dinitrophenyl group and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: Dnp-Gln
definition: A L-glutamine derivative that is L-glutamine substituted on the α-nitrogen by a 2,4-dinitrophenyl group.

name: Dnp-Trp-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-tryptophan substituted on the α-nitrogen by a 2,4-dinitrophenyl group and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: Dnp-Sar-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of sarcosine (1-methylglycine) substituted on nitrogen by a 2,4-dinitrophenyl group and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: Nα,Nτ-(Dnp)2-His-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-histidine substituted on the α and τ (tele) nitrogens by 2,4-dinitrophenyl groups and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: N6-Dnp-Lys-NH2
definition: An amino acid amide that is L-lysinamide substituted on the nitrogen at position 6 by a 2,4-dinitrophenyl group.

name: Dnp-Pro-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-proline substituted on nitrogen by a 2,4-dinitrophenyl group and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: Dnp-Nor-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-norvaline substituted on nitrogen by a 2,4-dinitrophenyl group and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: Tnp-Gln
definition: An L-α-amino acid that is L-glutamine substituted at the α-nitrogen by a 2,4,6-trinitrophenyl group.

name: Phe(4-NO2)-Gln
definition: A dipeptide consisting of L-phenylalanine nitro-substituted at C-4 of the phenyl ring and connected to L-glutamine via a peptide bond.

name: fluorescein-DNP hapten
definition: An L-lysyl-L-glutamine dipetide in which the N6 of the lysyl residue is linked to an acid-form fluorescein derivative and the glutamine residue carries an N-(2,4-dinitrophenyl)-L-alanine-containing substituent. It is used as a fluorescently labelled hapten.

name: 4-[4-(dimethylamino)styryl]-N-methylpyridinium
definition: A pyridinium cation obtained by methylation at position 1 of 4-(4-dimethylaminostyryl)pyridine

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of an α-sialyl residue linked (2→3) to an O-6-sulfated β-D-galactosyl residue that in turn is linked (1→4) to an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue at the reducing end.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues in a (2→3), (1→4) and (1→3) sequence.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/14:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as myristoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/16:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as hexanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/18:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/20:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as icosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/22:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as docosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/28:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as octacosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d18:0/30:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as tricontanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/14:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as myristoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/16:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/18:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/20:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as icosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/22:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as docosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/24:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as tetracosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/26:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as hexacosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/28:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as octacosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ins-1-P-Cer(d20:0/30:0)(1−)
definition: An inositol C20 phosphodihydroceramide(1−) in which the N-acyl group is specified as tricontanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3S,4S)-3-hydroxy-4-methyloctanoic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is caprylic (octanoic) acid substituted at positions 3 and 4 by hydroxy and methyl grous respectively.

name: temozolomide
definition: An imidazotetrazine that is 3,4-dihydroimidazo[5,1-d][1,2,3,5]tetrazine which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 8 by methyl, oxo, and carboxamide groups, respectively. A prodrug for MTIC (5-(3-methyltriaz-1-en-1-yl)-1H-imidazole-4-carboxamide, formed by spontaneous hydrolysis of temozolomide in the body), it is used as an oral alkylating agent for the treatment of newly diagnosed malignant glioblastoma multiforme (concomitantly with radiotherapy) and malignant melanoma.

name: levobunolol(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino function of levobunolol.

name: MTIC
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is dacarbazine in which one of the methyl groups is replaced by a hydrogen. It is the active metabolite of dacarbazine, and is also produced by spontaneous hydrolysis of temozolomide in the body.

name: hypoxanthine 3-N-oxide
definition: An oxopurine that is 3,9-dihydro-6H-purine which is substituted by an oxo group at position 6 and in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen at position 3 is replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a major component of Schreckstoff, an alarm pheromone found in fish.

name: coumestan
definition: A member of the class of coumestans that is 6H-[1]benzofuro[3,2-c]chromene substituted by an oxo group at position 6.

name: WR-1065
definition: An alkanethiol that is the N-3-aminopropyl derivative of cysteamine. Used as the S-phosphorylated prodrug, amifostine, for cytoprotection in cancer chemotherapy and radiotherapy.

name: HS44
definition: An N-acyl-1-deoxy-4-hydroxysphinganine in which the acyl group on nitrogen is hexacosanoyl and in which C-1 is substituted by a cyclitolic [(1S,2S,3R,4R,5S)-2,3,4,5-tetrahydroxycyclohexyl] amino group. It is a synthetic analogue of the CD1d-presented agonist α-galactosylceramide.

name: (R)-noradrenaline(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of (R)-noradrenaline, obtained by protonation of the primary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-elaidoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A lysophosphatidylcholine 18:1 in which the acyl group is at position 1 is elaidoyl [(9E)-octadec-9-enoyl] and the hydoxy group at position 2 is unsubstituted.

name: rhizoxin
definition: An macrolide antibiotic isolated from the pathogenic plant fungus Rhizopus microsporus. It also exhibits antitumour and antimitotic activity.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-DD-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-DD-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→3), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→3), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4), to each N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue of which is also linked (1→4) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: 15-ketoprostaglandin F1α
definition: A prostaglandin Fα that is prostaglandin F1α bearing a keto substituent at the 15-position. It is the initial metabolite of prostaglandin F1α via 15-hydroxyprostaglandin dehydrogenase.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked respectively (2→3), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→3), to each N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue of which is also linked an α-L-fucosyl residue, (1→4)-linked to the reducing-end residue and (1→3)-linked to the mid-chain one.

name: 6,15-diketo,13,14-dihydroprostaglandin F1α
definition: A prostaglandin Fα that is prostaglandin F1α bearing keto substituents at positions 6 and 15.

name: gibberellin A13
definition: A C20-gibberellin that is gibberellin A12 in which the 4a-methyl group is oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acid and a hydroxy substituent is present at the 2β-position.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residues in a (2→6), (1→4) and (1→3) sequence. α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc in which the anomeric configuration of the GalNAc residue at the reducing end is β.

name: gibberellin A25
definition: A C20-gibberellin that is gibberellin A12 in which the 4a-methyl group is oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: guanadrel(1+)
definition: A guanidinium ion resulting from the protonation of the guanidyl group of guanadrel.

name: N-benzyl-9-(α-D-glucosyl)adenine
definition: An N-glycosyl compound that is N-benzyladenine in which an α-D-glucopyranosyl residue is attached at position N-9.

name: tetranor-12R-HETE
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid that consists of 4Z,6E,10Z-hexadecatrienoic acid bearing an additional 8R-hydroxy substituent.

name: 11-HETE
definition: A HETE that is (5Z,8Z,12E,14Z)-icosa-5,8,12,14-tetraenoic acid substituted at position 11 by a hydroxy group.

name: 9-(α-D-glucosyl)-cis-zeatin
definition: An N-glycosylzeatin that is cis-zeatin having an α-D-glucopyranosyl residue attached at position N-9.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,14E,16Z,19Z)-13-hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that consists of (4Z,7Z,10Z,14E,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid bearing an additional 13-hydroxy substituent.

name: 9-(α-D-glucosyl)-trans-zeatin
definition: An N-glycosylzeatin that is trans-zeatin having an α-D-glucopyranosyl residue attached at position N-9.

name: 8-HDoHE
definition: A hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that consists of 4Z,6E,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoic acid bearing an additional 8-hydroxy substituent.

name: papulacandin A
definition: A papulacandin substituted by a (2E,4E)-deca-2,4-dienoyl chain at the O-(6') position and a (2E,4E,7S,8E,10E,14S)-7-hydroxy-8,14-dimethylhexadeca-2,4,8,10-tetraenoyl chain at the O-(3) position. It is a carbohydrate-containing antibiotic from the deuteromycetous fungus Papularia sphaerosperma which shows potent antifungal activity against Candida albicans.

name: 9-(α-D-glucosyl)dihydrozeatin
definition: An N-glycosyldihydrozeatin in which the glycosyl fragment is an α-D-glucopyranosyl residue located at position 9.

name: 16-HDoHE

definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) and 9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl (linoleoyl) respectively.

definition: An O-acylcarnitine having (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatetraenoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: O-[(7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoyl]carnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine having (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoyl as the acyl substituent.

definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) and octadecanoyl (stearoyl) respectively.

definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are both specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: horminone
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is abieta-8,12-diene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 12 and oxo groups at positions 11 and 14 (the 7α stereoisomer) .

name: tazarotenic acid
definition: A thiochromane that is acetylene in which the hydrogens are replaced by 5-carboxypyridin-2-yl and 4,4-dimethylthiochroman-6-yl groups. It is the active form of the prodrug tazarotene.

name: 2,3-bis-O-phytanyl-sn-glycerol 1-phosphate
definition: A glycerophospholipid that is sn-glycerol 1-phosphate carrying two O-phytanyl groups at positions 2 and 3.

name: (6aS,11aS)-pterocarpan
definition: The (6aS,11aS)-enantiomer of pterocarpan.

name: (6aR,11aR)-pterocarpan
definition: The (6aR,11aR)-enantiomer of pterocarpan.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the 1-acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate that is the N-hexacosanoyl derivative of sphingosine.

name: N-tetracosanoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate that is N-tetracosanoyl derivative of sphingosine.

name: N-docosanoylsphingosine-1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate that is the N-docosanoyl derivative of sphingosine.

name: oseltamivir acid
definition: A cyclohexenecarboxylic acid that is cyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxylic acid which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 5 by pentan-3-yloxy, acetamido, and amino groups, respectively (the 3R,4R,5S enantiomer). An antiviral drug, it is used as the corresponding ethyl ester prodrug, oseltamivir, to slow the spread of influenza.

name: N-icosanoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate that is the N-icosanoyl derivative of sphingosine.

name: 9-β-D-arabinofuranosylguanine
definition: A purine nucleoside in which guanine is attached to arabinofuranose via a β-N9-glycosidic bond. It inhibits DNA synthesis and causes cell death.

name: (S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxohexanoate
definition: An optically active form of 4-hydroxy-2-oxohexanoate having 4S-configuration.

name: (S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxopentanoate
definition: An optically active form of 4-hydroxy-2-oxopentanoate having 4S-configuration.

name: N-octadecanoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate that is the N-octadecananoyl (stearoyl) derivative of sphingosine.

name: N-hexadecanoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate that is the N-hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) derivative of sphingosine.

name: N-tetradecanoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate that is N-tetradecanoyl (myristoyl) derivative of sphingosine.

name: N-decanoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate that is the N-decanoyl derivative of sphingosine.
