definition: An optically active form of 4-hydroxy-2-oxopentanoic acid having 4S-configuration.

name: (S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxohexanoic acid
definition: An optically active form of 4-hydroxy-2-oxohexanoic acid having 4S-configuration.

name: 2,6-dimethyldeca-2,4,6,8-tetraenedial
definition: An apo carotenoid compound arising from oxidative degradation of the β,β-carotene skeleton at the 8'- and 13-positions.

name: victorin C
definition: A heterodetic cyclic peptide produced by the fungus Cochliobolus victoriae that is required for pathogenicity in the organism

name: trans-cyclooctene
definition: A cyclooctene in which the double bond adopts trans-configuration.

name: sirtinol
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-{[(2-hydroxy-1-naphthyl)methylene]amino}benzoic acid with the amino group of 1-phenylethylamine.

name: pyrabactin
definition: A sulfonamide obtained by formal condensation of the sulfo group of 4-bromonaphthalene-1-sulfonic acid with the exocyclic amino group of 2-pyridylmethylamine. Mimics the action of the abscisic acid, a phytohormone.

name: oryzalin
definition: A sulfonamide that is benzenesulfonamide substituted at positions 3 and 5 by nitro groups and at position 4 by a dipropylamino group.

name: elf18
definition: A polypeptide consisting of the first 18 amino acids at the N-terminus of the Bacterial Elongation Factor Tu protein that is capable of eliciting an innate immunity response in plants.

name: DAS734
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1H-triazole that is substituted at positions 1, 3 and 5 by isopropyl, carboxymethyl and p-chlorophenyl groups, respectively. It has been found to produced bleaching of new growth on a variety of dicotyledonous weeds and is a potent inhibitor of Arabidopsis (Arabidopsis thaliana) seedling growth.

name: concanamycin A
definition: A concanamycin in which the lactone ring contains 4 double bonds and is substituted by 4 methyl groups, 2 hydroxy groups, 2 methoxy groups and an ethyl group.

name: L-BMAA
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a methylamino group. A non-proteinogenic amino acid produced by cyanobacteria, it is a neurotoxin that has been postulated as a possible cause of neurodegenerative disorders of aging such as Alzheimer's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis/parkinsonism-dementia complex (ALS-PDC) syndrome of Guam.

name: ancymidol
definition: A tertiary alcohol that is methanol in which the hydrogens attached to the carbon are replaced by cyclopropyl, p-methoxyphenyl and pyrimidin-5-yl groups. By inhibiting gibberellin biosynthesis, ancymidol reduces plant growth, resulting in reduced internode elongation and thus more compact plants. It is used in the commercial production of a wide variety of container-grown bedding and foliage plants, including chrysanthemums, Easter lilies and poinsettias.

name: acifluorfen
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is 2-nitrobenzoic acid in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by a 2-chloro-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy group. It is a herbicide used for the post-emergence control of a variety of annual broadleaf weeds.

name: 2,4-DB
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is butyric acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 4 is replaced by a 2,4-dichlorophenoxy group. A selective post-emergence herbicide.

name: 2,3,5-triiodobenzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 3 and 5 are replaced by iodine atoms. It is an auxin polar transport inhibitor.

name: brassinazole
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is butan-2-ol which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 4 by phenyl, 1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl and p-chlorophenyl groups, respectively. An inhibitor of brassinosteroid biosynthesis.

name: acibenzolar-S-methyl
definition: A benzothiadiazole that is the S-methyl thioester derivative of acibenzolar. A profungicide (by hydrolysis of the thioester group to give the corresponding carboxylic acid), it is used as a fungicide and plant activator on a variety of crops, including cotton, chili peppers, lettuce, onions, spinach, tobacco, and tomatoes.

name: 2,6-dichloroisonicotinic acid
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is isonicotinic acid which is substituted by chlorine at positions 2 and 6.

name: β-L-arabinofuranosyl-(1→2)-β-L-arabinofuranose
definition: A disaccharide consisting of two β-L-arabinofuranose units joined by a (1→2)-linkage.

name: 1-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl)-ATP(6−)
definition: A 1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)-ATP(6−) in which the 5-phospho-D-ribosyl residue has β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: acibenzolar
definition: A benzothiadiazole that is 1,2,3-benzothiadiazole in which the hydrogen at position 7 is replaced by a sulfanylcarbonyl group. It is used (particularly as its S-methyl thioester) as a fungicide and plant activator.

name: 6β-[(p-hydroxybenzylidene)amino]penicillanic acid
definition: Penicillanic acid carrying a (p-hydroxybenzylidene)amino substituent at the 6β position. It has been used as a hapten in the production of a generic monoclonal antibody for determining penicillin residues in milk.

name: 6β-({5-[(p-aminophenyl)imino]pentylidene}amino)penicillanic acid
definition: Penicillanic acid carrying a (p-aminophenyl)imino]pentylidene}amino substituent at the 6β position. It has been used as a hapten in the production of a generic monoclonal antibody for determining penicillin residues in milk.

name: 17α-(N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl)estradiol 3-glucosiduronate
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion that is the conjugate base of 17α-(N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl)estradiol 3-glucuronoside, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(4-aminobutyl)dabigatranamide
definition: The monocarboxylic acid amide formed from dabigatran by reaction of the carboxy group of its β-alanine moiety with putrecine.

name: massadine
definition: An alkaloid isolated from Stylissa massa.

name: 1-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl)-ATP
definition: A 1-(5-phospho-D-ribosyl)-ATP in which the 5-phospho-D-ribosyl residue has β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 17α-(N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl)estradiol 3-glucuronoside
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that consists of 17α-estradiol having β-glucuronyl and α-N-acetylglucosaminyl residues attached via glycosidic linkages at positions 3 and 17 respectively.

name: 1,2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which both acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: 1-[(9Z)-octadec-9-enoyl]-2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as (9Z)-octadec-9-enoyl (oleoyl) and hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) respectively.

name: 2-hexadecanoyl-1-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl) and hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) respectively.

name: 2-hexadecanoyl-1-tetradecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as tetradecanoyl (myristoyl) and hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) respectively.

definition: A 1-hexadecanoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 2-acyl group is specified as (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenoyl (arachidonyl).

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-hexadecanoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 2-acyl group is specified as 9Z-octadecenoyl (oleoyl).

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: arabidopside A
definition: An arabidopside in which the glyceride moiety is acylated by cis-12-oxophytodienoyl and cis-dinor-oxyphytodienoyl groups at positions 1 and 2, respectively, and in which the carbohydrate moiety is a β-D-galactopyranosyl group. The cyclopentenone moiety of both acyl groups is cis-disubstituted.

name: arabidopside B
definition: An arabidopside in which the glyceride moiety is acylated by cis-12-oxophytodienoyl groups at positions 1 and 2, and in which the and in which the carbohydrate moiety is a β-D-galactopyranosyl group. The cyclopentenone moiety of both acyl groups is cis-disubstituted.

name: arabidopside C
definition: An arabidopside that is arabidopside A in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group at position 6 of the β-D-galactosyl moiety is replaced by an α-D-galactosyl group.

name: aloin
definition: A diastereoisomeric mixture of aloin A (barbaloin) and aloin B (isobarbaloin), which have similar properties. It is a bitter-tasting, yellow-brown colored compound found in the exudate of at least 68 Aloe species at levels of up to 6.6% of leaf dry weight (making between 3% and 35% of the total exudate), and in another 17 species at indeterminate levels. It is used as a stimulant-laxative, treating constipation by inducing bowel movements.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-hexadecanoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 2-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl).

name: allyl isothiocyanate
definition: An isothiocyanate with the formula CH2=CHCH2N=C=S. A colorless oil with boiling point 152°C, it is responsible for the pungent taste of mustard, horseradish, and wasabi.

name: arabidopside D
definition: An arabidopside that is arabidopside B in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group at position 6 of the β-D-galactosyl moiety is replaced by an α-D-galactosyl group.

name: arborescin
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound and guaianolide sesquiterpene lactone that is arglabin in which the exocyclic double bond has been reduced to a single bond. It is found in Artemesia adamsii.

name: arglabin
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound and guaianolide sesquiterpene lactone that is acrylic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a 4-hydroxy-3,8-dimethyl-1,3a,4,5,6,7-hexahydroazulen-5-yl group in which the double bond in the 7-membered ring has been epoxidised and in which the hydroxy group and the carboxy group have undergone formal condensation to give the corresponding γ-lactone. It is found in Artemisia glabella. Arglabin-DMA HCl, the hydrochloride salt of the adduct resulting from the conjugate addition of dimethylamine to the ene-lactone moiety, has been successfully used in Khazakhstan for the treatment of breast, colon, ovarian and lung cancers.

name: 1,2-dihexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-hexadecanoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 2-acyl group is also hexadecanoyl.

name: crispolide
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is a hydroperoxysesquiterpene lactone with a modified germacrane skeleton, isolated from the aerial parts of Tanacetum vulgare.

name: ethylpyrazine
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by an ethyl group. Found particularly in cereals and cereal products, it is present in baked or fried potato, bread, roasted peanuts, and cooked shrimp, as well as cocoa, coffee, and tea. It has a musty, nutty, buttery, peanut odor and a chocolate-peanut taste.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-[(9Z)-octadec-9-enoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) and (9Z)-octadec-9-enoyl (oleoyl) respectively.

name: helicin
definition: A β-D-glucoside resultng from the oxidation of the benzylic hydroxy group of salicin to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: (+)-cis-isohumulone
definition: A cyclic ketone that is the naturally occurring (4S,5R) enantiomer of the cis-isomer of isohumolone, produced during the brewing process due to thermal isomerism, which converts humulones to isohumulones via an acyloin-type ring contraction.

name: (−)-noscapine
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline which is substituted by a 4,5-dimethoxy-3-oxo-1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-1-yl group at position 1, a methylenedioxy group at positions 6-7 and a methoxy group at position 8. Obtained from plants of the Papaveraceae family, it lacks significant painkilling properties and is primarily used for its antitussive (cough-suppressing) effects.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-(9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)

name: tatridin B

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl) and octadecanoyl (stearoyl) respectively.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl) and 9Z-octadecenoyl (oleoyl) respectively.

name: 5α-cucurbitane

name: deglymidodrine
definition: An aromatic ether that is 1,4-dimethoxybenzene which is substituted at position 2 by a 2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl group. The immediate and active metabolite of midrodine, it is a direct-acting sympathomimetic with selective α-adrenergic agonist activity. Midrodine is used (generally as its hydrochloride salt) as a prodrug for deglymidodrine, which acts as a peripheral vasoconstrictor in the treatment of certain hypotensive states.

name: 5β-cucurbitane

name: Leu-Gln-Pro

name: canagliflozin hydrate

name: canagliflozin

name: ospemifene

definition: A member of the class of sulfamides that is sulfamide in which the hydrogens attached to one of the nitrogens are replaced by methyl groups, while those attached to the other nitrogen are replaced by a phenyl and a [dichloro(fluoro)methyl]sulfanediyl group. A fungicide introduced in 1965 and used in the cultivation of fruit and vegetables, as well as in wood preservatives, it is no longer approved for use in the European Union.

name: Trp-Trp
definition: A dipeptide formed from two L-tryptophan residues.

name: Trp-Val
definition: A dipeptide formed from L-tryptophan and L-valine residues.

name: Trp-Tyr
definition: A dipeptide formed from L-tryptophan and L-tyrosine residues.

name: Tyr-Ala
definition: A dipeptide formed from L-tyrosine and L-alanine residues.

name: 1-dodecylguanidine
definition: A member of the class of guanidines that is guanidine in which one of the amino groups is substituted by a dodecyl group. It is used (generally as its acetate salt, known as dodine) as a agrochemical fungicide.

name: Tyr-Gln
definition: A dipeptide formed from L-tyrosine and L-glutamine residues.

name: Tyr-Glu
definition: A dipeptide formed from L-tyrosine and L-glutamic acid residues.

name: 1-dodecylguanidine(1+)
definition: A guanidinium ion resulting from the protonation of the imino nitrogen of 1-dodecylguanidine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-Gly
definition: An N-glycosylated glycine in which the saccharide component is the branched decasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc

name: 1-dodecylguanidine acetate
definition: An acetate salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of 1-dodecylguanidine and acetic acid. It is used as a fungicide to control black spot and foliar diseases on apples, pears, peaches, nectarines and strawberries.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-Gly

name: 1-oleoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 36:3 that is the conjugate base of 1-oleoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: N-{α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc}-DHPE
definition: An N-glycosylated dialkylglycerophosphoethanolamine in which the dialkylglycerophosphoethanolamine is 1,2-dihexadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine and the glycosylating saccharide is the branched decasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc, the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end of which is in the ring-opened form.

name: 223RaCl2
definition: A radium molecular entity with formula 223RaCl2. Used as as a radiotherapeutic agent for the treatment of patients with castration-resistant prostate cancer, symptomatic bone metastases and no known visceral metastatic disease. An alpha-emitter, radium-223 has a half-life of 11.4 days.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 38:5 that is the conjugate base of 1-oleoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: fluticasone furoate
definition: A trifluorinated corticosteroid that consists of 6α,9-difluoro-11β,17α-dihydroxy-17β-{[(fluoromethyl)sulfanyl]carbonyl}-16-methyl-3-oxoandrosta-1,4-diene bearing a 2-furoyl substituent at position 17. Used in combination with vilanterol trifenate for treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 34:2 that is the conjugate base of 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 36:1 that is the conjugate base of 1-oleoyl-2-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: isocaproic acid
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acid that is pentanoic acid with a methyl group substituent at position 4. It is a metabolite of 20 α-hydroxycholesterol

name: isocaproate
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid anion that is pentanoate with a methyl group substituent at position 4.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 36:2 that is the conjugate base of 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 34:1 that is the conjugate base of 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: methyl N-acetylvalinate
definition: A valine derivative with one of the amine hydrogens replaced by an acetyl group and the carboxylic acid hydrogen replaced by a methyl group.

name: N-{α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc}-DHPE
definition: An N-glycosylated dialkylglycerophosphoethanolamine in which the dialkylglycerophosphoethanolamine is 1,2-dihexadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine and the glycosylating saccharide is the branched nonasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc, the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end of which is in the ring-opened form.

name: AOPE
definition: A dialkylglycerophosphoethanolamine in which the amino group of 1,2-dihexadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine (DHPE) carries an (aminooxy)acetyl functionality.

name: N-{α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc}-AOPE
definition: An N-glycosylated dialkylglycerophosphoethanolamine in which the dialkylglycerophosphoethanolamine is AOPE and the glycosylating saccharide is the branched nonasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc.

name: L-685,458
definition: A peptide and carboxamide that is L-leucyl-L-phenylalaninamide, L-Leu-L-Phe-NH2, which has been acylated on the N-terminus by a Phe-Phe hydroxyethylene dipeptide isotere, 2R-benzyl-5S-tert-butoxycarbonylamino-4R-hydroxy-6-phenylhexanoic acid. Compounds based on the structure of L-685,458 are potent inhibitors of γ-secretase, which mediates the final catalytic step that generates the amyloid β-peptide (Aβ), which assembles into the neurotoxic aggregates in the brains of sufferers of Alzheimer's disease.

name: aclacinomycin N(1+)
definition: An anthracycline cation that is the conjugate acid of aclacinomycin N, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group.

name: patulin
definition: A furopyran and lactone that is (2H-pyran-3(6H)-ylidene)acetic acid which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4 and in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has condensed with the carboxy group to give the corresponding bicyclic lactone. A mycotoxin produced by several species of Aspergillus and Penicillium, it has antibiotic properties but has been shown to be carcinogenic and mutagenic.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-acyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−) in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as oleoyl.

name: aclacinomycin Y(1+)
definition: An anthracycline cation that is the conjugate acid of aclacinomycin Y, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-myristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and tetradecanoyl respectively.

name: tetracenomycin F1(1−)

name: SureCN668028
definition: A nitrile that is phenylacetonitrile substituted by a carboxy and a methoxy group at positions 1 and 3 respectively.

name: 1-(γ-linolenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as γ-linolenoyl (6Z,9Z,12Z-octadecatrienoyl).

name: tetracenomycin D3(1−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of tetracenomycin F1, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: methyl (2E)-1,3-benzothiazol-2(3H)-ylidene(cyano)acetate
definition: An alkyl cyanoacetate ester that is methyl cyanoacetate with a 1,3-benzothiazol-2(3H)-ylidene substituent at position 2.

name: 1-(γ-linolenoyl)-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as γ-linolenoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-icosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)

name: 1-arachidonoyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate.

name: 1-icosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as icosanoyl (arachidoyl).

name: 1-arachidonoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-acyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-arachidonoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate

name: 1-icosanoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as icosanoyl (arachidoyl) and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1-myristoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as myristoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: dithiophosphoric acid
definition: A phosphorothioic acid that is the phosphoric acid having two of its oxygen atoms replaced by sulfur atoms.

name: 1,5-bis(diphospho)-1D-myo-inositol 2,3,4,6-tetrakisphosphate(14−)
definition: An inositol phosphate oxoanion obtained by global deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 1,5-bis(diphospho)-1D-myo-inositol 2,3,4,6-tetrakisphosphate.

name: 1-diphospho-1D-myo-inositol 2,3,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate(13−)
definition: An inositol phosphate oxoanion obtained by global deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 1-diphospho-1D-myo-inositol 2,3,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate.

name: 2-(2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl)-1H-isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione
definition: A dicarboximide that is isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is substituted by a 2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl group.

name: guanosine 2'-monophosphate
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 2'-monophosphate having guanine as the nucleobase.

name: cysteamine S-phosphate
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is the S-phospho derivative of cysteamine.

name: d(pT)3
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide composed of three deoxythymidylic acid residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages and terminated by a 5'-phosphate.

name: O4-phosphonatotyrosine(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phospho and carboxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group of O4-phosphotyrosine

name: O4-phosphotyrosine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is tyrosine phosphorylated at the phenolic hydroxy group.

name: 4',6,7-trihydroxyisoflavone
definition: A hydroxyisoflavone that is daidzein bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 6.

name: N-isovaleryl-L-homoserine lactone
definition: An N-acyl-L-homoserine lactone having isovaleryl as the acyl substituent.

name: O4-phospho-D-tyrosine
definition: A D-tyrosine derivative that is D-tyrosine phosphorylated at the phenolic hydroxy group.

name: homoeriodictyol
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone that consists of 3'-methoxyflavanone in which the three hydroxy substituents are located at positions 4', 5, and 7.

name: 5'-d[CTGCCTTCAG]-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA fragment comprised of one deoxyadenosine, four deoxycytidine, three thymidine and two deoxyguanidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence CTGCCTTCAG. It can exist as a hairpin structure, 5'-d [CTG(CCTT)CAG]-3', consisting of a four-nucleotide loop (CCTT) with a stem of three base-pairs, C-G, T-A and G-C.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 38:6 in which the acyl groups at C-1 and C-2 are specified as hexadecanoyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 38:4 in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 1-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-O-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group is specified as lauroyl (dodecanoyl)

name: 1-lauroyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as lauroyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 1-icosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine

name: 1-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion

name: (11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z)-3-oxohexacosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z)-3-oxohexacosapentaenoic acid.

name: N-(4-coumaroyl)-L-homoserine lactone
definition: An N-acyl-L-homoserine lactone having 4-coumaroyl as the acyl substituent.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 38:5 obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the phosphate group of 1-oleoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphoethanolamine.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-ManpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A hexasaccharide derivative consisting of an α-D-mannosyl residue β-linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 an β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl branched pentasaccharide unit.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 36:3 obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the phosphate group of 1-oleoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphoethanolamine.

name: 2-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-N-acetyl-6-(5-aminopentyl phosphoryl)-α-D-glucosaminopyranosyl-(1→2)-(2R)-3-hydroxypropanoate
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl residue linked (1→3) to an α-D-glucoside residue, the anomeric carbon of which is linked to O-2 of D-glyceric acid and the O-6 of which is connecteded via a phospho linkage to a 5-aminopentyl group.

definition: A branched pentasaccharide consisting of α-L-rhamnose, β-D-glucose and two α-D-glucose residues in (1→3), (1→4) and (1→2) sequence, to the non-reducing-end glucose residue of which is also linked (1→3) an α-L-rhamnose residue.

definition: An amino hexasaccharide comprising β-D-glucose, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, α-D-glucose, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine and α-D-mannose residues in (1→3), (1→4), (1→4) and (1→3) sequence, to the N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residue contiguous to the reducing-end mannose residue of which is also linked (1→3) a further β-D-glucose residue.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose in which the glycosyl moiety is L-rhamnose linked α to C-3 of β-D-glucose.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp
definition: A tetrasaccharide comprising three α-D-mannose residues, all linked (1→2), with a β-D-galactose residue also linked (1→4) to the reducing-end mannose residue. A Leishmania lipophosphoglycan capping tetrasaccharide.

name: [P-6-[CH2]5NH2]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[P-6-[CH2]5NH2]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-GroA
definition: A disaccharide derivative comprising two N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine residues linked (1→3), with a 6-aminopentylphospho group linked to each O-6 and with the anomeric carbon at the reducing end linked (1→2) to the O-2 of D-glyceric acid.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 36:2 obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the phosphate group of 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine.

definition: A dipeptide formed from L-valine and L-isoleucine residues.

definition: A dipeptide formed from L-valine and L-leucine residues.

definition: A dipeptide formed from L-valine and L-methionine residues.

name: Val-Phe

definition: A phosphatidylcholine 28:0 in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as lauroyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 28:0 in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl and lauroyl respectively.

definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine.

definition: A tripeptide formed from L-valine, L-tyrosine and L-valine residues joined in sequence.

definition: A phosphatidylcholine 34:0 in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and palmitoyl respectively.
