definition: A phosphatidylserine 34:1 that is the conjugate base of 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: malvin
definition: An anthocyanin cation that is malvidin carrying two β-D-glucosyl residues at positions 3 and 5.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 34:2 that is the conjugate base of 1-palmitoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 36:4 that is the conjugate base of 1-palmitoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic.

name: peonidin chloride
definition: An anthocyanidin chloride that has peonidin as the cationic component.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:1 in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are stearoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: petunidin chloride
definition: An anthocyanidin chloride that has petunidin as the cationic component.

name: 1-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the phosphate group of 1-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine.

name: vilanterol
definition: An dichlorobenzene derivative that is used in the form of its trifenate salt for treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 36:1 zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the phosphate group of 1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine.

name: vilanterol(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of vilanterol, obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group.

name: vilanterol trifenate
definition: A triphenylacetate salt obtained by combining vilanterol with one equivalent of triphenylacetic acid. Used in combination with fluticasone furoate for treatment of bronchospasm associated with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: thymidylyl(3'-5')thymidylyl(3'-5')thymidine
definition: An oligonucleotide composed of three deoxythymidylic acid residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: dabrafenib
definition: An organofluorine compound and antineoplastic agent, used as its mesylate salt in treatment of metastatic melanoma.

name: phleomycin D1
definition: A glycopeptide originally isolated from the bacterium Streptomyces verticillus which contains a (4'R)-4',5'-dihydro-2,4'-bi-1,3-thiazole-2',4-diyl moiety with a a 4-guanidylbutylaminocarbonyl group attached to the 4-position of the terminal thiazole ring. Like all phleomycins, phleomycin D1 can form complexes with redox-active metals such as Co, Cu, and Fe.

name: dabrafenib mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate (mesylate) salt prepared from equimolar amounts of dabrafenib and methanesulfonic acid. Used for treatment of metastatic melanoma.

name: cerberin
definition: A cardenolide glycoside that is the 2'-acetyl derivative of neriifolin.

name: 2-amino-5-chlorophenol
definition: Phenol carrying amino and chloro substituents at positions 2 and 5 respectively. It is part of the degradation pathway of 4-chloronitrobenzene, CHEBI:34399.

name: 3-dehydro-D-glucose-6-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 3-dehydro-D-glucose-6-phosphate.

name: 3,3'-neotrehalosadiamine(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the two amino groups of 3,3'-neotrehalosadiamine.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzaldehyde 2-pyridylhydrazone
definition: A hydrazone obtained by formal condensation of the carbonyl group of 2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzaldehyde with 2-hydrazinopyridine.

name: 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-indolyl β-D-galactoside
definition: An indolyl carbohydrate that is the β-D-galactoside of 3-hydroxy-1H-indole in which the indole moiety is substituted at positions 4 and 5 by chlorine and bromine, respectively. It is used to test for the presence of an enzyme, β-galactosidase, which cleaved the glycosidic bond to give 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-hydroxy-1H-indole, which immediately dimerises to give an intensely blue product.

name: N-[(5-acetyl-3-thienyl)methyl]-2-chloroacetamide semicarbazone
definition: A semicarbazone obtained by formal condensation of the keto group of N-[(5-acetyl-3-thienyl)methyl]-2-chloroacetamide with the hydrazino group of semicarbazide.

name: 2-amino-5-chloro-cis,cis-muconate 6-semialdehyde zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the carboxy group of 2-amino-5-chloro-cis,cis-muconic 6-semialdehyde

name: 4-nitrophenyl phthalimidoacetate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of phthalimidoacetic acid with the phenolic hydroxy group of 4-nitrophenol.

name: 4-methyl-2-oxochromen-7-yl {[3-(2,3-dihydro-1,4-benzodioxin-6-yl)-2-methyl-4-oxochromen-7-yl]oxy}acetate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of that carboxy group of {[3-(2,3-dihydro-1,4-benzodioxin-6-yl)-2-methyl-4-oxochromen-7-yl]oxy}acetic acid with the hydroxy group of 7-hydroxy-4-methylchromen-2-one.

name: 4-[1-(benzylamino)ethylidene]-2-(2,4-dibromophenyl)-5-methyl-2,4-dihydropyrazol-3-one
definition: A ring assembly that is the 2-(2,4-dibromophenyl) derivative of 4-[1-(benzylamino)ethylidene]-5-methyl-2,4-dihydropyrazol-3-one.

name: trans-2-icosenoyl-CoA
definition: A 2,3-trans-enoyl CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-2-icosenoic acid.

name: 1-myristoyl-2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 30:0 in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are myristoyl (tetradecanoyl) and palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) respectively.

name: trans-2-docosenoyl-CoA
definition: A 2,3-trans-enoyl CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-2-docosenoic acid.

name: trans-2-tetracosenoyl-CoA
definition: A 2,3-trans-enoyl CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-2-tetracosenoic acid.

name: 1-palmitoleoyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as palmitoleoyl.

name: 1,2-di-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are both (9Z)-hexadecenoyl (palmitoleoyl).

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-(9Z)-hexadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as octadecanoyl and (9Z)-hexadecenoyl respectively.

name: 1-(9Z)-octadecenoyl-2-(9Z)-hexadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (9Z)-octadecenoyl and (9Z)-hexadecenoyl respectively.

name: 2,3-bis-O-phytanyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A glycerophosphoserine that is L-serine in which the side-chain is substituted by an archaetidyl group.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-oleoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate.

name: N1-methylpseudouridine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A C-nucleoside phosphate consisting of N1-methylpseudouridine substituted at position 5' by a monophosphate group.

name: N3-methylcytidine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having N3-methylcytosine as the nucleobase.

name: tridecanoic-d25 acid
definition: A C13 straight-chain saturated fatty acid where the aliphatic hydrogens have been replaced by deuterium atoms.

name: N4-acetylcytidine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having N4-acetylcytosine as the nucleobase.

name: 10-pentadecenoic acid
definition: A pentadecenoic acid having its double bond in the 10-position.

name: cis-10-pentadecenoic acid
definition: The cis-isomer of pentadec-10-enoic acid.

name: trans-10-pentadecenoic acid
definition: The trans-isomer of pentadec-10-enoic acid.

name: aclacinomycin N
definition: An anthracycline antibiotic that is aclacinomycin A in which the keto group on the trisaccharide fragment has been reduced in a stereospecific manner to the corresponding alcohol.

name: morin
definition: A pentahydroxyflavone that is 7-hydroxyflavonol bearing three additional hydroxy substituents at positions 2' 4' and 5.

name: aclacinomycin Y
definition: An anthracycline antibiotic that is aclacinomycin A in which the ketone function on the trisaccharide fragment has undergone 2,3-dehydrogenation to afford the corresponding enone.

name: (10Z)-heptadecenoic acid
definition: The cis-isomer of 10-heptadecenoic acid.

name: chrysin
definition: A dihydroxyflavone in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 5 and 7.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and linoleoyl respectively.

name: trans-10-heptadecenoic acid
definition: The trans-isomer of 10-heptadecenoic acid.

name: 10-heptadecenoic acid
definition: A heptadecenoic acid having its double bond in the 10-position.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and palmitoleoyl respectively.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and stearoyl respectively.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-nonadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-oleoyl-2-nonadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate.

name: nonadecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of nonadecanoyl-CoA.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: datiscetin
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavone that is 7-hydroxyflavonol bearing two additional hydroxy substituents at positions 2' and 5.

name: linoelaidic acid
definition: An octadecadienoic acid containing two E (trans) double bonds at positions 9 and 12.

name: (13Z,16Z)-docosadienoic acid
definition: A docosadienoic acid having two cis-double bonds at position 13 and 16 respectively.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−) in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as oleoyl.

name: 1-(10Z)-heptadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol(1−)
definition: A lysophosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of 1-(10Z)-heptadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol.

name: 1-(10Z)-heptadecenoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol(1−)
definition: 1-acyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol(1−) in which the 1-acyl group is specified as (10Z)-heptadecenoyl.

name: (11Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecenoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (11Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-(11Z)-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-oleoyl-2-(11Z)-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate.

name: (6Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecenoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (6E)-octadecenoyl-CoA.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-(6Z)-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-oleoyl-2-(6Z)-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate.

name: N-[1-hydroxy-3-(morpholin-4-yl)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]hexadecanamide
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of palmitic acid with the primary amino group of 2-amino-3-(morpholin-4-yl)-1-phenylpropan-1-ol.

name: (1R,2R)-1-phenyl-2-palmitoylamino-3-morpholino-1-propanol
definition: An N-[1-hydroxy-3-(morpholin-4-yl)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]hexadecanamide in which both stereocentres have R configuration.

name: (1S,2S)-1-phenyl-2-palmitoylamino-3-morpholino-1-propanol
definition: An N-[1-hydroxy-3-(morpholin-4-yl)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]hexadecanamide in which both stereocentres have S configuration.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-icosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and icosanoyl (arachidoyl) respectively.

name: 5'-d[GCGAGTGAT(6-4)TATGGACGG]-3'
definition: A single-strand DNA oligonucleotide comprised of four deoxyadenosine, two deoxycytidine, four thymidine and eight deoxyguanidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence G-C-G-A-G-T-G-A-T-T-A-T-G-G-A-C-G-G, with a (6-4) lesion at the central two thymidine residues (PDB entry: 3VW3).

name: 1-arachidonoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−) in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as arachidonoyl.

name: N-benzyloxycarbonyl-L-leucyl-L-leucyl-L-leucinal
definition: A tripeptide that is L-leucyl-L-leucyl-L-leucine in which the C-terminal carboxy group has been reduced to the corresponding aldehyde and the N-terminal amino group is protected as its benzyloxycarbonyl derivative.

name: N,O-dimethyltyramine
definition: A secondary amino compound that is tyramine in which the hydrogen of the phenolic hydroxy group has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: lactamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is lactic acid in which the carboxylic acid group has been converted to the corresponding carboxamide.

name: 2-aminooctanoic acid
definition: An α-amino fatty acid that is caprylic acid which is substituted at position 2 by an amino group.

name: monomethyl succinate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester that is succinic acid in which one of the carboxy groups has been converted to its methyl ester.

name: 3-dehydro-D-glucose-6-phosphate
definition: A ketohexose monophosphate that is 3-dehydro-D-glucose having the monophosphate group located at position 6.

name: 5'-d[CCCGTCCATAATCACTCG]-3'
definition: A single-strand DNA oligonucleotide comprised of four deoxyadenosine, eight deoxycytidine, four thymidine and two deoxyguanidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence C-C-C-G-T-C-C-A-T-A-A-T-C-A-C-T-C-G. (PDB entry: 3VW3).

name: 5'-d[TC]-3'
definition: A single-strand DNA oligonucleotide consisting of a thymidine residue phospho-linked 3'→5' to a deoxycytidine residue (PDB entry: 2OK0).

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−)
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−) in which the acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylinositol 28:0 in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and lauroyl (dodecanoyl) respectively.

name: 1-myristoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphatidylglycerol(1−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as myristoyl and oleoyl respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: eupatin
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is quercetagetin methylated at positions 4', 6 and 7.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−) in which both acyl groups are specified as oleoyl.

name: patuletin
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is quercetagetin methylated at position 6.

name: dT(6-4)T
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide consisting of two thymidine molecules linked (3'→5') and also with a C6-C4 bond. It results from irradiation at 254 nm of normal dTpT (PDB entry: 1EHL).

name: 5'-d[CGAGCTGCCTTCAGTCG]-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of two deoxyadenosine, six deoxycytidine, four thymidine and five deoxyguanidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence d[CGAGCTGCCTTCAGTCG]. It can exist as a hairpin structure in several different conformations.

name: dT5
definition: An oligonucleotide comprised of five thymidine residues connected via 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: 1-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the 1-acyl group is specified as oleoyl.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as oleoyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: zaragozic acid A
definition: A polyketide isolated from fungi that is a potent inhibitor of fungal and mammalian squalene synthase.

name: formestane
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is androst-4-ene-3,17-dione in which the hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by a hydroxy group. Formestane was the first selective, type I steroidal aromatase inhibitor, suppressing oestrogen production from anabolic steroids or prohormones. It was formerly used in the treatment of oestrogen-receptor positive breast cancer in post-meopausal women. As it has poor oral bioavailability, it had to be administered by (fortnightly) intramuscular injection. It fell out of use with the subsequent development of cheaper, orally active aromatase inhibitors. Formestane is listed by the World Anti-Doping Agency as a substance prohibited from use by athletes.

name: 3',5'-cyclic UMP
definition: A 3',5'-cyclic pyrimidine nucleotide having uridine as the nucleobase.

name: ornidazole
definition: A C-nitro compound that is 5-nitroimidazole in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 2 are replaced by 3-chloro-2-hydroxypropyl and methyl groups, respectively. It is used in the treatment of susceptible protozoal infections and for the treatment of anaerobic bacterial infections.

name: urea hydrogen peroxide
definition: A mixture obtained by combining equimolar amounts of hydrogen peroxide and urea.

name: trifluridine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside compound having 5-trifluoromethyluracil as the nucleobase. An antiviral drug used mainly in the treatment of primary keratoconjunctivitis and recurrent epithelial keratitis.

name: tolylfluanid
definition: A member of the class of sulfamides that is dichlofluanid in which the hydrogen at the para position of the phenyl group is replaced by a methyl group. A fungicide first marketed in 1971 and used in the cultivation of fruit and vegetables, as well as in wood preservatives, it is no longer approved for use in the European Union.

name: 3',5'-cyclic dTMP
definition: A 3',5'-cyclic pyrimidine nucleotide derived from thymidine monophosphate.

name: thiodiglycol
definition: A diol that is pentane-1,5-diol in which the methylene group at position 3 is replaced by a sulfur atom

name: β-D-galactosyl-N-(tetracosanoyl)sphingosine
definition: A N-acyl-β-D-galactosylsphingosine in which the acyl group is tetracosananoyl.

name: α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-hexacosanoylceramide
definition: An α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosylceramide in which the substituent on the ceramide nitrogen is hexacosanoyl.

name: thallium(I) acetate
definition: An acetate salt comprising equal numbers of acetate and thallium ions.

name: tetrazolium violet
definition: An organic chloride salt having tetrazolium violet(1+) as the counterion.

name: tetrazolium violet(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the cationic component of tetrazolium violet.

name: tetrazolium blue
definition: An organic chloride salt having tetrazolium blue(1+) as the counterion.

name: tetrazolium blue(2+)
definition: An organic cation that is the cationic component of tetrazolium blue.

name: (S)-3,5-dihydroxyphenylglycine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of (S)-3,5-dihydroxyphenylglycine.

name: 3,5-dihydroxyphenylglyoxylate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3,5-dihydroxyphenylglyoxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: tannic acid
definition: A gallotannin obtained by acylation of the five hydroxy groups of D-glucose by 3,4-dihydroxy-5-[(3,4,5-trihydroxybenzoyl)oxy]benzoic acid (a gallic acid dimer).

name: dazomet
definition: A dithiocarbamic ester that is 1,3,5-thiadiazinane with a thione moiety at position 2 and in which the hydrogens attached to the nitrogens are replaced by methyl groups. A fungicide, herbicide and nematicide, it is used prior to sowing or planting for the control of soil fungi, nematodes, bacteria and germinating weeds, and as fumigant for poultry litter and eggs to control Salmonella. It is a non-ozone-depleting alternative to methyl bromide.

name: sodium molybdate dihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of sodium molybdate.

name: sodium molybdate (anhydrous)
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having molybdate as the counterion.

name: 1-O-octadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the alkyl group is specified as octadecyl

name: α-D-galactosyl-N-(hexacosanoyl)-11,12-methylene-C22-sphinganine
definition: A glycosylceramide in which the glycosyl moiety is α-D-galactose and the ceramide is N-(hexacosanoyl)-11,12-methylene-C22-sphinganine.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl and acetyl respectively.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and acetyl respectively.

name: sodium metavanadate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having metavanadate as the counterion.

name: α-D-galactosyl-N-[(4Z)-9-(2-decylcyclopropyl)non-4-enoyl]phytosphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylphytosphingosine in which the galactosyl group has α-anomeric configuration and the acyl group on nitrogen is (4Z)-9-(2-decylcyclopropyl)non-4-enoyl.

name: metavanadate
definition: A vanadium oxoanion in which a central vanadium is divalently bound to two oxygens and monovalently bound to a hydroxide.

name: sodium periodate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having periodate as the counterion.

name: sodium metaborate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having metaborate as the counterion.

name: sodium lactate
definition: An organic sodium salt having lactate as the counterion.

name: sodium bromate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having bromate as the counterion.

name: 12(R)-HPETE(1−)
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12(R)-HPETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 12-oxo-ETE(1−)
definition: A oxo fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12-oxo-ETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (8R)-hydroxy-(11R,12R)-epoxyicosa-(5Z,9E,14Z)-trienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (8R)-hydroxy-(11R,12R)-epoxyicosa-(5Z,9E,14Z)-trienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (8R)-hydroxy-(11S,12S)-epoxyicosa-(5Z,9E,14Z)-trienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (8R)-hydroxy-(11S,12S)-epoxyicosa-(5Z,9E,14Z)-trienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (10R)-hydroxy-(11S,12S)-epoxyicosa-(5Z,8Z,14Z)-trienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (10R)-hydroxy-(11S,12S)-epoxyicosa-(5Z,8Z,14Z)-trienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (13R)-hydroxy-(14S,15S)-epoxyicosa-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-trienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (13R)-hydroxy-(14S,15S)-epoxyicosa-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-trienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: [8)-α-Neu5Pr-(2→]10
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative consisting of ten α-D-N-propionylneuraminyl residues joined by (2→8) linkages.

name: aklaviketone
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the methyl ester of (1R,2R)-2-ethyl-2,5,7-trihydroxy-4,6,11-trioxo-1,2,3,4,6,11-hexahydrotetracene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: 1-O-octadecyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine O-38:4 in which the alkyl and acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are octadecyl and (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoyl respectively.

name: rifaximin
definition: A semisynthetic member of the class of rifamycins and non-systemic gastrointestinal site-specific broad spectrum antibiotic. Used in the treatment of traveller's diarrhoea, hepatic encephalopathy and irritable bowel syndrome.

name: pridinol
definition: A piperidine substituted at position 1 by a 3-hydroxy-3,3-diphenylpropyl group.

name: potassium tellurite
definition: A potassium salt consisting of potassium and tellurite ions in a 2:1 ratio.

name: potassium chromate
definition: A potassium salt consisting of potassium and chromate ions in a 2:1 ratio.

name: pipemidic acid
definition: A pyridopyrimidine that is 5-oxo-5,8-dihydropyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidine-6-carboxylic acid substituted at position 2 by a piperazin-1-yl group and at position 8 by an ethyl group. A synthetic broad-spectrum antibacterial, it is used for treatment of gastrointestinal, biliary, and urinary infections.

name: picropodophyllotoxin
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that has a furonaphthodioxole skeleton bearing 3,4,5-trimethoxyphenyl and hydroxy substituents.

name: phenylarsine oxide
definition: An arsine oxide derived from phenylarsine.

name: penimepicycline
definition: A penicillinate salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of phenoxymethylpenicillin and pipacycline.

name: arotinoid acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of benzoic acid substituted at position 4 by a 2-(5,5,8,8-tetramethyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydronaphthalen-2-yl)prop-1-en-1-yl group. It is a synthetic retinoid that acts as a selective agonist for the retinoic acid receptors (RAR).

name: pipacycline
definition: Tetracycline in which a hydrogen attached to the amide nitrogen is substituted by a 4-[(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazin-1-yl]methyl group.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−)
definition: A conjugate base of 1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol).

name: pipacycline(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of pipacycline.

name: nimustine
definition: An organochlorine compound that is urea in which the two hydrogens on one of the amino groups are replaced by nitroso and 2-chloroethyl groups and one hydrogen from the other amino group is replaced by a 4-amino-2-methylpyrimidin-5-ylmethyl] group. An antineoplastic agent especially effective against malignant brain tumors.

name: nimustine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of nimustine.

name: splitomicin
definition: A benzochromenone that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-benzo[f]chromene substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It has been found to exhibit potential inhibitory activity against Sir2 proteins.

name: sodium tetradecyl sulfate
definition: An organic sodium salt having tetradecyl sulfate as the counterion. Used in the treatment of small uncomplicated varicose veins of the lower extremities that show simple dilation with competent valves.

name: tetradecyl sulfate
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of tetradecyl sulfonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the O-sulfo group.

name: tetradecyl sulfonic acid
definition: An alkyl sulfate that is the mono-7-ethyl-2-methylundecan-4-yl ester of sulfuric acid.

name: ikarugamycin
definition: A polyketide macrolactam containing a tetramic acid (pyrrolidine-2,4-dione) ring system. It is isolated from Streptomyces as an antibiotic with antiprotozoal and cytotoxic activities.

name: N-phthaloyl-L-glutamic acid
definition: A glutamic acid derivative that is L-glutamic acid in which the two hydrogens on the amino group are substituted by a phthaloyl group.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminitol
definition: A 2-deoxyhexitol derivative that is D-glucitol in which the 2-hydroxy substituent is replaced by an acetamido group.

name: miltefosine
definition: A phospholipid that is the hexadecyl monoester of phosphocholine.

name: (R)-2-(4-chloro-2-methylphenoxy)propanoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (R)-2-(4-chloro-2-methylphenoxy)propanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (S)-2-(4-chloro-2-methylphenoxy)propanoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (S)-2-(4-chloro-2-methylphenoxy)propanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: methyltrioctylammonium chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt having methyltrioctylammonium as the cation.

name: (S)-dichlorprop(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of (S)-dichlorprop. The major species at pH 7.3

name: (R)-dichlorprop(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of (R)-dichlorprop. The major species at pH 7.3

name: 1-O-octadecyl-2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine betaine where the alkyl and the acyl groups at position 1 and 2 are octadecyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: ε-rhodomycinone
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the methyl ester of (1R,2R,4S)-2-ethyl-2,4,5,7,12-pentahydroxy-6,11-dioxo-1,2,3,4,6,11-hexahydrotetracene-1-carboxylic acid.

name: phenanthridone
definition: A member of the class of phenanthridines that is phenanthridine with an oxo substituent at position 6. A poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitor, it has been shown to exhibit immunosuppressive activity.

name: methyltrioctylammonium
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion with three octyl groups and one methyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-icosanoyl-2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:0 where the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are icosanoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: 13-dihydrodaunorubicin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 13-dihydrodaunorubicin, obtained by protonation of the primary amino function.

name: 13-deoxydaunorubicin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 13-deoxydaunorubicin, obtained by protonation of the primary amino function.

name: melibionic acid
definition: A disaccharide consisting α-D-galactosyl and D-gluconic acid residues joined by a (1→6)-linkage.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-decanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 26:0 in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are palmitoyl and decanoyl respectively.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-hexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine where the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are palmitoyl and hexanoyl respectively.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-capryloyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 24:0 where the acyl groups at position 1 and 2 are palmitoyl and capryloyl respectively.

name: lauryl sulfobetaine
definition: An ammonium betaine in which the ammonium nitrogen is substituted by dodecyl, 3-sulfatopropyl and two methyl groups.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-myristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 30:0 in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and myristoyl (tetradecanoyl) respectively.

name: glutamine hydroxamate
definition: A hydroxamic acid that is L-glutamine hydroxylated at N-5.

name: 2-heptyl-4-hydroxyquinoline
definition: A monohydroxyquinoline that is 4-hydroxyquinoline bearing an additional heptyl substituent at position 2.

name: BW B70C
definition: A hydroxamic acid that is urea in which both the hydrogens attached to one of the nitrogens are replaced by a hydroxy and a (1E)-1-[3-(4-fluorophenoxy)phenyl]but-1-en-3-yl group. A selective inhibitor of arachidonate 5-lipoxygenase, it can be used for the treatment of asthma.

name: 19-oxotestosterone
definition: An androstanoid that is testosterone with an oxo group at position 19.

name: aklanonate
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the monoanion obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group of aklanonic acid.

name: tomelukast
definition: A member of the class of acetophenones that is 1-phenylethanone substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group, a propyl group at position 3 and a 4-(1H-tetrazol-5-yl)butoxy group at position 4. A leukotriene antagonist, it exhibits anti-asthmatic activity.

name: methyl aklanonate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of aklanonic acid with methanol.

name: α-D-GalNAc-(1→2)-[α-D-Glc-(1→3)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-[β-D-Glc-(1→2)]-α-D-Man-(1→5)-α-Kdo
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide corresponding to the core oligosaccharide of the Gram negative bacterium Francisella tularensis.

name: peonidin
definition: An anthocyanidin cation that is flavylium bearing four hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 4', 5 and 7 as well as a methoxy substituent at position 3'.

name: sodium phenylbutyrate
definition: The organic sodium salt of 4-phenylbutyric acid. A prodrug for phenylacetate, it is used to treat urea cycle disorders.

name: 4-phenylbutyrate
definition: A carboxylic acid anion obtained by the removal of proton from the carboxy group of 4-phenylbutyric acid.

name: petunidin
definition: An anthocyanidin cation that is flavylium bearing five hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 3', 4', 5 and 7 as well as a methoxy substituent at position 5'.

name: 3,3'-neotrehalosadiamine
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of α- and β-D-kanosaminyl residues joined by a (1↔1)-linkage.

name: 2-amino-5-chloro-cis,cis-muconic 6-semialdehyde
definition: A muconic semialdehyde having amino and chloro substituents at positions 2 and 5 respectively.

name: nitrosulindac
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the 4-(nitrooxy)butyl ester of sulindac. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, which also has anticancer activity.

name: 8(S)-HPETE(1−)
definition: A HPETE anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (8S)-HPETE.

name: lactitol
definition: A glycosyl alditol consisting of β-D-galactopyranose and D-glucitol joined by a 1→4 glycosidic bond. It is used as a laxative, as an excipient, and as replacement bulk sweetener in some low-calorie foods.

name: 8-oxo-ETE(1−)
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 8-KETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (8S,9S)-epoxy-(10R)-hydroxyicosa-(5Z,11Z,14Z)-trienoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (8S,9S)-epoxy-(10R)-hydroxyicosa-(5Z,11Z,14Z)-trienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (8E,10S)-10-hydroxy-8-octadecenoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (8E,10S)-10-hydroxy-8-octadecenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 1-(2,4-dichlorobenzoyl)-1H-1,2,3-benzotriazole
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is obtained by the formal condensation of 2,4-dichlorobenzoic acid and benzotriazole. It acts as an inhibitor for tubulin acetylation mediated by trichostatin A.

name: benzotriazole
definition: The simplest member of the class of benzotriazoles that consists of a benzene nucleus fused to a 1H-1,2,3-triazole ring.

name: nonadecanoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of pentadecanoic acid.

name: 1-(2,4-dichlorobenzoyl)-1H-benzimidazole
definition: A member of the class of benzamides obtained by the formal condensation of 1H-benzimidazole and 2,4-dichlorobenzoic acid.

name: 2-(benzoylamino)-4-nitrobenzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzamides obtained by the formal condensation of the amino group of 4-nitroanthranilic acid with the carboxy group of benzoic acid.

name: 4-nitroanthranilic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is anthranilic acid with a nitro substituent at position 4.

name: 2-[(benzoylamino)methyl]-3,4,6-trichlorophenyl 4-nitrobenzoate
definition: A member of the class of benzamides obtained by the formal condensation of 2-(aminomethyl)-3,4,6-trichlorophenol and benzoic acid. The carboxamide is further esterified at the phenolic hydroxy group by 4-nitrobenzoic acid.

name: 2-(aminomethyl)-3,4,6-trichlorophenol
definition: A member of the class of trichlorophenols that is phenol substituted by chloro groups at positions 3, 4 and 6 and an aminomethyl group at position 2.

name: 2-benzoylbenzene-1,4-diyl bis(4-bromo-3-nitrobenzoate)
definition: A member of the class of benzophenones that is benzophenone substituted by (4-bromo-3-nitrobenzoyl)oxy groups at positions 1 and 4.

name: β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-(hexacosanoyl)sphingosine
definition: A β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosylceramide where the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexacosanoyl.

name: (8E,10S)-10-hydroperoxy-8-octadecenoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (8E,10S)-10-hydroperoxy-8-octadecenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 1-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1-monoglyceride where the acyl group is oleoyl.

name: 2-chloro-N-(2-nitrophenyl)-5-(1-piperidinylsulfonyl)benzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is N-(2-nitrophenyl)benzamide substituted by a chloro group at position 2 and a piperidin-1-ylsulfonyl group at position 5.

name: β-D-glucosyl-N-(hexacosanoyl)sphingosine
definition: A β-D-glucosylceramide where the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexacosanoyl.

name: 2-propyn-1-yl 2,4,6-tribromophenyl phthalate
definition: A phthalate ester that is the mixed diester obtained by the formal condensation of carboxy groups of phthalic acid with hydroxy groups of 2,4,6-tribromophenol and prop-2-yn-1-ol respectively.

name: (8E,10S,12Z)-10-hydroperoxyoctadeca-8,12-dienoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (8E,10S,12Z)-10-hydroperoxyoctadeca-8,12-dienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 1-(10Z)-heptadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 1-acyl group is specified as (10Z)-heptadecenoyl.

name: (8E,10S,12Z,15Z)-10-hydroperoxyoctadec-8,12,15-trienoate
definition: The monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of (8E,10S,12Z,15Z)-10-hydroperoxyoctadeca-8,12,15-trienoic acid.

name: tricin 7-O-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is tricin attached to a D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 3-[(4-bromophenyl)amino]-3-(4-methoxyphenyl)-1-phenylpropan-1-one
definition: An aromatic ketone that is propiophenone substituted at position 3 by (4-bromophenyl)amino and 4-methoxyphenyl groups respectively.

name: 1-(10Z)-heptadecenoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: 1-acyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol in which the 1-acyl group is specified as (10Z)-heptadecenoyl.

name: tricin 7-O-[sinapoyl]-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is tricin 7-O-glucoside with the hydroxy group on the glycosyl ring at position 6 replaced with a sinapoyl moiety.

name: (11Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecenoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (11Z)-octadecenoic acid.

name: ethyl 4-(3-methoxyphenyl)-6-methyl-2-thioxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyrimidine-5-carboxylate
definition: A member of the class of thioureas that is 3,4-dihydropyrimidine-2(1H)-thione substituted by a 3-methoxyphenyl group at position 4, a methyl group at position 6 and a ethoxycarbonyl group at position 5.

name: N-(4-bromophenyl)-2-{4-[(4-bromophenyl)carbamoyl]phenyl}-1,3-dioxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-isoindole-5-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of isoindoles that is 1H-isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione substituted at position 5 by a 4-bromoanilinocarbonyl group and at position 2 by a 4-[(4-bromophenyl)carbamoyl]phenyl group.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-(11Z)-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and (11Z)-octadecenoyl respectively.

name: N-[2-(1,3-benzoxazol-2-yl)phenyl]-4-methylbenzenesulfonamide
definition: A sulfonamide that is 4-methylbenzenesulfonamide in which one of the hydrogens attached to nitrogen atom is replaced by a 2-(1,3-benzoxazol-2-yl)phenyl group.

name: (6Z)-octadecenoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecenoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (6Z)-octadecenoic acid.

name: N-[2-(4-ethylphenyl)-1,3-benzoxazol-5-yl]-3-nitrobenzamide
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-benzoxazoles that is 1,3-benzoxazole substituted at positions 2 and 5 by 4-ethylphenyl and 3-nitrobenzamido groups respectively.

name: N-{4-[(1E)-3-oxo-3-phenylprop-1-en-1-yl]phenyl}-2,2-diphenylacetamide
definition: A a monocarboxylic acid amide that is 2,2-diphenylacetamide in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen atom is replaced by a 4-[(1E)-3-oxo-3-phenylprop-1-en-1-yl]phenyl group.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-(6Z)-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and (6Z)-octadecenoyl respectively.

name: N-(2,6-dimethylphenyl)-N2-(3,5-dimethylphenyl)glycinamide
definition: An amino acid amide obtained by the formal condensation of 2,6-dimethylaniline with N-(3,5-dimethylphenyl)glycine.

name: N-(3,5-dimethylphenyl)glycine
definition: A glycine derivative whose structure comprises a glycine core carrying a N-(3,5-dimethylphenyl) substituent.

name: N-(4-aminobutyl)-5-chloronaphthalene-2-sulfonamide
definition: A sulfonamide that is 5-chloronaphthalene-2-sulfonamide in which one of the hydrogens of the nitrogen atom is substituted by a 4-aminobutyl group.

name: N-(4-aminobutyl)-5-chloronaphthalene-2-sulfonamide hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt prepared from equimolar amounts of N-(4-aminobutyl)-5-chloronaphthalene-2-sulfonamide and hydrogen chloride.

name: isovitexin 7-O-[feruloyl]-glucoside
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is isovitexin with the hydroxy group at position 7 replaced with a glucopyranosyl entity which in turn is substituted at position 6 by a feruloyl moiety.

name: N-(4-aminobutyl)-5-chloronaphthalene-2-sulfonamide(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion obtained by the protonation of the amino group of N-(4-aminobutyl)-5-chloronaphthalene-2-sulfonamide.

name: 2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanoic acid
definition: An aromatic ether that is 2-hydroxypropanoic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted to its 2,4-dichlorophenyl ether.

name: isovitexin 7-O-[isoferuloyl]-glucoside
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is isovitexin with the hydroxy group at position 7 replaced with a glucopyranosyl entity which in turn is substituted at position 6 by an isoferuloyl moiety.

name: pararosaniline free base
definition: An imine that is 4-methylidenecyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-imine in which both the hydrogens of the methylidene group are replaced by 4-aminophenyl groups. The hydrochloride salt is the histological dye 'pararosaniline'.

name: (R)-dichlorprop
definition: The R- (active) enantiomer of dichlorprop. It is used as a herbicide for killing annual and broad leaf weeds.

name: (S)-dichlorprop
definition: The S- (inactive) enantiomer of dichlorprop.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: phenyl biguanide
definition: A member of the class of biguanides that is biguanide in which one of the terminal nitrogen atoms is substituted by a phenyl group.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-hexadecanoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 2-acyl substituent is specified as lauroyl (dodecanoyl).

name: blebbistatin
definition: A pyrroloquinoline that is 1,2,3,3a-tetrahydro-H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]quinolin-4-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3a, a methyl group at position 6 and a phenyl group at position 1. It acts as an inhibitor of ATPase activity of non-muscle myosin II.

name: monastrol
definition: A racemate comprising equimolar amounts of R- and S-monastrol.

name: (R)-monastrol
definition: An ethyl 4-(3-hydroxyphenyl)-6-methyl-2-thioxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyrimidine-5-carboxylate that has R configuration.

name: (S)-monastrol
definition: An ethyl 4-(3-hydroxyphenyl)-6-methyl-2-thioxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyrimidine-5-carboxylate that has S configuration.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which both acyl groups are specified as oleoyl.

name: sinapoyl-isovitexin 2''-O-arabinoside
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is isovitexin attached to a 4-O-[(2E)-3-(4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl)prop-2-enoyl]-α-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 2 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: (R)-blebbistatin
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of blebbistatin.

name: (S)-blebbistatin
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of blebbistatin.

name: 1,4-diamino-2,3-dicyano-1,4-bis(phenylthio)butadiene
definition: A dinitrile that is succinonitrile in which the methylene hydrogens at positions 2 and 3 are substituted by amino(phenylsulfanyl)methylidene groups. It acts as an inhibitor of MEK (mitogen activated protein kinase kinase).

name: 3-[3-(tert-butylsulfanyl)-1-(4-chlorobenzyl)-5-(propan-2-yl)-1H-indol-2-yl]-2,2-dimethylpropanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a isopropyl group at position 5, a tert-butylsulfanediyl group at position 3, a 4-chlorobenzyl group at position 1 and a 2-carboxy-2-methylpropyl group at position 2. It acts as an inhibitor of arachidonate 5-lipoxygenase.

name: hydroxy-2-naphthalenyl-methyl phosphonic acid trisacetoxymethylester
definition: An organic phosphonate that is the trisacetoxymethylester derivative of naphthalene substituted hydroxymethylphosphonic acid. It has been found to inhibit insulin receptor tyrosine kinase activity and insulin stimulated glucose oxidation.

name: LM-1685
definition: An indolyl carboxylate ester that is methyl 1H-indole-2-carboxylate substituted by a 4-chlorobenzyl group at position 1 and a methylsulfonyl group at position 5. It acts as a selective inhibitor of cyclooxygenase 2.

name: Y-27632
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is trans-[(1R)-1-aminoethyl]cyclohexanecarboxamide in which one of the nitrogens of the aminocarbony group is substituted by a pyridine nucleus. It has been shown to exhibit inhibitory activity against Rho-associated protein kinase (ROCK) enzyme.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-α-D-mannose
definition: An amino disaccharide comprised of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine linked (1→4) to D-mannose.

name: 2''-O-(4-sinapoylarabinosyl)isoscoparin
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is the 4'''-O-sinapoyl derivative of isoscoparin 2''-O-arabinoside.

name: 2''-O-α-L-arabinopyranosylisoscoparin
definition: A trihydroxyflavone that is isoscoparin glycosylated at position 2'' on the glucosyl ring by an α-L-arabinopyranosyl residue.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-α-D-mannose
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of a chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→4).

name: chrysoeriol 7-O-gentiobioside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is chrysoeriol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 7 is replaced by a gentiobiosyl moiety.

name: NU 1025
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazolin-4(1H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 2. It has been shown to exhibit inhibitory activity against poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase.

name: calmidazolium
definition: An imidazolium ion that is imidazolium cation substituted by a bis(4-chlorophenyl)methyl group at position 1 and a 2-[(2,4-dichlorobenzyl)oxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl group at position 3. It acts as an antagonist of calmodulin, a calcium binding messenger protein.

name: quinpirole
definition: A pyrazoloquinoline that is (4aR,8aR)-4,4a,5,6,7,8,8a,9-octahydro-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-g]quinoline substituted by a propyl group at position 5. It acts as a dopamine agonist.

name: 2-methyl-6-all-trans-nonaprenyl-1,4-benzoquinone
definition: A polyprenylhydroquinone that is 2-methylbenzene-1,4-diol substituted by a all-trans-nonaprenyl group at position 6.

name: tyrphostin AG 1478
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline substituted by methoxy groups at positions 6 and 7 and a (3-chlorophenyl)nitrilo group at position 4. It acts as an epidermal growth factor receptor antagonist.

name: tyrphostin AG 825

name: rac-1-α-linolenoyl-2-oleoylglycerol
definition: A rac-1,2-diglyceride that is composed of equal amounts of 2-oleoyl-3-α-linolenoyl-sn-glycerol and 1-α-linolenoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycerol.

name: 1-myristoyl-2-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1,2-diglyceride with myristoyl and oleoyl as the two acyl groups.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-3-palmitoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: The S-enantiomer of 1,2-dioleoyl-3-palmitoylglycerol.

name: palmityl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester resulting from the formal condensation of palmitic acid with palmityl alcohol. It is used as a thickener and emollient in cosmetics.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1,2-diglyceride with palmitoyl and oleoyl as the two acyl groups.

name: 1,2-hexadecanediol
definition: A glycol that is hexadecane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 2.

name: 2-hydroxypalmityl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester resulting from the formal condensation of palmitic acid with 1,2-hexadecandiol.

name: isoschaftoside
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is apigenin substituted at positions 6 and 8 by α-L-arabinopyranosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues respectively.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1,2-diglyceride with stearoyl and oleoyl as the acyl groups.

name: L-cycloserine
definition: A 4-amino-1,2-oxazolidin-3-one that has S configuration. An antibiotic isolated from Erwinia uredovora.

name: dT10
definition: An oligonucleotide comprised of ten thymidine residues connected via 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: dT8

name: dT4

name: poly(5-bromo-2'-deoxyuridylic acid)
definition: A polynucleotide comprised of 5-bromo-2'-deoxyuridine units connected via 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: 2-palmitoyloxypalmityl palmitate
definition: A wax ester resulting from the formal condensation of both the hydroxy groups of hexadecane-1,2-diol with two molecules of palmitic acid.

name: 1-α-linolenoyl-2-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1,2-diglyceride with linolenoyl and oleoyl as the two acyl groups.

name: 1-α-linolenoylglycerol
definition: A 1-monoglyceride that has α-linolenoyl as the acyl group.

name: 1-arachidonoyl-2-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1,2-diglyceride where arachidonoyl and oleoyl are the two acyl groups.

name: 1-arachidonoylglycerol
definition: A 1-monoglyceride where the acyl group is arachidonoyl.

name: 1-linoleoyl-2-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1,2-diglyceride where linoleoyl and oleoyl are the two acyl groups.

name: (8E,10S,12Z,15Z)-10-hydroperoxyoctadeca-8,12,15-trienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid obtained by the formal substitution of a hydrogen at position 10 of (8E,12Z,15Z)-octadeca-10,12,15-trienoic acid by a hydroperoxy group (the 10S stereoisomer).

name: procyanidin B8
definition: A proanthocyanidin that is (+)-catechin and (−)-epicatechin units joined by a bond between positions 4 and 6' respectively in an α-configuration. Procyanidin B8 is found in acorn and is present in fruit and leaves of blackberry (Rubus fruticosus), raspberry (Rubus idaeus) and cowberry (Vaccinium vitis idaea). It can be also found in grape seeds and in beer.

name: procyanidin B6
definition: A proanthocyanidin consisting of two molecules of (+)-catechin joined by a bond between positions 4 and 6' in α-configuration. Procyanidin B6 is isolated from leaves and fruit of cowberry Vaccinium vitis-idaea and other plants. It can also be found in grape seeds and in beer.

name: decyl oleate
definition: A wax ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the hydroxy group of decanol.

name: procyanidin B5
definition: A proanthocyanidin consisting of two molecules of (−)-epicatechin joined by a bond between positions 4 and 6' in β-configuration. It can be found in grape seeds, in Hibiscus cannabinus (kenaf) root and bark, in apple and in cacao.

name: palmityl oleate
definition: A wax ester obtained by the formal condensation of hexadecan-1-ol with oleic acid.

name: palmitoleyl alcohol
definition: A member of the class of hexadecen-1-ols that is hexadecanol containing a double bond located at position 9 (the Z-geoisomer).

name: palmitoleyl oleate
definition: A wax ester obtained by the formal condensation of hexadecen-1-ol with oleic acid.

name: stearyl oleate
definition: A wax ester obtained by the formal condensation of oleic acid with stearyl alcohol.

name: oleyl oleate
definition: A wax ester obtained by the formal condensation of oleic acid and oleyl alcohol.

name: icosan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is icosane in which one of the terminal methyl hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: arachidyl oleate
definition: A wax ester obtained by the formal condensation of icosan-1-ol with oleic acid.

name: palmityl palmitoleate
definition: A wax ester obtained by the formal condensation of hexadecan-1-ol with palmitoleic acid.

name: procyanidin B3
definition: A proanthocyanidin consisting of two molecules of (+)-catechin joined by a bond between positions 4 and 8' in α-configuration. It can be found in red wine, in barley, in beer, in peach or in Jatropha macrantha, the Huanarpo Macho.

name: palmityl stearate
definition: A wax ester obtained by the formal condensation of palmityl alcohol with stearic acid.

name: procyanidin B2
definition: A proanthocyanidin consisting of two molecules of (−)-epicatechin joined by a bond between positions 4 and 8' in a β-configuration. Procyanidin B2 can be found in Cinchona pubescens (Chinchona, in the rind, bark and cortex), in Cinnamomum verum (Ceylon cinnamon, in the rind, bark and cortex), in Crataegus monogyna (Common hawthorn, in the flower and blossom), in Uncaria guianensis (Cat's claw, in the root), in Vitis vinifera (Common grape vine, in the leaf), in Litchi chinensis (litchi, in the pericarp), in the apple, in Ecdysanthera utilis and in red wine.

name: procyanidin B1
definition: A proanthocyanidin consisting of (−)-epicatechin and (+)-catechin units joined by a bond between positions 4 and 8' respectively in a β-configuration.. Procyanidin B1 can be found in Cinnamomum verum (Ceylon cinnamon, in the rind, bark or cortex), in Uncaria guianensis (cat's claw, in the root), and in Vitis vinifera (common grape vine, in the leaf) or in peach.

name: L-erythro-3-methylmalyl-CoA(5−)

name: (3R)-citramalyl-CoA(5−)

name: holothurin A3(1−)

name: holothurin A3 acid
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is a tetrasaccharide derivative of 3,12,17,25-tetrahydroxy-18,20-epoxylanost-9(11)-ene-18,22-dione.

name: holothurin A4 acid

name: procyanidin C2

name: (8E,10S)-10-hydroperoxy-8-octadecenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is the (10S)-hydroperoxy derivative of (8E)-octadecenoic acid.

name: iron(2+) sulfate (anhydrous)
definition: A compound of iron and sulfate in which the ratio of iron(2+) to sulfate ions is 1:1. Various hydrates occur naturally - most commonly the heptahydrate, which loses water to form the tetrahydrate at 57°C and the monohydrate at 65°C.

name: (8E,10S,12Z)-10-hydroperoxyoctadeca-8,12-dienoic acid
definition: (8E,12Z)-10-hydroperoxy-8,12-octadecadienoic acid with S-configuration at C-10.

name: iron(2+) sulfate monohydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of iron(2+) sulfate. It is obtained from the heptahydrate by heating above 65°C. It is used as a source of iron in the treatment of iron-deficiency anaemia (generally in solid-dosage treatments; for liquid-dosage treatments, the heptahydrate is normally used).

name: iron(2+) sulfate heptahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the heptahydrate form of iron(2+) sulfate. It is used as a source of iron in the treatment of iron-deficiency anaemia (generally in liquid-dosage treatments; for solid-dosage treatments, the monohydrate is normally used).

name: phytyl diphosphate
definition: (E)-3,7,11,15-tetramethylhexadec-2-en-1-yl diphosphate in which both stereocentres have (R)-configuration.

name: phytyl phosphate
definition: A polyprenol phosphate that is the monophosphate derivative of phytol.

name: quercetin 4'-O-β-D-glucopyranoside

name: 1,2,3-tripalmitoleoylglycerol

name: dihydrodaidzein

name: 3-deoxy-L-threo-hex-2-ulopyranosonic acid

name: 1,2,3-trilinoleoylglycerol

name: 1,2,3-trilinolenoylglycerol
definition: A triglyceride formed by acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol with linolenic acid.

name: 1,3-dioleoyl-2-palmitoylglycerol

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-3-palmitoylglycerol
definition: A triglyceride in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl while that at position 3 is specified as palmitoyl.

name: 1,3-dipalmitoleoylglycerol

name: 1,3-dilinoleoylglycerol
definition: A 1,3-diglyceride in which both acyl groups are specified as linoleoyl.

name: (2S,3R)-capreomycidine
definition: An L-α-amino acid obtained by enzyme-mediated intramolecular cyclisation of L-arginine.

name: 1,3-dilinolenoylglycerol

name: 2,3-dipalmitoleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as palmitoleoyl.

name: 2,3-dilinoleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as linoleoyl.

name: 2,3-dilinolenoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as linolenoyl.

name: 3-methylfumaryl-CoA
definition: An ω-carboxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the least hindered carboxy group of mesaconic acid.

name: quercetin 3-O-α-D-rhamnofuranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a α-D-rhamnofuranosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: (3R)-citramalyl-CoA
definition: The (3R)-diastereomer of citramalyl-CoA.

name: arsenopyrite
definition: A sulfide mineral with formula AsFeS. It is the most abundant and widespread arsenic mineral.

name: α-D-rhamnofuranose
definition: A D-rhamnofuranose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: quercetin 3-O-α-L-fucopyranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a α-L-fucopyranosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: D-glucosaminic acid 6-phosphate
definition: A carbohydrate phosphate that is the 6-O-phospho derivative of 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-gluconic acid.

name: 1-oleoyl-3-palmitoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,3-diglyceride in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 3 are specified as oleoyl and palmitoyl respectively (the S-stereoisomer).

name: 1-palmitoyl-3-oleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,3-diglyceride in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 3 are specified as palmitoyl and oleoyl respectively (the R-stereoisomer).

name: 1-oleoyl-3-palmitoylglycerol
definition: A 1,3-diglyceride in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 3 are specified as oleoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: 2-palmitoyl-3-oleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 2 and 3 are specified as palmitoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: (S)-sarin
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of sarin; the more potent enantiomer of racemic sarin, a nerve agent that is employed as a chemical warfare agent.

name: (R)-sarin
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of sarin; the less active enantiomer of racemic sarin, a nerve agent that is employed as a chemical warfare agent.

name: isopropyl methylphosphonofluoridate
definition: A phosphinic ester that is the isopropyl ester of methylphosphonofluoridic acid.

name: disulfide-linked d(S-TGCGAATTCGCT-S/S-TCGCTTAAGCGT-S)

name: (3R,4R)-3,4-dihydroxycyclohexa-1,5-diene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A cyclohexadienecarboxylic acid that is cyclohexa-1,5-diene-1-carboxylic acid carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 (the 3R,4R-stereoisomer).

name: quercetin 7-O-β-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a β-L-rhamnopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 4-O-(β-L-Araf-(1→2)-β-L-Araf-(1→2)-β-L-Araf)-cis-L-Hyp.

name: 4-O-(β-L-Araf)-cis-L-Hyp zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 4-O-(β-L-Araf)-cis-L-Hyp.

name: cuevaene A
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is (2E,4Z,6E)-4-methoxy-6-methylhepta-2,4,6-trienoic acid substituted at position 7 by an 8-hydroxy-1,2,3,4-tetrahydrodibenzofuran-1-yl group.

name: quercetin 3-O-β-L-fucopyranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a β-L-fucopyranosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: quercetin 7-O-α-D-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a α-D-rhamnopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: α-L-rhamnofuranose
definition: An L-rhamnofuranose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: quercetin 3-O-α-L-rhamnofuranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a α-L-rhamnofuranosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 4-O-(β-L-Araf-(1→2)-β-L-Araf-(1→2)-β-L-Araf)-cis-L-Hyp
