name: Nα-methyl-L-histidine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of Nα-methyl-L-histidine.

name: iron(3+) sulfide
definition: A member of the class of iron(3+) sulfides that has formula Fe2S3. A black powder, it decomposes at room temperature to give iron(2+) chloride, hydrogen sulfide, and sulfur.

name: 5'-CTGC-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of one thymidine, one deoxyguanidine and two deoxycytidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence CTGC.

name: hispidulin
definition: A monomethoxyflavone that is scutellarein methylated at position 6.

name: 5'-CTGC-3' dsDNA oligonucleotide
definition: A double-stranded DNA fragment consisting of a 5'-CTGC-3' strand antiparallel to a 3'-GACG-5' strand.

name: 5'-GCAG-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of one deoxycytidine, one deoxyadenosine and two deoxyguanosine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence GCAG.

name: 2-arachidonyl glyceryl ether
definition: A monoalkylglycerol that is glycerol which is substituted by a (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosa-5,8,11,14-tetraen-1-yl group at position 2.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-O-arachidonyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A monoglyceride that is 1-oleoyl-sn-glycerol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by an arachidonyl group.

name: amfenac
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid that is benzophenone in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted by an amino group and a carboxymethyl group at position 2 and 3, respectively. The corresponding carboxamide, nepafenac, is a prodrug of amfenac and is used for the treatment of pain and inflammation following cataract surgery.

name: amfenac(1−)
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of amfenac. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: sodium (2-amino-3-benzoylphenyl)acetate
definition: An organic sodium salt having amfenac(1−) as the counterion.

name: SZL-P1-41
definition: A chromone that is 3-(1,3-benzothiazol-2-yl)-8-(1-piperidinylmethyl)chromen-4-one bearing additional ethyl and hydroxy substituents at positions 6 and 7 respectively.

name: (R,R)-2-methyl-6-phytylhydroquinone
definition: The (R,R)-stereoisomer of 2-methyl-6-phytylhydroquinone.

name: (R,R)-2,3-dimethyl-6-phytylhydroquinone
definition: The (R,R)-stereoisomer of 2,3-dimethyl-6-phytylhydroquinone.

name: nepafenac
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is amfenac in which the carboxylic acid group has been converted into the corresponding carboxamide. It is a prodrug for amfenac, used in eye drops to treat pain and inflammation following cataract surgery.

name: 3-oxodecanoate
definition: A 3-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-oxodecanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-quinolone
definition: A heteroaryl hydroxy compound that is 2-quinolone substituted at position 4 by a hydroxy group.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyhexadecanoate
definition: The R-enantiomer of 2-hydroxyhexadecanoate.

name: (S)-2-hydroxyhexadecanoate
definition: The S-enantiomer of 2-hydroxypalmitate.

name: D-cycloserine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of D-cycloserine, obtained by protonation of the amino group.

name: 26-desglucoavenacoside B
definition: A steroid saponin that is avenacoside B lacking the 26-O-glucosyl residue.

name: 26-desglucoavenacoside A
definition: A steroid saponin that is avenacoside A lacking the 26-O-glucosyl residue.

name: 4-O-(β-L-Araf)-cis-L-Hyp
definition: An O4-glycosyl-L-hydroxyproline that is cis-L-hydroxylproline glycosylated by a β-L-Araf moiety.

name: vadimezan
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 5,6-dimethyl-9-oxoxanthen-4-yl group.

name: (R)-2-hydroxylignocerate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (R)-2-hydroxylignoceric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 1-O-palmityl-2-acetyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1-alkyl-2-acetylglycerol in which the 1-alkyl group is specified as palmityl (hexadecyl).

name: 3-oleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 3-acyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl group is (9Z)-octadec-9-enoyl.

name: depsidone
definition: The simplest member of the class of depsidones comprising of a heterotricyclic system that is 11H-dibenzo[b,e][1,4]dioxepine substituted by an oxo group at position 11.

name: 5'-GTAACCGAAATCGGTTGA-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of six deoxyadenosine, three deoxycytidine, four thymidine and five deoxyguanidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence GTAACCGAAATCGGTTGA.

name: 5'-TCAACCGATTTCGGTTAC-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of four deoxyadenosine, five deoxycytidine, six thymidine and three deoxyguanosine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence T-C-A-A-C-C-G-A-T-T-T-C-G-G-T-T-A-C.

name: 5'-TCAACC-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of two deoxyadenosine, one thymidine and three deoxycytidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence TCAACC.

name: 2'-3'-cGAMP
definition: A cyclic purine dinucleotide that consists of AMP and GMP units cyclised via 3',5'- and 2',5'-linkages respectively.

name: c[G(2',5')pA(2',5')p]
definition: A cyclic purine dinucleotide that consists of AMP and GMP units cyclised via 2',5'-linkages.

name: 4-methyl-1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarbaldehyde
definition: A dialdehyde in which the two carbaldehyde functions are at positions 3 and 5 of 4-methyl-1,4-dihydropyridine. Although the compound is an entity in its own right, the nitrogen of the dihydropyridine ring may also arise from the ε-amino group of a lysine residue within a protein [MDHDC-protein adduct; malonaldedehyde (synonym malondialdehyde) acetaldehyde (MAA)-protein adduct].

name: (20S)-protopanaxadiol
definition: A diastereomer of protopanaxadiol in which the 20-hydroxy substituent has been introduced at the pro-S position.

name: protopanaxatriol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid sapogenin (isolated from ginseng and notoginseng) that is that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 6α, 12β and 20 pro-S positions and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position.

name: rac-1-oleoyl-3-palmitoylglycerol
definition: A racemate comprising equimolar amounts of 1-palmitoyl-3-oleoyl-sn-glycerol and 1-oleoyl-3-palmitoyl-sn-glycerol.

name: devancoaminyl vancomycin zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of devancoaminyl vancomycin.

name: vancomycin aglycone zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of vancomycin aglycone.

name: copper(II) oxide
definition: A metal oxide that has the formula CuO. It has an ionic structure.

name: dTDP-β-L-4-epi-vancosamine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dTDP-β-L-4-epi-vancosamine, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(2R)-2-hydroxystearoyl]sphingosine(1−)
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate(1−) in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (R)-2-hydroxystearoyl.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(2R)-2-hydroxybehenoyl]sphingosine(1−)
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate(1−) in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (R)-2-hydroxybehenoyl.

name: chloroorienticin B(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups and protonation of the two free amino groups of chloroorienticin B.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(2R)-2-hydroxylignoceroyl]sphingosine(1−)
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate(1−) in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (R)-2-hydroxylignoceroyl.

name: 1-(β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(2R)-2-hydroxybehenoyl]sphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (R)-2-hydroxybehenoyl.

name: 1-(β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(2R)-2-hydroxylignoceroyl]sphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (R)-2-hydroxylignoceroyl.

name: nicotinate-adenine dinucleotide phosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxy groups of nicotinic acid-adenine dinucleotide phosphate.

name: 2'-phospho-cyclic ADP-ribose(3−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of 2'-phospho-cyclic ADP-ribose.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid
definition: The R-enantiomer of 2-hydroxypalmitic acid.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-docosanoylsphingosine(1−)
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate(1−) in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as docosanoyl.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-tetracosanoylsphingosine(1−)
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate(1−) in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tetracosanoyl.

name: 1-(β-D-galactosyl)-N-behenoylsphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine where the ceramide N-acyl group is docosananoyl and the D-galactosyl component has β anomeric configuration.

name: (S)-2-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid
definition: The S-enantiomer of 2-hydroxypalmitic acid.

name: poly[d(Tm5C)]·poly[d(GA)]
definition: A double-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of in one strand a repeating unit of thymidine and 5-methyldeoxycytosine residues, with in a complementary strand a repeating unit of deoxyguanosine and deoxyadenosine residues, all residues in each strand being connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: poly[d(Tm5C)]
definition: A single-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a repeating unit of thymidine and 5-methyldeoxycytidine residues, with all residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: poly[d(GA)]
definition: A single-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a repeating unit of deoxyguanosine and 5-methyldeoxyadenosine residues, with all residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: flecainide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,5-bis(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)benzoic acid with the primary amino group of piperidin-2-ylmethylamine. An antiarrhythmic agent used (in the form of its acetate salt) to prevent and treat tachyarrhythmia (abnormal fast rhythm of the heart).

name: teniposide
definition: A furonaphthodioxole that is a synthetic derivative of podophyllotoxin with anti-tumour activity; causes single- and double-stranded breaks in DNA and DNA-protein cross-links and prevents repair by topoisomerase II binding.

name: α-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate(1−)
definition: A 2-ammonio-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose 6-phosphate in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: trametinib dimethyl sulfoxide
definition: An addition compound obtained by combining equimolar amounts of trametinib and dimethyl sulfoxide. Used for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations, and who have not received prior BRAF inhibitor treatment.

name: phenyl 5-phosphonato-α-D-ribofuranoside(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of phenyl 5-phospho-α-D-ribofuranoside.

name: trametinib
definition: A pyridopyrimidine that is used (as its dimethyl sulfoxide addition compound) for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with BRAF V600E or V600K mutations, and who have not received prior BRAF inhibitor treatment.

name: (S)-laudanine(1+)
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of laudanine(1+).

name: α-D-GalNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-[β-D-Glc-(1→2)]-α-D-Man-(1→5)-α-Kdo
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of an N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→2)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→5)-3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid tetrasaccharide chain, to the α-D-mannosyl residue of which is also linked β(1→2) a D-glucosyl residue. Epitope of Francisella tularensis.

name: (R)-laudanine(1+)
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of laudanine(1+).

name: N-[5-(1-naphthylmethyl)-1,3-thiazol-2-yl]cyclohexanecarboxamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by the formal condensation of cyclohexanecarboxylic acid with the amino group of 5-(naphthalen-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-thiazol-2-amine. It has been shown to exhibit antifungal activity.

name: afatinib dimaleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by combining afatinib with two molar equivalents of maleic acid. Used for the first-line treatment of patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.

name: dimethyl fumarate
definition: An enoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of both carboxy groups of fumaric acid with methanol. Used for treatment of adults with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis.

name: abafungin
definition: A member of the class of guanidines that is tetrahydropyrimidin-2(1H)-imine in which the hydrogen of the imino group is replaced by a thiazol-2-yl group which in turn is substituted by a 2-(2,4-dimethylphenoxy)phenyl group at position 4. It has been used for the topical treatment of fungal nail infections.

name: poly[d(TC)]·poly[d(GA)]
definition: A double-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of in one strand a repeating unit of thymidine and deoxycytidine residues, with in a complementary strand a repeating unit of deoxyguanosine and deoxyadenosine residues, all residues in each strand beiing connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: dolutegravir sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of dolutegravir. Used for treatment of HIV-1.

name: poly[d(TC)]
definition: A single-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a repeating unit of thymidine and deoxycytidine residues, with all residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: poly[d(TCC)]·poly[d(GGA)]
definition: A double-stranded DNA polynucleotide comprising in one strand a repeating sequence of one thymidine residue and and two deoxycytidine residues, with in a complementary strand a repeating sequence of two deoxyguanosine residues and one deoxyadenosine residue, all residues in each strand being connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: dolutegravir
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (4R,12aS)-7-hydroxy-4-methyl-6,8-dioxo-3,4,6,8,12,12a-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[1',2':4,5]pyrazino[2,1-b][1,3]oxazine-9-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 2,4-difluorobenzylamine. Used (as its sodium salt) for treatment of HIV-1.

name: poly[d(TCC)]
definition: A single-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a repeating sequence of one thymidine residue and two deoxycytidine residues, with all residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: poly[d(GGA)]
definition: A single-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a repeating sequence of two deoxyguanosine residues and one deoxycytosine residue, with all residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: dolutegravir(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of dolutegravir, obtained by deptotonation of the 7-hydroxy group.

name: vortioxetine hydrobromide
definition: A hydrobromide obtained by combining vortioxetine with one molar equivalent of hydrobromic acid. Used for treatment of major depressive disorder.

name: vortioxetine
definition: An N-arylpiperazine in which the aryl group is specified as 2-[(2,4-dimethylphenyl)sulfanyl]phenyl. Used (as its hydrobromide salt) for treatment of major depressive disorder.

name: vortioxetine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of vortioxetine, obtained by protonation of the secondary amino function.

name: riociguat
definition: A carbamate ester that is the methyl ester of {4,6-diamino-2-[1-(2-fluorobenzyl)-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridin-3-yl]pyrimidin-5-yl}methylcarbamic acid. It is used for treatment of chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension and pulmonary arterial hypertension

name: poly[d(TTC)]·poly[d(GAA)]
definition: A double-stranded DNA polynucleotide comprising in one strand a repeating sequence of two thymidine residues and and one deoxycytidine residue, with in a complementary strand a repeating sequence of one deoxyguanosine residue and two deoxyadenosine residues, all residues in each strand being connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: poly[d(TTC)]
definition: A single-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a repeating sequence of two thymidine residues and one deoxycytidine residue, with all residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: poly[d(GAA)]
definition: A single-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a repeating sequence of one deoxyguanosine residue and two deoxycytosine residues, with all residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: thioflavine T
definition: An organic chloride salt having 2-[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]-3,6-dimethyl-1,3-benzothiazol-3-ium as the counterion. It is widely used to visualise and quantify the presence of amyloids, both in vitro and in vivo.

name: dotriacontanoate
definition: An ultra-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of dotriacontanoic acid (lacceroic acid), obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: poly[d(T)]·poly[d(A)]·poly[d(T)]
definition: A triple-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of two strands of thymidine and residues, with a complementary strand of deoxyadenosine residues, all residues in each strand being connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: tetratriacontanoate
definition: An ultra-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of tetratriacontanoic aacid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyoctacosanoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (R)-2-hydroxyoctacosanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyhexacosanoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (R)-2-hydroxyoctacosanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: poly[d(G)]·poly[d(C)]
definition: A double-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a strand of deoxyguanosine residues with a complementary strand of deoxycytidine residues, all residues in each strand being connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: 71-hydroxychlorophyll a
definition: A member of the class of chlorophyll that is chlorophyll a substituted at position 71 by a hydroxy group.

name: flecainide(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the piperidine nitrogen of flecainide.

name: thioflavin T cation
definition: A benzothiazolium ion obtained by methylation of the thiazole nitrogen of 2-[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]-6-methyl-1,3-benzothiazole; the cationic component of thioflavin T.

name: β-L-rhamnofuranose
definition: An L-rhamnofuranose having β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: (R)-2-hydroxylignoceric acid
definition: A very long-chain fatty acid that is lignoceric acid bearing an (R)-2-hydroxy substituent.

name: β-D-rhamnofuranose
definition: A D-rhamnofuranose having β-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: D-rhamnofuranose
definition: The furanose form of D-rhamnose.

name: quercetin 3-O-β-L-rhamnofuranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a β-L-rhamnofuranosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: poly(deoxyguanylic acid)
definition: A polynucleotide comprised of 2'-deoxyguanosine units connected via 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: ω-hydroxytriacontanoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of ω-hydroxytriacontanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: ω-hydroxydotriacontanoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of ω-hydroxydotriacontanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (+)-(S)-alapyridaine
definition: An iminium betaine that is L-alanine in which the amino group is replaced by a 5-hydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)pyridinium-1-yl moiety.

name: brominated poly[d(GC)]·poly[d(GC)]
definition: A double-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of two complementary strands consisting of repeating units of brominated guanosine and deoxycytidine residues, all residues in each strand being connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages. The sites of bromination are at C-8 of guanine and C-5 of cytosine, although not all these sites are brominated, with bromination at the guanine C-8 predominating.

name: citric acid-d4
definition: A deuterated compound that is citric acid in which the four methylene hydrogens are replaced by deuterium.

name: L-alanine-2,3,3,3-d4
definition: A deuterated compound that is L-alanine in which the α-hydrogen and the three methyl hydrogens are replaced by deuterium.

name: glutamic acid-2,3,3,4,4-d5
definition: A deuterated compound that is glutamic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 3, 3, 4 and 4 are replaced by deuterium.

name: phenylalanine-d5
definition: A deuterated compound that is phenylalanine in which the five aromatic hydrogens are replaced by deuterium.

name: brominated poly[d(GC)]
definition: A single-stranded DNA polynucleotide consisting of a repeating unit of brominated deoxyguanosine and deoxycytidine residues, with all residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages. The sites of bromination are at C-8 of guanine and C-5 of cytosine, although not all these sites are brominated, with bromination at the guanine C-8 predominating.

name: 1-O-oleoyl-N-acetylsphingosine
definition: A 1-O-acyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the N- and O-acyl groups are specified as acetyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1-palmityl-2-acetyl-3-oleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1-alkyl-2-acetyl-3-acyl-sn-glycerol in which the alkyl and acyl groups are specified as palmityl and oleoyl.

name: dTDP-β-L-4-epi-vancosamine
definition: A dTDP-sugar having β-L-4-epi-vancosamine as the sugar component.

name: quercetin 7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a α-L-rhamnopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: chloroorienticin B
definition: A glycopeptide that is isolated from Amycolatopsis orientalis.

name: d(CG)12
definition: A 24-residue single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide consisting of an alternating sequence of deoxycytidine and deoxyguanosine residues, all connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages. It forms one strand of the double-stranded DNA oligonucleotide [d(C-G)·d(C-G)]12 [synonym d(CG/GC)12].

name: quercetin 3-O-β-D-fucopyranoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin attached to a β-D-fucopyranosyl moiety at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 1-O-palmitylglycerol
definition: An alkylglycerol that is glycerol carrying a single palmityl (hexadecyl) substituent at position 1.

name: 1-O-palmityl-3-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1-alkyl-3-acylglycerol in which the alkyl and acyl groups are specified as palmityl (hexadecyl) and oleoyl.

name: 1-O-palmityl-2-O-methyl-sn-glycerol
definition: An alkylglycerol having palmityl (hexadecyl) and methyl groups located at position2 1 and 2 respectively (the S-enantiomer).

name: 1-palmityl-2-methyl-3-oleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: An alkylglycerol that is 1-palmityl-2-methyl-sn-glycerol carrying an additional oleoyl substituent at position 3.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-palmitoylglycerol
definition: A 1,2-diglyceride in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as oleoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(2R)-2-hydroxystearoyl]sphingosine
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate in which the sulfo group is located at position 3 and the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (R)-2-hydroxystearoyl.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(2R)-2-hydroxybehenoyl]sphingosine
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate in which the sulfo group is located at position 3 and the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (R)-2-hydroxybehenoyl.

name: N,O-dioleoylethanolamine
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the hydroxy group of oleoyl ethanolamide.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(2R)-2-hydroxylignoceroyl]sphingosine
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate in which the sulfo group is located at position 3 and the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (R)-2-hydroxylignoceroyl.

name: O-oleoylanandamide
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the hydroxy group of anandamide.

name: 2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A lysophosphatidylcholine 18:1 in which the acyl group is specified as oleoyl and is located at position 2.

name: nicotinic acid-adenine dinucleotide phosphate
definition: A nicotinic acid dinucleotide that is NADP+ in which the carboxamide group on the pyridine ring is replaced by a carboxy group.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:1 in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and stearoyl respectively.

name: 1-O-stearoyl-N-acetylsphingosine
definition: A 1-O-acyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the N- and O-acyl groups are specified as acetyl and stearoyl (octadecanoyl) respectively.

name: (2S,3R)-trans-caftaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-caffeic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of meso-tartaric acid.

name: 2-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A lysophosphatidylcholine 18:0 in which the acyl group is specified as stearoyl (octadecanoyl) and is located at position 2.

name: 1-O-palmitoyl-N-acetylsphingosine
definition: A 1-O-acyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the N- and O-acyl groups are specified as acetyl and palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) respectively.

name: 2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A lysophosphatidylcholine 16:0 in which the acyl group is specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and is located at position 2.

name: 2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A lysophosphatidylcholine 20:4 in which the acyl group is specified as arachidonoyl and is located at position 2.

name: 1-O-arachidonoyl-N-acetylsphingosine
definition: A 1-O-acyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the N- and O-acyl groups are specified as acetyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 2'-phospho-cyclic ADP-ribose
definition: A cyclic purine nucleotide that is cyclic ADP-ribose substituted at position O-2' by a phospho group.

name: (2S,3R)-cis-caftaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of cis-caffeic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of meso-tartaric acid.

name: 2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A lysophosphatidylcholine 18:2 in which the acyl group is specified as linoleoyl and is located at position 2.

name: 2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A lysophosphatidylcholine 22:6 in which the acyl group is specified as (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl and is located at position 2.

name: 1-O-linoleoyl-N-acetylsphingosine
definition: A 1-O-acyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the N- and O-acyl groups are specified as acetyl and linoleoyl respectively.

name: 1-O-[(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl]-N-acetylsphingosine
definition: A 1-O-acyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the N- and O-acyl groups are specified as acetyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: 2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of 2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-O-(trans-4-coumaroyl)-β-D-glucopyranose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that is β-D-glucose bearing a trans-4-coumaroyl substituent at position 6.

name: 2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of 2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of 2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-O-(trans-4-coumaroyl)-α-D-glucopyranose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that is α-D-glucose bearing a trans-4-coumaroyl substituent at position 6.

name: 3-O-(cis-4-coumaroyl)-β-D-glucopyranose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that is β-D-glucose bearing a cis-4-coumaroyl substituent at position 3.

name: 3-O-(trans-4-coumaroyl)-β-D-glucopyranose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that is β-D-glucose bearing a trans-4-coumaroyl substituent at position 4.

name: (2R,3S)-trans-coutaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-coumaric acid with one of the hydroxy groups of meso-tartaric acid.

name: (2R,3S)-cis-coutaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of cis-coumaric acid with one of the hydroxy groups of meso-tartaric acid.

name: 1-O-{6-O-[(4-chlorophenyl)carbamoyl]-α-D-galactopyranosyl}-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having a 6-O-[(4-chlorophenyl)carbamoyl]-α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-docosanoylsphingosine
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate in which the sulfo group is located at position 3 and the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as docosanoyl.

name: phenyl 5-phosphono-α-D-ribofuranoside
definition: A ribose derivative that is the 5-phospho derivative of phenyl α-D-ribofuranoside.

name: 1-O-[6-O-(4-pyridylcarbamoyl)-α-D-galactopyranosyl]-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having a 6-O-(4-pyridylcarbamoyl)-α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: (S)-laudanine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of laudanine

name: laudanine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of laudanine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group.

name: laudanine
definition: A benzyltetrahydroisoquinoline that is norlaudanosoline carrying four methyl substituents at positions N-1, O-6, O-7 and O-4'.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-galactoside(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group of kaempferol 3-O-β-D-galactoside; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-laudanine
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of laudanine

name: rac-laudanosoline
definition: A racemate composed of equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-laudanosoline

name: 1-O-[6-O-(1-naphthylcarbamoyl)-α-D-galactopyranosyl]-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having a 6-O-(1-naphthylcarbamoyl)-α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: O-(α-D-glucosyl) poly[glycerol phosphate(1−)]
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the free phosphate OH groups of O-(α-D-glucosyl) poly(glycerol phosphate)

name: 2'-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5'-AMP
definition: An AMP-sugar in which the 2'-hydroxy group of AMP carries a 5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl substituent. Monomer unit of poly(ADP-Rib) [poly(adenosine diphosphate ribose)].

name: 2'-[2-(5-phosphoribosyl)-5-phosphoribosyl]-5'-AMP
definition: An AMP-sugar in which the 2'-hydroxy group of AMP carries a 5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl substituent, the 2-hydroxy group of which itself carries a further 5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl substituent. Branched portion of poly(ADP-Rib) [poly(adenosine diphosphate ribose)].

name: 5'-AATTTAA-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of four deoxyadenosine and three thymidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence AATTTAA.

name: 5'-AATTCAA-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of four deoxyadenosine, two thymidine residues and one deoxycytidine residue connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence AATTCAA.

name: benoxaprofen
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid substituted at position 2 by a 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-1,3-benzoxazol-5-yl group. It was used as a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug until 1982 when it was withdrawn from the market due to adverse side-effects including liver necrosis, photosensitivity, and carcinogenicity in animals.

name: (2R,3R)-cis-fertaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of cis-ferulic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of L-tartaric acid.

name: (2R,3R)-trans-fertaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-ferulic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of L-tartaric acid.

name: cis-ferulic acid
definition: A ferulic acid consisting of cis-cinnamic acid bearing methoxy and hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively on the phenyl ring.

name: (2S,3S)-cis-fertaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of cis-ferulic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of D-tartaric acid.

name: bumadizone
definition: A carbohydrazide obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups from butylmalonic acid with the hydrazino group of 1,2-diphenylhydrazine. Used (as its calcium semihydrate) for treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.

name: (2S,3S)-trans-fertaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-ferulic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of D-tartaric acid.

name: tryptophan N-glucoside
definition: A L-tryptophan derivative that is L-tryptophan in which the hydrogen attached to the indole nitrogen replaced by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: bumadizone calcium hemihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hemihydrate form of bumadizone calcium. Used for treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.

name: bumadizone calcium
definition: An organic calcium salt having 2-[(1,2-diphenylhydrazino)carbonyl]hexanoate as the counterion. Used (as its hemihydrate) for treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.

name: bumadizone(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of bumadizone, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (+)-epicatechin
definition: A catechin that is flavan carrying five hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 3', 4', 5 and 7 (the 2S,3S-stereoisomer).

name: (+)-epicatechin-3-O-gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3S)-hydroxy group of (+)-epicatechin.

name: cimicoxib
definition: An imidazole substituted at positions 1, 4 and 5 by 4-aminosulfonylphenyl, chloro and 3-fluoro-4-methyoxyphenyl groups respectively. A selective cyclooxygenase 2 inhibitor, it is used in veterinary medicine for the control of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis in dogs.

name: dexketoprofen
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is (S)-hydratropic acid substituted at position 3 on the phenyl ring by a benzoyl group. A cyclooxygenase inhibitor, it is used to relieve short-term pain, such as muscular pain, dental pain and dysmenorrhoea.

name: difenpiramide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group from biphenyl-4-ylacetic acid with the amino group of 2-aminopyridine. Used for treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.

name: (−)-catechin-3-O-gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3R)-hydroxy group of (−)-catechin.

name: (+)-catechin-3-O-gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3S)-hydroxy group of (+)-catechin.

name: droxicam
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 2H,5H-[1,3]oxazino[5,6-c][1,2]benzothiazine-2,4(3H)-dione 6,6-dioxide substituted at positions 3 and 5 by pyridin-2-yl and methyl groups respectively. A prodrug of piroxicam, it is used for the relief of pain and inflammation in musculoskeletal disorders such as rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis.

name: firocoxib
definition: An enol ether that is the cyclopropylmethyl ether of 3-hydroxy-5,5-dimethyl-4-[4-(methylsulfonyl)phenyl]furan-2-one. A selective cyclooxygenase 2 inhibitor, it is used in veterinary medicine for the control of pain and inflammation associated with osteoarthritis in horses and dogs.

name: (+)-trans-ε-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (+)-trans-stereoisomer of ε-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of trans-resveratrol.

name: flunixin
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is nicotinic acid substituted at position 2 by a 2-methyl-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenylamino group. A relatively potent non-narcotic, nonsteroidal analgesic with anti-inflammatory, anti-endotoxic and anti-pyretic properties; used in veterinary medicine (usually as the meglumine salt) for treatment of horses, cattle and pigs.

name: (−)-cis-ε-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (−)-cis-stereoisomer of ε-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of cis-resveratrol.

name: (2S,3R)-trans-ε-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (2S,3R)-trans-stereoisomer of ε-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of trans-resveratrol.

name: (2S,3S)-trans-δ-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (2S,3S)-trans-stereoisomer of δ-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of trans-resveratrol.

name: (+)-cis-ε-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (+)-cis-stereoisomer of ε-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of cis-resveratrol.

name: (2R,3S)-trans-ε-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (2R,3S)-trans-stereoisomer of ε-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of trans-resveratrol.

name: flunixin meglumine
definition: An organoammonium salt obtained by combining flunixin with one molar equivalent of 1-deoxy-1-(methylamino)-D-glucitol. A relatively potent non-narcotic, nonsteroidal analgesic with anti-inflammatory, anti-endotoxic and anti-pyretic properties; used in veterinary medicine for treatment of horses, cattle and pigs.

name: (2R,3S)-cis-ε-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (2R,3S)-cis-stereoisomer of ε-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of cis-resveratrol.

name: (2S,3R)-cis-ε-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (2S,3R)-cis-stereoisomer of ε-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of cis-resveratrol.

name: (2R,3R)-trans-δ-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (2R,3R)-trans-stereoisomer of δ-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of trans-resveratrol.

name: (2R,3R)-cis-δ-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (2R,3R)-cis-stereoisomer of δ-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of cis-resveratrol.

name: (2S,3S)-cis-δ-viniferin
definition: A stilbenoid that is the (2S,3S)-cis-stereoisomer of δ-viniferin, obtained by cyclodimerisation of cis-resveratrol.

name: (R)-2-hydroxy-α-linolenate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (R)-2-hydroxy-α-linolenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-heptadecatrienal
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty aldehyde that is heptadecenal having three double bonds located at postions 8, 11 and 14 (the 8Z,11Z,14Z-geoisomer).

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-heptadecatrienoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (8Z,11Z,14Z)-heptadecatrienoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: flunixin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of flunixin, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: flunoxaprofen
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid substituted at position 2 by a 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-1,3-benzoxazol-5-yl group (the S-enantiomer). Although it was shown to be effective in treatment of rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis, the clinical use of flunoxaprofen was discontinued due to possible hepatotoxic side-effects.

name: cis-piceid
definition: A stilbenoid that is cis-resveratrol substituted at position 3 by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: cis-3,5,3',4'-tetrahydroxystilbene
definition: A stilbenol that is cis-stilbene carrying four hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 5, 3', and 4'.

name: cis-astringin
definition: A stilbenoid that is cis-3,5,3',4'-tetrahydroxystilbene substituted at position 3 by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: ibufenac
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 4-isobutylphenyl group. Although it was shown to be effective in treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, the clinical use of ibufenac was discontinued due to hepatotoxic side-effects.

name: tetracenomycin F2(1−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of tetracenomycin F2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: ibuproxam
definition: A hydroxamic acid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of ibuprofen with the amino group of hydroxylamine. Used for treatment of pain and inflammation associated with musculoskeletal and joint disorders.

name: (R)-2-hydroperoxy-α-linolenate
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (R)-2-hydroperoxy-α-linolenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: indoprofen
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 is substituted by a 4-(1-oxo-1,3-dihydroisoindol-2-yl)phenyl group. Initially used as an anti-inflammatory and analgesic, it was withdrawn from the market due to causing severe gastrointestinal bleeding. It has been subsequently found to increase production of the survival motor neuron protein.

name: isoxicam
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is piroxicam in which the pyrid-2-yl group is replaced by a 5-methyl-1,2-oxazol-3-yl group. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, it was withdrawn from the market in the 1980s following its association with cases of Stevens-Johnson syndrome.

name: lonazolac
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 3-(4-chlorophenyl)-1-phenylpyrazol-4-yl group.

name: lonazolac calcium
definition: An organic calcium salt having [3-(4-chlorophenyl)-1-phenylpyrazol-4-yl]acetate as the counterion.

name: lonazolac(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of lonazolac, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: loxoprofen
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 is substituted by a 4-[(2-oxocyclopentyl)methyl]phenyl group. A prodrug that is rapidly converted into its active trans-alcohol metabolite following oral administration.

name: pallidol
definition: A tetracyclic stilbenoid that is a homodimer obtained by cyclodimerisation of resveratrol.

name: ferrous ammonium sulfate hexahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hexahydrate form of ferrous ammonium sulfate. Acts as an iron ion donor for building Fe-S clusters in vitro.

name: ampelopsin B
definition: A heterotetracyclic stilbenoid that is a homodimer obtained by cyclodimerisation of resveratrol.

name: quadrangularin A
definition: An indane-derived stilbenoid that is a homodimer obtained by cyclodimerisation of resveratrol.

name: (E)-trans-miyabenol C
definition: A benzofuran-derived stilbenoid that is a homotrimer obtained by cyclotrimerisation of resveratrol.

name: trans-diptoindonesin B
definition: A benzofuran-derived stilbenoid that is a homotrimer obtained by cyclotrimerisation of resveratrol. It is isolated from Dryobalanops oblongifolia.

name: sapienate
definition: A long-chain unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of sapienic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: loxoprofen sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt having loxoprofen(1−) as the counterion. The parent acid, loxoprofen, is a prodrug that is rapidly converted to its active trans-alcohol metabolite following oral administration.

name: loxoprofen(1−)
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of loxoprofen, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: clonixin
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is nicotinic acid substituted at position 2 by a (2-methyl-3-chlorophenyl)amino group. Used (as its lysine salt) for treatment of renal colic, muscular pain and moderately severe migraine attacks.

name: clonixin lysine salt
definition: An organoammonium salt obtained by combining clonixin with one molar equivalent of L-lysine. Used for treatment of renal colic, muscular pain and moderately severe migraine attacks.

name: riboflavin cyclic 4',5'-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and imido groups of riboflavin cyclic-4',5'-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: clonixin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of clonixin, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (2S)-2-(4-{[(1R,2S)-2-hydroxycyclopentyl]methyl}phenyl)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 is substituted by a 4-[(2-hydroxycyclopentyl)methyl]phenyl group (the 2S,1'R,2'S-stereoisomer. The active metabolite of loxoprofen.

name: mavacoxib
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole which is substituted at positions 1, 3 and 5 by 4-sulfamoylphenyl, trifluoromethyl and 4-fluorophenyl groups, respectively. A selective cyclooxygenase 2 inhibitor, it is used in veterinary medicine to treat pain and inflammation in dogs with degenerative joint disease.

name: sodium sulfide (anhydrous)
definition: A sulfide salt with formula Na2S. The pentahydrate and (particularly) the nonahydrate are also known. In gel form, sodium sulfide is used to soften toenails to assist in trimming (and so relive pain) of ingrowing toenails.

name: sodium sulfide nonahydrate
definition: A hydrate with formula Na2S·9H2O.

name: 4-{bis[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]methyl}phenol
definition: A tertiary amino compound in which the para positions of the three phenyl rings in triphenylmethane are substituted with two dimethylamino groups and one hydroxy group.

name: tritylium
definition: An organic cation formed by loss of a proton from the central carbon of triphenylmethane.

name: triphenylmethane
definition: A triarylmethane in which the three aryl groups are phenyl. It forms the basic skeleton of several synthetic dyes.

name: 4-(21-amino-4,9,12-trioxo-16,19-dioxa-5,8,13-triazahenicos-1-yloxy)-malachite green cation
definition: An iminium ion consisting of malachite green cation, substituted at the para position of the otherwise unsubstituted phenyl group with a diethylene glycol diamine linker, the terminal amino group of which may form part of a fluorogen activating protein (FAP).

name: dotriacontanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid that is dotriacontane in which one of the methyl groups has been oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: tetratriacontanoic acid
definition: A straight-chain saturated fatty acid that is tetratriacontane in which one of the methyl groups has been oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyoctacosanoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid that is the (R)-2-hydroxy derivative of octacosanoic acid.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyhexacosanoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid that is the (R)-2-hydroxy derivative of hexacosanoic acid.

name: ω-hydroxytriacontanoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid that is the 30-hydroxy derivative of triacontanoic acid.

name: ω-hydroxydotriacontanoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid that is the 32-hydroxy derivative of dotriacontanoic acid.

name: 5-benzoyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-pyrrolizine-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolizines that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-pyrrolizine which is substituted at positions 1 and 5 by carboxy and benzoyl groups, respectively.

name: N-hexanoyldihydroceramide
definition: A dihydroceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexanoyl.

name: (R)-ketorolac
definition: A 5-benzoyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-pyrrolizine-1-carboxylic acid that has R configuration. Unlike the S-enantiomer, it does not exhibit COX1 and COX2 inhibition, but does exhibit analgesic activity. Racemic ketorolac, known simply as ketorolac, is used (mainly as a tromethamine salt) as a potent analgesic for the short-term management of post-operative pain, and in eye drops to relieve the ocular itching associated with seasonal allergic conjunctivitis.

name: (S)-ketorolac
definition: A 5-benzoyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-pyrrolizine-1-carboxylic acid that has S configuration. While (S)-ketorolac is a COX1 and COX2 inhibitor, both enantiomers exhibit analgesic effects. Racemic ketorolac, known simply as ketorolac, is used (mainly as the tromethamine salt) as a potent analgesic for the short-term management of post-operative pain, and in eye drops to relieve the ocular itching associated with seasonal allergic conjunctivitis.

name: ketorolac(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of ketorolac. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: meclofenamic acid(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxy group of meclofenamic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as oleoyl.

name: sodium meclofenamate monohydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate of the sodium salt of meclofenamic acid. It is used for the treatment of dysmenorrhoea (painful periods), osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis.

name: 2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as linoleoyl.

name: (R)-2-hydroxy-α-linolenic acid
definition: A HOTrE that is α-linolenic acid substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group (the R-enantiomer)

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-heptadecatrienoic acid
definition: A trienoic fatty acid that is heptadecenoic acid having three double bonds located at postions 8, 11 and 14 (the 8Z,11Z,14Z-geoisomer).

name: (R)-2-hydroperoxy-α-linolenic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is α-linolenic acid having a single hydroperoxy substituent located at the 2R-position.

name: (20R)-protopanaxadiol
definition: A diastereomer of protopanaxadiol in which the 20-hydroxy substituent has been introduced at the pro-R position.

name: protopanaxadiol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid sapogenin (isolated from ginseng) that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 12β and 20 positions and in which a double bond has been introduced at the 24-25 position.

name: O-(α-D-glucosyl) poly(glycerol phosphate)
definition: A glycopolymer composed of a poly(glycerol phosphate) backbone which is randomly glycosylated by α-D-glucosyl residues at the secondary hydroxy positions.

name: ferrous ammonium sulfate (anhydrous)
definition: A compound of ammonium, iron and sulfate in which the ratio of ammonium to iron(2+) to sulfate ions is 2:1:2.

name: sapienic acid
definition: A hexadecenoic acid in which the double bond is located at position 6 (the Z-geoisomer). A major component of human sebaceous lipids that is involved in skin self-sterilisation and atopic dermatitis amelioration.

name: 4-hydroxy-5-methyl-2-methylenefuran-3-one
definition: A member of the class of furans that is 5-methyl-2-methylenefuran carrying additional oxo and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 respectively.

name: 2-methyl-5-methylenefuran-3,4-dione
definition: An α-diketone that is the 3,4-diketo derivative of 2-methyl-5-methylenefuran.

name: 4-hydroxy-2,5-dimethylfuran-3-one
definition: A member of the class of furans that is 2,5-dimethylfuran carrying additional oxo and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 respectively. It has been found particularly in strawberries and other such fruits.

name: 4-hydroxy-2,5-dimethylfuran-3-olate
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 4-hydroxy-2,5-dimethyl-3-furanone, obtained by deprotonation of the hydroxy group with concomitant keto/enol-type tautomerisation. It is thought to be a major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: miroprofen
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 is substituted by a 4-(imidazo[1,2-a]pyridin-2-yl)phenyl group. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug that also exhibits analgesic, antipyretic and platelet aggregation inhibition properties.

name: mofebutazone
definition: A pyrazolidine that is phenylbutazone lacking one of the phenyl substituents. It is used for treatment of joint and muscular pain.

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-gulose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the free diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-gulose.

name: naproxcinod
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of naproxen with the hydroxy group of 4-(nitrooxy)butanol. A cyclooxygenase-inhibiting nitric oxide donator that is metabolised to naproxen and a nitric oxide donating moiety, effective in treatment of osteoarthritis.

name: oxametacin
definition: A hydroxamic acid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of indometacin with the amino group of hydroxylamine.

name: oxyphenbutazone
definition: A metabolite of phenylbutazone obtained by hydroxylation at position 4 of one of the phenyl rings. Commonly used (as its hydrate) to treat pain, swelling and stiffness associated with arthritis and gout, it was withdrawn from the market 1984 following association with blood dyscrasis and Stevens-Johnson syndrome.

name: oxyphenbutazone hydrate
definition: A hydrate obtained by combining oxyphenbutazone with one molar equivalent of water. Commonly used to treat pain, swelling and stiffness associated with arthritis and gout, it was withdrawn from the market 1984 following association with blood dyscrasis and Stevens-Johnson syndrome.

name: 1-chloropropan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is isopropanol in which one of the methyl hydrogen atoms is substituted by chlorine.

name: 1-nitropropane
definition: A nitroalkane that is propane substituted at C-1 by a nitro group.

name: proglumetacin
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of indometacin with the hydroxy group of 3-[4-(2-hydroxyethyl)piperazin-1-yl]propyl N2-benzoyl-N,N-dipropyl-α-glutaminate. Used (as its dimaleate salt) to control pain and inflammation associated with musculoskeletal and joint disorders. Following oral administration, it is metabolised to indometacin and proglumide, a drug with antisecretory effects that helps prevent injury to the stomach lining.

name: N2-benzoyl-N,N-dipropyl-α-glutamine
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide obtained by formal condensation of the α-carboxy group of N-benzoylglutamic acid with dippropylamine.

name: (R)-proglumide
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of the racemic drug proglumide.

name: (S)-proglumide
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of the racemic drug proglumide.

name: robenacoxib
definition: An aromatic amino acid that is 2-amino-5-ethylphenylacetic acid in which one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by a 2,3,5,6-tetrafluorophenyl group. A selective cyclooxygenase 2 inhibitor that is used in veterinary medicine for the relief of pain and inflammation in cats and dogs.

name: cyclohex-1-ene-1-carbonyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of cyclohex-1-ene-1-carbonyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of cyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-xyloside(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group of kaempferol 3-O-β-D-xyloside; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dodecanedioate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of dodecanedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: SC560
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole which is substituted at positions 1, 3 and 5 by 4-methoxyphenyl, trifluoromethyl and 4-chlorophenyl groups, respectively. Unlike many members of the diaryl heterocycle class of cyclooxygenase (COX) inhibitors, SC-560 is selective for COX-1.

name: dTDP-α-D-fucofuranose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the free diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-α-D-fucofuranose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: hexadecanedioate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of hexadecanedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tepoxalin
definition: A hydroxamic acid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-[5-(4-chlorophenyl)-1-(4-methoxyphenyl)pyrazol-3-yl]propanoic acid with the amino group of N-methylhydroxylamine. It is used in veterinary medicine for the control of pain and inflammation caused by musculoskeletal disorders such as hip dysplasia and arthritis in dogs.

name: dehydrocoformycin(1+)
definition: An iminium ion obtained by selective protonation at position 4 on the diazepin ring of dehydrocoformycin. It is thought to be the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose
definition: A nucleotide-sugar having ADP as the nucleotide fragment and 2-O-acetyl-D-ribofuranos-5-yl as the sugar component.

name: dTDP-3-dehydro-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the free diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-3-dehydro-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tetradecanedioate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of tetradecanedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: suberate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of suberic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: sebacate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of suberic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-(4-cyclohexyl-1-naphthyl)propanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of naphthalenes that is propionic acid in which one of the α-hydrogens is replaced by a 4-cyclohexyl-1-naphthyl group.

name: (R)-vedaprofen
definition: The R-enantiomer of the racemic drug vedaprofen. The racemate is used for control of pain and inflammation particularly associated with chronic musculoskeletal disorders and soft tissue trauma in dogs and horses and for treatment of pain due to horse colic.

name: (S)-vedaprofen
definition: The R-enantiomer of the racemic drug vedaprofen. The racemate is used for control of pain and inflammation particularly associated with chronic musculoskeletal disorders and soft tissue trauma in dogs and horses and for treatment of pain due to horse colic.

name: pentachloroethane
definition: A member of the class of chloroethanes that is ethane in which five of the six hydrogens are replaced by chlorines. A non-flammable, high-boiling liquid (b.p. 161-162°C) with relative density 1.67 and an odour resembling that of chloroform, it is used as a solvent for oil and grease, in metal cleaning, and in the separation of coal from impurities.

name: 2,6-diaminotoluene
definition: A diamine that is toluene in which both of the hydrogens ortho- to the methyl group are replaced by amino groups.

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-gulose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-gulose as the sugar component.

name: PhIP
definition: An imidazopyridine that is 1H--imidazo[4,5-b]pyridine which is substituted at positions 1, 2, and 6 by methyl, amino, and phenyl groups, respectively. It is the most abundant of the mutagenic heterocyclic amines found in cooked meat and fish.

name: nonanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of nonanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-2-nonenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 2,3-trans-enoyl CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of trans-2-nonenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: azadirone
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 4,4,8-trimethylandrosta-1,14-diene substituted by an oxo group at position 3, an acetoxy group at position 7 and a furan-3-yl group at position 17. Isolated from Azadirachta indica, it exhibits antiplasmodial and antineoplastic activities.

name: kaempferol 3-O-β-D-xyloside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is apigenin substituted kaempferol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a β-D-xylosyl residue

name: dTDP-α-D-fucofuranose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having α-D-fucofuranose as the sugar component.

name: 1D-myo-inositol 3,5-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: An inositol phosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the four phosphate OH groups of 1D-myo-inositol 3,5-bisphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-glucosyl-N-(dodecanoyl)sphingosine
definition: A D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is dodecanoyl.

name: 22-oxodocosanoate
definition: An oxo fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 22-ketodocosanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: docosanedioate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of docosanedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-glucosyl-N-[(15Z)-tetracosenoyl]sphingosine
definition: A β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group is specified as (15Z)-tetracosenoyl.

name: 1D-myo-inositol 3,5-bisphosphate
definition: A myo-inositol bisphosphate in which the two phosphate groups are located at positions 3 and 5

name: 22-hydroxydocosanoate
definition: An ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 22-hydroxydocosanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 26-hydroxyhexacosanoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 26-hydroxyhexacosanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-menthol
definition: A p-menthan-3-ol which has (1S,2R,5S)-stereochemistry. In contrast to (−)-menthol, the (+)-enantiomer occurs only rarely in nature.

name: tetradecanedioic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is tetradecane in which the methyl groups have been oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acids.

name: 26-oxohexacosanoate
definition: An ω-oxo fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 26-oxohexacosanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: hexacosanedioate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of hexacosanedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-2-nonenoyl-CoA
definition: A 2,3-trans-enoyl CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-2-nonenoic acid.

name: dodecanedioyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion that is the pentaanion of dodecanedioyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid OH groups.

name: decanedioyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion that is the pentaanion of decanedioyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid OH groups.

name: octanedioyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion that is the pentaanion of octanedioyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid OH groups.

name: 22-oxodocosanoic acid
definition: A long-chain oxo-fatty acid that is the 22-oxo derivative of docosanoic acid.

name: docosanedioic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is docosane in which the methyl groups have been oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acids.

name: trans-cinnamamide
definition: The E (trans) isomer of cinnamamide.
