definition: A synthetic pentapeptide comprising N-acetyl-L-valine (Ac-Val), N-cyclohexylglycine (Chg), L-arginine (Arg), (2S)-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline-3-carboxylic acid (Tic)and L-phenylalaninamide (Phe-NH2) residues coupled in sequence.

name: (E)-4-oxohex-2-enal
definition: The enal that is (E)-hex-2-enal substituted with an oxo group at C-4.

name: 2-hydroxybehenate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxybehenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxytetracosanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxytetracosanoic acid (also known as 2-hydroxylignoceric or cerebronic acid), obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyoctadecanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid (stearic acid), obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyhexacosanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxyhexacosanoic acid (2-hydroxycerotic acid), obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyarachidate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxyarachidic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-2-hydroxypalmitoylsphingosine
definition: A 2-(2-hydroxyacyl)sphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxypalmitoyl.

name: N-2-hydroxystearoylsphingosine
definition: A 2-(2-hydroxyacyl)sphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxystearoyl.

name: N-2-hydroxylignoceroylsphingosine
definition: A 2-(2-hydroxyacyl)sphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxylignoceroyl.

name: N-[(15Z)-2-hydroxytetracosenoyl]sphingosine
definition: A 2-(2-hydroxyacyl)sphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (15Z)-2-hydroxytetracosenoyl.

name: poly(inosinic acid)
definition: A polynucleotide comprised of inosine units connected via 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: G20
definition: An oligonucleotide comprised of twenty guanosine residues connected via 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: I25
definition: An oligonucleotide comprised of 25 inosine residues connected via 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages.

name: 5-(hydroxymethyl)cytosine
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is cytosine in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: 5-carboxycytosine
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is cytosine in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by a carboxy group.

name: 5-formylcytosine
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is cytosine in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by a formyl group.

name: pikromycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of pikromycin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: narbomycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of pikromycin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-O-β-D-mycaminosyltylactone(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 5-O-β-D-mycaminosyltylactone, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-O-β-D-mycaminosyl-20-oxotylonolide(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 5-O-β-D-mycaminosyl-20-oxotylactone, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-O-mycaminosyltylonolide(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 5-O-mycaminosyltylonolide, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: demethyllactenocin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of demethyllactenocin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-β-L-mycarose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-β-L-mycarose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: demethylmacrocin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of demethylmacrocin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: macrocin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of macrocin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide comprising a β-D-mannosyl residue linked (1→4) to an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: cellobionate
definition: A carbohydrate acid anion that is the conjugate base of cellobionic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-D-glucuronate
definition: A carbohydrate acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-D-glucuronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxymethamphetamine
definition: A phenolic compound, the structure of which is that of methamphetamine methyl-substituted at the 4-position of the phenyl ring.

name: dTDP-β-L-vancosamine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dTDP-β-L-vancosamine, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: vancomycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of vancomycin, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the two amino functions; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-deoxyloganate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 7-deoxyloganic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-deoxyloganetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 7-deoxyloganetic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-deoxyloganetin
definition: An iridoid monoterpenoid that is the methyl ester of 7-deoxyloganetic acid.

name: isoxazolin-5-one
definition: An isoxazole that is 3-isoxazoline substituted at position 5 by an oxo group.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]3NH2
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of a D-glucosyl residue β-linked to a 3-aminopropyloxy group and which carries at O-3 a β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl linear trisaccharide unit.

name: 3-(5-oxoisoxazolin-2-yl)-L-alanine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of 3-(5-oxoisoxazolin-2-yl)-L-alanine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-(5-oxoisoxazolin-4-yl)-L-alanine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of 3-(5-oxoisoxazolin-4-yl)-L-alanine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2S,3S)-β-methylphenylalanine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of (2S,3S)-β-methylphenylalanine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]3NH2
definition: A pentasaccharide derivative consisting of a D-glucosyl residue β-linked to a 3-aminopropyloxy group and which carries at O-3 an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl linear tetrasaccharide unit.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]3NH2
definition: A hexasaccharide derivative consisting of a D-glucosyl residue β-linked to a 3-aminopropyloxy group and which carries at O-3 a β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-[α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl branched pentasaccharide unit.

name: 2-iminobutanoic acid
definition: A dehydroamino acid that is 2-aminobutanoic acid in which the amino group has been oxidised to the corresponding imine.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]3NH2
definition: A decasaccharide derivative consisting of a D-glucosyl residue β-linked to a 3-aminopropyloxy group and which carries at O-3 an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-[α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)]-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl branched nonasaccharide unit.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide consisting of two β-D-mannose residues, an α-L-rhamnose residue and a β-D-glucose residue (at the reducing end), joined by sequential (1→3), (1→3) and (1→3) linkages.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear pentasaccharide consisting of an α-D-mannose residue, two β-D-mannose residues, an α-L-rhamnose residue and a β-D-glucose residue (at the reducing end), joined by sequential (1→2), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→3) linkages.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched hexasaccharide consisting of a β-D-glucose residue, two β-D-mannose residues, an α-L-rhamnose residue and a β-D-glucose residue (at the reducing end), all joined by sequential (1→3) linkages, to the mannose residue nearest to the non-reducing end is also connected an α-D-mannose residue via a (1→2) linkage.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched decasaccharide consisting of an α-D-mannose residue, two β-D-mannose residues, an α-L-rhamnose residue, a β-D-glucose residue, two further β-D-mannose residues, a further α-D-rhamnose residue and a further β-D-glucose residue (at the reducing end), connected sequentially by a (1→2) and seven (1→3) linkages, to the mannose residue located three residues from the reducing-end glucose is also connected another α-D-mannnose residue via a (1→2) linkage.

name: (9Z,12Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (9Z,12Z)-hexadecadienoic acid.

name: A47934(2−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy, sulfo and one of the hydroxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group of A47934; major species at pH 7.3.

name: A41030A(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and one of the hydroxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group of A41030A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (11Z)-3-oxooctadecenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (11Z)-3-oxooctadecenoic acid.

name: (3R,11Z)-3-hydroxyoctadecenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3R,11Z)-3-hydroxyoctadecenoic acid.

name: (2E,11Z)-octadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,11Z)-octadecadienoic acid.

name: (13Z)-3-oxoicosenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (13Z)-3-oxoicosenoic acid.

name: (3R,13Z)-3-hydroxyicosenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3R,13Z)-3-hydroxyicosenoic acid.

name: (2E,13Z)-icosadienoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,13Z)-icosadienoic acid.

name: (13Z)-icosenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (13Z)-icosenoic acid.

name: 1-O-(α-lactosyl)-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-lactosyl residue at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-glucosyl)-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-glucosyl residue at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: methyl 2-methylpropyl 2,6-dimethyl-4-(2-nitrophenyl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarboxylate
definition: A dihydropyridine that is 1,4-dihydropyridine which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 6, a methoxycarbonyl group at position 3, an o-nitrophenyl group at position 4, and an isobutoxycarbonyl group at position 5. The racemate, a calcium channel blocker, is used in the treatment of hypertension and angina pectoris.

name: (R)-nisoldipine
definition: A methyl 2-methylpropyl 2,6-dimethyl-4-(2-nitrophenyl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarboxylate that has R configuration.

name: (S)-nisoldipine
definition: A methyl 2-methylpropyl 2,6-dimethyl-4-(2-nitrophenyl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarboxylate that has S configuration.

name: pavine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the amino function of pavine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: argemonine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the amino function of argemonine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyclanoline
definition: A charged berberine alkaloid obtained by N-methylation of (S)-scoulerine.

name: ω-hydroxytetracosanoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid that is the 24-hydroxy derivative of tetracosanoic acid.

name: Ac-Asp-Glu(3−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups of N-acetyl-Asp-Glu; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,18-dihydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that consists of octadecanoic (stearic) acid bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 18.

name: 3,12-dihydroxylauric acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that consists of lauric (dodecanoic) acid bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 12.

name: Ac-Asp-Glu-Glu(4−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the four carboxy groups of Ac-Asp-Glu-Glu; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11-hydroxylauric acid
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid that is lauric acid substituted at position 11 by a hydroxy group.

name: β-citrylglutamate(4−)
definition: A tetracarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the four carboxy groups of β-citrylglutamic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-copalol
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at positions 8(17) and 13 (the latter with E-stereochemistry) and carries a hydroxy group at the terminal C-15 position.

name: 13-epi-manool
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at positions 8(17) and 14 and carries an S-hydroxy group at position 13.

name: manool
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at positions 8(17) and 14 and carries an R-hydroxy group at position 13.

name: ent-manool
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at positions 8(17) and 14 and carries an S-hydroxy group at position 13.

name: (−)-ent-copalol
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at positions 8(17) and 13 (the latter with E-stereochemistry) and carries a hydroxy group at the terminal C-15 position.

name: syn-copalol
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at positions 8(17) and 13 (the latter with E-stereochemistry) and carries a hydroxy group at the terminal C-15 position.

name: 17(R),18(S)-EETeTr
definition: A 17(18)-EpETE in which the epoxy group has (17R,18S)-configuration.

name: (13S)-vitexifolin A
definition: A labdane diterpenoid in which the labdane skeleton has double bonds at positions 8(17) and 14 and carries an S-hydroxy group at position 13.

name: 17(S),18(R)-EETeTr
definition: A 17(18)-EpETE in which the epoxy group has (17S,18R)-configuration.

name: 19-HEPE
definition: A HEPE obtained by hydroxylation at position 19 of all-cis-5,8,11,14,17-icosapentaenoic acid.

name: 20-HEPE
definition: A HEPE obtained by hydroxylation at position 20 of all-cis-5,8,11,14,17-icosapentaenoic acid.

name: 20-oxoarachidonic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid that is arachidonic acid substituted at position 20 by an oxo group.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenedioic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraene in which the two methyl groups are replaced by carboxy groups.

name: trioctanoin
definition: A triglyceride obtained by acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol by octanoic acid. Used as an alternative energy source to glucose for patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as octanoyl. Formula C19H36O5.

name: 2-hydroxybehenic acid
definition: A long-chain fatty acid that is behenic (docosanoic) acid substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group.

name: 3-[(1-carboxylatovinyl)oxy]benzoate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 3-[(1-carboxyvinyl)oxy]benzoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,3-dioctanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both the 2- and 3-acyl groups are specified as octanoyl.

name: 2-hydroxyhexacosanoic acid
definition: A very long-chain fatty acid that is hexacosanoic (cerotic) acid substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group.

name: metacetamol
definition: A derivative of phenol which has an acetamido substituent located meta to the phenolic -OH group. It is a non-toxic regioisomer of paracetamol with analgesic properties, but has never been marketed as a drug.

name: β-D-galactosyl-N-(nervonoyl)sphingosine
definition: A D-galactosyl-N-acylsphingosine where the ceramide N-acyl group is nervonoyl [(15Z)-tetracos-15-enoyl] and the D-galactosyl component has β anomeric configuration.

name: 2-hydroxyarachidic acid
definition: A long-chain fatty acid that is arachidic (icosanoic) acid substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group.

name: α-naphthoflavone
definition: An extended flavonoid resulting from the formal fusion of a benzene ring with the h side of flavone. A synthetic compound, it is an inhibitor of aromatase (EC 1.14.14.14).

name: 1-oleoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate group of 1-oleoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate group of 1-palmitoyl-2-lauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol); major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-N-(9-β-D-ribofuranosylpurin-6-yl)glycinamide
definition: A glycine derivative that is glycinamide in which one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by a 9-β-D-ribofuranosylpurin-6-yl group.

name: 17β-estradiol 3-benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of benzoic acid with the phenolic hydroxy group of 17β-estradiol.

name: 1β-glutathionylseleno-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine
definition: A glutathione conjugate obtained by formation of a thioselenide link between the thiol group of glutathione and the selenol group of 1-seleno-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine.

name: 5-O-β-D-mycaminosyl-20-oxotylonolide
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is 20-oxotylactone having a 5-O-β-D-mycaminosyl residue attached at position 6.

name: 1β-methylseleno-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by a methylseleno group.

name: 5-O-mycaminosyltylonolide
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is tylonolide having a β-D-mycaminosyl residue attached at position 5.

name: methylseleninic acid
definition: An organoselenium compound that is seleninic acid in which the hydrogen attached to selenium is replaced by a methyl group.

name: β-naphthoflavone
definition: An extended flavonoid resulting from the formal fusion of a benzene ring with the f side of flavone.

name: boron-10 atom
definition: A stable isotope of boron with relative atomic mass 10.0129370, 19.9 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 3+.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-22-hydroxydocosahexaenoate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-22-hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-NAD(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the two diphosphate OH groups of α-NAD(1+); major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-NADP(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of α-NADP+; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cellobionic acid
definition: A disaccharide consisting β-D-glucosyl and D-gluconic acid residues joined by a (1→4)-linkage.

name: 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-D-glucuronic acid
definition: A disaccharide consisting β-D-glucosyl and D-glucuronic acid residues joined by a (1→3)-linkage.

name: 7-deoxyloganetic acid
definition: An iridoid monoterpenoid that is 1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran-4-carboxylic acid substituted at positions 1 and 7 by hydroxy and methyl groups respectively; the aglycone of 7-deoxyloganic acid.

name: L-adenosylselenohomocysteine
definition: A selenoamino acid that is L-selenomethionine in which the methyl group attached to the selenium is replaced by a 5'-adenosyl group.

name: 3-(5-oxoisoxazolin-2-yl)-L-alanine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 5-oxoisoxazolin-2-yl group.

name: 3-(5-oxoisoxazolin-4-yl)-L-alanine
definition: A member of the class of isoxazoles that is L-alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 5-oxoisoxazolin-4-yl group.

name: (2S,3S)-β-methylphenylalanine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-phenylalanine in which one of the benzyl hydrogens is replaced by a methyl group (the 3S-stereoisomer).

name: bromhexine
definition: A substituted aniline that is 2,4-dibromoaniline which is substituted at position 6 by a [cyclohexyl(methyl)amino]methyl group. It is used (as the monohydrochloride salt) as a mucolytic for the treatment of respiratory disorders associated with productive cough (i.e. a cough characterised by the production of sputum).

name: 14-hydroxymyristate
definition: A ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 14-hydroxymyristic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: A41030A
definition: A cyclic peptide antibiotic that is A47934 lacking the O-sulfo group; it is produced by a strain of Streptomyces toyocaensis.

name: (3S)-hydroxytetradecanedioyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion that is the pentaanion of (S)-3-hydroxytetradecanedioyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid functions; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E)-tetradecenedioyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion that is the pentaanion of trans-2-tetradecenedioyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid functions; major species at pH 7.3.

name: bromhexine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of bromhexine. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxotetradecanedioyl-CoA(5−)

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNac-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNac-(1→2)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of a linear hexasaccharide chain of α-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, β-D-glucose, L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose (Hep) and 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose (Kdo) residues linked in a (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→4), (1→5) sequence, to the Hep residue of which is linked (1→3) an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptosyl side-chain. lpt3 mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: spectinomycin(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino groups of spectinomycin.

name: 2,4,6-trinitroxylene
definition: A C-nitro compound that is m-xylene bearing three nitro substituents at positions 2, 4 and 6.

name: SR12813
definition: An organic phosphonate that is the tetraethyl ester of [2-(3,5-di-tert-butyl-4-hydroxyphenyl)ethene-1,1-diyl]bis(phosphonic acid).

name: oltipraz
definition: A 1,2-dithiole that is 3H-1,2-dithiole-3-thione substituted at positions 4 and 5 by methyl and pyrazin-2-yl groups respectively.

name: musk xylene
definition: A C-nitro compound that is m-xylene bearing three nitro substituents at positions 2, 4 and 6 as well as a tert-butyl group at position 5.

name: 1,8-dihydroxy-4-nitroxanthen-9-one
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is xanthen-9-one substituted at position 4 by a nitro group and at positions 1 and 8 by hydroxy groups.

name: methyl hexanoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester derived from hexanoic (caproic acid).

name: ethoxyquin
definition: A quinoline that is 1,2-dihydroquinoline bearing three methyl substituents at position 2, 2 and 4 as well as an ethoxy substituent at position 6.

name: diisopropyl methylphosphonate
definition: An organic phosphonate that is the diisopropyl ester of methylphosphonic acid.

name: CL-20
definition: A polycyclic cage that is hexaazaisowurtzitane in which all six amino hydrogens are replaced by nitro groups.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-(8-epi-prostaglandin F2α)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl and 8-epi-prostaglandin F2α respectively.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-(8-epi-prostaglandin F2α)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and 8-epi-prostaglandin F2α respectively.

name: β-D-QuipN4Fm-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 4-deoxy-4-formamido-β-D-quinovosyl residue linked (1→4) to a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranuronamide residue at the reducing end.

name: α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→3)-β-D-QuipNAc-(1→2)-β-D-QuipN4Fm-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN
definition: An amino hexasaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galacturonamide, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galacturonamide, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-quinovose, 4-deoxy-4-formamido-β-D-quinovose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galacturonamide and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galacturonamide residues linked in a (1→4), (1→3), (1→2), (1→4), (1→4) sequence.

name: 2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−) that is the conjugate base of 2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine, in which the carboxy and phosphate groups are anionic and the amino group is cationic; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-octadecanoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 2-acyl group is specified as linoleoyl.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and linoleoyl respectively.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-octadecanoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 2-acyl group is specified as oleoyl.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1,2-dilinoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as linoleoyl.

name: 1,2-dilinoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as linoleoyl.

name: neopikromycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino function of neopikromycin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: novapikromycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of novapikromycin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: methymycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of methymycin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: neomethymycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of neomethymycin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: novamethymycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of novamethymycin, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-palmityl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-alkyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate in which the alkyl and acyl groups are specified as palmityl (hexadecyl) and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: etidronic acid(2−)
definition: An organophosphonate dianion resulting from the removal of a proton from one of the hydroxy groups of each of the phosphonic acid groups of etidronic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-palmityl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-alkyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate in which the alkyl and acyl groups are specified as palmityl (hexadecyl) and oleoyl respectively.

name: CDP-dipalmitoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which both of the phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl).

name: isotridecanoic acid
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid comprising dodecanoic (lauric) acid substituted at position 11 by a methyl group.

name: (9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is tetracosanoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 9, 12, 15, 18 and 21 (the (9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z-isomer).

name: bicyclo[3.3.0]oct-2-ene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound consisting of two ortho-fused cyclopentane rings and containing one double bond located at position 2.

name: ramiprilat
definition: A dipeptide that is the active metabolite of ramipril. An angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor, used to treat high blood pressure and congestive heart failure.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z)-tetracosahexaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid that is tetracosanoic acid having six double bonds located at positions 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 and 21 (the (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z-isomer).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A branched oligosaccharide phosphate comprising two D-galactose residues, two N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, a D-glucose residue, two L-glycero-D-manno-heptose residues (one of which is phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3), with linkages as shown and with a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) residue at the reducing end. Corresponds to the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: (11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z)-hexacosapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is hexacosanoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 11, 14, 17, 20, 23 (the 11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z-isomer).

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z)-hexacosahexaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is hexacosanoic acid having six double bonds located at positions 8, 11, 14, 17, 20, 23 (the 8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z-isomer).

name: (13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z)-octacosapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is octacosanoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 13, 16, 19, 22 and 25 (the 13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z-isomer).

name: (10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z)-octacosahexaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is octacosanoic acid having six double bonds located at positions 10, 13, 16, 19, 22 and 25 (the 10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z-isomer).

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A branched oligosaccharide phosphate comprising a D-galactose residue, two N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, a D-glucose residue, two L-glycero-D-manno-heptose residues (one of which is phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3), with linkages as shown and with a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) residue at the reducing end. Corresponds to the lgtB mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: (15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z)-triacontapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is triacontapentaenoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 15, 18, 21, 24 and 27 (the 15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z-isomer).

name: (12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z)-triacontahexaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is triacontahexaenoic acid having six double bonds located at positions 12, 15, 18, 21, 24 and 27 (the 12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z-isomer).

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of a linear pentasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, β-D-glucose, L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose (Hep) and 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose (Kdo) residues linked in a (1→3), (1→4), (1→4), (1→5) sequence, to the Hep residue of which is linked (1→3) an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptosyl side-chain. lpt3 and and lgtB mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: (17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z,29Z)-dotriacontapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is dotriacontapentaenoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 17, 20, 23, 26 and 29 (the 17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z,29Z-isomer).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A branched oligosaccharide phosphate comprising a D-galactose residue, a D-glucose residue, an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, two L-glycero-D-manno-heptose residues (one of which is phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3), with linkages as shown and with a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) residue at the reducing end. Corresponds to the lgtA mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A branched oligosaccharide phosphate comprising a D-glucose residue, an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, two L-glycero-D-manno-heptose residues (one of which is phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3), with linkages as shown and with a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) residue at the reducing end. Corresponds to the galE mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of a trisaccharide chain of β-D-glucose, L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose (Hep) and 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulose (Kdo) residues linked in a (1→4), (1→5) sequence, to the Hep residue of which is linked (1→3) an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptosyl side-chain. lpt3 and and galE mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A linear oligosaccharide phosphate comprising an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine residue,an L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3, another L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue and a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) in a (1→2), (1→3), (1→5) sequence. Corresponds to the icsb mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-Kdo
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine residue,two L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residues and a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) in a (1→2), (1→3), (1→5) sequence. Corresponds to the icsb and lpt3 mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: tricaproin
definition: A triglyceride obtained by condensation of each of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol with hexanoic (caproic) acid.

name: 2,3-dihexanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as caproyl (hexanoyl).

name: tricaprin
definition: A triglyceride obtained by formal acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol by capric (decanoic) acid.

name: trilaurin
definition: A triglyceride obtained by formal acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol by lauric (dodecanoic) acid.

name: 2,3-didodecanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as lauroyl (dodecanoyl).

name: trimyristin
definition: A triglyceride obtained by formal acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol by myristic (tetradecanoic) acid.

name: 2,3-dimyristoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as myristoyl (tetradecanoyl).

name: tripalmitin
definition: A triglyceride obtained by formal acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol by palmitic (hexadecanoic) acid.

name: 2,3-dipalmitoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl).

name: 2,3-distearoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which both acyl groups are specified as stearoyl (octadecanoyl).

name: 1-[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-5-carbonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is 1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-5-carbonitrile in which one of the hydrogens at position 1 is replaced by a p-fluorophenyl group, while the other is replaced by a 3-(dimethylamino)propyl group.

name: 2-amino-2-phenylacetonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is phenylacetonitrile in which one of the α-hydrogens is replaced by an amino group.

name: D-α-phenylglycine zwitterion
definition: A D-α-amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of D-α-phenylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-aminopentanenitrile
definition: A nitrile that is pentanenitrile in which one of the α-hydrogens is replaced by an amino group.

name: 1-benzyl-3-(dimethylamino)-2-methyl-1-phenylpropyl propanoate
definition: A propanoate ester that is propyl propanoate substituted by a benzyl and phenyl group at position 1, a methyl group at position 2 and a dimethylamino group at position 3.

name: (14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z,29Z)-dotriacontahexaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is dotriacontapentaenoic acid having six double bonds located at positions 14, 17, 20, 23, 26 and 29 (the 14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z,29Z-isomer).

name: (19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z,31Z)-tetratriacontapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is tetratriacontapentaenoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 19, 22, 25 ,28 and 31 (the 19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z,31Z-isomer).

name: (R)-citalopram(1+)
definition: A 3-[5-cyano-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-1-yl]-N,N-dimethylpropan-1-aminium resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (R)-citalopram.

name: escitalopram(1+)
definition: A 3-[5-cyano-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-1-yl]-N,N-dimethylpropan-1-aminium resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of escitalopram.

name: 3-[5-cyano-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-1-yl]-N,N-dimethylpropan-1-aminium
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of 1-[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-5-carbonitrile.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-lysine(1+)
definition: An α-amino-acid cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the amino groups of (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-lysine: major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4R)-4-hydroxy-L-lysine(1+)
definition: An α-amino-acid cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the amino groups of (4R)-4-hydroxy-L-lysine: major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-ornithine(1+)
definition: An α-amino-acid cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the amino groups of (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-ornithine: major species at pH 7.3.

name: (11Z)-icos-11-en-1-ol
definition: A fatty alcohol 20:1 that is icosanol containing a double bond located at position 11 (the 11Z-geoisomer).

name: tetracosan-1-ol
definition: A very long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is tetracosane in which a hydrogen attached to one of the terminal carbons is replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been isolated from a variety of plants, including grape seeds, evening primrose (Oenothera biennis), pitaya fruits (Hylocereus polyrhizus and Hylocereus undatus), and the flowers of Arabian jasmine ( Jasminum sambac).

name: dotriacontan-1-ol
definition: An ultra-long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is dotriacontane in which a hydrogen attached to one of the terminal carbons is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: tetratriacontan-1-ol
definition: An ultra-long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is tetratriacontane in which one of the terminal methyl hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group

name: (13Z)-docosen-1-ol
definition: A long-chain fatty alcohol that is (13Z)-docosene in which one of the terminal methyl hydrogens at position 1 is replaced by a hydroxy group

name: tetradecan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain fatty alcohol that is tetradecane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide consisting of three repeats of a β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine disaccharide unit linked (1→4).

name: (E)-4-hydroxynon-2-enal dimethyl acetal
definition: An acetal that is the methyl acetal obtained by formal condensation of the carbonyl group of (E)-4-hydroxynon-2-enal with two molar equivalents of methanol.

name: 4-bromophenyl phenyl ether
definition: An aromatic ether that is diphenyl ether substituted at position 4 by a bromo group.

name: (R)-citalopram hydrobromide
definition: A 1-[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-5-carbonitrile hydrobromide resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of (R)-citalopram and hydrogen bromide.

name: escitalopram hydrobromide
definition: A 1-[3-(dimethylamino)propyl]-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-1,3-dihydro-2-benzofuran-5-carbonitrile hydrobromide resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of escitalopram and hydrogen bromide.

name: 4-amino-2,6-dinitrotoluene
definition: An amino-nitrotoluene that is 2,6-dinitrotoluene substituted at position 4 by an amino group.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNCOEt-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNCOEt-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNCOEt
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide consisting of three repeats of a β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→3)-N-propionyl-β-D-glucosamine disaccharide unit linked (1→4).

name: (3R)-3-carboxy-3-hydroxypropanoyl-CoA(5−)
definition: A acyl-CoA oxoanion that is the pentaanion of (3R)-3-carboxy-3-hydroxypropanoyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of phosphate, diphosphate and carboxy functions.

name: nitroflurbiprofen
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of flurbiprofen with the free hydroxy group of 4-(nitrooxy)butanol. It is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agent showing inhibitory effects against the cyclooxygenases COX1 and COX2.

name: 1-palmitylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-palmitylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A linear trisaccharide comprised of α-L-rhamnose, β-D-glucose and α-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→4).

name: 1-butyl-N-(2,6-dimethylphenyl)piperidine-2-carboxamide
definition: A piperidinecarboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-butylpipecolic acid with the amino group of 2,6-dimethylaniline.

name: α-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-N-tert-butylnitrone
definition: A nitrone that is the N-oxido derivative of 4-[(tert-butylimino)methyl]phenol.

name: 15-methylhexadecan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain fatty alcohol that is hexadecan-1-ol bearing a methyl substituent at position 15.

name: 13-methyltetradecan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain fatty alcohol that is tetradecan-1-ol bearing a methyl substituent at position 13.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-D-Glcpglycosylglucose in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has α configuration.

name: 11-methyldodecan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain fatty alcohol that is dodecan-1-ol bearing a methyl substituent at position 11.

name: p-coutaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of a 4-coumaric acid with one of the hydroxy groups of tartaric acid.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of one β-D-glucose and two α-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→2).

name: 1-butyl-N-(2,6-dimethylphenyl)piperidine-2-carboxamide hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining 1-butyl-N-(2,6-dimethylphenyl)piperidine-2-carboxamide with one molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: dextrobupivacaine hydrochloride (anhydrous)

name: 2,5-dimethylundecane

name: dihexadecanoyl phosphatidate(2−)

name: β-D-QuipN4Fm-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→3)-β-DQuipNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising a 4-deoxy-4-formamido-β-D-quinovose residue, two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galacturonamide residues and an N-acetyl-β-D-quinovosamine residue linked in a (1→4), (1→4), (1→3) sequence.

name: 1-butyl-N-(2,6-dimethylphenyl)piperidine-2-carboxamide hydrochloride hydrate

name: β-D-QuipN4Fm-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→3)-β-DQuipNAc-(1→2)-β-D-QuipN4Fm-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAcAN-(1→3)-β-DQuipNAc

name: levobupivacaine hydrochloride hydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of levobupivacaine hydrochloride. A piperidinecarboxamide-based local anaesthetic, it has a slow onset and long duration of action.

name: dextrobupivacaine hydrochloride hydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of dextrobupivacaine hydrochloride.

name: bupivacaine(1+)

name: 1-butyl-2-[(2,6-dimethylphenyl)carbamoyl]piperidinium
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of 1-butyl-N-(2,6-dimethylphenyl)piperidine-2-carboxamide, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group.

name: levobupivacaine(1+)
definition: The (S)-(−)-enantiomer of bupivacaine(1+).

name: dextrobupivacaine(1+)
definition: The (R)-(+)-enantiomer of bupivacaine(1+).

name: HexCer(d18:1/16:0)
definition: A cerebroside in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl.

name: N-tetracosanoyl hexosylceramide
definition: A cerebroside in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tetracosanoyl.

name: 1-oleylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-oleylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-dodecylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-dodecylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-tetradecylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-tetradecylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-pentadecylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-pentadecylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: heptadecan-1-ol

name: 1-heptadecylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-heptadecylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-octadecylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-octadecylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(9Z,12Z)-octadecadienylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-(9Z,12Z)-octadecadienylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrien-1-ol

name: 1-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-O-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-mannosyl phosphomycoketide
definition: A mannose phosphate consisting of α-D-mannose having a (4S,8S,12S,16S,20S)-4,8,12,16,20-pentamethylheptacosyl)phosphate group at position 1.

name: C32 mycoketide
definition: An ultra-long-chain primary fatty alcohol consisting of a C27 chain with a hydroxy group at C-1 and with methyl branches at C-4, -8, -12, -16 and -20, all with S stereochemistry.

name: β-D-mannosyl C30-phosphomycoketide
definition: A mannose phosphate consisting of β-D-mannose having a (4S,8S,12S,16S,20S)-4,8,12,16,20-pentamethylpentacosyl)phosphate group at position 1.

name: C30 phosphomycoketide
definition: A phospholipid that is the 4,8,12,16,20-pentamethylpentacosyl ester of phosphoric acid.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-lysine
definition: A L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine substituted at position 3 by a hydroxy group (the 3S-erythro-stereoisomer).

name: (4R)-4-hydroxy-L-lysine
definition: A 4-hydrox-L-lysine that is L-lysine substituted at position 4 by a hydroxy group (the 4R-threo-stereoisomer).

name: β-D-mannosyl C35-phosphodolichol
definition: A dolichyl D-mannosyl phosphate in which the dolichyl moiety contains six prenyl units and the mannosyl group has β anomeric configuration.

name: C35-phosphodolichol
definition: A dolichyl phosphate in which the dolichyl moiety contains six prenyl units

name: β-D-mannosyl (4S)-4-methylheptacosyl phosphate
definition: A mannose phosphate consisting of β-D-mannose having a (4S)-4-methylheptacosyl)phosphate group at position 1. Synthetic analogue of β-D-mannosyl C32-phosphomycoketide.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-ornithine
definition: An L-ornithine substituted at position 3 by a hydroxy group (the 3S-erythro-stereoisomer).

name: ginsenoside Mx
definition: A ginsenoside found in Panax ginseng that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 12β and 20 pro-S positions and in which the hydroxy group at position 20 has been converted to the corresponding β-D-xylopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: ginsenoside Mc
definition: A ginsenoside found in Panax notoginseng that is dammarane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 12β and 20 pro-S positions and in which the hydroxy group at position 20 has been converted to the corresponding α-L-arabinofuranosyl-β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: 1-oleoylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-acylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-oleoylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-linoleoylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-acylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-linoleoylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-arachidonoylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-acylglycerone 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-arachidonoylglycerone 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z,31Z)-tetratriacontahexaenoic acid
definition: An ω−3 fatty acid that is tetratriacontahexaenoic acid having six double bonds located at positions 16, 19, 22, 25 ,28 and 31 (the 16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z,31Z-isomer).

name: 2-hydroxy-3-(2-methoxyphenoxy)propyl carbamate
definition: A carbamate ester that is glycerol in which one of the primary alcohol groups has been converted to its 2-methoxyphenyl ether while the other has been converted to the corresponding carbamate ester.

name: (21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z,33Z)-hexatriacontapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is hexatriacontanoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 21, 24, 27, 30 and 33 (the 21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z,33Z-isomer).

name: (18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z,33Z)-hexatriacontahexaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is hexatriacontanoic acid having six double bonds located at positions 18, 21, 24, 27, 30 and 33 (the 18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z,33Z-isomer).

name: (R)-methocarbamol
definition: A 2-hydroxy-3-(2-methoxyphenoxy)propyl carbamate that has R configuration. Both (R)- and (S)-methocarbamol have muscle relaxant properties, with the (R)-enantiomer being more active than the (S)-enantiomer.

name: (S)-methocarbamol
definition: A 2-hydroxy-3-(2-methoxyphenoxy)propyl carbamate that has S configuration. Both (R)- and (S)-methocarbamol have muscle relaxant properties, with the (R)-enantiomer being more active than the (S)-enantiomer.

name: (23Z,26Z,29Z,32Z,35Z)-octatriacontapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is octatriacontanoic acid having six double bonds located at positions 23, 26, 29, 32 and 35 (the 23Z,26Z,29Z,32Z,35Z-isomer).

name: 1,3,5-octatriene
definition: An unbranched eight-carbon alkatriene with the three double bonds located at positions 1, 3 and 5.

name: 1-tetradecene
definition: An unbranched fourteen-carbon alkene with one double bond between C-1 and C-2.

name: 1-pentadecene
definition: An unbranched fifteen-carbon alkene with one double bond between C-1 and C-2.

name: 1-hexadecene
definition: An unbranched sixteen-carbon alkene with one double bond between C-1 and C-2.

name: 2,2,4,6,6-pentamethylheptane
definition: A branched alkane that is heptane carrying two methyl groups each at positions 2 and 6, and one methyl group at position 4.

name: 2,4,6,10-tetramethylpentadecane
definition: A branched alkane that is pentadecane carrying four methyl groups at at positions 2, 4, 6 and 10.

name: 3-ethyltoluene
definition: A derivative of toluene bearing an additional ethyl substituent at position 3.

name: 5-phenylundecane
definition: An alkylbenzene comprising undecane substituted at position 5 by a phenyl group.

name: 6-phenylundecane
definition: An alkylbenzene comprising undecane substituted at position 6 by a phenyl group.

name: 5-phenyldodecane
definition: An alkylbenzene comprising dodecane substituted at position 5 by a phenyl group.

name: 6-phenyldodecane
definition: An alkylbenzene comprising dodecane substituted at position 6 by a phenyl group.

name: 3-methyl-2-butanol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is 2-butanol carrying an additional methyl substituent at position 3.

name: pentan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is pentane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: pentan-3-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is pentane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It is produced by plants and is a component of emitted insect sex pheromones.

name: 3-methyl-2-pentanol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is 3-methylpentane substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group.

name: (9Z,12Z)-hexadecadienoic acid
definition: A hexadecadienoic acid in which the two double bonds are located at positions 9 and 12 (the 9Z,12Z-isomer).

name: (17Z)-hexacosenoic acid

definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is tetracosanoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 6, 9, 12, 15 and 18 (the 6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z,18Z-isomer).

name: (11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z)-hexacosatetraenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is tetracosanoic acid having four double bonds located at positions 11, 14, 17 and 20 (the 11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z-isomer).

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z)-hexacosapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is hexacosanoic acid containing five double bonds located at positions 8, 11, 14, 17 and 20 (the 8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z-isomer).

name: (13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z)-octacosatetraenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is octacosanoic acid having four double bonds located at positions 13, 16, 19, 22 (the 13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z-isomer).

name: (15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z)-triacontatetraenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is triacontanoic acid having four double bonds located at positions 15, 18, 21 and 24 (the 15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z-isomer).

name: (17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z)-dotriacontatetraenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is tetracosanoic acid having four double bonds located at positions 17, 20, 23 and 26 (the 17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z-isomer).

name: (19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z)-tetratriacontatetraenoic acid
definition: An ω−6 fatty acid that is tetratriacontanoic acid having four double bonds located at positions 19, 22, 25 and 28 (the 15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z-isomer).

name: trans-9-octadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecenoyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of trans-9-octadecenoyl-CoA; major species at p 7.3.

name: (21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z)-hexatriacontatetraenoic acid
definition: An ω−6 fatty acid that is hexatriacontanoic acid having four double bonds located at positions 21, 24, 27 and 30 (the 21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z-isomer).

name: (23Z,26Z,29Z,32Z)-octatriacontatetraenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is octatriacontanoic acid having four double bonds located at positions 23, 26, 29 and 32 (the 23Z,26Z,29Z,32Z-isomer).

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z)-hexacosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z,20Z)-hexacosapentaenoic acid.

name: (10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z)-octacosapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is octacosanoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 10, 13, 16, 19 and 22 (the 10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z-isomer).

name: (12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z)-triacontapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is triacontanoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 12, 15, 18, 21 and 24 (the 12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z-isomer).

name: ebselen
definition: A benzoselenazole that is 1,2-benzoselenazol-3-one carrying an additional phenyl substituent at position 2. Acts as a mimic of glutathione peroxidase.

name: (10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z)-octacosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z)-octacosapentaenoic acid.

name: trans-2-pentadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of trans-2-pentadecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z)-triacontapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z)-triacontapentaenoic acid.

name: undecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) species arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of undecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-2-undecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of trans-2-undecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,9Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (2E,9Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2R)-pristanoyl-CoA
definition: Pristanoyl-CoA in which C-2 of the pristanoyl group has R-configuration.

name: trans-2-heptadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of trans-2-heptadecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,9E)-octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (2E,9E)-octadecenoyl coenzyme A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,9Z)-octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (2E,9Z)-octadecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ent-crizotinib
definition: A 3-[1-(2,6-dichloro-3-fluorophenyl)ethoxy]-5-[1-(piperidin-4-yl)pyrazol-4-yl]pyridin-2-amine that is the (S)-enantiomer of crizotinib.

name: SCH51344
definition: A pyrazoloquinoline that is 6-methoxy-3-methyl-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]quinoline bearing an additional 2-[(2-hydroxyethoxy)ethyl]amino substituent at position 4

name: (2S)-2-methylpentadecanoyl-CoA
definition: A (2S)-2-methylacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2S)-2-methylpentadecanoic acid.

name: (2E,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecatrienoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (2E,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoyl-CoA.

name: (2E,4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosaheptaenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 2,3-trans-enoyl CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (2E,4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosaheptaenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,1'-dioleyl 2,2'-dilysocardiolipin
definition: A 2,2'-dilyso cardiolipin in which both of the phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as oleoyl.

name: trioleoyl 2-monolysocardiolipin
definition: A 2-monolysocardiolipin in which all three phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as oleoyl.

name: 3-[1-(2,6-dichloro-3-fluorophenyl)ethoxy]-5-[1-(piperidin-4-yl)pyrazol-4-yl]pyridin-2-amine
definition: A pyrazolylpiperidine that consists of 4-(pyrazol-1-yl)piperidine carrying a 2-amino-3-[1-(2,6-dichloro-3-fluorophenyl)ethoxy]pyridin-5-yl group at the 4-position of the pyrazole ring.

name: rac-crizotinib
definition: A racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-crizotinib. The active (R)-enantiomer acts as a kinase inhibitor and is used for the treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.

name: 2,3,7,8-tetrabromodibenzodioxine
definition: An organobromine compound that is dibenzodioxine carrying four bromo substituents at positions 2, 3, 7 and 8.

name: zirconium tetrachloride
definition: A zirconium coordination entity comprising four chlorine atoms bound to a central zirconium atom.

name: trovafloxacin mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate (mesylate) salt prepared from equimolar amounts of trovafloxacin and methanesulfonic acid. A broad-spectrum antibiotic that was withdrawn from the market due to risk of liver failure.

name: trovafloxacin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of trovafloxacin, obtained by protonation of the primary amino group.

name: tropisetron hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining equimolar amounts of tropisetron and hydrogen chloride.

name: tropisetron(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of tropisetron, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group.

name: tranilast
definition: An amidobenzoic acid that is anthranilic acid in which one of the anilino hydrogens is replaced by a 3,4-dimethoxycinnamoyl group.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraen-1-ol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraene in which one of the methyl hydrogens at position 1 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrien-1-ol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is (8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatriene in which one of the methyl hydrogens at position 1 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 1-hexadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-hexadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-(3-aminopyrrolidin-1-yl)-1-(2,4-difluorophenyl)-6-fluoro-4-oxo-1,4-dihydro-1,8-naphthyridine-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A 1,8-naphthyridine derivative that is 4-oxo-1,4-dihydro-1,8-naphthyridine-3-carboxylic acid bearing additional 2,4-difluorophenyl, fluoro and 3-aminopyrrolidin-1-yl substituents at positions 1, 6 and 7 respectively.

name: (S)-tosufloxacin
definition: A 7-(3-aminopyrrolidin-1-yl)-1-(2,4-difluorophenyl)-6-fluoro-4-oxo-1,4-dihydro-1,8-naphthyridine-3-carboxylic acid that is the (S)-enantiomer of tosufloxacin.

name: (2S)-2-acetamido-4-aminobutanoic acid
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino that is the N2-acetyl derivative of L-2,4-diaminobutyric acid.

name: (R)-tosufloxacin
definition: A 7-(3-aminopyrrolidin-1-yl)-1-(2,4-difluorophenyl)-6-fluoro-4-oxo-1,4-dihydro-1,8-naphthyridine-3-carboxylic acid that is the (R)-enantiomer of tosufloxacin.

name: 2-[(diphenylmethyl)sulfinyl]acetamide
definition: A sulfoxide that is dimethylsulfoxide in which two hydrogens attached to one of the methyl groups are replaced by phenyl groups, while one hydrogen attached to the other methyl group is replaced by a carbamoyl (aminocarbonyl) group.

name: tosufloxacin(1+)
definition: A racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)-tosufloxacin(1+) and (S)-tosufloxacin(1+).

name: (2S)-2-acetamido-4-aminobutanoic acid zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the carboxy group of (2S)-2-acetamido-4-aminobutanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-[6-carboxy-8-(2,4-difluorophenyl)-3-fluoro-5-oxo-5,8-dihydro-1,8-naphthyridin-2-yl]pyrrolidin-3-aminium
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the primary amino group of 7-(3-aminopyrrolidin-1-yl)-1-(2,4-difluorophenyl)-6-fluoro-4-oxo-1,4-dihydro-1,8-naphthyridine-3-carboxylic acid.

name: armodafinil
definition: A 2-[(diphenylmethyl)sulfinyl]acetamide that has R configuration at the sulfur atom. Like its racemate, modafinil, it is used for the treatment of sleeping disorders such as narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnoea, and shift-work sleep disorder. Peak concentration in the blood later occurs later following administration than with modafinil, so it is thought that armodafinil may be more effective than modafinil in treating people with excessive daytime sleepiness.

name: (S)-modafinil
definition: A 2-[(diphenylmethyl)sulfinyl]acetamide that has S configuration at the sulfur atom. The racemate comprising (S)-modafinil and its enantiomer, armodafinil, is known as modafinil and is used for the treatment of sleeping disorders such as narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnoea, and shift-work sleep disorder. The enantiomers have similar pharmacological actions in animals.

name: 2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
