definition: A δ-lactam that is piperidine which is substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: syringomycin E
definition: A member of the class of syringomycins that has 3-hydroxydodecanoyl as the fatty acyl tail group. It is isolated from Pseudomonas syringae pv. syringae and exhibits phytotoxic and antifungal properties.

name: daidzein(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group of daidzein. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 2,4,6-trihydroxybenzophenone(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of 2,4,6-trihydroxybenzophenone, obtained by deprotonation of one of the two ortho-hydroxy groups. Major structure at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: cytidine 2'-phosphate(2−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of cytidine 2'-phosphate. Major structure at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 3,6-dichlorocatechol(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of 3,6-dichlorocatechol, obtained by deprotonation of one of the twophenolic hydroxy groups. Major structure at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 8-epi-prostaglandin F2α(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 8-epi-prostaglandin F2α, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: 3',4',5,6-tetrahydroxy-3,7-dimethoxyflavone(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of 3',4',5,6-tetrahydroxy-3,7-dimethoxyflavone. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 3',5-dihydroxy-3,4',7-trimethoxyflavone(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of 3',5-dihydroxy-3,4',7-trimethoxyflavone. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: cyanidin 3-O-(6-O-glucosyl-2-O-xylosylgalactoside) betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of cyanidin 3-O-(6-O-glucosyl-2-O-xylosylgalactoside). It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: ilicicolin H
definition: An aromatic ketone in which the ketone carbonyl group is attached to a (1R,2R,4aS,7S,8aR)-4,7-dimethyl-1-[(1E)-prop-1-en-1-yl]-1,2,4a,5,6,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalen-2-yl group and a 4-hydroxy-5-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2-oxo-1,2-dihydropyridin-3-yl group. Isolated from the from the "imperfect" fungus Cylindrocladium iliciola strain MFC-870.

name: sodium selenide
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having selenide as the counterion.

name: SCH-351591
definition: An aromatic amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 8-methoxy-2-(trifluoromethyl)quinoline-5-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 3,5-dichloropyridin-4-amine 1-oxide. It is a potent inhibitor of phosphodiesterase IV (PDE4).

name: sodium selenate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having selenate as the counterion.

name: 1-{2-[(4-chlorobenzyl)sulfanyl]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl}-1H-imidazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1-ethyl-1H-imidazole in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is replaced by a (4-chlorobenzyl)sulfanediyl group while a second is replaced by a 2,4-dichlorophenyl group.

name: tetrindole mesylate
definition: A racemate composed of equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-tetrindole mesylate.

name: sulfaphenazole
definition: A sulfonamide that is sulfanilamide in which the sulfonamide nitrogen is substituted by a 1-phenyl-1H-pyrazol-5-yl group. It is a selective inhibitor of cytochrome P450 (CYP) 2C9 isozyme, and antibacterial agent.

name: (R)-tetrindole mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate (mesylate) salt prepared from equimolar amounts of (R)-tetrindole and methanesulfonic acid.

name: (S)-tetrindole mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate (mesylate) salt prepared from equimolar amounts of (S)-tetrindole and methanesulfonic acid.

name: 1-hexadecyl-2-ammonio-2-deoxy-sn-glycerol
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the amino group of 1-hexadecyl-2-amino-2-deoxy-sn-glycerol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-O-palmityl-2-desoxy-2-amino-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid that is the conjugate base of 1-O-palmityl-2-desoxy-2-amino-sn-glycero-3-phosphate.

name: tetrindole hydrochloride
definition: A racemate composed of equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-tetrindole hydrochloride.

name: (R)-tetrindole hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride prepared from equimolar amounts of (R)-tetrindole and hydrochloric acid.

name: luteolin 7-O-β-D-glucoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of luteolin 7-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (S)-tetrindole hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining equimolar amounts of (S)-tetrindole and hydrochloric acid.

name: (R)-tetrindole(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group of (R)-tetrindole.

name: (R)-temafloxacin
definition: 1-(2,4-difluorophenyl)-6-fluoro-7-(3-methylpiperazin-1-yl)-4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid that has R configuration.

name: (S)-temafloxacin
definition: 1-(2,4-difluorophenyl)-6-fluoro-7-(3-methylpiperazin-1-yl)-4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid that has S configuration.

name: 1-(2,4-difluorophenyl)-6-fluoro-7-(3-methylpiperazin-1-yl)-4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A quinolone that is 4-oxo-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid which is substituted at positions 1, 6, and 7 by 2,4-difluorophenyl, fluorine, and 3-methylpiperazin-1-yl groups, respectively.

name: melamine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of one of the three ring nitrogens of melamine. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 2'-hydroxydaidzein(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group of 2'-hydroxydaidzein. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 7-O-methylluteone(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of 7-O-methylluteone. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: uridine 2'-phosphate(2−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of uridine 2'-phosphate. Major structure at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 2-ammonio-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of 2-amino-3-(3-oxoprop-1-enyl)but-2-enedioic acid and the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: biochanin A 7-O-β-D-glucoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of biochanin A 7-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: enterobactin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of enterobactin, obtained by deprotonation of one of the phenolic hydroxy groups. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (13Z,16Z)-docosadienoate
definition: A long-chain unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (13Z,16Z)-docosadienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosatrienoic acid
definition: A long-chain ω−3 fatty acid that is docosanoic acid having three double bonds located at positions 13, 16 and 19 (the (13Z,16Z,19Z-geoisomer).

name: (13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosatrienoate
definition: A long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-O-methylvitexin 2''-O-α-L-rhamnoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of 7-O-methylvitexin 2''-O-α-L-rhamnoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 9-oxononanoate
definition: An aldehydic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9-oxononanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-cyclohexyl-2,3,3a,4,5,6-hexahydropyrazino[3,2,1-jk]carbazole
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 2,3,3a,4,5,6-hexahydropyrazino[3,2,1-jk]carbazole carrying a cyclohexyl substituent at position 8.

name: (R)-tetrindole
definition: An 8-cyclohexyl-2,3,3a,4,5,6-hexahydropyrazino[3,2,1-jk]carbazole that is the (R)-enantiomer of tetrindole.

name: (S)-tetrindole
definition: An 8-cyclohexyl-2,3,3a,4,5,6-hexahydropyrazino[3,2,1-jk]carbazole that is the (S)-enantiomer of tetrindole.

name: 6-deoxy-D-glucos-6-yl (2R,3R)-corynomycolate
definition: 6-Deoxy-D-glucos-6-yl corynomycolate in which the configurations at the 2- and 3-positions of the corynomycolate moiety are both R.

name: ethyl 2-(dimethylamino)-1-phenylcyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate
definition: An amino acid ester that is the ethyl ester of cyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylic acid in which the cyclohexane ring is substituted at positions 1 and 2 by phenyl and dimethylamino groups, respectively. It has four possible diastereoisomers; the opioid analgesic drug tilidine is a racemate comprising the two trans diastereoisomers.

name: 3-mercaptohexyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester obtained by formal O-acetylation of 3-mercaptohexanol.

name: β-(2-thienyl)-D-alanine
definition: An alanine derivative that is D-alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 2-thienyl group.

name: glucose 6-monomycolate (C80)
definition: A mycolate ester formed by esterification of (2R,3R,20Z,35Z)-3-hydroxy-2-tetracosanylhexapentaconta-20,35-dienoic acid with the 6-OH of D-glucose. (C80 is the average tail length of a reported naturally occurring range of 72-86 carbon atoms.)

name: ent-dextilidine
definition: An ethyl 2-(dimethylamino)-1-phenylcyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate that has R configuration at the carbon bearing the phenyl group and S configuration at the carbon bearing the dimethylamino group. It is the enantiomer of dextilidine; the opioid analgesic tilidine is the racemate comprising equimolar amounts of dextilidine and ent-dextilidine.

name: dextilidine
definition: An ethyl 2-(dimethylamino)-1-phenylcyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate that has S configuration at the carbon bearing the phenyl group and R configuration at the carbon bearing the dimethylamino group. The opioid analgesic tilidine is the racemate comprising equimolar amounts of dextilidine and its enantiomer, ent-dextilidine. A prodrug, tilidine is converted by the liver to the active analgesic, nortilidine; virtually all of the opioid activity resides in the (1S,2R) isomer (i.e. the isomer derived from dextilidine).

name: cyanidin 3-O-(2-O-β-D-glucuronosyl)-β-D-glucoside(2−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the 5 and 7 positions of cyanidin 3-O-(2-O-β-D-glucuronosyl)-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: luteolin 7-O-[(β-D-glucosyluronate)-(1→2)-(β-D-glucosiduronate)] 4'-O-β-D-glucosiduronate(4−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion arising from deprotonation of the carboxy and 5-hydroxy groups of luteolin 7-O-[(β-D-glucosiduronate)-(1→2)-(β-D-glucosiduronate)] 4'-O-β-D-glucosiduronate; major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin 6.2.0.).

name: mugineate(1−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of mugineic acid. Major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: guanosine 3',5'-bis(diphosphate)(5−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is a penta-anionic form of guanosine 3',5'-bis(diphosphate). It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−)
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−) in which the 2-acyl group is specified as arachidonoyl.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-propionyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl and propionyl respectively.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-butanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl and butanoyl respectively.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-valeroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the two acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl and valeroyl respectively.

name: lancovutide
definition: A 19-membered heterodetic cyclic peptide that is isolated from Streptoverticillium cinnamoneus. It exhibits antiproliferative properties and induces apoptosis in tumour cells and has been used for treatment of cystic fibrosis.

name: ethyl 2-(methylamino)-1-phenylcyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate
definition: An amino acid ester that is the ethyl ester of cyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylic acid in which the cyclohexane ring is substituted at positions 1 and 2 by phenyl and methylamino groups, respectively.

name: 5-fluorotryptophan
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is tryptophan in which the hydrogen at position 5 on the indole ring is replaced by a fluoro group.

name: delphinidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside-5-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group of delphinidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside-5-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (1S,2R)-nortilidine
definition: A ethyl 2-(methylamino)-1-phenylcyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate that is dextilidine in which one of the methyl groups attached to the nitrogen is replaced by hydrogen. Dextilidine is a prodrug for (1S,2R)-nortilidine, being metabolised to it by the liver.

name: 3,8'-biflaviolin 2,7,2'-triolate
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is a trianionic form of 3,8'-biflaviolin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (1R,2S)-nortilidine
definition: An ethyl 2-(methylamino)-1-phenylcyclohex-3-ene-1-carboxylate that is ent-dextilidine in which one of the methyl groups attached to the nitrogen is replaced by hydrogen. ent-Dextilidine is metabolised to (1R,2S)-nortilidine by the liver.

name: stipitatate(1−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of stipitatic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: thymidine 3'-monophosphate(2−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of thymidine 3'-monophosphate. Major structure at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: delphinidin 3,3',5-tri-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group of delphinidin 3,3',5-tri-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 7-aminocholesterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is cholesterol substituted at position 7 by an amino group.

name: dehydroglycine zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the imino group of dehydroglycine. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 3-(3,4-dihydroxypyridinium-1-yl)-L-alanine zwitterion
definition: An aromatic amino-acid zwitterion arising from deprotonation of the carboxy and 3-hydroxy groups asell as protonation of the amino group of the cationic 3-(3,4-dihydroxypyridinium-1-yl)-L-alanine; major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (2S)-2-ammonio-3-oxo-4-(phosphonatooxy)butanoate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is a dianionic form of (2S)-2-amino-3-oxo-4-(phosphonooxy)butanoic acid. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 9(S)-HODE(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 9(S)-HODE; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-glycero-D-altro-octulose-1,8-bisphosphate
definition: A ketooctose derivative that is D-glycero-D-altro-octulose carrying two phosphate substituents at positions 1 and 8.

name: 3-chlorolactic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is lactic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a chloro group.

name: 4-mercapto-4-methylpentan-2-one
definition: An alkylthiol that is 4-methylpentan-2-one substituted at position 4 by a mercapto group.

name: cyanidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the 5 and 7 positions of cyanidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 4-hydroxycoumarin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 4-hydroxycoumarin, obtained by deprotonation of the 4-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (2Z,4E)-2-ammoniomuconate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of 2-aminomuconic acid. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 3-cyano-L-alanine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 3-cyano-L-alanine. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: cincreasin
definition: A member of the class of benzoxazoles that is 2-benzoxazolinone substituted at position 6 by a bromo group.

name: gossypetin(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group of gossypetin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 1,1'-hexadecane-1,16-diylbis(1-methylpyrrolidinium) dibromide
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt that is the dibromide salt of 1,1'-hexadecane-1,16-diylbis(1-methylpyrrolidinium).

name: 1,1'-hexadecane-1,16-diylbis(1-methylpyrrolidinium)
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion obtained by methylation of the two tertiary amino groups of 1,1'-hexadecane-1,16-diyldipyrrolidine.

name: ferrirubin
definition: A member of the class of ferrichromes that is an iron(III) chelate of the homodetic cyclic hexapeptide (cyclo{glycyl-L-seryl-L-seryl-N5-hydroxy-N5-[(2Z)-5-hydroxy-3-methyl-1-pent-2-enoyl]-L-ornithyl-N5-hydroxy-N5-[(2Z)-5-hydroxy-3-methyl-1-pent-2-enoyl]-L-ornithyl-N5-hydroxy-N5-[(2Z)-5-hydroxy-3-methyl-1-pent-2-enoyl]-L-ornithine

name: potassium sorbate
definition: A potassium salt having sorbate as the counterion.

name: (E,E)-sorbate
definition: A sorbate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (E,E)-sorbic acid.

name: precorrin-3B(6−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion that is the hexaanionic form of precorrin-3B.

name: precorrin-5(7−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion that is a heptaanionic form of precorrin-5. Major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: precorrin-6A(7−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion that is the heptaanionic form of precorrin-6A. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: hydrogenobyrinate(4−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion that is the tetraanionic form of hydrogenobyrinic acid. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: hydrogenobyrinic acid a,c-diamide(2−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion that is the dianionic form of hydrogenobyrinic acid a,c-diamide. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: iminoaspartate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of iminoaspartic acid and the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: biochanin A 7-O-β-D-glucoside 6''-O-malonate(2−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is a dianionic form of biochanin A 7-O-(6-O-malonyl-β-D-glucoside). It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 3,3'-biflaviolin(3−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is a trianionic form of 3,3'-biflaviolin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of a di-N-acetylated lactosediamine to which is linked (1→3) an α-L-fucosyl residue and which is in turn linked (1→3) to the galectose residue of a second lactose moiety. Saccharide portion of the antigen lacdiNAc fucopentaose-BSA.

name: elaiophylin
definition: A macrodiolide that is isolated from several bacteria including Streptomyces violaceoniger and other soil actinomycetes.

name: boromycin
definition: A boron-containing macrolide antibiotic that is isolated from Streptomyces antibioticus.

name: (allyl 7-azido-3,7-dideoxy-β-L-gulo-oct-2-ulopyranosid)onic acid
definition: The carbohydrate acid derivative that is the allyl glycoside of 7-azido-7-deoxy-7-epi-Kdo.

name: sodium (allyl 7-azido-3,7-dideoxy-β-L-gulo-oct-2-ulopyranosid)onate
definition: The sodium salt of (allyl 7-azido-3,7-dideoxy-β-L-gulo-oct-2-ulopyranosid)onic acid.

name: nocardicin E(2−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and oxime OH groups of nocardicin E. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: demethylsulochrin(2−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and one of the ortho-phenolic groups of demethylsulochrin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: delphinidin 3-O-(6''-O-malonyl)-β-D-glucoside(2−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the malonyl carboxy as well as the 5- and 7-hydroxy groups of delphinidin 3-O-(6''-O-malonyl)-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 1-O-palmitoyl-2-O-(5-oxovaleryl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine having palmitoyl and 5-oxovaleryl groups at the 1- and 2-positions respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-(4-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-5-yl)propanoate(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-(4-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-5-yl)propanoic acid and the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: aci-nitroethane
definition: An aci-nitro compound that is the predominant form of ethylnitronate at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 9(R)-HODE(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 9(R)-HODE; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-oxo-dGTP(4−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside triphosphate oxoanion that is the tetraanion of 8-oxo-dGTP arising from deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 2-hydroxy-dATP(4−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside triphosphate oxoanion that is the tetraanion of 2'-deoxy-2-hydroxyadenosine 5'-triphosphate, arising from deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 1-{2-[(2-chloro-3-thienyl)methoxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl}imidazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that comprises 2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethylimidazole carrying an additional (2-chloro-3-thienyl)methoxy substituent at position 2.

name: (S)-averantin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion obtained by deprotonation of the 2-hydroxy group of (S)-averantin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 2-dimethylaminoethyl chloride hydrochloride

name: 2-dimethylammonioethyl chloride

name: 2-dimethylaminoethyl chloride

name: disodium 4,7-diphenyl-1,10-phenanthroline 4',4''-disulfonate

name: 4,7-diphenyl-1,10-phenanthroline 4',4''-disulfonic acid
definition: A member of the class of phenanthrolines that is 4,7-diphenyl-1,10-phenanthroline carrying two additional sulfo substituents at positions 4' and 4''

name: bleomycin A5

name: tetraethylammonium chloride

name: 1-arachidonoylglycerone 3-phosphate

name: (2E,9E)-octadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,9E)-octadecadienoic acid.

name: (2E,9Z)-octadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,9Z)-octadecadienoic acid.

name: (2E,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecatrienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoic acid.

name: (2E,4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosaheptaenoyl-coenzyme A
definition: A 2,3-trans-enoyl -CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosaheptaenoic acid.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-azelaoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid that is the conjugate base of 1-palmitoyl-2-azelaoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine, obtained by deprotonation of the free carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: azelaate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of of azelaic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-hexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-O-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group is specified as caproyl (hexanoyl).

name: α,β-didehydrotryptophan zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of α,β-didehydrotryptophan; major species at pH 7.3.

name: acetone d6
definition: A deuterated compound that is acetone in which all six hydrogen atoms are replaced by deuterium.

name: 8-methyl-8-azoniabicyclo[3.2.1]octyl 4-nitrophenyl phenylphosphonate
definition: An organic phosphonate that is phenylphosphonic acid diesterified with tropinium and 4-nitrophenol.

name: 2-methyl-1-pyrrolinium
definition: An iminium ion obtained by protonation of the imino group of 2-methyl-1-pyrroline. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (R)-2-methylpyrrolidinium
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imino group of (R)-2-methylpyrrolidine. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: 1-caproyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−) in which the acyl group is specified as caproyl (hexanoyl).

name: 1,2-dicapryl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as capryl (decanoyl).

name: 1,2-dicapryl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1,2-dicapryl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as octanoyl.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N6-hydroxyadenine
definition: A member of the class of 6-aminopurinnes that is adenine in which one of the exocyclic amino hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: N-acetyl-L-cysteinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-L-cysteine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-amino-4-hydroxybenzaldehyde
definition: A hydroxybenzaldehyde that is 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde bearing an additional amino substituent at position 3.

name: 1-hydroxy-2,1-benzoxaborole
definition: A member of the class of benzoxaboroles that is 2,1-benzoxaborole in which the hydrogen attached to the boron atom is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 3-methyl-L-tyrosine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 3-methyl-L-tyrosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-hydroxy-3-methyl-L-tyrosine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 5-hydroxy-3-methyl-L-tyrosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cholesteryl acetate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by formal acylation of the hydroxy group of cholesterol by acetic acid.

name: 2-amino-6,7-dimethyl-4-hydroxypteridine
definition: A 2-amino-4-hydroxypteridine carrying two additional methyl substituents at positions 6 and 7.

name: oxythiamine chloride hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining oxythiamine chloride with one molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: (2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl)phosphonate zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the phosphonate to the amino group of (2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl)phosphonate. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: oxythiamine chloride
definition: A organic chloride salt having oxythiamine as the counterion.

name: (4S)-4-hydroxy-L-isoleucine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of (4S)-4-hydroxy-L-isoleucine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: oxythiamine(1+)
definition: A 1,3-thiazolium cation that is 5-(2-hydroxyethyl)-4-methyl-1,3-thiazole alkylated at the N3 position by a (2-methyl-4-oxo-1,4-dihydropyrimidin-5-yl)methyl group.

name: valerylsalicylic acid
definition: A valerate ester that is salicylic acid in which the phenolic hydrogen is replaced by a valeryl (pentanoyl) group.

name: 5-methyl-1-naphthoate
definition: A member of the class of naphthoates that is 1-naphthoate substituted at position 5 by a methyl group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoate
definition: A member of the class of naphthoates that is 1-naphthoate substituted at positions 3 and 5 by hydroxy and methyl groups respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-hexanoylsphingosine-1-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: An N-acylsphingosine-1-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the N-acyl group is specified as hexanoyl.

name: N-hexanoylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: A sphingomyelin in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexanoyl.

name: 3α-hydroxy-ent-sandaracopimaradiene
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid that is ent-sandaracopimaradiene bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at the 3α-position.

name: oryzalexin D
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid that is ent-sandaracopimaradiene bearing two additional hydroxy substituents at the 3α- and 7β-positions.

name: oryzalexin A
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid that is ent-sandaracopimaradiene bearing additional hydroxy and oxo substituents at the 3α- and 7-positions respectively.

name: oryzalexin E
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid that is ent-sandaracopimaradiene bearing two additional hydroxy substituents at the 3α- and 9β-positions.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 38:6 zwitterion in which the acyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 are specified as hexadecanoyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 38:6 that is the conjugate base of hexadecanoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 1-(Z)-alk-1-enyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the alk-1-enyl and acyl groups are specified as (1Z)-octadecenyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A 1-(1Z-alkenyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−) in which the alk-1-enyl and acyl groups are specified as (1Z)-octadecenyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl-L-serine(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1-octadecanoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 40:6 zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the primary amino group of 1-octadecanoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine.

name: 3-deoxy-D-threo-hex-2-ulosarate(2−)
definition: A hexaric acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 3-deoxy-D-threo-hex-2-ulosaric acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 38:4 zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the primary amino group of 1-octadecanoyl-2-(5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z-icosatetraenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A phosphatidylserine 38:4 that is the conjugate base of 1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the phosphatidyl acyl group is specified as oleoyl.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of D-galactose at the reducing end with an α-L-fucosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: 9-cis-retinol
definition: A retinol in which the double bond at position 9 has cis configuration, whilst the remaining acyclic double bonds have trans configuration.

name: 9-cis-retinal
definition: A retinal in which the double bond at position 9 has cis configuration, whilst the remaining acyclic double bonds have trans configuration.

name: ferruginol
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is abieta-8,11,13-triene substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 12.

name: N5-hydroxy-L-ornithine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained from N5-hydroxy-L-ornithine by transfer of a proton from the α-carboxy group to the amino group.

name: ω-hydroxyphylloquinone
definition: A member of the class of phylloquinones obtained by hydroxylation of one of the terminal methyl groups of phylloquinone itself.

name: menaquinone-4
definition: A menaquinone whose side-chain contains 4 isoprene units in an all-trans-configuration.

name: ω-hydroxymenaquinone-4
definition: A prenylnaphthoquinone obtained by hydroxylation of one of the terminal methyl groups of menaquinone-4.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of D-galactose at the reducing end with an α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: 2,7-dihydroxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoate
definition: A member of the class of naphthoates that is 1-naphthoate substituted at positions 2 and 7 by hydroxy groups and at position 5 by a methyl group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-7-methoxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoate
definition: A member of the class of naphthoates that is 1-naphthoate substituted at positions 2, 5 and 7 by hydroxy, methyl and methoxy groups respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-demethyl-8-(α-L-rhamnosyl)tetracenomycin C
definition: A member of the class of tetracenomycins that is 8-demethyltetracenomycin C in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 8 is replaced by an α-L-rhamnosyl residue.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of D-galactose at the reducing end with an α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: 8-demethyl-8-(2-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnosyl)tetracenomycin C
definition: A member of the class of tetracenomycins that is 8-demethyltetracenomycin C in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 8 is replaced by a 2-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnosyl residue.

name: 8-demethyl-8-(2,3-O-dimethyl-α-L-rhamnosyl)tetracenomycin C
definition: A member of the class of tetracenomycins that is 8-demethyltetracenomycin C in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 8 is replaced by a 2,3-di-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnosyl residue.

name: 8-demethyl-8-(2,3,4-O-trimethyl-α-L-rhamnosyl)tetracenomycin C
definition: A member of the class of tetracenomycins that is 8-demethyltetracenomycin C in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 8 is replaced by a 2,3,4-tri-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnosyl residue.

name: elloramycin A
definition: A member of the class of tetracenomycins that is 8-demethyltetracenomycin C in which the hydroxyl hydrogens at position 8 and 10 a are replaced by a 2,3,4-tri-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnosyl and methyl groups respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide consisting of D-galactose at the reducing end with an α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: L-m-tyrosine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion that is L-m-tyrosine in which a proton has been transferred from the carboxy group to the amino group.

name: sodium feredetate
definition: An iron chelate resulting from the deprotonation of all four carboxy groups of ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid and the addition of an iron(3+) and a sodium ion. It is used for the treatment of iron deficiency anaemia.

name: ophiobolin F
definition: A sesterterpenoid that is (7Z)-ophiobola-7,19-diene carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 3.

name: [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]8
definition: An N-acetylated α-(2→8)-linked homosialopolysaccharide consisting of eight α-D-N-acetylneuraminyl residues joined by (2→8) linkages (i.e. [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]n where n = 8).

name: dTDP-β-L-rhodosamine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dTDP-β-L-rhodosamine, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate group and protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-2-deoxy-β-L-fucose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-2-deoxy-β-L-fucose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: aclacinomycin S zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the 5-hydroxy to the tertiary amino group of aclacinomycin S. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: nonan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is nonane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]5
definition: An N-acetylated α-(2→8)-linked homosialopolysaccharide consisting of five α-D-N-acetylneuraminyl residues joined by (2→8) linkages (i.e. [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]n where n = 5).

name: ambrein
definition: A triterpenoid alcohol that is a constituent of ambergris, an intestinal secretion of the sperm whale Physeter catodon.

name: ambroxan
definition: A diterpenoid derived from sclareol that is responsible for the odour of ambergris (a solid, waxy, flammable substance produced in the digestive system of sperm whales).

name: asarone
definition: A phenylpropanoid that is benzene substituted by methoxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 4 and a propen-1-yl group at position 5. It has been isolated from Acorus.

name: α-asarone
definition: The trans-isomer of asarone.

name: carminic acid
definition: A tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 1,3,4,6-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by a methyl group at position 8, a carboxy group at position 7 and a 1,5-anhydro-D-glucitol moiety at position 2 via a C-glycosidic linkage. It is a natural dye isolated from several insects such as Dactylopius coccus.

name: 15-oxolipoxin A4(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy function of 15-oxolipoxin A4; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5,10-dihydrophenazine-1-carboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5,10-dihydrophenazine-1-carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5,10-dihydro-9-dimethylallylphenazine 1-carboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5,10-9-dimethylallyldihydrophenazine-1-carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-O-dimethylallyl-L-tyrosine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the carboxy group of 4-O-dimethylallyl-L-tyrosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4,6,6-trimethylbicyclo[3.1.1]hept-3-en-2-one
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is bicyclo[3.1.1]heptane which is substituted by an oxo group at position 2 and by methyl groups at positions 4, 6 and 6, and which contains a double bond between positions 3 and 4.

name: (S)-(−)-verbenone
definition: A 4,6,6-trimethylbicyclo[3.1.1]hept-3-en-2-one in which both chiral centres have S configuration.

name: civetone
definition: A macrocycle that is cycloheptadecanone with an unsaturation at position 9 (the 9Z-stereoisomer). It has been found in African Civets.

name: pppGp(2'→5')A(5−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and triphosphate OH groups of pppGp(2'→5')A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxypropanoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is propanoic acid in which one of the α-hydrogens is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: ethyl 2-hydroxypropanoate
definition: The ethyl ester obtained of 2-hydroxypropanoic acid.

name: ethyl (2S)-lactate
definition: The (2S)-enantiomer of ethyl lactate.

name: ethyl (2R)-lactate
definition: The (2R)-enantiomer of ethyl lactate.

name: baicalein(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of baicalein. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 13,14-dihydro-15-oxolipoxin A4(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy function of 13,14-dihydro-15-oxolipoxin A4; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-hydroxyxanthotoxin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of 5-hydroxyxanthotoxin, obtained by deprotonation of the hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: pseudobaptigenin(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of pseudobaptigenin, obtained by deprotonation of the hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: scutellarein(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of scutellarein, obtained by selective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 13,14-dihydrolipoxin A4(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy function of 13,14-dihydrolipoxin A4; major species at pH 7.3.

name: huperzine A
definition: A sesquiterpene alkaloid isolated from a club moss Huperzia serrata that has been shown to exhibit neuroprotective activity. It is also an effective inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase and has attracted interest as a therapeutic candidate for Alzheimer's disease.

name: PP2
definition: A member of the class of pyrazolopyrimidine that is pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-amine bearing additional tert-butyl and 4-chlorophenyl substituents at positions 1 and 3 respectively. It is a potent ATP-competitive inhibitor of the Src family of protein tyrosine kinases.

name: Src Inhibitor-1
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline which is substituted at position 4 by a p-phenoxyanilino group and at positions 6 and 7 by methoxy groups. It is a potent, competitive dual site (both the ATP- and peptide-binding) Src kinase inhibitor. Src Inhibitor-1 is one of the 'gold standards' for Src kinase inhibition that has been shown to use PP1 or PP2 in parallel with Src-I1 to inhbit Src family kinases.

name: 3,7-dimethylocta-1,6-dien-3-yl acetate
definition: A monoterpenoid that is the acetate ester of linalool. It forms a principal component of the essential oils from bergamot and lavender.

name: (R)-linalyl acetate
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of linalyl acetate.

name: (S)-linalyl acetate
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of linalyl acetate.

name: meta-hydroxyphenylhydracrylic acid
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3 and a 3-hydroxyphenyl group at position 2. It is a metabolite of flavonoids and has been identified as one of the major phenolic acids in human urine.

name: methyl isothiocyanate
definition: An isothiocyanate having a methyl group attached to the nitrogen. It is also the active nematicide of the pronematicide metam-sodium.

name: wogonin(1−)
definition: The flavonoid oxoanion formed by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy function of wogonin. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: ortho-vanillin
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes that is salicylaldehyde substituted by a methoxy group at position 3.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 1-(alk-1-enyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the alk-1-enyl and acyl groups are specified as (1Z)-octadecenyl and (9Z)-octadecenoyl respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A 1-(1Z-alk-1-enyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3- phosphoserine(1−), obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and carboxy groups and protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 1-(Z)-alk-1-enyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the alk-1-enyl and acyl groups are specified as (1Z-octadecenyl) and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−)
definition: A 1-(1Z-alk-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoserine, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and carboxy groups and protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Src Inhibitor-5
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline which is substituted at position 4 by a 2-chloro-5-methoxyanilino group, at position 6 by a methoxy group and at position 7 by a 3-(morpholin-4-yl)propoxy group.

name: D-ribofuranose-2,5-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-ribofuranose-2,5-bisphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-ribofuranose 5-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-ribofuranose-5-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-linalylflaviolin-2-olate
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 3-linalylflaviolin, obtained by deprotonation of the 2-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (4-nitrophenyl)acetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of (4-nitrophenyl)acetic acid; it is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-sulfinopropionyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and sulfinic acid functions of 3-sulfinopropionyl-CoA. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: amantadine sulfate
definition: An alkylammonium sulfate salt obtained by combining amantadine and sulfuric acid in a 2:1 ratio. Used as an antiviral and antiparkinson drug.

name: cyclooctat-9-en-7-ol
definition: A diterpenoid characterized by a 5-8-5 dodecahydrodicyclopenta[a,d]cyclooctene fused-ring system, with a single double bond and one isopropyl, one hydroxy and three methyl substituents. Intermediate in the biosynthetic pathway to the diterpenoid cyclooctatin.

name: fluorometholone acetate
definition: A steroid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the 17-hydroxy function of fluorometholone with acetic acid. Used in the treatment of steroid responsive inflammatory conditions of the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva, cornea, and anterior segment of the eye.

name: 9,17-dioxo-1,2,3,4,10,19-hexanorandrostan-5-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 9,17-dioxo-1,2,3,4,10,19-hexanorandrostan-5-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Δ4-dafachronate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of Δ4-dafachronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Δ4-dafachronoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of Δ4-dafachronoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: diphenyl sulfone
definition: A sulfone compound having two S-phenyl substituents. It has been found in plants like Gnidia glauca and Dioscorea bulbifera.

name: D-keto-manno-heptulose
definition: The open chain form of D-manno-heptulose.

name: vasotocin
definition: A heterodetic cyclic peptide that is homologous to oxytocin and vasopressin. It is a pituitary hormone that acts as an endocrine regulator for water balance, osmotic homoeostasis and is involved in social and sexual behavior in non-mammalian vertebrates.

name: 1-hexadecyl-2-propionyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecyl and propionyl respectively.

name: 1-hexadecyl-2-butanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecyl and butanoyl respectively.

name: 1-hexadecyl-2-succinyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid obtained by deprotonation of the free carboxy group of 1-hexadecyl-2-succinyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyclooctatin
definition: A diterpenoid characterized by a 5-8-5 dodecahydrodicyclopenta[a,d]cyclooctene fused-ring system, with a single double bond and one isopropyl, two hydroxy, one hydroxymethyl and two methyl substituents.

name: 1-hexadecyl-2-glutaryl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid obtained by deprotonation of the free carboxy group of 1-hexadecyl-2-glutaryl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: chelerythrine
definition: A benzophenanthridine alkaloid isolated from the root of Zanthoxylum simulans, Chelidonium majus L., and other Papaveraceae.

name: trisodium guanosine 5'-[β,γ-imido]triphosphate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the trisodium salt of guanosine 5'-[β,γ-imido]triphosphate.

name: N5-phenyl-L-glutamine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from a transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of N5-phenyl-L-glutamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-7-methoxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 2-hydroxy-7-methoxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-deoxy-α-L-fucosylaclacinomycin S zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the 5-hydroxy to the tertiary amino group of 2-deoxy-α-L-fucosylaclacinomycin S. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 1-palmityl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-palmityl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-hexadecyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 2-acyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecyl and acetyl respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-benproperine
definition: A 1-[1-(2-benzylphenoxy)propan-2-yl]piperidine that has R configuration. The racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-benproperine is used as a cough suppressant.

name: (S)-benproperine
definition: A 1-[1-(2-benzylphenoxy)propan-2-yl]piperidine that has S configuration. The racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-benproperine is used as a cough suppressant.

name: 1-hexadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the alkyl group at C-1 is specified as hexadecyl.

name: (R)-benproperine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen of (R)-benproperine.

name: (S)-benproperine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen of (S)-benproperine.

name: (R)-benproperine trihydrogen phosphate
definition: An organoammonium phosphate resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of (R)-benproperine and phosphoric acid.

name: (S)-benproperine trihydrogen phosphate
definition: An organoammonium phosphate resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of (S)-benproperine and phosphoric acid.

name: poly(6-aminohexanoate)(1−)
definition: An ionic macromolecule obtained by deprotonation of the terminal carboxy group of poly(6-aminohexanoic acid).

name: 4-hydroxy-3-polyprenylbenzoate
definition: A member of the class of benzoates obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of any 4-hydroxy-3-polyprenylbenzoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-(2-oxoethylideneamino)-6-D-ribitylaminouracil
definition: An aminouracil that is D-ribitol in which the hydroxy group at position 1 is substituted by the 6-amino group of 6-amino-5-(2-oxoethylideneamino)uracil. Unstable mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT)-activating antigen, formed by non-enzymatic reaction between 5-amino-6-D-ribitylaminouracil and glyoxal.

name: 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribitylaminouracil
definition: An aminouracil that is D-ribitol in which the hydroxy group at position 1 is substituted by the 6-amino group of 6-amino-5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)uracil. Unstable mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT)-activating antigen, formed by non-enzymatic reaction between 5-amino-6-D-ribitylaminouracil and methylglyoxal.

name: trans-benzylideneacetone
definition: The trans-isomer of benzylideneacetone. It acts as an inhibitor of the enzyme phospholipase A2 (EC 3.1.1.4) of insects like diamond back moth.

name: cis-benzylideneacetone
definition: The cis-isomer of benzylideneacetone.

name: 1-oleyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate(2−)
definition: A 1-alkyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-oleyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ethyl (2S)-hydroxy(phenyl)acetate
definition: The (2S)-enantiomer of ethyl hydroxy(phenyl)acetate.

name: ethyl (2R)-hydroxy(phenyl)acetate
definition: The (2R)-enantiomer of ethyl hydroxy(phenyl)acetate.

name: guanosine 5'-[β,γ-imido]triphosphate
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate analogue that is GTP in which the oxygen atom bridging the β- to the γ- phosphate is replaced by a nitrogen atom A non-hydrolyzable analog of GTP, it binds tightly to G-protein in the presence of Mg2+.

name: guanosine 5'-[β,γ-imido]triphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and phosphonate OH groups of guanosine 5'-[β,γ-imido]triphosphate.

name: henicosan-1-ol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is henicosane in which a hydrogen attached to one of the terminal carbons is replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been isolated from the aerial parts of Siegesbeckia orientalis and from an Italian bread wheat variety, Pegaso, and its 11 near-isogenic lines.

name: tricosan-1-ol
definition: A very long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is tricosane in which a hydrogen attached to one of the terminal carbons is replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been isolated from bulbs of Polianthes tuberosa, bran from the Italian bread wheat variety Pegaso and its 11 near-isogenic lines, and from the aerial parts of Centaurea austro-anatolica.

name: cis-anethole
definition: The cis-stereoisomer of anethole.

name: LRRK2-IN-1
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidobenzodiazepines that is 5,11-dimethylpyrimido[4,5-b][1,4]benzodiazepin-6-one carrying at C-2 on the pyrimidine ring a 4-[(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)piperidine-1-carbonyl]-2-methoxyanilino substituent. It is an inhibitor of the Parkinson's disease kinase LRRK2.

name: CZC-25146
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is 2,6-diamino-5-chloropyrimidine in which the amino groups at positions 2 and 6 are respectively carrying 2-methoxy-4-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl and 2-(methanesulfonylamino)phenyl substituents. It is an inhibitor of the Parkinson's disease kinase LRRK2.

name: {2-[(isopropylamino)methyl]-7-nitro-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinolin-6-yl}methanol
definition: A member of the class of quinolines that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline which is substituted at positions 2, 6, and 7 by (isopropylamino)methyl, hydroxymethyl, and nitro groups, respectively.

name: (R)-oxamniquine
definition: A {2-[(isopropylamino)methyl]-7-nitro-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinolin-6-yl}methanol that has R configuration.

name: (S)-oxamniquine
definition: A {2-[(isopropylamino)methyl]-7-nitro-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinolin-6-yl}methanol that has S configuration.

name: icariin
definition: A member of the class of flavonols that is kaempferol which is substituted at position 8 by a 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group and in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4', and 7 have been converted to the corresponding 6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranoside, methyl ether, and β-D-glucopyranoside, respectively. A phoshphodiesterase-5 inhibitor, it is obtained from several species of plants in the genus Epimedium and is thought to be the main active ingredient of the Chinese herbal medicine Herba Epimedii (yinyanghuo).

name: (R)-11-hydroxylaurate(1−)
definition: An 11-hydroxylaurate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (11R)-hydroxylauric acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 18-hydroxyoleate
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 18-hydroxyoleic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: pentacosan-1-ol
definition: A very long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is pentacosane in which a hydrogen attached to one of the terminal carbons is replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been identified in the roots of Rhodiola imbricata.

name: ceritinib
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is 2,6-diamino-5-chloropyrimidine in which the amino groups at positions 2 and 6 are respectively carrying 2-methoxy-4-(piperidin-4-yl)-5-methylphenyl and 2-(isopropylsulfonyl)phenyl substituents. Used for the treatment of ALK-positive metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.

name: 5'-AAAAATCCTTTTTGGATTAAA-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of nine deoxyadenosine, eight thymidine, two deoxycytidine and two deoxyguanosine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence A-A-A-A-A-T-C-C-T-T-T-T-T-G-G-A-T-T-A-A-A. Synthetic model oligodeoxyribonucleotide ligand.

name: [GlcNAc-(1→4)-Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-γ-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)]n-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate and carboxy groups of [GlcNAc-(1→4)-Mur2Ac(oyl-L-Ala-γ-D-Glu-L-Lys-D-Ala-D-Ala)]n-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: hexacosanal
definition: A long-chain fatty aldehyde resulting from the formal oxidation of the hydroxy group of hexacosan-1-ol. It is a minor component of barley leaf wax.

name: S-methyl-5-thio-D-ribofuranose
definition: A thioribose consisting of D-ribofuranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is replaced by a methylthio group.

name: octacosanal
definition: A long-chain fatty aldehyde resulting from the formal oxidation of the hydroxy group of octacosan-1-ol.

name: cis-9-nonadecenoic acid
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid that is nonadecanoic acid that has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond with Z configuration between the carbons at positions 9 and 10. It has been isolated from the spores of reishi mushroom, Ganoderma lucidum, and found to inhibit tumour cell proliferation and induce apoptosis of HL-60 cells.

name: cis-8-heptadecenoic acid
definition: A heptadecenoic acid in which the double bond is located at the 8-9 position and has Z configuration.

name: pentacos-1-ene
definition: An alkene that is pentacosane which has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond at the 1-2 position.

name: nonacos-1-ene
definition: An alkene that is nonacosane which has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond at the 1-2 position.

name: β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1↔1')-N-stearoylsphingosine
definition: A β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as stearoyl.

name: ganglioside GM2 (18:0) (1−)
definition: An anionic ganglioside obtained by deprotonation of the neuraminosyl carboxy group of ganglioside GM2 (18:0); major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1↔1')-N-stearoylsphingosine
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosylceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as stearoyl.

name: diallyl trisulfide
definition: An organic trisulfide that is trisulfane in which both of the hydrogens are replaced by allyl groups. A component of the essential oil of garlic and a major component of the traditional Chinese medicine allitridium, it exhibits antifungal, antitumour and antioxidant activity

name: mastoparan
definition: A member of the class of mastopyrans that is a 14-amino acid polypeptide comprising isoleucyl, asparaginyl, leucyl, lysyl, alanyl, leucyl, alanyl, alanyl, leucyl, alanyl, lysyl, lysyl, isoleucyl, and leucinamide residues coupled in sequence. It is the major active component of the venom of the vespid wasp, Vespula lewisii and causes degranulation of mast cells.

name: (S)-2-aminopropan-1-ol
definition: A 2-aminopropan-1-ol that has S-configuration.

name: mastoparan-AF
definition: A member of the class of mastopyrans that is a 14-amino acid polypeptide comprising isoleucyl, asparaginyl, leucyl, lysyl, alanyl, isoleucyl, alanyl, alanyl, leucyl, alanyl, lysyl, lysyl, leucyl, and phenylalninamide residues coupled in sequence. It is the major active component of the venom of the hornet Vespa affinis and causes degranulation of mast cells. It exhibits antimicrobial activity against both Gram-positive and -negative bacteria as well as haemolytic activity on chicken, human and sheep erythrocytes.

name: N-cyclohexyl-4-(imidazo[1,2-a]pyridin-3-yl)-N-methylpyrimidin-2-amine
definition: An aminopyrimidine that is N-cyclohexyl-N-methylpyrimidin-2-amine in which the pyrimidine ring is substituted at position 4 by an imidazo[1,2-a]pyridin-3-yl group. It is an inhibitor of interleukin-1 receptor-associated kinase 4 (IRAK-4; EC 2.7.11.1).

name: mastoparan-A
definition: A member of the class of mastopyrans that is a 14-amino acid polypeptide comprising isoleucyl, lysyl, tryptophyl, lysyl, alanyl, isoleucyl, leucyl, aspartyl, alanyl, valyl, lysyl, lysyl, valyl, and isoleucinamide residues coupled in sequence. It is the major active component of the venom of the hornet Vespa analis and causes degranulation of mast cells. It exhibits antimicrobial activity against both Gram-positive and -negative bacteria as well as haemolytic activity on chicken, human and sheep erythrocytes.

name: dorsomorphin
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine which is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by pyridin-4-yl and p-[2-(piperidin-1-yl)ethoxy]phenyl groups, respectively. It is a potent, selective, reversible, and ATP-competitive inhibitor of AMPK (AMP-activated protein kinase, EC 2.7.11.31) and a selective inhibitor of bone morphogenetic protein (BMP) signaling.

name: mastoparan-B
definition: A member of the class of mastopyrans that is a 14-amino acid polypeptide comprising leucyl, lysyl, leucyl, lysyl, seryl, isoleucyl, valyl, seryl, tryptophyl, alanyl, lysyl, lysyl, valyl, and leucinamide residues coupled in sequence. It is the major active component of the venom of the hornet Vespa basalis and causes degranulation of mast cells. It exhibits antimicrobial activity against both Gram-positive and -negative bacteria as well as haemolytic activity on chicken, human and sheep erythrocytes.

name: 1-decanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as decanoyl.

name: mastoparan-D
definition: A member of the class of mastopyrans that is a 14-amino acid polypeptide comprising isoleucyl, asparaginyl, leucyl, lysyl, alanyl, isoleucyl, alanyl, alanyl, phenylalanyl, alanyl, lysyl, lysyl, leucyl, and leucinamide residues coupled in sequence. It is the major active component of the venom of the hornet Vespa ducalis and causes degranulation of mast cells. It exhibits antimicrobial activity against both Gram-positive and -negative bacteria as well as haemolytic activity on chicken, human and sheep erythrocytes.

name: mastoparan-M
definition: A member of the class of mastopyrans that is a 14-amino acid polypeptide comprising isoleucyl, asparaginyl, leucyl, lysyl, alanyl, isoleucyl, alanyl, alanyl, leucyl, alanyl, lysyl, lysyl, leucyl, and leucinamide residues coupled in sequence. It is the major active component of the venom of the hornet Vespa mandarinia and causes degranulation of mast cells. It exhibits antimicrobial activity against both Gram-positive and -negative bacteria as well as haemolytic activity on chicken, human and sheep erythrocytes.

name: mastoparan-V
definition: A member of the class of mastopyrans that is a 14-amino acid polypeptide comprising isoleucyl, asparaginyl, tryptophyl, lysyl, glycyl, isoleucyl, alanyl, alanyl, methionyl, alanyl, lysyl, lysyl, leucyl, and leucinamide residues coupled in sequence. It is the major active component of the venom of the hornet Vespa velutina and causes degranulation of mast cells. It exhibits antimicrobial activity against both Gram-positive and -negative bacteria as well as haemolytic activity on chicken, human and sheep erythrocytes.

name: 3,7-bis(dimethylamino)phenothiazine
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is 4aH-phenothiazine substituted by dimethylamino groups at positions 3 and 7.

name: tafamidis
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-benzoxazoles that is 1,3-benzoxazole-6-carboxylic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a 3,5-dichlorophenyl group. Used (as its meglumine salt) for the amelioration of transthyretin-related hereditary amyloidosis.

name: zofenopril
definition: A proline derivative that is 4-(phenylsulfanyl)-L-proline in which the amine proton is replaced by a (2S)-3-(benzoylsulfanyl)-2-methylpropanoyl group. A prodrug for zofenoprilat.

name: apremilast
definition: A member of the class of isoindoles that is isoindole-1,3-dione substituted at position 4 by an acetamido group and at position 1 by a 1-(3-ethoxy-4-methoxyphenyl)-2-(methylsulfonyl)ethyl group. Used for treatment of psoriatic arthritis.

name: 1-hexadecyl-2-amino-2-deoxy-sn-glycerol
definition: An amino alcohol that is 2-amino-propane-1-ol in which one of the hydroxyl hydrogens is replaced by a hexedecyl group (the S-enantiomer).

name: ponatinib
definition: A benzamide obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(imidazo[1,2-b]pyridazin-3-ylethynyl)-4-methylbenzoic acid with the anilino group of 4-[(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]-3-(trifluoromethyl)aniline. It is a multi-target tyrosine kinase inhibitor that targets ABL, SRC, FGFR, and others and was designed to overcome the resistance of BCR-ABL mutation to imatinib, in particular the gatekeeper mutation ABLT315I.

name: GSK3-XIII
definition: A member of the class of aromatic amines that is ammonia with two of the hydrogens replaced by 5-methylpyrazol-3-yl and 2-phenylquinazolin-4-yl groups.

name: nemadipine-A
definition: A dihydropyridine that is that is 1,4-dihydropyridine which is substituted at positions 2 and 6 by methyl groups, at positions 3 and 5 by ethoxycarbonyl groups, and at position 4 by a pentafluorophenyl group. An L-type calcium channel α1-subunit antagonist. When exposed to the microscopic soil nematode Caenorhabditis elegans, nemadipine-A induces a variety of defects including those affecting morphology and egg laying.

name: pipamperone
definition: A member of the class of bipiperidines that is 1,4'-bipiperidine which is substituted at the 1' and 4' positions by 4-(p-fluorophenyl)-4-oxobutyl and carboxamide groups, respectively. A first generation antipsychotic, its properties are generally similar to those of haloperidol.

name: (3Z,6Z)-dodecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3Z,6Z)-dodecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methyl-3-hydroxybutyrate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-methyl-3-hydroxybutyric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2S,3S)-3-hydroxy-2-methylbutanoate
definition: A 2-methyl-3-hydroxybutyrate that has (2S,3S)-configuration.

name: β-aminoarteether
definition: An artemisinin derivative in which the lactone of (+)-artemisinin has been converted into the corresponding lactol 2-aminoethyl ether [β (S) configuration at the new stereocentre].

name: β-aminoarteether maleate
definition: The maleate salt of β-aminoarteether. Synthetic artemisinin derivative with potent immunosuppressive activity.

name: aflatoxin M1
definition: A member of the class of aflatoxins that is aflatoxin B1 in which the hydrogen at position 9a is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: aflatoxin M1 8,9-epoxide
definition: A member of the class of aflatoxins that is obtained by the formal epoxidation across the 8,9-double bond of aflatoxin M1.

name: aflatoxin Q1
definition: A member of the class of aflatoxins that is aflatoxin B1 in which the hydrogen at the pro-3S position is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: aflatoxin B1 endo-8,9-oxide
definition: A member of the class of aflatoxins that is obtained by the formal epoxidation across the 8,9-double bond of aflatoxin B1.

name: 6-linalyl-2-O,3-dimethylflaviolin-7-olate
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 6-linalyl-2-O,3-dimethylflaviolin, obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 2-O,3-dimethylflaviolin-7-olate
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 2-O,3-dimethylflaviolin, obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 7-O-geranyl-2-O,3-dimethylflaviolin
definition: A hydroxy-1,4-naphthoquinone that is 3-methylflaviolin in which the hydroxyl hydrogens at positions 2 and 7 are replaced by methyl and geranyl groups respectively.

name: pederin
definition: A polyketide and carboxamide produced by a (Pseudomonas) bacterial endosymbiont of certain rove beetles (genus Paederus). Pederin is the agent responsible for the vesicant effects (linear or Paederus dermatitis) when the beetle is crushed against the skin. It is a powerful inhibitor of protein biosynthesis and mitosis and a potent antitumour agent.

name: 5α-pregan-20β-ol-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo-5α- steroid that is 5α-pregane-3-one carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at the 20β-position.

name: 21-dehydrocortisol
definition: A C21-steroid that is cortisol in which the 21-hydroxy group has been oxidised to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: 21-dehydrocortisone
definition: A C21-steroid that is cortisone in which the 21-hydroxy group has been oxidised to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: 11-dehydrocorticosterone
definition: An 11-oxo steroid that is corticosterone in which the hydroxy substituent at the 11β position has been oxidised to give the corresponding ketone.

name: 11,21-dioxoprogesterone
definition: A C21-steroid that is progesterone carrying two additional oxo substituents at positions 11 and 21

name: isoursodeoxycholate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of isoursodeoxycholic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3β-hydroxy-7-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3β-hydroxy-7-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ursodeoxycholate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of ursodeoxycholic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-oxolithocholate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of 7-oxolithocholic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5'-d[CCGTCCATAATCACTCGC]-3'
definition: A single-strand DNA oligonucleotide comprised of four deoxyadenosine, eight deoxycytidine, four thymidine and two deoxyguanidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence C-C-G-T-C-C-A-T-A-A-T-C-A-C-T-C-G-C.

name: 5'-d[GCGTGAT(6-4)TATGGAC]-3'
definition: A single-strand DNA oligonucleotide comprised of three deoxyadenosine, two deoxycytidine, four thymidine and eight deoxyguanidine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence G-C-G-T-G-A-T-T-A-T-G-G-A-C, with a (6-4) lesion at the central two thymidine residues.

name: 3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-α-D-Hepp-(1→7)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp
definition: A linear trisaccharide consisting of three L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residues joined sequentially by (1→7) and (1→3) linkages.

name: L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-α-Kdo
definition: A linear trisaccharide comprising two L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residues and a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-α-D-mannooctanoic acid, α-Kdo) residue in a (1→3), (1→5) sequence.

name: L-α-D-Hepp-(1→7)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-α-Kdo
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide comprising three L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residues and a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-α-D-mannooctanoic acid, α-Kdo) residue in a (1→7), (1→3), (1→5) sequence.

name: iron(III) oxide-hydroxide(1−)
definition: The inorganic anion obtained by deprotonation of iron(III) oxide-hydroxide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-methoxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoate
definition: A naphthoate that is the conjugate base of 3-methoxy-5-methyl-1-naphthoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: monepantel
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of p-[(trifluoromethyl)sulfanyl]benzoic acid with the amino group of (2S)-2-amino-3-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile in which the hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding 5-cyano-2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl ether. A broad-spectrum nematicide, it is used to control gastrointestinal roundworms in sheep and goats.

name: clavaldehyde(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of clavaldehyde, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-dienedioate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-dienedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-oxohept-4-ene-1,7-dioate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 2-oxohept-4-ene-1,7-dioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyglutaryl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion that results from the removal of all five protons from the phosphate and carboxylic acid groups of 2-hydroxyglutaryl-CoA. Major structure at pH 7.3 (Marvin 6.2.0)

name: 9-cis-retinoate
definition: A retinoate that is the conjugate base of 9-cis-retinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: chroman-6-ol
definition: A chromanol that is chromane in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: vitexin 2''-O-β-L-rhamnoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of vitexin 2''-O-β-L-rhamnoside obtained by deprotonation of the OH group at position 7 on the chromene. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 7-O-methylvitexin 2''-O-β-L-rhamnoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of 7-O-methylvitexin 2''-O-β-L-rhamnoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: N-hexadecanoylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: A sphingomyelin 34:1 in which the N-acyl group and sphingoid base are specified as hexadecanoyl and sphingosine respectively.

name: N-hexadecanoylsphinganine-1-phosphocholine
definition: A sphingomyelin 34:0 in which the N-acyl group and sphingoid base are specified as hexadecanoyl and sphinganine respectively.

name: N-hexadecanoylphytosphingosine-1-phosphocholine
