definition: A carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of N-(isopropoxycarbonyl)valine with the amino group of methyl 3-amino-3-(4-chlorophenyl)propanoate.

name: (S)-fenticonazole(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imidazole group of (S)-fenticonazole.

name: L-(R)-valifenalate
definition: A methyl 3-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-{[N-(isopropoxycarbonyl)valyl]amino}propanoate resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of N-(isopropoxycarbonyl)-L-valine with the amino group of methyl (3R)-3-amino-3-(4-chlorophenyl)propanoate.

name: L-(S)-valifenalate
definition: A methyl 3-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-{[N-(isopropoxycarbonyl)valyl]amino}propanoate resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of N-(isopropoxycarbonyl)-L-valine with the amino group of methyl (3S)-3-amino-3-(4-chlorophenyl)propanoate.

name: 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-N-{2-[3-methoxy-4-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)phenyl]ethyl}-2-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)acetamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the condensation of the carboxy group of p-chloromandelic acid propargyl ether with the amino group of 2-[3-methoxy-4-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)phenyl]ethylamine.

name: (R)-mandipropamid
definition: A 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-N-{2-[3-methoxy-4-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)phenyl]ethyl}-2-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)acetamide that has R configuration.

name: (S)-mandipropamid
definition: A 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-N-{2-[3-methoxy-4-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)phenyl]ethyl}-2-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)acetamide that has S configuration.

name: B 581
definition: A dipeptide obtained from the tetrapeptide Cys-Val-Phe-Met by reduction of the amide carbonyl groups of the Cys and Val residues.

name: dodecanoyl-AMP(1−)
definition: A fatty acyl-AMP(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of dodecanoyl-AMP; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: tetradecanoyl-AMP(1−)
definition: A fatty acyl-AMP(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of tetradecanoyl-AMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: hexadecanoyl-AMP(1−)
definition: A fatty acyl-AMP(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of hexadecanoyl-AMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: octyl gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the hydroxy group of octanol.

name: 2-(butan-2-yl)-4,6-dinitrophenol
definition: A dinitrophenol that is 2,4-dinitrophenol substituted by a butan-2-yl group at position 2.

name: (R)-dinoseb
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2-(butan-2-yl)-4,6-dinitrophenol.

name: (S)-dinoseb
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-(butan-2-yl)-4,6-dinitrophenol.

name: 1-[4-(4-chlorophenyl)thiazol-2-yl]-2-(pentan-3-ylidene)hydrazine
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-thiazoles that is 2-[2-(pentan-3-ylidene)hydrazino]-1,3-thiazole carrying an additional 4-chlorophenyl substituent at position 4.

name: 2-chloro-N-(2,4-dimethylthiophen-3-yl)-N-(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)acetamide
definition: An organochlorine compound that is 2-chloroacetamide substituted by a 2,4-dimethylthiophen-3-yl and a 1-methoxypropan-2-yl group at the nitrogen atom.

name: (R)-dimethenamid
definition: A 2-chloro-N-(2,4-dimethylthiophen-3-yl)-N-[(2R)-1-methoxypropan-2-yl]acetamide that has R configuration. It is the inactive enantiomer; its (active) enantiomer is the herbicide known as dimethenamid-P; the racemate is the herbicide dimethenamid.

name: dimethenamid-P
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-chloro-N-(2,4-dimethylthiophen-3-yl)-N-[(2S)-1-methoxypropan-2-yl]acetamide. It is the active enantiomer of dimethenamid, a herbicide applied to the soil to control various broad-leaved weeds and grasses.

name: juvenile hormone I
definition: A member of the juvenile hormone family of compounds that is the methyl ester of methyl (2E,6E,10R,11S)-10,11-epoxy-7-ethyl-3,11-dimethyl-2,6-tridecanoic acid.

name: juvenile hormone III bisepoxide
definition: A juvenile hormone that is methyl farnesoate in which the 6,7 and 10,11-double bonds have been epoxidised.

name: juvenile hormone III skipped bisepoxide
definition: A juvenile hormone that is methyl farnesoate in which the 2,3 and 10,11-double bonds have been epoxidised. Found in the stink bug, Plautia stali.

name: 1-[4-(4-chlorophenyl)thiazol-2-yl]-2-(propan-2-ylidene)hydrazine
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-thiazoles that is 2-[2-(propan-2-ylidene)hydrazino]-1,3-thiazole carrying an additional 4-chlorophenyl substituent at position 4.

name: 2-chloro-N-(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)-N-(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)acetamide
definition: An organochlorine compound that is 2-chloroacetamide substituted by a (2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)-N-(1-methoxypropan-2-yl) group at the nitrogen atom.

name: (R)-metolachlor
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2-chloro-N-(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)-N-(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)acetamide.

name: (S)-metolachlor
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-chloro-N-(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)-N-(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)acetamide.

name: 1-(butan-2-ylidene)-2-[4-(4-chlorophenyl)thiazol-2-yl]hydrazine
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-thiazoles that is 2-[2-(butan-2-ylidene)hydrazino]-1,3-thiazole carrying an additional 4-chlorophenyl substituent at position 4.

name: 3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl isothiocyanate
definition: A member of the class of isothiocyanates in which the substituent attached to nitrogen is specified as 3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl.

name: [(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)amino](oxo)acetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is oxoacetic acid substituted by a (2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)amino group at position 2.

name: (R)-metolachlor OXA
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of [(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)amino](oxo)acetic acid.

name: (S)-metolachlor OXA
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of [(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)amino](oxo)acetic acid.

name: luminespib
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-(2,4-dihydroxy-5-isopropylphenyl)-4-[4-(morpholin-4-ylmethyl)phenyl]-1,2-oxazole-3-carboxylic acid with the amino group of ethylamine.

name: isotianil
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,4-dichloro-1,2-thiazole-5-carboxylic acid with o-cyanoaniline. It is a fungicide used for the control of rice blast.

name: 5-bromo-3-(butan-2-yl)-6-methylpyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione
definition: A pyrimidone that is pyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione substituted by a bromo group at position 5, a butan-2-yl group at position 3 and a methyl group at position 6.

name: (R)-bromacil
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 5-bromo-3-(butan-2-yl)-6-methylpyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione.

name: (S)-bromacil
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 5-bromo-3-(butan-2-yl)-6-methylpyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione.

name: lysidine monophosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is CMP in which the 2-keto group on the cytosine ring is replaced by an ε-L-lysyl residue.

name: lysidine monophosphate(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is CMP(2−) in which the 2-keto group on the cytosine ring is substituted by an ε-L-lysyl residue. Major structure at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v. 6.2.0).

name: pyrimorph
definition: An enamide resulting from the formal condensation of 3-(p-tert-butylphenyl)-3-(6-chloropyridin-2-yl)acrylic acid with the amino group of morpholine. A fungicide developed in China, it shows high antifungal activity against diseases caused by Phytophthora infestans, Phytophthora capsici, Rhizoctonia solani, Peronophythora litchi, and Pseudoperonospora cubensis.

name: (R)-isoconazole
definition: A 1-{2-[(2,6-dichlorobenzyl)oxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl}imidazole that is the (R)-enantiomer of isoconazole.

name: 1-{2-[(2,6-dichlorobenzyl)oxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl}imidazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that carries a 2-[(2,6-dichlorobenzyl)oxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl group at position 1.

name: (S)-isoconazole
definition: A 1-{2-[(2,6-dichlorobenzyl)oxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl}imidazole that is the (S)-enantiomer of isoconazole.

name: (R)-isoconazole nitrate
definition: An organic nitrate salt obtained by reaction of equimolar amounts of (R)-isoconazole and nitric acid.

name: 9-PAHSA(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9-PAHSA, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-isoconazole nitrate
definition: An organic nitrate salt obtained by reaction of equimolar amounts of (S)-isoconazole and nitric acid.

name: 5-PAHSA(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-PAHSA, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-isoconazole(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imidazole group of (S)-isoconazole.

name: (R)-isoconazole(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imidazole group of (R)-isoconazole.

name: 10-PAHSA(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 10-PAHSA, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11-PAHSA(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 11-PAHSA, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12-PAHSA(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12-PAHSA, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13-PAHSA(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 13-PAHSA, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-[(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)amino]-2-oxoethanesulfonic acid
definition: An organosulfonic acid that is 2-oxoethanesulfonic acid substituted by a (2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)amino group at postion 2.

name: (R)-metolachlor ESA
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2-[(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)amino]-2-oxoethanesulfonic acid.

name: (S)-metolachlor ESA
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-[(2-ethyl-6-methylphenyl)(1-methoxypropan-2-yl)amino]-2-oxoethanesulfonic acid.

name: 1-{2-[(7-chloro-1-benzothiophen-3-yl)methoxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl}imidazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that carries a 2-[(7-chloro-1-benzothiophen-3-yl)methoxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl group at position 1.

name: (S)-sertaconazole
definition: A 1-{2-[(7-chloro-1-benzothiophen-3-yl)methoxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl}imidazole that is the (S)-enantiomer of sertaconazole.

name: arasertaconazole
definition: A 1-{2-[(7-chloro-1-benzothiophen-3-yl)methoxy]-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl}imidazole that is the active R-enantiomer of sertaconazole and is used (as its nitrate salt) for treatment of vulvovaginal candidiasis. The racemate itself is also used as a broad-spectrum antifungal drug.

name: (2-chlorophenyl)(4-chlorophenyl)pyrimidin-5-ylmethanol
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidin-5-ylmethanol in which one of the hydrogens attached to the carbon bearing the hydroxy group is replaced by a 2-chlorophenyl group while the other is replaced by a 4-chlorophenyl group.

name: (R)-fenarimol
definition: A (2-chlorophenyl)(4-chlorophenyl)pyrimidin-5-ylmethanol that has R configuration.

name: (S)-fenarimol
definition: A (2-chlorophenyl)(4-chlorophenyl)pyrimidin-5-ylmethanol that has S configuration.

name: (S)-sertaconazole nitrate
definition: An organic nitrate salt obtained by reaction of equimolar amounts of (S)-sertaconazole and nitric acid.

name: arasertaconazole nitrate
definition: An organic nitrate salt obtained by reaction of equimolar amounts of arasertaconazole and nitric acid. The active R-enantiomer of sertaconazole nitrate that is used for treatment of vulvovaginal candidiasis. The racemate itself is also used as a broad-spectrum antifungal drug.

name: (R)-nuarimol
definition: A (2-chlorophenyl)(4-fluorophenyl)pyrimidin-5-ylmethanol that has R configuration.

name: (S)-nuarimol
definition: A (2-chlorophenyl)(4-fluorophenyl)pyrimidin-5-ylmethanol that has S configuration.

name: CIGB-300
definition: A synthetic 25-membered heterodetic cyclic peptide consisting of a 14-membered linear component attached to an 11-membered cyclic portion. A CK2 inhibitor with potential antineoplastic activity.

name: (S)-sertaconazole(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imidazole group of (S)-sertaconazole

name: 7-PAHSA(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 7-PAHSA, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-PAHSA(1−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 8-PAHSA, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2-di-O-stearoyl-3-S-{2-[(2-{β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-1-O-yl}ethyl)amino]-2-oxoethyl}monothioglycerol
definition: A monothioglycerolipid in which the parent monothioglycerol is esterified on O-1 and O-2 by stearoyl groups and on S-3 by a 2-[(2-{β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-1-O-yl}ethyl)amino]-2-oxoethyl group

name: 1-O-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→2)-α-D-galactosyl]-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-Gal-(1→2)α-DGal glycosyl group at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: tetradecasphingosine
definition: A sphingoid that is the C14-analogue of sphingosine.

name: 1-(2-fluorophenyl)-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)ethanol
definition: A tertiary alcohol that is ethanol in which one of the hydrogens at position 1 is replaced by an p-fluorophenyl group, the other hydrogen at position 1 is replaced by a p-fluorophenyl group, and one of the hydrogens at position 2 is replaced by a 1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl group.

name: (R)-flutriafol
definition: A 1-(2-fluorophenyl)-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)ethanol that has R configuration.

name: (S)-flutriafol
definition: A 1-(2-fluorophenyl)-1-(4-fluorophenyl)-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)ethanol that has R configuration.

name: tetradecaphytosphingosine
definition: A sphingoid that is the C14-analogue of phytosphingosine.

name: 2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)hexan-2-ol
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1-hexyl-1H-1,2,4-triazole in which the hydrogens at position 2 of the hexyl chain are replaced by hydroxy and 2,4-dichlorophenyl groups.

name: (R)-hexaconazole
definition: A 2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)hexan-2-ol that has R configuration.

name: (S)-hexaconazole
definition: A 2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)hexan-2-ol that has S configuration.

name: 1,2,2'-trilinoleoyl-1'-monolysocardiolipin(2−)
definition: A 1-monolysocardiolipin(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1,2,2'-trilinoleoyl-1'-monolysocardiolipin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,1'-dilinoleoyl-2-oleoyl monolysocardiolipin(2−)
definition: A 2-monolysocardiolipin(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1,1'-dilinoleoyl-2-oleoyl monolysocardiolipin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-aminophenylglyoxylic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is glyoxylic acid in which the aldehydic hydrogen is replaced by a 2-aminophenyl group.

name: 1,2-dipalmitoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 32:2 in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as palmitoleoyl.

name: 1,2-distearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:0 in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as stearoyl (octadecanoyl).

name: 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-1-(1H-imidazol-1-yl)-3,3-dimethylbutan-2-one
definition: A ketone that is butan-2-one substituted by a 4-chlorophenoxy and a 1H-imidazol-1-yl group at position 1 and 2 methyl groups at position 3.

name: (R)-climbazole
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-1-(1H-imidazol-1-yl)-3,3-dimethylbutan-2-one.

name: (S)-climbazole
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-1-(1H-imidazol-1-yl)-3,3-dimethylbutan-2-one.

name: 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)hexanenitrile
definition: A nitrile that is hexanenitrile substituted at the 2-position by p-chlorophenyl and (1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)methyl groups.

name: (R)-myclobutanil
definition: A 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)hexanenitrile that has R configuration.

name: (S)-myclobutanil
definition: A 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)hexanenitrile that has S configuration.

name: 3-(3,5-dichlorophenyl)-5-ethenyl-5-methyl-2,4-oxazolidinedione
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidinones that is 5-ethenyl-5-methyl-2,4-oxazolidinedione in which the imide hydrogen is replaced by a 3,5-dichlorophenyl group.

name: (R)-vinclozolin
definition: A 3-(3,5-dichlorophenyl)-5-ethenyl-5-methyl-2,4-oxazolidinedione that is the (R)-enantiomer of vinclozolin.

name: (S)-vinclozolin
definition: A 3-(3,5-dichlorophenyl)-5-ethenyl-5-methyl-2,4-oxazolidinedione that is the (S)-enantiomer of vinclozolin.

name: 3-[(3aS,4S,5R,7aS)-5-hydroxy-7a-methyl-1,5-dioxo-octahydroinden-4-yl]propanoate
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-hydroxy-3-[(3aS,4S,5R,7aS)-7a-methyl-1,5-dioxo-octahydro-1H-inden-4-yl]propanoate, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A highly branched amino oligosaccharide consisting of a D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-NAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc nonasaccharide moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and an L-Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: 3-[(3aS,4S,5R,7aS)-5-hydroxy-7a-methyl-1-oxo-octahydroinden-4-yl]propanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate groups of 3-[(3aS,4S,5R,7aS)-5-hydroxy-7a-methyl-1-oxo-octahydroinden-4-yl]propanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A highly branched amino oligosaccharide consisting of a D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a α-L-Fuc-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc undecasaccharide moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and an L-Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-(methoxymethyl)nicotinic acid
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is nicotinic acid which is substituted substituted at position 5 by a methoxymethyl group and at position 2 by a 4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl group, that in turn is substituted by isopropyl, methyl, and oxo groups at positions 4, 4, and 5, respectively.

name: (S)-imazamox
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-(methoxymethyl)nicotinic acid.

name: (R)-imazamox
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 5-(methoxymethyl)-2-[4-methyl-5-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl]pyridine-3-carboxylic acid.

name: 3-ketocholest-4-en-26-al
definition: A 26-oxo steroid resulting from the oxidation of 3-oxocholest-4-en-26-ol to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: (10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatrienoic acid
definition: A long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is docosanoic acid having three double bonds located at positions 10, 13 and 16 (the (10Z,13Z,16Z-geoisomer).

name: 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-cyclopropyl-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol
definition: A tertiary alcohol that is butan-2-ol substituted by a 4-chlorophenyl group at position 2, a cyclopropyl group at position 3 and a 1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl group at position 1.

name: (2R,3S)-cyproconazole
definition: The (2R,3S)-stereoisomer of 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-cyclopropyl-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol.

name: (2S,3S)-cyproconazole
definition: The (2S,3S)-stereoisomer of 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-cyclopropyl-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol.

name: (2S,3R)-cyproconazole
definition: The (2S,3R)-stereoisomer of 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-cyclopropyl-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol.

name: (2R,3R)-cyproconazole
definition: The (2R,3R)-stereoisomer of 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-cyclopropyl-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol.

name: 1-{[3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-(4-fluorophenyl)oxiran-2-yl]methyl}-1H-1,2,4-triazole
definition: An epoxide that is oxirane substituted by a 2-chlorophenyl, 4-fluorophenyl and a 1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl groups.

name: (2S,3R)-epoxiconazole
definition: The (2S,3R)-stereoisomer of 1-{[3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-(4-fluorophenyl)oxiran-2-yl]methyl}-1H-1,2,4-triazole.

name: (2R,3S)-epoxiconazole
definition: The (2R,3S)-stereoisomer of 1-{[3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-(4-fluorophenyl)oxiran-2-yl]methyl}-1H-1,2,4-triazole.

name: olaparib
definition: A member of the class of N-acylpiperazines obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-fluoro-5-[(4-oxo-3,4-dihydrophthalazin-1-yl)methyl]benzoic acid with the free amino group of N-(cyclpropylcarbonyl)piperazine; used to treat advanced ovarian cancer.

name: 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of 2''-O-acetyl-ADP-D-ribose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-ethoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran-5-yl methanesulfonate
definition: A methanesulfonate ester that is methanesulfonic acid in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group has been replaced by a 2-ethoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran-5-yl group.

name: (S)-ethofumesate
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-ethoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran-5-yl methanesulfonate.

name: (R)-ethofumesate
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2-ethoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran-5-yl methanesulfonate.

name: N,N-diethyl-2-(naphthalen-1-yloxy)propanamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is propanamide substituted by two ethyl groups at the nitrogen atom and a naphthalen-1-yloxy group at position 2.

name: (R)-napropamide
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of N,N-diethyl-2-(naphthalen-1-yloxy)propanamide.

name: (S)-napropamide
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of N,N-diethyl-2-(naphthalen-1-yloxy)propanamide.

name: 1,2-dioctadecanoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate in which the 1-acyl group is also octadecanoyl.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-acyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycerol-3-phosphate(2−) in which the 1-acyl group is also oleoyl.

name: 3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oic acid
definition: A steroid acid that is 23,24-bisnor-chol-4-en-22-oic acid bearing an additional oxo substituent at position 3.

name: 3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-oxo-23,24-bisnor-chol-4-en-22-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2-di[(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl.

name: 1-(4-chlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-3-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)pentan-3-ol
definition: A tertiary alcohol that is pentan-3-ol substituted by a 4-chlorophenyl, methyl, methyl, and a 1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl at positions 1, 4, 4 and 3 respectively.

name: (S)-tebuconazole
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 1-(4-chlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-3-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)pentan-3-ol.

name: (R)-tebuconazole
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 1-(4-chlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-3-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)pentan-3-ol.

name: (5Z,9E,12S,14Z)-8,11,12,20-tetrahydroxyicosa-5,9,14-trienoic acid
definition: An icosanoid that is (5Z,9E,14Z)-icosa-5,9,14-trienoic acid carrying four hydroxy substituents at positions 8, 11, 12 and 20. An intermediary metabolite from the 12(R)-lipoxygenase pathway.

name: (25S)-3β-hydroxy-5-cholesten-26-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate groups of (25S)-3β-hydroxy-5-cholesten-26-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: galaxolide
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 1,3,4,6,7,8-hexahydrocyclopenta[g]isochromene substituted by methyl groups at positions 4, 6, 6, 7, 8 and 8 respectively. It is a synthetic musk used as a fragrance in cosmetics.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-[(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the 1- and 2-acyl substituent are specified as palmitoyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: N-(butan-2-yl)-N'-ethyl-6-methoxy-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is N-(butan-2-yl)-N'-ethyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a methoxy group at position 6.

name: (R)-secbumeton
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of N-(butan-2-yl)-N'-ethyl-6-methoxy-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine.

name: (S)-secbumeton
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of N-(butan-2-yl)-N'-ethyl-6-methoxy-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine.

name: N-(butan-2-yl)-6-chloro-N'-ethyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is N-(butan-2-yl)-N'-ethyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine substituted by a chloro group at position 6.

name: (R)-sebuthylazine
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of N-(butan-2-yl)-6-chloro-N'-ethyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine.

name: (S)-sebuthylazine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of N-(butan-2-yl)-6-chloro-N'-ethyl-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine.

name: 3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate and diphosphate groups of 3-oxo-23,24-bisnor-chol-4-en-22-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate and diphosphate groups of 3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxy-9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate and diphosphate groups of 3-hydroxy-9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxodotriacontanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-oxodotriacontanoyl-CoA (3-oxolacceroyl-CoA); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxy-9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oic acid
definition: An oxo seco-steroid that is 9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oic acid bearing an additional phenolic hydroxy substituent at position 3.

name: 3-hydroxy-9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-hydroxy-9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-hexanoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexanoyl.

name: daclatasvir hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining daclatasvir with two molar equivalents of hydrochloric acid. It is a potent inhibitor of nonstructural protein 5A and is used for treatment of hepatitis C.

name: daclatasvir(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imidazole groups of daclatasvir.

name: methoxysuccinyl-Ala-Ala-Pro-Ala chloromethyl ketone
definition: A tripeptide derived from methoxysuccinyl-Ala-Ala-Pro-Ala by conversion of the terminal carboxy group to the corresponding chloromethyl ketone.

name: methoxysuccinyl-Ala-Ala-Pro-Val chloromethyl ketone
definition: A tripeptide derived from methoxysuccinyl-Ala-Ala-Pro-Val by conversion of the terminal carboxy group to the corresponding chloromethyl ketone.

name: 3-{2-[4-(6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl]ethyl}-9-hydroxy-2-methyl-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-4-one
definition: A member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is 9-hydroxy-2-methyl-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-4-one carrying an additional 2-[4-(6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl]ethyl group at position 2.

name: (S)-paliperidone
definition: A 3-{2-[4-(6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl]ethyl}-9-hydroxy-2-methyl-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-4-one that is the (S)-enantiomer of paliperidone.

name: (R)-paliperidone
definition: A 3-{2-[4-(6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl]ethyl}-9-hydroxy-2-methyl-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-4-one that is the (R)-enantiomer of paliperidone.

name: 3-{2-[4-(6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl]ethyl}-2-methyl-4-oxo-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-9-yl hexadecanoate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 3-{2-[4-(6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl]ethyl}-9-hydroxy-2-methyl-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-4-one.

name: (S)-paliperidone palmitate
definition: A 3-{2-[4-(6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl]ethyl}-2-methyl-4-oxo-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-9-yl hexadecanoate that is the (S)-enantiomer of paliperidone palmitate.

name: (R)-paliperidone palmitate
definition: A 3-{2-[4-(6-fluoro-1,2-benzoxazol-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl]ethyl}-2-methyl-4-oxo-6,7,8,9-tetrahydropyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidin-9-yl hexadecanoate that is the (R)-enantiomer of paliperidone palmitate.

name: (10S,11S)-dihydroxy-10,11-dihydrocarbamazepine
definition: The (10S,11S)-enantiomer of 10,11-trans-dihydroxy-10,11-dihydrocarbamazepine.

name: (10R,11R)-dihydroxy-10,11-dihydrocarbamazepine
definition: The (10R,11R)-enantiomer of 10,11-trans-dihydroxy-10,11-dihydrocarbamazepine.

name: (25S)-3-oxocholest-4-en-26-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate and diphosphate groups of (25S)-3-oxocholest-4-en-26-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: pyrisoxazole
definition: A diastereoisomeric mixture of (3R,5S)- and (3R,5R)-pyrisoxazole. A novel isomeric fungicide primarily used for control of control tomato botrytis and also for fungal diseases of wheat and other crops.

name: 3-[5-(4-chlorophenyl)-2,3-dimethyl-1,2-oxazolidin-3-yl]pyridine
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidines that is 2,3-dimethyl-1,2-oxazolidine carrying additional 3-pyridyl and 4-chlorophenyl substituents at positions 3 and 5 respectively.

name: (3R,5R)-pyrisoxazole
definition: A 3-[5-(4-chlorophenyl)-2,3-dimethyl-1,2-oxazolidin-3-yl]pyridine that is the (3R,5R)-diastereomer of pyrisoxazole

name: (3R,5S)-pyrisoxazole
definition: A 3-[5-(4-chlorophenyl)-2,3-dimethyl-1,2-oxazolidin-3-yl]pyridine that is the (3R,5S)-diastereomer of pyrisoxazole.

name: 1-[2-(allyloxy)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl]imidazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles in which the hydrogen at position 1 is replaced by a 2-(allyloxy)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl group.

name: (S)-enilconazole
definition: A 1-[2-(allyloxy)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl]imidazole that is the (S)-enantiomer of enilconazole

name: (R)-enilconazole
definition: A 1-[2-(allyloxy)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl]imidazole that is the (R)-enantiomer of enilconazole.

name: UDP-β-L-rhamnose(2−)
definition: A UDP-L-rhamnose(2−) in which the rhamnose portion has β-configuration at its anomeric centre; the major form of UDP-β-L-rhamnose at pH 7.3.

name: {2-[3-(4-chlorophenyl)propyl]-2,4,4-trimethyl-1,3-oxazolidin-3-yl}(imidazol-1-yl)methanone
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidines that is 2-[3-(4-chlorophenyl)propyl]-2,4,4-trimethyl-1,3-oxazolidine in which the amino hydrogen is replaced by an (imidazol-1-yl)carbonyl group.

name: (S)-oxpoconazole
definition: A {2-[3-(4-chlorophenyl)propyl]-2,4,4-trimethyl-1,3-oxazolidin-3-yl}(imidazol-1-yl)methanone that is the (S)-enantiomer of oxpoconazole.

name: (S)-oxpoconazole fumarate
definition: A fumarate salt prepared from (S)-oxpoconazole by reaction of one molecule of fumaric acid for every two molecules of (S)-oxpoconazole.

name: (S)-oxpoconazole(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imidazole group of (S)-oxpoconazole.

name: (R)-oxpoconazole(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imidazole group of (R)-oxpoconazole.

name: pent-4-en-1-yl 2-[(2-furylmethyl)(imidazol-1-ylcarbonyl)amino]butanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-[(2-furylmethyl)(imidazol-1-ylcarbonyl)amino]butanoic acid with the hydroxy group of pent-4-en-1-ol.

name: (S)-pefurazoate
definition: A pent-4-en-1-yl 2-[(2-furylmethyl)(imidazol-1-ylcarbonyl)amino]butanoate that is the (S)-enantiomer of pefurazoate.

name: (R)-pefurazoate
definition: A pent-4-en-1-yl 2-[(2-furylmethyl)(imidazol-1-ylcarbonyl)amino]butanoate that is the (R)-enantiomer of pefurazoate.

name: dalcochinin-8'-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is the 8'-O-β-D-glucoside of dalcochinin.

name: 1-(biphenyl-4-yloxy)-3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butane-1,2-diol substituted at position O-1 by a biphenyl-4-yl group.

name: (1R,2R)-bitertanol
definition: A 1-(biphenyl-4-yloxy)-3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol that is the (1R,2R)-diastereomer of bitertanol.

name: (1S,2S)-bitertanol
definition: A 1-(biphenyl-4-yloxy)-3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol that is the (1S,2S)-diastereomer of bitertanol.

name: dalpatein(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dalpatein, obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (1S,2R)-bitertanol
definition: A 1-(biphenyl-4-yloxy)-3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-ol that is the (1S,2R)-diastereomer of bitertanol.

name: dalnigrein(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of dalnigrein, obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (25S)-26-hydroxycholest-4-en-3-one
definition: A 26-hydroxycholest-4-en-3-one in which the 25-position has S-configuration.

name: (25R)-26-hydroxycholest-4-en-3-one
definition: A 26-hydroxycholest-4-en-3-one in which the 25-position has R-configuration.

name: (25R)-3-ketocholest-4-en-26-al
definition: A 3-ketocholest-4-en-26-al in which the 25-position has R-configuration.

name: (25S)-3-ketocholest-4-en-26-al
definition: A 3-ketocholest-4-en-26-al in which the 25-position has S-configuration.

name: (R)-lipoyl-AMP
definition: A lipoyl-AMP in which the lipoyl moiety has (R)-configuration.

name: androst-5-ene-3,17-dione
definition: An androstanoid that is androst-5-ene bearing two oxo substituents at positions 3 and 17.

name: N-stearoyl-D-galactosylsphingosine
definition: An N-acyl-D-galactosylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as stearoyl (octadecanoyl).

name: N-behenoyl-D-galactosylsphingosine
definition: An N-acyl-D-galactosylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as behenoyl (docosanoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxybehenoyl)-D-galactosylsphingosine
definition: An N-acyl-D-galactosylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxybehenoyl (2-hydroxydocosanoyl).

name: N-tricosanoyl-D-galactosylsphingosine
definition: An N-acyl-D-galactosylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tricosanoyl

name: N-(2-hydroxytricosanoyl)-D-galactosylsphingosine
definition: An N-acyl-D-galactosylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxytricosanoyl.

name: N-lignoceroyl-D-galactosylsphingosine
definition: An N-acyl-D-galactosylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as lignoceroyl (tetracosanoyl).

name: N-(2-hydroxylignoceroyl)-D-galactosylsphingosine
definition: An N-acyl-D-galactosylsphingosine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as 2-hydroxylignoceroyl.

name: N-stearoyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−)
definition: An N-acyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of N-stearoyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-lignoceroyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−)
definition: An N-acyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of N-lignoceroyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-tricosanoylsphing-4-enine-1-phosphocholine
definition: A sphingomyelin 41:1 in which the N-acyl group and sphingoid base are specified as tricosanoyl and sphingosine respectively.

name: torvanol A(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of torvanol A hydrogen sulfate.

name: torvanol A hydrogen sulfate
definition: A methoxyisoflavan that is isoflavan substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2', methoxy groups at positions 6 and 3', a 2-carboxyethenyl group at position 5' and a sulfoxy group at position 4.

name: N-icosanoyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−)
definition: An N-acyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of N-icosanoyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-FucpNAc-(1→3)-D-FucpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of an N-acetyl-α-L-fucosaminyl residue linked (1→3) to an N-acetyl-α-D-fucosamine residue.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alaninate(3−)
definition: A UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alaninate(3−) in which the D-muramoyl fragment has α-configuration at its anomeric centre; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-docosanoyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−)
definition: An N-acyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of N-docosanoyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate(4−)
definition: A UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate(4−) in which the muramoyl fragment has α-configuration at its anomeric centre; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(2-hydroxybehenoyl)-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−)
definition: An N-acyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of N-(2-hydroxybehenoyl)-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(2-hydroxytetracosanoyl)-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−)
definition: An N-acyl-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of N-(2-hydroxytetracosanoyl)-(3-O-sulfo-D-galactosyl)sphingosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-L-lysinate(3−)
definition: Trianion of UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-L-lysine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminoheptanedioate(4−)
definition: A UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminoheptanedioate(4−) in which the muramoyl moiety has α-configuratijon at its anomeric centre; major species at pH 7.3

name: (S)-diniconazole
definition: A (1E)-1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-2-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)pent-1-en-3-ol that is the (S)-enantiomer of diniconazole.

name: (1E)-1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-2-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)pent-1-en-3-ol
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 4,4-dimethyl-2-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)pent-1-en-3-ol substituted at position 1 by a 2,4-dichlorophenyl group.

name: diniconazole-M
definition: A (1E)-1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-2-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)pent-1-en-3-ol that is the active R-enantiomer of diniconazole. A fungicide used to control a range of diseases including mildew, bunts and smuts.

name: N6-(UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl)-D-lysine(3−)
definition: Trianion of N6-(UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl)-D-lysine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ω-hydroxy-15-methylpalmitate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of ω-hydroxy-15-methyl-palmitic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ω-hydroxyphytanate
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of ω-hydroxyphytanic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-phenyl-2-(1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)butanenitrile
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1-chloro-4-(3-phenylpropyl)benzene substituted at position 3 of the propyl moiety by cyano and 1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl groups.

name: (S)-fenbuconazole
definition: 4-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-phenyl-2-(1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)butanenitrile that is the (S)-enantiomer of fenbuconazole.

name: (R)-fenbuconazole
definition: 4-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-phenyl-2-(1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)butanenitrile that is the (R)-enantiomer of fenbuconazole.

name: fluquinconazole
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is 6-fluoroquinazolin-4-one carrying additional 1,2,4-triazol-1-yl and 2,4-dichlorophenyl substituents at positions 2 and 3 respectively. A fungicide used to control Ascomycetes, Deuteromycetes and Basidiomycetes spp. on cereals, beets and fruit.

name: strobilurin B
definition: An enoate ester that is the methyl ester of (2E,3Z,5E)-6-(4-chloro-3-methoxyphenyl)-2-(methoxymethylene)-3-methylhexa-3,5-dienoic acid.

name: sodium 3-aminopropyl 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucose-1-phosphate
definition: The organic sodium salt of 3-aminopropyl 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucose-1-phosphate

name: 3-aminopropyl N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine-1-phosphate(1−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion formed by proton loss from the phospho group of 3-aminopropyl N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine-1-phosphate.

name: 3-aminopropyl N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine-1-phosphate
definition: An amino sugar phosphate that is α-D-glucosamine linked glycosidically to a (3-aminopropoxy)(hydroxy)phosphoryl group.

name: ethyl [4-({[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(imidazol-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl]methyl}sulfanyl)phenyl]carbamate
definition: A carbamate ester that is the ethyl ester of [4-({[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(imidazol-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl]methyl}sulfanyl)phenyl]carbamic acid.

name: (R,R)-tubulozole
definition: An ethyl [4-({[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(imidazol-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl]methyl}sulfanyl)phenyl]carbamate in which both stereocentres have R-configuration.

name: (S,S)-tubulozole
definition: An ethyl [4-({[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(imidazol-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-dioxolan-4-yl]methyl}sulfanyl)phenyl]carbamate in which both stereocentres have S-configuration.

name: zaragozic acid C
definition: A polyketide isolated from fungi that is a potent inhibitor of fungal and mammalian squalene synthase.

name: 15-hydroxypalmitic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is palmitic (hexadecanoic) acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 15.

name: 15-hydroxypalmitate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 15-hydroxypalmitic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 14-hydroxypalmitic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is palmitic (hexadecanoic) acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 14.

name: 14-hydroxypalmitate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 14-hydroxypalmitic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-D-muramoyl-L-alaninate
definition: The carbohydrate acid derivative anion formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy group of N-acetyl-D-muramoyl-L-alanine; principal microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: N6-(UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl)-D-lysine
definition: A UDP-glycopeptide in which the glycopeptide component consists of N6-(N-acetyl-α-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-γ-glutamyl)-D-lysine, joined to UDP via a glycosyl diphosphate bond.

name: diazaborine
definition: A organonitrogen heterocyclic compound consisting of 2,3,1-benzodiazaborinine substituted at positions 1 and 2 by hydroxy and 4-toluenesufonyl groups respectively.

name: dihydrocanadensolide
definition: A member of the class of furofurans that is tetrahydrofuro[3,4-b]furan-2,4-dione substituted at positions 3 and 6 by methyl and butyl groups respectively (the 3R,3aR,6S,6aS-stereoisomer).

name: N-succinimidyl N-methylcarbamate
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidinones that is N-hydroxysuccinimide in which the hydroxyl hydrogen is replaced by a methylcarbamoyl group.

name: SDZ 90-215
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide constructed from Pip, MeVal, Val, MeAsp, MeIle, MeIle, Gly, MeVal, Tyr(Me) and D-Lac residues.

name: (2E,6E,10E)-ω-hydroxyfarnesol
definition: A farnesane sesquiterpenoid obtained by hydroxylation of one of the terminal methyl groups of farnesol.

name: (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of (2E,6E,10E)-geranylgeranic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ω-hydroxygeranylgeraniol
definition: A diterpenoid obtained by hydroxylation of one of the terminal methyl groups of geranylgeraniol.

name: (2E,6E,10E,14E)-ω-hydroxygeranylgeranate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of (2E,6E,10E,14E)-ω-hydroxygeranylgeranic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,6E,10E)-ω-hydroxyfarnesyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of (2E,6E,10E)-ω-hydroxyfarnesyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: hygrolidin
definition: A macrolide consisting resulting from the formal lactonisation of the carboxy group of (2E,4E,6R,7S,8S,10E,12E,14S,15R,16S,17R,18S)-18-[(2R,4R,5S,6R)-4-{[(2E)-3-carboxyprop-2-enoyl]oxy}-2-hydroxy-5,6-dimethyltetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-yl]-7,15,17-trihydroxy-14-methoxy-2,4,6,8,10,16-hexamethylnonadeca-2,4,10,12-tetraenoic acid with the hydroxy group at position 15. It is active against SV40 tumour cells, and inhibits the growth of solid tumour-derived cell lines such as DLD-1 human colon cancer cells with increased cells in G1 and S phases.

name: NVP-BHS345
definition: A member of the class of imidazoquinolines that is 3-methyl-2-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-imidazo[4,5-c]quinoline substituted at position 1 by a 4-(1-cyanoisopropyl)phenyl group and at position 8 by a pyrimidin-5-yl group.

name: 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-(4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranosyluronate)-4-O-sulfonato-D-galactopyranose(2−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy and sulfate groups of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-(4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranosyluronic acid)-4-O-sulfo-D-galactopyranose arising from deprotonation of carboxylic acid and sulfate functions.

name: 7-hydroxyflavanone 7-O-[β-L-rhamnosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside]
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is 7-hydroxyflavanone having a β-(1→2)-L-rhamnosyl)-β-D-glucosyl moiety attached to the 7-hydroxy group.

name: 3-methylpalmitoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-methyl fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-methylpalmitoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-Boc-D-4-HO-3,5-Cl2-PhGly-D-4-HO-3,5-I2-PhGly-OMe
definition: A dipeptide comprising of phenylglycine derived residues linked by peptide bonds.

name: (5β)-bufadienolide
definition: The (5β)-stereoiosmer of bufadienolide.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol 3,4,5-triphosphate)
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 3-hydroxyaspartic acid
definition: A hydroxy-amino acid that is aspartic acid in which one of the methylene hydrogens has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: ethylenebis(dithiocarbamic acid)
definition: A dithiocarbamic acid resulting from the formal addition of a molecule of carbon disulfide to each amino group of ethylenediamine.

name: 14-methylhexadecasphingosine
definition: A sphingoid that is hexadecasphingosine substituted at position 14 by a methyl group.

name: β-D-glucosylsphingosine(1+)
definition: A D-glucosylsphingosine(1+) obtained by protonation of the amino group of any β-D-glucosylsphingosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)pentyl]1,2,4-triazole
definition: A member of the classof triazoles that is 1,2,4-triazole substituted at position 1 by a 2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)pentyl group.

name: (R)-penconazole
definition: A 1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)pentyl]1,2,4-triazole that is the (R)-enantiomer of penconazole.

name: (S)-penconazole
definition: A 1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)pentyl]1,2,4-triazole that is the (S)-enantiomer of penconazole.

name: 2-(4-fluorophenyl)-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)-3-(trimethylsilyl)propan-2-ol
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 2-(4-fluorophenyl)-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)-3-(trimethylsilyl)propane carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 2.

name: (R)-simeconazole
definition: A 2-(4-fluorophenyl)-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)-3-(trimethylsilyl)propan-2-ol that is the (R)-enantiomer of simeconazole.

name: (S)-simeconazole
definition: A 2-(4-fluorophenyl)-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)-3-(trimethylsilyl)propan-2-ol that is the (S)-enantiomer of simeconazole.

name: 1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-3-(1,1,2,2-tetrafluoroethoxy)propyl]1,2,4-triazole
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1,2,4-triazole substituted at position 1 by a 2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-3-(1,1,2,2-tetrafluoroethoxy)propyl group.

name: (R)-tetraconazole
definition: A 1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-3-(1,1,2,2-tetrafluoroethoxy)propyl]1,2,4-triazole that is the (R)-enantiomer of tetraconazole.

name: (S)-tetraconazole
definition: A 1-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-3-(1,1,2,2-tetrafluoroethoxy)propyl]1,2,4-triazole that is the (S)-enantiomer of tetraconazole.

name: 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-one
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1-hydroxy-3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-one in which the hydroxyl hydrogen is replaced by a 4-chlorophenyl group.

name: (R)-triadimefon
definition: A 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-one that is the (R)-enantiomer of triadimefon.

name: (S)-triadimefon
definition: A 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-3,3-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)butan-2-one that is the (S)-enantiomer of triadimefon.

name: (5E)-5-(4-chlorobenzylidene)-2,2-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)cyclopentanol
definition: A member of the class of cyclopentanols carrying 1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl and 4-chlorobenzylidene and geminal dimethyl substituents at positions 1, 2 and 5 respectively.

name: (R)-triticonazole
definition: A (5E)-5-(4-chlorobenzylidene)-2,2-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)cyclopentanol that is the (R)-enantiomer of triticonazole.

name: (S)-triticonazole
definition: A (5E)-5-(4-chlorobenzylidene)-2,2-dimethyl-1-(1,2,4-triazol-1-ylmethyl)cyclopentanol that is the (S)-enantiomer of triticonazole.

name: 2-[2-(1-chlorocyclopropyl)-3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxypropyl]-1,2-dihydro-1,2,4-triazole-3-thione
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1,2,4-triazole-3-thione substituted at position 2 by a 2-(1-chlorocyclopropyl)-3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxypropyl group.

name: (S)-prothioconazole
definition: A 2-[2-(1-chlorocyclopropyl)-3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxypropyl]-1,2-dihydro-1,2,4-triazole-3-thione that is the (S)-enantiomer of prothioconazole.

name: (R)-prothioconazole
definition: A 2-[2-(1-chlorocyclopropyl)-3-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxypropyl]-1,2-dihydro-1,2,4-triazole-3-thione that is the (R)-enantiomer of prothioconazole.

name: 2-cyano-N-[1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl]-3,3-dimethylbutanamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-cyano-3,3-dimethylbutanoic acid with the amino group of 1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethylamine.

name: (1R,2S)-diclocymet
definition: The stereoisomer of 2-cyano-N-[1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl]-3,3-dimethylbutanamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (S)-2-cyano-3,3-dimethylbutanoic acid with the amino group of (R)-1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)ethylamine.

name: N-(2-cyano-3-methylbutan-2-yl)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanoic acid with the amino group of 2-amino-2,3-dimethylbutanenitrile.

name: (R,R)-fenoxanil
definition: The stereoisomer of N-(2-cyano-3-methylbutan-2-yl)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (R)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanoic acid with the amino group of (R)-2-amino-2,3-dimethylbutanenitrile.

name: (R,S)-fenoxanil
definition: The stereoisomer of N-(2-cyano-3-methylbutan-2-yl)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (R)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanoic acid with the amino group of (S)-2-amino-2,3-dimethylbutanenitrile.

name: (S,S)-fenoxanil
definition: The stereoisomer of N-(2-cyano-3-methylbutan-2-yl)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (S)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanoic acid with the amino group of (S)-2-amino-2,3-dimethylbutanenitrile.

name: (S,R)-fenoxanil
definition: The stereoisomer of N-(2-cyano-3-methylbutan-2-yl)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (S)-2-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)propanoic acid with the amino group of (R)-2-amino-2,3-dimethylbutanenitrile.

name: 9(10)-EpOME(1−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9(10)-EpOME, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 14,15-EET(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 14,15-EET, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8,9-EET(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 8,9-EET, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: vernolate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of vernolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9,10-DiHOME(1−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9,10-DiHOME, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12,13-DiHOME(1−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12,13-DiHOME, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (5Z,8Z,11Z)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8Z,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (5Z,8Z,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (5Z,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: fosetyl-Al
definition: An aluminium salt composed of ethyl phosphonate anions and aluminium cations in a 3:1 ratio. A fungicide for various horticultural crops used to control a range of diseases including Phytophthora, Pythium and Plasmopara .

name: pyridoxatin
definition: A member of the class of dihydroxypyridines that is 1,4-dihydroxypyridin-2-one carrying an additional 6-ethenyl-2,4-dimethylcyclohexyl substituent at position 3. Pyridoxatin is a MMP-2 (Gelatinase A) inhibitor with antibiotic and anticancer properties. Also indicated to be a lipid peroxidation and DNA synthesis inhibitor as well as a free radical scavenger.

name: ravidomycin
definition: A C-glycosylated naphthoisochromene derivative obtained from Streptomyces ravidus; exhibits antibiotic and anticancer properties.

name: dihydroresveratrol-3-O-sulfate
definition: An organic sulfate that consists of dihydroresveratrol substituted by a sulfate group at position 3. It is a metabolite of dihydroresveratrol.

name: dihydroresveratrol-3-O-β-D-glucuronide
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is the 7-O-glucuronide of dihydroresveratrol .

name: resveratrol-3-O-sulfate
definition: An organic sulfate that is the 3-O-sulfate derivative of trans-resveratrol.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-α,α-trehalose
definition: A monoacyl α,α-trehalose in which the acyl group is specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and is located at position 2.

name: 2,3-dipalmitoyl-α,α-trehalose
definition: A polyacyl α,α-trehalose carrying two palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) substituents that are located at positions 2 and 3.

name: gallium(3+)
definition: A monoatomic trication derived from gallium.

name: trabectedin
definition: A tetrahydroisoquinoline alkaloid obtained from a Caribbean tunicate Ecteinascidia turbinata. Used for the treatment of soft tissue sarcoma and relapsed ovarian cancer.

name: N-acetylisoleucine
definition: An isoleucine derivative that is the N-acetyl derivative of isoleucine.

name: trapoxin A
definition: A homodetic cyclic tetrapeptide constructed from L-phenylalanyl (x2), D-pipecolinyl and L-2-amino-8-oxo-9,10-epoxydecanoyl residues.

name: ophthalmic acid
definition: A L-glutamine derivative that is L-glutamine substituted by a 1-[(carboxymethyl)amino]-1-oxobutan-2-yl at the terminal amino nitrogen atom.

name: octyl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic acid with the hydroxy group of octan-1-ol.

name: 4-fluorophenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative in which the hydrogen at position 4 on the benzene ring is replaced by a fluoro group.

name: tridecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A long-chain fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of tridecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: nonyl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic acid with the hydroxy group of nonan-1-ol.

name: decyl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic acid with the hydroxy group of decan-1-ol.

name: myristyl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic acid with the hydroxy group of tetradecan-1-ol.

name: arachidyl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic acid with the hydroxy group of icosan-1-ol.

name: stearyl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic acid with the hydroxy group of stearyl alcohol.

name: tetradecanal
definition: A long-chain fatty aldehyde that is tetradecane in which two hydrogens attached to a terminal carbon are replaced by an oxo group. It is found in coriander.

name: pentanal
definition: A saturated fatty aldehyde composed from five carbons in a straight chain.

name: sodium arsenate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt composed from sodium cations and arsenate anions in a 3:1 ratio.

name: hexadecyl elaidate
definition: A wax ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of elaidic acid with the hydroxy group of hexadecan-1-ol.

name: aminocandin
definition: A member of the family of echinocandins that shows broad-spectrum in vitro activity against Aspergillus and Candida spp.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-α-Kdo-(2→6)-(de-O-acylated lipid A)
definition: A lipid A derivative that consists of a branched octasaccharide phosphate made up from two D-galactose residues, two N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, a D-glucose residue, two L-glycero-D-manno-heptose residues (one of which is phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3), with linkages as shown and with a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) residue at the reducing end connected via an α(2→6) linkage to a de-O-acylated lipid A. Corresponds to the de-O-acylated lipid A conjugate of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: palmityl heptadecanoate
definition: A wax ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of heptadecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of palmityl alcohol.

name: palmityl laurate
definition: A wax ester resulting from the formal condensation of lauric acid with palmityl alcohol.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-α-Kdo-(2→6)-(de-O-acylated lipid A)
definition: A lipid A derivative that consists of a branched pentasaccharide phosphate made up from a D-glucose residue, an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, two L-glycero-D-manno-heptose residues (one of which is phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3), with linkages as shown and with a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) residue at the reducing end connected via an α(2→6) linkage to a de-O-acylated lipid A. Corresponds to the de-O-acylated lipid A conjugate of the galE mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-α-Kdo-(2→6)-(de-O-acylated lipid A)
definition: A lipid A derivative that consists of a linear tetrasaccharide phosphate comprising an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine residue,an L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3, another L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue and a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) in a (1→2), (1→3), (1→5) sequence, with the Kdo residue at the reducing end connected via an α(2→6) linkage to a de-O-acylated lipid A. Corresponds to the de-O-acylated lipid A conjugate of the icsB mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: 3-PEA-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-α-Kdo-(2→6)-(de-O-acylated lipid A)
definition: A lipid A derivative that consists of a linear trisaccharide phosphate comprising an L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue phosphoethanolamine-substituted on O-3, another L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue and a 3-deoxy-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid (2-keto-3-deoxy-D-mannooctanoic acid, Kdo) in a (1→3), (1→5) sequence, with the Kdo residue at the reducing end connected via an α(2→6) linkage to a de-O-acylated lipid A. Corresponds to the de-O-acylated lipid A conjugate of the icsA mutant of the core oligosaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis.

name: 2-(acetylamino)-4-methylphenyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester that is phenyl acetate substituted by an acetylamino group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 4.

name: 6-(2-hydroxyethoxy)-6-oxohexanoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester obtained by the formal condensation of one of the hydroxy groups of ethylene glycol with one of the carboxy groups of adipic acid.

name: 6-(carboxymethoxy)hexanoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is hexanoic acid substituted by a carboxymethoxy group at position 6.

name: 2,5-dihydroxycinnamic acid methyl ester
definition: A cinnamate ester that is the methyl ester of 2,5-dihydroxycinnamic acid.

name: 1-O-all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoyl-β-glucuronic acid
definition: A hydroxyretinoic glucuronide obtained by the glycosylation of the carboxy group of all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoic acid with β-glucuronic acid.

name: 4-(β-D-glucopyranuronosyloxy)retinoic acid
definition: A hydroxyretinoic glucuronide that is all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoic acid attached to a β-D-glucuronic acid residue via a glycosidic linkage.

name: 3-(benzyloxy)-3-oxopropanoic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester obtained by the formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of malonic acid with benzyl alcohol.

name: testosterone sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is testosterone substituted by a sulfoxy group at position 17.

name: 2,6-dimethylheptanoyl carnitine
definition: A C9-acylcarnitine in which the acyl group specified is 2,6-dimethylheptanoyl.

name: 2-carboxypalmitoyl-CoA(5−)
definition: A 2-carboxyacyl CoA(5−) arising from deprotonation of phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid functions of 2-carboxypalmitoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-carboxymyristoyl-CoA(5−)
definition: A 2-carboxyacyl CoA(5−) arising from deprotonation of phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid functions of 2-carboxymyristoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: O-linoleyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-octadecadienoyl-L-carnitine where the acyl group specified is linoleyl.

name: 2-carboxylauroyl-CoA(5−)
definition: A 2-carboxyacyl CoA(5−) arising from deprotonation of phosphate, diphosphate and carboxylic acid functions of 2-carboxylauroyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxyoctanoylcarnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine having 3-hydroxyoctanoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: 2-methoxy-N-[3-oxo-3-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)propyl]acetamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is acetamide substituted by a methoxy group at position 2 and a 3-oxo-3-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)propyl group at the nitrogen atom.

name: Phe-Tyr-Asp

definition: A N-alkylpiperazine that is piperazine substituted by a methyl and a 2-aminoethyl group at the N atoms respectively.

name: dimethyldithiocarbamate
definition: A member of the class of dithiocarbamate anions resulting from the removal of the proton from the dithiocarbamic acid moiety of dimethyldithiocarbamic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: propylene 1,2-bis(dithiocarbamic acid)
definition: A member of the class or dithiocarbamic acids resulting from the formal addition of a molecule of carbon disulfide to each of the nitrogens of propylenediamine.

name: propylene 1,2-bis(dithiocarbamate)
definition: A member of the class of dithiocarbamate anions resulting from the deprotonation of both of the dithiocarbamic acid moieties of propylene 1,2-bis(dithiocarbamic acid). The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-S-cysteinyl-DOPA
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is L-DOPA in which the hydrogen at position 2 on the phenyl ring is replaced by a cysteinyl group. Found in the urine of patients with melanoma.

name: 2,5-S,S'-dicysteinyldopa
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is L-DOPA in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 on the phenyl ring are replaced by cysteinyl groups. Found in the urine of patients with melanoma.

name: 1-myristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the phosphate group of 1-myristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-myristoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 32:1 zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the phosphate group of 1-myristoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-(2-amino-2-carboxyethyl)-5-hydroxy-2H-1,4-benzothiazine-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzothiazines that is 2H-1,4-benzothiazine-3-carboxylic acid bearing additional hydroxy and 2-amino-2-carboxyethyl substituents at positions 5 and 7 respectively.

name: trilinoleoyl 2-monolysocardiolipin

name: 2-carboxytetracosanoyl-CoA
definition: A 2-carboxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with one of the the carboxy groups of 2-carboxytetracosanoic acid.

name: cholesteryl myristate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of cholesterol with the carboxy group of myristic acid.

name: 2-carboxyhexacosanoyl-CoA
definition: A 2-carboxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with one of the the carboxy groups of 2-carboxyhexacosanoic acid.

name: (13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z)-2-hydroxyoctacosatetraenoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (13Z,16Z,19Z,22Z)-2-hydroxyoctacosatetraenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z)-2-hydroxytriacontapentaenoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (12Z,15Z,18Z,21Z,24Z)-2-hydroxytriacontapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z)-2-hydroxydotriacontapentaenoate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z)-2-hydroxydotriacontapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: rac-1-monooctanoylglycerol
definition: A rac-1-monoacylglycerol comprising equal amounts of 1-octanoyl-sn-glycerol and 3-octanoyl-sn-glycerol.

name: anticapsin zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of anticapsin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: bacilysin zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of bacilysin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dodecanoyl-AMP
definition: A fatty acyl-AMP that results from the formal condensation of the phosphoryl group of AMP with the carboxyl group of dodecanoic (lauric) acid.

name: 2-hydroxyoctacosanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxyoctacosanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxytricosanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxytricosanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cholesteryl pentadecanoate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of cholesterol with pentadecanoic acid.

name: dapdiamide A zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of dapdiamide A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dapdiamide B zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of dapdiamide B; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dapdiamide C zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of dapdiamide C; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cholesteryl palmitoleate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of cholesterol with palmitoleic acid.

name: 2-hydroxynervonate(1−)
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxynervonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cholesteryl heptadecanoate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of cholesterol with margaric acid.

name: torin 1
definition: A member of the class of pyridoquinolines that is 9-(quinolin-3-yl)benzo[h][1,6]naphthyridin-2-one bearing an additional 4-(4-propionylpiperazin-1-yl)-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl substituent at position 1. It is a potent inhibitor of mTOR and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: (9Z)-heptadecenoic acid
definition: A heptadecenoic acid in which the double bond is located at the 9-10 position and has Z configuration.

name: cholesteryl (9Z)-heptadecenoate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of cholesterol with cis-9-heptadecenoic acid.

name: N3-fumaroyl-(S)-2,3-diaminopropanoate
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of N3-fumaroyl-(S)-2,3-diaminopropanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N3-fumaramoyl-(S)-2,3-diaminopropanoic acid zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion that results from the transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the α-amino group of N3-fumaramoyl-(S)-2,3-diaminopropanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: synthalin
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the reaction of decamethylenediguanidine with 2 mol eq. of hydrogen chloride.

name: 2-hydroxymyristate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxymyristic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: synthalin A
definition: A member of the class of guanidines that is decane having guanidino groups at the 1- and 10-positions.

name: synthalin A(2+)
definition: A guanidinium ion resulting from the protonation of the two imine nitrogens of synthalin A.

name: hydrazinocurcumin
definition: A pyrazole obtained by cyclocodensation of the two carbonyl groups of curcumin with hydrazine.

name: cholesteryl linolenate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of cholesterol with (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadeca-9,12,15-trienoic acid.

name: nogalaviketone(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-OH group of nogalaviketone. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 6-(2-amino-2-carboxyethyl)-4-hydroxybenzothiazole
definition: A member of the class of benzothiazoles bearing hydroxy and 2-amino-2-carboxyethyl substituents at positions 4 and 6 respectively.

name: 7-(2-amino-2-carboxyethyl)-5-hydroxy-3,4-dihydro-2H-1,4-benzothiazin-3-one
definition: A member of the class of benzothiazines that is 3,4-dihydro-2H-1,4-benzothiazin-3-one bearing additional hydroxy and 2-amino-2-carboxyethyl substituents at positions 5 and 7 respectively.

name: methyl nogalonate(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the phenolic hydroxy group at position 5 of methyl nogalonate. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: cholesteryl all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of cholesterol with all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoic acid.

name: 2-palmitoyl-3-stearoyl-2'-sulfo-α,α-trehalose(1−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 2-palmitoyl-3-stearoyl-2'-sulfo-α,α-trehalose arising from deprotonation of the sulfate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-palmitoyl-3,6,6'-tristearoyl-2'-sulfo-α,α-trehalose(1−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 2-palmitoyl-3,6,6'-tristearoyl-2'-sulfo-α,α-trehalose arising from deprotonation of the sulfate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cholesteryl behenate
definition: A cholesterol ester obtained by the formal condensation of cholesterol with behenic acid.

name: 2',3'-dipalmitoyl-2-sulfo-α,α-trehalose(1−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 2',3'-dipalmitoyl-2-sulfo-α,α-trehalose arising from deprotonation of the sulfate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4R)-3,4-dihydro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate
