name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A heptasaccharide consisting of two α-maltotriose units linked (1→6), with a further α-D-glucose unit linked to O-6 of the glucose residue at the non-reducing end.

name: trans,trans-2,4-hexadienoyl-CoA
definition: A trans,trans-2,3,4,5-tetradehydroacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans,trans-2,4-hexadienoic acid.

name: trans-3-hexenoyl-CoA
definition: A trans-3-enoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-3-hexenoic acid.

name: (3E,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl-CoA
definition: A trans-3-enoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3E,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid.

name: O-acryloyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine having acryloyl as the acyl group.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-4-phosphate)(3−)
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate(3−) arising from deprotonation of all three free phosphate OH groups of 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-4-phosphate); major species at pH 7.3.

name: O-malonyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine in which the acyl group is specified as malonyl.

name: cobalt(II)-factor IV(6−)
definition: A precorrin carboxylic acid anion obtained by global deprotonation of the carboxy groups of cobalt(II)-factor IV. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: O-methylmalonyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine in which the acyl group specified is methylmalonyl.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(2-hydroxytridecyl)-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 2-hydroxytridecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(11-hydroxyheptadecyl)-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by an 11-hydroxyheptadecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(15-hydroxypentadecyl)-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 15-hydroxypentadecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(non-8-en-1-yl)-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a non-8-en-1-yl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(14-hydroxytetradecyl)-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 14-hydroxytetradecyl group.

name: 6-(hexadecan-2-yl)-4-hydroxy-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a hexadecan-2-yl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(2-methyldecyl)-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 2-methyldecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(11-methylheptadecyl)-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by an 11-methylheptadecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(11-methyldodecyl)-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-alkyl-4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by an 11-methyldodecyl group.

name: 3-(trimethylsilyl)propionate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-(trimethylsilyl)propionic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 3-(trimethylsilyl)propionic acid
definition: An organosilicon compound that is propionic acid substituted at position 3 by a trimethylsilyl group. It is used as internal reference in the NMR spectrum nuclear magnetic resonance for aqueous solvents (e.g. D2O).

name: chloroeremomycin(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the three amino functions of chloroeremomycin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(13-hydroxy-2-oxononadecyl)pyran-2-one
definition: An acyl tetraketide pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 13-hydroxy-2-oxononadecyl group.

name: epivancomycin(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the two amino functions of epivancomycin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(17-hydroxy-2-oxoheptadecyl)pyran-2-one
definition: An acyl tetraketide pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 17-hydroxy-2-oxoheptadecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(2-oxoundec-10-en-1-yl)pyran-2-one
definition: An acyl tetraketide pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 2-oxoundec-10-en-1-yl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(16-hydroxy-2-oxohexadecyl)pyran-2-one
definition: An acyl tetraketide pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 16-hydroxy-2-oxohexadecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(3-methyl-2-oxoheptadecyl)pyran-2-one
definition: An acyl tetraketide pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 3-methyl-2-oxoheptadecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(4-methyl-2-oxododecyl)pyran-2-one
definition: An acyl tetraketide pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 4-methyl-2-oxododecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(13-methyl-2-oxononadecyl)pyran-2-one
definition: An acyl tetraketide pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 13-methyl-2-oxononadecyl group.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(13-methyl-2-oxotetradecyl)pyran-2-one
definition: An acyl tetraketide pyran-2-one that is 4-hydroxy-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 13-methyl-2-oxotetradecyl group.

name: 3-methyl-2-indolate
definition: An indolecarboxylate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3-methyl-2-indolic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Fe(CO)2(CN)
definition: An iron coordination entity consisting of two carbonyl and one cyano group coordinated to a central iron atom. The product of HydG, which is then passed onto HydE and HydF to form the H-cluster of the [FeFe]-hydrogenase enzymes.

name: 2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2,6-dimethylheptanoic acid.

name: 4-ethoxyaniline
definition: An aromatic ether that is aniline in which the hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by an ethoxy group. It is a hydrolysis metabolite of phenacetin.

name: (11Z)-18-hydroxyoctadecenoyl-CoA
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (11Z)-18-hydroxyoctadecenoic acid.

name: GDP-α-D-mannuronic acid
definition: A GDP-D-mannuronic acid in which the anomeric centre of the mannuronic acid fragment has α-configuration.

name: (9Z,12Z)-18-hydroxyoctadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (9Z,12Z)-18-hydroxyoctadecadienoic acid.

name: 3-amino-N-(trans-3-carbamoyloxirane-2-carbonyl)-L-alanine
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide consisting of 3-aminoalanine in which the α-amino fuunction is acylated by a 3-carbamoyloxirane-2-carbonyl group. NB Although the relative configuration of the epoxide moiety has been assigned as trans, it has not yet been established whether the absolute configuration is R,R (as drawn) or S,S.

name: 7-hydroxylauric acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid comprising lauric acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 7.

name: 5-amino-5-(4-hydroxybenzyl)-6-(D-ribitylimino)-5,6-dihydrouracil(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the 5-amino group of 5-amino-5-(4-hydroxybenzyl)-6-((2,3,4,5-tetrahydroxypentyl)amino)dihydropyrimidine-2,4-dione.

name: 2,4,7-trihydroxypteridine
definition: A member of the class of pteridines that is pteridine in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 4, and 7 have been replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: 5'-ATGGACCAAAGAGTTTCAGGGA-3'
definition: A single-stranded DNA oligonucleotide comprised of eight deoxyadenosine, four thymidine, three deoxycytidine and seven deoxyguanosine residues connected by 3'→5' phosphodiester linkages in the sequence ATGGACCAAAGAGTTTCAGGGA. It is a mimic of HuR mRNA nucleotides 671-692 and acts as an antagonist that deregulates human antigen R (HuR) expression and inhibits AKTSER473 phosphorylation in prostate and other cancers.

name: O-glutaconyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine where the acyl group specified is glutaconyl.

name: O-tiglyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine compound having trans-2-methyl-2-butenoyl (tiglyl) as the acyl substituent.

name: 1,2-dipalmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-5-phosphate)
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 5-phosphate in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl).

name: O-3-methylglutaryl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine that is L-carnitine having a 3-methylglutaryl group as the acyl substituent

name: (3E,5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3E,5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosapentaenoic acid.

name: O-pimelyl-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine that is L-carnitine having a pimelyl group as the acyl substituent.

name: O-nonanoyl-L-carnitine
definition: The L-enantiomer of O-nonanoylcarnitine.

name: 3-(methylthio)acryloyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA thioester that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-(methylthio)acrylic acid.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-(methylthio)propanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA thioester that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxy-3-(methylthio)propanoic acid.

name: N1,N8-bis(coumaroyl)spermidine
definition: A secondary amino compound that is spermidine in which each of the primary amino groups has been mono-acylated by formal condensation with trans-coumaric acid.

name: trans-4-coumaroyl-CoA
definition: A 4-coumaroyl-CoA in which the double bond of the coumaroyl group has trans-geochemistry.

name: D-galactaro-1,4-lactone
definition: A δ-lactone that is D-galactono-1,4-lactone in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline betaine
definition: An amino-acid betaine that is trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline zwitterion in which both of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen have been replaced by methyl groups.

name: cis-4-hydroxy-D-proline betaine
definition: An amino-acid betaine that is trans-4-hydroxy-D-proline zwitterion in which both of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen have been replaced by methyl groups.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonic acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is guaiacol sulfated at position 4. Commonly used (in the form of its potassium salt) as an expectorant.

name: (R)-(2-chloro-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furyl)acetate
definition: A (2-chloro-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furyl)acetate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (R)-(2-chloro-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furyl)acetic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonate
definition: An arenesulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonic acid.

name: egualen
definition: A member of the class of azulenes carrying sulfo, ethyl and isopropyl substituents at positions 1, 3 and 7 respectively. Used (in the form of its sodium salt) for treatment of gastric ulcers.

name: bismuth(3+)
definition: A bismuth cation having a net electric charge of +3.

name: egualen(1−)
definition: An arenesulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of egualen.

name: 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate groups of 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion resulting from the removal of all four protons from the phosphate groups of 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9α-hydroxyandrost-4-en-3,17-dione
definition: A 3-oxo-Δ4-steroid that is androst-4-ene substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 17 and a hydroxy group at position 9.

name: 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oate(1−)
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 15-dehydroprostaglandin A1
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins A obtained by oxidation of the 15-hydroxy group of prostaglandin A1 to the corresponding ketone.

name: 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oate(1−)
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,4E,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,4E,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosapentaenoic acid.

name: trans-3-cis-5-octadienoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-3-cis-5-octadienoic acid.

name: 2-imino-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinazolin-4-one
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinazoline in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 4 have been replaced by imino and oxo groups, respectively.

name: (5Z)-icosenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (5Z)-icosenoic acid.

name: Ku-0063794
definition: A member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is an mTOR inhibitor and shows anti-tumour properties.

name: 3,17-dihydroxy-9,10-secoandrosta-1,3,5(10)-triene-9-one
definition: A seco-androstane that is 9,10-secoandrostane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at position 3 and 17 and an oxo group at position 9 and in which the A-ring is aromatic.

name: 3,4,17-trihydroxy-9,10-secoandrosta-1,3,5(10)-triene-9-one
definition: A seco-androstane that is 9,10-secoandrostane which is substituted by hydroxy groups at position 3, 4 and 17 and an oxo group at position 9 and in which the A-ring is aromatic.

name: 2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [(1R,2S)-2-hydroxy-1-thiopropyl]phosphonate(2−)
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphonate OH groups of [(1R,2S)-2-hydroxy-1-thiopropyl]phosphonic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (1R,2S)-1-(S-L-cysteinyl)-2-hydroxypropylphosphonate(2−)
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphonate groups as well as protonation of the amino group of (1R,2S)-1-(S-L-cysteinyl)-2-hydroxypropylphosphonate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (1S,2S)-1,2-dihydroxypropylphosphonate(1−)
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of one of the phosphonate OH groups of (1S,2S)-1,2-dihydroxypropylphosphonic acid.

name: glutathione S-sulfinate(2−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and sulfinate groups and protonation of the amino group of glutathione S-sulfinate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-hydroperoxy-10E-octadecenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is 9-hydroperoxy derivative of (10E)-octadecenoic acid.

name: 10-hydroperoxy-8E-octadecenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is 10-hydroperoxy derivative of (8E)-octadecenoic acid.

name: 1-tuberculosinyladenosine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is adenosine alkylated at position N1 by a tuberculosinyl group.

name: tetrachloro(cyclohexane-1,2-diamine-κ2N,N')platinum
definition: A platinum coordination entity consisting of cyclohexane-1,2-diamine co-ordinated via its amino groups to tetrachloroplatinum.

name: dexormaplatin
definition: A tetrachloro(cyclohexane-1,2-diamine-κ2N,N')platinum that is the pharmacologically active (1R,2R)-enantiomer of ormaplatin.

name: 1-(methylthio)ribulose 5-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 1-(methylthio)ribulose 5-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-heptanoyl-L-homoserine
definition: An N-acyl-L-amino acid that is the N-heptanoyl derivative of L-homoserine.

name: (1S,2S)-ormaplatin
definition: A tetrachloro(cyclohexane-1,2-diamine-κ2N,N')platinum that is the pharmacologically inactive (1S,2S)-enantiomer of ormaplatin.

name: satraplatin
definition: A platinum coordination entity that consists of a central platunum atom bound to chloro (x2), acetate (x2), amino, and cyclohexylamino groups. Used for treatment of advanced prostate cancer.

name: JM335
definition: A platinum coordination entity that consists of a central platinum atom bound to chloro (x2), hydroxy (x2), amino, and cyclohexylamino groups.

name: triplatin tetranitrate
definition: A trinuclear platinum coordination entity that is the tetranitrate salt of triplatin.

name: triplatin(4+)
definition: A platinum coordination entity that is the cationic portion of triplatin tetranitrate.

name: 2-bromo-2-{[(4-methylphenyl)sulfonyl]methyl}-1-indanone
definition: A member of the class of indanones that is 1-indanone substituted at position 2 by bromo and [(4-methylphenyl)sulfonyl]methyl groups.

name: neopikromycin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of pikromycin by Streptomyces venezuelae.

name: viridicatumtoxin
definition: A tetracycline-like polyketide antibiotic that is produced by several species of Penicillium and Aspergillus.

name: 2,5-dioxo-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-1,4-benzodiazepine-3-carboxylic acid
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-1,4-benzodiazepine which has been substituted by a carboxy group at position 3 and by oxo groups at positions 2 and 5.

name: 4-amino-1-methylimidazole-5-carboselenoamide
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles bearing methyl, amino and selenocarboxamido substituents at positions 1, 4 and 5 respectively.

name: picarbutrazox
definition: An oxime O-ether that is the (Z)-oxime derivative of 1-methyl-1H-tetrazol-5-yl phenyl ketone in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group has been replaced by the N-tert-butoxycarbonyl derivative of a [6-(Boc-amino)pyridin-2-yl]methyl group. It is a novel fungicide developed for use on cereals.

name: tolprocarb
definition: A carbamate ester that is the 2,2,2-trifluoroethyl ester of [(2S)-3-methyl-1-(4-methylbenzamido)butan-2-yl]carbamic acid. It is a novel systemic fungicide used for controlling rice blast.

name: (Kdo)2-lipid A 1-diphosphate (E. coli)
definition: A lipid A derivative, comprising lipid A glycosylated with two 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues and having a diphosphate in place of the phosphate group at position 1

name: (9S,10R)-10-hydroxy-9-(phosphonooxy)octadecanoic acid
definition: A carboxyalkyl phosphate that is octadecanoic acid carrying phosphonooxy and hydroxy substituents at positions 9 and 10 respectively.

name: (9S,10R)-dihydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is octadecanoic acid carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 9 and 10.

name: (R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoate
definition: A (3R)-3-hydroxy fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (3R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2R)-2-hydroxytetradecanoate
definition: A (2R)-2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (2R)-2-hydroxytetradecanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoate
definition: A (2S)-2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z)-12-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is (9Z)-octadec-9-enoic (oleic) acid carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 12.

name: cis-3-octenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A cis-3-enoyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of cis-3-octenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9E)-12-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is (9E)-octadec-9-enoic (elaidic) acid carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 12.

name: (6Z,9Z,11E)-octadecatrienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecatrienoyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (6Z,9Z,11E)-octadecatrienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: p-nitrophenyl palmitate
definition: A palmitate ester obtained by condensation of the carboxy group of palmitic acid with the phenolic hydroxy group of p-nitrophenol.

name: avilamycin A
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative that is produced by Streptomyces viridochromogenes and exhibits antibiotic properties.

name: avilamycin A precursor
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative that is produced by Streptomyces viridochromogenes and is an epimeric intermediate in the biosynthesis of avilamycin A.

name: (11E,13Z)-octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (11E,13Z)-octadecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,11E)-octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (5Z,11E)-octadecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (6Z,11E)-octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (6Z,11E)-octadecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline-2,4-dione
definition: A member of the class of quinolones that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 4 have been replaced by oxo groups.

name: (3E)-nonenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A trans-3-enoyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3E)-nonenoyl-CoA major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3E)-phycoerythrobilin
definition: The (3E)-isomer of phycoerythrobilin.

name: N-stearoyl-1-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyllysophosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as stearoyl (octadecanoyl) while the phosphatidyl acyl group is specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl)

name: 9,10-epoxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: An epoxy fatty acid consisting of octadecanoic (stearic) acid with a single epoxide located between positions 9 and 10.

name: lixisenatide
definition: A forty-four membered polypeptide consisting of L-His, Gly, L-Glu, Gly, L-Thr, L-Phe, L-Thr, L-Ser, L-Asp, L-Leu, L-Ser, L-Lys, L-Gln, L-Met, L-Glu, L-Glu, L-Glu, L-Ala, L-Val, L-Arg, L-Leu, L-Phe, L-Ile, L-Glu, L-Trp, L-Leu, L-Lys, L-Asn, Gly, Gly, LPro, L-Ser, L-Ser, Gly, L-Ala, L-Pro, L-Pro, L-Ser, L-Lys, L-Lys, L-Lys, L-Lys, L-Lys, and L-Lys-NH2 residues joined in sequence. Used as an adjunct to diet and exercise for the treatment of adults with type II diabetes.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues in a (2→6), (1→4) and (1→3) sequence.

name: N,1-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyllysophosphatidylethanolamine in which both the N- and O-acyl group are specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl).

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide made up from two repeating (1→3)-linked N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl units that are in turn joined to an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue via a (1→4)-linkage.

name: N-arachidonoyl-1-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyllysophosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as arachidonoyl while the phosphatidyl acyl group is specified as oleoyl.

name: N-icosanoyl-1-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyllysophosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as icosanoyl while the phosphatidyl acyl group is specified as oleoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl).

name: N-icosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as icosanoyl.

name: N-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl).

name: N-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as arachidonoyl (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z-icosatetraenoyl).

name: 1-(9Z-octadecenyl)-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-alkyl-2-acyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as 9Z-octadecenyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: oleocanthal
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the 2-(p-hydroxyphenyl)ethyl ester of (3S)-4-formyl-3-(2-oxoethyl)hex-4-enoic acid. Oleocanthal is found in olive oil but it is not clear whether the natural product is a mixture of E/Z isomers or a single isomer as the two isomers readily interconvert in solution; most pharmacological studies will have been performed using a mixture.

name: 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oate(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of the from from the carboxy group of 3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid.

name: 3-phenylpropanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-phenylpropanoic acid.

name: 3-phenylpropanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-phenylpropanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-L-α-D-Hepp6PEtn-(1→5)-[α-D-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-D-Kdo-(2→6)-lipid A
definition: A lipid A derivative in which an α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hep-(1→3)-[β-D-Glc-(1→4)]-L-α-D-Hep6PEtn branched decasaccharide is linked (1→5) to a lipid A component containing four C14 and two C16 fatty acyl chains. Reported as a proposed lipooligosaccharide outer core structure of Campylobacter jejuni strains (CO016 and GC105) isolated from patients with Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) who had anti-GM1b antibodies, but neither anti-GM1 nor anti-GD1a antibodies (PMID:25867522).

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-N-methylethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-N-methylethanolamine zwitterion in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-N,N-dimethylethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-N,N-dimethylethanolamine zwitterion in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl); major species at pH 7.3.

name: water blue
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal condensation of NSC 56820 with 2 mol eq. of sodium hydroxide. It is used as a histological stain for collagen and in Mallory's method for connective tissue.

name: 3-methylindolyl precursor of nosiheptide
definition: A heterodetic cyclic peptide that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of nosiheptide by Streptomyces actuosus

name: 3,4-dimethylindolyl precursor of nosiheptide
definition: A heterodetic cyclic peptide that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of nosiheptide by Streptomyces actuosus

name: L cluster
definition: An iron-sulfur cluster that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of M cluster.

name: 3-[(2-aminoethyl)thio]-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptan-7-one
definition: A member of the class of azabicycloalkanes that is 1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptan-7-one substituted at position 3 by a (2-aminoethyl)thio group.

name: 3-[(2-aminoethyl)thio]-6-methyl-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptan-7-one
definition: A member of the class of azabicycloalkanes that is 1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]heptan-7-one substituted at positions 3 and 6 by (2-aminoethyl)thio and methyl groups respectively.

name: UDP-N-acetylgalactosamine-5,6-ene(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of UDP-N-acetylgalactosamine-5,6-ene.

name: UDP-N-acetyltunicamine-uracil(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of UDP-N-acetyltunicamine-uracil.

name: oxetanocin A 4-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the removal of both of the protons from the dihydrogen phosphate group of oxetanocin A 4-(dihydrogen phosphate).

name: 4β-hydroxycholesterol
definition: A oxysterol that is cholesterol in which the hydrogen at the 4β position has been replaced by a hydroxy group. A metabolite of cholesterol formed by the drug-metabolizing enzyme cytochrome P450 3A4, it is one of the major oxysterols in the human circulation.

name: 4β,7α-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol carrying two additional hydroxy groups at the 4β and 7α positions.

name: N-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl.

name: 1,2-dihexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoglycerol
definition: A dipalmitoyl phosphatidylglycerol in which the stereocentre of the acylated glycerol portion has R-configuration.

name: N-arachidonoyl-1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as arachidonoyl while the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both specified as oleoyl.

name: monodechloroaminopyrrolnitrin
definition: A member of the class of pyrroles carrying a 2-amino-3-chlorophenyl substituent at position 3.

name: aminopyrrolnitrin
definition: A member of the class of pyrroles carrying chloro and 2-amino-3-chlorophenyl substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively.

name: 1-decanoyl-2-oleoylglycerol
definition: A 1,2-diglyceride in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as decanoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked (1→3), (1→4) and (1→3) respectively, with an α-L-fucose residue linked (1→2) to the galactose residue.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose and β-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4).

name: N,1,2-trioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group and the phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl).

name: N-stearoyl-1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as stearoyl (octadecanoyl) while the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprising β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→2).

name: N-myristoyl-1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as myristoyl (tetradecanoyl) while the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl).

name: N-lauroyl-1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as lauroyl (dodecanoyl) while the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl).

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide (dodecasaccharide) comprising two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl disaccharide units linked (1→2) and (1→6) to the α-D-mannosyl residue of an α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine branched pentasaccharide, to the β-D-mannosyl residue of which is also linked (1→3) a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear trisaccharide unit.

name: N-capryl-1-palmitoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as capryl (decanoyl) while the phosphatidyl acyl groups at position 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and linoleoyl (9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl) respectively.

name: N-capryloyl-1-palmitoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as capryloyl (octanoyl) while the phosphatidyl acyl groups at position 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and linoleoyl (9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl) respectively.

name: N-caproyl-1-palmitoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as caproyl (hexanoyl) while the phosphatidyl acyl groups at position 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and linoleoyl (9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl) respectively.

name: N-butyryl-1-palmitoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as butyryl while the phosphatidyl acyl groups at position 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl) and linoleoyl (9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl) respectively.

name: (R)-(2-chloro-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furyl)acetic acid
definition: An optically active form of (2-chloro-5-oxo-2,5-dihydro-2-furyl)acetic acid having R-configuration.

name: heparosan D-glucuronic acid
definition: A heparan composed of a backbone of repeating β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosamine units joined by (1→4)-linkages.

name: heparosan L-iduronic acid
definition: A heparan composed of a backbone of repeating α-L-iduronosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosamine units joined by (1→4)-linkages.

name: (R)-ethylmalonyl-CoA
definition: An ω-carboxyacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with one of the carboxy groups of (R)-ethylmalonic acid.

name: UDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: UDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-glucose in which the anomeric centre of the sugar component has α-configuration.

name: D-glucaro-1,4-lactone
definition: A δ-lactone that is D-glucono-1,4-lactone in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been oxidised to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: N,1-dipalmitoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N-acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl while the phosphatidyl acyl groups at position 1 and 2 are specified as hexadecanoyl and (9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl) respectively.

name: 5α-androstane-3β,7α,17β-triol
definition: A 3β sterol that is 5α-androstane which is substituted by β-hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 17 and by an α-hydroxy group at position 7.

name: N,1-dipalmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acyllysophosphatidylethanolamine in which both the N- and O-acyl group are specified as palmitoyl (hexadecanoyl).

name: 5α-androstane-3β,6α,17β-triol
definition: A 3β sterol that is 5α-androstane which is substituted by β-hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 17 and by an α-hydroxy group at position 6.

name: androst-5-ene-3β,7α,17β-triol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is β-hydroxyandrost-5-ene carrying two additional hydroxy groups at positions 7α and 17β.

name: (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydropteroic acid
definition: A pteroic acid derivative arising from formal hydrogenation of the 5,6- and 7,8-double bonds of pteroic acid.

name: (3β,5α,7α)-3,7-dihydroxyandrostan-17-one
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is 5α-androstan-17-one substituted by a β-hydroxy group at positions 3 and an α-hydroxy group at position 7.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-3,5-bisphosphate)
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 3,5-bisphosphate in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as octanoyl

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide comprising a linear pentasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→4), (1→6) and (1→4), to the galactose residue nearer to the reducing end is also linked (1→3) a branched α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl tetrasaccharide unit.

name: CDP-1-stearoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: CDP-1-palmitoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as palmitoyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAcp
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-L-fucose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucose and N-acetyl-α-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→2), (1→4) and (1→6).

name: CDP-1,2-diarachidonoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as arachidonoyl.

name: CDP-1-stearoyl-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and linoleoyl respectively.

name: CDP-1-stearoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: CDP-1-stearoyl-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as stearoyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: CDP-1,2-dilinoleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as linoleoyl.

name: CDP-1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A CDP-diacylglycerol in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as oleoyl.

name: p-nitrophenyl butyrate
definition: A butyrate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of 4-nitrophenol with the carboxy group of butyric acid.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp6S-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising α-L-fucose, 6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2) and (1→3).

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino disaccharide comprising N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine and N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-D-glucosamine residues linked (1→4).

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide chain of α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→3) and (1→6), to the β-D-galactose residue of which is also linked (1→2) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide chain of α-N-acetylneuramine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→4) and (1→2), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue of which is also linked (1→3) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: 2,3-dehydrobehenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-docosenoic acid. The product of dehydrogenation of behenoyl-CoA

name: N-octanoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: An N-acylsphingosine 1-phosphate in which the N-acyl group is specified as octanoyl.

name: N-oleoylsphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: An N-acylsphingosine 1-phosphate in which the N-acyl group is specified as oleoyl.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→3), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-galactose residue nearest to the non-reducing end is also linked (1→2) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: 2-allyl-1-hydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone
definition: A monohydroxyanthraquinone that is 9,10-anthraquinone in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 2 are replaced by a hydroxy and an allyl group, respectively.

name: 3-dehydrocarnityl CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-dehydrocarnitine.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→8)-α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide comprising two α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl residues, a β-D-galactose residue, an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue, a β-D-galactose residue and (at the reducing end) an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (2→8), (2→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4).

name: N,N,N-trimethylglycyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of glycine betaine.

name: (Z)-hex-3-enoyl-CoA
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (Z)-hex-3-enoic acid.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→8)-α-Neup5Gc-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising two α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl residues, a β-D-galactose residue and (at the reducing end) an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (2→8), (2→6) and (1→4).

name: N-isopropyl-L-glutamine
definition: A N5-alkylglutamine where the alkyl group is isopropyl.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide (tetradecasaccharide) consisting of a linear trisaccharide unit of β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, connected by (1→3) linkages, to the β-D-mannose residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) α-D-mannose residues, the one at O-2 being substituted at O-2 by an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl trisaccharide unit and the one at O-6 being substituted also at both O-2 and O-6 by N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl trisaccharide units.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4) and (1→6), to the reducing-end N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue is also linked (1→3) an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl disaccharide unit.

name: N-(γ-L-glutamyl)-L-alaninol
definition: A N5-alkylglutamine obtained by formal condensation of the side-chain carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of L-alaninol.

name: 4-amino-5-formamidomethyl-2-methylpyrimidine
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidine with the amino group at position 4 with additional methyl and formamidomethyl substituents at positions 2 and 5 respectively.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine with an N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl residue atached at the 3-position.

name: 11-deoxy-β-rhodomycin
definition: A member of the class of anthracyclines that is β-rhodomycin lacking the phenolic hydroxy group at position 11.

name: β-D-GlcpA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: An amino pentasacchride comprising a chain of 3-O-sulfo-β-D-glucuronic acid, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4).

name: 4-pregnen-3β-ol-20-one
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is 4-pregnen-3β-ol substituted by an oxo group at position 20.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol-4-phosphate)
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol 4-phosphate in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as octanoyl.

name: epivancomycin
definition: A glyopeptide that is vancomycin in which the terminal vancosamine of the disaccharide moiety is replaced by 4-epi-vancosamine.

name: 3-methyl-2-indolic acid
definition: An indolecarboxylic acid that is indole-2-carboxylic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a methyl group.

name: 4-pregnen-3β,20α-diol
definition: A C21-steroid in which a pregnane skeleton carries a β-hydroxy group at position 3, an α-hydroxy group at position 20 and a double bond between positions 4 and 5.

name: glutathione S-sulfinate
definition: An S-substituted glutathione that is glutathione in which the mercapto hydrogen has been replaced by a sulfinyl group.

name: cobalt(II)-factor IV
definition: A cobalt-corrinoid heptacarboxylic acid that is produced by Salmonella typhimurium.

name: (2R,3S)-2,7-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyisoflavanone
definition: A 2,7-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyisoflavanone in which positions 2 and 3 have R- and S-configuration respectively.

name: 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oic acid.

name: 2-methyl-L-tryptophan zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 2-methyl-L-tryptophan; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-4-en-22-oic acid.

name: 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchol-4-en-22-oic acid
definition: A steroid acid that is 23,24-bisnor-chol-4-en-22-oic acid bearing additional oxo and hydroxy substituent at positions 3 and 9 respectively.

name: 3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oic acid
definition: A steroid acid that is 23,24-bisnor-chol-1,4-dien-22-oic acid bearing an additional oxo substituent at position 3.

name: 9α-hydroxy-3-oxo-23,24-bisnorchola-1,4-dien-22-oic acid
definition: A steroid acid that is 23,24-bisnor-chol-1,4-dien-22-oic acid bearing additional oxo and hydroxy substituent at positions 3 and 9 respectively.

name: 2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoic acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is 2,4-dihydroxy-2,4-hexadienoic acid bearing additional methyl and oxo substituents at positions 5 and 6 respectively.

name: (9Z,12Z)-hexadeca-9,12,15-trienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (9Z,12Z)-hexadeca-9,12,15-trienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (1R,2S)-1-(S-L-cysteinyl)-2-hydroxypropylphosphonate
definition: An L-cysteine thioether in which the thiol hydrogen is replaced by a (1R,2S)-2-hydroxy-1-phosphonopropyl group

name: [(1R,2S)-2-hydroxy-1-thiopropyl]phosphonic acid
definition: A member of the class of phosphonic acids that is propylphosphonic acid substituted by thio and hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively (the 1R,2S-stereoisomer)

name: (1S,2S)-1,2-dihydroxypropylphosphonic acid
definition: A member of the class of phosphonic acids that is propylphosphonic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 2 (the 1S,2S-stereoisomer).

name: (1S,2S)-1,2-dihydroxypropylphosphonate(2−)
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphonate OH groups of (1S,2S)-1,2-dihydroxypropylphosphonic acid.

name: (14Z)-hexadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A hexadecenoyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (14Z)-hexadecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (14E)-hexadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (14E)-hexadecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E)-3-tosylacrylonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acrylonitrile in which the hydrogen located β,trans to the cyano group is replaced by a tosyl group. It is an inhibitor of cytokine-induced IκB-α phosphorylation in cells.

name: 1-(methylthio)ribulose 5-phosphate
definition: A ketopentose phosphate that is D-ribulose 5-phosphate in which the 1-hydroxy group is replaced by a methylthio group.

name: (2R)-2-hydroxytetradecanoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxymyristic acid having 2R-configuration.

name: (3S)-isoflavanone
definition: The (3S)-enantiomer of isoflavanone.

name: 5-amino-5-(4-hydroxybenzyl)-6-(D-ribitylimino)-5,6-dihydrouracil
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidones that is 5,6-diamino-5-[(4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl]pyrimidine-2,4-dione in which the imino hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a D-ribityl group.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxytetradecanoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxymyristic acid having 2S-configuration.

name: cis-3-octenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of cis-3-octenoic acid.

name: (6Z,9Z,11E)-octadecatrienoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecatrienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (6Z,9Z,11E)-octadecatrienoic acid.

name: 2-methylpentadec-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: A 2-methylpentadecenoyl-CoA in which the double bond is located at position 2 (geochemistry not specified).

definition: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-D-Glcp6S in which the anomeric configuration of the 6-O-sulfo-D-glucose residue at the reducing end is β.

name: (11E,13Z)-octadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (11E,13Z)-octadecadienoic acid.

name: (5Z,11E)-octadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (5Z,11E)-octadecadienoic acid.

name: (6Z,11E)-octadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An octadecadienoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (6Z,11E)-octadecadienoic acid.

name: (3E)-nonenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3E)-nonenoic acid.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-N-methylethanolamine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-N-methylethanolamine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-N,N-dimethylethanolamine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-N,N-dimethylethanolamine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups are both specified as oleoyl (9Z-octadecenoyl); major species at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-N-acetylgalactosamine-5,6-ene
definition: A UDP-amino sugar having N-acetylgalactosamine-5,6-ene as the amino sugar component.

name: UDP-N-acetyltunicamine-uracil
definition: A UDP-amino sugar that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of the tunicamycins.

name: ivabradine
definition: A member of the class of benzazepines that is 7,8-dimethoxy-1,3,4,5-tetrahydro-3-benzazepin-2-one in which the amide hydrogen is replaced by a [{[(7S)-3,4-dimethoxybicyclo[4.2.0]octa-1,3,5-trien-7-yl]methyl}(methyl)amino]propyl} group. Used (as its hydrochloride salt) to treat patients with angina who have intolerance to beta blockers and/or heart failure.

name: BNPS-skatole
definition: A bromoindole that is 3H-indole in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by an (o-nitrophenyl)sulfanyl group and in which the hydrogens at position 3 have been replaced by a bromine and a methyl group. It is used particularly for the selective cleavage of tryptophanyl peptide bonds (cleavage occurs at peptide bonds after amino acids with available Cγ=Cδ double bonds such as tryptophan, tyrosine, and histidine).

name: ivabradine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining ivabradine with one molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid. Used to treat patients with angina who have intolerance to beta blockers and/or heart failure.

name: D-arabinofuranose 5-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-arabinofuranose-5-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ivabradine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group of ivabradine.

name: edoxaban
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is used (as its tosylate monohydrate) for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

name: edoxaban tosylate hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate of the tosylate salt of edoxaban. Used for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

name: edoxaban tosylate
definition: An organosulfonate salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of edoxaban and 4-toluenesulfonic acid. Used (in the form of its monohydrate) for the treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

name: edoxaban(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of edoxaban.

name: isavuconazonium sulfate
definition: An azaheterocycle sulfate salt that is a prodrug for isavuconazole, an antifungal agent used for the treatment of invasive aspergillosis and invasive mucormycosis.

name: isavuconazonium
definition: An organic cation that is the cationic portion of isavuconazonium sulfate (a prodrug for isavuconazole, an antifungal agent used for the treatment of invasive aspergillosis and invasive mucormycosis).

name: isavuconazole
definition: A 1,3-thiazole that is butan-2-ol which is substituted at positions 1, 2, and 3 by 1,2,4-triazol-1-yl, 2,5-difluorophenyl, and 4-(p-cyanophenyl)-1,3-thiazol-2-yl groups, respectively. It is an antifungal drug used for the treatment of invasive aspergillosis and invasive mucormycosis.

name: eluxadoline
definition: An amino acid amide obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-carbamoyl-2,6-dimethyl-L-phenylalanine with the secondary amino group of 2-methoxy-5-({[(1S)-1-(4-phenylimidazol-2-yl)ethyl]amino}methyl)benzoic acid. It has mixed opioid receptor activity and is used for treatment of irritable bowel syndrome with diarrhoea.

name: L-homocarnosine
definition: A homocarnosine that has S configuration.

name: avibactam sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of avibactam. Used in combination with ceftazidime pentahydrate for the treatment of complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis.

name: butyl octadecanoate
definition: A fatty acid ester that is the butyl ester of stearic acid.

name: avibactam
definition: A member of the class of azabicycloalkanes that is (2S,5R)-7-oxo-1,6-diazabicyclo[3.2.1]octane-2-carboxamide in which the amino hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a sulfooxy group. Used (in the form of its sodium salt) in combination with ceftazidime pentahydrate for the treatment of complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis.

name: 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-2-octulosonate-8-phosphate(3−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phospho groups of 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-2-octulosonic acid 8-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonate
definition: A carbohydrate acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: CMP-3-deoxy-β-D-manno-octulosonate(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and phosphate functions of CMP-3-deoxy-β-D-manno-octulosonic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: avibactam(1−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of avibactam, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group.

name: panobinostat
definition: A hydroxamic acid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2E)-3-[4-({[2-(2-methylindol-3-yl)ethyl]amino}methyl)phenyl]prop-2-enoic acid with the amino group of hydroxylamine. A histone deacetylase inhibitor used (as its lactate salt) in combination with bortezomib and dexamethasone for the treatment of multiple myeloma.

name: panobinostat lactate
definition: A lactate salt having panobinostat(1+) as the counterion. A histone deacetylase inhibitor used in combination with bortezomib and dexamethasone for the treatment of multiple myeloma.

name: panobinostat(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino function of panobinostat.

name: palbociclib
definition: A member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is 2-{[5-(piperazin-1-yl)pyridin-2-yl]amino}pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidin-7-one bearing additional methyl, acetyl and cyclopentyl substituents at positions 5, 6 and 8 respectively. It is used in combination with letrozole for the treatment of metastatic breast cancer.

name: lenvatinib
definition: A member of the class of quinolines that is the carboxamide of 4-{3-chloro-4-[(cyclopropylcarbamoyl)amino]phenoxy}-7-methoxyquinoline-6-carboxylic acid. A multi-kinase inhibitor and orphan drug used (as its mesylate salt) for the treatment of various types of thyroid cancer that do not respond to radioiodine.

name: lenvatinib mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate salt obtained by reaction of lenvatinib with one molar equivalent of methanesulfonic acid. A multi-kinase inhibitor and orphan drug used (as its mesylate salt) for the treatment of various types of thyroid cancer that do not respond to radioiodine.

name: sangivamycin
definition: A nucleoside analogue that is adenosine in which the nitrogen at position 7 is replaced by a carbamoyl-substituted carbon. It is a potent inhibitor of protein kinase C.

name: lenvatinib(1+)
definition: A quinolinium ion obtained by protonation of the quinoline nitrogen of lenvatinib.

name: 5-hydroxy-2,4-dioxopentanoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-hydroxy-2,4-dioxopentanoic acid.

name: 5-(3-carboxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl)-4-hydroxy-6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyridine-2-carboxylate
definition: An oxo carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-(3-carboxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl)-4-hydroxy-6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyridine-2-carboxylic acid.

name: 5-(2'-formylethyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinate
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylate that is the conjugate base of 5-(2'-formylethyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinic acid.

name: 5-(2'-carboxyethyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinic acid
definition: A pyridone that is 6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyridine-2-carboxylic acid substituted by a 2-carboxyethyl group at position 5.

name: 5-(3'-carboxy-3'-oxopropyl)-4,6-dihydroxypicolinic acid
definition: A pyridone that is 4-hydroxy-6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyridine-2-carboxylic acid substituted by a 3-carboxy-3-oxopropyl group at position 5.

name: 6-oxo-2-hydroxy-7-(4'-chlorophenyl)-3,8,8-trichloroocta-2E,4E,7E-trienoic acid
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 3,8,8-trichloroocta-2,4,7-trienoic acid substituted by a 4-chlorophenyl group at position 7, a hydroxy group at position 2 and an oxo group at position 6.

name: bohemine
definition: Purine substituted on C-2, C-6 and N-9 with (3-hydroxypropyl)amino, benzylamino and isopropyl groups respectively; a synthetic, cell-permeable, cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) inhibitor that is structurally similar to olomoucine and roscovitine.

name: oxetanocin A 4-(dihydrogen phosphate)
definition: A nucleoside phosphate that is oxetanocin A in which the hydroxy of the hydroxymethyl group attached to the carbon bonded to the oxetane oxygen has been converted into the corresponding dihydrogen phosphate.

name: oxetanocin A
definition: A nucleoside analogue found in Bacillus megaterium in which an adenine moiety is attached to position 2 of a of an oxetane ring which is substituted at positions 3 and 4 by hydroxymethyl groups.

name: 2-hydroxytestosterone
definition: An androstanoid that is testosterone substituted at C2 by a hydroxy group with undefined stereochemistry.

name: 3,22-dioxochol-4-en-24-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3,22-dioxochol-4-ene-24-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: GDP-N,N'-diacetylbacillosamine(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of GDP-N,N'-diacetylbacillosamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3β-hydroxychola-5,20(22)-dien-24-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3β-hydroxychola-5,20(22)-dien-24-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3β-hydroxychol-5-en-24-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3β-hydroxychol-5-en-24-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 20-methyl-3-oxopregna-4,17-dien-21-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 20-methyl-3-oxopregna-4,17-dien-21-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9R,10S)-9(10)-EpOME
definition: A 9(10)-EpOME in which the epoxide has 9R,10S stereochemistry.

name: 17-hydroxy-3-oxopregn-4-en-20-carboxy-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 17-hydroxy-3-oxopregn-4-en-20-carboxy-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E)-hexadecenoylcarnitine
definition: An O-hexadecenoylcarnitine having (2E)-hexadecenoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: 3β-hydroxychola-5,22-dien-24-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3β-hydroxychola-5,22-dien-24-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9E)-octadec-9-enoylcarnitine
definition: An O-octadecenoylcarnitine in which the acyl group is specified as (9E)-octadec-9-enoyl.

name: 3-hydroxyoctanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-hydroxyoctanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxydecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-hydroxydecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methyl-3-oxopalmitoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 2-methyl-3-oxopalmitoyl-CoA.

name: 18-hydroxyoleoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 18-hydroxyoleoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: O-acetyl-D-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-D-carnitine in which the acyl group specified is acetyl.

name: 18-hydroxyoctadecanoate
definition: An ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 18-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: O-malonyl-D-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-D-carnitine in which the acyl group specified is malonyl.

name: O-pivaloylcarnitine
definition: A C5-acylcarnitine in which the acyl group specified is pivaloyl.

name: O-valeroylcarnitine
definition: A C5-acylcarnitine in which the acyl group specified is valeroyl.

name: O-octanoyl-D-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-D-carnitine in which the acyl group specified as octanoyl.

name: 18-hydroxyoleoyl-CoA
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 18-hydroxyoleic acid.

name: ethyl hexanoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester obtained by the formal condensation of hexanoic acid with ethanol.

name: aldehydo-L-talose
definition: The acyclic form of L-talose.

name: L-talopyranose
definition: The pyranose form of L-talose.

name: L-idopyranose
definition: The pyranose form of L-idose.

name: abietatriene
definition: A diterpene that is abietane having three double bonds located at positions 8, 11 and 13.

name: 5-hydroxyconiferyl alcohol
definition: A phenylpropanoid that is cinnamyl alcohol in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 4 on the benzene ring are replaced by hydroxy groups while that at position 5 is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: caffeyl alcohol
definition: A phenylpropanoid that is cinnamyl alcohol in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 4 on the benzene ring are replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: (24S,25)-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 24S and 25.

name: (24S,26)-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 24S and 26.

name: O-propenoyl-D-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine in which the acyl group specified is propenoyl.

name: (E)-p-coumaroylagmatine(1+)
definition: A p-coumaroylagmatine(1+) in which the double bond of the coumaroyl component has E-geochemistry.

name: (E)-p-coumaroylagmatine
definition: A p-coumaroylagmatine(1+) in which the double bond of the coumaroyl component has E-geochemistry.

name: O-glutaconylcarnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine in which the acyl group specified is glutaconyl.

name: (Z)-p-coumaroylagmatine(1+)
definition: A p-coumaroylagmatine(1+) in which the double bond of the coumaroyl component has Z-geochemistry.

name: O-pimelylcarnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine in which the acyl group specified is pimelyl.

name: (Z)-p-coumaroylagmatine
definition: A p-coumaroylagmatine in which the double bond of the coumaroyl component has Z-geochemistry.

name: N-[(11Z)-octadecenoyl]-sphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: A N-octadecenoylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine in which the acyl group specified is (11Z)-octadecenoyl.

name: 4β,24S-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4β and 24S.

name: 1,2-di-O-pentadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 30:0 in which the acyl group specified at positions 1 and 2 is pentadecanoyl.

name: 1-stearoyl-2-myristoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 32:0 in which the acyl group specified at positions 1 and 2 are stearoyl and myristoyl respectively.

name: 1-myristoyl-2-stearoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 32:0 in which the acyl group specified at positions 1 and 2 are myristoyl and stearoyl respectively.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-methoxycinnamoylagmatine
definition: A member of the class of cinnamamides obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-hydroxy-3-methoxycinnamid with the amino group of agmatine.

name: 1-[(9Z)-octadecenoyl]-2-tetradecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 32:1 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are oleoyl and myristoyl respectively.

name: (Z)-4-hydroxy-3-methoxycinnamoylagmatine
definition: A 4-hydroxy-3-methoxycinnamoylagmatine in which the double bond of the 4-hydroxy-3-methoxycinnamoyl component has Z-geochemistry.

name: 1-tetradecanoyl-2-[(9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 32:2 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are tetradecanoyl and (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl respectively.

name: 1-tetradecanoyl-2-[(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 32:3 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are tetradecanoyl and (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoyl respectively.

name: (25R)-3β-hydroxycholest-5-en-26-al
definition: A 3β-hydroxycholest-5-en-26-al in which the stereocentre at position 25 has R-configuration.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 34:1 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are octadecanoyl and (9Z)-hexadecenoyl respectively.

name: (25R)-3β-hydroxycholest-5-en-26-oate
definition: A 3β-hydroxycholest-5-en-26-oate in which the stereocentre at position 25 has R-configuration.

name: 1-[(9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl]-2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 34:2 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl and linoleoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(9Z)-octadecenoyl]-2-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 34:2 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are (9Z)-octadecenoyl and (9Z)-hexadecenoyl respectively.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-[(6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 34:4 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecanoyl and (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoyl respectively.

name: 1-tetradecanoyl-2-[(5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 34:4 in which teh acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are tetradecanoyl and (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoyl respectively.

name: 1-docosanoyl-2-tetradecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:0 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are docosanoyl and tetradecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-tetradecanoyl-2-docosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are tetradecanoyl and docosanoyl respectively.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-[(11Z)-octadecenoyl]-sn-glycerophosphochlonine
definition: A 1-octadecanoyl-2-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are octadecanoyl and (11Z)-octadecenoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(11Z)-octadecenoyl]-2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-octadecanoyl-2-octadecenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are (11Z)-octadecenoyl and octadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl]-2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:2 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl and octadecanoyl respectively.

name: (25R)-4β,26-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol which is substituted by hydroxy groups at 4β and 26 positions and has R-configuration at position 25.

name: 1,2-di-[(11Z)-octadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-di-octadecenoylsn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group specified at positions 1 and 2 is 11Z)-octadecenoyl .

name: (25R)-3β,4β-dihydroxycholest-5-en-26-al
definition: A 26-oxo steroid resulting from the oxidation of the terminal methyl group of 4β,26-dihydroxycholesterol to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: (25R)-3β,4β-dihydroxycholest-5-en-26-oate(1−)
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (25R)-3β,4β-dihydroxycholest-5-en-26-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-[(6Z,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:3 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are octadecanoyl and (6Z,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoyl respectively.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-[(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:3 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as hexadecanoyl and (5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoyl respectively.

name: (11Z)-hexadec-11-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (11Z)-hexadec-11-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-[(8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatrienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:3 in which the acyl group specified at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecanoyl and (8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatrienoyl respectively.

name: (10E,12Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (10E,12Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-[(6Z,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoyl]-2-[(9Z)-octadecenoyl]-snglycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 36:4 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are (6Z,9Z,12Z)-octadecatrienoyl and (9Z)-octadecenoyl respectively.

name: 4-aminoazobenzene-3,4'-disulfonic acid
definition: A member of the class of azobenzenes that is azobenzene in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted at the para position by a sulfo group, while the other is substituted at a meta position by a sulfo group and at the para position by an amino group. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'fast yellow'.

name: 4-aminoazobenzene-3,4'-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the sulfo groups of 4-aminoazobenzene-3,4'-disulfonic acid.

name: fast yellow
