definition: A 4-[2-(2-methyl-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)ethyl]-3-(non-8-en-1-yl)oxetan-2-one in which the stereocentres at positions 3 and 4 have R-configuration.

name: (3S,4S)-A2-58-06
definition: A 4-[2-(2-methyl-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)ethyl]-3-(non-8-en-1-yl)oxetan-2-one in which the stereocentres at positions 3 and 4 have S-configuration.

name: (2R)-2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: The 2R stereoisomer of 2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA(4−).

name: (2S)-2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: The 2S stereoisomer of 2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA(4−).

name: 1-[(9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl]-2-icosanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A diacylglycerol 38:2 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are (9Z,12Z)-octadecadienoyl and icosanoyl respectively.

name: 2-oxohexadecanoic acid
definition: An oxo fatty acid that is the 2-oxo derivative of hexadecanoic (palmitic) acid.

name: stattic
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzothiophenes that is 1-benzothiophene-1,1-dioxide substituted at position 6 by a nitro group. Used as a radiosensitising agent for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.

name: N-methyl-3-phenyl-3-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]propan-1-amine
definition: An aromatic ether consisting of 4-trifluoromethylphenol in which the hydrogen of the phenolic hydroxy group is replaced by a 3-(methylamino)-1-phenylpropyl group.

name: (R)-fluoxetine
definition: An N-methyl-3-phenyl-3-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]propan-1-amine that has R configuration. [The antidepressant drug fluoxetine is a racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-fluoxetine].

name: (S)-fluoxetine
definition: An N-methyl-3-phenyl-3-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]propan-1-amine that has S configuration. [The antidepressant drug fluoxetine is a racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)- and (S)-fluoxetine].

name: (R)-fluoxetine(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the protonation of the amino group of (R)-fluoxetine.

name: carboxyphosphate(2−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and one of the phosphate OH groups of carboxyphosphoric acid

name: (S)-fluoxetine(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the protonation of the amino group of (S)-fluoxetine.

name: (R)-fluoxetine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of (R)-fluoxetine with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: (S)-fluoxetine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of (S)-fluoxetine with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-Glcp6S
definition: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-Glcp6S in which the anomeric configuration of the glucose residue is β.

name: β-MurNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide comprising an N-acetyl-β-muramyl residue linked (1→4) to N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc in which the anomeric configuration of the GalNAc residue at the reducing end is α.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprised of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→3) and (1→6).

name: vanadyl sulfate dihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of vanadyl sulfate.

name: vanadyl sulfate trihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the trihydrate form of vanadyl sulfate.

name: vanadyl sulfate hexahydrate
definition: A vanadyl sulfate hydrate containing six water molecules.

name: eslicarbazepine acetate
definition: The acetate ester, with S configuration, of licarbazepine. An anticonvulsant, it is approved for use in Europe and the United States as an adjunctive therapy for epilepsy.

name: vanadyl sulfate hydrate
definition: A hydrate derived from vanadyl sulfate (number of water molecules is not specified).

name: flexirubin
definition: The parent member of the class of flexirubins obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 17-(4-hydroxy-3-methylphenyl)heptadeca-2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16-octaenoic acid with one of the phenolic hydroxy groups of 2-dodecyl-5-methyl resorcinol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide in which two tetrasaccharide branches, each formed from fucose, galactose, N-acetylglucosamine and mannose residues linked α(1→2), β(1→4) and β(1→2) respectively, are linked α(1→3) and α(1→6) to the mannose residue of a trisaccharide chain consisting of mannose and two N-acetylglucosamine residues all linked β(1→4) with a β-configuration of the anomeric carbon of the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: seldomycin 5
definition: An aminoglycoside antibiotic that is part of an antimicrobial complex consisting of factors 1,2,3,5 from a soil isolate named Streptomyces hofunensis.

name: 4,4-dimethyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
definition: A cholestanoid that is 5α-cholesta-8-en-3β-ol bearing two additional methyl substituents at position 4.

name: 4α-hydroxymethyl-4β-methyl-5α-8-cholesten-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying hydroxymethyl and methyl substituents at position 4.

name: 4α-formyl-4β-methyl-5α-8-cholesten-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying formyl and methyl substituents at position 4.

name: 3β-hydroxy-4β-methyl-5α-cholest-8-ene-4α-carboxylate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3β-hydroxy-4β-methyl-5α-cholest-8-ene-4α-carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: palmitoyllipid A(4−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of palmitoyllipid A; major species at pH 7.3.

name: lipid IVB(4−)
definition: An lipid IVA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of lipid IVB; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4α-methyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo steroid that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3-one carrying an additional methyl substituent at position 4α.

name: 4α-methyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying an additional methyl substituent at position 4α.

name: acid fuchsin
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 2-amino-5-[(4-amino-3-sulfophenyl)(4-imino-3-sulfocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)methyl]-3-methylbenzene-1-sulfonic acid. It is used in the Van Gieson method in conjunction with picric acid to demonstrate collagen fibres red, and in Masson's trichrome to colour smooth muscle in contrast to collagen.

name: 4α-hydroxymethyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying an additional hydroxymethyl substituent at position 4α.

name: 4α-formyl-5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying an additional formyl substituent at position 4α.

name: 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholest-8-ene-4α-carboxylate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholest-8-ene-4α-carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5α-cholest-8-en-3-one
definition: A cholestanoid that is 5α-cholest-8-ene substituted at position 3 by an oxo group.

name: lanost-8-ene-3β,30-diol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is lanost-8-ene carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 3β and 30.

name: lipid IIB(2−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of lipid IIB; major species at pH 7.3.

name: acid fuchsin (free acid form)
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is 3-[(4-amino-3-methylphenyl)(4-aminophenyl)methylidene]-6-iminocyclohexa-1,4-diene-1-sulfonic acid in which the hydrogens ortho to the amino functions are replaced by phenyl groups. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'acid fuchsin'.

name: 3β-hydroxylanost-8-en-32-al
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is lanost-8-ene carrying hydroxy and oxo substituents at positions 3β and 30 respectively.

name: acid fuchsin(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by the removal of two protons from 2-amino-5-[(4-amino-3-sulfophenyl)(4-imino-3-sulfocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)methyl]-3-methylbenzene-1-sulfonic acid (the free acid form of the biological stain 'acid fuchsin').

name: acid green 5
definition: An organic sodium salt having 3-[(ethyl{4-[(4-{ethyl[(3-sulfonatophenyl)methyl]amino}phenyl)(4-sulfonatophenyl)methylidene]cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene}azaniumyl)methyl]benzene-1-sulfonate as the counterion. It is the standard dye in North American for staining collagen and is also used extensively in plant histology.

name: acid green 5(1+)
definition: The iminium ion derived from acid green 5 (the disodium salt).

name: acid green 5(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by the removal of two protons from N-ethyl-4-[(4-{ethyl[(3-sulfophenyl)methyl]amino}phenyl)(4-sulfophenyl)methylidene]-N-[(3-sulfophenyl)methyl]cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-iminium (the free acid form of the biological stain 'acid green 5').

name: naphthol green B
definition: An organic sodium salt composed of iron(3+), sodium and 5-(oxidoimino)-6-oxo-5,6-dihydronaphthalene-2-sulfonate ions in a 1:1:3 ratio. Used to stain collagen and animal tissue.

name: 5-(hydroxyimino)-6-oxo-5,6-dihydronaphthalene-2-sulfonic acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is 5,6-dihydronaphthalene-2-sulfonic acid bearing hydroxyimino and oxo substituents at positions 5 and 6 respectively. The trisodium-iron(3+) salt is the biological stain 'naphthol green B'.

name: 5-(oxidoimino)-6-oxo-5,6-dihydronaphthalene-2-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo and hydroxyimino groups of 5-(hydroxyimino)-6-oxo-5,6-dihydronaphthalene-2-sulfonic acid.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)}-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: An eight-membered glucosamine oligosaccharide that consists of the disaccharide β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc, to the glucose residue of which are attached α-L-Fuc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc and β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc groups at O-3 and O-6 respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcppNAc-(1→3)}-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A nine-membered glucosamine oligosaccharide that consists of the disaccharide β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc, to the galactose residue of which are attached α-L-Fuc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc and β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc groups at O-3 and O-6 respectively. It is found in human milk.

name: rosaramicin
definition: A macrolide antibiotic with activity against Neisseria gonorrhoeae, Chlamydia trachomatis, Ureaplasma urealyticum and Mycoplasma hominis.

name: 35-aminobacteriohopane-30,31,32,33,34-pentol
definition: A member of the class of hopanoids that is bacteriohopane-30,31,32,33,34-pentol carrying an additional amino substituent at position 35. Isolated from Methylococcus capsulatus.

name: 35-amino-3-methylbacteriohopane-30,31,32,33,34-pentol
definition: A member of the class of hopanoids that is bacteriohopane-30,31,32,33,34-pentol carrying additional methyl and amino substituents at positions 3 and 35 respectively. Isolated from Methylococcus capsulatus.

name: 35-aminobacteriohopane-31,32,33,34-tetrol
definition: A member of the class of hopanoids that is bacteriohopane-31,32,33,34-tetrol carrying an additional amino substituent at position 35. Isolated from Methylococcus capsulatus.

name: 35-amino-3-methylbacteriohopane-31,32,33,34-tetrol
definition: A member of the class of hopanoids that is bacteriohopane-31,32,33,34-tetrol carrying additional methyl and amino substituents at positions 3 and 35 respectively. Isolated from Methylococcus capsulatus.

name: 2-O-(α-D-glucosyl)-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 2-O-(α-D-glucosyl)-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7R)-6-deoxy-D-manno-oct-7-ulosuronate
definition: A carbohydrate acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (7R)-6-deoxy-D-manno-oct-7-ulosuronic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-amino-3,8-dideoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 8-amino-3,8-dideoxy-α-D-manno-octulosonic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-hydroxy-8-[(E)-phenyldiazenyl]naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid carrying additional hydroxy and phenyldiazenyl substituents at positions 7 and 8 respectively. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'orange G'.

name: 7-hydroxy-8-[(E)-phenyldiazenyl]naphthalene-1,3-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the sulfo groups of 7-hydroxy-8-[(E)-phenyldiazenyl]naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid.

name: acid red 4
definition: An organic sodium salt having 4-hydroxy-3-[(2-methoxyphenyl)diazenyl]naphthalene-1-sulfonate as the counterion.

name: lipid A 1-(2-aminoethyl diphosphate)(3−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of lipid A 1-(2-aminoethyl diphosphate); major species at pH 7.3.

name: lipid A 1,4'-bis(2-aminoethyl diphosphate)(2−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino groups of lipid A 1,4'-bis(2-aminoethyl diphosphate); major species at pH 7.3.

name: lipid A 4'-(2-aminoethyl diphosphate)(3−)
definition: A lipid A oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of lipid A 4'-(2-aminoethyl diphosphate); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-[(2-methoxyphenyl)diazenyl]naphthalene-1-sulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is naphthalene-1-sulfonic acid carrying additional hydroxy and (2-methoxyphenyl)diazenyl substituents at positions 4 and 3 respectively. The sodium salt is the biological stain 'acid red 4'.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-[(2-methoxyphenyl)diazenyl]naphthalene-1-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of 4-hydroxy-3-[(2-methoxyphenyl)diazenyl]naphthalene-1-sulfonic acid.

name: 2-tert-butyl-9-fluoro-1,6-dihydrobenzo[h]imidazo[4,5-f]isoquinolin-7-one
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1,6-dihydrobenzo[h]imidazo[4,5-f]isoquinolin-7-one bearing additional tert-butyl and fluoro substituents at positions 2 and 9 respectively.

name: 4-[(2,4-dimethylphenyl)diazenyl]-3-hydroxynaphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid carrying additional hydroxy and (2,4-dimethylphenyl)diazenyl substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'acid red 26'.

name: 4-[(2,4-dimethylphenyl)diazenyl]-3-hydroxynaphthalene-2,7-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the sulfo groups of 4-[(2,4-dimethylphenyl)diazenyl]-3-hydroxynaphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid.

name: acid red 29
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 4,5-dihydroxy-3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid. It is used as the plasma stain in trichrome techniques.

name: 7-O-[(2-aminoethyl)phosphoryl]-α-Kdo-(2→4)-α-Kdo-(2→6)-lipid IVA(6−)
definition: A lipid IVA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of 7-O-[(2-aminoethyl)phosphoryl]-α-Kdo-(2→4)-α-Kdo-(2→6)-lipid IVA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4,5-dihydroxy-3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid carrying two additional hydroxy substituents at positions 4 and 5 as well as a phenyldiazenyl substituent at position 3. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'acid red 29'.

name: juvenile hormone I carboxylate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of juvenile hormone I carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4,5-dihydroxy-3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the sulfo groups of 4,5-dihydroxy-3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid.

name: acid red 44
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 7-hydroxy-8-[(naphthalen-1-yl)diazenyl]naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid.

name: 7-hydroxy-8-[(naphthalen-1-yl)diazenyl]naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid carrying additional hydroxy and (naphthalen-1-yl)diazenylsubstituents at positions 7 and 8 respectively. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'acid red 44'.

name: 7-hydroxy-8-[(naphthalen-1-yl)diazenyl]naphthalene-1,3-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the sulfo groups of 7-hydroxy-8-[(naphthalen-1-yl)diazenyl]naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid.

name: erythrosin
definition: An organoiodine compound that is the ring opened tautomer of fluorescein substituted at positions 2, 4, 5 and 7 by iodo groups.

name: erythrosin(2−)
definition: A benzoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phenol groups of erythrosin.

name: (R)-2-hydroxy-4-methylpentanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of (R)-2-hydroxy-4-methylpentanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-methylpent-2-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 4-methylpent-2-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: bisanhydrobacterioruberin
definition: A C50 carotenoid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of bacterioruberin, a red-coloured pigment found in several Halobacterium and Haloarcula species.

name: monoanhydrobacterioruberin
definition: A C50 carotenoid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of bacterioruberin, a red-coloured pigment found in several Halobacterium and Haloarcula species.

name: tulipalin B
definition: A member of the class of butan-4-olides that is 3-methylidenebutan-4-olide carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 4 (the 4R-enantiomer)

name: 6-tuliposide B
definition: A 6-O-acyl-D-glucose in which the 6-acyl group is specified as (3S)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-methylidenebutanoyl. A secondary metabolite with potent antibacterial activity, occurring specifically in tulip anthers.

name: 5-epi-valiolone 7-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 5-epi-valiolone 7-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: TDP-β-L-rhamnose
definition: A TDP-sugar having β-L-rhamnose as the sugar component.

name: TDP-actinospectose
definition: A TDP-sugar having actinospectose as the sugar component.

name: 7-methyl-GTP(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of 7-methyl-GTP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-caffeoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-trans-caffeoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dihydrocaffeoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of hydrocaffeoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-methyldecan-1-ol
definition: A fatty alcohol that is decan-1-ol in which one of the hydrogens at position 9 has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: 3-oxochol-4-en-24-oyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-oxochol-4-en-24-oic acid.

name: 3-oxochola-4,22-dien-24-oyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-oxochola-4,22-dien-24-oic acid.

name: 3-oxocholesta-4,24-dien-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-oxocholesta-4,24-dien-26-oic acid.

name: N-myristoylglycine
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as myristoyl (tetradecanoyl).

name: (Z)-N-cyclopropyl-11-methyldodec-2-enamide
definition: An enamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (Z)-11-methyldodec-2-enoic acid with the amino group of cyclopropylamine.

name: (Z)-11-methyl-N-(methylsulfonyl)dodec-2-enamide
definition: An N-sulfonylcarboxamide that is (Z)-11-methyldodec-2-enamide in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a methanesulfonyl (mesyl) group.

name: (Z)-N-hydroxy-11-methyldodec-2-enamide
definition: A hydroxamic acid resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (Z)-11-methyldodec-2-enoic acid with the nitrogen of hydroxylamine.

name: (Z)-14-methylpentadec-2-enoic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is cis-2-pentadecenoic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 14 has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: (Z)-tetradec-2-enoic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is tetradecanoic acid (myristic acid) which has undergone formal dehydrogenation to introduce a double bond with Z configuration between positions 2 and 3.

name: (Z)-13-methyltetradec-2-enoic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is cis-2-tetradecenoic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 13 has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: N-[(Z)-11-methyldodec-2-enoyl]piperidine
definition: An N-acylpiperidine resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (Z)-11-methyldodec-2-enoic acid with the amino group of piperidine.

name: 9-methyldecanal
definition: A saturated fatty aldehyde resulting from the formal oxidation of the hydroxy group of 9-methyldecan-1-ol to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: ethyl 11-methyldodec-2-enoate
definition: An enoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 11-methyldodec-2-enoic acid with the hydroxy group of ethanol.

name: ethyl dodec-2-enoate
definition: A long-chain fatty acid ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of dodec-2-enoic acid with the hydroxy group of ethanol.

name: (E)-11-methyldodec-2-enoic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is trans-dodec-2-enoic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 11 has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: N-[(Z)-dodec-2-enoyl]pyrrolidine
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (Z)-dodec-2-enoic acid with the amino group of pyrrolidine.

name: N-[(Z)-dodec-2-enoyl]piperidine
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (Z)-dodec-2-enoic acid with the nitrogen of piperidine.

name: (Z)-N-cyclopropyldodec-2-enamide
definition: An enamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (Z)-dodec-2-enoic acid with the amino group of cyclopropylamine.

name: N-[(Z)-dodec-2-enoyl]morpholine
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of (Z)-dodec-2-enoic acid with the nitrogen of morpholine.

name: SU1498
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2E)-2-cyano-3-[4-hydroxy-3,5-di(propan-2-yl)phenyl]prop-2-enoic acid with the amino group of 3-phenylpropylamine.

name: SU5614
definition: A member of the class of oxindoles that is 5-chlorooxindole in which the two hydrogens at position 3 are replaced by a (3,5-dimethylpyrrol-2-yl)methylidene group.

name: 3,4-dimethylindole-2-carboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3,4-dimethylindole-2-carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: dihydrobisanhydrobacterioruberin
definition: A C50 carotenoid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of bacterioruberin, a red-coloured pigment found in several Halobacterium and Haloarcula species.

name: isopentenyldehydrorhodopin
definition: A C45 carotenoid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of bacterioruberin, a red-coloured pigment found in several Halobacterium and Haloarcula species

name: dihydroisopentenyldehydrorhodopin
definition: A C45 carotenoid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of bacterioruberin, a red-coloured pigment found in several Halobacterium and Haloarcula species.

name: 3-hexenedioic acid
definition: A hexenedioic acid where the C=C double bond is located at the 3-position.

name: S-[(2E,6E)-farnesyl]-L-cysteine methyl ester
definition: An α-amino acid ester that is the methyl ester of S-[(2E,6E)-farnesyl]-L-cysteine.

name: (2R)-2-methyltetradecanoyl-CoA
definition: A (2R)-2-methylacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2R)-2-methyltetradecanoic acid.

name: (+)-(1S,2S)-norcoronamic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is 1-aminocyclopropanecarboxylic acid carrying an additional methyl substituent at position 2 on the cyclopropane ring.

name: propamidine isethionate
definition: A guanidinium salt obtained by combining propamidine with two molar equivalents of isethionic acid. Used for the treatment of minor eye or eyelid infections, such as conjunctivitis and blepharitis.

name: (2R)-2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA
definition: The 2R stereoisomer of 2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA.

name: (2S)-2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA
definition: The 2S stereoisomer of 2,6-dimethylheptanoyl-CoA.

name: hexamidine
definition: A polyether that is the bis(4-guanidinophenyl) ether of hexane-1,6-diol.

name: florfenicol
definition: A carboxamide that is the N-dichloroacetyl derivative of (1R,2S)-2-amino-3-fluoro-1-[4-(methanesulfonyl)phenyl]propan-1-ol. A synthetic veterinary antibiotic that is used for treatment of bovine respiratory disease and foot rot; also used in aquaculture.

name: Biebrich scarlet
definition: An organic sodium salt having 2-[(2-hydroxynaphthalen-1-yl)diazenyl]-5-[(4-sulfonatophenyl)diazenyl]benzene-1-sulfonate as the counterion. Used as a plasma stain in Masson's trichrome.

name: Biebrich scarlet (acid form)
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is m-[(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]benzene-1-sulfonic acid carrying a (2-hydroxynaphthalen-1-yl)diazenyl substituent at position 2. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'Biebrich scarlet'.

name: Biebrich scarlet(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of Biebrich scarlet.

name: woodstain scarlet
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 7-hydroxy-8-{[4-(phenyldiazenyl)phenyl]diazenyl}naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid. Occasionally used for the demonstration of muscle fibres in conjunction with, or as a replacement for, acid fuchsin.

name: 7-hydroxy-8-{[4-(phenyldiazenyl)phenyl]diazenyl}naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is 7-hydroxynaphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid substituted at position 8 by a [4-(phenyldiazenyl)phenyl]diazenyl group. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'woodstain scarlet'.

name: 7-hydroxy-8-{[4-(phenyldiazenyl)phenyl]diazenyl}naphthalene-1,3-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of 7-hydroxy-8-{[4-(phenyldiazenyl)phenyl]diazenyl}naphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid.

name: phloxine B
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 2,3,4,5-tetrachloro-6-(2,4,5,7-tetrabromo-6-hydroxy-3-oxo-3H-xanthen-9-yl)benzoic acid. It is used in the hematoxylin phloxine saffron (HPS) stain, stains paneth cell granules in Lendrum's phloxine-tartrazine method, and can be used to demonstrate alcoholic hyaline.

name: 2',4',5',7'-tetrabromo-2,3,4,5-tetrachlorofluorescein
definition: A xanthene dye that is fluorescein bearing bromine substituents at positions 2', 4', 5' and 7' (on the xanthene ring) and chlorine substituents at position 2, 3, 4, and 5 (on the phenyl ring). The disodium salt is the biological stain 'phloxine B'.

name: MgADP
definition: A magnesium salt composed of Mg(2+) and ADP(2−) ions in a 1:1 ratio. Magnesium-ADP is a potassium channel activator.

name: 2',4',5',7'-tetrabromo-2,3,4,5-tetrachlorofluorescein(2−)
definition: A benzoate anion resulting from the removal of protons from the phenolic hydroxy group and the carboxy group of 2',4',5',7'-tetrabromo-2,3,4,5-tetrachlorofluorescein.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-α-D-Man
definition: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Man in which the anomeric configuration of the mannose residue is α.

name: rose bengal free acid
definition: A xanthene dye that is fluorescein bearing bromine substituents at positions 2', 4', 5' and 7' (on the xanthene ring) and iodine substituents at position 2, 3, 4, and 5 (on the phenyl ring). The dipotassium salt is the biological stain 'rose bengal'.

name: azocarmine G
definition: An organic sodium salt having 7-phenyl-5-(4-sulfonatoanilino)benzo[a]phenazin-7-ium-3-sulfonate as the couterion.

name: azocarmine G(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of 7-phenyl-5-[(4-sulfophenyl)imino]-5,7-dihydrobenzo[a]phenazine-3-sulfonic acid.

name: azocarmine G free acid
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 7-phenyl-5-imino-5,7-dihydrobenzo[a]phenazine-3-sulfonic acid in which the imino hydrogen is replaced by a 4-sulfophenyl group. The monosodium salt is the biological stain 'azocarmine G'.

name: azocarmine B
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 4-[(7-phenyl-3-sulfobenzo[a]phenazin-7-ium-5-yl)amino]benzene-1,3-disulfonic acid.

name: azocarmine B(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of 4-[(7-phenyl-3-sulfobenzo[a]phenazin-5-ylidene)amino]benzene-1,3-disulfonic acid.

name: azocarmine B free acid
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 7-phenyl-5-imino-5,7-dihydrobenzo[a]phenazine-3-sulfonic acid in which the imino hydrogen is replaced by a 2,4-disulfophenyl group. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'azocarmine B'.

name: naphthol yellow S
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 5,7-dinitro-8-hydroxynaphthalene-2-sulfonic acid.

name: flavianate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo and phenolic hydroxy groups of flavianic acid.

name: flavianic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is naphthalene-2-sulfonic acid substituted by nitro groups at positions 5 and 7 as well as a hydroxy group at position 8. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'naphthol yellow S'.

name: 1-icosanoyl-2-arachidonoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as icosanoyl (arachidoyl) and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 1-icosanoyl-2-[(5Z,8Z,11ZZ,14Z,17Z)-eicosapentaenoyl]-sn-glycerol
definition: A diacylglycerol 40:5 in which the acyl groups specified are icosanoyl and (5Z,8Z,11ZZ,14Z,17Z)-eicosapentaenoyl respectively,

name: lissamine flavine FF
definition: An organic sodium salt having 6-amino-2-(4-methylphenyl)-1,3-dioxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-benzo[de]isoquinoline-5-sulfonate as the counterion. It is used as the displacement dye in the yellowsolve I method for fibrin.

name: lissamine flavine FF(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of lissamine flavine FF.

name: lissamine flavine FF free acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoisoquinolines that is 1,3-dioxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-benzo[de]isoquinoline-5-sulfonic acid substituted by 4-tolyl and amino groups at positions 2 and 6 respectively. The monosodium salt is the biological stain 'lissamine flavine FF'.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-docosanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A diacylglycerol 38:0 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecanoyl and docosanoyl respectively.

name: metanil yellow
definition: An organic sodium salt having 3-[(4-anilinophenyl)diazenyl]benzene-1-sulfonate as the counterion. Used in one variant of Masson's trichrome to stain collagen yellow in contrast to the red muscle, but is not in common used.

name: PF-670462
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the formal reaction of 3-[(3-chlorophenoxy)methyl]-1-(tetrahydro-2H-pyran-4-yl)-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-amine with 2 mol eq. of hydrogen chloride. It is a selective inhibitor of the δ- and ε-isoforms of casein kinase 1 (CK1δ and CK1ε).

name: PF-4800567
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-amine which is substituted at positions 1 and 3 by tetrahydro-2H-pyran-4-yl and (m-chlorophenoxy)methyl groups, respectively. It is a selective inhibitor of the ε isoform of casein kinase 1 (CK1ε).

name: 3-[(4-anilinophenyl)diazenyl]benzene-1-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of 3-[(4-anilinophenyl)diazenyl]benzene-1-sulfonic acid.

name: 3-[(4-anilinophenyl)diazenyl]benzene-1-sulfonic acid
definition: A member of the class of azobenzenes that is azobenzene in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted at the para position by an anilino group, while the other is substituted at a meta position by a sulfo group. The monosodium salt is the biological stain 'metanil yellow'.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-docosanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A diacylglycerol 40:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are octadecanoyl and docosanoyl respectively.

name: palmitoyllipid A
definition: A member of the class of lipid As that is lipid A in which the free OH group on the N-hydroxytetradecanoyl group is carrying a palimitoyl group.

name: lipid IVB
definition: A member of the class of lipid As that is lipid IVA in which one of the free OH groups on the two N-hydroxytetradecanoyl groups is carrying a palimitoyl group.

name: lipid IIB
definition: A member of the class of lipid As that is lipid IIA in which one of the free OH groups on the two N-hydroxytetradecanoyl groups is carrying a palimitoyl group.

name: 1-[(6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoyl]-2-[(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl]- sn -glycerol
definition: A diacylglycerol 40:10 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatetraenoyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: ethyl gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by the formal condensation of gallic acid with ethanol.

name: ethyl glucuronide
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid that is the ethyl derivative of β-D-glucuronic acid.

name: 2-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]glycerol
definition: A monoacylglycerol 16:1 in which the acyl group specified at position 2 is 9Z)-hexadecenoyl.

name: (E)-2-methylpentadec-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (E)-2-methylpentadec-2-enoic acid.

name: O-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl]-L-serine
definition: An O-glycosyl-L-serine having N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine as the glycosyl component.

name: O-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl]-L-threonine
definition: An O-glycosyl-L-threonine having N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine as the glycosyl component.

name: estra-1(10),4-diene-2,3,17-trione
definition: An o-quinone resulting from the formal oxidation of the dihydroxyphenyl moiety of 2-hydroxyestrone.

name: estra-1,5(10)-diene-3,4,17-trione
definition: An o-quinone resulting from the formal oxidation of the dihydroxyphenyl moiety of 4-hydroxyestrone.

name: O-fumarylcarnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine in which the acyl group specified is fumaryl.

name: 5-chlorooctyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester that is octyl acetate substituted by a chloro group at position 5.

name: (2E)-1,4-dimethoxybut-2-en-1-yl acetate
definition: An olefinic compound that is but-2-en-1-yl acetate substituted by methoxy groups at positions 1 and 4 respectively.

name: 2-(carboxyethoxy)propanal
definition: An oxo carboxylic acid that is propanal substituted by a carboxyethoxy group at position 2.

name: 2-(3-pyridyl)-3-(4-toluenesulfonamido)propylazetidine
definition: A member of the class of azetidines that is propylazetidine substituted by a 3-pyridyl group position 2 and a 4-toluenesulfonamido group at position 3.

name: 2-(pentyloxy)ethyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester that is ethyl acetate substituted by a pentyloxy group at position 2.

name: 1-ethoxy-1-pentoxyethane
definition: A dieter that is 1-pentoxyethane substituted by an ethoxy group at position 1.

name: 1-(2-phenylethyl)imidazolidine-2,4,5-trione
definition: An imidazolidinone that is parabanic acid substituted by a 2-phenylethyl group at position 1.

name: 3-methyl-4-{[(1Z)-prop-1-en-1-yl]oxy}butanal
definition: An olefinic compound that is butanal substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and a [(1Z)-prop-1-en-1-yl]oxy group at position 4 respectively.

name: ethyl 3-methylbutyl butanedioate
definition: A dieter obtained by the forma condensation of the two carboxy groups of succinic acid with ethanol and 3-methylbutanol respectively.

name: 3β-hydroxy-4β-methyl-5α-cholest-8-ene-4α-carboxylic acid
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying carboxy and methyl substituents at position 4.

name: ethyl 2-phenylethyl dimethylmalonate
definition: A dieter obtained by the formal condensation of the two carboxy groups of dimethylmalonic acid with ethanol and 2-phenylethanol respectively.

name: (22E,24S)-24-methylcholesta-5,7,14,22-tetraen-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is ergosterol having an additional double bond at position 14.

name: 2-methylbutyl 2-acetyloxyacetate
definition: An acetate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (acetyloxy)acetic acid with 2-methylbutanol.

name: 3-methylthiopropyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of 3-(methylsulfanyl)propan-1-ol with acetic acid.

name: ethyl 4-oxobutanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of succinic semialdehyde with ethanol.

name: PF-670462 free base
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole which is substituted at positions 1, 4, and 5 by cyclohexyl, p-fluorophenyl, and 2-aminopyrimidin-4-yl groups, respectively. It is a selective inhibitor of the δ- and ε-isoforms of casein kinase 1 (CK1δ and CK1ε).

name: PF-670462 free base(2+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the addition of two protons to the free base of PF-670462.

name: ethyl 2-phenylethyl butylphosphonate
definition: A phosphonic ester obtained by the esterification of both the hydroxy groups of butylphosphonic acid with ethanol and 2-phenylethanol respectively.

name: 2-(2-ethoxy-1-methoxyethyl)furan
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan substituted by a 2-ethoxy-1-methoxyethyl group at position 2.

name: 4β-methylzymosterol-4-carbaldehyde
definition: A 3β-sterol that consists of 4β-methylzymosterol in which the 4α-hydrogen is replaced by a formyl group.

name: 3-ethyl-1,5-octadiene
definition: An alkadiene that is 1,5-octadiene substituted by an ethyl group at position 3.

name: 4α-hydroxymethyl-4β-methylzymosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that consists of 4β-methylzymosterol in which the 4α-hydrogen is replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: (1-methylbutyl)cyclopentane
definition: A member of the class of cyclopentanes that is cyclopentane substituted by a 1-methylbutyl group.

name: butyl dec-9-enoate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of butan-1-ol with caproleic acid.

name: 3,3-dimethoxy-1-phenylpropane-1,2-dione
definition: An α-diketone that is 1-phenyl-1,2-propanedione substituted by two methoxy groups at position 3.

name: 3β-hydroxy-5α-cholest-8-ene-4α-carboxylic acid
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-cholest-8-en-3β-ol carrying an additional carboxy substituent at position 4α.

name: 3-ethoxypropyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester that is propyl acetate substituted by an ethoxy group at position 3.

name: diethyl 2-hydroxypentanedioate
definition: A diester obtained by the formal condensation of both the carboxy groups of 2-hydroxyglutaric acid with two molecules of ethanol respectively.

name: 4-(1-hydroxyethyl)-γ-butanolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide that is γ-butanolactone substituted by a 1-hydroxyethyl group at position 4.

name: Se-butyl pentaneselenoate
definition: An organoselenium compound obtained by the formal condensation of butane-1-selenol with pentanoic acid.

name: 1,1,5-trimethyl-1,2-dihydronaphthalene
definition: An ortho-fused bicyclic hydrocarbon that is 1,2-dihydronaphthalene substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 1 and 5 respectively.

name: ethyl 5-hexenoate
definition: The fatty acid ethyl ester of 5-hexenoic acid.

name: 2-O-(α-D-glucosyl)-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate
definition: A glucosylglycerol phosphate consisting of sn-glycerol 3-phosphate having an α-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 2.

name: formylthiophene
definition: An aldehyde that is thiophene substituted by a formyl group at position 2.

name: ethyl isobutyrate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester obtained by the formal condensation of isobutyric acid with ethanol.

name: 4,6,8-trimethylazulene
definition: A member of the class of azulenes that is azulene substituted by methyl groups at positions 4, 6 and 8 respectively.

name: trans-feruloyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3-trans-feruloyl-CoA. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: (7R)-6-deoxy-D-manno-oct-7-ulosuronic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid obtained by oxidation of the 8-hydroxy group of 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: 5-ethoxydihydro-2(3H)-furanone
definition: A butan-4-olide that is γ-butyrolactone substituted by an ethoxy group at position 5.

name: 2-(dichloromethyl)tetrahydrofuran
definition: A member of the class of oxolanes that is oxolane (tetrahydrofuran) substituted by a dichloromethyl group at position 2.

name: 3-decanone
definition: A ketone that is decane in which the methylene hydrogens at position 3 are replaced by an oxo group.

name: 4-chlorobutanol
definition: A primary alcohol that is butan-1-ol substituted by a chloro group at position 4.

name: tridecan-7-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is tridecane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7.

name: ethyl 3-nonenoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester obtained by the formal condensation of 3-nonenoic acid with ethanol.

name: 8-amino-3,8-dideoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid
definition: An amino monosaccharide obtained by replacement of the 8-hydroxy group of 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid by an amino group.

name: 4-hydroxy-2-methylacetophenone
definition: A member of the class of acetophenones that is acetophenone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4 and a methyl group at position 2 respectively.

name: 1-decene
definition: An alkene that is decane containing one double bond at position 1.

name: 7-amino-4-hydroxy-2-naphthalenesulfonic acid
definition: An aminonaphthalenesulfonic acid that is 2-naphthalenesulfonic acid substituted by an amino group at position 7 and a hydroxy group at position 4 respectively.

name: 2-isopropyl-1,3-dioxolane
definition: A dioxolane that is 1,3-dioxolane substituted by an isopropyl group at position 2.

name: sec-butyl butyrate
definition: A butyrate ester obtained by the formal condensation of butyric acid with butan-2-ol.

name: diethyl glutarate
definition: A diester obtained by the formal condensation of carboxy groups of glutaric acid with two molecules of ethanol respectively.

name: ethyl 3,3,4-trimethylpentanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,3,4-trimethylpentanoic acid with ethanol.

name: N-methylacetamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is the N-methyl derivative of acetamide.

name: dec-1-yne
definition: An alkyne that is decane carrying a triple bond at position 1.

name: 2-phenylethyl pentanoate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of 2-phenylethanol with valeric acid.

name: ethyl (2E)-2-decenoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester obtained by the formal condensation of trans-2-decenoic acid with ethanol.

name: ethyl 2-octenoate
definition: The fatty acid ethyl ester of 2-octenoic acid.

name: 3-methylheptyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of 3-methylheptanol.

name: 6-pentyloxan-2-one
definition: A δ-lactone that is 5-valerolactone substituted by a pentyl group at position 6.

name: benzocyclobutene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is benzene fused to a cyclobutane ring.

name: dodec-10-yn-1-ol
definition: An acetylenic compound that is dodecane carrying a triple bond at position 10 and a hydroxy group at position 1 respectively.

name: 2-methylbutyl decanoate
definition: A decanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of decanoic acid (capric acid) with the alcoholic hydroxy group of 2-methylbutan-1-ol.

name: 17β-hydroxy-5β-androst-1-en-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo Δ1-steroid with 5β-configuration formed from 17β-hydroxyandrosta-1,4-dien-3-one by reduction across the C4-C5 double bond.

name: 6-methyl-2-heptanyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of 6-methylheptan-2-ol.

name: 17β-hydroxy-5β-estran-3-one
definition: A C18 steroid with 5β-configuration formed from nandrolone by reduction across the C4-C5 double bond.

name: ethyl (2Z)-but-2-enoate
definition: A but-2-enoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of isocrotonic acid with ethanol.

name: 2-methyl-4-propyl-1,3-oxathiane
definition: An organosulfur heterocyclic compound and an oxacycle that is 1,3-oxathiane substituted by a methyl group at position 2 and a propyl group at position 4 respectively.

name: 2-phenylethyl pivalate
definition: A pivalate ester of 2-phenylethanol.

name: N4-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc}
definition: A glucosaminoglycan consisting of L-asparagine having the heptasaccharide α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc attached at the N4-position

name: ethyl 9-decenoate
definition: The fatty acid ethyl ester of dec-9-enoic acid.

name: lipid A 1-(2-aminoethyl diphosphate)
definition: A member of the class of lipid As in which the anomeric phosphate group of lipid A is replaced by 2-aminoethyl diphosphate.

name: 3,8-dimethyldeca-4,6-diyne-3,8-diol
definition: An acetylenic compound that is deca-4,6-diyne substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 8 and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 8 respectively.

name: 1,3-oxathiane
definition: An organosulfur heterocyclic compound and an oxacycle that is a cyclohexane in which the carbon atoms at position 1 and 3 are replaced by an oxygen and sulfur atom respectively.

name: (1,2,3-trimethyl-2-cyclopropen-1-yl)benzene
definition: A member of the class of benzenes that is benzene substituted by a 1,2,3-trimethyl-2-cyclopropen-1-yl group.

name: 3-methylbutyl dodecanoate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of dodecanoic acid with 3-methylbutan-1-ol.

name: diethylene glycol diacetate
definition: An acetate ester that is the diacetate obtained by the formal condensation of the two hydroxy groups of diethylene glycol with two molecules of acetic acid respectively.

name: 1,4-diacetoxybutane
definition: An acetate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the two hydroxy groups of butane-1,4-diol with two molecules of acetic acid

name: acridine orange free base
definition: A member of the class of aminoacridines that is acridine carrying two dimethylamino substituents at positions 3 and 6. The hydrochloride salt is the fluorescent dye 'acridine orange', used for cell cycle determination.

name: acridine red 3B
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining the free base of acridine red 3B with one molar equivalent of hydrogen chloride. Used for staining RNA in conjunction with malachite green.

name: (16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z)-tetratriacontapentaenoate
definition: A tetratriacontapentaenoate that is the conjugate base of (16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z)-tetratriacontapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z)-hexatriacontapentaenoate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z)-hexatriacontapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (20Z,23Z,26Z,29Z,32Z)-octatriacontapentaenoate
definition: An octatriacontapentaenoate that is the conjugate base of (20Z,23Z,26Z,29Z,32Z)-octatriacontapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: acridine red 3B(1+)
definition: An iminium ion obtained by protonation of the imino group of acridine red free base.

name: alcian yellow
definition: An organic chloride salt composed of {diazenediylbis[(4,1-phenylene)(6-methyl-1,3-benzothiazole-2,5-diyl)methylenesulfanediyl]}bis[(dimethylamino)-N,N-dimethylmethaniminium] and chloride ions in a 1:2 ratio.

name: alcian yellow cation
definition: An iminium ion that is the cationic component of alcian yellow.

name: alizarin blue
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is naphtho[2,3-f]quinoline-7,12-dione carrying two additional hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 6. Used as an acid-base indicator. Between pH 0.0 and pH 1.6 it changes from pink to yellow, and between pH 6.0 and pH 7.6 it changes from yellow to green.

name: (2Z,6Z,10Z,14Z,18Z,22Z,26Z,30Z,34E)-decaprenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of (2Z,6Z,10Z,14Z,18Z,22Z,26Z,30Z,34E)-decaprenyl diphosphate. Major structure at pH 7.3

name: alizarin red S
definition: An organic sodium salt having 3,4-dihydroxy-9,10-dioxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2-sulfonate as the counterion. It is commonly used to stain embryo skeletons in cleared whole mounts, usually of small mammals.

name: LY-411575
definition: A dibenzoazepine that is 5,7-dihydro-6H-dibenzo[b,d]azepin-6-one which is substituted at the 7 pro-S position by the C-terminal carboxamide nitrogen of N2-[(2S)-2-(3,5-difluorophenyl)-2-hydroxyacetyl]-L-alaninamide. It is a potent, cell permeable and selective γ-secretase inhibitor. It has been tested as a possible treatment for Alzheimer's disease and shows promise for its potential to counteract severe hearing loss.

name: 1,3-diacetoxypropane
definition: An acetate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the two hydroxy groups of propane-1,3-diol with acetic acid.

name: 3,4-dihydroxy-9,10-dioxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 3,4-dihydroxy-9,10-dioxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2-sulfonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group.

name: pentyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester of pentanol.

name: 4-oxopentanal
definition: A ketoaldehyde that is pentanal substituted by an oxo group at position 4.

name: propyl hexanoate
definition: A hexanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with propan-1-ol.

name: α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo
definition: An amino hexasaccharide consisting of six N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2), (1→3), (1→2), (1→2) and (1→2).

name: alizarin cyanin BBS
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 1,3,4,5,7,8-hexahydroxy-9,10-dioxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2,6-disulfonic acid. Used as a hematoxylin substitute in H&E staining.

name: diethyl malate
definition: A malate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the two carboxy groups of malic acid with two molecules of ethanol respectively.

name: α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo
definition: An amino hexasaccharide consisting of six N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked (1→2) throughout.

name: N-ethylacetamide
definition: A member of the class of acetamides that is the N-ethyl derivative of acetamide.

name: 1,3,4,5,7,8-hexahydroxy-9,10-dioxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2,6-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of 1,3,4,5,7,8-hexahydroxy-9,10-dioxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2,6-disulfonic acid.

name: 1,3,4,5,7,8-hexahydroxy-9,10-dioxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2,6-disulfonic acid
definition: A hexahydroxyanthraquinone that is 1,3,4,5,7,8-hexahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone carrying two additional sulfo groups at positions 2 and 6. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'alizarin cyanin BBS'.

name: pentyl propanoate
definition: A propanoate ester of pentan-1-ol.

name: propyl octanoate
definition: An octanoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of octanoic acid (caprylic acid) with the hydroxy group of propan-1-ol.

name: methyl glycinate
definition: A glycinyl ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of glycine with methanol.

name: chromoxane cyanin R
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the trisodium salt of 5-[(3-carboxy-5-methyl-4-oxocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)(2-sulfophenyl)methyl]-2-hydroxy-3-methylbenzoic acid. It can be used for the detection of some metals in tissue.

name: 11-cyclopentylundecanoic acid
definition: A carbocyclic fatty acid that is undecanoic acid substituted by a cyclopentyl group at position 11.

name: (2S)-2-heptanol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is heptane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2 (the 2S-stereoisomer).

name: 3-methyl-1-butyne
definition: A terminal acetylenic compound that is but-1-yne substituted by a methyl group at position 3.

name: butyl octanoate
definition: An octanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of octanoic acid with the hydroxy group of butanol.

name: 3-methylpentanol
definition: A primary alcohol that is pentanol substituted by a methyl group at position 3.

name: 1,1'-(propane-1,2-diyl)dibenzene
definition: A diphenylethane that is 1,2-dihydrostilbene substituted by a methyl group at position 1.

name: 1-butoxy-1-ethoxyethane
definition: A diether that is butane substituted by a 1-ethoxyethoxy group at position 1.

name: 4,5-dimethyl-2-pentadecyl-1,3-dioxolane
definition: A dioxolane that is 1,3-dioxolane substituted by methyl groups at positions 4 and 5 and a pentadecyl group at position 2 respectively.

name: 3,4-bis(methoxycarbonyl)benzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid substituted by methoxycarbonyl groups at positions 3 and 4 respectively.

name: 2-decanyl propionate
definition: A propanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of propionic acid with decan-2-ol.

name: chromoxane cyanin R(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo and carboxy groups of 5-[(3-carboxy-5-methyl-4-oxocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)(2-sulfophenyl)methyl]-2-hydroxy-3-methylbenzoic acid.

name: diethyl fumarate
definition: A dieter obtained by the formal condensation of fumaric acid with ethanol.

name: chromoxane cyanin R free acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is 2-hydroxy-3-methyl-5-[(2-sulfophenyl)methyl]benzoic acid in which both of the benzylic hydrogens are replaced by a 3-carboxy-5-methyl-4-oxocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene group. The trisodium salt is the biological stain 'chromoxane cyanin R'.

name: 3-oxobutyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester that is butyl acetate substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: N-icosanoylglycinate
definition: A N-acylglycinate in which the acyl group is specified as icosanoyl; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-ethylhexyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester that is hexyl acetate substituted by an ethyl group at position 2.

name: hexan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is hexane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: chrome violet CG
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the trisodium salt of 3,3'-[(3-carboxy-4-oxocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)methylene]bis(6-hydroxybenzoic acid).

name: 1α,2β,25-trihydroxy vitamin D3
definition: A hydroxy seco-steroid that is calciol carrying three additional hydroxy substituents at positions 1α, 2β and 25.

name: aurintricarboxylate
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups of aurintricarboxylic acid.

name: aurintricarboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of quinomethanes that is 3-methylidene-6-oxocyclohexa-1,4-diene-1-carboxylic acid in which the methylidene hydrogens are replaced by 4-carboxy-3-hydroxyphenyl groups. The trisodium salt is the biological stain 'chrome violet CG' while the triammonium salt is 'aluminon'.

name: aluminon
definition: An ammonium salt that is the ammonium salt of 3,3'-[(3-carboxy-4-oxocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)methylene]bis(6-hydroxybenzoic acid). A dye commonly used to detect the presence of the aluminium ion in an aqueous solution.

name: UK 63598
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide antibiotic that is isolated from Streptomyces sp. SNA15896 and also exhibits antitumour activity.

name: UK 65662
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide antibiotic that is isolated from Streptomyces sp. SNA15896 and also exhibits antitumour activity.

name: UK 63052
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide antibiotic that is isolated from Streptomyces sp. SNA15896 and also exhibits antitumour activity.

name: YTM-T
definition: A member of the class of pyrroloindoles that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of yatakemycin by Streptomyces sp. TP-A0356

name: Me-YTM-T
definition: A member of the class of pyrroloindoles that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of yatakemycin by Streptomyces sp. TP-A0356.

name: bicyclo[2.2.2]octane-2,6-dione
definition: An alicyclic ketone that is bicyclo[2.2.2]octane carrying two oxo groups located at positions 2 and 6.

name: [(S)-3-oxocyclohexyl]acetic acid
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in with one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 3-oxocyclohexyl group (the S-enantiomer).

name: p-nitrobenzyl chloride
definition: A C-nitro compound that is nitrobenzene in which the hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by a chloromethyl group.

name: S-(4-nitrobenzyl)glutathione
definition: An S-substituted glutathione in which the thiol hydrogen of glutathione is replaced by a 4-nitrobenzyl group.

name: S-[2-hydroxy-3-(4-nitrophenoxy)propyl]glutathione
definition: A glutathione derivative in which the thiol hydrogen of glutathione is replaced by a [2-hydroxy-3-(4-nitrophenoxy)propyl group.

name: phenethyl isobutyrate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of 2-phenylethanol with isobutyric acid.

name: N-docosanoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-docosanoylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dibenzyl ether
definition: A benzyl ether in which the oxygen atom is connected to two benzyl groups.

name: N-tetracosanoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-tetracosanoylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: phenethyl butyrate
definition: The butanoate ester of 2-phenylethanol.

name: N-hexacosanoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-hexacosanoylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-O-[(2-aminoethyl)phosphoryl]-α-Kdo-(2→4)-α-Kdo-(2→6)-lipid IVA
definition: A lipid A derivative, comprising lipid IVA glycosylated with two 3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonic acid (KDO) residues with the terminal KDO carrying a (2-aminoethyl)phosphoryl group at position 7.

name: 4-butyl-γ-butyrolactone
definition: A butan-4-olide that is γ-butyrolactone substituted by a butyl group at position 4.

name: 2-phenylethyl formate
definition: A formate ester of 2-phenylethanol.

name: isoamyl propanoate
definition: A propanoate ester of isoamylol.

name: lipid A 4'-(2-aminoethyl diphosphate)
definition: A member of the class of lipid As in which the 4' phosphate group of lipid A is replaced by 2-aminoethyl diphosphate.

name: isobutyl hexanoate
definition: A hexanoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with isobutanol.

name: isoamyl butyrate
definition: The butanoate ester of isoamylol.

name: lipid A 1,4'-bis(2-aminoethyl diphosphate)
definition: A member of the class of lipid As in which the 1- and 4'-phosphate groups of lipid A are both replaced by 2-aminoethyl diphosphate.

name: juvenile hormone I acid
definition: A member of the juvenile hormone family of compounds obtained by formal hydrolysis of the methyl ester group of juvenile hormone I.

name: ethyl octanoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of octanoic acid with ethanol.

name: ethyl laurate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester of lauric acid.

name: ethyl 3-hydroxytridecanoate
definition: A long-chain fatty acid ethyl ester of 3-hydroxytridecanoic acid.

name: butyl butanoate
definition: A butanoate ester of butan-1-ol.

name: ethyl decanoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester of decanoic acid.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide consisting of a chain of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→3), (1→4), (1→6) and (1→4), to the D-galactose residue nearest to the reducing end of which is also linked (1→3) a β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl unit, and with also an L-α-fucosyl residue linked (1→3) to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue nearest to the reducing end.

name: methyl octanoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of octanoic acid with the hydroxy group of methanol.

name: (R)-2-hydroxy-4-methylpentanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (R)-2-hydroxy-4-methylpentanoic acid.

name: 2-octanone
definition: A methyl ketone that is octane substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: 11-cis-retinoate
definition: A retinoate that is the conjugate base of 11-cis-retinoic acid, obtaained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-methylpent-2-enoyl-CoA
definition: An alk-2-enoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 4-methylpent-2-enoic acid.

name: methyl γ-D-aspartate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester obtained by condensation of the side-chain carboxy group of D-aspartic acid with methanol.

name: lithocholyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) that is the tetraanion of lithocholyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-pyridinol
definition: A monohydroxypyridine that is pyridine in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been detected as a thermal degradation product from the smoke of the burning leaves of Salvia divinorum, a Mexican psychoactive plant.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-{β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched tridecasaccharide derivative in which β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl and β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide units are linked (1→6) and (1→3) respectively to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: tetratriacontane
definition: A long-chain alkane consisting of an unbranched chain of 34 carbon atoms.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of β-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine in which the galactosyl residue at the non-reducing end has α-sialyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues attached via glycosidic linkages at positions 3 and 4 respectively.

definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide derivative in which two α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tridecasaccharide derivative in which two α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: 5-epi-valiolone 7-phosphate
definition: A member of the class of cyclitols that is 5-epi-valiolone carrying a phospho substituent at position 7.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino octasaccharide in which an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl disaccharide chain and a β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl chain are linked (1→6) and (1→3) respectively to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: trans-caffeoyl-CoA
definition: A caffeoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of trans-caffeic acid.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprised of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→3) and (1→3).

name: dihydrocaffeoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of dihydrocaffeic acid.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, α-D-galactose, βD-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine units connected via sequential (1→3), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4) linkages.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide derivative in which two α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide derivative in which two α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues in a linear (1→3), (1→6), (1→4) sequence.

definition: A branched pentasaccharide consisting of a trisaccharide chain of α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose and β-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→4), with α-L-fucosyl residues attached by (1→2) and (1→3) linkages to the β-D-galactose and β-D-glucose residues respectively.
