definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of a linear pentasaccharide chain of α-sialyl, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4), to the galactose residue nearest to the reducing end is also linked (1→6) a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl disaccharide unit.

name: 3,4-dimethylindole-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of indolecarboxylic acids that is indole-2-carboxylic acid carrying two methyl substituents at positions 3 and 4.

name: 6-hydroxy-N-methylmyosmine
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolines that is N-methyl-2-pyrroline carrying a 6-hydroxypyridin-3-yl substituent at position 2.

name: SIS3
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the reaction of SIS3 free base with 1 mol eq. of hydrogen chloride.

name: propamidine
definition: A polyether that is the bis(4-guanidinophenyl) ether of propane-1,3-diol. Used (as its isethionate salt) for the treatment of minor eye or eyelid infections, such as conjunctivitis and blepharitis.

name: propamidine(2+)
definition: A guanidinium ion obtained by protonation of both guanidino groups of propamidine.

name: azophloxine
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 5-acetamido-4-hydroxy-3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid.

name: 5-acetamido-4-hydroxy-3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is 3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid carrying additional phenyldiazenyl, hydroxy and acetamido substituents at position 3, 4, and 5 respectively. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'azophloxine'.

name: 5-acetamido-4-hydroxy-3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of 5-acetamido-4-hydroxy-3-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid.

name: prenyl-FMNH2(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of prenyl-FMNH2; major species at pH 7.3.

name: benzo scarlet 4BNS
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the trisodium salt of 4-hydroxy-7-[({5-hydroxy-6-[(3-methoxyphenyl)diazenyl]-7-sulfonaphthalen-2-yl}carbamoyl)amino]-3-[(6-sulfonaphthalen-2-yl)diazenyl]naphthalene-2-sulfonic acid. A direct cotton dye that is also capable of hydrogen bonding to amyloid and giving a dark enough red colour to be useful in diagnostic histology.

name: benzo scarlet 4BNS free acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is the free acid form of the dye benzo scarlet 4BNS. The trisodium salt is a direct cotton dye that is also capable of hydrogen bonding to amyloid and giving a dark enough red colour to be useful in diagnostic histology.

name: benzo scarlet 4BNS(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of benzo scarlet 4BNS free acid.

name: methyl blue
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the trisodium salt of 4,4'-{({4-[(4-sulfophenyl)imino]cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene}methylene)bis[(4,1-phenylene)azanediyl]}di(benzene-1-sulfonic acid). A histological dye that can be used either on its own or part of a mixture (aniline blue WS) for staining collagen in Masson's trichrome and Mallory's method for connective tissue.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a dodecasaccharide derivative in which two α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine branched tetrasaccharide.

name: (R)-2-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (R)-2-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-2-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (R)-2-hydroxybutanoic acid.

name: (25R)-7α,26-dihydroxycholest-4-en-3-one
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol which is substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and hydroxy groups at positions 7α and 26. It has R-configuration at position 25.

name: methyl blue free acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid, the disodium salt of which is the histological dye 'methyl blue' (used for staining collagen in Masson's trichrome and Mallory's method for connective tissue).

name: mauveine A
definition: An organic cation consisting of 7-(4-methylanilino)phenazine carrying additional methyl, amino and phenyl substituents at positions 2, 3 and 5 respectively. One of four components of mauvaine, a syntheteic violet-coloured dye.

name: mauveine B
definition: An organic cation consisting of 1,8-dimethyl-3-(4-methylanilino)phenazine carrying additional phenyl and amino substituents at positions 5 and 7 respectively. One of four components of mauvaine, a syntheteic violet-coloured dye.

name: mauveine B2
definition: An organic cation consisting of 7-(4-methylanilino)phenazine carrying additional methyl, amino and 4-methylphenyl substituents at positions 2, 3 and 5 respectively. One of four components of mauvaine, a syntheteic violet-coloured dye.

name: mauveine C
definition: An organic cation consisting of 1,8-dimethyl-3-(4-methylanilino)phenazine carrying additional 4-methylphenyl and amino substituents at positions 5 and 7 respectively. One of four components of mauvaine, a syntheteic violet-coloured dye.

name: fast red B
definition: An organosulfonate salt composed from 2-methoxy-4-nitrobenzene-1-diazonium and 5-sulfonaphthalene-1-sulfonate in a 1:1 ratio. Used for demostrating enterochromaffin in carcinoid tumours.

name: 2-methoxy-4-nitrobenzenediazonium
definition: The aromatic diazonium ion formed from diazotisation of 2-methoxy-4-nitroaniline. The 5-sulfonaphthalene-1-sulfonate salt is the biological stain 'fast red B'

name: 3-ethoxy-1-propanol
definition: A hydroxyether that is propan-1-ol substituted by an ethoxy group at position 3.

name: hexyl octanoate
definition: An octanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of octanoic acid with hexan-1-ol.

name: (2R,3E)-5-oxopent-3-ene-1,2,5-tricarboxylate
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups of (2R,3E)-5-oxopent-3-ene-1,2,5-tricarboxylic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: diazoethane
definition: A diazo compound in which the diazo group is attached to an ethylidene group.

name: methyl undecenate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester of 10-undecenoic acid.

name: methyl laurate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester of lauric acid.

name: octyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of octan-1-ol.

name: octyl formate
definition: A formate ester of octan-1-ol.

name: β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of two α-sialyl residues, a β-Dgalactosyl residue and an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue linked respectively (2→8), (2→8) and (1→4), to the galactosyl residue of which is also linked (1→4) an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue. It is the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GD2 with undefined anomeric stereochemistry at the reducing-end galactose residue.

name: 1-bromo-4-cyclopropylbenzene
definition: A member of the class of bromobenzenes that is bromobenzene substituted by a cyclopropyl group at position 4.

name: undecan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is undecane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: isobutyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of benzoic acid with isobutanol.

name: ethyl nonanoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester of nonanoic acid.

name: 4-methyl-3-penten-1-amine
definition: An alkylamine that is pent-3-en-1-amine substituted by a methyl group ay position 4.

name: ethyl 3-(methylthio)propionate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(methylthio)propionic acid with ethanol.

name: (2Z,4Z)-2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-dienedioate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-diene-1,7-dioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methylthiolan-3-one
definition: A member of the class of tetrahydrothiophenes that is thiolane substituted by a methyl group at position 2 and an oxo group at position 3 respectively.

name: (4Z)-2-oxohept-4-enedioate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of (4Z)-2-oxohept-4-enedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-penten-2-one
definition: A methyl ketone that is pent-1-ene substituted by an oxo group at position 4.

name: (2R,3E)-5-oxopent-3-ene-1,2,5-tricarboxylic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid that is pent-3-ene-1,2,5-tricarboxylic acid carrying an oxo substituent at position 5 (the 2R,3E-stereoisomer).

name: hexyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of hexan-1-ol.

name: nonyl acetate
definition: The acetate ester of nonan-1-ol.

name: ethyl 2-hydroxy-3-phenylpropanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionic acid with ethanol.

name: ethyl 2-hexenoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester of 2-hexenoic acid.

name: 4-penten-1-yl acetate
definition: An acetate ester of pent-4-en-1-ol.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide consisting of the pentasaccharide β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc attached to the primary hydroxy function of a ceramide in which the acyl function on nitrogen is stearoyl.

name: 4,5-dimethyl-1-hexene
definition: An alkene that is hex-1-ene substituted by methyl groups at positions 4 and 5 respectively.

name: ADP(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of two of the three diphosphate OH groups of adenosine 5'-diphosphate.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of a pentasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose and two further N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which is also linked (1→6) an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl trisaccharide unit.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residues connected in sequence by (1→3) linkages.

name: (S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxoheptanedioate
definition: A 4-hydroxy-2-oxoheptanedioate obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of (S)-4-hydroxy-2-oxoheptanedioic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-ethyl-1-hexene
definition: An alkene that is 1-hexene substituted by an ethyl group at position 4.

name: ethyl 1-allylcyclopropanecarboxylate
definition: A member of the class of cyclopropanes that is ethyl cyclopropanecarboxylate substituted by a prop-2-en-1-yl group at position 1.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a dodecasaccharide derivative in which two α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine branched tetrasaccharide.

name: 3-ethoxy-2-butanone
definition: A methyl ketone that is butan-2-one substituted by an ethoxy group at position 3.

name: methyl undecanoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester of undecanoic acid.

name: dihydromyrcenol
definition: A monoterpenoid that is oct-7-en-2-ol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 6 respectively.

name: myrcenol
definition: A monoterpenoid that is oct-7-en-2-ol substituted by a methyl group at position 2 and a methylidene group at position 6 respectively.

name: (4E)-2,3-dimethylhexa-1,4-diene
definition: An alkadiene that is hexa-1,4-diene substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 3 respectively.

name: prenyl-FMNH2
definition: A flavin mononucleotide obtained by prenylation of the N-10 position of FMNH2 followed by cyclisation. An essential cofactor for the decarboxylase enzymes UbiD and Fdc1.

name: 1-iodotetradecane
definition: An organoiodine compound that is tetradecane substituted by an iodo group at position 1.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tetradecasaccharide derivative in which two α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide units are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine branched tetrasaccharide.

name: 3-methylbutyl 2-hydroxypropanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxypropanoic acid with the hydroxy group of isoamylol.

name: chloroprallethrin
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of (1R,3S)-3-(2,2-dichloroethenyl)-2,2-dimethylcyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid and the hydroxy group of (4S)-4-hydroxy-3-methyl-2-(prop-2-yn-1-yl)cyclopent-2-en-1-one.

name: 3-methylbutyl octanoate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of isoamylol with caprylic acid.

name: isoamyl isobutyrate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of isoamylol with isobutyric acid.

name: 16α-hydroxydehydroepiandrosterone 3-sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 16α-hydroxydehydroepiandrosterone 3-sulfate, arising from deprotonation of the sulfate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,5-diaminotetrazole
definition: A member of the class of tetrazoles that is 1H-tetrazole substituted by amino groups at positions 1 and 5 respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear hexasaccharide chain of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose and two further N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which is also linked (1→6) a β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide unit.

name: cyhalodiamide
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide obtained by formal condensation of the two carboxy groups of 2-chlorophthalic acid with the amino groups of 4-(1,1,1,2,3,3,3-heptafluoropropan-2-yl)-2-methylaniline and 2-amino-2-methylpropanenitrile.

name: 3-methylbutyl hexanoate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with the alcoholic hydroxy group of 3-methylbutan-1-ol (isoamylol).

name: fluazaindolizine
definition: A member of the class of imidazopyridines that is the amide formed from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 8-chloro-6-(trifluoromethyl)imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine-2-carboxylic acid with the sulfonamide nitrogen of 2-chloro-5-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonamide.

name: 2-acetoxypropanal
definition: An aldehyde that is propanal substituted by an acetoxy group at position 2.

name: 1-undecyne
definition: A terminal acetylenic compound that is undecane carrying a triple bond at position 1.

name: β-ionone 5,6-epoxide
definition: An apo carotenoid monoterpenoid that is β-ionone substituted by an epoxy group across positions 5 and 6.

name: S-octyl ethanethioate
definition: A thioacetate ester of octane-1-thiol.

name: hexyl propanoate
definition: A propanoate ester of hexan-1-ol.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino nonasaccharide consisting of a tetrasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, all linked sequentially (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which are also linked N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)]-α-D-mannosyl units via (1→6) and (1→3) linkages respectively.

name: 1-aminopentadecane
definition: An alkylamine that is pentadecane substituted by an amino group at position 1.

name: 4-[5-(3,5-dichlorophenyl)-5-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazol-3-yl]-N-[(methoxyamino)methylidene]-2-methylbenzamide
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[5-(3,5-dichlorophenyl)-5-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazol-3-yl]-2-methylbenzoic acid with the amino group of N-methoxymethanimidamide.

name: (S)-fluxametamide
definition: A 4-[5-(3,5-dichlorophenyl)-5-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazol-3-yl]-N-[(methoxyamino)methylidene]-2-methylbenzamide that is the (S)-enantiomer of fluxametamide.

name: (R)-fluxametamide
definition: A 4-[5-(3,5-dichlorophenyl)-5-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazol-3-yl]-N-[(methoxyamino)methylidene]-2-methylbenzamide that is the (R)-enantiomer of fluxametamide.

name: ε-metofluthrin
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of (1R,3R)-2,2-dimethyl-3-[(1Z)-prop-1-en-1-yl]cyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid with the benzylic hydroxy group of [2,3,5,6-tetrafluoro-4-(methoxymethyl)phenyl]methanol.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino decasaccharide consisting of a tetrasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, all linked sequentially (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which are also linked N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)]-α-D-mannosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)]-α-D-mannosyl units via (1→6) and (1→3) linkages respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-{β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a dodecasaccharide derivative consisting of a tetrasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, all linked sequentially (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which are also linked β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl and β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)]-α-D-mannosyl units via (1→6) and (1→3) linkages respectively.

name: hexyl butyrate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of hexanol with butyric acid.

name: ethyl 3-hexenoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester of 3-hexenoic acid.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxyoctadecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3S)-hydroxyoctadecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxyicosanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-hydroxyicosanoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3S)-hydroxyicoscanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxytetracosanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-hydroxytetracosanoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3S)-hydroxytetracoscanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxydocosanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-hydroxydocosanoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3S)-hydroxydocoscanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: thietane
definition: An organosulfur heterocyclic compound containing a saturated four membered ring with 3 carbon atoms and 1 sulfur atom.

name: ε-momfluorothrin
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of (1R,3R)-3-[(1Z)-2-cyanoprop-1-en-1-yl]-2,2-dimethylcyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid with the benzylic hydroxy group of [2,3,5,6-tetrafluoro-4-(methoxymethyl)phenyl]methanol.

name: 1-hepten-3-one
definition: An enone that is hept-1-ene substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: 1-p-menth-1-ene-9-al
definition: A monoterpenoid that is propanal substituted by a 4-methylcyclohex-3-en-1-yl group at position 2.

name: isobutyl decanoate
definition: A decanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of decanoc acid (capric acid) with the alcoholic hydroxy group of isobutanol.

name: 6β-hydroxyandrost-4-ene-3,17-dione
definition: A 6β-hydroxy steroid that is androst-4-ene-3,17-dione substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 6.

name: 2,4,5-trimethyl-1,3-dioxolane
definition: A dioxolane that is 1,3-dioxolane substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 4 and 5 respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a dodecasaccharide derivative consisting of a tetrasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, all linked sequentially (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which are also linked β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl and β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl units via (1→6) and (1→3) linkages respectively.

name: (Z)-β-ocimene
definition: A β-ocimene that consists of octa-1,3,6-triene bearing two methyl substituents at positions 3 and 7 (the 3Z-isomer).

name: ethyl 4-octenoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester of 4-octenoic acid.

name: 3-(difluoromethyl)-N-methoxy-1-methyl-N-[1-(2,4,6-trichlorophenyl)propan-2-yl]pyrazole-4-carboxamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(difluoromethyl)-1-methylpyrazole-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of N-methoxy-1-(2,4,6-trichlorophenyl)propan-2-amine.

name: (S)-pydiflumetofen
definition: 3-(difluoromethyl)-N-methoxy-1-methyl-N-[1-(2,4,6-trichlorophenyl)propan-2-yl]pyrazole-4-carboxamide that is the (S)-enantiomer of pydiflumetofen.

name: (R)-pydiflumetofen
definition: 3-(difluoromethyl)-N-methoxy-1-methyl-N-[1-(2,4,6-trichlorophenyl)propan-2-yl]pyrazole-4-carboxamide that is the (R)-enantiomer of pydiflumetofen.

name: κ-bifenthrin
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (1R,3R)-3-[(1Z)-2-chloro-3,3,3-trifluoroprop-1-enyl]-2,2-dimethylcyclopropanecarboxylic acid with the hydroxy group of [(2-methyl-1,1'-biphenyl)-3-yl]methanol.

name: β-D-Galp6S-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine having a 6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 3.

name: 7-octen-2-one
definition: An methyl ketone that is octan-2-one carrying a double bond at position 7.

name: (4E)-hept-4-en-2-one
definition: A methyl ketone heptan-2-one carrying a double bond at position 4.

name: hexane-2,3-dione
definition: An α-diketone that is hexane substituted by oxo groups at positions 2 and 3 respectively.

name: (4-hexyl-2,5-dioxo-2,5-dihydro-3-furanyl)acetic acid
definition: A cyclic dicarboxylic anhydride that is furan-2,5-dione substituted by at position 3 by a carboxymethyl group and a hexyl group at position 4.

name: 7-octen-2-ol
definition: An olefinic compound that octan-2-ol carrying a double bond at position 7.

name: 3-methylsuccinic anhydride
definition: A tetrahydrofurandione that is succinic anhydride substituted by a methyl group at position 3.

name: SIS3 free base
definition: An enamide resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of 6,7-dimethoxy-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline with the carboxy group of (2E)-3-(1-methyl-2-phenyl-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridin-3-yl)acrylic acid.

name: (2E)-2-tridecene
definition: An alkene that is tridecane carrying a double bond at position 2.

name: SIS3 free base(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the addition of a proton to the free base of SIS3.

name: 2-octylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan substituted by an octyl group at position 2.

name: 15α-hydroxyestradiol
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is 17β-estradiol substituted by an α-hydroxy group at position 15.

name: 2,6-dimethyl-5-hepten-1-ol
definition: An olefinic compound that is hept-5-en-1-ol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 6 respectively.

name: 1-isopropoxyacetone
definition: A methyl ketone that is acetone substituted by an isopropoxy group at position 1.

name: 2-(1-phenylethyl)-1,3-dioxolane
definition: A dioxolane that is 1,3-dioxolane substituted by a 1-phenylethyl group at position 2.

name: 1,3-dioxolane
definition: A cyclic acetal that is pentane in which the carbon atoms at positions 1 and 3 are replaced by oxygen atoms respectively.

name: 7α-hydroxyestradiol
definition: A 7α-hydroxy steroid that is 17β-estradiol substituted by an α-hydroxy group at position 7.

name: 3-cyano-2-butanone
definition: A methyl ketone that is butan-2-one substituted by a cyano group at position 3.

name: 2,6-dimethyl-1,3,5,7-octatetraene
definition: An alkatetraene that is 1,3,5,7-octatetraene substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 6 respectively.

name: 3-phenyldecane
definition: A member of the class of benzenes that is benzene substituted by a decan-3-yl group.

name: 4-hydroxyestrone
definition: A 4-hydroxy steroid that is estrone substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1-4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino heptasaccharide in which two α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to D-galactose.

name: 1,1,6-trimethyltetralin
definition: A member of the class of tetralins that is tetralin substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 1 and 6 respectively.

name: 6α-hydroxyestrone
definition: A 6α-hydroxy steroid that is estrone substituted by an α-hydroxy group at position 6.

name: N-icosanoylglycine
definition: A N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as icosanoyl.

name: 2,3-dihydrobenzofuran
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is the 2,3-dihydroderivative of benzofuran.

name: (16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z)-tetratriacontapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is tetratriacontapentaenoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 16, 19, 22, 25 and 28 (the 16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z-isomer).

name: 3-furaldehyde
definition: An aldehyde that is furan substituted by a formyl group at position 3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)}-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino nonasaccharide in which two α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to D-galactose.

name: 3-formylthiophene
definition: An aldehyde that is thiophene substituted by a formyl group at position 3.

name: (18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z)-hexatriacontapentaenoic acid
definition: A very long-chain ω−6 fatty acid that is hexatriacontanoic acid having five double bonds located at positions 18, 21, 24, 27 and 30 (the 18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z-isomer).

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)}-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecaasaccharide derivative in which two α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl chains are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to D-galactose.

name: 4-hydroxypyridine
definition: A monohydroxypyridine that is pyridine in which the hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tetradecasaccharide derivative in which two N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide units are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine branched tetrasaccharide.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tetradecasaccharide derivative in which two α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide units are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine branched tetrasaccharide.

name: 15α-hydroxyestrone
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is estrone substituted by an α-hydroxy group at position 15.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide comprising a linear pentasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→4), (1→6) and (1→4), to the galactose residue nearer to the reducing end is also linked (1→3) a linear α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl trisaccharide unit.

name: 16β-hydroxyestradiol
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is 17β-estradiol substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 16.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-DGalp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which is (1→4)-linked an Nacetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue, together with two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide units linked (1→3) and (1→6).

name: methanediimine
definition: A carbodiimide in which both nitrogens are unsubstituted.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a pentasaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue [via a (1→4) linkage], an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-α-D-mannosyl(1→6) linear tetrasaccharide chain [linked (1→6)], and an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)]-α-D-mannosyl branched heptasaccharide unit [linked (1→3)].

name: erythrono-1,4-lactone
definition: A butan-4-olide that is dihydrofuran-2-one substituted at C-3 and C-4 by hydroxy groups (the 3R,4R-diastereomer).

name: 6β-hydroxyestrone
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is estrone substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 6.

name: fast blue salt B
definition: An organic chloride salt composed of 3,3'-dimethoxy[1,1'-biphenyl]-4,4'-bis(diazonium), zinc and chloride ions in a ratio of 1:1:4. Used for detection of marijuana metabolites in urine.

name: 16β-hydroxyestrone
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is estrone substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 16.

name: fast blue B
definition: The aromatic diazonium ion formed from diazotisation of 3,3'-dimethoxy[1,1'-biphenyl]-4,4'-diamine.

name: Evans blue free acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is the free acid form of the dye Evans blue. The tetrasodium salt is used as a counterstain, especially in fluorescent methods to suppress background autofluorescence.

name: Evans blue(4−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the four sulfo groups of 6,6'-{(3,3'-dimethyl[1,1'-biphenyl]-4,4'-diyl)bis[diazene-2,1-diyl]}bis(4-amino-5-hydroxynaphthalene-1,3-disulfonic acid).

name: azure A
definition: An organic chloride salt having 3-amino-7-(dimethylamino)phenothiazin-5-ium as the counterion. It is used in making azure eosin stains for blood smear staining.

name: 3-amino-7-(dimethylamino)phenothiazin-5-ium
definition: An organic cation that is phenothiazin-5-ium substituted by amino and dimethylamino groups at positions 3 and 7 respectively. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'azure A'.

name: azure B
definition: An organic chloride salt having 3-(dimethylamino)-7-(methylamino)phenothiazin-5-ium as the counterion. It is used in making azure eosin stains for blood smear staining and is an active metabolite of methylene blue.

name: 3-(dimethylamino)-7-(methylamino)phenothiazin-5-ium
definition: An organic cation that is phenothiazin-5-ium substituted by dimethylamino and amino groups at positions 3 and 7 respectively. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'azure B'.

name: azure C
definition: An organic chloride salt having 3-amino-7-(methylamino)phenothiazin-5-ium as the counterion.

name: 3-amino-7-(methylamino)phenothiazin-5-ium
definition: An organic cation that is phenothiazin-5-ium substituted by amino and methylamino groups at positions 3 and 7 respectively. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'azure C'.

name: victoria blue 4R
definition: An iminium salt composed of 4-([4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]{4-[methyl(phenyl)amino]naphthalen-1-yl}methylidene)-N,N-dimethylcyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-iminium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio. It binds to nucleic acids and can be used in standardised staining techniques suitable for automated cell-pattern recognition.

name: victoria blue 4R(1+)
definition: An iminium ion that forms the cationic portion of the histological dye 'victoria blue 4R'.

name: night blue
definition: An iminium salt composed of 4-{(4-anilinonaphthalen-1-yl)[4-(diethylamino)phenyl]methylidene}-N,N-diethylcyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-iminium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio.

name: night blue(1+)
definition: An iminium ion that forms the cationic portion of the histological dye 'night blue'.

name: tolonium chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt having 3-amino-7-(dimethylamino)-2-methylphenothiazin-5-ium (tolonium) as the counterion. It is a blue nuclear counterstain that can be used to demonstrate Nissl substance and is also useful for staining mast cell granules, both in metachromatic and orthochromatic techniques.

name: tolonium
definition: An organic cation that is phenothiazin-5-ium substituted by methyl, amino and dimethylamino groups at positions 2, 3 and 7 respectively. The chloride salt is used as a histological dye.

name: methyl green
definition: An iminium salt composed of (4-{[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl][4-(trimethylazaniumyl)phenyl]methylidene}cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)(dimethyl)ammonium and chloride ions in a 1:2 ratio. A histological dye used to demonstrate nucleic acids by the Unna-Pappenheim stain, in conjunction with Pyronin Y.

name: methyl green(2+)
definition: An iminium ion that forms the cationic portion of the histological dye 'methyl green'.

name: victoria blue B
definition: An iminium salt composed of 4-{(4-anilinonaphthalen-1-yl)[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]methylidene}-N,N-dimethylcyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-iminium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio. It binds to nucleic acids and can be used in standardised staining techniques suitable for automated cell-pattern recognition.

name: victoria blue B(1+)
definition: An iminium ion that forms the cationic portion of the histological dye 'victoria blue B'.

name: (25R)-3β,26-dihydroxycholest-5-en-7-one
definition: An oxysterol that is 7-ketocholesterol which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 26 and has R-configuration at position 25.

name: basic brown 1
definition: A bis(azo) compound that is 1,1'-(1,3-phenylene)bis(diazene) in which both azene hydrogens are replaced by 2,4-diaminophenyl groups. A metachromatic dye which stains acid mucins yellow. It is also a constituent of Papanicolaou's EA solutions, used for cervical, and other smears. Its dihydrochloride salt is also a biological dye known as Bismark brown Y.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a pentadecasaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue [via a (1→4) linkage], an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched heptasaccharide unit [linked (1→6)], and an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear tetrasaccharide unit [linked (1→3)].

name: N'-[(4-oxo-4H-chromen-3-yl)methylene]nicotinohydrazide
definition: A carbohydrazide that is nicotinohydrazide in which the terminal nitrogen has undergone formal condensation with the aldehyde group of 4-oxo-4H-chromene-3-carbaldehyde. It is an inhibitor of STAT5 (Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 5) protein.

name: pararosaniline
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride of 4,4'-[(4-iminocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)methanediyl]dianiline. One of the major constituents of Basic fuchsin, together with rosanilin, magenta II and new fuchsin.

name: pararosaniline(1+)
definition: An iminium ion obtained by protonation of the imino group of pararosaniline free base.

name: rosanilin
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride of 4-[(4-aminophenyl)(4-iminocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)methyl]-2-methylaniline. One of the major constituents of Basic fuchsin, together with pararosanilin, magenta II and new fuchsin.

name: rosanilin free base
definition: An imine that is 4-methylidenecyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-imine in which the hydrogens of the methylidene group are replaced by 4-aminophenyl and 3-methyl-4-aminophenyl groups. The monohydrochloride salt is the histological dye 'rosanilin'.

name: rosanilin(1+)
definition: An iminium ion obtained by protonation of the imino group of rosanilin free base.

name: magenta II
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride of 4-[(4-aminophenyl)(4-iminocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)methyl]-2-methylaniline. One of the minor constituents of Basic fuchsin, together with pararosanilin, rosanilin and new fuchsin.

name: magenta II free base
definition: An imine that is 4-methylidenecyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-imine in which both the hydrogens of the methylidene group are replaced by 4-amino-3-methylphenyl groups. The hydrochloride salt is the histological dye 'magenta II'.

name: magenta II(1+)
definition: An iminium ion obtained by protonation of the imino group of magenta II free base.

name: new fuchsin
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride of 4-[(4-aminophenyl)(4-iminocyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)methyl]-2-methylaniline. One of the minor constituents of Basic fuchsin, together with pararosanilin, rosanilin and magenta II.

name: new fuchsin free base
definition: An imine that is 2-methyl-4-methylidenecyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-imine in which both the hydrogens of the methylidene group are replaced by 4-amino-3-methylphenyl groups. The hydrochloride salt is the histological dye 'new fuchsin'.

name: new fuchsin(1+)
definition: An iminium ion obtained by protonation of the imino group of new fuchsin free base.

name: methylene green
definition: An organic chloride salt having 3,7-bis(dimethylamino)-4-nitrophenothiazin-5-ium as the counterion. It stains nuclei green and is sometimes used as a counterstain to red or purple primary stains.

name: (−)-car-4-ene
definition: A monoterpene that is bicyclo[4.1.0]hept-2-ene substituted by methyl groups at positions 4, 7 and 7 respectively (the 1R,4S,6S-stereoisomer).

name: (25R)-3β-hydroxycholest-5-en-7-one-26-al
definition: A 26-oxo steroid resulting from the oxidation of (25R)-3β,26-dihydroxycholest-5-en-7-one to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: (25R)-3β-hydroxycholest-5-en-7-one-26-oate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (25R)-3β-hydroxycholest-5-en-7-one-26-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-[(2-hydroxyethyl)thio]-1-propanol
definition: An aliphatic sulfide that is propan-1-ol substituted by a (2-hydroxyethyl)thio group at position 3.

name: 3,7-bis(dimethylamino)-4-nitrophenothiazin-5-ium
definition: An organic cation that is phenothiazin-5-ium substituted by dimethylamino groups at positions 3 and 7 as well as a nitro group at position 4. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'methylene green'.

name: (2E)-hex-2-en-1-yl propanoate
definition: The propanoate ester of (2E)-hex-2-en-1-ol.

name: isobutyl butyrate
definition: A butyrate ester resulting from the formal condensation of butanoic acid with isobutanol. It is used as a food flavour ingredient for apple, banana, peach and pinapple flavours in ice cream and confectionery.

name: pentyl butyrate
definition: The butyrate ester of pentan-1-ol.

name: ethyl 3-hydroxybutyrate
definition: The fatty acid ethyl ester of 3-hydroxybutyric acid.

name: ethyl 4-tert-butylbenzoate
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of 4-tert-butylbenzoic acid with ethanol.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxyoleoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An (S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3S)-3-hydroxyoleoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ethyl 2-heptenoate
definition: The fatty acid ethyl ester of 2-heptenoic acid.

name: trans-4-tert-butylcyclohexanecarboxylic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is cyclohexanecarboxylic acid substituted by a tert-butyl group at position 4 (the trans-stereoisomer).

name: N-(2,6-dimethylphenyl)-2-{4-[2-hydroxy-3-(2-methoxyphenoxy)propyl]piperazin-1-yl}acetamide
definition: An aromatic amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-{4-[2-hydroxy-3-(2-methoxyphenoxy)propyl]piperazin-1-yl}acetic acid with the amino group of 2,6-dimethylaniline.

name: mesylmethyl(benzyl)sulfone
definition: A member of the class of benzenes that is benzene substituted by a [(methanesulfonyl)methanesulfonyl]methyl group.

name: (S)-ranolazine

name: (7Z)-hexadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A hexadecenoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (7Z)-hexadecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (24E)-3α,7α-dihydroxy-5β-cholest-24-en-26-oyl-CoA(4−)

name: (2E,5Z)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An 2,3-trans-enoyl CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (2E,5Z)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (24R,25R)-3α,7α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (24R,25R)-3α,7α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dihydroxy mycolic acid

definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 3α,7α-dihydroxy-24-oxo-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3S,5Z)-3-hydroxytetradec-5-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A long-chain (3S)-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3S,5Z)-3-hydroxytetradec-5-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dihydroxy mycolate
definition: A very long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of dihydroxy mycolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z)-3-oxotetradecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (5Z)-3-oxotetradecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-prasugrel hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of (S)-prasugrel with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid (the racemic salt is a cardiovascular drug).

name: methoxy mycolate
definition: An ultra-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of methoxy mycolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3E)-tetradecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3E)-tetradecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: keto mycolate
definition: A very long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of keto mycolic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,4E)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (2E,4E)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2R,3R)-2,3-di(propan-2-yl)oxirane

name: (R)-prasugrel hydrochloride

name: (−)-dihydroedulan II

name: (2E,7Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA(4−)

name: (3S,7Z)-3-hydroxyhexadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acyl CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3S,7Z)-3-hydroxyhexadecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z)-3-oxohexadecenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (7Z)-3-oxohexadecenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-oxo-1,6-dihydrodibenzo[cd,g]indazole-3-sulfonic acid

name: (2E)-hexenoic acid

name: (2E)-hexenoate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (2E)-hexenoic acid.

name: 5-[2-cyclopropyl-1-(2-fluorophenyl)-2-oxoethyl]-4,5,6,7-tetrahydrothieno[3,2-c]pyridin-2-yl acetate

name: (S)-prasugrel
definition: An 5-[2-cyclopropyl-1-(2-fluorophenyl)-2-oxoethyl]-4,5,6,7-tetrahydrothieno[3,2-c]pyridin-2-yl acetate that is the (S)-enantiomer of prasugrel (the racemate is a cardiovascular drug).

name: (R)-prasugrel
definition: An 5-[2-cyclopropyl-1-(2-fluorophenyl)-2-oxoethyl]-4,5,6,7-tetrahydrothieno[3,2-c]pyridin-2-yl acetate that is the (R)-enantiomer of prasugrel (the racemate is a cardiovascular drug).

name: (R)-prasugrel(1+)

name: isolithocholate

name: 7α-hydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of 7α-hydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-(3-oxo-1-phenylbutyl)-1-benzopyran-2-one

name: 3β,12α-dihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3β,12α-dihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. The 3β-hydroxy epimer of deoxycholate. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 12α-hydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12α-hydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3β,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3β,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. The 3β-hydroxy epimer of cholate. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 7α,12α-dihydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of 7α,12α-dihydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-warfarin

name: (S)-warfarin

name: (R)-warfarin sodium

name: (S)-warfarin sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt having 2-oxo-3-[(1S)-3-oxo-1-phenylbutyl]-2H-1-benzopyran-4-olate as the counterion (the racemate is warfarin sodium, an anticoagulant drug and rodenticide).

name: (R)-warfarin potassium
definition: An organic potassium salt having 2-oxo-3-[(1R)-3-oxo-1-phenylbutyl]-2H-1-benzopyran-4-olate as the counterion (the racemate is warfarin potassium, an anticoagulant drug and rodenticide).

name: (S)-warfarin potassium
definition: An organic potassium salt having 2-oxo-3-[(1S)-3-oxo-1-phenylbutyl]-2H-1-benzopyran-4-olate as the counterion (the racemate is warfarin potassium, an anticoagulant drug and rodenticide).

name: (R)-warfarin(1−)

name: 7α-hydroxy-3-oxochol-4-en-24-oate

definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-oxochola-4,6-dien-24-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-gulonic acid

name: 2,4-dimethyl-3-pentanone

name: N-carboxyglycine

name: L-ribonic acid

name: (2Z,4Z)-2-hydroxyhepta-2,4-dienedioic acid

name: (3S)-3-hydroxyicosanoyl-CoA

name: isobutyl 2-phenylethyl 2,6-pyridinedicarboxylate
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine substituted by a (2-methylpropoxy)carbonyl and a (2-phenylethoxy)carbonyl group at positions 2 and 6 respectively.

name: (4E,6E)-3-hydroxydeca-4,6-dienoic acid
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is deca-4,6-dienoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3 (the 4E,6E-stereoisomer).

name: (4E,6E)-3-hydroxydeca-4,6-dienoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (4E,6E)-3-hydroxydeca-4,6-dienoic acid.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxytetracosanoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxytetracosanoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3S)-3-hydroxytetracosanoic acid.

name: (3S)-3-hydroxydocosanoyl-CoA

name: β-D-GalpNAc6S-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc

name: sodium glycochenodeoxycholate

name: 1-[(1Z)-octadec-1-enyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1-(Z-alk-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the Z-alk-1-enyl group is specified as (1Z)-octadec-1-enyl.

name: methionine sulfone zwitterion

name: N-acetyl-L-methionine sulfoximine(1−)

name: 2''-O-glutaryl-ADP-D-ribose(3−)

name: (S)-4-hydroxy-1-pyrroline-2-carboxylate

name: framycetin(6+)

name: 4-pregnen-20,21-diol-3-one

name: 4,6-dioxoheptanoic acid
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid that is heptanoic acid in which oxo groups replace the hydrogens at positions 4 and 6. It is an abnormal metabolite of the tyrosine metabolic pathway and a marker for type 1 tyrosinaemia.

name: 2R-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-16-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}hexadecyl]hexacosanoate
definition: A C76 α-mycolate having a C50 meromycolic chain and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: 9-ribosyl-trans-zeatin 5'-phosphate(2−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion that is that is AMP(2−) substituted at position N-6 by a (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-ribosyl-trans-zeatin 5'-diphosphate(3−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion that is ADP(3−) substituted at position N-6 by a (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group; major structure at pH 7.3.

name: 9-ribosyl-trans-zeatin 5'-triphosphate(4−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion that is that is ATP(4−) substituted at position N-6 by a (2E)-4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-18-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}octadecyl]tetracosanoate

definition: A C78 α-mycolate having a C54 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C24 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

definition: A C80 α-mycolate having a C54 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

definition: A C80 α-mycolate having a C54 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-22-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}docosyl]hexacosanoate
definition: A C82 α-mycolate having a C56 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

definition: A C82 α-mycolate having a C56 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z)-tetratriacontapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (16Z,19Z,22Z,25Z,28Z)-tetratriacontapentaenoic acid.

name: (13C5,15N)-valine
definition: An L-α-amino acid that is L-valine in which all five carbons are 13C isotopes while the nitrogen is the 15N isotope.

name: D-(1-13C)glucitol
definition: A glucitol that is D-glucitol in which the carbon at position 1 is the 13C isotope.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-18-{2-[10-(2-nonadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}octadecyl]hexacosanoate
definition: A C79 α-mycolate having a C53 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-20-{2-[10-(2-nonadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}icosyl]hexacosanoate
definition: A C81 α-mycolate having a C55 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z)-hexatriacontapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (18Z,21Z,24Z,27Z,30Z)-hexatriacontapentaenoic acid.

name: (20Z,23Z,26Z,29Z,32Z)-octatriacontapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (20Z,23Z,26Z,29Z,32Z)-octatriacontapentaenoic acid.

name: cis-4,5-bis(trimethylsiloxy)-1,2-dithiane
definition: A member of the class of dithianes that is 1,2-dithiane substituted at positions 4 and 5 by trimethylsilyloxy groups.

name: hexadecamethylcyclooctasiloxane
definition: A macrocyclic organosiloxane composed from eight repeating Me2SiO units.

name: 1,1,1-propanetricarboxylate
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 1,1,1-propanetricarboxylic acid.

name: p-tolyl β-D-glucuronide
definition: A glucosiduronic acid that is β-D-glucuronic acid in which the anomeric hydroxyl hydrogen is replaced by a p-tolyl group.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-12-{2-[14-(2-icosylcyclopropyl)tetradecyl]cyclopropyl}dodecyl]hexacosanoate
definition: A C78 α-mycolate having a C52 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: tetradecamethylcycloheptasiloxane
definition: A macrocyclic organosiloxane composed from seven units of dimethylsiloxane.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-14-{2-[14-(2-icosylcyclopropyl)tetradecyl]cyclopropyl}tetradecyl]hexacosanoate
definition: A C80 α-mycolate having a C54 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-14-{2-[(15Z)-hexatriacont-15-en-1-yl]cyclopropyl}-1-hydroxytetradecyl]hexacosanoate
definition: A C79 α-mycolate having a saturated C26 α-branch and a C53 meromycolic chain with a distal cis-double bond and a proximal cis-cyclopropyl function. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a linear trisaccharide derivative of α-L-fucose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and (at the reducing end) α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→2), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue of which is also linked (1→3) a β-D-galactose residue.

name: 3-(m-hydroxyphenyl)propanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propanoic acid.

name: 3-aminobutyrate
definition: A branched-chain amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-aminobutyric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 6-ketopiperidine-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A δ-lactam that is piperidine-2-carboxylic acid substituted at position 6 by an oxo group.

name: 3,5-dioxooctanedioic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is suberic acid which oxo groups replace the hydrogens at positions 3 and 5. It is an abnormal metabolite of the tyrosine metabolic pathway and a marker for type 1 tyrosinaemia.

name: Asp-Gly-Glu
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-aspartic acid, glycine, and L-glutamic acid units joined in sequence.

name: Asp-Gly-Glu(3−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of Asp-Gly-Glu.

name: 3-phosphoglycerate(2−)
