name: 3-oxooleoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-oxooleic acid.

name: (7Z)-hexadecenoyl-CoA
definition: A hexadecenoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (7Z)-hexadecenoic acid.

name: 3,7-diamino-5-phenylphenazin-5-ium
definition: An organic cation that is 5-phenylphenazin-5-ium substituted by amino groups at positions 3 and 7. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'phenosafranine'.

name: ethyl violet
definition: An organic chloride salt that is the monochloride salt of ethyl violet cation. Used for inclusion in mixed dye solutions of the iron resorcin fuchsin type for demonstrating elastic fibres.

name: ethyl violet cation
definition: An iminium ion that is the cationic component of the histological dye 'ethyl violet'.

name: Sudan IV
definition: A bis(azo) compound that is 2-naphthol substituted at position 1 by a {2-methyl-4-[(2-methylphenyl)diazenyl]phenyl}diazenyl group. A fat-soluble dye predominantly used for demonstrating triglycerides in frozen sections, but which may also stain some protein bound lipids in paraffin sections.

name: archaeal dolichol
definition: Any one of a group of polyprenols made up of varying numbers of cis-linked isoprene units, terminating in an α-saturated isoprenoid group containing an alcohol functional group. Dolichol used by archaea is is generally much shorter (C55-C60) than that used by eukaryotes and may have additional saturation positions in the chain.

name: naphthalene blue black CS
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal condensation of naphthalene blue black CS (acid form) with two equivalents of sodium hydroxide. Used for staining fibrin.

name: naphthalene blue black CS (acid form)
definition: A bis(azo) compound that is naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 3, 4, 5, and 6 are replaced by (p-nitrophenyl)azo, amino, hydroxy, and (p-sulfophenyl)azo groups, respectively. The trisodium salt is the histological dye 'naphthalene blue black CS'.

name: archaeal dolichyl N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl phosphate(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of archaeal dolichyl N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3. Dolichol used by archaea is is generally much shorter (C55-C60) than that used by eukaryotes and may have additional saturation positions in the chain.

name: 4-amino-5-hydroxy-3-[(4-nitrophenyl)diazenyl]-6-[(4-sulfonatophenyl)diazenyl]naphthalene-2,7-disulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of naphthalene blue black CS (acid form).

name: archaeal dolichyl 3-O-(2,3-diacetamido-2,3-dideoxy- β-D-glucuronsyl)-N-acetyl- α-D-glucosaminyl phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate group of any archaeal dolichyl 3-O-(2,3-diacetamido-2,3-dideoxy- β-D-glucuronsyl)-N-acetyl- α-D-glucosaminyl phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a tridecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end) all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear pentasaccharide units.

name: ketomycolate type-3 (XIII')
definition: The conjugate base of ketomycolic acid type-3 (XIII'). A class of mycolic acids characterized by the presence of a proximal cis C=C double bond followed by a cis-cyclopropyl group, a distal oxo group and a (CH-CH3) fragment of (S) stereochemistry in the meromycolic chain.

name: CDP-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-mannose(2−)
definition: A CDP-3,6-dideoxy-D-mannose(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the sugar component has α-configuration; major species at pH 7.3.

name: UDP-β-L-iduronate(3−)
definition: A UDP-L-iduronate(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the sugar component has β-configuration; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cylindrospermopsin zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the sulfooxy group to one of the nitrogens of the guanidine group of cylindrospermopsin.

name: cylindrospermopsin
definition: A triazaacenaphthylene that is 2,2a,3,4,5,5a,6,7-octahydro-1H-1,8,8b-triazaacenaphthylene which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 7 by methyl, sulfooxy, and (2,6-dioxo-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyrimidin-4-yl)(hydroxy)methyl groups, respectively (the 2aS,3R,4S,5aS,7R stereoisomer in which the carbon bearing the hydroxy group has R configuration). It is a cyanotoxin produced by several species of freshwater cyanobacteria, such as Aphanizomenon ovalisporum.

name: 7-epi-cylindrospermopsin
definition: A triazaacenaphthylene that is 2,2a,3,4,5,5a,6,7-octahydro-1H-1,8,8b-triazaacenaphthylene which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 7 by methyl, sulfooxy, and (2,6-dioxo-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyrimidin-4-yl)(hydroxy)methyl groups, respectively (the 2aS,3R,4S,5aS,7R stereoisomer in which the carbon bearing the hydroxy group has S configuration). It is a cyanotoxin produced by several species of freshwater cyanobacteria, such as Aphanizomenon ovalisporum.

name: deoxycylindrospermopsin
definition: A triazaacenaphthylene that is 2,2a,3,4,5,5a,6,7-octahydro-1H-1,8,8b-triazaacenaphthylene which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 7 by methyl, sulfooxy, and (2,6-dioxo-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyrimidin-4-yl)methyl groups, respectively (the 2aS,3R,4S,5aS,7R stereoisomer). A non-toxic analogue of the cyanotoxins cylindrospermopsin and 7-epi-cylindrospermopsin (the latter two have a hydroxy group attached to the carbon adjacent to the uracil ring), it is produced by several species of freshwater cyanobacteria, such as Cylindrospermopsis raciborskii.

name: prenyl phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of prenyl phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [5-(ammoniomethyl)-3-furyl]methyl diphosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of [5-(aminomethyl)-3-furyl]methyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4-{4-[2-(γ-L-glutamylamino)ethyl]phenoxymethyl}furan-2-yl)methanamine(1+)
definition: An α-amino-acid cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the amino groups of (4-{4-[2-(γ-L-glutamylamino)ethyl]phenoxymethyl}furan-2-yl)methanamine: major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(4-bromobutyl)-2-piperidinone
definition: A member of the class of δ-lactams that is 2-piperidinone in which the amide hydrogen is replaced by a 4-bromobutyl group.

name: 1,2,4-butanetriol
definition: A triol that is butane carrying three hydroxy substituents at position 1, 2 and 4.

name: (24E)-3α,7α-dihydroxy-5β-cholest-24-en-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (24E)-3α,7α-dihydroxy-5β-cholest-24-en-26-oic acid.

name: (24R,25R)-3α,7α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (24R,25R)-3α,7α,24-trihydroxy-5β-cholestan-26-oic acid.

name: (2E,5Z)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,5Z)-tetradecadienoic acid.

name: (3S,5Z)-3-hydroxytetradec-5-enoyl-CoA
definition: A long-chain (3S)-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3S,5Z)-3-hydroxytetradec-5-enoic acid.

name: (5Z)-3-oxotetradecenoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (5Z)-3-oxotetradecenoic acid.

name: (3E)-tetradecenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3E)-tetradecenoic acid.

name: (2E,4E)-tetradecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,4E)-tetradecadienoic acid.

name: (2E,7Z)-hexadecadienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E,7Z)-hexadecadienoic acid.

name: (3S,7Z)-3-hydroxyhexadecenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3S,7Z)-3-hydroxyhexadecenoic acid.

name: (7Z)-3-oxohexadecenoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (7Z)-3-oxohexadecenoic acid.

name: 6-deoxy-6-sulfoglucono-1,5-lactone(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 6-deoxy-6-sulfoglucono-1,5-lactone, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-deoxy-6-sulfo-D-gluconate(2−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and sulfo groups of 6-deoxy-6-sulfo-D-gluconic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-dehydro-3,6-dideoxy-6-sulfo-D-gluconate(2−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and sulfo groups of 2-dehydro-3,6-dideoxy-6-sulfo-D-gluconnic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-hexanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A phytoceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexanoyl.

name: N-hexanoylphytosphingosine 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of N-hexanoylphytosphingosine 1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7α-hydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oic acid
definition: A 3-oxo steroid that is chenodeoxycholic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has undergone formal oxidation to the corresponding ketone.

name: 3β,12α-dihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oic acid
definition: A dihydroxy-5β-cholanic acid in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 3β and 12α. The 3β-hydroxy epimer of deoxycholic acid.

name: D-3-sulfolactaldehyde(1−)
definition: A 3-sulfolactaldehyde(1−) in which the stereocentre at position 3 has R-configuration.

name: 3β,7α-dihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oic acid
definition: A dihydroxy-5β-cholanic acid in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 3β and 7α. The 3β-hydroxy epimer of chenodeoxycholic acid.

name: 12α-hydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oic acid
definition: A 3-oxo-5β-steroid that is 7-deoxycholic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has undergone formal oxidation to the corresponding ketone.

name: 3β,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oic acid
definition: A trihydroxy-5β-cholanic acid that is 5β-cholan-24-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 7 and 12 (the 3β,7α,12α stereoisomer).

name: geranyl phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of geranyl phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7α,12α-dihydroxy-3-oxo-5β-cholan-24-oic acid
definition: A 3-oxo steroid that is cholic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has undergone formal oxidation to the corresponding ketone.

name: 7α-hydroxy-3-oxochol-4-en-24-oic acid
definition: A 3-oxo Δ4-steroid that is 3-oxochol-4-en-24-oic acid carrying an additional 7α-hydroxy substituent.

name: 3-oxochola-4,6-dien-24-oic acid
definition: A 3-oxo Δ4-steroid that is the 3-oxo derivative of chola-4,6-dien-24-oic acid.

name: 2-ethylhexyl sulfate
definition: An alkyl sulfate that is the mono(2-ethylhexyl) ester of sulfuric acid.

name: 2,3-epoxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 2,3-epoxy-2,3-dihydrobenzoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-2,3-dehydro-2,6-dideoxy-4-keto-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-(2R,6S)-4-hydroxy-2-methyl-3-oxo-3,6-dihydro-2H-pyran-3(6H)-one; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-18-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}octadecyl]tetracosanoic acid
definition: A C76 mycolic acid having a C52 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C24 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-18-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}octadecyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C78 mycolic acid having a C52 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-16-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}hexadecyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C76 mycolic acid having a C50 meromycolic chain and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (R)-12-hydroxysqualene
definition: A triterpenoid that is squalene substituted at position 12 by a hydroxy group (the R-enantiomer).

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-20-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}icosyl]tetracosanoic acid
definition: A C78 mycolic acid having a C54 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C24 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-20-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}icosyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C80 mycolic acid having a C54 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-18-{2-[10-(2-icosylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}octadecyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C80 mycolic acid having a C54 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-22-{2-[10-(2-octadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}docosyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C82 mycolic acid having a C56 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-20-{2-[10-(2-icosylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}icosyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C82 mycolic acid having a C56 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: N-glycoloyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate
definition: An N-acyl-D-glucosamine phosphate in which the N-acyl group is specified as glycoloyl and the phosphate group is located at position 6. An intermediate in the N-glycolylneuraminic acid (Neu5Gc) degradation pathway

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-18-{2-[10-(2-nonadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}octadecyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C79 mycolic acid having a C53 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: D-ribitol 1-phosphate
definition: A ribitol phosphate that is D-ribitol carrying a single monophosphate substituent at position 1.

name: N-acetyl-L-methionine sulfone
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid that is N-acetyl-L-methionine where the sulfur is oxidised to the corresponding sulfone.

name: N-acetyl-L-methionine sulfoximine
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid that is L-methionine sulfoximine in which a hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by an acetyl group.

name: 2-hydro-β-NADP(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 2-hydro-β-NADP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydro-β-NAD(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 2-hydro-β-NAD; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-hydro-β-NADP(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 6-hydro-β-NADP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-hydro-β-NAD(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 6-hydro-β-NAD; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2''-O-glutaryl-ADP-D-ribose
definition: A nucleotide-sugar having ADP as the nucleotide fragment and 2-O-glutaryl-D-ribofuranos-5-yl as the sugar component.

name: (3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)methyloxidanyl
definition: An organic radical obtained by abstraction of the hydroxy proton from (3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)methanol.

name: 2''-O-succinyl-ADP-D-ribose
definition: A nucleotide-sugar having ADP as the nucleotide fragment and 2-O-succinyl-D-ribofuranos-5-yl as the sugar component.

name: 2''-O-malonyl-ADP-D-ribose
definition: A nucleotide-sugar having ADP as the nucleotide fragment and 2-O-malonyl-D-ribofuranos-5-yl as the sugar component.

name: 2,5-dihydroxybenzoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 2,5-dihydroxybenzoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-4-hydroxy-1-pyrroline-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A 4-hydroxy-1-pyrroline-2-carboxylic acid in which the 4-hydroxy group has S-configuration.

name: 2-O-[α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-glucosyl]-D-glyceric acid
definition: A glycoside consisting of D-glyceric acid having an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-glucosyl residue attached at position 2 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: tripropionin
definition: A triglyceride obtained by formal acylation of the three hydroxy groups of glycerol by propionic acid.

name: cis-3-hydroxy-D-proline
definition: A D-proline derivative that is D-proline monohydroxylated at position 3 (the cis-3-hydroxy-diastereomer).

name: 1,4-naphthoquinone-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid that is 1,4-naphthoquinone substituted at position 2 by a carboxy group.

name: 3-hydroxy-O,5-dimethyl-L-tyrosine
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is O-methyl-L-tyrosine carrying additional hydroxy and methyl substituents at positions 3 and 5 respectively.

name: 4-azaleucine
definition: An alanine derivative obtained by replacement of one of the methyl hydrogens of alanine by a dimethylamino group.

name: 3-chloroalanine
definition: A chloroalanine obtained by replacement of one of the methyl hydrogens of alanine by a chloro group.

name: (S)-2-methylbutanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 2-methylbutanoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of (S)-2-methylbutanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: brilliant cresyl blue
definition: An organic tetrachlorozincate salt having 3-amino-7-(diethylamino)-2-methylphenoxazin-5-ium as the counterion. Used for the staining of reticulocytes and platelets.

name: tetrachlorozincate(2−)
definition: A divalent inorganic anion composed of four chlorine atoms bound to a central zinc atom.

name: brilliant cresyl blue(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is phenoxazin-5-ium substituted by methyl, amino and diethylamino groups at positions 2, 3 and 7 respectively. The tetrachlorozincate salt salt is the histological dye 'brilliant cresyl blue'.

name: 2,2-dimethyl-3,6,9,12,15-pentaoxa-2-silahexadecane
definition: A polyether that is tetraethylene glycol in which the terminal hydroxy hydrogens are replaced by methyl and trimethylsilyl groups.

name: brilliant green
definition: An organic hydrogensulfate salt having 4-{[4-(diethylamino)phenyl](phenyl)methylidene}-N,N-diethylcyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-iminium as the counterion.

name: 7,9-di-tert-butyl-1-oxaspiro[4.5]deca-6,9-diene-2,8-dione
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is 1-oxaspiro[4.5]deca-6,9-diene-2,8-dione carrying two additional tert-butyl substituents at positions 7 and 9.

name: brilliant green cation
definition: An iminium ion that is the cationic component of the histological dye 'brilliant green'.

name: bis(trimethylsilyl)isovanillate
definition: A benzoate ester that is 3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoic acid in which the carboxy and phenolic hydrogens are replaced by trimethylsilyl groups.

name: nuclear fast red
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of 4-amino-1,3-dihydroxy-9,10-dioxo-9,10-dihydroanthracene-2-sulfonic acid. It forms bright red lakes with calcium and is a useful red nuclear staining lake with aluminum.

name: nuclear fast red free acid
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyanthraquinones that is 1,3-dihydroxyanthraquinone carrying additional sulfo and amino substituents at positions 2 and 4 respectively. The sodium salt is the histological dye 'nuclear fast red'

name: diethyl(propyl)amine
definition: A tertiary amine that is propylamine in which the two amino hydrogens are replaced by ethyl groups.

name: nuclear fast red(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of nuclear fast red free acid, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group.

name: methyl 1-methyl-5-oxo-L-prolinate
definition: An α-amino acid ester that is the methyl ester of 1-methyl-5-oxo-L-proline.

name: Celestin blue B
definition: An organic chloride salt composed of 1-carbamoyl-7-(diethylamino)-3,4-dihydroxyphenoxazin-5-ium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio. A histological dye used in solution with an iron alum mordant as a hematoxylin substitute in the H&E stain.

name: N,N-dipropylformamide
definition: A formamide in which the amide hydrogens of formamide are replaced by propyl groups.

name: Celestin blue B(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is 3,4-dihydroxyphenoxazin-5-ium carrying additional carbamoyl and diethylamino groups at positions 1 and 7 respectively. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'Celestin blue B'.

name: 2-oxido-5-methylquinone
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the hydroxy group of 2-hydroxy-5-methylquinone. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: Sirius red 4B
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal condensation of Sirius red 4B (acid form) with two equivalents of sodium hydroxide. Used as the plasma stain in some trichrome staining methods.

name: Sirius red 4B (acid form)
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is 7-amino-4-hydroxy-3-({4-[(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]phenyl}diazenyl)naphthalene-2-sulfonic acid in which one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by a benzoyl group. The disodium salt is the histological dye 'Sirius red 4B'.

name: Sirius red 4B(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of Sirius red 4B (acid form).

name: Pontamine sky blue 5B (acid form)
definition: A ring assembly consisting of two 5-amino-4-hydroxy-3-[(2-methoxyphenyl)diazenyl]naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid units joined by a 4,4'-linkage. The tetrasodium salt is the histological dye 'Pontamine sky blue 5B'.

name: Pontamine sky blue 5B(4−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of Pontamine sky blue 5B (acid form).

name: Chrome fast yellow 8GL
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal condensation of Chrome fast yellow 8GL (acid form) with two equivalents of sodium hydroxide.

name: Chrome fast yellow 8GL (acid form)
definition: A member of the class of benzoisoquinolines that is 6-amino-1,3-dioxo-5-sulfobenzo[de]isoquinoline substituted at position 2 by a 3-carboxy-4-hydroxyphenyl group. The disodium salt is the histological dye 'Chrome fast yellow 8GL'.

name: Chrome fast yellow 8GL(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo and carboxy groups of Chrome fast yellow 8GL (acid form).

name: benazeprilat
definition: A benzazepine that is 1,3,4,5-tetrahydro-2H-1-benzazepin-2-one in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a carboxy methyl group and in which the 3-pro-S hydrogen is replaced by the amino group of (2S)-2-amino-4-phenylbutanoic acid. An angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor, it is used as its monoester prodrug benazepril in the treatment of hypertension and heart failure.

name: benazepril(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group of benazepril.

name: Congo corinth
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal condensation of Congo corinth (acid form) with two equivalents of sodium hydroxide. A histological dye used to stain frozen sections for rapid diagnosis and to demonstrate amuloid.

name: Congo corinth (acid form)
definition: An aminonaphthalenesulfonic acid that is 3,3'-[[1,1'-biphenyl]-4,4'-diylbis(diazene-2,1-diyl)]di(naphthalene-1-sulfonic acid) in which the two hydrogens at the 4-positions on the naphthalene rings are placed by amino and hydroxy groups. The disodium salt is the histological dye 'Congo corinth'.

name: Congo corinth(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of Congo corinth (acid form).

name: Hoffman's violet
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining Hoffman's violet free base with one molar equivalent of hydrogen chloride. A specific stain for animal chromosomes.

name: methyl 3-{4-[2-hydroxy-3-(propan-2-ylamino)propoxy]phenyl}propanoate
definition: A methyl ester that is methyl 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate in which the hydrogen attached to the phenolic hydroxy group is substituted by a 2-hydroxy-3-(isopropylamino)propyl group.

name: Hoffman's violet free base
definition: A aromatic amine, the hydrochloride salt of which is the histological dye 'Hoffman's violet' (used as a specific stain for animal chromosomes).

name: Hoffman's violet(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the free base form of Hoffman's violet.

name: Sirius scarlet GG
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of 5-[(4-amino-5-methoxy-2-methylphenyl)diazenyl]-2-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonic acid. Occasionally used for the selective staining of amyloid.

name: Sirius scarlet GG (acid form)
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is 2-methoxybenzenesulfonic acid substituted at position 5 by a (4-amino-5-methoxy-2-methylphenyl)diazenyl group. The sodium salt is the histological dye 'Sirius scarlet GG'.

name: 5-[(4-amino-5-methoxy-2-methylphenyl)diazenyl]-2-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of 5-[(4-amino-5-methoxy-2-methylphenyl)diazenyl]-2-methoxybenzene-1-sulfonic acid.

name: lead(II) chloride
definition: An inorganic chloride consisting of two chlorine atoms covalently bound to a central lead atom.

name: Oil red O
definition: A bis(azo) compound that is 2-naphthol substituted at position 1 by a {4-[(2,5-dimethylphenyl)diazenyl]-2,5-dimethylphenyl}diazenyl group. A fat-soluble dye predominantly used for demonstrating triglycerides in frozen sections and for staining of protein bound lipids in paraffin sections.

name: 3,5-dichlorophenol
definition: A dichlorophenol in which the two chloro substituents are located at positions 3 and 5.

name: osmium tetroxide
definition: An osmium coordination entity consisting of four oxygen atoms bound to a central osmium atom via covalent double bonds.

name: Sudan black B
definition: A member of the class of perimidines that is 2,2-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-perimidine carrying a [4-(phenyldiazenyl)naphthalen-1-yl]diazenyl substituent at position 6. A fat-soluble dye predominantly used for demonstrating triglycerides in frozen sections and for staining of protein bound lipids in paraffin sections.

name: N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-pyridylmethyl)ethylenediamine
definition: An N-substituted diamine that is ethylenediamine in which the four amino hydrogens are replaced by 2-pyridylmethyl groups.

name: FluoZin-3
definition: A member of the class of xanthenes that is used as a Zn2+-selective fluorescent indicator.

name: TTT-3002
definition: An organic heterooctacyclic compound that is 1H,1'H-2,2'-biindole in which the nitrogens have undergone formal oxidative coupling to positions 2 and 5 of 3-amino-N,2-dimethyloxolane-3-carboxamide (the 2R,3R,5S product), and in which the 3 and 3' positions of the biindole moiety have also undergone formal oxidative coupling to positions 3 and 4 of 1,5-dihydro-2H-pyrrol-2-one.

name: (S)-2-methyl-1-(4-methylisoquinoline-5-sulfonyl)-1,4-diazepane
definition: A member of the class of isoquinolines that is the sulfonamide formed by the formal condensation of the sulfo group of 4-methylisoquinoline-5-sulfonic acid with the 1-amino group of (S)-2-methyl-1,4-diazepane.

name: (2E,6E)-farnesyl monophosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the dianion obtained by removal of the two protons from the monophosphate group of (2E,6E)-farnesyl monophosphate. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)(4−)
definition: An anionic ganglioside obtained by deprotonation of the neuraminosyl carboxy groups of ganglioside GQ1b (d18:1/C18:0); major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)(3−)
definition: An anionic ganglioside obtained by deprotonation of the neuraminosyl carboxy groups of ganglioside GT1b (d18:1/C18:0); major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)(2−)
definition: An anionic ganglioside obtained by deprotonation of the neuraminosyl carboxy groups of ganglioside GD1b(d18:1/C18:0); major species at pH 7.3.

name: epoxypheophorbide a(2−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion obtained by removal of two protons from the carboxy and acidic methylene groups of epoxypheophorbide a.

name: epoxypheophorbide a(1−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is the conjuagte base of epoxypheophorbide a. Major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v. 6.2.0).

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)(2−)
definition: An anionic ganglioside obtained by deprotonation of the neuraminosyl carboxy groups of ganglioside GD3 (d18:1/C18:0); major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)(1−)
definition: An anionic ganglioside obtained by deprotonation of the neuraminosyl carboxy group of ganglioside GM3 (d18:1/C18:0); major species at pH 7.3.

name: CDP-3,6-dideoxy-α-D-mannose
definition: A CDP-3,6-dideoxy-D-mannose in which the anomeric centre of the sugar component has α-configuration.

name: UDP-β-L-iduronic acid
definition: A UDP-L-iduronate in which the anomeric centre of the sugar component has β-configuration.

name: prenyl phosphate
definition: A prenol phosphate consisting of a single prenol unit attached to monophosphate

name: 2'-deoxytubercidin
definition: An N-glycosylpyrrolopyrimidine that is tubercidin in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the ribose moiety has been replaced by a hydrogen.

name: [5-(aminomethyl)-3-furyl]methyl diphosphate
definition: A member of the class of furans that is 2-furylmethylamine substituted at position 4 by a diphosphooxymethyl group.

name: (4-{4-[2-(γ-L-glutamylamino)ethyl]phenoxymethyl}furan-2-yl)methanamine
definition: A L-glutamine derivative obtained by formal condensation of the side-chain carboxy group of L-glutamine with one of the amino groups of 2-(4-{[5-(aminomethyl)furan-3-yl]methoxy}phenyl)ethan-1-amine.

name: PD 0325901
definition: A hydroxamic acid ester that is benzhydroxamic acid (N-hydroxybenzamide) in which the hydroxamic acid group has been converted to the corresponding 2,3-dihydroxypropyl ester and in which the benzene ring has been substituted at position 2 by a (2-fluoro-4-iodophenyl)amino group and at positions 3 and 4 by fluorines (the R enantiomer).

name: 6-deoxy-6-sulfoglucono-1,5-lactone
definition: A carbohydrate sulfonate that is D-glucono-1,5-lactone in which the 6-hydroxy group is replaced by a sulfo group.

name: nifurtoinol
definition: An imidazolidine-2,4-dione that is hydantoin substituted at position 1 by a [(5-nitro-2-furyl)methylene]amino group and at position 3 by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: sulfametrole
definition: A sulfonamide obtained by formal condensation of the sulfo group of 4-aminobenzenesulfonic acid with the amino group of 4-methoxy-1,2,5-thiadiazol-3-amine.

name: sulfisoxazole diolamine
definition: An organoammonium salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of sulfisoxazole and diethanolamine. It has antibiotic activity against a wide range of gram-negative and gram-positive organisms.

name: 6-deoxy-6-sulfo-D-gluconic acid
definition: A carbohydrate sulfonate that is D-gluconic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 6 is replaced by a sulfo group.

name: letosteine
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester that is the monoethyl ester of 2-{2-[(carboxymethyl)sulfanyl]ethyl}-1,3-thiazolidine-4-carboxylic acid. A mucolytic used in the treatment of chronic bronchopneumopathies and related conditions.

name: azaribine
definition: A N-glycosyl-1,2,4-triazine that is 6-azauridine acetylated at positions 2', 3' and 5' on the sugar ring. It is a prodrug for 6-azauridine and is used for treatment of psoriasis.

name: aranotin
definition: An organic heterohexacyclic compound with antiviral and antibiotic properties that is isolated from Amauroascus aureus.

name: antelmycin
definition: A nucleoside antibiotic with anthelminthic properties that is isolated from Streptomyces longissimus.

name: Sirius red F3B
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal condensation of Sirius red F3B (acid form) with six equivalents of sodium hydroxide. A polyazo dye used principally in staining methods for collagen and amyloid.

name: Sirius red F3B (acid form)
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is the free acid form of the dye Sirius red F3B. The hexasodium salt is a histological dye used principally in staining methods for collagen and amyloid.

name: Sirius red F3B(6−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of Sirius red F3B (acid form).

name: Durazol blue 4R
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal condensation of Durazol blue 4R (acid form) with three equivalents of sodium hydroxide.

name: Durazol blue 4R (acid form)
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is the free acid form of the dye Sirius red F3B (the trisodium salt).

name: Durazol blue 4R(3−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonic acid groups of Durazol blue 4R (acid form).

name: ethyl green
definition: An iminium salt composed of [4-([4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]{4-[ethyl(dimethyl)azaniumyl]phenyl}methylidene)cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene](dimethyl)ammonium, bromide and chloride ions in a 1:1:1 ratio. A histological dye used to demonstrate nucleic acids by the Unna-Pappenheim stain, in conjunction with Pyronin Y.

name: ethyl green(2+)
definition: An iminium ion that forms the cationic portion of the histological dye 'ethyl green'.

name: 5-hydroxyimidazole-4-carboxamide
definition: A hydroxyimidazole that is 5-hydroxyimidazole in which the hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by an aminocarbonyl group.

name: Fast green FCF(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by the removal of three protons from Fast green FCF(1+).

name: Fast green FCF(1+)
definition: An iminium ion that is the free acid form of Fast green FCF.

name: gallein
definition: A xanthene dye that is fluoran carrying four hydroxy substituents at positions 3', 4', 5' and 6'.

name: Gallamin blue
definition: An organic chloride salt composed of 1-carbamoyl-7-(dimethylamino)-3,4-dihydroxyphenoxazin-5-ium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio. A histological dye used in solution with an iron alum mordant as a hematoxylin substitute in the H&E stain.

name: 9-hydroxyellipticine
definition: A organic heterotetracyclic compound that is ellipticine in which the hydrogen at position 9 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: FR171456
definition: A steroid acid that is 9β,19-cyclo-5α-ergost-24(28)-ene-4α-carboxylic acid which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β, 8α, and 11α positions, by a methyl group at the 4β position, and by oxo groups at positions 1 and 6. It is a cholesterol and ergosterol synthesis inhibitor isolated from the fungus Sporormiella minima that specifically targets the enzyme, sterol-4-alpha-carboxylate-3-dehydrogenase, encoded by ERG26 in budding yeast, and NSDHL in humans.

name: Gallamin blue(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is 3,4-dihydroxyphenoxazin-5-ium carrying additional carbamoyl and dimethylamino groups at positions 1 and 7 respectively. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'Gallamin blue'.

name: α-D-glucose-1,2-(13C2)
definition: A D-glucose that is α-D-glucose-in which the carbon atoms at positions 1 and 2 have been replaced by the 13C isotope.

name: azaperone
definition: An N-arylpiperazine that is 2-(piperazin-1-yl)pyridine in which the amino hydrogen is replaced by a 3-(4-fluobenzoyl)propyl group. Used mainly as a tranquiliser for pigs and elephants.

name: (S)-lorglumide sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt obtained by formal condensation of N2-(3,4-dichlorobenzoyl)-N,N-dipentyl-L-α-glutamine with one equivalent of sodium hydroxide. The racemate is lorglumide sodium, a CCK antagonist.

name: (R)-lorglumide sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt obtained by formal condensation of N2-(3,4-dichlorobenzoyl)-N,N-dipentyl-D-α-glutamine with one equivalent of sodium hydroxide. The racemate is lorglumide sodium, a CCK antagonist.

name: N2-(3,4-dichlorobenzoyl)-N,N-dipentyl-α-glutamine
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide obtained by formal condensation of the α-carboxy group of N-(3,4-dichlorobenzoyl)glutamic acid with the amino group of dipentylamine.

name: (S)-lorglumide
definition: An N2-(3,4-dichlorobenzoyl)-N,N-dipentyl-α-glutamine that has (S)-configuration (the racemate is lorglumide, a CCK antagonist).

name: (S)-lorglumide(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (S)-lorglumide, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (R)-lorglumide(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (R)-lorglumide, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (S)-nefopam hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of (S)-nefopam with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid (the racemic salt is an analgesic drug).

name: (R)-nefopam hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of (R)-nefopam with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid (the racemic salt is an analgesic drug).

name: naphthalene-2-carboxamide
definition: A naphthalenecarboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-naphthoic acid with ammonia.

name: 5-methyl-1-phenyl-3,4,5,6-tetrahydro-1H-2,5-benzoxazocine
definition: A member of the class of benzoxazocines that is 3,4,5,6-tetrahydro-1H-2,5-benzoxazocine substituted by phenyl and methyl groups at positions 1 and 5 respectively.

name: (S)-nefopam
definition: A 5-methyl-1-phenyl-3,4,5,6-tetrahydro-1H-2,5-benzoxazocine that has (S)-configuration (the racemate is a non-opioid analgesic drug).

name: potassium oxide
definition: A metal oxide with formula K2O.

name: (S)-nefopam(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (S)-nefopam.

name: (R)-nefopam(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (R)-nefopam.

name: dafadine A
definition: An N-acylpiperidine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-[(2,6-dimethylphenoxy)methyl]-1,2-oxazole-3-carboxylic acid with the secondary amino group of 4-(pyridin-4-yl)piperidine.

name: dafadine B
definition: An N-acylpiperidine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-[(2-chloro-4-fluorophenoxy)methyl]-1,2-oxazole-3-carboxylic acid with the secondary amino group of 4-(pyridin-4-yl)piperidine

name: dafadine C
definition: An N-acylpiperidine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-[(2,6-difluorophenoxy)methyl]-1,2-oxazole-3-carboxylic acid with the secondary amino group of 4-(pyridin-4-yl)piperidine.

name: dafadine D
definition: An N-acylpiperidine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-[(3-trifluoromethylphenoxy)methyl]-1,2-oxazole-3-carboxylic acid with the secondary amino group of 4-(pyridin-4-yl)piperidine.

name: dafadine O
definition: An N-acylpiperidine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-[(3-methoxyphenoxy)methyl]-1,2-oxazole-3-carboxylic acid with the secondary amino group of 4-(pyridin-4-yl)piperidine.

name: CD437
definition: A naphthoic acid that is 6-phenylnaphthylene-2-carboxyic acid in which the phenyl substituent has been substituted at positions 3 and 4 by adamant-1-yl and hydroxy groups, respectively. It acts as a selective agonist of retinoic acid receptor (RAR)γ and induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in various cancer cells.

name: bisantrene
definition: A hydrazone resulting from the formal condensation of both of the aldehyde groups of anthracene-9,10-dicarbaldehyde with 2-hydrazinyl-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazole.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-{6-[(7-nitro-2-1,3-benzoxadiazol-4-yl)amino]hexanoyl}-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine
definition: A 3-sn-phosphatidyl L-serine in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are oleoyl and 6-[(7-nitro-2-1,3-benzoxadiazol-4-yl)amino]hexanoyl respectively.

name: BMS-754807
definition: A pyrrolotriazine that is pyrrolo[2,1-f][1,2,4]triazine which is substituted at position 2 by the pyrrolidine nitrogen of (2S)-N-(6-fluoropyridin-3-yl)-2-methylprolinamide, and at position 4 by a (5-cyclopropyl-1H-pyrazol-3-yl)amino group. It is a potent, reversible inhibitor of the insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor/insulin receptor family kinases.

name: (3R,3aS,6aR)-hexahydrofuro[2,3-b]furan-3-yl glycolate
definition: A furofuran that is (3R,3aS,6aR)-hexahydrofuro[2,3-b]furan-3-ol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen is replaced by a glycolate group.

name: 1-caffeoyl-5-feruloylquinic acid
definition: A quinic acid that is (−)-quinic acid acylated at positions 1 and 5 by caffeoyl and feruloyl groups respectively.

name: (14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z)-dotriacontapentaenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (14Z,17Z,20Z,23Z,26Z)-dotriacontapentaenoic acid.

name: 12(S)-HEPE
definition: A 12-HEPE that consists of (5Z,8Z,10E,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoic acid in which the 12-hydroxy group has S-configuration.

name: 13,14-dihydroprostaglandin F2α
definition: A prostaglandins Fα that is prost-5-en-1-oic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 9, 11 and 15.

name: 15(S)-HEPE
definition: A 15-HEPE that consists of (5Z,8Z,11Z,13E,17Z)-icosapentaenoic acid in which the 15-hydroxy group has S-configuration.

name: 15(S)-HETrE
definition: A 15-HETrE consisting of (8Z,11Z,13E)-icosatrienoic acid in which the 15-hydroxy group has S-configuration.

name: 17,18-DiHETE
definition: A DiHETE consisting of arachidonic acid having the two hydroxy substituents located at position 17 and 18.

name: 2-phosphoglycerate(3−)
definition: A phosphoglycerate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of 2-phosphoglyceric acid.

name: bryostatin 1
definition: A member of the class of bryostatins that is (17E)-2-oxooxacyclohexacos-17-ene which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 10, and 20; an acetoxy group at position 8; methyl groups at positions 9, 9, 18, and 19; 2-methoxy-2-oxoethylidene groups at positions 14 and 24; an (E,E)-octa-2,4-dienoyloxy group at position 21; and with oxygen bridges linking positions 6 to 10, 12 to 16, and 20 to 24. It is one of the most abundant member of the class of bryostatins.

name: 3-hydroxyphloretin 2'-O-xylosylglucoside
definition: An aryl β-D-glucoside that is 3-hydroxyphloretin in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 2' is replaced by a 6-O-β-D-xylosyl-β-D-glucosyl group.

name: 3-methylphenylacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 3-methylphenyl group.

name: 5-bromouridine 5'-triphosphate
definition: A pyrimidine ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate having 5-bromouracil as the pyrimidine component.

name: 5(S)-HETrE
definition: A 5-HETrE consisting of (6E,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the 5-hydroxy group has S-configuration.

name: 7-hydroxysecoisolariciresinol
definition: A polyphenol that is (−)-secoisolariciresinol carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 7.

name: 8,5'-diferulic acid
definition: A polyphenol composed of two molecules of ferulic acid joined by a bond between positions 8 and 5'.

name: hexan-2-ol
definition: A hexanol in which the hydroxy group is at position 2.

name: 3-methylpentane
definition: An alkane that is pentane which is substituted by a methyl group at position 3. It is used as a solvent in organic synthesis, as a lubricant and as a raw material for producing carbon black.

name: 1-hydroxybutan-2-one
definition: A primary α-hydroxy ketone that is butane-1,2-diol in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been formally oxidised to give the corresponding ketone.

name: vanilpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 3,4-dihydroxyphenylpyruvic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is substituted by a methoxy group.

name: (S)-2-methylbutanal
definition: A 2-methylbutanal that has S configuration.

name: methylcyclopentane
definition: A cycloalkane that is cyclopentane substituted by a single methyl group.

name: ethyl 2-methylbutyrate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester obtained by the formal condensation of 2-methylbutyric acid with ethanol. It is a constituent of the aroma of wines, strawberries, blueberries, and apples.

name: 3-methoxybenzoic acid
definition: A methoxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by a methoxy group at position 3.

name: (9E,11E)-octadecadienoic acid
definition: An octadeca-9,11-dienoic acid having 9-trans,11-trans-stereochemistry.

name: leukotriene B5
definition: A leukotriene composed of (6Z,8E,10E,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoic acid carrying (5S)- and (12R)-hydroxy substituents.

name: ε-(γ-glutamyl)lysine
definition: An N6-acyl-L-lysine derivative in which the acyl group is specified as γ-glutamyl.

name: butyl formate
definition: A formate ester resulting from the formal condensation of formic acid with the hydroxy group of butan-1-ol. Found in apples, strawberries, sherry and Pamesan cheese, it has a fruity, plum-like odour and taste.

name: hexanal
definition: A saturated fatty aldehyde that is hexane in which one of the terminal methyl group has been mono-oxygenated to form the corresponding aldehyde.

name: dihydrodehydro-β-ionone
definition: A member of the class of cyclohexadienes that is cyclohexa-1,3-diene substituted by a 3-oxobutyl group at position 1 and by methyl groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: 3-(2-methylpropyl)cyclohexene
definition: A member of the class of cycloalkenes that is cyclohexene substituted by a 2-methylpropyl group at position 3.

name: (E)-3-dodecene
definition: A 3-dodecene in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: (Z)-3-dodecene
definition: A 3-dodecene in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: (E)-2-dodecene
definition: A 2-dodecene that is dodecane which has been dehydrogenated to introduce a trans double bond between positions 2 and 3.

name: 2-ethyl-5-methylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 are replaced by ethyl and methyl groups, respectively.

name: hexan-3-ol
definition: A hexanol in which the hydroxy group is at position 3.

name: 1-(11Z)-icosenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-icosenoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the the double bond of the icosenoyl group is at the 11-12 position and has Z configuration.

name: DG(15:0/15:0/0:0)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol that has pentadecanoyl as 1- and 2-acyl groups.

name: 2,3,4-trihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A trihydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3, and 4.

name: 5α-androstane-3β,17β-diol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 5α-androstane-3β,17β-diol having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 3. It is a biochemical marker of peripheral tissue androgen metabolism.

name: 5-(3'-hydroxyphenyl)-γ-valerolactone-3'-O-β-D-glucuronide
definition: A butan-4-olide that is 5-(3'-hydroxyphenyl)-γ-valerolactone in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue

name: cholesteryl (5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: A cholesteryl octadecatrienoate obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid with the hydroxy group of cholesterol.

name: cholesteryl γ-linolenate
definition: A cholesteryl octadecatrienoate obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of γ-linolenic acid with the hydroxy group of cholesterol.

name: DG(16:0/14:0/0:0)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol that has palmitoyl and tetradecanoyl as 1- and 2-acyl groups respectively.

name: ethyl butyrate
definition: A butyrate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of ethanol with the carboxy group of butyric acid.

name: (11Z-octadecenoyl)-cholesterol
definition: A cholesteryl octadecenoate in which the acy group is specified as (11Z)-octadec-11-enoyl.

name: cholesteryl (11Z)-icosenoate
definition: A cholesteryl ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (11Z)-icos-11-enoic acid with the 3-hydroxy group of cholesterol.

name: (R)-salsolinol
definition: A 1-methyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline-6,7-diol that has R-configuration.

name: 2,6,8-trimethyldecane
definition: An alkane that is decane substituted by a methyl group at positions 2,6 and 8. It is a combustion product of natural gas.

name: heptan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is heptane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: (Z)-2-octene
definition: A 2-octene in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: (E)-2-octene
definition: A 2-octene in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: N-acetylcadaverine
definition: An N-substituted cadaverine that is cadaverine in which one of the amino groups has been converted to the corresponding acetamide.

name: carbamodithioic acid
definition: A member of the class of dithiocarbamic acids that is carbamic acid in which the oxo and hydroxy groups have been replaced by a thiocarbonyl and thiol group, respectively.

name: 2-ethyl-2-hexenal
definition: A monounsaturated fatty aldehyde that is hex-2-enal substituted by an ethyl group at position 2.

name: isoterpinolene
definition: A p-menthadiene with double bonds at positions 2 and 4(8).

name: methyl cyclohexanecarboxylate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of cyclohexanecarboxylic acid with methanol.

name: 3-methyleneheptane
definition: An alkene that is heptane which carries a methylidene group at position 3.

name: (Z)-3-octene

name: ethyl cyclohexanecarboxylate

name: methylpyrazine

name: 2,5-dimethylfuran

name: cotinine N-oxide
definition: An N-alkylpyrrolidine that is nicotine in which the methylene hydrogens at position 2 on the pyrrolidine ring have been replaced by an oxo group and the pyridine nitrogen converted into the corresponding N-oxide. A minor metabolite of nicotine.

name: urolithin A 3-O-glucuronide

name: 5-hydroxymethyl-2-furoic acid

name: 1-nitroheptane

name: 3-hydroxysebacic acid

name: 1-nitrohexane
definition: A primary nitroalkane that is hexane substituted by a nitro group at position 1.

name: 2,4-di-tert-butylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols carrying two tert-butyl substituents at positions 2 and 4.

name: 2-pentylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a pentyl group. It is found in many heat-processed foods and drinks.

name: methyl tetradecanoate

name: 18-oxocortisol

name: p-menthan-1-ol

name: 1-α-linolenoyl-2-icosanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups positions 1 and 2 are specified as α-linolenoyl and icosanoyl (arachidoyl) respectively.

name: p-mentha-1,3,8-triene
definition: A monoterpene that is cyclohexa-1,3-diene substituted at positions 1 and 4 by methyl and prop-1-en-2-yl groups respectively.

name: 1-[(8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl]-2-[(11Z)-icosenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl and (11Z)-icosenoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl]-2-icosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl and arachidoyl (icosanoyl) respectively.

name: 1-[(13Z,16Z)-docosadienoyl]-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (13Z,16Z)-docosadienoyl and linoleoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(13Z,16Z)-docosadienoyl]-2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (13Z,16Z)-docosadienoyl and hexadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatrienoyl]-2-[(9Z,12Z)-hexadecadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatrienoyl and (9Z,12Z)-hexadecadienoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatrienoyl]-2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatrienoyl and hexadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatrienoyl]-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosatrienoyl and linoleoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl]-2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl and octadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-[(8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl]-2-[(11Z)-octadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-phosphatidyl-1D-myo-inositol in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatetraenoyl and (11Z)-octadecenoyl respectively.

name: 2-hydroxyestradiol 3-methyl ether
definition: A 17β-hydroxy steroid that is 17β-estradiol in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a hydroxy group and the phenolic hydrogen at position 3 has bee replaced by a methyl group.

name: 2-methyl-5-(methylthio)furan
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan substituted by methyl and methylsulfanyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a metabolite found in coffee and human urine.

name: 4-hydroxycyclohexanecarboxylic acid
definition: A 4-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is cyclohexane substituted by a carboxy group at position 1 and a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: stigmastanol
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is 5α-stigmastane which is substituted at the 3β position by a hydroxy group.

name: 5α-dihydrotestosterone 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 5α-dihydrotestosterone having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 17.

name: 17α-hydroxypregnenolone 3-sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is 17α-hydroxypregnenolone in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: 18-hydroxycortisol
definition: A 18-hydroxy steroid that is cortisol carrying a hydroxy group at position 18. Its urinary excretion is increased in patients with aldosterone-producing adenoma.

name: lanthionine ketimine
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-thiazines that is 3,6-dihydro-2H-1,4-thiazine substituted by carboxy groups at positions 3 and 5. It is a natural but non-proteogenic amino acid found in human urine and brain.

name: 4-heptanone
definition: A dialkyl ketone that is heptane in which the two methylene protons at position 4 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: 2-methyl-3-[(2E)-5-carboxy-3-methylpent-2-enyl]-1,4-naphthoquinone
definition: A member of the class of naphthoquinones that is 2-methyl-1,4-naphthoquinone which is substituted at position 3 by a (2E)-5-carboxy-3-methylpent-2-en-1-yl group. A urinary metabolite of vitamin K1.

name: iberin
definition: An isothiocyanate that is 1-isothiocyanatopropane in which a hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a methylsulfinyl group. A glucosinolate hydrolysis product found in many members of the Brassicaceae family, it is a quorum-sensing inhibitor (QSI) of the bacterial pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

name: 3,4-dimethylthiophene
definition: A thiophene that is substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 4.

name: coprostanol
definition: A member of the class of phytosterols that is 5β-cholestane carrying a hydroxy substituent at the 3β-position.

name: epietiocholanolone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is 5β-androstane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3β and an oxo group at position 17. It is a metabolite of testosterone.

name: 2,4-dimethylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 4 are replaced by methyl groups.

name: methyl propenyl ketone
definition: An enone that is pent-2-ene in which the two methylene hydrogens have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: N-methylnorsalsolinol
definition: An isoquinolinol that is norsalsolinol substituted by a methyl group at position 2. It is present in normal human brain and also identified in the cerebrospinal fluid of patients with Parkinson's disease.

name: urolithin A 8-O-glucuronide
definition: A member of the class of benzochromenones that is urolithin A in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 8 has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronosyl group.

name: butyl hexanoate
definition: A hexanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with butan-1-ol. It is a volatile compound found in apples and peaches.

name: 9-HEPE
definition: A HEPE that is (5Z,7E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoic acid carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 9.

name: 5-[(α-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactopyranosyl)oxy]-L-lysine
definition: An O-glycosyl amino acid that is L-lysine in which one of the methylene hydrogens at position 5 has been replaced by an (α-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactopyranosyl)oxy group.

name: γ-Glu-Phe
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the side-chain carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of L-phenylalanine.

name: theaspirane
definition: A norisoprenoid with forumula C13H22O that is a flavour component found in various essential oils such as raspberry oil and passion fruit oil.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-[(8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 38:4 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and (8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl respectively.

name: m-tyramine
definition: A primary amino compound that is 2-phenylethanamine substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 4-methoxytyramine
definition: A monomethoxybenzene that is dopamine in which the hydroxy group at position 4 is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: 5-hydroxyindole
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is 1H-indole in which the hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: Leu-enkephalin
definition: A pentapeptide comprising L-tyrosine, glycine, glycine, L-phenylalanine and L-leucine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is an endogenous opioid peptide produced in vertebrate species, including rodents, primates and humans that results from decomposition of proenkephalin or dynorphin and exhibits antinociceptive properties.

name: 4,5,9,10-dehydroisolongifolene
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is 1,5-dihydro-2H-2,4a-methanonaphthalene carrying four methyl groups at positions 1,1,5, and 5.

name: isopropyl dodecanoate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by the formal condensation of carboxy group of dodecanoic acid with propan-2-ol. A metabolite found in human saliva.

name: 3-iodothyronamine
definition: An organoiodine compound that is benzene substituted by 4-hydroxyphenoxy, iodo, and 2-aminoethyl groups at positions 1, 2, and 4, respectively. It is a thyroid hormone metabolite and a potent agonist of trace amine-associated receptor 1.

name: 1-dodecene
definition: An alkene that is dodecane containing one double bond at position 1. It is an intermediate used in the production of lubricants and surfactants.

name: cyclotetradecane
definition: A cycloalkane that consists of fourteen carbons each bonded with two hydrogens.

name: propyl butyrate
definition: A butyrate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of propanol with the carboxy group of butyric acid.

name: (Z)-3-phenyl-2-propenal
definition: A 3-phenylprop-2-enal that has Z configuration.

name: 1-palmitoleoyl-2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 16:0_16:1 in which the acyl groups specified at positions 1 and 2 are palmitoleoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: (11Z)-octadecenoylcarnitine
definition: An O-acylcarnitine having (11Z)-octadecenoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: 2-butylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a butyl group. It is a constituent found in several plant species and some cooked foods.

name: 1,2-dihexadecanoyl-3-octadecanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A triacyl-sn-glycerol in which the which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as hexadecanoyl, while that at position 3 is specified as octadecanoyl

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-octadecanoyl-3-[(9Z)-octadecenoyl]-sn-glycerol
definition: A triacyl-sn-glycerol in which the which the acyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 3 are specified as hexadecanoyl, octadecanoyl and (9Z)-octadecenoyl respectively.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-[(9Z)-octadecenoyl]-3-[(11Z)-icosenoyl]-sn-glycerol
definition: A triacyl-sn-glycerol in which the which the acyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 3 are specified as hexadecanoyl, (9Z)-octadecenoyl and (11Z)-icosenoyl respectively.

name: 4-hexen-3-one
definition: An enone that is hex-2-ene in which the two methylene hydrogens at position 4 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: tridecanal
definition: A long-chain fatty aldehyde that is tridecane in which two hydrogens attached to a terminal carbon are replaced by an oxo group.

name: propyl propionate
definition: A propanoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of propanol with the carboxy group of propanoic acid.

name: 5-methoxysalicylic acid
definition: A methoxysalicylic acid that is salicylic acid which is carrying a methoxy group at position 5.

name: butyl propionate
definition: A propanoate ester of butan-1-ol.

name: propionylglycine
definition: A N-acylglycine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of propionic acid with the amino group of glycine.

name: methyl 3-phenylpropanoate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-phenylpropionic acid with methanol.

name: 3-hexanone
definition: A dialkyl ketone that is hexane in which the two methylene protons at position 3 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: 5-methylfuran-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of furoic acids that is 2-furoic acid substituted at position 5 by a methyl group.

name: glycoursodeoxycholic acid
definition: A bile acid glycine conjugate derived from ursoodeoxycholic acid.

name: (E)-2-penten-1-ol
definition: A 2-penten-1-ol in which the double bond has (E)-configuration. It is a volatile compound found in cooked mussels, olive oil, fermented cucumber brine and cashew apple juice.

name: 1-penten-3-one
definition: An enone that is pent-1-ene substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: butyrylglycine
definition: A N-acylglycine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of butyric acid with the amino group of glycine.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2,3-dioleoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A triacyl-sn-glycerol in which the 1-acyl group is octadecanoyl while the 2- and 3-acyl groups are oleoyl.

name: cystathionine ketimine
definition: A 1-thia-4-azacyclohepta-3-ene-3,5-dicarboxylic acid that has R-configuration. It is cyclic sulfur-containing imino acid detected in bovine brain extracts.

name: N-[(13Z,16Z)-3-hydroxydocosa-13,16-enoyl]sphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-hydroxydocosadienoylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine in which the N-acyl group is specified as (13Z,16Z)-3-hydroxydocosa-13,16-enoyl.

name: N-[(15Z)-3-hydroxytetracos-15-enoyl]sphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-hydroxytetracosenoylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine in which the N-acyl group is specified as (15Z)-3-hydroxytetracos-15-enoyl.

name: N-[(9Z)-3-hydroxyhexadec-9-enoyl]sphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-hydroxyhexadecenoylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine in which the N-acyl group is specified as (9Z)-3-hydroxyhexadec-9-enoyl.

name: N-[(13Z)-3-hydroxydocos-13-enoyl]sphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-hydroxydocosenoylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine in which the N-acyl group is specified as (13Z)-3-hydroxydocos-13-enoyl.

name: N-[(9Z)-3-hydroxytetradec-9-enoyl]sphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-hydroxytetradecenoylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine in which the N-acyl group is specified as (9Z)-3-hydroxytetradec-9-enoyl.

name: isolimonene
definition: A monoterpene that is cyclohex-1-ene substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and a prop-1-en-2-yl group at position 6 respectively.

name: monoisobutyl phthalate
definition: A phthalic acid monoester obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of phthalic acid with the hydroxy group of isobutanol.

name: cyclo(L-His-L-Pro)
definition: A homodetic cyclic peptide resulting from the formal condensation of both the amino and acid groups of L-histidine with the acid and amino groups of L-proline. It is a metabolite of thyrotropin-releasing hormone (TRH).

name: 3-fucosyllactose
definition: A trisaccharide that is lactose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the glucosyl moiety has undergone formal condensation with the anomeric hydroxy group of fucose (6-deoxy-L-galactose) to give the corresponding glycoside. Found in human milk.

name: rose oxide
definition: A member of the class of oxanes that is tetrahydro-2H-pyran which is substituted at positions 2 and 4 by an isoprop-1-enyl group and a methyl group, respectively. Organic compound of the pyran class and the monoterpene class and a fragrance found in roses and rose oil. All four possible stereoisomers are known; the 2S,4R and 2S,4S diastereoisomers [also known as the (−)-cis- and (−)-trans-isomers, respectively] are the main constituents in several essential oils and are used as a food flavouring and in perfumes and cosmetics.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-20-{2-[10-(2-nonadecylcyclopropyl)decyl]cyclopropyl}icosyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C81 α-mycolic acid having a C55 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: N-benzoyl-L-arginine
definition: An N-acyl-L-arginine that is L-arginine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the α-amino group has been replaced by a benzoyl group.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-12-{2-[14-(2-icosylcyclopropyl)tetradecyl]cyclopropyl}dodecyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C78 α-mycolic acid having a C52 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-14-{2-[14-(2-icosylcyclopropyl)tetradecyl]cyclopropyl}tetradecyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C80 α-mycolic acid having a C54 meromycolic chain with two cis cyclopropyl functions and a saturated C26 α-branch. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-14-{2-[(15Z)-hexatriacont-15-en-1-yl]cyclopropyl}-1-hydroxytetradecyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C79 α-mycolic acid having a saturated C26 α-branch and a C53 meromycolic chain with a distal cis-double bond and a proximal cis-cyclopropyl function. It is produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Ra.

name: N-benzoyl-L-tyrosine
definition: An N-acyl-L-tyrosine that is L-tyrosine in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group has been replaced by a benzoyl group.

name: 2-dehydro-3,6-dideoxy-6-sulfo-D-gluconic acid
definition: A carbohydrate sulfonate that is 3-deoxy-D-erythro-hex-2-ulosonic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 6 is replaced by a sulfo group.
