definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a pentadecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end) all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two N-glycoloyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear hexasaccharide units.

name: (2S,4R)-rose oxide
definition: A rose oxide that has S configuration at position 2 and R configuration at position 4. Also known as (−)-cis-rose oxide, it is responsible for the characteristic fragrance of roses.

name: carboxyphosphoric acid
definition: An acyclic mixed acid anhydride formed by condensation of phosphoric acid with carbonic acid.

name: (2R,4R)-rose oxide
definition: A rose oxide in which both of the stereocentres have R configuration. It is also known as (−)-trans-rose oxide.

name: methyl glutamate
definition: An α-amino acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the α-carboxy group of glutamic acid with methanol.

name: (2R,4S)-rose oxide
definition: A rose oxide that has R configuration at position 2 and S configuration at position 4. Also known as (+)-cis-rose oxide.

name: (2S,4S)-rose oxide
definition: A rose oxide in which both of the stereocentres have S configuration. It is also known as (+)-trans-rose oxide.

name: D-3-sulfolactaldehyde
definition: A 3-sulfolactaldehyde in which the stereocentre at position 3 has R-configuration.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a pentadecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end) all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear hexasaccharide units.

name: gallocyanin
definition: An organic chloride salt composed of 1-carboxy-7-(dimethylamino)-3,4-dihydroxyphenoxazin-5-ium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio. A histological dye used in solution with an iron alum mordant as a hematoxylin substitute in the H&E stain.

name: gallocyanin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is 3,4-dihydroxyphenoxazin-5-ium carrying additional carboxy and dimethylamino groups at positions 1 and 7 respectively. The chloride salt is the histological dye 'gallocyanin'.

name: Methyl violet 2B
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining Methyl violet 2B free base with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. Used in Gram's stain for the demonstration and primary classification of bacteria as well as to demonstrate amyloid.

name: L-3-sulfolactaldehyde(1−)
definition: A 3-sulfolactaldehyde(1−) in which the stereocentre at position 3 has S-configuration.

name: Methyl violet 2B free base
definition: An imine that is 4-methylidenecyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-imine in which both the hydrogens of the methylidene group are replaced by 4-(dimethylamino)phenyl groups. The hydrochloride salt is the histological dye 'Methyl violet 2B'.

name: Methyl violet 2B(1+)
definition: An iminium ion obtained by protonation of the imino group of Methyl violet 2B free base.

name: Guinee green B
definition: An organic sodium salt having 3-[(ethyl{4-[(4-{ethyl[(3-sulfonatophenyl)methyl]amino}phenyl)(phenyl)methylidene]cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene}azaniumyl)methyl]benzene-1-sulfonate. Used as a substitute for Light green SF yellowish in Masson's trichrome, although it is prone to fade. Previously used as a food dye but is now no longer approved.

name: Guinee green B(1+)
definition: An iminium ion that is the free acid form of Guinee green B.

name: Guinee green B(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonate groups of Guinee green B(1+).

name: hematein
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is -6a,7-dihydrobenzo[b]indeno[1,2-d]pyran-9-one carrying four hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 4, 6a and 10.

name: indigo carmine (acid form)
definition: A member of the class of indolones obtained by formal 2,2'-oxidative coupling of two molecules of 3-oxo-2,3-dihydroindole-5-sulfonic acids.

name: tricosanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A saturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtaned by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of tricosanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E)-tricosenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtaned by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of (2E)-tricosenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: indigo carmine(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the two sulfo groups of indigo carmine.

name: 5-CM-H2DCFDA
definition: A member of the class of xanthenes that is the acetic anhydride of dihydrofluorescein diacetate carrying additional chloro substituents at positions 2 and 7 as well as a chloromethyl substituent meta to the anhydride function.

name: 6-CM-H2DCFDA
definition: A member of the class of xanthenes that is the acetic anhydride of dihydrofluorescein diacetate carrying additional chloro substituents at positions 2 and 7 as well as a chloromethyl substituent para to the anhydride function.

name: dibromoacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid in which two of the methyl hydrogens are replaced by bromo groups.

name: N-(2-hydroxy-1-methylethyl)-9-octadecenamide
definition: A fatty amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of octadec-9-enoic acid with the amino group of 2-aminopropan-1-ol.

name: N-(p-nitrophenyl)-β-alaninamide
definition: A β-alanine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of β-alanine with the amino group of 4-nitroaniline.

name: scytonemin
definition: A ring assembly obtained by 1,1'-coupling of two molecules of (3E)-3-[(4-hydroxyphenyl)methylidene]cyclopenta[b]indol-2(3H)-one. A UV-screening molecule produced by many strains of cyanobacteria.

name: 4-nitrophenyl 6-O-phosphono-β-D-galactoside
definition: A galactose phosphate that is 4-nitrophenyl β-D-galactoside substituted at position 6 by a monophosphate group.

name: 6-bromo-2-naphthyl α-D-galactoside
definition: An α-D-galactoside having a 6-bromo-2-naphthyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 4-methylumbelliferyl α-L-arabinoside
definition: An α-L-arabinopyranoside having a 4-methylumbelliferyl substituent at the anomeric position

name: deferrichrome
definition: A homodetic cyclic peptide composed from two units of three glycyl and three N5-acetyl-N5-hydroxy-L-ornithyl residues.

name: 4-nitrophenyl α-L-arabinoside
definition: An α-L-arabinopyranoside having a 4-nitrophenyl substituent at the anomeric position

name: S-adenosyl-L-cysteine
definition: An L-cysteine derivative in which the thiol hydrogen of L-cysteine is replaced by an adenosyl group.

name: 2,4,6-trimethylphenylalanine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is phenylalanine in which the phenyl ring is methylated at positions 2, 4 and 6.

name: 4-nitrophenyl α-D-xyloside
definition: A xyloside that is α-D-xylopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 4-nitrophenyl group.

name: 6-bromo-2-naphthyl β-D-galactoside
definition: A β-D-galactoside having a 6-bromo-2-naphthyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: phenylalanine betaine
definition: An amino acid betaine derived from phenylalanine.

name: 2-naphthyl β-D-galactoside
definition: A β-D-galactoside having a 2-naphthyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: tyrosine betaine
definition: An amino acid betaine derived from tyrosine.

name: O,2,3-trimethyltyrosine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is tyrosine in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 3 as well as the phenolic hydrogen are replaced by methyl groups.

name: N-amidinoaspartic acid
definition: An aspartic acid derivative comprising aspartic acid carrying an N-amidino substituent.

name: 2-nitrophenyl β-D-galactoside
definition: A β-D-galactoside having a 2-nitrophenyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 2-naphthol AS BI-β-D-glucuronide
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid having a 6-bromo-3-[(2-methoxyphenyl)carbamoyl]naphthalen-2-yl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 4-nitrophenyl β-D-glucuronide
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid having a 4-nitrophenyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 6-bromo-2-naphthyl β-D-mannoside
definition: A β-D-mannoside having a 6-bromo-2-naphthyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 4-nitrophenyl β-D-xyloside
definition: A xyloside that is β-D-xylopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 4-nitrophenyl group.

name: 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-indolyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetic acid with the hydroxy group of 5-bromo-4-chloroindoxyl.

name: 2-naphthyl butyrate
definition: A butyrate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of butyric acid with the hydroxy group of 2-naphthol.

name: 2,3-epoxymenatetrenone
definition: A member of the class of tetralins obtained by formal epoxidation across the 2,3-double bond of menatetrenone.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)(2−)
definition: A α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosylceramide(2−) in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl).

name: 2-methylhexanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-methylhexanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methylhexenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-methylhexenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: geranyl phosphate
definition: A polyprenol phosphate that is geraniol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen is replaced by a phospho group.

name: N-hexanoylphytosphingosine 1-phosphate
definition: A ceramide 1-phosphate in which the sphingoid and acyl components are specified as phytosphingosine and hexanoyl respctively.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→8)-α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising two α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl residues, a β-D-galactose residue and (at the reducing end) an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (2→8), (2→3) and (1→4).

name: dTDP-2,3-dehydro-2,6-dideoxy-4-keto-α-D-glucose
definition: A dTDP-sugar having 2,3-dehydro-2,6-dideoxy-4-keto-α-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: β-citryl-Glu-Glu
definition: A dipeptide that is Glu-Glu in which one of the amino terminal hydrogens is replaced by a β-citryl group.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising an α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue, an α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl residue, a β-D-galactose residue and (at the reducing end) an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (2→8), (2→3) and (1→4).

name: 2-hydro-β-NADP
definition: An NADP obtained by formal reduction of the 1,2-position in the pyridine ring of β-NADP.

name: 2-hydro-β-NAD
definition: An NADP obtained by formal reduction of the 1,2-position in the pyridine ring of β-NAD.

name: 6-hydro-β-NADP
definition: An NADP obtained by formal reduction of the 1,6-position in the pyridine ring of β-NADP.

name: 6-hydro-β-NAD
definition: An NADP obtained by formal reduction of the 1,6-position in the pyridine ring of β-NAD.

name: α-Neup5Gc-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising an α-N-glycoloylneuraminyl residue, an α-N-acetylneuraminyl residue, a β-D-galactose residue and (at the reducing end) an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (2→8), (2→3) and (1→4).

name: 2,5-dihydroxybenzoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl residues, a β-D-galactose residue and (at the reducing end) an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (2→8), (2→3) and (1→4).

name: iodine green
definition: An iminium salt composed of (4-{[4-(dimethylamino)-3-methylphenyl][4-(trimethylazaniumyl)phenyl]methylidene}cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene)(dimethyl)ammonium and chloride ions in a 1:2 ratio. A histological dye used for staining chromatin and amyloid.

name: N-{4-[(3-bromophenyl)amino]quinazolin-6-yl}but-2-ynamide
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is 4,6-diaminoquinazoine in which the one of the hydrogens attached to the amino group at position 4 has been replaced by a m-bromophenyl group while one of the hydrogens attached to the amino group at position 6 has been replaced by a but-2-ynoyl group.

name: iodine green(2+)
definition: An iminium ion that forms the cationic portion of the histological dye 'iodine green'.

name: kermesic acid
definition: A tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,5,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by methyl and carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively. It is a natural dye isolated from the insect species Kermes ilices .

name: diaziquone
definition: A 1,4-benzoquinone that is substituted at positions 2 and 5 have been replaced by aziridin-1-yl groups and at positions 3 and 6 by (ethoxycarbonyl)amino groups.

name: laccaic acid A
definition: A tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,5,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by two carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 as well as a 5-(2-acetamidoethyl)-2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 7. The major component of LAC dye together with laccaic acids B, C and D

name: LY 117018
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzothiophenes that is raloxifene in which the piperidin-1-yl group has been replaced by a pyrrolidin-1-yl group.

name: laccaic acid B
definition: A tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,5,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by two carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 as well as a 5-(2-hydroxyethyl)-2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 7. A minor component of LAC dye together with laccaic acids A, C and D

name: raloxifene(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the piperidine nitrogen of raloxifene. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: laccaic acid C
definition: A tetrahydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,5,6,8-tetrahydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by two carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 as well as a 5-(2-amino-2-carboxyethyl)-2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 7. A minor component of LAC dye together with laccaic acids A, B and D

name: 2,5-bis(2-hydroxyethylamino)-3,6-diaziridinylbenzoquinone
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-benzoquinones that is 1,4-benzoquinone in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 have been replaced by aziridin-1-yl groups while the hydrogens at positions 3 and 6 have been replaced by (2-hydroxyethyl)amino groups.

name: laccaic acid D
definition: A trihydroxyanthraquinone that is that is 3,6,8-trihydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone substituted by methyl and carboxy groups at positions 1 and 2 respectively. A minor component of LAC dye together with laccaic acids A, B and C.

name: tacedinaline
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-acetamidobenzoic acid with one of the amino groups of 1,2-phenylenediamine. An oral cytostatic drug with impressive differential activity against leukemic cells and normal stem-cells. Also used in combination therapy for selected tumors including non-smoll cell lung, pancreatic, breast, and colorectal cancers.

name: PHA-665752
definition: A member of the class of indolones that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one which is substituted by a (2,6-dichlorobenzyl)sulfonyl group at position 5 and by a (1H-pyrrol-2-yl)methylidene group at position 2, the pyrrole ring of which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 5, and by a [2-(pyrrolidin-1-ylmethyl)pyrrolidin-1-yl]carbonyl group at position 4 (the Z,R isomer).

name: lissamine fast red
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 5-[(4-acetamido-2-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]-6-amino-4-hydroxynaphthalene-2-sulfonic acid. Used along with acid fuchsin as a constituent of the plasma staining solution in Lendrum's Picro-Mallory for fibrin.

name: lissamine fast red(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the sulfo groups of 5-[(4-acetamido-2-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]-6-amino-4-hydroxynaphthalene-2-sulfonic acid.

name: CTPB
definition: A benzamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-ethoxy-6-pentadecylbenzoic acid with one of the amino groups of 4-chloro-3-(trifluoromethyl)aniline.

name: lissamine fast red (acid form)
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is 6-aminonaphthalene-2-sulfonic acid carrying additional hydroxy and (4-acetamido-2-sulfophenyl)diazenyl substituents at positions 4 and 5 respectively. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'lissamine fast red'.

name: plitidepsin
definition: A didemnin that is didemin B in which the hydroxy group of the 1-(2-hydroxypropanoyl)-L-prolinamide moiety has been oxidised to the corresponding ketone. It was originally isolated from the Mediterranean tunicate Aplidium albicans.

name: lissamine fast yellow
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of 2,5-dichloro-4-{5-hydroxy-3-methyl-4-[(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]pyrazol-1-yl}benzene-1-sulfonic acid. It is used as the erythrocyte stain in Garvey's method for elastic, fibrin and collagen as well as a substitute for martius yellow in Lendrum's MSB.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide consisting of two N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine disaccharide units linked (1→3).

name: lissamine fast yellow(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the sulfo groups of 2,5-dichloro-4-{5-hydroxy-3-methyl-4-[(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]pyrazol-1-yl}benzene-1-sulfonic acid.

name: lissamine fast yellow (acid form)
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is 2,5-dichloro-4-(pyrazol-1-yl)benzene-1-sulfonic acid in which the pyrazole ring is substituted by methyl, (4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl and hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4, and 5 respctively. The disodium salt is the biological stain 'lissamine fast yellow'.

name: Luxol fast blue MBS
definition: A guanidinium salt that is the bis[1,3-di(2-tolyl)guanidinium] salt of a copper phthalocyanine-disulfonic acid. A dye that is soluble in alcohols and phospholipids and is used to demonstrate myelin.

name: Luxol fast blue MBS(2−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the sulfo groups of a copper phthalocyanine-disulfonic acid.

name: Luxol fast blue MBS (acid form)
definition: A metallophthalocyanine consisting of a phthalocyanine-disulfonic acid bound to a central copper atom. Used in the form of an arylguanidinium salt as a histological dye.

name: quizartinib
definition: A member of the class of phenylureas that is urea in which one of the amino groups has been substituted by a 5-tert-butyl-1,2-oxazol-3-yl group while the other has been substituted by a phenyl group substituted at the para- position by an imidazo[2,1-b][1,3]benzothiazol-2-yl group that, in turn, is substituted at position 7 by a 2-(morpholin-4-yl)ethoxy group.

name: 2,7-dibromo-4-hydroxymercurifluorescein(2−)
definition: A benzoate anion resulting from deprotonation from the phenol and the carboxy groups of 2,7-dibromo-4-hydroxymercurifluorescein.

name: 2,7-dibromo-4-hydroxymercurifluorescein
definition: A xanthene dye that is fluorescein bearing bromine substituents at positions 2 and 7 as well as a hydroxymercurio substituent at position 4.

name: (S)-2-methylbutanoyl-CoA
definition: A (2S)-2-methylacyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2S)-2-methylbutanoic acid.

name: RU 58668
definition: A 17β-hydroxy steroid that is 17β-estradiol in the the hydrogen at the 11β position has been replaced by a p-({5-[(4,4,5,5,5-pentafluoropentyl)sulfonyl]pentyl}oxy)phenyl group. RU 58668 is a pure anti-estrogen that downregulates estrogen receptor expression (IC50 = 0.04 nM).

name: 2-methylhexanoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-methylhexanoic acid.

name: rubitecan
definition: A pyranoindolizinoquinoline that is camptothecin in which the hydrogen at position 9 has been replaced by a nitro group. It is a prodrug for 9-aminocamptothecin.

name: selumetinib
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1-methyl-1H-benzimidazole which is substituted at positions 4, 5, and 6 by fluorine, (4-bromo-2-chlorophenyl)amino, and N-(2-hydroxyethoxy)aminocarbonyl groups, respectively. It is a MEK1 and MEK2 inhibitor.

name: epoxypheophorbide a
definition: A member of the class of pheophorbides obtained by formal epoxidation of pheophorbide a.

name: prostaglandin E2 1-glyceryl ester
definition: A 1-monoglyceride resulting from the condensation of the carboxy group of prostaglandin E2 with the 1-hydroxy group of glycerol.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)
definition: An α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl.

name: 9-(tetrahydrofuryl)adenine
definition: A nucleoside analogue that is adenine in which the nitrogen at position 9 has been substituted by a tetrahydrofuran-2-yl group. It is an adenylate cyclase inhibitor.

name: prostaglandin F2α 1-glyceryl ester
definition: A 1-monoglyceride resulting from the condensation of the carboxy group of prostaglandin F2α with the 1-hydroxy group of glycerol.

name: spiruchostatin B
definition: A spiruchostatin with molecular formula C21H33N3O6S2 originally isolated from a Pseudomonas culture broth.

name: (2E,6E)-farnesyl monophosphate
definition: A member of the class of farnesyl phosphates that is the monophosphatr derivative of (2E,6E)-farnesol

name: tandutinib
definition: An N-arylpiperazine that is piperazine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen at position 1 is replaced by a 6-methoxy-7-[3-(piperidin-1-yl)propoxy]quinazolin-4-yl group, while the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen at position 4 is replaced by a (p-isopropoxyphenyl)aminocarbonyl group. Tandutinib is an inhibitor of tyrosine kinases FLT3, PDGFR and KIT.

name: β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)
definition: A β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl.

name: tiazofurine
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 1,3-thiazole-4-carboxamide in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a β-D-ribofuranosyl group. It is metabolised to thiazole-4-carboxamide adenine dinucleotide (TAD), a selective inhibitor of inosine monophosphate dehydrogenase (IMP dehydrogenase).

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)
definition: An α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl.

name: vinflunine
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound and an organic heterotetracyclic compound that is vinorelbine in which the tetrahydropyridine moiety of the heterotetracyclic part of the molecule has been redced to the corresponding piperidine, and in which the ethyl group attached to this ring has been replaced by a 1,1-difluoroethyl group.

name: caffeic acid 3-sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is trans-caffeic acid in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a sulfo group. A metabolite from coffee.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-β-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and (at the reducing end) N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→6), to the N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue of which is also linked (1→3) a further β-D-galactose residue.

name: 2-chlorosuccinic acid
definition: A C4-dicarboxylic acid that is succinic acid substituted at position 2 by a chloro group.

name: 5-bromo-3-hydroxyindole
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is indoxyl carrying an additional bromo substituent at position 5.

name: 5-bromo-3-indolyl decanoate
definition: An decanoate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of decanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 5-bromoindoxyl.

name: 2-naphthyl tetradecanoate
definition: A tetradecanoate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of tetradecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 2-naphthol.

name: 2-naphthyl octanoate
definition: A octanoate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of octanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 2-naphthol.

name: bis(p-nitrophenyl)phosphocholine
definition: A member of the class of phosphocholines obtained by formal condensation of the phosphate group of phosphocholine with the phenolic groups of two molecules of 4-nitrophenol.

name: 2-naphthyl α-L-fucoside
definition: An α-L-fucoside that is α-L-fucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 2-naphthyl group.

name: 4-nitrophenyl α-L-fucoside
definition: An α-L-fucoside that is α-L-fucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 4-nitrophenyl group.

name: 2-naphthyl β-L-fucoside
definition: A β-L-fucoside that is β-L-fucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 2-naphthyl group.

name: 4-nitrophenyl β-L-fucoside
definition: A β-L-fucoside that is β-L-fucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 4-nitrophenyl group.

name: 2-naphthyl α-D-glucoside
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is α-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 2-naphthyl group.

name: 6-bromo-2-naphthyl β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 6-bromo-2-naphthyl group.

name: 2-naphthyl β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 2-naphthyl group.

name: 4-nitrophenyl β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 4-nitrophenyl group.

name: 4-nitrophenyl β-lactoside
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is β-lactose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 4-nitrophenyl group.

name: L-3-sulfolactaldehyde
definition: A 3-sulfolactaldehyde in which the stereocentre at position 3 has R-configuration.

name: tricosanoyl-CoA
definition: A very long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of tricosanoic acid.

name: 11β,13-dihydrolactucin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal hydrogenation across the 11,13-double bond of lactucin. Found in chicory

name: 11β,13-dihydrolactucin 15-oxalate
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of oxalic acid with the 15-hydroxy group of 11β,13-dihydrolactucin. Found in chicory.

name: lactucin 15-oxalate
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of oxalic acid with the 15-hydroxy group of lactucin. Found in chicory.

name: 8-deoxylactucin 15-oxalate
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of oxalic acid with the 15-hydroxy group of 8-deoxylactucin. Found in chicory.

name: (2E)-tricosenoyl-CoA
definition: A very long-chain fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (2E)-tricosenoic acid.

name: 11β,13-dihydro-8-deoxylactucin 15-oxalate
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of oxalic acid with the 15-hydroxy group of 11β,13-dihydro-8-deoxylactucin. Found in chicory.

name: 11β,13-dihydro-8-deoxylactucin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal hydrogenation across the 11,13-double bond of 8-deoxylactucin. Found in chicory

name: lactucopicrin 15-oxalate
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of oxalic acid with the 15-hydroxy group of lactucopicrin. Found in chicory.

name: 11β,13-dihydrolactucopicrin 15-oxalate
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of oxalic acid with the 15-hydroxy group of 11β,13-dihydrolactucopicrin. Found in chicory.

name: N1,N12-diethylspermine
definition: A substituted spermine that is spermine in which a hydrogen attached to each of the primary amino groups has been replaced by an ethyl group.

name: 11β,13-dihydrolactucopicrin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-hydroxyphenylacetic acid with the 8-hydroxy group of 11β,13-dihydrolactucin. Found in chicory.

name: pirazofurin
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 4-hydroxy-1H-pyrazole-5-carboxamide in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a β-D-ribofuranosyl group.

name: STAT3 inhibitor peptide
definition: A linear eighteen-membered polypeptide comprising the sequence Pro-Tyr-(PO3H2)-Leu-Lys-Thr-Lys-Ala-Ala-Val-Leu-Leu-Pro-Val-Leu-Leu-Ala-Ala-Pro.

name: Milling yellow 3G
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of 5-chloro-2-[5-hydroxy-3-methyl-4-({4-[(4-methylbenzene-1-sulfonyl)oxy]phenyl}diazenyl)-1H-pyrazol-1-yl]benzene-1-sulfonic acid.

name: Milling yellow 3G (free acid)
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is 5-chloro-2-(pyrazol-1-yl)benzene-1-sulfonic acid in which the pyrazole ring is substituted by methyl, 4-(tosyloxy)phenyldiazenyl and hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4, and 5 respctively. The monosodium salt is the biological stain 'Milling yellow 3G'.

name: Milling yellow 3G(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is conjugate base of Milling yellow 3G (free acid), resulting from the deprotonation of the sulfo group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: pacein
definition: A member of the class of benzofurans that is dibenzo[b,d]furan-3,7-dione bearing two methyl substituents at positions 1 and 9 as well as two 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylanilino substituents at positions 2 and 8.

name: PLX-4720
definition: A pyrrolopyridine that is vemurafenib in which the p-chlorophenyl group has been replaced by chlorine. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of the Raf kinase B-Raf(V600E).

name: TG101209
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is 5-methylpyrimidine-2,4-diamine in which the amino group at position 2 is substituted by a p-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)phenyl group, while that at position 4 is substituted by a m-(tert-butylsulfamoyl)phenyl group. A Janus kinase 2 (JAK2) inhibitor.

name: α-aminoorcein
definition: A member of the class of phenoxazines that is 1,9-dimethyl-3H-phenoxazin-3-one carrying additional amino and 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylphenyl substituents at positions 7 and 8 respectively. A component of orcein, a mixture of dyes isolated from lichens.

name: α-hydroxyorcein
definition: A member of the class of phenoxazines that is 1,9-dimethyl-3H-phenoxazin-3-one carrying additional hydroxy and 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylphenyl substituents at positions 7 and 8 respectively. A component of orcein, a mixture of dyes isolated from lichens.

name: β-hydroxyorcein
definition: A member of the class of phenoxazines that is 1,9-dimethyl-3H-phenoxazin-3-one carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 7 as well as two 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylphenyl substituents at positions 2 and 8. The isomer in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 2'' on the phenyl rings are both on the same side of the plane of the phenoxazine ring system. A component of orcein, a mixture of dyes isolated from lichens.

name: β-aminoorcein
definition: A member of the class of phenoxazines that is 1,9-dimethyl-3H-phenoxazin-3-one carrying an additional amino substituent at position 7 as well as two 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylphenyl substituents at positions 2 and 8. The isomer in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 2'' on the phenyl rings are both on the same side of the plane of the phenoxazine ring system. A component of orcein, a mixture of dyes isolated from lichens.

name: γ-aminoorcein
definition: A member of the class of phenoxazines that is 1,9-dimethyl-3H-phenoxazin-3-one carrying an additional amino substituent at position 7 as well as two 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylphenyl substituents at positions 2 and 8. The isomer in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 2'' on the phenyl rings are situated on opposite sides of the plane of the phenoxazine ring system. A component of orcein, a mixture of dyes isolated from lichens.

name: γ-hydroxyorcein
definition: A member of the class of phenoxazines that is 1,9-dimethyl-3H-phenoxazin-3-one carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 7 as well as two 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylphenyl substituents at positions 2 and 8. The isomer in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 2'' on the phenyl rings are situated on opposite sides of the plane of the phenoxazine ring system. A component of orcein, a mixture of dyes isolated from lichens.

name: β-aminoorceimine
definition: A member of the class of phenoxazines that is 3-imino-1,9-dimethyl-3H-phenoxazine carrying an additional amino substituent at position 7 as well as two 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylphenyl substituents at positions 2 and 8. The isomer in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 2'' on the phenyl rings are both on the same side of the plane of the phenoxazine ring system. A component of orcein, a mixture of dyes isolated from lichens.

name: γ-aminoorceimine
definition: A member of the class of phenoxazines that is 3-imino-1,9-dimethyl-3H-phenoxazine carrying an additional amino substituent at position 7 as well as two 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methylphenyl substituents at positions 2 and 8. The isomer in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 2'' on the phenyl rings are situated on opposite sides of the plane of the phenoxazine ring system. A component of orcein, a mixture of dyes isolated from lichens.

name: Ponceau S
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the tetrasodium salt of 3-hydroxy-4-({2-sulfo-4-[(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]phenyl}diazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid.

name: 3-(p-nitrophenyl)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is 3-phenylpropionic acid in which the hydrogen at the para position of the phennyl group has been replaced by a nitro group.

name: Ponceau S (acid form)
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is 3-hydroxynaphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid carrying a {2-sulfo-4-[(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]phenyl}diazenyl group at position 4. The tetrasodium salt is the biological stain 'Ponceau S'.

name: Ponceau S(4−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of Ponceau S.

name: homocysteic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is homocysteine in which the thiol group has benn oxidised to the corresponding sulfonic acid.

name: (2R)-2-{(1R)-1-hydroxy-15-[2-(20-methoxy-21-methylnonatriacontyl)cyclopropyl]pentadecyl}hexacosanoic acid
definition: A C85 α-mycolic acid produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis having a C58 meromycolic chain with one cis cyclopropyl function, one methoxy function and one methyl subsituent, and a saturated C24 α-branch.

name: Ser-Ile
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-serine with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: 2-nitrophenyl N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminide in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 2-nitrophenyl group.

name: Thr-Val
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-threonine with the amino group of L-valine.

name: 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-hydroxyindole
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is indoxyl carrying additional chloro and bromo substituents at positions 4 and 5 respectively.

name: Val-Thr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-valine with the amino group of L-threonine.

name: 1-naphthyl N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 1-naphthyl group.

name: N-(indol-3-ylacetyl)glycine
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the N-acyl group is specified as indol-3-ylacetyl.

name: (E)-3-(indol-2-yl)acrylic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is acrylic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 is replaced by an indol-2-yl group.

name: 2-nitrophenyl N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 2-nitrophenyl group.

name: 3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-1,2-didodecanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A glycolipid that consists of 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol having dodecanoyl as the acyl groups and an α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 3.

name: 5-bromo-4-chloro-3-indolyl N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide
definition: An indolyl carbohydrate that is the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide of indoxyl in which the indole moiety is substituted at positions 4 and 5 by chlorine and bromine, respectively.

name: 1,2-didodecanoyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as dodecanoyl (lauroyl).

name: 4-nitrophenyl N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminide in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 4-nitrophenyl group.

name: 2,3-di-O-dodecanoyl-1-O-β-D-galactopyranosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A β-D-galactopyranosyl diglyceride that consists of 2,3-diacyl-sn-glycerol having dodecanoyl as the acyl groups and the β-D-galactopyranosyl residue attached at position 1.

name: 4-nitrophenyl N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminide in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a 4-nitrophenyl group.

name: N-methylproline
definition: An L-proline derivative obtained by replacement of the amino hydrogen by a methyl group.

name: glycerol monomycolate (C85)
definition: A mycolate ester formed by esterification of (2R)-2-{(1R)-1-hydroxy-15-[2-(20-methoxy-21-methylnonatriacontyl)cyclopropyl]pentadecyl}hexacosanoic acid with the 1-OH of glycerol.

name: glycine 2-naphthylamide
definition: A glycine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of glycine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: glucose 6-monomycolate (C85)
definition: A mycolate ester formed by esterification of (2R)-2-{(1R)-1-hydroxy-15-[2-(20-methoxy-21-methylnonatriacontyl)cyclopropyl]pentadecyl}hexacosanoic acid with the 6-OH of D-glucose.

name: L-alanine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-alanine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-alanine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-arginine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-arginine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-arginine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-asparagine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-asparagine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-asparagine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-3-O-[(2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltriacont-2-enoyl]-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitic acid, and at the 3-position with (2S,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethyltriacontanoic acid.

name: Phe-Gln
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-phenylalanine with the amino group of L-glutamine.

name: phenylpropiolic acid
definition: An acetylenic compound that is propynoic acid in which the acetylenic hydrogen is replaced by a phenyl group.

name: dibenzothiophene sulfone
definition: A sulfone resulting from the oxidation of the sulfur atom of dibenzothiophene.

name: 2-methylhexenoyl-CoA
definition: A 2-enoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-methylhexenoic acid.

name: S-(5-deoxy-β-D-ribos-5-yl)-L-homocysteine
definition: An S-(5-deoxy-D-ribos-5-yl)-L-homocysteine in which the anomeric centre has β-configuration.

definition: A phosphatidylinositol mannoside having on a myo-inositol ring a phosphatidyl moiety (carrying palmitoyl and 10-methyloctadecanoyl groups) at the 1-position, an α-D-mannosyl residue at the 2-position, a palmitoyl group at the 5-position and a 6-O-palmitoyl-α-D-mannosyl group at the 6-position.

name: 2-O-α-D-mannosyl-1-O-{1-O-[(10S)-10-methyloctadecanoyl]-2-O-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphono}-5-O-palmitoyl-6-O-(6-O-palmitoyl-α-D-mannosyl)-1D-myo-inositol sodium salt
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of 2-O-α-D-mannosyl-1-O-{1-O-[(10S)-10-methyloctadecanoyl]-2-O-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphono}-5-O-palmitoyl-6-O-(6-O-palmitoyl-α-D-mannosyl)-1D-myo-inositol.

name: 6-chloro-2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-carbazole-1-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of carbazoles that is 2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-carbazole which is substituted at position 1 by an aminocarbohyl group and at position 6 by a chlorine.

name: (R)-selisistat
definition: A 6-chloro-2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-carbazole-1-carboxamide that has R configuration. It is the inactive enantiomer.

name: (S)-selisistat
definition: A 6-chloro-2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-carbazole-1-carboxamide that has S configuration It is the active enantiomer.

name: succinic acid-d4
definition: A deuterated compound that is succinic acid in which the four methylene hydrogens are replaced by deuterium.

name: N-sulfotyrosine
definition: An N-acyl-L-tyrosine obtained by replaceing one of the amino hydrogens with a sulfo group.

definition: An organic calcium salt that is the hemicalcium salt of (1S,2S,5R)-AH23848.

definition: A (4Z)-7-{5-[([1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl)methoxy]-2-(morpholin-4-yl)-3-oxocyclopentyl}hept-4-enoic acid in which the stereocentres at positions 1, 2 and 5 have R-, R- and S-configuration respectively.

definition: A (4Z)-7-{5-[([1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl)methoxy]-2-(morpholin-4-yl)-3-oxocyclopentyl}hept-4-enoic acid in which the stereocentres at positions 1, 2 and 5 have S-, S- and R-configuration respectively.

definition: A member of the class of cyclopentanones that is (4Z)-7-(3-oxocyclopentyl)hept-4-enoic acid in which the cyclopentenone ring is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by morpholin-4-yl and (1,1'-biphenyl-4-yl)methoxy groups respectively.

name: (1R,2R,5S)-AH23848(1−)
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (1R,2R,5S)-AH23848.

name: (1S,2S,5R)-AH23848(1−)
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (1S,2S,5R)-AH23848.

name: (3,5-dichloro-2,4,6-trihydroxyphenyl)hexan-1-one
definition: An aromatic ketone that is phloroglucinol in which two of the hydrogens attached to the benzene ring have been replaced by chlorines while the third has been replaced by a hexanoyl group. It is the immediate biosynthetic precursor for differentiation-inducing factor 1 (DIF-1). DIF-1 is released by developing Dictyostelium amoebae, inducing them to differentiate into stalk cells.

name: 1-(3,5-dichloro-2,6-dihydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)hexan-1-one(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the removal of a proton from one of the hydroxy groups of 1-(3,5-dichloro-2,6-dihydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)hexan-1-one (DIF-1). The major structure at pH 7.3.

name: (3,5-dichloro-2,4,6-trihydroxyphenyl)hexan-1-one(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from removal of the proton from the phenolic hydroxy group of (3,5-dichloro-2,4,6-trihydroxyphenyl)hexan-1-one that is para to the hexanoyl group. The major structure at pH 7.3.

name: primuline
definition: An organic sodium salt having 2'-(4-aminophenyl)-6-methyl[2,6'-bi-1,3-benzothiazole]-7-sulfonate as the counterion.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc

name: primuline (acid form)
definition: A member of the class of benzothiazoles that is 2,6'-bi-1,3-benzothiazole substituted at positions 2' 6 and 7 by 4-aminophenyl, methyl and sulfo groups respectively. The monosodium salt is the biological dye 'primuline'.

name: 2'-(4-aminophenyl)-6-methyl[2,6'-bi-1,3-benzothiazole]-7-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of 2'-(4-aminophenyl)-6-methyl[2,6'-bi-1,3-benzothiazole]-7-sulfonic acid.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising a linear pentasaccharide chain of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→6), to the N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue at the reducing end of which is also linked (1→3) a further β-D-galactose residue.

name: pyronin B
definition: An organic chloride salt having 6-(diethylamino)-N,N-diethyl-3H-xanthen-3-iminium as the cation. Depending on the mode of manufacture, pyronin B also exists in the form of an FeCl3 complex.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide consisting of an α-D-galactosamine residue to which are attached (1→3) and (1→6) two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl tetrasaccharide branches.

name: O-(3-hydroxyvaleryl)-L-carnitine
definition: An O-acyl-L-carnitine in which the acyl group is specified as 3-hydroxyvaleryl.

name: acridine red 3B free base
definition: A member of the class of xanthenes that is 3-imino-3H-xanthen-6-amine in which both nitrogens are carrying methyl substituents. The hydrochloride is the biological dye 'acridine red 3B'.

name: pyronin B(1+)
definition: An iminium ion that is the cationic component of pyronin B

name: pyronin B-FeCl3 complex
definition: An iminium salt composed of 6-(diethylamino)-N,N-diethyl-3H-xanthen-3-iminium and tetrachloroferrate ions ia 1:1 ratio. Depending on the mode of manufacture, pyronin B also exists in the form of a chloride salt.

name: N-benzoyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: An N-acyl-L-phenylalanine that is L-phenylalanine in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group has been replaced by a benzoyl group.

name: N-benzoyl-D-phenylalanine
definition: A D-phenylalanine derivative that is D-phenylalanine in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group has been replaced by a benzoyl group.

name: pyronin Y cation
definition: An iminium ion that is the cationic component of pyronin Y.

name: 2-(benzoylamino)-3-phenylpropanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is 3-phenylpropanoic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 has been replaced by a benzoylamino group.

name: 2-amino-4-(methylsulfanyl)-N-(2-naphthyl)butanamide
definition: A methionine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of methionine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-methionine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-methionine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-methionine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: D-methionine 2-naphthylamide
definition: A D-methionine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of D-methionine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: N-(α-L-aspartyl)-2-naphthylamine(1−)
definition: A β-amino-acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the side-chain carboxy group of N-(α-L-aspartyl)-2-naphthylamine.

name: N-(α-L-aspartyl)-2-naphthylamine
definition: An L-aspartic acid derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the α-carboxy group of L-aspartic acid with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-cysteine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-cysteine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-cysteine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-cystine mono-2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-cysteine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of L-cystine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-cystine di-2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-cysteine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy groups of L-cystine with the amino groups from two molecules of 2-naphthylamine.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/16:0)
definition: A sialodiosylceramide that consists of an α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc moiety attached via a glycosidic bond at position 1 of N-hexadecanoylsphingosine.

name: N-(α-L-glutamyl)-2-naphthylamine(1−)
definition: A γ-amino-acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the side-chain carboxy group of N-(α-L-glutamyl)-2-naphthylamine.

name: N-(α-L-glutamyl)-2-naphthylamine
definition: An L-glutamic acid derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the α-carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: WIN 18446
definition: A carboxamide that is 1,8-diaminooctane in which a hydrogen attached to each of the amino groups has been replaced by a dichloroacetyl group. Inhibitor of aldehyde dehydrogenase 1a2 (ALDH1a2). Inhibits the biosynthesis of retinoic acid from retinol in neonatal and adult murine testis. It down-regulates sex related genes in zebrafish.

name: N-(γ-L-glutamyl)-2-naphthylamine(1−)
definition: An L-α-amino-acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-(γ-L-glutamyl)-2-naphthylamine.

name: N-(γ-L-glutamyl)-2-naphthylamine
definition: An L-glutamine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the γ-carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide comprising a linear hexasaccharide chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→6), to the N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue at the reducing end of which is also linked (1→3) a further β-D-galactose residue.

name: L-glutamine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-glutamine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-histidine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-histidine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-histidine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a pentadecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end) all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear hexasaccharide units.

name: L-hydroxyproline 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-proline derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-4-hydroxy-L-proline with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: 1,2-dioctanoyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-beta-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as octanoyl.

name: 3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-1,2-dioctoanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A glycolipid that consists of 1,2-dioctanoyl-sn-glycerol having an α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 3.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-heptadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine where the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecanoyl and heptadecanoyl respectively.

name: L-isoleucine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-isoleucine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-isoleucine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: 1-(1Z-hexadecenyl)-2-(8Z,11Z,14Z-icosatrienoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine

name: L-leucine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-leucine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-leucine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-lysine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-lysine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-lysine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: 1-(1Z-hexadecenyl)-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine

name: 2-octanoyl-3-(β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1-(alk-1-enyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (1Z)-octadecenyl and hexadecanoyl respectively.

definition: A 1-(alk-1-enyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (1Z)-octadecenyl and (8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl respectively.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z-docosapentaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1-(alk-1-enyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (1Z)-octadecenyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosapentaenoyl respectively.

name: 1-(1Z,11Z-octadecadienyl)-2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1-(alk-1-enyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (1Z,11Z)-octadecadienyl and linoleoyl respectively.

name: 1-(1Z,9Z-octadecadienyl)-2-(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z-docosahexaenoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1-(alk-1-enyl)-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as (1Z,9Z)-octadecadienyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively.

name: N-nonadecanoylsphinganine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-acylsphinganine-1-phosphocholine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as nonadecanoyl.

name: 3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-2-octoanoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A glycoglycerolipid that consists of 3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-sn-glycerol in which the glycerol portion is acylated at position 2 by an octanoyl group.

name: N-(11Z-icosenoyl)-sphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: A sphingomyelin d18:1 in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (11Z)-icosenoyl.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/21:0)
definition: An α-NeuNAc-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-NeuNAc-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as henicosanoyl.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/24:0)
definition: An α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-Gal-(1→3)-β-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-Gal-(1→4)-β-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as tetracosanoyl.

name: β-D-galactosyl-(1↔1')-N-octadecanoylsphinganine
definition: A β-D-galactosyl-(1↔1')-N-acylsphinganine in which the acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoate
definition: A hexadecatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-galactosyl-(1↔1')-N-[(15Z)-tetracosenoyl]sphinganine
definition: A β-D-galactosyl-(1↔1')-N-acylsphinganine in which the acyl group is specified as (15Z)-tetracosenoyl.

definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a pentadecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked linked (1→3) and (1→6) two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear hexasaccharide units.

name: 1,2-di-(9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl)-3-(β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the groups at the 1- and 2-positions are both linoleoyl (9Z,12Z-octadecadienoyl).

name: 1-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-2-hexadecanoyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as oleoyl and palmitoyl respectively.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-L-Fucp
definition: An amino disaccharide in which D-GlcNAc is linked β(1→3) to L-fucose which has α-configuration at its anomeric centre.
