name: victoria blue R
definition: An iminium salt composed of 4-{[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl][4-(ethylamino)naphthalen-1-yl]methylidene}-N,N-dimethylcyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-iminium and chloride ions in a 1:1 ratio.

name: victoria blue R(1+)
definition: An iminium ion that forms the cationic portion of the histological dye 'victoria blue R'.

name: alkali blue 4B
definition: An organic sodium salt having 2-(4-{(4-amino-3-methylphenyl)[4-(phenylimino)cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene]methyl}anilino)benzene-1-sulfonate as the counterion. It is used for staining elastic fibres.

name: PI-103
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is pyrido[3',2':4,5]furo[3,2-d]pyrimidine substituted at positions 2 and 4 by 3-hydroxyphenyl and morpholin-4-yl groups respectively. A dual-kinase inhibitor with anti-cancer properties.

name: 4-O-(2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl)-5-O-phosphono-D-ribitol
definition: A disaccharide phosphate consisting of 2-O-(N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl)ribitol phosphorylated at O-1 of the ribitol residue; a ligand epitope of Staphylococcus aureus.

name: N-cyclopropyl-3-{4-[(cyclopropylmethyl)carbamoyl]phenyl}-4-methylbenzamide
definition: A dicarboxylic acid diamide obtained by condensation of the 3- and 4'-carboxy groups of 6-methyl[1,1'-biphenyl]-3,4'-dicarboxylic acid with cyclpropylamine and cyclpropylmethylamine respectively.

name: VX-745
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidopyridazines that is 6H-pyrimido[1,6-b]pyridazin-6-one substituted at positions 2 and 5 by (2,4-difluorophenyl)sulfanyl and 2,6-dichlorophenyl groups respectively

name: 4-chloro-6-{5-[(2-morpholin-4-ylethyl)amino]-1,2-benzisoxazol-3-yl}benzene-1,3-diol
definition: A member of the class of 1,2-benzoxazoles carrying 2,4-dihydroxy-4-chlorophenyl and (2-morpholin-4-ylethyl)amino substituents at positions 3 and 5 respectively.

name: 9-cyclopentyl-N8-(2-fluorophenyl)-N2-(4-methoxyphenyl)-9H-purine-2,8-diamine
definition: A member of the class of purines that is carrying 9-cyclopentyl-9H-purine-2,8-diamine in which the amino groups at positions 2 and 8 are carrying 4-methoxyphenyl and 2-fluorophenyl substituents respectively.

name: sotrastaurin
definition: A member of the class of maleimides that is maleimide which is substituted at position 3 by an indol-3-yl group and at position 4 by a quinazolin-4-yl group, which in turn is substituted at position 2 by a 4-methylpiperazin-1-yl group. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of protein kinase C and has been investigated as an immunosuppresant in renal transplant patients.

name: alkali Blue G
definition: An aminobenzenesulfonic acid that is 2-aminobenzenesulfonic acid in which one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by a 4-{(4-amino-3-methylphenyl)[4-(phenylimino)cyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-ylidene]methyl} group.

name: PQIP
definition: A member of the class of imidazopyrazines that is imidazo[1,5-a]pyrazin-8-amine carrying additional 2-phenylquinolin-7-yl and 3-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)cyclobutyl groups at positions 1 and 3 respectively. It is an inhibitor of insulin growth factor 1 receptor (IGF-1 receptor, IGFR1R) tyrosine kinase.

name: ICPD-26
definition: A member of the class of thiadiazoles that is 1,2,3-thiadiazole substituted at positions 4 and 5 by 2,4-dihydroxy-4-chlorophenyl and 4-methoxyphenyl groups respectively.

name: ICPD-47
definition: A member of the class of thiadiazoles that is 1,2,3-thiadiazole substituted at positions 4 and 5 by 2,4-dihydroxy-4-chlorophenyl and 4-methoxyphenyl groups respectively.

name: 1-[5-t-butyl-2-(4-methylphenyl)pyrazol-3-yl]-3-[4-(2-phenylmethoxyethyl)-1,3-thiazol-2-yl]urea
definition: A member of the class of ureas obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of [3-tert-butyl-1-(4-methylphenyl)pyrazol-5-yl]carbamic acid with the amino group of 4-[2-(benzyloxy)ethyl]-1,3-thiazol-2-amine.

name: N2-[3-methoxy-4-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl]-N4-(quinolin-3-yl)pyrimidine-2,4-diamine
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is pyrimidine-2,4-diamine substituted at positions N-2 and N-4 by 3-methoxy-4-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl and quinolin-3-yl groups respectively.

name: 1-(3-{5-[4-(aminomethyl)phenyl]-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridin-3-yl}phenyl)-3-(2-phenoxyphenyl)urea
definition: A member of the class of phenylureas obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (3-{5-[4-(aminomethyl)phenyl]pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridin-3-yl}phenyl)carbamic acid with the amino group of 2-phenoxyaniline. An inhibitor of tyrosine kinase.

name: 4-methyl-N-[3-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl]-3-[3-(piperidin-4-yl)-1,2-benzoxazol-6-yl]benzamide
definition: A biaryl resulting from the formal oxidative coupling of the 6 position of 3-(piperidin-4-yl)-1,2-benzoxazole with the 3 position of p-toluic acid and subsequent condensation of the carboxy group with the primary amino group of 3-(morpholin-4-yl)aniline to give the corresponding carboxamide. An inhibitor of p38-α MAP kinase.

name: methyl 3-[2-(2-thienyl)acetamido]thiophene-2-carboxylate
definition: A carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-thienylacetic acid with the amino group of methyl 3-aminothiophene-2-carboxylate. It is a selective inhibitor of c-Jun N-terminal kinases (JNKs).

name: N-cyclopropyl-2',6-dimethyl-4'-(5-methyl-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-yl)biphenyl-3-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of biphenyls that is biphenyl in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted at positions 2and 4 by a methyl and a 5-methyl-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-yl groups, respectively, while the other phenyl group is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by a methyl and an N-(cyclopropyl)aminocarbohyl group, respectively. An inhibitor of p38-α MAP kinase.

name: ZSTK-474
definition: A triamino-1,3,5-triazine that is 1,3,5-triazine in which two of the hydrogens have been replaced by morpholin-4-yl groups while the third hydrogen has been replaced by a 2-(difluoromethyl)benzimidazol-1-yl group. It is an inhibitor of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase.

name: mepiquat
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion has that has two methyl groups and a pentamethylene-1,5-diyl group attached to the nitrogen. Its salts are used as plant growth inhibitors.

name: 1-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoyl-2-(7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoyl-3-(β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-(β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol in which the 1- and 2- acyl groups are specified as (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoyl and (7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoyl respectively.

name: 1-(9S,13S,12-oxophytodienoyl)-2-(7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoyl-3-(β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-3-(β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol in which the 1- and 2- acyl groups are specified as (9S,13S-12-oxophytodienoyl) and (7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoyl respectively.

name: 2-(7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoyl-3-(β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol
definition: A 2-acyl-3-(β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol in which the acyl group at the 2 position is specified as (7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoyl.

name: 2-[(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A lysophosphatidylethanolamine 20:3 in which the acyl group is specified as (5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoyl and is located at position 2.

name: 4-O-(2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl)-D-ribitol
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine attached to D-ribitol via a β-(1→4)-linkage; epitope of Staphylococcus aureus.

name: N-(2,6-dichlorobenzoyl)-4-[1,6-dimethyl-2-oxo-4-(trifluoromethyl)-1,2-dihydropyridin-3-yl]-L-phenylalanine
definition: An L-phenylalanine derivative that is N-(2,6-dichlorobenzoyl)-L-phenylalanine carrying an additional 1,6-dimethyl-2-oxo-4-(trifluoromethyl)-1,2-dihydropyridin-3-yl substituent at position 4 on the phenyl ring.

name: L-ornithine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-ornithine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-ornithine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-phenylalanine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-phenylalanine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-phenylalanine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-proline 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-proline derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-proline with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: 5-oxo-L-proline 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-proline derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-oxo-L-proline with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-serine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-serine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-serine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-threonine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-threonine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-threonine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-tryptophan 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-tryptophan derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tryptophan with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-tyrosine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tyrosine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-valine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-valine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-valine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-leucine 4-methoxy-2-naphthylamide
definition: An L-leucine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-leucine with the amino group of 4-methoxy-2-naphthylamine.

name: L-alanyl-L-alanine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-alanyl-L-alanine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-alanyl-L-phenylalanyl-L-proline 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-alanyl-L-phenylalanyl-L-proline with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: β-alanine 2-naphthylamide
definition: A β-alanine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of β-alanine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: vatalanib
definition: A member of the class of phthalazines that is phthalazine in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 4have been replaced by a p-chlorophenylamino group and a pyridin-4-ylmethyl group, respectively. It is a multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor for all isoforms of VEGFR, PDGFR and c-Kit.

name: 4-(5-methyl-3-phenylisoxazol-4-yl)pyrimidin-2-amine
definition: A member of the class of isoxazoles carrying phenyl, 2-aminopyrimidin-4-yl and methyl substituents at positions 3, 4 and 5 respectively.

name: 4-phenylpyrimidine
definition: A biaryl that is pyrimidine substituted at position 4 by a phenyl group.

name: vatalanib succinate
definition: A succinate salt obtained by combining vatalanib with one molar equivalent of succinic acid. It is a multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor for all isoforms of VEGFR, PDGFR and c-Kit.

name: SGX-523
definition: A member of the class of triazolopyridazines that is 6-(1-methylpyrazol-4-yl)[1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-b]pyridazine-3-thiol in which the thiol hydrogen is replaced by a quinolin-6-yl group.

name: 5-(5-chloro-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-yl)-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-imidazo[4,5-c]pyridine
definition: An imidazopyridine that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-imidazo[4,5-c]pyridine in which the amino hydrogen is replaced by a 5-chloro-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-yl group. A potent inhibitor of AKT1 kinase.

name: AMG-208
definition: A member of the class of quinolines that is 7-methoxyquinoline substituted at position 4 by a (6-phenyl[1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-b]pyridazin-3-yl)methoxy group. AMG exhibits antitumour activity, particularly in prostate cancer.

name: 2-(6-methoxy-1-oxo-1,3-dihydro-2H-isoindol-2-yl)-N-[4-(piperazin-1-yl)pyridin-3-yl]-1,3-thiazole-4-carboxamide
definition: An aromatic amide obtained by formal condensation of the amino group of 2-(6-methoxy-1-oxo-1,3-dihydro-2H-isoindol-2-yl)-1,3-thiazole-4-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 4-(piperazin-1-yl)pyridin-3-amine.

name: leupeptin hemisulfate
definition: A peptide sulfate salt obtained by combining leupeptin with 0.5 molar equivalents of sulfuric acid.

name: ω-conotoxin GVIA
definition: A heterodetic cyclic polypeptide consisting of the linear sequence Cys-Lys-Ser-Hyp-Gly-Ser-Ser-Cys-Ser-Hyp-Thr-Ser-Tyr-Asn-Cys-Cys-Arg-Ser-Cys-Asn-Hyp-Tyr-Thr-Lys-Arg-Cys-Tyr-NH2 with three disulfide bridges between cysteine residues 1-16, 8-19 and 15-26. Isolated from the venom of the fish-hunting snail Conus geographus.

name: 5-hydroperoxy-15-HETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-hydroperoxy-15-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5(S)-HETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 5(S)-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: perfluorododecanoic acid
definition: A fluoroalkanoic acid that is dodecanoic acid in which all of the hydrogens attached to carbon atoms are replaced by fluorines. It is a highly persistent, bioaccumulative breakdown product of stain- and grease-proof coatings on food packaging, soft furnishings and carpets.

name: GSK690693
definition: A member of the class of imidazopyridines that is 4-(1-ethylimidazo[4,5-c]pyridin-4-yl)-2-methylbut-3-yn-2-ol carrying additional 2-(4-amino-1,2,5-oxadiazol-3-yl and [(3S)-piperidin-3-yl]methoxy substituents at positions 4 and 7 respectively.

name: 4-{2-[4-(3,10-dibromo-8-chloro-6,11-dihydro-5H-benzo[5,6]cyclohepta[1,2-b]pyridin-11-yl)piperidin-1-yl]-2-oxoethyl}piperidine-1-carboxamide
definition: A benzocycloheptapyridine that is benzo[5,6]cyclohepta[1,2-b]pyridine which is substituted at positions 3 and 10 by bromines, at position 8 by chlorine, and at position 11 by an N-acetylpiperidin-4-yl group in which one of the hydrogens of the acetyl moiety has been replaced by a 1-carbamoylpiperidin-4-yl group.

name: torkinib
definition: A member of the class of pyrazolopyrimidines that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine substituted by isopropyl, 5-hydroxyindol-2-yl and amino groups at positions 1, 3 and 4 respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of mTOR and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: 12(S)-HETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 12(S)-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: SB-239063
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles carrying 4-hydroxycyclohexyl, 4-fluorophenyl and 2-methoxypyrimidin-4-yl substituents at positions 1, 4 and 5 respectively.

name: torin 2
definition: A member of the class of pyridoquinolines that is benzo[h][1,6]naphthyridin-2-one carrying additional 3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl and 6-aminopyridin-3-yl substituents at positions 1 and 9 respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of mTOR and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: talmapimod
definition: An indolecarboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 6-chloro-3-[(dimethylamino)(oxo)acetyl]-1-methylindole-5-carboxylic acid with the secondary amino group of (2S,5R)-1-[(4-fluorophenyl)methyl]-2,5-dimethylpiperazine. It is a potent inhibitor of MAPK and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: pamapimod
definition: A member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is 8-methylpyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidin-7(8H)-one carrying additional (1,5-dihydroxypentan-3-yl)amino and 2,4-difluorophenoxy substituents at positions 2 and 6 respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of MAPK and is used for treatment of rheumatoid arthritis.

name: IC-87114
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazolin-4(3H)-one carrying (6-amino-9H-purin-9-yl)methyl, 2-methylphenyl and methyl substituents at positions 2, 3 and 5 respectively.

name: BIIB021
definition: A member of the class of 2-aminopurines that is 2-aminopurine which is substituted by a chlorine at position 6 and by a (4-methoxy-3,5-dimethylpyridin-2-yl)methyl group at position 9.

name: metformin(1+)
definition: A guanidinium ion obtained by monoprotonation of metformin.

name: U-73122
definition: An aza-steroid that is 3-O-methyl-17β-estradiol in which the 17β-hydroxy group is replaced by a 6-(maleimid-1-yl)hexylamino group. An inibitor of phospholipase C.

name: U0126.EtOH
definition: An addition compound obtained by combining equimolar amounts of (2Z,3Z)-bis{amino[(2-aminophenyl)sulfanyl]methylidene}butanedinitrile (U0126) and ethanol. An inhibitor of mitogen-activated protein kinase that also exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: U0126
definition: An aryl sulfide that is (2Z,3Z)-bis[amino(sulfanyl)methylidene]butanedinitrile in which the sulfanyl hydrogens are replaced by 2-aminophenyl groups. An inhibitor of mitogen-activated protein kinase that also exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: 12(S)-HHTrE(1−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12(S)-HHTrE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: anthra[1,9-cd]pyrazol-6(2H)-one
definition: A member of the class of anthrapyrazoles that is anthra[1,9-cd]pyrazole substituted at position 6 by an oxo group. An inhibitor of c-Jun N-terminal kinase.

name: thromboxane B2(1−)
definition: A thromboxane anion that is the conjugate base of thromboxane B2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11-oxo-ETE(1−)
definition: A polyunsaturated oxo fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 11-oxo-ETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: strychnine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining strychnine with one molar equivalent of hydrogen chloride.

name: strychnine(1+)
definition: An indole alkaloid cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group of strychnine.

name: potassium 2-(4-carboxylatophenyl)-4,4,5,5-tetramethylimidazoline-1-oxyl-3-oxide
definition: A potassium salt having 2-(4-carboxylatophenyl)-4,4,5,5-tetramethylimidazoline-1-oxyl-3-oxide as the counterion.

name: carboxy-PTIO
definition: A member of the class of imidazolines and organic radical that is 4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-3-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-3λ5-imidazol-1-yl]oxidanyl substituted at position 2 by a 4-carboxyphenyl group.

name: gamendazole
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 3-(indazol-3-yl}prop-2-enoic acid carrying additional 2,4-dichlorobenzyl and trifluoromethyl substituents at positions 1 and 6 respectively. An orally active antispermatogenic compound with antifertility effects that is a potential male contraceptive drug.

name: carboxylato-PTIO
definition: A benzoate that is the conjugate base of carboxy-PTIO, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: SB 203580
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles carrying 4-methylsulfinylphenyl, 4-pyridyl and 4-fluorophenyl substituents at positions 2, 4 and 5 respectively. An inhibitor of mitogen-activated protein kinase.

name: Ro 41-5253
definition: A thiochromane that is 3,4-dihydro-2H-1-benzothiopyran S,S-dioxide in which the hydrogens at position 4 are both replaced by methyl groups, the hydrogens at position 7 is replaced by a heptyloxy group, while the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a 1-phenylprop-1-en-2-yl group, the phenyl group of which is substituted at the para position by a carboxy group. It is a selective antagonist for retinoic acid receptor α.

name: 20-hydroxylipoxin A4(1−)
definition: A lipoxin anion that is the conjugate base of 20-hydroxylipoxin A4 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 20-hydroxylipoxin B4(1−)
definition: A lipoxin anion that is the conjugate base of 20-hydroxy-lipoxin B4 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: S-methyl-L-thiocitrulline
definition: An L-arginine derivative in which the guanidino NH2 group of L-arginine is replaced by a methylsufanyl group.

name: 5,20-DiHETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 5,20-DiHETE, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-HETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 8-HETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8,20-DiHETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 8,20-DiHETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12-HETE(1−)
definition: A HETE anion that is the conjugate base of 12-HETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12,20-DiHETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 12,20-DiHETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 20-oxoleukotriene B4(1−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of 20-oxoleukotriene B4 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-[3-(aminomethyl)benzyl]acetamidine
definition: An aralkylamine that is Nbenzylacetamidine substituted at position 3 on the benzene ring by an aminomethyl group. An inhibitor of nitric oxide synthase.

name: 20-hydroxy-20-oxoleukotriene B4(2−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of 20-hydroxy-20-oxoleukotriene B4 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid functions; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-trans-leukotriene B4(1−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of 6-trans-leukotriene B4 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: AM-251
definition: A carbohydrazide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-5-(4-iodophenyl)-4-methyl-1H-pyrazole-3-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 1-aminopiperidine. An antagonist at the CB1 cannabinoid receptor.

name: L-glutamyl-L-glutamic acid 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the C-terminal carboxy group of L-glutamyl-L-glutamic acid with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-glutamylglycine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the C-terminal carboxy group of L-glutamylglycine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: L-glutamylglycyl-L-arginine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the C-terminal carboxy group of L-glutamylglycyl-L-arginine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: N-glutaryl-L-phenylalanine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the C-terminal carboxy group of N-glutaryl-L-phenylalanine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: 20-hydroxy-6-trans-leukotriene B4(1−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of 20-hydroxy-6-trans-leukotriene B4 arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: glycylglycine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of glycylglycine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: glycyl-L-phenylalanine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of glycyl-L-phenylalanine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: glycyl-L-proline 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of glycyl-L-proline with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: 5-HEPE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-HEPE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: glycyl-L-tryptophan 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of glycyl-L-tryptophan with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: BMS-453
definition: A member of the class of dihydronaphthalenes that is 1,2-dihydronaphthalene which is substituted at positions 1, 1, 4, and 6 by methyl, methyl, phenyl, and 2-(p-carboxyphenyl)vinyl groups, respectively (the E isomer). It is a potent retinoic acid receptor γ (RARβ) agonist that acts as an antagonist against RARα and RARγ.

name: L-leucylglycine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-leucylglycine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: N-benzoyl-L-leucine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-benzoyl-L-leucine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: N-benzoyl-L-valylglycine 4-methoxy-2-naphthylamide
definition: A dipeptide amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-benzoyl-L-valylglycine with the amino group of 4-methoxy-2-naphthylamine.

name: N-benzoyl-L-arginine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-{1-[(naphthalen-2-yl)amino]-1-oxo-3-phenylpropan-2-yl}benzamide that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-benzoyl-L-arginine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: N-carbobenzyloxy-glycylglycyl-L-arginine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-carbobenzyloxy-glycylglycyl-L-arginine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: O-(chloroacetylcarbamoyl)fumagillol
definition: A carbamate ester that is fumagillol in which the hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding N-(chloroacetyl)carbamate derivative.

name: L-seryl-L-tyrosine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-seryl-L-tyrosine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: naloxone(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen of naloxone.

name: 2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose
definition: A deoxygalactose that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been replaced by a hydrogen.

name: 2-deoxy-D-ribofuranose
definition: A deoxypentose that is D-ribofuranose in which the hydroxy group at position C-2 is replaced by hydrogen.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysyl-D-alanine(2−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained from N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysyl-D-alanine; major structure at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysine(2−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained from N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamyl-6-carboxy-L-lysine. Major structure at pH 7.3

name: α-mannofuranuronic acid γ-lactone
definition: A carbohydrate lactone obtained by intramolecular condensation of the 6-carboxy group with the 3-hydroxy group of α-mannofuranuronic acid.

name: D-glycero-D-gulo-heptopyranose
definition: An aldoheptose that is the D-glycero-diastereomer of D-gulo-heptopyranose

name: α-D-Manp6P-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: An oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of four α(1→3)-linked D-mannose residues, with the residue at the non-reducing end carrying a phosphate group at position 6, and with that at the reducing end being α(1→2)-linked to a further D-mannose residue; prepared from the phosphomannan fraction of Hansenula holstii.

name: 12(S)-HETrE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion anion that is the conjugate base of 12(S)-HETrE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12(S)-HpEPE(1−)
definition: A 12-HPEPE anion that is the conjugate base of 12(S)-HpEPE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13(S)-HOTrE(1−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 13S-HOTrE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp6P-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of a linear chain of β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues all linked (1→4), to the mannose residue of which are also linked (1→3) and (1→6) respectively a 6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl disaccharide unit and an α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-[α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched trisaccharide unit.

name: 11-oxo-ETE
definition: An oxoicosatetraenoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,12E,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid bearing a single oxo substituent located at position 12.

name: 13-oxo-9Z,11E-ODE(1−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 13-oxo-9Z,11E-ODE, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: aurachin B(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of aurachin B, obtained by deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 4-hydroxy-2-methyl-3-oxo-[(2E,6E)-farnesyl]-3,4-dihydroquinoline-1-oxide
definition: A member of the class of quinoline N-oxides that is 4-hydroxy-2-methyl-3-oxo-3,4-dihydroquinoline-1-oxide carrying an additional (2E,6E)-farnesyl group at position 4.

name: 2-methyl-1-oxo-4-[(2E,6E)-farnesyl]-3,4-dihydroquinoline-3,4-diol
definition: A member of the class of quinoline N-oxides that is 2-methyl-1-oxo-4-3,4-dihydroquinoline-3,4-diol carrying an additional (2E,6E)-farnesyl group at position 4.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp6P-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp6P-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of a linear chain of β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues all linked (1→4), to the mannose residue of which are also linked (1→3) and (1→6) respectively a 6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl disaccharide unit and an α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-[6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched trisaccharide unit.

name: 18(R)-HETE(1−)
definition: A 18-HETE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 18(R)-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-(1-hydroxyethyl)bacteriochlorophyllide a(2−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is obtained from 3-(1-hydroxyethyl)bacteriochlorophyllide a via deprotonation of the carboxy group and formation of a carbide ion. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 3-(1-hydroxyethyl)chlorophyllide a(2−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is obtained from 3-(1-hydroxyethyl)chlorophyllide a via deprotonation of the carboxy group and formation of a carbide ion. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: prostaglandin H1(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of prostaglandin H1, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-acetylchlorophyllide a(2−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is obtained from 3-acetylchlorophyllide a via deprotonation of the carboxy group and formation of a carbide ion. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: bacteriochlorophyllide a(2−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is obtained from bacteriochlorophyllide a via deprotonation of the carboxy group and formation of a carbide ion. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: D-erythrulose 4-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-erythrulose 4-phosphate. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: 19-hydroxyprostaglandin H2(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 19-hydroxyprostaglandin H2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-erythrulose 4-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of L-erythrulose 4-phosphate. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: 19-hydroxyprostaglandin H1(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 19-hydroxyprostaglandin H1, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp6P-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp6P-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of a linear chain of β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues all linked (1→4), to the mannose residue of which are also linked (1→3) and (1→6) respectively a 6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl disaccharide unit and an α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-[α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched tetrasaccharide unit.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp6P-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp6P-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of a linear chain of β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues all linked (1→4), to the mannose residue of which are also linked (1→3) and (1→6) respectively a 6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl disaccharide unit and an α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-[6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched tetrasaccharide unit.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp6P-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp6P-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of a linear chain of β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues all linked (1→4), to the mannose residue of which are also linked (1→3) and (1→6) respectively a 6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl disaccharide unit and an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-[6-O-phosphono-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched tetrasaccharide unit.

name: 5(S),11(R)-DiHETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 5(S),11(R)-DiHETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5(S),15(R)-DiHETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 5(S),15(R)-DiHETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5(S),15(S)-DiHETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 5(S),15(S)-DiHETE, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 17(R)-HDoHE(1−)
definition: A hydroxy polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 17(R)-HDoHE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,14E,16Z,19Z)-13-hydroxydocosahexaenoate
definition: A hydroxy polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 13-HDoHE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: pentamannose phosphate polysaccharide
definition: A phosphomannan in which the repeating unit consists of four α(1→3)-linked D-mannose residues, with the residue at the non-reducing end carrying a phosphate group at position 6, and with that at the reducing end being α(1→2)-linked to a further D-mannose residue; repeating units are linked from C-1 of the reducing-end mannose to an oxygen of the phosphate group at the non-reducing end.

name: 18(R)-HEPE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 18(R)-HEPE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 15(R)-HEPE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 15(R)-HEPE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11(R)-HEPE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 11(R)-HEPE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 15-HPETE(1−)
definition: A HPETE anion that is the conjugate base of 15-HPETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-HPETE(1−)
definition: A HPETE anion that is the conjugate base of 5-HPETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13-HPODE(1−)
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 13-HPODE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z,10Z,13R,14E,16Z,19Z)-13-hydroxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (13R)-hydroxy-(7Z,10Z,14E,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group; major species at pH 7.3. It is an intermediate in 13-series resolvins biosynthesis from DPA (ω-3).

name: 18-HEPE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 18-HEPE, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5S)-hydroperoxy-18-hydroxy-EPE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (5S)-hydroperoxy-18-hydroxy-EPE, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: prostaglandin F2β(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of prostaglandin F2β, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: CHZ868
definition: A memger of the class of benzimidazoles that is benzimidazole that is substituted by methyl groups at positions 1 and 4, by a 2,4-difluoroanilino group at position 2, and by a (2-acetamidopyridin-4-yl)oxy group at position 5. It is a type II JAK2 inhibitor with antineoplastic activity.

name: VSWKTWFPNLAV
definition: A twelve-membered polypeptide comprising the sequence Val-Ser-Trp-Lys-Thr-Trp-Phe-Pro-Asn-Leu-Ala-Val.

name: YSPFHKWFPSMH
definition: A twelve-membered polypeptide comprising the sequence Tyr-Ser-Pro-Phe-His-Lys-Trp-Phe-Pro-Ser-Met-His.

name: NMNH(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of NMNH; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-hydroperoxy-15-HETE
definition: An icosanoid that is (6E,8Z,11Z,13E)-icosa-6,8,11,13-tetraenoic acid substituted at positions 5 and 15 by hydroperoxy and hydroxy groups respectively.

name: IPQVWRDWFKLP
definition: A twelve-membered polypeptide comprising the sequence Ile-Pro-Gln-Val-Trp-Arg-Asp-Trp-Phe-Lys-Leu-Pro.

name: cangrelor tetrasodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the tetrasodium salt of cangrelor. Used as an intravenous antiplatelet drug that prevents formation of harmful blood clots in the coronary arteries.

name: 3-O-(N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl)-L-serine
definition: An O-glycosyl-L-serine having N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl as the glycosyl component.

name: 3-O-(N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl)-L-threonine
definition: An O-glycosyl-L-threonine having N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl as the glycosyl component.

name: cangrelor
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate analogue that is 5'-O-[({[dichloro(phosphono)methyl](hydroxy)phosphoryl}oxy)(hydroxy)phosphoryl]adenosine carrying additional 2-(methylsulfanyl)ethyl and (3,3,3-trifluoropropyl)sulfanyl substituents at positions N6 and C2 respectively. Used (in the form of its tetrasodium salt) as an intravenous antiplatelet drug that prevents formation of harmful blood clots in the coronary arteries.

name: SR9243
definition: A sulfonamide resulting from the formal condensation of the sulfonic acid group of mesitylene-2-sulphonic acid with the amino group of 2-(m-bromophenyl)ethylamine in which the nitrogen is substituted by a 4-[m-(methylsulfonyl)phenyl]benzyl group.

name: cangrelor(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and phosphonate OH groups of cangrelor.

name: selexipag
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is N-(methanesulfonyl)-2-{4-[(propan-2-yl)(pyrazin-2-yl)amino]butoxy}acetamide carrying two additional phenyl substituents at positions 5 and 6 on the pyrazine ring. An orphan drug used for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension. It is a prodrug for ACT-333679 (the free carboxylic acid).

name: ACT-333679
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is {4-[(propan-2-yl)(pyrazin-2-yl)amino]butoxy}acetic acid carrying two additional phenyl substituents at positions 5 and 6 on the pyrazine ring. The active metabolite of selexipag, an orphan drug used for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension.

name: geranylgeranyl bacteriochlorophyllide a(1−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is that carbide ion obtained from geranylgeranyl bacteriochlorophyllide a via removal of the acidic proton at position 21. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 13(S)-HODE(1−)
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 13(S)-HODE, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cobimetinib
definition: A member of the class of N-acylazetidines obtained by selective formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,4-difluoro-2-(2-fluoro-4-iodoanilino)benzoic acid with the secondary amino group from the azetidine ring of 3-[(2S)-piperidin-2-yl]azetidin-3-ol. An inhibitor of mitogen-activated protein kinase that is used (as its fumarate salt) in combination with vemurafenib for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma.

name: cobimetinib fumarate
definition: A fumarate salt prepared from cobimetinib by reaction of one molecule of fumaric acid for every two molecules of cobimetinib. An inhibitor of mitogen-activated protein kinase that is used in combination with vemurafenib for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma.

name: cobimetinib(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group of cobimetinib.

name: bacteriochlorophyllide g(2−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is obtained from bacteriochlorophyllide g via deprotonation of the carboxy group and formation of a carbide ion. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: calcipotriol hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of calcipotriol. It is used in combination with betamethasone dipropionate, a corticosteroid, for the topical treatment of plaque psoriasis in adult patients.

name: sonidegib
definition: A member of the classo of biphenyls that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-methyl-4'-(trifluoromethoxy)[1,1'-biphenyl]-3-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 6-(2,6-dimethylmorpholin-4-yl)pyridin-3-amine. Used (as its phosphate salt) for treatment of locally advanced basal cell carcinoma.

name: sonidegib phosphate
definition: A phosphate salt obtained by reaction sonidegib with two equivalent of phosphoric acid. Used for treatment of locally advanced basal cell carcinoma.

name: flibanserin
definition: An N-alkylpiperazine that is 1-[2-(1,3-dihydro-2-oxobenzimidazol-1-yl)ethyl]piperazine in which the remaining amino proton is replaced by a 3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl group. A multifunctional serotonin agonist and antagonist which is used for the treatment of pre-menopausal women with hypoactive sexual desire disorder.

name: 14-HDoHE(1−)
definition: A polyunsaturated hydroxy-fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 14-HDoHE, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 14-oxo-DoHE(1−)
definition: A polyunsaturated hydroxy-fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 14-oxo-DoHE, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: validamycin B
definition: A member of the class of validamycins that is validamycin A in which the pro-R hydrogen at the unsubstituted position of the cycloxexane ring has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: validamycin A(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of validamycin A. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: tipiracil hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining tipiracil with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. Used in combination with trifluridine, a nucleoside metabolic inhibitor, for treatment of advanced/relapsed unresectable colorectal cancer.

name: tipiracil
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidones that is uracil substituted by chloro and (2-iminopyrrolidin-1-yl)methyl groups at positions 5 and 6 respectively. Used (as the hydrochloride salt) in combination with trifluridine, a nucleoside metabolic inhibitor, for treatment of advanced/relapsed unresectable colorectal cancer.

name: tipiracil(1+)
definition: A carboxamidinium ion obtained by protonation of the amidine function of tipiracil.

name: irinotecan hydrochloride hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the trihydrate form of irinotecan hydrochloride. Onivyde is used in combination with fluorouracil and leucovorin, for the treatment of patients with metastatic adenocarcinoma of the pancreas after disease progression following gemcitabine-based therapy. It is converted via hydrolysis of the carbamate linkage to its active metabolite, SN-38, which is ~1000 times more active.

name: 3,4-dichlorocatechol
definition: A dichlorocatechol that is catechol in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 4 are replaced by chlorines.

name: 2,3-dichloromuconate(2−)
definition: A dichloromuconate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 2,3-dichloromuconic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2'-hydroxyrifampicin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 2'-hydroxyrifampicin resulting from the deprotonation of the 6-hydroxy group; Major species at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 1,3,7-trimethyl-5-hydroxyisouric acid
definition: A member of the class of oxopurines that is 5-hydroxyisouric acid carrying three additional methyl substituents at positions 1, 3 and 7.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-2,4-heptadienoic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is 2,4-heptadienoic acid substituted by hydroxy and oxo groups at positions 2 and 6 respectively.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-2,4-heptadienoate
definition: A 6-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-2,4-heptadienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: aurachin C
definition: A C-type aurachin that is quinolin-4-one which is substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 1, a methyl group at position 2, and a triprenyl group at position 3.

name: aurachin C epoxide
definition: An epoxide resulting from the oxidation of the double bond at the 2-3 position of aurachin C.

name: 3-farnesyl-3-hydroxy-2-methyl-1-oxo-1λ5-quinolin-4-one
definition: A member of the class of quinoline N-oxides that is 3-hydroxy-2-methyl-1-oxo-1λ5-quinolin-4-one carrying an additional (2E,6E)-farnesyl group at position 3.

name: 2-imino-3-(indol-3-yl)propanoic acid
definition: A dehydroamino acid that is tryptophan in which the amino group has been oxidised to the corresponding imine.

name: 2-imino-3-(indol-3-yl)propanoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-imino-3-(indol-3-yl)propanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (−)-bursehernin
definition: A butan-4-olide that is (−)-pluviatolide in which the phenolic hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding methyl ether.

name: (−)-5'-desmethylyatein
definition: A butan-4-olide that is (−)-bursehernin bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 5 (adjacent to the two methoxy groups).

name: irinotecan(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group of irinotecan.

name: (−)-pluviatolide
definition: A butan-4-olide that is dihydrofuran-2(3H)-one which is substituted by a vanillyl group at position 3 and by a 3,4-methylenedioxybenzyl group at position 4 (the R,R stereoisomer).

name: protoviolaceinic acid
definition: A pyrrolecarboxylic acid that is pyrrole-2-carboxylic acid which is substituted at position 3 by a 1H-indol-3-yl group at at position 5 by a 5-hydroxy-1H-indol-3-yl group.

name: protoviolaceinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of protoviolaceinic acid, resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxy group. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: violaceinic acid
definition: A pyrrolecarboxylic acid that is pyrrole-2-carboxylic acid which is substituted at position 3 by a 3-hydroxyindol-3-yl group at at position 5 by a 5-hydroxyindol-3-yl group.

name: violaceinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of violaceinic acid, resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxy group. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: protoasukamycin
definition: A polyketide that is (all-E)-7-(3-amino-4-hydroxyphenyl)hepta-2,4,6-trienoic acid in which the amino group has been acylated by an (all-E)-7-cyclohexylhepta-2,4,6-trienoyl group and in which the carboxy group has undergone formal condensation with the amino group of 2-amino-3-hydroxycyclopent-2-en-1-one to give the corresponding carboxamide. Protoasukamycin is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of asukamycin.

name: 4-hydroxyprotoasukamycin
definition: A tertiary alcohol that is protoasukamycin in which the 2,4-disubstituted phenol moiety has been oxidised to give the corresponding 2,4-disubstituted 4-hydroxycyclohexa-2,5-dienone. It is a precursor in the biosynthesis of asukamycin.

name: asperlicin E
definition: A member of the class of asperlicins that is asperlicin C in which the lactam nitrogen of the benzodiazepineone moiety has undergone addition to the 2-position of the 2-3 double bond of the indole moeity, and in which the hydrogen at the 3-position of the indole moiety has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a cholecystokinin antagonist.

name: asperlicin C
definition: A member of the class of asperlicins in which the core 6,7-dihydroquinazolino[3,2-a][1,4]benzodiazepine-5,13-dione skeleton is substituted at the 7 pro-S position by an indol-3-ylmethyl group. It is a cholecystokinin antagonist.

name: DEL-22379
definition: An oxindole that is 5-amino-oxindole in which the 5-amino group has undergone formal condensation with the carboxy group of 3-(piperidin-1-yl)propanoic acid to give the corresponding carboxamide and in which the hydrogens at position 3 have been replaced by a (5-methoxy-1H-indol-3-yl)methylene group (Z configuration). It is an inhibitor of extracellular signal-regulated kinase (ERK) dimerisation.

name: protodeoxyviolaceinic acid
definition: A pyrrolecarboxylic acid that is pyrrole-2-carboxylic acid which is substituted at position 3 and 5 by indol-3-yl groups.

name: protodeoxyviolaceinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of protodeoxyviolaceinic acid, resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxy group. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: rolapitant
definition: An azaspiro compound that is 1,7-diazaspiro[4.5]decan-2-one carrying additional phenyl and 1-{[3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]ethoxy}methyl substituents at position 8. Used (in the form of the hydrochloride hydrate) for the prevention of delayed nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of emetogenic cancer chemotherapy.

name: deoxyviolaceinic acid
definition: A pyrrolecarboxylic acid that is pyrrole-2-carboxylic acid which is substituted at position 3 by a 3-hydroxyindol-3-yl group at at position 5 by an indol-3-yl group.

name: deoxyviolaceinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of deoxyviolaceinic acid, resulting from the removal of the proton from the carboxy group. Major structure at pH 7.3.

name: rolapitant hydrochloride hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of rolapitant hydrochloride. Used for the prevention of delayed nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of emetogenic cancer chemotherapy.

name: rolapitant hydrochloride (anhydrous)
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining irinotecan with one molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid. Used (in the form of the hydrate) for the prevention of delayed nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of emetogenic cancer chemotherapy.

name: rolapitant(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group of rolapitant.

name: uridine triacetate
definition: An acetate ester that is uracil in which the three hydroxy hydrogens are replaced by acetate group. A prodrug for uridine, it is used for the treatment of hereditary orotic aciduria and for management of fluorouracil toxicity.

name: FPAWFTKLYPRT
definition: A twelve-membered polypeptide comprising the sequence Phe-Pro-Ala-Trp-Phe-Thr-Lys-Leu-Tyr-Pro-Arg-Thr.

name: tenofovir alafenamide fumarate
definition: A fumarate salt prepared from tenofovir alafenamide by reaction of one molecule of fumaric acid for every two molecules of tenofovir alafenamide. A prodrug for tenofovir, it is used in combination therapy for the treatment of HIV-1 infection.

name: aurachin A
definition: An A-type aurichin that is 1,2-dihydrofuro[2,3-c]quinoline 5-oxide which is substituted at position 2 by a (6E)-10-hydroxy-2,6-dimethylundeca-2,6-dien-10-yl group and at position 4 by a methyl group (relative configuration shown). Found in the myxobacterium Stigmatella aurantiaca strain Sg a15.

name: QINTAKWWKTHF
definition: A twelve-membered polypeptide comprising the sequence Gln-Ile-Asn-Thr-Ala-Lys-Trp-Trp-Lys-Thr-His-Phe.

name: tenofovir alafenamide
definition: An L-alanine derivative that is isopropyl L-alaninate in which one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by an (S)-({[(2R)-1-(6-amino-9H-purin-9-yl)propan-2-yl]oxy}methyl)(phenoxy)phosphoryl group. A prodrug for tenofovir, it is used (as the fumarate salt) in combination therapy for the treatment of HIV-1 infection.

name: tenofovir alafenamide(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the exocyclic amino group of tenofovir alafenamide.

name: lesinurad
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is [(3-bromo-1,2,4-triazol-5-yl)sulfanyl]acetic acid substituted at position 1 of the triazole ring by a 4-cyclopropylnaphthalen-1-yl group. Used for treatment of gout.

name: aripiprazole lauroxil
definition: A dodecanoate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of dodecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 7-{4-[4-(2,3-dichlorophenyl)piperazin-1-yl]butoxy}-2-oxo-3,4-dihydroquinolin-1(2H)-yl]methanol. A prodrug for aripiprazole, it is used for treatment of schizophrenia.

name: NCS172285
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is androst-5-en-3β-ol in which the 17β-hydrogen has been replaced by a 1,3-dihydroxy-3,3-bis(trifluoromethyl)propyl group. NCS172285 (also known as acts as NSC12) has been used as an extracellular fibroblast growth factor (FGF) trap with implications in cancer therapy. The stereochemistry shown is that of the most active stereoisomer, as determined by Mattia Anselmi (PhD thesis, University of Parma, 2015).

name: cariprazine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining cariprazine with one molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid. Used for treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.

name: cariprazine
definition: An N-alkylpiperazine that is N,N-dimethyl-N'-{trans-4-[2-(piperazin-1-yl)ethyl]cyclohexyl}urea substituted at position 4 on the piperazine ring by a 2,3-dichlorophenyl group. Used (as the hydrochloride salt) for treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.

name: cariprazine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of cariprazine.

name: alectinib
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 6,6-dimethyl-5,6-dihydro-11H-benzo[b]carbazol-11-one carrying additional cyano, 4-(morpholin-4-yl)piperidin-1-yl and ethyl substituents at positions 3, 8 and 9 respectively. Used (as the hydrochloride salt) for the treatment of patients with anaplastic lymphoma kinase-positive, metastatic non-small cell lung cancer.

name: alectinib(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of alectinib.

name: DASKALRSSGMP
definition: A twelve-membered polypeptide comprising the sequence Asp-Ala-Ser-Lys-Ala-Lys-Arg-Ser-Ser-Gly-Met-Pro.

name: ixazomib citrate
definition: A glycine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-(2,5-dichlorobenzoyl)glycine with the amino group of 2,2'-{2-[(1R)-1-amino-3-methylbutyl]-5-oxo-1,3,2-dioxaborolane-4,4-diyl}diacetic acid. A prodrug for ixazomib that is used in combination therapy for treatment of multiple myeloma.

name: N-acetyl-L-phosphinothricin(2−)
definition: An N-acetylphosphinatothricinate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of carboxylic acid and phosphinate functions of N-acetyl-L-phosphinothricin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: sibiromycin
definition: An aminoglycoside antibiotic produced by Streptosporangium sibiricum that also exhibits antitumour properties.

name: ixazomib
definition: A glycine derivative that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-(2,5-dichlorobenzoyl)glycine with the amino group of [(1R)-1-amino-3-methylbutyl]boronic acid. The active metabolite of ixazomib citrate, it is used in combination therapy for treatment of multiple myeloma.

name: osimertinib
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is 4-(1-methylindol-3-yl)pyrimidin-2-amine in which one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by a 2-methoxy-4-[2-(dimethylamino)ethyl](methyl)amino-5-acrylamidophenyl group. Used (as the mesylate salt) for treatment of EGFR T790M mutation positive non-small cell lung cancer.

name: dTDP-4-dehydro-2,3,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-4-dehydro-2,3,6-trideoxy-α-D-glucose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-4-ammonio-2,3,4,6-tetradeoxy-α-D-glucose(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of dTDP-4-amino-2,3,4,6-tetradeoxy-α-D-glucose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-4-(methylammonio)-2,3,4,6-tetradeoxy-α-D-glucose(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of dTDP-4-(methylamino)-2,3,4,6-tetradeoxy-α-D-glucose; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dTDP-α-D-forosamine(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups and protonation of the amino group of dTDP-α-D-forosamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: osimertinib mesylate
definition: A methanesulfonate (mesylate) salt prepared from equimolar amounts of osimertinib and methanesulfonic acid. It is used for treatment of EGFR T790M mutation positive non-small cell lung cancer.

name: osimertinib(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of osimertinib.

name: lumacaftor
definition: An aromatic amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 1-(2,2-difluoro-1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl)cyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid with the aromatic amino group of 3-(6-amino-3-methylpyridin-2-yl)benzoic acid. Used for the treatment of cystic fibrosis.

name: sugammadex sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the octasodium salt of sugammadex. Used for reversal of neuromuscular blockade induced by rocuronium and vecuronium in adults undergoing surgery.

name: sugammadex
definition: An octasaccharide derivative that is γ-cyclodextrin in which all eight primary hydroxy groups are replaced by 2-(carboxyethyl)sulfanyl groups. Used (as the octasodium salt) for reversal of neuromuscular blockade induced by rocuronium and vecuronium in adults undergoing surgery.

name: MCB-613
definition: A cyclic ketone that is 4-ethylcyclohexanone which is substituted by pyridin-3-ylmethylene groups at positions 2 and 6. It is a potent small molecule stimulator of steroid receptor coactivators (SRCs). MCB-613 increases SRCs' interactions with other coactivators and markedly induces ER stress coupled to the generation of reactive oxygen species. Since cancer cells overexpress SRCs and rely on them for growth, MCB-613 can be used to selectively induce excessive stress in cancer cells.

name: 2-exo-hydroxy-1,4-cineole
definition: A cineole in which the 1,4-cineole skeleton is substituted at C-2 with a hydroxy group oriented exo (S configuration).

name: sugammadex(8−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion obtained by global deprotonation of the carboxy groups of sugammadex.

name: tiotropium bromide
definition: An organic bromide salt having (1α,2β,4β,5α,7β)-7-[(hydroxydi-2-thienylacetyl)oxy]-9,9-dimethyl-3-oxa-9-azoniatricyclo[3.3.1.02,4]nonane as the counterion. Used (in the form of the hydrate) for maintenance treatment of airflow obstruction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: tiotropium
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion obtained by methylation of the tertiary amino group of (1α,2β,4β,5α,7β)-7-[(hydroxydi-2-thienylacetyl)oxy]-9-methyl-3-oxa-9-azoniatricyclo[3.3.1.02,4]nonane. Used (in the form of the bromide hydrate) for maintenance treatment of airflow obstruction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: 3-vinylbacteriochlorophyllide d(1−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is the conjugate base of 3-vinylbacteriochlorophyllide d, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8,12-diethyl-3-vinylbacteriochlorophyllide d(1−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is the conjugate base of 8,12-diethyl-3-vinylbacteriochlorophyllide d, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12-ethyl-8-propyl-3-vinylbacteriochlorophyllide d(1−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is the conjugate base of 12-ethyl-8-propyl-3-vinylbacteriochlorophyllide d, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12-ethyl-8-isobutyl-3-vinylbacteriochlorophyllide d(1−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is the conjugate base of 12-ethyl-8-isobutyl-3-vinylbacteriochlorophyllide d, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1α,23(S),25-trihydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that consists of vitamin D3 (calciol) bearing additional hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 23 and 25 (with 1α,23S-configuration). An intermediate in the degradation pathway of 1α,25-(OH)2D3.

name: lipid A-F
definition: A lipid A derivative, prepared from Campylobacter jejuni HS:19, in which each of its two glucosaminyl units is substituted on nitrogen by a 3-(2-hydroxytetracosanoyloxy)octadecanoyl unit.

name: glycopyrronium bromide
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt composed of 3-{[cyclopentyl(hydroxy)phenylacetyl]oxy}-1,1-dimethylpyrrolidin-1-ium and bromide ions in a 1:1 ratio.

name: (2S,3R)-glycopyrronium bromide
definition: A glycopyrronium bromide that has (2S,3R)-configuration. The racemate, ritropirronium bromide, is used for treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: (2R,3S)-glycopyrronium bromide
definition: A glycopyrronium bromide that has (2R,3S)-configuration. The racemate, ritropirronium bromide, is used for treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: 20-hydroxylipoxin A4
definition: A member of the class of lipoxins that is lipoxin A4 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 20.

name: LOSGM1
definition: A lipooligosaccharide, prepared from Campylobacter jejuni (strain HS:19). It binds with cholera toxin B.

name: 20-hydroxylipoxin B4
definition: A member of the class of lipoxins that is lipoxin B4 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 20.

name: 5,20-DiHETE
definition: A DiHETE that is 5-HETE carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 20.

name: 23(S),25-dihydroxy-24-oxovitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is 25-hydroxyvitamin D3 carrying an additional hydroxy group at position 23 (with 23S-configuration) and an oxo group at position 24. An intermediate in the degradation pathway of 25-OH-vitamin D3.

name: 8,20-DiHETE
definition: A DiHETE that is 8-HETE carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 20.

name: (20S)-hydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that consists of vitamin D3 (calciol) carrying an additional hydroxy group at position 20 with S-configuration.

name: 20(S),25-dihydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that consists of vitamin D3 (calciol) carrying additional hydroxy groups at positions 20 (with S-configuration) and 25.

name: (20S,24R)-dihydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that consists of vitamin D3 (calciol) carrying additional hydroxy groups at positions 20 (with S-configuration) and 24 (with R-configuration).

name: (20S,24S)-dihydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that consists of vitamin D3 (calciol) carrying additional hydroxy groups at positions 20 and 24 (both with S-configuration).

name: 3-deoxy-D-glycero-β-D-galacto-nonulosonate 9-phosphate(3−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and carboxy groups of 3-deoxy-D-glycero-β-D-galacto-nonulosonic acid 9-phosphate

name: 3-deoxy-D-glycero-β-D-galacto-nonulosonate
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3-deoxy-D-glycero-β-D-galacto-nonulosonic acid

name: CMP-3-deoxy-D-glycero-β-D-galacto-nonulosonate(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and phosphate functions of CMP-3-deoxy-D-glycero-β-D-galacto-nonulosonic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12,20-DiHETE
definition: A DiHETE that is 12-HETE carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 20.

name: 20-hydroxy-6-trans-leukotriene B4
definition: A member of the class of leukotrienes that is 6-trans-leukotriene B4 bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at position 20.

name: MgADP(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is MgADP which has lost the proton attached to the diphosphate moiety.

name: 3,3'-diaminobenzidine
definition: A member of the class of biphenyls that is benzidine in which one of the hydrogens ortho to each of the amino groups has been replaced by an amino group.

name: 12(S)-HETrE
definition: A HETrE that is (8Z,10E,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the hydroxy group is located at the 12(S)-posiiton.

name: 12(S)-HpEPE
definition: A 12-HPEPE in which the hydroperoxy group at positions 12 has S-configuration.

name: alvocidib(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of alvocidib.

name: alvocidib hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of alvocidib and hydrogen chloride. A cyclin-dependent kinase 9 (CDK9) inhibitor, it has been studied for the treatment of acute myeloid leukaemia, arthritis and atherosclerotic plaque formation.

name: sodium 3α,7α-dihydroxy-5β-cholane-24-sulfonate
definition: An organic sodium salt having 3α,7α-dihydroxy-5β-cholane-24-sulfonate as the counterion.

name: resolvin E1(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of resolvin E1; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 18-oxoresolvin E1(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of 18-oxoresolvin E1; major species at pH 7.3.

name: sucrose 6G-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of sucrose 6G-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-galactopyranose 6-phosphate(2−)
definition: A D-glucopyranose 6-phosphate(2−) resulting from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-galactopyranose 6-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-[(E)-caffeoyl]shikimate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-[(E)-caffeoyl]shikimic acid. Major structure at pH 7.3

name: 2α-(3-hydroxypropyl)-1α,25-dihydroxy-19-norvitamin D3
definition: A vitamin D that is 19-norcalcitriol carrying an additional 3-hydroxypropyl substituent at position 2. A synthetic analogue of vitamin D, it exhibits anticancer properties.

name: 9,10-dimethoxypterocarpan-3-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A member of the class of pterocarpans that is 3-hydroxy-9,10-dimethoxypterocarpan in which the phenol hydrogen is replaced by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: (2Z,4Z)-2,3-dichloromuconic acid
definition: A 2,3-dichloromuconic acid in which both double bonds have Z geochemistry.

name: (2Z,4Z)-2,3-dichloromuconate(2−)
definition: A 2,3-dichloromuconate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of (2Z,4Z)-2,3-dichloromuconic acid. Major species at pH 7.3

name: N-[3-(4-{[1-(5-chloro-2,4-dimethoxyanilino)-1-oxopropan-2-yl]sulfanyl}anilino)-3-oxo-1-phenylprop-1-en-2-yl]benzamide
definition: A member of the class of enamides obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-benzamido-3-phenylprop-2-enoic acid with the aromatic amino group of 2-[(4-aminophenyl)sulfanyl]propanoic acid, the carboxy group of which has also undergone formal condensation with the amino group of 5-chloro-2,4-dimethoxyaniline.

name: D-ribose 5-triphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of all four phosphate OH groups from D-ribose 5-triphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: mersacidin zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of mersacidin. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: propanesulfenic acid
definition: An S-alkylsulfenic acid that is sulfenic acid in which the thiol hydrogen is replaced by a propyl group.

name: 2-aminothiophenol
definition: An aryl thiol that is thiophenol substituted at position 2 by an amino group.

name: actinorhodin(3−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups as well as the 10'-hydroxy group of actinorhodin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: S-propyl propanethiosulfinate
definition: A sulfinic acid derivative obtained by formal condensation of propanethiosulfinic acid with propanethiol.

name: 3-bromo-β-lapachone
definition: A benzochromenone that is β-lapachone in which one of the hydrogens attached to the carbon adjacent to that bearing the gem-dimethyls is replaced by a bromine.

name: astragaloside I
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is cycloastragenol glycosylated at positions 3 and 6 by 2,3-di-O-acetyl-β-D-xylosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues respectively.

name: astragaloside II
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is cycloastragenol glycosylated at positions 3 and 6 by 2-O-acetyl-β-D-xylosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues respectively.

name: biliverdin hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining biliverdin with one molar equivalent of hydrogen chloride.

name: sodium dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate.

name: ethyl 4-chloro-2-(methylsulfanyl)hexahydropyrimidine-5-carboxylate
definition: A pyrimidinecarboxylate ester that is the ethyl ester of 4-chloro-2-(methylsulfanyl)hexahydropyrimidine-5-carboxylic acid.

name: epithienamycin E
definition: A member of the class of carbapenems that is (5R,6R)-3-{[(E)-2-aminoethenyl]sulfanyl}-6-[(1S)-1-hydroxyethyl]-7-oxo-1-azabicyclo[3.2.0]hept-2-ene-2-carboxylic acid in which the free hydroxy and amino groups are carrying sulfo and acetyl substituents respectively.

name: fertaric acid
definition: A cinnamate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of ferulic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of tartaric acid.

name: 1-O-(D-glucosyl)glycerol
definition: A glucosylglycerol consisting of a D-glucosyl residue attached at position 1 of glycerol via a glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1↔1)-N-tetradecanoylsphingosine
definition: A β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1↔1')-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group specified is tetradecanoyl.

name: propyl linoleate
definition: A fatty acid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of linoleic acid with the hydroxy group of propanol.

name: L-o-tyrosine
definition: A 2-hydroxyphenylalanine that has L-configuration.

name: 2-hydroxyphenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 2 on the benzene ring.

name: D-o-tyrosine
definition: A 2-hydroxyphenylalanine that has D-configuration.

name: 2-naphthyl dihydrogen phosphate
definition: An aryl phosphate resulting from the formal condensation of phosphoric acid with 1 mol eq. of 2-naphthol. It is a substrate for phosphatase.

name: phenyl hydrogen phosphonate
definition: An aryl phosphate resulting from the formal condensation of phosphonic acid with 1 mol eq. of phenol

name: p-nitrophenyl phenyl phosphonate
definition: An aryl phosphate resulting from the formal condensation of phosphonic acid with 1 mol eq. each of phenol and 4-nitrophenol.

name: ethyl N-benzoyl-L-tyrosinate
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is the ethyl ester of N-benzoyltyrosine.

name: N-{1-[(naphthalen-2-yl)amino]-1-oxo-3-phenylpropan-2-yl}benzamide
definition: A member of the class of N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamides that is N-(naphthalen-2-yl)-3-phenylpropanamide in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 has been replaced by a benzamido group.

name: N-benzoyl-L-phenylalanine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-{1-[(naphthalen-2-yl)amino]-1-oxo-3-phenylpropan-2-yl}benzamide that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-benzoyl-L-phenylalanine with the amino group of 2-aminonaphthalene.

name: N-benzoyl-D-phenylalanine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-{1-[(naphthalen-2-yl)amino]-1-oxo-3-phenylpropan-2-yl}benzamide that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-benzoyl-D-phenylalanine with the amino group of 2-aminonaphthalene.

name: N-{5-carbamimidamido-1-[(naphthalen-2-yl)amino]-1-oxopentan-2-yl}benzamide
definition: A member of the class of N-(2-naphthyl)carboxamides that is 5-carbamimidamido-N-(naphthalen-2-yl)pentanamide in which one of the hydrogens at position 2 has been replaced by a benzamido group.

name: N-benzoyl-D-arginine 2-naphthylamide
definition: An N-{1-[(naphthalen-2-yl)amino]-1-oxo-3-phenylpropan-2-yl}benzamide that is the amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-benzoyl-D-arginine with the amino group of 2-naphthylamine.

name: PD-153035 hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining PD-153035 with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: PD-153035
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines carrying a 3-bromophenylamino substituent at position 4 and two methoxy substituents at positions 6 and 7.

name: PD-153035(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino function of PD-153035.

name: 5-aminofluorescein
definition: A primary amino compound that is fluorescein carrying an amino substituent at C-5. Building block/intermediate for the synthesis of the fluorescent dye flourescein; also used to produce N-(fluorescein-5-yl)maleamic acid.

name: tetrasodium 5'-phosphonatopyridoxal-6-azobenzene-2,4-disulfonate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the tetrasodium salt of 5'-phosphopyridoxal-6-azobenzene-2,4-disulfonic acid

name: 5'-phosphonatopyridoxal-6-azobenzene-2,4-disulfonate
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phospho and sulfo groups of 5'-phosphopyridoxal-6-azobenzene-2,4-disulfonic acid.

name: semaxanib
definition: An oxindole that is 3-methyleneoxindole in which one of the hydrogens of the methylene group is replaced by a 3,5-dimethylpyrrol-2-yl group.

name: β-aminopropionitrile hemifumarate
definition: A fumarate salt prepared from β-aminopropionitrile by reaction of one molecule of fumaric acid for every two molecules of β-aminopropionitrile.

name: β-ammoniopropionitrile
definition: A primary ammonium ion obtained by protonation of the amino function of β-aminopropionitrile.

name: Solvent yellow 56
definition: An azobenzene that is N,N-diethylaniline substituted at position 4 by a phenylazo group.

name: orantinib
definition: An oxindole that is 3-methyleneoxindole in which one of the hydrogens of the methylene group is substituted by a 2-(2-carboxyethyl)-3,5-dimethylpyrrol-3-yl group. It is an ATP-competitive inhibitor of the tyrosine kinase activity of fibroblast growth factor receptor 1.

name: CMP-8-amino-3,8-dideoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonate(1−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion that is the conjugate base of CMP-8-amino-3,8-dideoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulosonic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: CHIR 99021
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is 2-aminopyrimidine substituted at positions N2, 5 and 6 by (5-cyanopyridin-2-yl)ethyl, 4-methylimidazol-2-yl and 2,4-dichlorophenyl groups respectively.

name: SB 415286
definition: A member of the class of maleimides carrying 3-chloro-4-hydroxyphenylamino and 2-nitrophenyl substituents at positions 3 and 4 respectively.

name: SB 431542
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is 4-(imidazol-2-yl)benzamide carrying additional 1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl and pyridin-2-yl substituents at positions 4 and 5 respectively on the imidazole ring.

name: 3-methyl-4-oxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline-2-carbaldehyde
definition: An amino aldehyde that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 4 by formyl, methyl, and oxo groups, respectively.
