It has been found in Japanese Paeoniae Radix, which has been used in various Chinese medicinal preparations as an anodyne, sedative, antispasmodic, and astringent.

name: 8-oxoresolvin D1
definition: A resolvin that is docosa-4Z,9E,11E,13Z,15E,19Z-hexaenoic acid which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 7 and 17 positions as well as an oxo group at the 8-position (the 7S,17S-stereoisomer).

name: 2-methylquinoxaline-6-carboxylic acid
definition: A quinoxaline derivative in which the quinoxaline (1,4-naphthyridine) skeleton is substituted with a carboxy function at C-6 and a methyl group at C-2.

name: 5-methylquinoxaline
definition: A quinoxaline derivative in which the quinoxaline (1,4-naphthyridine) skeleton is substituted at C-5 with a methyl group.

name: 17-oxoresolvin D1
definition: A resolvin that is docosa-4Z,9E,11E,13Z,15E,19Z-hexaenoic acid which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 7 and 8 positions as well as an oxo group at the 17-position (the 7S,8R-stereoisomer).

name: 18(S)-HEPE
definition: An 18-HEPE that consists of (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic in which the 18-hydroxy group has S-configuration.

name: (5S)-hydroperoxy-(18S)-hydroxy-(6E,8Z,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid that is (6E,8Z,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic acid substituted at positions 5 and 18 by hydroperoxy and hydroxy groups respectively (the 5S, 18S-stereoisomer).

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine 4,6-bissulfate
definition: A UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 4,6-bissulfate in which the anomeric centre of the galactosamine fragment has α-configuration.

name: UDP-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine 4-sulfate
definition: A UDP-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine 4-sulfate in which the anomeric centre of the galactosamine fragment has α-configuration.

name: β-D-4-deoxy-Δ4-GlcpA-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having a 4-deoxy-α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl residue attached at the 3-position.

name: (8S)-hydroperoxy-(14S,15R)-epoxy-(5Z,9E,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is (14S,15R)-epoxy-(5Z,9E,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the hydroperoxy group is located at position 8S.

name: (8S)-hepoxilin A3
definition: A hepoxilin A3 in which the stereocentre at position 8 has S-configuration

name: 2,3-dimethylquinoxaline
definition: A quinoxaline derivative in which the quinoxaline (1,4-naphthyridine) skeleton is substituted with a methyl group at each of positions C-2 and C-3.

name: NAV2729
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is 4H-pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidin-7-one which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 5 by benzyl, p-chlorophenyl, and p-nitrophenyl groups, respectively. It is an inhibitor of ADP-ribosylation factor 6 (ARF6), a member of the ADP ribosylation factor family of GTP-binding proteins.

name: 2-methylquinoxaline
definition: A quinoxaline derivative in which the quinoxaline (1,4-naphthyridine) skeleton is substituted at C-2 with a methyl group.

name: quinaldine
definition: A quinoline compound in which the quinoline skeleton is substituted at C-2 with a methyl group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues in a linear (1→3), (1→4), (1→4) sequence.

name: 6'-O-acetylpaeoniflorin
definition: A semisynthetic monoterpene glycoside obtained by acetylation of the 6'-position of the natural product paeoniflorin.

name: 6'-O-galloylalbiflorin
definition: A monoterpene glycoside that is albiflorin carrying a galloyl substituent at position 6. Isolated from the roots of Paeonia lactiflora.

name: paeoniflorin sulfonate
definition: A monoterpene glycoside with formula C23H28O14S, originally isolated from the roots of Paeonia lactiflora.

name: apigenin 7-O-β-L-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is apigenin substituted by a β-L-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: trachelosperogenin B
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is urs-12-ene carrying a carboxy substituent at position 28 as well as five hydroxy substituents at positions 2, 3, 19, 23 and 24 (the 2α,3β stereoisomer).

name: matairesinoside
definition: A lignan that is (−)-matairesinol in which one of the phenolic hydroxy groups has been replaced by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: epipinoresinol
definition: An enantiomer of pinoresinol having (+)-(1R,3aR,4S,6aR)-configuration.

name: salicifoliol
definition: A lignan that is tetrahydro-1H,3H-furo[3,4-c]furan-1-one carrying a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl substituent at position 4.

name: clionasterol
definition: A member of the class of phytosterols that is poriferast-5-ene carrying a β-hydroxy substituent at position 3.

name: spathulenol
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpenoid that is 4-methylidenedecahydro-1H-cyclopropa[e]azulene carrying three methyl substituents at positions 1, 1 and 7 as well as a hydroxy substituent at position 7.

name: aristoloterpenate-I
definition: A sesquiterpenoid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of aristolochic acid with the hydroxy group of (1R,2Z,6E,10E)-3-formyl-7,11-dimethylcyclododeca-2,6,10-trien-1-ol.

name: versicolactone B
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone with formula C15H22O3 that is isolated from Viola yedoensis and Aristolochia versicolor.

name: camphenilone
definition: A cyclic terpene ketone that is norcamphor carrying two methyl substituents at position 3.

name: isobornyl formate
definition: A bornane monoterpenoid that is isoborneol in which the hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a formyl group.

name: δ-terpineol acetate
definition: A p-menthane monoterpenoid that is δ-terpineol in which the hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by an acetyl group.

name: δ-elemene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is cyclohexene that is substituted at positions 1, 3, 4, and 4 by isopropyl, isopropenyl, methyl, and vinyl groups, respectively (the R,R stereoisomer).

name: β-maaliene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is 1a,2,3,3a,4,5,6,7b-octahydro-1H-cyclopropa[a]naphthalene carrying foru methyl substituents at positions 1, 1, 3a and 7.

name: (+)-α-gurjunene
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpene that is 1a,2,3,4,4a,5,6,7b-octahydro-1H-cyclopropa[e]azulene carrying four methyl substituents at positions 1, 1, 4 and 7.

name: naringenin 7-O-β-D-glucuronide
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone that is naringenin in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 7 has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronosyl residue.

name: (E,E)-hepta-2,4-dienal
definition: A heptadienal in which the two double bonds are located at positions 2 and 4 (the E,E-geoisomer).

name: 3-hydroxyheptanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acid that is heptanoic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (2R,5S)-linalyl oxide
definition: A monoterpenoid that is 2-(2-hydroxypropan-2-yl)oxolane carying additional methyl and vinyl substituents both located at position 5 (the 2R,5S-diastereomer).

name: amicarbazone
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-5-one which is substituted at position 1 by a tert-butylaminocarbonyl group and at position 3 by an isopropyl group. A selective herbicide for pre- and post-emergence control of annual dicotyledonous weeds and grasses, it is not approved for use within the European Union.

name: clodinafop
definition: An aromatic ether that is (R)-lactic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted to the corresponding p-[(5-chloro-3-fluoropyridin-2-yl)oxy]phenyl ether. It is the parent acid of the herbicide clodinafop-propargyl.

name: sulfapyridine
definition: A sulfonamide consisting of pyridine with a 4-aminobenzenesulfonamido group at the 2-position.

name: (E)-2-undecenal
definition: A 2-undecenal in which the C=C bond has E configuration.

name: glycidyl methacrylate
definition: An enoate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of methacrylic acid with the hydroxy group of glycidol.

name: (Z)-hex-3-en-1-yl methyl carbonate
definition: A carbonate ester that is dimethyl carbonate in which one of the methyl groups has been replaced by a (Z)-hex-3-en-1-yl group. It has a floral scent and is used in the production of fruit or vegetable-like flavour additives.

name: 8-methyl-1-undecene
definition: An alkene that is undec-1-ene carrying a methyl substituent at position 8.

name: linaloyl oxide
definition: A member of the class of oxanes carrying a vinyl substituent at position 2 as well as three methyl substituents at positions 2, 6 and 6.

name: dodecanoic anhydride
definition: An acyclic carboxylic anhydride resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy groups of two molecules of dodecanoic acid.

name: trifloroside
definition: A secoiridoid glycoside that is (4aS,5R,6R)-6-hydroxy-5-vinyl-4,4a,5,6-tetrahydro-1H,3H-pyrano[3,4-c]pyran-1-one in which the hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding 2,3,6-tri-O-acetyl-β-D-glucoside, the 4-hydroxy group of which has been esterified by formal condensation with the carboxy group of 2,3-dihydroxybenzoic acid 3-β-D-glucoside. It is a component of Gentiana scabra root extract, which is used as an internal remedy in traditional Korean medicine for the treatment of diabetes mellitus.

name: roburic acid
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid with formula C30H40O2 that is isolated from the roots of Gentiana dahurica and Gentiana macrophylla.

name: lespedezol D1
definition: A member of the class of pterocarpans that is (6aR,11aR)-3,9-dihydroxypterocarpan in which the hydrogen at position 8 has been replaced by a methoxy group.

name: acteoside
definition: A glycoside that is the α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucoside of hydroxytyrosol in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the glucopyranosyl moiety has undergone esterification by formal condensation with trans-caffeic acid.

name: 9-hydroxyundec-10-enoic acid
definition: A hydroxy monounsaturated fatty acid that is undec-10-enoic acid which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 9. It has been isolated from the leaves of Corchorus olitorius, also known as the medicinal foodstuff moroheiya.

name: viscumneoside I
definition: A viscumneoside that is homoeriodictyol in which the hydroxy groups at the 7 and 4' positions have been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside and β-D-apiofuranoside derivatives, respectively. Found in Viscum coloratum, an evergreen hemiparasitic plant whose stems and leaves are used in traditional Chinese medicine for the treatment of rheumatism.

name: viscumneoside III
definition: A viscumneoside that is homoeriodictyol in which the hydroxy group at position 7 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside, the 2-hydroxy group of which has been converted to its β-D-apiofuranoside derivative. Found in Viscum coloratum, an evergreen hemiparasitic plant whose stems and leaves are used in traditional Chinese medicine for the treatment of rheumatism.

name: viscumneoside IV
definition: A viscumneoside that is rhamnacine (3',7-dimethylquercetin) in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucoside and in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the glucosyl moiety has been acylated by formal condensatio with the pro-R carboxy group of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid.

name: viscumneoside V
definition: A viscumneoside that is viscumneoside III in which the primary hydroxy group of the β-D-apiofuranosyl moiety has itself been converted to the corresponding β-D-apiofuranoside derivative. Found in Viscum coloratum, an evergreen hemiparasitic plant whose stems and leaves are used in traditional Chinese medicine for the treatment of rheumatism.

name: viscumneoside VI
definition: A viscumneoside that is homoeriodictyol in which the hydroxy group at position 7 has been converted to the corresponding (6-O-acetyl)-β-D-glucopyranoside. Found in Viscum coloratum, an evergreen hemiparasitic plant whose stems and leaves are used in traditional Chinese medicine for the treatment of rheumatism.

name: viscumneoside VII
definition: A viscumneoside that is viscumneoside IV in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the glucosyl moiety has been converted to the corresponding β-D-apifuranoside derivative. Found in Viscum coloratum, an evergreen hemiparasitic plant whose stems and leaves are used in traditional Chinese medicine for the treatment of rheumatism.

name: coriatin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone containing two epoxide groups and two tertiary hydroxy groups that has been isolated from the roots of Coriaria nepalensis.

name: corianin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone containing an epoxide group and two tertiary hydroxy groups that has been isolated from the fruits of Coriaria ruscifolia and Coriaria japonica.

name: deoxyfuconojirimycin
definition: A hydroxypiperidine in which the three hydroxy substituents are located at positions 3, 4 and 5 together with an additional methyl substituent at position 2.

name: cyclomorusin A
definition: An extended flavonoid that is cyclomulberrin in which the hydroxy group at position 10 has undergone oxidative cyclisation to position 3 of the 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl substituent, with migration of the double bond into conjugation with the aromatic ring. It is a moderate inhibitor of acetylcholinesterase (IC50 = 16.2 - 36.6 μM), and a strong inhibitor of platelet-activating factor (PAF; 1-O-alkyl-2-acetyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine) induced platelet aggregation.

name: cyclomulberrin
definition: A extended flavonoid that is 6H,7H-chromeno[4,3-b]chromen-7-one which is substituted by a 2-methylprop-1-en-1-yl group at position 6, a 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group at position 11, and hydroxy groups at positions 3, 8, and 10. It is found in the bark of Morus species and has been reported to protect human neuronal cells derived from the human neuroblastoma SH-SY5Y cell line.

name: (−)-homalomenol C
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound and sesquiterpenoid that is 11-oxatricyclo[5.3.1.02,6]undecane-1,8-diol which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 5 and 8, and by an isopropyl group at position 5. The absolute stereochemistry is not known; it is either 1R,2S,5R,6R,7R,8R (as shown), or the enantiomer.

name: (−)-homalomenol D
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound and sesquiterpenoid that is 11-oxatricyclo[5.3.1.02,6]undecan-8-ol which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 8, and by an isopropyl group at position 5. The absolute stereochemistry is not known; it is either 1R,2R,5S,6S,7R,8R (as shown), or the enantiomer.

name: mono(3-carboxypropyl) phthalate
definition: A phthalic acid monoester obtained by formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of phthalic acid with the hydroxy group of 4-hydroxybutyric acid.

name: meadowlactone
definition: A δ-lactone obtained by intramolecular condensation of the 5-hydroxy and carboxy groups of 5-hydroxyicosanoic acid. A nonenzymatic oxidation product of arachidonic acid.

name: mono[2-(carboxymethyl)hexyl] phthalate
definition: A phthalic acid monoester resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxy gruops of phthalic acid with the hydroxy group of 3-(hydroxymethyl)heptanoic acid.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate in which the anomeric centre connected to the diphosphate group has α-configuration.

name: β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate in which the anomeric centre connected to the diphosphate group has α-configuration.

name: 4-O-[(2R)-1-glycerylphosphono]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glycosyl diphosphate having eleven prenyl units and with 4-O-[(2R)-1-glycerylphosphono]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine as the glycosyl fragment.

name: benfluralin
definition: A tertiany amino compound that is 2,6-dinitro-4-(trifluoromethyl)aniline in which the hydrogens attached to the aniline nitrogen have been replaced by one ethyl and one butyl group. It is used as a pre-emergence herbicide used for the control of grass and other weeds in a range of food and non-food crops.

name: quinclorac-methyl
definition: The methyl ester of quinclorac. Used as an agricultural herbicide.

name: bensulfuron
definition: An N-sulfonylurea that is urea in which a hydrogen attached to one of the nitrogens has been replaced by an (o-carboxybenzyl)sulfonyl group, while a hydrogen attached to the other nitrogen has been replaced by a 4,6-dimethoxypyrimidin-2-yl group. An acetolactate synthase inhibitor, it is used (particularly as its methyl ester, bensulfuron-methyl) as a herbicide for the control of a variety of both annual and perennial weeds in crops, particularly wheat and rice.

name: N-benzoylglycyl-N6-[2-hydroxy-3-(quinoxalin-2-yl)propyl]lysine
definition: A lysine derivative in which the alpha and epsilon nitrogens are substituted respectively with benzoylglycyl and 2-hydroxy-3-(quinoxalin-2-yl)propyl groups.

name: N-benzoylglycyl-N6-[2-hydroxy-2-(3-methylquinoxalin-2-yl)ethyl]lysine
definition: A lysine derivative in which the alpha and epsilon nitrogens are substituted respectively with benzoylglycyl and 2-hydroxy-2-(3-methylquinoxalin-2-yl)ethyl groups.

name: 11(S),15(S)-dihydroxy-14(R)-(S-glutathionyl)-5(Z),8(Z),12(E)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: A glutathione conjugate in which the thiol hydrogen of glutathione has been replaced by a (6S,7R,8E,10S,12Z,15Z)-19-carboxy-6,10-dihydroxynonadeca-8,12,15-trien-7-yl group.

name: 11(S)-hydroxy-14(S),15(S)-hepoxilin A3
definition: A hepoxilin having (5Z,9E,14Z) double bond stereochemistry, an (11S)-hydroxy substituent and a 14S,15S-epoxy group.

name: benazolin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of benazolin.

name: benazolin-dimethylammonium
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of benazolin and dimethylamine. It is used as a post-emergence herbicide for the control of annual weeds in crops.

name: benazolin-potassium
definition: The potassium salt of benazolin. It is used as a post-emergence herbicide for the control of annual weeds in crops.

name: fangchinoline
definition: A bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is (1β)- berbaman which has been substituted by methyl groups at the 2 and 2' positions, by methoxy groups at the 6, 6', and 12 positions, and by a hydroxy group at position 7. Isolated from Stephania tetrandra, it has been found to possess neuroprotective and anti-tumour activity.

name: cassameridine
definition: An oxoaporphine alkaloid that is 7H-dibenzo[de,g]quinolin-7-one which is substituted by methylenedioxy grups at the 1,2 and 9,10 positions. Compared with liriodenine, which lacks the 9,10-methylenedioxy group, cassameridine displays only moderate antifungal activity.

name: oxofangchirine
definition: A bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is 1',2',3',4'-tetradehydroberbaman which has been substituted by a methyl group at position 2, methoxy groups at positions 6, 6', 7, and 12, and an oxo group at the 15' position. Isolated from Stephania tetrandra.

name: stephanthrine
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 2-(2H-phenanthro[3,4-d][1,3]dioxole in which the hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a 2-(dimethylamino)ethyl group.

name: benazolin-ethyl
definition: The ethyl ester of benazolin. It is used as a post-emergence herbicide used (generally as a salt or ester) for the control of annual weeds in wheat and oilseed rape. It is not approved for use with the European Union.

name: isorhamnetin 3-O-robinobioside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is isorhamnetin substituted at position 3 by a robinobiosyl residue.

name: β-terpineol
definition: A member of the class of terpineols that is cyclohexanol carrying additional methyl and propenyl substituents at positions 1 and 4 respectively.

name: (+)-homalomenol A
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is perhydroindane which is substituted by a (2-methylprop-1-en-1-yl) group at position 1, methyl groups at positions 3a and 7, and hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 7 (the 1R,3aR,4R,7S,7aR stereoisomer).

name: (+)-homalomenol B
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (+)-homalomenol A in which the double bond of the 2-methylpropen-1-yl group has migrated from the 1-2 position to the 2-3 position.

name: 1β,4β,7α-trihydroxyeudesmane
definition: A eudesmane sesquiterpenoid that is eudesmane carrying three hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 4 and 7.

name: oplodiol
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is 1,2,3,4,4a,5,8,8a-octahydronaphthalene which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 4, an isoopropyl group at position 7, and by methyl groups at positions 1 and 4a (the 1S,4R,4aR,8aR isomer). A sesquiterpenoid plant metabolite.

name: bullatantriol
definition: A sesqiterpenoid that is octahydro-1H-indene which is substituted by a 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropyl group at position 1, methyl groups at positions 3a and 7, and hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 7 (the 1R,3aR,4R,7S,7aR stereoisomer). It has been isolated from various Homalomena species.

name: α-cadinol
definition: A cadinane sesquiterpenoid that is cadin-4-ene carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 10.

name: (−)-Τ-muurolol
definition: A cadinane sesquiterpenoid that consists of 4-isopropyl-1,6-dimethyl-1,2,3,4,4a,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalene having a hydroxy substituent at position 1 and (1S,4S,4aR,8aS)-configuration.

name: mucrolidin
definition: A eudesmane sesquiterpenoid that is eudesmane carrying three hydroxy substituents at positions 1, 4 and 6.

name: 5(S)-hydroperoxy-18(R)-hydroxy-(6E,8Z,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid that is (6E,8Z,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic acid substituted at positions 5 and 18 by hydroperoxy and hydroxy groups respectively (the 5S, 18R-stereoisomer).

name: 5(S),6(S)-epoxy-18(R)-hydroxy-(7E,9E,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic acid
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid consisting of (7E,9E,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic acid carrying additional (18R)-hydroxy and (5S,6S)-epoxy groups.

name: 10-methyltetradecanoic acid
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid that is tetradecanoic acid in which one of the hydrogens at psoition 10 has been replaced by a methyl group. It is one of a number of methyl-branched fatty acids that have been identified as constituents of sheep perinephric fat.

name: (S,R,R,R)-nebivolol hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of (S,R,R,R)-nebivolol with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: (R,S,S,S)-nebivolol hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of (R,S,S,S)-nebivolol with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: (R,S,S,S)-nebivolol(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino function of (R,S,S,S)-nebivolol.

name: (S,R,R,R)-nebivolol(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino function of (S,R,R,R)-nebivolol.

name: 1-methyl-4-imidazoleacetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 1-methyl-4-imidazoleacetic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: clodinafop-propargyl
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of clodinafop with the hydroxy group of prop-2-yn-1-ol. It is widely used as a herbicide for the control of annual grass weeds in cereal crops.

name: ibuprofen(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of ibuprofen, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: salicylurate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of salicyluric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: SH-11037
definition: A homoisoflavonoid that is cremastranone in which the phenolic hydroxy of the 3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzyl group has undergone formal esterification with N-Boc-L-phenylalanine and in which both of the remaining hydroxy groups have undergone O-methylation.

name: 2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of 2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-pentacycloanammoxic acid
definition: A carbocyclic fatty acid consisting of octanoic acid which is terminally substituted by five fused cyclobutane-rings ([5]-ladderane). Ladderane fatty acids can be found in anammox bacteria.

name: methyl (+)-pentacycloanammoxate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (+)-pentacycloanammoxic acid with methanol.

name: methyl 6-(pentacyclo[6.4.0.02,7.03,6.09,12]dodec-4-yl)hexanoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester consisting of methyl hexanoate, which is terminally substituted by five fused butane-rings ([5]-ladderane). Ladderane fatty acid methyl esters are core lipids of anammox bacteria.

name: RH-24580
definition: A methyl ketone resulting from the formal hydration of the ethynyl group of the herbicide propyzamide. It is a major soil metabolite of propyzamide.

name: α-putrescinylthymine
definition: An N-substituted putrescine that is thymine in which a hydrogen of the methyl group has been replaced by one of the amino groups of putrescine. It replaces about half of the thymine residues in the DNA of bacetriophage φW-14.

name: disodium 5'-guanylate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of GMP.

name: 3-hydroxysebacate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 3-hydroxysebacic acid.

name: propionylglycinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of propionylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: butyrylglycinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of butyrylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ethylmalonate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the removal of a proton from both of the carboxylic acid groups of ethylmalonic acid.

name: octadec-9-enoate
definition: An octadecenoate in which the double bond is at C-9.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyglutaryl-CoA(5−)
definition: A 2-hydroxyglutaryl-CoA(5−) that results from the removal of all five protons from the phosphate and carboxylic acid groups of (R)-2-hydroxyglutaryl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: methyl 8-(tetracyclo[6.4.0.02,7.03,6]dodec-10-yl)octanoate
definition: Methyl ester of 8-(tetracyclo[6.4.0.02,7.03,6]dodec-10-yl)octanoate, an octanoic acid, which is terminally substituted by [3]-ladderane, a structure consisting out of three fused butane rings and one fused hexane ring. Ladderane fatty acid methyl esters are core lipids of anammox bacteria.

name: 2-(8-[3]-ladderane-octanyl)glycerol
definition: A 2-alkylglycerol in which glycerol is linked to 8-[3]-ladderane-octanyl via an ether-bond at position 2. Glycerols, substituted by ladderanes are core lipids of anammox bacteria.

name: cremastranone
definition: A homoisoflavonoid that is 2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-onethat is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7, a methoxy group at position 6, and a 3-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from various plants, including the bulb of Cremastra appendiculata.

name: N-acetylmethioninate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetylmethionine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetylmethionine
definition: A methionine derivative that is methionine in which one of the amine hydrogens is substituted by an acetyl group.

name: acetaminophen O-β-D-glucosiduronate
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronate that is the conjugate base of acetaminophen O-β-D-glucosiduronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: butyl 2-(4-{[5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group 2-(4-{[5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoic acid with the hydroxy group of butan-1-ol.

name: fluazifop-P-butyl
definition: A butyl 2-(4-{[5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate that has R configutation. The active enantiomer of the herbicide fluazifop-butyl, it is used as a post-emergence herbicide for the control grass weeds in various broad-leaved crops.

name: (S)-fluazifop-butyl
definition: A butyl 2-(4-{[5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate that has S configuration. It is the inactive enantiomer of the herbicide fluazifop-P-butyl.

name: elbasvir
definition: A complex organic heterotetracyclic compound that is a hepatitis C virus nonstructural protein 5A inhibitor used in combination with grazoprevir (under the brand name Zepatier) for treatment of chronic HCV genotypes 1 or 4 infection in adults.

name: N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosylceramide (d18:1/16:0)
definition: An N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosylceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl.

name: 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride that is the monohydrochloride of 5-aminolevulinic acid. It is metabolised to protoporphyrin IX, a photoactive compound which accumulates in the skin. Used in combination with blue light illumination for the treatment of minimally to moderately thick actinic keratosis of the face or scalp.

name: 5-ammoniolevulinic acid
definition: A primary ammonium ion obtained by protonation of the amino group of 5-aminolevulinic acid.

name: C646
definition: A pyrazolone that is 5-methyl-4-methylene-2-(p-carboxyphenyl)-2,4-dihydro-3H-pyrazol-3-one in which the exocyclic carbon of the methylene group is attached to a 5-(4,5-dimethyl-2-nitrophenyl)furan-2-yl group by a single bond. C646 is a potent, cell permeable and selective competitive inhibitor of p300 and CBP (p300/CBP) histone acetyltransferases.

name: grazoprevir
definition: An azamacrocyclic compound that is a hepatitis C protease inhibitor used in combination with elbasvir (under the brand name Zepatier) for treatment of chronic HCV genotypes 1 or 4 infection in adults.

name: S-malonyl-4'-phosphopantetheine
definition: An S-acyl-4'-phosphopantetheine obtained by formal condensation of the thiol group of D-pantetheine 4'-phosphate with one of the carboxy groups of malonic acid.

name: 7α,12α-dihydroxy-3-oxochol-4-en-24-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 7α,12α-dihydroxy-3-oxochol-4-en-24-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12α-hydroxy-3-oxochola-4,6-dien-24-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of 12α-hydroxy-3-oxochola-4,6-dien-24-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxydecanoate
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-hydroxydecanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: acridine half-mustard
definition: A member of the class of aminoacridines that is acridine which is substituted by a methoxy group at position 2, chlorine at position 6, and a {3-[(2-chloroethyl)amino]propyl}amino group at position 9.

name: acridine half-mustard(2+)
definition: An ammonium ion that is acridine half-mustard in which both of the secondary amino groups have been protonated.

name: acridine half-mustard dihydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of acridine half-mustard with 2 mol eq. of hydrogen chloride.

name: 3-hydroxydecanoic acid
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid that is decanoic acid substituted at position 3 by a hydroxy group.

name: RO4927350
definition: A carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the primary amino group of 4-propanoyl-1,3-thiazol-2-amine with the carboxy group of a 3-phenylbutiyric acid which has been substituted at position 2 by a (4R)-4-[p-(2-hydroxyethoxy)phenyl]-2,5-dioxoimidazolidin-1-yl group. It is a potent, highly selective inhibitormitogen-activated protein kinase 1/2 inhibitor.

name: 5-hydroxyhexanoate
definition: An (ω−1)-hydroxy fatty acid that is the conjugate base of 5-hydroxyhexanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: sapitinib
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is 4-amino-7-methoxyquinazoline in which the amino group has been substituted by a 3-chloro-2-fluorophenyl group and in which position 6 of the quinoline ring has been substituted by a {1-[2-(methylamino)-2-oxoethyl]piperidin-4-yl}oxy group. Sapitinib is a dual tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) of epithelial growth factor receptors (EGFR) HER2 and HER3.

name: alliin zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion that is allin in which a proton has been transferred from the carboxy group to the amino group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: bradykinin(2+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the amino and guanidino groups of bradykinin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: O-acetylhomoserine zwitterion
definition: An α-amino acid zwitterion that is O-acetylhomoserine in which a proton has been transferred from the carboxy group to the amino group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,9-dideoxy-9-glutaramido-2,3-dehydo-N-acetylneuraminic acid
definition: N-Acetylneuraminic acid reduced across the 2,3-bond with loss of the hydroxy group at C-2 and in which the 9-hydroxy group is substituted by a glutaramido group.

name: pyroglutamylvaline
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of pyroglutamic acid with the amino group of valine.

name: pyroglutamylvalinate
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate acid of pyroglutamylvaline, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E,E)-bilirubin
definition: A member of the class of biladienes that is an analogue of bilirubin in which the double bonds at position 4 and 15 have E-geochemistry.

name: DSGEGDFLAEGGGVR(3−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by removal of three protons from the fifteen-membered polypeptide Asp-Ser-Gly-Glu-Gly-Asp-Phe-Leu-Ala-Glu-Gly-Gly-Gly-Val-Arg. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: DSGEGDFLAEGGGVR
definition: A fifteen-membered polypeptide consisting of Asp, Ser, Gly, Glu, Gly, Asp, Phe, Leu, Ala, Glu, Gly, Gly, Gly, Val and Arg residues joined in sequence.

name: pregnenolone sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of pregnenolone sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: androsterone sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of androsterone sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methoxyacetaminophen glucuronide
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid that is 2-methoxyacetaminophen in which the phenolic hydrogen is replaced by a β-D-glucuronosyl group.

name: 2-methoxyacetaminophen glucuronide(1−)
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronate that is the conjugate base of 2-methoxyacetaminophen glucuronide, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: velpatasvir
definition: A complex organic heteropentacyclic compound that is a hepatitis C virus nonstructural protein 5A inhibitor used in combination with sofosbuvir (under the brand name Epclusa) for treatment of patients with chronic hepatitis C of all six major genotypes.

name: oxytetracycline zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the 2-hydroxy group to the adjacent tertiary amino group of oxytetracycline; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5a,11a-dehydrooxytetracycline zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the 2-hydroxy group to the adjacent tertiary amino group of 5a,11a-dehydrooxytetracycline; major species at pH 7.3.

name: brivaracetam
definition: A non-proteinogenic amino acid derivative that is butanamide in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a (4R)-2-oxo-4-propylpyrrolidin-1-yl. Used for treatment of partial onset seizures related to epilepsy.

name: pimavanserin tartrate
definition: A tartrate salt that is the hemitartrate salt of pimavanserin. An atypical antipsychotic that is used for treatment of hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease.

name: α-D-Xyl-(1→3)-β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-α-D-Xyl-(1→3)-β-D-GlcA
definition: A tetrasaccharide consisting of alternating D-glucuronic acid and D-xylosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→3)-linkages. A repeating unit in glycoprotein DAG1

name: pimavanserin
definition: A member of the class of ureas in which three of the four hydrogens are replaced by 4-fluorobenzyl, 1-methylpiperidin-4-yl, and 4-(isopropyloxy)benzyl groups. An atypical antipsychotic that is used (in the form of its tartrate salt) for treatment of hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease.

name: chlorphthalim
definition: A member of the class of phthalimides that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydrophthalimide in which the nitrogen has been substituted by a p-chlorophenyl group. It is used as a herbicide.

name: pimavanserin(1+)
definition: A piperidinium ion obtained by protonation of the piperidine nitrogen of pimavanserin.

name: venetoclax
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolopyridines that is a potent inhibitor of the antiapoptotic protein B-cell lymphoma 2. It is used for treamtment of chronic lymphocytic leukemia with 17p deletion.

name: lifitegrast
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-[2-(1-benzofuran-6-carbonyl)]-5,7-dichloro-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline-6-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 3-(methanesulfonyl)-L-phenylalanine. Used for treatment of keratoconjunctivitis sicca (dry eye syndrome).

name: salicyluric β-D-glucuronide
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of salicyluric acid with the anomeric hydroxy group of β-D-glucuronic acid.

name: salicyluric β-D-glucuronide(1−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion that is the conjugate base of salicyluric β-D-glucuronide, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-Glu-Trp
definition: A glutamyl-L-amino acid obtained by formal condensation of the γ-carboxy group of glutamic acid with the amino group of tryptophan.

name: γ-Glu-Trp(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of γ-Glu-Trp, obtained by removal of protons from the two carboxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-Glu-Gly(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of γ-Glu-Gly, obtained by removal of protons from the two carboxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-Glu-His
definition: A glutamyl-L-amino acid obtained by formal condensation of the γ-carboxy group of glutamic acid with the amino group of histidine.

name: γ-Glu-His(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of γ-Glu-His, obtained by removal of protons from the two carboxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: yanuthone L
definition: A class I yanuthone that is yanuthone K in which a hydrogen of the pro-E methyl group at the terminus of the farnesyl substituent has been replaced by a hydroxy group. Isolated from the filamentous fungus Aspergillus niger, it shows antifungal activity towards the pathogenic yeast Candida albicans (IC50 = 17.0 ±1.9 μM).

name: yanuthone K
definition: A class I yanuthone that is 5,6-epoxy-cyclohex-2-en-1-one which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 6 by methyl, acetoxy, and trans,trans-farnesyl groups, respectively (the R,R,R stereoisomer). Isolated from the filamentous fungus Aspergillus niger, it shows antifungal activity towards the pathogenic yeast Candida albicans (IC50 = 17.5 ±3.9 μM).

name: yanuthone M
definition: A class I yanuthone that is yanuthone K in which the double bond at the terminal end of the farnesyl substituent has undergone hydration to afford the corresponding tertiary alcohol. Isolated from the filamentous fungus Aspergillus niger, it shows antifungal activity towards the pathogenic yeast Candida albicans (IC50 = 77.5 ±3.7 μM).

name: yanuthone X2
definition: A class II yanuthone that is 5,6-epoxy-cyclohex-2-en-1-one which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 6 by methoxy, hydroxy, and trans,trans-farnesyl groups, respectively (the 4S,5R,6R stereoisomer). Isolated from the filamentous fungus Aspergillus niger, it shows antifungal activity towards the pathogenic yeast Candida albicans (IC50 = 51.7 ±4.7 μM).

name: γ-Glu-Leu(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of γ-Glu-Leu, obtained by removal of protons from the two carboxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(2-aminophenyl)decane-1,3-dione
definition: An aromatic ketone that is 1-(2-aminophenyl)decane carrying two oxo substituents at positions 1 and 3.

name: Cys-Gly disulfide
definition: An organic disulfide obtained by the oxidation of two Cys-Gly molecules which are then linked via a disulfide bond.

name: Cys-Gly disulfide dizwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of two protons from the carboxy to the amino groups of Cys-Gly disulfide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Gly-Phe zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Gly-Phe.

name: 6α-hydroxycannabidiol
definition: A hydroxy-cannabidiol that is cannabidiol in which the 6-pro-S hydrogen of the cyclohexene ring has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is one of the main metabolites of cannabidiol by human liver microsomes, produced by CYP2C19 and CYP3A.

name: [Hyp3]-bradykinin
definition: An oligopeptide that is an analogue of bradykinin in which the third amino acid, proline, is replaced with hydroxyproline.

name: 6β-hydroxycannabidiol
definition: A hydroxy-cannabidiol that is cannabidiol in which the 6-pro-R hydrogen of the cyclohexene ring has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is one of the main metabolites of cannabidiol by human liver microsomes, produced by CYP3A.

name: 7-hydroxycannabidiol
definition: A hydroxy-cannabidiol that is cannabidiol in which the methyl group that is attached to the double bond of the cyclohexene ring has been oxidised to the corresponding hydroxymethyl group. It is one of the main metabolites of cannabidiol by human liver microsomes, produced particularly by CYP2C19.

name: [Hyp3]-bradykinin(2+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the amino and guanidino groups of [Hyp3]-bradykinin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4''-hydroxycannabidiol
definition: A hydroxy-cannabidiol that is cannabidiol in which one of the hydrogens at position 4 of the pentyl chain has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is one of the main metabolites of cannabidiol by human liver microsomes, produced particularly by CYP3A.

name: 1''-hydroxycannabidiol
definition: A hydroxy-cannabidiol that is cannabidiol in which one of the two hydrogens at position 1 of the pentyl chain has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of cannabidiol by human liver microsomes, produced particularly by CYP1A.

name: tauro-β-muricholic acid
definition: A bile acid taurine conjugate derived from β-muricholic acid.

name: 2''-hydroxycannabidiol
definition: A hydroxy-cannabidiol that is cannabidiol in which one of the two hydrogens at position 2 of the pentyl chain has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of cannabidiol by human liver microsomes, produced by CYP3A.

name: 3''-hydroxycannabidiol
definition: A hydroxy-cannabidiol that is cannabidiol in which one of the two hydrogens at position 3 of the pentyl chain has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of cannabidiol by human liver microsomes.

name: 5''-hydroxycannabidiol
definition: A hydroxy-cannabidiol that is cannabidiol in which one of the hydrogens at position 5 of the pentyl chain has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of cannabidiol by human liver microsomes.

name: tauro-β-muricholate
definition: A cholanic acid conjugate anion that is the conjugate base of tauro-β-muricholic acid arising from deprotonation of the sulfonate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-arachidonoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol(1−)
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol(1−) in which the 1-acyl group is specified as arachidonoyl.

name: S-(5-acetamido-2-hydroxyphenyl)cysteine
definition: A cysteine derivative in which the thiol hydrogen of cysteine is replaced by a 5-acetamido-2-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: S-(5-acetamido-2-hydroxyphenyl)cysteine zwitterion
definition: An α-amino acid zwitterion that is S-(5-acetamido-2-hydroxyphenyl)cysteine in which a proton has been transferred from the carboxy group to the amino group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: [des-Arg9]-bradykinin
definition: An eight-membered oligopeptide comprising Arg, Pro, Pro, Gly, Phe, Ser, Pro and Phe residues joined in sequence. It is an analogue of bradykinin lacking the Arg residue at position 9.

name: [des-Arg9]-bradykinin(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the amino and guanidino groups of [des-Arg9]-bradykinin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-[(9-β-D-ribofuranosylpurin-6-yl)carbamoyl]threonate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-[(9-β-D-ribofuranosylpurin-6-yl)carbamoyl]threonine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: pyrocatechol sulfate(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of pyrocatechol sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: quinol sulfate(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of quinol sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: O-methylmalonylcarnitine(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion that is the conjugate base of O-methylmalonylcarnitine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 1-acyl group is specified as linoleoyl.

name: 1-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol(1−)
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol(1−) in which the 1-acyl group is specified as linoleoyl.

name: (2R,3R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylpentanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy-3-methylpentanoate in which the stereocentres at positions 2 and 3 both have R-configuration.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylpentanoic acid
definition: A branched-chain fatty acid that is 3-methylpentanoic acid carrying a hydroxy substitutent at position 2.

name: prostaglandin G1(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of prostaglandin G1, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylpentanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxy-3-methylpentanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: octadecanedioic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is octadecane in which both terminal methyl groups have been replaced by carboxy groups.

name: octadecanedioate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of octadecanedioic acid.

name: o-cresol hydrogen sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is o-cresol in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: o-cresol sulfate
definition: A phenyl sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of o-cresol hydrogen sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-Glu-Ala(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of γ-Glu-Ala, obtained by removal of protons from the two carboxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-Glu-Abu
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the γ-carboxy group of glutamic acid with the amino group of 2-aminobutyric acid.

name: γ-Glu-Abu(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of γ-Glu-Abu, obtained by removal of protons from the two carboxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyclo(L-Leu-L-Pro)
definition: A homodetic cyclic peptide composed from leucyl and prolyl residues.

name: yanuthone X1
definition: A class II yanuthone that is yanuthone X2 in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the 5,6-epoxycyclohex-2-en-1-one core has been converted to the corresponding acetate ester. Like yanuthone X2, yanuthone X1 has been isolated from the filamentous fungus Aspergillus niger, but shows much lower antifungal activity towards the pathogenic yeast Candida albicans than yanuthone X2 (IC50 >100 μM for yanuthone X1, compared with = 51.7 ±4.7 μM for yanuthone X2).

name: chavicol hydrogen sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is chavicol in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: chavicol sulfate
definition: A phenyl sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of chavicol hydrogen sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5α-androstane-3α,17β-diol disulfate
definition: An androstane sulfate that is 5α-androstan-3α,17β-diol in which both hydroxy hydrogens have been replaced by sulfo groups.

name: 5α-androstane-3α,17β-diol disulfate(2−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of both sulfo groups of 5α-androstan-3α,17β-diol disulfate

name: (3α,5α,17β)-3-hydroxyandrostan-17-yl sulfate
definition: An androstane sulfate that is 5α-androstan-3α,17β-diol in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 17 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: clofencet
definition: A pyridazinone that is 1-(p-chlorophenyl)pyridazin-4-one which is substituted at positione 5 and 6 by carboxy and ethyl groups, respectively. It is used (particularly as the potassium salt, known as clofencet-potassium) as a chemical hybridisation agent for commercial hybrid seed production. It is not approved for use within the European Union.

name: (3α,5α,17β)-3-hydroxyandrostan-17-yl sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of (3α,5α,17β)-3-hydroxyandrostan-17-yl sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: clofencet(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of clofencet.

name: clofencet-potassium
definition: A potassium salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of clofencet and potassium hydroxide. It is used as a chemical hybridisation agent for commercial hybrid seed production. It is not approved for use within the European Union.

name: (3α,5α,17β)-17-hydroxyandrostan-3-yl sulfate
definition: An androstane sulfate that is 5α-androstan-3α,17β-diol in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: (3α,5α,17β)-17-hydroxyandrostan-3-yl sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of (3α,5α,17β)-17-hydroxyandrostan-3-yl sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5α-androstane-3β,17α-diol disulfate
definition: An androstane sulfate that is 5α-androstan-3β,17α-diol in which both hydroxy hydrogens have been replaced by sulfo groups.

name: 5α-androstane-3β,17α-diol disulfate(2−)
definition: A 5α-androstan-3β,17α-diol disulfate anion obtained by deprotonation of both sulfo groups of 5α-androstan-3β,17α-diol disulfate.

name: 5α-androstane-3β,17β-diol disulfate
definition: An androstane sulfate that is 5α-androstan-3β,17β-diol in which both hydroxy hydrogens have been replaced by sulfo groups.

name: 5α-androstane-3β,17β-diol disulfate(2−)
definition: A 5α-androstan-3β,17α-diol disulfate anion obtained by deprotonation of both sulfo groups of 5α-androstan-3β,17β-diol disulfate.

name: 5α-pregnane-3β,20α-diol disulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is 5α-pregnane-3β,20α-diol in which both hydroxy hydrogens have been replaced by sulfo groups.

name: 5α-pregnane-3β,20α-diol disulfate(2−)
definition: A 5α-pregnane-3β,20α-diol disulfate anion obtained by deprotonation of both sulfo groups of 5α-pregnane-3β,20α-diol disulfate.

name: karetazan
definition: A member of the class of 4-pyridones that is N-ethyl-4-pyridone that is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 6 by p-chlorophenyl, carboxy, and methyl groups, respectively. It is used (particularly as its potassium salt, known as karetazan-potassium) as a chemical hybridisation agent for commercial hybrid seed production. It is not approved for use within the European Union.

name: 4-androstene-3β,17β-diol disulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is 4-androstene-3β,17β-diol in which both hydroxy hydrogens have been replaced by sulfo groups.

name: 4-pyridone
definition: The simplest member of the class of pyridin-4-ones, that is 1,4-dihydropyridine in which the hydrogens at position 4 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: 4-androstene-3β,17β-diol disulfate(2−)
definition: A 4-androstene-3β,17β-diol disulfate anion obtained by deprotonation of both sulfo groups of 4-androstene-3β,17β-diol disulfate.

name: lugdunin
definition: A thiazolidine-containing homodetic cyclic peptide that is isolated from human nasal bacteria. Exhibits bactericidal activity against many major pathogens including methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA).

name: karetazan(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of karetazan.

name: karetazan-potassium
definition: A potassium salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of karetazan and potassium hydroxide. It is used as a chemical hybridisation agent for commercial hybrid seed production. It is not approved for use within the European Union.

name: sintofen
definition: A member of the class of cinnolines that is 1-(p-chlorophenyl)cinnolin-4-one which is substituted at positions 3 and 5 by carboxy and 2-methoxyethoxy groups, respectively. It is a chemical hybridisation agent, used for the sterilisation of wheat.

name: prostaglandin E3(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of prostaglandin E3, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: prostaglandin G3(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of prostaglandin G3, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: prostaglandin H3(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of prostaglandin H3, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 17-methyloctadecanoic acid
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid that is octadecanoic (stearic) acid carrying a methyl substituent at position 17.

name: pyflubumide
definition: A dicarboximide resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of 4-(1,1,1,3,3,3-hexafluoro-2-methoxypropan-2-yl)-3-isobutylaniline with isobutyric acid and with 1,3,5-trimethylpyrazole-4-carboxylic acid. Developed by Nihon Nohyaku Co. Ltd. (Japan), it is a pro-acaricide, with its metabolite (the -NH form lacking the isubutanoyl group) exhibiting high activity on mitochondrial complex II. It has been reported to be very effective in controlling spider mites (Tetranychus, Oligonychus, and Panonychus species) during all life stages.

name: 17-methyloctadecanoate
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 17-methyloctadecanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-[(E)-hexadec-1-enyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: 1-(alk-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the alk-1-enyl group is specified as (E)-hexadec-1-enyl.

name: 1-[(E)-hexadec-1-enyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: 1-(alk-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the alk-1-enyl group is specified as (E)-hexadec-1-enyl.

name: 1-(octadec-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: 1-(alk-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the alk-1-enyl group is specified as octadec-1-enyl.

name: 1-(octadec-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: 1-(alk-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the alk-1-enyl group is specified as octadec-1-enyl.

name: 2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of 2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl).

name: Phe-Ala zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Phe-Ala; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Phe-Arg(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the side-chain guanidino group and the amino terminus of Phe-Arg; major species at pH 7.3.

name: γ-CEHC β-glucuronide
definition: A member of the class of chromanes that is γ-CEHC in which the phenolic hydrogen is replaced by a β-glucuronosyl residue.

name: 2-bromohexadecanoic acid
definition: A bromo fatty acid that is hexadecanoic (palmitic) acid carrying a single bromo substituent at position 2.

name: quininib
definition: A styrylquinoline that is trans-2-styrylquinoline in which the the phenyl group has been substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group. It is an anti-angiogenic compound that exerts a dose-dependent antagonism of the cysteinyl leukotriene pathway, preferentially antagonising cysteinyl leukotriene receptor 1. The major species at pH 7.3

name: N-(hexadecanoyl)hexadecasphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-acylhexadecasphingosine-1-phosphocholine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: 2-hydroxydecanoic acid
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid that is decanoic acid substituted at position 2 by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-undecenal
definition: An undecenal in which the C=C bond is located at the 2-3 position.

name: 2-hydroxydecanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxydecanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: glycohyocholic acid
definition: A bile acid glycine conjugate having hyocholic acid as the bile acid component.

name: glycohyocholate
definition: A cholanic acid conjugate anion that is the conjugate base of glycohyocholic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-ketopiperidine-2-carboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 6-ketopiperidine-2-carboxylic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N5-acetylornithine
definition: An ornithine derivative in which one of the amino hydrogens on the side-chain of ornithine has been replaced by an acetyl group.

name: N5-acetylornithine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of N5-acetylornithine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-1-methyl-L-histidine
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino acid that is N-acetyl-L-histidine in which the hydrogen attached to position 1 on the imidazole ring has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: N-acetyl-1-methyl-L-histidinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-1-methyl-L-histidine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-3-methyl-L-histidine
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino acid that is N-acetyl-L-histidine carrying a methyl substituent at position 3 on the imidazole ring.

name: N-acetyl-3-methyl-L-histidinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-3-methyl-L-histidine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(3-acetamidopropyl)pyrrolidin-2-one
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones in which the amide hydrogen of pyrrolidin-2-one has been replaced by a 3-acetamidopropyl group.

name: 2-aminophenyl hydrogen sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is 2-aminophenol in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)nicotinic acid
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is nicotinic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a 4,5-dihydro-imidazol-2-yl group, which in turn is substituted at positions 4, 4, and 5 by isopropyl, ethyl, and oxo groups, respectively.

name: (R)-imazapyr
definition: A 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)nicotinic acid that has R configuration.

name: (S)-imazapyr
definition: A 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)nicotinic acid that has S configuration.

name: (R)-imazapyr(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (R)-imazapyr.

name: (S)-imazapyr(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (S)-imazapyr.

name: (S)-imazamox(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (S)-imazamox.

name: 2-aminophenyl sulfate
definition: A phenylsulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 2-aminophenyl hydrogen sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyibuprofen(1−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxyibuprofen, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyibuprofen
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is ibuprofen in which the methine proton on the isobutyl group has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: carboxyibuprofen
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is ibuprofen in which one of the methyl groups in the isobutyl portion has been converted to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: carboxyibuprofen(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of carboxyibuprofen.

name: β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Xyl-OBn
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative that is β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Xyl in which the reducing end hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a benzyl group.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Xyl-OBn
definition: A glycosylxylose derivative that is β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Xyl in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a benzyl group.

name: trans-3-hydroxycotinine β-D-glucuronide(1−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion that is the conjugate base of trans-3-hydroxycotinine β-D-glucuronide, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-3-hydroxycotinine β-D-glucuronide
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid that is trans-3-hydroxycotinine in which the hydroxy hydrogen is replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue.

name: 1-acetylindole-3-carboxaldehyde
definition: An N-acylindole that is N-acetylindole carrying an additional formyl substituent at position 3.

name: 9-(β-D-glucosyl)-cis-zeatin
definition: An N-glycosylzeatin that is cis-zeatin having a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue attached at position N-9.

name: bisorcic(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of bisorcic, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-(β-D-glucosyl)-trans-zeatin
definition: An N-glycosylzeatin that is trans-zeatin having a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue attached at position N-9.

name: 7-(β-D-glucosyl)-cis-zeatin
definition: An N-glycosylzeatin that is cis-zeatin having a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue attached at position N-7.

name: (R)-imazapyr-isopropylammonium
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of the carboxy group of (R)-imazapyr with isopropylamine.

name: (S)-imazapyr-isopropylammonium
definition: An organoammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of the carboxy group of (S)-imazapyr with isopropylamine.

name: 26-hydroxycastasterone
definition: A brassinosteroid that is castasterone carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 26.

name: bisorcic
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino acid that is L-ornithine carrying two acetyl substituents at positions N-2 and N-5.

name: kaempferol 3-O-gentiobioside-7-O-rhamnoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol having gentiobiosyl and α-L-rhamnosyl residues attached at positions O-3 and O-7 respectively.

name: methyl tuberonate
definition: A methyl ester derived from tuberonic acid.

name: tuberonic acid
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid that is (+)-7-isojasmonic acid in which one of the hydrogens of the side-chain methyl group is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-oxindole-3-acetic acid
definition: A member of the class of oxindoles that is 2-oxindole carrying a carboxymethyl substituent at position 3.

name: 5-methoxyindole-2-carboxylic acid
definition: An indolecarboxylic acid that is indole-2-carboxylic acid carrying an additional methoxy substituent at position 5.

name: 2-aminoheptanoic acid zwitterion
definition: An α-amino acid zwitterion that is 2-aminoheptanoic acid in which a proton has been transferred from the carboxy group to the amino group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: kaempferol 3,7-di-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is kaempferol having two β-D-glucosyl residues attached at positions O-3 and O-7. Isolated from the aerial parts of Delphinium staphisagria, it exhibits trypanocidal activity.

name: 4-acetylphenyl sulfate
definition: A phenyl sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 4-acetylphenyl hydrogen sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-acetylphenyl hydrogen sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is 4-acetylphenol in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: (R)-imazamox-ammonium
definition: An ammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of the carboxy group of (R)-imazamox with 1 mol eq. of ammonia.

name: (S)-imazamox-ammonium
definition: An ammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of the carboxy group of (S)-imazamox with 1 mol eq. of ammonia.

name: quininib(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen of quininib. The major species below pH 4.

name: quininib hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of quininib and hydrogen chloride. It is an anti-angiogenic compound that exerts a dose-dependent antagonism of the cysteinyl leukotriene pathway, preferentially antagonising cysteinyl leukotriene receptor 1.

name: indaziflam
definition: A diastereoisomeric mixture of the two fluoroethyl diastereoisomers of N-(2,6-dimethylindan-1-yl)-6-(1-fluoroethyl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine in which the indane moiety has 1R,2S configuration. A cellulose biosynthesis inhibitor, it is used as a pre-emergence herbicide for the control of annual grasses and broad-leaved weeds in citrus, grapes, fruit trees, Christmas tree farms, lawns and sports fields. The two diastereoisomers have very similar biological activity; commercial material is a 95:5 mixture of the (1R,2S,fluoroethyl-R) and (1R,2S,fluoroethyl-S) diastereoisomers.

name: N-[(1R,2S)-2,6-dimethyindan-1-yl]-6-[(1R)-1-fluoroethyl]-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine
definition: An N-(2,6-dimethylindan-1-yl)-6-(1-fluoroethyl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine in which the indane moiety has 1R,2S configuration and the fluoroethyl substituent has R configuration. A cellulose biosynthesis inhibitor, it is the major active component of the herbicide indaziflam.

name: N-[(1R,2S)-2,6-dimethyindan-1-yl]-6-[(1S)-1-fluoroethyl]-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine
definition: An N-(2,6-dimethylindan-1-yl)-6-(1-fluoroethyl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine in which the indane moiety has 1R,2S configuration and the fluoroethyl substituent has S configuration. A cellulose biosynthesis inhibitor, it is the minor component of the herbicide indaziflam.

name: N-(2,6-dimethylindan-1-yl)-6-(1-fluoroethyl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine
definition: A member of the class of indanes that is 2,5-dimethylindane in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by one of the primary amino groups of 6-(1-fluoroethyl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine.

name: quercetin 3-O-rhamnoside-7-O-glucoside
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin 7-O-β-D-glucoside carrying an additional α-L-rhamnosyl residue at position 3.

name: quercetin 3,7-di-O-α-L-rhamnoside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside that is quercetin carrying two α-L-rhamnosyl residues at positions O-3 and O-7.

name: tetramethylpyrazine
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine in which all four hydrogens have been replaced by methyl groups. An alkaloid extracted from Chuanxiong (Ligusticum wallichii).

name: N-tert-butyl(3,5,6-trimethylpyrazin-2-yl)methanimine N-oxide
definition: A nitrone that is the N-oxido derivative of N-tert-butyl(3,5,6-trimethylpyrazin-2-yl)methanimine.

name: 5-chloromuconolactone(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-chloromuconolactone, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-pentyl-2-icosanoyl-3-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol
definition: A 1-alkyl-2-acyl-3-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-sn-glycerol (seminolipid) in which the alkyl and acyl substituents at O-1 and O-2 respectively are pentyl and icosanoyl.

name: microcystin LF
definition: A microcystin consisting of D-alanyl, L-leucyl, (3S)-3-methyl-D-β-aspartyl, L-phenylalanyl, (2S,3S,4E,6E,8S,9S)-3-amino-4,5,6,7-tetradehydro-9-methoxy-2,6,8-trimethyl-10-phenyldecanoyl, D-γ-glutamyl, and 2,3-didehydro-N-methylalanyl residues joined into a 25-membered macrocycle.

name: microcystin LW
definition: A microcystin consisting of D-alanyl, L-leucyl, (3S)-3-methyl-D-β-aspartyl, L-tryptophanyl, (2S,3S,4E,6E,8S,9S)-3-amino-4,5,6,7-tetradehydro-9-methoxy-2,6,8-trimethyl-10-phenyldecanoyl, D-γ-glutamyl, and 2,3-didehydro-N-methylalanyl residues joined into a 25-membered macrocycle.

name: leukotriene B5(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of leukotriene B5, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12-HEPE(1−)
definition: A HEPE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 12-HEPE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [methyl(oxido){1-[6-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-3-yl]ethyl}-λ6-sulfanylidene]cyanamide
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is 5-ethyl-2-trifluoromethylpyridine in which the ethyl group is substituted at position 1 by an N-cyano-S-methylsulfonimidoyl group. The insecticide sulfoxalor is a mixture of the four possible stereoisomers arising from the two tetrahedral stereocentres.

name: 9-HEPE(1−)
definition: A HEPE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 9-HEPE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,5,7-trihydroxy-4'-methoxyisoflavanone
definition: A hydroxyisoflavanone bearing three hydroxy substituents at positions 2, 5 and 7 in addition to a methoxy substituent at position 4'.

name: 12-dehydro-leukotriene B4(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 12-dehydro-leukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-(2-methylidenecyclopropyl)butanedioic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxydicarboxylic acid that is malic acid in which one of the methylene hydrogens at position 3 has been replaced by a methylidenecyclopropyl group.

name: (RC,RS)-sulfoxaflor
definition: A [methyl(oxido){1-[6-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-3-yl]ethyl}-λ6-sulfanylidene]cyanamide that has R configuration at both the sulfur atom and at the carbon attached to position 3 of the pyridine ring.

name: (RC,SS)-sulfoxaflor
definition: A [methyl(oxido){1-[6-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-3-yl]ethyl}-λ6-sulfanylidene]cyanamide that has S configuration at the sulfur atom and R configuration at the carbon attached to position 3 of the pyridine ring.

name: (SC,SS)-sulfoxaflor
definition: A [methyl(oxido){1-[6-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-3-yl]ethyl}-λ6-sulfanylidene]cyanamide that has S configuration at both the sulfur atom and at the carbon attached to position 3 of the pyridine ring.

name: 3-(4,6-dihydroxy-3-oxocyclohexa-1,4-dien-1-yl)acrylic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is acrylic acid in which one of the olefinic hydrogens at position 3 has been replaced by a 4,6-dihydroxy-3-oxocyclohexa-1,4-dien-1-yl group.

name: (SC,RS)-sulfoxaflor
definition: A [methyl(oxido){1-[6-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-3-yl]ethyl}-λ6-sulfanylidene]cyanamide that has R configuration at the sulfur atom and S configuration at the carbon attached to position 3 of the pyridine ring.

name: caffeic acid quinone
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is acrylic acid in which one of the olefinic hydrogens at position 3 has been replaced by a 3,4-dioxocyclohexa-1,5-dien-1-yl group.

name: 6'-O-mycolyltrehalose-6'phosphate
definition: A trehalose monomycolate that is α,α-trehalose 6-phosphate carrying an additional mycolyl substituent at position 6'.

name: 10,11-dihydro-12-oxoleukotriene B4(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 10,11-dihydro-12-oxoleukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (12R)-hydroxy-10,11-dihydroleukotriene E4(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (12R)-hydroxy-10,11-dihydroleukotriene E4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: acetoprole
definition: A phenylpyrazole insecticide that is 3-acetyl-1H-pyralole which is substituted at positions 1, 4, and 5 by 2,6-dichloro-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl, methylsulfinyl, and amino groups, respectively. A GABA-gated chloride channel antagonist, it was formerly used as an insecticide and acaricide for the control of sucking and chewing insect pests.

name: 10,11-dihydro-20,20-dihydroxyleukotriene B4(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 10,11-dihydro-20,20-dihydroxyleukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 10,11-dihydro-20,20,20-trihydroxyleukotriene B4(1−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of 10,11-dihydro-20,20,20-trihydroxyleukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 10,11-dihydroleukotriene B4(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 10,11-dihydroleukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9,10,18-trihydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid that is 18-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid carrying two additional hydroxy substituents at positions 9 and 10.

name: barium sulfate
definition: A metal sulfate with formula BaO4S. Virtually insoluble in water at room temperature, it is mostly used as a component in oil well drilling fluid it occurs naturally as the mineral barite.

name: bixin dialdehyde
definition: An apo carotenoid that is the dialdehyde obtained by reduction of the terminal methyl ester and carboxy groups of bixin.

name: 1D-myo-inositol 1,2,5,6-tetrakisphosphate
definition: A myo-inositol tetrakisphosphate having the four phosphates placed in the 1-, 2-, 5- and 6-positions.

name: etheroleic acid
definition: A divinyl ether fatty acid that is (9Z,11E,14E)-nonadeca-9,11,14-trienoic acid in which the methylene group at position 10 has been replaced by oxygen.

name: fagopyritol B1
definition: An α-D-galactoside that is 1D-chiro-inositol having an α-D-galactosyl residue attached at position 2 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: nickel ferrite
definition: A mixed metal oxide with formula Fe2NiO4.

name: zinc ferrite
definition: A mixed metal oxide with formula Fe2O4Zn.

name: gibberellin A15 (lactone form)
definition: A C20-gibberellin that is the lactone form of gibberellin A15.

name: choline chloride
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt with choline cation and chloride anion.

name: β-D-glucosamine 6-sulfate
definition: A 6-O-sulfo-D-glucosamine in which the anomeric centre has β-configuration.

name: 10-HETE(1−)
definition: A HETE anion that is the conjugate base of 10-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12-oxo-20-hydroxyleukotriene B4(1−)
