definition: A trans-2,3-unsaturated fatty aldehyde that is (E)-dodec-2-ene in which the allylic methyl group has been oxidised to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: 17α-hydroxypregnenolone 3-sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of 17α-hydroxypregnenolone 3-sulfate.

name: N-methylproline zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of N-methylproline; major species at pH 7.3.

name: homovanillate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion which is obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of homovanillic acid.

name: cholesteryl nonadecanoate
definition: A cholesterol ester derived obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of nonadecanoic acid with the 3-hydroxy group of cholesterol.

name: N-acetyltryptophanate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion which is obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-acetyltryptophan.

name: L-γ-Glu-L-Thr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the side-chain carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of L-threonnine.

name: drilodefensin 1
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is furan-3-sulfonic acid carrying hexyl and ethyl substituents at positions 2 and 5 respectively.

name: Cutin-1
definition: A phosphonium ylide that is 2-(triphenylphosphoranylidene)acetamide in which the nitrogen has been converted to the corresponding carbamoyl derivative. By targeting the β-subunit of fatty acid synthase, it inhibits nuclear envelope expansion and nuclear elongation during the closed mitosis of fission yeast.

name: dihydroferulate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of dihydroferulic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ε-(γ-glutamyl)lysine dizwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion that is the dizwitterionic form of ε-(γ-glutamyl)lysine obtained by migration of protons from both carboxy groups to the amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: nigragillin
definition: An enamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2E,4E)-hexa-2,4-dienoic acid with the secondary amino group of (2S,5R)-1,2,5-trimethylpiperazine.

name: nigerazine B
definition: An enamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-cinnamic acid with the secondary amino group of (2S,5R)-1,2,5-trimethylpiperazine.

name: nigerazine A
definition: An enamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-cinnamic acid with the secondary amino group of (2R,5R)-1,2,5-trimethylpiperazine.

name: aurasperone B
definition: A dimeric naphthopyran with formula C32H30O12, isolated from several Aspergillus species.

name: fonsecinone C
definition: A dimeric naphthopyran with formula C32H28O11, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: fonsecinone B
definition: A dimeric naphthopyran with formula C32H28O11, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: fonsecinone A
definition: A dimeric naphthopyran with formula C32H26O10, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: aurasperone A
definition: A dimeric naphthopyran with formula C32H26O10, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: asperpyrone B
definition: A dimeric naphthopyran with formula C32H26O10, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: asperpyrone C
definition: A dimeric naphthopyran with formula C32H26O10, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: YWA1
definition: A heptaketide that is 2,3-dihydro-4H-benzo[g]chromen-4-one bearing a methyl substituent at position 2 and four hydroxy substituents at positions 2, 5, 6 and 8.

name: 1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-5-methyl-4,5-dihydro-1H-pyrazole-3,5-dicarboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 4,5-dihydro-1H-pyrazole substituted by a 2,4-dichlorophenyl group, carboxy group, carboxy group and methyl group at positions 1,3,5 and 5, respectively.

name: (R)-mefenpyr
definition: A 1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-5-methyl-4,5-dihydro-1H-pyrazole-3,5-dicarboxylic acid that has R configuration.

name: (S)-mefenpyr
definition: A 1-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-5-methyl-4,5-dihydro-1H-pyrazole-3,5-dicarboxylic acid that has S configuration.

name: (R)-PGA2-S-glutathione conjugate(2−)
definition: A prostanoid anion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl α-amino group of (R)-PGA2-S-glutathione conjugate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-PGA2-S-glutathione conjugate(2−)
definition: A prostanoid anion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl α-amino group of (S)-PGA2-S-glutathione conjugate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-PGJ2-S-glutathione conjugate(2−)
definition: A prostanoid anion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl α-amino group of (R)-PGJ2-S-glutathione conjugate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-PGJ2-S-glutathione conjugate(2−)
definition: A prostanoid anion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl α-amino group of (S)-PGJ2-S-glutathione conjugate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1α-hydroxyandrost-4-ene-3,17-dione
definition: An androstanoid that is androst-4-ene-3,17-dione in which the hydrogen at the 1α position has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: pyranonigrin A
definition: A member of the class of pyranopyrroles that is 2-[(1E)-prop-1-en-1-yl]-6,7-dihydropyrano[2,3-c]pyrrole-4,5-dione carrying two additional hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 7. Originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl and 5-acetyl-α-neuraminyl residues linked respectively (1→4) and (2→3) to D-galactose.

name: pyranonigrin J
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones with formula C17H23NO4, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: pyranonigrin I
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones with formula C18H25NO4, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: pyranonigrin H
definition: A member of the class of pyranopyrroles with formula C18H23NO5, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: pyranonigrin E
definition: A member of the class of pyranopyrroles with formula C18H21NO4, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: pyranonigrin G
definition: A member of the class of pyranopyrroles with formula C18H23NO4, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: pyranonigrin K
definition: A member of the class of pyranopyrroles with formula C17H21NO4, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: prostaglandin G1
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins G that is 9α,11α-epidioxy-13-trans-prostenoic acid carrying an additional hydroperoxy substituent at the 15S-position.

name: all-trans-3,4-didehydroretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid obtained by 3,4-desaturation of β-ionone ring of all-trans-retinoic acid

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,17S,19Z)-17-hydroperoxydocosahexaenoate
definition: A hydroperoxydocosahexaenoate that is the conjugate base of (17S)-HPDoHE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,17S)-17-hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,17S)-17-hydroperoxydocosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-17-hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate that is the conjugate base of 17-HPDoPE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z,10Z,12E,16Z,19Z)-14-hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate that is the conjugate base of (7Z,10Z,12E,16Z,19Z)-14-hydroperoxydocosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,16Z)-14-hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,16Z)-14-hydroperoxydocosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-[β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc
definition: A branched β-D-glucan that consists of a β-1,3-linked nonaglucan backbone with a β-1,6-glucotetraose branch at the 6-O-position of the nonaglucan central sugar unit.

name: β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc
definition: A branched β-D-glucan that consists of a β-1,3-linked nonaglucan backbone with a β-1,3-glucodiaose branch at the 6-O-position of the nonaglucan central sugar unit.

name: β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-[β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→3)-β-D-Glc
definition: A branched β-D-glucan that consists of a β-1,3-linked nonaglucan backbone with a β-1,3-glucotetraose branch at the 6-O-position of the nonaglucan central sugar unit.

name: 7α-hydroxy-3-oxo-4-cholestenoate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of 7α-hydroxy-3-oxo-4-cholestenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3

name: (1→3)-dodeca-β-D-glucan
definition: A (1→3)-β-D-glucan consisting of 12 glucosyl residues linked in a linear sequence.

name: rubrofusarin B
definition: A benzochromenone that is rubrofusarin in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted to the corresponding methyl ether.

name: BMS-192548
definition: A member of the class of tetracyclines with formula C21H18O9, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: TAN-1612
definition: A member of the class of tetracyclines with formula C21H18O9, originally isolated from Penicillium claviforme.

name: asperrubrol
definition: A methyl ester derived from (2Z,4E,6E,8E,10E,12E)-3-hydroxy-2,12-dimethyl-13-phenyltrideca-2,4,6,8,10,12-hexaenoic acid. Originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: anisindione
definition: A cyclic β-diketone consisting of indane-1,3-dione having a 4-methoxyphenyl substituent at the 4-position.

name: 5(S),6(S)-epoxy-18-hydroxy-(7E,9E,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoate
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 5(S),6(S)-epoxy-18-hydroxy-(7E,9E,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: asperenone
definition: An enone that is (4E,6E,8E,10E,12E)-8-methyl-13-phenyltrideca-4,6,8,10,12-pentaene in which the two methylene hydrogens at position 3 have been replaced by an oxo group. Originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: flavasperone
definition: A naphtho-γ-pyrone that is 4H-naphtho[1,2-b]pyran-4-one carrying a methyl substituent at position2, a hydroxy substituent at position 5 and two methoxy substotuents at positions 8 and 10. Originally isolated from Aspergillus niger.

name: aurasperone C
definition: A dimeric naphtho-γ-pyrone with formula C31H28O12, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger

name: α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/26:1(17Z))
definition: An α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosylceramide in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as (17Z)-hexacosenoyl.

name: doxorubicinol
definition: A member of the class of tetracenequinones that is the major metabolite of the anthracycline doxorubicin, a chemotherapeutic agent effective against a broad range of malignant neoplasms. It is thought to exhibit cardiotoxic properties.

name: HG-9-91-01
definition: A member of the class of phenylureas that is a potent inhibitor of salt-inducible kinase 2, a potential target protein for therapy in ovarian cancer.

name: 13-HODE(1−)
definition: A HODE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 13-HODE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-HODE(1−)
definition: A HODE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 9-HODE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7E,9E,11Z,13E,15R,17Z)-5,6,15-trihydroxyicosapentaenoate
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (7E,9E,11Z,13E,15R,17Z)-5,6,15-trihydroxyicosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (6Z,8E,10E,14Z,16E,18R)-5,12,18-trihydroxyicosapentaenoate
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (6Z,8E,10E,14Z,16E,18R)-5,12,18-trihydroxyicosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: GNF5343
definition: An aromatic amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-furoic acid with the aromatic amino group of 4-chloro-3-([1,3]oxazolo[4,5-b]pyridin-2-yl)aniline.

name: GNF6702
definition: An aromatic amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,4-dimethyl-1,3-oxazole-5-carboxylic acid with the aromatic amino group of 4-fluoro-3-[6-(pyridin-2-yl)[1,2,4]triazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidin-2-yl]aniline. A proteasome inhibitor known to be active against the three parasites that cause Chagas disease, leishmaniasis and sleeping sickness.

name: fonsecin B
definition: A naphtho-γ-pyrone that is fonsecin in which the hydroxy group at position 8 (meta to the methoxy group) has been converted to the corresponding methyl ether. Found in Aspergillus fonsecaeus.

name: tensyuic acid A
definition: A tensyuic acid that is itaconic acid which has been substituted at position 3 by a 3-(methoxycarbonyl)propyl group and in which the non-conjugated carboxy group has been converted to the corresponding methyl ester. The (+)-isomer, isolated from Aspergillus niger FKI-2342.

name: tensyuic acid B
definition: A tensyuic acid that is itaconic acid which has been substituted at position 3 by a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group. The (−)-isomer, isolated from Aspergillus niger FKI-2342.

name: tensyuic acid F
definition: A tensyuic acid that is itaconic acid which has been substituted at position 3 by a 3-(ethoxycarbonyl)propyl group. The (−)-isomer, isolated from Aspergillus niger FKI-2342.

name: tensyuic acid C
definition: A tensyuic acid that is tensyuic acid B in which the methyl ester group has been replaced by an ethyl ester group. The (−) isomer. In contrast to (inactive) tensyuic acid B, tensyuic acid C shows moderate antimicrobial activity against Bacillus subtilis.

name: tensyuic acid D
definition: A tensyuic acid that is tensyuic acid B in which the non-conjugated carboxy group has been converted to the corresponding methyl ester. The (+)-isomer, isolated from Aspergillus niger FKI-2342.

name: tensyuic acid E
definition: A tensyuic acid that is itaconic acid which has been substituted at position 3 by a 7-(methoxycarbonyl)heptanyl group. The (+)-isomer, isolated from Aspergillus niger FKI-2342.

name: fumonisin B4
definition: A fumonisin that is fumonisin B2 that is lacking hydroxy group located γ- to the amino substituent.

name: benznidazole
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2-nitroimidazol-1-yl)acetic acid with the aromatic amino group of benzylamine. Used for treatment of Chagas disease.

name: lyciumoside II
definition: A diterpene glycoside that is 20-hydroxygeranyllinalool substituted carrying β-D-glucosyl and β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucosyl residues at position O-3 and O-20 respectively.

name: yanuthone F
definition: A class I yanuthone that is 7-deacetoxyyanuthone A in which one of the hydrogens of the trans-terminal methyl groups of the sesquiterpenoid side-chain has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: yanuthone H
definition: A class I yanuthone that is 22-deacetoxyyanuthone A in which one of the hydrogens of the trans-terminal methyl groups of the sesquiterpenoid side-chain has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: yanuthone I
definition: A class I yanuthone that is 5,6-epoxy-4-hydroxy-3-hydroxymethylcyclohex-2-en-1-one which is substituted at position 6 by a (2E)-7-carboxy-3-methyloct-2-en-1-yl group (the R,R,R stereoisomer).

name: yanuthone J
definition: A class I yanuthone that is yanuthone E in which the sesquiterpenoid double bond furthest from the epoxycyclohexenone ring has undergone formal addition of water to give the corresponding tertiary alcohol.

name: yanuthone G
definition: A class I yanuthone that is yanuthone F in which the hydroxy group attached to the epoxycyclohexenone ring has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucoside.

name: yanuthone E
definition: A class I yanuthone that is 22-deacetylyanuthone A in which the primary alcohol has been esterified by condensation with one of the carboxy groups of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid.

name: yanuthone D
definition: A class I yanuthone that is yanuthone E in which the secondary hydroxy group has been oxidised to the corresponding ketone. It is the only one of the sixteen yanuthones described up to 2015 to display strong antimicrobial activity.

name: toluquinol
definition: A member of the class of hydroquinones that is hydroquinone in which one of the benzene hydrogens has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: 7-deacetoxyyanuthone A
definition: A class I yanuthone that is 5,6-epoxy-4-hydroxy-3-methylcyclohex-2-en-1-one which is substituted at position 6 by an (E,E)-3,7,11-trimethyldodeca-2,6,10-trien-1-yl group (the R,R,R stereoisomer).

name: 22-deacetylyanuthone A
definition: A class I yanuthone that is 7-deacetoxyyanuthone A in which the methyl group attached to the epoxy-cyclohexenone ring has been oxidised to the corresponding hydroxymethyl group.

name: 9-oxo-ODE(1−)
definition: A octadecanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 9-oxo-ODE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: aspernigrin A
definition: A member of the class of 4-pyridones that is 4-pyridone in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 6 have been replaced by aminocarbonyl and benzyl groups, respectively. It has been isolated from the Cynodon dactylon-associated endophytic fungus Cladosporium herbarum IFB-E002 and from a sponge-derived Aspergillus niger.

name: aspernigrin B
definition: A pyridine alkaloid with formula C27H24N2O5 that is isolated from Aspergillus niger and displays neuroprotective protperties.

name: 9-HETE(1−)
definition: A HETE anion that is the conjugate base of 9-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-oxo-ETE(1−)
definition: An oxo-ETE anion that is the conjugate base of 9-oxo-ETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: azanigerone A
definition: An azaphilone that is the ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,4-dimethylhexanoic acid with the tertiary hydroxy group of 7-hydroxy-7-methyl-6,8-dioxo-7,8-dihydro-6H-2-benzopyran-3-carboxylic acid.

name: azanigerone B
definition: An azaphilone that is the ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,4-dimethylhexanoic acid with the tertiary hydroxy group of 7-hydroxy-3-(2-hydroxypropyl)-7-methyl-6H-2-benzopyran-6,8(7H)-dione.

name: azanigerone C
definition: An azaphilone that is the ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,4-dimethylhexanoic acid with the tertiary hydroxy group of 7-hydroxy-3-(1,2-dihydroxypropyl)-7-methyl-6H-2-benzopyran-6,8(7H)-dione.

name: azanigerone D
definition: An azaphilone that is the ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,4-dimethylhexanoic acid with the tertiary hydroxy group of 7-hydroxy-7-methyl-6,8-dioxo-2,6,7,8-tetrahydroisoquinoline-3-carboxylic acid.

name: azanigerone E
definition: An azaphilone that is 6H-2-benzopyran-6,8(7H)-dione carrying a 2-hydroxypropyl sunstyituent at position 3 as well as methyl and hydroxy substituents at position 7.

name: azanigerone F
definition: An azaphilone that is 6H-2-benzopyran-6,8(7H)-dione carrying a 2-hydroxypropyl sunstyituent at position 3 as well as methyl and acetoxy substituents at position 7.

name: FK17-P2a
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde that is 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde which is substituted by a methyl group at position e and by a at positions 3 and 4-hydroxy-2-oxopentyl group at position 6. A fungal metabolite isolated from Pseudobotrytis and Aspergillus niger (stereochemistry not been determined).

name: afidopyropen
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1,3,4,4a,5,6,6a,12,12a,12b-decahydro-2H,11H-benzo[f]pyrano[4,3-b]chromen-11-one which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 4, 6a, and 12b; hydroxy groups at positions 3, 6, and 9; and a cyclopropycarbonyloxymethyl group and a cyclopropylcarbonyloxy group at positions 17 and 18 respectively, and a pyridin-3-yl group at position 14 (the (3S,4R,4aR,6S,6aS,12R,12aS,12bS stereoisomer). It is an insecticide that is effective against sucking insects on fruit, vegetables and nuts.

name: desferricoprogen B
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is 2,5-diketopiperazine which is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by 3-(hydroxyamino)propyl groups in which the nitrogens have been acylated by (2E)-5-hydroxy-3-methylpent-2-enoyl groups. The substituent at position 3 has been further modified by having its terminal hydroxy group esterified by condensation with the carboxy group of N5-hydroxy-L-ornithine in which the N5 nitrogen has been acylated by a (2E)-5-hydroxy-3-methylpent-2-enoyl group.

name: desferricoprogen B(3−)
definition: A hydroxamic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from each of the three hydroxamic acid groups of desferricoprogen B.

name: coprogen B
definition: An Fe(III)-complexed hydroxamate siderophore with formula C33H51FeN6O12 that is secreted by several fungi and bacteria.

name: 3'-(enolpyruvyl)uridine 5'-monophosphate
definition: A uridine 5'-phosphate that is UMP in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by an enolpyruvyl group.

name: uracil octosyl acid 5'-phosphate
definition: An N-glycosyl compound with formula C12H15N2O11P that is a common intermediate in the biosynthesis of nikkomycins and polyoxins by bacteria.

name: 4-O-[di(2R)-1-glycerylphosphonato]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 4-O-[di(2R)-1-glycerylphosphonato]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: mevalonyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of mevalonic acid.

name: α-bradyrhizose
definition: A heptol that is 6-methylhexahydro-1-benzopyran carrying seven hydroxy substituents located at positions 2, 3, 4, 4a, 5, 6 and 7.

name: anhydromevalonyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of anhydromevalonic acid.

name: N5-anhydromevalonyl-N5-hydroxy-L-ornithine
definition: An L-ornithine derivative obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of anhydromevalonic acid with the hydroxylamine nitrogen of N5-hydroxy-L-ornithine.

name: (2Z,4E)-4-hydroxy-6-oxoocta-2,4-dienedioic acid
definition: An oxodicarboxylic acid that is a tautomer of 4-maleylacetoacetic acid in which the carbonyl of the α,β-unsaturated ketone moiety has tautomerised to the corresponding enol (the 2Z,4E isomer).

name: prostaglandin F1α alcohol
definition: A member of the class of prostaglandins Fα that is prostaglandin F1α in which the carboxy group has been reduced to the corresponding primary alcohol.

name: S-acetylglutathione
definition: An S-acylglutathione in which the S-acyl group is specified as acetyl.

name: S-(chloromethyl)glutathione(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl amino group of S-(chloromethyl)glutathione; major species at pH 7.3.

name: S-(4-oxobutan-2-yl)glutathione
definition: A glutathione conjugate that is the product of a glutathione conjugate addition reaction with crotonaldehyde.

name: S-(1,4-dihydroxy-3-methylnaphthalen-2-yl)glutathione(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl amino group of S-(1,4-dihydroxy-3-methylnaphthalen-2-yl)glutathione; major species at pH 7.3.

name: S-[(2-phenylethyl)carbamothioyl]glutathione(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl amino group of S-[(2-phenylethyl)carbamothioyl]glutathione; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-(methoxymethyl)phenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is p-cresol in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a methoxy group.

name: FMNH2(3−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups as well as position N1 of FMNH2.

name: tabtoxinine-δ-lactam
definition: A δ-lactam that is L-pipecolic acid carrying additional hydroxy and aminomethyl substituents at position 5 as well as an oxo substituent at position 6.

name: eucommiol
definition: An alicyclic compound that is cyclopent-3-en-1-ol carrying additional hydroxymethyl substituents at positions 3 and 4 as well as a 2-hydroxyethyl substituent at position 2 (the 1R,2R-diastereomer).

name: sedanonic acid lactone
definition: A member of the class of 2-benzofurans that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one carrying an additional butylidene substituent at position 3.

name: 4-O-[1-D-ribitylphosphonato-(2R)-1-glycerylphosphonato]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 4-O-[1-D-ribitylphosphonato-(2R)-1-glycerylphosphonato]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-O-[poly(1-D-ribitylphosphonato)-1-D-ribitylphosphonato-(2R)-1-glycerylphosphonato]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate polyanion
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by global deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 4-O-[poly(1-D-ribitylphosphonato)-1-D-ribitylphosphonato-(2R)-1-glycerylphosphonato]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate.

name: 4-O-({poly[1-D-ribitylphosphonato]}-di{[2R]-1-glycerylphosphonato})-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate polyanion
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by global deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 4-O-({poly[1-D-ribitylphosphonato]}-di{[2R]-1-glycerylphosphonato})-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate

name: methanesulfinic acid
definition: An organosulfinic acid that is methane in which one of the hydrogens has been replaced by a sulfino group.

name: chromopyrrolate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups of chromopyrrolic acid; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 8(S),15(S)-DiHPETE(1−)
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 8(S),15(S)-DiHPETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 14(R),15(S)-DiHPETE(1−)
definition: A bis(hydroperoxy)icosatetraenoate that is the conjugate base of 14(R),15(S)-DiHPETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-aminobutyryl-CoA(3−)
definition: An acyl-CoA oxoanion arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions as well as protonation of the amino group of 3-aminobutyryl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8(S),15(S)-DiHETE(1−)
definition: A DiHETE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 8(S),15(S)-DiHETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-talosamine
definition: A hexosamine that is D-talose in which the 2-hydroxy group has been replaced by an amino group.

name: demethoxyaschantin
definition: A member of the class of furofurans that is tetrahydro-1H,3H-furo[3,4-c]furan-1-yl]-1,3-benzodioxole carrying an additional 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl substituent at position 4.

name: hypothiocyanous acid
definition: A sulfur oxoacid that is sulfenic acid in which the hydrogen attached to the sulfur has been replaced by a cyano group.

name: (Z)-6-amino-2-hydroxy-4-(2-oxovinyl)hept-3-enedioic acid
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid that is (Z)-6-aminohept-3-enedioic acid carrying additional hydroxy and oxovinyl substituents at positions 2 and 4 respectively.

name: tetranorbiotin
definition: A member of the class of thienoimidazoles that is 2-oxohexahydrothieno[3,4-d]imidazole carrying an additional carboxy group at position 4 (the 3aS,4R,6aR-diastereomer).

name: 2-trans-abscisic acid D-glucosyl ester
definition: An enoate ester that results from the condensation of the carboxylic acid group of 2-trans-abscisic acid with the anomeric hydroxy group of D-glucopyranose.

name: α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: An α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol) in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: An α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol) in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: (10Z,12E)-hexadecadienal
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty aldehyde that is hexadecadienal in which the two double bonds are located at positions 10 and 12 (the 10Z,12E-geoisomer).

name: N-hydroxy-MeIQx
definition: An imidazoquinoxaline that is 3H-imidazo[4,5-f]quinoxaline substituted at positions 3 and 8 by methyl groups and at position 2 by a hydroxyamino group. The active metabolite of the dietary carcinogen MeIQx.

name: 14(R),15(S)-DiHETE(1−)
definition: A DiHETE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 14(R),15(S)-DiHETE arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ochratoxin α
definition: A member of the class of isocoumarins that is 1-oxo-3,4-dihydro-2-benzopyran-7-carboxylic acid carrying additional methyl, chloro and hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 5 and 8 respectively. A non-toxic metabolite of the mycotoxin ochratoxin A.

name: 2-(acetoxyamino)-3-methylimidazo[4,5-f]quinoline
definition: An imidazoquinoline that is 3H-imidazo[4,5-f]quinoline substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and an acetoxyamino group at position 2. The active metabolite of the dietary carcinogen 3-methyl-3H-imidazo[4,5-f]quinolin-2-amine (IQ).

name: decarbamoylsaxitoxin
definition: A pyrrolopurine that is 2,6-diiminodecahydropyrrolo[1,2-c]purine carrying an additional hydroxymethyl substituent at position 4 as well as two hydroxy substituents at position 10. A toxin that is isolated from marine dinoflagellates and cyanobacteria and is known to cause paralytic shellfish poisoning.

name: N-hydroxy-PhIP
definition: An imidazopyridine that is 1H--imidazo[4,5-b]pyridine which is substituted at positions 1, 2, and 6 by methyl, hydoxyamino, and phenyl groups, respectively. The active metabolite of the dietary carcinogen PhIP.

name: ornaline
definition: A glutamic acid derivative in which one of the amino hydrogens of glutamic acid has been replaced by a 4-amino-1-carboxybutyl group.

name: 6-aminohexanoic acid cyclic oligomer
definition: A macrocyclic lactam obtained by cyclo-oligomerisation of 6-aminohexanoic acid.

name: piperazine adipate
definition: A piperazinium salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of piperazine and adipic acid.

name: clitidine
definition: A pyridine nucleoside comprising 4-imino-1,4-dihydro-3-pyridinecarboxylic acid as the nucleobase having the β-ribofuranosyl moiety attached at position 1. A toxin produced by poisonous mushrooms.

name: D-galactose 6-sulfate
definition: A monosaccharide sulfate that is D-galactose carrying a single sulfo substituent at position 6.

name: glycolaldehyde phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of glycolaldehyde phosphate; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 2,5-diiminio-3,4-bis(indol-3-yl)hexanedioate
definition: A zwitterion that is derived from 2,5-diimino-3,4-bis(indol-3-yl)hexanedioic acid by deprotonation of both carboxylic acid groups and protonation of both amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,4-bis(7-chloroindol-3-yl)-2,5-diiminiohexanedioate
definition: A zwitterion that is derived from 3,4-bis(7-chloroindol-3-yl)-2,5-diiminohexanedioic acid by deprotonation of both carboxylic acid groups and protonation of both amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5α-androst-1-ene-3,17-dione
definition: A 3-oxo Δ1-steroid that is androst-1-ene substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 17.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-19,20-epoxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-19,20-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,19Z)-16,17-epoxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,19Z)-16,17-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,16Z,19Z)-13,14-epoxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,16Z,19Z)-13,14-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10,11-epoxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10,11-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-19,20-epoxydocosatetraenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-19,20-epoxydocosatetraenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,19Z)-16,17-epoxydocosatetraenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (7Z,10Z,13Z,19Z)-16,17-epoxydocosatetraenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z,10Z,16Z,19Z)-13,14-epoxydocosatetraenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (7Z,10Z,16Z,19Z)-13,14-epoxydocosatetraenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10,11-epoxydocosatetraenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (7Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10,11-epoxydocosatetraenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-20-hydroxydocosapentaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-20-hydroxydocosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: lithocholate sulfate(2−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and sulfate functions of lithocholic acid sulfate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3S,5R,10R,12S,14S,15R,16R)-3,5,10,14,15-pentahydroxy-12,16-dimethylicosan-2-one
definition: A pentol that is 12,16-dimethylicosan-2-one in which the five hydroxy substituents are located at positions 3, 5, 10, 14 and 15.

name: 2-hydroxy-17β-estradiol 3-sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxy-17β-estradiol 3-sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group.

name: amoxicilloate
definition: A thiazolidinemonocarboxylate anion resulting from proton loss from the carboxy group located on the β-lactam ring of amoxicilloic acid.

name: sodium amoxicilloate
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of amoxicilloic acid.

name: amoxicilloyl-butylamine(1−)
definition: A thiazolidinemonocarboxylate formed by proton loss from the carboxy group of amoxicilloyl-butylamine.

name: amoxicilloyl-butylamine sodium salt
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of amoxicilloyl-butylamine.

name: (4Z,7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,17S,19Z)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosahexaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,17S,19Z)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,17S)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosapentaenoate
definition: A hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,17S)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosapentaenoate
definition: A hydroperoxydocosapentaenoate that is the conjugate base of (7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: amoxicilloyl polylysine
definition: Poly-L-lysine (n > 40) in which 50-70% of the ε-amino groups are substituted with amoxicilloyl groups.

name: tetraacetic acid lactone
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one which is substituted at positions 4 and 6 by hydroxy and acetonyl groups, respectively.

name: carlosic acid
definition: A tetronic acid derivative that is furan-2(5H)-one which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 5 by butanoyl, hydroxy, and carboxymethyl groups, respectively (the S enantiomer).

name: carlosic acid methyl ester
definition: The methyl ester of carlosic acid.

name: agglomerin F
definition: A butenolide that is the methyl ester of 4-(4-hydroxy-5-methylidene-2-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-3-yl)-4-oxobutanoic acid

name: benzylpenicilloyl-octa-L-lysine
definition: An oligopeptide that is octa-L-lysine (Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys) in which each lysine residue is substituted on the ε-nitrogen by a benzylpenicilloyl group; used in skin-testing for penicillin allergy.

name: 2,4-dihydroxy-3,5,6-trimethylbenzaldehyde
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde that is 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde in which all three phenyl hydrogens have been replaced by methyl groups.

name: 6-ethyl-2,4-dihydroxy-3,5-dimethylbenzaldehyde
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde that is 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde in which the hydrogens at positions 3, 5, and 6 have been replaced by methyl, methyl, and ethyl groups, respectively.

name: aflatoxin B1 dialdehyde(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of aflatoxin B1 dialdehyde, obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0).

name: nigerloxin
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid which is substituted at positions 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 by carbamoyl, hydroxy, E)-prop-1-en-1-yl, methyl, and methoxy groups, respectively. Obtained from solid-state fermentation of Aspergillus niger CFR-W-105, it inhibits soy bean lipoxygenase-1 (LOX-1) and rat lens aldose reductase (RLAR). It also shows free radical scavenging activity.

name: (2Z,4E)-3-(2-carboxy-1-hydroxyethyl)-2,4-hexadienedioic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid that is hexa-2,4-dienedioic acid which is substituted at position 3 by a 2-carboxy-1-hydroxyethyl group (the 2Z,4E isomer; a mixture of isomers at the carbon bearing the alcoholic hydroxy group). It has been produced from trans-caffeic acid using Aspergillus niger, but the conversion rate was increased 3.5 times by using a coculture of Streptomyces coelicolor and Aspergillus niger.

name: 12-oxo-6-trans-leukotriene B4(1−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of 12-oxo-6-trans-leukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Δ6-trans-12-epi-leukotriene B4(1−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of Δ6-trans-12-epi-leukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: S-(2,4-dinitrophenyl)glutathione(1−)
definition: An S-substituted glutathione(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the the two carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl amino group of S-(2,4-dinitrophenyl)glutathione. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 17α-ethynylestradiol 3-sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 17α-ethynylestradiol 3-sulfate arising from deprotonation of the sulfate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: prostaglandin D2 2-glyceryl ester
definition: A 2-monoglyceride resulting from the condensation of the carboxy group of prostaglandin D2 with the 2-hydroxy group of glycerol.

name: oxidised coenzyme F420-(γ-Glu)n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer derived from oxidised coenzyme F420-(γ-Glu)n. Major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: heptacosan-1-ol
definition: A very long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is heptacosane in which one of the terminal methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: O-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc}-L-threonine
definition: An O-glycosyl-L-threonine having N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine as the glycosyl component.

name: α-D-sedoheptulopyranose 7-phosphate
definition: A ketoheptose phosphate consisting of α-D-sedoheptulopyranose having a phosphate group at the 7-position.

name: α-D-sedoheptulopyranose 7-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of α-D-sedoheptulopyranose 7-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13(R)-HPODE(1−)
definition: A 13-HPODE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 13(R)-HPODE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z,11E,13R,15Z)-13-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid, obtained by the formal substitution of a hydrogen at position 13 of (9Z,11E,15Z)-octadeca-9,11,15-trienoic acid by a hydroperoxy group (the 13R-stereoisomer).

name: (9Z,11E,13R,15Z)-13-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoate
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (9Z,11E,13R,15Z)-13-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z,11R,12Z,15Z)-11-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid, obtained by the formal substitution of a hydrogen at position 11 of (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoic acid by a hydroperoxy group (the 11R-stereoisomer).

name: (9Z,11R,12Z,15Z)-11-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoate
definition: The monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of (9Z,11R,12Z,15Z)-11-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (9S,10E,12Z,14E,16S)-9,16-bis(hydroperoxy)octadecatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid that is (10E,12Z,14E)-octadecatrienoic acid carrying two hydroperoxy substituents at positions 9 and 16 (the 9S,16S-diastereomer).

name: (9S,10E,12Z,14E,16S)-9,16-bis(hydroperoxy)octadecatrienoate
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (9S,10E,12Z,14E,16S)-9,16-bis(hydroperoxy)octadecatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: N-oleoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-oleoylglycine. It is believed to be an intermediate in oleamide biosynthesis. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4'-O-methylnorbelladine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group of 4'-O-methylnorbelladine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: An α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol) in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: (4aS,10bR)-noroxomaritidine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group of (4aS,10bR)-noroxomaritidine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4aR,10bS)-noroxomaritidine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group of (4aR,10bS)-noroxomaritidine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: flupyradifurone
definition: A tertiary amino compound that is ammonia in which the nitrogens have been replaced by (6-chloropyridin-3-yl)methyl, 2,2-difluoroethyl, and 5-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-3-yl groups, respectively. A nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (AChR) agonist, it is used as an insecticide to control sucking pests in a variety of crops.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: An α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol) in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: An α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol) in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)
definition: An α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol) in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: norbelladine(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group of norbelladine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc(PP-Dol)

name: pelargonidin 3-O-sophoroside
definition: An anthocyanidin 3-O-sophoroside derived from pelargonidin

name: artemoin C
definition: An artemoin in which the two hydroxy groups on the C-30 side-chain are located at positions 15 and 16.

name: artemoin B
definition: An artemoin in which the two hydroxy groups on the C-30 side-chain are located at positions 17 and 18.

name: artemoin A
definition: An artemoin in which the two hydroxy groups on the C-30 side-chain are located at positions 19 and 20.

name: cohibin C
definition: A member of the class of cohibins in which the long-chain dihydroxyalkyl group at position 3 is specified as 15,16-dihydroxydotriacont-19-en-1-yl. NB The absolute configuration of the stereocentre at position 5 on the furanone ring is known to be S, but only the relative configuration of the diol moiety has been assigned as threo. It has not yet been established whether it is the (R,R)-diol (as shown here) or the (S,S)-diol.

name: cohibin D
definition: A member of the class of cohibins in which the long-chain dihydroxyalkyl group at position 3 is specified as 13,14-dihydroxydotriacont-17-en-1-yl. NB The absolute configuration of the stereocentre at position 5 on the furanone ring is known to be S, but only the relative configuration of the diol moiety has been assigned as threo. It has not yet been established whether it is the (R,R)-diol (as shown here) or the (S,S)-diol.

name: 11a-hydroxytetracycline
definition: A member of the class of tetracyclines obtained by selective hydroxylation at position 11a of tetracycline.

name: N-oleoyl-L-phenylalaninate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-oleoyl-L-phenylalanine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-oleoyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: An N-acyl-L-phenylalanine resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the amino group of L-phenylalanine.

name: N-arachidonoyl-L-phenylalaninate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-arachidonoyl-L-phenylalanine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide, a synthetic dimer of cellobiuronic acid in which the two β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl disaccharide units are linked (1→3)

name: 1-O-(6-thio-α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-hexacosanylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having a 6-thio-α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 6-thio-β-D-galactose
definition: A thiosugar that is β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 is replaced by a sulfanyl group.

name: 1,2-bis(octadec-9-enoyl)phosphatidic acid
definition: A phosphatidic acid (36:2) in which both acyl groups are specified as octadec-9-enoyl.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a trisaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucuronosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→4).

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a trisaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucuronosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→4).

name: N-oleoyl-L-serinate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-oleoyl-L-serine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpAOCH2CH2NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a trisaccharide consisting of β-D-glucuronosyl, β-D-glucosyl and β-D-glucuronosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→3).

name: N-oleoyl-L-glutaminate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-oleoyl-L-glutamine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a disaccharide consisting of β-D-glucuronosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked (1→4).

name: N-oleoyl-L-leucinate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-oleoyl-L-leucine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpAOCH2CH2NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a disaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl and β-D-glucuronosyl residues linked (1→4).

name: 2-aminoethyl β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of the monosaccharide β-D-glucopyranose.

name: 2-aminoethyl β-D-glucosiduronic acid
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of the monosaccharide derivative β-D-glucopyranuronic acid.

name: N-octadecanoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-octadecanoylglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]glycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]glycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,4-dioxine
definition: An oxacycle that is 4H-pyran in which the methylene group at position 4 is replaced by an oxygen. Non-aromatic.

name: 2,2',4,4',5,5'-hexabromobiphenyl
definition: A polybromobiphenyl that is biphenyl in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 2', 4, 4', 5, and 5' have been replace by bromines.

name: (8R,9E,11Z,14Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosatrienoate
definition: A hydroperoxyicosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (8R,9E,11Z,14Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-10-hydroperoxyicosatrienoate
definition: A hydroperoxyicosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (8Z,11Z,14Z)-10-hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (8Z,12E,14Z)-11-hydroperoxyicosatrienoate
definition: A hydroperoxyicosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (8Z,12E,14Z)-11-hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z,11Z,13S,15Z)-12,13-epoxyoctadecatrienoate
definition: An octadecanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (9Z,11Z,13S,15Z)-12,13-epoxyoctadecatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,9E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosapentaenoate
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (5Z,9E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosapentaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3

name: (4Z,7Z,11E,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10-hydroperoxydocosahexaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,11E,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10-hydroperoxydocosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3

name: N-palmitoyl dopamine
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the amino group of dopamine. It is present as an endogenous compound in the mammalian brain.

name: N-palmitoylserotonin
definition: An N-acylserotonin obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the primary amino group of serotonin.

name: fumonisin B6
definition: A fumonisin with formula C34H59NO14, originally isolated from Aspergillus niger and also found in unprocessed coffee beans.

name: Cu(I)-S-Mo(IV)(=O)O-NBIC Cluster
definition: A metal-sulfur-oxygen cluster with formula C5H9CuMoNO2S. Bound ligand.

name: 1,2,5,6,9,10-hexabromocyclododecane
definition: A bromoalkane consisting of cyclododecane bearing six bromo substituents at positions 1, 2, 5, 6, 9 and 10.

name: N-oleoylserotonin
definition: An N-acylserotonin obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleoic acid with the primary amino group of serotonin.

name: N-stearoylserotonin
definition: An N-acylserotonin obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of stearic acid with the primary amino group of serotonin. It has been found in the jejunum and ileum of pigs and mice.

name: N6-(pyridoxal phosphate)-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative that is the aldimine obtained via formal condensation of the side-chain amino group of L-lysine with the carbonyl group of pyridoxal phosphate.

name: (1→4)-6-phospho-α-D-glucan polyanion
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by global deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of (1→4)-6-phospho-α-D-glucan; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-butanoylserotonin
definition: An N-acylserotonin obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of butyric acid with the primary amino group of serotonin.

name: N-hexadecanoyl-1,2-dihexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine(1−)
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate group of N-hexadecanoyl-1,2-dihexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-[(11Z)-octadecenoyl]sphinganine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-octadecenoylsphinganine-1-phosphocholine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (11Z)-octadecenoic acid with the amino group of sphinganine-1-phosphocholine.

name: N-oleoylsphinganine-1-phosphocholine
definition: An N-octadecenoylsphinganine-1-phosphocholine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the amino group of sphinganine-1-phosphocholine.

name: 1-pentadecanoyl-2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as pentadecanoyl and octadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-pentadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as octadecanoyl and penttadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-tetradecanoyl-2-docosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as tetradecanoyl and docosanoyl respectively.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-icosanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl and icosanoyl respectively.

name: (5Z,8R,9E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosapentaenoate
definition: (5Z,9E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosapentaenoate in which the 8-hydroperoxy group has R-configuration.

name: 2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)-5-{[2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)ethyl]amino}-2-(propan-2-yl)pentanenitrile
definition: A secondary amino compound that is 3,4-dimethoxyphenylethylamine in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen has been replaced by a 4-cyano-4-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)-5-methylhexyl group.

name: (S)-norverapamil
definition: 2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)-5-{[2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)ethyl]amino}-2-(propan-2-yl)pentanenitrile that has S configuration.

name: (R)-norverapamil
definition: 2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)-5-{[2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)ethyl]amino}-2-(propan-2-yl)pentanenitrile that has R configuration.

name: arsenocholine
definition: An arsonium ion that is choline in which the central nitrogen has been replaced by arsenic.

name: (acetamidomethyl)phosphonate(1−)
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of (acetamidomethyl)phosphonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of one of the phosphonate OH groups. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: N2,3-ethenoguanine
definition: A nucleobase analogue obtained by addition of an etheno group across positions N2 and 3 of guanine.

name: 1,N2-ethenoguanine
definition: A nucleobase analogue obtained by addition of an etheno group across positions 1 and N2 of guanine.

name: (S)-(1-aminoethyl)phosphonate
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of (S)-(1-aminoethyl)phosphonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphonate OH groups and protonation of the amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: [(S)-1-acetamidoethyl]phosphonate(1−)
definition: An organophosphonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of [(1S)-1-acetamidoethyl]phosphonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of one of the phosphonate OH groups. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: O4-methylthymine
definition: A methylthymine in which the methyl group is located at the O4-position.

name: (R)-2-amino-4-oxopentanoic acid zwitterion
definition: A 2-amino-4-oxopentanoic acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of (R)-2-amino-4-oxopentanoic acid; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: N-arachidonoyl-L-leucinate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-arachidonoyl-L-leucine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-oxoadenine
definition: An oxopurine that is adenine bearing a single oxo substituent at position 8.

name: 8-hydroxyadenine
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is adenine bearing a single hydroxy substituent at position 8.

name: 4-methyladenine
definition: A methyladenine in which the methyl substituent is located at position 4.

name: CHIR-090
definition: An L-threonine derivative obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-({4-[(morpholin-4-yl)methyl]phenyl}ethynyl)benzoic acid with the amino group of N-hydroxy-L-threoninamide.

name: (9Z,11S,12Z,15Z)-11-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoate
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group of (9Z,11S,12Z,15Z)-11-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: α-muricholate
definition: A bile acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of α-muricholic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: presqualene monophosphate
definition: A triterpenyl phosphate that is presqualene in which the hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a monophosphate group.

name: β-muricholate
definition: A bile acid anion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy group of β-muricholic acid (i.e. the conjugate base of β-muricholic acid). It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-oleoyl-L-isoleucinate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-oleoyl-L-isoleucine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-oleoyl-L-glutamate(2−)
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy groups of N-oleoyl-L-glutamic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1β-hydroxydeoxycholate
definition: A cholanic acid anion, that is the conjugate base of 1β-hydroxydeoxycholic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-NADHX
definition: A tetrahydronicotinamide adenine dinucleotide obtained by formal stereo- and regioselective hydration across the 5,6-double bond in the nicotinyl ring of NADH, with the hydroxy group located at position 6, having (R)-configuration.

name: 2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of a glycerophosphoethanolamine. Positions 1 and 2 of sn-glycero-3-phospho-ethanolamine are substituted by geranylgeranyl groups.

name: all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: leucomethylene blue
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is 10H-phenothiazine in which the ring hydrogens at positions 3 and 7 have been replaced by dimethylamino groups.

name: pateamine
definition: A marine macrodiolide that is isolated from the sponge Mycale hentscheli and exhibits anticancer and antiviral properties

name: (S)-all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoate
definition: An all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoate that is the conjugate base of (S)-all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: all-trans-4-oxoretinoate
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-4-oxoretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: spirolaurenone
definition: A spirocyclic sesquiterpenoid that is isolated from the red alga Laurencia glandulifera.

name: capsiate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (6E)-8-methylnon-6-enoic acid with the benzylic hydroxy group of vanillyl alcohol. A non-pungent analogue of capsaicin with a similar biological profile.

name: 20-oxo-5-O-β-mycaminosyltylactone
definition: A macrolide antibiotic that is 20-oxotylactone having a β-D-mycaminosyl residue attached at position 5.

name: taxine B
definition: A diterpene alkaloid and potent cardiotoxin that is found in the leaves and berries of the European yew (Taxus baccata).

name: filiforminol
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpenoid that is isolated from the Australian marine alga Laurencia filiformis.

name: 16-oxohexadecanoic acid
definition: An ω-oxo fatty acid derived from hexadecanoic acid.

name: (2R,5Z)-4-methyl-5-[2-(phosphonooxy)ethylidene]-2,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazole-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A 2,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazole carrying carboxy-, methyl- and (2-phosphonooxy)ethylidene-substituents at positions 2, 4 and 5 respectively.

name: 3',5'-cyclic IMP(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 3',5'-cyclic IMP arising from deprotonation of the free phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-tembetarine
definition: A tembetarine obtained by methylation of the tertiary amino function of (R)-reticuline.

name: (S)-tembetarine
definition: A tembetarine obtained by methylation of the tertiary amino function of (R)-reticuline.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[P-6-[CH2]5NH2]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-GroA
definition: A synthetic disaccharide phosphate consisting of an α-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GlcNAc disaccharide linked glycosidically to O-2 of D-glyceric acid and connected to a 5-aminopentyl linker via a phospho group at O-6 of the reducing-end residue. Synthesized for immobilization on microarray surfaces and conjugation to carrier proteins as a potential vaccine candidate to protect from Clostridium difficile infections.

name: P-{α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[D-GroA-(2→1)]-α-D-GlcpNAc-6-yl}-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[P-6-[CH2]5NH2]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-GroA
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative with a dimeric structure in which two 2-O-[N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl]-D-glyceric acid units are linked via a phosphodiester bridge, the reducing-end GlcNAc residue also being connected at O-6 to a 5-aminopentyl linker via a further phosphodiester linkage.

name: guanylyl-(3'→5')-cytidine(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of guanylyl-(3'→5')-cytidine, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate group.

name: 2-methyl-D-serine
definition: The D-enantiomer of 2-methylserine.

name: 2-methylserine
definition: A hydroxy-amino acid that is serine which is substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: (R)-laudanosine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of (R)-laudanosine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-tetrahydropapaverine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of (R)-tetrahydropapaverine, obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-glaucine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of (R)-glaucine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-1,2,9,10-tetramethoxy-6-methylaporphine(1+)
definition: A aporphine alkaloid that is the quaternary ammonium ion obtained by methylation of the tertiary amino group of (S)-glaucine.

name: L-xylo-3-hexulose
definition: A ketohexose that is 1,2,4,5,6-pentahydroxyhexan-3-one having L-xylo-configuration.

name: bulbocapnine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of bulbocapnine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: muricholic acids
definition: A group of trihydroxy-5β-cholanic acids that are the 6,7-diastereoisomers of 3α,6,7-trihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oic acid.

name: N-methylbulbocapnine(1+)
definition: A aporphine alkaloid that is the quaternary ammonium ion obtained by methylation of the tertiary amino group of bulbocapnine.

name: dehydroluciferin
