name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14S,16Z,19Z,21R)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoate
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoate that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14S,16Z,19Z,21R)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14S,16Z,19Z,21S)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoate
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoate that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14S,16Z,19Z,21S)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14R,16Z,19Z,21R)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoate
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoate that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14R,16Z,19Z,21R)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14R,16Z,19Z,21S)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoate
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoate that is the conjugate base of (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14R,16Z,19Z,21S)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ethylisopropylamiloride
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is amiloride in which the amino substitutent of the pyrazine ring that is adjacent to the chloro substituent has been substituted by an ethyl group and by an isopropyl group.

name: 11-dehydro-thromboxane B2(1−)
definition: A thromboxane anion that is the conjugate base of 11-dehydro-thromboxane B2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: phenylhydrazine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of phenylhydrazine and hydrogen chloride.

name: (R)-2-(phosphonomethyl)malate(3−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the two carboxy and one of the phosphonate OH groups of (R)-2-(phosphonomethyl)malic acid. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (+)-sesamin monocatechol
definition: A catechol resulting from the hydrolysis of one of the two methylene acetal groups in (+)-sesamin. Found as a product of (+)-sesamin in rat liver homogenate and also produced from sesamin by an enzyme (SesA) found in Sinomonas species. no. 22 growing on sesamin.

name: (+)-sesamin dicatechol
definition: A furofuran that is (+)-sesamin in which both of the methylene acetals groups have been hydrolysed to afford the corresponding bis-catechol. Found as a product of (+)-sesamin in rat liver homogenate and also produced from sesamin by an enzyme (SesA) found in Sinomonas species. no. 22 growing on sesamin.

name: 20-hydroxy-20-oxoleukotriene B4-20-(β-D-glucuronide)(2−)
definition: A leukotriene anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid functions of 20-hydroxy-20-oxoleukotriene B4-20-(β-D-glucuronide); major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(indole-3-acetyl)glutamic acid
definition: An indoleacetic acid amide conjugate obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of indole-3-acetic acid with the amino group of glutamic acid.

name: benzyl β-primeveroside
definition: A 6-O-(β-D-xylopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranoside in which the anomeric substituent is specified as benzyl.

name: linalool 3,6-oxide primeveroside
definition: A disaccharide derivative obtained by formal condensation of the hydroxy group of linalool 3,6-oxide with the anomeric centre of β-D-xylosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucose

name: 2-phenylethyl β-primeveroside
definition: A 6-O-(β-D-xylopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranoside in which the anomeric substituent is specified as 2-phenylethyl.

name: linalool 3,7-oxide β-primeveroside
definition: 6-O-(β-D-xylopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranoside derived from linalool 3,7-oxide.

name: epiafzelechin 3-gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3R)-hydroxy group of epiafzelechin.

name: epicatechin 3-O-(3'-O-methylgallate)
definition: A gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3R)-hydroxy group of epicatechin.

name: 5'-deoxy-5'-(methylsulfinyl)adenosine
definition: A member of the class of adenosines obtained by replacement of the 5'-hydroxy group of adenosine by a methylsulfinyl group.

name: 1-O-caffeoylquinic acid
definition: An alkyl caffeate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-caffeic acid with the 1-hydroxy group of (−)-quinic acid.

name: (4aS,10bR)-noroxomaritidine
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is 4,4a-dihydro-3H,6H-5,10b-ethanophenanthridin-3-one carrying additional hydroxy and methoxy substituents at positions 8 and 9 respectively (the 4aS,10bR-diastereomer).

name: 2-galloyl-D-glucose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the 2-hydroxy group of D-glucose.

name: (4aR,10bS)-noroxomaritidine
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid that is 4,4a-dihydro-3H,6H-5,10b-ethanophenanthridin-3-one carrying additional hydroxy and methoxy substituents at positions 8 and 9 respectively (the 4aR,10bS-diastereomer).

name: N-(1-deoxy-1-fructosyl)phenylalanine
definition: An L-phenylalanine derivative in which one of the amino hydrogens of L-phenylalanine has been replaced by a 1-fructosyl group.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,16Z,19Z)-13,14-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid
definition: An EpDPE obtained by formal epoxidation across the 13,14-double bond of all-cis-docosa-4,7,10,13,16,19-hexaenoic acid.

name: (R)-dyspropterin
definition: A dyspropterin in which the stereocentre at position 6 has R-configuration.

name: (6R)-6-lactoyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydropterin
definition: A 6-lactoyl-5,6,7,8-tetrahydropterin in which the stereocentre at position 6 has R-configuration.

name: (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 24-sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 24-sulfate.

name: (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 3-sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 3-sulfate.

name: (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 3,24-disulfate(2−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo groups of (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 3,24-disulfate.

name: (4Z,7Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10,11-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid
definition: An EpDPE obtained by formal epoxidation across the 10,11-double bond of all-cis-docosa-4,7,10,13,16,19-hexaenoic acid.

name: (6R)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrobiopterin
definition: A 5,6,7,8-tetrahydrobiopterin in which the stereocentre at position 6 has R-configuration.

name: (6R)-5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate poly(γ-L-glutamate) macromolecule
definition: A 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate polyglutamate macromolecule in which the stereocentre at position 6 on the tetrahydrofolyl moiety has R-configuration.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-19,20-epoxydocosatetraenoic acid
definition: A epoxydocosatetraenoic acid obtained by formal epoxidation across the 19,20-double bond of (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoic acid.

name: (7Z,10Z,13Z,19Z)-16,17-epoxydocosatetraenoic acid
definition: A epoxydocosatetraenoic acid obtained by formal epoxidation across the 16,17-double bond of (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoic acid.

name: (7Z,10Z,16Z,19Z)-13,14-epoxydocosatetraenoic acid
definition: A epoxydocosatetraenoic acid obtained by formal epoxidation across the 13,14-double bond of (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoic acid.

name: 11-oxo-ETE-CoA(4−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 11-oxo-HETE-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 15-oxo-ETE-CoA(4−)
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 15-oxo-HETE-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cholesterol sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of cholesterol sulfate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-(indol-3-yl)acetic acid
definition: A member of the class of indole-3-acetic acids that is indole-3-acetic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. This is a very minor tautomer; the major tautomer is the corresponding oxindole.

name: 17β-estradiol 3-sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of 17β-estradiol 3-sulfate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10,11-epoxydocosatetraenoic acid
definition: A epoxydocosatetraenoic acid obtained by formal epoxidation across the 10,11-double bond of (7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosapentaenoic acid.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-20-hydroxydocosapentaenoic acid
definition: A hydroxydocosapentaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-docosapentaenoic acid in which the hydroxy group is located at position 20.

name: 2-hydroxy-17β-estradiol 3-sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is 2-hydroxy-17β-estradiol in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: (6R)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolyl-poly(γ-glutamate) macromolecule
definition: A tetrahydrofolyl-poly(glutamate) macromolecule in which the stereocentre at position 6 on the tetrahydrofolyl moiety has R-configuration.

name: (4Z,7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,17S,19Z)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosahexaenoic acid
definition: A docosanoid that is (4Z,7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid carrying two hydroperoxy substituents at positions 10 and 17.

name: 4-O-phosphonato-D-threonate(3−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of 4-O-phosphono-D-threonic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-erythronate
definition: An erythronate that is the conjugate base of D-erythronic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxo-4-(phosphonatooxy)butanoate(3−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of (S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxo-4-(phosphonooxy)butanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-2-hydroxy-3-oxo-4-(phosphonatooxy)butanoate(3−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of (R)-2-hydroxy-3-oxo-4-(phosphonooxy)butanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,17S)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosapentaenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxydocosapentaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,11Z,13Z,15E)-docosapentaenoic acid carrying two hydroperoxy substituents at positions 10 and 17.

name: (7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-10,17-bis(hydroperoxy)docosapentaenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxydocosapentaenoic acid that is (7Z,11Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosapentaenoic acid carrying two hydroperoxy substituents at positions 10 and 17.

name: 12-oxo-6-trans-leukotriene B4
definition: A leukotriene consisting of 6-trans-leukotriene B4 having a 12-keto group in place of the 12-hydroxy group.

name: 3-amino-D-alanine
definition: A 3-aminoalanine that has R configuration.

name: 3-amino-D-alanine zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the β-amino group of 3-amino-D-alanine. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 17α-ethynylestradiol 3-sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is 17α-ethynylestradiol in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: (1→4)-6-phospho-α-D-glucan
definition: A glucan derivative that is (1→4)-α-D-glucan in which the 6-position of the repeating unit has been phosphorylated.

name: cyclohexyl isocyanate
definition: An isocyanate comprising a cyclohexane core with a single isocyanato substituent.

name: N-arachidonoyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: An N-acyl-L-phenylalanine resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of arachidonic acid with the amino group of L-phenylalanine.

name: theaflavin
definition: A biflavonoid that is 3,4,5-trihydroxybenzocyclohepten-6-one which is substituted at positions 1 and 8 by (2R,3R)-3,5,7-trihydroxy-3,4-dihydro-2H-chromen-2-yl groups. It is the main red pigment in black tea.

name: N-oleoyl-L-serine
definition: An L-serine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the amino group of L-serine.

name: N-oleoyl-L-glutamine
definition: An L-glutamine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the amino group of L-glutamine.

name: N-oleoyl-L-leucine
definition: An L-leucine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the amino group of L-leucine.

name: N-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]glycine
definition: A fatty acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-hexadecenoic acid with the amino group of glycine.

name: N-octadecanoylglycine
definition: A fatty acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of octadecanoic acid with the amino group of glycine.

name: (8R,9E,11Z,14Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid that is (9E,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the hydroperoxy substituent is located at position 8R.

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-10-hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid that is (8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the hydroperoxy substituent is located at position 10.

name: (8Z,12E,14Z)-11-hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid that is (8Z,12E,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the hydroperoxy substituent is located at position 11.

name: (5Z,8R,9Z,11Z,14Z)-8,9-epoxyicosatetraenoic acid
definition: An EpETE that is (5Z,9Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid in which the epoxide function is located across positions 8 and 9.

name: (9Z,11Z,13S,15Z)-12,13-epoxyoctadecatrienoic acid
definition: An octadecanoid that is (9Z,11Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoic acid having an epoxy group located across positions 12 and 13.

name: estrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of estrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 16α-hydroxyestrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of 16α-hydroxyestrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 16α-hydroxyestrone 16-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of 16α-hydroxyestrone 16-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A hydroxyoctadecanoic acid that is octadecanoic acid (stearic acid) which has been substituted by a hydroxy group at position 9.

name: testosterone 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of testosterone 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3R)-1,2-didehydro-3-hydroxy-16-methoxy-2,3-dihydrotabersoninium
definition: An indole alkaloid cation that is the conjugate acid of (3R)-1,2-didehydro-3-hydroxy-16-methoxy-2,3-dihydrotabersonine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 17β-estradiol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of 17β-estradiol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 17α-estradiol 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of 17α-estradiol 7-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: estriol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of estriol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: estriol 16-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of estriol 16-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 20-hydroxyprostaglandin E2(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 20-hydroxyprostaglandin E2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13(S)-HETE(1−)
definition: A 13-HETE anion that is the conjugate base of 13(S)-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13(R)-HODE(1−)
definition: A 13-HODE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 13(R)-HODE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,9E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosapentaenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is (5Z,9E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosapentaenoic acid in which the hydroperoxy group is located at position 8.

name: (4Z,7Z,11E,13Z,16Z,19Z)-10-hydroperoxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A docosanoid that is (4Z,7Z,11E,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid carrying a hydroperoxy substituent at position 10.

name: 3-[2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]-4-(phenylthio)bicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-en-2-one
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is bicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-en-2-one which is substituted at positions 3 and 4 by 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl and phenylthio groups, respectively.

name: (1R,5S)-benzobicyclon
definition: A 3-[2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]-4-(phenylthio)bicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-en-2-one that has (1R,5S) configuration. The proherbicide benzobicyclon is a racemate consisting of equimolar amounts of this compound and its enantiomer.

name: (1S,5R)-benzobicyclon
definition: A 3-[2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]-4-(phenylthio)bicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-en-2-one that has (1S,5R) configuration. The proherbicide benzobicyclon is a racemate consisting of equimolar amounts of this compound and its enantiomer.

name: 20-hydroxyprostaglandin E1(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 20-hydroxyprostaglandin E1, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8R,9E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosapentaenoic acid
definition: (5Z,9E,11Z,14Z,17Z)-8-hydroperoxyicosapentaenoic acid in which the 8-hydroperoxy group has R-configuration.

name: 20-hydroxyprostaglandin A1(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 20-hydroxyprostaglandin A1, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8-nitroguanosine 3',5'-cyclic monophosphate
definition: A 3',5'-cyclic purine nucleotide that is guanosine 3',5'-cyclic monophosphate in which the hydrogen at position 8 on the purine fragment has been replaced by a nitro group.

name: eupatorin
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is 6-hydroxyluteolin in which the phenolic hydogens at positions 4', 6 and 7 have been replaced by methyl groups.

name: (R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-oxobutanoate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-oxobutanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-oxobutanoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (S)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-oxobutanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-2,4-dihydroxy-3-oxobutanoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (S)-2,4-dihydroxy-3-oxobutanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: guanylyl-(3'→5')-cytidine
definition: A (3'→5')-dinucleotide composed from guanosine and cytidine units.

name: N-hexadecanoyl-1,2-dihexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the N- and O-acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: epitestosterone 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide)(1−)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of epitestosterone 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (acetamidomethyl)phosphonic acid
definition: A member of the class of acetamides obtained by formal condensation of acetic acid with the amino group of (aminomethyl)phosphonic acid.

name: (S)-(1-aminoethyl)phosphonic acid
definition: A primary amino compound that is phosphonic acid having a 1-aminoethyl group attached to the phosphorus.

name: (E)-2-methoxycinnamic acid
definition: A member of the class of cinnamic acids that is trans-cinnamic acid carrying a methoxy substituent at position 2 on the benzene ring.

name: [(S)-1-acetamidoethyl]phosphonic acid
definition: A member of the class of acetamides obtained by formal condensation of acetic acid with the amino group of (S)-(1-aminoethyl)phosphonic acid.

name: 4',7-dihydroxyflavanone
definition: A dihydroxyflavanone in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at positions 4' and 7.

name: (R)-2-amino-4-oxopentanoic acid
definition: A D-alanine derivative in which one of the methyl hydrogens of D-alanine has been replaced by an acetyl group.

name: β-guanidino-L-alanine
definition: A L-alanine derivative in which one of the methyl hydrogens of L-alanine has been replaced by a guanidino group.

name: L-β-homomethionine
definition: A β-amino acid that is (3R)-3-aminopentanoic acid in which one of the terminal methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a methylsulfanyl group.

name: tembetarine
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion obtained by methylation of the tertiary amino function of reticuline.

name: N-arachidonoyl-L-leucine
definition: An L-leucine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of arachidonic acid with the amino group of L-leucine.

name: (9Z,11S,12Z,15Z)-11-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid, obtained by the formal substitution of a hydrogen at position 11 of (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoic acid by a hydroperoxy group (the 11S-stereoisomer).

name: 2,3-bis-O-(geranylgeranyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A dialkylglycerophosphoethanolamine in which both alkyl groups are specified as geranylgeranyl.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-L-tyrosine
definition: An O4'-glycosyl-L-tyrosine in which the glycosyl group is specified as N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl.

name: haloxyfop-P(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy group of haloxyfop-P.

name: (S)-haloxyfop
definition: A 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoic acid that has S configuration. It is the least-active enantiomer of the (racemic) herbicide haloxyfop.

name: 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is 2-phenoxypropanoic acid in which the hydrogen at the para position of the phenyl ring has been replaced by a [3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy group.

name: haloxyfop-P-sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal reaction of haloxyfop-P with 1 mol eq. of sodium hydride.

name: (S)-haloxyfop-sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt resulting from the formal reaction of (S)-haloxyfop with 1 mol eq. of sodium hydride. The agrochemical herbicide haloxyfop-sodium is an equimolar mixture of (S)-haloxyfop-sodium and its enantiomer.

name: 3-oxochenodeoxycholoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of 3-oxochenodeoxycholoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: S-adenosyl-S-carboxymethyl-L-homocysteine
definition: A sulfonium compound that is S-adenosyl-L-methionine in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a carboxy group.

name: 3-oxocholoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of 3-oxocholoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxodeoxycholoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of 3-oxodeoxycholoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ximelagatran (hydroxylamine form)
definition: A member of the class of azetidines that is melagatran in which the carboxylic acid group has been converted into the corresponding ethyl ester and in which the amidine group has been converted to the corresponding hydroxylamine. Tautomeric with the oxime form of ximelagatran.

name: 3-oxocholan-24-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of 3-oxolithocholoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-propanoyl-L-methioninate
definition: An N-(fatty acyl)-L-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-propanoyl-L-methionine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Gln-Tyr-Ile-Lys-Ala-Asn-Ser-Lys-Phe-Ile-Gly-Ile-Thr-Glu-Leu
definition: An oligopeptide composed of L-glutamine, L-tyrosine, L-isoleucine, L-lysine, L-alanine, L-asparagine, L-serine, L-lysine, L-phenylalanine, L-isoleucine, glycine, L-isoleucine, L-threonine, L-glutamic acid and L-leucine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Pro-Arg-Tyr-Val-Lys-Gln-Asn-Thr-Leu-Lys-Leu-Ala-Thr
definition: An oligopeptide composed of L-proline, L-arginine, L-tyrosine, L-valine, L-lysine, L-glutamine, L-asparagine, L-threonine, L-leucine, L-lysine, L-leucine, L-alanine and L-threonine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: N-oleoyl-L-isoleucine
definition: An L-isoleucine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: pivaloyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A short chain fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of pivaloyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-oleoyl-L-glutamic acid
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the amino group of L-glutamic acid.

name: Asn-Pro-Val-Val-His-Phe-Phe-Lys-Asn-Ile-Val-Thr-Pro-Arg-Thr-Pro-Pro-Pro-Ser
definition: An oligopeptide composed of L-asparagine, L-proline, L-valine, L-valine, L-histidine, L-phenylalanine, L-phenylalanine, L-lysine, L-asparagine, L-isoleucine, L-valine, L-threonine, L-proline, L-arginine, L-threonine, L-proline, L-proline, L-proline and L-serine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: (S)-haloxyfop(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from deprotonation of the carboxy group of (S)-haloxyfop.

name: methyl 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate
definition: The methyl ester of 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoic acid.

name: N-(2-oxindole-3-acetyl)-L-aspartic acid
definition: An N-acyl-L-aspartic acid in which the acyl group is specified as 2-oxindole-3-acetyl.

name: 1β-hydroxydeoxycholic acid
definition: A trihydroxy-5β-cholanic acid in which the three hydroxy groups are located at positions 1β, 3α, and 12α.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, β-D-galactosyl, β-D-glucuronosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4).

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpOCH2CH2N3
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-azidoethyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide (Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype 3 tetrasaccharide) consisting of two β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl disaccharide units linked (1→3).

name: 2-((5-(hydroxyamino)furan-2-yl)methylene)hydrazinecarboxamide
definition: A member of the class of furans obtained by reduction of the 5-nitro group of nitrofurazone to the corresponding hydroxylamine.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAcOCH2CH2N3
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-azidoethyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide (Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype 14 tetrasaccharide) consisting of at the reducing end an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue to which are linked (1→4) and (1→6) respectively a β-D-glucose residue and a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl disaccharide unit.

name: haloxyfop-P-methyl
definition: A methyl 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate that has R configuration. It is a proherbicide (by hydrolysis of the methyl ester) for the herbicide haloxyfop-P, the most active enantiomer of the racemic herbicide haloxyfop.

name: (S)-all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoic acid
definition: An all-trans-4-hydroxyretinoic acid in which the 4-hydroxy group has S-configuration.

name: (S)-haloxyfop-methyl
definition: A methyl 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate that has S configuration. It is the (much less active) enantiomer of the proherbicide haloxyfop-P-methyl.

name: (R)-laudanosine
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is (R)-tetrahydropapaverine in which the amino hydrogen has been replaced by a methyl group

name: (R)-tetrahydropapaverine
definition: The R-enantiomer of tetrahydropapaverine.

name: 2-ethoxyethyl 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 2-ethoxyethanol.

name: haloxyfop-P-etotyl
definition: A 2-ethoxyethyl 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate that has R configuration.

name: (S)-haloxyfop-etotyl
definition: A 2-ethoxyethyl 2-(4-{[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]oxy}phenoxy)propanoate that has S configuration.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide consisting of α-D-galactosyl, β-D-glucuronosyl, β-D-glucosyl and α-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4).

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GalpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: An α-D-galactoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-glucuronosyl, β-D-glucosyl, α-D-glucosyl and α-D-galactosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4).

name: 2-O-[α-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-α-D-glucosyl]-D-glycerate
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion that is the conjugate base of 2-O-[α-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-α-D-glucosyl]-D-glyceric acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-O-[6-O-octanoyl-α-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-α-D-glucosyl]-D-glycerate
definition: A carbohydrate acid derivative anion that is the conjugate base of 2-O-[6-O-octanoyl-α-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-α-D-glucosyl]-D-glyceric acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpAO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, α-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucuronosyl and α-D-galactosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4).

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GalpO[CH2]2NH2
definition: An α-D-galactoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-glucuronosyl, β-D-glucosyl, α-D-glucosyl and α-D-galactosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4).

name: 5-phospho-D-xylonic acid
definition: An aldonic acid phosphate that is D-xylonic acid carrying a single phosphate group at the 5-position.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GalpO[CH2]2NH2
definition: An α-D-galactoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a disaccharide consisting of α-D-glucosyl and α-D-galactosyl residues linked (1→4).

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide consisting of α-D-glucosyl, α-D-galactosyl, β-D-glucuronosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4).

name: 5-phospho-D-xylonate (3−)
definition: A 4-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of 5-phospho-D-xylonic acid. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: D-xylono-1,4-lactone-5-phosphate
definition: A aldonolactone phosphate that is D-xylono-1,4-lactone carrying a single phospho substituent at position 5.

name: D-xylono-1,4-lactone-5-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-xylono-1,4-lactone-5-phosphate. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: L-arabino-1,4-lactone-5-phosphate
definition: A aldonolactone phosphate that is L-arabino-1,4-lactone carrying a single phospho substituent at position 5.

name: L-arabino-1,4-lactone-5-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of L-arabino-1,4-lactone-5-phosphate. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 5-phospho-L-arabinonic acid
definition: An arabinonic acid derivative that is L-arabinonic acid carrying a single phospho substituent at position 5.

name: Ac-Tyr-Val-Ala-Asp-7-amino-4-trifluoromethylcoumarin
definition: A tetrapeptide obtained by formal condensation of the C-terminal carboxy group of Ac-Tyr-Val-Ala-Asp with the amino group of 7-amino-4-trifluoromethylcoumarin.

name: 5-phospho-L-arabinonate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of 5-phospho-L-arabinonic acid. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (22E)-3-oxochola-4,22-dien-24-oyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (22E)-3-oxo-chola-4,22-dien-24-oyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a disaccharide consisting of a β- and an α-D-glucosyl residue linked (1→4).

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GalpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a trisaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, α-D-glucosyl and α-D-galactosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4).

name: L-α-phenylglycine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-α-phenylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-L-α-phenylglycinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-L-α-phenylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9R,10S)-dihydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is octadecanoic acid in which the two hydroxy groups are located at positions 9R and 10S.

name: 24-epi-cathasterone-22-O-sulfate
definition: A brassinosteroid that is 24-epi-cathasterone on which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 22 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: 26,27-dehydrozymosterol
definition: A cholestanoid that zymosterol in which the two methyl groups at positions 26 and 27 have been replaced by a cyclopropane ring.

name: S-(6-methylthiohexylhydroximoyl)glutathione
definition: An S-substituted glutathione in which the thiol hydrogen of glutathoine has been replaced by a 6-methylthiohexylhydroximoyl group.

name: 2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid 5-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 2,5-dihydroxybenzoic acid in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: 1,2-dihexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol-3'-phosphate)
definition: A 3-(3-sn-phosphatidyl)-sn-glycerol 1-phosphate in which both phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: 1-naphthyl β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a 1-naphthyl group.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GalpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a tetrasaccharide consisting of two β-D-glucosyl residues, an α-D-glucosyl residue and (at the reducing end) an α-D-galactosyl residue, all linked sequentially (1→4).

name: S-(4-hydroxy-1-oxononan-3-yl)cysteinylglycine
definition: A dipeptide that is cysteinylglycine in which the thiol hydrogen has been replaced by a 4-hydroxy-1-oxononan-3-yl group.

name: quercetin 3-β-gentiobioside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 3 of quercetin has been replaced by a gentiobiosyl group.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GalpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a pentasaccharide consisting of α-D-galactosyl, β-D-glucuronosyl, β-D-glucosyl, α-D-glucosyl and α-D-galactosyl residues, all linked sequentially (1→4).

name: quercetin 3-β-gentiotrioside
definition: A quercetin O-glycoside in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 3 of quercetin has been replaced by a gentiotriosyl group.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GalpOCH2CH2NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a hexasaccharide consisting of α-D-glucosyl, α-D-galactosyl, β-D-glucuronosyl, β-D-glucosyl, α-D-glucosyl and α-D-galactosyl residues, all linked sequentially (1→4).

name: 3-[(1Z,4R)-4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-ylidene]pyruvate
definition: A 3-(4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-ylidene)pyruvate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3-[(1Z,4R)-4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-ylidene]pyruvic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-[(1R,4R)-4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-yl]pyruvate
definition: A tetrahydro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3-[(1R,4R)-4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-yl]pyruvic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-[(1S,4R)-4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-yl]pyruvate
definition: A tetrahydro-4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3-[(1S,4R)-4-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-yl]pyruvic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: kaempferol 3-β-gentiobioside
definition: A kaempferol O-glucoside in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 3 of kaempferol has been replaced by a gentiobiosyl group.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-[(3E)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol (18:1/16:1) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as oleoyl and (3E)-hexadecenoyl respectively.

name: 1-linoleoyl-2-[(3E)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol (18:2/16:1) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as linoleoyl and (3E)-hexadecenoyl respectively.

name: 1-α-linolenoyl-2-[(3E)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol (18:3/16:1) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as α-linolenoyl and (3E)-hexadecenoyl respectively.

name: 1-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-2-(7Z,10Z,13Z-hexadecatrienoyl)-3-β-D-galactosyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A monogalactosyldiacylglycerol 34:4 in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as oleoyl and (7Z,10Z,13Z)-hexadecatrienoyl respectively.

name: 1,2-di-(α-linolenoyl)-3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-sn-glycerol
definition: A 3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are both specified as α-linolenoyl.

name: 1,2-dilinoleoyl-3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-sn-glycerol
definition: A 3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are both specified as linoleoyl.

name: 1-(9Z,12Z,15Z-octadecatrienoyl)-2-hexadecanoyl-3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-sn-glycerol
definition: A 3-[α-D-galactosyl-(1→6)-β-D-galactosyl]-1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as α-linolenoyl and hexadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-α-linolenoyl-2-hexadecanoylphosphatidylglycerol
definition: A phosphatidylglycerol (18:3/16:0) in which the 1- and 2-acyl groups are specified as α-linolenoyl and hexadecanoyl respectoively.

name: (9Z,11E,13S,14Z)-13-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid that is (9Z,11E,14Z)-octadecatrienoic acid in which the hydroperoxy group is located at position 13S.

name: 3-methoxybenzaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes in which the hydrogen at position 3 of benzaldehyde has been replaced by a methoxy group.

name: flamenol
definition: A member of the class of resorcinols that is phloroglucinol in which one of the phenolic hydrogens has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: α-allenylagmatine
definition: A member of the class of guanidines that is agmatine in which one of the methylene hydrogens adjacent to the primary amino group has been replaced by an allenyl group.

name: carboxymethyl-CoA
definition: An S-alkyl-CoA having carboxymethyl as the S-alkyl component.

name: 2-hydroxyethyl hexadecanoate
definition: A hexadecanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of carboxy group of hexadecaoic acid with one of the hydroxy groups of ethylene glycol

name: 12-hydroxyjasmonates
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12-hydroxyjasmonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12-sulfojasmonate
definition: A 5-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and sulfate groups of 12-sulfojasmonic acid. Major species at pH 7.3

name: 11-hydroxyjasmonate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12-hydroxyjasmonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11-sulfojasmonate
definition: A 5-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and sulfate groups of 11-sulfojasmonic acid. Major species at pH 7.3

name: 1,3-dioctanoylglycerol
definition: A 1,3-diglyceride in which both acyl groups are specified as octanoyl.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol-3'-phosphate)
definition: A 3-(3-sn-phosphatidyl)-sn-glycerol 1-phosphate in which the phosphatidyl acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl and hexadecanoyl respectively.

name: β-Asp-Glu
definition: A dipeptide consisting of an L-aspartyl residue attached to L-glutamic acid via the β-carboxy group.

name: N-isovaleryl-L-alanine
definition: An N-acyl-L-alanine resulting from the formal condensation of carboxy group of isovaleric acid with the amino group of L-alanine.

name: 5-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A hydroxyoctadecanoic acid that is octadecanoic acid (stearic acid) in which one of the hydrogens at position 5 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: cyclobis-(1→6)-α-nigerosyl
definition: A cyclic tetrasaccharide constructed from four α-glucopyranosyl residues joined by alternate α-(1→6)- and α-(1→3)-linkages.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotetrose composed of two isomaltose units joined by an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: mandelamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is phenylacetamide in which one of the benzylic hydrogens has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (E)-1-(glycyl-L-cystein-S-yl)-ω-(methylthio)alkylhydroximate zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of any (E)-1-(glycyl-L-cystein-S-yl)-ω-(methylthio)alkylhydroximate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: xanthogalenol
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 2' and 6', a methoxy group at position 4' and a prenyl group at position 3'.

name: 4'-O-methylxanthohumol
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2' and 4, methoxy group at positions 4' and 6' and a prenyl group at position 3'.

name: 1-aci-nitro-2-(phenyl)ethane
definition: An aci-nitro compound resulting from the formal tautomerisation of the nitro group of (2-nitroethyl)benzene.

name: S-[(Z)-N-hydroxy-2-phenylethanimidoyl]-L-cysteinylglycine zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of S-[(Z)-N-hydroxy-2-phenylethanimidoyl]-L-cysteinylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: S-[(E)-N-hydroxy-2-(indol-3-yl)ethanimidoyl]-L-cysteinylglycine zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of S-[(E)-N-hydroxy-2-(indol-3-yl)ethanimidoyl]-L-cysteinylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Cys(IAN)-Gly zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of Cys(IAN)-Gly; major species at pH 7.3.

name: glycolaldehyde triphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by removal of four protons from the triphosphate function of glycolaldehyde triphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-sulfenohercynine
definition: A L-histidine derivative that is ergothioneine in which the thiol hydrogen has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (R)-cyflumetofen
definition: A 2-methoxyethyl 2-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-cyano-3-oxo-3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propanoate that has R configuration.

name: (S)-cyflumetofen
definition: A 2-methoxyethyl 2-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-cyano-3-oxo-3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propanoate that has S configuration.

name: 2-methoxyethyl 2-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-2-cyano-3-oxo-3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propanoate
definition: A nitrile that is acetonitrile in which the methyl hydrogens have been replaced by o-trifluoromethylbenzoyl, p-tert-butylphenyl, and (2-methoxyethoxy)carbonyl groups.

name: pheophytin a(1−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion that is the carbanion obtained by removal of the acidic proton from position 21 of pheophytin a. Major species at pH 7.3

name: nickel-sirohydrochlorin(8−)
definition: A cyclic tetrapyrrole anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of nickel-sirohydrochlorin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tenuazonic acid(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the carbanion obtained by removal of the acidic proton from position 3 of tenuazonic acid; major speies at pH 7.3.

name: AP20187
definition: A tertiary amino compound that is 2-(aminomethyl)-N,N-dimethylpropane-1,3-diamine in which the primary ammino groups have each been acylated by condensation with the carboxy group of 2-{3-[(1R)-3-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)-1-hydroxypropyl]phenoxy}acetic acid, the hydroxy groups of which have been esterified by condensation with the carboxy group of L-pipecolic acid, the nitrogen of which has been acylated by condensation with (2S)-2-(3,4,5-trimethoxyphenyl)butyric acid. It is a synthetic, cell-permeable ligand that can be used to induce homodimerization of fusion proteins containing the DmrB domain.

name: colupulone
definition: A β-bitter acid in which the acyl group is specified as isobutanoyl.

name: adlupulone
definition: A β-bitter acid in which the acyl group is specified as 2-methylbutanoyl.

name: 9,9-bis(4-hydroxyphenyl)fluorene

name: 8,9-epoxy-(5Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl-CoA

name: 6β,16α,17α-trihydroxyprogesterone

name: 11,12-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl-CoA

name: 14,15-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoyl-CoA

name: cholesta-5,7-dien-3β,25-diol

name: cholesta-5,7-dien-3β,24S-diol

name: cholestanol 7α,8α-epoxide

name: LY-2157299
definition: A pyrrolopyrazole that is 5,6-dihydro-4H-pyrrolo[1,2-b]pyrazole which is substituted at positions 2 and 3 by 6-methylpyridin-2-yl and 6-(aminocarbonyl)quinolin-4-yl groups, respectively. name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc(2−)

name: Na2[β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc]

name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-OMe

name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-OMe(2−)

name: Na2[β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-OMe]

name: β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-OMe

name: β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-OMe(1−)

name: Na[β-D-GlcA-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-OMe]

name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-[CH2]2NHC(O)[CH2]3SH

name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-[CH2]2NHC(O)[CH2]3SH(2−)
definition: The carbohydrate acid derivative anion formed from β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-[CH2]2NHC(O)[CH2]3SH by loss of two protons, one from each of its sulfo and carboxy groups.

name: 1β-hydroxytestosterone
definition: An androstanoid that is testosterone carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at the 1β-position. A metabolite of testosterone.

name: 2β-hydroxytestosterone
definition: An androstanoid that is testosterone carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at the 2β-position.

name: Na2[β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-[CH2]2NHC(O)[CH2]3SH]
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OC6H4-4-[CH2]2NHC(O)[CH2]3SH.

name: CORM 3
definition: A ruthenium coordination entity that acts as a water-soluble carbon monoxide-releasing molecule.

name: 12-[(9Z)-octadecenoyloxy]octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the hydroxy group of 12-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 13-[(9Z)-octadecenoyloxy]octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the hydroxy group of 13-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 9-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyloxy]octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-hexadecenoic acid with the hydroxy group of 9-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 12-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyloxy]octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-hexadecenoic acid with the hydroxy group of 12-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 13-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyloxy]octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-hexadecenoic acid with the hydroxy group of 13-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OMe
definition: A β-D-galactoside that is the methyl glycoside of a disaccharide consisting of a 3-O-sulfo-β-D-glucuronic acid residue linked (1→3) to β-D-galactose.

name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OMe(2−)
definition: The carbohydrate acid derivative anion formed from β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OMe by loss of two protons, one from each of its sulfo and carboxy groups.

name: 12-(octadecanoyloxy)octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of octadecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 12-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: Na2[β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OMe]
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the disodium salt of β-D-GlcA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-OMe.

name: 13-(octadecanoyloxy)octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of octadecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 13-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 9-(octadecanoyloxy)octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of octadecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 9-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 5-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyloxy]octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-hexadecenoic acid with the hydroxy group of 5-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 5-[(9Z)-octadecenoyloxy]octadecanoic acid
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-octadecenoic acid with the hydroxy group of 5-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 5,6-epoxy-(8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 5,6-epoxy-(8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid.

name: 5-dehydro-L-gluconate
definition: A ketogluconate that is the conjugate base of 5-dehydro-L-gluconic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: (2ξ)-3-deoxy-7-O-phospho-β-D-threo-hept-6-ulopyranosonic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid phosphate consisting of (2ξ)-3-deoxy-β-D-threo-hept-6-ulopyranosonic acid carrying a single phospho substituent at position 7.

name: 17β-hydroxy-5α-estr-1(10)-en-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo-5α-steroid that is 5α-estrane which is substituted by an oxo group at position 3, a hydroxy group at the 17β position, and which has a double bond between positions 1 and 10. It is a 19-norsteroid arising from successive oxidation of dihydrotestosterone at C19.

name: 5-hydroxy-(6E,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 5-hydroxy-(6E,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid.

name: 12-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,10E,14Z)-icosatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 12-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,10E,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid.

name: JQ1
definition: A member of the class of thienotriazolodiazepines that is the tert-butyl ester of [(6S)-4-(4-chlorophenyl)-2,3,9-trimethyl-6H-thieno[3,2-f][1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a][1,4]diazepin-6-yl]acetic acid. name: N-carbamoyl-L-methioninate
definition: An N-carbamoyl-L-α-amino acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-carbamoyl-L-methionine. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-5-[2-(methylthio)ethyl]hydantoin
definition: An L-5-monosubstituted hydantoin in which the substituent is specified as 2-(methylthio)ethyl.

name: myristamide
definition: A fatty amide of myristic acid.

name: 8-[(1S,2S)-3-oxo-2-{(Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl}cyclopentyl]octanoic acid
definition: An 8-{3-oxo-2-[(2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl]cyclopentyl}octanoic acid that has 1S,2S-configuration.

name: 15-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z,13E)-icosatetraenoyl-CoA
definition: An unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 15-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z,13E)-icosatetraenoic acid.

name: (R)-5-[2-(methylthio)ethyl]hydantoin
definition: A D-5-monosubstituted hydantoin in which the substituent is specified as 2-(methylthio)ethyl.

name: N-carbamoyl-D-methioninate
definition: An N-carbamoyl-D-α-amino acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-carbamoyl-D-methionine. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19R,20S)-19,20-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid

name: (S)-6-acetamido-3-aminohexanoic acid zwitterion
definition: A 6-acetamido-3-aminohexanoic acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of (3S)-6-acetamido-3-aminohexanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 16(R)-HETE(1−)
definition: A 16-HETE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 16(R)-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 16(S)-HETE(1−)
definition: A 16-HETE(1−) that is the conjugate base of 16(S)-HETE, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of both free diphosphate OH groups of α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFoO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of four N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2), (1→3) and (1→2) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: prostaglandin E2 2-glyceryl ester
definition: A 2-monoglyceride obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of prostaglandin E2 with the 2-hydroxy group of glycerol.

name: α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFoO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of three N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2) and (1→3) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFoO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of three N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→2) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFoO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of two N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked (1→3) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: prostaglandin I2 2-glyceryl ester
definition: A 2-monoglyceride obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of prostaglandin I2 with the 2-hydroxy group of glycerol.

name: prostaglandin F2α 2-glyceryl ester
definition: A 2-monoglyceride obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of prostaglandin F2α with the 2-hydroxy group of glycerol.

name: α-D-Rhap2,3Me24NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFoO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of an N-formyl-2,3-di-O-methyl-α-D-perosamine residue linked (1→3) to an N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residue which is linked glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19S,20R)-19,20-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid
definition: A (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)-19,20-epoxydocosapentaenoic acid with (19S,20R)-configuration.

name: α-D-Rhap2Me4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFoO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of an N-formyl-2-O-methyl-α-D-perosamine residue linked (1→3) to an N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residue which is linked glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: 15(S)-HPETE 2-glyceryl ester
definition: A 2-monoglyceride obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 15(S)-HPETE with the 2-hydroxy group of glycerol.

definition: A glycoside that consists of an N-formyl-2-O-methyl-α-D-perosamine residue and two N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2) and (1→3) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: (5Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-8,9-epoxyicosatetraenoic acid
definition: An EpETE obtained by formal epoxidation of the 8,9-double bond of all-cis-5,8,11,14,17-icosapentaenoic acid.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFoO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of an α-D-mannose residue linked (1→3) to an N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residue which in turn is linked glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFoO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of an α-D-mannose residue and three N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2), (1→3) and (1→2) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

definition: A glycoside that consists of an α-D-mannose residue and five N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues all linked sequentially (1→2) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: α-D-Rhap4[CH2]5NH2-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFoOMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that consists of a 4-O-(5-aminopentyl)-α-D-mannose residue and two N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2) and (1→3) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a methyl group.

name: α-D-Rhap4[CH2]5NH2-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→3)-α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFoOMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that consists of a 4-O-(5-aminopentyl)-α-D-mannose residue and three N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked sequentially (1→2), (1→3) and (1→2) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a methyl group.

name: (E)-2-(indol-3-yl)-1-thioacetohydroximic acid
definition: A thiohydroximic acid in which the C-substituent is specified as (3-indolyl)methyl (the E-geoisomer).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-2,5-anhydro-D-Man

Obtained by depolymerisation of the group B Streptococcus (GBS) type III capsular polysaccharide during which process the 2,5-anhydro-D-mannose residue is formed from a the original reducing-end N-acetyl-glucosaminyl residue (PMID:28439022).

name: ilomastat
definition: An N-acyl-amino acid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2R)-2-[2-(hydroxyamino)-2-oxoethyl]-4-methylpentanoic acid with the amino group of N-methyl-L-tryptophanamide. A cell permeable broad-spectrum matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) inhibitor

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-2,5-anhydro-D-Man
definition: A branched amino pentadecasaccharide comprising β-D-galactosyl, β-D-glucosyl and 2,5-anydro-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→6), to the galactosyl residue of which are linked (1→3) two units of β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc themselves linked (1→3). Obtained by depolymerisation of the group B Streptococcus (GBS) type III capsular polysaccharide during which process the 2,5-anhydro-D-mannose residue is formed from the original reducing-end N-acetyl-glucosaminyl residue (PMID:28439022).

name: 1-[(9Z)-octadecenyl]-3-[(9Z)-octadecenoyl]-sn-glycerol
