name: (5Z,8Z,14Z,17Z)-11,12-epoxyicosatetraenoic acid
definition: An EpETE obtained by formal epoxidation of the 11,12-double bond of all-cis-5,8,11,14,17-icosapentaenoic acid.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,17Z)-14,15-epoxyicosatetraenoic acid
definition: An EpETE obtained by formal epoxidation of the 14,15-double bond of all-cis-5,8,11,14,17-icosapentaenoic acid.

name: (Z)-1-(glutathione-S-yl)-2-phenylacetohydroximate
definition: A glutathione conjugate in which the mercapto hydrogen of glutathione has been replaced by an N-hydroxy-2-phenylethanimidoyl group.

name: mycobilin a
definition: A linear tetrapyrrole obtained by the enzymic degradation of heme by Mycobacterium tuberculosis enzyme MhuD.

name: mycobilin b
definition: A linear tetrapyrrole obtained by the enzymic degradation of heme by Mycobacterium tuberculosis enzyme MhuD.

name: biliverdin β
definition: A linear tetrapyrrole obtained by the enzymic degradation of heme by Pseudomonas aeruginosa heme oxygenase.

name: biliverdin δ
definition: A linear tetrapyrrole obtained by the enzymic degradation of heme by Pseudomonas aeruginosa heme oxygenase.

name: (9Z,12Z)-11-hydroxyoctadecadienoic acid
definition: A HODE that is linoleic acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 11.

name: 3-(methylaminomethyl)indole
definition: An aminoalkylindole that is indole carrying a methylaminomethyl substituent at postion 3.

name: (13S)-hydroxy-(14S,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: A 13-hydroxy-14,15-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 13(S)-hydroxy-(14S,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13-hydroxy-(14R,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoate(1−)
definition: A 13-hydroxy-14,15-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 13-hydroxy-(14R,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13,14,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: A trihydroxyicosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 13,14,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11,14,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,12E)-icosatrienoate(1−)
definition: A trihydroxyicosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 11,14,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,12E)-icosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: anaerobilin
definition: A linear tetrapyrrole obtained by degradation of heme by an enzyme isolated from Escherichia coli O157:H7.

name: N-lauroylsphingosine-1-phosphocholine
definition: A sphingomyelin d18:1 in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as dodecanoyl (lauroyl).

name: 8-amino-8-demethylriboflavin
definition: A benzopteridine that is riboflavin in which the methyl group at position 8 has been replaced by an amino group.

name: 8-demethyl-8-(methylamino)riboflavin
definition: A benzopteridine that is riboflavin in which the methyl group at position 8 has been replaced by a methylamino group.

name: 11,12,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,13E)-icosatrienoate
definition: A trihydroxyicosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 11,12,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,13E)-icosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 13-hydroxy-14,15-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 13-hydroxy-14,15-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-2-(phosphonomethyl)malic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is succinic acid in which the methylene hydrogens at position 2 have been replaced by phosphonomethyl and hydroxy groups (the R-enantiomer).

name: 7-HETE
definition: A HETE that is arachidonic acid carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 7.

name: 13-HETE
definition: A HETE that is arachidonic acid carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 13.

name: (14R)-HDoHE
definition: A 14-HDoHE in which the stereocentre at position 14 has R-configuration.

name: (14S)-HDoHE
definition: A 14-HDoHE in which the stereocentre at position 14 has S-configuration.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14S,16Z,19Z)-14,22-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at the 14S- and 22-positions.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14R,16Z,19Z)-14,22-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at the 14R- and 22-positions.

name: pyridinium-3,5-biscarboxylate mononucleotide(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of pyridinium-3,5-biscarboxylic acid mononucleotide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14S,16Z,19Z,21R)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at the 14S- and 21R-positions.

name: 5-carboxy-1-(5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranosyl)pyridinium-3-carbonyl adenylate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of 5-carboxy-1-(5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranosyl)pyridinium-3-carbonyl adenylate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranosyl)-5-(sulfanylcarbonyl)pyridinium-3-carbonyl adenylate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the sulfanylcarbonyl and phosphate OH groups of 1-(5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranosyl)-5-(sulfanylcarbonyl)pyridinium-3-carbonyl adenylate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-methoxysalicylaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes carrying hydroxy and methoxy substituents at positions 2 and 5 respectively.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14S,16Z,19Z,21S)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at the 14S- and 21S-positions.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14R,16Z,19Z,21R)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at the 14R- and 21R-positions.

name: 11 hydroxy-(14R,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,12E)-icosatrienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 11 hydroxy-(14R,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,12E)-icosatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,4-diaminopteridine-6-carbaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of pteridines that is pteridine in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 4 are replaced by amino groups, whilst that at position 6 is replaced by a carbaldehyde group.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,14R,16Z,19Z,21S)-dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,12E,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at the 14R- and 21S-positions.

name: 2-hydroxy-1-naphthaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of naphthaldehydes that is naphthalene-1-carbaldehyde substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2. Active core of sirtinol (CHEBI:73158).

name: 20-hydroxyprostaglandin E2
definition: A prostaglandin E derivative that is prostaglandin E2 in which one of the methyl hydrogens at position 20 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 5-formylsalicylic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid in which a benzoic acid nucleus is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by a formyl group and an hydroxy group respectively.

name: pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylate mononucleotide(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate OH groups of pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ni(II)-pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylate mononucleotide(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of Ni(II)-pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: aclonifen
definition: A primary amino compound that is aniline in which the phenyl group has been substituted at positions 2, 3, and 6 by chlorine, phenoxy, and nitro groups, respectively. A protoporphyrinogen oxidase (PPO) inhibitor, it is used as a herbicide against a broad range of weeds in a wide range of crops.

name: 1,2-naphthoquinone-4-sulfonic acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is 1,2-naphthoquinone substituted at position 4 with a sulfonic acid group. Used principally as a reagent in colorimetric determinations.

name: prohexadione
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is cyclohexanecarboxylic acid which is substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 5, and by a propanoyl group at position 4. A plant growth regulator, it is used (commonly as the corresponding calcium salt, known as prohexadione-calcium) as an anti-lodging agent in small-grain cereals.

name: 2,3-dihydro-1,4-benzodioxine-6-carbaldehyde
definition: A heteroarenecarbaldehyde in which a formyl group is located at position 6 of 2,3-dihydro-1,4-benzodioxine.

name: 20-hydroxy-20-oxoleukotriene B4-20-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate obtained by the formal condensation of the 20-carboxy group of 20-hydroxy-20-oxoleukotriene B4 with the anomeric hydroxy group of β-D-glucuronic acid.

name: 3-acetylcoumarin
definition: A member of the class of coumarins that is coumarin in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by an acetyl group.

name: (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 24-sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is (24S)-24-hydroxycholesterol carrying a single sulfo substituent at the O-24 position.

name: (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 3-sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is (24S)-24-hydroxycholesterol carrying a single sulfo substituent at the O-3 position.

name: (24S)-hydroxycholesterol 3,24-disulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate that is (24S)-24-hydroxycholesterol in which both hydroxy hydrogens have been replaced by sulfo groups.

name: 19-hydroxyleukotriene B4(1−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of 19-hydroxyleukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 18-hydroxyleukotriene B4(1−)
definition: A leukotriene anion that is the conjugate base of 18-hydroxyleukotriene B4, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: chlormequat chloride
definition: An organic chloride salt comprising equal numbers of chlormequat and chloride ions. A gibberellin biosynthesis inhibitor, it is used as a plant growth retardant to produce plants with sturdier, thicker stalks, facilitating the havesting of ornamental flowers and cereal crops.

name: pyridinium-3,5-biscarboxylic acid mononucleotide
definition: A pyridine nucleotide having 3,5-dicarboxypyridine as the nucleobase.

name: 5-carboxy-1-(5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranosyl)pyridinium-3-carbonyl adenylate
definition: An acyclic mixed acid anhydride obtained by condensation of one of the carboxy group of pyridinium-3,5-biscarboxylic acid mononucleotide with the phosphste group of AMP.

name: 1-(5-O-phosphono-β-D-ribofuranosyl)-5-(sulfanylcarbonyl)pyridinium-3-carbonyl adenylate
definition: An acyclic mixed acid anhydride obtained by condensation of one of the carboxy group of pyridinium-3-sulfanylcarbonyl-5-carboxylic acid mononucleotide with the phosphste group of AMP.

name: pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide
definition: A pyridine nucleotide having pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylic acid as the nucleobase.

name: Ni(II)-pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide
definition: A nickel coordination entity obtained by complexation of nickel(II) with pyridinium-3,5-bisthiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide.

name: 4'-adenylkanamycin A
definition: A aminoglycoside phosphate obtained by formal condensation of the phosphate group of AMP with the 4'-hydroxy group of kanamycin A.

name: 6-chloro-4-hydroxycoumarin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is coumarin in which a hydroxy group replaces the hydrogen at position 4 and a chloro substituent replaces the hydrogen at position 6.

name: 5-hydroxybenzimidazole
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 5.

name: (13R)-S-glutathionyl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoate(2−)
definition: A docosanoid anion obtained by deprotonation of the three carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl alpha -amino group of (13R)-S-glutathionyl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (13R)-glycinylcystein-S-yl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoate(1−)
definition: A docosanoid anion obtained by deprotonation of the two carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl alpha -amino group of (13R)-S-cysteinylglycinyl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-sorbose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of L-sorbose 1-phosphate. Major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: (13R)-S-cysteinyl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoate(1−)
definition: A docosanoid anion obtained by deprotonation of the two carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl alpha -amino group of (13R)-S-cysteinylglycinyl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-[(11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatrienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-palmitoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the 2-acyl group is specified as (11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatrienoyl.

name: cholesteryl (11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: A cholesteryl ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatrienoic acid with the 3-hydroxy group of cholesterol.

name: prohexadione(2−)
definition: An organic anion derived from prohexadione by deprotonation of both the carboxy group and a hydroxy group of any of the enolate forms of the triketo moiety. The corresponding calcium salt, prohexadione-calcium, is used as an anti-lodging agent in small-grain cereals.

name: prohexadione-calcium
definition: A calcium salt containing equal numbers of prohexadione(2−) and Ca2+ ions. A plant growth regulator, it is used as an anti-lodging agent in small-grain cereals.

name: dehydroacetic acid
definition: A pyran-2,4-dione substituted at position 3 by an acetyl group and at position 6 by a methyl group. A fungicide and bactericide it is used primarily in processed fruit and vegetables.

name: methyl β-(acetylthio)isobutyrate
definition: A methyl ester derived from β-(acetylthio)isobutyric acid.

name: (R)-3-(acetylthio)isobutyric acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is isobutyric acid in which a hydrogen of one of the methyl groups has been replaced by an acetylthio group (the R enantiomer). It is an important intermediate for the preparation of various angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors such as captopril and alacepril.

name: (9Z)-heptadecenoate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (9Z)-heptadecenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E)-1-hydroxy-2-(non-1-en-1-yl)quinolin-4-one
definition: A hydroxylamine that is N-hydroxyquinolin-4-one in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a (1E)-non-1-en-1-yl group. It is the most active agent produced by Pseudomonas aeruginosa that modulates the growth and virulence of Staphylococcus aureus; the corresponding Z isomer is inactive.

name: (13R,14S)-dihydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (13R,14S)-dihydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (7R,14S)-dihydroxy-(4Z,8E,10E,12Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoate
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of (7R,14S)-dihydroxy-(4Z,8E,10E,12Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11-oxo-ETE-CoA
definition: A 3-oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 11-oxo-ETE.

name: 15-oxo-ETE-CoA
definition: An oxo-fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 15-oxo-ETE.

name: isonitramine
definition: A azaspiro compound that is 2-azaspiro[5.5]undecane carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 7 (the 6R,7R-diastereomer). A synthetic Nitraria alkaloid.

name: (R)-2-hydroxy-3-oxo-4-(phosphonooxy)butanoic acid
definition: The ketoaldonic acid phosphate formed formally from D-erythronic acid by oxidation of the 3-hydroxy group to an oxo group and phosphorylation at the 1-hydroxy group.

name: (S)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid that is butyric acid carrying an oxo substituent at position 2 as well as two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 (the S-enantiomer).

name: 9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoate
definition: An ω-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 18-hydroxy-9,10-epoxyoctadecanoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9S,10R)-9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoate
definition: A 9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoate that is the conjugate base of (9S,10R)-9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9R,10S)-9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoate
definition: A 9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoate that is the conjugate base of (9R,10S)-9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9R,10S)-9,10-epoxyoctadecanoate
definition: A 9,10-epoxyoctadecanoate that is the conjugate base of (9R,10S)-9,10-epoxyoctadecanoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9S,10R)-epoxyoctadecanoate
definition: A 9,10-epoxyoctadecanoate that is the conjugate base of (9S,10R)-epoxyoctadecanoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9,10-epoxy-17-hydroxyoctadecanoate
definition: An (ω−1)-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9,10-epoxy-17-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Xyl-(1→6)-[α-D-Xyl-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(→4)]-β-D-Glc
definition: A tetrasaccharide composed from two α-D-Xyl-(1→6)-β-D-Glc joined by a (→4)-linkage between the two Glc residues.

name: 9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxy-(12Z)-octadecenoate
definition: An octadecanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxy-(12Z)-octadecenoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Xyl-(1→6)-[α-D-Xyl-(1→6)-[α-D-Xyl-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)]-β-D-Glc-(1→4)]-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-β-D-GlC-(1→4)-D-Glc
definition: A branched nonasaccharide composed from six β-D-glucosyl and three α-D-xylosyl residues

name: 12,13-epoxy-18-hydroxy-(9Z)-octadecenoate
definition: An octadecanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 18-hydroxy-12,13-epoxy-(9Z)-octadecenoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3

name: optovin
definition: A member of the class of thiazolidinone that is rhodanine in which the two methylene hydrogens have been replaced by a 2,5-dimethyl-1-(pyridin-3-yl)-1H-pyrrol-3-yl]methylidene group. A TRPA1 ligand that can be reversibly photoactivated.

name: tetrahydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone hydrate
definition: The hydrate of tetrahydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone. The number of water molecules of crystallization (n) is variable, although most commonly the dihydrate (shown in the diagram) is formed in the solid phase.

name: tetrahydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone
definition: A hydroxybenzoquinone in which all four protons of the benzoquinone structure are substituted by hydroxy groups. A systemic keratolytic, it is normally supplied as its hydrate (CHEBI:137471).

name: 5,6-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 5,6-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatrienoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 8,9-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 8,9-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11,12-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,14Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoate that is the conjugate base of 20-hydroxy-11,12-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,14Z)-eicosatrienoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 14,15-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoate
definition: An icosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 14,15-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3R)-1,2-didehydro-3-hydroxy-16-methoxy-2,3-dihydrotabersonine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid that is a reactive intermediate in the biosynthesis of vindoline by Catharanthus roseus.

name: (R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid that is butyric acid carrying an oxo substituent at position 2 as well as two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 4 (the R-enantiomer).

name: (2R,5S)-2,5-diammoniohexanoate
definition: An α-amino-acid cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the amino groups of (2R,5S)-2,5-diaminohexanoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 16α-hydroxyestrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 16α-hydroxyestrone in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue.

name: 16α-hydroxyestrone 16-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 16α-hydroxyestrone in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 16 has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue.

name: 17α-estradiol 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 17α-estradiol in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 17 has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue.

name: epitestosterone 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is epitestosterone in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 17 has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue.

name: 13(S)-HETE
definition: A 13-HETE in which the stereocentre at position 13 has S-configuration.

name: 13(R)-HODE
definition: A 13-HODE in which the stereocentre at position 13 has S-configuration.

name: 7-oxoresolvin D2(1−)
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 7-oxoresolvin D2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 16-oxoresolvin D2(1−)
definition: A docosanoid anion that is the conjugate base of 16-oxoresolvin D2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-2,4-dihydroxy-3-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A ketoaldonic acid that is butyric acid carrying an oxo substituent at position 3 as well as two hydroxy substituents at positions 2 and 4 (the S-enantiomer).

name: quizalofop-P
definition: A 2-{4-[(6-chloroquinoxalin-2-yl)oxy]phenoxy}propanoic acid that has R configuration. An acetyl-CoA carboxylase inhibitor, it is used (generally as the corresponding ethyl or tefuryl ester proherbicides) for the control of annual and perennial grass weeds in sugar beet.

name: 2-{4-[(6-chloroquinoxalin-2-yl)oxy]phenoxy}propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is 2-phenoxypropanoic acid in which the phenyl group is substituted at the para position by a (6-chloroquinoxalin-2-yl)oxy group.

name: (S)-quizalofop
definition: A 2-{4-[(6-chloroquinoxalin-2-yl)oxy]phenoxy}propanoic acid that has S configuration. It is the (inactive) enantiomer of the herbicide quizalofop-P.

name: (2Z,10Z)-3-hydroxy-5,17-dioxo-4,5-secoestra-2,10-diene-3-oate
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of (2Z,10Z)-3-hydroxy-5,17-dioxo-4,5-secoestra-2,10-diene-3-oic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3. A meta-cleavage metabolite in the estrogen degradation pathway.

name: (+)-isoafricanol
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpene with formula C15H26O, that is isolated from Streptomyces violaceusniger, S. malaysiensis and Leptographium lundbergii.

name: (−)-spiroviolene
definition: A spirocyclic diterpene with formula C20H32 which is produced by a diterpene cyclase gene expressed in an engineered Streptomyces host.

name: CDP-D-ribulose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the free diphosphate OH groups of CDP-D-ribulose. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: CDP-D-ribose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the free diphosphate OH groups of CDP-D-ribose. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 20-hydroxyprostaglandin E1
definition: A prostaglandin E derivative that is prostaglandin E1 in which one of the methyl hydrogens at position 20 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: tsukubadiene
definition: A tricyclic diterpene with formula C20H32 which is produced by a diterpene cyclase gene expressed in an engineered Streptomyces host.

name: 20-hydroxyprostaglandin A1
