definition: A seven-membered oligopeptide comprising L-leucine, L-serine, L-glutamic acid, L-threonine, L-glutamic acid, L-threonine and D-leucine residues coupled in sequence, modified by insertion at the N-terminal position of the flexible and hydrophilic PEG chain 1,13-diamino-4,7,10-trioxatrideacne succinamic acid linker (Ttds).

name: cyclo(Leu-Ser-Glu-Thr-Thr-D-Leu)
definition: A six-membered homodetic cyclic peptide comprising the sequence L-leucine, L-serine,L-α-glutamic acid, L-threonine, L-threonine, D-leucine

name: lithocholic acid 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is lithocholic acid having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 3.

name: cyclo(Leu-Ser-Glu-Thr-Glu-Thr-Lys(Ac)-D-Leu)
definition: An eight-membered homodetic cyclic peptide comprising the sequence L-leucine, L-serine, L-α-glutamic acid, L-threonine, L-α-glutamic acid, L-threonine, N6-acetyl-L-lysine, D-leucine.

name: 2-hydroxyestrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 2-hydroxyestrone having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 3.

name: cyclo(Leu-Ser-Glu-Thr-Glu-Thr-Lys-D-Leu)
definition: An eight-membered homodetic cyclic peptide comprising the sequence L-leucine, L-serine, L-α-glutamic acid, L-threonine, L-α-glutamic acid, L-threonine, L-lysine, D-leucine.

name: cyclo(Leu-Ser-Glu-Thr-Lys-Thr-D-Leu)
definition: A seven-membered homodetic cyclic peptide comprising the sequence L-leucine, L-serine, L-α-glutamic acid, L-threonine, L-lysine, L-threonine, D-leucine.

name: CDP-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A CDP-D-glucose(2−) having α-configuration at the anomeric centre. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: cyclo(Leu-Ser-Glu-Thr-Tyr(SO3H)-Thr-Lys-D-Leu)
definition: An eight-membered homodetic cyclic peptide comprising the sequence L-leucine, L-serine, L-α-glutamic acid, L-threonine, O-sulfo-L-tyrosine, L-threonine, L-lysine, D-leucine.

name: cyclo(Leu-Ser-Glu-Thr-Tyr-Thr-Lys-D-Leu)
definition: An eight-membered homodetic cyclic peptide comprising the sequence L-leucine, L-serine, L-α-glutamic acid, L-threonine, L-tyrosine, L-threonine, L-lysine, D-leucine.

name: TDP-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of TDP-α-D-glucose. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 5-dehydro-L-gluconic acid
definition: A ketogluconic acid that is L-gluconic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been oxidised to the corresponding ketone.

name: polyprenal
definition: Any enal having a polyprenyl chain.

name: S-polyprenyl-L-cysteine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of S-polyprenyl-L-cysteine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ethyl 2-{4-[(6-chloroquinoxalin-2-yl)oxy]phenoxy}propanoate
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-{4-[(6-chloroquinoxalin-2-yl)oxy]phenoxy}propanoic acid with ethanol.

name: quizalofop-P-ethyl
definition: An ethyl 2-{4-[(6-chloroquinoxalin-2-yl)oxy]phenoxy}propanoate that has R configuration. A proherbicide for quizalofop-P, it is used to control annual and perennial grass weeds in a variety of crops, including potatoes, sugar beet, peanuts, cotton and flax.

name: (S)-quizalofop-ethyl
definition: An ethyl 2-{4-[(6-chloroquinoxalin-2-yl)oxy]phenoxy}propanoate that has S configuration.

name: tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol
definition: A primary alcohol that is methanol in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been replaced by a tetrahydrofuran-2-yl group.

name: N-carbamoyl-L-methionine
definition: An N-carbamoyl-L-α-amino acid derived from L-methionine.

name: cyanomethyl 2,3,4,6-tetra-O-acetyl-1-thio-α-D-mannoside
definition: A thioglycoside in which 2,3,4,6-tetra-O-acetyl-1-thio-D-α-mannopyranose is glycosylated at sulfur with a cyanomethyl group.

name: N-carbamoyl-D-methionine
definition: An N-carbamoyl-D-α-amino acid derived from D-methionine.

name: cyanomethyl 2,3,5-tri-O-acetyl-α-D-arabinofuranosyl-(1→6)-2,3,4-tri-O-acetyl-1-thio-α-D-mannopyranoside
definition: A thioglycoside in which 2,3,5-tri-O-acetyl-α-D-arabinofuranosyl-(1→6)-2,3,4-tri-O-acetyl-α-D-thiomannopyranose is glycosylated at sulfur with a cyanomethyl group.

name: cyanomethyl 2,3,4,6-tetra-O-acetyl-α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-2,3,4-tri-O-acetyl-1-thio-α-D-mannopyranoside
definition: A thioglycoside in which 2,3,4,6-tetra-O-acetyl-α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-2,3,4-tri-O-acetyl-1-thio-α-D-mannopyranose is glycosylated at sulfur with a cyanomethyl group.

name: 2-imino-2-methoxyethyl 1-thio-α-D-mannopyranoside
definition: A thioglycoside in which 1-thio-α-D-mannopyranose is glycosylated at sulfur with a 2-imino-2-methoxyethyl group.

name: 2-hydroxyestrone 2-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 2-hydroxyestrone having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 2.

name: 2-imino-2-methoxyethyl α-D-arabinofuranosyl-(1→6)-1-thio-α-D-mannopyranoside
definition: A thioglycoside in which α-D-arabinofuranosyl-(1→6)-1-thio-α-D-mannopyranose is glycosylated at sulfur with a 2-imino-2-methoxyethyl group.

name: 2-imino-2-methoxyethyl α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-1-thio-α-D-mannopyranoside
definition: A thioglycoside in which α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-1-thio-α-D-mannopyranose is glycosylated at sulfur with a 2-imino-2-methoxyethyl group.

name: 4-hydroxyestrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 4-hydroxyestrone having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 3.

name: 4-hydroxyestrone 4-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 4-hydroxyestrone having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 4.

name: 4-methoxyestrone 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 2-methoxyestrone having a β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 3.

name: 4-methoxy-17β-estradiol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 4-methoxy-17β-estradiol having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 3.

name: 1,3-dichloropropane
definition: A chloroalkane that is propane in which a hydrogen from each of the terminal methyl groups has been replaced by a chlorine.

name: 5-amino-1-(5-phosphonato-β-D-ribosyl)imidazol-3-ium
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups as well as protonation of the endocyclic nitrogen at position 3 in the imidazole ring of 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl)imidazole. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: (β-Asp-Arg)n zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion derived from (β-Asp-Arg)n. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 19-hydroxyprostaglandin I2(1−)
definition: A prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 19-hydroxyprostaglandin I2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 19-hydroxythromboxane A2(1−)
definition: A thromboxane anion that is the conjugate base of 19-hydroxythromboxane A2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 18-hydroxythromboxane A2(1−)
definition: A thromboxane anion that is the conjugate base of 18-hydroxythromboxane A2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (β-Asp-Arg)n-Asp(1−)
definition: A peptide anion that is the conjugate base of (β-Asp-Arg)n-Asp; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-Asp-Arg zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of two protons from the carboxy to the amino and guanidino groups of β-Asp-Arg; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E)-2-ethylidene-4-hydroxy-5-methyl-3(2H)-furanone
definition: A member of the class of furans that is (2E)-2-ethylidenefuran-3(2H)-one carrying additional hydroxy and methyl substituents at positions 4 and 5 respectively.

name: 2-ethyl-4-hydroxy-5-methyl-3(2H)-furanone
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan-3(2H)-one carrying additional ethyl, hydroxy and methyl substituents at positions 2, 4 and 5 respectively. A key aroma compound in soy sauce and fish sauce.

name: 3-(1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl)pyridine
definition: An N-alkylpyrrolidine that consists of N-methylpyrrolidine bearing a pyridin-3-yl substituent at position 2.

name: 2-bromophenyl 2,4-dibromophenyl ether
definition: A polybromodiphenyl ether that is diphenyl ether in which the hydrogens at the 2, 2', and 4 positions have been replaced by bromines.

name: (5Z,8S,9S,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A (5Z,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (5Z,8S,9S,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14R,15R)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A (5Z,8Z,11Z)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (5Z,8Z,11Z,14R,15R)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8Z,11R,12R,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A (5Z,8Z,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (5Z,8Z,11R,12R,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8Z,11S,12S,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A (5Z,8Z,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (5Z,8Z,11S,12S,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14S,15S)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A (5Z,8Z,11Z)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (5Z,8Z,11Z,14S,15S)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-hexosamine 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An N-acetyl-D-hexosamine 1-phosphate(2−) in which the anomeric centre has α-configuration.

name: (5Z,8R,9R,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoate
definition: A (5Z,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (5Z,8R,9R,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Z-DEVD-FMK
definition: A tetrapeptide consisting of Fmoc-L-aspartic acid 4-methyl ester, methyl L-α-glutamic acid 5-methyl ester, L-valine and the fluoromethyl ketone derived from the 1-carboxy group of L-aspartic acid 4-methyl ester coupled in sequence. It is a specific, irreversible caspase-3 inhibitor that also shows potent inhibition of caspase-6, caspase-7, caspase-8, and caspase-10.

name: 5-(N-methyl-N-propyl)amiloride
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is amiloride in which the primary amino group adjacent to the chloro substiuent has been substituted by a methyl group and a propyl group.

name: 1-(5-fluoropentyl)-3-(2-iodobenzoyl)indole
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole which is substituted at position 1 by a 5-fluoropentyl group and a position 3 by an o-fluorobenzoyl group. It is a selective agonist for the CB1 cannabinoid receptor; Ki values for the CB1 and CB2 receptors are 0.08 and 1.44 nM, respectively.

name: lactogangliotetraosylceramide
definition: A glycotetraosylceramide Having N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-[N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)]-β-D-glucosyl as the glycotetraosyl component and which is acylated on the amino group by a tetracosanoyl group. A leukaemia-associated antigen with an unusual branching structure.

name: α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl phospho oligosaccharide that consists of a α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl moiety linked via a diphospho group to ditrans,octacis-undecaprenol.

name: 5α-androstane-3β,17β-diol 17-O-(β-D-glucuronide)
definition: A steroid glucosiduronic acid that is 5α-androstane-3β,17β-diol having a single β-D-glucuronic acid residue attached at position 17.

name: 5α-dihydrotestosterone sulfate
definition: A 3-oxo-5α-steroid that is 5α-dihydrotestosterone in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 17 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: N1,N8-bis(caffeoyl)spermidine
definition: A secondary amino compound that is spermidine in which each of the primary amino groups has been mono-acylated by formal condensation with trans-caffeic acid.

name: (3β,5α,17β)-3-hydroxyandrostan-17-yl sulfate
definition: An androstane sulfate that is 5α-androstan-3β,17β-diol in which the hydroxy hydrogen at position 17 has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: dotarizine
definition: An N-alkylpiperazine in which the two amino hydrogens of piperazine have been replaced by diphenylmethyl and 3-(2-phenyl-1,3-dioxolan-2-yl)propyl groups. A calcium channel blocker and serotonin (5-HT2) receptor antagonist used in the treatment of migraine.

name: dTDP-4-formamido-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A nucleotide-sugar oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of dTDP-4-formamido-4,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucose. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 4-bromophenyl 2,4-dibromophenyl ether
definition: A polybromodiphenyl ether that is diphenyl ether in which the hydrogens at the 2, 4, and 4' positions have been replaced by bromines.

name: 10-epi-juneol
definition: A eudesmane sesquiterpenoid that is 4a-methyl-8-methylidene-decahydronaphthalene carrying additional hydroxy and isopropyl substituents at positions 1 and 2 respectively (the 1S,2S,4aS,8aS-diastereomer).

name: 2,4-dibromophenyl 3,4-dibromophenyl ether
definition: A polybromodiphenyl ether that is diphenyl ether in which the hydrogens at the 2, 4, 3', and 4' positions have been replaced by bromines.

name: (3E,7E)-dolathalia-3,7,11-triene
definition: A bicyclic diterpene consisting of 2,3,5,6,9,10,13,13a-octahydro-1H-benzo[11]annulene carrying five methyl substituents at positions 3, 3, 7, 11 and 13a.

name: 7-epi-α-eudesmol
definition: A eudesmane sesquiterpenoid in which the eudesmane skeleton carries a hydroxy substituent at C-11 and has a double bond between C-3 and C-4.

name: (+)-4-epi-cubebol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid consisting of octahydro-1H-cyclopenta[1,3]cyclopropa[1,2]benzen-3-ol carrying two additional methyl substituents at positions 3 and 7 as well as an isopropyl substituent at position 4 (the 3S,3aS,3bS,4R,7S,7aS diastereomer).

name: τ-cadinol
definition: A cadinane sesquiterpenoid that is cadin-4-ene carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 10.

name: (2E,6E)-hedycaryol
definition: A germacrane sesquiterpenoid that is germacra-1(10),4-diene carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 11.

name: (2Z,6E)-hedycaryol
definition: A germacrane sesquiterpenoid that is germacra-1(10),4-diene carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 11.

name: (−)-10-epi-cubebol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid consisting of octahydro-1H-cyclopenta[1,3]cyclopropa[1,2]benzen-3-ol carrying two additional methyl substituents at positions 3 and 7 as well as an isopropyl substituent at position 4 (the 3S,3aR,3bR,4S,7S,7aR diastereomer).

name: sesterfisherol
definition: A tetracyclic sesterterpenoid obtained by by expressing a small gene cluster consisting of a terpene synthase (Nf SS) and a cytochrome P450 monooxygenase (Nf P450).

name: β-thujene
definition: A thujene that has a bicyclo[3.1.0]hex-2-ene skeleton which is substituted at positions 1 and 4 by isopropyl and methyl groups, respectively.

name: stellata-2,6,19-triene
definition: A tricyclic sesterterpene with formula C25H40 that is obtained from Aspergillus stellatus.

name: guaia-4,6-diene
definition: A bicyclic sesquiterpene that is 1,2,6,7,8,8a-hexahydroazulene carrying an isopropyl substituent at position 5 as well as two methyl substituents at positions 5 and 8.

name: pseudolaratriene
definition: A bicyclic diterpene that is 1,2,3,3a,4,5,8,8a-octahydroazulene carrying two methyl substituents at positions 6 and 8a as well as a 6-methylhepta-2,5-dien-2-yl at position 3. The relative stereochemistry has been assigned tentatively.

name: selina-4(15),7(11)-diene
definition: A bicyclic sesquiterpene that is 1-methylidenedecahydronaphthalene carrying additional methyl and isopropylidene substituents at positions 4a and 7 respectively.

name: 2,4,5-trihydroxyphenylacetic acid
definition: A benzenetriol that is phenylacetic acid carrying three hydroxy substituents at positions 2, 4 and 5.

name: 2,4,5-trihydroxyphenylacetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2,4,5-trihydroxyphenylacetic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: coelenterazine h dioxetanone
definition: A member of the class of oxidized luciferins that is obtained via formal oxidative cleavage of Renilla luciferin.

name: 2,4-dibromophenyl 2,3,4-tribromophenyl ether
definition: A polybromodiphenyl ether that is diphenyl ether in which the hydrogens at the 2, 3, 4, 2', and 4' positions have been replaced by bromines.

name: 2,4-dibromophenyl 2,4,6-tribromophenyl ether
definition: A polybromodiphenyl ether that is diphenyl ether in which the hydrogens at the 2, 4, 6, 2', and 4' positions have been replaced by bromines.

name: nocamycin I
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound and tetramic acid derivative originally isolated from an unidentified oligosporic actinomycete strain (no. E864-861) and found to be active against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative anaerobic bacteria as well as some aerobic bacteria such as Streptococci. The methyl ester of nocamycin E.

name: 1,1'-dihydroxyneurosporene
definition: A carotenol obtained by formal hydration across the two double bonds at positions 1 and 1' of neurosporene.

name: chloroxanthin
definition: A carotenol obtained by formal hydration across the double bonds at position 1 of neurosporene.

name: perfluorooctanesulfonamide
definition: A perfluorinated compound that is perfluorooctane in which one of the terminal fluorines has been replace by a sulfamoyl group.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(N-hexadecanoyl)ethanolamine
definition: A 1-[(Z)-alk-1-enyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(N-acyl)ethanolamine in which the alk-1-enyl and N-acyl groups are specified as 1Z-octadecenyl and hexadecanoyl respectively.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(N-oleoyl)ethanolamine
definition: A 1-[(Z)-alk-1-enyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(N-acyl)ethanolamine in which the alk-1-enyl and N-acyl groups are specified as 1Z-octadecenyl and oleoyl respectively.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(N-arachidonoyl)ethanolamine
definition: A 1-[(Z)-alk-1-enyl]-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(N-acyl)ethanolamine in which the alk-1-enyl and N-acyl groups are specified as 1Z-octadecenyl and arachidonoyl respectively.

name: 1-(1Z-octadecenyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1-(alk-1-enyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphate in which the alkenyl group is specified as 1Z-octadecenyl.

name: 2-[(9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroperoxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of 2-[(9S,11R)-epidioxy-15(S)-hydroperoxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-[(9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the phosphate to the amino group of 2-[(9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-[(9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroperoxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3- phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group is specified as (9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroperoxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl.

name: 2-[(9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3- phosphocholine
definition: A prostanoid-LPC that is the ammonium betaine of a 2-(prostaglandin H2)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-6-acetamido-3-aminohexanoic acid
definition: A 6-acetamido-3-aminohexanoic acid in which the chiral centre at position 3 has S-configuration.

name: 2-palmitoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-D-myo-inositol that has palmitoleoyl as the acyl group.

name: α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-diphospho-ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol
definition: A polyprenyl phospho oligosaccharide consisting of the tetrasaccharide α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamin linked via a diphospho group to ditrans,polycis-undecaprenol.

name: 16(S)-HETE
definition: A 16-HETE in which the chiral centre at position 16 has S-configuration.

name: chondroitin 4',6'-disulfate anion
definition: A polysaccharide acid oxoanion arising from global deprotonation of the carboxylic and sulfonic acid groups of the repeating units in chondroitin 4',6'-disulfate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: leukotriene C4 methyl ester
definition: The methyl ester of leukotriene C4, the esterified acid group being the one forming position 1 of the icosatetraenyl chain. Leukotriene C4 methyl ester is a more lipid-soluble form of leukotriene C4.

name: 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-methylbenzoic acid
definition: An imidazolone that is 1,5-dihydro-4H-imidazol-4-one which is substituted at position 2 by a 2-carboxy-4-methylphenyl group, and at position 5 by methyl and isopropyl groups.

name: 6-[(4R)-4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-2-imidazolin-2-yl]-m-toluic acid
definition: A 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-methylbenzoic acid in which the chiral centre has R configuration.

name: 6-[(4S)-4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-2-imidazolin-2-yl]-m-toluic acid
definition: A 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-methylbenzoic acid in which the chiral centre has S configuration.

name: dermatan 4',6'-disulfate anion
definition: A polysaccharide acid oxoanion arising from global deprotonation of the carboxylic and sulfonic acid groups of the repeating units in dermatan 4',6'-disulfate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: methyl 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-methylbenzoate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-methylbenzoic acid with methanol.

name: methyl 6-[(4R)-4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-2-imidazolin-2-yl]-m-toluate
definition: A methyl 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-methylbenzoate in which the chiral centre has R configuration.

name: methyl 6-[(4S)-4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-2-imidazolin-2-yl]-m-toluate
definition: A methyl 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-5-methylbenzoate in which the chiral centre has S configuration.

name: 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-4-methylbenzoic acid
definition: An imidazolone that is 1,5-dihydro-4H-imidazol-4-one which is substituted at position 2 by a 2-carboxy-5-methylphenyl group, and at position 5 by methyl and isopropyl groups.

name: leukotriene E4 methyl ester
definition: The methyl ester of leukotriene E4, the esterified acid group being the one forming position 1 of the icosatetraenyl chain. Leukotriene E4 methyl ester is a more lipid-soluble form of leukotriene E4.

name: rac-6-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-2-imidazolin-2-yl)-p-toluic acid
definition: A racemate comprising equimolar amounts of the R- and S- enantiomers of 6-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-2-imidazolin-2-yl)-p-toluic acid. It is the minor component of the herbicide imazamethabenz.

name: methyl 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-4-methylbenzoate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-(4-isopropyl-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl)-4-methylbenzoic acid with methanol.

name: (13S)-hydroxy-(14S,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: A 13-hydroxy-14,15-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the three chiral centres at positions 13, 14 and 15 all have S-configuration.

name: 13-hydroxy-(14R,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: A 13-hydroxy-14,15-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the chiral centres at positions 14 and 15 have R- and S-configuration respectively while that at position 13 remains unspecified.

name: 13,14,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: A trihydroxyicosatrienoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid in which the three hydroxy groups are located at positions 13, 14 and 15.

name: 17α-hydroxy-C21-steroid
definition: Any C21-steroid carrying a hydroxy substituent at the 17α-position. Note that individual examples may have ring substituents at other positions and/or contain double bonds, aromatic A-rings, expanded/contracted rings etc., so the formula and mass may vary from that given for the generic structure.

name: 21-hydroxy-C21-steroid
definition: Any C21-steroid carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 21.

name: 11,12,15-trihydroxy-(5Z,8Z,13E)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: A trihydroxyicosatrienoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,13E)-icosatrienoic acid in which the three hydroxy groups are located at positions 11, 12 and 15.

name: 1,2-di-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 32:2 obtained by transfer of a proton from the amino to the phosphate group of 1,2-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine.

name: 13-hydroxy-14,15-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid having the epoxide group across positions 14-15 and the hydroxy substituent located at position 13.

name: 11 hydroxy-(14R,15S)-epoxy-(5Z,8Z,12E)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,12E)-icosatrienoic acid having the epoxide group across positions 14-15 and the hydroxy substituent located at position 11.

name: D-tagatopyranose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phospohate OH groups of D-tagatopyranose 1-phosphate; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: fomesafen(1−)
definition: An organic nitrogen anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the N-sulfonylcarboxamide moiety of fomesafen.

name: fomesafen-sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the sodium salt of fomesafen. A protoporphyrinogen oxidase inhibitor, it was specially developed for post-emergence control of broad-leaf weeds in soya.

name: (+)-(2S,3R,9R)-pristinol
definition: A bicyclic sesquiterpenoid that is 2,3,5,6,7,8,9,9a-octahydro-1H-cyclopenta[8]annulen-6-ol carrying four additional methyl substiuents at positions 1, 4, 8 and 8.

name: nezukol
definition: An isopimarane diterpenoid that is isopimarane in which the ethyl subtituent at position 13 has undergone formal dehydrogenation to the corresponding vinyl group, and in which the hydrogen at position 8 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It has been found in the leaves of several plants, including Cryptomeria japonica and Isodon rubescens.

name: 5-hydroxy-α-gurjunene
definition: A tricyclic sesquiterpenoid obtained by formal hydration across the endocyclic double bond of (−)-α-gurjunene

name: Asp-Tyr-Met-Gly-Trp-Met-Asp-Phe-NH2
definition: An eight-membered oligopeptide consisting of Asp, Tyr, Met, Gly, Trp, Met, As and Phe-NH2 residues joined in sequence.

name: sulfanegen
definition: A member of the class of dithianes that is 1,4-dithiane-2,5-dicarboxylic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 have been replaced by hydroxy groups. Sulfanegen is a prodrug for 3-mercaptopyruvic acid and is an experimental antidote for cyanide poisoning.

name: pApA(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phospohate OH groups of pApA. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-6-deoxy-α-L-Talp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A trisaccharide derivative consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-6-deoxy-α-L-talosyl disaccharide unit.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-6-deoxy-α-L-Talp2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A trisaccharide derivative consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-2-O-acetyl-6-deoxy-α-L-talosyl disaccharide unit.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-6-deoxy-α-L-Talp2Me-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A trisaccharide derivative consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-6-deoxy-2-O-methyl-α-L-talosyl disaccharide unit.

name: aspirin-triggered resolvin D1
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that consists of docosa-4Z,9E,11E,13Z,15E,19Z-hexaenoic acid carrying three hydroxy substituents at positions 7, 8, and 17 (the 7S,8R,17S-stereoisomer).

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-6-deoxy-α-L-Talp4Ac2Me-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A trisaccharide derivative consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-4-O-acetyl-6-deoxy-2-O-methyl-α-L-talosyl disaccharide unit.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-6-deoxy-α-L-Talp2,4Ac2-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A trisaccharide derivative consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-2,4-di-O-acetyl-6-deoxy-α-L-talosyl disaccharide unit.

name: 6-deoxy-α-L-Talp2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a 2-O-acetyl-6-deoxy-α-L-talosyl residue.

name: p-Glu-Arg-Pro-Arg-Leu-Ser-His-Lys-Gly-Pro-Met-Pro-Phe
definition: A thirteen-membered polypeptide consisting of p-Glu, Arg, Pro, Arg, Leu, Ser, His, Lys, Gly, Pro, Met, Pro and Phe residues joined in sequence.

name: 6-deoxy-α-L-Talp2,4Ac2-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a 2,4-di-O-acetyl-6-deoxy-α-L-talosyl residue.

name: (6E,8Z,11Z)-5-oxoicosatrienoic acid
definition: A trienoic fatty acid that is (6E,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid carrying an additional oxo substituent at position 5.

name: (2R,5S)-2,5-diaminohexanoic acid
definition: A diamino acid that is hexanoic acid carrying two amino substituents at positions 2 and 5 (the 2R,5S-diastereomer).

name: 1,2-dihexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 12:0 in which both acyl groups are specified as hexanoyl.

name: 1,2-diheptanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 14:0 in which both acyl groups are specified as heptanoyl.

name: 19-hydroxyleukotriene B4
definition: A leukotriene that is leukotriene B4 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 19.

name: 1-hexanoyl-2-heptanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-hexanoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group at position 2 is specified as heptanoyl.

name: 1-heptanoyl-2-hexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 13:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as heptanoyl and hexanoyl respectively.

name: 1-hexadecanoyl-2-heptanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: 1-palmitoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the 2-acyl group is specified as heptanoyl.

name: 1-heptanoyl-2-hexadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: 1-acyl-2-palmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the 1-acyl group is specified as heptanoyl.

name: 18-hydroxyleukotriene B4
definition: A leukotriene that is leukotriene B4 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 18.

name: (13R)-S-glutathionyl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid
definition: A docosanoid that is (14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid in which a glutathionyl group is attached at position 13R via a sulfide linkage.

name: N-benzyl-2-[4-fluoro-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]butanamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-[4-fluoro-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]butyric acid with the amino group of benzylamine.

name: (R)-beflubutamid
definition: An N-benzyl-2-[4-fluoro-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]butanamide that has R configuration.

name: (S)-beflubutamid
definition: An N-benzyl-2-[4-fluoro-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]butanamide that has S configuration.

name: (13R)-S-cysteinylglycinyl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid
definition: A docosanoid that is (14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid in which a cysteinylglycinyl group is attached at position 13R via a sulfide linkage.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-Dglucosamine, α-D-galactose and D-galactose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3)linkages respectively.

name: (13R)-S-cysteinyl-(14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid
definition: A docosanoid that is (14S )-hydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16 Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid in which a cysteinyl group is attached at position 13R via a sulfide linkage.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide composed of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine and D-galactose residues in a β(1→4) linkage.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-pentanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as octadecanoyl and pentanoyl respectively.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-hexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 24:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as octadecanoyl and hexanoyl respectively.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-octanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 26:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as octadecanoyl and octanoyl respectively.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-nonanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 27:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as octadecanoyl and nonanoyl respectively.

name: 1-octadecanoyl-2-dodecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 30:0 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as octadecanoyl and dodecananoyl respectively.

name: 1,2-dihexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as hexanoyl.

name: 1-heptanoyl-2-hexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as heptanoyl and hexanoyl respectively.

name: 1,2-diheptadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 34:0 zwitterion in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as heptadecanoyl.

name: ent-atiserene
definition: A diterpene that is the enantiomer of atisane which has undergone formal dehydrogenation to indroduce an exocyclic double bond at position 16.

name: N-hexadecanoyl-1,2-diheptadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine(1−)
definition: An N-hexadecanoylphosphatidylethanolamine(1−) in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as heptadecanoyl.

name: CDP-D-ribulose
definition: A CDP-sugar having D-ribulose as the sugar component with the CDP moiety attached at position 5.

name: N-oleoyl-1,2-diheptadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine(1−)
definition: An N-oleoylphosphatidylethanolamine(1−) in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as heptadecanoyl.

name: ent-copal-8-ol diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of ent-copal-8-ol diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (13R)-epi-8,13-epoxylabd-14-ene
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid that is isolated from plants and fungi and exhibits anti-bacterial protperties.

name: CDP-D-ribose
definition: A CDP-sugar having aldehydo-D-ribose as the sugar component with the CDP moiety attached at position 5.

name: β-geranylfarnesene
definition: A sesterterpene that is β-farnesene in which one of the terminal methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a geranyl group.

name: β-hexaprene
definition: An acyclic triterpene that is 3-methylidenetetracosa-1,6,10,14,18,22-hexaene carrying five methyl substituents at positions 7, 11, 15, 19 and 23 (the all-E geoisomer).

name: β-heptaprene
definition: An acyclic sesquarterpene that is 3-methylideneoctacosa-1,6,10,14,18,22,26-heptaene carrying six methyl substituents at positions 7, 11, 15, 19, 23 and 27 (the all-E geoisomer).

name: N-acetyl-α-D-muramic acid 1-phosphate
definition: A member of the class of muramic acids that is N-acetyl-α-D-muramic acid in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a phospho group.

name: peregrinol diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of peregrinol diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9,13(R)-epoxylabd-14-ene
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of marrubiin by the medicinal plant Marrubium vulgare.

name: (13R)-manoyl oxide
definition: A tricyclic labdane diterpenoid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of forskolin by Coleus forskohlii.

name: oridonin
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound and ent-kaurane diterpenoid with formula C20H28O6 isolated from the leaves of the medicinal herb Rabdosia rubescens.

name: 2-hydroxy-7,8-dihydropteroic acid
definition: A member of the class of pteroic acids that is 7,8-dihydropteroic acid carrying a phenolic hydroxy substituent at the position ortho to the carboxylic acid function.

name: 2-chloro-3-{2-chloro-5-[4-(difluoromethyl)-3-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]-4-fluorophenyl}propanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 2,4-dihydro-3H-1,2,4-triazol-3-one which is substituted at positions 2, 4, and 5 by 5-(2-carboxy-2-chloroethyl)-4-chloro-2-fluorophenyl, difluoromethyl, and methyl groups, respectively.

name: (R)-carfentrazone
definition: A 2-chloro-3-{2-chloro-5-[4-(difluoromethyl)-3-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]-4-fluorophenyl}propanoic acid that has R configuration.

name: (S)-carfentrazone
definition: A 2-chloro-3-{2-chloro-5-[4-(difluoromethyl)-3-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]-4-fluorophenyl}propanoic acid that has S configuration.

name: rubesanolide D
definition: An abietane diterpenoid found in the medicinal plant Isodon rubescens that is 7α,8β-dihydroxyabiet-13-ene in which the 20-methyl group has undergone formal oxidation to the corresponding carboxy group and condensed with the 8-hydroxy group to give the corresponding γ-lactone. It has shown inhibitory activity against biofilm formation of the dental bacterium Streptococcus mutans.

name: ethyl 2-chloro-3-{2-chloro-5-[4-(difluoromethyl)-3-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]-4-fluorophenyl}propanoate
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-chloro-3-{2-chloro-5-[4-(difluoromethyl)-3-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]-4-fluorophenyl}propanoic acid with ethanol.

name: (R)-carfentrazone-ethyl
definition: An ethyl 2-chloro-3-{2-chloro-5-[4-(difluoromethyl)-3-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]-4-fluorophenyl}propanoate that has R configuration.

name: (S)-carfentrazone-ethyl
definition: An ethyl 2-chloro-3-{2-chloro-5-[4-(difluoromethyl)-3-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]-4-fluorophenyl}propanoate that has S configuration.

name: cycloaraneosene
definition: A diterpene that has a dicyclopenta[a,d]cyclooctane skeleton containing a double bond at the 6a-7 position and which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 1 and 9a, a methylene group at position 4 and an isopropyl group at position 7 (the 1R,3aR,9aS,10aR isomer). A precursor for sordaricin, the aglycone of sodarin found in Sordaria araneosa.

name: (13R,14S)-dihydroxy-(4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,7Z,9E,11E,16Z,19Z )-docosahexaenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at the 13R- and 14S-positions.

name: (7R,14S)-dihydroxy-(4Z,8E,10E,12Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,8E,10E,12Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at the 7R- and 14S-positions.

name: 3-hydroxyhexane-2,5-dione
definition: A diketone that is hexane-2,5-dione in which a hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (9S,10R)-9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A 9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid in which the chiral centres at positions 9 and 10 have S- and R-configuration respectively.

name: N-(4-oxoglutaryl)-L-cysteinylglycine(2−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of N-(4-oxoglutaryl)-L-cysteinylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9R,10S)-9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A 9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid in which the chiral centres at positions 9 and 10 have R- and S-configuration respectively.

name: (9R,10S)-9,10-epoxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A 9,10-epoxyoctadecanoic acid in which the chiral centres at positions 9 and 10 have R- and S-configuration respectively.

name: (9S,10R)-epoxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A 9,10-epoxyoctadecanoic acid in which the chiral centres at positions 9 and 10 have S- and R-configuration respectively.

name: 9,10-epoxy-17-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: An epoxy fatty acid that is 9,10-epoxyoctadecanoic acid (9,10-epoxystearic acid) carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 17.

name: 9,10-epoxy-18-hydroxy-(12Z)-octadecenoic acid
definition: An octadecanoid that is 9,10-epoxy-(12Z)-octadecenoic acid carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 18.

name: 2-heptanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group is specified as heptanoyl.

name: D-xylulose 1,5-bisphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of D-xylulose 1,5-bisphosphate; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 1-O-hexadecyl-2-(8-carboxyoctanoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid obtained by deprotonation of the free carboxy group of 1-O-hexadecyl-2-(8-carboxyoctanoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12,13-epoxy-18-hydroxy-(9Z)-octadecenoic acid
definition: An octadecanoid that is 12,13-epoxy-(9Z)-octadecenoic acid carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 18.

name: 5,6-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoic acid that is (8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid having the epoxide group across positions 5-6 and the hydroxy substituent located at position 20.

name: 8,9-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoic acid that is (5Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid having the epoxide group across positions 8-9 and the hydroxy substituent located at position 20.

name: 11,12-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid having the epoxide group across positions 11-12 and the hydroxy substituent located at position 20.

name: 14,15-epoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid
definition: An epoxy(hydroxy)icosatrienoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoic acid having the epoxide group across positions 14-15 and the hydroxy substituent located at position 20.

name: oxidized Renilla luciferin(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by deprotonation of the amide group of oxidized Renilla luciferin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: 7-oxoresolvin D2
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is resolvin D2 in which the 7-hydroxy group has undergone formal oxidation to the corresponding ketone.

name: 16-oxoresolvin D2
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is resolvin D2 in which the 16-hydroxy group has undergone formal oxidation to the corresponding ketone.

name: (2Z,10Z)-3-hydroxy-5,17-dioxo-4,5-secoestra-2,10-diene-3-oic acid
definition: An oxo seco-steroid that is a meta-cleavage metabolite in the estrogen degradation pathway; an unstable precursor to pyridinestrone acid.

name: pyridinestrone-3-carboxylic acid
definition: An aza-steroid that is 17-oxoestra-1,3,5(10)-triene-3-carboxylic acid in which the carbon at position 4 in the A-ring has been replaced by a nitrogen. An abiotic metabolite in the 4,5-seco pathway of aerobic estrogen degradation by the bacterium Sphingomonas sp. strain KC8.

name: pyraflufen
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is 2-chloro-4-fluorophenylacetic acid in which the phenyl group is substituted at position 5 by a 4-chloro-5-(difluoromethoxy)-1-methylpyrazol-3-yl group. A protoporphyrinogen oxidase inhibitor, it is used (usually as the corresponding ethyl ester proherbicide, pyraflufen-ethyl) for the control of broad-leaved weeds and grasses in a variety of crops.

name: 2-hydroxyoctanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxyoctanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5S,15S)-dihydroperoxy-(6E,8Z,11Z,13E)-icosatetraenoic acid
definition: A bis(hydroperoxy)icosatetraenoic acid that is (6E,8Z,11Z,13E)-icosatetraenoic acid in which the two hydroperoxy groups are located at positions 5S and 15S.

name: 2-hydroxydecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxydecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5S,6R)-dihydroxy-(7E,9E,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid
definition: A dihydroxyicosatetraenoic acid (7E,9E,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid in which the two hydroxy substituents are located at positions 5S and 6R.

name: 2-hydroxyisovaleryl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxyisovaleryl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyheptadecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxyheptadecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyicosanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxyicosanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxydodecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxydodecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxytetradecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxytetradecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: labda-7,13(16),14-triene
definition: A diterpene derived from labdane by dehydrogenation across the C(7)‒C(8), C(13)‒C(16) and C(14)‒C(15) bonds.

name: (12E)-labda-8(17),12,14-triene
definition: A diterpene derived from labdane by dehydrogenation across the C(8)‒C(17), C(12)‒C(13) and C(14)‒C(15) bonds.

name: α-onocerin
definition: A triterpenoid that is ethane in which each carbon has been substituted by a (1R,4aR,6S,8aS)-6-hydroxy-5,5,8a-trimethyl-2-methylenedecahydronaphthalen-1-yl group.

name: β-onocerin
definition: A triterpenoid that is ethane in which each carbon has been substituted by a (4aS,6S,8aS)-6-hydroxy-2,5,5,8a-tetramethyl-3,4,4a,5,6,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalen-1-yl group.

name: (21S)-21,22-epoxypolypoda-8(26)-13,17-trien-3β-ol
definition: A triterpenoid that is an intermediate in the biosynthesis of α-onocerin by the fern Lycopodium clavatum.

name: (3S,22S)-2,3:22,23-diepoxy-2,3,22,23-tetrahydrosqualene
definition: A squalene triterpenoid obtained by epoxidation accross the 2,3- and 22,23-double bonds of squalene.

name: kahweol
definition: A diterpenoid with formula C20H26O3, isolated from the beans of Coffea arabica. It exhibits antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anti-angiogenesis and anti-proliferative properties.

name: (−)-kolavenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of diphosphate OH groups of (−)-kolavenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-kolavenyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of diphosphate OH groups of (+)-kolavenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-kolavelool
definition: A member of the class of octahydronaphthalenes that is 1,2,3,4,4a,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalene which is substituted at position 1 by a 3-hydroxy-3-methylpent-1-en-5-yl group and a methyl group, and by further methyl groups at positions 2, 4, and 5 (the 1R,2S,4aS,8aS stereoisomer; the stereochemistry at the tertiary alcohol was not determined).

name: S-allylsulfenic acid
definition: An S-alkylsulfenic acid in which the alkyl group is specified as allyl.

name: 19-hydroxycarbocyclic thromboxane A2(1−)
definition: A thromboxane anion that is the conjugate base of 19-hydroxycarbocyclic thromboxane A2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 18-hydroxycarbocyclic thromboxane A2(1−)
definition: A thromboxane anion that is the conjugate base of 18-hydroxycarbocyclic thromboxane A2, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5S)-hydroxy-(15S)-hydroperoxy-(6E,8Z,11Z,13E)-icosatetraenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy(hydroxy)icosatetraenoic acid that is (6E,8Z,11Z,13E)-icosatetraenoic acid in which the hydroxy and hydroperoxy substituents are located at positions 5S and 15S respectively.

name: (5S,6R)-dihydroxy-(15S)-hydroperoxy-(7E,9E,11Z,13E)-icosatetraenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy(hydroxy)icosatetraenoic acid that is (7E,9E,11Z,13E)-icosatetraenoic acid carrying 2 hydroxy substituents at positions 5S and 6R as well as a hydroperoxy substituent at position 15S.

name: L-firefly luciferyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of L-firefly luciferyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ent-Photinus luciferin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of ent-Photinus luciferin, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: pyridinium-3-carboxylate-5-thiocarboxylate mononucleotide(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy, thiocarboxy and phosphate OH groups of pyridinium-3-carboxy-5-thiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11(S)-HETE
definition: An 11-HETE in which the chiral centre at position 11 has S-configuration.

name: 2-[(11R)-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,12E,14Z)-icosatetraenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as (11R)-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,12E,14Z)-icosatetraenoyl.

name: 4-sulfanylbutanoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 4-sulfanylbutanoic acid. The major species at pH7.3.

name: 4,4'-disulfanyldibutanoate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of both of the carboxy groups of 4,4'-disulfanyldibutanoic acid.

name: ditetradecanoyl phosphatidylglycerol(1−)
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)(1−) that is the conjugate base of dimyristoyl phosphatidylglycerol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-[(5Z,13E,15S)-11α,15-dihydroxy-9-oxoprosta-5,13-dien-1-oyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as (5Z,13E,15S)-11α,15-dihydroxy-9-oxoprosta-5,13-dien-1-oyl

name: (4S,7R)-7-hydroxy-4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: A (4S)-7-hydroxy-4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one that has R configuration at position 7.

name: (4R,7S)-7-hydroxy-4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: A (4R)-7-hydroxy-4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one that has S configuration at position 7.

name: [4)-β-D-GlcA-(1→4)-β-D-GlcA2(or 3)Ac-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-[(R)-4,6-CH3(COO−)C-β-D-Gal3(or 2)OHb-(1→3)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-α-DGlc2(or 3)Ac-(1→]n
definition: A branched polysaccharide acid oxoanion comprised of an octasaccharide repeating unit consisting of a backbone of two glucose and two glucuronic acid residues, and a side chain of three glucose and one galactose residues. The octasaccharide is modified by two pyruvyl and one non-stoichiometric O-acetyl group, and one non-stoichiometric hydroxybutanoyl group. Note that the structure shown and its molfile represent only one of the possible substitution patterns.

name: 4-methylpent-3-en-1-yl acetate
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of 4-methylpent-3-en-1-ol with acetic acid.

name: (1E)-2,6-dimethylhepta-1,5-dien-1-yl formate
definition: A formate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the E-enol tautomer of 2,6-dimethylhept-5-enal with formic acid.

name: allocholoyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of allocholic acid.

name: allodeoxycholoyl-CoA
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of allodeoxycholic acid.

name: β-muricholoyl-CoA
definition: A member of the class of choloyl-CoAs that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of β-muricholic acid.

name: ursodeoxycholoyl-CoA
definition: A member of the class of choloyl-CoAs that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of ursodeoxycholic acid.

name: (S)-2-methyl-1-(4-methylisoquinoline-5-sulfonyl)-1,4-diazepane(2+)
definition: A ammonium ion obtained by protonation of the secondary and quinoline nitrogens of (S)-2-methyl-1-(4-methylisoquinoline-5-sulfonyl)-1,4-diazepane.

name: (4S,7R)-7-isopropyl-4-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: A 7-isopropyl-4-methyloxepan-2-one that has 4S,7R configuration.

name: 7-oxotaurolithocholic acid
definition: A bile acid taurine conjugate derived from 7-oxolithocholic acid.

name: TDP-α-D-glucose
definition: A TDP-sugar having α-D-glucose as the sugar component.

name: 4-methylpent-3-en-1-ol
definition: A homoallylic alcohol that is 2-methylpent-2-ene in which a hydrogen of the methyl group at position 5 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 7,12-dioxolithocholic acid
definition: A bile acid that is lithocholic acid carrying two additional oxo substituents at positions 7 and 12.

name: 7-oxoglycolithocholic acid
definition: A bile acid glycine conjugate that is glycolithocholic acid carrying an additional oxo substituent at postion 7.

name: 7-oxotaurodeoxycholic acid
definition: A bile acid taurine conjugate derived from 7-oxodeoxycholic acid.

name: 7-oxoglycodeoxycholic acid
definition: A bile acid glycine conjugate that is glycodeoxycholic acid carrying an additional oxo substituent at position 7.

name: (15Z)-12-oxophyto-10,15-dienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4-) that is the tetraanion of (15Z)-12-oxophyto-10,15-dienoyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7β-hydroxy-3,12-dioxo-5β-cholanic acid
definition: An oxo-5β-cholanic acid in which two oxo substituents are located at positions 3 and 12 together with a hydroxy substituent at position 7β.

name: 4-sulfanylbutanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is butyric acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 4 has been replaced by a thiol group.

name: 3α,7β-dihydroxy-12-oxo-5β-cholanic acid
definition: An oxo-5β-cholanic acid that is ursodeoxycholic acid carrying an additional oxo substituent at position 12.

name: 4,4'-disulfanyldibutanoic acid
definition: An organic disulfide resulting from the formal oxidative dimerisation of 4-sulfanylbutanoic acid.

name: (E)-hex-4-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (E)-hex-4-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-{[3-(2-benzamido-4-methyl-1,3-thiazol-5-yl)-pyrazol-5-yl]carbonyl}-G-dR-G-dD-dD-dD-NH2
definition: A hexapeptide consisting of N-{[3-(2-benzamido-4-methyl-1,3-thiazol-5-yl)-1H-pyrazol-5-yl]carbonyl}glycine, D-arginine, glycine, D-α-aspartic acid, D-α-aspartic acid, and D-α-aspartic 1-amide residues coupled in sequence. An angiotensin II type 2 receptor agonist.

name: N,N'-diphenylthiourea
definition: Thiourea in which each nitrogen carries a phenyl substituent.

name: N,N'-dibutylthiourea
definition: Thiourea in which each nitrogen carries a butyl substituent.

name: flucarbazone
definition: An N-sulfonylurea that is 3-methoxy-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1,2,4-triazole-1-carboxamide in which the carboxamide nitrogen has undergone formal condensation with the sulfonic acid group of 2-(trifluoromethoxy)benzenesulfonic acid. An acetolactate synthase inhibitor, it is used (generally as the corresponding sodium salt, flucarbazone-sodium) to control grass weeds in cereal crops.

name: flucarbazone(1−)
definition: An organic nitrogen anion resulting from the deprotonation of the sulfonamide nitrogen of flucarbazone.

name: (9R,13R)-1a,1b-dinor-10,11-dihydro-12-oxo-15-phytoenoate
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (9R,13R)-1a,1b-dinor-10,11-dihydro-12-oxo-15-phytoenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9S,13S)-1a,1b-dinor-10,11-dihydro-12-oxo-15-phytoenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of (9S,13S)-1a,1b-dinor-10,11-dihydro-12-oxo-15-phytoenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-{(1S,5S)-4-oxo-5-[(2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl]cyclopent-2-en-1-yl}hexanoate
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 6-{(1S,5S)-4-oxo-5-[(2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl]cyclopent-2-en-1-yl}hexanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9S,13S)-1a,1b-dinor-12-oxo-10,15-phytodienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA(4) arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate functions of (9S,13S)-1a,1b-dinor-12-oxo-10,15-phytodienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-{(1S,5S)-4-oxo-5-[(2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl]cyclopent-2-en-1-yl}hexanoic acid
definition: A carbocyclic fatty acid that is cyclopent-2-en-1-one which has been substituted at positions 4 and 5 by 5-carboxypentyl and (2ZZ)-pent-2-en-1-yl groups, respectively (the S,S stereoisomer). It is an intermediate in the synthesis of jasmonic acid from hexadecatrienoic acid.

name: bis(7)-tacrine
definition: A secondary amino compound consisting of two molecules of tacrine that are linked together through their exocyclic amino groups by a heptane-1,7-diyl chain. Bis(7)-tacrine is an acetylcholinesterase (AChE)inhibitor (IC50 0.40 nM, >1,000 times more potent than tacrine). It has also been found to protect against H2O2 -induced apoptosis in rat pheochromocytoma cells.

name: hexadecanoyl phosphate(2−)
definition: An acyl monophosphate(2−) in which the acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl), major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-3-hydroxytetradecanoate
definition: A (3S)-3-hydroxy fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (3S)-3-hydroxytetradecanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-chloro-N-[trans-4-(methylamino)cyclohexyl]-N-[3-(pyridin-4-yl)benzyl]-1-benzothiophene-2-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzothiophenes that is 3-chloro-1-benzothiophene-2-carboxamide in which the amide nitrogen is substituted by trans-4-(methylamino)cyclohexyl and 3-(pyridin-4-yl)benzyl groups. A smoothened (Smo) receptor agonist that antagonizes cyclopamine action at the Smo receptor. Activates the Hedgehog signaling pathway in a Patched independent manner.

name: [α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)]n-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-GlcNAc-ditrans,octacis-undecaprenol(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of [α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)]n-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-α-D-GlcNAc-ditrans,octacis-undecaprenol; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3R)-3-hydroxy-2,3-dihydrotabersoninium
definition: An indole alkaloid cation that is the conjugate acid of (3R)-3-hydroxy-2,3-dihydrotabersonine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3R)-1,2-didehydro-3-hydroxy-2,3-dihydrotabersoninium
definition: An indole alkaloid cation that is the conjugate acid of (3R)-1,2-didehydro-3-hydroxy-2,3-dihydrotabersonine, obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5(6)-carboxyfluorescein
definition: A commercially available mixture of 5-carboxyfluorescein and 6-carboxyfluorescein isomers. A fluorescent dye, it is commonly used as a tracer agent.

name: resolvin E3
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is (5Z,8Z,11Z,13E,15E)-icosapentaenoic acid which is substituted at positions 17 and 18 by hydroxy groups (the 17,18S stereoisomer).

name: β-L-idofuranose
definition: L-idofuranose in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: paullone
definition: An indolobenzazepine that is 5,6,7,12-tetrahydroindolo[3,2-d][1]benzazepine carrying an oxo substituent at position 6.

name: alsterpaullone
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-1-benzazepin-2-one which shares its 4-5 bond with the 3-2 bond of 5-nitro-1H-indole.

name: 5(S)6-epoxy-18(S)-HEPE
definition: An epoxy fatty acid that is (7E,9E,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosa-7,9,11,14,16-pentaenoic acid carrying an epoxy group at position 5S and a hydroxy group at position 18S. It is an intermediate in resolvin E1 biosynthesis.

name: etazolate
definition: A pyrazolopyridine that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine which is substituted at positions 1, 4, and 5 by ethyl, 2-isopropylidenehydrazino, and ethoxycarbonyl groups, respectively. A phosphodiesterase IV inhibitor with antidepressant and anxiolytic properties.

name: Glu-Trp-Asp-Arg
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, L-tryptophan, L-aspartic acid, and L-arginine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: piericidin A
definition: A member of the class of monohydroxypyridines that acts as an irreversible mitochondrial Complex I inhibitor that strongly associates with ubiquinone binding sites in both mitochondrial and bacterial forms of NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase

name: BPDZ 711
definition: A member of the class of chromanes that acts as an inhibitor of histone deacetylase class III and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-α-D-GalpNAc-O-propargyl
definition: A glycoside consisting of α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-α-D-GalpNAc linked glycosidically to a propargyl (prop-2-yn-1-yl) group.

name: trans-Ned 19
definition: A member of the class of β-carbolines that is 2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-β-carboline-3-carboxylic acid in which one of the methylene protons at position 1 has been replaced by a 3-{[4-(2-fluorophenyl)piperazin-1-yl]methyl}-4-methoxyphenyl group.

name: D-myo-Ins(1,4,5)P3 hexakis(butyryloxymethyl) ester
definition: A phosphatidylinositol trisphosphate that is 1D-myo-inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate in which all all six phosphate hydrogens have been replaced by butyryloxymethyl groups. It is a cell-permeant analogue of inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate and an agonist of the inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor.

name: (18R)-resolvin E3
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is (5Z,8Z,11Z,13E,15E)-icosapentaenoic acid which is substituted at positions 17 and 18 by hydroxy groups (the 17,18R) stereoisomer).

name: (3E,5Z)-dodecadienoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A (3E,5Z)-dienoyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of (3E,5Z)-dodecadienoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-amino-1-(5-phospho-β-D-ribosyl)imidazole
definition: A 1-(phosphoribosyl)imidazole that is 5-aminoimidazole in which the proton at position 1 has been replaced by a 5-phospho-β-D-ribofuranosyl group.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z,16E,18R)-18-hydroperoxyicosapentaenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyicosapentaenoic acid that is (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z,16E)-icosapentaenoic acid in which the pro-R hydrogen at position 18 has been replaced by a hydroperoxy group. One of the two stereoisomers formed when acetylated COX2 oxidises the ω-3 fatty acid EPA.

name: (3E,5Z)-dodecadienoate
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (3E,5Z)-dodecadienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 19-hydroxyprostaglandin I2
definition: A prostaglandin I that consists of prostaglandin I1 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 19.

name: 19-hydroxythromboxane A2
definition: A thromboxane A that is thromboxane A2 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 19.

name: 18-hydroxythromboxane A2
definition: A thromboxane A that is thromboxane A2 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 18.

name: (5Z,8S,9S,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A (5Z,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid in which the two stereocentres at positions 8 and 9 both have S-configuration.

name: (5Z,8R,9R,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A (5Z,11Z,14Z)-8,9-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid in which the two stereocentres at positions 8 and 9 both have R-configuration.

name: (R)-3-hydroxypentanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A short-chain (3R)-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3R)-hydroxypentanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-3-hydroxypentanoate
definition: A (3R)-3-hydroxy fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (R)-3-hydroxypentanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: pneumocysterol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is (24Z)-24-ethylidenelanost-8-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at the 3β position.

name: (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,17R,19Z)-17-hydroperoxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A docosanoid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid carrying a hydroperoxy substituent at position 17R.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14R,15R)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A (5Z,8Z,11Z)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid in which the two stereocentres at positions 14 and 15 both have R-configuration.

name: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14S,15S)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A (5Z,8Z,11Z)-14,15-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid in which the two stereocentres at positions 14 and 15 both have S-configuration.

name: (5Z,8Z,11R,12R,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A (5Z,8Z,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid in which the two stereocentres at positions 11 and 12 both have R-configuration.

name: (5Z,8Z,11S,12S,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid
definition: A (5Z,8Z,14Z)-11,12-dihydroxyicosatrienoic acid in which the two stereocentres at positions 11 and 12 both have S-configuration.

name: (4S,7S)-7-hydroxy-4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: A (4S)-7-hydroxy-4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one in which the stereocentre at position 7 has S-configuration.

name: (4R,7R)-7-hydroxy-4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one
definition: A (4R)-7-hydroxy-4-isopropenyl-7-methyloxepan-2-one that has R configuration at position 7.

name: 4,4'-diapolycopen-4-al
definition: An apo carotenoid triterpenoid that is 4,4'-diapolycopene in which one of the terminal methyl groups has been replaced by a formyl group.

name: 4,4'-diapolycopen-4-oate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 4,4'-diapolycopen-4-oic acid; obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4(S)-hydroperoxy-17(R)-hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is (5E,7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosa-5,7,10,13,15,19-hexaenoic acid carrying a hydroperoxy group at the 4S-position and a hydroxy group at the 17R-position.

name: 7(S)-hydroperoxy-17(R)-hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid

name: (S)-3-hydroxypentanoate
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (S)-3-hydroxypentanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4S(5)-epoxy-17R-hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: An epoxy fatty acid that is (6E,8E,10Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosa-6,8,10,13,15,19-hexaenoic acid which is carrying an epoxy group at position 4S and a hydroxy group at position 17R. It is a metabolite of docosahexaenoic acid that can be converted to a D-resolvin.

name: 7S,8S-epoxy-17R-hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid
definition: A hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid that is (4Z,9E,11E,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosa-4,9,11,13,15,19-hexaenoic acid carrying an epoxy group at position 7S and a hydroxy group at position 17R. It is a metabolite of docosahexaenoic acid, and serves as a precursor to D-resolvins.

name: aspirin-triggered resolvin D2
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is (4Z,8E,10Z,12E,14E,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid carrying three hydroxy substituents at positions 7, 16 and 17 (the 7S,16R,17R-stereoisomer).

name: aspirin-triggered resolvin D3
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is (5Z,7E,9E,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid carrying three hydroxy substituents at positions 4, 11 and 17 (the 4S,11R,17R-stereoisomer)

name: aspirin-triggered resolvin D4
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is (6E,8E,10Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid carrying three hydroxy substituents at positions 4, 5 and 17 (the 4S,5R,17R-stereoisomer).

name: aspirin-triggered resolvin D5
definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is (4Z,8E,10Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 7 and 17 (the 7S,17R-stereoisomer).

definition: A member of the class of resolvins that is (5E,7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosahexaenoic acid carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 4 and 17 (the 4S,17R-stereoisomer).

definition: An N-jasmonyl-L-α-amino acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-(12-hydroxyjasmonyl)-L-isoleucine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-[(3R)-jasmonyl]-L-isoleucinate
definition: An N-jasmonyl-L-α-amino acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-[(3R)-jasmonyl]-L-isoleucine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A short chain fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyhexanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A medium chain fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxyhexanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: heptadecanal
definition: A long-chain fatty aldehyde that is heptadecane carrying an oxo substituent at position 1. It is found in citrus.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylundecanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A medium chain fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxy-3-methylundecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylnonanoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A medium chain fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 2-hydroxy-3-methylnonanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

definition: A medium chain fatty acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions of 3-methyldodecanoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 17(S)-HDoHE
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty acid that is (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,15E,19Z)-docosa-4,7,10,13,15,19-hexaenoic acid carrying a hydroxy substituent at the 17S-position. It is a metabolite of docosahexaenoic acid in human blood and mouse brain, and serves as a precursor to 17(S)-resolvins.

name: 4(S)-hydroperoxy-17(S)-hydroxydocosahexaenoic acid

name: resolvin D6

name: 2-amino-5-phosphonopentanoic acid

name: resolvin D4

name: CBL0137

name: protectin D1

It is a selective antagonist for the prostanoid receptor EP3, a prostaglandin receptor for prostaglandin E2 (PGE2).
