definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as (9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroperoxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl.

name: 2-[(9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as (9S,11R)-epidioxy-(15S)-hydroxy-(5Z,13E)-prostadienoyl.

name: (Z)-6-(3-hexenyl)tetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-(3-hexenyl)tetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-one in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: α-isomethylionyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetic acid with the hydroxy group of 3-methyl-4-(2,6,6-trimethylcyclohex-2-en-1-yl)but-3-en-2-ol. It is used a flavoring agent.

name: 1,2-di-[(9Z)-hexadecenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which both acyl substituents are specified as (9Z)-hexadecenoyl (palmitoleoyl).

name: D-tagatopyranose 1-phosphate
definition: A ketohexose monophosphate that is D-tagatopyranose in which the phosphono substituent is located at position 1.

name: Gly-Tyr-Ser-Ile-Thr-Ser-His-Tyr
definition: An oligopeptide composed of glycine, L-tyrosine, L-serine, L-isoleucine, L-threonine, L-serine, L-histidine and L-tyrosine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Ala-Arg-Gly-Tyr-Ser-Ser-Phe-Ile-Tyr-Trp-Phe-Phe-Asp-Phe
definition: An oligopeptide composed of L-alanine, L-arginine, glycine, L-tyrosine, L-serine, L-serine, L-phenylalanine, L-isoleucine, L-tyrosine, L-trytophan, L-phenylalanine, L-phenylalanine, L-aspartic acid and L-phenylalanine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Ala-Arg-Gly-Tyr-Ser-Ser-Phe-Ile-Tyr-Trp-Phe-Phe
definition: An oligopeptide composed of L-alanine, L-arginine, glycine, L-tyrosine, L-serine, L-serine, L-phenylalanine, L-isoleucine, L-tyrosine, L-trytophan, L-phenylalanine and L-phenylalanine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Ala-Arg-Gly-Tyr-Ser-Ser-Phe-Arg-Tyr-Trp-Phe-Phe
definition: An oligopeptide composed of L-alanine, L-arginine, glycine, L-tyrosine, L-serine, L-serine, L-phenylalanine, L-arginine, L-tyrosine, L-trytophan, L-phenylalanine and L-phenylalanine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: ent-copal-8-ol diphosphate
definition: A diterpenyl phosphate that is the O-diphospho derivative of ent-copal-8-ol.

name: CDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose(2−)
definition: A CDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-glucose(2−) in which the anomeric centre of the deoxyglucose fragment has α-configuration.

name: (3R)-3-hydroxy-4-oxobutanoate
definition: An aldehydic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (R)-3-hydroxy-4-oxobutanoic acid.

name: CAY10397
definition: A member of the class of azobenzenes that is azobenzene in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted at position 4 by an ethoxycarbonyl group, while the other is substituted by a carboxymethyl group at position 3 and a hydroxy group at position 4. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of 15-hydroxyprostaglandin dehydrogenase (15-hydroxy-PGDH).

name: MMP9 inhibitor I
definition: A hydroxamic acid that is N-hydroxy-3-methylbenzamide in which the the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 have been replaced by benzyl[(4-methoxyphenyl)sulfonyl]amino and (diethylamino)methyl groups, respectively. It is a cell-permeable, potent, selective, and reversible inhibitor of matrix metallopeptidase-9 (MMP-9, EC 3.4.24.35).

name: prinomastat hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of prinomastat and hydrogen chloride. A selective inhibitor with of matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) 2, 3, 9, 13, and 14.

name: 3α-hydroxy bile acid CoA thioester(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of any 3α-hydroxy bile acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxo bile acid CoA thioester(4−)
definition: A steroidal acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of any 3-oxo bile acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: oxolinic acid
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid having the carboxy group at position 7 as well as oxo and ethyl groups at positions 4 and 1 respectively and a dioxolo ring fused at the 5- and 6-positions. A synthetic antibiotic, it is used in veterinary medicine for the treatment of bacterial infections in cattle, pigs and poultry.

name: HT-2 toxin
definition: A trichothecene mycotoxin that is T-2 toxin in which the acetyloxy group at position 4S has been hydrolysed to the corresponding hydroxy group. It is the major metabolite of T-2 toxin.

name: β-D-fructofuranose 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: a D-fructofuranose 1-phosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of β-D-fructofuranose 1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: prinomastat
definition: A hydroxamic acid that is (3S)-N-hydroxy-2,2-dimethylthiomorpholine-3-carboxamide in which the hydrogen attached to the thiomorpholine nitrogen has been replaced by a [4-(pyridin-4-yloxy)phenyl]sulfonyl group. It is a selective inhibitor with of matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) 2, 3, 9, 13, and 14.

name: prinomastat(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the protonation of prinomastat.

name: (R)-3-hydroxy-4-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 4-oxobutanoic acid in which the pro-R hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 6-diazo-5-oxo-L-norleucine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-norleucine which is substituted at position 5 by an oxo group and at position 6 by a diazo group. It is as inhibitor of various glutamine-utilising enzymes.

name: peregrinol diphosphate
definition: A diterpenyl phosphate that is the 15-O-diphospho derivative of peregrinol.

name: meso-zeaxanthin
definition: A carotenol that is β,β-carotene carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 3 and 3' (the 3R,3'S-diastereomer). It is rarely found in diet and is believed to be formed at the macula by metabolic transformations of ingested carotenoids.

name: 1,2-dihexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as hexanoyl.

name: 1-heptanoyl-2-hexanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as heptanoyl and hexanoyl respectively.

name: 1,2-diheptadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as heptadecanoyl.

name: N-hexadecanoyl-1,2-diheptadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-hexadecanoylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as heptadecanoyl.

name: N-oleoyl-1,2-diheptadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: An N-oleoylphosphatidylethanolamine in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are both specified as heptadecanoyl.

name: 1-nitroso-L-tryptophan
definition: An L-tryptophan derivative in which the indolyl ring nitrogen carries a nitroso substituent.

name: Nω-nitroso-L-arginine
definition: An L-arginine derivative in which one of the ω-nitrogen atoms carries a nitroso substituent.

name: N-(4-oxoglutaryl)-L-cysteinylglycine
definition: A dipeptide that is glutathione in which the amino group on the glutamyl residue has been replaced by an oxo group.

name: S-nitroso-L-cysteine
definition: An L-cysteine derivative in which the sulfur atom carries a nitroso substituent. A cell-permeable low-molecular-weight nitrosothiol and nitric oxide donor.

name: D-xylulose 1,5-bisphosphate
definition: A xylulose phosphate that is D-xylulose carrying two phospho groups at positions 1 and 5.

name: β-L-Rhap-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→2)]-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-RhapO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A branched hexasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear tetrasaccharide unit of β-L-rhamnose, β-D-glucose, and two α-L-rhamnose residues, linked sequentially (1→4), (1→3) and (1→3), to the non-reducing-end α-L-rhamnose residue is also linked (1→2) an α-D-glucuronosyl-(1→6)-α-D-glucosyl disaccharide branch, the whole linked glycosidically to a 5-aminopentyl group.

name: 1-O-hexadecyl-2-(8-carboxyoctanoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as hexadecyl and 8-carboxyoctanoyl respectively.

name: 2-hydroxyoctanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty-acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxyoctanoic acid.

name: 11-hydroxyferruginol
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is ferruginol in which the hydrogen ortho to the phenolic hydroxy group has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: carnosate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of carnosic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: salviol
definition: A meroterpenoid that is ferruginol which has been substituted by an α-hydroxy group at position 6.

name: maniladiol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene in which the hydrogens at the 3β and 16β positions have been replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: cochalate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of cochalic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-RhapO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of two α-L-rhamnosyl residues linked (1→3) and at the reducing end linked glycosidically to a 5-aminopentyl group.

name: (4S)-2,3-dehydroleucocyanidin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of (4S)-2,3-dehydroleucocyanidin, obtained by deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: β-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of a β-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a β-L-rhamnosyl residue.

name: (4S)-2,3-dehydroleucopelargonidin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of (4S)-2,3-dehydroleucopelargonidin, obtained by deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-RhapO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A trisaccharide derivative consisting of an α-L-rhamnosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl disaccharide unit.

name: daturadiol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is olean-12-ene in which the hydrogens at the 3β and 6β positions have been replaced by hydroxy groups. Found in the seeds of the downy thorn-apple, Datura innoxia.

name: α-D-GlcpA-(1→6)-α-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of an α-D-glucosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-6 an α-D-glucosyluronic acid residue.

name: β-L-Rhap-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-RhapO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of an α-L-rhamnosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 a β-L-rhamnosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→3)-α-L-rhamnosyl trisaccharide unit.

name: 2-hydroxydecanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty-acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxydecanoic acid.

name: α-D-GlcpA-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-α-L-RhapO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of an α-L-rhamnosyl residue glycosidically linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries at O-3 an α-D-glucuronosyl-(1→6)-α-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnosyl trisaccharide unit.

name: sugiol
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is ferruginol in which the methylene group para to the phenolic hydroxy group has been substituted by an oxo group.

name: 11-hydroxysugiol
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is sugiol in which the hydrogen ortho to the phenolic hydroxy group has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 11,20-dihydroxysugiol
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is 11-hydroxysugiol in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group attached to a ring junction has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 2-hydroxyisovaleryl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty-acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxyisovaleric acid.

name: 11,20-dihydroxyferruginol
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is ferruginol in which a hydrogen of the bridgehead methyl group and the hydrogen ortho to the phenolic hydroxy group have both been replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: 9β-pimara-7,15-diene-3β-ol
definition: A pimarane diterpenoid in which the hydrogen at position 3β has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: ent-cassa-12,15-dien-2β-ol
definition: A diterpenoid that is ent-cassa-12,15-diene in which the hydrogen at position 2β has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: ent-cassa-12,15-dien-2β,3β-diol
definition: A diterpenoid that is ent-cassa-12,15-diene in which the hydrogens at positions 2β and 3β have been replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: ent-cassa-12,15-dien-2-one
definition: A diterpenoid that is ent-cassa-12,15-diene in which the methylene hydrogens at position 2 have been replaced by a keto group.

name: ent-3β-hydroxycassa-12,15-dien-2-one
definition: A diterpenoid that is ent-cassa-12,15-diene carrying oxo and hydroxy substituents at positions 2 and 3β respectively.

name: drimendiol
definition: A member of the class of octahydronaphthalenes that is drimenol in which a hydrogen of the allylic methyl group has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 11α-hydroxycucurbitadienol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is 4,9-cyclo-9,10-secocholesta-5,24-diene substituted by methyl groups at positions 9β, 10, and 14, and by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 11α.

name: 11-oxocucurbitadienol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is cucurbitadienol in which the methylene hydrogens at position 11 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: mogrol
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is cucurbitadienol in which the side-chain double bond (position 24-25) has undergone formal oxidation to introduce hydroxy groups at positions 24 and 25 (the 24R stereoisomer). It is a biometabolite of mogrosides found in Siraitia grosvenorii.

name: mogroside IE
definition: A mogroside that is mogrol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a β-D-glucosyl residue.

name: Lys-GalA
definition: An L-lysine derivative arising from amide formation between N-2 of L-lysine and the carboxy group of α-D-galactopyranuronic acid.

name: AZD1979(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of AZD1979. A melanin concentrating hormone receptor 1 (MCHr1) antagonist.

name: AZD1979 oxetane hydrolysis product
definition: A diol resulting from hydrolysis of the oxetane ring of AZD1979.

name: 2-hydroxyheptadecanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty-acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxyheptadecanoic acid

name: 2-hydroxyicosanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty-acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxyicosanoic acid

name: 2-hydroxydodecanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty-acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxydodecanoic acid.

name: 2-hydroxytetradecanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty-acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxytetradecanoic acid.

name: AMCR277A
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is calcitriol which has undergone formal oxidative coupling at positions 20 and 23 to the hydroxy group and methyl group, respectively, of methanol to afford the corresponding oxolane ring (the 20S,23S stereoisomer). It is a superagonist of the vitamin D nuclear receptor in vitro, but is as calcemic in vivo as the natural ligand.

name: AMCR277B
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is calcitriol which has undergone formal oxidative coupling at positions 20 and 23 to the hydroxy group and methyl group, respectively, of methanol to afford the corresponding oxolane ring (the 20S,23R stereoisomer). It is less calcemic towards the vitamin D nuclear receptor than 1α,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 in vivo.

name: (1S,3R)-dihydroxy-(20S)-[(5'S)-(2"-hydroxy-2"-propyl)-(2'R)-tetrahydrofuryl]-22,23,24,25,26,27-hexanor-1α-hydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is a synthetic analogue of vitamin D3 which contains an oxolane ring and exhibits weak vitamin D receptor agonist activity

name: (1S,3R)-dihydroxy-(20S)-[(5'R)-(2"-hydroxy-2"-propyl)-(2'S)-tetrahydrofuryl]-22,23,24,25,26,27-hexanor-1α-hydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is a synthetic analogue of vitamin D3 which contains an oxolane ring and exhibits weak vitamin D receptor agonist activity.

name: hydroxysafflor yellow A
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is 3,4,5-trihydroxycyclohexa-2,5-dien-1-one which is substituted by β-D-glucosyl groups at positions 2 and 4, and by a p-hydroxycinnamoyl group at position 6. It is the main bioactive compound of a traditional Chinese medicine obtained from safflower (Carthamus tinctorius).

name: (1S,3R)-dihydroxy-(20S)-[(5'S)-(2"-hydroxy-2"-propyl)-(2'S)-tetrahydrofuryl]-22,23,24,25,26,27-hexanor-1α-hydroxyvitamin D3
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is a synthetic analogue of vitamin D3 which contains an oxolane ring and exhibits weak vitamin D receptor agonist activity.

name: nerylneryl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups of nerylneryl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (−)-kolavenyl diphosphate
definition: A diterpenyl phosphate that is the O-diphospho derivative of (−)-kolavenol

name: (+)-kolavenyl diphosphate
definition: A diterpenyl phosphate that is the O-diphospho derivative of (+)-kolavenol

name: L-firefly luciferyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of L-firefly luciferin.

name: ent-Photinus luciferin
definition: A 1,3-thiazolemonocarboxylic acid consisting of 3,5-dihydrothiophene-4-carboxylic acid having a 6-hydroxybenzothiazol-2-yl group at the 2-position.

name: golgicide A
definition: A diastereoisomeric mixture comprising racemic cis- and racemic trans-goglioside A in a 10:1 ratio. It is a potent and rapidly reversible GBF1 (Golgi-specific brefeldin A-resistance guanine nucleotide exchange factor 1) inhibitor. The (3aS,4R,9bR) isomer is the most active (see Bioorg. Med. Chem. Lett., 2012, 22, 5177-5181).

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl)phytosphingosine-1-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol)(1−)
definition: An inositol-1-phospho-N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl)phytosphingoid(1−) in which the sphingoid base portion contains 18 carbons.

name: 2-[5-(but-3-yn-2-yloxy)-4-chloro-2-fluorophenyl]-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione
definition: A dicarboximide that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione in which the nitrogen has been substituted by a 5-(but-3-yn-2-yloxy)-4-chloro-2-fluorophenyl group.

name: (R)-flumipropyn
definition: A 2-[5-(but-3-yn-2-yloxy)-4-chloro-2-fluorophenyl]-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione that has R configuration.

name: (S)-flumipropyn
definition: A 2-[5-(but-3-yn-2-yloxy)-4-chloro-2-fluorophenyl]-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-isoindole-1,3(2H)-dione that has S configuration.

name: carbocyclic thromboxane A2
definition: A member of the class of thromboxanes that is thromboxane A2 in which the bridging oxygen has been replaced by a methylene group.

name: 19-hydroxycarbocyclic thromboxane A2
definition: A member of the class of thromboxanes that is carbocyclic thromboxane A2 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 19.

name: 18-hydroxycarbocyclic thromboxane A2
definition: A member of the class of thromboxanes that is carbocyclic thromboxane A2 carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at position 18.

name: GSK2656157
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7-methyl-7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-amine which has been substituted at position 5 by a 4-fluoro-2,3-dihydro-1H-indol-5-yl group, the nitrogen of which has been acylated by a (6-methylpyridin-2-yl)acetyl group. An orally bioavailable PERK inhibitor.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-1-hydroxy-16-{(1R,2S)-2-[(17R,18R)-17-methoxy-18-methylhexatriacontyl]cyclopropyl}hexadecyl]hexacosanoic acid
definition: A synthetic chiral mycolic acid analogue comprising 3-hydroxypropanoic acid having a tetracosanyl group at position 2 and a further long-chain alkyl group containing cyclopropyl, methoxy and methyl functions attached at position 3.

name: pyridinium-3-carboxy-5-thiocarboxylic acid mononucleotide
definition: A pyridine nucleotide having 3-carboxy-5-(sulfanylcarbonyl)pyridine as the nucleobase.

name: 3-ethyl-2,7-dimethyloctane
definition: An alkane that is octane substituted by an ethyl group at position 3 and by methyl groups at positions 2 and 7. It is a urinary sex pheromone found in male mice.

name: (15Z)-12-oxophyto-10,15-dienoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of (15Z)-12-oxophyto-10,15-dienoic acid.

name: 4-hydroxytryptamine(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group of 4-hydroxytryptamine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: norbaeocystin(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and protonation of the amino group of norbaeocystin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: baeocystin(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and protonation of the amino group of baeocystin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: psilocybin(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the protons from the phosphate group and the protonation of the tertiary amino group of psilocybin. The major species at pH 7.3

name: N5-phospho-L-glutamine(2−)
definition: An organic phosphoramidate anion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphoramidate and carboxy groups as well as protonation of the amino group of N5-phospho-L-glutamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6,8-difluoro-4-(pyridin-3-yl)-3a,4,5,9b-tetrahydro-3H-cyclopenta[c]quinoline
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 3a,4,5,9b-tetrahydro-3H-cyclopenta[c]quinoline which is substituted by a pyridin-3-yl at position 4 and by fluorines at positions 6 and 8.

name: (3aR,4S,9bS)-golgicide A
definition: A 6,8-difluoro-4-(pyridin-3-yl)-3a,4,5,9b-tetrahydro-3H-cyclopenta[c]quinoline that has 3aR,4S,9bS configuration.

name: (3aS,4R,9bR)-golgicide A
definition: A 6,8-difluoro-4-(pyridin-3-yl)-3a,4,5,9b-tetrahydro-3H-cyclopenta[c]quinoline that has 3aS,4R,9bR configuration. It is the most active stereoisomer of golgicide A.

name: (3aR,4R,9bS)-golgicide A
definition: A 6,8-difluoro-4-(pyridin-3-yl)-3a,4,5,9b-tetrahydro-3H-cyclopenta[c]quinoline that has 3aR,4R,9bS configuration.

name: (3aS,4S,9bR)-golgicide A
definition: A 6,8-difluoro-4-(pyridin-3-yl)-3a,4,5,9b-tetrahydro-3H-cyclopenta[c]quinoline that has 3aS,4S,9bR configuration.

name: (E)-hex-4-enoyl-CoA
definition: A fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (E)-hex-4-enoic acid.

name: (9R,13R)-1a,1b-dinor-10,11-dihydro-12-oxo-15-phytoenoic acid
definition: A carbocyclic fatty acid that is hexanoic acid substituted at position 6 by a 3-oxo-2-{(Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl}cyclopentyl group.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose having a D-galactopyranosyl residue attached at the 6-position via an α-linkage. α-D-Gal-(1→6)-D-Gal in which the configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre is β.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→6)]-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched trisaccharide comprising β-D-galactose (at the reducing end), to which are linked (1→2) and (1→6) α-D-galactosyl residues.

name: (R,R)-3-(3-hydroxydecanoyloxy)decanoate
definition: A 3-hydroxydecanoyl-3-hydroxydecanoate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (R,R)-3-(3-hydroxydecanoyloxy)decanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9S,13S)-1a,1b-dinor-10,11-dihydro-12-oxo-15-phytoenoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of (9S,13S)-1a,1b-dinor-10,11-dihydro-12-oxo-15-phytoenoic acid.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-octanamido-N-(6-phenylhexyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(octanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(6-phenylhexyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: (9S,13S)-1a,1b-dinor-12-oxo-10,15-phytodienoyl-CoA
definition: An oxo fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxylic acid group of (9S,13S)-1a,1b-dinor-12-oxo-10,15-phytodienoic acid.

name: hexadecanoyl phosphate
definition: An acyl monophosphate in which the acyl group is specified as hexadecanoyl (palmitoyl).

name: (R,R)-3-(3-hydroxydecanoyloxy)decanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxydecanoyl-3-hydroxydecanoic acid in which both stereocentres have R configuration.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-octanamido-N-(8-phenyloctyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(octanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(8-phenyloctyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: N-[(2S,3S,4R)-1-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-3,4-dihydroxy-16-phenylhexadecan-2-yl]octanamide
definition: A synthetic sphingoid in which C16 phytosphingosine is substituted at O-1, C-16 and N with respectively an α-D-galactopyranosyl group, a phenyl group and an octanoyl group.

name: (3E,5Z)-dodecadienoyl-CoA
definition: A medium-chain unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (3E,5Z)-dodecadienoic acid.

name: (3R)-3-hydroxy-2,3-dihydrotabersonine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid obtained by formal hydration across the 2,3-double bond of tabersonine.

name: OSMI-1
definition: A sulfonamide resulting from the formal condensation of the sulfonic acid group of 2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinoline-6-sulfonic acid with the primary amino group of (2R)-2-amino-N-(2-furylmethyl)-2-(2-methoxyphenyl)-N-(2-thienylmethyl)acetamide. OSMI-1 is a cell permeable inhibitor of O-linked β-N-acetylglucosamine transferase (O-GlcNAc transferase, OGT).

name: 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(15Z)-tetracos-15-enoyl]sphingosine(1−)
definition: A galactosylceramide sulfate(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl)-N-[(15Z)-tetracos-15-enoyl]sphingosine obtained by deprotonation of the sulfate group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-glucosyl-N-(oleoyl)sphingosine
definition: An N-acyl-β-D-galactosylsphingosine where the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as oleoyl.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(7-phenylheptanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 7-phenylheptanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(9-phenylnonanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 9-phenylnonanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: β-D-mannosyl C32-phosphomycoketide(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid that is the conjugate base of β-D-mannosyl C32-phosphomycoketide obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: phosphomycoketide C32(2−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid that is the conjugate base of phosphomycoketide C32 obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-O-({poly[2-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-D-ribitylphosphonato]}-di{[2R]-1-glycerylphosphonato})-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate groups of 4-O-({poly[2-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl-1-D-ribitylphosphonato]}-di{[2R]-1-glycerylphosphonato})-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-O-({poly[2-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-1-D-ribitylphosphonato]}-di{[2R]-1-glycerylphosphonato})-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate groups of 4-O-({poly[2-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-1-D-ribitylphosphonato]}-di{[2R]-1-glycerylphosphonato})-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: mannose-1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: A phosphate monoester dianion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of mannose-1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: mannose-(1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate)2(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of mannose-(1D-myo-inositol 1-phosphate)2; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-O-[poly(2-β-D-glucosyl-1-D-ribitylphosphonato)-1-D-ribitylphosphonato-(2R)-1-glycerylphosphonato]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate groups of 4-O-[poly(2-β-D-glucosyl-1-D-ribitylphosphonato)-1-D-ribitylphosphonato-(2R)-1-glycerylphosphonato]-N-acetyl-β-D-mannosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S,S)-bis-(3-oleoylglycero)-1-phosphate(1−)
definition: A 3,3'-lysobisphosphatidate obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of (S,S)-bis-(3-oleoylglycero)-1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ADP-5-ethyl-4-methylthiazole-2-carboxylate(3−)
definition: A organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy and phosphate groups of ADP-5-ethyl-4-methylthiazole-2-carboxylic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S,S)-3-oleoylglycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol(1−)
definition: A 1-acylglycero-3-phospho-1'-glycerol(1−) that is the conjugate base of (S,S)-3-oleoyl-sn-glycero-1-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: AZD1979
definition: A carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-(p-methoxyphenyl)-1,3,4-oxadiazole-2-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 3-phenoxyazetidine and in which the phenoxy group has been substituted at the para- position by a 2-oxa-6-azaspiro[3.3]heptan-6-ylmethyl group. It is a melanin concentrating hormone receptor 1 (MCHr1) antagonist.

name: (S,S)-bis-(2-oleoylglycero)-1-phosphate(1−)
definition: A 1,1'-lysobisphosphatidate obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of (S,S)-bis-(2-oleoylglycero)-1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S,S)-2-oleoylglycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid that is the conjugate base of (S,S)-2-oleoylglycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [(1→2)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→4)-α-D-galacturonosyl]n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of [(1→2)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→4)-α-D-galacturonosyl]n; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-galacturonosyl-[(1→2)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→4)-α-D-galacturonosyl]n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of α-D-galacturonosyl-[(1→2)-α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→4)-α-D-galacturonosyl]n; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)-N-methyl-N-[(3-methyloxetan-3-yl)methyl]methanamine
definition: A tertiary amino compound that is p-methoxybenzylamine in which the hydrogens attached to the amino group have been replaced by methyl and 3-methyloxetan-3-yl groups.

name: 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)-N-methyl-N-[(3-methyloxetan-3-yl)methyl]methanamine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion obtained by protonation of the amino group of 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)-N-methyl-N-[(3-methyloxetan-3-yl)methyl]methanamine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: oleuropein aglycone
definition: A secoiridoid that is the methyl ester of 3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-5-carboxylic acid which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 4 by hydroxy, ethylidene, and carboxymethyl groups, respectively and in which the carboxylic acid moiety of the carboxymethyl substituent has been converted to the corresponding 3,4-dihydroxyphenethyl ester (the 2R,3E,4S stereoisomer). The most important phenolic compound present in olive cultivars.

name: 2-{[(4-methoxybenzyl)(methyl)amino]methyl}-2-methylpropane-1,3-diol
definition: A tertiary amino compound that is p-methoxybenzylamine in which the hydrogens attached to the amino group have been replaced by a methyl group and a 2,2-bis(hydroxymethyl)propyl group. Obtained from 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)-N-methyl-N-[(3-methyloxetan-3-yl)methyl]methanamine by hydrolysis of the oxetane moiety using human liver microsomes.

name: 2-{[(4-methoxybenzyl)(methyl)amino]methyl}-2-methylpropane-1,3-diol(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of 2-{[(4-methoxybenzyl)(methyl)amino]methyl}-2-methylpropane-1,3-diol.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(11-phenylundecanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 11-phenylundecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(15-phenylpentadecanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 15-phenylpentadecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(21-phenylhenicosanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 21-phenylhenicosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(25-phenylpentacosanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 25-phenylpentacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1'-(3'-oleoyl)-sn-glycerol(1−)
definition: An acylglycerophosphoacylglycerol(1−) that is the conjugate base of 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1'-(3'-oleoyl)-sn-glycerol, obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-[6-(4-methoxyphenyl)hexanoyl]phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 6-(4-methoxyphenyl)hexanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: N-[6-(4-fluorophenyl)hexanoyl]-1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 6-(4-fluorophenyl)hexanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-{6-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]hexanoyl}phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 6-(4-trifluoromethyl)hexanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: bryostatin 2
definition: A member of the class of bryostatins that is bryostatin 1 in which the acetoxy group has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: N-[6-([1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl)hexanoyl]-1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 6-([1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl)hexanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 4,4'-diapolycopen-4-oic acid
definition: An apo carotenoid triterpenoid that is 4,4'-diapolycopene in which one of the terminal methyl groups has been replaced by a carboxy group.

name: 1-O-(all-trans-retinoyl)-β-D-glucuronate
definition: A retinoid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of 1-O-all-trans-retinoyl-β-D-glucuronide arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-(β-D-glucopyranuronosyloxy)retinoate(2−)
definition: A retinoid glucosiduronic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of 4-(β-D-glucopyranuronosyloxy)retinoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5,6-epoxyretinoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5,6-epoxyretinoic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-O-(5,6-epoxyretinoyl)-β-D-glucuronate
definition: A retinoid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of 1-O-(5,6-epoxyretinoyl)-β-D-glucuronic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-O-(4-oxoretinoyl)-β-D-glucuronate
definition: A retinoid glucosiduronic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 1-O-(4-oxoretinoyl)-β-D-glucuronic acid arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-[8-(4-methoxyphenyl)octanoyl]phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 8-(4-methoxyphenyl)octanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-[8-(4-trifluoromethyl)phenyloctanoyl]phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 8-[(4-trifluoromethyl)phenyl]octanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: N-[8-([1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl)octanoyl]-1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 8-([1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl)octanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-[11-(4-methoxyphenyl)undecanoyl]phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 11-(4-methoxyphenyl)undecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-{11-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]undecanoyl}phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 11-(4-trifluoromethyl)undecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: cochalic acid
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is oleanane which has been substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β and 16β positions, dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond at the 12-13 position, and in which the methyl substituent at position 17 has undergone oxidation to give the corresponding carboxylic acid. Found in the cactus Myrtillocactus cochal.

name: N-[11-([1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl)undecanoyl]-1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 11-([1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl)undecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 4-hydroxytryptamine
definition: A member of the class of tryptamines that is tryptamine in which the the indole ring has been substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: N-[(2S,3S,4R)-1-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-3,4-dihydroxy-6-phenylhexan-2-yl]hexacosanamide
definition: An α-galactosylceramide in which the nitrogen carries a hexacosanamido group and C-4 carries in addition to a hydroxy function a 2-phenylethyl group. Essentially a phytosphingosine analogue with a truncated lipid chain terminating in a benzene ring, it has been used in investigations on the binding affinity of glycolipids to CD1d molecules.

name: N-[(2S,3S,4R)-1-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-3,4-dihydroxy-8-phenyloctan-2-yl]hexacosanamide
definition: An α-galactosylceramide in which the nitrogen carries a hexacosanamido group and C-4 carries in addition to a hydroxy function a 4-phenylbutyl group. Essentially a phytosphingosine analogue with a truncated lipid chain terminating in a benzene ring, it has been used in investigations on the binding affinity of glycolipids to CD1d molecules.

name: N-[(2S,3S,4R)-1-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-3,4-dihydroxy-11-phenylundecan-2-yl]hexacosanamide
definition: An α-galactosylceramide in which the nitrogen carries a hexacosanamido group and C-4 carries in addition to a hydroxy function a 7-phenylhexyl group. Essentially a phytosphingosine analogue with a truncated lipid chain terminating in a benzene ring, it has been used in investigations on the binding affinity of glycolipids to CD1d molecules.

name: N-[(2S,3S,4R)-1-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-3,4-dihydroxy-13-phenyltridecan-2-yl]hexacosanamide
definition: An α-galactosylceramide in which the nitrogen carries a hexacosanamido group and C-4 carries in addition to a hydroxy function a 9-phenylnonyl group. Essentially a phytosphingosine analogue with a truncated lipid chain terminating in a benzene ring, it has been used in investigations on the binding affinity of glycolipids to CD1d molecules.

name: (2S)-1-oleoyl-2-methylglycero-3-phosphothionate
definition: A glycerophospholipid obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with the primary hydroxy group of (2S)-2-methylglycero-3-phosphothionate.

name: GRI977143
definition: A benzoisoquinoline that is 1H-benzo[de]isoquinoline-1,3(2H)-dione in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen has been replaced by a 3-[(2-carboxyphenyl)thio]propyl group. It is a selective LPA2 receptor non-lipid agonist.

name: (R,R)-bis(2-oleoylglycero)-3-phosphate(1−)
definition: A 2-acylglycerophospho-(2'-acylglycerol)(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of (R,R)-bis-(2-oleoylglycero)-1-phosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R,R)-2-oleoylglycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol(1−)
definition: An anionic phospholipid that is the conjugate base of (R,R)-2-oleoylglycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3E,5Z)-dodecadienoic acid
definition: A medium-chain polyunsaturated fatty acid that is dodecanoic acid containing two double bonds at positions 3 and 5 (the 3E,5Z-geoisomer).

name: (R)-3-hydroxypentanoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (R)-3-hydroxypentanoic acid.

name: (R)-3-hydroxypentanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxypentanoic acid in which the chiral centre at position 3 has R-configuration.

name: gemini-0072
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is a synthetic fluorinated and deuterated analogue of vitamin D3 which exhibits vitamin D receptor superagonist and anti-cancer activity.

name: gemini-0097
definition: A hydroxycalciol that is a synthetic fluorinated and deuterated analogue of vitamin D3 which exhibits vitamin D receptor superagonist and anti-cancer activity.

name: benzylpenilloic acid
definition: A thiazolidinemonocarboxylic acid resulting from nucleophilic cleavage of the β-lactam ring of benzylpenicillin.

name: NBD-N(Me)-DKK(Biotin)βA-OH
definition: A tetrapeptide comprising in sequence an α-aspartyl residue, two lysyl residues and a β-alanyl residue, to the nitrogen of the aspartyl residue of which are linked both a methyl group and a 7-nitro-2,1,3-benzoxadiazol-4-yl moiety, while the ε nitrogen of the lysyl(II) residue carries a biotin moiety. It is used a peptide probe, with the biotin moiety finding application in immunoassays.

name: [4-(6-methylheptanoyl)-5-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-3-yl]methyl phosphate
definition: A butenolide that is (5-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-3-yl)methyl phosphate carrying an additional 6-methylheptanoyl substituent at position 4.

name: NBD-N(Me)-DKβA-OH
definition: A tripeptide comprising in sequence α-aspartyl, lysyl residue and β-alanyl residues, to the nitrogen of the aspartyl residue of which are linked both a methyl group and a 7-nitro-2,1,3-benzoxadiazol-4-yl moiety.

name: NBD-N(Me)-DβA-OH
definition: A dipeptide comprising in sequence α-aspartyl and β-alanyl residues, to the nitrogen of the aspartyl residue of which are linked both a methyl group and a 7-nitro-2,1,3-benzoxadiazol-4-yl moiety.

name: DNP-N-GKβA-OH
definition: A tripeptide comprising in sequence glycyl, lysyl and β-alanyl residues, to the nitrogen of the glycyl residue of which is linked a 2,4-dinitrophenyl moiety.

name: [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of [8)-α-Neu5Ac-(2→]n; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-cis-4-hydroxyretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of 9-cis-4-hydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-cis-4-oxoretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of 9-cis-4-oxoretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-cis-4-oxoretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of 9-cis-retinoic acid bearing an oxo substituent at position 4 on the cyclohexenyl ring.

name: all-trans-16-hydroxyretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of all-trans-retinoic acid bearing an hydroxy substituent at position 16.

name: all-trans-16-hydroxyretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-16-hydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: all-trans-18-hydroxyretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-18-hydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: all-trans-4,16-dihydroxyretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of all-trans-retinoic acid bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 4 and 16.

name: all-trans-4,16-dihydroxyretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-4,16-dihydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: all-trans-4,18-dihydroxyretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of all-trans-retinoic acid bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 4 and 18.

name: all-trans-4,18-dihydroxyretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-4,18-dihydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: all-trans-4-oxo-16-hydroxyretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of all-trans-retinoic acid carrying an oxo substituent at position 4 and a hydroxy substituent at position 16.

name: all-trans-4-oxo-16-hydroxyretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-4-oxo-16-hydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: all-trans-4-oxo-18-hydroxyretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that consists of all-trans-retinoic acid carrying an oxo substituent at position 4 and a hydroxy substituent at position 18.

name: all-trans-4-oxo-18-hydroxyretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-4-oxo-18-hydroxyretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [(3S)-4-(6-methylheptanoyl)-5-oxooxolan-3-yl]methyl phosphate
definition: A butan-4-olide that is (5-oxooxolan-3-yl)methyl phosphate carrying an additional 6-methylheptanoyl substituent at position 4.

name: (S)-3-hydroxypentanoyl-CoA
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA resulting from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (S)-3-hydroxypentanoic acid.

name: 6β-hydroxycortisone
definition: A C21-steroid that is cortisone bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at the 6β-position. It is produced as a metabolite of cortisol by cytochrome p450-3A4 (CYP3A4, an important enzyme involved in the metabolism of a variety of exogenous and endogenous compounds) and can be used to detect moderate and potent CYP3A4 inhibition in vivo.

name: (S)-3-hydroxypentanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxypentanoic acid in which the chiral centre at position 3 has S-configuration.

name: 6β-hydroxycortisol
definition: A C21-steroid that is cortisol bearing an additional hydroxy substituent at the 6β-position. In humans, it is produced as a metabolite of cortisol by cytochrome p450-3A4 (CYP3A4, an important enzyme involved in the metabolism of a variety of exogenous and endogenous compounds) and can be used to detect moderate and potent CYP3A4 inhibition in vivo.

name: 3-hydroxypentanoic acid
definition: A short-chain fatty acid that is valeric acid in which one of the methylene hydrogens at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 4-O-methylxanthohumol(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of 4-O-methylxanthohumol, obtained by deprotonation of the 1-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3 (according to Marvin v 6.2.0.).

name: calcitriol 25-O-(β-D-glucuronate)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of calcitriol 25-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: calcidiol 25-O-(β-D-glucuronate)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of calcidiol 25-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: calcidiol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronate)
definition: A steroid glucuronide anion that is the conjugate base of calcidiol 3-O-(β-D-glucuronide) arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAcO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: [(2→8)-N,O7-diacetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of [(2→8)-N,O7-diacetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [(2→8)-N,O9-diacetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of [(2→8)-N,O9-diacetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [(2→6)-α-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of [(2→6)-α-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [(2→6)-α-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N,O7-diacetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of [(2→6)-α-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N,O7-diacetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n; major species at pH 7.3.

name: [(2→6)-α-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N,O9-diacetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n polyanion
definition: A polyanionic polymer obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy groups of [(2→6)-α-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-N,O9-diacetyl-α-D-neuraminosyl]n; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-alanyl-AMP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is adenosine 5'-monophosphate in which one of the hydroxy groups of the phosphate has been condensed with the carboxylic acid group of D-alanine.

name: 4α-phorbol 12,13-didecanoate
definition: A phorbol ester that is phorbol in which the hydroxy groups at the cyclopropane ring juction (position 13) and the adjacent carbon (position 12) have been converted to the corresponding decanoate esters. A Trpv4-specific ligand.

name: (+)-jasmonic acid
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid that is (3-oxocyclopentyl)acetic acid substituted by a (2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl group at position 2 of the cyclopentane ring.

name: N-[(3R)-12-hydroxyjasmonyl]-L-isoleucine
definition: An L-isoleucine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (3R)-12-hydroxyjasmonic acid with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: N-[(3R)-jasmonyl]-L-isoleucine
definition: An L-isoleucine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (3R)-jasmonic acid with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: 2-hydroxybutanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxybutanoic acid.

name: 2-hydroxyhexanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxyhexanoic acid.

name: otophylloside B
definition: A steroid saponin that is 17α-pregnenolone which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 8, 12β, 14β and 17β, in which the 14β-hydrocy group has been acylated by formal condensation with the carboxy group of (2E)-3,4-dimethylpent-2-enoic acid, and in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been glycosylated with 2,6-dideoxy-3-O-methyl-β-D-arabino-hexopyranosyl-(1→4)-2,6-dideoxy-3-O-methyl-β-D-ribo-hexopyranosyl-(1→4)-2,6-dideoxy-3-O-methyl-β-D-ribo-hexopyranos. A C-21 steroidal glycoside, it is the essential active ingredient of the traditional Chinese medicine Qingyangshen, isolated from Cynanchum otophyllum and used to treat epilepsy and rheumatic pain.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAcO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAcO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-α-D-GalNAc and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-GalNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: 20β-dihydrocortisol
definition: A 17α-hydroxy-C21-steroid that is cortisol in which the 20-oxo group has been reduced to a hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of cortisol identified in the urine of horses and humans, and its urinary excretion is increased in obesity.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAcO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAcO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAcO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-α-D-GalNAc and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-Gal and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]6CH=CH2
definition: A glycoside formed between the branched tetrasaccharide α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-[α-D-Gal-(1→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc and the alkenyl alcohol oct-7-en-1-ol.

name: coelenterazine 2-hydroperoxide
definition: A member of the class of oxidized luciferins that is obtained via formal hydroperoxidation at position 2 of Oplophorus luciferin.

name: coelenterazine dioxetanone
definition: A member of the class of oxidized luciferins that is obtained via formal oxidative cleavage of Oplophorus luciferin.

name: 3-hydroxy-11Z-octadecenoylcarnitine
definition: An O-(hydroxyoctadecenoyl)carnitine having 3-hydroxy-11Z-octadecenoyl as the acyl substituent.

name: methoxypoly(ethylene glycol)-maleimide
definition: A poly(ethylene glycol) derivative that is methoxypoly(ethylene glycol) in which the terminal hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding 2-maleimidoethyl ether. Used particularly for the mPEGylation of free thiol groups in cysteine residues of proteins.

name: 1-O-(4-aminobenzoyl)-β-D-glucopyranose
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 1R is substituted by a (4-aminobenzoyl)oxy group.

name: 5-chloro-L-tryptophan zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the α-amino group of 5-chloro-L-tryptophan.

name: nepicastat
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-dihydroimidazole-2-thiones that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-imidazole-2-thione in which one of the nitrogens is substituted by a 5,7-difluoro-1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalen-2-yl group while the carbon adjacent to it is substituted by an aminomethyl group (the S enantiomer). It is a potent and selective inhibitor of both bovine and human dopamine β-hydroxylase, an enzyme that catalyzes the conversion of dopamine to norepinephrine.

name: 6-chloro-L-tryptophan zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the α-amino group of 6-chloro-L-tryptophan; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6,7-dichloro-L-tryptophan zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the α-amino group of 6,7-dichloro-L-tryptophan; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4Z,8Z)-4,8-dimethyl-12-oxotrideca-4,8-dienal
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (4Z,8Z)-4,8-dimethyltrideca-4,8-diene carrying two oxo substituents at positions 1 and 12. A product from bacterial degradation of rubber.

name: 1-(4-chlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)pentan-3-ol
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 2,2-dimethylpentane that is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 5 by hydroxy, 1,2,4-triazol-1-yl, and p-chlorophenyl groups, respectively.

name: (S,S)-paclobutrazol
definition: A 1-(4-chlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)pentan-3-ol in which both stereocentres have S configuration.

name: (R,R)-paclobutrazol
definition: A 1-(4-chlorophenyl)-4,4-dimethyl-2-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)pentan-3-ol in which both stereocentres have R configuration.

name: all-trans-4-hydroxyretinal
definition: A retinoid that is all-trans-retinal carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 4 on the cyclohexenyl ring.

name: all-trans-4-oxoretinal
definition: A retinoid that is all-trans-retinal carrying an oxo substituent at position 4 on the cyclohexenyl ring.

name: N-(p-amylcinnamoyl)anthranilic acid
definition: An amidobenzoic acid that is anthranilic acid in which one of the anilino hydrogens is replaced by a 4-pentylcinnamoyl group. It is a transient receptor potential (TRP) channel blocker and phospholipase A2 (PLA2) inhibitor.

name: methacetin
definition: A member of the class of acetamides that is paracetamol in which the hydrogen of phenolic hydroxy group has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: methacetin-(methoxy-13C)
definition: A 13C-modified compound that is methacetin which has 13C as the predominant isotope of the methoxy carbon. In normal subjects, methacetin is rapidly metabolised in the liver, being dealkylated by hepatic CYP1A2 to give paracetamol (acetaminophen); the methyl of the methoxy group is eliminated as CO2. Administering methacetin-(methoxy-13C) to a patient enables the liver (cytochrome P-450 1A2) function to be determined quickly and precisely by measuring the 13CO2 in the breath (e.g. by isotope-selective non-dispersive infrared spectrometry (NDIRS)).

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylundecanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy-3-methylundecanoic acid.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methylnonanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy-3-methylnonanoic acid.

name: piperacilloyl-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative obtained from nucleophilic cleavage of the β-lactam ring of piperacillin by the ε-amino group of the L-lysine molecule.

name: flucloxacilloyl-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative obtained from nucleophilic cleavage of the β-lactam ring of flucloxacillin by the ε-amino group of the L-lysine molecule.

name: amoxicilloyl-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative obtained from nucleophilic cleavage of the β-lactam ring of amoxicillin by the ε-amino group of the L-lysine molecule.

name: benzylpenicilloyl-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative obtained from nucleophilic cleavage of the β-lactam ring of benzylpenicillin (penicillin G) by the ε-amino group of the L-lysine molecule.

name: aztreonyl-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative obtained from nucleophilic cleavage of the β-lactam ring of aztreonam by the ε-amino group of the L-lysine molecule.

name: 3-methylnonanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-methylnonanoic acid.

name: (R)-2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl-CoA
definition: A 2-hydroxyhexadecanoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (R)-2-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid.

name: 2-hydroxy-3-methyldodecanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy-3-methyldodecanoic acid.

name: 1,3,7,9-tetramethyluric acid
definition: An oxopurine that is uric acid in which the hydrogens at positions 1,3,7 and 9 are replaced by methyl groups. It is a purine alkaloid that is found in Chinese tea known as kucha (Camellia assamica var. kucha) and exhibits anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-ManpO[CH2]3NH2
definition: A mannooligosaccharide derivative consisting of a D-mannosyl residue α-linked to a 3-aminopropyl group and which carries an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl unit linked (1→3) and an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannosyl unit linked (1→6).

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-ManpO[CH2]3NH2
definition: A mannooligosaccharide derivative consisting of a D-mannosyl residue β-linked to a 3-aminopropyl group and which carries an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl unit linked (1→3) and an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-β-D-mannosyl unit linked (1→6).

name: 3-methyldodecanoyl-CoA
definition: A hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-methyldodecanoic acid.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-ManpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: A mannooligosaccharide derivative consisting of a D-mannosyl residue α-linked to a 5-aminopentyl group and which carries an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl unit linked (1→3) and an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→3)-[α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl unit linked (1→6).

name: α-D-galactosyl ditrans,octacis-undecaprenyl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenyl glucosyl phosphate in which an α-D-galactosyl residue is linked to a undecaprenyl group via a diphospho group.

name: CDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-α-D-glucose
definition: A CDP-4-dehydro-6-deoxy-D-glucose in which the anomeric centre of the deoxyglucose fragment has α-configuration.

name: N-hexadecanoyl-O-(1-octadecanoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho)-L-serine
definition: An N-acyl-O-(3-sn-phosphatidyl)-L-serine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the amino group of 1-octadecanoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine.

name: N-hexadecanoyl-O-(1-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho)-L-serine
definition: An N-acyl-O-(3-sn-phosphatidyl)-L-serine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the amino group of 1-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-L-serine

name: N-hexadecanoyl-1-[(1Z)-octadecenoyl]-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine
definition: A glycerophosphoethanolamine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the amino group of 1-[(1Z)-octadecenoyl]-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched undecasaccharide derivative consisting of a heptasaccharide chain of α-sialyl, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose, and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→4), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which is (1→6)-linked a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide branch and to the reducing end N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue of which is (1→6)-linked an α-L-fucose residue. When it is the N-glycan content of the tumour necrosis factor (TNF) alpha blocker cetuximab, the terminal Neu5Ac residue may be replaced by Neu5Gc, while the fucose residue may be absent. When it is the N-glycan content of the tumour necrosis factor (TNF) alpha blocker infliximab, the terminal Neu5Ac residue may be replaced by Neu5Gc, while one or both of the fucose and terminal galactose residues may be absent.

name: 1-oleoyl-2-[(4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphate
definition: A 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol 3-phosphate in which the 1- and 2-acyl substituent are specified as oleoyl and (4Z,7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z,19Z)-docosahexaenoyl respectively; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-fructofuranose 1-phosphate
definition: A D-fructofuranose 1-phosphate in which the anomeric centre has β-configuration.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched pentadecasaccharide derivative comprising N-glycoloylneuraminic acid, D-galactose, N-acetyl-D-glucosamine and D-mannoseD residues linked as shown. It constitutes the N-glycan moiety in bovine thyroglobulin.

name: 4-O-β-D-glucosyl-trans-ferulic acid
definition: A methoxyycinnamic acid that is ferulic acid in which the phenolic hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into its β-D-glucoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched dodecasaccharide derivative comprising N-acetylneuraminic acid, D-galactose, N-acetyl-D-glucosamine and D-mannoseD residues linked as shown. It constitutes the N-glycan moiety in human thyroglobulin.

name: eriodictyol 7-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A flavanone glycoside that is eriodictyol attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage. It is an Nrf2 activator and provides protection against cisplatin-induced toxicity.

name: nitroso-dapsone
definition: A sulfone that is a metabolite of dapsone in which one of the amino groups of dapsone has been oxidized to a nitroso group.

name: (4S)-2,3-dehydroleucocyanidin
definition: A chromenol that is 2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-4H-1-benzopyran carrying four additional hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 4, 5 and 7.

name: (4S)-2,3-dehydroleucopelargonidin
definition: A chromenol that is 2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-4H-1-benzopyran carrying four additional hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 4, 5 and 7.

name: monoacetyldapsone
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from acetylation of one of the amino groups of dapsone.

name: acedapsone
definition: A sulfone that is dapsone in which both of the amino groups been acetylation. An antimicrobial drug, it also has antimalarial activity.

name: 3-nitroacetaminophen-TMS
definition: An acetamide that is acetaminophen (paracetamol) substituted on the phenolic oxygen and the amido nitrogen with trimethylsilyl groups

name: nerylneryl diphosphate
definition: A polyprenol diphosphate having (Z,Z,Z)-geranylgeraniyl (nerylneryl) as the polyprenyl component.

name: norbaeocystin
definition: A tryptamine alkaloid that is tryptamine carrying an additional phosphoryloxy substituent at position 4.

name: (+)-O-methylkolavelool
definition: A diterpenoid that is (+)-kolavelool in which the tertiary hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: 5-chloro-L-tryptophan
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-tryptophan in which the hydrogen at position 5 of the indole ring has been replaced by a chlorine.

name: beta-pinacene
definition: A diterpene that is cyclotetradeca-1,3,7,11-tetraene which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 7, and 11, and by an isopropyl group at position 4 (the 1Z,3E,7E,11E isomer). It is a constituent of the essential oils from Pinus koraiensis and Pinus sibirica.

name: disodium tetrachloropalladate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt in which the counteranion is tetrachloropalladate(2−).

name: titanium(IV) isopropoxide
definition: A titanium coordination entity consisting of a titanium(IV) cation with four propan-2-olate anions as counterions.

name: titanium(IV) bis(ammonium lactato)dihydroxide
definition: A bisammonium salt of a titanium coordination entity in which the titanium central atom is coordinated to two 2-methyl-3-oxobutane-1,4-diyl bidentate ligands and two hydroxy groups.

name: calcium titanate
definition: A calcium salt with the formula CaTiO3, generally obtained in the form of the mineral perovskite.

name: baeocystin
definition: A tryptamine alkaloid that is N-methyltryptamine carrying an additional phosphoryloxy substituent at position 4.

name: N5-phospho-L-glutamine

name: nonaflavuxanthin
definition: A C45 carotenoid that is an intermediate in the biosyntheses of decaprenoxanthin by Corynebacterium glutamicum and γ-cyclic sarcinaxanthin by Micrococcus luteus.

name: flavuxanthin
definition: A C50 carotenoid that is an intermediate in the biosyntheses of decaprenoxanthin by Corynebacterium glutamicum and γ-cyclic sarcinaxanthin by Micrococcus luteus.

name: Ara6-ANSSFAP
definition: A glycopeptide consisting of the Ara6 epitope attached to an Ala-Asn-Ser-Ser-Phe-Ala-Pro-NH2 heptapeptide via a [(2-hydroxyethoxy)imino]acetyl linker.

name: N-(2-hydroxyhexacosanoyl)phytosphingosine-1-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol)
definition: An inositol phosphoceramide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxyhexacosanoic acid with the amino group of phytosphingosine-1-phospho-(1D-myo-inositol).

name: Ara6-DAHATLR
definition: A glycopeptide consisting of the Ara6 epitope attached to an Asp-Ala-His-Ala-Thr-Leu-Arg-NH2 heptapeptide via a [(2-hydroxyethoxy)imino]acetyl linker.

name: Ara6-TTYVVNP
definition: A glycopeptide consisting of the Ara6 epitope attached to a Thr-Thr-Tyr-Val-Val-Asn-Pro-NH2 heptapeptide via a [(2-hydroxyethoxy)imino]acetyl linker.

name: MP-PYT
definition: A member of the class of barbiturates that is barbituric acid in which one of the nitrogens (position 1) is substituted by a p-tolyl group while the carbon at position 5 is substituted by a (2E)-3-[p-(dimethylamino)phenyl]allylidene group. It has significant osteogenic activity.

name: DMP-PYT
definition: A member of the class of barbiturates that is barbituric acid in which one of the nitrogens (position 1) is substituted by a 3,5-dimethylphenyl group while the carbon at position 5 is substituted by a (2E)-(3-[p-(dimethylamino)phenyl]allylidene group. It has significant osteogenic activity.

name: phosphomycoketide C32
definition: A C32 phosphomycoketide in which all five stereocentres have S-configuration.

name: (13C)carbon dioxide
definition: A 13C-modified compound that is carbon dioxide in which the carbon is present as its 13C isotope.

name: (S,S)-bis-(3-oleoylglycero)-1-phosphate
definition: A 2,2'-lysobisphosphatidic acid in which both acyl groups are specified as oleoyl.

name: (S,S)-3-oleoylglycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol
definition: A member of the class of glycerophosphoglycerols obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with one of the primary hydroxy groups of (S,S)-glycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol

name: (S,S)-bis(2-oleoylglycero)-1-phosphate
definition: A 1,1'-lysobisphosphatidic acid in which both acyl groups are specified as oleoyl.

name: (S,S)-2-oleoylglycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol
definition: A member of the class of glycerophosphoglycerols obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of oleic acid with one of the secondary hydroxy groups of (S,S)-glycero-1-phospho-1'-glycerol

name: 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1'-(3'-oleoyl)-sn-glycerol
definition: A member of the class of glycerophosphoglycerols that is sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the hydroxy hydrogens at positions 1, 2 and 3' have been replaced by oleoyl groups.

name: antalarmin
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-amine which is substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 5, and 6, by a mesityl group at position 7, and in which the amino substituent at position 4 has been substituted by ethyl and butyl groups. It is an antagonist of corticotropin-releasing factor 1 (CRF-1) receptors (Ki = 1 nM).

name: 1-O-(5,6-epoxyretinoyl)-β-D-glucuronic acid
definition: A retinoid that is 5,6-epoxyretinoic acid in which the carboxy proton has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl residue.

name: (9Z,12R)-12-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (9Z,12R)-12-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-[(9Z)-12-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoyl]-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group is specified as (9Z)-12-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoyl.

name: archaeal dolichyl α-D-glucosyl phosphate(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of archaeal dolichyl α-D-glucosyl phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH group; major species at pH 7.3. Dolichol used by archaea is is generally much shorter (C55-C60) than that used by eukaryotes and may have additional saturation positions in the chain.

name: archaeal dolichyl β-D-glucuronosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosyl phosphate(2−)

Dolichol used by archaea is is generally much shorter (C55-C60) than that used by eukaryotes and may have additional saturation positions in the chain.

name: methyl α-L-rhamnosyl-(1→2)-3-(2-glycerylphospho)-β-D-galactoside

name: 8-amino-8-demethylriboflavin 5'-phosphate(3−)

name: 2-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnose

name: 4-O-methylxanthohumol

name: 8-hydrazinocarbonyloctyl 2-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnoside
