name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A maltotriose trisaccharide in which the glucose residue at the reducing end is in the pyranose form.

name: 12-epi-fischerindole G
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 5,6,6a,7,8,9,10,10a-octahydroindeno[2,1-b]indole which is substituted at positions 6, 6, and 9 by methyl groups, and at positions 8, 9, and 10 by chlorine, vinyl, and isocyano groups respectively (the 6aS,8R,9S,10R,10aS stereoisomer). It is an indole alkaloid produced by the Stigonematales genus of cyanobacteria.

name: 4-[(1S,3aR,4S,6aR)-4-(1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl)tetrahydrofuro[3,4-c]furan-1-yl]-2-methoxyphenol
definition: A furofuran that is tetrahydro-1H,3H-furo[3,4-c]furan which is substituted at positions 1 and 4 by 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl and 1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl groups, respectively (the 1S,3aR,4S,6aR stereoisomer). The biosynthetic precursor of (+)-sesamin.

name: α-D-galacturonosyl-(1→4)-D-galacturonate(2−)
definition: A carbohydrate acid anion arising from deprotonation of both carboxy groups of 4-(α-D-galactopyranuronosyl)-D-galactopyranuronic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (6S)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydrofolyl-poly(γ-glutamate) macromolecule
definition: A tetrahydrofolyl-poly(glutamate) macromolecule in which the stereocentre at position 6 on the tetrahydrofolyl moiety has S-configuration.

name: α-D-GalpA-(1→4)-D-GalpA
definition: A digalacturonic acid in which an α-D-galactopyranuronic acid unit is joined to a D-galactopyranuronic acid unit via an α-(1→4)-linkage.

name: cyclooctat-9-en-5,7-diol
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is cyclooctatin in which the hydroxymethyl substituent has been reduced to the corresponding methyl group. It is the biosynthetic precursor of cyclooctatin.

name: 2,3,6-trichloro-4-hydroxyphenolate
definition: A phenolate anion that is 2,3,5-trichlorobenzene-1,4-diol in which the hydroxy group that is ortho- to two chlorines has undergone deprotonation. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,6-dichloro-4-hydroxyphenolate
definition: A phenolate anion that is 2,6-dichlorohydroquinone in which the hydroxy group that is ortho to both of the chlorines has been deprotonated. The major species at pH 7.3

name: pilocarpine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of (+)-pilocarpine, a medication used to treat increased pressure inside the eye and dry mouth.

name: 16,16-dimethylprostaglandin E2
definition: A prostanoid that is prostaglandin E2 in which both of the hydrogens at position 16 have been replaced by methyl groups. A synthetic analogue of prostaglandin E2, it is a potent inhibitor of pancreatic function and growth of experimental tumors. It also protects the gastric mucosa, prevents ulceration, and promotes the healing of peptic ulcers.

name: (2Z,4E)-4-amino-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienedioate
definition: A polyunsaturated dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of both of the carboxy groups of (2Z,4E)-4-amino-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienedioic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: nocamycin E(2−)
definition: A carboxylic acid dianion that is a dianion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group and the enol group of nocamycin E. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: nocamycin I(1−)
definition: An organic anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol moiety of nocamycin I. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,6-didemethyltoxoflavin
definition: A pyrimidotriazine that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydropyrimido[5,4-e][1,2,4]triazine with oxo groups at positions 5 and 7.

name: tetramic acid
definition: A γ-lactam that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-pyrrol-2-one in which the hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. Despite its simple structure, it was not synthesised until 1972; earlier attempts were later shown to have resulted only in the formation of the isomer 5-imino-4,5-dihydrofuran-3-ol.

name: (2E,5S,6E,8E,10E)-5-hydroxydodeca-2,6,8,10-tetraenal
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty aldehyde that is (2E,6E,8E,10E)-dodeca-2,6,8,10-tetraenal in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: validoxylamine B(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of validoxylamine B; major species at pH 7.3.

name: validoxylamine B
definition: An amino cyclitol that is (1S,2S,3R,6S)-6-amino-4-(hydroxymethyl)cyclohex-4-ene-1,2,3-triol in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a (1R,2S,3R,4R,5S,6S)-2,3,4,6-tetrahydroxy-5-(hydroxymethyl)cyclohexyl group.

name: (S)-2,5,5-trimethylthiazolidine-4-carboxylic acid
definition: A trimethyl-substituted thiazolidine carboxylic acid derived by cleavage of and loss of C=O from the azetidine ring of penicillanic acid.

name: dodecyl dodecanoate
definition: A dodecanoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of dodecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of dodecan-1-ol.

name: diodone
definition: A 4-pyridone in which the pyridone is iodo-substituted at C-3 and -5 and has a carboxymethyl substituent on nitrogen; used as a radiocontrast agent urography.

name: rubimaillin
definition: A benzochromene that is 2H-benzo[h]chromene which is substituted by two methyl groups at position 2, a methoxycarbonyl group at position 5, and a hydroxy group at position 6. Found in the Chinese medical plant Rubia cordifola, It has an anti-cancer effect by inhibition of TNF-α-induced NF-κB activation. It is also a dual inhibitor of acyl-CoA:cholesterol acyltransferase 1 and 2 (ACAT1 and ACAT2), but is more selective for the ACAT2 isozyme.

name: orthosulfamuron
definition: An N-sulfonylurea and sulfuric amide resulting from the formal condensation of sulfuric acid with the primary amino group of 1-(4,6-dimethoxypyrimidin-2-yl)urea and with the primary amino group of 2-amino-N,N-dimethylbenzamide (1 mol eq. of each). An acetolactate synthase inhibitor, it is used as a pre- and post-emergent herbicide for the treatment of grasses and broad-leaved weeds in rice crops.

name: fazarabine
definition: An N-glycosyl-1,3,5-triazine that is 4-amino-1,3,5-triazin-2(1H)-one substituted by a β-D-arabinofuranosyl residue via an N-glycosidic linkage. A synthetic analogue of cytosine arabinoside and 5-azacytidine that incorporates structural features of both compounds, it shows good activity against a variety of transplanted tumors.

name: ketomycolic acid type-3 (XIII')
definition: A class of mycolic acids characterized by the presence of a proximal cis C=C double bond followed by a cis-cyclopropyl group, a distal oxo group and a (CH-CH3) fragment of (S) stereochemistry in the meromycolic chain.

name: (1S)-1-phenylethanaminium
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of (S)-1-phenylethanamine; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-N-acetyl-1-phenylethylamine
definition: An N-(1-phenylethyl)acetamide that has S configuration.

name: (R)-N-acetyl-1-phenylethylamine
definition: An N-(1-phenylethyl)acetamide that has R configuration.

name: (1R)-1-phenylethanaminium
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of (R)-1-phenylethanamine; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: grandiflorenic acid
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid with formula C20H28O2 which exhibits anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, antileishmanial and wound-healing properties.

name: α-methyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: An L-phenylalanine derivative that consists of L-phenylalanine bearing an additional methyl substituent at position 2.

name: 3-methoxy-α-methyl-L-tyrosine
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative in which the tyrosine skeleton is substituted with a methoxy group at C-3 of the phenyl ring and with a methyl group at the α carbon. It can also be regarded as a 3-O-methyl,α-methyl derivative of L-dopa.

name: α-methylnoradrenaline
definition: A catecholamine in which the 2-aminoethyl group is substituted with a hydroxy group at C-1 and a methyl group at C-2, with configurations 1R,2S. A metabolite of α-methyl-L-dopa, it is an alpha2-adrenergic agonist and acts as a topical nasal decongestant and vasoconstrictor, most often used in dentistry.

name: metyltetraprole
definition: A member of the class of tetrazoles that is 1-methyl-4-phenyltetrazole in which the phenyl group has been substituted at positions 2 and 3 by [1-(p-chlorophenyl)-1H-pyrazol-3-yl]oxy}methyl and methyl groups, respectively. A quinone outside inhibitor, it is a fungicide that can be used to control a broad range of diseases, including Septoria leaf blotch in wheat.

name: ronidazole
definition: A carbamate ester that is 5-nitroimidazole in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 2 are replaced by methyl and (carbamoyloxy)methyl groups, respectively. An antiprotozoal agent, it is used in veterinary medicine for the treatment of histomoniasis and swine dysentery.

name: dimetridazole
definition: A C-nitro compound that is 5-nitroimidazole in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 2 are replaced by methyl groups. An antiprotozoal drug, it has been banned by both the Government of Canada and the European Union as a livestock feed additive owing to suspicions of it being carcinogenic.

name: (methylsulfanyl)acetaldehyde
definition: An aldehyde that is acetaldehyde in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a methylsulfanyl group.

name: N-(1-phenylethyl)acetamide
definition: A member of the class of acetamides resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of 1-phenylethylamine with 1 mol eq. of acetic acid.

name: (2Z,4E)-4-amino-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienedioic acid
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid that is 4-aminohepta-2,4-dienoic acid which is substituted at position 6 by an oxo group [the (2Z,4E) isomer].

name: nocamycin E
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound and tetramic acid derivative isolated from a mutant strain of Saccharothrix syringae. Nocamycin E exhibits considerably lower antibacterial activity than the corresponding methyl ester, nocamycin I.

name: diafenthiuron-S-oxide
definition: A sulfoxide resulting from the oxidation of the thiourea sulfur group of diafenthiuron.

name: α-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Glc-(1→3)-[α-D-Gal-(1→6)]-D-Glc-(1→3)-[LD-Hep-(1→7)]-α-LD-Hep4P-(1→3)-α-LD-Hep4PPEtN-(1→5)-α-D-Kdo
definition: A branched oligosaccharide derivative consisting of nine residues corresponding to the core region of Salmonella lipopolysaccharide molecules and used as a model compound in investigations on the conjugation of the O-antigen to the CRM197 carrier protein. (It should be noted that the site and degree of phosphorylation of the HepIII residue are uncertain, while for the PPEtN group the percentage substitution can vary according to the strain of origin and the growth conditions.)

name: di-(N-succinimidyl) adipate
definition: An N-hydroxysuccinimide ester formed from adipic acid.

name: (E)-hex-2-en-1-ol
definition: A hex-2-en-1-ol that has (E)-configuration.

name: (E)-hex-2-enyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of (E)-hex-2-en-1-ol with the carboxy group of acetic acid.

name: neryl acetate
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of nerol with the carboxy group of acetic acid.

name: isoxaflutole
definition: A member of the class of isoxazoles that is 1,2-oxazole substituted by a 2-(methanesulfonyl)-4-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl group and a cyclopropyl group at positions 4 and 5, respectively. It is a 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase inhibitor which is used as a herbicide for weed control in maize and sugarcane.

name: 2-cyano-3-cyclopropyl-1-(2-mesyl-4-trifluoromethylphenyl)propan-1,3-dione
definition: A β-diketone and nitrile resulting from the the degradation of the isoxazole ring of isoxaflutole. The active herbicide of the proherbicide isoxaflutole.

name: 3,5-dimethoxytoluene
definition: A member of the class of toluenes that is toluene in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 5 have been replaced by methoxy groups. It is the major scent compound of many rose varieties.

name: germacrene D-4-ol
definition: A germacrane sesquiterpenoid that is germacrene D in which the exocyclic double bond has undergone formal addition of water to afford the corresponding tertiary alcohol.

name: methyl {[2-chloro-4-fluoro-5-(1-oxo-3-sulfanylidenetetrahydro-1H-[1,2,4]triazolo[1,2-a]pyridazin-2(3H)-yl)phenyl]sulfanyl}acetate
definition: A triazolopyridazine that is tetrahydro-1H-[1,2,4]triazolo[1,2-a]pyridazine which is substituted at positions 1, 3, and 4 by oxo, sulfanyl and 4-chloro-2-fluoro-5-[(2-methoxy-2-oxoethyl)sulfanyl]phenyl groups, respectively. The active metabolite of the proherbicide fluthiacet-methyl.

name: elemol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is isopropanol which is substituted at position 2 by a (3S,4S)-3-isopropenyl-4-methyl-4-vinylcyclohexyl group.

name: (4E,6E)-2,6-dimethylocta-2,4,6-triene
definition: An ocimene that consists of octa-2,4,6-triene bearing methyl substituents at positions 2 and 6 (the 4E,6E-isomer).

name: N-carbamoyl-D-phenylglycine
definition: A member of the class of ureas that is N-carbamoylglycine in which the pro-R hydrogen has been replaced by a phenyl group.

name: (6E)-nerolidol
definition: A nerolidol in which the double bond at position 6 adopts a trans-configuration.

name: 3-acetylbenzamide
definition: A methyl ketone that is benzamide in which one of the meta hydrogens has been replaced by an acetyl group. It is a bacterial secondary metabolite from actinomycete strain WA23-4-4 isolated from the intestinal tract of Periplaneta americana (American cockroach), it shows significant antifungal activity against Candida albicans ATCC 10231 and Aspergillus niger ATCC 16404 but is less active against Trichophyton rubrum ATCC 60836 and Aspergillus fumigatus ATCC 96918.

name: (2R)-2-[(1R)-4-methylcyclohex-3-en-1-yl]propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propionic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a 4-methylcyclohex-3-en-1-yl group (the R,R stereoisomer). A secondary metabolite with antifungal activity obtained from the endophytic fungus Pestalotiopsis foedan, obtained from the branch of the upriver orange mangrove, Bruguiera sexangula.

name: (1R,4R,5R,8S)-8-hydroxy-4,8-dimethyl-2-oxabicyclo[3.3.1]nonan-3-one
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that is 2-oxabicyclo[3.3.1]nonan-3-one which has been substituted by an oxo group at position 3, methyl groups at positions 4 and 8, and by a hydroxy group at position 8 (the 1R,4R,5R,8S stereoisomer). Isolated from the plant endophytic fungus Pestalotiopsis foedan.

name: hapten OTAb
definition: A synthetic phenylalanine derivative derived formally from the mycotoxin ochratoxin A by substitution at position 4 of the phenyl ring with a 5-carboxypentyl group.

name: 4-(2,4,7-trioxa-bicyclo[4.1.0]heptan-3-yl)phenol
definition: A cyclic acetal resulting from the formal condensation of the aldehydic group of p-hydroxybenzaldehyde with the hydroxy groups of 1,2-epoxypropane-1,3-diol. Isolated from Pestalotiopsis mangiferae, an endophytic fungus associated with the mango (Mangifera indica), it shows potent antibacterial and antifungal activity against E. coli, Bacillus subtilis, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Micrococcus luteus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Candida albicans.

name: hapten OTAd
definition: A synthetic phenylalanine derivative derived formally from the mycotoxin ochratoxin A by replacement of the methyl group at position 3 of the isochromene ring with a 4-carboxybutyl group.

name: djalonensone
definition: A benzochromenone that is alternariol in which the hydroxy group at position 9 has been converted into the corresponding methyl ether. A natural product found in Chaetomium globosum as well as being one of the two most important compounds belonging to the group of Altenaria mycotoxins.

name: rhizopycnolide A
definition: A benzochromene that is benzo[c]chromen-6-one which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 4 and 7, methoxy groups at positions 3 and 9, a methyl group at position 1, and a 2-carboxy-2-hydroxyethyl group at position 4, and in which the carboxy group has undergone condensation with the 4-hydroxy group to afford the corresponding spirocyclic lactone. It is active against the pathogenic bacteria Agrobacterium tumefaciens, Bacillus subtilis, Pseudomonas lachrymans, Ralstonia solanacearum, Staphylococcus hemolyticus, and Xanthomonas vesicatoria, with MIC values in the range 25-100 μg/mL.

name: 2-phenylethyl 1H-indol-3-ylacetate
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of indole-3-acetic acid with the hydroxy group of 2-phenylethanol.

name: metam
definition: A member of the class of dithiocarbamic acids that is dithiocarbamic acid in which a hydrogen attached to the amino group has been replaced by a methyl group. It is used (most widely as the corresponding sodium salt, metam-sodium) as an agricultural pesticide, mainly as a broad spectrum soil fumigant for the control of weeds, nematodes, soil-borne insects and fungi.

name: metam(1−)
definition: A dithiocarbamate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the thiol group of metam.

name: hapten OTAe
definition: A synthetic phenylalanine derivative derived formally from the mycotoxin ochratoxin A by amide formation between its carboxy group and 6-aminohexanoic acid.

name: 9-deoxy-hymatoxin A
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is isopimarane in which a hydrogen at position 2 of the 13-ethyl substituent has been replaced by a (sulfooxy) group, a double bond has been introduced at the 7-8 position, and the β-methyl group at position 4 has been oxidised to the corrsponding carboxy group and coupled to position 6 to give a γ-lactone. Isolated from an avendophytic fungus, Xylaria sp. YM 311647, obtained from Azadirachta indica, it shows potent inhibitory activity against C. albicans and Pyricularia oryzae.

name: botryosphaerin H
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid that is decahydro-4H,9H-[2]benzofuro[7,1-fg]isochromene-4,9-dionewhich is substituted by methyl groups at the 3a and 10b positions and by hydroxy groups at the 6 and 6a positions. A tetranorlabdane diterpenoid isolated from isolated from the solid fermentation products of Botryosphaeria sp. P483 that exhibits antifungal activity.

name: stemphyperylenol
definition: An organic polycyclic compound that is 1,2,6b,7,8,12b-hexahydroperylene-3,9-dione which is substituted at positions 1, 4, 7, and 10 by hydroxy groups (the all-S isomer).

name: hapten OTAf
definition: A synthetic phenylalanine derivative consisting of a 1:1 diatereoisomeric mixture of ochratoxin A and its isochromenyl C-3 epimer.

name: guignardone N
definition: A meroterpenoid found in Guignardia and Fusarium species and shown to exhibit inhibitory activity against Candida albicans growth.

name: hyalodendriol C
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 6H-benzo[c]chromen-6-one substituted by a methyl group at position 1, chloro group at position 2, methoxy group at position 3, and by hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 9. It is a metabolite isolated from Hyalodendriella species.

name: palmariol B
definition: A benzochromenone that is 6H-benzo[c]chromen-6-one which is substituted by a methyl group at position 1, chloro group at position 2, hydroxy groups at positions positions 3 and 7, and by a methoxy group at position 9.

name: 4-hydroxymellein
definition: An isochromane that is mellein bearing a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: botrallin
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 2,4a-dihydro-6H-benzo[c]chromen-6-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 7, an oxo group at position 2, methoxy groups at positions 3 and 9, and a methyl group at position 4a. It is isolated from Hyalodendriella species.

name: sporothriolide
definition: A furofuran that is (3aR,6aR)-hexahydrofuro[3,4-b]furan substituted by an oxo group at positions 2 and 4, methylene group at position 3 and by an hexyl group at position 6. It is a metabolite isolated from several species of fungi.

name: altenusin
definition: A carboxybiphenyl that is [biphenyl]-2-carboxylic acid which is substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 3, 4' and 5', methoxy group at position 5 and a methyl group at position 2'. It is a a metabolite isolated from Alternaria and several other fungal species.

name: 5-(undeca-3,5,7-trien-1-yl)furan-2-ol
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan-2-ol in which the hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a undeca-3,5,7-trien-1-yl group. The configuration of the undecatrienyl double bonds is not stated.

name: 5-hydroxybenzofuran-2-one
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 1-benzofuran-2(3H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5.

name: (R)-3-hydroxybutanenitrile
definition: A 3-hydroxybutanenitrile that has R configuration. A metabolite isolated from Aspergillus sp. KJ-9, it is active against a wide variety of phytopathogenic fungi.

name: solabegron
definition: A carboxybiphenyl that is [biphenyl]-3-carboxylic acid carrying a (2-{[(2R)-2-(3-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxyethyl]amino}ethyl)nitrilo group at the 3' position. A selective β3-adrenergic receptor agonist currently in clinical development for the treatment of overactive bladder and irritable bowel syndrome.

name: pinoxaden acid
definition: An organic hydroxy compound resulting from the hydrolysis of the the pivalate ester group of the proherbicide pinoxaden.

name: 3,6-dichloro-2-methoxybenzoate
definition: A member of the class of benzoates resuting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3,6-dichloro-2-methoxybenzoic acid (dicamba). Major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: 5-hydroxy-8-methoxy-4-phenylisoquinolin-1(2H)-one
definition: An isoquinolinol that is 5-hydroxyisoquinolin-1(2H)-one which has been substituted at positions 4 and 8 by phenyl and methoxy groups, respectively. Isolated from the fermentation of an endophytic fungus Penicillium sp. R22 in Nerium indicum. It displayed weak antibacterial activity.

name: fusarithioamide A
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is 2-aminobenzoic acid in which the hydrogen atom of the carboxy group has been substituted by a [(1S)-1-hydroxy-3-mercaptopropyl]nitrilo group and in which one of the the hydrogens of the amino group has been substituted by a (2R)-2-aminopropanoyl group. It is a metabolite isolated from the endophytic fungus, Fusarium chlamydosporium.

name: helvolic acid methyl ester
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of helvolic acid with methanol. Isolated from the fermentation of endophytic fungus Fusarium sp. in Ficus carica leaves.

name: aigialone
definition: A furopyran that is 5,6-dihydro-4H-furo[2,3-b]pyran-3(2H)-one which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 5, methyl groups at positions 2 and 5, and a heptyl group at position 6 (the 2R,4R,5S,6R stereoisomer). Isolated from the mangrove fungus Aigialus parvus BCC 5311 and from Phaeoacremonium sp., an endophytic fungus from Senna spectabilis.

name: N-methylhippuric acid
definition: An N-acylglycine that is N-methylglycine in which the hydrogen of the amino group is substituted by a benzoyl group.

name: isoaigialone B
definition: A γ-lactone that is 3,4,5,7-tetrahydro-2H-furo[3,4-b]pyran substituted by heptyl, methyl, hydroxy, hydroxy, oxo and methyl groups at positions 2R, 3S, 3S, 4R, 5 and 7R, respectively. It is isolated from the endophytic fungus Phaeoacremonium sp. and exhibits antifungal activities.

name: sclerodol B
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is (3β,5α)-4,4,14-trimethylandrost-8-en-3-ol which is substituted by a (3E,6S)-2-methoxy-2-methylhept-3-en-6-yl group at position 17.

name: milbemycin D
definition: A milbemycin originally isolated from Streptomyces hygroscopicus with formula C33H48O7 that has insecticidal and anthelmintic proerties.

name: indanomycin
definition: An indene that is (3aS,7aR)-2,3,3a,4,5,7a-hexahydro-1H-indene which is substituted at the 2-pro-R position by a 1H-pyrrol-2-ylcarbonyl group, at the 9-pro-S position by an ethyl group, and at the 5-pro-R position by a hexa-1,3-dineyl group in which position 4 has been substituted by a (2R,3S,6R)-6-[(1R)-1-carboxyethyl]-3-methyltetrahydropyran-2-yl group. It exhibits activity against Gram-positive bacteria as well as antihypertensive and antitumour. It also functions as an effective growth promoter for ruminants.

name: 3-ethyl-1,3-dihydro-3-methoxy-2H-indol-2-one
definition: An oxindole that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one which is substituted by ethyl and methoxy groups at position 3.

name: ekatetrone
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1,8-dihydroxy-9,10-anthraquinone which is substituted at position 2 and 3 by 3-amino-1-hydroxy-3-oxopropyl and carboxymethyl groups, respectively, in which the hydroxy group β- to the carboxamide has undergone formal condensation with the carboxy group to give the corresponding δ-lactone. Isolated from various strains of Kitasatospora aureofaciens (Streptomyces aureofaciens), it inhibits the growth of Ehrlich ascites carcinoma in vitro.

name: 4,5-dihydroxyisophthalic acid
definition: A hydroxybenzoic acid that is isophthalic acid (benzene-1,3-dicarboxylic acid) in which the hydrogens at positions 4 and 5 have been replaced by hydroxy groups. An inhibitor of brain glutamate decarboxylase.

name: neticonazole(1+)
definition: An imidazolium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen at position 3 of the imidazole group of neticonazole.

name: 2-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-3-hydroxy-3-(1,3,4-trimethyl-1H-pyrazol-5-yl)acrylonitrile
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is cyenopyrafen in which the pivalate ester group has been hydrolysed to give the corresponding enol. It is the active acaricide of the proacaricide cyenopyrafen.

name: N-(2-hydroxyethyl)-β-alanine
definition: A β-alanine derivative that is propanoic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens at position 3 is replaced by a (2-hydroxyethyl)nitrilo group.

name: α-D-talopyranose
definition: D-Talopyranose having α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: Ser-Thr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-serine with the amino group of L-threonine.

name: Pro-Thr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-proline with the amino group of L-threonine.

name: ethyl 2-hydroxy-5-methylpyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine-6-carboxylate
definition: A member of the class of pyrazolopyrimidines that is pyrazophos in which the the thiophosphate group has been hydrolysed to the corresponding hydroxy group. The active fungicide of the profungicide pyrazophos.

name: (5s,8s)-3-(2,5-dimethylphenyl)-4-hydroxy-8-methoxy-1-azaspiro[4.5]dec-3-en-2-one
definition: An azaspiro compound that is spirotetramat in which the carbonate ester group has been hydrolysed to the corresponding hydroxy group. It is the active insecticide of the proinsecticicde spirotetramat.

name: 5,6,6'-trihydroxy-5'-methoxy[biphenyl]-3,3'-dicarboxylate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of both ot the carboxy groups of 5,6,6'-trihydroxy-5'-methoxy[biphenyl]-3,3'-dicarboxylic acid. The major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2,3-benzothiadiazole-7-carboxylic acid
definition: A benzothiadiazole that is acibenzolar-S-methyl in which the thioester group has been hydrolysed to the corresponding carboxylic acid group. The active herbicide of the proherbicide acibenzolar-S-methyl.

name: (1R,5S)-benzobicyclon hydrolysate
definition: A 3-[2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]-4-hydroxybicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-en-2-one that has (1R,5S) configuration. The herbicide benzobicyclon hydrolysate is a racemate consisting of equimolar amounts of this compound and its enantiomer.

name: (1S,5R)-benzobicyclon hydrolysate
definition: A 3-[2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]-4-hydroxybicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-en-2-one that has (1S,5R) configuration. The herbicide benzobicyclon hydrolysate is a racemate consisting of equimolar amounts of this compound and its enantiomer.

name: benzyl β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 1R is substituted by a benzyloxy group.

name: glycyl-4-aminobutyric Acid
definition: An N-acyl-γ-aminobutyric acid where the acyl group is specified as aminoacetyl.

name: 3-[2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]-4-hydroxybicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-en-2-one
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is 4-hydroxybicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-en-2-one in which position 3 is substituted by a 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl group.

name: ganglioside GM2 (20:0)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is icosanoyl. A constituent of natural ganglioside GM2.

name: ganglioside GM2 (24:1)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is tetracos-15-enoyl. A constituent of natural ganglioside GM2.

definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-arginine with the amino group of L-proline.

name: Asn-Ile
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-asparagine with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: Asn-Leu
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-asparagine with the amino group of L-leucine.

name: Asn-Met
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-asparagine with the amino group of L-methionine.

name: Asn-Phe
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-asparagine with the amino group of L-phenylalanine.

name: Asn-Trp
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-asparagine with the amino group of L-tryptophan.

name: Asp-Met
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-aspartic acid with the amino group of L-methionine.

name: Asp-Thr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-aspartic acid with the amino group of L-threonine.

name: Gln-Asn
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamine with the amino group of L-asparagine.

name: Gln-Leu
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamine with the amino group of L-leucine.

name: Gln-Phe
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamine with the amino group of L-phenylalanine.

name: Gln-Trp
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamine with the amino group of L-tryptophan.

name: Gln-Tyr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamine with the amino group of L-tyrosine.

name: Gln-Val
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamine with the amino group of L-valine.

name: Glu-Gln
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of L-glutamine.

name: Glu-Ile
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamic acid with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: His-Ile
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-histidine with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: His-Phe
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-histidine with the amino group of L-phenylalanine.

name: Ile-Asp
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-isoleucine with the amino group of L-aspartic acid.

name: Ile-Lys
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-isoleucine with the amino group of L-lysine.

name: Ile-Thr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-isoleucine with the amino group of L-threonine.

name: Met-Asn
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-methionine with the amino group of L-asparagine.

name: Phe-Lys
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-phenylalanine with the amino group of L-lysine.

name: Pro-Met
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-proline with the amino group of L-methionine.

name: Ser-Trp
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-serine with the amino group of L-tryptophan.

name: Thr-Ile
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-threonine with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: Trp-Asn
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tryptophan with the amino group of L-asparagine.

name: Trp-Ile
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tryptophan with the amino group of L-isoleucine.

name: Trp-Pro
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tryptophan with the amino group of L-proline.

name: Trp-Thr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tryptophan with the amino group of L-threonine.

name: ganglioside GM2 (24:0)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is tetracosanoyl. A synthetic modification of the natural ganglioside GM2.

name: Tyr-Asn
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tyrosine with the amino group of L-asparagine.

name: ganglioside GM2 (18:1)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is octadec-9-enoyl. A synthetic modification of the natural ganglioside GM2.

name: Tyr-Asp
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tyrosine with the amino group of L-aspartic acid.

name: Tyr-Pro
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tyrosine with the amino group of L-proline.

name: Tyr-Ser
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tyrosine with the amino group of L-serine.

name: Tyr-Thr
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tyrosine with the amino group of L-threonine.

name: ganglioside GM2 (16:0)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is hexadecanoyl. A synthetic modification of the natural ganglioside GM2.

name: ganglioside GM2 (8:0)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is octanoyl. A synthetic modification of the natural ganglioside GM2.

name: ganglioside GM2 (5:0)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is pentanoyl. A synthetic modification of the natural ganglioside GM2.

name: ganglioside GM2 (2:0)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group on the sphingosine nitrogen is acetyl. A synthetic modification of the natural ganglioside GM2.

name: N-hydroxypipecolic acid
definition: An N-hydroxy-α-amino-acid resulting from the formal N-hydroxylation of the amino group of piperidine-carboxylic acid (pipecolic acid).

name: lyso-GM2
definition: A glycosphingolipid that is N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose linked (1↔1') to sphingosine [(2S,3R,4E)-2-aminooctadec-4-ene-1,3-diol]. A synthetic modification of the natural ganglioside GM2.

name: ganglioside GM2 (18:0) amide
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is ganglioside GM2 (18:0) in which the carboxy function of the sialic acid residue has been converted into a carboxamide.

name: S-methyl glutathione(1−)
definition: An S-substituted glutathione(1−) resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group and the deprotonation of both of the carboxy groups of S-methyl glutathione. The major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 2-(4-tert-butylphenyl)-3-oxo-3-[2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propanenitrile
definition: A β-ketonitrile resulting from the hydrolysis and decarboxylation of the proherbicide cyflumetofen.

name: ganglioside GM2 (18:0) methylamide
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is ganglioside GM2 (18:0) in which the carboxy function of the sialic acid residue has been converted into an N-methylcarboxamide.

name: ganglioside GM2 (18:0) methyl ester
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is ganglioside GM2 (18:0) in which the carboxy function of the sialic acid residue has been esterified to form its methyl ester.

name: S-methylglutathione
definition: An S-substituted glutathione that is glutathione in which the mercapto hydrogen has been replaced by a methyl group.

name: S-methylglutathione zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton for the carboxy group to the amino group of the L-γ-glutamyl residue of S-methylglutathione.

name: diethyl 2-[(dimethoxyphosphorothioyl)thio]succinate
definition: A diester that is diethyl succinate in which position 2 is substituted by a (dimethoxyphosphorothioyl)thio group.

name: (R)-malathion
definition: A diethyl 2-[(dimethoxyphosphorothioyl)thio]succinate that is the R-enantiomer of malathion.

name: (S)-malathion
definition: A diethyl 2-[(dimethoxyphosphorothioyl)thio]succinate that is the S-enantiomer of malathion.

name: diethyl 2-[(dimethoxyphosphoryl)thio]succinate
definition: A diester that is diethyl succinate in which position 2 is substituted by a (dimethoxyphosphoryl)thio group.

name: (R)-malaoxon
definition: A diethyl 2-[(dimethoxyphosphoryl)thio]succinate that is the R-enantiomer of malaoxon.

name: (S)-malaoxon
definition: A diethyl 2-[(dimethoxyphosphoryl)thio]succinate that is the S-enantiomer of malaoxon.

name: ganglioside GM2 (18:0) NeuAc-C7-de(1,2,-dihydroxyethyl)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is ganglioside GM2 (18:0) in which the sialo residue is truncated at C-7.

name: ganglioside GM2 (18:0) (NeuAc-N-deacetyl)
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide that is ganglioside GM2 (18:0) in which the sialo N-acetyl group has been deacetylated.

name: α-Neu5Gc-(2→8)-α-Neu5Gc-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer
definition: A sialodiosylceramide consisting of the tetrasaccharide α-Neu5NGc-(2→8)-α-Neu5NGc-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc attached to the primary hydroxy function of ceramide.

name: N4-{2,6-dimethoxy-4-methyl-5-[3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]quinolin-8-yl}pentane-1,4-diamine
definition: An aminoquinoline that is 8-aminoquinoline which is substituted by methoxy groups at positions 2 and 6, a methyl group at position 4, and a m-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy group at position 5, and in which the amino substituent at position 8 is itself substituted by a 5-aminopentan-2-yl group.

name: (R)-tafenoquine
definition: A N4-{2,6-dimethoxy-4-methyl-5-[3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]quinolin-8-yl}pentane-1,4-diamine that has R configuration.

name: (S)-tafenoquine
definition: A N4-{2,6-dimethoxy-4-methyl-5-[3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]quinolin-8-yl}pentane-1,4-diamine that has S configuration.

name: N-tert-butyl-N'-(2,6-diisopropyl-4-phenoxyphenyl)methanediimine
definition: An aromatic ether that is 1,3-diisopropyl-5-phenoxybenzene in which the hydrogen atom at position 2 is substituted by a [(tert-butylimino)methylene]amino group. The active insecticide of the proinsecticide diafenthiuron.

name: tralopyril
definition: A pyrrole resulting from the N-dealkylation of the ethoxymethyl group of chlorfenapyr. It is the active insecticide of the proinsecticide chlorfenapyr.

name: CholEsteryl BODIPY 542/563 C11
definition: A BODIPY dye in which the 4,4-difluoro-4-bora-3a,4a-diaza-s-indacene skeleton is substituted at position 5 by a p-methoxyphenyl group and at position 3 by an 11-[(3β)-cholest-5-en-3-yloxy]-11-oxoundecyl group. An orange-red BODIPY dye.

name: tyloxapol
definition: A polymeric compound resulting from the reaction of 4-(1,1,3,3-tetramethylbutyl)phenol with formaldehyde to give a chain in which 6-8 molecules are linked together by CH2 groups ortho to the phenolic hydroxy groups, which have then undergone reaction with oxirane to give polyoxyethyleneoxy moieties, Ar(OCH2CH2)xOH, where x = 8-10. A nonionic liquic polymer, it inhibits lipoprotein lipase and hence clearance of triglyceride from the plasma, so is used to induce hyperlipidaemia in test animals. Also used as a surfactant to aid liquefaction and removal of mucus- and pus-containing bronchopulmonary secretions.

name: pyrasulfotole
definition: A pyrazole pesticide that is 1,3-dimethylpyrazol-5-ol in thich the hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a 2-(methylsulfonyl)-4-(trifluoromethyl)benzoyl group. A 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase inhibitor, it is used as a herbicide (particularly in conjunction with the safener mefenpyr-diethyl) to control various broad-leaved weeds.

name: trifludimoxazin
definition: A member of the class of 1,3,5-triazinanes that is 6-sulfanylidene-1,3,5-triazinane-2,4-dione in which the hydrogens attached to the nitrogens adjacent to the thioxo group have been replace by methyl groups and in which the hydrogen attached to the remaining nitrogen has replaced by a 2,2,7-trifluoro-3-oxo-4-(prop-2-yn-1-yl)-3,4-dihydro-1,4-benzoxazin-6-yl group. A protoporphyrinogen oxidase inhibitor, it is used as a herbicide.

name: imidaprilat
definition: A member of the class of imidazolidines that is imidapril in which the ethyl ester group has been hydrolysed to the corresponding acid group. It is the active metabolite of imidapril used to treat hypertension.

name: trandolaprilat
definition: A heterobicyclic compound that is trandolapril in which the ethyl ester group has been hydrolysed to the corresponding acid group. It is the active metabolite of the prodrug trandolapril.

name: spiraprilat
definition: An azaspiro compound that is spirapril in which the ethyl ester group has been hydrolysed to the corresponding carboxylic acid group. It is the active metabolite of the angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor spirapril.

name: quinapril(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group of quinapril.

name: ochratoxin B
definition: A phenylalanine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of L-phenylalanine with the carboxy group of (3R)-8-hydroxy-3-methyl-1-oxo-3,4-dihydro-1H-2-benzopyran-7-carboxylic acid. Ochratoxin B differs from the more naturally abundant ochratoxin A in the absence of the dihydroisocoumarin chlorine atom. It has cytotoxic effects on kidney and liver cells in vitro but only minor effects in vivo, due to its rapid metabolism and excretion. It inhibits cell proliferation of human liver HepG2 cells at doses as low as 1 μg/ ml but lacks the genotoxic activity of ochratoxin A, even at higher concentrations.

name: ochratoxin C
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is the ethyl ester of ochratoxin A.

name: delanzomib
definition: A C-terminal boronic acid peptide inhibitor which induces apoptosis in multiple myeloma, hematological and solid tumor cell lines.

name: 4-undecylbenzenesulfonic acid
definition: An arenesulfonic acid that is benzenesulfonic acid substituted by an undecyl group at position 4.

name: Myricanone
definition: A cyclic ketone isolated from the bark of Morella species and has been shown to exhibit cytotoxic activity against cancer cells.

name: 2-ethyl-5-methylpyrazine
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine with an ethyl group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 5 or vice versa. Found in tea, soybean paste, chocolate and sesame seed oil.

name: desmethyldoxepin
definition: A dibenzooxepine resulting from the demethylation of the antidepressant doxepin. It is the active metabolite of doxepin.

name: 3-hydroxy-6-methoxy-1-methyl-4,5-diphenyl-2-piperidinone
definition: A member of the class of piperidones that is 1-methylpiperidin-2-one in which a hydrogen at positions 3,4,5 and 6 has been replaced by hydroxy, phenyl, phenyl and methoxy groups, respectively.

name: gevotroline hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of gevotroline and hydrogen chloride.

name: 2-cyclopenten-1-one
definition: An enone that is cyclopentanone having a C=C double bond at position 2.

name: 1-bromo-4-fluorobenzene
definition: A member of the class of bromobenzenes that is bromobenzene carrying a fluoro atom at position 4.

name: forasartan
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine which is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by o-(tetrazol-5-yl)phenyl and (3,5-dibutyl-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)methyl groups, respectively. It is a nonpeptide antagonist of angiotensin II, type 1 (AT1) receptors, used for the treatment of hypertension.

name: 2,2-dimethylpropanal
definition: A member of the class of propanals that is propanal substituted by two methyl groups at position 2.

name: 2,4-dimethylheptane
definition: An alkane that is heptane in which a hydrogen has been replaced by a methyl group at positions 2 and 4.

name: 2,3,5-trimethylhexane
definition: An alkane that is hexane substituted by a methyl group at positions 2,3 and 5.

name: 2,3-dimethylbutane
definition: An alkane that is butane substituted by a methyl group at positions 2 and 3.

name: 2,4-dimethylhexane
definition: An alkane that is hexane carrying a methyl group at positions 2 and 4.

name: 2-methyl-1-pentene
definition: An alkene that is pent-1-ene carrying a methyl group at position 2.

name: 2,4-dimethyl-1-heptene
definition: An alkene that is 2-methylhept-1-ene carrying a methyl group at position 4.

name: tert-butyl ethyl ether
definition: An ether having ethyl and tert-butyl as the two alkyl components. It is used as an engine fuel additive to reduce emissions of carbon monoxide and soot.

name: 2-ethylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen atom at position 2 has been replaced by an ethyl group.

name: 3-hexen-2-one
definition: An enone that is hex-3-ene in which the methylene hydrogen atoms at position 2 have been replaced by an oxo group.

name: 2-methylthiophene
definition: A member of the class of thiophenes that is thiophene in which the hydrogen atom at position 2 is substituted by a methyl group.

name: N-ethyl-N-(2-hydroxyethyl)nitrosamine
definition: A nitrosamine that is N-nitrosodiethylamine in which one of the ethyl froups has been replaced by a 2-hydroxyethyl group. It is used to induce renal and liver tumours in rodents.

name: C80 mycolic acid
definition: A mycolic acid produced by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Its structure is that of hexacosanoic acid substituted at position 2 by a (1R,18Z,33Z)-1-hydroxytetrapentaconta-18,33-dien-1-yl group. (The term C80 refers to the average tail length of a reported naturally occurring range of 72-86 carbon atoms.)

name: Pse-(2→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-[Pse-(2→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-D-GalNAc
definition: An amino octasaccharide consisting of two β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine disaccharide units linked β(1→3), to each galactosyl residue of which is linked β(1→6) a pseudaminyl-(2→6)-D-glucosyl branch. The molecule represents two of the repeat units of the exopolysaccharide of the the Gram negative pathogen Acinetobacter baumannii strain 54149, of which the majority of the repeat units contain the aforementioned linked pseudaminic acid moiety (PMID:29965749).

name: acaulide
definition: A macrodiolide consisting of two (3E,5R,6S,9R,14S)-5-hydroxy-6,14-dimethyl-2,8,11-trioxo-1,7-dioxacyclotetradec-3-en-9-yl attached to position 1 of (6S)-6-methyldihydro-2H-pyran-2,4(3H)-dione. Isolated from a culture of Acaulium sp. H-JQSF associated with the isopod Armadillidium vulgare.

name: BODIPY 493/503
definition: A BODIPY dye in which the 4,4-difluoro-4-bora-3a,4a-diaza-s-indacene skeleton is substituted at positions 1, 3, 5, 7, and 8 by methyl groups. It is used as a stain for neutral lipds and as a tracer for oil and other nonpolar lipids.

name: (1R)-(2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl)phosphonate
definition: A (2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl)phosphonate zwitterion that has (R)-configuration; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: hapalindole U
definition: A hapalindole that is hapalindole H in which the octahydronaphthalene ring junction carbons both have S configuration instead of R.

name: hapalindole G
definition: A hapalindole that is hapalindole U in which the pro-R hydrogen at position 8 has been replaced by a chlorine. It is produced by the cyanobacterium Fischerella ambigua.

name: hapalindole
definition: Any member of large group of hapalindole-type alkaloids that are bioactive metabolites of the Subsection V (formerly order Stigonematales)in the phylum Cyanobacteria which have either a tetracyclic structure based on 10-isocyano-6,6,9-trimethyl-9-vinyl-2,6,6a,7,8,9,10,10a-octahydronaphtho[1,2,3-cd]indole, or a tricyclic structure resulting from the cleavage of the bond linking the indole ring to the dimethyl-substituted carbon.

name: (S)-1-hydroxy-N-methylcanadine
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is (S)-N-methylcanadine in which the hydrogen at position 14 is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: (13S,14R)-1,13-dihydroxy-N-methylcanadine
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion resulting from the methylation of the amino group of (S)-canadine in which the hydrogen at position 1 and the pro-S hydrogen at position 13 have been replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: (13S,14R)-1-hydroxy-13-O-acetyl-N-methylcanadine
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is (13S,14R)-1,13-dihydroxy-N-methylcanadine in which the alcoholic hydroxy group at position 13 has been converted into the corresponding acetate ester.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-[β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-N-stearoylsphingosine 1II',2II lactone
definition: A sialotetraosylceramide consisting of the disialoganglioside GM1 with a lactone ring formed between C-1 of the NeuNac residue and C-2 of the galactose residue proximal to the ceramide moiety.

name: (13S,14R)-1,8-dihydroxy-13-O-acetyl-N-methylcanadine
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is (13S,14R)-1-hydroxy-13-O-acetyl-N-methylcanadine which carries a hydroxy group at position 8.

name: 3-O-acetyl-4'-O-demethylpapaveroxine
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is 8-hydroxy-2-methyl-6,7-methylenedioxy-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline which is substituted at the 1-pro-R position by an (acetyloxy)(2-formyl-3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)methyl group. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of noscarpine in the opium poppy, Papaver somniferum.

name: trisodium phosphonoformate
definition: The trisodium salt of phosphonoformic acid. It is used as an antiviral agent in the treatment of cytomegalovirus retinitis (CMV retinitis, an inflamation of the retina that can lead to blindness) and as an alternative to ganciclovir for AIDS patients who require concurrent antiretroviral therapy but are unable to tolerate ganciclovir due to haematological toxicity.

name: 3-O-acetylpapaveroxine
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is 3-O-acetyl-4'-O-demethylpapaveroxine in which the phenolic hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding methyl ether. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of noscarpine in the opium poppy, Papaver somniferum.

name: (−)-noscapine hemiacetal
definition: A lactol that is (−)-noscapine [which is also known as (−)-α-narcotine] in which the carbonyl group of the lactone moiety has been reduced to give the corresponding lactol. It is the biosynthetic precursor of (−)-noscapine.

name: L-tyrosinal(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of L-tyrosinal.

name: L,L-homocystine
definition: A homocystine in which both chiral centres have L configuration.

name: aspirin-based probe AP
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetylsalicylic acid with the phenolic hydroxy group of 2-(1,3-benzothiazol-2-yl)-4-fluorophenol. The latter is a fluorophore which is to the aspirin moiety via an H2O2-responsive bond. It can be used as probe for imaging H2O2 (overproduction of H2O2 causes oxidative stress and is characteristic of vascular diseases). In contrast to arylboronat-based probes, it shows high specificity for H2O2 over peroxynitrite (which is much more reactive than H2O2, but exists at much lower abundance).

name: 3-methoxycatechol
definition: A member of the class of catechols that is catechol in which a hydrogen that is ortho to one of the hydroxy groups has been replaced by a methoxy group. It displays agonistic activity against G protein-coupled receptor 35 (GPR35).

name: 2-ethoxyphenol
definition: An aromatic ether that is catechol in which one of the hydroxy groups has been alkylated to give the corresponding ethyl ether. A low-melting (20-25 °C), high-boiling (216-217 °C) smoke flavour compound.

name: 2-methylanisole
definition: A monomethoxybenzene that is o-cresol in which phenolic hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding methyl ether. A 'green' solvent (b.p. 171 °C) and food flavour ingredient, it is found in mastic oils, virgin olive oils and frankincense.

name: N1,N3-bis[2-(bis{2-[(2-aminoethyl)amino]-2-oxoethyl}amino)ethyl]-2-[2-(2-{2-[(prop-2-yn-1-yl)oxy]ethoxy}ethoxy)ethyl]malonamide
definition: A dendrimer macromolecule consisting of a malonamide core, each N of which carries a 2-(bis{2-[(2-aminoethyl)amino]-2-oxoethyl}amino)ethyl branch and with a 2-(2-{2-[(prop-2-yn-1-yl)oxy]ethoxy}ethoxy)ethyl substituent at C-2.

name: 4-O-β-D-glucosyl-trans-sinapate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 4-O-β-D-glucosyl-trans-sinapic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-{2-[2-(2-azidoethoxy)ethoxy]ethyl}-N1,N3-bis[2-(bis{2-[(2-aminoethyl)amino]-2-oxoethyl}amino)ethyl]malonamide
definition: A dendrimer macromolecule consisting of a malonamide core, each N of which carries a 2-(bis{2-[(2-aminoethyl)amino]-2-oxoethyl}amino)ethyl branch and with a 2-[2-(2-azidoethoxy)ethoxy]ethyl substituent at C-2.

name: 4-O-β-D-glucosyl-trans-caffeate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 4-O-β-D-glucosyl-trans-caffeic acid. The major specides at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5CO2Me
definition: A glycoside that consists of six β-D-glucose residues all linked sequentially (1→3) and linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 5-(methoxycarbonyl)pentyl group.

name: N-{β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-ManO[CH2]3S[CH2]2NHC(O)[CH2O]4C(O)[CH2]2S[CH2]2C(O)}-YGKDVKDLFDYAQE-NH-[CH2O]3[CH2]2C(O)NHC(CO2H)[CH2]4N3
definition: A glycopeptide that is the combined B- and T-cell epitope of Candida albicans cell wall β1,2-mannotriose and the cell wall peptide Fba (derived from fructose-bisphosphate aldolase), the peptide moiety consisting of the amino acid sequence Tyr-Gly-Lys-Asp-Val-Lys-Asp-Leu-Phe-Asp-Tyr-Ala-Gln-Glu.

name: Lansamide 4
definition: A 3-hydroxy-6-methoxy-1-methyl-4,5-diphenyl-2-piperidinone in which positions 3,4,5 and 6 have S,S,R,R stereochemistry, respectively.

name: 2-hydroxydodecanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxydodecanoic acid. The major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: Candida albicans hexasaccharide dendrimer—glycopeptide conjugate
definition: A dendrimer macromolecule that is a conjugate between the tetravalent dendrimer hexasaccharide N1,N3-bis[2-[bis(2-{[2-({2-[(2-{[6-(β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)hexanoyl]amino}ethyl)amino]-3,4-dioxocyclobut-1-en-1-yl}amino)ethyl]amino}-2-oxoethyl)amino]ethyl]-2-[2-(2-{2-[(prop-2-yn-1-yl)oxy]ethoxy}ethoxy)ethyl]malonamide and the glycopeptide N-{β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-ManO[CH2]3S[CH2]2NHC(O)[CH2O]4C(O)[CH2]2S[CH2]2C(O)}-YGKDVKDLFDYAQE-NH-[CH2O]3[CH2]2C(O)NHC(CO2H)[CH2]4N3.

A dendrimer macromolecule consisting of a malonamide core, each N of which carries a 2-[bis(2-{[2-({2-[(2-{[6-(β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)hexanoyl]amino}ethyl)amino]-3,4-dioxocyclobut-1-en-1-yl}amino)ethyl]amino}-2-oxoethyl)amino]ethyl branch and with a 2-(2-{2-[(prop-2-yn-1-yl)oxy]ethoxy}ethoxy)ethyl substituent at C-2.

name: N-(p-octylbenzoyl)-piperidin-4-ol
definition: A tertiary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation between of the carboxy group of p-octylbenzoic acid with the amino group of 4-hydroxypiperidine.

name: 2,3-dihydroxydodecanoate
definition: A medium-chain fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2,3-dihydroxydodecanoic acid. Major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: 2-hydroxydodec-2-enoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion obtained by the formal deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxydodec-2-enoic acid [the (minor) enol tautomer of 2-oxododecanoic acid]; major microspecies of the enol tautomer at pH 7.3.

name: undec-1-en-1-ol
definition: A fatty alcohol 11:1 that is undecanol containing a double bond located at position 1; a minor tautomer of undecanal.

name: 3-hydroxybutane-1,2,3-tricarboxylate
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion resulting from the deprotonation of all three carboxy groups of 3-hydroxybutane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Gal3S-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/24:0)
definition: A β-D-Gal3S-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer in which the acyl and alkyl chains are respectively tetracosanoyl and 3-hydroxyoctadec-4-en-1-yl.

name: 3β-hydroxy-15,16-epoxydolabrene
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid that is 15,16-epoxydolabrene in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 15,16-epoxydolabrene
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid that is dolabradiene in which vinyl substituent has undergone oxidation to give the corresponding epoxide.

name: dolabradiene
definition: A carbotricyclic compound and diterpene that is tetradecahydrophenanthrene which is substituted by a methylene group at position 1, methyl groups at positions 4b, 7, and 10a, and a vinyl group at position 7 (the 4aS,4bR,7S,8aR,10aS stereoisomer).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino pentasaccharide comprising D-glucose at the reducing end with a β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-α-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-galactosyl moiety at the 4-position.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide comprising a linear hexasaccharide of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→6), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the GlcNac and GalNAc residues of which are also (1→3) linked α-L-galactose and β-D-galactose residues respectively.

name: (S)-β-macrocarpen-15-ol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (S)-β-macrocarpene in which a hydrogen of the methyl group that is attached to a double bond has been replaced by a hydroxy group. The first step in the biosynthesis of the sesquiterpene phytoalexin zealexin A1 from (S)-β-macrocarpene in maize.

name: (4S)-4-(5,5-dimethylcyclohex-1-en-1-yl)cyclohex-1-ene-1-carbaldehyde
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (S)-β-macrocarpen-15-ol in which the hydroxy group has been oxidised to an aldehyde group. The second step in the biosynthesis of the sesquiterpene phytoalexin zealexin A1 from (S)-β-macrocarpene in maize.

name: zealexin A1(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting forom the deprotonation of the carboxy group of zealexin A1. The major speciess at pH 7.3.

name: akuammigine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C21H24N2O3, isolated from Vinca sardoa and Uncaria rhynchophylla.

name: dregamine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C21H26N2O3, isolated from several species of Tabernaemontana.

name: isoretuline
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C21H26N2O2.

name: vindolinine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C21H24N2O2, isolated from several plant species.

name: (−)-voacangine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C22H28N2O3, isolated from several plant species.

name: voachalotine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C22H26N2O3, isolated from several Tabernaemontana species.

name: caracurine VII
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C19H22N2O2, isolated from several species of Strychnos.

name: tipifarnib
definition: A quinolone that is 1-methylquinolin-2-one which carries a 3-chlorophenyl and an amino(4-chlorophenyl)(1-methyl-imidazol-5-yl)methyl groups at the 4 and 6 positions, respectively (the R-isomer).

name: 7-deoxyloganetic alcohol
definition: A cyclopentapyran that is (4aS,7aR)-1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran substituted at position 1 by a hydroxy group and at positions 4 and 7 by a hydroxymethyl and methyl group, respectively (the 1R,4aS,7S,7aR-diastereomer).

name: 7-deoxyloganetic aldehyde
definition: A cyclopentapyran that is (4aS,7aR)-1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran substituted at position 1 by a hydroxy group and at positions 4 and 7 by a formyl and methyl group, respectively (the 1R,4aS,7S,7aR-diastereomer).

name: gibberellin A60
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Triticum aestivum. It differs from gibberellin A1 in lacking a β-OH at C-2 but possessing one at C-4 (gibbane numberings).

name: cinnamycin
definition: A type B lantibiotic consisting of a 19 amino acid tetracyclic polypeptide produced by Streptomyces cinnamoneus.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxynaringenin
definition: A 2,5,7-trihydroxy-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one that has (S) configuration.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxyeriodictyol
definition: A 2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-2,5,7-trihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one that has (S) configuration.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxypinocembrin
definition: A 2,5,7-trihydroxy-2-phenyl-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one that has (S) configuration.

name: gibberellin A61
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Triticum aestivum; it differs from gibberellin A1 in the absence of OH groups at C-2 and C-7 (gibbane numberings).

name: gibberellin A45
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Pyrus communis. It differs from gibberellin A1 in the absence of OH groups at C-2 and -7 and the presence of a β-OH at C-9 (all gibbane numbering).

name: gibberellin A63
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Pyrus communis. It differs from gibberellin A1 in the absence of an OH group at C-2 and the presence of a β-OH at C-9 (all gibbane numbering).

name: gibberellin A67
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Helianthus annuus. It differs from gibberellin A1 in the absence of an OH group at C-2 and the presence of a β-OH at C-9 (all gibbane numbering).

name: gibberellin A68
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Malus sylvestris. It differs from gibberellin A1 in the absence of an OH group at C-7 and the presence of a double bond between C-3 and C-4 (all gibbane numbering).

name: gibberellin A72
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Helianthus annuus. It differs from gibberellin A1 in the presence of a β-OH at C-9 (gibbane numbering).

name: 15β-OH gibberellin A3
definition: A C19-gibberellin differing from gibberellin A3 in the presence of a β-OH at C-9 (gibbane numbering) (C-15 gibberellin numbering).

name: gibberellin A10
definition: A C19-gibberellin, initially identified in Gibberella fujikuroi. It differs from gibberellin A1 in the absence of the β-OH at C-9 and the α-OH at C-7, the substitution of the methylene group at C-8 by a β-Me and the presence of an α-OH also at C-8 (all gibbane skeletal numberings).

name: gibberellin A18
definition: A C20-gibberellin, initially identified in Lupinus luteus, that is gibberellin A12 in which extra hydroxy substituents are present at the 2β- and 7α-positions.

name: gibberellin A3 norketone
definition: A gibberellin norketone in which the =O of the keto function in gibberellin A3 is replaced by a =CH2 methylidene group.

name: rauvomitine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C30H34N2O5.

name: α-nootkatol
definition: A 4,4a-dimethyl-6-(prop-1-en-2-yl)-2,3,4,4a,5,6,7,8-octahydronaphthalen-2-ol with (2R,4R,4aS,6R) stereochemistry.

name: 6-isopropenyl-4,4a-dimethyl-2,3,4,4a,5,6,7,8-octahydronaphthalen-2-ol
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is 2,3,4,4a,5,6,7,8-octahydronaphthalen-2-ol which carries a methyl, methyl and prop-1-en-2-yl groups at positions 4, 4a, and 6, respectively.

name: mevinic acid anion
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of mevinic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: retuline
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C21H26N2O2, isolated from several species of Strychnos.

name: equisetin(1−)
definition: An organic anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol moiety of equisetin. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: trichosetin(1−)
definition: An organic anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol moiety of trichosetin.

name: tabernaemontanine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C21H26N2O3, isolated from several species of Tabernaemontana.

name: abediterol
definition: A quinolone that is 8-hydroxyquinolin-2(1H)-one which carries a 2-{[6-(2,2-difluoro-2-phenylethoxy)hexyl]amino}-1-hydroxyethyl group at position 5. It is a long acting β2-adrenoceptor agonist currently in development for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and asthma.

name: (2,2,3-trimethylcyclopent-3-en-1-yl)acetonitrile
definition: A nitrile that is acetonitrile in which one of the hydrogens has been replaced by a 2,2,3-trimethylcyclopent-3-en-1-yl group. A powerful fragrance compound with pine, rosemary and hay-like tonalities.

name: oct-5-enal
definition: A monounsaturated fatty aldehyde that is octanal which has undergone formal dehydrogenation to give a double bond between positions 5 and 6.

name: 2β-hydroxy-5-epi-aristolochene
definition: An eremorphilane sesquiterpenoid that is (+)-5-epi-aristolochene in which the pro-R hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (−)-4-epi-eremophilene
definition: A member of the class of octahydronahthalenes that is (−)-eremophilene in which the carbon bearing the methyl group at position 4 (i.e. the methyl group furthest from the isopropenyl group) has R configuration instead of S.

name: 4-epi-eremophilene-2β-ol
definition: A 6-isopropenyl-4,4a-dimethyl-2,3,4,4a,5,6,7,8-octahydronaphthalen-2-ol that is (−)-4-epi-eremophilene in which the 2-pro-R hydrogen has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (−)-eremophilene
definition: A member of the classs of octahydronaphthalenes and a sesquiterpene that is 1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,7-octahydronaphthalene which is substituted by an isopropenyl group at position 3 and by methyl groups at positions 4a and 5 (the 3R,4aR,5S- diastereoisomer).

name: (R)-S-adenosyl-L-methionine zwitterion
definition: An S-adenosyl-L-methionine zwitterion that has R-configuration; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-S-adenosyl-L-methionine zwitterion
definition: An S-adenosyl-L-methionine zwitterion that has S-configuration; major species at pH 7.3.

name: sideretin (reduced form)
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is fraxetin which has been substituted by an additional hydroxy group at positions 5. It is the primary molecule exuded by Arabidopsis thaliana roots in response to iron deficiency.

name: sideretin (oxidized form)
definition: A member of the class of p-quinones resulting from the formal oxidation of the hydroquinone moiety of 5,7,8-trihydroxy-6-methoxy-2H-chromen-2-one.

name: 3-demethyl-5-methylmenaquinone
definition: A member of the class of prenylnapthoquinones that carries a methyl group at position 5.

name: 1β-methyl-gibberellin A4
definition: An alkyl-gibberellin that is gibberellin A4 carrying an extra methyl substituent at position 1β (4β using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 1α-methyl-gibberellin A4
definition: An alkyl-gibberellin that is gibberellin A4 carrying an extra methyl substituent at position 1α (4α using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 2β-methyl-gibberellin A4
definition: An alkyl-gibberellin that is gibberellin A4 carrying an extra methyl substituent at position 2β (3β using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 2α-methyl-gibberellin A4
definition: An alkyl-gibberellin that is gibberellin A4 carrying an extra methyl substituent at position 2α (3α using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 2β-methyl-gibberellin A1
definition: An alkyl-gibberellin that is gibberellin A1 carrying an extra methyl substituent at position 2β (3β using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 2α-methyl-gibberellin A1
definition: An alkyl-gibberellin that is gibberellin A1 carrying an extra methyl substituent at position 2α (3α using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 3β-chloro-gibberellin A9
definition: A halo-gibberellin that is gibberellin A9 carrying a chloro substituent at position 3β (2β using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 3β-fluoro-gibberellin A9
definition: A halo-gibberellin that is gibberellin A9 carrying a fluoro substituent at position 3β (2β using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 3-epi-gibberellin A1
definition: An epi-gibberellin that is gibberellin A1 differing in configuration at C-3 (C-2 using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: 3-epi-gibberellin A4
definition: An epi-gibberellin that is gibberellin A4 differing in configuration at C-3 (C-2 using gibbane skeletal numbering).

name: (E)-sinapaldehyde 4-O-β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside resulting from the formal condensation of the phenolic hydroxy group of (E)-sinapaldehyde with β-D-glucose.

name: nitroproston
definition: A nitro compound obtained by the formal condensation of prostaglandin E2 with 1,3-dinitroglycerol.

name: 8-(2-carboxyethyl)-2,7-dimethyl-3-vinyl-9-(phenyldiazenyl)dipyrrin-1(10H)-one
definition: A synthetic dipyrrin derived from rings A and D of bilirubin IXα in which C-9 carries a phenyldiazenyl substituent.

name: 8-(2-carboxyethyl)-2,7-dimethyl-3-vinyl-9-{2-[2-(ethoxycarbonyl)phenyl]diazenyl}dipyrrin-1(10H)-one
definition: A synthetic dipyrrin derived from rings A and D of bilirubin IXα in which C-9 carries a 2-[2-(ethoxycarbonyl)phenyl]diazenyl substituent.

name: 8-(2-carboxyethyl)-2,7-dimethyl-3-vinyl-9-[2-(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]dipyrrin-1(10H)-one
definition: A synthetic dipyrrin derived from rings A and D of bilirubin IXα in which C-9 carries a 2-(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl substituent.

name: trichosetin
definition: A member of the class of octahydronaphthalenes that is (2R,4aS,5R,6R,8aS)-2,5-dimethyl-6-[(1E)-prop-1-en-1-yl]-1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalene in which the hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a (Z)-hydroxy[(5S)-5-(hydroxymethyl)-2,4-dioxopyrrolidin-3-ylidene]methyl group. Produced by the dual culture of Trichoderma harzianum and Catharanthus roseus callus, it exhibits significant antimicrobial activity against Gram-positive bacteria such as Staphylococcus aureus and Bacillus subtilis.

name: 3-[(2E)-4-methyl-5-[(Z)-(4-methyl-5-oxo-3-vinyl-1,5-dihydro-2H-pyrrol-2-ylidene)methyl]-2-(phenylhydrazono)-2H-pyrrol-3-yl]propanoic acid
definition: A hydrazone that is a tautomer of 8-(2-carboxyethyl)-2,7-dimethyl-3-vinyl-9-(phenyldiazenyl)dipyrrin-1(10H)-one.

name: equisetin
definition: A member of the class of tetramic acids that is trichosetin in which the hydrogen attached to the lactam nitrogen has been replaced by a methyl group. It is produced by the filamentous fungus Fusarium heterosporum.

name: bilirubin IIIα
definition: A biladiene that is a linear tetrapyrrole and a regioisomer of bilirubin IXα, in which the dipyrroles are of exovinyl type only.

name: bilirubin XIIIα
definition: A biladiene that is a linear tetrapyrrole and a regioisomer of bilirubin IXα, in which the dipyrroles are of endovinyl type only.

name: 4-hydroxy-indole-3-carbonyl nitrile
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is 1H-indol-4-ol which is substituted by a nitriloacetyl group at the 3 position.

name: indole-3-carbonyl nitrile
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole which is substituted by a nitriloacetyl group at the 3 position.

name: biotripyrrin-a
definition: A tripyrrole that is an oxidized metabolite of bilirubin, in which methyl groups are present at positions 2, 7 and 13 with a vinyl group at position 3.

name: biotripyrrin-b
definition: A tripyrrole that is an oxidized metabolite of bilirubin, in which methyl groups are present at positions 3, 7 and 13 with a vinyl group at position 2.

name: 5-(2-aminoethoxy)methyl-2'-deoxyuridine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside that is 5-hydroxymethyl-2'-deoxyuridine in which the hydroxymethyl group at position 5 has been formally converted to the corresponding 2-aminoethyl ether. It is a thymidine hypermodification replacing 40% of thymidine nucleotides in the Salmonella phage ViI.

name: 5-(2-aminoethyl)-2'-deoxyuridine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside that is 2'-deoxyuridine in which the hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a 2-aminoethyl group. It is a thymidine hypermodification replacing 30% of thymidine in the DNA of the Pseudomonas phage M6.

name: (2S)-1-(6-chloro-5-fluoroindol-1-yl)-propan-2-amine
definition: A 1-(6-chloro-5-fluoroindol-1-yl)-propan-2-amine that has S configuration. A selective agonist for both the 5-hydroxytryptamine 2B (5-HT2B) and 5-hydroxytryptamine 2C (5-HT2C)serotonin receptor subtypes, commonly used as fumarate salt.

name: ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl phosphate-GalA(2−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion and organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of both the carboxy group and the phosphate group of ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl phosphate-GalA. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: all-trans-3,4-didehydro-13,14-dihydroretinol
definition: A retinoid that is all-trans-3,4-didehydroretinol in which the double bond α- to the the terminal hydroxy group has been reduced to a single bond.

name: (2R)-2-hydroxyeriodictyol
definition: A 2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-2,5,7-trihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one that has (R) configuration.

name: 2-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-2,5,7-trihydroxy-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one
definition: A pentahydroxyflavanone carrying the hydroxy groups at positions 2,3', 4', 5 and 7.

name: (2R)-2-hydroxynaringenin
definition: A 2,5,7-trihydroxy-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one that has (R) configuration.

name: 2,5,7-trihydroxy-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone carrying the hydroxy groups at positions 2, 4', 5 and 7.

name: (2R)-2-hydroxypinocembrin
definition: A 2,5,7-trihydroxy-2-phenyl-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one that has (R) configuration.

name: 2,5,7-trihydroxy-2-phenyl-2,3-dihydro-4H-chromen-4-one
definition: A trihydroxyflavanone carrying the hydroxy groups at positions 2,5 and 7.

name: threonyl-3-sulfoalanine
definition: A dipeptide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of threonine with the amino group of cysteic acid.

name: benz[a]anthracene 5,6-oxide
definition: An arene epoxide that is tetraphene which has undergone 1,2 addition of an oxygen atom to the double bond at the 5-6 position.

name: (3E)-3-hexadecenoic acid
definition: A hexadecenoic acid having a trans-double bond at the 3-position.

name: 11,12-epoxy-3-methylcholanthrene
definition: An organic heterohexacyclic compound that is 3-methylcholanthrene which has undergone epoxidation by the formal 1,2-addition of an oxygen atom to the double bond at the 11-12 position.

name: erucamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of erucic acid with ammonia. It is commonly used as a slip additive in the plastic manufacturing industry.

name: 16-hydroxy-10-oxohexadecanoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid that is hexadecanoic acid substituted by an oxo group at position 10 and by a hydroxy group at position 16.

name: octadeca-9,12-diynoic acid
definition: An octadecadiynoic acid having its triple bonds at positions 9 and 12.

name: auxin a
definition: A carbocyclic compound that is 3,5-di-sec-butylcyclopentene which is substituted by a 4-carboxy-1,3,4-trihydroxybutyl group at position 1.

name: dihydrofukinolide
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone that is (3R,3a'R)-decahydrospiro[furan-3,2'-indene] carrying an oxo, methylene, acetoxy, [(2S)-2-methylbutanoyl]oxy, methyl and methyl groups at positions 2, 4, 3', 4', 7' and 7a', respectively.

name: ganoderol B
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is lanosta-7,9(11),24-triene which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 27. It has been isolated from several Ganoderma species.

name: gingerenone B
definition: A diarylheptanoid that is (4E)-hept-4-en-3-one substituted by a 4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 1 and a 4-hydroxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 7. It has been isolated from the rhizomes of Zingiber officinale.

name: isopersin
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is henicosan-1-ol which carries an acetoxy group at position 2, keto group at position 4, and two double bonds at positions 12 and 15.

name: isosojagol
definition: A member of the class of coumestans that is coumestrol with a prenyl substituent at position 10.

name: licoagroside B
definition: A monosaccharide derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of 2-methyl-4-oxo-4H-pyran-3-yl β-D-glucopyranoside with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaric acid.

name: methyl N-methylanthranilate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-methylanthranilic acid with methanol.

name: N-malonyltryptophan
