definition: A tryptophan derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the α-amino group of tryptophan with malonic acid.

name: (3S)-3,7-dimethyloct-7-en-1-yl phenylacetate
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of phenylacetic acid with (3S)-3,7-dimethyloct-7-en-1-ol.

name: sedanonic acid
definition: A cyclohexenecarboxylic acid that is cyclohex-1-ene-1-carboxylic acid which is substituted by a pentanoyl group at position 6.

name: yucalexin P8
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is ent-pimara-9(11),15-diene which is substituted by oxo groups at position 2 and 12, by a β-epoxide at the 8,14 position, and by an α-hydroxy group at position 3.

name: zealexin A1
definition: A sesquiterpene phytoalexin that is (S)-β-macrocarpene in which the methyl group that is attached to a double bond has undergone formal oxidation to give the corresponding carboxylic acid. It is produced by maize (Zea mays) to provide biochemical protection against fungal infection.

name: 3-methyl-4-nitrocatechol
definition: A nitrotoluene that is 2-nitrotoluene carrying two hydroxy substituents at positions 5 and 6.

name: 2-chloro-6-nitrotoluene
definition: A nitrotoluene that is toluene in which the hydrogens ortho- to the methyl group have been replaced by a chlorine and a nitro group. A low-melting (37 °C) solid.

name: 4-chloro-3-methylcatechol
definition: A chlorocatechol that is catechol which is substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and a chlorine at position 4.

name: 2-chloro-4-nitrotoluene
definition: A nitrotoluene that is p-nitrotoluene in which one of the hydrogens that is ortho to the methyl group has been replaced by a chlorine. A pale yellow crystalline compound that is insoluble in water but dissolves in most organic solvents, it is used in the manufacture of dyes.

name: 3-chloro-4-methylcatechol
definition: A chlorocatechol that is catechol which is substituted by a chlorine at position 3 and a methyl group at position 4.

name: 3,4-dinitrotoluene
definition: A dinitrotoluene in which the methyl group is meta to one of the nitro groups and para to the other. A yellow crystalline compound that is virtually insoluble in water but dissolves in most organic solvents.

name: 5-methyl-3-nitrocatechol
definition: A methylcatechol that is 3-nitrocatechol carrying a methyl substituent at position 5.

name: 2,3-dinitrotoluene
definition: A dinitrotoluene that is toluene in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 3 have been replaced by nitro groups.

name: 4-methyl-3-nitrocatechol(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group that is ortho to the nitro group of 4-methyl-3-nitrocatechol; the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: anagrelide
definition: A 1,5-dihydroimidazo[2,1-]quinazoline having an oxo substituent at the 2-position and chloro substituents at the 6- and 7-positions.

name: (Z)-desmethyldoxepin
definition: The (Z)-isomer of desmethyldoxepin.

name: (E)-desmethyldoxepin
definition: The (E)-isomer of desmethyldoxepin.

name: ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl phosphate.

name: 4-methyl-3-nitrocatechol
definition: A methylcatechol that is 4-methylcatechol in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a nitro group.

name: ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl phosphate
definition: A polyprenol phosphate having twelve prenyl units in the chain (the 2Z,6Z,10Z,14Z,18Z,22Z,26Z,30Z,34Z,38E,42E-isomer).

name: ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl phosphate-GalA
definition: A galactosiduronic acid resulting from the formal condensation of the anomeric hydroxy group of β-D-galactopyranuronic acid with the phosphate group of ditrans,polycis-dodecaprenyl phosphate.

name: 4-(N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl)-D-ribitol 1-phosphate
definition: A disaccharide phosphate consisting of 2-O-(N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl)ribitol phosphorylated at O-1 of the ribitol residue; a 5-phosphate β-WTA (Staphylococcus aureus Wall Teichoic Acid) analogue.

name: trans-feruloylacetyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A feruloylacetyl-CoA(4−) in which the C=C double bond of the feruloyl group has trans configuration.

name: gevotroline
definition: A β-carboline that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-pyrido[4,3-b]indole which is substituted by a 3-(pyridin-3-yl)propyl group at position 2 and a fluoro group at position 8.

name: gevotroline(1+)
definition: A singly-charged organic cation obtained by protonation of gevotroline.

name: 4-O-β-D-glucosyl-trans-caffeic acid
definition: A hydroxycinnamic acid that is trans-caffeic acid in which the phenolic hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into its β-D-glucoside.

name: 3-[(3-aminopropyl)amino]-4-hydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 3-amino-4-hydroxybenzoic acid in which one of the hydrogens attached to the amino group has been replaced by a 3-aminopropyl group. Derivative of aminohydroxybenzoic acid, a novel and abundant metabolite found in Acinetobacter baylyi ADP1 grown on quinate carbon source.

name: 3-hydroxy-L-tryptophan
definition: A hydroxy-L-tryptophan which carries a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: trans-feruloylacetyl-CoA
definition: A feruloylacetyl-CoA in which the double bond of the feruloyl group has trans configuration.

name: pectenotoxin-11
definition: A cyclic polyether isolated from the toxic dinoflagellate Dinophysis acuta.

name: α-D-galactosamine 1-phosphate(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the phosphate group of α-D-galactosamine 1-phosphate zwitterion. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: saxitoxin acetate
definition: An acetate salt that is the diacetate of the toxic alkaloid saxitoxin.

name: ω-conotoxin MVIIA
definition: A heterodetic cyclic polypeptide consisting of the linear sequence Cys-Lys-Gly-Lys-Gly-Ala-Lys-Cys-Ser-Arg-Leu-Met-Tyr-Asp-Cys-Cys-Thr-Gly-Ser-Cys-Arg-Ser-Gly-Lys-Cys-NH2 with three disulfide bridges between cysteine residues 1-16, 8-20 and 15-25. A neuronal N-type Ca2+ channel blocker in mammalian and amphibian brain, it blocks release of GABA and glutamate at neuronal synapses. Used as a probe for calcium channel receptors, it is selective for different receptor subtypes. A synthetic form, named ziconotide, is an atypical analgesic agent for the amelioration of severe and chronic pain.

name: 5-aminoimidazol-3-ium ribonucleoside
definition: An imidazolium ion resulting from the protonation of the 3-position of the imidazole moiety of 5-aminoimidazole ribonucleoside. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: guanosine 3'-diphosphate 5'-triphosphate hexaanion
definition: A ribonucleoside triphosphate oxoanion that is the hexaanion of guanosine 3'-diphosphate 5'-triphosphate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-galactosamine 1-phosphate
definition: A D-galactosamine 1-phosphate in which the anomeric centre has α configuration.

name: α-D-galactosamine 1-phosphate zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the phosphate group to the amino group of α-D-galactosamine 1-phosphate.

name: 4-hydroxy-D-valine
definition: A D-valine derivative that is D-valine which carries a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: 6,12-dimethyldibenzo[d,d']benzo[1,2-b:4,5-b']bisthiophene
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is p-xylene in which the 2-3 and 5-6 bonds of the benzene ring have each been fused with the b edge of a benzothiophene moiety.

name: 3-hydroxy-L-valine
definition: A hydroxy-L-valine which carries a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 5-aminoimidazole ribonucleoside
definition: A 1-ribosylimidazole that is 5-aminoimidazole in which the hydrogen at position 1 has been replaced by a β-D-ribofuranosyl group.

name: vibegron
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (6S)-4-oxo-4,6,7,8-tetrahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrimidine-6-carboxylic acid with the amino group of (R)-[(2R,5S)-5-(4-aminobenzyl)pyrrolidin-2-yl](phenyl)methanol. It is a β3-adrenergic receptor agonist currently in clinical development for the treatment of patients with overactive bladder.

name: 2-aminooctanoate
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-aminooctanoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 1-carboxyheptan-1-aminium
definition: An α-amino-acid cation that is the conjugate acid of 2-aminooctanoic acid, arising from protonation of the amino group.

name: γ-carboxy-L-glutamate(3−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion obtained by the deprotonation of the three carboxy groups of γ-carboxy-L-glutamic acid.

name: nonanedioic acid monoglycoside
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of nonanedioic acid with the hydroxy group of hexopyranose.

name: lificiguat
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 1H-indazole which is substituted by a benzyl group at position 1 and a 5-(hydroxymethyl)-2-furyl group at position 3. It is an activator of soluble guanylate cyclase and inhibits platelet aggregation.

name: praliciguat
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 5-fluoro-2-(1H-pyrazol-3-yl)pyrimidine which is substituted by a 2-fluorobenzyl group at position 1, 1,2-oxazol-3-yl group at position 5, and by a [3,3,3-trifluoro-2-hydroxy-2-(trifluoromethyl)propyl]nitrilo group at position 4. It is a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator under clinical development for the treatment of heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.

name: vericiguat
definition: A pyrazolopyridine that is 5-fluoro-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine in which the amino hydrogen at position 1 has been substituted by a 2-fluorobenzyl group and the hydrogen at position 3 has been substituted by a 4,6-diamino-5-[(methoxycarbonyl)amino]pyrimidin-2-yl group. It is a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator which is used for treatment of chronic heart failure.

name: cinaciguat
definition: A benzoic acid that is 4-(aminomethyl)benzoic acid in which the amino group is substituted by 4-carboxybutyl and 2-(2-{[4-(2-phenylethyl)benzyl]oxy}phenyl)ethyl groups. It is a soluble guanylate cyclase activator, used for the treatment of acute decompensated heart failure.

name: BAY 41-2272
definition: A pyrazolopyridine that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine which is substituted by a 2-fluorobenzyl group at position 1 and by a 4-amino-5-cyclopropylpyrimidin-2-yl group at position 3. It is an activator of soluble guanylate cyclase.

name: lepirudin
definition: A heterodetic cyclic peptide composed of 65 amino acids joined in sequence and cyclised by three disulfide bridges between cysteine residues 6-14, 16-28 and 22-39. It is a highly specific inhibitor of thrombin and used as an anticoagulant in patients with heparin-induced thrombocytopenia.

name: CMB4563
definition: An imidazoquinoline that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-imidazo[4,5-c]quinolin-2-one which is substituted at positions 1, 3, and 8 by by p-(pyrrol-1-yl)phenyl, methyl, and pyridin-3-yl group, respectively. A potent and specific inhibitor of Target Of Rapamycin Complex 2 (TORC2).

name: octadec-17-ynoic acid
definition: An acetylenic fatty acid that is octadecanoi acid (stearic acid) which has been doubly dehydrogenated at positions 17 and 18 to give the corresponding alkynoic acid.

name: bisphenol F diglycidyl ether
definition: An aromatic ether that is bisphenol F where the hydrogens of both hydroxy groups have been replaced by a oxiran-2-ylmethyl group.

name: dabuzalgron
definition: A sulfonamide that is N-phenylmethanesulfonamide which carries a chloro group at position 2, 4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-ylmethoxy group at position 5, and a methyl group at position 6. Its is a selective α-adrenoceptor agonist that is used in the treatment of urinary incontinence.

name: premutilin
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid which is an intermediate in the biosynthetic pathway leading to the synthesis of the antibiotic, pleuromutilin.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose in which an α-D-glucopyranose residue is linked to a D-glucopyranose residue by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: inunolide
definition: A germacranolide isolated from Inula racemosa, Rudbeckia laciniata and Stevia polyphylla.

name: 1,2-dichloropropane
definition: A chloroalkane that is propane in which a hydrogen from each of two adjacent carbons has been replaced by chlorines.

name: (R)-1,2-dichloropropane
definition: A 1,2-dichloropropane that has R configuration.

name: 8-epi-inunolide
definition: A germacranolide that is (3aR,5E,9E,11aS)-2,3,3a,4,7,8,11,11a-octahydrocyclodeca[b]furan substituted by an oxo group, methylidene group, methyl group and methyl group at positions 2,3,6 and 10, respectively.

name: (S)-1,2-dichloropropane
definition: A 1,2-dichloropropane that has S configuration.

name: (20S)-20-O-(β-D-glucosyl)-3-hydroxydammarene
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is dammarenediol-II where the hydrogen of the hydroxy group at position 20 is replaced by a β-D-glucoside.

name: 2-(1,3-benzothiazol-2-yl)-4-fluorophenol
definition: A member of the class of benzothiazoles that is 1,3-benzothiazole in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a 5-fluoro-2-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: (20S)-ginsenoside Rh1
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid that is (20S)-protopanaxadiol which is substituted by β-D-glucoside at the 6α position.

name: CHIC-35
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound resulting from the formal fusion of the 2-3 bond of 5-chloroindole with the 2-3 bond of cycloheptanecarboxamide (the S enantiomer). It is a potent, cell-permeable, metabolically stable and selective inhibitor of the deacetylase SIRT1.

name: (3S,4R,5R,6S)-1,3,4,5,6-pentachlorocyclohexene
definition: A chlorocyclohexene that is cyclohexene which carries 5 chlorines at positions 1,3,4,5 and 6, respectively. It has (3S,4R,5R,6S) configuration.

name: laminarihexaose
definition: A β-D-glucan in which six D-glucose residues are connected by β(1→3) linkages.

name: 1-icosanoylglycerol
definition: A 1-monoglyceride resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of icosanoic acid with one of the primary hydroxy groups of glycerol.

name: 1-(11Z-icosenoyl)glycerol
definition: A 1-monoglyceride resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (11Z)-icosenoic acid (also known as gondoic acid) with one of the primary hydroxy groups of glycerol.

name: 1-behenoylglycerol
definition: A fatty acid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group at position-1 of glycerol with the carboxy group of docosanoic acid.

name: 1-erucoylglycerol
definition: A fatty acid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group at position-1 of glycerol with the carboxy group of erucic acid.

name: 1-(all-cis-docosa-7,10,13,16-tetraenoyl)glycerol
definition: A 1-monoglyceride resulting from the formal condensation of 1-(all-cis-docosa-7,10,13,16-tetraenoic acid (adrenic acid) with one of the primary hydroxy groups of glycerol.

name: 1-(all-cis-docosa-4,7,10,13,16,19-hexaenoyl)-glycerol
definition: A 1-monoglyceride resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 1-all-cis-docosa-4,7,10,13,16,19-hexaenoic acid with one of the primary hydroxy groups of glycerol.

name: 2-sulfinoacetaldehyde(1−)
definition: An organosulfinate oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the sulfino group of sulfinoacetaldehyde. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-tetracosanoylglycerol
definition: A fatty acid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group at position-1 of glycerol with the carboxy group of tetracosanoic acid.

name: 1-nervonoylglycerol
definition: A fatty acid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group at position-1 of glycerol with the carboxy group of (15Z)-tetracosenoic acid.

name: sulfinoacetaldehyde
definition: An organosulfinic acid that is methanesulfinic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens has been replaced by a formyl group.

name: isonocardicin A zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of isonocardicin A.

name: tschimganine
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of vanillic acid with the hydroxy group of (−)-borneol. A metabolite isolated from Ferula dissecta.

name: tert-butyl 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzoate
definition: A benzoate ester that is tert-butyl benzoate that carries a methoxy group at position 3 and a hydroxy group at position 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: β-hibitakanine
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,5-dimethoxybenzoic acid with the hydroxy group of (−)-borneol.

name: 3-hydroxybutane-1,2,3-tricarboxylic acid
definition: A tricarboxylic acid that is butan-2-ol in which a hydrogen from each of positions 2, 3, and 4 has been replaced by carboxy groups.

name: tetrahydroalstonine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of tetrahydroalstonine. The major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: ajmalicine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of ajmalicine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5β-chola-3,8(14),11-trien-24-oic acid
definition: A C24-steroid that is cholanic acid which has been triply dehydrogenated to introduce double bonds at the 3-4, 8-14, and 11-12 positions.

name: glyflavanone A
definition: An extended flavonoid that is 2,3-dihydro-4H,8H-pyrano[2,3-f]chromen-4-one which is substituted by a p-methoxyphenyl group at the 2-pro-S position, a methoxy group at position 5, and two methyl groups at position 8.

name: alstonine(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the protonation of the carbonilide moiety of alstonine. The major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: serpentine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of serpentine. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-epi-ent-eudesmane-5,11-diol
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is decahydronaphthalene substituted at positions 2, 4a, 8 and 8a by 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl, methyl, methyl and hydroxy groups, respectively. The (3R,4aS,5S,8aS) stereoisomer.

name: lycopaoctaene
definition: An acyclic carotene that is lycopene in which the double bonds at positions C-7, C-11, C-15, C-7', C-11' and C-15' have been reduced to single bonds.

name: hydropyrenol
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid, isolated from Streptomyces avermitilis host carrying the sclav_p0765 gene.

name: isoelisabethatriene
definition: A carbobicylic compound that is 1,2,3,4,5,6-hexahydronaphthalene which is carrying a (6S)-2-methylhept-2-en-6-yl group at position 1 and methyl groups at positions 4R and 7.

name: tamsulosin(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group of tamsulosin. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E,5S,6E,8E,10E)-1-ammoniododeca-2,6,8,10-tetraen-5-ol
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of (2E,5S,6E,8E,10E)-1-aminododeca-2,6,8,10-tetraen-5-ol. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-(2-{[2-(2-ethoxyphenoxy)ethyl]amino}propyl)-2-methoxybenzenesulfonamide
definition: A secondary amino compound that is ammonia in which nitrogen is substituted by a 1-(4-methoxy-3-sulfamoylphenyl)propan-2-yl group and a 2-(2-ethoxyphenoxy)ethyl group.

name: coelimycin P1
definition: An organosulfur heterocyclic compound that is 1,5-oxathiocane which has been substituted at the 2-pro-R, 3, 6, and 8 positions by oxo, acetamido, 5,6-dihydropyridin-2(1H)-ylidene, and (2E)-but-2-enoyl groups, respectively, and which has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond at the 7-8 position. It was isolated from Streptomyces coelicolor M145 after genetically engineered increase of the metabolic flux and is the product of a polyketide biosynthetic gene cluster.

name: ent-tamsulosin
definition: A 5-(2-{[2-(2-ethoxyphenoxy)ethyl]amino}propyl)-2-methoxybenzenesulfonamide that has (S)-configuration. The enantiomer of tamsulosin.

name: ent-tamsulosin(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the secondary amino group of ent-tamsulosin. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: ent-tamsulosin hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of ent-tamulosin and hydrogen chloride.

name: (2E,5S,6E,8E,10E)-1-aminododeca-2,6,8,10-tetraen-5-ol
definition: An amino alcohol that is dodeca-2,6,8,10-tetraen-1-amine in which all four double bonds have trans configuration and in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 5 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 1,5-oxathiocane
definition: An oxathiocane in which the oxygen and sulfur atoms are at positions 1 and 5 respectively.

name: 2-hydroxydodec-2-enoic acid
definition: A hydroxy monounsaturated fatty acid that is dodec-2-enoic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. A minor tautomer of 2-oxododecanoic acid.

name: 2-oxododecanoic acid
definition: An oxo fatty acid that is dodecanoic acid (lauric acid) which is substituted at position 2 by an oxo group.

name: 2-oxododecanoate
definition: An oxo fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2-oxododecanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,3-dihydroxydodecanoic acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is dodecanoic acid (lauric acid) in which a hydrogen at position 2 and a hydrogen at position 3 have each been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 3-aminoisobutanoic acid zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of 3-aminoisobutyric acid arising from migration of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (Z)-non-6-enal
definition: A monounsaturated fatty aldehyde that is (3Z)-non-3-ene which is carrying an oxo group at position 1.

name: (E)-non-2-enal
definition: A monounsaturated fatty aldehyde that is (2E)-non-2-ene which is carrying an oxo group at position 1.

name: 3,5-dimethoxybenzoic acid
definition: A methoxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid which is substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: 3,5-dimethoxybenzoate
definition: The conjugate base of 3,5-dimethoxybenzoic acid.

name: (Z)-non-6-en-1-ol
definition: A medium-chain primary fatty alcohol that is (Z)-non-6-ene carrying a hydroxy group at position 1. It has been found in muskmelon and watermelon.

name: (E)-non-2-en-1-ol
definition: A medium-chain primary fatty alcohol that is (E)-non-2-ene carrying a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: chenodeoxycholate-3-O-β-D-glucoside(1−)
definition: A bile acid anion that results from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of chenodeoxycholic acid-3-O-β-D-glucoside; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-guanidinohydantoin
definition: An imidazolidine-2,4-dione substituted by a guanidino group at position 5.

name: (2E,6Z)-nona-2,6-dien-1-ol
definition: A primary allylic alcohol that is (2E,6Z)-nona-2,6-diene in which a hydrogen at position 1 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (E)-oct-2-en-1-ol
definition: A medium-chain primary fatty alcohol that is (E)-2-octene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: (E)-4-hydroxynon-2-en-1-ol
definition: A medium-chain primary fatty alcohol that is (2E)-non-2-ene which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 4.

name: 2,3,4,7,9-pentahydroxy-6-methyl-1H-phenalen-1-one
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is funalenone in which the methoxy group at position 2 has been demethylated to the corresponding hydroxy derivative.

name: spiroiminodihydantoin
definition: An azaspiro compound that is 1,3,6,8-tetraazaspiro[4.4]non-6-ene which is substituted by oxo groups at positions 2, 4, and 9. Both enantiomers are highly mutagenic products resulting from the oxidation of guanine and 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanine in DNA by reactive oxygen species.

name: (E)-4-oxonon-2-en-1-ol
definition: A medium-chain fatty alcohol that is (E)-non-2-en-1-ol which is substituted with an oxo group at position 4.

name: (2E,4E)-2,4-hexadien-1-ol
definition: A medium-chain primary fatty alcohol that is hexan-1-ol with two trans double bonds at positions 2 and 4.

name: α-KDN-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-{[8)-α-KDN-(2→]n→6}-D-GalpNAc (n = 1—9)
definition: A branched oligosacharide consisting of a tetrasaccharide chain of deamino-α-neuraminyl (KDN), β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→3) and (1→3), to the reducing-end N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue of which is also linked (2→6) a single KDN or a (2→8)-linked chain of KDN residues, the number of KDN residues in the chain ranging between 1 and 9, with an average of 3. The diagram shows the structure with 3 KDN residues in the side-chain.

name: oligo(α2→8KDN) (DP = 2—7)
definition: An oligosaccharide consisting of deamino-α-neuraminyl residues linked (2→8) (degree of polymerisation = 2—7; average degree of polymerisation ≈ 3).

name: dihydropyriculol
definition: A member of the class of benzyl alcohols resulting from the formal reduction of the aldehyde group of pyriculol. Produced by the rice blast fungus Magnaporthe oryzae.

name: pyriculariol
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes that is salicylaldehyde which is substituted at position 6 by a (1E,3E,5R,6S)-5,6-dihydroxyhepta-1,3-dien-1-yl group. An isomer of pyriculol.

name: dihydropyriculariol
definition: A hydroxybenzyl alcohol that is pyriculariol in which the aldehyde goup has been reduced to the corresponding alcohol.

name: nectriapyrone
definition: A member of the class of nectriapyrones that is pyran-2-one which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 6 by methyl, methoxy, and but-2-en-2-yl groups, respectively in which the butenyl substituent has E configuration. A fungal metabolite that has been induced in the rice blast fungus Pyricularia oryzae by overexpression of a polyketide synthase gene (NEC1) and an O-methyltransferase gene (NEC2).

name: desmethylnectriapyrone
definition: A member of the class of nectriapyrones that is pyran-2-one which is substituted at positions 3, 4, and 6 by methyl, hydroxy, and but-2-en-2-yl groups, respectively in which the butenyl substituent has E configuration.

name: platinum-iridium alloy
definition: Any alloy composed of platinum and iridium.

name: N-hexadecanoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-hexadecanoylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 15β-stemmadenine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with forumula C21H26N2O3, isolated from the fruits of Tabernaemontana heyneana.

name: methyl pentadecanoate
definition: A fatty acid ester obtained by condensation of the carboxy group of pentadecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of methanol.

name: methyl 12-methyltetradecanoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 12-methyltetradecanoic acid (12-methylmyristic acid) with methanol.

name: (S)-nicotine N1'-oxide
definition: A nicotine N1'-oxide resulting from the oxidation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen of (S)-nicotine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-(S)-nicotine N1'-oxide
definition: An (S)-nicotine N1'-oxide in which the N1'-methyl group is on the opposite side of the pyrrolidine ring to the pyridine substituent. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: cis-(S)-nicotine N1'-oxide
definition: An (S)-nicotine N1'-oxide in which the N1'-methyl group is on the same side of the pyrrolidine ring as the pyridine substituent. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: asulam(1−)
definition: An organic nitrogen anion resulting from the deprotonation of the N-acylsulfonamide moiety of asulam. The conjugate base of asulam.

name: (16R)-deshydroxymethyl-stemmadenine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (16R)-deshydroxymethyl-stemmadenine.

name: (16S)-deshydroxymethyl-stemmadenine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (16S)-deshydroxymethyl-stemmadenine.

name: asulam-sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt obtained by formal reaction of equimolar amounts of azulam and sodium. A dihydropteroate synthase inhibitor, it is used as a herbicide (mainly for killing bracken).

name: O-acetyl-15α-stemmadenine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of O-acetyl-15α-stemmadenine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 15α-stemmadenine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of 15α-stemmadenine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: catharanthine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from thr protonation of the tertiary amino group of catharanthine.

name: ribozinoindole-1
definition: A triazinoindole that is 5H-[1,2,4]triazino[5,6-b]indole which is substituted at position 3 by a (2-methylprop-2-en-1-yl)thio group. A potent inhibitor of midasin which is an essential protein for eukaryotic ribosome biogenesis.

name: N-dodecanoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-dodecanoylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-decanoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-decanoylglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-octanoylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-octanoylglycine. The conjugate base of N-octanoylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: octanamide
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of octanoic acid with ammonia.

name: hexanamide
definition: A fatty amide of hexanoic acid.

name: (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienamide
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of α-linolenic acid with ammonia.

name: 3-deoxy-keto-D-fructose
definition: A deoxyketohexose that is keto-D-fructose that is lacking the hydroxy group at position 3. A metabolite of 3-deoxyglucosone, a dicarbonyl sugar synthesised through the Maillard reaction.

name: aldehydo-D-glucuronate
definition: A D-glucuronate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of aldehydo-D-glucuronic acid; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-hexanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-hexanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2Z)-4-oxobut-2-ene-1,2,4-tricarboxylate
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion resulting from the deprotonation of all three carboxy groups of(2Z)-4-oxobut-2-ene-1,2,4-tricarboxylate, The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-octanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-octanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-decanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-decanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-dodecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-dodecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-tetradecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-tetradecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-hexadecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-hexadecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-(2S)-hydroxyglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadeca-9,12,15-trienoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadeca-9,12,15-trienoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: CE(22:4(7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z))
definition: A cholesteryl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of all-cis-docosa-7,10,13,16-tetraenoic acid (adrenic acid) with the hydroxy group of cholesterol.

name: phosphatidylcholine (22:4(7Z,10Z,13Z,16Z)/20:4(5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z))
definition: A phosphatidylcholine (22:4/20:4) which carries a (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-22-oxodocosa-6,9,12,15-tetraen-22-yl group at position 1 and a (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosa-5,8,11,14-tetraenoyl group at position 2.

name: PC(20:0/18:2(9Z,12Z))
definition: A phosphatidylcholine 38:2 which carries an icosanoyl group at position 1 and a (6Z,9Z)-18-oxooctadeca-6,9-dien-18-yl group at position 2.

name: 1-hexadecyl-2-(9Z-nonadecenoyl)-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are hexadecyl and (9Z)-nonadec-9-enoyl respectively.

name: (2S)-2-hydroxy-4-oxobutane-1,2,4-tricarboxylate
definition: A 2-hydroxy-4-oxobutane-1,2,4-tricarboxylate resulting from the deprotonation of all three carboxy groups of (2S)-2-hydroxy-4-oxobutane-1,2,4-tricarboxylic acid; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: tigecycline(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of tigecycline; major species at pH 7.3.

name: rifamycin SV hemiaminal(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the deporotonation of the phenolic hydroxy group of rifamycin SV hemiaminal. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadeca-9,12,15-trienoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine resulting from the formal condensation of (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadeca-9,12,15-trienoic acid with the amino group of (2S)-hydroxyglycine.

name: N-(9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoylglycine
definition: An N-acylglycine in which the acyl group is specified as (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoyl (linolenoyl).

name: N-(9Z-octadecenoyl)-(2S)-hydroxyglycine
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine resulting from the formal condensation of (9Z-octadecenoic acid (oleic acid) with the amino group of (2S)-hydroxyglycine.

name: (2S)-α-hydroxyglycine
definition: An α-hydroxyglycine that has S configuration.

name: N-hexadecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine resulting from the formal condensation of hexadecanoic acid (palmitic acid) with the amino group of (2S)-hydroxyglycine.

name: N-tetradecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine resulting from the formal condensation of tetradecanoic acid (myristic acid) with the amino group of (2S)-hydroxyglycine.

name: N-dodecanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine resulting from the formal condensation of dodecanoic acid (lauric acid) with the amino group of (2S)-hydroxyglycine.

name: N-decanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine resulting from the formal condensation of decanoic acid (capric acid) with the amino group of (2S)-hydroxyglycine.

name: N-octanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine resulting from the formal condensation of octanoic acid (caprylic acid) with the amino group of (2S)-hydroxyglycine.

name: N-hexanoyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine
definition: An N-acyl-(2S)-hydroxyglycine resulting from the formal condensation of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with the amino group of (2S)-hydroxyglycine.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-(5-hydroxyvaleroyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-palmitoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the 2-acyl group is specified as 5-hydroxypentanoyl.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-(7-hydroxyheptanoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-palmitoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the 2-acyl group is specified as 7-hydroxyheptanoyl.

name: 1-palmitoyl-2-(9-hydroxynonanoyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 1-palmitoyl-2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the 2-acyl group is specified as 9-hydroxynonanoyl.

name: akuammicine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of akuammicine, arising from the protonation of the tertiary amino group.

name: D-galactose 4-sulfate
definition: A monosaccharide sulfate that is D-galactose carrying a single sulfo substituent at position 4.

name: asulam-potassium
definition: An organic potassium salt obtained by formal reaction of equimolar amounts of azulam and potassium. A dihydropteroate synthase inhibitor, it is used as a herbicide (mainly for killing bracken).

name: (2S)-2-hydroxy-4-oxobutane-1,2,4-tricarboxylic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-4-oxobutane-1,2,4-tricarboxylic acid that has S configuration.

name: 1-O-hexadecyl-2-(5-oxovaleroyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as hexadecyl and 4-oxobutyl respectively.

name: 1-O-hexadecyl-2-(5-hydroxyvaleroyl)-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine
definition: A 2-acyl-1-alkyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the alkyl and the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as hexadecyl and 4-hydroxybutyl respectively.

name: 6-hydroxymethyladenine
definition: A 6-alkylaminopurine that is adenine where one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: precondylocarpine acetate
definition: An organic cation which is an intermediate in the biosynthetic pathway leading to the synthesis of the monoterpenoid indole alkaloids, catharanthine and tabersonine.

name: dihydroprecondylocarpine acetate
definition: An organic cation which is an intermediate in the biosynthetic pathway leading to the synthesis of the monoterpenoid indole alkaloids, catharanthine and tabersonine.

name: (−)-vincadifformine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (−)-vincadifformine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: estetrol
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is 17β-estradiol which has been substituted at the 15α and 16α positions by two additional hydroxy groups. It is a natural estrogen produced exclusively during pregnancy by the fetal liver.

name: nitryl chloride
definition: A nitro compound in which the nitrogen of the nitro group is bonded to a chlorine. It is used as a nitrating and chlorinating agent in organic synthesis.

name: cyclopyrimorate
definition: A member of the class of pyridazine that is 3-chloropyridazine which has been substituted at positions 5 and 6 by (morpholin-4-ylcarbonyl)oxy and 2-cyclopropyl-6-methylphenoxy groups, respectively. A selective herbicide used to control broad-leaved and grassy weeds in cereals and rice.

name: pyrifluquinazon
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is 3,4-dihydroquinazolin-2-one which is substituted at positions 1, 4, and 6 by acetyl, pyridin-3-ylmethyl, and perfluoroisopropyl groups, respectively. An insecticide used to control sucking and chewing pests by disturbing their coordination and ability to feed.

name: 2'-hydroxytriclocarban
definition: A phenylurea that is urea substituted by 4-chloro-2-hydroxyphenyl and 3,4-dichlorophenyl groups at positions 1 and 3 respectively. A metabolite of triclocarban.

name: 2'-sulfooxytriclocarban
definition: A phenylurea that is urea substituted by 4-chloro-2-sulfooxyphenyl and 3,4-dichlorophenyl groups at positions 1 and 3 respectively. A metabolite of triclocarban.

name: 2,3,4,7,9-pentahydroxy-6-methyl-1H-phenalen-1-one(1−)
definition: An organic anion resulting from the deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group of 2,3,4,7,9-pentahydroxy-6-methyl-1H-phenalen-1-one; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: N-(1-acetylpiperidin-4-yl)-N'-[4-(trifluoromethoxy)phenyl]urea
definition: A phenylurea that is urea substituted by 1-acetylpiperidin-4-yl and 4-(trifluoromethoxy)phenyl groups at positions 1 and 3 respectively.

name: N-[1-(methanesulfonyl)piperidin-4-yl]-N'-[4-(trifluoromethoxy)phenyl]urea
definition: A phenylurea that is urea substituted by 1-(methylsulfonyl)piperidin-4-yl and 4-(trifluoromethoxy)phenyl groups at positions 1 and 3 respectively.

name: 4,4'-dichlorocarbanilide
definition: A phenylurea that is urea in which one of the hydrogens of each amino group is replaced by a 4-chlorophenyl group.

name: nectriapyrone D
definition: A member of the class of nectriapyrones that is nectriapyrone that carries a hydroxy group at position 4. It is a fungal metabolite isolated from Diaporthe gulyae.

name: 3,6,7,9-tetrahydroxy-3-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-naphtho[2,1-b]pyran-1-one
definition: A naphtho-γ-pyrone that is 3-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-naphtho[2,1-b]pyran-1-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3,6,7 and 9.

name: 3,6,7,9-tetrahydroxy-3-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-naphtho[2,1-b]pyran-1-one(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 3,6,7,9-tetrahydroxy-3-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-naphtho[2,1-b]pyran-1-one, arising from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 6; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tyramine phosphate
definition: An aryl phosphate that is tyramine in which the phenolic hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a phospho group.

name: andrastin E(1−)
definition: An enolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol group of andrastin E. Major species at pH 7.3. Published in http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.tet.2013.07.029

name: andrastin D(1−)
definition: An enolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol of andrastin D.Major species at pH 7.3. Published in http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.tet.2013.07.029

name: andrastin F(1−)
definition: An enolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol group of andrastin F. Major species at pH 7.3. Published in http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.tet.2013.07.029

name: andrastin C(1−)
definition: An enolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol group of andrastin C. Major species at pH 7.3. Published in http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.tet.2013.07.029

name: andrastin B(1−)
definition: An enolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol group of andrastin B. Major species at pH 7.3. Published in Tetrahedron, 2013, 69(38), 8199-8204. http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.tet.2013.07.029

name: andrastin A(1−)
definition: An enolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol group of andrastin A. Major species at pH 7.3. Published in Tetrahedron, 2013, 69(38), 8199-8204. http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.tet.2013.07.029

name: saflufenacil
definition: A member of the class of sulfamides that is sulfamide in which one of the amino groups has been substituted by a methyl group an an isopropyl group, while the other has been substituted by a 2-chloro-4-fluoro-5-[3-methyl-2,6-dioxo-4-(trifluoromethyl)-3,6-dihydropyrimidin-1(2H)-yl]benzoyl group. An important BASF herbicide, not registered in Europe but sold in USA, Canada and several other countries to control weeds in a wide range of food crops. Often mixed with other products such as glyphosate.

name: methfuroxam
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of 2,4,5-trimethyl-3-furoic acid with the amino group of aniline. An obsolete fungicide formerly used to control Basidiomycetes pathogens on cereal crops.

name: pyriminostrobin
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine which is substituted at positions 2, 4, and 6 by 2,4-dichloroanilino, trifluoromethyl, and {2-[(1E)-1,3-dimethoxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-2-yl]benzyl}oxy groups, respectively. An acaricide used for the control of mites on citrus and cotton crops.

name: GM1-GM1 dimer
definition: A ganglioside derivative derived from two GM1 skeletons linked through their amino nitrogen atoms by an adipoyl (hexanedioyl) group.

name: GD1a-GD1a dimer
definition: A ganglioside derivative derived from two GD1a skeletons linked through their amino nitrogen atoms by an adipoyl (hexanedioyl) group.

name: GM1-GD1a hybrid ganglioside dimer
definition: A ganglioside derivative derived from a GM1 skeleton linked to a GD1a skeleton through their respective amino nitrogen atoms by an adipoyl (hexanedioyl) group.

name: (+)-vincadifformine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (+)-vincadifformine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: chlorfenac(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of chlorfenac.

name: chlorfenac-ammonium
definition: An ammonium salt comprising equimolar amounts of chlorfenac(1-) anions and ammonium cations. An obsolete herbicide.

name: chlorfenac-sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt comprising equimolar amounts of chlorfenac(1-) anions and sodium cations. An obsolete herbicide.

name: (+)-vincadifformine
definition: An aspidosperma alkaloid that is the methyl ester of 2,3-didehydroaspidospermidine-3-carboxylic acid.

name: (R)-DRF053 hydrochloride hydrate
definition: A hydrochloride and hydrate of DRF053, an analogue (and more potent version) of roscovitine - it is 2 fold more potent against cyclin dependent kinase 5 (CDK5) and >150 times more potent against CDK1. Formula C23H27N7O·xHCl·yH2O.

name: O-acetyl-15α-stemmadenine
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of 15α-stemmadenine with the carboxy group of acetic acid.

name: (9R,10R)-dihydroxyoctadecanoate
definition: A 9,10-dihydroxystearate in which the chiral carbon atoms at positions 9 and 10 have the R-configuration

name: (R)-DRF053
definition: A member of the class of 2,6-diaminopurines that is 2,6-diamiopurine which is substituted by an isopropyl group at position 9 and in which the amino groups at positions 2 and 6 are substituted by a 1-hydroxybutan-2-yl and 3-(pyridin-2-yl)phenyl groups, respectively (the R enantiomer). A cyclin dependent kinase inhibitor, widely used as its hydrochloride hydrate.

name: deoxyaureothin
definition: A 4-pyranone that is 2-methoxy-3,5-dimethyl-4H-pyran-4-one which is substituted at position 6 by a 2,4-dimethyl-1-(p-nitrophenyl)hexa-1,3-dien-6-yl group (the E,E isomer).

name: spectinabilin
definition: A polyketide that is deoxyspectinabilin in which the tetramethyldeca-tetraen-1-yl chain attached to the 4-pyranone moiety has undergone oxidation at position 1 and at the methyl group at position 3 to afford the corresponding tetrahydrofuranyl moiety. Produced by Streptomyces spectabilis, it exhibits antiviral and antimalarial activity.

name: andrastin A
definition: A 19-oxo steroid that is that is andrastin B in which the hydroxy group at position 19 has been oxidised to give the corresponding aldehyde. A farnesyltransferase inhibitor produced by Penicillium roqueforti, a filamentous fungus involved in the ripening of several kinds of blue cheeses.

name: deoxyspectinabilin
definition: A member of the class of 4-pyranones that is 2-methoxy-3,5-dimethylpyran-4-one which is substituted at position 6 by a [(3E,5E,7E,9E)-3,5,7,9-tetramethyl-10-(4-nitrophenyl)deca-3,5,7,9-tetraen-1-yl] group. The immediate precursor of the Streptomyces spectabilis metabolite spectinabilin.

name: 9β-9,19-cyclolanost-24-ene-3β,28-diol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenod that is 9β,19-cyclolanost-24-ene which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3β and 28 positions.

name: 4α-formyl-4β,14α-dimethyl-9β,19-cyclo-5α-cholest-24-en-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-4α-formyl-4β-methylsteroid that is 9β-9,19-cyclolanost-24-ene-3β,28-diol in which the hydroxy group at position 28 has been oxidised to the corresponding aldehyde.

name: 3β-hydroxy-9β-9,19-cyclolanost-24-en-28-oate
definition: A steroid acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3β-hydroxy-9β-9,19-cyclolanost-24-en-28-oic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: triflusulfuron
definition: An N-sulfonylurea that is urea in which a hydrogen attached to one of the nitrogens has been replaced by a (2-carboxy-6-methylphenyl)sulfonyl group, while a hydrogen attached to the other nitrogen has been replaced by a 4-(dimethylamino)-6-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl group. An acetolactate synthase inhibitor, it is used (generally as the corresponding methyl ester proherbicide) to control annual and perennial broad-leaved weeds in sugar beet and other crops.

name: 4α-hydroxymethyl-5α-ergosta-7,24(28)-dien-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 24-methylidenelophenol in which the methyl group at position 4 has been oxidised to the corresponding hydroxymethyl group.

name: 4α-formyl-ergosta-7,24(28)-dien-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-ergosta-7,24(28)-diene which is substituted at the 3β and 4α positions by hydroxy and formyl groups, respectively.

name: 3β-hydroxy-5α-ergosta-7,24(28)-diene-4α-carboxylate
definition: A steroid acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3β-hydroxy-5α-ergosta-7,24(28)-diene-4α-carboxylic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-amino-4-[hydroxy(methyl)phosphoryl]butanoic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid that is 2-aminobutanoic acid which is substituted at position 4 by a hydroxy(methyl)phosphoryl group.

name: glufosinate-P
definition: A 2-amino-4-[hydroxy(methyl)phosphoryl]butanoic acid that has S configuration at position 2. A glutamine synthetase inhibitor, it is used (generally as the corresponding ammonium or sodium salts, known as glufosinate-P-ammonium and glufosinate-P-sodium, respectively) as a herbicide to control annual weeds and grasses.

name: (2R)-glufosinate
definition: A 2-amino-4-[hydroxy(methyl)phosphoryl]butanoic acid that has R configuration at position 2. The enantiomer of glufosinate-P.

name: (2R)-glufosinate zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of (2R)-glufosinate.

name: glufosinate-P zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of glufosinate-P.

name: (2R)-glufosinate zwitterion(1−)
definition: An organic anion resulting from the deprotonation of the phosphinic acid group of (2R)-glufosinate zwitterion.

name: glufosinate-P zwitterion(1−)
definition: An organic anion resulting from the deprotonation of the phosphinic acid group of (2R)-glufosinate-P zwitterion.

name: glufosinate-P-ammonium
definition: An ammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of equimolar amounts of glufosinate-P and ammonia. A glutamine synthetase inhibitor, used as a herbicide to control annual weeds and grasses.

name: andrastin B
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is andrastin C in which a hydrogen of the methyl group at position 19 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. A farnesyltransferase inhibitor produced by Penicillium roqueforti, a filamentous fungus involved in the ripening of several kinds of blue cheeses.

name: 4-nitrobenzoate
definition: A member of the class of benzoates resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 4-nitrobenzoic acid.

name: 1-carboxybiuret(1−)
definition: An organic anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carbamic acid group of 1-carboxybiuret.

name: 1,3-dicarboxyurea(2−)
definition: An organic anion resulting from the deprotonation of both of the carboxy groups of 1,3-dicarboxyurea. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (3S,4R)-7,2'-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyisoflavanol
definition: A 7,2'-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyisoflavanol that has 3S,4R configuration.

name: andrastin C
definition: A 17-oxosteroid that is 17-oxo-5β,9β,10α,13α-androsta-11,15-dieneandroxta-11,15-diene which is substituted by an acetoxy group at the 3β position, methyl groups at the 4, 4, 8, 12, and 16 positions, a methoxycarbonyl group at position 14, and a hydroxy group at position 15. A farnesyltransferase inhibitor produced by Penicillium roqueforti, a filamentous fungus involved in the ripening of several kinds of blue cheeses.

name: (3R,4R)-2'-hydroxy-4',5'-methylenedioxyisoflavan-4,7-diol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyisoflavans that is isoflavan-4,7-diol which is substituted by a hydroxy group at the 2' position and by a methylenedioxy group at the 4'-5' positions (the R,R stereoisomer).

name: (3R,4R)-7,2',4'-trihydroxyisoflavanol
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyisoflavans that is isoflavan-4-ol which is substituted at positions 7, 2' and 4' by hydroxy groups (the 3R,4R stereoisomer).

name: demethyldeoxyspectinabilin(1−)
definition: An enolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the enol moiety of demethyldeoxyspectinabilin. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: andrastin D
definition: A 3-oxo steroid that is andrastin C in which the acetoxy group at the 3beta position has undergone formal oxidative cleavage to afford the corresponding 3-oxo derivative. A farnesyltransferase inhibitor produced by Penicillium roqueforti, a filamentous fungus involved in the ripening of several kinds of blue cheeses.

name: andrastin E
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is andrastin D in which the keto group at position 3 has undergone formal reduction to give the corresponding 3α-hydroxy compound.

name: andrastin F
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is andrastin D in which the keto group at position 3 has undergone formal reduction to give the corresponding 3β-hydroxy compound.

name: 1,3-dicarboxyurea
definition: A member of the class of condensed ureas that is urea in which each of the amino groups has had one of the attached hydrogens replace by a carboxy group.

name: 7,2'-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyisoflavanol
definition: A member of the class of isoflavans that is isoflavan-4-ol substituted at positions 7 and 2' by hydroxy groups and at position 4' by a methoxy group.

name: N1,N8-bis-(dihydrocaffeoyl)spermidine
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of a molecule of dihydrocaffeic acid with each of the primary amino groups of spermidine. Found in potato tubers.

name: 3-(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)-3-oxopropanoyl-CoA
definition: An acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)-3-oxopropanoic acid (vanilloylacetic acid). It is a potential intermediate in vanillate synthesis.

name: vanilloyl-CoA
definition: A member of the class of benzoyl-CoAs having 4-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzoyl (also known as vanilloyl) as the aroyl group. A potential intermediate of vanillate biosynthesis.

name: poly(glycyl-L-arginine)
definition: A polypeptide composed of dipeptide Gly-Arg units joined via peptide linkages.

name: vicenin-3
definition: A C-glycosyl compound that is apigenin substituted by a β-D-glucosyl group and a β-D-xylosyl group at positions 6 and 8 respectively.

name: vanilloylacetic acid
definition: A 3-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is dihydroferulic acid in which the benzylic methylene group has been oxidised to give the corresponding ketone.

name: cycloeucalenone
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is 4α,14-dimethyl-9β,19-cyclo-5α-ergost-24(28)-ene which is substituted by an oxo group at position 3. It has been isolated from several plant species including Quercus variabilis, Ammocharis coranica, Solanum cernuum and Tinospora crispa.

name: 24-methylene-9β-9,19-cyclolanostane-3β,28-diol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-4α-formyl-4β-methylsteroid that is 24-methylenecycloartanol in which the alpha-methyl substituent at position 4 has been substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: 3β-hydroxy-24-methylene-9β-9,19-cyclolanostan-28-al
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-4α-formyl-4β-methylsteroid that is 24-methylene-9β-9,19-cyclolanostane-3β,28-diol in which the hydroxy group at position 28 has been oxidised to give the corresponding aldehyde.

name: (E)-4-hydroxynon-2-enoate
definition: A hydroxy monounsaturated fatty acid anion arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (2E)-4-hydroxynon-2-enoic acid.

name: 3-phenylprop-2-enal
definition: A member of the class of cinnamaldehydes that is prop-2-enal in which a hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a phenyl group. The configuration of the double bond is not specified; the name "cinnamaldehyde" is widely used to refer to the E (trans) isomer.

name: 4α-hydroxymethyl-stigmasta-7,24(241)-dien-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is 5α-stigmasta-7,24(28)-dien-3β-ol which is substituted at the 4α position by a hydroxymethyl group and in which the 24(28) double bond has Z configuration.

name: (24Z)-4α-formyl-stigmasta-7,24(241)-dien-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is (24Z)-stigmasta-7,24(28)-diene which is substituted at the 3β and 4α positions by hydroxy and formyl groups, respectively.

name: demethyldeoxyspectinabilin
definition: A polyketide that is deoxyspectinabilin in which the methoxy group at position 2 of the pyranone moiety has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: (16R)-deshydroxymethyl-stemmadenine
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1,4,5,6,7,8-hexahydro-2H-3,6-ethanoazonino[5,4-b]indole in which position 5 is substituted by an ethylidene group and position 7R is substituted by a methoxycarbonyl group.

name: (16S)-deshydroxymethyl-stemmadenine
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1,4,5,6,7,8-hexahydro-2H-3,6-ethanoazonino[5,4-b]indole in which position 5 is substituted by an ethylidene group and position 7S is substituted by a methoxycarbonyl group.

name: 3-(difluoromethyl)-N-(7-fluoro-1,1,3-trimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-inden-4-yl)-1-methyl-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(difluoromethyl)-1-methylpyrazole-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 7-fluoro-1,1,3-trimethylindan-4-amine.

name: (R)-fluindapyr
definition: A 3-(difluoromethyl)-N-(7-fluoro-1,1,3-trimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-inden-4-yl)-1-methyl-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxamide that has R configuration. The fungicide fluindapyr is a racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)-fluindapyr and (S)-fluindapyr.

name: (S)-fluindapyr
definition: A 3-(difluoromethyl)-N-(7-fluoro-1,1,3-trimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-inden-4-yl)-1-methyl-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxamide that has S configuration. The fungicide fluindapyr is a racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (R)-fluindapyr and (S)-fluindapyr.

name: 6-sulfo-α-D-quinovose(1−)
definition: A 6-sulfo-D-quinovose(1−) that has α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 6-sulfo-β-D-quinovose(1−)
definition: A 6-sulfo-D-quinovose(1−) that has β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 3-hydroxybutanenitrile
definition: A hydroxynitrile that is butyronitirle in which a hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: D-histidine zwitterion
definition: A polar amino acid zwitterion restulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the α-amino group of D-histidine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: marinolate C
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of marinolic acid C. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (Z)-pyribencarb
definition: A (2-chloro-5-{N-[(6-methylpyridin-2-yl)methoxy]ethanimidoyl}benzyl)carbamate that has Z-configuation at the C=N bond of the oxime ether group.

name: methyl (2-chloro-5-{N-[(6-methylpyridin-2-yl)methoxy]ethanimidoyl}benzyl)carbamate
definition: A member of the class of methylpyridines that is (6-methylpyridin-2-yl)methanol in which the hydroxy group is substituted by a [1-(4-chloro-3-{[(methoxycarbonyl)amino]methyl}phenyl)ethylidene]amino group.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoate
definition: A 6-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyoleate
definition: A 2-hydroxyoctadecenoate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxyoleic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxygondoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxygondoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxyerucate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxyerucic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxypalmitoleate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxypalmitoleic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyclolaudenol
definition: A pentacyclic triterpenoid that is (24S)-methyl-9β,19-cyclolanost-25-ene which carries a hydroxy group at position 3β. It is isolated from several plant species inclduing Turraeanthus and Tillandsia.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A muconic semialdehyde that is 6-oxohexa-2,4-dienoic acid which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2 and a methyl group at position 5 (the 2Z,4E isomer).

name: (3-aminopropyl)phosphonic acid
definition: A phosphonic acid in which the hydrogen attached to the phosphorus of phosphonic acid is substituted by a 3-aminopropyl group. It is a partial agonist of GABAB receptors.

name: (3-aminopropyl)phosphonic acid zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the phosphonic acid group to the amino group of (3-aminopropyl)phosphonic acid; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-homoarginine(1+)
definition: A guanidinium ion that is the conjugate acid of L-homoarginine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1'-hydroxy-demethylspheroidene
definition: A carotenol obtained by formal hydration of a double bond at position 1' of demethylspheroidene.

name: ML240
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline which is substituted at positions 2, 5 and 8 by 2-amino-1H-benzimidazol-1-yl, benzylnitrilo and methoxy groups, respectively. It is a ATP-competetive inhibitor of AAA ATPase p97, also known as valosin-containing protein (VCP).

name: isooctyl laurate
definition: A dodecanoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of dodecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of 6-methylheptan-1-ol.

name: 1-carboxybiuret
definition: A member of the class of condensed ureas that is urea in which one of the amino groups has had one of the attached hydrogens replaced by a carbamoyl group and the second amino group has had one of its hydrogens replaced by a carboxy group.

name: firefly D-sulfoluciferin(2−)
definition: The conjugate base of firefly sulfoluciferin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxypalmitoleic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid that is (9Z)-hexadecenoic acid which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 2-hydroxyerucic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid that is erucic acid which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: firefly L-sulfoluciferin(2−)
definition: An aryl sulfate oxoanion that is the enantiomer of firefly D-sulfoluciferin(2−); major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-(phenethylamino)-butan-2-one
definition: A methyl ketone that is 2-phenylethan-1-amine in which one of the hydrogen's of the amino group is substituted by a 3-oxobutan-2-yl group. It is a volatile organic compound produced by the skin bacterium, S.schleiferi.

name: lactobionate
definition: A gluconate that is the conjugate base of lactobionic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 3-(4-aminophenyl)pyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3-(4-aminophenyl)pyruvic acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-amino-L-phenylalanine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 4-amino-L-phenylalanine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-homocarnosine zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-homocarnosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-(4-aminophenyl)pyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 3-(4-aminophenyl)propanoic acid which is substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: 4-aminophenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine carrying an amino group at position 4 on the benzene ring.

name: D-leucine zwitterion
definition: A D-α-amino acid zwitterion arising from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of D-leucine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-norleucine zwitterion
definition: A D-α-amino acid zwitterion arising from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of D-norleucine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-homoserine zwitterion
definition: A D-α-amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of D-homoserine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-amino-D-phenylalanine
definition: The D-enantiomer of 4-aminophenylalanine.

name: (2E)-4-hydroxynon-2-enoic acid
definition: A 4-hydroxynon-2-enoic acid in which the double bond has (E)-configuration.

name: 10-hydroxyoctadecanoate
definition: A hydroxy saturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 10-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid.

name: 2'-3'-cGAMP(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 2'-3'-cGAMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 10-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is octadecanoic acid carrying a hydroxy group at position 10.

name: 2-hydroxyoleic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid that is oleic acid which carries a hydroxy group at position 2. It is an orally bioavailable synthetic hydroxylated fatty acid which modulates the lipid content of cancer cell membranes and induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in several cancer cell lines.

name: Gp[2'-5']Ap[3']
definition: A (2'→5')-dinucleotide comprising guanosine and adenosine connected by a 2'→5' linkage and with a phosphate group at the 3'-terminus.

name: Gp[2'-5']Ap[3'](3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of Gp[2'-5']Ap[3']; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxygondoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid that is (11Z)-icos-11-enoic acid which carries a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: N-(2,3-dihydroxybenzoyl)serine
definition: A serine derivative resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,3-dihydroxybenzoic acid with the amino group of serine.

name: GI254023X
definition: A L-valine derivative that is 3-methyl-L-valine in which carboxy OH group is replaced by a methylnitrilo group and the one of the amino hydrogens is replaced by a (2R)-2-{(1S)-1-[formyl(hydroxy)amino]ethyl}-5-phenylpentanoyl group. It is a potent MMP9 and ADAM10 metalloprotease inhibitor with IC50 of 2.5 and 5.3 nM, respectively.

name: N-(5-{[(5-tert-butyl-1,3-oxazol-2-yl)methyl]sulfanyl}-1,3-thiazol-2-yl)-2-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)pyridine-4-carboxamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)pyridine-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 5-{[(5-tert-butyl-1,3-oxazol-2-yl)methyl]sulfanyl}-1,3-thiazol-2-amine. A CDKL2 inhibitor (Kd = 63nM).

name: 2-acetamidophenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is 2-aminophenol in which one of the hydrogens attached to the amino group has been replaced by an acetyl group. A positional isomer of paracetamol which possesses anti-inflammatory, anti-arthritic and anti-platelet aggregation properties.

name: 4-acetamidotoluene
definition: A member of the class of toluenes that is 4-aminotoluene in which one of the hydrogens attached to the amino group has been replaced by an acetyl group.

name: ({6-[4-(methylsulfanyl)phenyl]thieno[3,2-d]pyrimidin-4-yl}sulfanyl)acetic acid
definition: A thienopyrimidine that is thieno[3,2-d]pyrimidine which is substituted by a (carboxymethyl)sulfanediyl group at position 4 and by a 4-(methylsulfanyl)phenyl group at position 6. It is a STK17B kinase inhibitor.

name: N-[5-(1-benzyl-1H-1,2,3-triazol-4-yl)-1H-indazol-3-yl]-N2,N2-dimethylglycinamide
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 1H-indazole which is substituted by a (N,N-dimethylglycyl)nitrilo group and a 1-benzyl-1H-1,2,3-triazol-4-yl group at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is a GSK-3β, CDK1, CDK2, CSNK1G2 and CLK4 kinase inhibitor.

name: N-(5-{[(5-tert-butyl-1,3-oxazol-2-yl)methyl]sulfanyl}-1,3-thiazol-2-yl)tetrahydro-2H-pyran-4-carboxamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of tetrahydro-2H-pyran-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 5-{[(5-tert-butyl-1,3-oxazol-2-yl)methyl]sulfanyl}-1,3-thiazol-2-amine. It is a CDK18 kinase inhibitor.

name: CCT251545
definition: A chloropyridine that is 3-chloropyridine substituted by a 1-oxo-2,8-diazaspiro[4.5]decan-8-yl group and a 4-(1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl)phenyl group at positions 4 and 5, respectively. It is an orally bioavailable inhibitor of Wnt signaling (IC50 = 5 nM) and a potent and selective chemical probe for cyclin-dependent kinases CDK8 and CDK19.

name: N-(2-[(2-aminoethyl)(methyl)amino]-5-{[3-cyano-7-(cyclopropylamino)pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidin-5-yl]amino}phenyl)acetamide
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine which is substituted at positions 3, 5, and 7 by cyano, {3-acetamido-4-[(2-aminoethyl)(methyl)amino]phenyl}nitrilo and cyclopropylnitrilo groups, respectively. It is a DYRK2 and CSNK2A2 kinase inhibitor.

name: BI00036838
definition: A member of the class of oxindoles that is 5-acetyl-3-methylidene-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one in which one of the hydrogens of the methylidene group is substituted by a 2,2-dimethylhydrazinyl group and the other hydrogen is substituted by an ethyl group. It is a DYRK1B kinase inhibitor.

name: lorlatinib
definition: A cyclic ether that is 16,17-dihydro-2H-8,4-(metheno)pyrazolo[4,3-h][2,5,11]benzoxadiazacyclotetradecin-15(10H)-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 10R, and by cyano, amino and fluoro groups at positions 3, 7 and 12 respectively. It is a small molecule inhibitor of ALK and ROS1 kinase developed by Pfizer for the treatment of ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer.

name: 4-(6-ethoxypyrazolo[1,5-b]pyridazin-3-yl)-N-(3-methoxyphenyl)pyrimidin-2-amine
definition: A pyrazolopyridazine that is pyrazolo[1,5-b]pyridazine which is substituted by a 2-(3-methoxyanilino)pyrimidin-4-yl group at position 3 and by an ethoxy group at position 6. It is a CLK4 kinase inhibitor.

name: N-(2-methoxyethyl)-4-{[6-(pyridin-4-yl)quinazolin-2-yl]amino}benzamide
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline which is substituted by a {4-[(2-methoxyethyl)carbamoyl]phenyl}nitrilo group and a pyridin-4-yl group at positions 2 and 6, respectively. It is a B-Raf and MKNK2 kinase inhibitor.

name: 2-(6-methylpyridin-2-yl)-N-(pyridin-4-yl)quinazolin-4-amine
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline which is substituted at positions 2 and 4 by 6-methylpyridin-2-yl and pyridin-4-ylnitrilo groups, respectively. It is an ALK5 and PKN3 kinase inhibitor.

name: GW296115X
definition: An indolocarbazole compound having methoxy groups at positions 3 and 9 and an additional fused pyrrolidine-2,5-dione ring. It is an inhibitor of BRSK2 kinase, PDGF-dependent receptor autophosphorylation and cell proliferation.

name: THZ531
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 5-chloro-4-(1H-indol-3-yl)-N-[(3R)-piperidin-3-yl]pyrimidin-2-amine in which the piperidine NH group is substituted by a 4-{[(2E)-4-(dimethylamino)but-2-enoyl]amino}benzoyl group. It is a first-in-class CDK12 and CDK13 covalent kinase inhibitor with IC50 of 158 nM and 69 nM, respectively.

name: N-(5-{[(5-tert-butyl-1,3-oxazol-2-yl)methyl]sulfanyl}-1,3-thiazol-2-yl)-1-(N,N-dimethylglycyl)piperidine-4-carboxamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 1-(N,N-dimethylglycyl)piperidine-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 5-{[(5-tert-butyl-1,3-oxazol-2-yl)methyl]sulfanyl}-1,3-thiazol-2-amine. It is a CDKL5 and CDK16 kinase inhibitor.

name: 4-(2,6-difluorobenzamido)-N-(piperidin-4-yl)-1H-pyrazole-3-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of pryrazoles that is 4-amino-1H-pyrazole-3-carboxylic acid in which the primary amino group has been acylated by a 2,6-difluorobenzoyl group and in which the carboxylic acid has been converted to a carboxamide by formal condensation with the primary amino group of 4-aminopiperidine. It is a CDK1, CDK2 and CDK17 kinase inhibitor.

name: (2E)-2-benzylidene-3-(cyclohexylamino)indan-1-one
definition: A 2-benzylidene-3-(cyclohexylamino)indan-1-one in which the double bond has E configuration. An inhibitor of the dual specificity phosphatase 6 (Dusp6).

name: PDGF receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor III
definition: An N-arylpiperazine that is piperazine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen at position 1 is replaced by a (4-phenoxyphenyl)aminocarbonyl group, while the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen at position 4 is replaced by a 6,7-dimethoxyquinazolin-4-yl group. It is an inhibitor of tyrosine kinases FLT3, PDGFR and KIT.

name: BCI-215
definition: An aromatic ketone that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-inden-1-one which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 5 by (E)-benzylidene, cyclohexylamino, and bromine, respectively. A hyperactivator of fibroblast growth factor signaling in transgenic zebrafish that is devoid of developmental toxicity and restores defective MAPK activity caused by overexpression of DUSP1 and DUSP6 in mammalian cells.

name: ferric yersiniabactin
definition: An iron coordination entity consisting of iron(III) coordinated as a 1:1 complex by three nitrogen electron pairs and three negatively charged oxygen atoms of yersiniabactin with a distorted octahedral coordination.

name: succinamate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of succinamic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Galp group
definition: An organyl group consisting of a D-galactopyranose having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue attached at the 4-position, bound at the 1-position.

name: (9S),10-epoxy-(10,12Z)-octadecadienoate
definition: A long-chain unsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (9S),10-epoxy-(10,12Z)-octadecadienoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxylic acid group.

name: N,N',N'',N'''-tetraacetylchitotetraose
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of three 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: N,N'-diacetylchitobiono-1,5-lactone
definition: A disaccharide that is N-acetyl-D-glucosamino-1,5-lactone in which the hydroxy group at position 5 is replaced by a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: cloquintocet
definition: A member of the class of quinolines that is quinoline which is substituted by a chloro group at position 5 and by a carboxymethoxy group at position 8.

name: (S)-codamine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the amino group of (S)-codamine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-cloquintocet-mexyl
definition: A heptan-2-yl [(5-chloroquinolin-8-yl)oxy]acetate that has R-configuration.

name: (S)-cloquintocet-mexyl
definition: A heptan-2-yl [(5-chloroquinolin-8-yl)oxy]acetate that has S-configuration.

name: heptan-2-yl [(5-chloroquinolin-8-yl)oxy]acetate
definition: A member of the class of quinolines that is quinoline which is substituted by a chloro group at position 5 and by a 2-[(heptan-2-yl)oxy]-2-oxoethoxy group at position 8.

name: β-alanyl-L-argininium
definition: A peptide cation that is the conjugate acid of β-alanyl-L-arginine, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of both the primary amino and guanidino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-alanyl-L-lysinium
definition: A peptide cation that is the conjugate acid of β-alanyl-L-lysine zwitterion, arising from the protonation of one of the amino groups. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: glycyl-L-leucine zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Gly-Leu. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: azumolene sodium
definition: The anhydrous sodium salt of azumolene.

name: aldrithiol
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine which is substituted by a pyridin-2-yldisulfanediyl group at position 2. It is a reagent used in molecular biology as an oxidizing agent. Also used in peptide synthesis and for detecting thiols.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A maltotetraose tetrasaccharide consisting of three α-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A maltohexaose hexasaccharide consisting of five α-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A maltoheptaose heptasaccharide consisting of six α-D-glucose residues and a D-glucose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: D-cellohexaose
definition: A hexasaccharide consisting of five β-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: 5,6-didehydrosparteine
definition: A quinolizidine alkaloid obtained by formal dehydrogenation at the 5,6-position of sparteine. It is a metabolite of sparteine found in human urine and plasma.

name: culmorin
definition: A sesquiterpenoid fungal metabolite isolated from Fusarium culmorum.

name: 2,3,3,3-tetrafluoro-2-(heptafluoropropoxy)propanoic acid
definition: A perfluorinated compound that is 2-propoxypentanoic acid in which all 11 of the hydrogens attached to carbon atoms have been replaced by fluorine atoms. Used as an alternative to perfluorooctanoic acid in the fluoropolymer industry for years, its widespread environmental distribution, high bioaccumulation capability, and human exposure have caused great concern, particularly as its potential toxicity and health risk is still largely unknown.

name: azumolene
definition: A 1,3-oxazole which is substituted by a [(2,4-dioxoimidazolidin-1-yl)imino]methyl group at position 2 and a 4-bromophenyl group at position 5. It is a muscle relaxant used for the treatment/prevention of malignant hyperthermia.

name: azumolene(1−)
definition: The organic anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the hydrogen-bearing nitrogen atom of azumolene.

name: indole-4-carbaldehyde
definition: A heteroarenecarbaldehyde that is indole in which the hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a formyl group.

name: 2-O-sulfate-4-hydroxyacetophenone
