definition: An acetophenone substituted by a sulfooxy group at position 2 and by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: 2-fluoro-6-(4-methoxyphenoxy)benzonitrile
definition: An aromatic ether that is diphenyl ether substituted by a cyano group, fluoro group and a methoxy group at positions 1,2 and 4, respectively.

name: 3-amino-5-morpholinomethyl-2-oxazolidinone
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidinones that is 3-amino-1,3-oxazolidin-2-one substituted by a morpholin-4-ylmethyl group at position 5. It is the metabolite of furaltadone, a broad-spectrum antibacterial drug which was widely used as an additive in livestock and aquaculture feed.

name: α-aminosuberic acid
definition: An α-amino acid that is octanedioic acid substituted by an amino group at position 2.

name: 1-(hydroxymethyl)-5,5-dimethylhydantoin
definition: An imidazolidine-2,4-dione substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 1 and two methyl groups at position 5. It is approved by the FDA for use as an adjuvant in the bleaching of recycled paper and board used in food packaging, and is also a decomposition product of DMDM hydantoin, a preservative and antimicrobial agent used in cosmetics and personal care products.

name: 3,5,6-trihydroxyindoline
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is indoline with hydroxy substituents at positions 3,5 and 6.

name: norophthalmic acid
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, L-alanine, and glycine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: bioallethrin
definition: A partly enantiopure variant of allethrin consisting of a mixture of two allethrin isomers (1R,trans;1R and 1R,trans;1S) in an approximate ratio of 1:1. Widely registered mosquito adulticide and spatial repellent. Bioallethrin is a synthetic pyrethroid used as a pesticide against household pest insects such as mosquitoes, houseflies and cockroaches.

name: (+)-dehydrodiconiferyl alcohol
definition: A dehydrodiconiferyl alcohol that has (2S,3R)-configuration. A natural product isolated from several plant species including Allium sativum and Codonopsis pilosula.

name: 22-ketocholesterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is cholesterol carrying an oxo group at position 22.

name: 8-aminooctanoic acid
definition: An ω-amino fatty acid that is octanoic acid which carries an amino group at position 8.

name: diisopropanolamine
definition: A secondary amino compound that is diethanolamine substituted by methyl groups at positions 1 and 1'. It is a versatile chemical used in a variety of personal care, cosmetic and industrial products.

name: 5-(4-hydroxybutyl)hydantoin
definition: An imidazolidine-2,4-dione substituted by a 4-hydroxybutyl group at position 5.

name: N-(2-hydroxyethyl)iminodiacetic acid
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid that is glycine in which both hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is substituted by a carboxymethyl group and a 2-hydroxyethyl group.

name: (S)-norreticuline(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of (S)-norreticuline, resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: indole-3-butyrate
definition: An indol-3-yl carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of indole-3-butyric acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: N2-[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]-L-glutaminate
definition: An N2-acyl-L-glutaminate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N2-[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]-L-glutamine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-chloro-L-lysinium
definition: An α-amino-acid cation that is the conjugate acid of 4-chloro-L-lysine zwitterion; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)butanoate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the dprotonation of the carboxy group of 4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)butanoic acid (2,4-DB). The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N2-[4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)butanoyl]-L-glutamine(1−)
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N2-[4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)butanoyl]-L-glutamine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]-L-cysteinate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]-L-cysteine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-propargylglycine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of L-propargylglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-{4-[2-hydroxy-3-(propan-2-ylamino)propoxy]phenyl}propanoic acid
definition: A carboxylic acid that is 3-phenylpropanoic acid substituted at position 4 by a 2-hydroxy-3-(propan-2-ylamino)propoxy group.

name: 3-aminopropan-1-ol
definition: A member of the class of propanolamines that is propane with a hydroxy substituent at C-1 and an amino substituent at C-2, making it both a primary amine and a primary alcohol.

name: N-demethylmirtazapine
definition: A benzazepine metabolite resulting from demethylation of the antidpressant, mirtazapine.

name: didesethylflurazepam
definition: A primary amino compound resulting from the dealkylation of both ethyl groups of the anti-insomnia drug flurazepam. It is the major metabolite of flurazepam.

name: halauxifen-methyl
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of halauxifen with methanol. It is a proherbicide used for the control of broad-leaved weeds in cereals and oilseed rape.

name: N-arachidonoyl-L-serine
definition: An N-acyl-amino acid resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of arachidonic acid with the amino group of L-serine. It is an endocannabinoid-like lipid isolated from bovine brains.

name: N-{2-[(4,6-dimethoxypyrimidin-2-yl)(hydroxy)methyl]-6-(methoxymethyl)phenyl}-1,1-difluoromethanesulfonamide
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine which is substituted by a [2-{[(difluoromethyl)sulfonyl]amino}-3-(methoxymethyl)phenyl](hydroxy)methyl group at position 2 and by methoxy groups at positions 4 and 6.

name: (R)-pyrimisulfan
definition: A N-{2-[(4,6-dimethoxypyrimidin-2-yl)(hydroxy)methyl]-6-(methoxymethyl)phenyl}-1,1-difluoromethanesulfonamide that has R configuration.

name: (S)-pyrimisulfan
definition: A N-{2-[(4,6-dimethoxypyrimidin-2-yl)(hydroxy)methyl]-6-(methoxymethyl)phenyl}-1,1-difluoromethanesulfonamide that has S configuration.

name: tyclopyrazoflor
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole which is substituted at positions 1, 3 and 4 by a pyridin-3-yl group, chloro group and an ethyl{3-[(3,3,3-trifluoropropyl)sulfanyl]propanoyl}nitrilo group, respectively. It is an insecticide from Dow AgroSciences LLC.

name: (2E)-oct-2-enoate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (2E)-oct-2-enoic acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-lisofylline
definition: A 1-(5-hydroxyhexyl)-3,7-dimethyl-3,7-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6-dione that has (R)-configuration. A synthetic small molecule which was under development for the treatment of type 1 diabetes mellitus.

name: (2E)-decenoate
definition: An unsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of trans-2-decenoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methyloctadecanoate
definition: A 2-methyl fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-methyloctadecanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,6-dimethylheptanoate
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2,6-dimethylheptanoic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: alanine-2,3,3,3-d4
definition: A deuterated compound that is alanine in which each of the four hydrogens attached to carbon atoms have been replaced by deuterium.

name: ethyl 4-(3-hydroxyphenyl)-6-methyl-2-thioxo-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyrimidine-5-carboxylate
definition: A member of the class of thioureas that is 3,4-dihydropyrimidine-2(1)-thione substituted by a 3-hydroxyphenyl group at position 4, an ethoxycarbonyl group at position 5, and a methyl group at position 6.

name: sesquisabinene B
definition: A sesquiterpene that consists of (1R,5R)-2-methylidenebicyclo[3.1.0]hexane having a (2S)-6-methylhept-5-en-2-yl group attached at position 5.

name: sesquisabinene A
definition: A sesquiterpene that consists of (1R,5R)-2-methylidenebicyclo[3.1.0]hexane having a (2R)-6-methylhept-5-en-2-yl group at position 5.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methylhexanoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-hydroxy-3-methylhexanoic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: N2-(3-hydroxy-3-methylhexanoyl)-L-glutaminate
definition: An N2-acyl-L-glutaminate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N2-(3-hydroxy-3-methylhexanoyl)-L-glutamine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N2-[(2E)-3-methylhex-2-enoyl]-L-glutaminate
definition: An N2-acyl-L-glutaminate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N2-[(2E)-3-methylhex-2-enoyl]-L-glutamine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2E)-3-methylhex-2-enoate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (2E)-3-methylhex-2-enoic acid.

name: (S)-lisofylline
definition: A 1-(5-hydroxyhexyl)-3,7-dimethyl-3,7-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6-dione that has (S)-configuration. It is the inactive optical enantiomer of (R)-lisofylline, an anti-inflammatory agent.

name: 1-(5-hydroxyhexyl)-3,7-dimethyl-3,7-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6-dione
definition: A dimethylxanthine that is 3,7-dihydro-1H-purine-2,6-dione which is substituted at positions 1,3 and 7 by a 5-hydroxyhexyl group, methyl group and methyl group, respectively.

name: 4,4-dimethylcholest-8(14)-en-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-4,4-dimethylsteroid that is that is cholestan-3β-ol in which the hydrogens at position 4 have been replaced by methyl groups and a double bond has been introduced between positions 8 and 14.

name: 4β-hydroxymethyl-4α-methyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-dien-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-4β-hydroxymethyl-4α-methylsteroid that is 14-demethyllanosterol in which the methyl group at the 4β position has been oxidised to the corresponding hydroxymethyl group.

name: 4β-formyl-4α-methyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-dien-3β-ol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-4β-formyl-4α-methylsteroid resulting from the formal oxidation of the 4beta-hydroxymethyl group of 4β-hydroxymethyl-4α-methyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-dien-3β-ol to the corresponding formyl group.

name: 3β-hydroxy-4α-methyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-diene-4β-carboxylate
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-4α-methylsteroid-4β-carboxylate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3β-hydroxy-4α-methyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-diene-4β-carboxylic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: ipflufenoquin
definition: A member of the class of quinolines that is quinoline substituted by a methyl group, 3-fluoro-2-(2-hydroxypropan-2-yl)phenoxy group, fluoro group and fluoro group at positions 2, 3, 7 and 8, respectively. It is a fungicide being developed by Nippon-Soda Co. Ltd (Japan) which has stable efficacy against a wide range of plant diseases, such as gray mold, scab and rice blast.

name: sodorifen
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is bicyclo[3.2.1]oct-6-ene which is substituted by a methylene group at position 3 and by methyl groups at the 1,2,4,5,6,7, and 8-anti positions. It is the major volatile component released by the rhizobacterium Serratia odorifera.

name: D-galactofuranose
definition: The furanose form of D-galactose.

name: α-D-NeuNAc-(2→9)-α-D-NeuNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of two α(2→9)-linked sialic acid units; corresponds to the repeating unit in the group C polysaccharide of Neisseria meningitidis (MenC).

name: vincristine(2+)
definition: A vinca alkaloid cation resulting from the protonation of the two tertiary amino groups of vincristine. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: thiogeraniol
definition: A thiol that is geraniol in which the hydroxy group has been replaced by a thiol group.

name: PE(19:0/18:3(9Z,12Z,15Z))
definition: A phosphatidylethanolamine 37:3 in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as nonadecanoyl and (9Z,12Z,15Z)-octadecatrienoyl, respectively.

name: N-octanoylanthranilate
definition: An amidobenzoate that is the conjugate base of N-octanoylanthranilic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: γ-dodecalactone
definition: A γ-lactone that is oxolan-2-one substituted by an octyl group at position 5.

name: neopentyl glycol
definition: A propane-1,3-diol carrying two methyl groups at position 2.

name: (13E)-octadecenoic acid
definition: An octadecenoic acid with a trans-double bond at position C-13.

name: valerianol
definition: A member of the class of octahydronaphthalenes that is 1,2,3,4,6,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalene which is substituted by methyl groups at the 8 and 8a positions, and by a 2-hydroxypropan-2-yl group at position 2 (the 2R,8R,8aS stereoisomer).

name: (R)-bopindolol
definition: A 1-(tert-butylamino)-3-[(2-methyl-1H-indol-4-yl)oxy]propan-2-yl benzoate that has R-configuration.

name: (S)-bopindolol
definition: A 1-(tert-butylamino)-3-[(2-methyl-1H-indol-4-yl)oxy]propan-2-yl benzoate that has S-configuration.

name: 1-(tert-butylamino)-3-[(2-methyl-1H-indol-4-yl)oxy]propan-2-yl benzoate
definition: A methylindole that is 2-methyl-1H-indol-4-ol in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group is replaced by a 2-(benzoyloxy)-3-(tert-butylamino)propyl group.

name: (Z)-2-methylureidoacrylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (Z)-2-methylureidoacrylic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9S),10-epoxy-(10,12Z)-octadecadienoic acid
definition: An epoxy fatty acid that is oxirane substituted by a (2Z)-oct-2-en-1-ylidene group and a 7-carboxyheptyl group at positions 2 and 3, respectively.

name: 3,5,6-trichloro-2-pyridinol
definition: A hydroxypyridine that is pyridin-2-ol substituted by chloro groups at positions 3,5 and 6. It is a metabolite of the agrochemical chlorpyrifos.

name: nepetaside
definition: A terpene glycoside that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group at position 1R is replaced by a (4R,4aR,6R,7R,7aS)-4,7-dimethyl-1-oxooctahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran-6-yl group. It is a plant metabolite isolated from Nepeta cataria.

name: ravuconazole
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1-butyl-1H-1,2,4-triazole in which the butyl group is substituted at positions 2, 2, and 3 by hydroxy, 2,4-difluorophenyl, and 4-(p-cyanophenyl)-1,3-thiazol-2-yl groups, respectively (the R,R stereoisomer). It exhibits antifungal activity by inhibition of 14α demethylase, an enzyme involved in sterol synthesis, resulting in lysis of the fungal cell wall and fungal cell death. (NCIO4)

name: 1-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-[3-(5-methyl-1,3-benzoxazol-2-yl)phenyl]thiourea
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-benzoxazoles that is 5-methyl-2-phenyl-1,3-benzoxazole which is substituted by a [(4-chlorophenyl)carbamothioyl]nitrilo group at position 5. It is a bacterial glutamate racemase inhibitor.

name: 4-chloro-L-lysine
definition: An L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine substituted by a chloro group at position 4.

name: 4-chloro-L-lysine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 4-chloro-L-lysine

name: 3-methylhexane
definition: An alkane that is hexane substituted by a methyl group at position 3.

name: 2,3,3-trimethylpentane
definition: A branched alkane that is pentane carrying one methyl group at positions 2, and two methyl groups at position 3.

name: 3,3-dimethyloctane
definition: An alkane that is octane in which the two methylene hydrogens at position 3 have been replaced by methyl groups.

name: (E)-dec-3-en-2-ol
definition: A fatty alcohol that is (3E)-dec-3-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 1-chlorobutan-2-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is butan-2-ol in which one of the methyl hydrogen atoms is substituted by chlorine.

name: 1,2,3-trichloro-2-methylpropane
definition: A chloroalkane that is 1,3-dichloropropane substituted by a chloro group and a methyl group at position 2.

name: 4-ethenyl-1,2-dimethylbenzene
definition: A member of the class of styrenes that is 1,2-dimethylbenzene substituted by a vinyl group at position 4.

name: 1,1,3,3-tetrachloro-2-methylpropane
definition: A chloroalkane that is propane substituted by chloro groups at positions 1,1,3 and 3, respectively.

name: 4-methylpent-3-enoic acid
definition: A methyl-branched chain fatty acid that is pent-3-enoic acid substituted by a methyl group at position 4.

name: 1,2,3,4-tetrachlorobutane
definition: A chloroalkane that is butane substituted by chloro groups at positions 1,2,3 and 4.

name: decane-1,2-diol
definition: A glycol that is decane bearing two hydroxy substituents located at positions 1 and 2.

name: 2,5-di-tert-butylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol substituted by tert-butyl groups at position 2 and 5.

name: Se-methyl-L-selenomethionine(1+)
definition: An α-amino-acid cation resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of Se-methyl-L-selenomethionine. Major species at pH 7.3

name: butafenacil
definition: An organofluorine compound that is 1-methyl-6-(trifluoromethyl)pyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione substituted by a 4-chloro-3-({[2-methyl-1-oxo-1-(prop-2-en-1-yloxy)propan-2-yl]oxy}carbonyl)phenyl group at position 3. It is a herbicide which inhibits the protoporphyrinogen-oxidase enzyme in plant chloroplasts, resulting in rapid knockdown of various broadleaf and grass weeds.

name: (Z)-2-methylureidoacrylic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid resulting from the formal 1,4-addition of one of the amino groups of urea to methacrylic acid (the Z isomer), or by the hydrolytic ring cleavage of uracil

name: 1,3,8-trihydroxy-4-methyl-2,7-diprenylxanthone
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1,3 and 8, prenyl groups at positions 2 and 7, and a methyl group at position 4.

name: thalicpureine
definition: A phenanthrene substituted by a 2-(methylamino)ethyl group at position 1 and by methoxy groups at positions 2,3,4,6 and 7, respectively. It is a plant metabolite isolated from Annona purpurea and Fagonia olivieri.

name: ethyl vanillin isobutyrate
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes that is benzaldehyde substituted by an ethoxy group at position 3 and by a (2-methylpropanoyl)oxy group at position 4.

name: N,N'-[disulfanediyldi(ethane-2,1-diyl)]bis[2-(1H-indol-3-yl)ethan-1-amine]
definition: An organic disulfide composed of two molecules of 2-{[2-(1H-indol-3-yl)ethyl]amino}ethane-1-thiol linked together via a disulfide bond. It is a glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) activator which reduces oxidative stress in cells and zebrafish.

name: 2-{[2-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxyethyl]amino}-N-[(2-fluorophenyl)methyl]acetamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide that is 2-amino-1-(2-chlorophenyl)ethanol in which one of the amino hydrogens is substituted by a 2-[(2-fluorobenzyl)amino]-2-oxoethyl group.

name: (4-hydroxy-3,4-dihydroisoquinolin-2(1H)-yl)[3-(3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl)phenyl]methanone
definition: An isoquinolol that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinolin-4-ol in which the hydrogen of the secondary amine is substituted by a 3-(3-hydroxy-3-methylbutyl)benzoyl group.

name: N-pyrazin-2-yl-N2-{1-[2-(1H-pyrazol-1-yl)phenyl]ethyl}glycinamide
definition: A member of the class pyrazines that is pyrazin-2-amine in which one of the amino protons is substituted by a ({1-[2-(1H-pyrazol-1-yl)phenyl]ethyl}amino)acetyl group.

name: N-acetyl-L-tryptophanate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-L-tryptophan, obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-D-phenylalaninate
definition: An N-acyl-D-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-D-phenylalanine, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-L-glutaminate
definition: An N2-acetylglutaminate that has L-configuration; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-D-glutaminate
definition: The conjugate base of N2-acetyl-D-glutamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-methylhexanoic acid
definition: A 3-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is hexanoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group and a methyl group at position 3. It is a metabolite found in human sweat.

name: 2,6-dimethylheptanoic acid
definition: A methyl-branched chain fatty acid that is heptanoic acid substituted by a methyl group at positions 2 and 6.

name: (R)-triaziflam
definition: An N-[1-(3,5-dimethylphenoxy)propan-2-yl]-6-(2-fluoropropan-2-yl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine that is the (R)-enantiomer of triaziflam.

name: (S)-triaziflam
definition: An N-[1-(3,5-dimethylphenoxy)propan-2-yl]-6-(2-fluoropropan-2-yl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine that is the (S)-enantiomer of triaziflam.

name: N-[1-(3,5-dimethylphenoxy)propan-2-yl]-6-(2-fluoropropan-2-yl)-1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine
definition: A diamino-1,3,5-triazine that is 1,3,5-triazine substituted by a [1-(3,5-dimethylphenoxy)propan-2-yl]nitrilo group, amino group and 2-fluoropropan-2-yl group at positions 2,4 and 6, respectively.

name: (R,R)-chrysanthemol
definition: A chrysanthemol in which both chiral centres have R configuration.

name: (R,R)-chrysanthemal
definition: An aldehyde resulting from the formal oxidation of the hydroxy group of (R,R)-chrysanthemol.

name: (R,R)-chrysanthemate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (+)-trans-chrysanthemic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: manganese dihydroxide
definition: A manganese hydroxide in which the manganese atom is bound to two hydroxide groups.

name: N-octanoylanthranilic acid
definition: An amidobenzoic acid resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of octanoic acid with the amino group of anthranilic acid.

name: β-alanyl-L-lysine zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of β-alanyl-L-lysine.

name: 3-(4-methyl-1,2,3-thiadiazolyl)-6-trichloromethyl[1,2,4]triazolo[3,4-b][1,3,4]thiadizole
definition: A triazolothiadiazole that is 1,7a-dihydro[1,2,4]triazolo[3,4-b][1,3,4]thiadiazole substituted by a 4-methyl-1,2,3-thiadiazol-5-yl group at position 3 and by a trichloromethyl group at position 6. It is a fungicide with a wide spectrum of activity and inhibits the enzymatic activity of pyruvate kinase.

name: dihydroartemisinate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of dihydroartemisinic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E)-non-2-enoate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (E)-non-2-enoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E)-non-2-enoic acid
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid that is nonanoic acid which has undergone dehydrogenation to introduce a trans double bond at the 2-3 position.

name: (−)-antofine
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is (13aR)-9,11,12,13,13a,14-hexahydrodibenzo[f,h]pyrrolo[1,2-b]isoquinoline substituted at positions 2, 3 and 6 by methoxy groups. It is an alkaloid produced by relatives of the milkweed family and exhibits antiviral, anti-inflammatory, antiadipogenic and antitumorigenic activities.

name: (E)-hept-2-enal
definition: A monounsaturated fatty aldehyde that is (2E)-hept-2-ene which is carrying an oxo group at position 1. Found in the peel of Malaysian pink and white pomelo peel and in the scent gland secretion of the rice stink bug Oebalus pugnax.

name: (E)-hept-2-enoate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (E)-hept-2-enoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-citronellate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (S)-citronellic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: (Z,S)-jasmolone
definition: A β-hydroxy ketone that is (ZZ,S)-cinerolone in which the (2Z)-but-2-en-1-yl substituent has been replaced by a (2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl group.

name: (Z,S)-cinerolone
definition: A β-hydroxy ketone that is cyclopent-2-en-1-one which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 4 by (2Z)-but-2-en-1-yl, methyl, and hydroxy groups, respectively (the 2S enantiomer).

name: 1,3-dihydroxybutan-2-one
definition: A primary α-hydroxy ketone that is butan-2-one substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 1 and 3.

name: (2S)-homocitric acid
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of homocitric acid.

name: (2R,6S,10S)-2,6,10,14-pristanic acid
definition: The (2R,6S,10S)-diastereomer of pristanic acid.

name: Ala-Gly-Ala-Gly
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-alanine, glycine, L-alanine, and glycine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: (2S)-2-amino-4-phosphonobutanoic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenc L-α-amino acid that is L-α-aminobutyric acid in which one of the hydrogens of the terminal methyl group has been replaced by a dihydroxy(oxido)-λ5-phosphanyl group. It is a potent and selective agonist for the group III metabotropic glutamate receptors (mGluR4/6/7/8).

name: (2E,4E,6R,8Z)-6-hydroxytetradeca-2,4,8-trienoic acid
definition: A hydroxy polyunsaturated fatty acid that is (2E,4E,8Z)-tetradeca-2,4,8-trienoic acid which is carrying a hydroxy group at the 6R-position.

name: (9Z,11E)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-9,11-dienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is (9E,11E)-octadeca-9,11-dienoic acid carrying a hydroperoxy group at position 9.

name: pyrimidine-2,4-dicarbothioic O-acid
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine which is substituted by hydroxycarbonothioyl groups at positions 2 and 4.

name: 2-hydroxy-L-proline
definition: A hydroxyproline that is L-proline substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 4-hydroxy-L-leucine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 4-hydroxyleucine.

name: (9Z,11E,15Z)-13-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoate
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoate that is the conjugate base of (9Z,11E,15Z)-13-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxyleucine
definition: A leucine derivative that is leucine substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: 4-hydroxy-D-leucine
definition: The D-enantiomer of 4-hydroxyleucine.

name: (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoate
definition: An (ω−1)-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z,12Z)-17-hydroxyoctadeca-9,12-dienoate
definition: An (ω−1)-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (9Z,12Z)-17-hydroxyoctadeca-9,12-dienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: phosphenodiimidic amide
definition: A phosphorus molecular entity that is phosphine in which the hydrogens are substituted by two imino groups and an amino group.

name: pyrazine-2,5-diol
definition: A pyrazine substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 2 and 5.

name: diflomotecan
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is (5R)-8-[(6,7-difluoroquinolin-3-yl)methyl]-5-ethyl-5-hydroxy-1,4,5,8-tetrahydrooxepino[3,4-c]pyridine-3,9-dione in which position 7 of the oxepinopyridine moiety is joined to position 3 of the difluoroquinoine ring by a single bond. An E-ring modified camptothecin analogue that has greater lactone stability in plasma compared with other topoisomerase I inhibitors.

name: (R)-homocamptothecin
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is (5R)-5-ethyl-5-hydroxy-8-(quinolin-3-ylmethyl)-1,4,5,8-tetrahydrooxepino[3,4-c]pyridine-3,9-dione in which position 7 of the oxepinopyridine group has been joined to position 2 of the quinoline ring by a single bond. A semisynthetic analogue of camptothecin, it is an inhibitor of topoisomerase I.

name: (9Z)-16-hydroxyhexadec-9-enoate
definition: An ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-16-hydroxyhexadec-9-enoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-methylpiperazine-2,5-dione
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine substituted by oxo groups at positions 2 and 5, and by a methyl group at position 3.

name: (E)-16-octadecenoic acid methyl ester
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (16E)-octadec-16-enoic acid with methanol.

name: isorhamnetin(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of isorhamnetin, arising from the deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-hydroxyferulate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5-hydroxyferulic acid, obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoate 17-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid 17-O-β-D-glucoside.

name: (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoate 17-O-sophoroside
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid 17-O-sophoroside. The major species at pH 7.3

name: (9Z)-18-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoate 18-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-18-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid 18-O-β-D-glucoside.

name: 16-(β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)hexadecanoate
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 16-(β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)hexadecanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: isoskyrin
definition: A member of the class of bianthracenes resulting from the oxidative dimerisation of emodin between position 4 of one molecule and position 5 of the other.

name: 12-oxododecanoic acid
definition: An ω-oxo fatty acid that is dodecanoic acid carrying an oxo group at position 12.

name: 12-oxododecanoate
definition: A ω-oxo fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12-oxododecanoic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 16-oxohexadecanoate
definition: An ω-oxo fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 16-oxohexadecanoic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: lobarin
definition: A member of the class of 2-benzofurans that is 3-butyl-3-hydroxy-2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one substituted by a 3-carboxy-4,6-dihydroxy-2-pentylphenoxy group and a methoxy group at positions 4 and 6, respectively. It is a metabolite isolated from the Sumatran lichen, Stereocaulon halei.

name: 2-hexen-1-ol
definition: A primary allylic alcohol that is 2-hexene in which a hydrogen at position 1 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: arthothelin
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 6, chloro groups at positions 2, 4 and 5 and a methyl group at position 8. It has been isolated from the lichen, Lecanora iseana.

name: 2,4-dichlorolichexanthone
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 1, chloro groups at positions 2 and 4, methoxy groups at positions 3 and 6 and a methyl group at position 8.

name: (9Z)-18-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoate 18-O-sophoroside
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-18-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid 18-O-sophoroside. The major species at pH 7.3

name: dihydroartemisinic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is propanoic acid substituted at position 2 by a (1S,4R,4aS,8aR)-4,7-dimethyl-1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalen-1-yl group. It is a sesquiterpenoid precursor of the antimalarial drug, artemisinin.

name: spongotine A
definition: A member of the class of imidazolines that is 4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazole which is substituted by a 1H-indole-3-carbonyl group at position 2 and a 6-bromo-1H-indol-3-yl group at position 4S. It is a bisindole alkaloid isolated from the marine sponge, Spongosorites sp.

name: bromodeoxytopsentin
definition: An aromatic ketone that is imidazole which is substituted by a 1H-indole-3-carbonyl group and a 6-bromo-1H-indol-3-yl group at positions 2 and 4, respectively. Isolated from the Mediterranean shallow-water sponge, Topsentia genetrix. It is a potent inhibitor of MRSA pyruvate kinase and exhibits antibacterial properties.

name: bromotopsentin
definition: An aromatic ketone that is imidazole that is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by (6-hydroxy-1H-indol-3-yl)carbonyl and 6-bromo-1H-indol-3-yl groups respectively. Isolated from Mediterranean shallow-water sponges Topsentia genetrix, and from Caribbean deep-sea sponges of the Halichondriidae family, it has antitumour and antiviral properties. Toxic to fish.

name: N-[4-cyano-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-3-[(4-fluorophenyl)sulfonyl]-2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanamide
definition: A member of the class of (trifluoromethyl)benzenes that is 4-amino-2-(trifluoromethyl)benzonitrile in which one of the amino hydrogens is substituted by a 3-[(4-fluorophenyl)sulfonyl]-2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanoyl group.

name: (S)-bicalutamide
definition: A N-[4-cyano-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-3-[(4-fluorophenyl)sulfonyl]-2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanamide that is the (S)-enantiomer of bicalutamide.

name: 5-hydroxy-3,3',4',7-tetramethoxyflavone(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group of 5-hydroxy-3,3',4',7-tetramethoxyflavone. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: pannarin
definition: A member of the class of depsidones that is 11H-dibenzo[b,e][1,4]dioxepine substituted by methyl groups at positions 1,6 and 9, chloro group at position 2, hydroxy group at position 3, formyl group at position 4, methoxy group at position 8 and an oxo group at position 11. It is a lichen metabolite isolated from several Psoroma species.

name: divarinol
definition: A 5-alkylresorcinol in which the alkyl group is specified as propyl.

name: 2-methyloctadecanoic acid
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acid that is octadecanoic (stearic) acid bearing a methyl substituent at position 2.

name: α-C-GalCer
definition: A neoglycosphingolipid that is a synthesized C-glycosyl analogue of myelin-derived galactosylceramide (Mye-GalCer).

name: α-C(F)-GalCer
definition: A neoglycosphingolipid that is fluorinated α-C-GalCer, a synthesized C-clycosyl analogue of myelin-derived galactosylceramide (Mye-GalCer).

name: isotenuazonic acid
definition: A pyrroline cyclic ketone that is an isomer of tenuazonic acid, a mycotoxin produced by various plant pathogenic fungi.

name: altenuene
definition: A benzochromenone mycotoxin isolated from the fungus Allernaria tenuis.

name: Euxyl K 400
definition: A preservative for cosmetics and toiletries containing two active ingredients, 1,2-dibromo-2,4-dicyanobutane and 2-phenoxyethanol in the ratio 1:4.

name: 1,3-diphenylguanidine
definition: Guanidine carrying a phenyl substituent on each of the two amino groups. It is used as an accelerator in the rubber industry.

name: zinc dibutyldithiocarbamate
definition: A dithiocarbamate salt that is the zinc salt of dibutyldithiocarbamic acid.

name: 1-bromo-2-propanol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is propan-2-ol substituted by a bromo group at position 1.

name: tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphate
definition: An organosilicon compound that is phosphoric acid in which the three hydroxy groups are substituted by (trimethylsilyl)oxy groups.

name: α-galactosylphytosphingosine
definition: A sphingoid derived from degradation of mammalian α-linked galactosylceramides by removal of the fatty acid by acid ceramidase.

name: dibutyldithiocarbamic acid
definition: A member of the class of dithiocarbamic acids that is dibutylcarbamic acid in which both of the oxygens are replaced by sulfur.

name: methyl cis-10-pentadecenoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of cis-10-pentadecenoic acid with the hydroxy group of methanol.

name: zinc diethyldithiocarbamate
definition: A dithiocarbamate salt that is the zinc salt of diethyldithiocarbamic acid. It is an accelerator and activator for natural rubber.

name: diethyldithiocarbamic acid
definition: A member of the class of dithiocarbamic acids that is diethylcarbamic acid in which both of the oxygens are replaced by sulfur.

name: methyl γ-linolenate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester obtained from the formal condensation of methanol and γ-linolenic acid.

name: cis-11,14-eicosadienoic acid methyl ester
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (11Z,14Z)-icosadienoic acid with methanol.

name: methyl henicosanoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of henicosanoic acid with methanol.

name: carba mix
definition: A mixture of three allergens: diphenylguanidine, zinc dibutyldithiocarbamate and zinc diethyldithiocarbamate, chemicals used as fungicides and pesticides, and also in the manufacture of many rubber products.

name: dibutyldithiocarbamate
definition: A member of the class of dithiocarbamate anions resulting from the removal of the proton from the dithiocarbamic acid moiety of dibutyldithiocarbamic acid.

name: diethyldithiocarbamate
definition: A member of the class of dithiocarbamate anions resulting from the removal of the proton from the dithiocarbamic acid moiety of diethyldithiocarbamic acid.

name: α-D-Ara-(1→5)-[α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→3)]-α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→2)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-ManO[CH2]6N3
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative that consists of the dodecasaccharide α-D-Ara-(1→5)-[α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→3)]-α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→2)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man linked at the reducing end glycosidically to a 6-azidohexyl group.

name: α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→3)-[α-D-Ara-(1→5)]-α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→5)-α-D-Ara-(1→2)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)-[α-D-Man-(1→2)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man
definition: An oligosaccharide that is a branched dodecasaccharide consisting of a block of six arabinofuranose residues linked to a block of six mannopyranose residues as shown in the structure. The α-D-mannose residue at the reducing end can be linked glycosidically to (for example) a 6-azidohexyl or 6-[(3,4-dioxocyclobut-1-en-1-yl)amino]hexyl group.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp
definition: β-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp having β-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-Man
definition: β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→2)-D-Man having β-configuration at the reducing end anomeric centre.

name: N2-[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]-L-glutamine
definition: An N2-acyl-L-glutamine that has 4-(1H-indol-3-yl)butanoyl as the acyl group.

name: 3PO
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine substituted by a 3-oxo-3-(pyridin-4-yl)prop-1-en-1-yl group at position 3. An inhibitor of PFKFB3 kinase, an enzyme with a key role in glycolysis.

name: 3-(2-isocyanovinyl)indole
definition: An isocyanide that is indole which is substituted at position 3 by a 2-isocyanovinyl group. The Z isomer has been isolated from a Pseudomonas species and has antibacterial properties.

name: (+)-minovincinine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (+)-minovincinine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (−)-(R)-19-hydroxytabersonine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (−)-(R)-19-hydroxytabersonine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: (−)-minovincinine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (−)-minovincinine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: lochnericine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of lochnericine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: hörhammericine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of hörhammericine. The major species at pH 7.3. Note that the stereoconfiguration of the epoxy group is based on CHEBI:144374, and of the 19 hydroxy group on CHEBI:144372 (the same enzyme produces the two).

name: 19-O-acetylhörhammericine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of 19-O-acetylhörhammericine. The major species at pH 7.3. Note the stereoconfiguration of the epoxy group is based on CHEBI:144374, and of the 19-acetoxy group on CHEBI:144372.

name: 4-(sulfooxy)-cinnamic acid
definition: An aryl sulfate that is (2E)-3-phenylprop-2-enoic acid which is substituted by a sulfooxy group at position 4. It is produced by the seagrass Zostera marina and has very promising antifouling potential against several micro- and macrofouling organisms.

name: (E)-5-hydroxyferulate
definition: The E-isomer of 5-hydroxyferulate. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3β-hydroxyatractylon
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is (4aR,8aR)-8a-methyl-4,4a,5,6,7,8,8a,9-octahydronaphtho[2,3-b]furan substituted by a methyl group, methylidene group and a hydroxy group at positions 3, 5 and 6S, respectively. It is a sesquiterpenoid isolated from the plant, Atractylodes lancea.

name: dinophysistoxin 1
definition: A ketal that is a marine toxin structurally related to okadaic acid. Produced by dinoflagellates it is known to accumulate in shellfish and cause diarrhoeic shellfish poisoning. It is an inhibitor of serine/threonine protein phosphatases 1 (PP1) and PP2A and has been shown to promote cancer cell growth in tumour cell lines and animal models.

name: montbretin A
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at the 3 and 4' positions have been glycosylated by an alpha-L-rhamnopyranosyl-(1→2)-6-O-[(2E)-3-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)prop-2-enoyl]-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnopyranosyl group and a 4-O-(α-L-rhamnopyranosyl)-β-D-xylopyranose group, respectively.

name: iron(III) citrate
definition: An iron chelate resulting from the combination of iron(3+) and citrate(3−).

name: Cys-Met-Gln
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-cysteine, L-methionine and L-glutamine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-caffeoyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside](1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-caffeoyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside]. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: myricetin 3-O-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside](1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of myricetin 3-O-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside]. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N2-acetyl-D-glutamine
definition: An N2-acetylglutamine that has D-configuration.

name: montbretin A(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of the flavonoid moiety of montbretin A. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: myricitrin(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion that is the conjugate base of myricitrin arising from selective deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: afzelin(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxonion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of the flavone moiety of afzelin (kaempferol 3-O-α-L-rhamnoside). The major species at pH 7.3.

name: iron(III) citrate monohydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate form of iron(III) citrate. It is an iron-based phosphate binder approved for hyperphosphataemia in patients with chronic kidney disease.

name: quercetin 3,7-bis-O-α-L-rhamnoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 5 of the flavonoid moiety of quercetin 3,7-bis-O-α-L-rhamnoside. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: quercetin 3-O-β-D-glucopyranoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of the flavone moiety of quercetin. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: quercetin 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of the flavone moiety of quercetin 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: myricetin 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of the flavonoid moiety of myricetin 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside. The major species at pH 7.3. Identified in PMID 29667287 Fig. S17, peak 8.

name: quercetin 3-O-[(6-O-caffeoyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside](2−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 of the flavonoid moiety of quercetin 3-O-[(6-O-caffeoyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside]. Identified in Fig. S20, peak 1

name: triacsin C
definition: A nitroso compound that is N-undecylnitrous hydrazide carrying double bonds at positions 1,2,4, and 7. It is a long-chain fatty acyl CoA synthetase inhibitor and interferes with lipid metabolism by inhibiting the de novo synthesis of glycerolipids and cholesterol esters.

name: myricetin 3-O-β-D-glucopyranoside(1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at position 7 of myricetin 3-O-β-D-glucopyranoside. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-trans-4-coumaroyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside](2−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 7 of the flavonoid ring of myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-trans-4-coumaroyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside]. Identified in Fig. S21 peak 2 of PMID:29967287.

name: myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-acetyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside](1−)
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group at positio 7 of the flavonoid moiety of myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-acetyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside]. Identified in PMID: 23549747 Fig. S21 peak 4.

name: Gln-Cys-Cys
definition: A tripeptide composed of one L-glutamine and two L-cysteine units joined by peptide linkages.

name: Lys-Glu-Thr
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-lysine, L-glutamic acid and L-threonine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Gly-Ala-Ala
definition: A tripeptide composed of glycine, L-alanine and L-alanine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Lys-Glu-Glu
definition: A tripeptide composed of one L-lysine and two L-glutamic acid units joined by peptide linkages.

name: 2,4-dihydroxyacetophenone-5-O-sulfate
definition: An acetophenone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4, and by a sulfooxy group at position 5. It is a metabolite of the Chinese medicine 'Shuangdan' granule.

name: Gly-Arg-Pro
definition: A tripeptide composed of glycine, L-arginine and L-proline joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Lys-Ser-Trp
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-lysine, L-serine and L-tryptophan joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Ser-Leu-Ser
definition: A tripeptide formed from L-serine, L-leucine and L-serine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: (S)-8-oxocitronellyl enol
definition: An 8-oxocitronellyl enol in which the chiral centre has S configuration.

name: cis-cis-nepetalactone
definition: A cyclopentapyran that is (4aR,7aS)-1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran substituted at position 1 by an oxo group and at positions 4 and 7 by methyl groups, respectively (the 4aR,7S,7aS-diastereomer). An iridoid monoterpenoid isolated from several Nepeta plant species.

name: cis-cis-nepetalactol
definition: A cyclopentapyran that is (4aR,7aS)-1,4a,5,6,7,7a-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]pyran substituted at position 1 by a hydroxy group and at positions 4 and 7 by methyl groups (the 4aR,7S,7aS)-diastereomer.

name: (R)-8-oxocitronellyl enol
definition: An 8-oxocitronellyl enol in which the chiral centre has R configuration.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-2,4-heptadienoate which has 2Z,4E configuration. Obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienoic acid, it is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-deoxy-α-D-ribofuranose
definition: A deoxypentose that is α-D-ribofuranose in which the hydroxy group at position 5 is substituted by a hydrogen.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-hydroxy-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-6-oxohepta-2,4-dienoic acid which has 2Z,4E configuration.

name: 2-[4-(4-chlorophenoxy)-2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)propan-2-ol
definition: An aromatic ether that is diphenyl ether substituted by a 2-hydroxy-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)propan-2-yl group at position 1, trifluoromethyl group at position 2 and a chloro group at position 4.

name: (R)-mefentrifluconazole
definition: A 2-[4-(4-chlorophenoxy)-2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)propan-2-ol that is the (R)-enantiomer of mefentrifluconazole.

name: (S)-mefentrifluconazole
definition: A 2-[4-(4-chlorophenoxy)-2-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-1-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)propan-2-ol that is the (S)-enantiomer of mefentrifluconazole.

name: 4-(diethylamino)but-2-yn-1-ol
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of cyclohexyl(hydroxy)phenylacetic acid with the hydroxy group of 4-(diethylamino)but-2-yn-1-ol.

name: (R)-oxybutynin
definition: A 4-(diethylamino)but-2-yn-1-ol that has R configuration. It is responsible for virtually all of the antimuscarinic activity of (racemic) oxybutynin.

name: Trp-Trp-Val
definition: A tripeptide composed of two L-tryptophan and one L-valine residues joined by peptide linkages.

name: Phe-Arg-Thr
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-phenylalanine, L-arginine, and L-threonine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Glu-Glu-Arg
definition: A tripeptide composed of two L-glutamic acid residues and an L-arginine residue joined in sequence.

name: Glu-Glu-Gln
definition: A tripeptide composed of two L-glutamic acid and one L-glutamine units joined by peptide linkages.

name: 3β-hydroxycostunolide
definition: A heterobicyclic compound that is costunolide in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: D-fucitol
definition: The D-enantiomer of fucitol.

name: (S)-citronellic acid
definition: A citronellic acid that has (S)-configuration.

name: (R)-citronellic acid
definition: A citronellic acid that has (R)-configuration.

name: 4-methylumbelliferone sulfate(1−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 4-methylumbelliferone sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-methylumbelliferone β-D-glucuronide(1−)
definition: A beta-D-glucosiduronate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of 4-methylumbelliferone beta-D-glucuronide. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5,7-dimethyl-2-methylamino-4-(3-pyridylmethyl)-1,3-benzothiazol-6-yl sulfate(1−)
definition: An aryl sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 5,7-dimethyl-2-methylamino-4-(3-pyridylmethyl)-1,3-benzothiazol-6-yl hydrogen sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5,7-dimethyl-2-methylamino-4-(3-pyridylmethyl)-1,3-benzothiazol-6-yl β-D-glucuronide(1−)
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronate that is the conjugate base of E3040 glucuronide, obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-4,5-dihydroxy-2-oxopentanal
definition: A ketoaldopentose and deoxypentose that is 2-oxopentanal that is substituted at positions 4 and 5 by hydroxy groups (the 4S) enantiomer).

name: 4-hydroxy-2-oxobutanal
definition: A 2-oxo aldehyde that is 4-hydroxybutanal carrying an oxo group at position 2. It is a degradation product of vitamin C.

name: Pro-Glu-Ile
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-proline, L-glutamic acid and L-isoleucine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: (2R*,6S*)-2,6-diamino-3ξ-hydroxyheptanedioic acid
definition: An amino dicarboxylic acid that is meso-2,6-diaminopimelic acid in which a hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a constituent of bacterial cell wall peptidoglycan.

name: D-2,4-diaminobutyric acid
definition: A 2,4-diaminobutyric acid that has R-configuration.

name: DD-2,6-diaminopimelic acid
definition: A 2,6-diaminopimelic acid in which both chiral centres have R configuration.

name: 4-hydroxy-D-proline
definition: The D-stereoisomer of 4-hydroxyproline.

name: marinolic acid C
definition: An enoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2E)-4-{(2S,3R,4R,5S)-3,4-dihydroxy-5-[(2E,4R,5S)-5-hydroxy-4-methylhex-2-en-1-yl]oxan-2-yl}-3-methylbut-2-enoic acid with the alcoholic hydroxy group of 8-hydroxyoctanoic acid.

name: indoxyl sulfate(1−)
definition: An aryl sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of indoxyl sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-S-(2-succino)-L-cysteine(3−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid trianion resulting from the deprotonation of all three hydroxy groups of N-acetyl-S-(2-succino)-L-cysteine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: LDC4297
definition: A pyrazolotriazine that is pyrazolo[1,5-a][1,3,5]triazine substituted by a piperidin-3-yloxy group, [2-(1H-pyrazol-1-yl)benzyl]nitrilo group and an isopropyl group at positions 2, 4 and 8 respectively. It is a potent and selective CDK7 inhibitor and exhibits antiviral activity.

name: PF-956980
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine substituted at position 4 by a methyl[(3R,4R)-4-methyl-1-(pyrrolidin-1-ylcarbonyl)piperidin-3-yl]nitrilo group. It is a potent JAK3-selective chemical probe.

name: PA-16-0081C
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is N,1,4,4-tetramethyl-4,5-dihydro-1H-pyrazolo[4,3-h]quinazoline-3-carboxamide substituted by a [2-methyl-4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)phenyl]nitrilo group at position 8.

name: 4-(6-ethoxypyrazolo[1,5-b]pyridazin-3-yl)-N-phenylpyrimidin-2-amine
definition: A pyrazolopyridazine that is pyrazolo[1,5-b]pyridazine which is substituted by a 2-anilinopyrimidin-4-yl group at position 3 and by an ethoxy group at position 6.

name: 4-(6-ethoxypyrazolo[1,5-b]pyridazin-3-yl)-N-[3-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl]pyrimidin-2-amine
definition: A pyrazolopyridazine that is pyrazolo[1,5-b]pyridazine substituted by a 2-[3-(morpholin-4-yl)anilino]pyrimidin-4-yl group at position 3 and an ethoxy group at position 6.

name: SB-245391
definition: A piperidinylimidazole that is 1H-imidazole carrying a piperidin-4-yl group, 4-fluorophenyl group and a 2-([biphenyl]-4-yloxy)pyrimidin-4-yl group at positions 1, 4 and 5 respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of p38α mitogen-activated protein kinase.

name: SB-284851-BT
definition: A piperidinylimidazole that is 1H-imidazole carrying a piperidin-4-yl group, 4-fluorophenyl group and a 2-(3,5-dimethylphenoxy)pyrimidin-4-yl group at positions 1, 4 and 5 respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of p38α mitogen-activated protein kinase and BRD4.

name: N-(4-carboxy-4-oxobutanoyl)-L-ethylglycylglycine(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of both of the carboxy groups of N-(4-carboxy-4-oxobutanoyl)-L-ethylglycylglycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-[(2S)-2-ammoniobutanoyl]glycinate
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of N-[(2S)-2-aminobutanoyl]glycine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ser-Lys
definition: A dipeptide composed of L-serine and L-lysine joined by a peptide linkage. It is a constituent of bacterial cell wall peptidoglycan type A11.14 and A3α.

name: nerol oxide
definition: A member of the class of pyrans that is 3,6-dihydro-2H-pyran which is substituted at positions 2 and 4 by a 2-methylprop-1-en-1-yl group and a methyl group, respectively.

name: cis-isogeraniol
definition: An isogeraniol that has (Z)-configuration.

name: linalool oxide pyranoside
definition: A member of the class of oxanes that is oxane substituted by methyl groups at positions 2,2 and 6, by a hydroxy group at position 3 and by an ethenyl group at position 6.

name: trans-isogeraniol
definition: An isogeraniol that has (E)-configuration.

name: ADP orthovanadate
definition: A vanadium coordination entity that is ADP in which a hydrogen of the terminal phosphate group has been replaced by a (trihydroxido)(oxido)vanadium moiety.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-henicosa-1,6,9,12,15-pentaene
definition: An alkapentaene that is henicos-1-ene with 4 cis double bonds at positions 6,9,12 and 15.

name: (6Z,9Z,12Z,15Z)-tricosa-1,6,9,12,15-pentaene
definition: An alkapentaene that is tricos-1-ene with 4 cis double bonds at positions 6,9,12 and 15.

name: Gln-Lys-Arg
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-glutamine, L-lysine, and L-arginine units joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: N-[(2S)-2-aminobutanoyl]glycine
definition: A dipeptide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-α-aminobutyric acid [(2S)-2-aminobutanoic acid] with the amino group of glycine.

name: L-β-ethynylserine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of L-β-ethynylserine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-Lys-D-Asp
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-lysine with the amino group of D-aspartic acid. It is a constituent of bacterial peptidoglycan type A4α.

name: 2',3,4-trihydroxy-trans-chalcone
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2', 3 and 4. The precursor of 3',4'-dihydroxyaurone.

name: L-Lys-D-Glu
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-lysine with the amino group of D-glutamic acid. It is a constituent of bacterial peptidoglycan type A4α.

name: 2',3,4-trihydroxy-trans-chalcone(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the phenolic hydroxy group that is ortho to the acyl substituent; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3',4'-dihydroxyaurone
definition: A hydroxyaurone that is aurone which is substituted by hydroxy groups at the 3' and 4' positions; major species at pH 7.3. It shows inhibitory activity against several isoforms of the histone deacetylase complex (HDAC).

name: L-Orn-D-Asp
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-ornithine with the amino group of D-aspartic acid. It is a constituent of bacterial peptidoglycan type A4β.

name: L-Orn-D-Glu
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-ornithine with the amino group of D-glutamic acid. It is a constituent of bacterial peptidoglycan type A4β.

name: delphinidin(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 3- and 5-hydroxy groups of delphinidin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: delphinidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine obtained by deprotonation of the 5 position of delfinidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: pelargonidin(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 3- and 5-hydroxy groups of pelargonidin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: pelargonidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An organic betaine obtained by deprotonation of the hydroxy group at the 5 position of pelargonidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: peonidin(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 3- and 5-hydroxy groups of peonidin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: peonidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine obtained by deprotonation of the 5 position of peonidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: malvidin(1−)
definition: An organic anion obtained by selective deprotonation of the 3- and 5-hydroxy groups of malvidin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: malvidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: An oxonium betaine obtained by deprotonation of the hydroxy group at the 5 position of malvidin 3-O-β-D-glucoside. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: PFE-PKIS 18
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine which has been substituted at positions 2, 4, and 5 by (1-isopropyl-2-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-indol-5-yl)amino, [3-(methylsulfonyl)benzyl]amino, and trifluoromethyl groups, respectively.

name: profoxydim
definition: A cyclic ketone that is 3-hydroxycyclohex-2-en-1-one substituted by a N-[2-(4-chlorophenoxy)propoxy]butanimidoyl group at position 2 and by a thian-3-yl group at position 5. It is a herbicide used for the control of grass weeds in rice.

name: (8Z,11Z,13E,15S)-15-hydroperoxyicosa-8,11,13-trienoate
definition: A hydroperoxyicosatrienoate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (8Z,11Z,13E,15S)-15-hydroperoxyicosa-8,11,13-trienoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: m-tyraminium
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of m-tyramine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: nickel subsulfide
definition: A nickel coordination entity with formula Ni3S2. Used in the manufacture of lithium batteries.

name: heazlewoodite
definition: A sulfide mineral with formula Ni3S2 which is named after Heazlewood, Tasmania, where it was first described.

name: N-glycolylneuraminyllactosylceramide
definition: A sialotriaosylceramide in which the triaosyl group is 3,5-dideoxy-5-(2-hydroxyacetamido)-D-glycero-α-D-galacto-non-2-ulopyranonosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucopyranosyl attached to the primary hydroxy function of ceramide. A tumour antigen found in solid tumors such as breast carcinoma, nonsmall cell lung cancer, and melanoma, but not usually detected in normal human cells.

name: 2-ammonio-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose
definition: A primary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (15S)-hydroperoxy-(11Z,13E)-icosadienoate
definition: A hydroperoxy polyunsaturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (15S)-hydroperoxy-(11Z,13E)-icosadienoic acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-β-ethynylserine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-propargylglycine which is carrying a hydroxy group at the 3R position.

name: N6-methyl-AMP(2−)
definition: A nucleoside 5'-monophosphate(2−) that results from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of N6-methyl-AMP.

name: (15S)-hydroperoxy-(11Z,13E)-icosadienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty acid that is (11Z,13E)-icosadienoic acid in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 15 has been replaced by a hydroperoxy group.

name: (9Z)-18-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid 18-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside resulting from the formal condensation of β-D-glucoyranose with the alcoholic hydroxy group of 18-hydroxyocctadec-9-enoic acid.

name: (2E)-3-methylhex-2-enoic acid
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid that is (2E)-hexenoic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 has been replaced by a methyl group. A malodourous component in the sweat of schizophrenics.

name: isogeraniol
definition: A homoallylic alcohol that is 2,6-dimethylocta-2,5-diene in which a hydrogen of the methyl group at position 8 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 5-hydroxy-3,3',4',7-tetramethoxyflavone
definition: A monohydroxyflavone that is 5-hydroxyflavone which is substituted by methoxy groups at positions 3,3',4' and 7.

name: N2-[4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)butanoyl]-L-glutamine
definition: An N2-acyl-L-glutamine that is L-glutamine in which one of the hydrogens of the α-amino group has been replaced by a 4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)butanoyl group.

name: (8Z,11Z,13E,15S)-15-hydroperoxyicosa-8,11,13-trienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyicosatrienoic acid that is (8Z,11Z,13E)-icosatrienoic acid in which the pro-S hydrogen at position 15 has been replaced by a hydroperoxy group.

name: 3,6-dichloropyridine-2,5-diol
definition: A hydroxypyridine that is pyridine substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 5 and chloro groups at positions 3 and 6. It is a metabolite of the agrochemical chlorpyrifos.

name: 6-chloropyridine-2,3,5-triol
definition: A hydroxypyridine that is pyridine substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2,3 and 5 and a chloro group at position 6. It is a metabolite of the agrochemical chlorpyrifos.

name: 3,6-dihydroxypyridine-2,5-dione(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 3,6-dihydroxypyridine-2,5-dione, obtained by selective deprotonation of the hydroxy group at positions 2.

name: 6-chloro-2,5-dioxo-2,5-dihydropyridin-3-olate
definition: An enolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group of 6-chloro-3-hydroxypyridine-2,5-dione. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,6-dichloropyridine-2,5-dione
definition: A pyridone that is pyridine-2,5-dione which is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by chloro groups. It is a metabolite of the agrochemical, chlorpyrifos.

name: PMX-205
definition: A homodetic cyclic peptide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N2-(3-phenylpropanoyl)-L-ornithyl-L-prolyl-3-cyclohexyl-D-alanyl-L-tryptophyl-L-arginine with the 5-amino group of the N2-acylornithyl residue.

name: 6-chloro-3-hydroxypyridine-2,5-dione
definition: A monochloropyridine that is 2,5-dioxo-2,5-dihydropyridine which is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by a hydroxy group and a chlorine, respectively.

name: 5-ammoniopentanal
definition: An ammonium ion derivative that is the conjugate acid of 5-aminopentanal, obtained by protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-piperideinium
definition: An iminium ion obtained by protonation of the imino group of 1-piperideine; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: Pro-Arg-Pro
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-proline, L-arginine and L-proline joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Ser-Trp-Lys
definition: A tripeptide formed from L-serine, L-tryptophan and L-lysine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Thr-Thr-Thr
definition: A tripeptide composed of three L-threonine units joined by peptide linkages.

name: S-(2-succinyl)-L-cysteine
definition: An L-cysteine thioether that is L-cysteine in which the hydrogen of the thiol group has been replaced by a 1,2-dicarboxyethyl group. It is a chemical modification which occurs in tissue proteins and formed by a Michael addition of cysteine to fumaric acid.

name: 3,6-dihydroxypyridine-2,5-dione
definition: A pyridone that is pyridine-2,5-dione which is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by hydroxy groups. A metabolite of the agrochemical, chlorpyrifos.

name: (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid
definition: An (ω−1)-hydroxy fatty acid that is (9Z)-octadec-9-enoic acid (oleic acid) in which a hydrogen at position 17 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2-{[4-(4-nitrophenyl)butan-2-yl]amino}ethanol
definition: A member of the class of phenylethanolamines that is phenylethanolamine in which the the phenyl group is substituted at the para- position by a methoxy group, while the am no group is substituted by a 4-(p-nitrophenyl)butan-2-yl group. A β-adrenergic agonist that has been used illegally in China as an animal feed additive to as a growth promotion to enhance the the lean meat-to-fat ratio for livestock.

name: 8-oxocitronellyl enol
definition: An α,β-unsaturated aldehyde that is octa-2,7-dienal which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 8, methyl groups at positions 2 and 6, and in which both double bonds have E configuration.

name: 16-(β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)hexadecanoic acid
definition: A β-D-glucoside resulting from the formal condensation of the ω-hydroxy group of 16-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid (16-hydroxypalmitic acid) with β-D-glucose.

name: 1-O-dodecylglycerol
definition: An alkylglycerol that is glycerol in which the hydrogen of one of the primary hydroxy groups has been replaced by a dodecyl group.

name: L-arginyl-AMP(1+)
definition: An organic cation resulting from the deprotonation of the phosphate group and protonation of the α-amino and imine nitrogens of the L-arginine moiety of L-arginyl-AMP; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: TY 52156
definition: An imidohydrazide resulting from the formal condensation of the hydrazide carbonyl group of N'-(p-chlorophenyl)-3,3-dimethyl-2-oxobutanehydrazide with the amino group of p-chloroaniline. A potent and selective antagonist of sphingosine-1-phosphate receptor 3 (S1PR3).

name: VPC 23019
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of O-phospho-D-serine with the amino group of m-octylaniline. An analogue of sphingosine-1-phosphate (S1P), it is a potent antagonist for both S1P1 and S1P3 receptors. It can inhibit S1P-induced migration of thyroid cancer cells, ovarian cancer cells, and neural stem cells.

name: NSC 23766 trihydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride resulting from the formal reaction of NSC 23766 with 3 mol eq. of hydrogen chloride. An inhibitor of the signalling G-protein known as RAC1 (Ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 1).

name: NSC 23766
definition: An aminopyrimidine that is 6-methylpyrimidine-2,4-diamine in which the amino groups at positions 2 and 4 are substituted by 5-(diethylamino)pentan-2-yl and 4-amino-2-methylquinolin-6-yl groups respectively. An inhibitor of the signalling G-protein known as RAC1 (Ras-related C3 botulinum toxin substrate 1).

name: steviolbioside(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of steviolbioside. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: steviolmonoside(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of steviolmonoside. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: steviol(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of steviol, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: rebaudioside A
definition: A rebaudioside that is rubusoside in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 of the β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at the 13α position have both been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: rebaudioside B(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of rebaudioside B. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: rebaudioside E
definition: A rebaudioside that is stevioside in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the glucosyl ester moiety has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucoside.

name: rebaudioside M
definition: A rebaudioside that is rebaudioside A in which the the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 of the β-D-glucosyl ester moiety have both been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucoside. Found in very low concentraitions in the leaves of Stevia Rebaudiana, it is more than 200 times sweeter than sucrose.

name: N-acetyl-S-(2-succino)-L-cysteine
definition: An N-acetyl-L-amino acid that is L-cysteine in which the hydrogen of the thiol group has been replace by a 1,2-dicarboxyethyl group. The first metabolite in the disposal of S-(2-succino)-L-cysteine by Bacillus subtilis.

name: rubusoside
definition: A steviol glycoside that is steviol in which both the carboxy group and the tertiary allylic hydroxy group have been converted to their corresponding β-D-glucosides. A precious bioactive natural sweetener which mainly exists the in Chinese sweet tea plant, Rubus suavissimus.

name: rebaudioside D
definition: A rebaudioside that is rebaudioside A in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the β-D-glucosyl ester moiety has been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucoside. Found in minute quantities in the leaves of Stevia rebaudiana.

name: steviol
definition: An ent-kaurane diterpenoid that is 5β,8α,9β,10α-kaur-16-en-18-oic acid in which the hydrogen at position 13 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: L-psicose
definition: The L-enantiomer of psicose.

name: steviolmonoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside resulting from the formal condensation the tertiary allylic hydroxy group of steviol with β-D-glucopyranose.

name: steviolbioside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is steviolmonoside in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the glucoside moiety has been converted into its β-D-glucoside.

name: 20-HETE methyl ester
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-20-hydroxyicosa-5,8,11,14-tetraenoic acid (20-HETE) with methanol.

name: methyl (5Z,9E,11Z,14Z)-8-hydroperoxy-20-hydroxyicosa-5,9,11,14-tetraenoate
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (5Z,9E,11Z,14Z)-8-hydroperoxy-20-hydroxyicosa-5,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid with methanol.

name: methyl 12-hydroperoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,10E,14Z)-icosatetraenoate
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty ester that is the methyl ester of 12-hydroperoxy-20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,10E,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid.

name: methyl (5Z,7E,11Z,14Z)-9-hydroperoxy-20-hydroxyicosa-5,7,11,14-tetraenoate
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (5Z,7E,11Z,14Z)-9-hydroperoxy-20-hydroxyicosa-5,7,11,14-tetraenoic acid with methanol.

name: methyl (9R,10E,12Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12-dienoate
definition: A hydroperoxy fatty ester that is the methyl ester of (9R,10E,12Z)-9-hydroperoxyoctadeca-10,12-dienoic acid.

name: solasodine 3-β-D-glucoside(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of solasodine 3-β-D-glucoside. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: solasodine(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of solasodine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: pregnenolone 3-β-D-glucoside
definition: A sterol 3-β-D-glucoside in which the sterol is 3β-hydroxypregn-5-en-20-one.

name: 3β-hydroxy-16α,17α-epoxypregnenolone
definition: An epoxy steroid that is pregnenolone which has an epoxy group whose oxygen is attached to the 16α and 17α-positions.

name: 3β-hydroxy-16α,17α-epoxypregnenolone 3-β-D-glucoside
definition: An epoxy steroid that is 3β-hydroxypregnenolone 3-β-D-glucoside in which the hydrogens at the 16alpha and 17alpha positions have been replaced by the oxygen of the epoxide ring.

name: epiandrosterone 3-β-D-glucoside
definition: A sterol 3-β-D-glucoside that has epiandrosterone as the sterol component.

name: 4-(dichloroacetyl)piperazine-1-carbaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of piperazines that is piperazine in which one of the nitrogens is substituted with a formyl group, while the other is substituted with a dichloroacetyl group. An antispermatogenic agent.

name: 16,17-didehydropregnenolone 3-β-D-glucoside
definition: A sterol 3β-D-glucoside in which the parent sterol is 16,17-didehydropregnenolone.

name: 1,4-cyclohexanedicarboxylic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is cyclohexane substituted by carboxy groups at positions 1 and 4.

name: betaenone A
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is tricyclo[6.2.2.02,7]dodecan-9-one which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 4, and 11; by methyl groups at positions 4, 6, 8, and 11; by a hydroxymethylene group at position 10; and by a (2R)-butan-2-yl group at position 12 (the 1S,2S,4R,6R,7S,8R,10Z,11S,12R stereoisomer). A phytotoxin produced by Pleospora betae, the causal fungus of leaf spot disease on sugar beet.

name: stemphyloxin II
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is betaenone A in which the butan-2-yl side-chain has been hydroxylated at position 1. A phytotoxin isolated from the endophytic fungus Stemphylium botryosum, it shows high affinity for ferric (but not ferrous) ions.

name: stemphyloxin I
definition: An octahydronaphthalene that is 2,4,5,7-tetramethyloctahydronaphthalen-1(2H)-one which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 7, a (2R)-1-hydroxybutan-2-yl group at position 3, and a (2Z)-3-hydroxyprop-2-enoyl group at position 4 (the 2S,3R,4R,4aS,5R,7R,8aS stereoisomer). Isolated from the endophytic fungus Stemphylium botryosum, it is the causal agent of leaf spot and foliage blight disease in tomatoes. Its phytotoxcity is at least 200 times greater than that of stemphyloxin II. It shows high affinity for Fe3+ (but not Fe2+) ions.

name: dihydrostemphyloxin I
definition: An octahydronaphthalene that is stemphyloxin I in which the C=C bond of the enol moiety has been reduced to a C‒C bond.

name: campesterol 3-β-D-glucoside
definition: A sterol 3-β-D-glucoside resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of campesterol with β-D-glucopyranose. Found in cloves, common wheat, and peaches.

name: (S)-gabaculine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of gabaculine.

name: adipiodone(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of adipiodone arising from deprotonation of the two carboxy groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: viguilenin
definition: An organic heterocricyclic compound and germacranolide with formula C20H30O7 isolated from Viguiera linearis.

name: asperphenamate
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-benzoyl-L-phenylalanine with the hydroxy group of N-benzoyl-L-phenylalaninol. A metabolite found in several Pencillium and Aspergillus species, as well as in plants as a product of endophytic fungi.

name: N-benzoyl-L-phenylalaninate
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anionresulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-benzoyl-L-phenylalanine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-benzoyl-L-phenylalaninol
definition: A member of the class of benzamides resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of benzoic acid with the amino group of L-phenylalaninol.

name: bassianolide
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide consisting of a cyclic tetramer of the depsipeptide D-Hiv-N-methyl-L-leucine (where D-Hiv = D-α-hydroxyisovaleric acid). Found in the fungal species Beauveria bassiana and Verticillium lecanii, it has insecticidal properties and is used as a commercial biopesticide to control of insects of agricultural, veterinary and medical significance. For elucidation of the structure, see Suzuki et al., Tetrahedron Lett. 1977 v25, 2167-2170.

name: (+)-isoepoxydon
