definition: A cyclic ketone that is (−)-phyllostine in which the carbonyl group which is furthest from the hydroxymethyl substituent has been formally reduced to give the corresponding secondary alcohol with S configuration. A metabolite of the patulin pathway in Penicillium urticae.

name: phyllostine
definition: An epoxide resulting from epoxidation of the 5-6 double bond of 2-(hydroxymethyl)-1,4-benzoquinone (the 5S,6R enantiomer).

name: isopatulin
definition: A furopyran and lactone that is (2H-pyran-3(6H)-ylidene)acetic acid which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4 an 6 and in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has condensed with the carboxy group to give the corresponding bicyclic lactone. Also known as neopatulin, it is a mycotoxic substance produced by Aspergillus and Penicillium species.

name: (E)-ascladiol
definition: A butenolide that is furan-2(5H)-one which is substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 4 and a 2-hydroxyethylidene group at position 5 (the 5E isomer). A direct precursor of patulin in cell-free preparations of Penicillium urticae patulin-minus mutants J1 and S11, but not S15.

name: 24-methylenecholesteryl β-D-glucoside
definition: A sterol 3-β-D-glucoside having 24-methylenecholesterol as the sterol component.

name: SKF-96365 hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of SKF-96365. It is a TRP channel blocker.

name: SKF-96365 free base
definition: An ether that is 2-(1H-imidazol-1-yl)-1-(4-methoxyphenyl)ethanol in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group has been substituted by a 3-(4-methoxyphenyl)propyl group.

name: SKF-96365 free base(1+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the imidazole group of SKF-96365 free base.

name: (+)-minovincinine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid that is (+)-vincadifformine which carries a hydroxy group at position 19S. A natural product found in several plant species including Alstonia venenata and Catharanthus trichophyllus.

name: myricetin 3-O-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside]
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside.

name: myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-caffeoyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside]
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is myricetin 3-O-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside] in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the glucosyl group has been acylated by a caffeoyl [(1E)-1-(3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)-3-oxoprop-1-en-3-yl] group.

name: 12-hydroxynevirapine
definition: A dipyridodiazepine that is nevirapine in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group has been substituted by a hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of the anti-HIV drug, nevirapine.

name: 3-hydroxymethylantipyrine
definition: A pyrazolone that is antipyrine in which one of the hydrogens of the 5-methyl group is substituted by a hydroxymethyl group. It is a metabolite of the analgesic drug, antipyrene.

name: 4-hydroxypropofol
definition: A hydroquinone that is propofol which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4. It is a metabolite of the short acting anaesthetic drug, propofol.

name: 5,6-trans-vitamin D3
definition: A member of the class of D3 vitamins that is calciol in which the double bond at position 5 adopts a trans-configuration. During exposure to sunlight, previtamin D3 and vitamin D3 in the skin become photoisomerized to 5,6-trans-vitamin D3.

name: 5-O-desmethyldonepezil
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is donepezil in which the 5-methoxy group has been demethylated to the corresponding hydroxy derivative. It is metabolite of donepezil, a drug used in the treatment of dementia.

name: 7-hydroxyticlopidine
definition: A thienopyridine that is ticlopidine which carries a hydroxy group at position 7. It is a metabolite of the antiplatelet drug, ticlopidine.

name: bisnorcholic acid
definition: A bile acid that is 24-dinor-5β-cholan-22-oic acid bearing three hydroxy substituents at positions 3α, 7α and 12α.

name: O-desethyl candesartan
definition: A benzimidazolecarboxylic acid that is candesartan in which the ethoxy group has been replaced by a hydroxy group. It is the inactive metabolite of the anti-hypertensive drug, candesartan.

name: promazine sulfoxide
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is promazine carrying an oxo group at position 5. It is a metabolite of the anti-psychotic medication, chlorpromazine.

name: tauroursocholic acid
definition: A bile acid taurine conjugate of ursocholic acid.

name: N-(4-carboxy-4-oxobutanoyl)-L-ethylglycylglycine
definition: A dipeptide that is N-[(2S)-2-aminobutanoyl]glycine in which the terminal amino group has been acylated by formal condensation of the 5-carboxy group of 2-oxopentanedioic acid.

name: cellulose acetate
definition: A glucan derivative obtained through the esterification of cellulose by acetic anhydride or acetic acid, resulting in the substitution of some of the hydroxy groups of cellulose by acetyl groups. It is used in a variety of applications including base material for photographic film, clothing, membrane filters, coatings, food packaging, and as a frame material for eyeglasses.

name: 2-benzoxazolinone
definition: A member of the class of benzoxazoles that is 2,3-dihydro-1,3-benzoxazole carrying an oxo group at position 2.

name: 2-acetylpyrazine
definition: A pyrazine that is substituted by an acetyl group at position 2. It has been identified as one of the volatile flavor constituents in popcorn, bread crust, vinegar, and potato snacks.

name: methyl 3-aminopyrazine-2-carboxylate
definition: A pyrazine that is substituted by a methoxycarbonyl group at position 2 and an amino group at position 3.

name: 2-methylpyrrolidine
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidines that is pyrrolidine which is substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid 17-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A long-chain fatty acid that is the 17-O-β-D-glucoside of (9Z)-17-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid.

name: 6,7-dihydroxy-4-methylcoumarin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is 4-methylcuomarin which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4. A hyaluronan synthesis inhibitor. It has also been used as a fluorescent sensor to monitor the consumption of a boronic acid in Suzuki coupling reactions; fluorescence is readily detectable by the naked eye using a standard 365 nm UV lamp.

name: myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-acetyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside]
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is myricetin 3-O-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside] in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the beta-D-glucosyl group has been converted to the corresponding acetate. Identified in PMID: 23549747 Fig. S21 peak 4.

name: myricetin 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside. Identified in PMID 29667287 Fig. S17, peak 8.

name: (3E)-pent-3-en-2-one
definition: A methyl propenyl ketone in which the double bond has (E)-configuration. It is a key odorant responsible for the chestnut-like aroma in green tea.

name: (9Z)-16-hydroxyhexadec-9-enoic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid that is palmitoleic acid [(9Z)-16-hexadec-9-enoic acid) which is substituted by a hydroxy group at the terminal carbon.

name: (9Z,11E,15Z)-13-hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid
definition: A hydroperoxyoctadecatrienoic acid that is (9Z,11E,15Z)-octadecatrienoic acid which is substituted at position 13 by a hydroperoxy group.

name: 1-O-(4-hydroxybenzoyl)-β-D-glucopyranose
definition: An O-acyl carbohydrate that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy hydrogen has been replaced by a 4-hydroxybenzoyl group.

name: (9Z,12Z)-17-hydroxyoctadeca-9,12-dienoic acid
definition: An (ω−1)-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid that is the conjugate base of (9Z,12Z)-octadeca-9,12-dienoic acid which has been substituted at position 17 by a hydroxy group.

name: 3β-hydroxy-4α-methyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-diene-4β-carboxylic acid
definition: A steroid acid that is 3β-hydroxy-4α-methyl-5α-cholesta-8,24-diene in which the hydrogen at the 4β position has been replaced by a carboxy group.

name: N2-[(2E)-3-methylhex-2-enoyl]-L-glutamine
definition: An N2-acyl-L-glutamine resulting from the formal condensation of the alpha-amino group of L-glutamine with the carboxy group of (2E)-3-methylhex-2-enoic acid.

name: N-[4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl]-L-cysteine
definition: An N-acyl-L-α-amino acid resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-(indol-3-yl)butanoic acid with the amino group of L-cysteine.

name: N2-(3-hydroxy-3-methylhexanoyl)-L-glutamine
definition: An N2-acyl-L-glutamine that has 3-hydroxy-3-methylhexanoyl as the N2-acyl group.

name: α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1↔1')-N-acetylsphingosine
definition: α-N-acetylneuraminosyl-(2→3)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucosyl-(1↔1')-N-acylsphingosine in which the acyl group is acetyl. Ganglioside GM1 with an acetyl group substituting for the long fatty acid typicalof ceramide.

name: (Z)-2,3-didehydroaspartic acid
definition: A 2,3-dehydroamino acid resulting from the formal dehydrogenation of the side chain of aspartic acid to introduce a C=C double bond at the 2-3 position.

name: 1-hydroxymidazolam
definition: An imidazobenzodiazepine that is midazolam in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is substituted by a hydroxy group. It is the major metabolite of the anesthetic, midazolam.

name: 4-hydroxymidazolam
definition: An imidazobenzodiazepine that is midazolam which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4. It is the minor hydroxylated metabolite of the anesthetic, midazolam.

name: 1',4-dihydroxymidazolam
definition: An imidazobenzodiazepine that is midazolam which is substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 2 and 4. It is the minor metabolite of the anesthetic, midazolam.

name: 19-O-acetylhörhammericine
definition: An Aspidosperma alkaloid that is hörhammericine in which the hydroxy group at position 19 has been converted to the corresponding acetate ester. Note the stereoconfiguration of the epoxy group is based on CHEBI:144374, and that of the 19-acetoxy group on the hydroxy group of CHEBI:144372.

name: 1-hydroxymidazolam β-D-glucuronide
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid that is β-D-glucuronic acid in which the anomeric hydroxyl hydrogen has been replaced by a 8-chloro-6-(2-fluorophenyl)-1-methyl-4H-imidazo[1,5-a][1,4]benzodiazepin-4-yl group. It is the glucuronidated conjugate of the midazolam metabolite, 1-hydroxymidazolam.

name: 4-hydroxymidazolam β-D-glucuronide
definition: A β-D-glucosiduronic acid that is β-D-glucuronic acid in which the anomeric hydroxyl hydrogen has been replaced by a 8-chloro-6-(2-fluorophenyl)-1-methyl-4H-imidazo[1,5-a][1,4]benzodiazepin-4-yl group. It is the glucuronidated conjugate of the midazolam metabolite, 4-hydroxymidazolam.

name: (S)-codamine
definition: A benzylisoquinoline alkaloid that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinolin-7-ol which is substituted by 3,4-dimethoxybenzyl, methyl, and methoxy groups at positions 1, 2, and 6, respectively (the 1S enantiomer).

name: N-[(2S,3R,4E)-1-{[5-acetamido-3,5-dideoxy-D-glycero-α-D-galacto-non-2-ulosyl-(2→3)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-D-glucosyl]oxy}-3-hydroxyoctadec-4-en-2-yl]octadecanamide
definition: A ganglioside derivative that is gangliosde GM1 in which the sialic acid residue contains CH2OH instead of COOH.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(18:0/18:0)
definition: A ganglioside derivative that is ganglioside GM1 with a single bond instead of the C4=C5 double bond of sphingosine.

name: erythromycin-[N-methyl-14C]
definition: A 14C-modified compound that is erythromycin A in which one of the methyl groups of the dimethylnitrilo group has a 14C label. It is used in a breath test to detect liver cytochrome P450 enzyme (CYP3A4) activity in humans.

name: 3β-hydroxy-5α-ergosta-7,24(28)-diene-4α-carboxylic acid
definition: A steroid acid resulting from the formal oxidation of the formyl group of 4α-formyl-ergosta-7,24(28)-dien-3β-ol to the corresponding carboxylic acid.

name: 4-O-β-D-glucosyl-trans-sinapic acid
definition: A β-D-glucoside resulting from the formal condensation of the phenolic hydroxy group of trans-sinapic acid with β-D-gucopyranose.

name: 6-sulfo-β-D-quinovose
definition: A 6-sulfo-D-quinovose (6-deoxy-6-sulfo-D-glucopyranose) that has β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 2-penten-1-ol
definition: A primary allylic alcohol that is 2-pentene in which a hydrogen at position 1 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 6-sulfo-α-D-quinovose
definition: A 6-sulfo-D-quinovose that has α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: (Z)-2-penten-1-ol
definition: A 2-penten-1-ol in which the double bond has (Z)-configuration. It is a volatile compound found in green tea, virgin olive oil, and broccoli. It is also used as a fragrance ingredient cosmetics, shampoos and soaps as well as in non-cosmetic products such as household cleaners and detergents.

name: crenolanib
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole which is substituted by a 8-(4-aminopiperidin-1-yl)quinolin-2-yl group at position 1 and by a (3-methyloxetan-3-yl)methoxy group at position 5. It is an inhibitor of type III tyrosine kinases, PDGFRα/β and FLT3 (IC50 of 11, 3.2, and 4 nM). Currently under clinical development for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia.

name: sulfachlorpyrazine
definition: A sulfonamide containing a 5-chloropyrazin-2-yl moiety linked to the amide nitrogen; principally used in veterinary medicine.

name: binimetinib
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1-methyl-1H-benzimidazole which is substituted at positions 4, 5, and 6 by fluorine, (4-bromo-2-fluorophenyl)nitrilo, and N-(2-hydroxyethoxy)aminocarbonyl groups, respectively. It is a MEK1 and MEK2 inhibitor (IC50= 12 nM). Approved by the FDA for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation in combination with encorafenib.

name: gilteritinib
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine-2-carboxamide which is substituted by {3-methoxy-4-[4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)piperidin-1-yl]phenyl}nitrilo, (oxan-4-yl)nitrilo and ethyl groups at positions 3,5 and 6, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of FLT3 and AXL tyrosine kinase receptors (IC50 = 0.29 nM and 0.73 nM, respectively). Approved by the FDA for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia in patients who have a FLT3 gene mutation.

name: pexidartinib
definition: A pyrrolopyridine that is 5-chloro-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridine which is substituted by a [6-({[6-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-3-yl]methyl}amino)pyridin-3-yl]methyl group at position 3. It is a potent multi-targeted receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor of CSF-1R, KIT, and FLT3 (IC50 of 20 nM, 10 nM and 160 nM, respectively). Approved by the FDA for the treatment of adult patients with symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT).

name: enasidenib
definition: A 1,3,5-triazine which is substituted by (2-hydroxy-2-methylpropyl)nitrilo, 6-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl and [2-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-4-yl]nitrilo groups at positions 2,4 and 6, respectively. It is an isocitrate dehydrogenase-2 (IDH2) inhibitor which has been approved for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukaemia (AML).

name: N6-lactoyl-L-lysine
definition: An N6-acyl-L-lysine that has lactoyl as the N6-acyl group.

name: N6-(2-hydroxyisobutanoyl)-L-lysine
definition: An N6-acyl-L-lysine that has 2-hydroxyisobutanoyl as the N6-acyl group.

name: bentranil
definition: A benzoxazine that is 4H-3,1-benzoxazin-4-one substituted by a phenyl group at position 2. It is a postemergence herbicide used for the control of annual weeds in cereal crops, maize, and rice.

name: (R)-diclofop
definition: A 2-[4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)phenoxy]propanoic acid that is the (R)-enantiomer of diclofop.

name: (S)-diclofop
definition: A 2-[4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)phenoxy]propanoic acid that is the (S)-enantiomer of diclofop.

name: sulfabromomethazine
definition: A sulfonamide consisting of 5-bromo-4,6-dimethylpyrimidine with a 4-aminobenzenesulfonamido group at the 2-position. A long-acting derivative of sulfamezathine, it is used in the poultry, swine and cattle industries for the treatment of coccidiosis and various bacterial infections.

name: 2-[4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)phenoxy]propanoic acid
definition: An aromatic ether that is 2-(4-hydroxyphenoxy)propanoic acid in which the hydrogen of the hydroxy group at position 4 has been substituted by a 2,4-dichlorophenyl group.

name: sulfaethoxypyridazine
definition: A sulfonamide consisting of 6-ethoxypyridazine with a 4-aminobenzenesulfonamido group at the 3-position. Generally licensed for veterinary use only against bacterial infections, such as fowl cholera and salmonella infection.

definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of 2-[4-(2,4-dichlorophenoxy)phenoxy]propanoic acid with methanol.

name: N-acetyl-9-O-acetyl-2-O-methyl-α-neuraminic acid
definition: A member of the class of N-acetylneuraminic acids that is N-acetyl-9-O-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 2 (adjacent to the carboxy group) has been methylated to give the corresponding methoxy group.

name: rigosertib
definition: An N-[2-methoxy-5-({[2-(2,4,6-trimethoxyphenyl)ethenyl]sulfonyl}methyl)phenyl]glycine in which the double bond has E-configuration. It is a non-ATP-competitive inhibitor of PLK1 with an IC50 of 9 nM and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: rigosertib sodium
definition: The sodium salt of rigosertib. It is an anti-cancer agent which has been granted Orphan Drug Designation by the FDA for use in patients with myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS).

name: rigosertib(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of rigosertib, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-O-(4-O-benzyl-α-D-galactosyl)-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having a 4-O-benzyl-α-D-galactosyl residue at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen. One of a series of an extensive set of 4"-O-alkylated α-GalCer analogues evaluated (PMID:30556652) as invariant natural killer T-cell (iNKT) antigens.

name: D-glucopyranose 6-sulfate(1−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion resulting from deprotonation of the sulfate OH group of D-glucopyranose 6-sulfate; major species at pH 7.3.

name: glasdegib
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole which is substituted by a (2R,4S)-4-{[(4-cyanophenyl)carbamoyl]amino}-1-methylpiperidin-2-yl group at position 2. It is a hedgehog signalling pathway inhibitor that acts by binding to Smoothened (SMO) receptors and blocking signal transduction (IC50 = 5 nM). It is used in combination with low-dose cytarabine, for the treatment of newly-diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) in adult patients (aged ≥ 75 years), or who have medical conditions that prevent the use of standard chemotherapy.

name: sapacitabine
definition: A nucleoside analogue resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the amino group of CNDAC. It is the prodrug of CNDAC and is currently in clinical development for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

name: ivosidenib
definition: A tertiary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-1-(4-cyanopyridin-2-yl)-5-oxopyrrolidine-2-carboxylic acid with the secondary amino group of (2S)-2-(2-chlorophenyl)-N-(3,3-difluorocyclobutyl)-2-[(5-fluoropyridin-3-yl)amino]acetamide. It is approved by the FDA for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) in patients with an isocitrate dehydrogenase-1 (IDH1) mutation.

name: indisulam
definition: A chloroindole that is 3-chloro-1H-indole substituted by a [(4-sulfamoylphenyl)sulfonyl]nitrilo group at position 7. It is a carbonic anhydrase inhibitor and a potential anti-cancer agent currently in clinical development.

name: 1-O-[4-O-(3,4-dichlorobenzyl)-α-D-galactosyl]-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine

name: halauxifen
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is 4-amino-3-chloropyridine-2-carboxylic acid which is substituted by a 4-chloro-2-fluoro-3-methoxyphenyl group at position 6. It is a herbicide used for the control of broad-leaved weeds in cereals and oilseed rape.

definition: An N-sulfonylurea in which the sulfur atom is attached to a 4-(methoxycarbonyl)-2-methylthiophen-3-yl group and in which the non-sulfonated nitrogen is substituted by a 3-methoxy-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl group. name: thiencarbazone
definition: An N-sulfonylurea in which the sulfur atom is attached to a 4-carboxy-2-methylthiophen-3-yl group and in which the non-sulfonated nitrogen is substituted by a 3-methoxy-4-methyl-5-oxo-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl group. It is a metabolite of the herbicide, thiencarbazone-methyl.

definition: A glycophytoceramide having a 4-O-(2-adamantylethyl)-α-D-galactosyl residue at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen. One of a series of an extensive set of 4"-O-alkylated α-GalCer analogues evaluated (PMID:30556652) as invariant natural killer T-cell (iNKT) antigens.

name: N-(1-benzylpyrrolidin-3-yl)-5,6-dimethylthieno[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-amine
definition: A thienopyrimidine that is 5,6-dimethylthieno[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-amine in which the amino group at position 4 has been substituted by an N-(1-benzylpyrrolidin-3-yl) group.

name: 1-O-(4-O-propyl-α-D-galactosyl)-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having a 4-O-propyl-α-D-galactosyl residue at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen. One of a series of an extensive set of 4"-O-alkylated α-GalCer analogues evaluated (PMID:30556652) as invariant natural killer T-cell (iNKT) antigens.

name: (R)-Fasnall
definition: An N-(1-benzylpyrrolidin-3-yl)-5,6-dimethylthieno[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-amine in which the chiral centre has R configuration. Both enantiomers act as fatty acid synthase inhibitors, although the (S)-enantiomer was found to be more than 4 times as active as the (R)-enantiomer.

name: (S)-Fasnall
definition: An N-(1-benzylpyrrolidin-3-yl)-5,6-dimethylthieno[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-amine in which the chiral centre has S configuration. Both enantiomers act as fatty acid synthase inhibitors, although the (S)-enantiomer was found to be more than 4 times as active as the (R)-enantiomer.

name: pevonedistat
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine which is substituted by a (1S)-2,3-dihydro-1H-inden-1-ylnitrilo group at position 4 and by a (1S,3S,4S)-3-hydroxy-4-[(sulfamoyloxy)methyl]cyclopentyl group at position 7. It is a potent and selective NEDD8-activating enzyme inhibitor with an IC50 of 4.7 nM, and currently under clinical investigation for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and myelodysplastic syndromes.

name: motixafortide
definition: A heterodetic cyclic peptide that has antineoplastic activity. It is a CXC chemokine receptor 4 (CXCR4) antagonist with an IC50 value of 0.8 nM and is currently under clinical investigation for the treatment of hematological malignancies, solid tumors, and stem cell mobilization. It was granted orphan drug designation by the FDA for the treatment of pancreatic cancer in 2019.

name: AMG-925
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 9H-pyrido[4',3':4,5]pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine which is substituted by a [6-(hydroxyacetyl)-5,6,7,8-tetrahydro-1,6-naphthyridin-2-yl]nitrilo group at position 2 and by a trans-4-methylcyclohexyl group at position 9. It is a FLT3 and CDK4 dual kinase inhibitor that has antineoplastic activity. Currently under clinical investigation in patients with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML).

name: viteagnusin D
definition: A labdane diterpenoid resulting from the formal allylic rearrangement of the allylic hydroxy group of peregrinol.

name: S-nitrosoglutathione(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups and protonation of the glutamyl amino group of S-nitrosoglutathione; major species at pH 7.3.

name: S-nitroso-coenzyme A(4−)
definition: Tetraanion of S-nitrosothiol arising from deprotonation of phosphate and diphosphate groups; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: labd-13(16),14-diene-9-ol
definition: A labdane diterpenoid resulting from the formal dehydration of the allylic hydroxy group of peregrinol.

name: peregrinol
definition: A labdane diterpenoid that is labdane which has been hydroxylated at position 5 of the decalin ring and in which the 3-methylpentyl substituent (also at position 5 of the decalin ring) has been dehydrogenated to introduce a trans double bond at the 3-4 position and hydroxylated at position 5.

name: ethametsulfuron
definition: An N-sulfonylurea that is urea in which one of the nitrogens has been substituted by a 4-ethoxy-6-(methylamino)-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl group, while the other has been substituted by a (2-carboxyphenyl)sulfonyl group.

name: labd-13Z-ene-9,15,16-triol
definition: A labdane diterpenoid that is peregrinol in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group attached to the double bond has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: ethametsulfuron-methyl
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of ethametsulfuron with methanol. A herbicide used for the control of broad-leaved weeds in oil seed rape and fodder rape.

name: picloram-methyl
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of picloram with methanol.

name: 2,4-D choline
definition: A quaternary ammonium salt resulting from the reaction of 2,4-D with choline. It is a post-emergence herbicide used for selective control of broadleaf weeds.

name: 1-methyl-2-[(2-methylbenzyl)oxy]-4-(propan-2-yl)-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane
definition: An oxabicycloalkane that is 1-methyl-4-(propan-2-yl)-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptan-2-ol in which the hydroxy group is substituted by a (2-methylphenyl)methoxy group.

name: exo-(+)-cinmethylin
definition: A 1-methyl-2-[(2-methylbenzyl)oxy]-4-(propan-2-yl)-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane that is the exo-(+)-isomer of cinmethylin.

name: exo-(−)-cinmethylin
definition: A 1-methyl-2-[(2-methylbenzyl)oxy]-4-(propan-2-yl)-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane that is the exo-(−)-isomer of cinmethylin.

name: syn-isopimara-7,15-diene
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is isopimarane with double bonds introduced at the 7-8 and 15-16 positions and in which the hydrogen at position 9 is β instead of α.

name: dibunate
definition: A naphthalenemonosulfonate obtained by the deprotonation of the sulfonic acid group of dibunic acid.

name: cilazapril monohydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate of cilazapril. It is used for the treatment of hypertension and heart failure.

name: tetryzoline(1+)
definition: An imidazolium ion resulting from the protonation of the dihydro imidazole ring of tetryzoline.

name: tetrahydrozoline nitrate
definition: An organic nitrate salt obtained by reaction of equimolar amounts of tetryzoline and nitric acid. It is used as a drug for the temporary relief of discomfort and redness of eyes due to minor eye irritations.

name: 2'-MANT-GTP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate that is GTP substituted at the 2' position by an N-methylanthraniloyl group.

name: 3'-MANT-GTP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate that is GTP substituted at the 3' position by an N-methylanthraniloyl group.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc in which the anomeric hydroxy group has α- configuration.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranosyl, α-D-galactopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl, and β-D-glucopyranose units joined together in sequence by (1→3), (1→4), and (1→4) glycosidic linkages, respectively.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A member of the class of neuraminic acids that is neuraminic acid attached in sequence to β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl, and β-D-glucopyranose units by (2→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), 1→3), and (1→4) glycosidic linkages, respectively.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A member of the class of neuraminic acids that is neuraminic acid attached in sequence to β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl, and β-D-gucoopyranose units by (2→3), (1→3), (1→4), and (1→4) glycosidic linkages, respectively. It corresponds to the carbohydrate portion of ganglioside GM1b.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp
definition: An α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Galp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has α configuration.

name: 6-deoxy-α-L-talopyranose
definition: A deoxytalose that is α-L-talopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been replaced by hydrogen.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Xylp
definition: A tetrasaccharide that is β-D-glucopyranuroic acid, attached in sequence to β-D-galactopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl, and β-D-xylopyranose by (1→3), (1→3), and (1→4) glycosidic linkages, respectively.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three molecules of β-D-glucopyranose attached in sequence by (1→2) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising three residues of D-mannose and one of N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine, in a linear sequence, all joined by β-(1→3)-linkages.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three molecules of β-D-glucopyranose attached in sequence by (1→6) and (1→3) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf
definition: A β-D-Galf-(1→6)-D-Galf which has beta configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranuronoside.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide composed of D-galactose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyl residues in (α-1→3) linkage.

name: α-D-arabinofuranose
definition: A D-arabinofuranose that has α-configuration at the anomeric carbon.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranuronoside.

name: α-L-IdopA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding α-L-idopyranuronoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc in which the N-acetylaminoglucose moiety has α configuration.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose consisting of two alpha-D-galactopyranose units and a beta-D-galactopyranose joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-NeuGc-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A member of the class of neraminic acids that is β-D-Galp-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp in which position 3 of the Galp residue is attached to position 2 of the N-glycolylneuraminic acid.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide comprising a β-D-mannosyl residue linked (1→3) to an N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A polysaccharide derivative that is α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4) in which the mannopyranosyl group attached by a (1→4)-linkage to the 2-acetamidoglucopyranosyl group is substituted at position 6 by an α-D-Manp group, which in turn is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by 2-O-α-D-Manp-α-D-Manp groups.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Xylp
definition: A glycosylxylose that is β-D-xylopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted to the corresponding 2-O-β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: normethylfondaparinux
definition: A heparin pentasaccharide resulting from the hydrolysis of the O-methyl group of fondaparinux.

name: 6-O-α-L-arabinofuranosyl-β-D-glucopyranose
definition: An α-L-arabinofuranoside resulting from the formal condensation of the 6-hydroxy group of β-D-glucopyranose with the anomeric hydroxy group of α-L-arabinofuranose.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched trisaccharide that is β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the gluocopyranose moiety has been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose that is β-D-glucose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4 have each been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Glcp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc in which both of the N-acetylgalactose units have α configuration at position 1.

name: methyl β-D-glucopyranuronate
definition: A methyl D-glucopyranuronate in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: β-D-glucofuranose
definition: A D-glucofuranose that has β- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-a-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A polysaccharide consisting of α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the β-D-Manp group is substituted by an α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-]-α-D-Manp group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp
definition: An α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-D-Manp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β- configuration.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→2)-α-L-Arap-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-D-xylopyranose, α-L-arabinopyranose and β-D-glucopyranose joined together in sequence by (1→2) and (1→6)-glycosidic bonds, respectively.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide that is β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc in which the mannosyl group has been glycosylated by α-D-mannopyranosyl groups at positions 3 and 6.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide that is β-D-mannopyranose in which the hydrogens of hydroxy groups are replaced by a 3-O-α-D-mannopyranosyl-α-D-mannopyranosyl group at position 6, a α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannopyranosyl group at position 3, and a chitobiose group at position 1.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide comprising a linear heptasaccharide chain consisting of N-acetylα-neuraminic acid, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, and β-D-glucose residues, linked sequentially (2→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3), and (1→4), with α-L-fucosyl residues linked (1→3) to each of the N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpN
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising a linear chain of three α-D-mannose and one N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine resides joined in sequence by (1→2), (1→6) and (1→2) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNS
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-glucopyranuronic acid residue joined by a (1→4) glycosidic linkage to a 2-deoxy-2-(sulfoamino)-α-D-glucopyranosyl residue.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A high mannose oligosaccharide consisting of three α-D-mannopyranose residues, a β-D-mannopyranose residue, a 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue and a 2-acetamido-α-D-glucopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→2), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4), and (1→4) glycosidic linkages, and in which the second mannosyl group from the chitobiose moiety is substituted at position 6 by a α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-[α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→3)]-α-D-mannopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-Glcp
definition: A β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-D-Glcp which has β- configuration at the anomeric carbon of the non-terminal glucopyranose ring.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine joined together in sequence by (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp
definition: A α-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Gal in which both galactose residues have α- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A member of the class of neuraminic acids that is neuraminic acid attached in sequence to β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl, and β-D-glucopyranosyl, residues by (2→3), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages. The galactosyl residue attached to the neuraminic acid is glycosylated at position 4 by a β-D-acetamidogalactosyl residue, while the other galactosiyl residue has been glycosylated at position 4 by a β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-β-D-galactopyranosyl residue.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide that is α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-2-D-GlcpNAc inomeric hydroxy group of the terminal N-acetamidoglucose residue has α configuration.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-L-Arap
definition: A disaccharide that is α-D-arabinopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucoside.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three molecules of β-D-glucopyranose joined in a linear sequence by (1→4) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A member of the class of neuraminic acids that is neuraminic acid attached in sequence to β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl, and β-D-glucopyranosyl, residues by (2→3), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages. The galactosyl residue attached to the neuraminic acid is glycosylated at position 4 by a β-D-acetamidogalactosyl residue, while the other galactosyl residue has been glycosylated at position 4 by a 2-acetamido-β-D-galactopyranosyl residue.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-mannose, β-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucose and α-D-2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucose residues joined by sequential (1→4)-linkages.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp NAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that is an N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: 6-deoxy-β-D-allopyranose
definition: A deoxyallose that is β-D-allopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been replaced by a hydrogen.

name: sambubiose
definition: A disaccharide consisting of β-D-xylose and β-D-glucose linked via a 1→2 glycosidic bond.

name: Glc(α1→2)Glc(α1→3)Glc(α1→3)Man(α1→2)Man(α1→2)Man(α1→3)[Man(α1→2)Man(α1→3)[Man(α1→2)Man(α1→6)]Man(α1→6)]Man(β1→4)GlcNAc(β1→4)α-GlcNAc
definition: A polysaccharide consisting of α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc in which the β-D-Manp- residue is glycosylated at position 6 by an α-D-mannopyranosyl group, which in turn is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by 2-O-α-D-mannopyranosyl-α-D-mannopyranosyl groups.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide and an amino nonasaccharide that is α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc in which position 2 of the α-D-mannopyranosyl group at the end of the shortest branch from the chitobiose moiety has been converted to the corresponding α-D-mannopyranoside.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Xylp
definition: A glycosylxylose that is β-D-xylopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three molecules of β-D-glucopyranose joined in a linear sequence by 1→2 glycosidic linkages.

name: α-L-Arap-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the corresponding α-L-arabinopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of α-L-fucose, β-D-galactose and two N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues joined in sequence by (1→2), (1→3) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino octasaccharide consisting of four β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-β-D-N-acetylglucosamine disaccharides linked together by (1→3) glycosidic linkage, but with β-D-glucopyranose replacing β-D-N-acetylglucosamine as the terminal monosaccharide.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Xylp
definition: A glycosylxylose that is β-D-xylopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactopyranoside.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Arap
definition: A glycosylarabinose that is α-L-arabinopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: 6-deoxy-β-D-gulopyranose
definition: A deosygulose that is beta-D-gulopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been replaced by a hydrogen.

name: β-D-Glcp(1→2)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 have each been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-galactopyranosamine, β-D-galactopyranose and β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: 6-PEA-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)α-D-GlcpN
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a 6-O-[(2-aminoethoxy)(hydroxy)phosphoryl-α-D-mannopyranosyl residue, two α-D-mannopyranosyl residues, and a 2-amino-α-D-glucose residue linked together in sequence by (1→2), (1→6) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→2)-β-D-GlcpA
definition: A β-D-Xylp-(1→2)-D-GlcpA in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three molecules of β-D-glucopyranose joined in a linear sequence by 1→6 glycosidic linkages.

name: (S)-3-(indol-3-ylmethyl)-6,7,8,8a-tetrahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-1-one
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a [(8aS)-1-oxo-1,2,6,7,8,8a-hexahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-3-yl]methyl group at position 3.

name: carpronium
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-(trimethylammonio)butanoic acid with methanol.

name: (S)-3-{[2-(1,1-dimethylallyl)-indol-3-yl]methyl}-6,7,8,8a-tetrahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-1-one
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a 3-methylbut-1-en-3-yl group at position 2 and a [(8aS)-1-oxo-1,2,6,7,8,8a-hexahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-3-yl]methyl group at position 3.

name: 1-hydroxy-3-{[2-(1,1-dimethylallyl)-indol-3-yl]methyl}-6H,7H,8H-5λ5-pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-5-ylium
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a 3-methylbut-1-en-3-yl group at position 2 and a (1-hydroxy-7,8-dihydro-6H-pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-5-ium-3-yl)methyl group at position 3.

name: (R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyrate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (R)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyric acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: bolandiol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is estr-4-ene substituted by a β-hydroxy group at positions 3 and 17. It is a synthetic anabolic steroid that is used as a dietary supplement by athletes to enhance performance.

name: pibutidine
definition: An aromtic ether that is 4-(piperidin-1-ylmethyl)pyridin-2-ol in which the hydroxy group has been substituted by a {(2Z)-4-[(2-amino-3,4-dioxocyclobut-1-en-1-yl)amino]but-2-en-1-yl}oxy group. It is a H2 receptor antagonist which was developed for the treatment of peptic ulcers and duodenal ulcers.

name: 2-(β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)benzoic acid
definition: A 2-(D-glucosyloxy)benzoic acid with β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: D-glucofuranose
definition: The furanose form of D-glucose.

name: pibutidine(1+)
definition: A piperidinium ion resulting from the protonation of the piperidine nitrogen of pibutidine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: fluopimomide
definition: A benzamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,3,5,6-tetrafluoro-4-methoxybenzoic acid with the amino group of 1-[3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-yl]methanamine. It is a benzamide fungicide, synthesized by Shandong Sino-Agri United Biotechnology Co., Ltd (China). Used for the control of cucumber and grape downy mildew, phytophthora capsici, litchi downy blight, potato late blight, rice sheath blight, and cotton rhizoctonia solani.

name: 2,6-diisopropylnaphthalene
definition: A member of the class of napthalenes that is naphthalene which is substituted by an isopropyl group at positions 2 and 6. It is a plant growth regulator which inhibits the sprouting of potatoes during storage.

name: 2-(β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)benzoate
definition: A benzoate resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of 2-(β-D-glucopyranosyloxy)benzoic acid.

name: propyromazine bromide
definition: An organic bromide salt of propyromazine. It is a muscarinic antagonist which has antispasmodic potential.

name: tandospirone
definition: A dicarboximide that is (3aR,4S,7R,7aS)-hexahydro-1H-4,7-methanoisoindole-1,3(2H)-dione which is substituted by a 4-[4-(pyrimidin-2-yl)piperazin-1-yl]butyl group at position 2. It is a potent and selective 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist (Ki = 27 nM).

name: tandospirone(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the addition of a proton to the piperazine nitrogen which is attached to the alkyl chain. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-hydroxy-3-{[2-(1,1-dimethylallyl)-indol-3-yl]methyl}-4H,6H,7H,8H-pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-2-ium
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a 3-methylbut-1-en-3-yl group at position 2 and a (1-hydroxy-4,6,7,8-tetrahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-2-ium-3-yl)methyl group at position 3.

name: β-D-glucosyl salicylate
definition: A D-glucosyl salicylate in which the glucosyl moiety has β-configuration at the anomeric centre. A transferrin binding compound used in research for cancer therapy.

name: notoamide S
definition: A notoamide that is 2-(2-methylbut-3-en-2-yl)-7-(3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl)-1H-indol-6-ol which has been substituted at position 3 by a [(3S,8aS)-1,4-dioxooctahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-3-yl]methyl group. Isolated from a mussel-derived Aspergillus species. The precursor of notoamide E.

name: notoamide E
definition: A pyranoindole that is notoamide S in which the phenolic hydrosy group at position 6 of the indole moiety has formal addition to the 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl group at postion 7 of the indole moiety to give the corresponding 7,7-dimethyl-1,7-dihydropyrano[2,3-g]indole derivative. Isolated from a mussel-derived Aspergillus species.

name: notoamide C
definition: A notoamide that is 7,7-dimethyl-1,7-dihydropyrano[2,3-g]indol-2(3H)-one which is substituted at position 3 by 3-methylbut-1-en-3-yl and [(3S,8aS)-1,4-dioxooctahydropyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-3-yl]methyl groups (the all-S stereoisomer). Isolated from a mussel-derived Aspergillus species.

name: notoamide D
definition: An organic heterohexacyclic compound isolated from a mussel-derived Aspergillus species that is 3,6b,7,7a,10,11,12,12a,14a,15-decahydro-8H,13H-pyrano[2,3-g]pyrrolo[1'',2'':4',5']pyrazino[1',2':1,5]pyrrolo[2,3-b]indole-8,13-dione which is substituted by two methyl groups at position 3, a hydroxy group at the 6b position, and a 2-methylbut-3-en-2-yl group at the 14a position (the 6bR, 7aS, 12aS, 14aS stereoisomer).

name: (R)-propyromazine
definition: A 1-methyl-1-[1-oxo-1-(10H-phenothiazin-10-yl)propan-2-yl]pyrrolidinium that has R-configuration.

name: (S)-propyromazine
definition: A 1-methyl-1-[1-oxo-1-(10H-phenothiazin-10-yl)propan-2-yl]pyrrolidinium that has S-configuration.

name: 1-methyl-1-[1-oxo-1-(10H-phenothiazin-10-yl)propan-2-yl]pyrrolidinium
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is 10H-phenothiazine which is substituted by a 2-(1-methylpyrrolidin-1-ium-1-yl)propanoyl group at position 10.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc in which the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is methylated.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-GalpA−-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc in which the CH2OH of the galactose within the trisaccharide chain is replaced by anionic carboxylate and the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is methylated.

name: delphinidin 3-O-rutinoside-7-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: An anthocyanin cation consisting of delphinidin having a rutinosyl [6-deoxy-α-L-mannosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl] residue attached at the 3-hydroxy position and a β-D-glucosyl residue at the 7-hydroxy position.

name: delphinidin 3-O-rutinoside-7-O-β-D-glucoside betaine
definition: A conjugate base of delphinidin 3-O-rutinoside-7-O-β-D-glucoside arising from selective deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-O[CH2]3NH3+
definition: A glycoside that is β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc in which the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is replaced by a 3-azaniumylpropyl group.

name: butropium
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-3-hydroxy-2-phenylpropanoic acid with the hydroxy group of (3-endo)-8-(4-butoxybenzyl)-3-hydroxy-8-methyl-8-azoniabicyclo[3.2.1]octane. Its bromide salt is used as an antispasmodic drug.

name: amezinium
definition: A pyridazinium ion that is pyridazin-1-ium which is substituted by a phenyl, amino and methoxy groups at positions 1, 4 and 6, respectively.

name: butylscopolamine
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-3-hydroxy-2-phenylpropanoic acid with the hydroxy group of (2R,4S,5S,7s)-9-butyl-7-hydroxy-9-methyl-3-oxa-9-azoniatricyclo[3.3.1.02,4]nonane.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-GalpA−-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-O[CH2]3NH3+
definition: A glycoside that is β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-GalA−-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc in which the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is replaced by a 3-azaniumylpropyl group.

name: β-D-Galp6N+-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the galactose residue linked to O-4 of the reducing end glucosyl residue is replaced by an ammoniumyl group and the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is methylated.

name: β-D-Galp6N+-(1→4)-[β-D-GalpA−-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcNAc in which the CH2OH of the galactose within the trisaccharide chain is replaced by anionic carboxylate, the hydroxy group at position 6 of the galactose residue linked to O-4 of the reducing end glucosaminyl residue is replaced by an ammoniumyl group and the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is methylated.

name: prednisolone phosphate
definition: A synthetic glucocorticoid resulting from the formal condensation of the 21-hydroxy group of prednisolone with one of the hydroxy groups of phosphoric acid. It is a prodrug for prednisolone that is activated in vivo by phosphatases.

name: prednisolone phosphate(2−)
definition: A steroid phosphate oxoanion which is the dianion obtained by the deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of prednisolone phosphate.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-Glcp-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-Glcp (LacLex) in which the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is methylated.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc (Lex) in which the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is methylated.

name: silanamine
definition: An N-silyl compound that is silane in which a hydrogen is substituted by an amino group.

name: 16-heptadecenal
definition: A monounsaturated fatty aldehyde that is heptadecanal carrying a double bond at position 16.

name: N-(trifluoroacetyl)glycine
definition: An N-acylglycine resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of glycine with the carboxy group of trifluoroacetic acid.

name: tiquizium
definition: A member of the class of quinolizines that is trans-5-methyloctahydro-2H-quinolizinium which is substituted by a di(thiophen-2-yl)methylidene group at position 3. Its bromide salt is used as an antispasmodic drug.

name: hex-3-en-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is hex-3-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1.

name: 2-acetylphenol
definition: A monohydroxyacetophenone that is acetophenone in which one of the hydrogens ortho to the acetyl group has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 3-hydroxy-2,4,4-trimethylpentyl 2-methylpropanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of isobutyric acid with the 1-hydroxy group of 2,4,4-trimethylpentane-1,3-diol.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc (LacLex) in which the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is methylated.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)]-β-D-Glcp-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)]-β-D-Glcp (RhaLac) in which the hydroxy group at the reducing-end anomeric centre is methylated.

name: 3β-hydroxy-9β-9,19-cyclolanost-24-en-28-oic acid
definition: A steroid acid that is 4β,14-dimethyl-5α,9β-9,19-cyclocholest-24-en-3β-ol in which the 4α hydrogen has been replaced by a carboxy group.

name: 8-PIP-cAMP
definition: A cyclic adenyl ribonucleotide that is cAMP (cyclic adenosine 3',5'-phosphate) in which the hydrogen at position 8 has been replaced by a piperidin-1-yl group. A selective cAMP-dependent protein kinase A (PKA) activator and cAMP analogue with high selectivity for site A of PKA type I and for site B of PKA type II.

name: (S)-methcathinone(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative that is the conjugate acid of (S)-methcathinone obtained from the protonation of the amino group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: (Z)-3-amino-2-methylacrylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (Z)-3-amino-2-methylacrylic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-methylhypoxanthine
definition: A methylhypoxanthine that is hypoxanthine with the methyl group at position 9.

name: 7-methylhypoxanthine
definition: A methylhypoxanthine that is hypoxanthine with the methyl group at position 7.

name: γ-octalactone
definition: A γ-lactone that is oxolan-2-one substituted by a butyl group at position 5. It is a volatile compound found in peaches, mangoes, beef and ham.

name: 3-methylhypoxanthine
definition: A methylhypoxanthine that is hypoxanthine with the methyl group at position 3.

name: γ-decalactone
definition: A γ-lactone that is oxolan-2-one substituted by a hexyl group at position 5.

name: (Z)-3-amino-2-methylacrylic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is methacrylic acid (2-methylacrylic acid) in which the pro-Z hydrogen at the β position has been replaced by an amino group.

name: α-D-Man3Me-(1→4)-α-D-Man3Me
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is alpha-mannobiose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of each mannose residue has been substituted by a methyl group.

name: Asn-Arg
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-asparagine with the amino group of L-arginine.

name: L-lyxonate
definition: A lyxonate that is the conjugate base of L-lyxonic acid, obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc6S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)
definition: A sialopentaosylceramide consisting of a branched hexasaccharide made up from one sialyl residue, two galactose residues, one L-fucose residue, one N-acetyl-6-sulfoglucosamine residue and one glucose residue, which at the reducing end is attached to a d18:1/18:0 ceramide moiety via a β-linkage; commonly known as sialyl 6-sulfo Lewis X.

name: D-lyxonate
definition: A lyxonate that is the conjugate base of D-lyxonic acid, obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: 7β-hydroxy-3-oxo-5α-cholan-24-oic acid
definition: A bile acid that is 5α-cholan-24-oic acid carrying an oxo group at position 3 and a hydroxy group at position 7β.

name: 6-ketoestriol
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is estriol carrying an oxo group at position 6.

name: 16-sinapoyloxypalmitic acid
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-sinapic acid with the hydroxy group of 16-hydroxyhexadecanoic acid.

name: 16-sinapoyloxypalmitate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 16-sinapoyloxypalmitic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group.

name: quercetin 3-O-gentiotetroside
definition: A quercetin O-glucoside that is quercetin attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranoside residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: α-Neu5d5N;1,5-lactam-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc6S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)
definition: A sialopentaosylceramide consisting of a branched hexasaccharide made up from one lactamized sialyl residue, two galactose residues, one L-fucose residue, one N-acetyl-6-sulfoglucosamine residue and one glucose residue, which at the reducing end is attached to a d18:1/18:0 ceramide moiety via a β-linkage; commonly known as lactamized sialyl 6-sulfo Lewis X ganglioside.

name: apigenin-7-O-gentiobioside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is apigenin substituted by a 6-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranoside group at position 7.

name: L-canaline zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-canaline; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neu5d5N;1,5-lactam-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc6S-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1↔1')-Cer(d18:1/18:0)
definition: A sialotetraosylceramide consisting of a linear pentasaccharide made up from one lactamized sialyl residue, two galactose residues, one N-acetyl-6-sulfoglucosamine residue and one glucose residue, which at the reducing end is attached to a d18:1/18:0 ceramide moiety via a β-linkage.

name: α-Neu5d5N;1,5-lactam-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc6SO3Na-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-O{[2-(C14H29)]C16H32}
definition: A neoglycolipid consisting of a linear pentasaccharide made up from one lactamized sialyl residue, two galactose residues, one N-acetyl-6-sulfonatoglucosamine residue (with associated sodium cation) and one glucose residue, which at the reducing end is attached glycosidically to a 2-(tetradecyl)hexadecyl group.

name: curcumin 4'-O-β-D-gentiotrioside
definition: A glycoside that is curcumin substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranoside group at position 4'.

name: curcumin 4'-O-β-D-gentiotetraside
definition: A glycoside that is curcumin substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucopyranoside group at position 4'.

name: α-Neu5d5N;1,5-lactam-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc6SO3Na-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-O{[2-(C14H29)]C16H32}
definition: A neoglycolipid consisting of a branched hexasaccharide made up from one lactamized sialyl residue, two galactose residues, onr fucose residue, one N-acetyl-6-sulfonatoglucosamine residue (with associated sodium cation) and one glucose residue, which at the reducing end is attached glycosidically to a 2-(tetradecyl)hexadecyl group.

name: genistin 7-O-gentiobioside
definition: A glycosyloxyisoflavone that is genistein substituted by a 6-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranoside group at position 7.

name: β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine
definition: A member of the class of chitobioses consisting of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having a β-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at the 4-position.

name: sesaminol
definition: A furofuran that is cis-tetrahydro-1H,3H-furo[3,4-c]furan substituted by a 6-hydroxy-1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl group at position 1S and a 1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl group at position 4S. It is metabolite found in sesame seeds.

name: sesaminol 2-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is sesaminol in which the hydroxy group at position 5 is substituted by a β-D-glucopyranoside group. A metabolite found in sesame seeds.

name: sesaminol 2-O-β-D-gentiobioside
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is sesaminol in which the hydroxy group at position 5 has been substituted by a 6-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranoside group. It is a metabolite found in sesame seeds.

name: 7-O-methylmyricetin
definition: A monomethoxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy group at position 7 is substituted by a methoxy group.

name: quercetin 3-O-[(6-O-caffeoyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside]
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of caffeic acid with the hydroxy group at position 6 of the terminal glucose residue of quercetin 3-O-β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-glucoside.

name: myricetin 3-O-[(6-O-trans-4-coumaroyl-β-D-glucosyl)-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside]
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is myricetin 3-O-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→2)-α-L-rhamnoside] in which the terminal glucose residue has been esterified at position 6 by formal condensation with 4-coumaric acid. Identified in Fig. S21 of PMID:29967287.

name: mupirocin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of mupirocin obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: trospium
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hydroxy(diphenyl)acetic acid with the hydroxy group of (1S,3R,5R)-3-hydroxy-8λ5-azaspiro[bicyclo[3.2.1]octane-8,1'-pyrrolidin]-8-ylium. Its chloride salt is used to treat overactive bladder.

name: 2-hydroxymelatonin
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is melatonin in which the hydrogen at position 2 of the indole ring has been replaced by a hydroxy group. A predominant hydroxylated melatonin metabolite in plants.

name: N-oleoylethanolamine phosphate
definition: A N-acylethanolamine phosphate in which the acyl group is specifed as (9Z)-octadec-9-enoyl. It is a lysophosphatidic acid-1 (LPA1) receptor agonist.

name: digoxin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of digoxin resulting from the deprotonation of furanone moiety; major species at pH 7.3.

name: digitoxin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of digitoxin resulting from the deprotonation of furanone moiety; major species at pH 7.3.

name: digoxigenin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of digoxigenin resulting from the deprotonation of the furanone moiety; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ouabain(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of ouabain resulting from the deprotonation of the furanone moiety; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ouabagenin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of ouabagenin resulting from the deprotonation of the furanone moiety; major species at pH 7.3.

name: AS1842856
definition: A quinolone that is 4-quinolone substituted at positions 1, 3, 5, 6 and 7 by ethyl, carboxy, amino, fluorine, and cyclohexylamino groups, respectively. It can directly bind to and block the transcription activity of the active forkhead box protein O1 (Foxo1), but not the Ser256-phosphorylated form. It induces cell death and growth arrest in Burkitt lymphoma cell lines at low concentrations.

name: (R)-(+)-perillyl alcohol
definition: A perillyl alcohol in which the chiral centre has R configuration.

name: (S)-methcathinone
definition: A 2-methylamino-1-phenylpropan-1-one that has (S)-configuration.

name: D-cystine zwitterion
definition: A cysteine zwitterion derived from D-cysteine by transfer of a proton from each of the carboxy groups to the amino groups.

name: neophytadiene
definition: A diterpene that is 3-methylidenehexadec-1-ene substituted at positions 7, 11 and 15 by a methyl group.

name: mupirocin calcium (anhydrous)
definition: The anhydrous form of the calcium salt of mupirocin. The dihydrate form is used as an antibacterial drug for the treatment of skin infections.

name: methyl 3,4,5-trihydroxybenzoate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by the formal condensation of gallic acid with methanol. It exhibits anti-oxidant, anti-tumor, anti-microbial and anti-inflammatory properties.

name: trilobatin
definition: An aryl β-D-glucoside that is phloretin attached to a β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 4' via a glycosidic linkage. It is isolated from the leaves of the Chinese sweet tea Lithocarpus polystachyus and exhibits significant anti-hyperglycemic, anti-oxidative and anti-inflammatory properties.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp6S
definition: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp6S in which the anomeric configuration of the 6-O-sulfo-D-glucose residue at the reducing end is β.

name: norrubrofusarin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of norrubrofusarin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: ustilaginoidin A(2−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of ustilaginoidin A, obtained by deprotonation of the two hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 5'. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: bencarbazone
definition: A thiocarboxamide that is benzenecarbothioamide substituted by a fluoro, 4-methyl-5-oxo-3-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl, and (ethanesulfonyl)nitrilo groups at positions 3,4 and 6, respectively. It is a herbicide used for the post-emergent control of broad-leaved weeds in corn, cereals, and sugar cane.

name: 2-[(ethanesulfonyl)amino]-5-fluoro-4-[4-methyl-5-oxo-3-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]benzene-1-carbothioamide
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-thiazoles that is 4-(1,3-thiazol-2-yl)piperidine in which the piperidine amino group is substituted by a [3,5-bis(difluoromethyl)-1H-pyrazol-1-yl]acetyl group and position 4 of the thiazole ring is substituted by a 5-{2-chloro-6-[(methylsulfonyl)oxy]phenyl}-4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazol-3-yl group.

name: (R)-fluoxapiprolin
definition: A 2-[(ethanesulfonyl)amino]-5-fluoro-4-[4-methyl-5-oxo-3-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]benzene-1-carbothioamide that has (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-fluoxapiprolin
definition: A 2-[(ethanesulfonyl)amino]-5-fluoro-4-[4-methyl-5-oxo-3-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl]benzene-1-carbothioamide that has (S)-configuration.

name: deoxyherqueinone(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion obtained by deprotonation of the 4-hydroxy group of deoxyherqueinone. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: herquline A(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of herquline A resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S,S)-2,5-di-(p-hydroxybenzyl)piperazine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of one of the amino groups of (S,S)-2,5-di-(p-hydroxybenzyl)piperazine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide that is α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the terminal (1→3)- and (1→6)-attached mannosyl groups have been gylcosylated at positions 2 and 3 respectively by 2-O-α-D-mannopyranosyl-α-D-mannopyranosyl groups.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the dimannopyranosyl group is attached to the diacetylchitobiose moiety by β-(1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-3)Man(a1-2)Man(a1-2)Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-2)Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-2)Man(a1-6)]Man(a1-6)]Man(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-4)GlcNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide consisting of α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-mannopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-D-glucopyranosyl residues joined sequentially by (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-2-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide that is beta-D-mannopyranose in which the hydrogens of hydroxy groups are replaced by an alpha-D-mannopyranosyl-group at position 6, an alpha-D-mannopyranosyl-(1right2)-alpha-D-mannopyranosyl-(1right2)-alpha-D-mannopyranosyl group at position 3, and a chitobiose group at position 1.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the mannosyl group has been glycosylated by an α-D-mannopyranosyl residue.

name: β-D-Glc-(1→4)-GlcNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-glucose linked via a (1→3)-glycosidic bond to N-acetyl-D-glucosamine.

name: Glc(a1-3)Man(a1-2)Man(a1-2)Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-2)Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-2)Man(a1-6)]Man(a1-6)]Man(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-4)GlcNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide that is Man(a1-2)Man(a1-2)Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-2)Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-2)Man(a1-6)]Man(a1-6)]Man(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-4)GlcNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the initial mannosyl gruop has been converted to the corresponding α-D-glucoside.

name: Glc(α1→2)Glc(α1→3)Glc(α1→3)Man(α1→2)Man(α1→2)Man(α1→3)[Man(α1→2)Man(α1→3)[Man(α1→2)Man(α1→6)]Man(α1→6)]Man(β1→4)GlcNAc(β1→4)GlcNAc
definition: A high-mannose oligosaccharide that is Glc(a1-3)Glc(a1-3)Man(a1-2)Man(a1-2)Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-2)Man(a1-3)[Man(a1-2)Man(a1-6)]Man(a1-6)]Man(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-4)GlcNAc in which the initial (α-1→3)-D-glucosyl residue has been glycosylated at position 2 by an α-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: 4-iodophenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine carrying an iodo group at position 4 on the benzene ring.

name: rubrofusarin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of rubrofusarin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (S,S)-2,5-di-(p-hydroxybenzyl)piperazine
definition: A member of the class of piperazines that is piperazine in which the pro-S hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 have each been replaced by a p-hydroxybenzyl group.

name: deoxyherqueinone
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 8,9-dihydro-4H-phenaleno[1,2-b]furan substituted by methyl groups at positions 1,8,8 and 9R, hydroxy groups at positions 3,4 and 7, methoxy group at position 5 and oxo group at position 6. It is isolated from the soil fungus, Penicillium herquei.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→4) and (1→6), to the galactosamine residue of which is also linked (1→3) a β-D-galactosyl residue.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-Glcp6S in which the anomeric configuration of the glucose residue is β.

name: rubrofusarin B(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of rubrofusarin B. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: Kaletra
definition: A mixture containing lopinavir and ritonavir. It is a prescription medicine that is used with other antiretroviral medicines to treat Human Immunodeficiency Virus-1 (HIV-1) infection in adults and children 14 days of age and older.

name: 4-(indol-3-yl)butanoyl-β-D-glucose
definition: A β-D-glucoside resulting from the formal condensation of 1-hydroxy group of β-D-glucopyranose with the carboxy group of indole-3-butyric acid.

name: 1-hydroxy-3-(indol-3-ylmethyl)-6H,7H,8H-5λ5-pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-5-ylium
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a (1-hydroxy-7,8-dihydro-6H-pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-5-ium-3-yl)methyl group at position 3. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-2-methylbutanoate
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (S)-2-methylbutanoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4α-hydroxymethyl-5α-cholest-7-en-3β-ol
definition: A 4α-hydroxymethyl steroid that is 5-α-cholest-7-en-3β-ol in which the α-hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a hydroxymethyl group.

name: N-acetyl-D-leucinate
definition: An N-acyl-D-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-D-leucine: major species at pH 7.3.

name: nigerone
definition: A biaryl resulting from the formal oxidative dimerisation of two molecules of 5-hydroxy-6,8-dimethoxy-2-methyl-4H-benzo[g]chromen-4-one to form a single bond linking position 10 of each moiety (the 10Ra enantiomer).

name: 1-phenyl-2-hexanone
definition: A ketone that is hexylbenzene carrying an oxo group at position 2.

name: 2'-methylacetophenone
definition: A member of the class of acetophenones that is acetophenone which is substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: 5-heptadecylresorcinol
definition: A 5-alkylresorcinol that is resorcinol which is substituted by a heptadecyl group at position 5. It is found in wheat bran.

name: 5-tricosylresorcinol
definition: A 5-alkylresorcinol that is resorcinol which is substituted by a tricosyl group at position 5. It is found in wheat bran.

name: hexadecyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of benzoic acid with the hydroxy group of hexadecan-1-ol.

name: nonanophenone
definition: An aromatic ketone that consists of benzene substituted by a nonanoyl group.

name: 3-(trimethylsilyl)-L-alanine
definition: An L-alanine derivative that is L-alanine in which one of the hydrogens of the methyl group is substituted by a trimethylsilyl group.

name: trimethylsilyl nonanoate
definition: A silyl ester obtained by replacing the hydrogen of the carboxy group of nonanoic acid by a trimethylsilyl group.

name: 4-{2-[(2-hydroxybenzyl)amino]ethyl}-2,5-dimethoxybenzonitrile
definition: A secondary amino compound that is 4-(2-aminoethyl)-2,5-dimethoxybenzonitrile in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group has been replaced by a 2-hydroxybenzyl group. A 5-hydroxytryptamine 2A receptor agonist.

name: dinophysistoxin 2
definition: A ketal that is a rare marine toxin structurally related to okadaic acid. Found yearly along with okadaic acid in Portuguese shellfish, its presence has been correlated with the occurrence of Dinophysis acta.

name: 4-{2-[(2-hydroxybenzyl)amino]ethyl}-2,5-dimethoxybenzonitrile(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the amino group of 4-{2-[(2-hydroxybenzyl)amino]ethyl}-2,5-dimethoxybenzonitrile.

name: julichrome Q6
definition: A member of the class of anthracenes that is 3,8,9-trihydroxy-3-methyl-3,4-dihydroanthracen-1(2H)-one which is substituted at position 4 by a 1-acetoxyetyl group and in which the acetoxy-bearing carbon has R configuration while the remaining two chiral centres have S configuration.
