A putative precursor in the biosynthesis of julichrome Q6-6. The corresponding 8-glucuronide has been isolated from a soil-derived strain of Streptomyces sp.

name: julichrome Q6-6
definition: A member of the class of bianthracenes resulting from the 7,7'-oxidative dimerisation of julichrome Q6. The major species at pH 7.3

name: 3-phosphonatoshikimate(3−)
definition: Trianion of 3-phosphoshikimic acid arising from deprotonation of the phosphate and carboxy groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4,7-dihydroxy-5-methylcoumarin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 4,7-dihydroxy-5-methylcoumarin, obtained by deprotonation of the 4-hydroxy group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 7-demethylsiderin
definition: A member of the class of hydroxycoumarins that is coumarin which is substituted by methoxy, methyl, and hydroxy groups at positions 4, 5 and 7, respectively.

name: orlandin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group orlandin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: desertorin A(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of desertorin A, obtained by deprotonation of 7-hydroxy group of desertorin A. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: remdesivir
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-[(S)-{[(2R,3S,4R,5R)-5-(4-aminopyrrolo[2,1-f][1,2,4]triazin-7-yl)-5-cyano-3,4-dihydroxytetrahydrofuran-2-yl]methoxy}(phenoxy)phosphoryl]-L-alanine with the hydroxy group of 2-ethylbutan-1-ol. A broad-spectrum antiviral prodrug with potent in vitro antiviral activity against a diverse panel of RNA viruses such as Ebola virus, MERS-CoV and SARS-CoV. It is currently in Phase III clinical trials for the treatment of Covid-19 in adults.

name: N-(2-aminoethyl)-1-aziridine-ethanamine
definition: A primary amino compound that is ethane-1,2-diamine in which the hydrogen on one of the amino groups is replaced by a 2-(aziridin-1-yl)ethyl group. It is a angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) inhibitor and a potential therapeutic agent for treating SARS coronavirus infections.

name: cinanserin
definition: An aryl sulfide that is (2E)-3-phenyl-N-(2-sulfanylphenyl)prop-2-enamide in which the hydrogen of the thiol group is substituted by a 3-(dimethylamino)propyl group. It is a 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor antagonist and an inhibitor of SARS-CoV replication.

name: emetine dihydrochloride hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate of the dihydrochloride salt of emetine.

name: aurasperone A(2−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of aurasperone A, obtained by deprotonation of the two hydroxy groups at positions 5 and 5'. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: desertorin A
definition: A bicoumarin that is 7-hydroxy-4-methoxy-5-methyl-2H-chromen-2-one substituted by a 7-hydroxy-4-methoxy-5-methyl-2-oxo-2H-chromen-6-yl group at position 8.

name: julichrome Q6-6(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group on the middle ring of one of the two dihydroanthracene groups of julichrome Q6-6. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: monapinone E
definition: A naphthopyran that is 3,4-dihydronaphtho[2,3-c]pyran-1-one which is substituted by a (2R,4R)-2,4,9-trihydroxynonyl group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 7. Published in Acta Pharm. Sin. B, 2013, 3, 163-166. See also J. Antibiot., 2011, 64, 503-508.

name: dinapinone E
definition: A binaphthopyran resulting from the oxidative coupling at position 8 of two molecules of monapinone E.

name: 4,7-dihydroxy-5-methylcoumarin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is 2H-chromen-2-one substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 4 and 7, and a methyl group at position 5.

name: (M)-viriditoxin
definition: A dimethyl 2,2'-(9,9',10,10'-tetrahydroxy-7,7'-dimethoxy-1,1'-dioxo-3,3',4,4'-tetrahydro-[6,6'-binaphtho[2,3-c]pyran]-3,3'-diyl)diacetate in which the the 3 and 3' positions (bearing the 2-methoxy-2-oxoethyl (CH2CO2Me) groups) both have S configuration, while the 6 and 6' positions (where the binaphthopyran units are linked) have Ra configuration (the M atropisomer). It has been isolated from the fungi Aspergillus viridinutans and the fungus Paecilomyces variotii derived from the inner tissues of the giant jellyfish Nemopilema nomurai.

name: semiviriditoxin
definition: A naphthopyran that is 3,4-dihydro-naphtho[2,3-c]pyran-1-one which is substituted by a 2-methoxy-2-oxoethyl group at position 3, a methoxy group at position 7, and hydroxy groups at positions 9 and 10 (the 3S enantiomer). It is produced by the fungus Paecilomyces variotii, isolated from the larvae of the mountain pine beetle Dendroctonus ponderosae. The biological precursor of viriditoxin.

name: ustilaginoidin A
definition: A binaphthopyran resulting from the formal oxidative coupling at position 9 of two molecules of 5,6,8-trihydroxy-2-methyl-4H-naphtho[2,3-b]pyran-4-one.

name: dimethyl 2,2'-(9,9',10,10'-tetrahydroxy-7,7'-dimethoxy-1,1'-dioxo-3,3',4,4'-tetrahydro-[6,6'-binaphtho[2,3-c]pyran]-3,3'-diyl)diacetate
definition: A binaphthopyran resulting from the formal oxidative dimerisation at position 6 of two molecules of methyl (9,10-dihydroxy-7-methoxy-1-oxo-3,4-dihydro-1H-naphtho[2,3-c]pyran-3-yl)acetate.

name: (P)-viriditoxin
definition: A dimethyl 2,2'-(9,9',10,10'-tetrahydroxy-7,7'-dimethoxy-1,1'-dioxo-3,3',4,4'-tetrahydro-[6,6'-binaphtho[2,3-c]pyran]-3,3'-diyl)diacetate in which the the 3 and 3' positions (bearing the 2-methoxy-2-oxoethyl (CH2CO2Me) groups) both have S configuration, while the 6 and 6' positions (where the binaphthopyran units are linked) have Sa configuration (the P atropisomer). It is found in trace amounts (with much greater amounts of the M atropisomer) in the fungus Paecilomyces variotii derived from the inner tissues of the giant jellyfish Nemopilema nomurai.

name: cercosporin(2−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the two hydroxy groups at position 5 and 12 of cercosporin. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: nor-toralactone
definition: A naphtho-γ-pyrone that is 1H-benzo[g]isochromen-1-one substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and hydroxy groups at positions 7, 9 and 10.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcN-O[CH2]6SH
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of three α-D-mannose residues and one β-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (1→2), (1→6) and (1→4), with the glucosamine residue linked glycosidically to a 6-sulfanylhexyl group.

name: PubChem CID 91849816
definition: A polysaccharide with molecular formula C129H211N9O97S consisting of NeuAc(a2-3)Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-2)[Gal3S(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-4)]Man(a1-3)[NeuAc(a2-3)Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-2)[NeuAc(a2-3)Gal(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-6)]Man(a1-6)]Man(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-4)[Fuc(a1-6)]GlcNAc.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose composed of three β-D-glucose units joined by two (1→3)-linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-D-Glc-ol
definition: A glycosyl alditol that is D-glucitol in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted to the corresponding 6-deoxy-α-L-galactopyranoside (also known as α-L-fucoside) and β-D-galactopyranoside, respectively.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisitng of two α-D-acetamidogalactose residues linked by a (1→6)-glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Gal-ol
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is 3-O-(2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl)-D-galactitol in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 of the acetaminoglucopyranosyl moiety has been glycosylated by D-galactopyranosyl and L-fucosyl groups, respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of D-galactose at the reducing end having an α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp
definition: An L-Fucp-(1→2)-[D-Galp-(1→3)]-D-Galp in which the disubstituted D-galactosyl residue has β- configuration at the anomeric centre, while the L-fucosyl group at position 2 and the D-galactosyl group at position 3 have α- and β- configuration, respectively.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→1)-D-Man-OH
definition: An glycosyl alditol consisting of α-D-mannopyranose and D-mannitol residues joined in sequence by a (1→1) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-?D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of α-D-mannosyl, D-mannosyl, 2-acetamido-β-D-glucosyl and 2-acetamido-D-glucosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→6), (1→4), and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of two α-D-glucose residues and a β-D-glucose at the reducing end joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue attached to a D-mannopyranose at the 3-position.

name: β-(1→2)-galactotriose
definition: A galactotriose composed of three β-D-galactopyranose units joined by (1→2)-linkages.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide that is D-galactopyranose which has been glycosylated at positions 3 and 6 by β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl groups, respectively.

name: α-D-GlcpNS-(1→4)-α-L-IdopA2S-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNS6S-(1→4)-L-IdopA 2S
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate consisting of 2-(sulfoamino)-α-D-glucopyranosyl, 2-O-sulfo-α-L-idopyranuronosyl, 6-O-sulfo-2-sulfoamino-α-D-glucopyranosyl and 2-O-sulfo-L-idopyranuronic acid residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GlcA3S-(1→4)-D-Xylp
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of 3-O-sulfo-β-D-glucopyranuronic acid and D-xylopyranose joined by a (1→4) glycosidic linkage.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A mannooligosaccharide derivative that is α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-β-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the mannopyranosyl residue attached to the acetamidoglucose moiety has been glycosylated by an α-D-mannopyranosyl group.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is 3-O-(2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyl)-D-galactopyranose in which the acetamidoglucosyl group has been glycosylated at positions 3 and 4 by β-D-galactosyl and α-L-fucosyl groups, respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-QuipNAc
definition: A branched trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-β-D-quinovose (= 2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-β-D-glucopyranose) which has been glycosylated at positions 3 and 4 by β-D-galactopyranosyl and α-L-fucopyranosyl (= 6-deoxy-α-L-galactopyranosyl) groups, respectively.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of α-D-glucopyranose, β-D-glucopyranose and D-glucopyranose attached in sequence by (1→2) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-D-Glc-OH 2NAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucitol which has been glycosylated at position 4 by a β-D-mannopyranosyl group, which in turn has been glycosylated at positions 3 and 6 by α-D-mannopyranosyl groups.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide comprising three successive D-galactosyl residues and a D-glucosyl residue at the reducing end joined by sequential α-(1→3)-, α-(1→4)- and β-(1→4)-linkages.

name: β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide composed of 2-acetamido-4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl, and α-D-mannopyranose residues coupled in sequence by (1→4) and (1→2) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is β-D-Galp-β-D-GalpNAc-D-Glcp in which the acetaminogalactosyl group has undergone formal glycosylation at position 6 by a β-D-acetaminogalactopyranosyl group.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of three α-D-acetaminoglucopyranose residues and a D-acetaminoglucose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide that is D-galactopyranose which has been glycosylated at positions 3 and 6 by 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-β-D-galactopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl groups.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasacccharide that is D-galactopyranose that has been glycosylated by 2-acetamido-β-D-galactopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl groups at positions 4 and 6.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-D-Glcp
definition: A glucooligosaccharide consisting of five β-D-glucosyl residues and a D-glucosyl resicuejoined in sequence by (1→6), (1→6), (1→3), (1→6), and (1→6) glycosidic bonds in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the terminal residue (bearing the anomeric hydroxy group) has been glycosylated by a β-D-glucosyl group.

name: β-D-ManpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a 2-acetamido-β-D-mannopyranose residue and two α-D-glucopyranose residues joined together in sequence by (1→4)-glycosidic bonds.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp
definition: A glycosyllgalactose that is the 6-O-fucoside of α-D-galactopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc 6S-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-D-Glc-OH 2NAc 6S
definition: An amino pentasaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-6-O-sulfo-D-glucitol which has been glycosylated at positions 3 and 4 by 6-deoxy-α-L-galactopyranosyl and 6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-6-O-sulfo-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl groups, respectively.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into the corresponding α-D-galactoside.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcf
definition: A glucotriose composed of α-D-glucopyranose, α-D-glucopyranose and β-D-glucofuranose residues joined in sequence by 1→6 glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 6 have been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside and α-D-glucopyranoside, respectively.

name: [α-D-Glcp-(1→6)]6-D-Glcp
definition: A glucooligosaccharide consisting of six α-D-glucopyranosyl residues and a D-glucopyranosyl residue connected in sequence by (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-fructofuranosyl-(2,1)-β-D-fructofuranose
definition: An inulobiose in which the anomeric centre has β-configuration.

name: 4α-hydroxymethylzymosterol
definition: A 4-hydroxymethylzymosterol in which the hydroxymethyl group at position 4 has α-configuration.

name: 4α-formylzymosterol
definition: A 4-formylzymosterol in which the formyl group at position 4 has α-configuration.

name: 3,3',5'-trimethylmyricetin
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at position 3, 3' and 5' have been replaced by methoxy groups.

name: N4-acetylcytosine
definition: A pyrimidone that is cytosine bearing an N4-acetyl substituent.

name: 7,3',5'-trimethylmyricetin
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at position 7, 3' and 5' have been replaced by methoxy groups.

name: 6-PEA-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcN-O[CH2]6SH
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of a 6-O-[(2-aminoethoxy)(hydroxy)phosphoryl-α-D-mannose residue, two α-D-mannose residues and one β-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (1→2), (1→6) and (1→4), with the glucosamine residue linked glycosidically to a 6-sulfanylhexyl group.

name: 3,3'-dimethylquercetin
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is quercetin in which the hydroxy groups at position 3 and 3' have been replaced by methoxy groups. It has been isolated from several plant species and exhibits anti-bacterial and anti-cancer properties.

name: 3,3',4',5'-tetramethylmyricetin
definition: A tetramethoxyflavone that is myricetin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3, 3', 4' and 5' are replaced by methoxy groups. It is isolated from Bridelia ferruginea, a subtropical medicinal plant widely used in traditional African medicine.

name: 3,4'-dimethylkaempferol
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is kaempferol in which the hydroxy groups at position 3 and 4' have been replaced by methoxy groups. It is a component of bee glue and isolated from several plant species including Tanacetum microphyllum.

name: herquline B(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of herquline B resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-Fucp-(1→2)-[D-Galp-(1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: Any branched trisaccharide consisting of D-galactopyranose having an L-fucosyl residue at the 2-position and a D-galactosyl residue at the 3-position.

name: 7,4'-dimethylkaempferol
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is kaempferol in which the hydroxy groups at position 4' and 7 have been replaced by methoxy groups. It is a component of bee glue and has been isolated from several plant species including Betula exilis, Zingiber mekongense and Alpinia flabellata.

name: (1S,7R,8R,14S)-6,9-dioxo-15,17-diazatetracyclo[12.2.2.13,7.18,12]icosa-3(20),12(19)-dien-15-ium
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of one of the amino groups of (1S,7R,8R,14S)-15,17-diazatetracyclo[12.2.2.13,7.18,12]icosa-3(20),12(19)-diene-6,9-dione. This is compound 7 of pmid:27690412.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcN-O[CH2]6SH
definition: A linear pentasaccharide derivative consisting of four α-D-mannose residues and one β-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (1→2), (1→2), (1→6) and (1→4), with the glucosamine residue linked glycosidically to a 6-sulfanylhexyl group.

name: α-D-Man-(1→2)-6-PEA-α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcN-O[CH2]6SH
definition: A linear pentasaccharide derivative consisting of an α-D-mannose residue, a 6-O-[(2-aminoethoxy)(hydroxy)phosphoryl-α-D-mannose residue, two further α-D-mannose residues and one β-D-glucosamine residue, linked sequentially (1→2), (1→2), (1→6) and (1→4), with the glucosamine residue linked glycosidically to a 6-sulfanylhexyl group.

name: [α-D-Man-(1→2)-6-PEA-α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man-(1→4)-α-D-GlcN-(1→6)]-1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol
definition: A myo-inositol monophosphate derivative consisting of 1-O-(6-thiohexylphosphono)-D-myo-inositol having an α-D-mannosyl-(1→2)-6-O-(2-aminoethylphosphono)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-α-D-glucosaminyl residue at the 6-position.

name: marinobufagenin
definition: A cardiotonic steroid secreted by the toad Bufo rubescens and other related species such as Bufo marinus. An endogenous Na/K-ATPase inhibitor, it is a vasoconstrictor with effects similar to digitalis.

name: ilicicolin B
definition: An ilicicolin that is 2,4-dihydroxy-6-methyl-benzaldehyde which is substituted at position 3 by a (2E,6E)-3,7,11-trimethyldodeca-2,6,10-trien-1-yl group.

name: ascochlorin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of ascochlorin resulting from the deprotonation of the 4-hydroxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: ascofuranol(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group that is para- to the aldehyde group of ascofuranol. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: ascofuranone(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of ascofuranone resulting from the deprotonation of the 4-hydroxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: myristoleamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of myristoleic acid with ammonia.

name: palmitoleamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (9Z)-hexadecenoic acid with ammonia.

name: (8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatrienamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of all-cis-icosa-8,11,14-trienoic acid with ammonia.

name: (11Z,14Z,17Z)-icosatrienamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of all-cis-icosa-11,14,17-trienoic acid with ammonia.

name: (11Z,14Z)-icosadienamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (11Z,14Z)-icosadienoic acid with ammonia.

name: nervonamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (15Z)-tetracosenoic acid with ammonia.

name: gondamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (11Z)-icos-11-enoic acid with ammonia.

name: petroselinamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of petroselinic acid with ammonia.

name: (7Z)-octadecenamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (7Z)-octadecenoic acid with ammonia.

name: (12Z)-octadecenamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (12Z)-octadecenoic acid with ammonia.

name: fumigatin
definition: A member of the class of monohydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones that is 1,4-benzoquinone which is substituted by a methoxy, hydroxy and methyl group at positions 2,3 and 5, respectively. It is a mycotoxin isolated from Aspergillus fumigatus.

name: 5-methylorsellinate
definition: A dihydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 5-methylorsellinic acid, obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,4-dihydroxy-5,6-dimethylbenzaldehyde
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde that is 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde in which the hydrogens at positions 5 and 6 have been replaced by methyl groups.

name: benzyl cinnamate
definition: The cinnamate ester derived from cinnamic acid and benzyl alcohol. Occuring in Balsam of Peru and Tolu balsam, in Sumatra and Penang benzoin, and as the main constituent of copaiba balsam, it is used in heavy oriental perfumes, as a fixative and as a flavouring agent.

name: (Z)-hexadec-11-enal
definition: A hexadecenal containing a double bond at position 11 (the cis-stereoisomer). Major pheromone component detected in the whole-animal male Helicoverpa zea antennal preparations

name: levomethorphan
definition: A 6-methoxy-11-methyl-1,3,4,9,10,10a-hexahydro-2H-10,4a-(epiminoethano)phenanthrene in which the stereocenters at positions 4a, 10 and 10a have R-configuration. It is a prodrug of levorphanol and a strong narcotic analgesic, and listed as a schedule II controlled substance.

name: 6-methoxy-11-methyl-1,3,4,9,10,10a-hexahydro-2H-10,4a-(epiminoethano)phenanthrene
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1,3,4,9,10,10a-hexahydro-2H-10,4a-(epiminoethano)phenanthrene which is substituted by a methoxy group at position 6 and a methyl group at position 11.

name: (3E)-phytochromobilin
definition: The (3E)-isomer of phytochromobilin.

name: resibufagenin
definition: A steroid lactone that has been used in the treatment of preeclampsia. A synthetic bufadienolide it is an antagonist of marinobufagenin (MBG) and differs from it by replacement of its 5β-OH and 13β-Me groups by hydrogen.

name: palmityl acetate
definition: An acetate ester derived from hexadecan-1-ol (palmityl alcohol); used as an emollient, masking agent and skin conditioner; pheromone constituent present in various species of mouse, arachnid and insect.

name: N-(docosanoyl)ethanolamine
definition: An N-(long-chain-acyl)ethanolamine that is the ethanolamide of docosanoic acid.

name: N-(15Z-tetracosenoyl)ethanolamine
definition: A N-(long-chain-acyl)ethanolamine that is the ethanolamide of (15Z)-tetracosenoic acid.

name: glymidine
definition: A sulfonamide that is N-(pyrimidin-2-yl)benzenesulfonamide which is substituted at position 5 of the pyrimidine ring by a 2-methoxyethoxy group. It is a hypoglycemic drug used for the treatment of diabetes mellitus.

name: glymidine(1−)
definition: An organic nitrogen anion resulting from the deprotonation of the sulfonamide nitrogen of glymidine. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: N,N-dimethyltetradecanamide
definition: A fatty amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadec-9-enoic acid with dimethylamine. Skin and eye irritant.

name: N-oleoyltaurine(1−)
definition: A fatty acid-taurine conjugate obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonate group of N-oleoyltaurine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-dodecylpyrrolidin-2-one
definition: Pyrrolidin-2-one substituted at nitrogen by an n-dodecyl group.

name: 15-acetyldeoxynivalenol
definition: A trichothecene mycotoxin that is deoxynivalenol acetylated on the oxygen at C-15. A skin and eye irritant, along with its 3-acetyl regioisomer and its parent deoxynivalenol it is considered among the most commonly and widely distributed cereal contaminants.

name: 3-acetyldeoxynivalenol
definition: A trichothecene mycotoxin that is deoxynivalenol acetylated on the oxygen at C-3. A skin and eye irritant, along with its 15-acetyl regioisomer and its parent deoxynivalenol it is considered among the most commonly and widely distributed cereal contaminants.

name: N-docosanoyltaurine(1−)
definition: A fatty acid-taurine conjugate(1−) obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group of N-docosanoyltaurine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-nervonoyltaurine(1−)
definition: A fatty acid-taurine conjugate obtained by deprotonation of the sulfonate group of N-nervonoyltaurine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-{α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)}-α-D-GalNAc
definition: β-D-Gal-(1→3)-{α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)}-D-GalNAc in which the anomeric configuration of the GalNAc residue at the reducing end is alpha.

name: N-oleoyltaurine
definition: A fatty acid-taurine conjugate derived from oleic acid.

name: palytoxin
definition: A polyol marine coelenterate toxin composed of substituted N-3-hydroxypropyl-trans-3-amidoacrylamides and produced by species of Palythoa and Zoanthus soft corals (collectively called zoantharians), either as a defence mechanism or to assist them in capturing prey. An ionophore that forms cation channels through Na+/K+-ATPase, it is a potent vasoconstrictor useful in evaluation of anti-angina agents. It is considered to be one of the most poisonous non-protein substances known, second only to maitotoxin in terms of toxicity in mice.

name: tauroursocholate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of tauroursocholic acid, obtained by the deprotonation of the sulfonic acid group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: flutropium
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hydroxy(diphenyl)acetic acid with the hydroxy group of (3-endo,8-syn)-8-(2-fluoroethyl)-3-hydroxy-8-methyl-8-azoniabicyclo[3.2.1]octane. Its bromide salt is used as a drug for the treatment asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

name: dibunic acid
definition: A naphthalenesulfonic acid that is naphthalene-1-sulfonic acid which is substituted by tert-butyl groups at positions 2 and 6.

name: 2,3,6,8,9-pentahydroxy-3-(2-oxopropyl)-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroanthracen-1-one
definition: A member of the class of anthracenones that is 3,4-tetrahydroanthracen-1-one which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3, 6, 8 and 9, and a 2-oxopropyl group at position 3.

name: TAN-1612(1−)
definition: An enolate resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group of the enol moiety of TAN-1612.

name: (R)-efonidipine
definition: A 2-[benzyl(phenyl)amino]ethyl 5-(5,5-dimethyl-2-oxido-1,3,2-dioxaphosphinan-2-yl)-2,6-dimethyl-4-(3-nitrophenyl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3-carboxylate that has (R)-configuration. It is a selective blocker of T-type Ca2+ channels.

name: (S)-efonidipine
definition: A 2-[benzyl(phenyl)amino]ethyl 5-(5,5-dimethyl-2-oxido-1,3,2-dioxaphosphinan-2-yl)-2,6-dimethyl-4-(3-nitrophenyl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3-carboxylate that has (S)-configuration. It is a blocker of L- and T-type Ca2+ channels.

name: 2-[benzyl(phenyl)amino]ethyl 5-(5,5-dimethyl-2-oxido-1,3,2-dioxaphosphinan-2-yl)-2,6-dimethyl-4-(3-nitrophenyl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3-carboxylate
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-(5,5-dimethyl-2-oxido-1,3,2-dioxaphosphinan-2-yl)-2,6-dimethyl-4-(3-nitrophenyl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3-carboxylic acid with the hydroxy group of 2-[benzyl(phenyl)amino]ethanol.

name: (R)-clorprenaline
definition: A 1-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-isopropylaminoethanol that has (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-clorprenaline
definition: A 1-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-isopropylaminoethanol that has (S)-configuration.

name: 1-(2-chlorophenyl)-2-isopropylaminoethanol
definition: A member of the class of monochlorobenzenes that is chlorobenzene which is substituted by a 1-hydroxy-2-[(propan-2-yl)amino]ethyl group at position 2.

name: halicin
definition: A member of the class of thiadiazoles that is 1,3,4-thiadiazol-2-amine which is substituted by a (5-nitro-1,3-thiazol-2-yl)sulfanediyl group at position 5. It is a c-Jun N-terminal kinase inhibitor (IC50 = 0.7uM) and exhibits antibacterial properties.

name: (−)-voacangine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (−)-voacangine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: secodine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of secodine, obtained by protonation of the nitrogen atom of the tetrahydropyridine moiety. The major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (−)-coronaridine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of (−)-coronaridine.

name: cyclo[18]carbon
definition: An allotrope of carbon with molecular formula C18 existing as a ring of eighteen carbon atoms, connected by alternating triple and single bonds.

name: angryline(1+)
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (5S,12bR,12cS)-7-carboxy-1-ethyl-3,6,8,12c-tetrahydro-4H-5,12b-ethanoindolo[3,2-a]quinolizin-5-ium with methanol.

name: dehydrosecodine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion result from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of dehydrosecodine (the enamine form). An intermediate in the biosynthesis of aspidosperma and iboga alkaloids.

name: 10-hydroxycoronaridine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of 10-hydroxycoronaridine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: pyrafluprole
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole which is substituted by a 2,6-dichloro-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl, nitrile, (fluoromethyl)sulfanediyl and [(pyrazin-2-yl)methyl]nitrilo groups at positions 1,3,4 and 5, respectively. It is an experimental insecticide introduced by Nihon Nohyaku Co Ltd, Japan.

name: (R)-flufiprole
definition: A 1-[2,6-dichloro-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-5-[(2-methylprop-2-en-1-yl)amino]-4-[(trifluoromethyl)sulfinyl]-1H-pyrazole-3-carbonitrile that has R configuration at the sulfoxide.

name: (S)-flufiprole
definition: A 1-[2,6-dichloro-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-5-[(2-methylprop-2-en-1-yl)amino]-4-[(trifluoromethyl)sulfinyl]-1H-pyrazole-3-carbonitrile that has S configuration at the sulfoxide.

name: JWH-133
definition: A dibenzopyran that is Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol which is lacking the hydroxy group and in which the pentyl group at position 3 has been replaced by a 1,1-dimethylbutyl group. A potent and highly selective CB2 receptor agonist.

name: HU-308
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is bicyclo[3.1.1]hept-2-ene which is substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 2, a 2,6-dimethoxy-4-(2-methyloctan-2-yl)phenyl group at position 4, and two methyl groups at position 6 (the 1S,4S,5S stereoisomer). A highly selective and effective cannabinoid type-2 agonist and the enantiomer of HU-433.

name: SR 144528
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-(4-chloro-3-methylphenyl)-1-(4-methylbenzyl)-1H-pyrazole-3-carboxylic acid with the amino group of (1S,2S,4R)-1,3,3-trimethylbicyclo[2.2.1]heptan-2-amine. A potent and selective cannabinoid receptor type 2 (CB2 receptor) inverse agonist (Ki = 0.6 nM).

name: 1-[2,6-dichloro-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]-5-[(2-methylprop-2-en-1-yl)amino]-4-[(trifluoromethyl)sulfinyl]-1H-pyrazole-3-carbonitrile
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole that is substituted at positions 1, 3, 4, and 5 by 2,6-dichloro-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl, cyano, (trifluoromethyl)sulfinyl, and (2-methylprop-2-en-1-yl)nitrilo groups, respectively.

name: secodine
definition: A methyl ester that is 1H-indole substituted by a 3-methoxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-2-yl group at position 2 and a 2-(5-ethyl-3,4-dihydropyridin-1(2H)-yl)ethyl groups at position 3. It is a transient intermediate in the synthesis of indole alkaloids such as vindoline and vincadifformine.

name: N-(3-{[α-D-GalN-(1→4)-α-D-GalN-yl]oxy}propyl)-21-(biotinylamino)-4,7,10,13,16,19-hexaoxadodecan-1-amide
definition: A disaccharide derivative in which α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-α-D-galactosamine is linked glycosidically to biotin via a (21-oxo-3,6,9,12,15,18-hexaoxa-22-azapentacosan-1-yl)amino spacer. One of a set of synthesised biotinylated oligo-α-(1→4)-D-galactosamines comprising from two to six monosaccharide units, along with their N-acetylated derivatives (PMID:31913631), aimed at analysing the specificity of the antibody responses to a complex exopolysaccharide galactosaminogalactan found in Aspergillus fumigatus, the most important airborne human fungal pathogen in industrialized countries.

name: 10-hydroxycoronaridine
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is coronaridine in which the hydrogen of the indole moiety that is para- to the indole nitrogen has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: ibogamine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of ibogamine. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: noribogaine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of noribogaine.

name: ibogaine(1+)

name: spectinomycin(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion derived from spectinomycin by protonation of the secondary amino group located between the two alcoholic hydroxy groups.

definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is ibogamine in which the indole hydrogen para to the indole nitrogen has been replaced by a hydroxy group.
