name: ascofuranol
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde that is 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde which is substituted by a {(2E,6E)-7-[(2S,4S)-4-hydroxy-5,5-dimethyltetrahydrofuran-2-yl]-3-methylocta-2,6-dien-1-yl} group at position 3, chlorine at position 5, and a methyl group at position 6. A meroterpenoid produced by various filamentous fungi, including Acremonium egyptiacum.

name: N-nervonoyltaurine
definition: A fatty acid-taurine conjugate derived from nervonic acid.

name: N-acetyl-D-leucine
definition: The N-acetyl derivative of D-leucine.

name: dehydrosecodine
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is methyl 2-(1H-indol-2-yl)prop-2-enoate in which the indole moiety has been substituted at position 3 by a 2-(5-ethylpyridin-1(2H)-yl)ethyl group. An intermediate in the biosynthesis of aspidosperma and iboga alkaloids.

name: 5-methylorsellinic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid that is o-orsellinic acid in which the hydrogen at position 5 is substituted by a methyl group.

name: (3S)-3-{[3',4'-difluoro-5-({4'-fluoro-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidinium-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-yl}carbamoyl)[biphenyl]-2-yl]oxy}pyrrolidinium dichloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of 3',4'-difluoro-N-{4'-fluoro-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-yl}-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-carboxamide. It is a β-catenin/BCL9 protein-protein interaction inhibitor (Ki = 2.1 μM).

name: 3-methylorsellinic acid
definition: A dihydroxybenzoic acid that is o-orsellinic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a methyl group.

name: 3-methylorsellinate
definition: A dihydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 3-methylorsellinic acid, obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Xylp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An α-D-Xylp-(1→6)-D-Glcp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration. The disaccharide unit of xyloglucan in plant cell-walls.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-L-Arap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, α-L-arabinopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose consisting of two α-D-galactopyranose and a D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) gllycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding beta-D-galactopyranoside.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→6)-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide consisting of β-D-xylopyranose and D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: L-gulofuranose
definition: The furanose form of L-gulose.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted into the corresponding α-D-mannopyranosyl and 2-acetamino-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: α-D-galactofuranose
definition: A D-galactofuranose that has α- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GclpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 have each been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl derivatives.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-α-D-Glcp
definition: A α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-D-Glcp which has α- configuration at the anomeric carbon of the non-terminal glucopyranose ring.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→3)-α-D-Manp
definition: A disaccharride consisting of β-D-xylopyranose and α-D-mannopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residue, two β-D-mannopyranose residues and a β-D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→2), (1→2), and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two β-D-glucopyranose residues and a β-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding D-galactopyranoside. The stereochemistry at the anomeric position in each of the galactopyranose rings is not stated.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→6)-α-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-α-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the corresponding β-L-fucopyranoside.

name: α-L-Arap-(1→2)-[β-D-Glcp-(1-3)]-α-L-Arap
definition: A trisaccharide that is α-L-arabinopyranose which has been glycosylated at positions 2 and 3 by α-L-arabinopyranosyl and β-D-glucopyrnaosyl groups, respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galf
definition: A β-D-Galp-(1→6)-D-Galf in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glcopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 6 have each been converted into the corresponding α-L-fucopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-L-Galp-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the corresponding β-L-galactopyranoside.

name: α-D-Xylp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding α-D-xylopyranoside.

name: β-D-GlcN-(1→6)-D-GlcN
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-amino-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide that is lactose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the galactose ring has been converted into its α-L-fucopyranosyl derivative.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp2Me-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisacharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 2 have been converted into the corresponding 2-O-methyl-β-D-galactopyranosyl and α-L-fucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-[α-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 6 have each been converted into their corresponding α-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp
definition: A β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Galp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has α configuration.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[α-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is α-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the D-galactopyranose moiety has been glycosylated by an α-L-fucopyranosyl group.

name: Δ4-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S
definition: A Δ4-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc4S in which the the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β- configuration.

name: α-D-glucopyranosyl α-D-galactopyranoside
definition: A glycosyl glycoside that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy group has been converted into the corresponding α-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-L-Fucp
definition: An amino disaccharide that is β-L-fucose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→6)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of two β-D-galactopyranose residues and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-{α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)}-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide consisting of a linear sequence of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue is also linked (2→6) an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl residue, while the galactosyl residue proximal to the reducing end has also linked (1→3) to it an α-L-fucosyl (1→3)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl trisaccharide unit.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two β-D-galactopyranose residues and a β-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by two (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: Δ4-β-D-GlcpA2S-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: A Δ4-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc6S in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β- configuration.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of an α-D-galactopyranose residue and two β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Galp in which the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration

name: isobemisiose
definition: A glucotriose that is α-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)-α-D-glucopyranoside in which the anomeric hydroxy group has been converted into the corresponding α-D-glucopyranoside. An unusual trisaccharide abundant in the silverleaf whitefly, Bemisia argentifolii.

name: D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide that is lactose in which the hydroxy group at the 3' position has been converted to the corresponding D-galactopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide that is β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted to the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranoside.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-L-fucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-D-Glcp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide that is α-D-glactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-α-D-galactopyranoside.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp
definition: A mannotetrose consisting of four α-D-mannopyranose residues linked by three (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-Galp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-GalpNAc
definition: An aminotetrasaccharide that is β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-GalpNAc in which the non-terminal galatopyranosyl group has been glycosylated at position 2 by an α-L-fucopyranosyl group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→4)]-α-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose that is α-D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4 have each been converted into the corresponding α-D-mannopyranoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the α-D-GalpNAc moiety has been glycosylated by a β-D-Galp group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-L-Man-OH
definition: A tetrasaccharide consisting of three β-D-galactopyranosyl residues and an L-mannitol group joined in sequence by (1→6), (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose that is α-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been glycosylated by an α-L-fucopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-β-D-galactopyranosyl, α-D-galactopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl and β-D-glucopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-β-D-galactopyranose, α-D-galactopyranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is 2-acetamido-3-O-(2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl)-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose in which the 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety has been glycosylated at positions 3 and 4 by α-L-fucosyl and β-D-galactopyranosyl groups, respectively.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→4)-α-L-Arap-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-D-xylopyranose, α-L-arabinopyranose and β-D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose that is D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 6 have each been converted into the corresponding α-D-mannopyranoside.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl and D-galactopyanosyl residues joined together in sequence by (1→3) and (1→2) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A tetrasaccharide consisting of three β-D-galactopyranosyl residues and a D-glucopyranosyl residue joined in sequence by three (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two β-D-glucopyranosyl groups and a β-D-galactopyranosyl groupjoined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-mannopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-lactose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose joined by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6 have each been glycosylated by an α-L-fucopyranosyl group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of two α-D-mannopyranosyl and two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→6), (1→4) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: D-xylofuranose
definition: The furanose form of D-xylose.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A mannohexaose consisting of three β-D-mannopyranosyl residues, two α-D-mannopyranosyl residues and a D-mannopyransyl residue joined in sequence by (1→2) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: A carbohydrate sulfate that is 2-acetamido-6-O-sulfo-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranuronoside.

name: β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-[β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)]-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-D-glucopyranose
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide that consists of the linear tetrasaccharide β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc in which the β-D-Gal residue is substituted at position 6 by a β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc group. It is found in human milk.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→2)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4 have been converted to the corresponding β-D-galactopyranoside and β-D-glucopyranoside, respectively.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide that is lactose in which the hydroxy group at the 4' position has been converted into the corresponding β-L-fucopyranoseide.

name: 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-(β-D-Galp6S)-D-galactitol
definition: An aminodisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactitol in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the 6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranose derivative.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-Gal-OH
definition: A glycosyl alditol derivative that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactitol in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been glycosylated by an α-L-fucopyranosyl-(1→2) β-D-galactopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consistinng of β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyl and D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: 3-methyl-3-sulfanylhexan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is hexan-1-ol which is substituted by a methyl group and a thiol group at position 3. It is the odor component of human axilla sweat and the major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of two molecules of α-D-glucopyranose and a D-glucopyranose moiety joined together in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 have each been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: β1,4-GalNAc-disialyl-Lc4
definition: An amino heptasaccharide consisting of a β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc tetrasaccharide backbone, to the galactosyl residue distal to the reducing end is (1→4)-linked a β-DGlcNAc residue, while Neu5Ac residues are linked to this same galactosyl residue and the GlcNAc residue via (2→3) and (2→6) glycosidic linkages respectively. An antigen for the monoclonal antibody RM2, it is used as a histological marker for prostate cancer.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-L-Fucp
definition: A disaccharide that is L-fucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranos, β-D-galactopyranose and β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose, and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by (1→4), (1→3), and (1→4) glycosidic bonds and in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the non-terminal 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose moiety has been to the corresponding α-D-galactopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide that is β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3 and 6 of the mannosyl residue have been glycosylated by a β-D-xylopyranosyl residue, an N-acetyl-β-D-glucopyranosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannopyranosyl group and an α-D-mannopyranosyl residue respectively, while the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries also an α-L-fucosyl residue attached via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[3-O-sulfo-β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of α-L-fucoopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic linkages and in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the acetamidogalactopyranose moiety has been glycosylated by a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-D-galactosamine
definition: An amino disaccharide composed of N-acetylneuraminic acid and 2-(acetylamino)-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose residues joined by an (α-2→6) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-lyxofuranose
definition: A D-lyxofuranose which has α-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→2) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A β-D-Xylp-(1→4)-D-Glcp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: selaginose
definition: A glucotriose that is α-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy group has been glycosylated by an α-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: Δ4-β-D-GlcpA2S-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate that is 4-deoxy-Δ4-β-D-GlcpA2S-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the 2-acetamido-beta-D-galactopyranose moiety has been converted into the corresponding hydrogen sulfate derivative.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the corresponding α-L-fucoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-2-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An aminotrisaccharide that is N-acetyllactosamine in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the corresponding α-L-fucopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-L-mannofuranose
definition: An L-mannofuranose that has β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Xylp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two β-D-galactopyranose residues and a D-xylopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp
definition: A β-L-Fucp-(1→4)-D-Galp in which the galactopyranose moiety has α- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→2)-α-D-Glcp-(1↔1)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide that is β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-D-glucopyranoside in which the anomeric hydroxy group has been converted into the corresponding α-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→2)[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-L-fucopyranose and D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond, in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the glucopyranose moiety has been glycosylated by β-D-galactopyranose.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues and an α-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding α-L-fucopyranoside.

name: Δ4-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc4S
definition: An oligsaccharide sulfate that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranosidurosyl derivative.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two β-D-galactopyranose residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→2)]-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 have been glycosylated by β-D-glucopyranosyl and β-D-galactopyranosyl groups, respectively.

name: β-L-galactofuranose
definition: An L-galactofuranose in which the anomeric centre has β configuration.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of three β-D-gluopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of α-D-glucopyranose, α-D-galactopyranose and α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of α-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at 2 and 3 have each been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosyl derivatives.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose that is β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 6 have been converted into the corresponding α-D-glucopyranosyl and β-D-glucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of a β-D-galactopyranose residue and two β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of two α-D-mannopyranose residues linked by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: 2-O-(α-D-Manp)-D-Man-OH
definition: A glycosyl alditol that is D-mannitol in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding α-D-mannopyranoside.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc3S
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-3-O-sulfo-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-[β-D-Glcp-(β-1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted to the corresponding α-D-glucopyranoside, while that at position 1 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranosyl, α-D-galactopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc(1→4)]-D-Manp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide that is D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy group at positions 2 and 4 have been converted to the β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-α-D-glucopyranoside and the β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranoside respectively.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp-(1→2)-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose consisting of two α-D-galactopyranose residues and a galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→2) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotetraose consisting of three α-D-glucopyranosyl residues and a β-D-glucopyransyl residue joined in sequence by (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-L-Fucp
definition: An aminotrisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl and α-L-fucopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of an α-D-mannopyranosyl residue and two 2-acetamido-α-D-glucopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranosyl. 2-acetamido-α-D-galactopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-D-glucopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose consisting of two β-D-galatopyranose residues and a D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An aminotetrasaccharide that is 2-acetamido-α-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been glycosylated by α-L-fucopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-4-O-α-D-mannopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl groups, respectively.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose that is β-D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding α-D-mannopyranoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, β-D-glucopyranose and D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An aminotrisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-mannopyranoside.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two β-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched tridecasaccharide derivative in which β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl and β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide units are linked (1→6) and (1→3) respectively to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of α-D-mannopyranosyl, β-D-mannopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-α-D-glucopyranosyl and α-D-mannopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→2), (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp2Me-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranosyl, 2-O-methyl-β-D-galactopyranosyl and 2-acetamidoD-glucopyranosyl residues linked in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-β-D-glucosyl and D-mannopyranosyl residues linked in sequence by (1→3) and (1→2) glycosidic linkeages.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose consisting of α-D-galactopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and D-galactpyranose joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp3Me-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, 3-O-methyl-β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of α-D-glucopyranose, β-D-glucopyranose and D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted to the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-α-D-Galp
definition: A branched trisaccharide in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted into the corresponding α-D-glucopyranosyl and β-D-glucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of D-glucopyranose, α-D-glucopyranose and β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by two (1→4) glycosidic bonds. The configuration of the anomeric centre at the non-reducing terminus is not specified.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamino-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a β-D-mannopyranose residue and two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-L-Fucp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and β-L-fucopyranose joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GclpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 have each been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-GalNAc-ol
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactitol in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the galactitol moiety has been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→6)-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf
definition: A galactotriose consisting of three β-D-galactofuranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→5) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, β-D-glucopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotetrose in which four α-D-glucopyranose residues are joined in sequence by (1→4), (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of an α-D-glucopyranose and two α-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→2) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of three 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranose residues, a 2-acetamido-α-D-glucopyranose residue and a further 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Manp
definition: An amino disaccharide comprised of 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranose linked (1→4) to β-D-mannopyranose.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotetrose consisting of four α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6), (1→6) and (1→2) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp4S-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate that is 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyanose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been glycosylated by α-L-fucopyransyl and 4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranosyl groups, respectively.

name: β-L-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding β-L-galactopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose and two β-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: An aminodisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been glycosylated by an α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranosiduronic acid group.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-GalpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide that is β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc in which the β-D-galactosyl group attached by a (1→4) linkage to an acetamidoglucopyranosyl group has glycosylated at its 3-hydroxy group by an α-D-galactopyransyl group.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[α-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-α-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted into the corresponding α-D-glucopyranosyl and α-L-fucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose consisting of an α-D-mannopyranose residue and two β-D-mannopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: 2'-fucosyllactose
definition: A trisaccharide that is lactose in which the hydroxy group at the 2' positions has been glycosylated by an α-L-fucopyranosyl group. It is the most abundant human milk oligosaccharide.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Galf
definition: A galactotriose consisting of two α-D-galactopyranosyl groups and a D-galactofuranose group linked in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotetraose consisting of an α-D-glucopyranosyl group, two β-D-glucopyranosyl groups, and a further α-D-glucopyranosyl group joined in sequence by three (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man residue, while the D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end is substituted at position 6 by an α-L-Fuc residue.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deox-β-D-glucoyranosyl, β-D-mannopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: Neu5Ac-(α-2→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An aminodisaccharide consisting of N-acetylneuraminic acid and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose joined in sequence by a (2→3) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of two α-D-glucopyranosyl residues and a D-glucopyranosyl residue joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→2) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of α-N-acetylneuraminic acid and N-acetyl-β-D-glucocosamine joined in sequence by a (2→6) glycosidic bond. A 5-aminopentyl linker may be attached to the oxygen at position 1 of the reducing-end glucosamine residue.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-α-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosides.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An aminotetrasaccharide consisting of three molecules of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds in which the non-terminal group has been glycosylated at the 6-hydroxy group by fourth 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose moiety.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl and D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3), (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched mannopentaose consisting of three α-D-mannopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→2) linkages, in which the hydroxy group at position 6 of the mannose at the reducing end has been by an alpha-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA
definition: An aminotetrasaccharide consisting of two units of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucopyranuronic acid joined together by a (1→3') glycosidic linkage.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxyglucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6 have been glycosylated by 2-O-(α-L-fucopyranosyl)-β-D-galactopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-β-D-galactopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl groups, respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranosyl, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl and α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An aminotrisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 6 have been glycosylated by a β-D-galactopyranosyl group and a β-D-glucopyranosyl group, respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→6)]-β-D-Galf
definition: A galactotriose that is β-D-galactofuranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6 have been glycosylated by β-D-galatopyranosyl residues.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose consisting of three α-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-L-lyxopyranose
definition: An L-lyxopyranose that has β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose that is β-D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding α-D-mannopyranoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpN
definition: An amino disaccharide that is that is the 3-O-β-D-galactopyranoside of 2-amino-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→6)-β-D-Galf
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of two β-D-galactofuranosyl residues joined by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-D-Galp-(1→6)]-β-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose that is β-D-galatopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6 have been glycosylated by α-D-galactopyranosyl residues.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 f the acetamidogalactopyranose group has been glycosylated by a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-(3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-D-Manp
definition: A mannotetarose consisting of three α-D-mannopyranose residues and a D-mannopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→2), (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-Galp-(1→4)]-β-Galp-(1→3)-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the β-D-galactopyranosyl moiety has been glycosylated by an α-D-galactopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joine in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Manp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl and α-D-mannopyranosyl residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galp6S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide comprised of an 6-sulfated β-D-galactopyranosyl residue, a 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue, and a 2-acetamido-D-galactopyranosyl reidue joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic linkages.

name: 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-3-O-β-D-galactopyranosyl-D-glucitol
definition: An amino disaccharide that is the 3-O-β-D-galactopyranoside of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucitol.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[6-deoxy-α-L-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-D-GalNAc-ol
definition: An aminopentasaccharide that is 2-acetamido-D-alactitol which has been glycosylated at positions 3 and 6 by 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl and α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-[β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)]-2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranosyl groups, respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide that is β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc in which position 3 of the non-terminal 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranoysyl residue has been glycosylated by an α-L-fucosyl group (6-deoxy-α-L-galactosyl group).

name: GS-441524
definition: A C-nucleoside analog that is (2R,3R,4S,5R)-3,4-dihydroxy-5-(hydroxymethyl)tetrahydrofuran-2-carbonitrile substituted by a 4-aminopyrrolo[2,1-f][1,2,4]triazin-7-yl group at position 2. It is the active metabolite of remdesivir and exhibits a broad range of inhibitory activity against various RNA viruses including HCV, parainfluenza and SARS-CoV.

name: cinanserin(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative that is the conjugate acid of cinanserin, obtained by the protonation of the tertiary amino group. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: cinanserin hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of cinanserin. It is an inhibitor of 3C-like proteinase of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus (SARS-Cov) and reduces virus replication in vitro.

name: 3',4'-difluoro-N-{4'-fluoro-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-yl}-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-carboxamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3',4'-difluoro-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 4'-fluoro-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-amine. It is an β-catenin/BCL9 protein-protein interaction inhibitor.

name: 3',4'-difluoro-N-{4'-fluoro-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-yl}-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-carboxamide(2+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative that is the conjugate acid of 3',4'-difluoro-N-{4'-fluoro-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-yl}-6-[(3S)-pyrrolidin-3-yloxy][biphenyl]-3-carboxamide, obtained by the protonation of the two pyrrolidine moieties. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 2,6-dichlorobenzoquinone
definition: A member of the class of 1,4-benzoquinones that is p-benzoquinone in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 6 have been replaced by chlorines. A highly toxic and carcinogenic disinfection by-product found in drinking water.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)}-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising two fucosyl residues, three galactose residues and two N-acetylglucosamine residues, with a glucose residue at the reducing end, in the arrangement shown.

name: 2-chloro-6-hydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 2-chloro-6-hydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone, obtained from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 3,6-dichloropyridine-2,5-diol(1−)
definition: A organic anion that is the conjugate base of 3,6-dichloropyridine-2,5-diol, resulting from the deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group.

name: CGP-42112A
definition: A hexapeptide consisting of L-tyrosine, L-lysine, L-histidine, L-proline and L-isoleucine amino acid residues coupled in sequence and in which the amino group of the L-tyrosyl residue is substituted by a (pyridin-3-ylcarbonyl)nitrilo group and in which the L-lysyl side chain amino group is substituted by a {N2-[(benzyloxy)carbonyl]-L-arginyl}nitrilo group. It is a potent angiotensin II receptor type 2 (AT2 receptor) agonist.

name: (1S,7R,8R,14S)-15,17-diazatetracyclo[12.2.2.13,7.18,12]icosa-3(20),12(19)-diene-6,9-dione
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is (1R,1'R)-[1,1'-bi(cyclohex-2-en-1-yl)]-6,6'-dione in which position 3 of each ring is joined to a methyl substituent of (2S,5S)-dimethylpiperazine.

name: smaditerpenic acid C
definition: A diterpenoid isolated from the leaves of Smallanthus sonchifolius.

name: (2-formyloxan-3-yl) acetate
definition: A member of the class of oxanes that is oxane which is substituted by a formyl group at position 2 and an acetyloxy group at position 3.

name: 3-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-7-hydroxy-4H-chromen-4-one
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 3-phenyl-4H-chromen-4-one which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 7 and chloro groups at positions 2' and 4'. It is a SIRT1 activator.

name: all-trans-octaprenol
definition: An ultra long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is the all-trans-isomer of octaprenol.

name: all-trans-hexaprenol
definition: A long-chain primary fatty alcohol that is the all-trans-isomer of hexaprenol.

name: (E)-hex-3-en-1-ol
definition: A hex-3-en-1-ol in which the double bond adopts an E-configuration.

name: 2-propylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol which is substituted by a propyl group at position 2.

name: 3-propylcatechol
definition: A member of the class of catechols that is catechol which is substituted by a propyl group at position 3. It is a chemical component in tobacco.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxo-nona-2,4-dienoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienoic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-6-oxonona-2,4-dienoic acid
definition: An α,β-unsaturated monocarboxylic acid that is nona-2,4-dienoic acid carrying hydroxy and oxo substituents at positions 2 and 6 respectively.

name: fumigermin
definition: A member of the class of nectriapyrones that is 2H-pyran-2-one which is substituted at positions 3, 4, 5 and 6 by methyl, hydroxy, methyl and but-2-en-2-yl groups, respectively. It is a secondary metabolite produced by Aspergillus fumigatus and inhibits germination of spores of the inducing Streptomyces rapamycinicus.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear chain of α-sialyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl residues, linked (2→3), (1→4) and (1→3) respectively, with an α-L-fucosyl residue linked to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue.

name: SG85
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-[(benzyloxy)carbonyl]-O-tert-butyl-L-serine with the primary amino group of ethyl (2E,4S)-5-[(3S)-2-oxopyrrolidin-3-yl]-4-(L-phenylalanylamino)pent-2-enoate. It is a potent enterovirus 3C protease inhibitor with EC50 of 180 nM against enterovirus 71 (EV71) and 60 nM against human rhinovirus 14 in a live virus-cell-based assay.

name: tilorone
definition: A member of the class of fluoren-9-ones that is 9H-fluoren-9-one which is substituted by a 2-(diethylamino)ethoxy group at positions 2 and 7. It is an interferon inducer and a selective α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (α7 nAChR) agonist. Its hydrochloride salt is used as an antiviral drug.

name: angiotensin I dizwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion that is the dizwitterionic form of angiotensin I having both carboxy groups deprotonated and the aspartyl amino group and arginine side-chain protonated. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: angiotensin (1-9) dizwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion that is the dizwitterionic form of angiotensin (1-9) having both carboxy groups deprotonated and the aspartyl amino group and arginine side-chain protonated. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: [des-Phe8, des-Arg9]-bradykinin(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group and protonation of the primary amino and guanidino groups of [des-Phe8, des-Arg9]-bradykinin. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: (6R,7S,9S)-2-imino-7,9-dimethyl-1,3-diazaspiro[5.5]undecan-4-one
definition: An azaspiro compound resulting from the spiro-fusion of 2-imino-1,3-diazinan-4-one at position 6 with 1,3-dimethylcyclohexane. It is a marine metabolite isolated from Vietnamese pufferfish Tetraodon biocellatus and a potential intermediate in the biosynthetic pathway leading to the synthesis of tetrodotoxin.

name: tilorone(2+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative resulting from the protonation of the two tertiary amino groups of tilorone.

name: tilorone dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of tilorone. It is used as an antiviral drug to treat influenza, herpes infection, viral hepatitis, acute respiratory viral infections and SARS.

name: R-29148
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidines that is 1,3-oxazolidine which is substituted by two methyl groups, dichloroacetyl group and a methyl group at positions 2, 3 and 5, respectively. It is a herbicide safener.

name: (R)-imazaquin
definition: A 2-[4-methyl-5-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl]quinoline-3-carboxylic acid that has R-configuration. It is the more active enantiomer of imazaquin.

name: (S)-imazaquin
definition: A 2-[4-methyl-5-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl]quinoline-3-carboxylic acid that has S-configuration.

name: 2-[4-methyl-5-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl]quinoline-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid that is quinoline-3-carboxylic acid which is substituted by a 4-methyl-5-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl group at position 2.

name: neurotensin(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy groups of L-α-glutamyl and L-leucine residues, and protonation of the side chains of L-lysyl and L-arginyl residues of neurotensin. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: neurotensin (1-12)(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy groups of L-α-glutamyl and L-isoleucine residues, and protonation of the side chains of L-lysyl and L-arginyl residues of neurotensin (1-12). It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: kinetensin(2+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of L-leucine residue, and protonation of the amino group of L-isoleucyl and protonation of the side chains of L-arginyl residues of kinetensin. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: kinetensin (1-8)(2+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of L-phenylalanine residue, and protonation of the amino group of L-isoleucyl and protonation of the side chains of L-arginyl residues of kinetensin (1-8). It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-imazapic
definition: A 5-methyl-2-[4-methyl-5-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl]pyridine-3-carboxylic acid that has (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-imazapic
definition: A 5-methyl-2-[4-methyl-5-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl]pyridine-3-carboxylic acid that has (S)-configuration.

name: (R)-imazaquin-ammonium
definition: An ammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of the carboxy group of (R)-imazaquin with 1 mol eq. of ammonia.

name: (S)-imazaquin-ammonium
definition: An ammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of the carboxy group of (S)-imazaquin with 1 mol eq. of ammonia.

name: (R)-imazaquin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (R)-imazaquin.

name: (S)-imazaquin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (S)-imazaquin.

name: Phe-His zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Phe-His. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-methyl-2-[4-methyl-5-oxo-4-(propan-2-yl)-4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazol-2-yl]pyridine-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A pyridinemonocarboxylic acid that is 5-methylpyridine-3-carboxylic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a 4,5-dihydro-imidazol-2-yl group, which in turn is substituted at positions 4, 4, and 5 by isopropyl, methyl, and oxo groups, respectively.

name: His-Pro zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of His-Pro. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-imazapic(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (R)-imazapic.

name: (S)-imazapic(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group of (S)-imazapic.

name: (R)-imazapic-ammonium
definition: An ammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of the carboxy group of (R)-imazapic with 1 mol eq. of ammonia.

name: (S)-imazapic-ammonium
definition: An ammonium salt resulting from the formal reaction of the carboxy group of (S)-imazapic with 1 mol eq. of ammonia.

name: β-casomorphin-7 (human)(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups, and protonation of the primary amino group of human β-casomorphin-7. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-casomorphin-6 (human)(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups, and protonation of the primary amino group of human β-casomorphin-6. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: His-Leu zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of His-Leu. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: neurotensin (1-8) dizwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion that is the dizwitterionic form of neurotensin (1-8) having both carboxy groups deprotonated and the side-chains of L-lysyl and L-arginine protonated. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: neurotensin (1-7)(1−)
definition: A peptide anion of neurotensin (1-7) resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy groups of L-α-glutamyl and L-proline residues, and protonation of the side chain of L-lysyl group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: apelin-13(3+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained from the protonation of the N-terminus amino group and L-arginyl side chains, and deprotonation of the C-terminus carboxy group of apelin-13. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: apelin-12(3+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained from the protonation of the N-terminus amino group and L-arginyl side chains, and deprotonation of the C-terminus carboxy group of apelin-12. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: tideglusib
definition: A member of the class of thiadiazolidines that is 1,2,4-thiadiazolidine-3,5-dione which is substituted by a naphthalen-1-yl group at position 2 and by a benzyl group at position 4. It is a non-ATP competitive inhibitor of glycogen synthase kinase 3β (GSK3β) and has neuroprotective effects. Currently under clinical investigation for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and progressive supranuclear palsy.

name: ma'ilione
definition: A sesquiterpenoid isolated from the marine red algae, Laurencia scoparia.

name: 6-azauridine 5'-monophosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 6-azauridine 5'-monophosphate. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: ammonium thiosulfate
definition: An inorganic ammonium salt composed of ammonium and thiosulfate ions in a 2:1 ratio. It is used in the leaching of gold and silver, as a fertilizer and as a photographic fixing salt.

name: prunetin-5-olate
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 5-hydroxy group of prunetin. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: ammonium polyphosphate
definition: An inorganic ammonium salt of polyphosphate. It is used as a flame retardant and as a fertilizer. The chain length (n) of this polymer is variable and can be linear or branched.

name: tert-butyl N-{1-[(1S)-1-{[(1R,2S)-1-(benzylcarbamoyl)-1-hydroxy-3-[(3S)-2-oxopyrrolidin-3-yl]propan-2-yl]carbamoyl}-2-cyclopropylethyl]-2-oxopyridin-3-yl}carbamate
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-2-{3-[(tert-butoxycarbonyl)amino]-2-oxopyridin-1(2H)-yl}-3-cyclopropylpropanoic acid with the primary amino group of (2R,3S)-3-amino-N-benzyl-2-hydroxy-4-[(3S)-2-oxopyrrolidin-3-yl]butanamide. It is an inhibitor of SARS-CoV-2 main protease.

name: TDZD-8
definition: A member of the class of thiadiazolidines that is 1,2,4-thiadiazolidine-3,5-dione which is substituted by a methyl group at position 2 and by a benzyl group at position 4. It is a non-ATP competitive inhibitor of glycogen synthase kinase 3β (GSK3β). An experimental compound which was being developed for the potential treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

name: roducitabine
definition: A triol that is (1S,2R)-4-fluoro-3-(hydroxymethyl)cyclopent-3-ene-1,2-diol which is substituted by a 4-amino-2-oxopyrimidin-1(2H)-yl group at position 5. It is a cytidine analog which exhibits anticancer activity in several cancers, including gemcitabine-resistant tumours.

name: tryptophol-2-sulfonic acid
definition: An indolyl alcohol that is tryptophol which is substituted by a sulfo group at position 2.

name: neocasomorphin(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups, and protonation of the primary amino group of neocasomorphin. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: beta-casochemotide-1(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups, and protonation of the primary amino group of β-casochemotide-1. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: ammonium phosphate sulfate
definition: An inorganic sulfate salt obtained by reaction of sulfuric acid with one equivalent of ammonium phosphate.

name: cyanoguanidine
definition: A guanidine in which one of the amino hydrogens of guanidine itself is substituted by a cyano group. It is used in the manufacture of fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, explosives, oil well drilling muds, and dyestuffs.

name: (R)-furilazole
definition: A 2,2-dichloro-1-[5-(furan-2-yl)-2,2-dimethyl-1,3-oxazolidin-3-yl]ethanone that has (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-furilazole
definition: A 2,2-dichloro-1-[5-(furan-2-yl)-2,2-dimethyl-1,3-oxazolidin-3-yl]ethanone that has (S)-configuration.

name: 2,2-dichloro-1-[5-(furan-2-yl)-2,2-dimethyl-1,3-oxazolidin-3-yl]ethanone
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidines that is 2,2-dimethyl-1,3-oxazolidine which is substituted by a dichloroacetyl group at position 3 and by a furan-2-yl group at position 5.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and β-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpN
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranosyl, β-D-galactopyranosyl and 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-Galp
definition: A branched trisaccharide that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 have been converted to the corresponding α-L-fucopyranosyl and α-D-galactopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose consisting of α-D-mannopyranose, β-D-mannopyranose and D-mannopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding β-L-fucopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: An α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-D-Galp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose consisting of D-galactopyranose, α-D-galactopyranose and β-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose and β-D-galactose residues joined by a (1→4) glycosidic bond in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the galactopyranose ring has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-[β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)]-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-D-glucopyranose
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide that consists of the linear tetrasaccharide β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Glc in which the β-D-Gal residue is substituted at position 6 by a β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc group. It is found in human milk.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: An α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Galp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a β-D-galactopyranose residue and two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: 1-O-(α-D-glucosyl)glycerol
definition: A 1-O-(D-glucosyl)glycerol in which the D-glucosyl moiety has α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→6)]-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 6 have each been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-L-talofuranose
definition: An L-talofuranose in which the anomeric centre has β configuration.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6 have been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactopyranosyl derivatives.

name: β-D-ManpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-mannopyranose residue and two β-D=glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Manp-(1→4)]-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyl and β-D-mannopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Gal-OH
definition: A glycosyl alditol that is D-galactitol in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-D-Man-OH
definition: An α-L-fucoside resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group at position 2 of D-mannitol with α-L-fucose.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNS
definition: An L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl-(1→4)-D-GlcpNS in which both anomeric centres have α configuration.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding α-L-fucopyranoside.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Gal-OH
definition: A glycosyl alditol resulting from the formal condensation of β-D-galactopyranose with the hydroxy group at position 3 of galactitol.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalNAc-OH
definition: A glycosyl alditol derivative consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and N-acetyl-D-galactosaminitol residues joined in sequence by (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: L-glucofuranose
definition: The furanose form of L-glucose.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-Manp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-dexoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: α-D-fucofuranose
definition: A D-fucofuranose that has α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-glucopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Xylp
definition: A disaccharide that is β-D-xylose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into the corresponding α-D-glucopyranoside.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two α-D-glucopyranose residues and an α-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate consisting of 3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranose and -2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→4)-α-D-Galp
definition: A galactobiose that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactofuranoside.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man group.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Xylp-(1→2)-β-D-Xylp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of a β-D-glucopyranose residue and two β-D-xylopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-Manp in which the acetamidoglucopyranosyl moiety has been glycosylated at position 3 by an α-L-fucopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been glycosylated by β-lactose.

name: α-D-Xylp-(1→6)-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been glycosylated by an α-D-xylopyranosyl group.

name: 2,2'-difucosyllactose
definition: A tetrasaccharide that is lactose in which the hydroxy groups at the 2 and 2' positions have been glycosylated by α-L-fucosyl groups.

name: 5-iodo-2'-deoxyuridine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside compound having 5-iodouracil as the nucleobase; used as an antiviral agent.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of two β-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc-OH
definition: A glycosyl alditol derivative consisting of D-mannopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and N-acetyl-D-glucosaminitol residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by an α-L-Fuc-(1→3)-[β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp2Me-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
