definition: A trisaccharide consisting of α-D-galactopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and L-fucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpN
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-amino-2-deoxypyranose joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residu joined in sequence by (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucoypranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of an α-D-glucopyranose residue and two β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose consisting of two α-D-galactopyranose residues and a β-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined by a (1→4) glycosidic bond. The stereochemistry at the anomeric centre of each D-GlcpNAc moiety is not stated.

name: α-L-Araf-(1→2)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-α-L-Arap
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of α-L-arabinofuranose and α-L-arabinopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond, and in which a β-D-glucopyranose residue has been attached to the arabinopyranose residue by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: ?-D-Manp-(1→5)-?-D-Araf-(1→2)-D-Araf
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of a D-mannopyranose residue and two D-arabinofuranose residues joined in sequence by (1→5) and (1→2) glycosidic bonds. The stereochemistry of the anomeric centres of the three residues is not stated.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide consisting of α-D-glucopyranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: Δ4-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An oligosaccharide sufate consisting of α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronic acid and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-6-O-sulfo-D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)]-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 have been converted into the corresponding α-D-mannopyranosyl and β-D-galactopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[β-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 6 have been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosy and β-L-fucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: α-D-galactosamine
definition: A 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose that has α- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-talofuranose
definition: A D-talotyranose that has β- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide comprised of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose and two further N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4).

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose, α-D-galactopyranose and β-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide unit of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked in a (1→4), (1→6 and (1→4) sequence, with an α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl trisaccharide unit linked (1→3) to the galactose residue proximal to the reducing end.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting that is α-L-fucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)]-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose in which the 2-acetaminoglucopyranose moiety has been glycosylated at position 3 by an α-L-fucopyranosyl group.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-α-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the central α-D-galactopyranosyl moiety has been glycosylated by an α-L-fucopyranosyl group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose consisting of an α-D-mannopyranose residue and two β-D-mannopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→2) glycosidic bonds.

name: D-Galp3S-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is 4-O-(D-galactopyranosyl)-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the galactopyranose moiety has been converted into the corresponding hydrogen sulfate derivative.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Xylp
definition: A disaccharide consisting of a β-D-galactopyranose residue joined to a D-xylopyranose residue by a (1→4) glycosidic bond. Used to diagnose hypolactasia (lactose intolerance as a result of lactase deficiency) via presence of D-xylose after cleavage by lactase.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Arap
definition: A disaccharide consisting of α-D-glucopyranose and D-arabinopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Arap
definition: A β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Arap in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: α-L-lyxopyranose
definition: An L-lysopyranose in which the anomeric centre has α- configuration.

name: Δ4-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: A Δ4-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-D-Glcp in which the the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has α- configuration.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-glycopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding α-L-fucoside.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→2)-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding α-D-galactopyranoside.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide derivative in which two α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)-[N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide units are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine trisaccharide.

name: α-D-Galf-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of α-D-glucofuranosyl and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose resicues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6 have been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactopyranosyl and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyransoyl derivatives, respectively.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of a D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and an α-L-Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→6)-linkage.

name: β-D-Arap-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: A disaccharide that is α-D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-arabinopyranoside.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→4)]-D-Manp
definition: A mannotriose that is D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4 have each been converted into the corresponding α-D-mannopyranose derivative.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotetrose consisting of α-D-glucopyranosyl, β-D-glucopyranosyl, α-D-glucopyranosyl and D-glucopyranoseresidues joined in sequence by three (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→9)-Neup5Ac
definition: A member of the class of neuraminic acids that is N-acetylneuraminic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 9 has been glycosylated by a β-D-galactopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of two 2-acetamido-β-D-galactopyranse residues linked by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-IdopA2S-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-O-sulfo-α-L-idopyranuronic acid and 2-acetamido-D-galatopyranose residues joined by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been glycosylated by an α-D-galactopyranosyl group.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpA
definition: A glycosylglucopyranuronic acid consisting of β-D-xylosyl and β-D-glucuronic acid residues joined by a (1→3) glycosidic linkage.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)--D-GalpNAc
definition: An aminotetrasaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranose and 2-acetamido-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-GlcpN-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpN
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of two molecules of 2-amino-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose linked by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl-(1→4)-2-deoxy-6-O-sulfo-2-(sulfoamino)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A disaccharide derivative consisting of α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronic acid and 2-deoxy-6-O-sulfo-2-(sulfoamino)-α-D-glucopyranose residues joined by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: Neu5Ac-?-(2→3)-D-Galp
definition: A amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetylneuaminic acid and D-galactopyranose joined by a (2→3) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GalNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranosyl residue and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranosyl residue joined by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6 have each been glycosylated by a α-L-fucopyranosyl group.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of 2 α-D-glucopyranose residues and a D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) residues.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose and α-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→2)-Manp
definition: A mannotetrose comprising β-D-mannopyranose, β-D-mannopyranose, α-D-mannopyranose and D-mannopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of two β-D-glucopyranosyl residues and a D-glucopyranosyl residue joined in sequence by (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have each been glycosylated by a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positons 3 and 4 have been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosyl and β-L-fucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-Man-OH
definition: A glycosyl alditol consisting of an α-D-mannopyranose residue and a D-mannitol residue joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-L-glucofuranose
definition: An L-glucofuranose which has β- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[β-D-Manp-(1→3)]-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is D-galactomannose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted into the corresponding β-D-mannopyranosyl and β-D-glucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: 4,6-dideoxy-α-L-xylo-hexopyranosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted to the corresponding β-D-galactopyranosyl and 4,6-dideoxy-α-L-xylo-hexopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 6 by a β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 3 by a β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[α-D-Glcp-(1→3)]-α-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 have been converted into the corresponding α-D-glucopyranosyl and β-L-fucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose and β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→1)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of a β-D-galactopyranose residue and two α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→1) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Galp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β- configuration.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galctopyranose, β-D-glucopyranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-3-deoxy-β-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, 3-deoxy-β-D-xylo-hexopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→6)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-D-mannopyranose, β-D-mannopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-idopyranose
definition: A D-idopyranose that has alpha-configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→5)-β-D-Galf-(1→5)-D-Galf
definition: A galactotriose consisting of two β-D-galactofuranose residues and a D-galactofuranose residue joined in sequence by (1→5) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: 1-O-(2-O-α-D-galactopyranosyl-α-D-glucopyranosyl)-glycerol
definition: A glycosylglycerol that is 1-O-(α-D-glucosyl)glycerol in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the glucose ring has been converted to the corresponding α-D-galactopyranoside.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of β-D-glucopyranose, α-D-glucopyranose and D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of β-D-glucopyranosyl, α-D-glucopyranosyl and D-glucopyranoseresidues joined in sequence by two (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: fenoterol
definition: A member of the class resorcinols that is 5-(1-hydroxyethyl)benzene-1,3-diol in which one of the methyl hydrogens is replaced by a 1-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propan-2-amino group. A β2-adrenergic agonist, it is used (as the hydrobromide salt) as a bronchodilator in the management of reversible airway obstruction.

name: β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-D-glucopyranose
definition: A linear amino octasaccharide comprised of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4). It is found in human milk.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of α-D-glucopyranose, α-D-galactopyranose and D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2,3-dideoxy-β-D-xylo-hexopyranose
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamideo-2,3-dideoxy-β-D-xylo-hexopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A glucotriose consisting of two β-D-glucopyranosyl residues and a D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: 5-acetamido-3,5-dideoxy-D-glycero-α-D-galacto-non-2-ulopyranonosyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-[6-deoxy-α-L-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)]-D-glucopyranose
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising of α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-gal-(1→4)-D-glc in which the D-glc residue is substituted by an α-L-Fuc group at position 3. It is found in human milk.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose, α-D-mannopyranose and D-mannopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2) and (1→6) glycosidic bonds.

name: L-galactofuranose
definition: The furanose form of L-galactose.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide that is D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into the corresponding β-L-fucopyranoside.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose and β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic linkage.

name: β-D-GalpNAc4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide sulfate consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2,4-dideoxy-β-D-xylo-hexopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residuces linked in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-xylopyranose
definition: An L-xylopyranose that has α- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of two β-D-galactopyranose residues and an α-D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-L-talopyranose
definition: An L-talopyranose that has α- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: β-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNS
definition: An L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl-(1→4)-D-GlcpNS in which both anomeric centres have β configuration.

name: D-Galp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of D-galactopyranose, β-D-galactopyranose and D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by (1→6) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-D-galactosyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4) and (1→6).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-L-Fucp
definition: A trisaccharide that is α-L-fucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 have each been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose, α-D-glucopyranose and D-glucopyranose residuce joined in sequence by (1→4) glycosidic linkages.

name: rac-GR24
definition: A racemate comprising equimolar amounts of (+)-GR24 and (−)-GR24. It has been found to inhibit lateral shoot branching (see Nature 2008, v455, 189), stimulate germination of Striga (witchweeds), and aid in the symbiosis of over 80% of terrestrial plants with fungi at arbuscular mycorrihizae in roots.

name: ammonium magnesium phosphate
definition: An inorganic phosphate that is the ammonium magnesium salt of phosphoric acid.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(2-methylazetidin-1-yl)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by a -methylazetidin-1-yl group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: ammonium magnesium phosphate hexahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hexahydrate form of ammonium magnesium phosphate. It is a constituent of urinary calculi.

name: ammonium magnesium phosphate monohydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate of ammonium magnesium phosphate. A constituent of urinary calculi.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(2,2-dimethylazetidin-1-yl)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by a 2,2-dimethylazetidin-1-yl group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(azetidin-1-yl)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by an azetidin-1-yl group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(3-isopropoxyazetidin-1-yl)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by a 3-isopropoxyazetidin-1-yl group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(3-fluoroazetidin-1-yl)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by a 3-fluoroazetidin-1-yl group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(3-methoxyazetidin-1-yl)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by a 3-methoxyazetidin-1-yl group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(3-cyclopropyl-3-fluoroazetidin-1-yl)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by a 3-cyclopropyl-3-fluoroazetidin-1-yl group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(isobutylamino)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by an isobutylamino group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-[(S)-sec-butylamino]abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by an (S)-sec-butylamino group. One of a series of synthesised abacavir analogues with antiviral activity found to stimulate IFN-γ secretion in abacavir-responsive clones.

name: 6-de(cyclopropylamino)-6-(isopropylamino)abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is an analogue of abacavir in which the cyclopropylamino group at position 6 of the purine moiety is replaced by a 3-isopropoxyazetidin-1-yl group. Unlike several other synthesised abacavir analogues, it is completely deficient in T-cell reactivity with abacavir-responsive clones.

name: (R)-cyclaniliprole
definition: A 3-bromo-N-{2-bromo-4-chloro-6-[(1-cyclopropylethyl)carbamoyl]phenyl}-1-(3-chloropyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-5-carboxamide that has (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-cyclaniliprole
definition: A 3-bromo-N-{2-bromo-4-chloro-6-[(1-cyclopropylethyl)carbamoyl]phenyl}-1-(3-chloropyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-5-carboxamide that has (S)-configuration.

name: 3-bromo-N-{2-bromo-4-chloro-6-[(1-cyclopropylethyl)carbamoyl]phenyl}-1-(3-chloropyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-5-carboxamide
definition: A carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of 3-bromo-1-(3-chloropyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-5-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 2-amino-3-bromo-5-chloro-N-(1-cyclopropylethyl)benzamide.

name: (+)-GR24
definition: A (3E)-3-{[(4-methyl-5-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-2-yl)oxy]methylidene}-3,3a,4,8b-tetrahydro-2H-indeno[1,2-b]furan-2-one that has (3E,3aR,8bS) configuration in the indenofuranone moiety and R at the chiral centre in the furanone ring.

name: (−)-GR24
definition: A (3E)-3-{[(4-methyl-5-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-2-yl)oxy]methylidene}-3,3a,4,8b-tetrahydro-2H-indeno[1,2-b]furan-2-one that has (3aS,8bR) configuration in the indenofuranone moiety and S at the chiral centre in the furanone ring.

name: (3E)-3-{[(4-methyl-5-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-2-yl)oxy]methylidene}-3,3a,4,8b-tetrahydro-2H-indeno[1,2-b]furan-2-one
definition: An indenofuran that is (3E)-3,3a,4,8b-tetrahydro-2H-indeno[1,2-b]furan-2-one which is substituted at position 3 by a ({[(4-methyl-5-oxo-2,5-dihydrofuran-2-yl]oxy}methylidene) group.

name: 2-phenylpropanal
definition: A member of the class of phenylacetaldehydes that is phenylacetaldehyde in which a hydrogen alpha to the aldehyde carbonyl group has been replaced by a methyl group. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: bixlozone
definition: An isoxazolidinone that is 1,2-oxazolidin-3-one substituted by a 2,4-dichlorobenzyl group at position 2 and two methyl groups at position 4. It is a herbicide used for the control of annual ryegrass (including herbicide resistant biotypes) and regionally specific broadleaf weeds.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide in which a β-D-galactosyl-(1→)-β-D-glucose disaccharide carries β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl units via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages respectively.

name: pethidine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative that is the conjugate acid of pethidine, obtained from the protonation of the piperidine moiety. It is the major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (4R,5S)-dethiobiotin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (4R,5S)-dethiobiotin, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine trisaccharide in which the mannose residue carries N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl units through (1→3) and (1→6) linkages respectively.

name: 1-feruloyl-sn-glycerol
definition: An enoate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of trans-ferulic acid with the 1-hydroxy group of glycerol.

name: SN-38 carboxylic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid resulting from the hydrolysis of the δ-lactone ring of SN-38. It is a metabolite of SN-38.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide in which an α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-β-D-glucose linear pentasaccharide carries at the galactose residue proximal to the reducing end a second α-L-fucosyl residue via a (1→2) linkage.

name: chloroquine(2+)
definition: A quinolinium ion obtained by protonation of the quinoline nitrogen and tertiary amino group of the antimalarial drug chloroquine. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: neurotensin (1-7)
definition: A 7 amino acid peptide fragment of neurotensin.

name: 5,5-dimethyl-1-pyrroline N-oxide
definition: A member of the class of 1-pyrroline nitrones (1-pyrroline N-oxides) resulting from the formal N-oxidation of 5,5-dimethyl-1-pyrroline. Used as a spin trap for the study of radicals formed by enzymatic acetaldehyde oxidation.

name: 5,5-dimethyl-1-pyrroline
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolines that is 1-pyrroline in which the two hydrogens at position 5 are replaced by methyl groups.

name: neurotensin (1-8)
definition: An 8 amino acid peptide fragment of neurotensin.

name: neurotensin (1-12)
definition: A 12 amino acid peptide fragment of neurotensin.

name: kinetensin (1-8)
definition: An 8 amino acid oligopeptide fragment of kinetensin lacking the C-terminal L-leucine residue.

name: losartan(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of losartan, obtained from the deprotonation of the tetrazole NH group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: candesartan(2−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the tetrazole NH group and carboxy group of candesartan. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: PFI-3
definition: An azabicycloalkane that is (1R,4R)-2,5-diazabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane which is substituted at position 2 by a 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl group and at position 5 by a pyridin-2-yl group. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of polybromo 1 (Kd = 48 nM), SMARCA2 and SMARCA4 (Kd = 89 nM) bromodomains.

name: NOC-5
definition: A nitroso compound that is triazane in which the nitrogen at position 1 is substituted by an isopropyl group and a 3-aminopropyl group, that at position 2 is substituted by a hydroxy group, and that at position 3 is substituted by an oxo group. It is a nitric oxide donor.

name: zolasartan(2−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy group and tetrazole NH group of zolasartan. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: yersiniabactin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of yersiniabactin, obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: D-lyxofuranose
definition: The furanose form of D-lyxose.

name: kermesate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is the conjugate base of kermesic acid, obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: carminate(2−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion obtained from the deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy and 7-carboxy groups of carminic acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: laccaic acid D(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is the conjugate base of laccaic acid D, obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-mannofuranose
definition: A mannofuranose that has L configuration.

name: L-talofuranose
definition: L-Talose in its furanose ring form.

name: D-fucofuranose
definition: The furanose form of D-fucose.

name: D-talofuranose
definition: The furanose form of D-talose.

name: D-altropyranose
definition: The pyranose form of D-altrose.

name: (2E,4E)-deca-2,4-dienal
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty aldehyde that is decanal which has undergone formal dehydrogenation to introduce trans- double bonds at the 2-3 and 4-5 positions. A product of lipid peroxidation in cell membranes and a component of cooking oil fumes.

name: emetine(2+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative obtained from protonation of the nitrogens of emetine. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: emetine dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of emetine.

name: hydroxychloroquine(2+)
definition: A quinolinium ion obtained by protonation of the quinoline nitrogen and tertiary amino group of the antimalarial drug hydroxychloroquine. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: xylazine(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of xylazine, obtained by the protonation of the thiazine nitrogen.

name: xylazine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of xylazine. It is used as a sedative, analgesic, and muscle relaxant in veterinary medicine.

name: crambescidin 401
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic guanidine alkaloid isolated from the marine sponge Crambe crambe.

name: 3-hydroxynonyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetic acid with 1-hydroxy group of nonane-1,3-diol.

name: MEDICA 16
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is hexadecanedioic acid carrying methyl groups at positions 3 and 14. It is a free fatty acid 1 (FFA1/GPR40) receptor agonist and an ATP citrate lyase inhibitor, and exhibits hypolipidemic and antidiabetogenic properties.

name: hawkinsin
definition: A cysteine derivative that is cysteine in which the thiol group is substituted by a [2-(carboxymethyl)-2,5-dihydroxycyclohex-3-en-1-yl]sulfanediyl group. Hawkinsinuria is an inherited disorder which is characterized by the inability to break down the amino acid tyrosine. This results in the finding of certain metabolites in the urine, such as hawkinsin.

name: ligstroside
definition: A secoiridoid glycoside that is the methyl ester of 3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-5-carboxylic acid which is substituted at positions 2, 3, and 4 by hydroxy, ethylidene, and carboxymethyl groups, respectively and in which the anomeric hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into its β-D-glucoside and the carboxylic acid moiety of the carboxymethyl substituent has been converted to the corresponding 4-hydroxyphenethyl ester (the 2S,3E,4S stereoisomer). An important phenolic compound present in olive cultivars.

name: 2-chloro-3-oxoadipate
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 2-chloro-3-oxoadipic acid. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: vanillylamine(1+)
definition: An arylmethylammonium that is the conjugate acid of vanillylamine obtained from the protonation of the primary amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: bempedoic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is pentadecanedioic acid which is substituted by methyl groups groups at positions 2 and 14, and by a hydroxy group at position 8. It is a drug used for the treatment of high LDL cholesterol, which is sometimes referred to as 'bad cholesterol'.

name: 3-[4-(sulfooxy)phenyl]propanoic acid
definition: An aryl sulfate that is phenyl hydrogen sulfate substituted by a 2-carboxyethyl group at position 4. It is a human xenobiotic metabolite found in human plasma and urine after thyme consumption.

name: (+)-catechin-3'-methyl ether
definition: A member of the class of catechins that is (+)-catechin in which the hydroxy group at position 3' has been replaced by a methoxy group. It is a metabolite of (+)-catechin, a major polyphenol found in several fruits and vegetables.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-GalpO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A pentasaccharide derivative consisting of β-D-galactose at the reducing end linked glycosidically to a 2-aminoethyl group, while having a β-D-glucosyl residue at the 4-position and an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosyl moiety at the 3-position.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-GalpO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A decasaccharide derivative consisting of two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)]-β-D-galactose units connected via a β-(1→4) linkage from the galactose of one unit to the glucose of the other, with a 2-aminoethyl group linked glycosidically to the galactose residue at the reducing end.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-β-D-Galp
definition: A ten-membered branched glucosamine oligosaccharide consisting of two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)]-β-D-galactose units connected via a β-(1→4) linkage from the galactose of one unit to the glucose of the other.

name: isoaspulvinone E
definition: A 4-hydroxy-5-(4-hydroxybenzylidene)-3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)furan-2(5H)-one in which the double bond adopts an E-configuration. It is a marine metabolite isolated from the fungus Aspergillus terreus and exhibits antiviral activity.

name: isoaspulvinone E(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of isoaspulvinone E, arising from selective deprotonation of the butenolide OH group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→3)-[β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→5)]-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-α-D-ArafOCH2CH2NH2
definition: A synthetic glycoside that consists of the branched hexasaccharide β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→3)-[β-D-Araf-(1→2)-α-D-Araf-(1→5)]-α-D-Araf-(1→5)-α-D-Araf having a 2-aminoethyl moiety at the reducing-end anomeric centre.

name: phenguignardate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of phenguignardic acid, obtained from the derotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: dehydroemetine
definition: A pyridoisoquinoline which was developed in response to the cardiovascular toxicity associated with emetine and results from the dehydrogenation of the heterotricylic ring of emetine. It is an antiprotozoal agent and displays antimalarial, antiamoebic, and antileishmanial properties.

name: β-casomorphin-7 (human)
definition: A seven amino acid oligopeptide fragment of the human milk protein, β-casein. It is an inhibitor of pancreatic elastase, 5-HT2-serotonin receptors, μ-opioid receptors and δ-opioid receptors.

name: cenicriviroc
definition: A member of the class of benzazocines that is (5Z)-1,2,3,4-tetrahydro-1-benzazocine which is substituted by a 2-methylpropyl, N-{4-[(S)-(1-propyl-1H-imidazol-5-yl)methanesulfinyl]phenyl}carboxamide and 4-(2-butoxyethoxy)phenyl groups at positions 1, 5 and 8, respectively. It is a potent chemokine 2 and 5 receptor antagonist currently in development for the treatment of liver fibrosis in adults with nonalcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH).

name: β-casomorphin-6 (human)
definition: A six amino acid oligopeptide fragment of the human milk protein, β-casein.

name: neocasomorphin
definition: A six amino acid oligopeptide fragment of the human milk protein, β-casein.

name: atromentin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of atromentin, obtained from the deprotonation of one of the hydroxy groups of the 1,4-benzoquinone moiety. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-hydroxyuridine
definition: A member of the class of uridines that is uridine in which the hydrogen at position 5 of the uracil ring is substituted by a hydroxy group.

name: L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronosyl-(1→4)-D-GlcpNS
definition: A disaccharide consisting of L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronose and 2-(sulfoamino)-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: 10,13-dimethyltetradecanoic acid
definition: A branched-chain saturated fatty acid comprising tetradecanoic acid carrying a methyl substituent at positions 10 and 13. It is a marine metabolite isolated from the Caribbean Sponges Calyx podatypa and Agelas dispar.

name: 2-aminophenylacetic acid
definition: A member of the class of phenylacetic acids that is phenylacetic acid which carries an amino group at position 2 of the phenyl ring. A fungal metabolite produced by Colletotrichum gloeosporioides.

name: 2-hydroxyglutaramic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide that is 5-amino-5-oxopentanoic acid carrying a hydroxy group at position 2. It is a metabolite identified in human breast milk.

name: methyl 2-methyl-3-oxoserinate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester that is alanine in which the hydrogen at position 2 is substituted by a methoxycarbonyl group.

name: N-(carboxymethyl)-L-alanine
definition: An L-alanine derivative that is L-alanine in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a carboxymethyl group. It is a marine metabolite which acts as a fish attractant.

name: β-casochemotide-1
definition: A five amino acid oligopeptide fragment of the human and bovine milk protein, β-casein. It acts as an inducer of macrophage chemotaxis.

name: [des-Phe8, des-Arg9]-bradykinin
definition: A seven-membered oligopeptide comprising Arg, Pro, Pro, Gly, Phe, Ser, and Pro residues joined in sequence by peptide bonds. It is a metabolite of bradykinin lacking the Phe residue at position 8 and the Arg residue at position 9.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-Glcp
definition: A tetrasaccharide that is lactose in which the hydroxy groups at the 3 and 2' positions have each been glycosylated by an α-L-fucosyl group.

name: atromentin
definition: A member of the class of dihydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones that is 2,5-dihydroxycyclohexa-2,5-diene-1,4-dione which is substituted by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group at positions 3 and 6. It is a mushroom pigment isolated from several fungi species and acts as a smooth muscle stimulant, and exhibits anticoagulant, antibacterial and antineoplastic properties.

name: apelin-12
definition: A 12 amino acid oligopeptide fragment of apelin-13 lacking the terminal L-phenylalanine residue.

name: (S)-phenylacetylcarbinol
definition: A 1-hydroxy-1-phenylpropan-2-one that has (S)-configuration.

name: (R)-phenylacetylcarbinol
definition: A 1-hydroxy-1-phenylpropan-2-one that has (R)-configuration. It is used as a precursor for the production of ephedrine and pseudoephedrine.

name: L-arabinuronate
definition: An arabinuronate that is the conjugate base of L-arabinuronic acid, obtained by the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: helium-3(1+)
definition: An inorganic radical cation resulting from the loss of one electron from helium-3.

name: (R)-methcathinone(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative that is the conjugate acid of (R)-methcathinone obtained from the protonation of the amino group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methylamino-1-phenylpropan-1-one
definition: An aromatic ketone that is propiophenone in which the hydrogen α- to the keto group has been replaced by a methylamino group.

name: (R)-methcathinone
definition: A 2-methylamino-1-phenylpropan-1-one that has (R)-configuration.

name: N-(tert-butoxycarbonyl)-L-seryl-L-valyl-N-{(2S,3E)-5-ethoxy-5-oxo-1-[(3S)-2-oxopyrrolidin-3-yl]pent-3-en-2-yl}-L-leucinamide
definition: A tripeptide that is L-seryl-L-valyl-L-leucine in which the amino group at the N-terminal is substituted by a tert-butoxycarbonyl group and the carboxy group at the C-terminal is substituted by a {(2S,3E)-5-ethoxy-5-oxo-1-[(3S)-2-oxopyrrolidin-3-yl]pent-3-en-2-yl}amino group. It is a 3C-like protease inhibitor of MERS-CoV and SARS-CoV.

name: N-(4-{[(1H-benzotriazol-1-yl)acetyl][(thiophen-3-yl)methyl]amino}phenyl)propanamide
definition: A member of the class of benzotriazoles that is 1H-benzotriazole which is substituted by a 2-oxo-2-{(4-propanamidophenyl)[(thiophen-3-yl)methyl]amino}ethyl group at position 1. It is a 3C-like protease inhibitor of SARS-CoV and bat coronavirus HKU4.

name: D-dopa zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of D-dopa. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: carbon-12(4+)
definition: A monoatomic tetracation resulting from the loss of four electrons from carbon-12.

name: oxygen-16(6+)
definition: A monoatomic hexacation resulting from the loss of six electrons from oxygen-16.

name: N-{4-[(1H-benzotriazol-1-ylacetyl)(thiophen-3-ylmethyl)amino]phenyl}-2-methylpropanamide
definition: A member of the class of benzotriazoles that is 1H-benzotriazole which is substituted by a 2-{[4-(2-methylpropanamido)phenyl][(thiophen-3-yl)methyl]amino}-2-oxoethyl group at position 1. It is a 3C-like protease inhibitor of SARS-CoV and bat coronavirus HKU4.

name: 10058-F4
definition: A member of the class of thiazolidinones that is 2-sulfanylidene-1,3-thiazolidin-4-one which is substituted at position 5 by a (4-ethylphenyl)methylidene group. It is a cell permeable inhibitor of c-Myc-Max dimerization and exhibits antitumour effects in vivo. It downregulates c-Myc expression and upregulates CDK inhibitors, p21 and p27 resulting in the inhibition of proliferation, induction of apoptosis and cell cycle arrest in G0/G1 phase.

name: N-arachidonoyl-L-serine(1−)
definition: A N-(fatty acyl)-L-serine(1−) that is the conjugate base of N-arachidonoyl-L-serine, resulting from the derotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-methyl-5-[(1E)-3-oxobut-1-en-1-yl]uracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a methyl group at position 6 and a (1E)-3-oxobut-1-en-1-yl group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: benzoyl-AMP(1−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH group of benzoyl-AMP; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxy-6-(pyridin-3-yl)-2H-pyran-2-one
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one which has been substituted at positions 4 and 6 by hydroxy and pyridin-3-yl groups, respectively.

name: 2-oxo-6-(pyridin-3-yl)-2H-pyran-4-olate
definition: An enolate resulting from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group of 4-hydroxy-6-(pyridin-3-yl)-2H-pyran-2-one. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: deacetylpyripyropene E
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is (3S,4aR,6aR,12aR,12bS)-3-hydroxy-4,4,6a,12b-tetramethyl-1,3,4,4a,5,6,6a,12,12a,12b-decahydro-2H,11H-benzo[f]pyrano[4,3-b]chromen-11-one substituted by a pyridin-3-yl group at position 9 (the 3S,4aR,6aR,12aR,12bS stereoisomer).

name: atrochrysone carboxylate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of atrochrysone carboxylic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-[(1-deoxy-D-ribityl)methyl]-5-[(1E)-3-oxobut-1-en-1-yl]uracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a (1-deoxy-D-ribityl)methyl group at position 6 and a (1E)-3-oxobut-1-en-1-yl group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 6-[(1,5-dideoxy-D-ribityl)amino]-5-[(E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino]uracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a (1,5-dideoxy-D-ribityl)amino group at position 6 and an (E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 8-(1,5-dideoxy-1-D-ribityl)-7-methyllumazine
definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 1,5-dideoxy-1-D-ribityl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 7; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 6-[(5-hydroxypentyl)amino]-5-[(E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino]uracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a (5-hydroxypentyl)amino group at position 6 and an (E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 5-hydroxypentyl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 7; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a (1,4-dideoxy-D-ribityl)amino group at position 6 and an (E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 1,4-dideoxy-1-D-ribityl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 6; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 1,4-dideoxy-1-D-ribityl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 7; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 6-[(4-hydroxybutyl)amino]-5-[(E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino]uracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a (4-hydroxybutyl)amino group at position 6 and an (E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 8-(4-hydroxybutyl)-6-methyllumazine
definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 4-hydroxybutyl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 6; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 4-hydroxybutyl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 7; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 6-[(1,2-dideoxy-D-ribityl)amino]-5-[(E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino]uracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a (1,2-dideoxy-D-ribityl)amino group at position 6 and an (E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 8-(1,2-dideoxy-1-D-ribityl)-7-methyllumazine
definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 1,2-dideoxy-1-D-ribityl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 7; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 6-[(2-hydroxyethyl)amino]-5-[(E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino]uracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a (2-hydroxyethyl)amino group at position 6 and an (E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 8-(2-hydroxyethyl)-6-methyllumazine
definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 2-hydroxyethyl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 6; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).
