definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 2-hydroxyethyl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 7; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 6-[(3-hydroxypropyl)amino]-5-[(E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino]uracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil substituted with a (3-hydroxypropyl)amino group at position 6 and an (E)-(2-oxopropylidene)amino group at position 5; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 8-(3-hydroxypropyl)-7-methyllumazine
definition: A pteridine that is lumazine substituted with a 3-hydroxypropyl group at position 8 and a methyl group at position 7; one of 20 modifications to the potent microbial riboflavin-based metabolite antigen 5-(2-oxopropylideneamino)-6-D-ribityl aminouracil (5-OP-RU), an activator of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cells when presented by the MR1 protein (reported in MED:32123373).

name: 2-methyl-L-serine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion obtained from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of 2-methyl-L-serine. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: zolasartan
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 3-bromo-1-benzofuran which is substituted by a 2-(1H-tetrazol-5-yl)phenyl group at position 2 and by a (2-butyl-5-carboxy-4-chloro-1H-imidazol-1-yl)methyl group at position 5. It is an angiotensin II receptor type 1 (AT1) antagonist and was in clinical trials for the treatment of hypertension (now discontinued).

name: (R)-flufenprox
definition: A 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-3-{[2-(4-ethoxyphenyl)-3,3,3-trifluoropropoxy]methyl}benzene that has (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-flufenprox
definition: A 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-3-{[2-(4-ethoxyphenyl)-3,3,3-trifluoropropoxy]methyl}benzene that has (S)-configuration.

name: 1-(4-chlorophenoxy)-3-{[2-(4-ethoxyphenyl)-3,3,3-trifluoropropoxy]methyl}benzene
definition: An aromatic ether that is [3-(4-chlorophenoxy)phenyl]methanol in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a 2-(4-ethoxyphenyl)-3,3,3-trifluoropropoxy group.

name: 1-hydroxy-1-phenylpropan-2-one
definition: A secondary α-hydroxy ketone that is benzene which is substituted by a 1-hydroxy-2-oxopropyl group at position 1.

name: 4-aminopyridine-3-methanol
definition: An aminopyridine that is 4-aminopyridine which is substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 3. It is a potassium channel blocker which restores axonal conduction after spinal cord injury.

name: 2-dodecylbenzenesulfonic acid
definition: A member of the class dodecylbenzenesulfonic acids that is benzenesulfonic acid in which the hydrogen at position 2 of the phenyl ring is substituted by a dodecyl group.

name: 3-dodecylbenzenesulfonic acid
definition: A member of the class dodecylbenzenesulfonic acids that is benzenesulfonic acid in which the hydrogen at position 3 of the phenyl ring is substituted by a dodecyl group.

name: 4-dodecylbenzenesulfonic acid
definition: A member of the class dodecylbenzenesulfonic acids that is benzenesulfonic acid in which the hydrogen at position 4 of the phenyl ring is substituted by a dodecyl group.

name: 3-acetylazepan-2-one
definition: A member of the class of caprolactams that is ε-caprolactam which carries an acetyl group at position 3.

name: 2-chloro-6-hydroxy-1,4-benzoquinone
definition: A member of the class of monohydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones that is 1,4-benzoquinone which is substituted by a chloro group and hydroxy group at positions 2 and 6, respectively.

name: 3-[β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-yl]-1,2-dimyristoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A glycosylglycerol derivative in which the glycosyl moiety of glycosyl-sn-glycerol is β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl attached at O-3, with O-1 and O-2 both carrying myristoyl substituents. Synthetic C. difficile lipoteichoic acid (LTA) molecule consisting only of lipid + core region.

name: nelociguat
definition: A member of the class of pyrazolopyridines that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine which is substituted by a 2-fluorobenzyl and 4,6-diamino-5-[(methoxycarbonyl)amino]pyrimidin-2-yl groups at positions 1 and 3, respectively. It is an active metabolite of riociguat and a soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator developed by Bayer for the treatment of erectile dysfunction and heart failure.

name: tigecycline
definition: Tetracycline in which the hydroxy group at position 5 and the methyl group at position 6 are replaced by hydrogen, and with a dimethylamino substituent and an (N-tert-butylglycyl)amino substituent at positions 7 and 9, respectively. A glycylcycline antibiotic, it has activity against a broad range of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, including tetracycline-resistant organisms. It is used for the intravenous treatment of complicated skin and skin structure infections caused by susceptible organisms.

name: L-arabinuronic acid
definition: An arabinuronic acid having L-configuration.

name: D-arabinuronic acid
definition: An arabinuronic acid having D-configuration.

name: CDN1163
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-isopropoxybenzoic acid with the primary amino group of 2-methylquinolin-8-amine. An allosteric activator of sarco/endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+-ATPase (SERCA).

name: dihydrogeodin(2−)
definition: A phenolate anion obtained by deprotonation of the two phenolic hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 6 of dihydrogeodin. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: emodin anthrone
definition: A member of the class of anthracenones that is anthracen-9(10H)-one which carries a methyl group at position 6 and hydroxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 8, respectively. It is an intermediate precursor in the synthesis of hypericin.

name: 3-{β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[D-GrO-(2→1)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(6-P-6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-yl}-1,2-dimyristoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A glycosylglycerol derivative in which the glycosyl moiety of glycosyl-sn-glycerol is N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-[(D-glyceric acid)-(2→1)]-β-D-glucosaminyl-(6-phospho-6)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl attached at O-3, with O-1 and O-2 both carrying myristoyl substituents. Synthetic C. difficile lipoteichoic acid (LTA) molecule consisting of lipid + core region and one [(→6)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[P-6]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-GroA polymeric repeat (where P-6 is a phosphodiester bridge and GroA is glyceric acid).

name: 1-phenylpropan-1-aminium
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 1-phenylpropan-1-amine, obtained from the protonation of the amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: atrochrysone
definition: A member of the class of anthracenones that is 3,4-dihydroanthracen-1(2H)-one which carries a methyl group at position 3 and hydroxy groups at positions 3, 6, 8, and 9, respectively.

name: 3-{β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[D-GrO-(2→1)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(6-P-6)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[D-GrO-(2→1)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(6-P-6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-yl}-1,2-dimyristoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A glycosylglycerol derivative in which the glycosyl moiety of glycosyl-sn-glycerol is N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-[(D-glyceric acid)-(2→1)]-β-D-glucosaminyl-(6-phospho-6)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-[(D-glyceric acid)-(2→1)]-β-D-glucosaminyl-(6-phospho-6)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl attached at O-3, with O-1 and O-2 both carrying myristoyl substituents. Synthetic C. difficile lipoteichoic acid (LTA) molecule consisting of lipid + core region and two [(→6)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[P-6]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-GroA polymeric repeats (where P-6 is a phosphodiester bridge and GroA is glyceric acid).

name: 3-aminobutanoic acid zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion that is 3-aminobutanoic acid in which a proton has been transferred from the carboxy group to the amino group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-{β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[D-GrO-(2→1)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(6-P-6)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[D-GrO-(2→1)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(6-P-6)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-[D-GrO-(2→1)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(6-P-6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-β-D-Glc-yl}-1,2-dimyristoyl-sn-glycerol
definition: A glycosylglycerol derivative in which the glycosyl moiety of glycosyl-sn-glycerol is N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-[(D-glyceric acid)-(2→1)]-β-D-glucosaminyl-(6-phospho-6)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-[(D-glyceric acid)-(2→1)]-β-D-glucosaminyl-(6-phospho-6)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-[(D-glyceric acid)-(2→1)]-β-D-glucosaminyl-(6-phospho-6)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl-(1→6)-β-D-glucosyl attached at O-3, with O-1 and O-2 both carrying myristoyl substituents. Synthetic C. difficile lipoteichoic acid (LTA) molecule consisting of lipid + core region and three [(→6)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[P-6]-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-D-GroA polymeric repeats (where P-6 is a phosphodiester bridge and GroA is glyceric acid).

name: 3,8,9,10-tetrahydroxy-6-methyl-1,4-dihydroanthracen-1-one
definition: A member of the class of anthracenones that is anthracen-1(4H)-one substituted by a methyl group at position 6 and by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 8, 9 and 10, respectively.

name: (3R)-3,8,9,10-tetrahydroxy-6-methyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroanthracen-1-one
definition: A member of the class of anthracenones that is 3,4-dihydroanthracen-1(2H)-one substituted by a methyl group at position 6 and by hydroxy groups at positions 3R, 8, 9 and 10, respectively.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Glcp
definition: An amino disaccharide that is α-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-α-D-Galp
definition: A branched trisaccharide that is α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-α-D-Galp in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the D-galactopyranose moiety has been glycosylated by an α-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: β-epilactose
definition: A disaccharide that is D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 4 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→3)-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose that is D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactofuranosyl derivative.

name: α-D-Galf-(1→2)-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of α-D-galactofuranose and D-galactopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-D-Xylp
definition: A glycosylxylose consisting of β-D-glucopyranuronic acid and D-xylopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: 1-O-glyceryl α-D-galactofuranoside
definition: A D-galactosylglycerol that is α-D-glucofuranose in which the hydrogen of the anomeric hydroxy group has been replaced by a 2,3-dihydroxypropyl group.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Glcp
definition: An amino disaccharide that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose and-β-D-glucopyranuronic acid residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose residue and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of α-L-fucopyranose and α-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: L-lyxofuranose
definition: The furanose form of L-lyxose.

name: α-D-GlcpN-(1→6)-D-GlcpN
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-amino-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose and 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: 1-O-glyceryl β-D-galactopyranoside
definition: A 3-D-galactosyl glycerol in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydrogen has β configuration.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→2)-D-Galp
definition: A disaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose and D-galactopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: Δ4-β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of α-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronic acid and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: gentiobiitol
definition: A glycosyl alditol consisting of β-D-glucopyranose and D-glucitol joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: α-L-lyxofuranose
definition: An L-lyxofuranose that has α configuration at the anomeric position.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of s-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose and β-D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: D-GlcpNAc-(?1→6)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residue and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Arap-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of α-L-arabinopyranose and β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-β-D-Galp
definition: An α-D-Glcp-(1→6)-D-Galp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: 1-O-glyceryl β-D-galactofuranoside
definition: A D-galactosylglycerol that is glycerol in which one of the primary hydroxy groups has been converted into the corresponding β-D-galactofuranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-glucopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-α-D-Galp
definition: An α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-D-Galp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has α configuration.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide derivative that is α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries an α-L-Fuc residue via a (1→3) linkage.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of α-D-mannopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-Manp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranose and D-mannopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues joined by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino pentasaccharide comprising α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and β-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of β-D-galactopyranose and 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose that is β-D-mannopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-xylopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-L-altrofuranose
definition: An L-altrofuranose that has β configuration at the anomeric position.

name: β-D-galactopyranosyl D-galactopyranoside
definition: A glycosyl glycoside consisting of β-D-galactopyranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined by a (1→1) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of α-D-glucopyranose and D-galactopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of α-L-fucopyranose and D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Fucp
definition: A glycosylfucose that is α-L-fucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: An α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-D-Galp in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has β configuration.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: α-L-altrofuranose
definition: An L-altrofuranose that has α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-D-Xylp
definition: A glycosylxylose that is D-xylopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been converted into the corresponding β-D-glucopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→4)-β-D-Xylp
definition: A glycosylxylose consisting of β-D-glucopyranuronic acid and β-D-xylopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-[β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)]-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-D-glucopyranose
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide that consists of the linear tetrasaccharide β-D-Gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Gal in which the β-D-Gal residue is substituted at position 6 by a β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc group. It is found in human milk.

name: α-L-Arap-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose that is β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted into the corresponding α-L-arabinopyranosyl derivative.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpA
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-β-D-glucopyranose and β-D-glucopyranuronic acid residues joined in sequence by a (1→4)-glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→6)-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-galactopyranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-β-D-Manp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose and β-D-mannopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide compound consisting of a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a Man-α(1→3)-[Man-α(1→6)]-Man-β(1→4)-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and a Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→3)-linkage.

name: 3-phenylpropylaminium
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 3-phenylpropylamine, obtained from the protonation of the primary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: premycofactocin
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones that is pyrrolidine-2,3-dione which is substituted by two methyl groups at position 4 and by a 4-hydroxybenzyl group at position 5. It is a biologically active redox cofactor used by Mycobacterium smegmatis carveol dehydrogenase in the oxidation of carveol.

name: 3-amino-5-[(4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl]-4,4-dimethylpyrrolidin-2-one(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 3-amino-5-[(4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl]-4,4-dimethylpyrrolidin-2-one, obtained from the protonation of the primary amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-[(4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl]-3-imino-4,4-dimethylpyrrolidin-2-one
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones that is 3-iminopyrrolidin-2-one which is substituted by two methyl groups at position 4 and by a 4-hydroxybenzyl group at position 5.

name: 2,4,6-trihydroxyphenylhexan-1-one
definition: A 2-acylphloroglucinol in which the acyl group is specified as hexanoyl. It is the intermediate biosynthetic precursor for differentiation-inducing factor 1 (DIF-1).

name: GS-441524 monophosphate
definition: A C-nucleoside phosphate that is GS-441524 in which the 5'-hydroxy group has been replaced by a phosphate group. In cells, GS-441524 monophosphate gets converted into the pharmacologically active triphosphate form (GS-443902).

name: (+)-geodin
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is 3H,4'H-spiro[[1]benzofuran-2,1'-cyclohexa[2,5]diene]-3,4'-dione substituted by methoxycarbonyl, hydroxy, chloro, methyl, methoxy and chloro groups at positions 2', 4, 5, 6, 6' and 7, respectively. It is a fungal metabolite isolated from Aspergillus terreus and Penicillium glabrum.

name: (+)-geodin(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of (+)-geodin, arising from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: GS-443902
definition: An organic triphosphate that is GS-441524 in which the 5'-hydroxy group has been replaced by a triphosphate group. It is the active metabolite of remdesivir.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a β-D-galactopyranose residue and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: β-L-Fucp-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of β-L-fucopyranose and D-galactopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-D-glucosaminyl residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are connected branches consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl and β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages respectively.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 6 by a β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: 1-piperazinecarboxaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of piperazine-1-carbaldehydes that is piperazine substituted by a formyl group at position 1.

name: 1,2-diphenylcyclobutane
definition: A member of the class of cyclobutanes that is cyclobutane in which a hydrogen at positions 1 and 2 is replaced by a phenyl group.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear trisaccharide comprising two β-D-galactosyl residues and (at the reducing end) a β-D glucose linked in sequence (1→3) and (1→4).

name: 2,3,6,7-tetramethyloctane
definition: An alkane that is octane substituted by a methyl group at positions 2,3,6 and 7.

name: 2,9-dimethyldecane
definition: An alkane that is decane which is substituted by a methyl group at positions 2 and 9.

name: 2,4,6-trimethyldecane
definition: An alkane that is decane substituted by a methyl group at positions 2,4 and 6.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino hexasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by α-D-Man residues and the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end is substituted at position 6 by an α-L-Fuc residue.

name: 2,3-dimethylpentane
definition: An alkane that is pentane substituted by a methyl group at positions 2 and 3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues all linked sequentially (1→3).

name: triethylenediamine
definition: An organic heterobicylic compound that is piperazine with an ethane-1,2-diyl group forming a bridge between N1 and N4. It is typically used as a catalyst in polymerization reactions.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-D-AllpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of an α-D-glucopyranose residue and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-allopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-L-thrHexpA4en-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a β-L-threo-hex-4-enopyranuronse residue and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a tetradecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear pentasaccharide units [linked (1→3) and (1→6)], while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of α-D-galactopyranose and α-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by respectively α-D-Man-(1→2)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man and α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man groups.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino heptasaccharide in which N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine carries two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl trisaccharide units via (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-D-Arap
definition: A glycosylarabinose consisting of β-D-glucopyranose and D-arabinopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-D-glucopyranose
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide comprised of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4). It is found in human milk.

name: aldehydo-L-idose
definition: The open chain form of L-idose.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of and α-L-fucose residue and a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and an α-L-Fuc residue attached via an α-(1→6)-linkage.

name: β-D-gulofuranose
definition: A D-gulofuranose that has β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-D-Man
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and D-mannose residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→4) and (1→2).

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: The amino hexasaccharide derivative α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the anomeric configuration of the reducing-end GlcNAc residue is β.

name: β-D-lyxofuranose
definition: A D-lyxofuranose that has β- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: 6-deoxy-α-L-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-[β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)]-D-glucopyranose
definition: An amino pentasaccharide comprising of β-D-gal-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-gal-(1→4)-D-glc in which the D-glc residue is substituted by an α-L-Fuc group at position 3. It is found in human milk.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of a 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranose residue and a D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-D-Glc-OH
definition: A glycosyl alditol consisting of α-L-fucopyranose and D-glucitol residues joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: D-Manp-(1→5)-D-Araf
definition: A glycosylarabinose consisting of D-mannopyranose and D-arabinofuranose joined in sequence by a (1→5) glycosidic bond.

name: N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-D-glucose
definition: An amino trisaccharide that comprises of a linear sequence of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and D-glucose residues linked (2→3) and (1→4). It is found in human milk.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: α-D-gulofuranose
definition: A D-gulofuranose that has α- configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: D-Manp-(1→2)-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of two D-mannopyranose residues joined by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-α-L-Fucp
definition: A glycosylfucose consisting of β-D-glucopyranose and α-L-fucopyranose residues joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: cephalanone F
definition: A member of the class of benzophenones that is benzophenone in which one phenyl group is substituted at positions 2 and 6 by hydroxy groups and at position 4 by a methyl group while the other is substituted at positions 2 and 6 by hydroxy and carboxy groups, respectively. It is a secondary metabolite isolated from the fungal species Graphiopsis chlorocephala, Paecilomyces variotii and Pseudopalawania siamensis.

name: agnestin A
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 1,2-dihydro-9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by a carboxy group at position 1R, hydroxy groups at positions 2R and 8, and a methyl group at position 3. It has been isolated from the fungus Paecilomyces variotti.

name: agnestin B
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is agnestin A in which the double bond between positions 3 and 4 has been reduced and the carboxlic acid group at position 1 forms a single bond with the carbon atom at position 3 resulting in a cyclic ester. It has been isolated from the fungus Paecilomyces variotti.

name: nataloe-emodin
definition: A trihydroxyanthraquinone that is 9,10-anthraquinone which is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2, and 8 and by a methyl group at position 6. It is isolated from the leaves of Picramnia sellowii and Picramnia latifolia plants.

name: nataloe-emodin(1−)

name: cladofulvin

name: cladofulvin(2−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the dianion of cladofulvin, obtained from the deprotonation of the 6 and 7'-hydroxy groups. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: ethylmercuric chloride

name: sodium 2-butyloctyl sulfate

name: glycylsarcosine

name: Gly-Gly-Pro

name: dihydrogeodin
definition: A member of the class of benzophenones that is sulochrin in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 5 are substituted by chloro groups. It is isolated from several Aspergillus species.

name: tremuloidin
definition: An aryl β-D-glucoside that is salicin in which the hydrogen of the 2-hydroxy group is replaced by a benzoyl group. It is found in the leaves and bark of willows and poplars.

name: β-D-ManpA4Ac-(1→3)-α-L-FucpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-FucpNAcO[CH2]3NH2
definition: A linear trisaccharide derivative consisting of 2-acetamido-4-O-acetyl-2-deoxy-β-D-mannuronic acid, N-acetyl-α-L-fucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-fucosamine residues all linked sequentially (1→3) with the N-acetylfucosamine residue linked glycosidically to a 3-aminopropyl group. name: phenguignardic acid
definition: A member of the class of dioxolanes that is 1,3-dioxolane substituted by a carboxy, benzyl and benzylidene groups at positions 2, 2 and 4, respectively. It is a phytotoxic metabolite of the grape black rot fungus Guignardia bidwellii.

name: benzyl 2,5-dihydroxybenzoate

name: hydroxy torasemide

name: copper(II) phthalocyanine
definition: A metallophthalocyanine that is copper(2+) forming a coordination complex with phthalocyanine. It is a synthetic blue pigment which is used as a colorant in paints and dyes.

name: (+)-albicanol
definition: A drimane-type sesquiterpenoid orginally isolated from the liverwort Diplophyllum albicans. It exhibits fish antifeedant, antifungal and antineoplastic activities.

name: crinosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is campesterol in which position 22 has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond. It is a phytosterol found in marine algae, mussels, crinoids, mites and plants.

name: dauca-4,7-diene
definition: A carbobicylic compound that is (8aS)-1,2,3,3a,4,5,8,8a-octahydroazulene substituted by a propan-2-ylidene, methyl and methyl groups at positions 1, 3aR and 6, respectively.

name: aculene D
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (3aR)-4,7,8,8a-tetrahydroazulen-1(3aH)-one substituted by an ethyl, methyl, hydroxy and methyl groups at positions 3, 6, 8S, and 8aR, respectively. It is a fungal metabolite isolated from Penicillium sp. SCS-KFD08 and Aspergillus aculeatus.

name: asperaculane G(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of asperaculane G, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: aculene C
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is 8,8a-dihydroazulen-1(7H)-one substituted by an ethyl, methyl, hydroxy and methyl groups at positions 3, 6, 8S, and 8aR, respectively. It is a fungal metabolite isolated from Penicillium sp. SCS-KFD08 and Aspergillus aculeatus.

name: aculene B(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of aculene B, arising from the protonation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: aculene A(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of aculene A, arising from the protonation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4'-hydroxy torasemide

name: torasemide carboxylic acid

name: arterolane maleate
definition: The maleic acid salt of arterolane. It is an antimalarial drug used as a fixed combination with piperaquine.

name: arterolane(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of arterolane, resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,2,4-trioxolane
definition: A member of the class of trioxolanes that is cyclopentane in which the carbon atoms at positions 1, 2 and 4 are replaced by oxygen atoms.

name: rac5c
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 1-[1-(naphthalen-1-yl)ethyl]piperidine-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 1-(2-methoxypyridin-4-yl)methanamine. It is a SARS-CoV-2 papain-like protease (PLpro) inhibitor.

name: N-docosanoyltaurine

name: benzoyl-AMP

name: Glu-Cys

name: 3-(1H-imidazol-1-yl)propanoic acid
definition: An imidazolyl carboxylic acid that is propanoic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by an imidazol-1-yl group. It is a metabolite of histidine found in human urine and faeces.

name: aculene B
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of aculene D with the carboxylic acid group of L-proline. It is a sesquiterpenoid isolated from the fungus Aspergillus aculeatus.

name: aculene A
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of aculene C with the carboxylic acid group of L-proline. It is a sesquiterpenoid isolated from the fungus Aspergillus aculeatus.

name: hexylcarbamic acid
definition: An amino acid consisting of carbamic acid having an N-hexyl substituent.

name: butyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by condensation of benzoic acid and butanol. It is used as a perfume ingredient and as a solvent for cellulose ether, a dye carrier for textiles.

name: propyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by condensation of benzoic acid and propanol. It has a balsamic odor reminescent of nuts with a sweet, fruity, nut-like taste.

name: butyl 3-(methylsulfanyl)propanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(methylthio)propionic acid with butan-1-ol.

name: ethyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by condensation of benzoic acid and ethanol. It is a volatile oil component found in ripe kiwifruit, cranberry juice, and palm kernel oil.
