definition: A member of the class of fluorenes that is 9-(p-chlorobenzylidene)-9H-fluorene which is substitutec by chlorine at positions 2 and 7, and by a 2-(dibutylamino)-1-hydroxyethyl group at position 4. An antimalarial drug used in combination with artemether for the treatment of multi-drug resistant strains of falciparum malaria.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising the linear sequence α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc, to the terminal GlcNAc residue is attached at the 6-position a β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc disaccharide side-branch.

name: (E)-2-pentenal
definition: A 2-pentenal in which the double bond has (E)-configuration. It is found in cigarette smoke, virgin olive oil, and milk.

name: 3-fluorobenzaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes that is benzaldehyde substituted by a fluoro group at position 3.

name: 3-fluorobenzyl alcohol
definition: A member of the class of benzyl alcohols that is benzyl alcohol substituted by a fluoro group at position 3.

name: sigmoidin G
definition: A pentahydroxyflavanone that is 2,3,3',4'-tetrahydro-2'H,4H-[2,6'-bichromen]-4-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3', 4', 5, 7, and 8' and by two methyl groups at position 2'. It is isolated from the stam bark of Erythrina sigmoidea.

name: 4-hydroxynonanal
definition: An hydroxy fatty aldehyde that is nonanal in which one of the hydrogens at position 4 has been replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: N-acetyl-L-thialysine zwitterion
definition: A S-alkyl-L-cysteine zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of N-acetyl-L-thialysine. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-L-thialysine
definition: An L-cysteine thioether resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetic acid with the amino group of L-thialysine.

name: felinine zwitterion
definition: A S-alkyl-L-cysteine zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of felinine. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 3-methyl-3-sulfanylbutan-1-ol
definition: An alkanethiol that is butane substituted at position 1 by a hydroxy group and at position 3 by methyl and sulfanyl groups. A volatile organic compound found in coffee, passion fruit juice, beer and domestic cat urine.

name: 3-mercaptopentanol
definition: An alkanethiol that is pentane substituted at positions 1 and 3 by hydroxy and sulfanyl groups respectively.

name: S-ethyl-L-cysteine zwitterion
definition: A S-alkyl-L-cysteine zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of S-ethyl-L-cysteine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methyl-3-sulfanylbutan-1-ol
definition: An alkanethiol that is butan-1-ol substituted at positions 2 and 3 by methyl and sulfanyl groups respectively.

name: ascofuranone
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde that is 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde which is substituted by a (2E,6E)-7-[(2S)-5,5-dimethyl-4-oxotetrahydrofuran-2-yl]-3-methylocta-2,6-dien-1-yl group at position 3, chlorine at position 5, and a methyl group at position 6. A meroterpenoid produced by the soil fungus, Acremonium sclerotigenum. It is a promising drug candidate against the tropical disease, African trypanosomiasis.

name: serratol
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid obtained by regio- and stereoselective hydration of the exocyclic double bond of cembrene C.

name: ganolucidic acid D
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from the spores of Ganoderma lucidum.

name: ambrettolic acid
definition: An ω-hydroxy-long-chain fatty acid that is hexadec-7-enoic acid carrying a hydroxy group at position 16.

name: amrubicinol
definition: A diastereoisomeric mixture resulting from the formal reduction of the acetyl group at position 9 of amrubicin to the corresponding 1-hydroxyethyl group. The active metabolite of amrubicin in lung cancer patients.

name: N-[(2,6-dioxo-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyrimidin-4-yl)carbonyl]-β-alanine
definition: A β-alanine derivative obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of orotic acid with the amino group of β-alanine. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: methyl N-[(2,6-dioxo-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyrimidin-4-yl)carbonyl]-β-alaninate
definition: A β-alanine derivative obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of orotic acid with the amino group of methyl β-alaninate. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: 2-amino-4-{[(3-carbamoyl-1,2,4-oxadiazol-5-yl)methyl]amino}-6-isopropylpyrimidin-1-ium
definition: An aminopyrimidine, protonated on N-1, substituted with an isopropyl group at C-6 and carrying a (3-carbamoyl-1,2,4-oxadiazol-5-yl)methyl substituent on the amino group at C-4. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: S-ethyl-L-cysteine
definition: A S-alkyl-L-cysteine that is L-cysteine in which the hydrogen of the thiol group is substituted by an ethyl group.

name: (S)-3-{[5-(methoxymethyl)pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidin-7-yl](methyl)amino}propane-1,2-diol
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine carrying a methoxymethyl substituent at C-5 and a [(2S)-2,3-dihydroxypropyl](methyl)amino group at C-7. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: (S)-3-{[6-(methoxymethyl)-1-methyl-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-yl]amino}-2,3-dihydrothiophene 1,1-dioxide
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine carrying a methoxymethyl substituent at C-6 and a [(3S)-1,1-dioxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-1λ6-thiophen-3-yl]amino group at C-4. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: (4-{[(3,5-dimethylisoxazol-4-yl)methyl]amino}quinazolin-2-yl)methanol
definition: A quinazoline carrying a hydroxymethyl substituent at C-2 and a [(3,5-dimethyl-1,2-oxazol-4-yl)methyl]amino group at C-4. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: N2-[3-(3-oxo-3,4-dihydroquinoxalin-2-yl)propanoyl]-L-serinamide
definition: A quinoxaline derivative in which quinoxalin-2(1H)-one carries an L-serine-based function {[(2S)-1-amino-3-hydroxy-1-oxopropan-2-yl]amino}-3-oxopropyl} at C-2. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: O,O-diethyl thiophosphate
definition: An organic phosphorothioate anion that is the conjugate base of O,O-diethyl hydrogen thiophosphate, resulting from the deprotonation of the thiophosphate group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-7-{[4-(6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyrimidin-4-yl)piperidin-1-yl]carbonyl}-1,3-diazepane-2,4-dione
definition: Piperidine carrying a 6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyrimidin-4-yl group at C-4 and a [(4R)-2,7-dioxo-1,3-diazepan-4-yl]carbonyl substituent on N-1. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: ascochlorin
definition: A dihydroxybenzaldehyde that is 2,4-dihydroxybenzaldehyde which is substituted by a (1E,3E)-3-methyl-1-[(1R,2R,6R)-1,2,6-trimethyl-3-oxocyclohexyl]penta-1,3-dien-5-yl group at position 3, chlorine at position 5, and a methyl group at position 6. A meroterpenoid produced by several fungi including Ascochyta viciae . It exhibits anticancer, antifungal and antiprotozoal activities.

name: (S)-1-{1-[1-(2-amino-9H-purin-6-yl)piperidin-4-yl]-1H-1,2,3-triazol-4-yl}ethanol
definition: Piperidine carrying a 2-amino-9H-purin-6-yl group on nitrogen and a 4-[(1S)-1-hydroxyethyl]-1H-1,2,3-triazol-1-yl substituent on N-4. One of a series of mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell agonists.

name: 1,3-bis(6-isocyanatohexyl)-1,3-diazetidine-2,4-dione
definition: A diisocyanate in which an isocyanatoheyl group is linked to each of the nitrogens in 1,3-diazetidine-2,4-dione.

name: (−)-δ-cadinol
definition: A cadinane sesquiterpenoid that consists of 1,6-dimethyl-4-(propan-2-yl)-1,2,3,4,4a,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalene having a hydroxy substituent at position 1 and (1R,4S,4aR,8aS)-configuration.

name: (−)-cubenol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (8aS)-1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalene substituted by an isopropyl group at position 1, methyl groups at positions 4 and 7, and by a hydroxy group at position 4a (the 1S,4R,4aR,8aR-diastereoisomer).

name: epizonarene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is (8aR)-1,2,3,7,8,8a-hexahydronaphthalene which is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by methyl groups and at position 8 by an isopropyl group (the 1R,8aS-diastereoisomer).

name: (−)-epicubenol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (8aS)-1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-octahydronaphthalene substituted by an isopropyl group at position 1, methyl groups at positions 4 and 7, and by a hydroxy group at position 4a (the 1S,4R,4aS,8aR-diastereoisomer).

name: viridiflorol
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is (1aS,4aR,7aR,7bR)-decahydro-1H-cyclopropa[e]azulene carrying four methyl substituents at positions 1, 1, 4 and 7 as well as a hydroxy substituent at position 4. It is a sesquiterpenoid isolated from several plant species and is a strong feeding deterrent for the melaleuca weevil that retards larval development.

name: tetramyristoyl cardiolipin(2−)
definition: A cardiolipin(2−) that is the conjugate base of tetramyristoyl cardiolipin obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-naphthaleneacetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 1-naphthaleneacetic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxybenzyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group benzoic acid with the primary hydroxy group 3-hydroxybenzyl alcohol.

name: 3-hydroxybenzyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetic acid with the hydroxy group of 3-hydroxybenzyl alcohol.

name: phenethyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of benzoic acid with the hydroxy group of 2-phenylethanol.

name: geranyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of benzoic acid with the hydroxy group of geraniol.

name: octyl benzoate
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of benzoic acid with the hydroxy group of octan-1-ol. It is found in the leaves of lemon balm.

name: phomopsene
definition: A tetracyclic diterpene that is (6aS,6bR,10aR)-1,2,3,5,6,6a,6b,7,8,9,9a,10-dodecahydrodicyclopenta[a,d]indene substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 4, 7, 7 and 9a, respectively.

name: Se-methylselenomethionine
definition: A selenoamino acid that is selenomethionine in which the selanyl group has been methylated.

name: Se-methyl-D-selenomethionine
definition: A Se-methylselenomethionine that has D-configuration.

name: E. coli strain O157 LPS core oligosaccharide R1
definition: A branched ten-membered oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of two galactose residues, three glucose residues, one 4-phospho-D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue, one L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue, one 4-phospho-L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue and two Kdo residues, one of which is at the reducing end. The unit constitutes one of the core oligosaccharide structures of enterobacterial lipopolysaccharide obtained from E. coli strain O157.

name: Gln-Phe-Tyr
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-glutamine, L-phenylalanine and L-tyrosine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: E. coli strain O157 LPS core oligosaccharide R3
definition: A branched ten-membered oligosaccharide phosphate consisting of three galactose residues, two glucose residues, one 4-phospho-D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue, one L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue, one 4-phospho-L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose residue and two Kdo residues, one of which is at the reducing end. The unit constitutes one of the core oligosaccharide structures of enterobacterial lipopolysaccharide obtained from E. coli strain O157.

name: enrasentan
definition: A member of the class of indanes that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-indene which is substituted by a 1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl group, carboxy group, 2-(2-hydroxyethoxy)-4-methoxyphenyl group and a propoxy group at positions 1S, 2R, 3S and 5, respectively. It is an orally active mixed endothelin A/B receptor antagonist with a 100-fold greater affinity for the endothelin A receptor. The drug was being developed by GSK for the treatment of congestive heart failure and pulmonary hypertension (clinical trials discontinued).

name: PD-166866
definition: A member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidine substituted by an amino group at position 2, 3,5-dimethoxyphenyl group at position 6, and by a (tert-butylcarbamoyl)nitrilo group at position 7. It is a selective ATP competitive inhibitor of the human fibroblast growth factor-1 receptor (FGFR1) tyrosine kinase with an IC50 of 52.4 nM.

name: MMP-9-IN-1
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of [(4-oxo-6-propyl-1,4-dihydropyrimidin-2-yl)sulfanyl]acetic acid with the amino group of 4-(difluoromethoxy)aniline. It is a specific matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) inhibitor.

name: methanol-d4
definition: A deuterated compound that is methanol in which all four hydrogen atoms are replaced by deuterium. It is commonly used as a solvent in NMR spectroscopy.

name: 4-hydroxychlorothalonil(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of 4-hydroxychlorothalonil, arising from the deprotonation of the hydroxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: asperaculane G
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (8aR)-1,2,3,3a,4,5,8,8a-octahydroazulene substituted by a 1-carboxyethylidene group at position 1, hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4, and methyl groups at positions 3a and 6 (the 3R,3aR,4S,8aR-diastereomer).

name: α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→6)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-O[CH2]3NH2
definition: A branched synthetic oligosaccharide derivative containing a terminal Ley tetrasaccharide, a unique α(1→3)-, α(1→6)- and α(1→2)-linked heptoglycan, and a β-D-galactose connector. An aminopropyl linker at the reducing end enables printing onto microscope slides. Synthesised for immunological evaluation of the Helicobacter pylori O6 O-antigen tridecasaccharide.

name: (−)-gallocatechin gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3R)-hydroxy group of (−)-gallocatechin. A natural product found in found in green tea.

name: fagopyritol A1
definition: An α-D-galactoside having a 1D-chiro-inositol substituent at the anomeric position.

name: α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-O[CH2]3NH2
definition: A linear synthetic trisaccharide derivative consisting of three D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptopyranose residue linked (1→2). An aminopropyl linker at the reducing end enables printing onto microscope slides. One of a series of substructures of the Helicobacter pylori O6 O-antigen tridecasaccharide O-antigen used for its immunological evaluation.

name: α-DD-Hep-(1→6)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-O[CH2]3NH2
definition: A linear synthetic tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of four D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptopyranose residue linked in sequence (1→6),(1→2), (1→2), (1→2). An aminopropyl linker at the reducing end enables printing onto microscope slides. One of a series of substructures of the Helicobacter pylori O6 O-antigen tridecasaccharide O-antigen used for its immunological evaluation.

name: trans-13-docosenamide
definition: A 13-docosenamide in which the double bond adopts an (E)-configuration.

name: α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→6)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-O[CH2]3NH2
definition: A linear synthetic pentasaccharide derivative consisting of five D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptopyranose residue linked in sequence (1→3), (1→6),(1→2), (1→2), (1→2). An aminopropyl linker at the reducing end enables printing onto microscope slides. One of a series of substructures of the Helicobacter pylori O6 O-antigen tridecasaccharide O-antigen used for its immunological evaluation.

name: α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-O[CH2]3NH2
definition: A linear synthetic trisaccharide derivative consisting of three D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptopyranose residue linked (1→3). An aminopropyl linker at the reducing end enables printing onto microscope slides. One of a series of substructures of the Helicobacter pylori O6 O-antigen tridecasaccharide O-antigen used for its immunological evaluation.

name: α-L-Fuc-(1→2)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Gal-O[CH2]3NH2
definition: A branched synthetic pentasaccharide derivative consisting of a chain of α-L-fucose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and β-D-glucose residues linked in sequence (1→2), (1→4), (1→3), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine is also linked (1→3) another α-L-fucose residue. An aminopropyl linker at the reducing end enables printing onto microscope slides. One of a series of substructures of the Helicobacter pylori O6 O-antigen tridecasaccharide O-antigen used for its immunological evaluation.

name: (+)-gallocatechin gallate
definition: A gallate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of gallic acid with the (3S)-hydroxy group of (+)-gallocatechin.

name: α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→3)-α-DD-Hep-(1→6)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-(1→2)-α-DD-Hep-O[CH2]3NH2
definition: A linear synthetic octasaccharide derivative consisting of eight D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptopyranose residue linked in sequence (1→3), (1→3), (1→3), (1→3), (1→6),(1→2), (1→2). An aminopropyl linker at the reducing end enables printing onto microscope slides. One of a series of substructures of the Helicobacter pylori O6 O-antigen tridecasaccharide O-antigen used for its immunological evaluation.

name: dimethyl terephthalate
definition: A diester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy groups of terephthalic acid with methanol. It is a primary ingredient widely used in the manufacture of polyesters and industrial plastics.

name: CX-5461
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 5-oxo-5H-[1,3]benzothiazolo[3,2-a][1,8]naphthyridine-6-carboxylic acid substituted by a 4-methyl-1,4-diazepan-1-yl group at position 2 and in which the carboxy group at position 6 is substituted by a [(5-methylpyrazin-2-yl)methyl]nitrilo group. An inhibitor of ribosomal RNA (rRNA) synthesis which specifically inhibits RNA polymerase I-driven transcription of rRNA in several cancer cell lines. It is currently in phase I/II clinical trials for advanced hematologic malignancies and triple-negative breast cancer with BRCA1/2 mutation.

name: decanoyl-L-Arg-L-Val-L-Lys-L-Arg-chloromethylketone
definition: A tetrapeptide consisting of N-decanoyl-L-arginine, L-valine, L-lysine, and L-arginine joined in sequence by peptide linkages and in which the carboxy group at the C-terminus is substituted by a chloroacetyl group. It is a furin inhibitor that has antiviral activity against Chikungunya virus, Zika virus and Japanese encephalitis virus.

name: 13-docosenamide
definition: A primary fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 13-docosenoic acid with ammonia. The double bond configuration is unspecified.

name: oviedomycin
definition: A member of the class of tetraphenes that is 1,4,7,12-tetrahydrotetraphene substituted by oxo groups at positions 1, 4, 7, and 12, by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 6 and 8, and by a methyl group at position 3. It is a natural product found in Streptomyces antibioticus ATCC 11891 which exhibits cytotoxicity against A549 human lung cancer cells, HepG2 liver cancer cells, and MCF-7 breast cancer cells.

name: tilivalline
definition: A pyrrolobenzodiazepine that is (11aS)-2,3,5,10,11,11a-hexahydro-1H-pyrrolo[2,1-c][1,4]benzodiazepine substituted by an oxo group at position 5, by a hydroxy group at position 9, and by a 1H-indol-3-yl group at position 11S. It is a natural product discovered in Klebsiella oxytoca which is the causative toxin in antibiotic associated hemorrhagic colitis. It exhibits a microtubule-stabilizing activity that leads to mitotic arrest in the host cells.

name: tilimycin
definition: A pyrrolobenzodiazepine that is (11aS)-2,3,5,10,11,11a-hexahydro-1H-pyrrolo[2,1-c][1,4]benzodiazepine which is substituted by an oxo group at position 5 and by hydroxy groups at positions 9 and 11. It is an enterotoxic natural product synthesized via a non-ribosomal peptide synthase in Klebsiella oxytoca.

name: steffimycin D
definition: An anthracycline antibiotic that is steffimycin in which the carbonyl group that is adjacent to the carbon bearing both a hydroxy group and a methyl group has been reduced to the corresponding methylene group. An antitumour anthracycline first isolated from Streptomyces steffisburgensis.

name: G-15
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 3a,4,5,9b-tetrahydro-3H-cyclopenta[c]quinoline substituted by a 6-bromo-1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl group at position 4 (the 3aS,4R,9bR-stereoisomer). It is a high affinity and selective GPER1 receptor antagonist (Ki = 20 nM) which inhibits the anti-depressive effects of estrogen in vivo.

name: G-1
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 3a,4,5,9b-tetrahydro-3H-cyclopenta[c]quinoline substituted by 6-bromo-1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl and acetyl groups at positions 4 and 8, respectively (the 3aS,4R,9bR-stereoisomer). It is a potent and selective GPER1 agonist (Ki = 11 nM).

name: aurafuron A
definition: A polyketide that is 2,3-dihydrofuran substituted by hydroxy, methyl, oxo, methyl and (2S,3Z,5E,7R,8R,9E)-2,8-dihydroxy-7,9,12-trimethyltrideca-3,5,9-trien-1-yl groups at positions 2, 2, 3, 4, and 5, respectively. It is a cytotoxic natural product found in several myxobacteria species and inhibits the growth of some filamentous fungi.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→-3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→-4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→-3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide chain of α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked (1→3), (1→4) and (1→3) respectively, with an α-L-fucose residue linked (1→2) to the β-galactose residue.

name: legioliulin
definition: A member of the class of isocoumarins that is 8-hydroxy-1H-isochromen-1-one substituted by a (1E,3E)-4-phenylbuta-1,3-dien-1-yl group at position 3. It is a fluorophore responsible for the blue-white autofluorescence in Legionella dumoffii.

name: auricin
definition: An angucycline-like polyketide discovered in Streptomyces aureofaciens that is only stable at acidic pH.

name: (aminooxy)acetic acid hemihydrochloride
definition: The hemihydrochloride salt of (aminooxy)acetic acid. It is a malate-aspartate shuttle (MAS) inhibitor which also inhibits the GABA degradating enzyme 4-aminobutyrate aminotransferase and cystathionine β-synthetase.

name: colibactin
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-thiazoles that comprises of two units of 2-[(2-{6-[(2S)-2-methyl-3,4-dihydro-2H-pyrrol-5-yl]-5-oxo-4-azaspiro[2.4]hept-6-en-7-yl}acetamido)methyl]-1,3-thiazole-4-carboxylic acid linked together via the formal condensation of the carboxy groups. It is a secondary metabolite produced by certain strains of bacteria found in the human gut such as Escherichia coli. It has the ability to bind covalently to DNA and is strongly associated with colorectal cancer.

name: 4-acetoxybenzyl alcohol
definition: An aromatic primary alcohol that is benzyl alcohol in which the hydrogen at position 4 is substituted by an acetyloxy group.

name: erdasporine A
definition: A organic heterohexacyclic compound that is 12,13-dihydro-6H-indolo[2,3-a]pyrrolo[3,4-c]carbazole in which the hydrogens at positions 5 and 10 are substituted by a methoxycarbonyl and hydroxy groups, respectively. It is synthesized by a gene cluster found in environmental DNA and exhibits cytotoxic activity against human HCT116 cancer cells and Staphylococcus aureus.

name: erdasporine B
definition: An organic heterohexacyclic compound that is 12,13-dihydro-6H-indolo[2,3-a]pyrrolo[3,4-c]carbazole in which the hydrogen at position 5 is substituted by a methoxycarbonyl group. It is synthesized by a gene cluster found in environmental DNA and exhibits cytotoxic activity against human HCT116 cancer cells and Staphylococcus aureus.

name: erdasporine C
definition: An organic heterohexacyclic compound that is 6,7,12,13-tetrahydro-5H-indolo[2,3-a]pyrrolo[3,4-c]carbazole in which the hydrogens at positions 5 and 7 are substituted by a methoxycarbonyl and oxo groups, respectively. It is synthesized by a gene cluster found in environmental DNA and exhibits cytotoxic activity against human HCT116 cancer cells and Staphylococcus aureus.

name: lavendiol
definition: An olefinic compound that is (6E,8E,10E)-dodeca-6,8,10-trien-5-one substituted by a hydroxy group at positions 1 and 3S, and by a methyl group at position 4. It is a polyketide synthesized by a silent biosynthetic gene cluster from Streptomyces lavendulae.

name: N-{α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc}-AEAB
definition: A branched heptasaccharide consisting of four α-D-mannosyl residues, one β-D-mannosyl residue and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues, one of which at the reducing end is bonded to the the aryl amino group of 2-amino-N-(2-aminoethyl)benzamide.

name: alternapyrone
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 3, 4, 5 and 6 are replaced by methyl, hydroxy, methyl and (4E,6E,12E)-4,6,8,12,14-pentamethylhexadeca-4,6,12-trien-2-yl groups, respectively. It is a decaketide that is anabolized by a type I polyketide synthase in Alternaria solani.

name: mangicol A
definition: A sesterterpenoid natural product found in the fungus Fusarium heterosporum. It exhibits significant antiinflammatory activity in the PMA-induced mouse ear edema model.

name: 1-cyclopropyl-6-fluoro-4-oxo-7-(piperazin-1-yl)-N-[4-(5-thioxo-4,5-dihydro-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-yl)phenyl]-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 1-cyclopropyl-6-fluoro-4-oxo-7-(piperazin-1-yl)-1,4-dihydroquinoline-3-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 5-(4-aminophenyl)-1,3,4-oxadiazole-2(3H)-thione.

name: pectolinarin
definition: A disaccharide derivative that consists of pectolinarigenin substituted by a 6-O-(6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranosyl)-β-D-glucopyranosyl moiety at position 7 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: Glu-Asp-Asp
definition: A tripeptide composed of one L-glutamic acid and two L-aspartic acid units joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a trisaccahride backbone consisting of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked in sequence (1→4) and (1→3), with α-L-fucose residues linked to the galactose and N-acetylglucosamine via (1→2) and (1→3) linkages respectively.

name: 3'-deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-cytidine
definition: A pyrimidine 3'-deoxyribonucleoside that is cytidine in which the hydroxy group at position 3' is replaced by a hydrogen and a double bond is introduced between positions 3' and 4'. It is a metabolite of 3'-deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-CTP.

name: 3'-deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-CTP
definition: An organic triphosphate resulting from the formal condensation of the 5'-hydroxy group of 3'-deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-cytidine with triphosphoric acid. It is a chain terminator for RNA-dependent RNA polymerases.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising a tetrasaccharide backbone consisting of α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked in sequence (1→3), (1→4) and (1→3), with α-L-fucose residues linked to the β-galactose and N-acetylglucosamine via (1→2) and (1→3) linkages respectively.

name: Arg-Asp-Asp
definition: A tripeptide composed of one L-arginine and two L-aspartic acid units joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprising a tetrasaccharide backbone consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked in sequence (1→3), (1→4) and (1→3), with α-L-fucose residues linked to the β-galactose and N-acetylglucosamine via (1→2) and (1→3) linkages respectively.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine branched tetrasaccharide, onto the mannosyl residue of which are two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide units linked (1→3) and (1→6).

name: Lys-Lys-Leu
definition: A tripeptide composed of two L-lysine units and L-leucine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: salinipyrone A
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 3, 4, 5 and 6 are replaced by methyl, hydroxy, methyl and (1E,3E,5S,6R)-6-hydroxy-3,5-dimethylocta-1,3-dienyl groups, respectively. It is a polyketide isolated from the marine actinomycete Salinispora pacifica.

name: Lys-Leu-Ser
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-lysine, L-leucine and L-serine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Glu-Glu-Leu
definition: A tripeptide composed of two L-glutamic acid residues and an L-leucine residue joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Glu-Glu-Lys
definition: A tripeptide containing two L-glutamic acid residues and an L-lysine residue joined in sequence.

name: 3,7-dihydroxytropolone
definition: A cyclic ketone that is tropolone in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 7 are substituted by hydroxy groups. It is isolated from the soil bacterium Streptomyces tropolofaciens strain K611-97.

name: gibepyrone A
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 6 are replaced by methyl and (2E)-2-buten-2-yl groups, respectively. It is a mycotoxin produced by the rice pathogen Fusarium fujikuroi.

name: lasalocid(1−)
definition: A member of the class of benzoates that is the conjugate base of lasalocid, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Glu-Asp-Arg
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, L-aspartic acid, and L-arginine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: jawsamycin
definition: A polyketide that is 5'-amino-5'-deoxy-3,4,5,6-tetrahydrouridine in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group is substituted by a (1E,3E)-1-[(1R,1'R,1''R,1'''R,2S,2'R,2''R,2'''S)-2'''-{(E)-2-[(1R,2R)-2-methylcyclopropyl]ethenyl}[1,1':2',1'':2'',1'''-quater(cyclopropan)]-2-yl]-5-oxopenta-1,3-dien-5-yl group. It is a metabolite isolated from the bacterium, Streptoverticillium fervens and targets the catalytic subunit of the fungal UDP-glycosyltransferase, the first step in the biosynthesis of glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI) anchors. It exhibits broad spectrum antifungal activity against several pathogenic fungi including Mucorales.

name: (S)-(+)-1-indanol
definition: An indan-1-ol in which the carbon bearing the hydroxy group has S configuration.

name: shanorellin
definition: A member of the class monohydroxy-1,4-benzoquinones that is 1,4-benzoquinone in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 3, 5 and 6 are replaced by hydroxy, methyl, methyl and hydroxymethyl groups, respectively. It is a secondary metabolite synthesized by several fungi of the Ascomycota phylum.

name: asperlactone
definition: A member of the class of butenolides that is furan-2(5H)-one substituted by (2S,3S)-3-methyloxiran-2-yl and (1S)-1-hydroxyethyl group at positions 3 and 5R, respectively. It is a secondary metabolite isolated from Aspergillus ochraceus that exhibits antifungal and antibacterial properties.

name: aspyrone
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is 5,6-dihydro-2H-pyran-2-one in which the hydrogens at positions 3, 5S and 6R are replaced by (2S,3S)-3-methyloxiran-2-yl, hydroxy and methyl groups, respectively. It is a fungal metabolite isolated from Aspergillus melleus and exhibits nematicidal, antibacterial and antifungal properties.

name: streptazone E
definition: A member of the class of cyclopentapyridines that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-cyclopenta[b]pyridine substituted by an oxo group at position 4 and by a (2E)-but-2-en-1-ylidene group at position 5. It is a polyketide natural product found in Streptomyces sp.

name: 2-methyl-1-tetralone
definition: A member of the class of tetralins that is tetralin in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 2 are replaced by oxo and methyl groups, respectively.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide unit consisting of α-D-galactosyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl and (at the reducing end) N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues all linked (1→3), to the β-galactosyl residue is linked also (1→2) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: curacomycin
definition: A homodetic cyclic peptide found in several Streptomyces species, consisting of 3-hydroxyasparagine, L-ornithine, L-isoleucine, D-leucine, D-valine and 5-chloro-L-tryptophan joined in sequence in a cyclic arrangement by peptide linkages. It exhibits antibacterial properties.

name: curacozole
definition: An azamacrocycle obtained from a core peptide of sequence Phe-Ile-Ile-Gly-Ser-Thr-Cys-Cys encoded in the genome of several Streptomyces species. It exhibits potent cytotoxic activity against HCT116 and HOS cancer cells.

name: tabtoxin
definition: A monobactam phytotoxic dipeptide produced by Pseudomonas syringae, that causes wildfire disease in tobacco.

name: florylpicoxamid
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-{[3-(acetyloxy)-4-methoxypyridin-2-yl]carbonyl}-L-alanine with the hydroxy group of (2S)-1,1-bis(4-fluorophenyl)propan-2-ol. It is a fungicide introduced by Dow AgroSciences for the control of a wide variety of pathogens such as Septoria spp, Powdery Mildews, Botrytis spp, and others in cereals, vines, fruits, nuts and vegetables.

name: bis(S-citronellalthiosemicarbazonato)nickel(II)
definition: A nickel coordination entity that is (S)-citronellalthiosemicarbazonate complexed with nickel in a 2:1 ratio. It induces apoptosis and exhibits anticancer properties.

name: 5-[[3-(1-phenylethoxy)-4-(2-phenylethoxy)phenyl]methylene]-4-oxo-2-thioxo-3-thiazolidineacetic acid
definition: A member of the class of thiazolidinones that is 2-sulfanylidene-1,3-thiazolidin-4-one in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 5 are replaced by carboxymethyl and 3-(1-phenylethoxy)-4-(2-phenylethoxy)benzylidene groups, respectively. It is an inhibitor of protein mannosyl transferase 1 (PMT1) and blocks protein O-mannosylation.

name: SGC-CK2-1
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine which is substituted at positions 3, 5, and 7 by cyano, (4-methyl-3-propanamidophenyl)nitrilo and cyclopropylnitrilo groups, respectively. It is a potent and selective chemical probe for the pleiotropic kinase CK2.

name: {[6-(1-benzothiophen-2-yl)thieno[3,2-d]pyrimidin-4-yl]sulfanyl}acetic acid
definition: A thienopyrimidine that is thieno[3,2-d]pyrimidine which is substituted by a (carboxymethyl)sulfanediyl group at position 4 and by a 1-benzothiophen-2-yl group at position 6. It is a STK17B kinase inhibitor.

name: SGC-CLK-1
definition: A pyrazolopyridazine that is pyrazolo[1,5-b]pyridazine which is substituted by a 2-[3-methoxy-5-(trifluoromethyl)anilino]pyrimidin-4-yl group at position 3 and by a methoxy group at position 6. It is a human GSK-3β, CDK2, CDK4, CLK1, CLK2, and CLK4 kinase inhibitor.

name: 2-cyclopentyl-4-[5-(3-methylphenyl)furo[2,3-b]pyridin-3-yl]benzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of furopyridines that is furo[2,3-b]pyridine substituted by a 4-carboxy-3-cyclopentylphenyl group at position 3 and by a 3-methylphenyl group at position 5. It is an inhibitor of CAMKK2 kinase (IC50 = 30nM).

name: norloline
definition: A loline alkaloid with formula C7H12N2O. It is isolated from the plants Lolium cuneatum and Lolium temulentum.

name: loline
definition: A loline alkaloid with formula C8H14N2O.

name: thiolutin
definition: A dithiolopyrrolone antibiotic that is 4,5-dihydro[1,2]dithiolo[4,3-b]pyrrole in which the hydrogens at positions 4,5 and 6 have been replaced by methyl, oxo and acetamido groups, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of RNA polymerases, inhibits the angiogenesis of human umbilical vein endothelial cells, and also inhibits JAMM metalloproteases.

name: holomycin
definition: A dithiolopyrrolone antibiotic that is 4,5-dihydro[1,2]dithiolo[4,3-b]pyrrole in which the hydrogens at positions 5 and 6 have been replaced by oxo and acetamido groups, respectively. It is an inhibitor of DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, and exhibits antibacterial and antitumour properties.

name: aureothricin
definition: A dithiolopyrrolone antibiotic that is 4,5-dihydro[1,2]dithiolo[4,3-b]pyrrole in which the hydrogens at positions 4,5 and 6 have been replaced by methyl, oxo and propanoylamino groups, respectively. It is a moderate antimicrobial by-product of the thiolutin fermentation in various Streptomyces species.

name: pyoluteorin
definition: A member of the class of resorcinols that is resorcinol in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a 4,5-dichloro-1H-pyrrole-2-carbonyl group. It is a natural product found in Pseudomonas fluorescens which exhibits antibacterial properties and is a strong inducer of caspase-3-dependent apoptosis.

name: tropodithietic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is 8,9-dithiabicyclo[5.2.0]nona-1,3,6-triene substituted by a carboxy group at position 2 and an oxo group at position 3. It is a broad spectrum antibiotic produced by the marine bacterium Phaeobacter inhibens that also acts as a signalling molecule at lower concentrations.

name: (S)-citronellalthiosemicarbazonate
definition: A thiosemicarbazone resulting from the formal condensation of the formyl group of (S)-(−)-citronellal with the non-thioacylated amino group of hydrazinecarbothioamide.

name: N-{3-[(5-cyclopropyl-2-{[3-methyl-1-(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl)-1H-pyrazol-4-yl]amino}pyrimidin-4-yl)amino]propyl}cyclobutanecarboxamide
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is pyrimidine in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 4 and 5 have been replaced by [3-methyl-1-(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl)-1H-pyrazol-4-yl]nitrilo, {3-[(cyclobutylcarbonyl)amino]propyl}nitrilo, and cyclopropyl groups, respectively.

name: BI00048423
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 4,5-dihydro-1H-[1,3]thiazolo[4,5-g]indazole which is substituted at positions 1, 3 and 7 by 2-chlorophenyl, pyridin-3-yl, and [(1H-imidazol-2-ylmethyl)carbamoyl]amino groups, respectively.

name: tetrahydropentoxyline
definition: A member of the class of β-carbolines that is 2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-β-carboline in which a hydrogen at positions 1 and 3 have been replaced by a (5S)-D-arabinityl and carboxy groups, respectively. It is a metabolite found in human urine.

name: cyproflanilide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is benzene in which the hydrogens at positions 1, 2 and 3 are substituted by [2-bromo-4-(1,1,1,2,3,3,3-heptafluoropropan-2-yl)-6-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]aminocarbonyl, fluoro, and (cyclopropylmethyl)(4-fluorobenzoyl)nitrilo groups, respectively. It is an insecticide developed by CAC Shanghai International Trading Co Ltd., China.

name: virensol B
definition: A member of the class of hydroxybenzyl alcohols that is 2-(hydroxymethyl)phenol in which the hydrogen at position 3 is substituted by a (1E,3E,5E)-undeca-1,3,5-trien-1-yl group.

name: methylprednisolone 21-suleptanic acid ester
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the 21-hydroxy group of 6α-methylprednisolone with the carboxy group of 8-[methyl(2-sulfoethyl)amino]-8-oxooctanoic acid.

name: methylprednisolone 21-suleptanic acid ester(1−)
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of methylprednisolone 21-suleptanic acid ester, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1,3-dichloroacetone
definition: A ketone that is propan-2-one in which a hydrogen at positions 1 and 3 have been replaced by chloro groups. It is used in the synthesis of citric acid. Also used as a solvent and as an intermediate in organic synthesis.

name: hexyl hexanoate
definition: A hexanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexanoic acid (caproic acid) with hexan-1-ol. It is a constituent found in passion fruit, apples, strawberries and wine.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide made up from one α-L-fucose residue, two β-D-galactose residues, two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues and one D-glucose residue (at the reducing end).

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide made up from four N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues, two α-D-mannose residues, one β-D-mannose residue and (at the reducing end) one N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residue.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide consisting of a tetrasaccharide backbone of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked sequentially (1→4), in which the mannosyl residue carries via a (1→6) linkage an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl trisaccharide unit, as well as an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl disaccharide unit via a (1→3) linkage.

name: phloxine O
definition: A xanthene dye that is fluorescein in which the hydrogens at positions 2',4',5' and 7' are replaced by bromo groups, and the hydrogens at positions 4,5,6 and 7 are replaced by chloro groups. It is a red synthetic pigment which is widely used in colored cosmetics (e.g. lipsticks and blushers).

name: novolactone
definition: A natural product isolated from a fungal strain closely related to Aporospora terricola. It is an allosteric inhibitor of Hsp70.

name: rohitukine
definition: A member of the class of chromones that is 4H-chromen-4-one in which the hydrogens at positions 2,5,7 and 8 are replaced by methyl, hydroxy, hydroxy, and (3S,4R)-3-hydroxy-1-methylpiperidin-4-yl groups, respectively. It is an alkaloid initially isolated from Amoora rohituka and is a precursor of the anti-cancer compound flavopiridol.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino decasaccharide consisting of a tetrasaccharide backbone of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked sequentially (1→4), in which the mannosyl residue carries via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl trisaccharide units.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-{β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Man-(1→3)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tetradecasaccharide derivative consisting of a tetrasaccharide chain of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues, all linked sequentially (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which are also linked β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl and β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl units via (1→6) and (1→3) linkages respectively.

name: 6-methoxynaphthalene-1-carbonitrile
definition: A member of the class of naphthalenes that is naphthalene in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 6 are replaced by cyano and methoxy groups, respectively.

name: CG-1521
definition: An enamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2E,4E,6E)-7-phenylhepta-2,4,6-trienoic acid with the amino group of hydroxylamine. It is an inhibitor of histone deacetylase (HDAC) which exhibits anticancer properties.

name: poacic acid
definition: A hydroxycinnamic acid that is (2E)-3-phenylprop-2-enoic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 3, 4 and 5 are replaced by 2-(4-hydroxy-3-methoxyphenyl)ethenyl, hydroxy and methoxy groups, respectively. It is a natural product found in maize bran which exhibits antifungal activities against several fungal and oomycete pathogens including Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, Alternaria solani, and Phytophthora sojae. It inhibits β-1,3-glucan synthesis in cells walls resulting in rapid cell lysis.

name: premycofactocinol
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolines that is 2-pyrroline in which the hydrogens at positions 2,3,4,4, and 5 are replaced by hydroxy, hydroxy, methyl, methyl, and (4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl groups, respectively. It results from the reduction of premycofactocin by oxidoreductases.

name: 2-[4-[(E)-2-(6,8-dichloro-2-phenyl-2H-chromen-3-yl)ethenyl]phenyl]-4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-1,3,2-dioxaborolane
definition: A member of the class of chromenes that is 2H-chromene substituted at positions 2,3,6 and 8 by phenyl, 2-[4-(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-1,3,2-dioxaborolan-2-yl)phenyl]ethenyl, chloro and chloro groups, respectively. It is a potent retinoic acid receptor α agonist (Kd = 14nM) designed for the treatment of kidney disease.

name: ammonium persulfate
definition: An inorganic ammonium salt in which two of the terminal hydroxy groups of peroxydisulfuric acid are deprotonated and associated with ammonium ions as counter-cations.

name: 2,5-diaminotoluene sulfate
definition: An organic sulfate salt obtained by combining 2,5-diaminotoluene with one molar equivalent of sulfuric acid; occurs as an intermediate during hair dye formulation.

name: glyceryl monothioglycolate
definition: A thioglycolate ester resulting from esterification of thioglycolic acid with glycerol. As a component of developer solutions in permanent wave products, it is the second most frequent allergen in hairdressers and avoidance of acid permanent waves is mandatory.

name: fujikurin D
definition: A pyrandione that is dihydro-2H-pyran-2,4(3H)-dione in which the hydrogens at positions 3, 5 and 6 are substituted by 1-hydroxy-2-methylbutylidene, methyl, and methyl groups, respectively. It is a natural product isolated from the fungus Fusarium fujikuroi.

name: pyrrolomycin A
definition: A member of the class of pyrroles that is 1H-pyrrole which is substituted by chloro groups at positions 2 and 3 and by a nitro group position 4. It is the simplest member of the pyrrolomycins, a family of natural products found in several species of the Streptomyces genus. The compound is active against Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria and some genera of fungi.

name: cacibiocin A
definition: An aminocoumarin resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of pyrrole-2,5-dicarboxylic acid with the amino group of 3-amino-4,7-dihydroxycoumarin. It is a natural product isolated from Catenulispora acidiphila that doesn't exhibit an antimicrobial activity contrary to most aminocoumarins.

name: ammonium thioglycolate
definition: An organic ammonium salt having thioglycolate(1−) as the counterion. Also known as perm salt, it has use in perming hair.

name: resorcinol monobenzoate
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of benzoic acid with resorcinol.

name: beraprost(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is conjugate base of beraprost, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-toloxatone
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of toloxatone.

name: (S)-toloxatone
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of toloxatone.

name: 5-(hydroxymethyl)-3-(3-methylphenyl)-1,3-oxazolidin-2-one
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidinones that is 5-(hydroxymethyl)-1,3-oxazolidin-2-one substituted by a 3-methylphenyl group at position 3.

name: (1S,2R)-ritodrine
definition: A 4-[2-[[1-hydroxy-1-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propan-2-yl]amino]ethyl]phenol that has (1S,2R)-configuration.

name: D-GlcpN-(1↔1)-D-Galp
definition: A glycosyl glycoside derivative consisting of a 2-amino-2-deoxy-D-glucopyranose residue and a D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1↔1) glycosidic bond.

name: D-Glcp-(1↔1)-D-Xylp
definition: A glycosyl glycoside D-xylopyraonse and D-glucopyranose joined by a (1↔1) glycosidic linkage.

name: D-Glcp-(1↔1)-D-Galp
definition: A glycosyl glycoside consisting of a D-glucopyranose residue and a D-galactopyranose residue joined by a (1↔1) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-L-Fucp
definition: A glycosylfucose consisting of a β-D-glucopyranose residue and a β-L-fucopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-L-lyxofuranose
definition: An L-lyxofuranonse that has β configuration at the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1↔1)-α-D-Xylp
definition: A glycosyl glycoside consisting of α-D-glucopyranose and α-D-xylopyranose residues joined by a (1↔1) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Galf
definition: A glycosyl galactose consisting of an α-D-glucopyranose residue and a β-D-galactofuranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Xylf-(1→2)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a β-D-xylofuranose residue, a β-D-mannopyranose residue and two 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residues joined in sequence by (1→2), (1→4) and (1→4) glycosidic bonds.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→6)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of a β-D-xylopyranose residue and an α-D-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide in which a tetrasaccharide backbone consisting of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and β-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4), the galactose residue at the non-reducing end of which carries via a (1→6) linkage a trisaccharide side-chain comprising N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked (2→6) and (1→4).

definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a hexadecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear hexasaccharide units [linked (1→3) and (1→6)], while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→6)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide comprising two N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residues linked (1→6).

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-β-D-Galp
definition: A tetrasaccharide that is α-L-fucopyranosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 of the galactopyranose moiety bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has been glycosylated by a molecule of α-L-fucopyranose.

name: α-D-Xylp-(1→3)-D-Glcp
definition: A glycosylglucose consisting of an α-D-xylopyranose residue and a F-glucopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: 1-O-D-glucopyranosyl-D-mannitol
definition: A glycosyl alditol consistion of a D-glucopyranose and a D-manitol residue joined in sequence by a (1→1) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-α-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-α-D-glucosamine residues linked glycosidically in a (1→3), (1→3) and (1→4) sequence.

A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a docosasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear nonasaccharide units [linked (1→3) and (1→6)], while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: enoxacin
definition: A 1,8-naphthyridine derivative that is 1,4-dihydro-1,8-naphthyridine with an ethyl group at the 1 position, a carboxy group at the 3-position, an oxo sustituent at the 4-position, a fluoro substituent at the 5-position and a piperazin-1-yl group at the 7 position. An antibacterial, it is used in the treatment of urinary-tract infections and gonorrhoea.

name: D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Galp
definition: A partially-defined glycan that is α-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been glycosylated to give the corresponding D-glucopyranoside.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-glucosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→4) and (1→6).

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting at the non-reducing end of a β-D-galactosyl residue joined through a (1→3) glycosidic linkage to N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactose.

name: α-D-Galf-(1→2)-β-D-Galp
definition: A galactobiose consisting of an α-D-galactofuranose residue and a β-D-galactopyrannose residue joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: D-Glcp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of a D-glucopyranose residue and a β-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: D-glucopyranose 3-sulfate
definition: A monosaccharide sulfate that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been converted to the corresponding hydrogen sulfate derivative.

name: β-D-Galf-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A galactobiose consisting of a β-D-galactofuranose residue and a β-D-galactopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→4)-D-glucopyranose
definition: A linear amino octasaccharide comprised of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4). It is found in human milk.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→2)-β-D-Manp
definition: A glycosylmannose consisting of an α-D-galactopyranose residue and a β-D-mannopyranose residue joined in sequence by a (1→2) glycosidic bond.

name: taltirelin tetrahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the tetrahydrate form of taltirelin. It activates neuronal cells by promoting the release and turnover of neurotransmitters (acetylcholine, dopamine) and its nerve growth factor-like action. The drug is approved in Japan and used to treat ataxia (daily activities such as gait, eating, and conversation) in patients suffering from spinocerebellar degeneration.

name: isotrichodermol
definition: A trichothecene mycotoxin produced by Fusarium graminearum. It is a biosynthetic precursor in the synthesis of T2-toxin.

name: buzepide
definition: A member of the class of azepanes that is 2-phenylacetamide in which the methylene hydrogens at position 2 are replaced by a phenyl group and an aminocarbonyl group. It inhibits gastric juice secretion.

name: buzepide(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of buzepide, resulting from the protonation of the azepane tertiary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (1R,2S)-cicloxilic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-2-phenylcyclohexanecarboxylic acid that has (1R,2S)-stereoconfiguration.

name: (1S,2R)-cicloxilic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy-2-phenylcyclohexanecarboxylic acid that has (1S,2R)-stereoconfiguration.

name: 2-hydroxy-2-phenylcyclohexanecarboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of cyclohexanols that is cyclohexane substituted by carboxy, hydroxy and phenyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 2, respectively.

name: S. pneumoniae serotype 14 capsular oligosaccharide derivative
definition: A synthetic oligosaccharide derivative in which three β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-(1→6)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc tetrasaccharide units are linked through N-pentylpentanamide linkers, with a 5-aminopentyl spacer group attached to the GlcNAc residue within the terminal unit. Synthesised as a spacer-bridged oligosaccharide mimic of the capsular polysaccharide of Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype 14, the 5-aminopentyl spacer group affords a method of linking to the CRM197 carrier protein, a genetically detoxified form of diphtheria toxin.

name: (aminooxy)acetate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (aminooxy)acetic acid, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: Glu-Gly-Arg-chloromethylketone
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, glycine and L-arginine joined in sequence by peptide linkages and in which the carboxy terminus is substituted by a chloroacetyl group. It is a potent and irreversible inhibitor of urokinase-type plasminogen activator (uPA) and factor Xa.

name: β-D-Galp6S-(1→3)-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino disaccharide comprised of 6-O-sulfo-β-D-galactose linked (1→3) to N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-D-glucosamine.
