definition: A branched 14-residue amino oligosaccharide comprising a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide backbone, to the mannosyl residue are connected α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl and α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl units via (1→2) and (1→6) linkages respectively.

name: cefminox(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups and protonation of the primary amino group of cefminox. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: prednisolone succinate(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester(1−) that is the conjugate base of prednisolone succinate resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (2S,3R)-bifluranol
definition: A 4,4'-pentane-2,3-diylbis(2-fluorophenol) that has (2S,3R)-stereoconfiguration.

name: (2R,3S)-bifluranol
definition: A 4,4'-pentane-2,3-diylbis(2-fluorophenol) that has (2R,3S)-stereoconfiguration.

name: 4,4'-pentane-2,3-diylbis(2-fluorophenol)
definition: A polyphenol that is 4,4'-(ethane-1,2-diyl)diphenol substituted by fluoro groups at positions 2 and 2', a methyl group at position 2 and an ethyl group at position 3.

name: tomaymycin
definition: A pyrrolobenzodiazepine that is (11aS)-2,3,5,10,11,11a-hexahydro-1H-pyrrolo[2,1-c][1,4]benzodiazepine which is substituted at positions 2,5,7,8 and 11R by ethylidene, oxo, methoxy, hydroxy and methoxy groups, respectively. It is a natural product of Streptomyces achromogenes that binds covalently with guanine in the minor groove of DNA. It is an antitumoral compound which is active in ovarian, plasmacytoma, and leukemia cancer cell lines at nanomolar concentrations.

name: vanchrobactin
definition: A catechol-type natural product that is composed of 2,3-dihydroxybenzoic acid, D-arginine and L-serine joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is a siderophore synthesized by the bacterial fish pathogen Vibrio anguillarum.

name: althiomycin
definition: A peptide antibiotic isolated from soil and enteric bacteria. It is a protein synthesis inhibitor which exhibits antibacterial activity against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.

name: lymphostin
definition: A member of the class of pyrroloquinolines that is pyrrolo[4,3,2-de]quinoline in which the hydrogens at positions 4, 6 and 8 are replaced by (1E)-1-methoxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-3-yl, acetylamino and amino groups, respectively. It is an alkaloid isolated from Streptomyces and Salinispora species, exhibits potent immunosuppressive activity, and inhibits Fyn and Lck protein kinases.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched 17-residue amino oligosaccharide comprising a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine trisaccharide backbone, to the mannosyl residue are connected α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl and α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl units via (1→2) and (1→6) linkages respectively.

name: 5-hydroxy-4',7-dimethoxyflavanone
definition: A dimethoxyflavanone that is naringenin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4' and 7 are replaced by methoxy groups.

name: 4-methylcyclohexanemethanol
definition: An alicyclic primary alcohol that is cyclohexane substituted by a hydroxy methyl group and methyl group at positions 1 and 4. It acts as a hydrotrope, solubilizing hydrophobic substances in aqueous environments. It also prevents protein aggregation, alters membrane dynamics and metal homeostasis, and is used in a flotation process for cleaning and processing coal.

name: 4-(2-amino-3-hydroxyphenyl)-2,4-dioxobutanoate
definition: A dioxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 4-(2-amino-3-hydroxyphenyl)-2,4-dioxobutanoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: N7-methyl-GpppA
definition: A guanosine 5'-phosphate that is 7-methyl-GTP(1+) in which the hydroxy group of the terminal phosphate is substituted by an adenosyl group. It is a cap analog that can be incorporated into mRNA.

name: sulbactam sodium
definition: The organic sodium salt of sulbactam.

name: Ala-Cys
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-alanine with the amino group of L-cysteine.

name: Arg-Gly
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-arginine with the amino group of glycine.

name: Cys-Arg
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-cysteine with the amino group of L-arginine.

name: Gln-Ser
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-glutamine with the amino group of L-serine.

name: Glu-Arg
definition: A dipeptide composed of L-glutamic acid and L-arginine joined by a peptide linkage.

name: Pro-Cys
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-proline acid with the amino group of L-cysteine.

name: Thr-Asn
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-threonine with the amino group of L-asparagine.

name: Thr-Lys
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-threonine with the amino group of L-lysine.

name: Tyr-Cys
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-tyrosine with the amino group of L-cysteine.

name: Ala-Leu-Ala
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-alanine, L-leucine and L-alanine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Ile-Leu-Pro
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-isoleucine, L-lrucine, and L-proline joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: 7,8-dichloro-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline
definition: A 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline hacing chloro substituents at the 7- and 8-positions.

name: aminophenazone
definition: A pyrazolone that is 1,2-dihydro-3H-pyrazol-3-one substituted by a dimethylamino group at position 4, methyl groups at positions 1 and 5 and a phenyl group at position 2. It exhibits analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties.

name: Met-Phe-Met
definition: A tripeptide consisting of L-methionine, L-phenylalanine and L-methionine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: aztreonam
definition: A synthetic monocyclic β-lactam antibiotic (monobactam), used primarily to treat infections caused by Gram-negative bacteria. It inhibits mucopeptide synthesis in the bacterial cell wall, thereby blocking peptidoglycan crosslinking.

name: bispyribac(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of bispyribac, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-cis,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: Trianion of 2-cis,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Glu-Arg-Gly
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, L-arginine, and glycine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Ser-Asp-Lys
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-serine, L-aspartic acid and L-lysine amino acids joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Thr-Pro-Pro
definition: A tripeptide composed of one L-threonine and two L-proline units joined by peptide linkages.

name: triclosan
definition: An aromatic ether that is phenol which is substituted at C-5 by a chloro group and at C-2 by a 2,4-dichlorophenoxy group. It is widely used as a preservative and antimicrobial agent in personal care products such as soaps, skin creams, toothpaste and deodorants as well as in household items such as plastic chopping boards, sports equipment and shoes.

name: Tyr-Ile-Leu
definition: A tripeptide composed of L-tyrosine, L-isoleucine, and L-leucine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: 2,4,6-trihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: A trihydroxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 4 and 6.

name: methyl 3-hydroxybenzoate
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-hydroxybenzoic acid with methanol.

name: 2,3-dinor-TXB1
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is thromboxane B1 which is lacking two methylenes in the carboxyalkyl chain. It is a urinary metabolite of thromboxane B2.

name: 5,8,11-eicosatrienoic acid
definition: An icosatrienoic acid with three bonds at positions 5, 8 and 11.

name: nonan-3-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is nonane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: heptan-4-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is heptane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: pentyl octanoate
definition: An octanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of carboxy group of octanoic acid with pentan-1-ol.

name: 1,4-dimethylcyclohexane
definition: A cycloalkane that is cyclohexane substituted by a methyl group at positions 1 and 4.

name: 2,3,4-trimethylpentane
definition: An alkane that is pentane substituted by a methyl group at positions 2,3 and 4. It is a constituent of gasoline.

name: 3-ethylpentane
definition: An alkane that is pentane substituted by an ethyl group at position 3.

name: 3-ethyl-3-methyldecane
definition: An alkane that is decane in which the two methylene hydrogens at position 3 have been replaced by a methyl group and an ethyl group.

name: methylcyclohexane
definition: A cycloalkane that is cyclohexane substituted by a single methyl group.

name: N-acetyl-S-phenyl-L-cysteine
definition: The S-phenyl derivative of N-acetyl-L-cysteine. It is a urinary metabolite of benzene and used as a biomarker to assess benzene exposure.

name: trimellitic acid
definition: Benzene substituted at the 1,2, and 4 positions by carboxy groups.

name: 4-hydroxy-3-methylacetophenone
definition: A monohydroxyacetophenone that is acetophenone carrying methyl and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4, respectively.

name: ethyl 4-oxocyclohexanecarboxylate
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-oxocyclohexanecarboxylic acid with ethanol.

name: oxolan-3-one
definition: An oxalane substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: N-methyl-1-deoxynojirimycin
definition: A hydroxypiperidine that is duvoglustat in which the amino hydrogen is replaced by a methyl group. It is an inhibitor of α-glucosidase, an agonist of the glucose sensor SGLT3 and exhibits anti-HIV activity.

name: 3-(2,5-dimethoxyphenyl)propanoic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is 3-phenylpropionic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 of the phenyl ring are replaced by methoxy groups.

name: 3-phenylbutyric acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is butanoic acid substituted by a phenyl group at position 3.

name: 20α-dihydroprednisolone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisolone in which the oxo group at position 20 has been reduced to the corresponding α-hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of prednisolone.

name: EG00229
definition: A member of the class of thiophenes that is thiophene substituted by a carbonyl-L-arginine and (2,1,3-benzothiadiazole-4-sulfonyl)amino groups at positions 2 and 3. It is an inhibitor of the neuropilin-1 and VEGF-A interaction and a potential anti-cancer agent.

name: pentamethonium
definition: A quarternary ammonium cation that is cadaverine in which the terminal amino hydrogens are substituted methyl groups. Its bromide and iodide salt exhibits ganglionic blocking activity and used in the treatment of hypertension.

name: colforsin daropate
definition: A carboxylic ester resuting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N,N-dimethyl-β-alanine with the 6-hydroxy group of forskolin. It is an adenylate cyclase activator.

name: ochratoxin A(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is conjugate base of ochratoxin A, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: colforsin daropate(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of colforsin daropate, resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amine group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: dodeclonium
definition: An aromatic ether that is 4-chlorophenol in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a 2-[dodecyl(dimethyl)azaniumyl]ethoxy group.

name: MLN-4760
definition: A L-histidine derivative that is L-histidine in which a hydrogen of the primary amino group is substituted by a (1S)-1-carboxy-3-methylbutyl group and the ring NH group is substituted by a 3,5-dichlorobenzyl group. It is a potent and selective human angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) inhibitor (IC50 = 0.44 nM) which was in clinical development for the treatment of ulcerative colitis.

name: tachysterol 3
definition: A hydroxy seco-steroid that results from the photoisomerization of previtamin D3.

name: 2,3-dichlorobenzoic acid
definition: A chlorobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid in which the ring hydrogens at positions 2 and 3 are substituted by chloro groups.

name: 3,5-dichlorobenzoic acid
definition: A chlorobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid in which the ring hydrogens at positions 3 and 5 are substituted by chloro groups.

name: 3,5-dichlorobenzoate
definition: A chlorobenzoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 3,5-dichlorobenzoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,3,5-trichlorobenzoic acid
definition: A chlorobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid in which the ring hydrogens at positions 2,3 and 5 are substituted by chloro groups.

name: 3,4,5-trichlorobenzoic acid
definition: A chlorobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid in which the ring hydrogens at positions 3,4 and 5 are substituted by chloro groups.

name: 3-bromobenzoic acid
definition: A bromobenzoic acid carrying a single bromo subsituent at the 3-position.

name: 2,3-dichlorobenzoate
definition: A chlorobenzoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2,3-dichlorobenzoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-iodobenzoic acid
definition: An iodobenzoic acid with a single iodo substituent placed at the 3-position.

name: 2-amino-5-chlorobenzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of chlorobenzoic acids that is benzoic acid in which the ring hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 are replaced by amino and chloro groups, respectively.

name: 5-chloro-2-methylbenzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of chlorobenzoic acids that is benzoic acid in which the ring hydrogens at positions 2 and 5 are replaced by methyl and chloro groups, respectively.

name: 2-chlorobutane
definition: A chloroalkane that is butane which carries a chloro group at position 2.

name: hydroxytrimethylaminium
definition: A methylated tertiary amine that is trimethylammonium in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: 2,3,5-trichlorobenzoate
definition: A chlorobenzoate obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of 2,3,5-trichlorobenzoic acid. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a tetradecasaccharide derivative in which two N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-(1→3)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)]-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide units are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to the mannose residue of a β-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→6)]-N-acetyl-D-glucosamine branched tetrasaccharide.

name: 2,4-di-O-phospho-α-D-mannose
definition: A hexose phosphate that is α-D-mannose phosphorylated on O-2 and O-4.

name: 2,4-di-O-phospho-D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose
definition: A heptose derivative that is D-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose phosphorylated on O-2 and O-4.

name: aminoethyl nitrate
definition: A nitrate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of ethanolamine with the hydroxy group of nitric acid. It causes vasodilation by generating nitric oxide and is used for the treatment of angina pectoris and ischemic heart disease.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-7-dodecanamido-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-5,6-dihydroxy-N-(6-phenylhexyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(dodecanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(6-phenylhexyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: nucleocidin
definition: A nucleoside antibiotic that is 5'-O-sulfamoyladenosine in which the hydrogen atom at position 4' is replaced by a fluorine atom. It is a natural product synthesized by several Streptomyces species. It exhibits broad spectrum antibacterial activity, and also has a strong effect against Trypanosoma brucei, the protozoan parasite responsible for the African sleeping sickness.

name: 5-methoxytryptamine(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 5-methoxytryptamine obtained by the protonation of the primary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 3-D-galactosyl glycerol
definition: A D-galactosylglycerol in which consisting of D-galactopyranose joined to one of the primary hydroxy groups of glycerol by a glycosidic bond.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→6)]-β-D-Galp
definition: A galactotriose that is β-D-galactopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6 have been converted to the corresponding β-D-galactopyranosyl derivatives.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-icosanamido-N-(6-phenylhexyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(icosanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(6-phenylhexyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-hexacosanamido-N-(6-phenylhexyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(hexacosanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(6-phenylhexyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-octanamido-N-(4-phenylbutyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(octanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(6-phenylbutyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-hexacosanamido-N-(4-pentylphenyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(hexacosanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(4-pentylphenyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: 3-methylvaleric acid
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acid that is pentanoic acid which carries a methyl group at position 3.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-hexadecanamido-5,6-dihydroxy-N-(6-phenylhexyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(hexadecanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(6-phenylhexyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1

name: avenasterol
definition: A stigmastane sterol that is 5α-stigmastane carrying a hydroxy group at position 3β and double bonds at positions 7 and 24.

name: noradrenaline(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of noradrenaline, obtained by protonation of the primary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-octanamido-N-nonyloctanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(hexanoylamino)-8-(hexylamino)-8-oxo-octyl moiety at O-1.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-octanamido-N-(4-pentylphenyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(octanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(4-pentylphenyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: (5R,6S,7S)-5,6-dihydroxy-8-(α-D-galactosyloxy)-7-octanamido-N-(3-pentylphenyl)octanamide
definition: A synthetic α-galactosylsphingamide in which the galactose ring carries a (2S,3S,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-2-(octanoylamino)-8-oxo-8-[(3-pentylphenyl)amino]octyl moiety at O-1.

name: inpyrfluxam
definition: A member of the class of indanes that is indane substituted by methyl groups at positions 1,1 and 3R and by a [3-(difluoromethyl)-1-methyl-1H-pyrazole-4-carbonyl]amino group at position 4. It is a fungicide that is a Complex II succinate dehydrogenase inhibitor, which is a functional part of the tricarboxylic acid cycle and linked to the mitochondrial electron transport chain. It exhibits high efficacy against major plant diseases including Brown Rust on wheat, Net Blotch on barley, and Black Scurf on potato.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a branched tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which has also linked (1→3) to it an α-D-glucuronosyl residue. The 5-aminopentyl group at the reducing end is a spacer to enable further conjugation to a carrier protein for immunological studies.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A branched tetrasaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which has also linked (1→3) to it an α-D-glucuronosyl residue.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a branched hexasaccharide consisting of β-D-mannosyl, α-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the mannosyl residue proximal to the reducing end of which has also linked (1→3) to it an α-D-glucuronosyl residue. The 5-aminopentyl group at the reducing end is a spacer to enable further conjugation to a carrier protein for immunological studies.

name: β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A branched hexasaccharide consisting of β-D-mannosyl, α-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the mannosyl residue proximal to the reducing end of which has also linked (1→3) to it an α-D-glucuronosyl residue.

name: α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a branched heptasaccharide consisting of α-D-glucuronosyl, β-D-mannosyl, α-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the mannosyl residue proximal to the reducing end of which has also linked (1→3) to it an α-D-glucuronosyl residue. The 5-aminopentyl group at the reducing end is a spacer to enable further conjugation to a carrier protein for immunological studies.

name: α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A branched heptasaccharide consisting of α-D-glucuronosyl, β-D-mannosyl, α-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the mannosyl residue proximal to the reducing end of which has also linked (1→3) to it an α-D-glucuronosyl residue.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a branched octasaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl, α-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), with both mannosyl residues also having linked (1→3) to them α-D-glucuronosyl residues. The 5-aminopentyl group at the reducing end is a spacer to enable further conjugation to a carrier protein for immunological studies.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp
definition: A branched octasaccharide consisting of β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl, α-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), with both mannosyl residues also having linked (1→3) to them α-D-glucuronosyl residues.

name: (S)-mosapramine
definition: A 1'-[3-(3-chloro-10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepin-5-yl)propyl]hexahydro-2H-spiro[imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine-3,4'-piperidin]-2-one that has (S)-configuration.

name: (R)-mosapramine
definition: A 1'-[3-(3-chloro-10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepin-5-yl)propyl]hexahydro-2H-spiro[imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine-3,4'-piperidin]-2-one that has (R)-configuration.

name: 1'-[3-(3-chloro-10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepin-5-yl)propyl]hexahydro-2H-spiro[imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine-3,4'-piperidin]-2-one
definition: A dibenzoazepine that is 10,11-dihydro-5H-dibenzo[b,f]azepine which is substituted by chlorine at position 3 and in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a 3-(2-oxohexahydro-2H-spiro[imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine-3,4'-piperidin]-1'-yl)propyl group.

name: solanidine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group of solanidine. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: komodoquinone B
definition: A member of the class of tetracenequinones that is 7,8,9,10-tetrahydrotetracene-5,12-dione carrying hydroxy groups at positions 1, 6, 8S, 10S and 11 and a methyl group at position 8S. It is the aglycone of komodoquinone A which was isolated from the marine bacterium Streptomyces sp. KS3.

name: komodoquinone A
definition: An anthracycline that is komodoquinone B in which the hydroxy group at position 1 is replaced by a 3,6-dideoxy-3-(dimethylamino)-α-L-galactopyranoside group. First isolated from the marine bacterium Streptomyces sp. KS3, it induces neuronal cell differentiation in the neuroblastoma cell line.

name: fostriecin
definition: A structurally unique, naturally-occurring phosphate monoester isolated from the soil bacterium Streptomyces pulveraceus. It inhibits DNA topoisomerase II as well as several protein phosphatase including PP2A and PPA4, and exhibits potent antitumor activity against several cancer cell lines.

name: ochrindole A
definition: A bisindole alkaloid that is phenol bearing a 3,3-dimethylallyl group at position 4, two methoxy groups at positions 3 and 6, and two indol-3-yl groups at positions 2 and 5. It is a natural product isolated from the sclerotia of Aspergillus orbraceus, with moderate activity against some insects, as well as Gram-positive bacteria.

name: terreazepine
definition: A member of the class of benzazepines that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-1-benzazepine substituted by oxo groups at positions 2 and 5 and a o-aminobenzamido group at position 4. It is a secondary metabolite found in Aspergillus terreus.

name: levesquamide
definition: A polyketide-nonribosomal peptide with an isothiazolinone moiety found in Streptomyces sp. RKND-216. It has a strong selective activity against M. tuberculosis, with no cytotoxicity against mammalian cell lines.

name: biscognienyne B
definition: A member of the class of epoxides that is (1R,6S)-7-oxabicyclo[4.1.0]hept-3-ene substituted by 3-methylbut-2-en-1-yl, hydroxy, 2-methylbut-1-en-3-yn-4-yl, and hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2R, 3 and 5R. It is a meroterpenoid natural product synthesized by the Ascomycota fungus Biscogniauxia sp.

name: acrophiarin
definition: A cyclic hexapeptide echinocandin antibiotic with a myristoyl side chain. It is produced by a specific strain of Penicillium arenicola and exhibits antimycotic activity.

name: 3-penten-1-yne
definition: An enyne that is pentane which carries a triple bond at position 1 and a double bond at position 3.

name: 3-phenylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a phenyl group. It is a maillard reaction product identified in mushroom hydrolysates.

name: 2-heptylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a heptyl group. It is an effective inhibitor of chemical induced carcinogenesis.

name: benzo[d]isothiazol-3-one
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound based on a fused 1,2-thiazole and benzene bicyclic ring skeleton, with the S atom positioned adjacent to one of the positions of ring fusion.

name: ustiloxin B
definition: A heterodetic cyclic peptide with formula C26H39N5O12S produced by Ustilaginoidea virens fungi. It is an inhibitor of microtubule assembly.

name: 2-O-palmitoyl-2'-O-sulfo-3-O-[(2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethylhexadec-2-enoyl]-α,α-trehalose
definition: A sulfoglycolipid in which α,α-trehalose, sulfated at the 2'-position, is acylated at the 2-position with palmitoic acid, and at the 3-position with (2E,4S,6S,8S)-2,4,6,8-tetramethylhexadec-2-enoic acid.

name: quillate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of quillaic acid, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: quillaic acid 28-β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside that is quillaic acid in which the carboxy group at position 28 is substituted by a β-D-glucopyranoside group.

name: 5-nonen-2-one
definition: A methyl ketone that is nonan-2-one carrying a double bond at position 5.

name: spiropidion
definition: An azaspiro compound that is 1-methoxypiperidine which is fused at position 4 to the 5-position of a 1,5-dihydro-2H-pyrrol-2-one that is substituted at positions 1, 3 and 4 by methyl, 4-chloro-2,6-dimethylphenyl and (ethoxycarbonyl)oxy groups, respectively. It is a proinsecticide developed by Syngenta and used to protect a wide range of crops from some of the most damaging, difficult to control sucking pests such as aphids, whiteflies, Pysllids, armoured scales, soft scales, spider mites, rust mites, and red mites including California red scale, green peach aphid (Myzus persicae), tobacco whitefly etc.

name: L-ascorbic acid 2-phosphate
definition: An aldonolactone phosphate that is the 2-phosphate ester of L-ascorbic acid. It can stimulate collagen formation.

name: L-ascorbate 2-phosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion formed from L-ascorbic acid 2-phosphate by deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group and of both hydroxy groups of the phosphate function; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-oxocholestane
definition: A ketocholestane that is cholestane which carries an oxo group at position 3.

name: 25-hydroxy 3-oxocholestane
definition: A 25-hydroxy steroid that is 3-oxocholestane which carries a hydroxy group at position 25.

name: hexacyclonic acid
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is cyclohexane substituted by a hydroxymethyl and carboxymethyl groups at position 1.

name: hexacyclonate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of hexacyclonic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-naphthyl sulfate(1−)
definition: An aryl sulfate oxoanion resulting from the deprotonation of the sulfooxy group of 2-naphthyl sulfate . The major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: bisphenol A sulfate(1−)
definition: A phenyl sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of bisphenol A sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-isopropylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol which is carrying an isopropyl group at position 4.

name: 4-isopropylphenyl sulfate(1−)
definition: A phenyl sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 4-isopropylphenyl sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfate group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: GRL-0617
definition: A benzamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-amino-2-methylbenzoic acid with the amino group of (1R)-1-(naphthalen-1-yl)ethan-1-amine. It is a potent noncovalent inhibitor (IC50 = 600 nM) of severe acute respiratory syndrome-coronavirus papain-like protease (SARS-CoV PLpro).

name: preluffariellolide A
definition: A sesterterpenoid that is cyclohexane substituted by methyl, hydroxy, (2E,6E,10E)-1-hydroxy-3,7,11-trimethyltrideca-2,6,10-trien-13-yl, methyl and methyl groups at positions 1,1,2,3 and 3, respectively.

name: 4-isopropylphenyl sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is benzene substituted by a propan-2-yl group at position 1 and by a sulfooxy group at position 4.

name: N-butyl-5-(4-hydroxyphenyl)-6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyrazine-2-carboxamide
definition: A pyrazinecarboxamide in which a 6-oxo-1,6-dihydropyrazine nucleus is substituted on C-5 by a 4-hydroxyphenyl group and on C-2 by a butylcarbamyl group. A synthetic determinant of cefadroxil, it is a promising tool for determining in vitro cross-reactivity to cefadroxil in amoxicillin-allergic patients.

name: chlorthion
definition: An organic thiophosphate that is O,O-dimethyl O-phenyl phosphorothioate substituted by a chloro group at position 3 and a nitro group at position 4. It is a potent cholinesterase inhibitor and used as an insecticide for the control of a wide range of insects.

name: dopamine quinone(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of dopamine quinone, resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: fumisoquin A(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of fumisoquin A, obtained from the protonation of the amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: fumisoquin B zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the sulfate to the amino group of fumisoquin B; major species at pH 7.3.

name: fumisoquin C(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of fumisoquin C, obtained from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: nafarelin acetate
definition: An acetate salt obtained by reaction of nafarelin with one equivalent of acetic acid.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-Kdo
definition: A branched hexasaccharide consisting of a linear tetrasaccharide comprising β-D-galactose, two L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose (L-α-D-Hep) residues and a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulose (α-Kdo) residue linked in sequence (1→3), (1→3) and (1→5), to the L-α-D-Hep residue proximal to the reducing end is also linked (1→4) a β-D-glucose residue, while the α-Kdo residue also carries a second α-Kdo residue linked (2→-4). One of a number of chemoenzymatically synthesised oligosaccharides composed of the inner core oligosaccharide of Campylobacter jejuni extended by various ganglioside mimics.

name: 4-amino-5-chloro-2-ethoxy-N-({4-[(4-fluorophenyl)methyl]morpholin-2-yl}methyl)benzamide
definition: A benzamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-amino-5-chloro-2-ethoxybenzoic acid with the amino group of 1-[4-(4-fluorobenzyl)morpholin-2-yl]methanamine.

name: (R)-mosapride
definition: A 4-amino-5-chloro-2-ethoxy-N-({4-[(4-fluorophenyl)methyl]morpholin-2-yl}methyl)benzamide that has (R)-configuration.

name: (S)-mosapride
definition: A 4-amino-5-chloro-2-ethoxy-N-({4-[(4-fluorophenyl)methyl]morpholin-2-yl}methyl)benzamide that has (S)-configuration.

name: benzododecinium bromide
definition: The organic bromide salt of benzododecinium. It is a cationic surfactant that has antispetic and disinfectant properties.

name: benzododecinium chloride
definition: The organic chloride salt of benzododecinium. It has antiseptic and disinfectant properties, and used as a preservative in eye drop formulations.

name: (−)-zwittermicin A
definition: The (−)-enantiomer of zwittermicin A.

name: fumisoquin A
definition: A pyridoisoquinoline that is (11aR)-1,3,4,6,11,11a-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[1,2-b]isoquinoline substituted by hydoxy groups at positions 1S,7,8 and 11R, by an amino group at position 3S and an oxo group at position 4. It is produced by a biosynthetic gene cluster called fsq in the human pathogen Aspergillus fumigatus.

name: fumisoquin C
definition: An isoquinoline alkaloid produced by a biosynthetic gene cluster called fsq in the human pathogen Aspergillus fumigatus.

name: fumisoquin B
definition: A pyridoisoquinoline that is (11aR)-1,3,4,6,11,11a-hexahydro-2H-pyrido[1,2-b]isoquinoline substituted by hydoxy groups at positions 1S,7 and 11R, by an amino group at position 3S, oxo group at position 4 and a sulfooxy group at position 8. It is produced by a biosynthetic gene cluster called fsq in the human pathogen Aspergillus fumigatus.

name: 2-naphthyl sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is naphthalene in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a sulfooxy group.

name: bisphenol A sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is bisphenol A in which of the hydroxy groups is substituted by a sulfooxy group. It is a metabolite of bisphenol A that is excreted in human urine.

name: dextromethadone
definition: A 6-(dimethylamino)-4,4-diphenylheptan-3-one that has (S)-configuration. It is the less active enantiomer of methadone and has very little activity on opioid receptors and mainly responsible for the inhibition of hERG K+ channels and thus for cardiac toxicity. The drug is currently under clinical development for the treatment of major depressive disorder.

name: 6-(dimethylamino)-4,4-diphenylheptan-3-one
definition: A ketone that is heptan-3-one substituted by a dimethylamino group at position 6 and two phenyl groups at position 4.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→4)]-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-[α-Kdo-(2→4)]-α-Kdo
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of a linear pentasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid, β-D-galactose, two L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose (L-α-D-Hep) residues and a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulose (α-Kdo) residue linked in sequence (2→3), (1→3),(1→3), (1→3) and (1→5), to the L-α-D-Hep residue proximal to the reducing end is also linked (1→4) a β-D-glucose residue, while the α-Kdo residue also carries a second α-Kdo residue linked (2→-4). One of a number of chemoenzymatically synthesised oligosaccharides composed of the inner core oligosaccharide of Campylobacter jejuni extended by various ganglioside mimics.

name: KOM70144
definition: A benzamide that is GRL-0617 in which one of the hydrogen's of the primary amino group is replaced by an acetyl group. It an inhibitor of SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 papain-like protease (PLpro) with an IC50 of 2.6 μM and 5.0 μM, respectively. It also inhibits SARS-CoV and SARS-CoV-2 infection of Vero E6 cells in vitro (EC50 values are 13.1 and 21 μM, respectively).

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: An α-D-glucoside that is the 5-aminopentyl glycoside of a branched pentasaccharide consisting of α-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucosyl, β-D-mannosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which has also linked (1→3) to it an α-D-glucuronosyl residue. The 5-aminopentyl group at the reducing end is a spacer to enable further conjugation to a carrier protein for immunological studies.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp

name: (E)-tomaymycin
definition: The (E)-isomer of tomaymycin.

name: (Z)-tomaymycin
definition: The (Z)-isomer of tomaymycin.

name: tyrvalin
definition: A member of the class of pyrazinones that is pyrazin-2(1H)-one substituted by an isopropyl and (4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl groups at positions 3 and 6, respectively. It is a natural product found in Staphylococcus aureus.

name: phevalin
definition: A member of the class of pyrazinones that is pyrazin-2(1H)-one substituted by an isopropyl and benzyl groups at position 3 and 6, respectively. It is a natural product found in Staphylococcus aureus that inhibits calpain in a casein hydrolysis assay (IC50 = 1.3 μM), contributes to S. aureus infection in mice, and alters human keratinocyte gene expression.

name: leuvalin
definition: A member of the class of pyrazinones that is pyrazin-2(1H)-one substituted by isopropyl and isobutyl groups at positions 3 and 6, respectively. It is a natural product found in Staphylococcus aureus.

name: koraiol
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is tricyclo[7.2.0.02,5]undecane which is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6 and by methyl groups at positions 2, 6, 10 and 10 (the 1S,2R,5S,6S,9S-diastereoisomer). It is a sesquiterpenoid isolated from Pinus koraiensis.

name: 3-acetyl-2,5-dimethylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan substituted by methyl, acetyl and methyl groups at positions 2, 3 and 5, respectively.

definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of a linear pentasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine, β-D-galactose, two L-glycero-α-D-manno-heptose (L-α-D-Hep) residues and a 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulose (α-Kdo) residue linked in sequence (1→4), (1→3),(1→3) and (1→5), to the L-α-D-Hep residue proximal to the reducing end is also linked (1→4) a β-D-glucose residue, while the galactose residue also carries an N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid residue via a (2→3) linkage and the α-Kdo residue also carries a second α-Kdo residue linked (2→-4). One of a number of chemoenzymatically synthesised oligosaccharides composed of the inner core oligosaccharide of Campylobacter jejuni extended by various ganglioside mimics.

name: trichobrasilenol
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is (3aS,7aS)-octahydro-1H-indene substituted by a methyl group at positions 1S, 6 and 6, and by a 1-hydroxypropan-2-ylidene group at position 4. It is a sesquiterpenoid produced by a Trichoderma terpene cyclase.

name: monomethyl fumarate
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of fumaric acid with methanol. Is is a metabolite of dimethyl fumarate and used for the the treatment of patients with relapsing multiple sclerosis (MS). It also induces the NFE2L2 (Nrf2) transcription factor by binding to KEAP1.

name: stellatate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of stellatic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide consisting of a sequence of two N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid residues, a β-D-galactose residue, an N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residue, a further β-D-galactose residue abd a β-D-glucose residue linked in sequence (2→8), (2→3), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4). The oligosaccharide of ganglioside GD1c.

name: N-[(S)-lactoyl]-L-phenylalaninate
definition: A N-acyl-L-α-amino acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-[(S)-lactoyl]-L-phenylalanine obtained from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: avenanthramide B(1−)
definition: A hydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of avenanthramide B, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: domoate(2−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of domoic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy groups and protonation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: glutaric anhydride
definition: A cyclic dicarboxylic anhydride that is oxane which carries oxo groups at positions 2 and 6. It is used as an intermediate in the production of pharmaceuticals, corrosion inhibitors, and polymers (E.g. epoxy polyesters).

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp3S-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-D-Galp
definition: A sulfated branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of D-galactose at the reducing end with an α-L-fucosyl-(1→4)-[3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→4)-[β-D-Galp3S-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A sulfated branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of D-glucose at the reducing end with an α-L-fucosyl-(1→4)-[3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)]-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 4-position.

name: β-D-Galp3S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A sulfated linear amino tetrasaccharide consisting of D-glucose at the reducing end with a 3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl moiety attached at the 4-position.

name: 11-oxomiltiradiene(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of 11-oxomiltiradiene, arising from the deprotonation of the methylene group at position 14. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-pisiferate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (+)-pisiferic acid, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: miltiradien-20-al
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is miltiradiene which carries a formyl group at position 20. It is a metabolite of miltiradiene.

name: avenanthramide B
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of ferulic acid with the amino group of 2-amino-5-hydroxybenzoic acid. It is an oat phytoalexin produced in response to pathogen attack and elicitation.

name: 11-oxomiltiradiene
definition: An abietane diterpenoid that is miltiradiene in which the carbon at position 11 has been oxidised to the corresponding oxo group.

name: jasmolactone
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is tetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-one substituted by a pent-2-en-5-yl group at position 6. It is used as a flavouring agent and as an ingredient in perfumes.

name: (E)-6-(3-hexenyl)tetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-one
definition: A 6-(3-hexenyl)tetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-one in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: 6-(3-hexenyl)tetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-one
definition: A member of the class of 2-pyranones that is tetrahydro-2H-pyran-2-one substituted by a hex-3-en-1-yl group at position 6.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear hexasaccharide chain of β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose and two further N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→4), (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannose residue of which is also linked (1→6) a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide unit.

name: 2,3-dimethylsuccinic acid
definition: An α,ω-dicarboxylic acid that is succinic acid substituted by two methyl groups at positions 2 and 3 respectively.

name: (3R)-2,3-dimethylpentane
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2,3-dimethylpentane.

name: (3S)-2,3-dimethylpentane
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2,3-dimethylpentane.
