definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which is (1→4)-linked an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue, together with an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide unit linked (1→6) and an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl unit linked (1→3).

name: quiannulatene
definition: A sesterterpene that is produced by the heterologous expression of sesterterpene synthase EvQS from Aspergillus stellatus.

name: (E)-3-penten-1-yne
definition: A 3-penten-1-yne in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: (Z)-3-penten-1-yne
definition: A 3-penten-1-yne in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: 3-octene
definition: An octene that is octane containing one double bond at position 3.

name: 2-octene
definition: An octene that is octane containing one double bond at position 2.

name: 8-hydroxylaurate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 8-hydroxylauric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 10-hydroxylaurate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 10-hydroxylauric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-hydroxylaurate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9-hydroxylauric acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 9-hydroxymyristate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 9-hydroxymyristic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 10-hydroxymyristate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 10-hydroxymyristic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 12-hydroxymyristate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 12-hydroxymyristic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11-hydroxymyristate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 11-hydroxymyristic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: ophiobolin C
definition: A sesterterpenoid that is ophiobolane with a hydroxy group at position 3, oxo group at positions 5, formyl group at position 7, and double bonds at positions 7-8 and 19-20.

name: soppiline B
definition: A member of the class of resorcinols that is 5-heptadecylbenzene-1,3-diol which carries cis double bonds at positions 2 and 6, trans double bonds at positions 4 and 15, and a methyl group at position 15.

name: soppiline C(1−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of soppiline C, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-dodecene
definition: A dodecene that is dodecane with a double bond at position 3.

name: cannabichromenate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of cannabichromenic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-dodecene
definition: A dodecene that is dodecane with a double bond at position 2.

name: (Z)-2-dodecene
definition: A 2-dodecene that is dodecane which has been dehydrogenated to introduce a cis double bond between positions 2 and 3.

name: cannabichromenic acid
definition: A chromenol that is 2H-chromene substituted by methyl, 2-methylpent-2-en-5-yl, hydroxy, carboxy and pentyl groups at positions 2,2,5,6 and 7, respectively.

name: soppiline A(1−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of soppiline A, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-{α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is an octadecasaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue [via a (1→4) linkage], an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched heptasaccharide unit [linked (1→6)], and an an N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl branched heptasaccharide unit [linked (1→3)].

name: neosaxitoxin
definition: A pyrrolopurine that is saxitoxin carrying a hydroxy substituent on the nitrogen atom at position 5. It is a sodium channel blocker that is undergoing clinical trials as a prolonged-duration local anesthetic.

name: soppiline A
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is icosanoic acid carrying a hydroxy group at position 3R, methyl group at position 18, cis double bonds at positions 5 and 9, and trans double bonds at positions 7 and 18.

name: soppiline C
definition: A member of the class of resorcinols that is 16-(3,5-dihydroxyphenyl)hexadecanoic acid which carries cis double bonds at positions 10 and 14, a trans double bond at position 12, and an ethylidene group at position 2.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a hexadecasaccharide derivative comprising a linear tetrasaccharide of β-D-mannose and three N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues at the reduciong end and the one proximal to it are each linked (1→6) L-fucosyl residues, while to the β-D-mannose residue of which are linked two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→3)]-[α-L-fucosyl-(1→2)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)]-α-D-mannosyl branched pentasaccharide units via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages.

name: maremycin G
definition: An indole alkaloid with formula C22H21N3O3S. It is a natural product synthesized by an NRPS/PKS system in Streptomyces sp. B917 and exhibits antifungal properties.

name: 8-hydroxylauric acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid comprising lauric acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 8.

name: 9-hydroxylauric acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid comprising lauric acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 9.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues, all linked (1→4), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine at the reducing of which is also linked (1→6) an L-fucose residue, while the mannose residue carries N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl units via (1→6) and (1→3) glycosidic linkages respectively.

name: 10-hydroxylauric acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid comprising lauric acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 10.

name: 9-hydroxymyristic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is myristic acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 9.

name: semaglutide
definition: A polypeptide that contains a linear sequence of 31 amino acids joined together by peptide linkages. It is an agonist of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptors (GLP-1 AR) and used for the treatment of type 2 diabetes.

name: kinanthraquinone
definition: A monohydroxyanthraquinone that is anthraquinone in which the hydrogen atoms at positions 1, 2, 5 and 6 are replaced hydroxy, 3-methylbut-3-enamidyl, methoxy and methoxy groups, respectively. It is a natural product isolated from Streptomyces sp. SN-593, and shows moderate cytotoxicity against HL-60 and NRK cells.

name: kinanthraquinone B
definition: A monohydroxyanthraquinone that is anthraquinone in which the hydrogen atoms at positions 1, 2, 5 and 6 are replaced hydroxy, 3-methylbut-3-enoic acid, methoxy and methoxy groups, respectively. It is a natural product isolated from Streptomyces sp. SN-593.

name: delgocitinib
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine substituted by a (3S,4R)-1-(cyanoacetyl)-3-methyl-1,6-diazaspiro[3.4]octan-6-yl group at position 4. It is a pan-Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor and is approved for treatment of atopic dermatitis (AD) in Japan.

name: cis-1,4-dimethylcyclohexane
definition: The cis-isomer of 1,4-dimethylcyclohexane.

name: trans-1,4-dimethylcyclohexane
definition: The trans-isomer of 1,4-dimethylcyclohexane.

name: naphthalene-1,8-diol
definition: A member of the class of naphthalenediols that is naphthalene in which the hydrogens at positions 1 and 8 are replaced by hydroxy groups.

name: 3-methylvalerate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-methylvaleric acid, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methylvalerate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-methylvaleric acid, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 11-hydroxymyristic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is myristic acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 11.

name: 10-hydroxymyristic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is myristic acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 10.

name: 12-hydroxymyristic acid
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid that is myristic acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 12.

name: cis-bisulepin
definition: The (Z)-isomer of dithiadene.

name: dithiadene
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 4,9-dihydrothieno[2,3-c][2]benzothiepine substituted by a 3-(dimethylamino)propylidene group at position 4.

name: 2-hydroxyethyl octadecanoate
definition: An octadecanoate ester obtained by formal condensation between the carboxy group of octadecanoic (stearic) acid and one of the hydroxy groups of ethylene glycol. It is an ingredient in many personal care products and cosmetics.

name: JTE-607 dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of JTE-607. It is a cytokine inhibitor which suppresses the production of proinflammatory cytokines such as interleukin (IL-1β), IL-6, IL-8, granulocyte macrophage colony stimulating factor (GM-CSF), and tumor necrosis factor (TNF-α). It acts as a pro-drug which is cleaved by carboxylesterase 1 (CES1) to its active free acid form, which then binds to cleavage and polyadenylation specificity factor 3 (CPSF3).

name: JTE-607 free base
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,5-dichloro-2-hydroxy-4-[2-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)ethoxy]benzoic acid with the amino group of ethyl L-phenylalaninate. It inhibits cytokine production in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC's) without causing immunosuppression.

name: JTE-607 zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion formed from JTE-607 by transfer of a proton from the hydroxy to the methylated amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: JTE-607(2+)
definition: An organic cation obtained by protonation of the two tertiary amino groups of JTE-607 free base.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-glucosyl and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→4) and (1→6).

name: AZT-1152
definition: A dihydrogen phosphate prodrug of a pyrazoloquinazoline aurora kinase inhibitor AZD1152-hydroxyquinazoline pyrazol anilide(HQPA) and is converted rapidly to the active AZD1152-HQPA in plasma.

name: 2-hydroxy-5-{1-hydroxy-2-[(4-phenylbutan-2-yl)amino]ethyl}benzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is benzamide substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2 and by a 1-hydroxy-2-[(4-phenylbutan-2-yl)amino]ethyl group at position 5.

name: (S,S)-labetalol
definition: A 2-hydroxy-5-{1-hydroxy-2-[(4-phenylbutan-2-yl)amino]ethyl}benzamide that has 1S,2S-configuration.

name: (R,S)-labetolol
definition: A 2-hydroxy-5-{1-hydroxy-2-[(4-phenylbutan-2-yl)amino]ethyl}benzamide that has 1R,2S-configuration.

name: (S,R)-labetolol
definition: A 2-hydroxy-5-{1-hydroxy-2-[(4-phenylbutan-2-yl)amino]ethyl}benzamide that has 1S,2R-configuration.

name: 1,3,5,2,4,6-triazatriphosphinine
definition: An inorganic heteromonocyclic compound that is 1,3,5-triazine in which the carbon atoms have been replaced by phosphorus atoms. It was one of a series of compounds which was being developed for use as a fire-resistant hydraulic fluid.

name: 2-methylvaleric acid
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acid that is pentanoic acid which carries a methyl group at position 2.

name: N-methyl-L-dopa
definition: The L-enantiomer of N-methyldopa.

name: N-methyl-D-dopa
definition: The D-enantiomer of N-methyldopa.

name: N-methyldopa
definition: A tyrosine derivative that is dopa in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a methyl group.

name: 1-deoxynojirimycin-1-sulfonic acid
definition: A hydroxypiperidine that is duvoglustat carrying a sulfo group at position 6β. It is an α-glucosidase inhibitor and an activator of the human glucose sensor SGLT3.

name: ASP-3026
definition: A member of the class of diamino-1,3,5-triazines that is 1,3,5-triazine-2,4-diamine in which the amino groups at positions 2 and 4 are respectively carrying 2-methoxy-4-[4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)piperidin-1-yl]phenyl and 2-(propan-2-ylsulfonyl)phenyl substituents. It is a potent inhibitor of anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK), Ack and ROS1 activity (IC50 values are 3.5, 5.8 and 8.9 nM respectively) and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: AZD1080
definition: A member of the class of hydroxyindoles that is 1H-indole substituted by hydroxy, 5-(morpholin-4-ylmethyl)pyridin-2-yl, and cyano groups at positions 2, 3 and 5, respectively. It is a potent, brain permeable inhibitor of human GSK3α and GSK3β with Ki of 6.9 nM and 31 nM, respectively. The drug was being developed by AstraZeneca for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease (clinical trial now discontinued).

name: AZD2858
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine substituted by (pyridin-3-yl)aminocarbonyl, amino, and 4-(4-methylpiperazine-1-sulfonyl)phenyl groups at positions 2, 3 and 6, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of GSK3α and GSK3β (IC50 values of 0.9 and 4.9 nM, respectively) and increases bone mass (via Wnt activation) in rats.

name: AZD3463
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a 2-[4-(4-aminopiperidin-1-yl)-2-methoxyanilino]-5-chloropyrimidin-4-yl group at position 3. It is an orally bioavailable dual inhibitor of ALK and IGF1R with Ki value of 0.75 nM for ALK.

name: BAYu9773
definition: A dicarboxylic acid that is that is (7E,9E,11Z,14Z)-icosa-7,9,11,14-tetraenoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4S and a (4-carboxyphenyl)sulfanediyl group at 5R. It is a dual cysteinyl leukotriene receptor antagonist that acts at the CysLT1 and CysLT2 receptors (IC50 = 0.44 and 0.30 μM, respectively).

name: BMS-214662
definition: A member of the class of benzodiazepines that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-1,4-benzodiazepine substituted by (1H-imidazol-5-yl)methyl, benzyl, (thiophen-2-yl)sulfonyl, and cyano groups at positions 1, 3R, 4 and 7, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of farnesyltransferase (IC50 = 1.35nM) which was under clinical development for the treatment of solid tumors.

name: brivanib alaninate
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-alanine with the hydroxy group of brivanib. It is a prodrug of brivanib (BMS-540215), a potent oral dual inhibitor of VEGFR-2 and FGFR-1 (IC50 of 25 nM and 148 nM, respectively) and was in development for the treatment of hepatocellular and colon carcinomas.

name: CHIR-98014
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is pyrimidine substituted by {2-[(6-amino-5-nitropyridin-2-yl)amino]ethyl}amino, 2,4-dichlorophenyl, and 1H-imidazol-1-yl groups at positions 2, 4 and 5, respectively. It is a potent ATP-competitive inhibitor of GSK3α and GSK3β (IC50 values of 0.65 and 0.58 nM, respectively).

name: CP-724714
definition: A 2-methoxy-N-[3-[4-[3-methyl-4-[(6-methyl-3-pyridinyl)oxy]anilino]-6-quinazolinyl]prop-2-enyl]acetamide in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration. It is a potent inhibitor of HER2/ErbB2 (IC50 = 10 nM) and exhibits anti-cancer activity.

name: GDC-0623
definition: A member of the class of imidazopyridines that is imidazo[1,5-a]pyridine substituted by (2-fluoro-4-iodophenyl)amino and (2-hydroxyethoxy)aminoacyl groups at positions 5 and 6. It is a potent ATP non-competitive inhibitor of MEK1 (Ki = 0.13nM) and also has efficacy against both mutant BRAF and mutant KRAS. It is in clinical development for treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors.

name: LB42908
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolecarboxamides that is 1H-pyrrole substituted by [1-(3a,7a-dihydro-1,3-benzodioxol-5-ylmethyl)-1H-imidazol-5-yl]methyl, (4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)carbonyl, and naphthalen-1-yl groups at positions 1, 3 and 4, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of Ras farnesyltransferase (IC50= 0.9nM against H-Ras and 2.4nM against K-Ras) with potential anticancer activity.

name: LY-2090314
definition: A member of the class of diazepinoindoles that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydro[1,4]diazepino[6,7,1-hi]indole substituted by piperidin-1-ylcarbonyl, 4-(imidazo[1,2-a]pyridin-3-yl)-2,5-dioxo-2,5-dihydro-1H-pyrrol-3-yl and fluoro groups at position 2, 7 and 9, respectively. It is a potent ATP-competitive inhibitor of glycogen synthase kinase-3 (GSK-3) with IC50 values of 1.5 nM and 0.9 nM for GSK-3α and GSK-3β. The drug is in clinical development for the treatment of advanced/metastatic cancer.

name: LY3009120
definition: A member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidine substituted by methylamino, 5-{[(3,3-dimethylbutyl)carbamoyl]amino}-4-fluoro-2-methylphenyl, and methyl groups at positions 2, 6 and 7, respectively. It is a potent pan RAF inhibitor which inhibits BRAFV600E, BRAFWT and CRAFWT (IC50 = 5.8, 9.1 and 15 nM, respectively). It also inhibits RAF homo- and heterodimers and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: MI-1148
definition: A tripeptide comprising of L-arginine, 3-methyl-L-valine and L-arginine joined in sequence by peptide linkages and in which the amino terminus is substituted by a [4-(carbamimidamidomethyl)phenyl]acetyl group and the carboxy terminus is substituted by a (4-carbamimidoylbenzyl)amino group. It is a highly potent inhibitor of furin endoprotease (Ki = 5.5 pM) that has anti-infectious activity.

name: MK-8353
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 1H-indazole substituted by a 6-(propan-2-yloxy)pyridin-3-yl group at position 3 and by a {[(3S)-3-(methylsulfanyl)-1-(2-{4-[4-(1-methyl-1H-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl)phenyl]-3,6-dihydropyridin-1(2H)-yl}-2-oxoethyl)pyrrolidin-3-yl]carbonyl}amino group at position 5. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of ERK1 and ERK2 in vitro (IC50 values of 23.0 nM and 8.8 nM, respectively). The drug is being developed by Merck Sharp & Dohme and is currently in clinical development for the treatment of advanced/metastatic solid tumors.

name: MP-A08
definition: A sulfonamide that consists of two moieties of 4-methyl-N-phenylbenzenesulfonamide connected to each other at position 2 by an aldimine linker. It is a ATP-competitive inhibitor of sphingosine kinase that targets both SK1 and SK2 (Ki values of 27 μM and 6.9 μM, respectively) and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: N-ethyl-1-deoxynojirimycin
definition: A hydroxypiperidine that is duvoglustat in which the amino hydrogen is replaced by an ethyl group. It is an inhibitor of α-glucosidase, an agonist of the glucose sensor SGLT3 and exhibits anti-HIV activity.

name: garomefrine
definition: A sulfonamide that is benzene substituted by (methylsulfonyl)amino, (1R)-2-amino-1-hydroxyethyl and fluoro groups at positions 1, 3 and 4, respectively. It is a selective agonist of α1A adrenoreceptor.

name: (2R)-2-amino-2-(methoxymethyl)-4-(4-octylphenyl)butan-1-ol
definition: A 2-amino-2-(methoxymethyl)-4-(4-octylphenyl)butan-1-ol that has R-configuration. It is a sphingosine kinase-2 inhibitor.

name: (E)-2-[[[4-(2-chlorophenyl)-1,3-thiazol-2-yl]hydrazinylidene]methyl]benzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-thiazoles that is 1,3-thiazole substituted by (2E)-2-(2-carboxybenzylidene)hydrazinyl and 2-chlorophenyl groups at positions 2 and 4, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of human dihydroorotate dehydrogenase (hDHODH) with IC50 of 32 nM. It exhibits antineoplastic activity and broad-spectrum antiviral activity against various RNA viruses including influenza A, Zika, Ebola, and SARS-CoV-2 viruses.

name: SCH772984
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 1H-indazole substituted by pyridin-4-yl and {[(3R)-1-(2-oxo-2-{4-[4-(pyrimidin-2-yl)phenyl]piperazin-1-yl}ethyl)pyrrolidin-3-yl]carbonyl}amino groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of mitogen-activated protein kinases ERK1 and ERK2 (IC50 = 4 and 1 nM, respectively) that exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: SLM6071469
definition: A 1,2,4-oxadiazole that is substituted by 3-(trifluoromethyl)-4-{[4-(trifluoromethyl)benzyl]oxy}phenyl and (2S)-1-carbamimidoylpyrrolidin-2-yl groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of sphingosine kinase 2 (SphK2) with Ki of 89 nM.

name: TAK-580
definition: A 1,3-thiazolecarboxamide that is 2-[(1R)-1-aminoethyl]-1,3-thiazole-5-carboxylic acid in which the carboxy group undergoes formal condensation with the amino group of 5-chloro-4-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-2-amine and in which the amino group undergoes formal condensation with the carboxy group of 6-amino-5-chloropyrimidine-4-carboxylic acid. It is a pan-RAF kinase inhibitor which is currently in clinical development for the treatment of radiographically recurrent or progressive low-grade glioma in children and young adults.

name: TAK-632
definition: A member of the class of benzothiazoles that is 1,3-benzothiazole substituted by (cyclopropanecarbonyl)amino, 4-fluoro-3-{2-[3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]acetamido}phenoxy, and cyano groups at positions 2, 6 and 7, respectively. It is a potent pan-RAF inhibitor with IC50 of 1.4, 2.4 and 8.3 nM for CRAF, BRAFV600E, BRAFWT, respectively.

name: tesevatinib
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline substituted by (3,4-dichloro-2-fluorophenyl)amino, methoxy, and [(3aR,5r,6aS)-2-methyloctahydrocyclopenta[c]pyrrol-5-yl]methoxy groups at positions 4, 6 and 7, respectively. It is a multi-target tyrosine kinase inhibitor of EGFR, ErbB2, KDR, Flt4 and EphB4 and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine carrying two individual N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosyl tetrasaccharide units via (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: garomefrine(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of garomefrine, obtained from the protonation of the primary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: garomefrine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of garomefrine with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. It is a α1A adrenoreceptor agonist which was being developed for the treatment of urinary incontinence (now discontinued).

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide consisting of β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked sequentially (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two α-D-mannosyl residues via (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages while the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine at the reducing end carries also via a (1→6) linkage an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: asnovolin J
definition: A meroterpenoid with formula C26H38O5 isolated from the fungus Aspergillus novofumigatus. It is an intermediate produced in the biosynthetic pathway leading to the synthesis of novofumigatonin.

name: asnovolin I(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of asnovolin I resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: asnovolin K
definition: A meroterpenoid with formula C26H36O6 isolated from the fungus Aspergillus novofumigatus. It is an intermediate produced in the biosynthetic pathway leading to the synthesis of novofumigatonin.

name: brivanib
definition: A secondary alcohol resulting from the hydrolysis of the carboxylic ester group of brivanib alaninate. It is a dual VEGFR-2/FGFR-1 kinase inhibitor whose alanine prodrug, brivanib alaninate is currently under development as an oral agent for the treatment of cancer.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and (at the reducing end) N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which is (1→4)-linked an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue, together with two N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide units linked (1→3) and (1→6).

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→3) and (1→6).

name: GSK343
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 1-isopropyl-1H-indazole-4-carboxamide in which the nitrogen of the carboxamide group is substituted by a (6-methyl-2-oxo-4-propyl-1,2-dihydropyridin-3-yl)methyl group and in which the indazole ring is substituted at position 6 by a 2-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)pyridin-4-yl group. A highly potent and selective EZH2 inhibitor (IC50 = 4 nM).

name: punicalagin
definition: An ellagitannin with formula C48H28O30. It is found in pomegranates and exhibits potent antiinflammatory, antiatherogenic, anticancer, and antioxidant activities.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-FucpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a linear trisaccharide comprising β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-L-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→6), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine of which is also linked (1→4) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: acalabrutinib
definition: A member of the class of imidazopyrazines that is imidazo[1,5-a]pyrazine substituted by 4-(pyridin-2-ylcarbamoyl)phenyl, (2S)-1-(but-2-ynoyl)pyrrolidin-2-yl, and amino groups at positions 1, 3 and 8, respectively. It is an irreversible second-generation Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor that is approved by the FDA for the treatment of adult patients with mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) who have received at least one prior therapy.

name: 2-amino-2-(methoxymethyl)-4-(4-octylphenyl)butan-1-ol
definition: An aminoalcohol that is benzene substituted by a 3-amino-3-(hydroxymethyl)-4-methoxybutyl group at position 1 and an octyl group at position 4.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: A linear amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-L-fucosyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→2), (1→4) and (1→2).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprised of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl and N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (2→6) and (1→4).

name: melleolide F
definition: A sesquiterpenoid resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of o-orsellinic acid with the 2-hydroxy group of (2R,2aS,4aS,7aS,7bR)-3-(hydroxymethyl)-6,6,7b-trimethyl-1,2,4a,5,6,7,7a,7b-octahydro-2aH-cyclobuta[e]indene-2,2a-diol. It is a metabolite isolated from the fungus Armillaria mellea.

name: 2-methyl-5-propionylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan substituted by propionyl and methyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a flavouring agent found in sesame seed oil and coffee.

name: 2-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoic acid
definition: A methoxybenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by hydroxy and methoxy groups at positions 2 and 4, respectively.

name: isorhapontigenin
definition: A stilbenol that is trans-stilbene in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5, while the other phenyl group is substituted by a methoxy group at position 3 and a hydroxy group at position 4. It natural product isolated from the seeds of Aïphanes aculeata and has antioxidant, anti-tumour, and anti-inflammatory effects.

name: morpholinium
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of morpholine resulting from the protonation of the NH group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxyphenylpyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 3-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is pyruvic acid in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 3-hydroxyphenyl group.

name: 2,2-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoate
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2,2-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 2,2-dihydroxy-3-methylbutanoic acid
definition: A 2-hydroxy fatty acid that is isovaleric acid bearing two hydroxy substituents at position 2.

name: aetokthonotoxin
definition: A bromoindole that is 2,3,5-tribromo-1H-indole which is substituted by a 5,7-dibromo-3-cyano-1H-indol-2-yl group at position 1. It is a biindole alkaloid isolated from the cyanobacterium Aetokthonos hydrillicola and causes vacuolar myelinopathy in bald eagles.

name: SID 26681509
definition: A carbohydrazide that is L-tryptophan in which the amino and carboxy groups are substituted by tert-butoxycarbonyl and 2-({[2-(2-ethylanilino)-2-oxoethyl]sulfanyl}carbonyl)hydrazinyl groups, respectively. It is a potent and reversible inhibitor of human cathepsin L (IC50 = 56 nM).

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GalpNAc6S
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide consisting of at the reducing end an N-acetyl-6-sulfo-β-D-galactosamine residue to which are linked α-L-fucosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl residues via (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc3S-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino trisaccharide consisting of at the reducing end an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue to which are linked α-L-fucosyl and N-acetyl-3-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosaminyl residues via (1→3) and (1→4) glycosidic linkages respectively.

name: cytidylyl-(3'→5')-guanosine
definition: A (3'→5')-dinucleotide composed from cytidine and guanosine units.

name: sch 210972(2−)
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of sch 210972 resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy and hydroxy groups. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: mefuparib hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of mefuparib. It is a potent poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitor which exhibits strong anticancer activity and also inhibits SARS-CoV-2 in cell culture.

name: PJ34
definition: A member of the class of phenanthridines that is 5,6-dihydrophenanthridine substituted at positions 2 and 6 by (N,N-dimethylglycyl)amino and oxo groups, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases PARP1 and PARP2 (IC50 of 110 nM and 86 nM, respectively) and exhibits anti-cancer, cardioprotective and neuroprotective properties.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide unit consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and (at the reducing end) N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked in sequence (1→3), (1→3) and (1→6), to the β-galactosyl residue is linked also (1→2) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: PJ34(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group of PJ34. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: PJ34 hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt prepared from equimolar amounts of PJ34 and hydrochloric acid.

name: mefuparib
definition: A member of the class of 1-benzofurans that is 1-benzofuran substituted by 4-[(methylamino)methyl]phenyl, fluoro and aminocarbonyl groups at positions 2, 5, and 7, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases PARP1 and PARP2 (IC50 of 3.2 nM and 1.9 nM, respectively). The compound exhibits anti-cancer properties and has also shown promising antiviral activity against the virus that causes COVID-19.

name: mefuparib(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group of mefuparib. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: asnovolin I
definition: A meroterpenoid with formula C25H34O6 isolated from the fungus Aspergillus novofumigatus. It is an intermediate produced in the biosynthetic pathway leading to the synthesis of novofumigatonin.

name: 1,4,4,7a-tetramethyl-1,4,5,7a-tetrahydro-2H-inden-2-one
definition: A member of the class of indenes that is 2,4,5,7a-tetrahydro-1H-indene substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 4, 4 and 7a and by an oxo group at position 2.

name: mycophenolic acid
definition: A member of the class of 2-benzofurans that is 2-benzofuran-1(3H)-one which is substituted at positions 4, 5, 6, and 7 by methyl, methoxy, (2E)-5-carboxy-3-methylpent-2-en-1-yl, and hydroxy groups, respectively. It is an antibiotic produced by Penicillium brevi-compactum, P. stoloniferum, P. echinulatum and related species. An immunosuppressant, it is widely used (partiularly as its sodium salt and as the 2-(morpholin-4-yl)ethyl ester prodrug, mycophenolate mofetil) to prevent tissue rejection following organ transplants and for the treatment of certain autoimmune diseases.

name: 8-heptadecenal
definition: A monounsaturated fatty aldehyde that is heptadecanal carrying a double bond at position 8.

name: butyl butyryllactate
definition: A diester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-(butanoyloxy)propanoic acid with butan-1-ol.

name: bihapten 1 dimethyl ether
definition: A butan-4-olide having a methylidene group at the 3-position and a 9-(2,3-dimethoxyphenyl)nonyl substituent at the 5-position.

name: oleoside 11-methyl ester
definition: A secoiridoid glycoside that is [(2R,3E,4S)-3-ethylidene-2-hydroxy-5-(methoxycarbonyl)-3,4-dihydro-2H-pyran-4-yl]acetic acid in which the anometric hydroxy group has been converted to the corresponding β-D-glucoside. It has been isolated from several plant species including Olea europaea.

name: 2-decylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a decyl group.

name: 2-[(ethylthio)methyl]furan
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan substituted by an (ethylsulfanyl)methyl group at position 2.

name: 1-dodecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol)
definition: A 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-(1'-sn-glycerol) in which the 1-acyl substituent is specified as dodecanoyl (lauroyl).

name: β-D-GalpNAc4,6S2-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having an N-acetyl-4,6-di-O-sulfo-β-D-galactosaminyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-GalpNAc3S-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc3S
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of 3-sulfated N-acetyl-D-glucosamine having a 3-sulfated N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl residue attached at position 4.

name: camostat(1+)
definition: A guanidinium ion resulting from the protonation of the guanidyl group of camostat. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: AKI00000020a
definition: A member of the class of imidazopyrimidopyrimidines that is 5,6-dihydroimidazo[1,2-a]pyrimido[5,4-e]pyrimidine substituted by [4-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl]amino, oxo and 2,6-dichlorophenyl groups at positions 2, 5 and 6, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of Wee-1 kinase (Ki = <10 nM).

name: 6-O-malonyl-trans-rhaponticin(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester(1−) that is the conjugate base of 6-O-malonyl-trans-rhaponticin, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: cis-rhaponticin
definition: A rhaponticin in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: YM-216391
definition: An azamacrocycle with formula C34H32N8O7S isolated from the cultured mycelium of Streptomyces nobilis. It exhibits potent cytotoxic activity against human cancer cell lines.

name: Thr-Thr zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-threonyl-L-threonine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Thr-Ser zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-threonyl-L-serine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ser-Thr zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-seryl-L-threonine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Gly-His zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of glycyl-L-histidine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ala-Cys zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-alanyl-L-cysteine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-ATP(4−)
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate(4−) obtained by global deprotonation of the triphosphate OH groups of 2-hydroxy-ATP; major species present at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxy-AMP(2−)
definition: A nucleoside 5'-monophosphate(2−) that results from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of 2-hydroxy-AMP. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6P
definition: A disaccharide phosphate that is N-acetyl-6-O-phospho-β-D-glucosamine having a β-D-galactosyl residue attached at O-4.

name: cis,cis-2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of cis,cis-2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans,trans-2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoic acid
definition: A 2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoic acid in which both double bonds adopt a trans-configuration.

name: trans,trans-2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of trans,trans-2,4-dihydroxy-5-methyl-6-oxo-2,4-hexadienoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide consisting of a linear tetrasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4) and (1→6), to the β-D-galactosamine of which is also linked (1→2) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: stellatic acid
definition: A sesterterpenoid with formula C25H38O2 which is isolated from the fungus Emericella variecolor.

name: dilazep(2+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of dilazep resulting from the protonation of the two amino groups of the diazepane moiety.

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4) and (1→2).

name: α-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising α-D-galactose, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4) and (1→2), to the β-D-galactose residue of which is also linked (1→2) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→2)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4) and (1→2), to the β-D-galactose residue of which is also linked (1→2) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of α-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and α-D-mannose residues joined in sequence by (1→3) and (1→2) glycosidic bonds.

name: 6-{4-[(4-ethylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]phenyl}-N-(1-phenylethyl)-7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-amine
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolopyrimidines that is 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine substituted by (1-phenylethyl)amino and 4-[(4-ethylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]phenyl groups at positions 4 and 6, respectively.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→3) and (1→2).

name: nirmatrelvir
definition: An azabicyclohexane that is (1R,5S)-3-azabicyclo[3.1.0]hexane substituted by {(1S)-1-cyano-2-[(3S)-2-oxopyrrolidin-3-yl]ethyl}aminoacyl, 3-methyl-N-(trifluoroacetyl)-L-valinamide, methyl and methyl groups at positions 2S, 3, 6 and 6, respectively. It is the first orally administered inhibitor of SARS-CoV-2 main protease developed by Pfizer and used in combination with ritonavir for the treatment of COVID-19.

name: favipiravir-RTP
definition: A nuceloside analogue in which the nucleobase is favipiravir. It is a RNA-dependent RNA polymerase inhibitor which exhibits anti-influenza and anti-coronaviral activities.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An oligosaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide backbone of a β-D-mannosyl residue, an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosyl residue and (at the reducing end) an N-acetyl-β-D-glucose residue, all linked through (1→4) glycosidic linkages, to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two separate N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl tetrasaccharide units via (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: 3-methylarginine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is arginine carrying a methyl group at position 3. It is a rare amino acid produced by Pseudomonas syringae syringae, with a strong toxicity against Pseudomonas syringae glycinea, two soybean pathogens.

name: promysalin
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-1-(2-hydroxybenzoyl)-2,3-dihydro-1H-pyrrole-2-carboxylic acid with the hydroxy group of (2R,8R)-2,8-dihydroxytetradecanamide. It is a metabolite isolated from Pseudomonas putida, , which resides in the rhizosphere of rice plants. The compound selectively inhibits the growth of Pseudomonas aeruginosa at low-micromolar concentrations.

name: quinolobactin
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid that is xanthurenic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 4 is replaced by a methoxy group. It is a siderophore isolated from Pseudomonas fluorescens ATCC 17400.

name: inuloxin A
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone with formula C15H20O3. It is a natural product isolated from the aerial parts of Inula viscosa, a widespread Mediterranean plant known for its content of pharmacologically active metabolites. It has herbicidal, antifungal and antiamoebic activity.

A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a nonadecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end) all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear octasaccharide units.

A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a henicosasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end) all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear nonasaccharide units.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a tridecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and (at the reducing end) N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues, all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear pentasaccharide units.

name: virensol A
definition: An aromatic primary alcohol that is phenol in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 3 and 4 are replaced by hydroxymethyl, (1E,3E,5E)-undeca-1,3,5-trien-1-yl, and hydroxy groups, respectively.

name: dutomycin
definition: An anthracycline antibiotic of formula C44H54O17 isolated from Streptomyces species. It directly binds to the human serine protease inhibitor B6 (SERPINB6), inducing autophagy and apoptosis.

name: cerulenin
definition: An epoxydodecadienamide isolated from several species, including Acremonium, Acrocylindrum and Helicoceras. It inhibits the biosynthesis of several lipids by interfering with enzyme function.

name: 2-hexylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a hexyl group.

name: (2E)-2-hexenyl isovalerate
definition: A 2-hexenyl isovalerate in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: cis-3-hexenyl isovalerate
definition: A 3-hexenyl isovalerate in which the double bond adopts cis-configuration.

name: bis(2-methyl-3-furyl)disulfide
definition: A member of the class of furans that is disulfane in which both hydrogen's are substituted by 2-methylfuran-3-yl groups. It is a flavouring agent found in meat.

name: 3-methylpyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazine
definition: A pyrrolopyrazine that is pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazine in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a methyl group.

name: STM2457
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-oxo-4H-pyrido[1,2-a]pyrimidine-2-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 1-[2-(aminomethyl)imidazo[1,2-a]pyridin-6-yl]-N-(cyclohexylmethyl)methanamine. It is a highly potent and selective first-in-class small molecule inhibitor of METTL3 (N6-adenosine-methyltransferase 70 kDa subunit) enzyme activity and exhibits anti-leukaemic activity.

name: pantocin A
definition: A member of the class of indolizines that is 3,5,6,7-tetrahydroindolizine which carries a 2-aminoacyl-4-amino-4-oxobutanoic acid, oxo, amino groups at positions 3S, 5 and 6S, respectively. It is a ribosomally encoded and post-translationally modified peptide natural product found in several species of the Pantoea genus and derived from a Glu-Glu-Asn precursor peptide.

name: lithium hexafluorophosphate
definition: An inorganic lithium salt having hexafluorophosphate(1−) as the counterion. It is an electrolyte used in lithium-ion batteries.

name: sodium hexafluorophosphate
definition: An inorganic sodium salt having hexafluorophosphate(1−) as the counterion. It is an electrolyte used in sodium-ion batteries.

name: bis(2-methyl-4,5-dihydro-3-furyl) disulfide
definition: A member of the class of dihydrofurans that is disulfane in which both hydrogen's are substituted by 2-methyl-4,5-dihydrofuran-3-yl groups. It is a flavouring agent found in meat.

name: hexyl heptanoate
definition: A heptanoate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of heptanoic acid (enanthic acid) with hexan-1-ol.

name: phenylsilane
definition: An organosilicon compound that is benzene in which a hydrogen is replaced by a silyl group.

name: cobalt(II) bis(acetylacetonate)
definition: A cobalt coordination entity in which two molecules of 2,4-dioxopentan-3-ide form a coordination complex with cobalt(2+).

A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a tricosasaccharide derivative comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end) all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear decasaccharide units via (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a nonacosasaccharide derivative comprising a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues (one of which is at the reducing end) all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear tridecasaccharide units via (1→3) and (1→6) glycosidic linkages.

name: PF-00835231
definition: A primary alcohol resulting from the cleavage of the phosphate group of the prodrug PF-07304814. It is an inhibitor of SARS-CoV-1 and -2 main protease (3CLpro) and exhibits potent in vitro antiviral activity.

name: β-D-GlcpA3S-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprising a chain of 3-O-sulfo-β-D-glucuronic acid, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→3), (1→4) and (1→2).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→8)-α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-D-Glcp
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of three sialyl residues, two galactose residues, one N-acetylglucosamine and a glucose residue at the reducing end.

name: ethylzingerone
definition: A methyl ketone that is 4-phenylbutan-2-one in which the phenyl ring is substituted at positions 3 and 4 by ethoxy and hydroxy groups, respectively. It is a preservative with antimicrobial activity and a good safety profile that has been approved for use in cosmetics. It is structurally similar to zingerone, a phytochemical found in the root of the ginger plant Zingiber officinale.

name: fluorescein (acid form)
definition: A xanthene dye that is highly fluorescent and commonly used as a fluorescent tracer.

name: β-acoradiene
definition: A spiro compound that is 1,8-dimethyl-4-(prop-1-en-2-yl)spiro[4.5]decane that has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond at position 8-9 (the 1R,4S,5R isomer).

name: α-acoradiene
definition: A spiro compound that is 1,8-dimethyl-4-(prop-1-en-2-yl)spiro[4.5]decane that has been dehydrogenated to introduce a double bond at position 8-9 (the 1R,4S,5S isomer).

name: lycosantalene
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is tricyclo[2.2.1.02,6]heptane carrying methyl groups at position 1 and 7 and a (6Z)-2,6-dimethylnona-2,6-dien-9-yl group at position 7. It is a diterpene produced by a terpenoid biosynthetic gene cluster in tomatoes.

name: 1(10),5-germacradien-4-ol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is cyclodeca-2,7-diene substituted by methyl, hydroxy, isoproyl, and methyl groups at positions 1, 1, 4S and 7, respectively.

name: bicycloelemene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is 7,7-dimethylbicyclo[4.1.0]heptane substituted by prop-1-en-2-yl, ethenyl and methyl groups at positions 2, 3 and 3, respectively (the 1R,2R,3S,6R-stereoisomer). It is a sesquiterpene isolated from the leaves of several plant species.

name: longiborneol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is (1R,3aR,4S,8aS)-1,5,5,8a-tetramethyldecahydro-1,4-methanoazulene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 9S.

name: (+)-thalianatriene
definition: A sesterterpene with formula C25H40 that is produced by a sesterterpene synthase gene from the plant Arabidopsis thaliana.

name: (−)-retigeranin B
definition: A sesterterpene produced by a sesterterpene synthase gene identified in the plant Arabidopsis thaliana.

name: astellifadiene
definition: A sesterterpene with formula C25H40 that is produced by a terpene synthase gene from Emericella variecolor NBRC 32302 which is heterologously expressed in Aspergillus oryzae NSAR1.

name: bictegravir
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2R,5S,13aR)-8-hydroxy-7,9-dioxo-2,3,4,5,7,9,13,13a-octahydro-2,5-methanopyrido[1',2':4,5]pyrazino[2,1-b][1,3]oxazepine-10-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 2,4,6-trifluorobenzylamine. It is a second-generation integrase strand transfer inhibitor (INSTI) and used (as its sodium salt) for the treatment of HIV-1.

name: cabotegravir
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (3S,11aR)-6-hydroxy-3-methyl-5,7-dioxo-2,3,5,7,11,11a-hexahydro[1,3]oxazolo[3,2-a]pyrido[1,2-d]pyrazine-8-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 2,4-difluorobenzylamine. Used (as its sodium salt) for treatment of HIV-1.

name: 9-cis-retinoyl-β-D-glucuronide
definition: A retinoid that is 9-cis-retinoic acid in which the carboxy proton has been replaced by a β-D-glucuronyl group. It is a major metabolite of 9-cis-retinoic acid.

name: 3-methylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 3 is replaced by a methyl group. It is a chemical that is produced in foods during food processing and preservation techniques that involve heat treatment such as cooking and pasteurization.

name: cabotegravir(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of cabotegravir, obtained by deptotonation of the 6-hydroxy group.

name: cabotegravir sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of cabotegravir. Used for treatment of HIV-1.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a dodecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear tetrasaccharide units [linked (1→3) and (1→6)], while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: bictegravir(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of bictegravir, obtained by deptotonation of the 8-hydroxy group.

name: bictegravir sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of bictegravir. Used for treatment of HIV-1.

name: 2-(5-butylthiophen-2-yl)-2,5-dihydropyrazolo[4,3-c]quinolin-3-one
definition: A pyrazoloquinoline that is 2,5-dihydropyrazolo[4,3-c]quinolin-3-one which is substituted at position 2 by a 5-butyl-2-thienyl group.

name: 5H-furo[3,2-g]chromen-5-one
definition: A member of the class of furanochromones that is 5H-furo[3,2-g][1]benzopyran carrying an oxo group a position 5.

name: PF-07304814
definition: An indolecarboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-methoxy-1H-indole-2-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of N-[(2S)-3-oxo-1-[(3S)-2-oxopyrrolidin-3-yl]-4-(phosphonooxy)butan-2-yl]-L-leucinamide. It is the phosphate prodrug of PF-00835231, an anticoronaviral agent.

name: copanlisib
definition: An imidazoquinazoline that is 2,3-dihydroimidazo[1,2-c]quinazoline substituted by (2-aminopyrimidine-5-carbonyl)amino, methoxy, and 3-(morpholin-4-yl)propoxy groups at positions 5, 7 and 8, respectively. It is a intravenous pan-class I PI3K inhibitor used for the treatment of relapsed follicular lymphoma in patients who have received at least 2 prior systemic therapies.

name: fenoxasulfone
definition: A dichlorobenzene that is benzene in which the hydrogens at positions 1, 2, 4 and 5 are replaced by [(5,5-dimethyl-4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazol-3-yl)sulfonyl]methyl, chloro, ethoxy and chloro groups, respectively. It is a rice herbicide developed by Kumiai Chemical Industry Co. Ltd which displays excellent herbicidal activity against Echinochloa spp. and other annual weeds.

name: copanlisib dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of copanlisib.

name: aceneuramic acid
definition: An N-acetylneuraminic acid that is keto-neuraminic acid in which one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by an acetyl group.

name: aceneuramate
definition: An N-acetylneuraminate that is the conjugate base of aceneuramic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: ferrostatin-1
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-amino-4-(cyclohexylamino)benzoic acid with ethanol. It is a potent inhibitor of ferroptosis, a distinct non-apoptotic form of cell death caused by lipid peroxidation. It is also a radical-trapping antioxidant and has the ability to reduce the accumulation of lipid peroxides and chain-carrying peroxyl radicals.

A branched amino oligosaccharide that is an icosasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear octasaccharide units [linked (1→3) and (1→6)], while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: SRS11-92
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(benzylamino)-4-(cyclohexylamino)benzoic acid with ethanol. It is a potent inhibitor of ferroptosis induced by erastin in HT-1080 human fibrosarcoma cells (EC50 = 6 nM).

name: SRS16-86
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(adamantan-1-yl)amino]-3-{(Z)-[(pyrimidin-5-yl)methylidene]amino}benzoic acid with tert-butanol. It is an inhibitor of ferroptosis induced by erastin in HT-1080 and NIH3T3 cells when used at a concentration of 1 μM.

name: liproxstatin-1
definition: An azaspiro compound that is 1'H-spiro[piperidine-4,2'-quinoxaline] in which the hydrogen at position 3' is replaced by a (3-chlorobenzyl)amino group. It is a potent inhibitor of ferroptosis.

name: PD-146176
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 1H-indole which is ortho-fused to a 2H-1-benzothiopyran group at positions 2-3. It is an inhibitor of 15-lipoxygenase that limits atherosclerotic lesion development in rabbits.

name: XJB-5-131
definition: A peptidomimetic that is an inhibitor of ferroptosis and prevents the onset of motor decline in a mouse model for Huntington's disease.

name: narlaprevir
definition: An azabicyclohexane that is (1R,5S)-6,6-dimethyl-3-azabicyclo[3.1.0]hexane substituted by [(3S)-1-(cyclopropylamino)-1,2-dioxoheptan-3-yl]aminoacyl and N-({1-[(tert-butylsulfonyl)methyl]cyclohexyl}carbamoyl)-3-methyl-L-valyl groups at positions 2S and 3, respectively. It is a hepatitis C virus (HCV) NS3/4A serine protease inhibitor (Ki = 6 nM) that is used for the treatment of chronic hepatitis C.

name: talaroconvolutin A
definition: An octahydronaphthalene with formula C32H41NO3. It is a fungal metabolite isolated from Talaromyces convolutus and is an inducer of ferroptosis in colorectal cancer cells.

name: ferroptocide
definition: A triazolopyridazine that is 5,8-dihydro-1H-[1,2,4]triazolo[1,2-a]pyridazine-1,3(2H)-dione substituted by phenyl and (2S,3aS,4S,5S,7R,8S,8aS,9R)-7-[(chloroacetyl)oxy]-2,8a-dihydroxy-4,8,9-trimethyl-1-oxooctahydro-1H-3a,8-propanoazulen-5-yl groups at positions 2 and 6, respectively. It is a small molecule inhibitor of thioredoxin, a key component of the antioxidant system in cells. It induces rapid ferroptotic death in immortalized cancer cell lines and primary cancer cells from patients.

A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a tetracosasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear decasaccharide units [linked (1→3) and (1→6)], while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: RSL3
definition: A β-carboline that is 2,3,4,4a,9,9a-hexahydro-1H-β-carboline in which the hydrogens at positions 1, 2 and 3 are replaced by 4-(methoxycarbonyl)phenyl, chloroacetyl and methoxycarbonyl groups, respectively (the 1S,2R stereoisomer). It is a potential antineoplastic agent which triggers ferroptosis by inactivating the glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) enzyme.

A branched amino oligosaccharide that is a hexacosasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked two β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear undecasaccharide units [linked (1→3) and (1→6)], while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is an octadecasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the mannosyl residue of which are linked a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannosyl linear pentasaccharide group via a (1→3) linkage and a β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→2)-[β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→6)]-α-D-mannosyl branched nonasaccharide group via a (1→6) linkage, while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-fucose residue.

name: (6Z)-nerolidol
definition: A nerolidol in which the double bond at position 6 adopts a cis-configuration.

name: (6R,7S)-himachala-9,11-diene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is (9aS)-5,6,7,8,9,9a-hexahydro-1H-benzo[7]annulene substituted by methyl groups at positions 3, 5, 5 and 9R. It is a pheromone produced by males of several Phyllotreta species.

name: (1S,6S,7R)-sesquipiperitol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is bisabolane having double bonds at positions 2 and 9 as well as a hydroxy substituent at position 1 (the 1S,6S,7R-stereoisomer). It is a male produced sex pheromone of Tibraca limbativentris.

name: 16α-hydroxyprednisolone
definition: A 16-hydroxyprednisolone in which the hydroxy group at position 16 adopts α-configuration. It is a metabolite of budesonide found in human urine and plasma.

name: di-1-propenyl sulfide
definition: An organic sulfide that is hydrogen sulfide substituted by two prop-1-en-1-yl groups. It is a volatile constituent found in garlic and onions.

name: (cyclohexylmethyl)pyrazine
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a cyclohexylmethyl group.

name: 2-acetyl-5-methylthiophene
definition: A thiophene that is substituted by acetyl and methyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively.

name: N-[(2E)-3,7-dimethylocta-2,6-dien-1-yl]cyclopropanecarboxamide
definition: An N-(3,7-dimethylocta-2,6-dien-1-yl)cyclopropanecarboxamide in which the double bond at position 2 adopts an E-configuration.

name: 2-oxooctanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is octanoic acid carrying an oxo group at position 2.

name: norsalsolinol
definition: An isoquinolinol that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 6 and 7. It is present in the dopamine-rich areas of the human brain, including the substantia nigra.

name: ethyl 3-(2-furyl)acrylate
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan substituted by a 3-ethoxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl group at position 2.

name: 5,5',6,6'-tetrahydroxy-3,3'-biindolyl
definition: A hydroxyindole that is 1H-indole-5,6-diol substituted by a 5,6-dihydroxy-1H-indol-3-yl group at position 3.

name: N-[(S)-lactoyl]-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine in which the amino group is replaced by a [(2S)-2-hydroxypropanoyl]amino group. It is a metabolite produced as a result of exercise in mice, racehorses, and humans which suppresses feeding and obesity.

name: rhapontigenin
definition: A stilbenol that is trans-stilbene in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 5, while the other phenyl group is substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3 and a methoxy group at position 4.

name: pilosin
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is flavone carrying hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, and 8, and methoxy groups at positions 4' and 6.

name: 11H-benzo[a]fluoren-11-ylacetic acid
definition: A carbotetracyclic compound that is 11H-benzo[a]fluorene substituted by a carboxymethyl group at position 11.

name: clenbuterol
definition: A substituted aniline that is 2,6-dichloroaniline in which the hydrogen at position 4 has been replaced by a 2-(tert-butylamino)-1-hydroxyethyl group.

name: 4'-O-methyl-(−)-epicatechin
definition: A catechin that is (−)-epicatechin in which the hydroxy group at position 4' is replaced by a methoxy group. It is a metabolite of (−)-epicatechin.

name: dihydroisorhamnetin
definition: A tetrahydroxyflavanone that is taxifolin in which the hydroxy group at position 3' is substituted by a methoxy group. It is a metabolite of taxifolin.

name: 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion obtained by removal of the three protons from the diphosphate group of 2-trans,6-trans-farnesyl diphosphate.

name: gemcitabine
definition: A 2'-deoxycytidine having geminal fluoro substituents in the 2'-position. An inhibitor of ribonucleotide reductase, gemcitabine is used in the treatment of various carcinomas, particularly non-small cell lung cancer, pancreatic cancer, bladder cancer and breast cancer.

name: 2-hexenyl isovalerate
definition: A fatty ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of isovaleric acid with the hydroxy group of 2-hexen-1-ol.

name: GSK2879552
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is piperidine substituted by (4-carboxyphenyl)methyl and {[(1R,2S)-2-phenylcyclopropyl]amino}methyl groups at positions 1 and 4, respectively. It is a potent and irreversible inhibitor of lysine specific demethylase 1 (LSD1, also known as KDM1A). It was under clinical investigation for the treatment of acute myeloid leukaemia and small cell lung carcinoma.

name: (3R,6Z)-nerolidol
definition: A (6Z)-nerolidol in which the hydroxy group at positon 3 adopts an R-configuration.

name: (3S,6Z)-nerolidol
definition: A (6Z)-nerolidol in which the hydroxy group at positon 3 adopts an S-configuration.

name: lanperisone
definition: A 2-methyl-3-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)-1-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propan-1-one in which the methyl group at position 2 adopts R-configuration. It is a muscle relaxant and induces ferroptosis in cancer cells.

name: 2-methyl-3-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)-1-[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]propan-1-one
definition: An aromatic ketone that is (trifluoromethyl)benzene in which the hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by a 2-methyl-3-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)propanoyl group.

name: lanperisone(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of lanperisone resulting from the protonation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: fluciclovine
definition: A member of the class of cyclobutanes that is cyclobutane which carries a carboxy, amino and fluoro groups at positions 1, 1 and 3, respectively (the 1r,3r-stereoisomer).

name: RSL5
definition: A quinolone that is 4,6,7,8-tetrahydroquinolin-5(1H)-one substituted by methyl, (2-methoxyethoxy)carbonyl, 2-fluorophenyl and 4-chlorophenyl groups at positions 2, 3, 4 and 7, respectively (the 4S,7S-stereoisomer). It is an inhibitor of voltage-dependent anion channel 3 (VDAC3) and a ferroptosis inducer.

name: FIN56
definition: A fluorene that is N-9H-fluoren-9-ylidenehydroxylamine substituted by N-cyclohexylsulfonyl groups at positions 2 and 7. It induces ferroptosis via degradation of GPX4 and also binds and activates squalene synthase.

name: FINO2
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is 1,2-dioxaspiro[4.5]decane substituted by methyl, 2-hydroxyethyl and tert-butyl groups at positions 3, 3 and 8, respectivey (the 5s,8s-stereoisomer). It induces ferroptosis in cancer cells by indirectly inhibiting glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) enzymatic function and directly oxidizes iron leading to widespread lipid peroxidation.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-L-FucpO[CH2]6NH2
definition: A disaccharide derivative that is the 6-aminohexyl glycoside of the disaccharide α-L-fucopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-L-fucopyranose.

name: DPI2
definition: A thiazolidinone that is 2-sulfanylidene-1,3-thiazolidin-4-one substituted by 3-{[3-(morpholin-4-yl)propyl]amino}-3-oxopropyl and 4-ethylbenzylidene groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is a ferroptosis inducer.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-α-L-FucpO[CH2]6NH2
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide derivative that is the 6-aminohexyl glycoside of the tetrasaccharide α-L-fucopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-L-fucopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-L-fucopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-L-fucopyranose.

name: 4-(hydroxymethyl)-2-propylfuran-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan substituted by propyl, carboxy and hydroxymethyl groups at positions 2, 3 and 4, respectively. It is an inducer of antibiotic biosynthesis in Streptomyces species.

name: 4-methylglutamic acid
definition: A glutamic acid derivative that is glutamic acid substituted by a methyl group at position 4.

name: UAB126
definition: A member of the class of naphthalenes that is naphthalene substituted by a 4-[(E)-2-carboxyethenyl]phenyl group at position 1. It is a small molecule that reverses diet-induced obesity and its associated metabolic disorders.

name: ML162
definition: A monochlorobenzene that is benzene substituted by (chloroacetyl){2-oxo-2-[(2-phenylethyl)amino]-1-(thiophen-2-yl)ethyl}amino, chloro and methoxy groups at positions 1, 3 and 4, respectively. name: BAY11-7085
definition: A sulfone that is benzene substituted by [(E)-2-cyanoethenyl]sulfonyl and tert-butyl groups at position 1 and 4, respectively. It is an irreversible inhibitor of IκB-α phosphorylation in cells (IC50 = 10 μM) and prevents the activation of NF-κB.

name: iFSP1
definition: A member of the class of pyridobenzimidazoles that is pyrido[1,2-a]benzimidazole substituted by amino, cyano, 4-methylphenyl, and cyano groups at positions 1, 2, 3 and 4, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of ferroptosis suppressor protein 1 (FSP1) with EC50 of 103 nM. It induces ferroptosis in GPX4 knockout cells that overexpress FSP1.

name: ML-210
definition: An N-acylpiperazine that is piperazine substituted by 5-methyl-4-nitro-1,2-oxazole-3-carbonyl and bis(4-chlorophenyl)methyl groups at positions 1 and 4, respectively. It is a glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) inhibitor which induces ferroptosis in cancer cells expressing the RAS oncogene.

name: D-buthionine-(S,R)-sulfoximine
definition: A 2-amino-4-(S-butylsulfonimidoyl)butanoic acid which has R-configuration.

name: 2-amino-4-(S-butylsulfonimidoyl)butanoic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is homocysteine in which the thiol group carries an oxo, imino and butyl groups.

name: L-thyroxine sulfate(1−)
definition: A thyroxine sulfate(1−) that has L-configuration. The major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: fluciclovine (14C)
definition: A member of the class of cyclobutanes that is (14C)cyclobutane which carries a carboxy, amino and fluoro groups at positions 1, 1 and 3, respectively (the 1r,3r-stereoisomer).

name: dimethyl diselenide
definition: An organoselenium compound that is diselane covalently bound to two methyl groups. It has been detected in onion-family vegetables and soft-necked garlics. It induces ER stress and toxic protein aggregation in the budding yeast, S. cerevisiae and used as a reagent to identify distonic radical cations.

name: (2S)-3-sulfopropanediol(1−)
definition: A 3-sulfopropanediol(1−) that has S-configuration.

name: 3-oxopropane-1-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 3-oxopropane-1-sulfonic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-nonylfuran
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan in which the hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a nonyl group.
