name: N-glycoloyl-α-neuraminate
definition: An N-glycoloylneuraminate that is conjugate base of N-glycoloyl-α-neuraminic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

An amino oligosaccharide that is a triacontasaccharide derivative consisting of a trisaccharide of β-D-Man and two β-D-GlcNAc residues all linked in sequence (1→4), to the Man residue of which are linked a β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-2)-α-D-Man linear nonasaccharide group via a (1→3) linkage and a β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-2)-[β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-3)-β-D-Gal-(1-4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1-6)]-α-D-Man branched heptadecasaccharide group via a (1→6) linkage, while to the β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end is linked (1→6) an α-L-Fuc residue.

name: methyl 3-(4-hydroxyphenyl)propionate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of phloretic acid with methanol. It is a nitrification inhibitor and a plant growth regulator.

name: calcium-43 atom
definition: A minor stable isotope of calcium with relative atomic mass 42.95877 and 0.135 atom percent natural abundance.

name: brachialactone
definition: A tetracyclic diterpenoid with formula C20H30O4. It is a nitrification inhibitor isolated from root exudates of Brachiaria humidicola.

name: molybdenum-98 atom
definition: A stable isotope of molybdenum with relative atomic mass 97.90541, 24.29 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 0.

name: strontium-88 atom
definition: A major stable isotope of strontium with relative atomic mass 87.90561 and 82.58 atom percent natural abundance.

name: rubidium-85 atom
definition: A stable isotope of rubidium with relative atomic mass 84.91179, 72.17 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 5/2.

name: selenium-82 atom
definition: A stable isotope of selenium with relative atomic mass 81.91670, 8.82 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 0.

name: zinc-66 atom
definition: A stable isotope of zinc with relative atomic mass 65.92603, 27.7 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 0.

name: nickel-60 atom
definition: A stable isotope of nickel with relative atomic mass 59.93079, 26.223 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 0.

name: 1,9-decanediol
definition: A diol that is decane substituted by hydroxy groups at position 1 and 9. It is a natural product found in rice root exudates and acts as an effective biological nitrification inhibitor for soil ammonia-oxidizing bacteria and archaea.

name: methyl (Z)-7-hexadecenoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (Z)-hexadec-7-enoic acid with methanol.

name: cobalt-59 atom
definition: A stable isotope of cobalt with relative atomic mass 58.93319, 100 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 7/2.

name: N-nitroso-N-methyl-4-aminobutyric acid
definition: A nitrosamine that has methyl and 3-carboxypropyl substituents. It is a tobacco-derived nitrosamino acid that is a known animal and potential human carcinogen. It induces bladder transitional cell carcinomas in rats and has recently been identified as a contaminant in certain blood pressure medications.

name: 2-(morpholin-4-yloxy)ethanol
definition: A member of the class of morpholines that is morpholine in which the amino group is substituted by a 2-hydroxyethoxy group.

name: manganese-55 atom
definition: A stable isotope of manganese with relative atomic mass 54.93804, 100 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 5/2.

name: arsenic-75 atom
definition: A stable isotope of arsenic with relative atomic mass 74.921596, 100 atom percent natural abundance and nuclear spin 3/2.

name: N-acetyl-L-aspartic acid-1,2,3,4-13C4
definition: A 13C-modified compound that is N-acetyl-L-aspartic acid in which the carbon atoms at postions 1, 2, 3 and 4 are present as their 13C isotopes. Used in biological studies for metabolic alterations associated with schizophrenia.

name: di-μ-iodobis(ethylenediamine)diplatinum(II)
definition: A platinum coordination entity consisting of two units of ethane-1,2-diamine co-ordinated via its amino groups to di-μ-iododiplatinum.

name: 2-oxodecanotate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-oxodecanoic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-oxohexadecanoate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-oxohexadecanoic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: di-μ-iodobis(ethylenediamine)diplatinum(II) nitrate
definition: An organic nitrate salt obtained by reaction of di-μ-iodobis(ethylenediamine)diplatinum(II) with two molar equivalents of nitric acid.

name: L-aspartic acid-1,4-13C2
definition: The L-enantiomer of aspartic acid-1,4-13C2.

name: D-aspartic acid-1,4-13C2
definition: The D-enantiomer of aspartic acid-1,4-13C2.

name: aspartic acid-1,4-13C2
definition: A 13C-modified compound that is apspartic acid in which the carbon atoms at postions 1 and 4 are present as their 13C isotopes.

name: 4-fluoro-4'-hydroxybenzophenone
definition: A member of the class of benzophenones that is phenol substituted by a 4-fluorobenzoyl group at position 4.

name: tetrahydrodemethoxycurcumin
definition: A β-diketone that is tetrahydrocurcumin in which one the methoxy groups has been replaced by a hydrogen atom.

name: tetrahydroxycurcumin
definition: A β-diketone that is curcumin in which the two methoxy groups have been replaced by hydroxy groups. It is a metabolite of curcumin.

name: N-[(E)-{[(Z)-2-amino-1,2-dicyanoethenyl]imino}methyl]phenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine in which the amino group is substituted by a [(E)-{[(Z)-2-amino-1,2-dicyanoethenyl]imino}methyl]amino group. It is a chemical intermediate for nucleotide synthesis.

name: 2-{5-amino-4-[cyano(imino)methyl]-1H-imidazol-1-yl}-3-phenylpropanoic acid
definition: An aminoimidazole that is 1H-imidazole substituted by 1-carboxy-2-phenylethyl, cyano(imino)methyl, and amino groups at positions 1, 4 and 5, respectively. It is a chemical intermediate.

name: 2-oxooctanoate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-oxooctanoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: benzylpenicilloyl-butylamine(1−)
definition: A penicillinate anion formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy function of benzylpenicilloyl-butylamine.

name: (5Z)-5-octenoic acid
definition: An olefinic fatty acid that is octanoic acid carrying a double bond at position 5 (the 5Z-isomer).

name: isodomoic acid A
definition: An L-proline derivative that is L-proline substituted by a carboxymethyl group at position 3 and a 6-carboxyhepta-2,5-dien-2-yl group at position 4. It is isolated from the red alga, Chondria armata.

name: setiptiline(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of setiptiline obtained by protonation of the tertiary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: benzylpenicilloyl-butylamine sodium
definition: The organic sodium salt of the (5R,6R)-benzylpenicilloyl-butylamine conjugate.

name: setiptiline maleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by reaction of setiptiline with one equivalent of maleic acid.

name: dizocilpine(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of dizocilpine obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: dizocilpine maleate
definition: A maleate salt obtained by reaction of dizocilpine with one equivalent of maleic acid.

name: sodium amide
definition: An inorganic sodium salt composed of a sodium cation and an azanide anion. It is used as a strong base in organic synthesis.

name: cis-3-hexene
definition: A 3-hexene in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: 1-hexyne
definition: A terminal acetylenic compound that is hexane carrying a triple bond at position 1.

name: 2,3,5-trimethylhydroquinone
definition: A member of the class of hydroquinones that is hydroquinone substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 3 and 5.

name: pyridinium chlorochromate
definition: A pyridinium salt having chlorochromate as the counterion. It is used as an oxidizing agent to convert primary and secondary alcohols to aldehydes and ketones respectively.

name: pyridinium dichromate
definition: A pyridinium salt that is the dipyridinium salt of dichromic acid. It is a strong oxidizing agent which can convert primary and secondary alcohols to aldehydes and ketones respectively.

name: 3-hexene
definition: An alkene that is hexane carrying a double bond at position 3.

name: trans-3-hexene
definition: A 3-hexene in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: α-D-Rhap4NFo-(1→2)-α-D-Rhap4NFo
definition: An amino disaccharide epitope consisting of two N-formyl-α-D-perosamine residues linked (1→2). Its coupling with the carrier protein CRM197 via the DAS linker results in a neoglycoconjugate which has been used in investigations into vaccine development against brucellosis.

name: presqualene monophosphate(2−)
definition: A double charged organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of presqualene monophosphate. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,3,4-trihydroxbenzophenone
definition: A benzenetriol that is benzophenone in which one of the phenyl groups is substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3, and 4. It is a redox mediator.

name: niraparib
definition: A 2-[4-(piperidin-3-yl)phenyl]-2H-indazole-7-carboxamide that has S-configuration. It is a potent inhibitor of PARP1 and PARP2 (IC50 of 3.8 and 2.1 nM, respectively) and approved as a first-line maintenance treatment for women with advanced ovarian cancer after responding to platinum-based chemotherapy.

name: germacra-1(10),5-dien-4β-ol
definition: A 1(10),5-germacradien-4-ol in which the hydroxy group has S-configuration

name: germacra-1(10),5-dien-4α-ol
definition: A 1(10),5-germacradien-4-ol in which the hydroxy group has R-configuration

name: Asp-Met-Met-Cys
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-aspartic acid, two L-methionine units, and a L-cysteine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Ala-Met-Asp-Tyr
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-alanine, L-methionine, L-aspartic acid and L-tyrosine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Pro-Val-Val-Pro
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-proline, two L-valine units and L-proline joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Asn-Gly-Pro-His
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-asparagine, glycine, L-proline, and L-histidine units joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Asn-Lys-His-His
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-asparagine, L-lysine and two L-histidine units joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: riboflavin sodium
definition: The organic sodium salt of riboflavin.

name: L-5-benzylhydantoin
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 5-benzylhydantoin.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide comprising a (2→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) sequence of α-N-acetylneuramine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and (at the reducing end) N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine.

name: trans-4-p-coumaroylquinic acid
definition: A 4-p-coumaroylquinic acid in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: GSK-5498A
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole substituted by 2-fluoro-6-(trifluoromethyl)benzyl and (2,6-difluorobenzoyl)amino groups at positions 1 and 3, respectively. It is a inhibitor of Ca2+ release-activated Ca2+ (CRAC) channel and inhibits the release of mast cell mediators and T-cell cytokines in human and rat preparations.

name: piCRAC-1
definition: A monoazo compound that is a photoisomerizable analogue of GSK-5498A. It is a Ca2+ release-activated Ca2+ (CRAC) channel inhibitor which exists in the trans-configuration in the dark (415nm) and in the cis-configuration under 365 nm illumination.

name: 2'-deoxyuridine 3'-monophosphate(2−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 3'-monophosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 2'-deoxyuridine 3'-monophosphate (3'-dUMP); major species at pH 7.3.

name: trans-piCRAC-1
definition: The trans isomer of piCRAC-1.

name: cis-piCRAC-1
definition: The cis isomer of piCRAC-1.

name: (1S)-isoindoline-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid in which benzene is ortho-fused onto the C-3‒C-4 bond of L-proline.

name: cis,trans-1,3,5-triphenylcyclohexane
definition: A 1,3,5-triphenylcyclohexane in which two phenyl groups are on the same side of the cyclohexane ring and the third phenyl group is on the opposite side.

name: cis,cis-1,3,5-triphenylcyclohexane
definition: A 1,3,5-triphenylcyclohexane in which all three phenyl groups are on the same side of the cyclohexane ring.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→2)-α-D-Manp6Ac-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp6Ac-(1→3)-α-D-Manp
definition: A branched heptasaccharide derivative consisting of a backbone of four α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→3), with the residues at the non-reducing end and at the one proximal to the residue at the reducing end acetylated at O-6, and with a β-D-glucuronosyl residue and two β-D-xylosyl residues linked (1→2) to the main chain as shown in the diagram. One of a number of synthetic oligosaccharides used to create a synthetic strategy to Cryptococcus neoformans glucuronoxylomannan (GXM) capsular polysaccharide part structures.

name: piroheptine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of piroheptine, arising from the protonation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-Xylp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp6Ac-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpA-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp6Ac-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp6Ac
definition: A branched decasaccharide derivative consisting of a backbone of five α-D-mannose residues linked sequentially (1→3), with the middle residue carrying a β-D-glucuronosyl residue via a (1→2) linkage. All of the remaining four mannose residues carry β-D-xylosyl residues also linked (1→2), while three of the chain of five mannose residues are also acetylated at O-6 as depicted in the diagram. One of a number of synthetic oligosaccharides used to create a synthetic strategy to Cryptococcus neoformans glucuronoxylomannan (GXM) capsular polysaccharide part structures.

name: dainate A(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid anion that is conjugate base of dainic acid A, arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy groups and protonation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: KP1339
definition: A ruthenium coordination entity that is the sodium salt of tetrachloro[bis(1H-indazole)]ruthenate(III). It is a anticancer drug in clinical development for the treatment of solid tumours.

name: L-779976
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is (βS)-β-methyl-D-tryptophan in which the primary amino group undergoes formal condensation with the carboxy group of 4-(2-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-benzimidazol-1-yl)piperidine-1-carboxylic acid and the carboxy group undegoes formal condensation with the amino group of (1R,3S)-cyclohexane-1,3-diyldimethanamine. It is a selective nonpeptidic agonist of the somatostatin subtype-2 (SST2) receptor with Ki of 0.05 nM.

name: palmitate phytyl ester
definition: A fatty acid phytyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of phytol with the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid.

name: (2R,5R)-hexanediol
definition: A hexane-2,5-diol with R-configuration at both the C-2 and C-5 centres.

name: dainic acid A
definition: An L-proline derivative that is L-proline substituted by a carboxymethyl group at position 3 and a (2E)-6-methylhepta-2,5-dien-2-yl group at position 4. It is produced by the red algal Chondria armata.

name: myristate phytyl ester
definition: A fatty acid phytyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of phytol with the carboxy group of tetradecanoic acid.

name: laurate phytyl ester
definition: A fatty acid phytyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of phytol with the carboxy group of dodecanoic acid.

name: caprate phytyl ester
definition: A fatty acid phytyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of phytol with the carboxy group of decanoic acid.

name: all-cis-hexadeca-7,10,13-trienoate phytyl ester
definition: A fatty acid phytyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of phytol with the carboxy group of all-cis-7,10,13-hexadecatrienoic acid.

name: velutin
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is luteolin in which the hydroxy groups at positions 7 and 3' are replaced by methoxy groups.

name: (R,R,S)-α-tocopherol
definition: The (R,R,S)-stereoisomer of α-tocopherol.

name: (R,S,R)-α-tocopherol
definition: The (R,S,R)-stereoisomer of α-tocopherol.

name: (R,S,S)-α-tocopherol
definition: The (R,S,S)-stereoisomer of α-tocopherol.

name: (S,R,R)-α-tocopherol
definition: The (S,R,R)-stereoisomer of α-tocopherol.

name: (S,S,R)-α-tocopherol
definition: The (S,S,R)-stereoisomer of α-tocopherol.

name: (S,R,S)-α-tocopherol
definition: The (S,R,S)-stereoisomer of α-tocopherol.

name: L-803087
definition: A fluoroindole that is 1H-indole substituted by phenyl, 4-{[(2S)-5-carbamimidamido-1-methoxy-1-oxopentan-2-yl]amino}-4-oxobutyl, fluoro and fluoro groups at positions 2, 3, 5 and 7, respectively. It is a selective nonpeptidic agonist of the somatostatin subtype-4 (SST4) receptor with Ki of 0.7 nM.

name: L-817818
definition: A benzoindole that is 1H-benzo[g]indole substituted by naphthalen-2-yl and 2-({(2R)-6-amino-1-[(2S)-2-aminopropoxy]-1-oxohexan-2-yl}amino)-2-oxoethyl groups at positions 2 and 3, respectively. It is a selective nonpeptidic agonist of the somatostatin subtype-5 (SST5) receptor with Ki of 0.4 nM.

name: 2-[4-(piperidin-3-yl)phenyl]-2H-indazole-7-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 2H-indazole substituted by 4-(piperidin-3-yl)phenyl and aminocarbonyl groups at positions 2 and 7, respectively. It is a potent PARP1 inhibitor with IC50 of 3.2 nM.

name: 2-{4-[(3R)-piperidin-3-yl]phenyl}-2H-indazole-7-carboxamide
definition: A 2-[4-(piperidin-3-yl)phenyl]-2H-indazole-7-carboxamide that has R-configuration. It is a potent PARP1 inhibitor with IC50 of 2.4 nM.

name: caffeine-d9
definition: A deuterated isotopologue of caffeine in which the nine hydrogens contained in the 1, 3, and 7 methyl groups are substituted with deuterium.

name: thiazolidine-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A thiazolidinemonocarboxylic acid that is 1,3-thiazolidine substituted by a carboxy group at position 2.

name: albumycin
definition: A member of the class of isoindoles that is 4,7-dihydro-2H-isoindole substituted by methyl, oxo, methylamino, and oxo groups at positions 1, 4, 5, and 7, respectively. It is produced by heterologous expression of the fluostatin biosynthetic gene cluster from the marine derived Micromonospora rosaria SCSIO N160 in Streptomyces albus J1074.

name: mansouramycin A
definition: A member of the class of isoquinolines that is 5,8-dihydroisoquinoline substituted by methyl, methyl, oxo, methylamino and oxo groups at positions 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8, respectively. It was isolated from Streptomyces Sp. strain Mei37 from North Sea coast, Germany.

name: salumycin
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 4,7-dihydro-2H-indazole substituted by oxo groups at positions 4 and 7, and a methylamino group at position 5. It is produced by Streptomyces albus J1074 mutant strain.

name: 3-oxopropane-1-sulfonic acid
definition: An organosulfonic acid that is propanal substituted by a sulfo group at position 3.

name: 1-thia-4-azacyclohepta-3-ene-3,5-dicarboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of thiazepinedicarboxylic acids that is 2,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1,4-thiazepine substituted by carboxy groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: IMID-2
definition: A member of the class of imidazopyrimidines that is imidazo[1,2-a]pyrimidine substituted by a [4-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)piperazin-1-yl]acetyl group at position 3.

name: 6-O-malonyl-trans-rhaponticin
definition: A malonate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the 6-hydroxy group of trans-rhaponticin with the carboxy group of malonic acid.

name: L-778,123 hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of L-778,123. It is a dual inhibitor of FPTase and GGPTase-I (IC50 of 2nM and 98nm, respectively) and exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: naxagolide
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is (4aR,10bR)-3,4,4a,5,6,10b-hexahydro-2H-naphtho[1,2-b][1,4]oxazine substituted by propyl and hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 9, respectively. It is a potent dopamine D2-receptor agonist and its hydrochloride salt was under clinical development by Merck & Co as a potential antiparkinsonian agent (now discontinued).

name: naxagolide(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of naxagolide arising from the protonation of the tertiary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: naxagolide hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of naxagolide.

name: sodium pyrophosphate decahydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the decahydrate form of sodium diphosphate.

name: β-D-ManpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→2)-α-L-Rhap-(1-P-4)-β-D-ManpNAc-(1→4)-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-1-P-[CH2]5NH2
definition: A synthetic phosphate-linked oligosaccharide analogue that is a chimeric oligosaccharide antigen (ST19AF) comprised of one repeating unit each of the pneumococcal polysaccharides of Streptococcus pneumoniae serotypes 19A and 19F (ST19A and ST19F; CHEBI:62986 and CHEBI:62687). A terminal C5-amino linker enables site-specific conjugation to a carrier protein, to induce protective antibodies against both serotypes.

name: MK 351A
definition: A member of the class of formamidines that is lisinopril in which the primary amino group is substituted by an {(E)-[(4-hydroxyphenyl)imino]methyl}amino group. It is a potent ACE inhibitor.

name: 3-(4-azidobenzyl)-4-hydroxycoumarin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is 4-hydroxycoumarin which is substituted at position 3 by a 4-azidobenzyl group. It is a photoaffinity probe used in the identification of warfarin-binding proteins present in mammalian tissue.

name: brequinar
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylic acid that is quinoline substituted by 2'-fluoro[1,1'-biphenyl]-4-yl, methyl, carboxy and fluoro groups at positions 2, 3, 4, and 6, respectively. It is an inhibitor of dihydroorotate dehydrogenase, an enzyme that is required for de novo pyrimidine biosynthesis. The compound exhibits antineoplastic and antiviral properties.

name: plinabulin
definition: A member of the class of 2,5-diketopiperazines that is piperazine-2,5-dione substituted by benzylidene and (5-tert-butyl-1H-imidazol-4-yl)methylidene groups at positions 3 and 6, respectively. It is a vascular disrupting agent and a microtubule destabalising agent which was in clinical trials (now discontinued) for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer.

name: itarnafloxin
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is 3H-benzo[b]pyrido[3,2,1-kl]phenoxazin-3-one substituted by 2-[(2S)-1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl]ethanaminoacyl, fluoro, and 3-(pyrazin-2-yl)pyrrolidin-1-yl groups at positions 2, 5 and 6, respectively. It is a G-quadruplex interactive agent, previously in clinical trials for the treatment of carcinoid/neuroendocrine tumours (now discontinued).

name: (E)-dacarbazine
definition: A dacarbazine in which the N=N double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: andilesin A
definition: A meroterpenoid with formula C25H32O6. It is isolated from the fungus Aspergillus stellatus.

name: indole-5,6-quinone-2-carboxylate
definition: An indolecarboxylate that is the conjugate base of indole-5,6-quinone-2-carboxylic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: brequinar(1−)
definition: A quinolinemonocarboxylate that is the conjugate base of brequinar arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: brequinar sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt of brequinar.

name: N-trans-cinnamoyltyramine
definition: A member of the class of cinnamamides that is tyramine substituted by a (1E)-3-oxo-1-phenylprop-1-en-3-yl group at the nitrogen atom. It is found in rice and exhibits an allelopathic effect to suppress the growth of weeds.

name: grasshopper ketone
definition: A member of the class of allenes that is cyclohexane substituted by 3-oxobut-1-en-1-ylidene, methyl, hydroxy, hydroxy, methyl and methyl groups at positions 1, 2, 2, 4, 6 and 6, respectively (the 2R,3R,4S-stereoisomer). It is isolated from the grasshopper, Romalea microptera.

name: NiFe4S5 cluster
definition: A nickel-iron-sulfur cluster in which the nickel and iron atoms are linked by bridging sulfur atoms with the ratio Ni:Fe:S = 1:4:5.

name: N-{2-[(4-benzylpiperidin-1-yl)methyl]benzimidazol-5-yl}methanesulfonamide
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by (4-benzylpiperidin-1-yl)methyl and (methylsulfonyl)amino groups at positions 2 and 6, respectively. It is a potent antagonist of the GluN2B subunit of the N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor.

name: N-[2-(4-phenoxybenzyl)benzimidazol-5-yl]methanesulfonamide
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 4-phenoxybenzyl and (methylsulfonyl)amino groups at positions 2 and 6, respectively. It is a potent antagonist of the GluN2B subunit of the N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Manp2NAc3NAcA-(1→3)-β-L-FucpNAc4NMe-(1→6)-[L-α-D-Hepp-(1→4)]-D-Manf2,5anh
definition: A pentasaccharide derivative that comprises the distal pentasaccharide of the oligosaccharide segment of Bordetella pertussis strain 186 lipooligosaccharide.

name: α-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Manp2NAc3NAcA-(1→3)-β-L-FucpNAc4NMe-(1→6)-[L-α-D-Hepp-(1→4)]-α-D-GlcpN-(1→4)-[α-D-GalpNA-(1→6)]-β-D-Glcp-(1→4)-{α-D-GlcpN-(1→7)-[α-D-GlcpA-(1→2)]-D-α-D-Hepp-(1→3)}-L-α-D-Hepp-(1→5)-α-Kdop
definition: A twelve-residue oligosaccharide derivative that comprises the core oligosaccharide and distal trisaccharide of the oligosaccharide segment of Bordetella pertussis strain 186 lipooligosaccharide.

name: N-(3,7-dimethylocta-2,6-dien-1-yl)cyclopropanecarboxamide
definition: A cyclopropylcarboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of cyclopropanecarboxylic acid with the amino group of 3,7-dimethylocta-2,6-dien-1-amine.

name: 2-oxosuberate(2−)
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid dianion that is the conjugate base of 2-oxosuberic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 1-(2-(diphenylmethoxy)ethyl)-4-(2-(4-azido-3-iodophenyl)ethyl)piperazine
definition: An N-alkylpiperazine that consists of piperazine bearing 2-(benzhydryloxy)ethyl and 2-(4-azido-3-iodophenyl)ethyl groups at positions 1 and 4 respectively.

name: 4-[2-(diphenylmethoxy)ethyl]-1-[(4-azidophenyl)-methyl]-piperidine
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is piperidine substituted by (4-azidophenyl)methyl and 2-(diphenylmethoxy)ethyl groups at positions 1 and 4, respectively. It binds to the dopamine transporter ligand binding site.

name: sesterorbiculene
definition: A sesterterpene that is produced by several fungal chimeric terpene synthases (PTTS009, PTTS037 and PTTS054).

name: sesterevisene
definition: A sesterterpene that is produced by a fungal chimeric terpene synthase, PTTS010.

name: variediene
definition: A tricyclic diterpene that was initially produced by a chimeric terpene synthase gene found in the fungus Emericella variecolor which was heterologously expressed in Aspergillus oryzae.

name: fusaproliferene
definition: A sesterterpene that is produced by the fungal chimeric terpene synthase, PTTS036.

name: clavaphyllene
definition: A sesterterpene that is produced by a fungal chimeric terpene synthase, PTTS051.

name: penichrysol
definition: A diterpenoid that is produced by the fungal chimeric terpene synthases, PTTS087 and PTTS136.

name: brassiteraene A
definition: A sesterterpene that is produced by the fungal chimeric terpene synthase, PTTS125.

name: brassiteraene B
definition: A sesterterpene that is produced by the fungal chimeric terpene synthase, PTTS125.

name: 5-cis-lycopene
definition: An acyclic carotene that is lycopene having a cis-double bond at position 5.

name: 13-cis-lycopene
definition: An acyclic carotene that is lycopene having a cis-double bond at position 13.

name: 2,4-dichloro-3-oxoadipic acid
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid that is adipic acid substituted by an oxo group at position 3 and chloro groups at positions 2 and 4.

name: (8Z)-heptadecenal
definition: An 8-heptadecenal in which the double bond at position 8 adopts a cis-configuration.

name: 1,4,4,7a-tetramethyl-2,4,5,7a-tetrahydro-1H-inden-2-ol
definition: A member of the class of indenes that is 2,4,5,7a-tetrahydro-1H-indene substituted by methyl groups at positions 1, 4, 4 and 7a and by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 2-(α-D-Glcp-yl)-sn-3-GroP-[sn-3-GroP]5OH
definition: A synthetic α-glucosyl-functionalized stereospecifically numbered glycerol phosphate (GroP) oligomer in which the α-glucosyl substituent is located at the terminal unit of an sn-3-GroP hexamer.

name: [sn-3-GroP]6OH
definition: A synthetic stereospecifically numbered glycerol phosphate (GroP) oligomer. The structure of an sn-3-GroP hexamer, it can be conjugated to a protein through a 6-aminohexyl linker.

name: [sn-3-GroP]5OH
definition: A synthetic stereospecifically numbered glycerol phosphate (GroP) oligomer. The structure of an sn-3-GroP pentamer, it can be conjugated to a protein through a 6-aminohexyl linker.

name: L-dehydroascorbic acid hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the monohydrate of L-dehydroascorbic acid.

name: pavettamine
definition: An aminoalcohol that is N1-(5-aminopentyl)pentane-1,5-diamine substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 2', 4 and 4' (the 2R,4S,2'R,4'S-stereoisomer). It is a toxin produced by several plant species and the casual agent of gousiekte (''quick'' disease).

name: leucopterin (keto form)
definition: A member of the class of pterins that is 3,4,5,6,7,8-hexahydropteridine substituted by an amino group at position 2 and oxo groups at positions 4, 6 and 7. It is a pigment found in the wings of butterflies.

name: homoavicholic acid
definition: A 3α-hydroxy steroid that is avicholic acid that contains an extra methylene (CH2) group at position 24.

name: bongkrekate(3−)
definition: A tricarboxylic acid anion resulting from the deprotonation of the three carboxy groups of bongkrekic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: galanthamine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is conjugate acid of galanthamine resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: huperzine A(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of huperzine A resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 26-hydroxylanosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is lanosterol carrying a hydroxy group at position 26.

name: 26-oxolanosterol
definition: A 3β-sterol that is lanosterol carrying an oxo group at position 26.

name: hainanate A
definition: A steroid acid anion that is the conjugate base of hainanic acid A resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a (1→3), (1→4), (1→6) sequence of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and (at the reducing end) N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues, with the N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue also carrying a β-D-galactose residue via a (1→3) linkage.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of an N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue to which are linked via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl trisaccharide units.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is a branched undecasaccharide derivative in which two linear pentasaccharide branches, each formed from α-N-acetylneuraminyl-(2→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl-(1→3)-β-D-galactosyl-(1→4)-N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine are linked (1→3) and (1→6) to an N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue.

name: hastatoside
definition: An iridoid monoterpenoid with formula C17H24O11 that is isolated from several plants including Verbena officinalis and exhibits a sleep-promoting effect.

name: platencin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of platencin resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: caffeine-(trimethyl-13C3)
definition: A 13C-modified compound that is caffeine in which the carbon atoms of the three methyl groups at positions 1, 3 and 7 are replaced by 13C isotopes.

name: platensimycin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of platensimycin resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 20β-hydroxycortisone
definition: A C21-steroid that is cortisone in which the oxo group at position 20 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino hexasaccharide comprising a (2→6), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→3) sequence of α-sialyl, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear tetrasaccharide comprising β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked in sequence (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4).

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide comprising a linear hexasaccharide chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→4), (1→3), (1→4), (1→6), to the N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue at the reducing end of which is also linked (1→3) a further β-D-galactose residue.

name: leucopterin (enol form)
definition: A member of the class of pteridines that is pteridine substituted by an amino group at position 2 and hydroxy groups at positions 4, 6 and 7.

name: ent-pavettamine
definition: An aminoalcohol that is N1-(5-aminopentyl)pentane-1,5-diamine substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 2', 4 and 4' (the 2R,4S,2'R,4'S-stereoisomer).

name: (8E)-heptadecenal
definition: An 8-heptadecenal in which the double bond at position 8 adopts a trans-configuration.

name: avicholate
definition: A bile acid anion that is the conjugate base of avicholic acid obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-lanthionine dizwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion that is the dizwitterionic form of L-lanthionine obtained by migration of protons from both carboxy groups to the amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-homolanthionine dizwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion that is the dizwitterionic form of L-homolanthionine obtained by migration of protons from both carboxy groups to the amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: oncrasin-1
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by 4-chlorobenzyl and formyl groups at positions 1 and 3, respectively. It is an anti-cancer agent that is active against lung cancer cells with K-Ras mutations.

name: sotorasib
definition: A pyridopyrimidine that is pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidin-2(1H)-one substituted by 4-methyl-2-(propan-2-yl)pyridin-3-yl, (2S)-2-methyl-4-(prop-2-enoyl)piperazin-1-yl, fluoro and 2-fluoro-6-hydroxyphenyl groups at positions 1, 4, 6 and 7, respectively. It is approved for the treatment of patients with non-small cell lung cancer having KRASG12C mutations.

name: 1,1-dimethoxyethane
definition: An acetal that is dimethoxymethane substituted by a methyl group at position 1.

name: norcocaine
definition: A tropane alkaloid that is cocaine in which the N-methyl group has been demethylated. It is a metabolite of cocaine.

name: D-threo-neopterin
definition: A neopterin that has 1R,2R-configuration.

name: heptan-3-ol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is heptane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: neostigmine bromide
definition: The bromide salt of neostigmine.

name: 2,8-dioxoadenine
definition: An oxopurine that is adenine bearing two oxo substituents at positions 2 and 8.

name: 5-ethyl-5-methyl-1,3-oxazolidine-2,4-dione
definition: An oxazolidinone that is 1,3-oxazolidine-2,4-dione substituted by a methyl and ethyl group at position 5. It is a metabolite of paramethadione.

name: 6-oxo-nonan-1-ol
definition: An aliphatic alcohol that is nonan-1-ol carrying an oxo group at position 6.

name: 3-methylnonane-2,4-dione
definition: A β-diketone that is 3-methylnonane substituted by oxo groups at positions 2 and 4.

name: S-propyl hexanethioate
definition: A thioester obtained by the formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexanoic acid with the thiol group of propane-1-thiol.

name: 9-icosenoic acid
definition: An icosenoic acid having a double bond at position 9 (double bond configuration unknown).

name: (17Z)-icosenoic acid
definition: A 17-icosenoic acid in which the double bond adopts cis-configuration.

name: ethyl 2-methyl-3-pentenoate
definition: A fatty acid ethyl ester of 2-methyl-3-pentenoic acid.

name: hainanic acid A
definition: A tetracyclic triterpenoid isolated from the fruiting bodies of Ganoderma hainanense.

name: saxitoxin(2+)
definition: An iminium ion resulting from the protonation of the two imine groups of saxitoxin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tetrodotoxin(1+)
definition: An iminium ion resulting from the protonation of the imine group of tetrodotoxin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5E)-5-nonen-2-one
definition: A 5-nonen-2-one in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: (5Z)-5-nonen-2-one
definition: A 5-nonen-2-one in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: 9-cis-lycopene
definition: An acyclic carotene that is lycopene having a cis-double bond at position 9.

name: 15-cis-lycopene
definition: An acyclic carotene that is lycopene having a cis-double bond at position 15.

name: Z-L-Lys-SBzl hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of thiobenzyl benzyloxycarbonyl-L-lysinate. It is a substrate for a sensitive colorimetric assay for trypsin-like enzymes.

name: galanthamine hydrobromide
definition: The hydrobromide salt of galanthamine.

name: thiobenzyl benzyloxycarbonyl-L-lysinate
definition: An L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine in which the amino group is replaced by a [(benzyloxy)carbonyl]amino group and the carboxy group is replaced by a (benzylsulfanyl)carbonyl group. It is a substrate for a sensitive colorimetric assay for trypsin-like enzymes.

name: thiobenzyl benzyloxycarbonyl-L-lysinate(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of thiobenzyl benzyloxycarbonyl-L-lysinate resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-778,123 (free base)
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole substituted by (4-cyanophenyl)methyl and [4-(3-chlorophenyl)-3-oxopiperazin-1-yl]methyl groups at positions 1 and 5, respectively. It is a dual inhibitor of FPTase and GGPTase-I.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→3)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a linear tetrasaccharide chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→6), (1→4) and (1→6), to the N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue at the reducing end of which is also linked (1→3) a further β-D-galactose residue.

name: amperozide
definition: A member of the class of ureas that is urea in which three of the four hydrogens are replaced by ethyl and 4-[4,4-bis(4-fluorophenyl)butyl]piperazin-1-yl groups. An atypical antipsychotic which was in clinical development for the treatment of schizophrenia and substance-related disorders. It is a potent 5-HT2A antagonist and used in veterinary medicine because of its sedative effect on pigs.

name: ribavirin 5'-diphosphate
definition: A 1-ribosyltriazole that is ribavirin in which the hydroxy group at the 5'-position is replaced by a diphosphate group. It is the metabolite of the antiviral agent ribavirin.

name: 1,2,4-triazole-3-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1H-1,2,4-triazole substituted by an aminocarbonyl group at position 3. It is the major catabolite and aglycon of ribavirin.

name: ribavirin carboxylic acid
definition: A 1-ribosyltriazole that is ribavirin in which the carbamoyl group at position 3 is replaced by a carboxy group. It is a catabolite and impurity of ribavirin.

name: amperozide(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is conjugate acid of amperozide resulting from the protonation of the piperazine moiety; major species at pH 7.3.

name: amperozide hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of amperozide.

name: 3,3-diethyl-2-pyrrolidinone
definition: A pyrrolidin-2-one substituted by two ethyl groups at position 3.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-GalpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising a linear trisaccharide chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl and N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residues linked sequentially (2→3) and (1→3), to the N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine residue at the reducing end of which is also linked (1→6) an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue.

name: cis-flupenthixol(2+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion obtained by protonation of the two tertiary amino groups of cis-flupenthixol.

name: cis-flupenthixol dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of cis-flupenthixol.

name: beauveriolide I
definition: A cyclodepsipeptide with formula C27H41N3O5. It was originally isolated from the fungus Beauveria sp. FO-6979 during a screening program for inhibitors of lipid droplet accumulation in murine macrophages. It is an inhibitor of acyl-CoA: cholesterol acyltransferase (ACAT) and effective at reducing atherogenic lesions of the artery and heart in mouse models.

name: 1-[1-(1-benzothiophen-2-yl)cyclohexyl]piperidine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt obtained by reaction of 1-[1-(1-benzothiophen-2-yl)cyclohexyl]piperidine with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino pentasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 6 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: 4-phenyl-3-furoxancarbonitrile
definition: A 1,2,5-oxadiazole substituted by an oxido, cyano and phenyl groups at positions 2, 3 and 4, respectively. It is a vasodilator and inhibitor of platelet aggregation.

name: RK-24466
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolopyrimidines that is 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine substituted by amino, 4-phenoxyphenyl, and cyclopentyl groups at positions 4, 5 and 7, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of Lck that inhibits Lck (64-509) and LckCD isoforms (IC50 of less than 1 and 2 nM, respectively).

name: AMN082 dihydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining N,N'-bis(diphenylmethyl)ethane-1,2-diamine with two molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: N,N'-bis(diphenylmethyl)ethane-1,2-diamine(2+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the two amino groups of N,N'-bis(diphenylmethyl)ethane-1,2-diamine.

name: chlorprothixene hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of chlorprothixene.

name: chlorprothixene(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of chlorprothixene resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man groups.

name: 2-(1H-benzimidazol-2-yl)aniline
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by a 2-aminophenyl group at position 2.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino decasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: piperonylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of piperonylic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-methoxybenzoate
definition: A methoxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 3-methoxybenzoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (benzyloxy)acetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is benzyl alcohol in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a carboxymethoxy group.

name: (E,E)-di-1-propenyl sulfide
definition: A di-1-propenyl sulfide in which the two double bonds adopt trans-configuration.

name: (Z,Z)-di-1-propenyl sulfide
definition: A di-1-propenyl sulfide in which the two double bonds adopt cis-configuration.

name: (E,Z)-di-1-propenyl sulfide
definition: A di-1-propenyl sulfide in which one of the double bonds adopts a trans-configuration and the other double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: 2-(1,3-benzothiazol-2-yl)phenol
definition: A member of the class of benzothiazoles that is 1,3-benzothiazole substituted by a 2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 2.

name: 2-(1,3-benzoxazol-2-yl)phenol
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-benzoxazoles that is 1,3-benzoxazole substituted by a 2-hydroxyphenyl group at position 2.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino oligosaccharide that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by a β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: 2CN113
definition: An oligopeptide that is N-[(1E,3S)-6-amino-1-(methanesulfonyl)-6-oxohex-1-en-3-yl]-N2-carboxy-L-leucinamide in which the carboxy group is protected by a Cbz group. It is a SARS-CoV-2 Nsp5 main protease inhibitor that inhibits SARS-CoV-2 replication.

name: 2CN115
definition: An oligopeptide that is N-[(1E,3S)-6-amino-1-(methanesulfonyl)-6-oxohex-1-en-3-yl]-N2-carboxy-L-leucinamide in which the carboxy group is protected by a (3-ethynylphenyl)methyl group. It is a SARS-CoV-2 Nsp5 main protease inhibitor that inhibits SARS-CoV-2 replication.

name: 7-amino-2-(ethylsulfanyl)-5-oxo-1-phenyl-1,5-dihydro[1,2,4]triazolo[1,5-a]pyridine-6,8-dicarbonitrile
definition: A member of the class of triazolopyridines that is [1,2,4]triazolo[1,5-a]pyridin-5(1H)-one substituted by phenyl, ethylsulfanediyl, cyano, amino and cyano groups at positions 1, 2, 6, 7 and 8, respectively.

name: (R)-eliprodil
definition: The R-enantiomer of eliprodil.

name: (S)-eliprodil
definition: The S-enantiomer of eliprodil.

name: 1,2,3,6-tetrahydrophthalic anhydride
definition: A cyclic dicarboxylic anhydride that is 1,3,3a,4,7,7a-hexahydro-2-benzofuran carrying oxo groups at positions 1 and 3.

name: 1-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-[4-(4-fluorobenzyl)piperidin-1-yl]ethanol
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is piperidine substituted by a 2-(4-chlorophenyl)-2-hydroxyethyl group at position 1 and by a 4-fluorobenzyl group at position 4.

name: LLNL-02
definition: A member of the class of benzazepines that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-2-benzazepine substituted by a (2S)-2-{[(2E)-2-(hydroxyimino)acetyl]amino}propyl group at position 2. It is an antidote currently in development for nerve agent poisoning.

name: molnupiravir
definition: A nucleoside analogue that is N4-hydroxycytidine in which the 5'-hydroxy group is replaced by a (2-methylpropanoyl)oxy group. It is the prodrug of the active antiviral ribonucleoside analog N4-hydroxycytidine (EIDD-1931), has activity against a number of RNA viruses including SARS-CoV-2, MERS-CoV, and seasonal and pandemic influenza viruses. It is currently in phase III trials for the treatment of patients with COVID-19.

name: N4-hydroxycytidine
definition: A nucleoside analogue that is cytidine which carries a hydroxy group at the N4-positon. It has broad-spectrum antiviral activity against influenza, SARS-CoV , SARS-CoV-2 and MERS-CoV.

name: 3-amino-2,4-dihydroxybenzoate
definition: An aminobenzoate that is the conjugate base of 3-amino-2,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,3-dimethyl-2-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 3,3-dimethylbutyric acid substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: 4-hydroxy-TEMPO
definition: A member of the class of aminoxyls that is TEMPO carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 4. It is a radical scavenger which exhibits anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties.

name: 4-oxo-TEMPO
definition: A member of the class of aminoxyls that is TEMPO carrying an oxo group at position 4.

name: isovaleronitrile
definition: An aliphatic nitrile that is 2-methylpropane substituted by a cyano group at position 1.

name: 3-methyl-1-nitrobutane
definition: A primary nitroalkane that is 2-methylbutane substituted by a nitro group at position 4. It is a herbivore-induced plant volatile found in the leaves of Oenothera biennis.

name: 4-methoxy-TEMPO
definition: A member of the class of aminoxyls that is TEMPO carrying a methoxy substituent at position 4.

name: 4-carboxy-TEMPO
definition: A member of the class of aminoxyls that is TEMPO carrying a carboxy group at position 4.

name: 4-amino-TEMPO
definition: A member of the class of aminoxyls that is TEMPO carrying an amino group at position 4.

name: 4-acetamido-TEMPO
definition: A piperidinecarboxamide that is TEMPO carrying an acetamido group at position 4.

name: 4-(2-iodacetamido)-TEMPO
definition: A piperidinecarboxamide that is TEMPO carrying an 2-iodoacetamido group at position 4.

name: 4-maleimido-TEMPO
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is TEMPO carrying a maleimido group at position 4.

name: 4-hydroxy-TEMPO benzoate
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is TEMPO carrying a benzoyloxy group at position 4.

name: 4-methacryloyloxy-TEMPO
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is TEMPO carrying a methacryloyloxy group at position 4.

name: cremeomycin(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of cremeomycin resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: EUK-8
definition: A manganese coordination entity in which manganese(III) is coordinated to a salen ligand and a chlorine atom. It is a superoxide dismutase and catalase mimetic.

name: fasudil(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of fasudil arising from the protonation of the diazepane ring; major species at pH 7.3.

name: fasudil hydrochloride hydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the hemihydrate form of fasudil hydrochloride. It is a drug indicated for the prevention of cerebral vasospasm and ensuing cerebral ischemia following surgery for subarachnoid hemorrhage.

name: 20β-dihydroprednisolone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisolone in which the oxo group at position 20 has been reduced to the corresponding β-hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of prednisolone.

name: 6β-hydroxyprednisolone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisolone carrying a hydroxy group at the 6β position. It is a metabolite of prednisolone found in human urine.

name: ferulsinaic acid
definition: A member of the class of coumarins that is 2H-chromen-2-one substituted by a [(1R,2R,3S,5S)-2-(2-carboxyethyl)-2,5-dimethyl-3-(2-methylprop-1-en-1-yl)cyclopentyl]methoxy group at position 7. It is isolated from the roots of Ferula sinaica.

name: (S)-nomifensine
definition: The S enantiomer of nomifensine.

name: kynuramine(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of kynuramine resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: midafotel
definition: A member of the class of piperazines that is piperazine substituted by a carboxy group at position 2R and a (1E)-1-phosphonoprop-1-en-3-yl group at position 4. It is an antagonist of N-methyl-D-aspartate receptors (NMDARs) and was in clinical development by Novartis for the treatment of cognition disorders and brain injuries (now discontinued).

name: Ro 25-6981 maleate
definition: The maleic acid salt of Ro 25-6981. It is a potent and selective antagonist of GluN2B-containing NMDA receptors.

name: (R)-nicardipine
definition: The R-enantiomer of nicardipine.

name: 2-[benzyl(methyl)amino]ethyl methyl 2,6-dimethyl-4-(3-nitrophenyl)-1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarboxylate
definition: A dihydropyridine that is 1,4-dihydropyridine substituted by a methyl, {2-[benzyl(methyl)amino]ethoxy}carbonyl, 3-nitrophenyl, methoxycarbonyl and methyl groups at positions 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, respectively.

name: 2-hydroxyputrescine
definition: An alkane-α,ω-diamine that is putrescine substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 2-hydroxyputrescine(2+)
definition: An alkane-α,ω-diammonium(2+) that is the dication of 2-hydroxyputrescine arising from protonation of both primary amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: suramin(6−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the hexanion of suramin resulting from the deprotonation of the six sulfo groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Δ6-prednisolone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisolone in which a double bond is introduced at position 6. It is a metabolite of prednisolone found in human urine.

name: 6α-hydroxyprednisolone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisolone carrying a hydroxy group at the 6α position. It is a metabolite of prednisolone found in human urine.

name: Δ6-prednisone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisone in which a double bond is introduced at position 6. It is a metabolite of prednisone found in human urine.

name: 6α-hydroxyprednisone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisone carrying a hydroxy group at the 6α position. It is a metabolite of prednisone found in human urine.

name: 6β-hydroxyprednisone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisone carrying a hydroxy group at the 6β position. It is a metabolite of prednisone found in human urine.

name: solanid-5-en-3-ol
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is solanid-5-ene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: (E)-jasmolactone
definition: A jasmolactone in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: (Z)-jasmolactone
definition: A jasmolactone in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: (R)-3,4-dihydroxymandelaldehyde
definition: A 3,4-dihydroxymandelaldehyde that has R-configuration.

name: hexakis(2,2,3,3-tetrafluoropropoxy)cyclotriphosphazene
definition: An organofluorine compound that is 1,3,5,2,4,6-triazatriphosphinine substituted by 2,2,3,3-tetrafluoropropoxy groups at positions 2, 2, 4, 4, 6, and 6.

name: 3-methylisoquinoline
definition: An isoquinoline substituted by a methyl group at position 3.

name: 1-(4-hydroxy-2,6-dimethyl-5,6-dihydropyridin-3-yl)ethanone
definition: A dihydropyridine that is 2,3-dihydropyridine substituted by methyl, acetyl, hydroxy and methyl groups at position 2, 3, 4, and 6, respectively.

name: 5α-bufol
definition: The 5α-stereoisomer of bufol.

name: N,N'-diethylethylenediamine
definition: A diazaalkane consisting of octane having the two aza groups at the 3- and 6-positions.

name: pacificanone A
definition: A polyketide isolated from the marine actinomycete Salinispora pacifica.

name: anisatin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone with formula C15H20O8. It is a neurotoxic natural product found in plants of the family Illiciaceae.

name: (20S)-17α,20-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: An oxysterol that is cholesterol substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 17 and 20 (the 20S-stereoisomer).

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: 20α-dihydroprednisone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisone in which the oxo group at position 20 is replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of prednisone found in human urine.

name: 20β-dihydroprednisone
definition: A glucocorticoid that is prednisone in which the oxo group at position 20 is replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a metabolite of prednisone found in human urine.

name: β-D-ManpNAc4P-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: The amino disaccharide β-D-ManpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp phosphorylated at O-4 of the mannosyl residue.

name: ManNAz-DBCO-Pam3CSK4
definition: A carbohydrate derivative formed from a tetra-acetyl-N-azidoacetylmannosamine (AC4ManNAz) linked through a dibenzylcyclooctyl group (DBCO) to the triacylipopeptide N-palmitoyl-S-[2,3-bis(palmitoyloxy)propyl]-Cys-Ser-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys (Pam3CSK4; CHEBI:134411). Commonly abbreviated to MDP, it has been developed as an artificial neoantigen on tumour cells to enhance tumour immunogenicity, able to significantly improve the response and the clinical outcome of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs).

name: tetraacetyl-N-azidoacetyl-D-mannosamine
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is D-mannosamine in pyranose form with an azidocarbonyl group substituted on nitrogen and all hydroxy groups acetylated. It can be used to introduce an azido group in living cells which can be metabolized to N-azido acetylneuramic acid and eventually incorporated into the glycoproteins and glycolipids on the cell surface, while exhibiting very low toxicity.

name: allyl cyanide
definition: An aliphatic nitrile that is hydrogen cyanide in which the hydrogen has been replaced by an allyl group.

name: indirubin
definition: A member of the class of indolones that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one substituted by a 3-oxo-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-ylidene group at position 3. It is the active component of Dang Gui Long Hui Wan, which has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat inflammatory diseases and chronic myeloid leukemia.

name: 14-methylpentadecanoate
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 14-methylpentadecanoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxybutylnitrile
definition: A hydroxynitrile that is butanenitrile substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: 3-hydroxypropyl isothiocyanate
definition: An isothiocyanate that is 1-isothiocyanatopropane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3.

name: 5-ethenyl-1,3-oxazolidine-2-thione
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidines that is 1,3-oxazolidine substituted by sulfanylidene and ethenyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively.

name: (R)-goitrin
definition: A 5-ethenyl-1,3-oxazolidine-2-thione that has R-configuration. It is a constituent of a traditional Chinese herbal medicine, Radix isatidis.

name: (E)-4-hexen-3-one
definition: A 4-hexen-3-one in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: (Z)-4-hexen-3-one
definition: A 4-hexen-3-one in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: bis(pinacolato)diboron
definition: A 1,3,2-dioxaborolane that is 4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-1,3,2-dioxaborolane in which the boron hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a 4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-1,3,2-dioxaborolan-2-yl group. It is a reagent used in organic synthesis to synthesise pinacol boronic esters.

name: trimethyl phosphite
definition: An organophosphorus compound that is phosphane in which the three hydrogens are replaced by methoxy groups. It is an alkylating agent used primarily in the synthesis of organophosphate compounds.

name: Ro 25-6981(1+)
definition: A piperidinium ion resulting from the protonation of the piperidine nitrogen of Ro 25-6981; major species at pH 7.3.

name: triphenylphosphine
definition: A member of the class of tertiary phosphines that is phosphane in which the three hydrogens are replaced by phenyl groups.

name: capsidiol 3-acetate
definition: An acetate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group at position 3 of capsidiol with acetic acid. It is a phytoalexin produced by Nicotiana benthamiana against potato virus X.

name: 4-methoxybutyrfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-(4-methoxyphenyl)-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with butanoic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: 7β-hydroxydehydroepiandrosterone
definition: An androstanoid that is dehydroepiandrosterone carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at the 7β-position. It is a metabolite of dehydroepiandrosterone.

name: ocfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-(2-fluorophenyl)-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with methoxyacetic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: 3-naphthalen-2-yl-D-alanine
definition: A 3-naphthalen-2-ylalanine that has D-confliguration.

name: 5-acetyl-2,6-dimethyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyridin-4-one
definition: A tetrahydropyridine that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydropyridine substituted by methyl, oxo, acetyl and methyl groups at position 2, 4, 5, and 6, respectively.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→2)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by an α-D-Man-(1→2)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group.

name: psora 4
definition: A member of the class of psoralens that is psoralen substituted by a 4-phenylbutoxy group at position 5. It is a potent inhibitor of the voltage-gated potassium channel Kv1.3 (EC50 = 3 nM).

name: LFM-A13
definition: An enamide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2Z)-2-cyano-3-hydroxybut-2-enoic acid with the amino group of 2,5-dibromoaniline. It is a dual-function inhibitor of Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) and Polo-like kinases (PLK) that exhibits anticancer properties.

name: LY-367,265
definition: A fluoroindole that is 1H-indole in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 6 are replaced by 1-[2-(2,2-dioxo-5,6-dihydro-4H-2λ6-[1,2,5]thiadiazolo[4,3,2-ij]quinolin-1(2H)-yl)ethyl]-1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridin-4-yl and fluoro groups, respectively. It is an inhibitor of the 5-hydroxytryptamine transporter (Ki = 2.3 nM) and an antagonist of 5-hydroxytryptamine(2A) receptor (Ki = 0.81 nM).

name: L-744,832
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-{[(2S,3S)-2-{[(2R)-2-amino-3-sulfanylpropyl]amino}-3-methylpentyl]oxy}-3-phenylpropanoic acid with the amino group of propan-2-yl (2S)-2-amino-4-(methylsulfonyl)butanoate. It is a farnesyltransferase inhibitor that exhibits anticancer properties.

name: ketanserin tartrate
definition: The tartrate salt of ketanserin.

name: ketanserin(1+)
definition: A piperidinium ion obtained by protonation of the piperidine nitrogen of ketanserin; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 2,8-dihydroxyadenine
definition: A member of the class of 6-aminopurines that is adenine bearing two hydroxy substituents at positions 2 and 8. It is a highly insoluble metabolite of adenine that causes radiolucent urolithiasis. It is produced by individuals who suffer from adenine phosphoribosyltransferase (APRT) deficiency, a rare autosomal recessive error of purine metabolism.

name: 1,7-octadiene
definition: An alkadiene that is octane carrying two double bonds at positions 1 and 7.

name: DM-4103
definition: A 4-oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 4-oxobutanoic acid substituted at position 4 with a 5-chloro-2-[2-methyl-4-(2-methylbenzamido)benzamido]phenyl group. An oxobutyric acid metabolite of the vasopressin V2-receptor antagonist tolvaptan.

name: DM-4107
definition: A 4-hydroxy monocarboxylic acid that is 4-hydroxybutanoic acid substituted at position 4 with a 5-chloro-2-[2-methyl-4-(2-methylbenzamido)benzamido]phenyl group. An hydroxybutyric acid metabolite of the vasopressin V2-receptor antagonist tolvaptan.

name: (Z)-propanethial S-oxide
definition: A propanethial S-oxide in which the double bond adopts a Z-configuration.

name: (E)-propanethial S-oxide
definition: A propanethial S-oxide in which the double bond adopts an E-configuration.

name: tetrahydrofuranylfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-phenyl-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with tetrahydrofuran-2-carboxylic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: 7β-hydroxypregnenolone
definition: A 20-oxo steroid that is pregnenolone carrying an additional hydroxy substituent at the 7β-position.

name: 7-ketopregnenolone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-Δ5-steroid that is pregnenolone carrying an oxo group at position 7.

name: 7-ketodehydroepiandrosterone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-Δ5-steroid that is dehydroepiandrosterone carrying an additional oxo group at position 7.

name: 7β-hydroxyepiandrosterone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is epiandrosterone carrying a hydroxy group at the 7β position. It is an endogenous androgen metabolite that has been shown to exert neuroprotective effects.

name: β-D-Galp4S-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide comprised of a linear sequence of 4-O-sulfo-β-D-galactose, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine, β-D-galactose and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked (1→4), (1→3) and (1→4).

name: (+)-δ-cadinol
definition: A cadinane sesquiterpenoid that consists of 1,6-dimethyl-4-(propan-2-yl)-1,2,3,4,4a,7,8,8a-octahydronaphthalene having a hydroxy substituent at position 1 and (1S,4R,4aS,8aR)-configuration.

name: α-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-GalfNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetyl-α-D-galactopyranosamine and N-acetyl-β-D-galactofuranosamine residues joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic linkage.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc6S
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-β-D-glucosamine having an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at position 4.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-Mur
definition: An amino disaccharide that consists of muramic acid having an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue attached at position 4.

name: 4-cyanobenzoyl chloride
definition: An acyl chloride consisting of benzoyl chloride in which the hydrogen at position 4 is replaced by a cyano group.

name: di-tert-butyl nitroxide
definition: An aminoxyl that is N-tert-butyl-2-methylpropan-2-amine carrying an oxidanediyl group at the nitrogen atom.

name: 4,4-dimethyloxazolidine-N-oxyl
definition: A member of the class of oxazolidines that is 4,4-dimethyl-1,3-oxazolidine carrying an oxidanediyl group at position 3.

name: cremeomycin
definition: A diazo compound that is cyclohexa-1,3-diene substituted by carboxy, methoxy, diazo and oxo groups at positions 1, 4, 5, and 6, respectively. It is an natural product isolated from Streptomyces cremeus.

name: streptidine(2+)
definition: A guanidinium ion obtained by protonation of both guanidino groups of streptidine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man-(1→6)-α-D-Man group, while the D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end is substituted at position 6 by an α-L-Fuc residue.

name: (1-oxyl-2,2,5,5-tetramethylpyrroline-3-methyl)methanethiosulfonate
definition: An aminooxyl that is pyrroline substituted by an oxidanediyl group at position 1, by methyl groups at positions 2, 2, 5 and 5, and by a [(methylsulfonyl)sulfanyl]methyl group at position 3. It is a highly reactive thiol-specific spin label.

name: 3-amino-2,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid
definition: An aminobenzoic acid that is benzoic acid substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 4, and by an amino group at position 3.

name: dantrolene sodium hemiheptahydrate
definition: A hydrate which is the hemiheptahydrate of anhydrous dantrolene sodium.

name: hexadecan-2-ol
definition: A secondary fatty alcohol that is hexadecane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2.

name: 7-oxatyphasterol
definition: A brassinosteroid that is brassinolide in which the hydroxy group at position 2 has been replaced by a hydrogen atom.

name: (2-nitrophenyl)acetic acid
definition: A member of the class of phenylacetic acids that is phenylacetic acid in which the phenyl grup is substituted at the ortho- position by a nitro group.

name: (22S)-hydroxysitosterol
definition: A stigmastane sterol that is sitosterol substituted by a hydroxy group at position 22S.

name: tricholignan A
definition: A methylcatechol that is benzene substituted by hydroxy, hydroxy, (3E)-penta-1,3-dien-1-yl, methyl and methoxy groups at positions 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5, respectively. It is an iron(III)-reducing natural product isolated from the ascomycota Trichoderma harzianum.

name: 3,13,19-trimethyltricosanoic acid
definition: A methyl-branched fatty acid that is tricosanoic acid substituted by a methyl group at positions 3, 13 and 19.

name: AR-42
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-3-methyl-2-phenylbutanoic acid with the amino group of 4-amino-N-hydroxybenzamide. It is a pan-HDAC inhibitor that was in clinical development for the treatment of hematological malignancies and solid tumours.

name: (10Z)-tricosene
definition: A tricosene in which the double bond at position 10 has cis-configuration.

name: ammonium isovalerate
definition: An organic ammonium salt of isovaleric acid.

name: pentyl dodecanoate
definition: A dodecanoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of dodecanoic acid with the hydroxy group of pentan-1-ol.

name: N-methylthiourea
definition: A member of the class of thioureas that is thiourea in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by a methyl group.

name: 7-methyloctan-1-ol
definition: A primary alcohol that is octane which is substituted by a methyl group at position 7 and a hydroxy group at position 1. It is a fragrance ingredient.

name: N-ethylthiourea
definition: A member of the class of thioureas that is thiourea in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by an ethyl group.

name: N-acetylthiourea
definition: A member of the class of thioureas that is thiourea in which one of the hydrogens is replaced by an acetyl group.

name: octane-1-thiol
definition: An alkanethiol that is octane substituted by a thiol group at position 1.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group and the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end is substituted at position 6 by an α-L-Fuc residue.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide compound consisting of a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with an α-D-Man-(1→3)-{α-D-Man-(1→3)-[{α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man-(1→6)}-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a (1→4)-linkage and two α-L-Fuc residues attached via (1→3)- and (1→6)-linkages.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)}-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino decasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group, while the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by α-L-Fuc residues.

name: palovarotene
definition: An olefinic compound that is ethene is which a hydrogen at position 1 is replaced by a 4-carboxyphenyl group and a hydrogen at position 2 is replaced by a 5,5,8,8-tetramethyl-3-[(1H-pyrazol-1-yl)methyl]-5,6,7,8-tetrahydronaphthalen-2-yl group (the E-stereoisomer). It is a selective retinoic acid receptor γ (RARγ) agonist developed by Ipsen, to reduce the formation of new heterotopic ossification in adults and children with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP), a rare bone disorder.

name: 3,3',4',5-tetrachlorosalicylanilide
definition: A salicylanilide derivative with chloride substituents at C-3 and C-5 of the salicylate moiety and at C-3 and C-4 of the anilide moiety.

name: 2-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoate
definition: A monohydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 2-hydroxy-4-methoxybenzoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-2-phenylpropylamine
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 2-phenylpropylamine.

name: aldehydo-D-idose
definition: The open chain form of D-idose.

name: 28-norteasterone
definition: A brassinosteroid that is 6-deoxo-28-norteasterone carrying an oxo group at position 6.

name: dopaminechrome (enol form)
definition: A member of the class of indolones that is 3,5-dihydro-2H-indole substituted by an oxo group at position 5 and a hydroxy group at position 6.

name: Nα-benzoyl-L-asparagine 4-nitroanilide
definition: An L-asparagine derivative that is L-asparagine in which the amino group undergoes formal consensation with the carboxy group of benzoic acid and in which the carboxy OH group is replaced by a (4-nitrophenyl)amino group. It is an asparaginyl endopeptidase substrate.

name: dopaminechrome (keto form)
definition: A member of the class of indoledione that is 2,3,5,6-tetrahydro-1H-indole carrying oxo groups at positions 5 and 6; major microspecies at pH 7.3. It is an endogenous compound formed during dopamine oxidation and can induce neurotoxicity under certain aberrant conditions and induce Parkinson-like syndrome.

name: durohydroquinone
definition: A member of the class of hydroquinones that is benzene-1,4-diol carrying four methyl groups at positions 2, 3, 5 and 6.

name: 4-formylbenzoate
definition: A benzoate that is the conjugate base of 4-formylbenzoic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: carbovir triphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the tetraanion of carbovir triphosphate, arising from deprotonation of the four triphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: carbovir diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of carbovir diphosphate, arising from deprotonation of the diphosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: carbovir monophosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the dianion of carbovir monophosphate, arising from deprotonation of the monophosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R,S)-[hydroxy(phenyl)methyl]succinyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) that is the pentaanion of (R,S)-[hydroxy(phenyl)methyl]succinyl-CoA, arising from deprotonation of phosphate, diphosphate and carboxy functions. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (S)-2-benzoylsuccinyl-CoA(5−)
definition: An acyl-CoA(4−) arising from deprotonation of the phosphate, diphosphate and carboxy groups of (S)-2-benzoylsuccinyl-CoA.

name: preterpestacin I
definition: A sesterterpenoid that has been characterized as the product of Bipolaris maydis BmTS3.

name: 8-oxo-ATP(4−)
definition: A nucleoside triphosphate(4−) that is ATP with adenine bearing a single oxo substituent at position 8; major species present at pH 7.3.

name: (R,S)-[hydroxy(phenyl)methyl]succinyl-CoA
definition: A [hydroxy(phenyl)methyl]succinyl-CoA in which the [hydroxy(phenyl)methyl]succinic acid moiety adopts 1R,2S-configuration.

name: (3E)-ethyl 2-methyl-3-pentenoate
definition: An ethyl 2-methyl-3-pentenoate in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: (3Z)-ethyl 2-methyl-3-pentenoate
definition: An ethyl 2-methyl-3-pentenoate in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: 3-methoxy-1-butanol
