definition: A primary alcohol that is butane-1,3-diol in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: 3,3,4,4-tetramethyl-2-pentanone
definition: A methylketone that is pentan-2-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 3, 3, 4 and 4.

name: ribavirin 5'-monophosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the removal of both protons from the phosphate group of ribavirin 5'-monophosphate. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: ribavirin 5'-diphosphate(3−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the removal of the three diphosphate OH groups of ribavirin 5'-diphosphate. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: ribavirin 5'-triphosphate(4−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion resulting from the removal of the four triphosphate OH groups of ribavirin 5'-triphosphate. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: conidiogenol
definition: A diterpenoid with formula C20H34O2. It is isolated from Penicillium cyclopium and exhibits potent conidiation inducing activity.

name: conidiogenone
definition: A diterpenoid with formula C20H32O2. It is isolated from Penicillium cyclopium and exhibits potent conidiation inducing activity.

name: 8-oxo-ATP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate that is ATP carrying an oxo group at position 8.

name: 8-hydroxy-ATP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate that is ATP carrying a hydroxy group at position 8.

name: acetyl norfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-phenylpiperidin-4-amine with acetic acid. It is a metabolite of acetylfentanyl.

name: alternariol hapten ALa
definition: An alternariol hapten that is one of two regioisomeric haptens of the mycotoxin alternariol in which the five-atom carboxylated aliphatic spacer arm is located through the hydroxy group at C-9.

name: alternariol hapten ALb
definition: An alternariol hapten that is one of two regioisomeric haptens of the mycotoxin alternariol in which the five-atom carboxylated aliphatic spacer arm is located through the hydroxy group at C-3.

name: (E)-2-ethyl-2-hexenal
definition: A 2-ethyl-2-hexenal in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: (Z)-2-ethyl-2-hexenal
definition: A 2-ethyl-2-hexenal in which the double bond adopts a cis-configuration.

name: achilleol A
definition: A triterpenoid that is (1S)-2,2-dimethyl-4-methylidenecyclohexanol which is substituted at position 3 by a (6E,10E,14E)-2,6,10,15-tetramethylheptadeca-2,6,10,14-tetraen-17-yl group. It was the first monocyclic triterpenoid found in nature and originally isolated from Achillea odorata.

name: 4'-(4-fluorophenyl)acetanilide
definition: A biphenyl that is 1,1'-biphenyl substituted by a fluoro group at position 4 and a acetylamino group at position 4'. It induces neoplastic lesions in rats.

name: N-2-fluorenylphthalamic acid
definition: A member of the class of fluorenes that is 9H-fluorene substituted by a (2-carboxybenzoyl)amino group at position 2.

name: α-methyl-L-histidine
definition: An α-methylhistidine that has L-configuration.

name: S-(1-ethyl-2,5-dioxo-3-pyrrolidinyl)-L-cysteine
definition: An L-cysteine derivative that results when maleimide reacts with the thiol group of L-cysteine forming a thioether bond.

name: 3-chloro-L-tyrosine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 3-chloro-L-tyrosine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: nitrosocarbaryl
definition: A nitroso compound that is carbaryl in which the amino hydrogen is substituted by a nitroso group.

name: patulin‒4-bromothiophenol adduct
definition: An organosulfur compound that is a di-thiol adduct resulting from the reaction of the mycotoxin patulin with 4-bromothiophenol. Used in research into developing user-friendly and rapid immunoanalytical techniques for the decontamination by patulin in foodstuffs.

name: ICR 340
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of ICR 340.

name: ICR 340 (free base)
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is benzo[b][1,5]naphthyridine substituted by methoxy, chloro and {3-[(2-chloroethyl)(ethyl)amino]propyl}amino groups at positions 2, 7 and 10, respectively.

name: patulin‒4-bromothiophenol hapten
definition: An organosulfur compound that is a di-thiol hapten resulting from the reaction of the mycotoxin patulin with 4-bromothiophenol followed by condensation of the resultant adduct with β-alanine. Used in research into developing user-friendly and rapid immunoanalytical techniques for the decontamination by patulin in foodstuffs.

name: ICR 340(2+)
definition: An ammonium ion that is ICR 340 (free base) in which the tertiary amino group and the nitrogen of the benzonaphthpyridine ring are protonated.

name: 3,5-dinitrosalicylic acid hydrazide
definition: A carbohydrazide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3,5-dinitrosalicylic acid with one of the amino groups of hydrazine. It is a metabolite of nifursol found in foodstuffs of animal origin.

name: FLAG peptide
definition: An eight amino acid peptide consisting of L-aspartic acid, L-tyrosine, L-lysine, four L-aspartic acid residues, and L-lysine joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is widely used as a fusion tag for the purification and detection of a wide variety of recombinant proteins.

name: ribavirin carboxylate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of ribavirin carboxylic acid arising from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: CaMn4O5 cluster
definition: A metal-oxygen cluster containing 1 calcium atom, 4 managanese atoms and 5 oxygen atoms. It is the catalytic center of water oxidation in photosystem II (PSII).

name: (3,5-dihydroxyphenyl)acetate
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (3,5-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide compound consisting of a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a Man-α(1→3)-[Man-α(1→6)-Man-α(1→6)]-Man-β(1→4)-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage and two Fuc residues attached via α-(1→3)- and α-(1→6)-linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino nonasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by an α-D-Man-(1→2)-α-D-Man group, while the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end also carries two Fuc residues attached via α-(1→3)- and α-(1→6)-linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-[β-D-GlcNAc-(1→6)]-α-D-Man group, while the β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries two α-L-Fuc residues via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino nonasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man groups, while the D-GlcNAc carries two L-Fuc residues attached via α-(1→3)- and α-(1→6)-linkages.

name: N,N-dimethylsphingosine(1+)
definition: A sphingoid base(1+) that is the conjugate acid of N,N-dimethylsphingosine, obtained by protonation of the primary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E)-ethyl 3-(2-furyl)acrylate
definition: An ethyl 3-(2-furyl)acrylate in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: N,O-dimethylserotonin
definition: A tryptamine derivative hahing a methoxy group at position 5 of the indole portion and a methyl substituent on the side-chain nitrogen.

name: AZ3451
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by (1S)-1-cyclohexylethyl, 6-bromo-1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl, and 4-(cyanoanilino)acyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 5, respectively. It is an allosteric modulator of protease-activated receptor 2 (IC50 = 23 nM) and exhibits anti-osteoarthritis properties.

name: PB28
definition: A member of the class of tetralins that is tetralin that is substituted by 3-(4-cyclohexylpiperazin-1-yl)propyl and methoxy groups at positions 1 and 5, respectively. It is a sigma 2 (σ2) receptor agonist (Ki = 0.68 nM) and exhibits antineoplastic and anti SARS-CoV-2 activities.

name: pelabresib
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 4H-[1,2]oxazolo[5,4-d][2]benzazepine substituted by methyl, 2-amino-2-oxoethyl, and 4-chlorophenyl groups at positions 1, 4S and 6, respectively. It is a small molecule inhibitor of bromodomain and extra-terminal (BET) proteins and exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: PF-06446846
definition: A triazolopyridine that is 3H-[1,2,3]triazolo[4,5-b]pyridine substituted by a 4-{(3-chloropyridin-2-yl)[(3R)-piperidin-3-yl]carbamoyl}phenyl group at position 3. It is a potent inhibitor of PCSK9.

name: 6-hydroxymyosmine
definition: A monohydroxypyridine that is myosmine substituted by a hydroxy group at position 6; major microspecies at pH 7.3. It is a metabolite of nornicotine produced by Shinella sp. strain HZN7.

name: XL413
definition: A benzofuropyrimidine that is 3,4-dihydro[1]benzofuro[3,2-d]pyrimidine substituted by (2S)-pyrrolidin-2-yl, oxo and chloro groups at positions 2, 4, and 8, respectively. It is a potent ATP competitive inhibitor of Cdc7 kinase (IC50 = 3.4 nM) and exhibits anticancer properties.

name: 6-hydroxy-pseudooxy-nornicotinium
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 6-hydroxy-pseudooxy-nornicotine resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: varespladib(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide(1−) that is the conjugate base of varespladib resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5-methyltetrahydrofolate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 5-methyltetrahydrofolic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: varespladib
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by benzyl, ethyl, oxamoyl, and carboxymethoxy groups at positions 1, 2, 3, and 4, respectively. It is an oral secretory phospholipase A2 inhibitor and exhibits anti-inflammatory effects.

name: 2,5-dimethoxy-4-bromophenethylamine
definition: A 2-arylethylamine compound where the aryl moiety is 4-bromo-2,5-dimethoxyphenyl.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-D-Rib-ol-(5-P-2)-α-D-GalpO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A synthetic phosphate-linked oligosaccharide analogue that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a pseudotetrasaccharide corresponding to a repeating unit of the Streptococcus pneumoniae type 6A capsular polysaccharide.

name: metcamifen
definition: An N-sulfonylcarboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the sulfamoyl group of 4-[(methylcarbamoyl)amino]benzene-1-sulfonamide with the carboxy group of 2-methoxybenzoic acid. It is a herbicide safener applied as a seed treatment in sorghum.

name: α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap-(1→4)-D-Rib-ol-(5-P-2)-α-D-GalpO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A synthetic phosphate-linked oligosaccharide analogue that is the 2-aminoethyl glycoside of a pseudotetrasaccharide corresponding to a repeating unit of the Streptococcus pneumoniae type 6B capsular polysaccharide.

name: levomefolate calcium
definition: An organic calcium salt of (6S)-5-methyltetrahydrofolic acid.

name: (2Z,4E)-2-aminomuconic acid
definition: A 2-aminomuconic acid in which the two double bonds adopt a 2Z,4E-configuration.

name: (2E,4Z)-2-aminomuconic acid
definition: A 2-aminomuconic acid in which the two double bonds adopt a 2E,4Z-configuration.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino oligosaccharide that is an undecasaccharide derivative in which β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc has its mannosyl group substituted at positions 3 and 6 by β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man groups, while the D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries two L-Fuc residues attached via α-(1→3)- and α-(1→6)-linkages.

name: 2-aminomuconate
definition: A polyunsaturated dicarboxylic acid dianion arising from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 2-aminomuconic acid.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide that is β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the mannosyl group has been glycosylated by an α-D-mannopyranosyl residue and the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue carries an α-L-fucosyl residue via a (1→3) linkage.

name: saikosaponin C
definition: A member of the class of saikosaponins that is saikogenin E substituted by a 6-deoxy-α-L-mannopyranosyl-(1→4)-[β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→6)]-β-D-glucopyranosyl group at position 3β. It is a natural product isolated from the traditional Chinese herb, Radix Bupleuri and exhibits anti-HBV replication activity.

name: dysidenin
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (4S)-5,5,5-trichloro-N-methyl-N-[(3S)-4,4,4-trichloro-3-methylbutanoyl]-L-leucine with the amino group of (1S)-1-(1,3-thiazol-2-yl)ethanamine. It is a marine metabolite initially isolated from the sponge dysidea herbacea.

name: glycyrrhetic acid 3-O-glucuronide
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is the 3-O-β-glucuronide of glycyrrhetic acid. It is a metabolite of glycyrrhizin contained in licorice and potentially a causative agent in the pathogenesis of pseudoaldosteronism.

name: 6-hydroxy-pseudooxy-nornicotine
definition: A hydroxypyridine that is pyridine substituted by 4-aminobutanoyl and hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6, respectively. It is a metabolite of nornicotine produced by Shinella sp. strain HZN7.

name: SYC-435
definition: A cyclic hydroxamic acid that is 1-hydroxypyridin-2(1H)-one in which the hydrogens at positions 4 and 6 are substituted by methyl and benzyl groups, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of mutant isocitrate dehydrogenase 1 (Ki values of 190 nM against R132H mutant and 120 nM against R132C mutant).

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide derivative that is α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the β-D-GlcNAc residue carries an α-L-Fuc residue via a (1→3) linkage and the the D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries two α-L-Fuc residues via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-Manp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide that is β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc in which the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue distal to the reducing end carries an α-L-fucosyl residue via a (1→3) linkage.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide derivative that is α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the two GlcNAc residues each carry an α-L-Fuc residue via a (1→3) linkage.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide derivative that is α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the β-GlcNAc residue distal to the reducing end carries an α-L-Fuc residue via a (1→3) linkage and the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries an α-L-Fuc residue via a (1→6) linkage.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-{α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide derivative that is β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the β-GlcNAc residue distal to the reducing end carries an α-L-Fuc residue via a (1→3) linkage and the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries an α-L-Fuc residue via a (1→6) linkage.

name: 3-hydroxy-3-phenylpropionitrile
definition: A nitrile that is 3-phenylpropionitrile in which one of the methylene hydrogens at position 3 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: DDR1-IN-1
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(4-ethylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]-3-(trifluoromethyl)benzoic acid with the amino group of 5-(5-amino-2-methylphenoxy)-1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one. It is a potent inhibitor of discoidin domain receptor tyrosine kinase 1 and 2 (DDR1/2) with IC50 = 105 nM and 413 nM, respectively.

name: Met-enkephalin zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Met-enkephalin. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Arg-Phe(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the side-chain guanidino group and the amino terminus of Arg-Phe; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (2R,3S)-PPDA
definition: A 1-(phenanthren-2-ylcarbonyl)piperazine-2,3-dicarboxylic acid that has 2R,3S-configuration.

name: (2S,3R)-PPDA
definition: A 1-(phenanthren-2-ylcarbonyl)piperazine-2,3-dicarboxylic acid that has 2S,3R-configuration.

name: 1-(phenanthren-2-ylcarbonyl)piperazine-2,3-dicarboxylic acid
definition: A tertiary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of phenanthrene-2-carboxylic acid with the amino group of piperazine-2,3-dicarboxylic acid.

name: (S)-tianeptine
definition: The S-enantiomer of tianeptine.

name: (R)-tianeptine
definition: The R-enantiomer of tianeptine.

name: 7-[(3-chloro-6-methyl-5,5-dioxido-6,11-dihydrodibenzo[c,f][1,2]thiazepin-11-yl)amino]heptanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of dibenzothiazepines that is 3-chloro-6-methyl-6,11-dihydrodibenzo[c,f][1,2]thiazepine 5,5-dioxide substituted by a (6-carboxyhexyl)amino group at position 11.

name: himastatin
definition: A dimeric cyclohexadepsipeptide with formula C72H104N14O20. It is an antibiotic isolated from Streptomyces hygroscopicus and exhibits antitumor and antibacterial activity.

name: trimethylpyrazine
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine in which three hydrogens at positions 2, 3 and 5 have been replaced by methyl groups.

name: 5a-carba-β-D-mannosyl C32-phosphomycoketide
definition: A cyclitol phosphate that is 5a-carba-β-D-mannose having a (4S,8S,12S,16S,20S)-4,8,12,16,20-pentamethylheptacosyl)phosphate group at position 1.

name: (β-D-mannosyl)methyl C32-phosphonomycoketide
definition: A mannose phosphate consisting of β-D-mannose having a (4S,8S,12S,16S,20S)-4,8,12,16,20-pentamethylheptacosyl)phosphonomethyl group at position 1.

name: 1,1-difluoro-1-(β-D-mannosyl)methyl C32-phosphonomycoketide
definition: A mannose phosphate consisting of β-D-mannose having a (4S,8S,12S,16S,20S)-4,8,12,16,20-pentamethylheptacosyl)phosphono(difluoro)methyl group at position 1.

name: α-L-QuipNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-QuipNAc-(1→4)]-α-D-GalpANAc-(1→3)-α-L-QuipNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of an N-acetyl-α-L-quinovosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galacturonosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-L-quinovosamine trisaccharide unit, the galacturonosaminyl residue of which carries a further N-acetyl-α-L-quinovosaminyl residue via a (1→4) glycosidic linkage. Corresponds to the tetrasaccharide repeating unit of the capsular polysaccharide of Vibrio vulnificus MO6-24.

name: α-D-FucpNAc-(1→3)-[α-L-RhapNAc-(1→4)]-α-D-GalpANAc-(1→3)-α-L-QuipNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of an N-acetyl-α-L-fucosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-D-galacturonosaminyl-(1→3)-N-acetyl-α-L-quinovosamine trisaccharide unit, the galacturonosaminyl residue of which carries also an N-acetyl-α-L-rhamnosaminyl residue via a (1→4) glycosidic linkage. Corresponds to the tetrasaccharide repeating unit of the capsular polysaccharide of Vibrio vulnificus BO62316.

name: N-(1-hydroxydodecan-2-yl)tetracosanamide
definition: A carboxamide consisting of a 1-hydroxydodecan-2-yl moiety linked via nitrogen to tetracosanamide. A ceramide mimetic, it is composed of a saturated C12-sphingosine mimetic and lignoceric acid (C24:0).

name: hispidin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of hispidin resulting from the deprotonation of the 4-hydroxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: calcium silicate
definition: An inorganic calcium salt having silicate as the counterion.

name: calcium stearate
definition: An organic calcium salt of stearic acid. It is a component of some lubricants and surfactants.

name: tripotassium phosphate
definition: An inorganic potassium salt that is the tripotassium salt of phosphoric acid.

name: 6'-sialyl LacNAc-C12L
definition: An artificial glycosphingolipid composed of the ceramide mimetic C12L (CHEBI:190285) bound to a 6'-sialyl LacNAc [α-Neu5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc] oligosaccharide via a β-linkage.

name: sLex-C12L
definition: An artificial glycosphingolipid composed of the ceramide mimetic C12L (CHEBI:190285) bound to a sialyl Lewisx [α-Neu5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-D-GlcNAc] oligosaccharide via a β-linkage.

name: Lex-C12L
definition: An artificial glycosphingolipid composed of the ceramide mimetic C12L (CHEBI:190285) bound to a Lewisx [β-D-Gal-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→3)]-D-GlcNAc] oligosaccharide via a β-linkage.

name: γ-camphorene
definition: A cycloalkene that is cyclohexene substituted by 2-methylpent-2-en-5-yl and 6-methylhepta-1,5-dien-2-yl groups at positions 1 and 5, respectively. It is a diterpene isolated from several plant species.

name: azobenzene
definition: A molecule whose structure comprises two phenyl rings linked by a N=N double bond; the parent compound of the azobenzene class of compounds.

name: 4,4'-dichlorobenzhydrol
definition: A secondary alcohol that is diphenylmethanol which carries chloro groups at positions 4 and 4'. It is a metabolite of the insecticide DDT.

name: 3β-(2-diethylaminoethoxy)androst-5-en-17-one
definition: A 17-oxo steroid that is dehydroepiandrosterone in which the hydroxy group at position 3β is replaced by a 2-(diethylamino)ethoxy group. It is a cholesterol biosynthesis inhibitor and induces cataracts in rats.

name: 3β-(2-diethylaminoethoxy)androst-5-en-17-one(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 3β-(2-diethylaminoethoxy)androst-5-en-17-one arising from the protonation of the tertiary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 3β-(2-diethylaminoethoxy)androst-5-en-17-one hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by reaction of 3β-(2-diethylaminoethoxy)androst-5-en-17-one with one equivalent of hydrochloric acid. It is a cholesterol synthesis and transport inhibitor.

name: barium carbonate
definition: An inorganic carbonate salt of barium.

name: barium nitrate
definition: An inorganic nitrate salt of barium.

name: barium acetate
definition: An acetate salt in which the cationic component is barium(2+).

name: ergotamine(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is conjugate acid of ergotamine resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: caesium formate
definition: The organic caesium salt of formic acid.

name: testosterone sulfate(1−)
definition: A steroid sulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of testosterone sulfate, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: C3-C12L
definition: An artificial glycosphingolipid composed of the ceramide mimetic C12L (CHEBI:190285) bound to a β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc oligosaccharide via a β-linkage.

name: CF4-C12L
definition: An artificial glycosphingolipid composed of the ceramide mimetic C12L (CHEBI:190285) bound to a β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→6)]-D-GlcNAc oligosaccharide via a β-linkage.

name: N-(1-hydroxyoctadecan-2-yl)tetracosanamide
definition: A carboxamide consisting of a 1-hydroxyoctadecan-2-yl moiety linked via nitrogen to tetracosanamide. A ceramide mimetic, it is composed of a saturated C18-phytosphingosine and lignoceric acid (C24:0).

name: 2α-hydroxytaxusin
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that is taxusin substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2α.

name: 2α,7β-dihydroxytaxusin
definition: A taxane diterpenoid that is taxusin substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2α and 7β.

name: CF4-C182L
definition: An artificial glycosphingolipid composed of the ceramide mimetic C182L (CHEBI:190504) bound to a β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→6)]-D-GlcNAc oligosaccharide via a β-linkage.

name: CF3-C182L
definition: An artificial glycosphingolipid composed of the ceramide mimetic C182L (CHEBI:190504) bound to a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fuc-(1→6)]-D-GlcNAc oligosaccharide via a β-linkage.

name: imipenem zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of imipenem having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated methaneimidamido group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-[β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide consisting of a β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc trisaccharide unit, to the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end of which is also linked (1→6) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc
definition: An amino trisaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 6 have been converted into the corresponding 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl and α-L-fucopyranosyl derivatives, respectively.

name: calcium citrate
definition: An organic calcium salt composed of calcium cations and citrate anions in a 3:2 ratio.

name: dasatinib(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of dasatinib, resulting from the protonation of the piperazine tertiary amino group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising a chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl and β-D-galactose residues linked sequentially (2→6) and (1→3). A 5-aminopentyl linker may be attached to the oxygen at position 1 of the galactose residue.

name: Leu-enkephalin zwitterion
definition: A peptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Leu-enkephalin. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: substance P(3+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained from the protonation of the amino and guanidino groups of substance P; major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-Phe-L-Phe-Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2(1+)
definition: A peptide cation that is the conjugate acid of L-Phe-L-Phe-Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2, arising from the protonation of the N-terminal amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-Phe-Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2(1+)
definition: A peptide cation that is the conjugate acid of L-Phe-Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2, arising from the protonation of the N-terminal amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2(1+)
definition: A peptide cation that is the conjugate acid of Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2, arising from the protonation of the N-terminal amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-Leu-L-Met-NH2(1+)
definition: A peptide cation that is the conjugate acid of L-Leu-L-Met-NH2, arising from the protonation of the N-terminal amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: goralatide(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by removal of protons from the two carboxy groups as well as protonation of the primary amino group of goralatide; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-L-seryl-L-aspartate(2−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of N-acetyl-L-seryl-L-aspartic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Lys-Pro(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the side-chain amino group and the amino terminus of Lys-Pro; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ile-Leu zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Ile-Leu.

name: Tyr-Ile-Leu zwitterion
definition: A tripeptide zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of Tyr-Ile-Leu. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: Tyr-Gly-Gly zwitterion
definition: A tripeptide zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of Tyr-Gly-Gly. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: Phe-Met zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Phe-Met.

name: Phe-Leu zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino terminus of Phe-Leu.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprising a chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and β-D-galactose residues linked sequentially (2→6) and (1→3), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue of which is also attached via a β(1→3) linkage a futher D-galactosyl residue. A 5-aminopentyl linker may be attached to the oxygen at position 1 of the galactose residue.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and β-D-galactose residues linked sequentially (2→6) and (1→3), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue of which is also attached via a β(1→3) linkage an N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl-(1→4)-D-galactosyl disaccharide side-chain. A 5-aminopentyl linker may be attached to the oxygen at position 1 of the reducing-end galactose residue.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and β-D-galactose residues linked sequentially (2→6) and (1→3), to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue of which is also attached via a β(1→3) linkage an N-acetylneuraminyl-(1→3)-D-galactosyl disaccharide side-chain. A 5-aminopentyl linker may be attached to the oxygen at position 1 of the reducing-end galactose residue.

name: dihydrodemethylsterigmatocystin
definition: An organic heteropentacyclic compound that is sterigmatocystin in which the methoxy group at position 6 is replaced by a hydroxy group.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-[α-Neup5Ac-(2→3)]-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp
definition: A branched amino pentasaccharide comprising a chain of α-N-acetylneuraminyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and β-D-galactose residues linked sequentially (2→3), (1→3) and (1→3), to the D-galactosyl residue distal to the reducing end is also attached an N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residue of which is also attached via a β(1→6) linkage an N-acetyl-D-galactosyl residue. A 5-aminopentyl linker may be attached to the oxygen at position 1 of the reducing-end galactose residue.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→6)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide comprising α-N-acetylneuraminyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and β-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (2→6) and (1→3). A 5-aminopentyl linker may be attached to the oxygen at position 1 of the reducing-end glucose residue.

name: N-methyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline
definition: A tertiary amine consisting of 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoline having an N-methyl substituent.

name: RepSox
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole substituted by 6-methylpyridin-2-yl and 1,5-naphthyridin-2-yl groups at positions 3 and 4, respectively. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of TGF-β R1 kinase (IC50 = 4 nM) and ALK5 autophosphorylation and binding (IC50 = 23 nM).

name: SU11274
definition: A member of the class of oxindoles that is 1,3-dihydro-2H-indol-2-one substituted by {3,5-dimethyl-4-[(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)carbonyl]-1H-pyrrol-2-yl}methylidene and N-(3-chlorophenyl)-N-methylmethanesulfonyl groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is a potent ATP-competitive inhibitor of c-Met (IC50 = 20 nM) and exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: L-Leu-L-Met-NH2
definition: A dipeptide composed of L-leucine and L-methioninamide units joined by a peptide linkage. It is a noncompetitive inhibitor of Gap1 transport.

name: Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2
definition: A tripeptide composed of glycine, L-leucine and L-methioninamide joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is a C-terminal fragment of substance P.

name: N-acetyl-L-seryl-L-aspartic acid
definition: A dipeptide formed from N-acetyl-L-seryl and L-aspartic acid residues.

name: L-Phe-Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-phenylalanine, glycine, L-leucine, and L-methioninamide joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is a C-terminal fragment of substance P.

name: L-Phe-L-Phe-Gly-L-Leu-L-Met-NH2
definition: A pentapeptide composed of L-phenylalanine, L-phenylalanine, glycine, L-leucine, and L-methioninamide joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is a C-terminal fragment of substance P.

name: Ser-Asp-Lys-Pro
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-serine, L-aspartic acid, L-lysine, and L-proline joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: goralatide
definition: A tetrapeptide that is Ser-Asp-Lys-Pro in which the N-terminal amino group carries an acetyl group. It is selective inhibitor of primitive haematopoietic cell proliferation and exhibits anti-inflammatory, anti-fibrotic, and pro-angiogenic properties.

name: 4-formylbenzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid substituted by a formyl group at position 4.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino hexasaccharide comprised of a backbone of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked in sequence (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannosyl residue is also linked (1→2) a β-D-xylosyl residue.

name: zearalenone hapten ZEo
definition: A macrolide that is an immunizing hapten of the mycotoxin zearalenone which incorporates a carboxylated[(5-carboxypentyl)oxy]imino spacer arm through the carbonyl function at C-7.

name: zearalenone hapten ZEp
definition: A macrolide that is an immunizing hapten of the mycotoxin zearalenone which incorporates a carboxylated five-carbon long aliphatic spacer arm through the oxygenated quasi-distal position at C-14.

name: 17β-estradiol 17-sulfate
definition: A steroid sulfate obtained by the formal condensation of sulfuric acid with the 17-hydroxy group of 17β-estradiol.

name: benzpyrimoxan
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine substituted by [4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]methoxy and 1,3-dioxan-2-yl groups at positions 4 and 5, respectively. It is an insecticide discovered and developed by Nihon Nohyaku, inhibits molting of nymphs of plant and leaf hoppers and reduces the pest population in paddy fields.

name: mannostatin A
definition: An amino cyclitol that is cyclopentane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 3, by an amino group at positon 4, and by a methylsulfanediyl group at position 5 (the 1R,2R,3R,4S,5R-stereoisomer). It is isolated from the soil bacterium Streptoverticillium verticillium.

name: mannostatin B
definition: An amino cyclitol that is cyclopentane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2 and 3, by an amino group at positon 4, and by a methylsulfinyl group at position 5 (the 1R,2R,3R,4S,5R-stereoisomer). It is isolated from the soil bacterium Streptoverticillium verticillium.

name: Lys-Gly(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the side-chain amino group and the amino terminus of Lys-Gly; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Asp-Gly(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the terminal and side-chain carboxy groups and protonation of the terminal amino group of Asp-Gly; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Gly-Asp(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the terminal and side-chain carboxy groups and protonation of the terminal amino group of Gly-Asp; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Phe-Phe zwitterion
definition: An L-aminoacyl-L-amino acid zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-phenylalanyl-L-phenylalanine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with a β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a β-(1→4)-linkage.

name: Leu-Leu zwitterion
definition: An L-aminoacyl-L-amino acid zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-leucyl-L-leucine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-methyl-guanosine-5'-triphosphate-5'-guanosine
definition: A guanosine 5'-phosphate that is 7-methyl-GTP in which the hydroxy group of the terminal phosphate is substituted by a guanosinyl group. It is a cap analog that can be incorporated into mRNA.

name: Tyr-Gly zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-tyrosylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Met-Phe-Met zwitterion
definition: A tripeptide zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of Met-Phe-Met. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: Ala-Leu-Ala zwitterion
definition: A tripeptide zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of Ala-Leu-Ala. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide comprised of a backbone of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked in sequence (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannosyl residue is also linked (1→2) a β-D-xylosyl residue, while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is also linked (1→6) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: dilevalol(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of (R,R)-labetalol resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R)-leptophos
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of leptophos.

name: (S)-leptophos
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of leptophos.

name: O-(4-bromo-2,5-dichlorophenyl) O-methyl phenylphosphonothioate
definition: An organic phosphonate that is phenylphosphonothioic O,O-acid in which the hydroxy groups are substituted by methoxy and 4-bromo-2,5-dichlorophenoxy groups.

name: epyrifenacil
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of S-3100-CA with ethanol. It is a proherbicide for S-3100-CA and exhibits high efficacy against a wide range of broad-leaved weeds and grass weeds.

name: S-3100-CA
definition: An aromatic ether that is benzene substituted by [2-(carboxymethoxy)pyridin-3-yl]oxy, chloro, fluoro, and 3-methyl-2,6-dioxo-4-(trifluoromethyl)-3,6-dihydropyrimidin-1(2H)-yl groups at position 1, 2, 4 and 5, respectively. It is the active metabolite of the proherbicide epyrifenacil.

name: spirobudifen
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is 1-oxaspiro[4.5]dec-3-en-2-one substituted by 2,4-dichlorophenyl and (butoxycarbonyl)oxy groups at positions 3 and 4, respectively. It is an acaricide from Zhejiang Udragon Bioscience.

name: tiorantraniliprole
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxylic acid group of 3-bromo-1-(3-chloropyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-5-carboxylic acid with the primary amino group of 2-amino-3,5-dichloro-N-(propan-2-yl)benzenecarbothioamide. It is an insecticide from Zhejiang Udragon Bioscience.

name: 3-methylbenzylsuccinate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 3-methylbenzylsuccinic acid; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-methylbenzylsuccinic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid consisting of succinic acid carrying a 3-methylbenzyl group at position 2.

name: isocycloseram
definition: A diastereoisomeric mixture containing containing 80-100% of the (4R,5S)-isomer and 0-20% of (4R,5R)-,(4S,5R)-, and (4S,5S)-isomers. It is a broad-spectrum insecticide and acaricide developed by Syngenta Crop Protection that is active against several pest species including lepidopteran, hemipteran, and dipteran pest species.

name: (4R,5S)-isocycloseram
definition: The (4R,5S)-stereoisomer of isocycloseram.

name: (4R,5R)-isocycloseram
definition: The (4R,5R)-stereoisomer of isocycloseram.

name: (4S,5R)-isocycloseram
definition: The (4S,5R)-stereoisomer of isocycloseram.

name: (4S,5S)-isocycloseram
definition: The (4S,5S)-stereoisomer of isocycloseram.

name: 4-[5-(3,5-dichloro-4-fluorophenyl)-5-(trifluoromethyl)-4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazol-3-yl]-N-(2-ethyl-3-oxo-1,2-oxazolidin-4-yl)-2-methylbenzamide
definition: A member of the class of isoxazoles that is 4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazole substituted by 4-[(2-ethyl-3-oxo-1,2-oxazolidin-4-yl)carbamoyl]-3-methylphenyl, trifluoromethyl, and 3,5-dichloro-4-fluorophenyl groups at positions 3, 5, and 5, respectively.

name: 3-hydroxyglutarate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 3-hydroxyglutaric acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,4-dimethylphenyl hydrogen sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is 2,4-xylenol in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: 2,5-xylenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that phenol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 5.

name: 2,5-dimethylphenyl hydrogen sulfate
definition: An aryl sulfate that is 2,5-xylenol in which the phenolic hydrogen has been replaced by a sulfo group.

name: 2,2-dimethylsuccinate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 2,2-dimethylsuccinic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,3-dimethylsuccinate(2−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 2,3-dimethylsuccinic acid ; major species at pH 7.3.

name: tetflupyrolimet
definition: An N-alkylpyrrolidine that is pyrrolidine substituted by methyl, oxo, (2-fluorophenyl)aminocarbonyl, and 3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl groups at positions 1, 2, 3, and 4, respectively. It is a herbicide developed by FMC Corporation for the control of grass weeds in rice, as well as key broadleaf weeds and sedges.

name: (E)-N-[2-(4-bromocinnamylamino)ethyl]isoquinoline-5-sulfonamide
definition: A N-[2-(4-bromocinnamylamino)ethyl]isoquinoline-5-sulfonamide in which the double bond adopts a trans-configuration.

name: (2R,3S)-C75
definition: A 4-methylidene-2-octyl-5-oxotetrahydrofuran-3-carboxylic acid that has 2R,3S-configuration.

name: (2S,3R)-C75
definition: A 4-methylidene-2-octyl-5-oxotetrahydrofuran-3-carboxylic acid that has 2S,3R-configuration.

name: 4-methylidene-2-octyl-5-oxotetrahydrofuran-3-carboxylic acid
definition: A tetrahydrofuranone that is tetrahydrofuran substituted by octyl, carboxy, methylidene, and oxo groups at positions 2, 3, 4 and 5, respectively.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide that is β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 of the mannosyl residue have been glycosylated by β-D-xylopyranosyl and α-D-mannopyranosyl residues respectively, while the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries also an α-L-fucosyl residue attached via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: ADP-α-D-ribose
definition: An ADP-D-ribose with α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: ADP-β-D-ribose
definition: An ADP-D-ribose with β configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: DDR1-IN-2
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(4-ethylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]-3-(trifluoromethyl)benzoic acid with the primary amino group of N3-[(4-methoxy-1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridin-5-yl)methyl]-4-methylbenzene-1,3-diamine. It is a potent inhibitor of discoidin domain receptor tyrosine kinase 1 and 2 (DDR1/2) with IC50 = 47 nM and 145 nM, respectively.

name: taiwanin C
definition: A furonaphthodioxole that is furo[3',4':6,7]naphtho[2,3-d][1,3]dioxol-6(8H)-one substituted by a 1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl group at position 5. It is a naturally occurring lignan extracted from Taiwania cryptomerioides and found to be a potential inhibitor of COX2 expression.

name: 2-aminoacetyl fluoride
definition: An acyl flouride that is acetyl fluoride substituted by an amino group at position 2. It is a carcinogenic agent which induces hepatocellular carcinoma in rodents.

name: 2,4-hexadienyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetic acid with the hydroxy group of hexa-2,4-dien-1-ol.

name: α-camphorene
definition: A cycloalkene that is cyclohexene substituted by 2-methylpent-2-en-5-yl and 6-methylhepta-1,5-dien-2-yl groups at positions 1 and 4, respectively. It is a diterpene isolated from several plant species.

name: 8-{3-oxo-2-[(2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl]cyclopentyl}octanoic acid
definition: A cyclopentanone that is cyclopentane substituted by a 7-carboxyheptyl, (2Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl, and oxo groups at positions 1, 2, and 3, respectively.

name: arachidonyl-2'-chloroethylamide
definition: A fatty amide obtained by the formal condensation of arachidonic acid with 2-chloroethanamine. It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor (Ki = 1.4 nM) and also has a low affinity for the CB2 receptor (Ki = 3100 nM).

name: 8-[(1S,2S)-3-oxo-2-{(Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl}cyclopentyl]octanoate
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 8-[(1S,2S)-3-oxo-2-{(Z)-pent-2-en-1-yl}cyclopentyl]octanoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: helioxanthin
definition: A furonaphthodioxole that is furo[3',4':6,7]naphtho[1,2-d][1,3]dioxol-7(9H)-one substituted by a 1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl group at posiiton 10. It is a inhibitor of HBV, HCV and HSV-1 viruses.

name: acetyl fluoride
definition: An acyl fluoride that is fluoroethane carrying an oxo group at position 1.

name: pennicitrinone C
definition: A pyranoxanthene that is 3,5-dihydro-2H-pyrano[4,3,2-kl]xanthene substituted by methyl groups at positions 2R, 3S, 4, and 10, by an oxo group at position 5, by hydroxy groups at positions 8 and 10, and by a (2S,3S)-3-hydroxybutan-2-yl group at position 9. It is a natural product isolated from the fungus Penicillium citrinum B-57.

name: penicitrinol B
definition: A furopyranoxanthene with formula C24H28O6. It is a natural product isolated from the fungus Penicillium citrinum B-57.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with an α-D-Man-(1→6)-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)]-[α-D-Man-(1→3)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a (1→4)-linkage and α-L-Fuc residues attached via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages.

name: (16S,22S)-dihydroxycholesterol
definition: A C27-steroid that is cholesterol carrying a hydroxy group at position 16S and 22S.

name: ponatinib(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of ponatinib resulting from the protonation of the piperazine nitrogen. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: ponatinib hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of ponatinib. It is a potent pan inhibitor of tyrosine kinases, active in all single resistance ABL kinase mutations including the T315l mutation. It is approved for the treatment of chronic myeloid leukemia.

name: (16S)-hydroxy-22-oxocholesterol
definition: A C27-steroid that is cholesterol carrying a hydroxy group at position 16S and an oxo group at position 22.

name: Glu-Arg-Gly-Met
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, L-arginine, glycine, and L-methionine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: Glu-Arg-Gly-Met-Thr
definition: A pentapeptide composed of L-glutamic acid, L-arginine, glycine, L-methionine, and L-threonine joined in sequence by peptide linkages.

name: (22R)-furost-5-en-3β,22-diol
definition: A 3β-hydroxy-Δ5-steroid that is furostan carrying a double bond between positions 5-6 and hydroxy groups at positions 3β and 22R.

name: lauryl acrylate
definition: An acrylate ester obtained by the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of dodecan-1-ol with the carboxy group of acrylic acid.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide that is β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc in which the hydroxy groups at positions 2 and 3 of the mannosyl residue have been glycosylated by a β-D-xylopyranosyl residue and an N-acetyl-β-D-glucopyranosaminyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannopyranosyl group respectively, while the GlcNAc residue at the reducing end carries also an α-L-fucosyl residue attached via a (1→3)-linkage.

name: anisiflupurin
definition: A member of the class of 6-aminopurines that is 9H-purine substituted by fluoro and (3-methoxyphenyl)amino groups at positions 2 and 6, respectively. It is a plant growth regulator developed by Syngenta crop protection AG and an inhibitor of cytokinin oxidase/dehydrogenase 2.

name: fenmezoditiaz
definition: An iminium betaine that is 2,3,7,8-tetrahydro[1,3]thiazolo[3,2-a]pyrimidin-4-ium substituted by a 2-chloro-1,3-thiazol-5-yl, oxidanidyl, phenyl, oxo, and methyl groups at positions 3R, 5, 6, 7 and 8, respectively. It is a mesoionic insecticide developed by BASF.

name: 3-methoxytyraminium
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 3-methoxytyramine resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (−)-N6-(2-phenylisopropyl)adenosine
definition: A hydrocarbyladenosine in which adenosine is substituted at N-6 by a (2R)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl group. It is a potent adenosine A1 receptor agonist that exhibits neuroprotective and antinociceptive properties.

name: spinacetin 3-β-gentiobioside
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is spinacetin in which the hydroxy group at position 3 has been replaced by a β-gentiobiosyl group.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide comprised of a backbone of α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked in sequence (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannosyl residue is also linked (1→2) a β-D-xylosyl residue, while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end is also linked (1→6) an α-L-fucosyl residue.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide consisting of a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with an α-D-Man-(1→3)-[β-D-Xyl-(1→2)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a (1→4) linkage and α-L-Fuc residues attached via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide comprised of a backbone of N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, α-D-mannosyl, β-D-mannosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked in sequence (1→2), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4), to the β-D-mannosyl residue is also linked (1→2) a β-D-xylosyl residue, while to the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end are also linked (1→3) and (1→6) α-L-fucosyl residues.

name: N-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)cyclobutyl]-2-(trifluoromethyl)pyridine-3-carboxamide
definition: A member of the class of cyclobutanes that is cyclobutane substituted by [2-(trifluoromethyl)pyridine-3-carbonyl]amino and 2,4-dichlorophenyl groups at positions 1 and 2, respectively.

name: (R,R)-cyclobutrifluram
definition: A N-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)cyclobutyl]-2-(trifluoromethyl)pyridine-3-carboxamide that has 1R,2R-configuration.

name: (S,S)-cyclobutrifluram
definition: A N-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)cyclobutyl]-2-(trifluoromethyl)pyridine-3-carboxamide that has 1S,2S-configuration.

name: metarylpicoxamid
definition: An ester resulting from the formal condensation of the hydroxy group of (2S,3S)-3-(2-methylphenyl)butan-2-yl N-(3-hydroxy-4-methoxypyridine-2-carbonyl)-L-alaninate with the carboxy group of propanoic acid. It is a fungicide from Corteva Agriscience.

name: L-796,778
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-{[(2S)-1-(4-nitroanilino)-1-oxo-3-phenylpropan-2-yl]carbamoyl}-D-norleucyl-L-lysine with methanol. It is a partial agonist of somatostatin subtype receptor 3 (Ki = 24 nM) that exhibits anticonvulsant effects.

name: 1-O-α-D-glucopyranosyl-D-mannitol
definition: A 1-O-D-glucopyranosyl-D-mannitol that has α configuration at the anomeric centre.

name: (2ξ)-6-O-α-D-glucopyranosyl-D-arabino-hexitol
definition: A glycosyl alditol consisting of α-D-glucopyranose and (2ξ)-D-arabino-hexitol residues joined in sequence by a (1→1) glycosidic bond.

name: 1-O-α-D-glucopyranosyl-D-mannitol dihydrate
definition: A hydrate that is the dihydrate form of 1-O-α-D-glucopyranosyl-D-mannitol.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc

definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 3,4-dihydro-2H,5H-pyrano[3,2-c]chromene substituted by methyl, oxo, hydroxy, methoxy and methoxycarbonyl groups at positions 2R, 4, 7, 8 and 10, respectively. It is isolated from the fungal strain Ascomycota sp. Ind19F07, which was isolated from the deep sea sediment of the Indian Ocean.

definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 1H,10H-pyrano[4,3-b]chromene substituted by methyl, hydroxy, methoxy, methoxycarbonyl, and oxo groups at positions 3, 6, 7, 9 and 10, respectively. It is produced by cultures of Chaetomium sp. Gö 100/2, which was isolated from marine algae.

name: chaetocyclinone A

It is produced by cultures of Chaetomium sp. Gö 100/2, which was isolated from marine algae.

name: chaetocyclinone C
definition: A chromone with formula C32H24O14. It is produced by cultures of Chaetomium sp. Gö 100/2, which was isolated from marine algae.

name: anisotanol A
definition: A norsesquiterpenoid with formula C14H24O3. It is isolated from Anisodus tanguticus.

name: anisotanol B
definition: A norsesquiterpenoid with formula C14H22O3. It is isolated from Anisodus tanguticus.

name: anisotanol C
definition: A norsesquiterpenoid with formula C14H22O3. It is isolated from Anisodus tanguticus and displays antiangiogenic activity by inhibiting the viability, migration, and tube formation in HUVECs.

name: anisotanol D
definition: A norsesquiterpenoid with formula C14H22O3. It is isolated from Anisodus tanguticus.

name: westerdijkin A
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the the carboxy group of {4-[(2-hydroxy-3-methylbut-3-en-1-yl)oxy]phenyl}acetic acid with methanol. It is a natural product isolated from the culture of the deep sea-derived fungus Aspergillus westerdijkiae SCSIO 05233.

name: sydoxanthone C
definition: A member of the class of xanthones that is 9H-xanthen-9-one substituted by methoxycarbonyl, methylsulfinyl, hydroxymethyl and hydroxy groups at positions 1, 2, 6 and 8, respectively. It is a natural product isolated from the deep-sea-derived fungus Aspergillus sp. SCSIO Ind09F01.

name: acremolin B
definition: An imidazopurine that is 4,5-dihydro-1H-imidazo[2,1-b]purine substituted by methyl, oxo, methyl, and isopropyl groups at positions 1, 4, 5, and 7, respectively. It is a natural product isolated from the deep-sea-derived fungus Aspergillus sp. SCSIO Ind09F01.

name: secoxyloganin(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester(1−) that is the conjugate base of secoxyloganin, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 1,6-dihydroxyphenazine
definition: A member of the class of phenazines that is phenazine substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 6.

name: 1-hydroxy-6-methoxyphenazine
definition: A member of the class of phenazines that is phenazine substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1 and a methoxy groups at position 6. It is a bacterial metabolite found in Streptomyces thioluteus and exhibits weak antibacterial activity.

name: 1,6-dimethoxyphenazine
definition: A member of the class of phenazines that is phenazine substituted by methoxy groups at positions 1 and 6. It is a bacterial metabolite found in Streptomyces thioluteus.

name: 1,6-dimethoxyphenazine N5-oxide
definition: An N-oxide that is 1,6-dimethoxyphenazine carrying an oxido group at positions 5; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 1,6-dimethoxyphenazine N5,N10-dioxide
definition: An N-oxide that is 1,6-dimethoxyphenazine carrying oxido groups at positions 5 and 10; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 8-hydroxyquinoline N-oxide
definition: A quinoline N-oxide carrying a hydroxy substituent at position 8.

name: O-methyltyrosine
definition: A tyrosine derivative that is tyrosine in which the hydroxy group at position 4 of the phenyl ring is substituted by a methoxy group.

name: 2,4-dihydroxypyrimidine-5-carboxylic acid
definition: A hydroxypyrimidine that is pyrimidine-2,4-diol carrying a carboxy group at position 5.

name: O-methyl-D-tyrosine
definition: The D-enantiomer of O-methyltyrosine.

name: quinacillin
definition: A semisynthetic penicillase-resistant penicillin with antibacterial activity; it binds to and inactivates penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs) located on the inner membrane of the bacterial cell wall.

name: cefaloram
definition: A cephalosporin derivative with potent antibacterial activity which binds to and inactivates penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs) located on the inner membrane of the bacterial cell wall. PBPs are enzymes involved in the terminal stages of assembling the bacterial cell wall and in reshaping the cell wall during growth and division, inactivation of which interferes with the cross-linkage of peptidoglycan chains necessary for bacterial cell wall strength and rigidity, resulting in the weakening of the bacterial cell wall and causing cell lysis.

name: erysodine
definition: An erythrina alkaloid with formula C18H21NO3 isolated from several erythrina plant species. It is a competitive antagonist of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors and exhibits antiparasitic and insecticidal activities.

name: Ala-Lys(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the side-chain amino groups and the amino terminus of Ala-Lys; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ala-Val zwitterion

name: BAY-826
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-cyano-5-(pentafluoro-λ6-sulfanyl)benzoic acid with the amino group of 2,4-dimethyl-5-[6-(pyridin-3-yl)-1H-imidazo[1,2-b]pyrazol-1-yl]aniline. name: ciprofloxacin zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion formed from ciprofloxacin by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 7-methyl-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol
definition: A member of the class of naphthalenediols that is 1,2-dihydronaphthalene substituted by hydroxy, hydroxy and methyl groups at position 1, 2 and 7, respectively.

name: leupeptin(1+)
definition: A guanidinium ion that is the conjugate acid of leupeptin, arising from protonation of the guanidino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-hydroxyphenazine-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of phenazines that is phenazine substituted by a carboxy group at positions 1 and a hydroxy group at position 6. A natural product found in Streptomyces sp. IFM 11204.

name: foslevodopa
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is L-dopa in which the hydroxy group at position 4' is replaced by a phosphonooxy group. It is a water-soluble prodrug of levodopa which is used for the treatment of Parkinson's disease.

name: foscarbidopa
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is carbidopa in which the hydroxy group at position 4' is replaced by a phosphonooxy group. It is a water-soluble prodrug of carbidopa which is used for the treatment of Parkinson's disease.

name: N-phenyl-D-glucopyranosylamine
definition: An N-D-glucosylarylamine that is D-glucopyranose in which the hydroxy group at position 1 is replaced by an anilino group.

name: 7-methylmellein
