name: ochratoxin B(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of ochratoxin B resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (19Z)-geissoschizine
definition: An indole alkaloid with formula C21H24N2O3.

name: (12Z)-10-hydroxyoctadec-12-enoic acid
definition: An octadecenoic acid that is (12Z)-octadec-12-enoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 10. It is a metabolite of linoleic acid produced by the gut lactic acid bacterium Lactobacillus plantarum.

name: LY 379268
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that is (1R,5S)-2-oxabicyclo[3.1.0]hexane carrying amino, carboxy, and carboxy groups at positions 4R, 4R and 6R, respectively. It is a potent agonist of group II metabotropic glutamate receptors mGluR2 and mGluR3 (EC50 = 2.69 nM and 4.48 nM, respectively) that exhibits antipsychotic-like action in animal models of schizophrenia.

name: S-(3-hydroxypropyl)-thioacetate
definition: A thioester that is ethanethioic S-acid in which the thiol group is substituted by a (3-hydroxypropyl)sulfanediyl group.

name: asterriquinone C1
definition: A bisindole alkaloid that is quinone bearing two hydroxy substituents at position 2 and 5 and two indol-3-yl groups at positions 3 and 6, one of which is carrying a 1,1-dimethylallyl group at position 2; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (1R,2S)-7-methyl-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol
definition: A cis-1,2-dihydroxy-1,2-dihydro-7-methylnaphthalene that has 1R,2S-configuration.

name: (1S,2R)-7-methyl-1,2-dihydronaphthalene-1,2-diol
definition: A cis-1,2-dihydroxy-1,2-dihydro-7-methylnaphthalene that has 1S,2R-configuration.

name: ladanein
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is scutellarein in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4' and 7 are replaced by methoxy groups. It is an effective anti-HCV agent.

name: salvigenin
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is scutellarein in which the hydroxy groups at positions 4', 6, and 7 are replaced by methoxy groups.

name: SM-164
definition: A potent cell-permeable and bivalent Smac mimetic which binds to XIAP, cIAP-1 and cIAP-2 proteins (Ki = 0.56 nM, 0.31 nM and 1.1 nM, respectively). It induces apoptosis and tumor regression in cancer xenograft models.

name: 2-amino-4-(3-nitrophenyl)-3-cyano-7-(dimethylamino)-4H-chromene
definition: A member of the class of chromenes that is 4H-chromene substituted by amino, cyano, 3-nitrophenyl, and dimethylamino groups at positions 2, 3, 4 and 7, respectively. It exhibits anti-cancer activity.

name: α-L-Rhap3Me-(1→4)-[α-L-Rhap3Me-(1→4)]4-α-L-Rhap3Me-(1→2)-L-glyceraldehyde
definition: A linear hexasaccharide derivative consisting of six 3-O-methyl-α-L-rhamnose residues linked sequentially (1→4), with the residue at the reducing end linked glycosidically to the 2-oxygen of L-glyceraldehyde.

name: spiroalbatene
definition: A diterpene produced by a diterpene synthase from Allokutzneria albata.

name: diosmetin-7-olate
definition: A flavonoid oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the 7-hydroxy group of diosmetin; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: mochimganine
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of vanillic acid with the hydroxy group of cyclohexanol.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→6)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino decasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 6 by an α-L-Fuc-(1→6)-[β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 3 by a β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino decasaccharide derivative that is β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-D-GlcNAc in which the mannosyl group is substituted at position 3 by an α-L-Fuc-(1→3)-[β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group and at position 6 by a β-D-GalNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man group.

name: 7,8-dimethoxyflavone
definition: A dimethoxyflavone that is the 7,8-dimethyl ether derivative of 7,8-dihydroxyflavone.

name: rhamnacene-3-olate
definition: A flavonol oxoanion that is the conjugate base of rhamnacene resulting from the deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group; Major species at pH.7.3.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide consisting of α-D-mannose, β-D-mannose and two N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues linked sequentially (1→6), (1→4) and (1→4), to the α-D-mannose residue of which are linked (1→3) and (1→6) two further α-D-mannose residues and to the β-D-mannose residue of which is (1→3)-linked also an α-D-mannose residue. The N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue at the reducing end carries also an α-L-fucosyl residue via a (1→3) linkage.

name: α-Neup5Ac-(2→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprised of N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and (at the reducing end) N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residues all linked sequentially (1→4), with the reducing-end N-acetyl-β-D-glucosamine residue carrying also an L-fucosyl residue via a (1→3) linkage.

name: pentafluorobenzyl bromide
definition: A member of the class benzyl bromides that is benzyl bromide in which the hydrogens at positions 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 of the phenyl ring are replaced by fluoro groups. It is a versatile derivatization agent in chromatography and mass spectrometry.

name: β-longipinene
definition: A bridged compound and sesquiterpene that is tricyclo[5.4.0.02,8]undecane that is substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 6, and 6, and by a methylidene group at position 9.

name: carcininium
definition: A primary ammonium ion obtained by protonation of the primary amino group of carcinine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: sulfociprofloxacin
definition: An organosulfonic acid that is ciprofloxacin carrying a sulfo group at position 4 of the piperazine ring. It is a metabolite of ciprofloxacin.

name: varespladib methyl
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of varespladib with methanol. It is a potential therapy for the treatment of snakebite envenomings in which toxicity depends on the action of PLA2s.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-α-D-GlcpNAcOMe
definition: A methyl glycoside that is α-L-fucopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by methoxy.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino octasaccharide that consists of the linear tetrasaccharide β-D-Xyl-(1→2)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the Man residue is substituted at positions 3 and 6 by β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man groups.

name: octanoyloxidanyl
definition: An organic radical derived from octanoic acid.

name: bicyclosesquiphellandrene
definition: An octahydronaphthalene that is 1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,7-octahydronaphthalene substituted by isopropyl, methyl, and methylidene groups at positions 1, 4 and 7, respectively (the (1S,4R,4aR)-stereoisomer).

name: (2S)-5-hydroxy-4',7-dimethoxyflavanone
definition: A 5-hydroxy-4',7-dimethoxyflavanone that has (S)-configuration.

name: (−)-helminthogermacrene
definition: The (−)-isomer of helminthogermacrene.

name: (+)-helminthogermacrene
definition: The (+)-isomer of helminthogermacrene.

name: (1E)-1-aci-nitro-ω-(methylsulfanyl)alkane
definition: A 1-aci-nitro-ω-(methylsulfanyl)alkane in which the double bond adopts an E-configuration.

name: (Z)-ω-(methylsulfanyl)alkyl desulfoglucosinolate
definition: A ω-(methylsulfanyl)alkyl desulfoglucosinolate in which the double bond adopts a Z-configuration.

name: 1-epi-bicyclosesquiphellandrene
definition: An octahydronaphthalene that is 1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,7-octahydronaphthalene substituted by isopropyl, methyl, and methylidene groups at positions 1, 4 and 7, respectively (the (1S,4R,4aS)-stereoisomer).

name: PYR-41
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-{4-[(5-nitrofuran-2-yl)methylidene]-3,5-dioxopyrazolidin-1-yl}benzoic acid with ethanol. It is an irreversible and cell-permeable inhibitor of ubiquitin-activating enzyme E1.

name: prespatane
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is decahydrocyclobuta[1,2-a:3,4-a']dicyclopentene substituted by prop-1-en-2-yl, methyl and methyl groups at positions 1, 3a and 6, respectively (the 1S,3aS,3bR,6S,6aS,6bS-stereoisomer). It is a sesquiterpene initially isolated from the tropical marine sponge Cymbastela hooperi.

name: talaropentaene
definition: A triterpene produced by Talaromyces verruculosus talaropentaene synthase from all-trans-hexaprenyl diphosphate.

name: macrophomene
definition: A triterpene produced by Macrophomina phaseolina macrophomene synthase.

name: colleterpenol
definition: A triterpenoid produced by Colletotrichum gloeosporioides colleterpenol synthase from all-trans-hexaprenyl diphosphate.

name: ent-bonnadiene
definition: A diterpene produced by a bacterial diterpene synthase from Chryseobacterium wanjuense.

name: 4-methoxytyraminium
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 4-methoxytyramine resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group; major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 4-O-methyl-L-dopa zwitterion
definition: An aromatic L-α-amino acid zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 4-O-methyl-L-dopa. Major species at pH 7.3

name: (Z)-PYR-41
definition: A PYR-41 that has (Z)-configuration.

name: (E)-PYR-41
definition: A PYR-41 that has (E)-configuration.

name: mollebenzylanol A
definition: A diterpenoid isolated from the leaves of Rhododendron molle.

name: mollebenzylanol B
definition: A diterpenoid isolated from the leaves of Rhododendron molle.

name: 4-O-methyl-L-dopa
definition: An L-dopa in which the hydroxy group at position 4 is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: okaramine C
definition: An indole alkaloid isolated from Penicillium simplicissimum. It exhibits insecticidal activity.

name: α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: An amino tetrasaccharide that is β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc in which the hydroxy group at position 3 of the mannosyl group has been glycosylated by an α-D-mannopyranosyl residue.

name: fluchloraminopyr
definition: A 2-[(4-amino-3,5-dichloro-6-fluoropyridin-2-yl)oxy]propanoic acid that has (R)-configuration. It is a herbicide developed by KingAgroot (an agricultural biotechnology company in China) for the treatment of grass weeds and broadleaf weeds.

name: 2-[(4-amino-3,5-dichloro-6-fluoropyridin-2-yl)oxy]propanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of aminopyridines that is pyridine substituted by 1-carboxyethoxy, chloro, amino, chloro, and fluoro groups at positions 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6, respectively.

name: fluchloraminopyr-tefuryl
definition: A tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethyl 2-[(4-amino-3,5-dichloro-6-fluoropyridin-2-yl)oxy]propanoate that has (R)-configuration. It is the proherbicde of fluchloraminopyr.

name: (R)-fluoxytioconazole (thione)
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of fluoxytioconazole (thione).

name: (S)-fluoxytioconazole (thione)
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of fluoxytioconazole (thione).

name: (R)-fluoxytioconazole (thiol)
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of fluoxytioconazole (thiol).

name: (S)-fluoxytioconazole (thiol)
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of fluoxytioconazole (thiol).

name: tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethyl 2-[(4-amino-3,5-dichloro-6-fluoropyridin-2-yl)oxy]propanoate
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-[(4-amino-3,5-dichloro-6-fluoropyridin-2-yl)oxy]propanoic acid with the hydroxy group of tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethanol.

name: aminocyclopyrachlor-triethylammonium
definition: The triethylammonium salt of aminocyclopyrachlor.

name: 4,5,4'-trihydroxy-3,3'-dimethoxybibenzyl
definition: A diphenylethane that is 1,2-dihydrostilbene substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 4, 4', and 5 and a methoxy groups at positions 3 and 3'. It is isolated from Dendrobium ellipsophyllum and sensitizes lung cancer cells to anoikis.

name: 7,8-diacetoxy-4-methylcoumarin
definition: A coumarin substituted by a methyl group at position 4 and by acetyloxy groups at positions 7 and 8. It exhibits strong antioxidant and radical scavenging properties.

name: kwakhurin
definition: A member of the class of 7-hydroxyisoflavones that is 7-hydroxyisoflavone with additional hydroxy groups at positions 4' and 6', a methoxy group at position 3' and a prenyl group at position 2'. A characteristic estrogen-like isoflavonoid produced in Pueraria candollei var. mirifica (Leguminosae), which has long been used as a folk medicine for rejuvenation in Thailand.

name: sceliphrolactam
definition: A polyene macrocyclic lactam with formula C28H35NO6. It was isolated from an actinomycete, Streptomyces sp. and displays antifungal activity against amphotericin B-resistant Candida albicans.

name: talarodiene
definition: A diterpene that is produced by a cryptic type I diterpene synthase in marine-derived fungus Aspergillus flavipes.

name: β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide derivative that is β-D-GlcNAc-(1→2)-α-D-Man-(1→3)-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc in which the D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end is substituted at position 6 by an α-L-Fuc residue.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→6)]-{α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-β-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino heptasaccharide compound consisting of a β-D-GlcNAc residue at the reducing end with an α-D-Man-(1→3)-[α-D-Man-(1→6)]-β-D-Man-(1→4)-β-D-GlcNAc moiety attached via a (1→4)-linkage and two α-L-Fuc residues attached via (1→3)- and (1→6)-linkages.

name: isovanillin
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes that is 4-methoxybenzaldehyde substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3. It is an inhibitor of aldehyde oxidase.

name: ferulic acid
definition: A member of the class of ferulic acids that is cinnamic acid substituted by a methoxy and a hydroxy group at positions 3 and 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: 4-ethylazetidin-2-one
definition: A β-lactam that is azetidin-2-one substituted by an ethyl group at position 4.

name: (+)-dihydroisorhamnetin
definition: A dihydroisorhamnetin that has 2R,3R-configuration.

name: viridicatin(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of viridicatin resulting from the deprotonation of the 3-hydroxy group. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: O-methyl-L-tyrosine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of O-methyl-L-tyrosine. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: glutamic acid 5-methyl ester
definition: A glutamic acid derivative that is glutamic acid in which the carboxy group at position 5 has been replaced by a methoxycarbonyl group.

name: iritremulanol A
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is 1,2,3,3a,4,5,6,7-octahydroazulene substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 2, 4 and 8, and by a hydroxymethyl group at position 8 (the 5R,8R,8aR-stereoisomer). It is a sesquiterpenoid synthesised by heterologous expression of a sesquiterpene synthase from the basidiomycete Irpex lacteus.

name: ARS-1620
definition: A qinazoline derivative carrying chloro and fluoro substituents at positions 6 and 8 respectively, a 2-fluoro-6-hydroxyphenyl group at position 7, and a 4-(prop-2-enoyl)piperazin-1-yl group at position 4. A potent, selective, and orally bioavailable covalent KRAS-G12C inhibitor, it inhibits the protein coding gene KRAS (Kirsten rat sarcoma virus) with high potency in cells and animals.

name: N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl-L-tyrosine
definition: An O4'-glycosyl-L-tyrosine in which the glycosyl group is specified as N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl.

name: difurfuryl ether
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan which is substituted by a (furan-2-ylmethoxy)methyl group at position 2.

name: androst-5-ene-3α,16β,17β-triol
definition: A 3α-hydroxy steroid that is androst-5-ene carrying three additional hydroxy groups at positions 3α, 16β and 17β.

name: β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GalpNAc
definition: A linear amino trisaccharide consisting of three N-acetyl-β-D-galactosamine residues linked (1→4).

name: yoda 1
definition: A member of the class of thiadiazoles that is 1,3,4-thiadiazole substituted by pyrazin-2-yl and (2,6-dichlorobenzyl)sulfanediyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a selective activator of mechanosensitive channel piezo1.

name: (R)-salsolinol(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of (R)-salsolinol obtained by protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide consisting of α-L-fucose, β-D-galactose and β-D-glucose residues joined by sequential (1→2)- and (1→3)-linkages.

name: norsalsolinol(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of norsalsolinol arising from the protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (4-hydroxy-3,5-dinitrophenyl)acetic acid
definition: A member of the class of phenylacetic acids that is phenylacetic acid in which the phenyl group is substituted by nitro, hydroxy and nitro groups at positions 3, 4 and 5 respectively.

name: Ru360
definition: A binuclear oxo-bridged Ru compound that selectively inhibits mitochondrial calcium uniporter mediated Ca2+-uptake with nanomolar potency in cells.

name: S. aureus (α-1,4)-GlcNAc WTA-trimer
definition: A Staphylococcus aureus wall technoic acid (WTA) fragment consisting of a chain of three ribitol 5-phosphate (RboP) residues modified with an α-D-GlcNAc residue linked to C-4 of the central RboP residue.

name: S. aureus (β-1,4)-GlcNAc WTA-trimer
definition: A Staphylococcus aureus wall technoic acid (WTA) fragment consisting of a chain of three ribitol 5-phosphate (RboP) residues modified with a β-D-GlcNAc residue linked to C-4 of the central RboP residue.

name: S. aureus (β-1,3)-GlcNAc WTA-trimer
definition: A Staphylococcus aureus wall technoic acid (WTA) fragment consisting of a chain of three ribitol 5-phosphate (RboP) residues modified with a β-D-GlcNAc residue linked to C-3 of the central RboP residue.

name: akebia saponin D
definition: A triterpenoid saponin that is hederagenin attached to a α-L-arabinopyranosyl residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage and a 6-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl residue at position 28 via an ester linkage. It is the active ingredient found in the traditional Chinese herb Radix Dipsaci.

name: ochnaflavone
definition: A biflavonoid with an ether linkage between the B-rings of the apigenin and luteolin subunits. It has been isolated from several members of the Ochnaceae plant family.

name: ustilaginoidin B
definition: A binaphthopyran resulting from the formal oxidative coupling at positions 9 of molecules of 5,6,8-trihydroxy-2-methyl-4H-benzo[g]chromen-4-one and 5,6,8-trihydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)-4H-benzo[g]chromen-4-one.

name: ustilaginoidin C
definition: A binaphthopyran resulting from the formal oxidative coupling at position 9 of two molecules of 5,6,8-trihydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)-4H-naphtho[2,3-b]pyran-4-one.

name: ustilaginoidin G
definition: A binaphthopyran resulting from the formal oxidative coupling at positions 9 of molecules of 5,6,8-trihydroxy-2-methyl-2,3-dihydro-4H-benzo[g]chromen-4-one and (6S)-5,6,8-(6S)-5,6,8-trihydroxy-2-methyl-6,9-dihydro-4H-benzo[g]chromen-4-one.

name: ustilaginoidin I
definition: A binaphthopyran resulting from the formal oxidative coupling at positions 9 of molecules of 5,6,8-trihydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)-2,3-dihydro-4H-benzo[g]chromen-4-one and (6S)-5,6,8-trihydroxy-2-methyl-6,9-dihydro-4H-benzo[g]chromen-4-one.

name: hemiustilaginoidin F
definition: A naphtho-γ-pyrone which carries hydroxy substituents at positions C-5, C-6 and C-8 and a methyl group at C-2. Obtained from the laccase gene deletion mutant of Villosiclava virens (anamorph: Ustilaginoidea Virens), it is a precursor of ustilaginoidins used as the raw material for hapten synthesis through diazotization and Mannich reactions followed by bioconjugation with carrier proteins for complete antigen synthesis.

name: hemiustilaginoidin D
definition: A naphtho-γ-pyrone which carries hydroxy substituents at positions C-5, C-6 and C-8 and methyl groups at C-2 and C-3. Obtained from the laccase gene deletion mutant of Villosiclava virens (anamorph: Ustilaginoidea Virens), it is a precursor of ustilaginoidins used as the raw material for hapten synthesis through diazotization and Mannich reactions followed by bioconjugation with carrier proteins for complete antigen synthesis.

name: 9-fluoro-3-methyl-10-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)-7-oxo-2,3-dihydro-7H-[1,4]oxazino[2,3,4-ij]quinoline-6-carboxylic acid
definition: An oxazinoquinoline that is 2,3-dihydro-7H-[1,4]oxazino[2,3,4-ij]quinolin-7-one substituted by methyl, carboxy, fluoro, and 4-methylpiperazin-1-yl groups at positions 3, 6, 9, and 10, respectively.

name: 3-BrB-PP1
definition: A member of the class of pyrazolopyrimidines that is pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidin-4-amine bearing additional tert-butyl and 3-bromobenzyl substituents at positions 1 and 3 respectively. It is an ATP-competitive inhibitor of CDPK1 and AKT kinase.

name: methyl trans-cinnamate
definition: The E (trans) isomer of methyl cinnamate.

name: methyl cis-cinnamate
definition: The Z (cis) isomer of methyl cinnamate.

name: tigilanol tiglate
definition: A diterpenoid natural product isolated from the kernels of the Australian blushwood tree (Fontainea picrosperma). It is approved as a veterinary pharmaceutical for the treatment of non-metastatic and non-resectable canine mast cell tumours.

name: aristolochic acid B
definition: An aristolochic acid that is phenanthrene-1-carboxylic acid substituted by a methylenedioxy group at the 3,4 positions and by a nitro group at position 10.

name: aristolochic acid C
definition: An aristolochic acid that is phenanthrene-1-carboxylic acid substituted by a methylenedioxy group at the 3,4 positions, by an hydroxy group at position 6, and by a nitro group at position 10.

name: aristolochic acid D
definition: An aristolochic acid that is phenanthrene-1-carboxylic acid substituted by a methylenedioxy group at the 3,4 positions, by an hydroxy group at position 6, by a methoxy group at position 8, and by a nitro group at position 10.

name: guaia-1(5),6-diene
definition: A carbobicyclic compound that is 1,2,3,4,5,6-hexahydroazulene substituted by methyl groups at positions 1S and 4S and by an isoproyl group at position 7. It is a sesquiterpene synthesised by heterologous expression of a sesquiterpene cyclase from the deep-sea fungus Spiromastix sp.

name: dicamba-sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt of dicamba.

name: dicamba-potassium
definition: An organic potassium salt of dicamba.

name: dicamba-olamine
definition: An organoammonium salt that is the ethanolamine salt of dicamba.

name: dicamba-methyl
definition: The methyl ester of dicamba.

name: LSD-d3
definition: A deuterated compound that is lysergic acid diethylamide in which the three methyl hydrogens are replaced by deuterium.

name: amitriptyline-d3
definition: A deuterated compound that is amitriptyline in which three hydrogen atoms of the methyl group are replaced by deuterium.

name: diazepam-d8
definition: A deuterated compound that is diazepam in which all eight hydrogen atoms of the methyl and phenyl groups are replaced by deuterium.

name: all-trans-13,14-dihydroretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of all-trans-13,14-dihydroretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: α-tocopheryloxyacetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is (R,R,R)-α-tocopherol in which the hydroxy group at position 6 is replaced by a carboxymethoxy group. It is a nonhydrolyzable ether analog of vitamin E that exhibits anticancer properties.

name: tirzepatide
definition: A 39-amino acid linear polypeptide which is conjugated to a C20 fatty diacid moiety via a linker connected to lysine-20. It is a dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 agonist used for the management of type 2 diabetes mellitus.

name: neopine(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion derivative that is the conjugate acid of neopine arising from protonation of the tertiary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: neoverrucosan-5β-ol
definition: A diterpenoid isolated from the liverwort Mylia verrucosa.

name: verrucosan-2β-ol
definition: A diterpenoid isolated from Chloroflexus aurantiacus.

name: lydicene
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is 2,3,4,4a,5,6,6a,7,10,11-decahydro-1H-cyclohepta[a]naphthalene substituted by methyl groups at positions 2, 2, 4a, 6a, and 9, respectively (the 4aR,6aS-stereoisomer).

name: nona-2,4,6-trienal
definition: A polyunsaturated fatty aldehyde that is nonanal which has 3 double bonds at positions 2, 4 and 6. The configuration of the double bonds is unknown.

name: 4-hydroxy-4-methylglutamic acid
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is glutamic acid substituted by a hydroxy and a methyl group at position 4.

name: 4-hydroxy-4-methyl-L-glutamic acid
definition: A 4-hydroxy-4-methylglutamic acid that has L-configuration.

name: (2E,4E,6Z)-nonatrienal
definition: A nona-2,4,6-trienal in which the double bonds at positions 2 and 4 adopt trans-configuration and the double bond at position 6 adopts cis-configuration.

name: 8(9)-EET methyl ester
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 8(9)-EET with methanol.

name: dimethyl sebacate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester that is sebacic acid in which both carboxy groups are replaced by methoxycarbonyl groups.

name: dimethyl azelate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester that is nonanedioic acid in which both carboxy groups are replaced by methoxycarbonyl groups.

name: 3-(2-ethylhexoxy)propan-1-amine
definition: A primary aliphatic amine that is 3-aminopropan-1-ol in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a (2-ethylhexyl)oxy group.

name: 1-(2-furoyl)-4-piperidinamine
definition: An N-acylpiperidine that is piperidin-4-amine substituted at position 1 by a furan-2-ylcarbonyl group.

name: 3-amino-1-N-alloc-piperidine
definition: An aminopiperidine that is piperidin-3-amine substituted by a [(prop-2-en-1-yl)oxy]carbonyl group at position 1.

name: 2-(3-hydroxyoctyl)-5-oxo-1-pyrrolidineheptanoic acid
definition: A pyrrolidin-2-one substituted by 6-carboxyhexyl and 3-hydroxyoctyl groups at positions 1 and 2, respectively. It is a potent prostaglandin EP4 receptor agonist (Ki=35 nM).

name: JWH-201
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole which is substituted at position 1 by a pentyl group and at position 3 by a (4-methoxyphenyl)acetyl group. It is a synthetic cannabinoid with relatively poor affinity for both CB1 (Ki = 1064 nM) and CB2 (Ki = 444 nM) receptors.

name: Thr-Pro-Pro-Ala-Gly-Pro-Asp-Val-Gly-Pro-Arg
definition: An oligopeptide comprising of L-threonine, L-proline, L-proline, L-alanine, glycine, L-proline, L-aspartic acid, L-valine, glycine, L-proline, and L-arginine amino acids joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is isolated from the venoms of three species of New World pit vipers from the subfamily, Crotalinae.

name: 1-methyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline-6,7-diol
definition: An isoquinolinol that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline substituted by a methyl group at position 1 and by hydroxy groups at positions 6 and 7.

name: 3-[({5-[(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)methyl]-4-ethyl-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl}sulfanyl)methyl]-N-(2,3-dimethylphenyl)benzamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-[({5-[(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)methyl]-4-ethyl-4H-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl}sulfanyl)methyl]benzoic acid with the amino group of 2,3-dimethylaniline.

name: 3-hexenyl isovalerate
definition: A fatty acid ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of isovaleric acid with the hydroxy group of hex-3-en-1-ol.

name: trans-3-hexenyl isovalerate
definition: A 3-hexenyl isovalerate in which the double bond adopts trans-configuration.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)]-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAcO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A synthetic β-D-glucoside that is a branched pentasaccharide derivative consisting of two glucose residues, two rhamnose residues (out of which one is acetylated at the 2nd position) and one N-acetylglucosamine residue with at the reducing end an aminoethyl linker allowing for efficient conjugation to a carrier protein. The basic structure (i.e. without the linker) is the pentasaccharide repeat unit of the O25B major serotype within the extraintestinal pathogenic E. coli (ExPEC) group which expresses a unique O-antigen.

name: (S)-2-formylglutarate(2−)
definition: A 2-formylglutarate(2−) that has S-configuration.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-{β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)]-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)}-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)]-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAcO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A synthetic β-D-glucoside that is a branched decasaccharide derivative consisting of two β-D-Glc-(1→6)-[α-L-Rha-(1→3)]-α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-L-Rha2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc pentasaccharide units linked (1→4) between the GlcNac residue at the reducing end of one unit and the OH at position 4 of the α-D-glucose residue of the other unit. An aminoethyl linker from the reducing-end GlcNAc residue allows for efficient conjugation to a carrier protein.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap2Ac-(1→3)-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNacO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A synthetic β-D-glucoside that is a branched pentadecasaccharide derivative consisting of three β-D-Glc-(1→6)-[α-L-Rha-(1→3)]-α-D-Glc-(1→3)-α-L-Rha2Ac-(1→3)-β-D-GlcNAc pentasaccharide units linked (1→4) between the GlcNac residue at the reducing end of one unit and the OH at position 4 of the α-D-glucose residue of the adjacent unit. An aminoethyl linker from the reducing-end GlcNAc residue allows for efficient conjugation to a carrier protein.

name: ohmefentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of 2-(4-anilino-3-methylpiperidin-1-yl)-1-phenylethanol with propanoic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: 5-amino-1-[3-fluoro-4-(morpholin-4-yl)phenyl]imidazole-4-carbonitrile
definition: A member of the class of monofluorobenzenes that is benzene substituted by 5-amino-4-cyano-1H-imidazol-1-yl, fluoro, and morpholin-4-yl groups at positions 1, 3 and 4, respectively.

name: 2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)-9-[3-methyl-4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)phenyl]purine-6-carboxamide
definition: A member of the clas of purines that is 9H-purine substituted by 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl, aminocarbonyl, and 4-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)-3-nitrophenyl groups at positions 2, 6 and 9, respectively. It is an inhibitor of EGFR and a potential anticancer agent.

name: NNC 55-0396 dihydrochloride
definition: The dihydrochloride salt of NNC 55-0396. It is a stable analogue of mibefradil and a highly selective T-type calcium channel blocker.

name: β-D-Glcp-(1→6)-[β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)]-α-D-Glcp-(1→3)-α-L-Rhap2AcO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A synthetic α-L-rhamnoside consisting of a linear trisaccharide of β-D-glucosyl, β-D-glucosyl and 2-O-acetyl-α-L-rhamnosyl residues linked sequentially (1→6) and (1→3), to the β-D-glucosyl residue are also linked α-L-rhamnosyl and N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl residues via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages respectively. An aminoethyl linker from the reducing-end RhaNAc residue allows for efficient conjugation to a carrier protein.

name: α-L-Rhap-(1→-3)-[α-L-Rhap-(1→3)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)]-[β-D-Glcp-(1→6)]-α-D-GlcpO[CH2]2NH2
definition: A synthetic α-D-glucoside that is a branched decasaccharide derivative consisting of α-L-rhamnosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and α-D-glucosyl residues linked sequentially (1→3) and (1→4), to the α-D-glucosyl residue at the reducing end are also linked α-L-rhamnosyl and β-D-glucosyl residues via (1→3) and (1→6) linkages respectively. An aminoethyl linker from the reducing-end Glc residue allows for efficient conjugation to a carrier protein.

name: N-hydroxyguanidinium
definition: A guanidinium ion that is the conjugate acid of N-hydroxyguanidine, resulting from the protonation of the imine nitrogen; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-formyl-L-methionyl-L-leucyl-L-phenylalaninate
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of N-formyl-L-methionyl-L-leucyl-L-phenylalanine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-chloro-L-phenylalanylglycine
definition: A dipeptide obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-chloro-L-phenylalanine with the amino group of glycine.

name: Gly-Lys(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the side-chain amino group and the amino terminus of Gly-Lys; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 5β-bufol
definition: The 5β-stereoisomer of bufol.

name: apinocaltamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of {4-[1-(trifluoromethyl)cyclopropyl]phenyl}acetic acid with the amino group of 6-[(3-amino-1H-pyrazol-1-yl)methyl]pyridine-3-carbonitrile. It is a selective, orally available T-type calcium channel blocker that is being studied as a potential new treatment in epilepsy.

name: N-acetyl-S-benzyl-L-cysteine(1−)
definition: An S-substituted N-acetyl-L-cysteinate that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-S-benzyl-L-cysteine resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-acetyl-S-hydroxy-L-cysteine(1−)
definition: An S-substituted N-acetyl-L-cysteinate that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-S-hydroxy-L-cysteine resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyathadiol
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid with formula C20H32O2.

name: N-acetyl-S-methyl-L-cysteine(1−)
definition: An S-substituted N-acetyl-L-cysteinate that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-S-methyl-L-cysteine resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: cyathatriol
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid with formula C20H32O3. It is produced by the bird's nest fungus Cyathus earlei.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp6N3-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino hexasaccharide comprising α-L-fucosyl, β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-galactosaminyl, α-D-galactosyl, 6-azido-β-D-galactosyl and (at the reducing end) β-D-glucose residues linked sequentially (1→2), (1→3), (1→3), (1→4) and (1→4). An azido-globo H analogue, it can be conjugated to the diphtheria toxoid cross-reactive material CRM197 for vaccination with C34 adjuvant in mice.

name: 11-O-acetylcyathatriol
definition: A tricyclic diterpenoid with formula C22H34O4. It is produced by the bird's nest fungus Cyathus earlei.

name: N-acetyl-S-hydroxy-L-cysteine
definition: An L-cysteine derivative that is L-cysteine in which the thiol and amino groups are replaced by hydroxysulfanediyl and acetylamino groups, respectively.

name: N-acetyl-S-methyl-L-cysteine
definition: The S-methyl derivative of N-acetyl-L-cysteine.

name: N-acetyl-S-benzyl-L-cysteine
definition: The S-benzyl derivative of N-acetyl-L-cysteine.

name: α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp6N3-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpO[CH2]5NH2
definition: An amino hexasaccharide derivative that is α-L-Fucp-(1→2)-β-D-Galp-(1→3)-β-D-GalpNAc-(1→3)-α-D-Galp-(1→4)-β-D-Galp6N3-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp (CHEBI:194350), the reducing-end residue of which is linked glycosidically to a 5-aminopentyl group linker.

name: N-acetyl-S-phenyl-L-cysteine(1−)
definition: An S-substituted N-acetyl-L-cysteinate that is the conjugate base of N-acetyl-S-phenyl-L-cysteine resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (−)-vernolate
definition: A vernolate that is the conjugate base of (−)-vernolic acid, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (R,R,S)-lobaplatin
definition: The (R,R,S)-isomer of lobaplatin.

name: (S,S,S)-lobaplatin
definition: The (S,S,S)-isomer of lobaplatin.

name: 2-amino-3-cyano-7-(dimethylamino)-4-(2-methoxyphenyl)-4H-chromene
definition: A member of the class of chromenes that is 4H-chromene substituted by amino, cyano, 2-methoxyphenyl, and dimethylamino groups at positions 2, 3, 4 and 7, respectively. It exhibits anti-angiogenic activity.

name: (S)-mevalonolactone
definition: A 4-hydroxy-4-methyloxan-2-one that has (S)-configuration.

name: (10E)-octadecenoate
definition: An octadecenoate that is the conjugate base of (10E)-octadecenoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9E,11E)-octadecadienoate
definition: An octadeca-9,11-dienoate having 9-trans,11-trans-stereochemistry.

name: 10-hydroxypalmitate
definition: A hydroxy fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of 10-hydroxypalmitic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (5Z,8Z)-octadecadienoate
definition: An octadecadienoate that is the conjugate base of (5Z,8Z)-octadecadienoic acid, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 10-hydroxypalmitic acid
definition: A hydroxypalmitic acid that is palmitic (hexadecanoic) acid carrying a single hydroxy substituent at position 10.

name: (10E)-octadecenoic acid
definition: An octadecenoic acid with a trans-double bond at position C-10.

name: (7Z)-tricosene
definition: A 7-tricosene in which the double bond at position 7 has cis-configuration.

name: 1-ethyl-3-(2-methylbutyl)piperidine
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is piperidine substituted by ethyl and 2-methylbutyl groups at positions 1 and 3, respectively.

name: (2'S,3S)-stenusine
definition: A 1-ethyl-3-(2-methylbutyl)piperidine that has (2'S,3S)-configuration.

name: (2'R,3R)-stenusine
definition: A 1-ethyl-3-(2-methylbutyl)piperidine that has (2'R,3R)-configuration.

name: (2'S,3R)-stenusine
definition: A 1-ethyl-3-(2-methylbutyl)piperidine that has (2'S,3R)-configuration.

name: (2'R,3S)-stenusine
definition: A 1-ethyl-3-(2-methylbutyl)piperidine that has (2'R,3S)-configuration.

name: AcGly-Ser(O-L-α-D-Hep)-Gly-Leu
definition: A derivatised tetrapeptide in which a parent tetrapeptide comprising glycine, L-serine, glycine and L-leucine residues coupled in sequence, has its terminal glycine residue acetylated on nitrogen and its serine residue L-glycero-α-D-heptosylated on oxygen.

name: Gly-Ser-Gly-Leu
definition: A synthetic tetrapeptide comprising glycine, L-serine, glycine and L-leucine residues coupled in sequence.

name: 4-carboxyanilinium
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 4-aminobenzoic acid resulting from the protonation of the amino group.

name: 4-ammoniobenzoate
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 4-aminobenzoic acid.

name: AcGly-Ser(O-D-α-D-Hep)-Gly-Leu
definition: A derivatised tetrapeptide in which a parent tetrapeptide comprising glycine, L-serine, glycine and L-leucine residues coupled in sequence, has its terminal glycine residue acetylated on nitrogen and its serine residue D-glycero-α-D-heptosylated on oxygen.

name: 4-hydroxy-all-trans-13,14-dihydroretinoate
definition: A retinoid anion that is the conjugate base of 4-hydroxy-all-trans-13,14-dihydroretinoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-hydroxy-all-trans-13,14-dihydroretinoic acid
definition: A retinoid that is all-trans-13,14-dihydroretinoic acid substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: (5Z,8Z)-octadecadienoic acid
definition: An octadecadienoic acid having two double bonds located at positions 5 and 8 (the 5Z,8Z-geoisomer).

name: flavocillin
definition: A penicillin in which the substituent at position 6 of the penam ring is a [3-(4-oxo-4H-chromen-2-yl)benzoyl]nitrilo group.

name: pentaphenylphosphorane
definition: A member of the class of phosphoranes that is phosphorane in which all 5 hydrogen's are replaced by phenyl groups.

name: 3-aminopropanesulfonic acid zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of 3-aminopropanesulfonic acid arising from transfer of a proton from the sulfo to the amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: oripavine(1+)
definition: The trialkylammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the amino group of oripavine; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: broclozone
definition: An isoxazolidinone that is 1,2-oxazolidin-3-one substituted by a 2-bromo-4-chlorobenzyl group at position 2 and two methyl groups at position 4. It is DOXP-inhibiting herbicide developed by KingAgroot with both foliar and soil activity, and expected to be launched in China in 2025.

name: (E,E)-2,4-hexadienyl acetate
definition: A 2,4-hexadienyl acetate that has two trans double bonds at positions 2 and 4.

name: heliamine(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of heliamine resulting from the protonation of the amino group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,5-dihydroxy-3-methylpentanoic acid
definition: A dihydroxy monocarboxylic acid comprising valeric acid having two hydroxy groups at the 3- and 5-positions together with a methyl group at the 3-position.

name: 3,5-dihydroxy-3-methylpentanoate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3,5-dihydroxy-3-methylpentanoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: muramine
definition: A dibenzazecine alkaloid that is 5,7,8,14-tetrahydrodibenzo[c,g]azecin-13(6H)-one substituted by a methyl group at position 6 and by methoxy groups at positions 3, 4, 10, and 11.

name: indolauxipyr
definition: A fluoroindole that is indole substituted by a 4-amino-6-carboxy-5-chloro-3-fluoropyridin-2-yl group at position 6 and by a fluoro group at position 7. It is a herbicide developed by Corteva Agriscience and sold as the corresponding ester, indolauxipyr-cyanomethyl.

name: indolauxipyr-cyanomethyl
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of indolauxipyr with hydroxyacetonitrile. It is a herbicide developed by Corteva Agriscience.

name: flerovium atom
definition: A carbon group element atom with a symbol Fl and atomic number 114.

name: nihonium atom
definition: A boron group element atom with a symbol Nh and atomic number 113.

name: moscovium atom
definition: A pnictogen atom with a symbol Mc and atomic number 115.

name: livermorium atom
definition: A chalcogen atom with a symbol Lv and atomic number 116.

name: tennessine atom
definition: A halogen atom with a symbol Ts and atomic number 117.

name: oganesson atom
definition: A p-block element atom with a symbol Og and atomic number 118.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→4)]-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→3)-β-D-Galp-(1→4)-[α-L-Fucp-(1→3)]-D-GlcpNAc
definition: A branched amino hexasaccharide, denoted LeaLex, consisting of a tetrasaccharide backbone of β-D-galactosyl, N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl, β-D-galactosyl and D-glucosamine residues linked glycosidically in a (1→3), (1→3), (1→4) sequence, the N-acetyl-β-D-glucosaminyl and reducing-end N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues of which also carry α-L-fucosyl residues via (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic linkages respectively. The mouse anti-Lea monoclonal antibody SPM 522 has been reported to bind to LeaLex better than to Lea alone.

name: 4-[1-hydroxy-2-(methylamino)ethyl]benzene-1,2-diol
definition: A catecholamine in which the aminoethyl side-chain is hydroxy-substituted at C-1 and methylated on nitrogen.

name: perivine(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of perivine obtained by protonation of the secondary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 6-bromoconicamin
definition: A bromoindole that is 1H-indole substituted by 2-(trimethylazaniumyl)ethenyl and bromo groups at positions 3 and 6, respectively. It is isolated from the marine sponge Geodia barretti.

name: cyclo(Pro-Arg)
definition: A homodetic cyclic peptide resulting from the formal condensation of both the amino and acid groups of proline with the acid and amino groups of arginine. It is found in the deep-sea sponge Geodia barretti.

name: heliamine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of heliamine.

name: uranidine
definition: A quinolone that is quinolin-4(1H)-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 3, 5, and 8. It is isolated from the sponge Aplysina aerophoba.

name: 3-(5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)pyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-(5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)pyruvic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: Ala-Ala zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of Ala-Ala; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (Z)-oct-2-enal
definition: The (Z)-isomer of oct-2-enal.

name: gravacridonediol
definition: An acridone derivative with formula C19H19NO5. It is isolated from the roots of Ruta graveolens and Thamnosma rhodesica.

name: calmidazolium chloride
definition: The organic choride salt of calmidazolium.

name: 1,2,3-cyclohexatriene
definition: A cycloalkatriene that is cyclohexane carrying three double bonds at positions 1, 2 and 3. It is a highly strained isomer of benzene.

name: Gly-Gly-Gly zwitterion
definition: A tripeptide zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of Gly-Gly-Gly. Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 2-hydroxymethyl-3-pentylphenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol substituted by hydroxymethyl and pentyl groups at positions 2 and 3, respectively.

name: 8-decenal
definition: A decenal in which the C=C bond is located at the 8-9 position.

name: cis-8-decenal
definition: An 8-decenal in which the double bond has Z configuration.

name: 2-hexylpyridine
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine carrying a hexyl substituent at position 2.

name: 4-formyl-2-methoxyphenyl L-menthyl glutarate
definition: A diester that is pentanedioic acid in which the carboxy groups are replaced by (4-formyl-2-methoxyphenoxy)carbonyl and {[(1R,2S,5R)-5-methyl-2-(propan-2-yl)cyclohexyl]oxy}carbonyl groups.

name: vanilpyruvate
definition: A 2-oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of vanilpyruvic acid, arising from deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-methylheptan-3-one
definition: A dialkyl ketone that is 4-methylheptane substituted by an oxo group at position 3.

name: diethyl 2-sulfanylbutanedioate
definition: A diester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy groups of thiomalic acid with ethanol. It is a metabolite of the insecticide malathion.

name: harmine-d3
definition: A deuterated compound that is harmine in which all three hydrogen atoms of the methoxy group are replaced by deuterium.

name: Asp-Met(1−)
definition: A peptide anion obtained by deprotonation of both carboxy groups and protonation of the aspartyl amino group of Asp-Met. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-(2-hydroxyphenyl)malonamic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoamide that is malonamic acid in which the amino group is substituted by a (2-hydroxyphenyl)amino group.

name: 6-methoxy-2-benzoxazolinone
definition: A 2-benzoxazolinone that is substituted by a methoxy group at position 6.

name: 2-amino-5-methoxyphenol
definition: A phenol substituted by amino and methoxy groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively.

name: spermidine-(butyl-13C4)
definition: A spermidine in which four carbon atoms have been replaced by the 13C isotope.

name: 1,16-hexadecanediol
definition: A diol that is hexadecane substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 16.

name: 5-hydroxy-3-methylfuran-2(5H)-one
definition: A butenolide that is furan-2(5H)-one substituted by a methyl group at position 3 and a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: orobanchol ABC-rings
definition: An indenofuran that is (3aS,8bR)-3,3a,4,5,6,7,8,8b-octahydro-2H-indeno[1,2-b]furan substituted by oxo, hydroxymethylidene, hydroxy, methyl, and methyl groups at positions 2, 3, 4, 8, and 8, respectively.

name: artemether
definition: An artemisinin derivative that is artemisinin in which the lactone has been converted to the corresponding lactol methyl ether. It is used in combination with lumefantrine as an antimalarial for the treatment of multi-drug resistant strains of falciparum malaria.

name: α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)-[3-O-methyl-α-D-mannosyl-(1→4)]n-1-O,3-O-dimethyl-α-D-mannose

name: AOH1996
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-(naphthalen-1-ylcarbonyl)glycine with the amino group of 2-(3-methoxyphenoxy)aniline. It is a selective arginase inhibitor being developed by Calithera Biosciences for the treatment of solid tumours.

name: ML355
definition: A sulfonamide resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of 2-aminobenzothiazole with the sulfo group of 4-[(2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzyl)amino]benzenesulfonic acid. definition: A tertiary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(difluoromethyl)-5-fluoro-1-methyl-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of N-[5-chloro-2-(propan-2-yl)benzyl]cyclopropanamine. It is a broad spectrum fungicide developed by Bayer that exhibits high efficacy against the major fungal diseases of cereal crops (wheat, triticale, rye, barley and oats).

name: mangicdiene
definition: A sesterterpene synthesised by a terpene synthase from Fusarium graminearum.

name: variecoltetraene
definition: A sesterterpene synthesised by a terpene synthase from Fusarium graminearum.

name: fusaterpenol
definition: A diterpenoid synthesised by a monofunctional diterpene synthase from Fusarium graminearum.

name: (+)-trans-fustin
definition: The (2R,3R)-stereoisomer of fustin.

name: (−)-trans-fustin
definition: The (2S,3S)-stereoisomer of fustin.

name: LLY-507
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-cyano-2'-{4-[2-(3-methyl-1H-indol-1-yl)ethyl]piperazin-1-yl}[biphenyl]-3-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 3-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)propan-1-amine. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of SMYD2 and inhibits the ability of SMYD2 to methylate p53. It serves as a valuable chemical probe to aid in the dissection of SMYD2 function in cancer and other biological processes.

name: AZ505
definition: A benzoxazine that is 2H-1,4-benzoxazin-3(4H)-one substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5 and a 2-{[2-(cyclohexyl{N-[2-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)ethyl]-β-alanyl}amino)ethyl]amino}ethyl group at position 8. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of SMYD2.

name: (+)-somaliensene B
definition: A sesterterpene that is 1-methylcyclohexene substituted by a (5E,9E)-6,10,14-trimethylpentadeca-1,5,9,13-tetraen-2-yl group at position 4 (the 4R-stereoisomer).

name: sarcorine
definition: A steroid alkaloid that is 5α-pregnane substituted by an acetylamino group at position 3β, a methyl group at position 20S, and a dimethylamino group at position 21.

name: 2-pyrimidinemethanol
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 2.

name: 1-amino-3,3-diethoxypropane
definition: A diether that is (ethoxymethoxy)ethane substituted by a 2-aminoethyl group at position 1.

name: 7-ethoxy-N3-(2-furanylmethyl)-3,9-acridinediamine
definition: A member of the class of aminoacridines that is acridin-9-amine substituted by [(furan-2-yl)methyl]amino and ethoxy groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively. It is a lysine deficient protein kinase (WNK) signaling inhibitor (IC50 = 16 μM).

name: isosarcodine
definition: A steroid alkaloid that is 5α-pregnane substituted by an acetyl(methyl)amino group at position 3β, a methyl group at position 20S, and a dimethylamino group at position 21.

name: sarcodine
definition: A steroid alkaloid that is 5α-pregnane substituted by a dimethylamino group at position 3β, a methyl group at position 20S, and an acetyl(methyl)amino group at position 21.

name: sarcocine
definition: A steroid alkaloid that is pregn-5-ene substituted by a dimethylamino group at position 3β, a methyl group at position 20S, and an acetyl(methyl)amino group at position 21.

name: pachyaximine A
definition: A steroid alkaloid that is pregn-5-ene substituted by a methoxy group at position 3β, a methyl group at position 20S, and a dimethylamino group at position 21.

name: 5-ethynylcytidine
definition: A nucleoside analogue that is cytidine substituted by an ethynyl group at position 5.

name: zuranolone
definition: A 3-hydroxy steroid that is 5β-19-norpregnane substituted by hydroxy, methyl, oxo, and 4-cyano-1H-pyrazol-1-yl groups at positions 3, 3, 20 and 21, respectively. It is a positive allosteric modulator of GABAA receptor developed by Sage Therapeutics and Biogen for the treatment of postpartum depression in adults.

name: YXG-158
definition: An aza-steroid that is (8ξ,9ξ,14ξ)-androsta-5,16-diene substituted by (4-fluorobenzoyl)amino and 4-methyl-1H-imidazol-1-yl groups at positions 3S and 17, respectively. It is a potent anti-cancer agent that inhibits androgen synthesis and CYP17A1.

name: vamorolone
definition: A 3-oxo-Δ1,Δ4-steroid that is pregna-1,4,9(11)-trien-17-ol substituted by oxo, oxo, and hydroxy groups at positions 3, 20, and 21, respectively. It is approved by the FDA for the treatment of patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy aged 2 years and older.

name: ZCAN262
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolopyrazoles that is 2,4,5,6-tetrahydropyrrolo[3,4-c]pyrazole substituted by 2,4-difluorobenzyl and 4-(dimethylcarbamoyl)pyrimidin-2-yl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It targets the AMPA receptor GluA2 subunit and exhibits potent effects in restoring neurological function and myelination in mouse models for multiple sclerosis.

name: ulotaront
definition: A member of the class of thienopyrans that is 4,7-dihydro-5H-thieno[2,3-c]pyran substituted by a (methylamino)methyl at position 7S. It is a trace amine-associated receptor 1 and serotonin 5-HT1A receptors agonist that has demonstrated efficacy in the treatment of patients with schizophrenia.

name: dihydroserrulatene
definition: A diterpene from Leucophyllum frutescens.

name: zonarene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is 1,2,3,7,8,8a-hexahydronaphthalene which is substituted at positions 1 and 6 by methyl groups and at position 4 by an isopropyl group (the 1S-isomer).

name: subrutilane
definition: A sesterterpene produced by subrutilane synthase from the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: pemafibrate
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-benzoxazoles that is 1,3-benzoxazol-2-amine in which the amino hydrogens are replaced by 3-[(1R)-1-carboxypropoxy]benzyl and 3-(4-methoxyphenoxy)propyl groups. It is a selective peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor (PPAR)-α agonist that is used for the treatment of hyperlipidaemia.

name: AT-1015 hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of AT-1015 free base.

name: smoothib
definition: An imidazopyrazole that is 1,6-dihydroimidazo[4,5-c]pyrazole substituted by 4-methylbenzyl and 4-{4-[3-(1H-indol-3-yl)propanoyl]piperazin-1-yl}phenyl groups at positions 1 and 5, respectively. It is a novel inhibitor of the Hedgehog signaling pathway.

name: serrulatane
definition: A diterpene from Leucophyllum frutescens.

name: KRIBB11
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 1H-indazole substituted by a [6-(methylamino)-3-nitropyridin-2-yl]amino group at position 5. It is an inhibitor of heat shock factor 1 (IC50 = 1.2μM) and suppresses tumour growth in mouse xenograft models.

name: 3-(trimethylsilyl)propane-1-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of 3-(trimethylsilyl)propane-1-sulfonic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the sulfo group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: cis-cyclooctene
definition: A cyclooctene in which the double bond adopts cis-configuration.

name: pirtobrutinib
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-fluoro-2-methoxybenzoic acid with the amino group of 5-amino-3-[4-(aminomethyl)phenyl]-1-[(2S)-1,1,1-trifluoropropan-2-yl]-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxamide. It is a BTK inhibitor used for the treatment of adult patients with chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma.

name: elacestrant
definition: A member of the class of tetralins that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalene which is substituted by hydroxy group at position 2 and by a 2-(ethyl{4-[2-(ethylamino)ethyl]benzyl}amino)-4-methoxyphenyl group at position 6R. It is a is an estrogen receptor degrader indicated for the treatment of postmenopausal women or adult men, with ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer with disease progression following at least one line of endocrine therapy.

name: nirogacestat
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole substituted by a 1-[(2,2-dimethylpropyl)amino]-2-methylpropan-2-yl group at position 1 and a {N-[(2S)-6,8-difluoro-1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalen-2-yl]-L-norvalyl}amino group at position 4. It is a γ-secretase inhibitor whose hydrobromide salt is indicated for adult patients with progressing desmoid tumours who require systemic treatment.

name: nirogacestat dihydrobromide
definition: A hydrobromide salt obtained by reaction of nirogacestat with two equivalents of hydrobromic acid.

name: nirogacestat(2+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the two secondary amino groups of nirogacestat; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: repotrectinib
definition: An azamacrocycle with formula C18H18FN5O2. It is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor (highly potent against ROS1, TRKA-C, and ALK) used for the treatment of locally advanced or metastatic ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer.

name: fruquintinib
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline substituted by [2-methyl-3-(methylcarbamoyl)-1-benzofuran-6-yl]oxy, methoxy, and methoxy groups at positions 4, 6, and 7, respectively. It is a highly potent and selective inhibitor of VEGFR 1, 2 and 3 (IC50 = 33, 0.35, and 35 nM) used for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer.

name: capivasertib
definition: An aminopiperidine that is piperidine substituted by 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-yl, amino, and [(1S)-1-(4-chlorophenyl)-3-hydroxypropyl]aminocarbonyl groups at positions 1, 4, and 4, respectively. It is a pan-AKT kinase inhibitor used in combination with fulvestrant for the treatment of adult patients with hormone receptor (HR)-positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-negative, locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer with one or more PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-alterations.

name: daprodustat
definition: A member of the class of barbiturates that is barbituric acid substituted by cyclohexyl groups at positions 1 and 3, and by a (carboxymethyl)aminocarbonyl group at position 5. It is an inhibitor of hypoxia-inducible factor prolyl hydroxylase developed by GlaxoSmithKline for the treatment of anaemia in patients with chronic kidney disease.

name: motixafortide acetate
definition: A acetate salt obtained by combining motixafortide with six molar equivalents of acetic acid. It is a drug that was approved for use in combination with filgrastim to mobilize hematopoietic stem cells for collection and subsequent autologous transplantation in patients with multiple myeloma.

name: bexagliflozin
definition: A C-glycosyl comprising of β-D-glucose in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by a 4-chloro-3-({4-[2-(cyclopropyloxy)ethoxy]phenyl}methyl)phenyl group. It is a sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.

name: sotagliflozin
definition: An S-glycosyl compound that is 1-thio-β-L-xylopyranose in which the anomeric hydroxy group is replaced by a 4-chloro-3-[(4-ethoxyphenyl)methyl]phenyl group and the thiol is replaced by a methylsulfanediyl group. It is an inhibitor of SGLT1 and SGLT2 that is approved to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death, hospitalization for heart failure, and urgent heart failure visit in adults with heart failure or type 2 diabetes mellitus, chronic kidney disease, and other cardiovascular risk.

name: etrasimod
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydrocyclopenta[b]indole substituted by carboxymethyl and [4-cyclopentyl-3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]methoxy groups at positions 3R and 7, respectively. It is a potent and functional antagonist of the sphingosine-1-phosphate-1 (S1P1) receptor (IC50 = 1.88 nM in CHO cells).

name: etrasimod arginine
definition: An organoammonium salt obtained by combining etrasimod with one molar equivalent of L-arginine. It is a sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor modulator approved for the treatment of moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis in adults.

name: etrasimod(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of etrasimod resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: ritlecitinib
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 7H-pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidine substituted at position 4 by a [(3R,6S)-6-methyl-1-(prop-2-enoyl)piperidin-3-yl]amino group. It is a dual inhibitor of Janus kinase 3 and the TEC family of tyrosine kinases.

name: ritlecitinib tosylate
definition: An organosulfonate salt obtained by combining equimolar amounts of ritlecitinib and 4-toluenesulfonic acid. It is a kinase inhibitor, developed by Pfizer for the treatment of severe alopecia areata in adults and adolescents 12 years and older.

name: ritlecitinib(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of ritlecitinib resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen in the pyrrolopyrimidine ring; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: fezolinetant
definition: A triazolopyrazine that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydro[1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a]pyrazine substituted by 3-methyl-1,2,4-thiadiazol-5-yl, 4-fluorobenzoyl and methyl groups at positions 3, 7, and 8R, respectively. It is a prescription medicine used to reduce moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms due to menopause.

name: TA-1887
definition: A fluoroindole that is 1H-indole substituted by a β-D-glucopyranosyl, 4-cyclopropylbenzyl, and fluoro groups at positions 1, 3 and 4, respectively. It is a highly potent and selective SGLT2 inhibitor, with antihyperglycemic effects in high-fat diet-fed KK mice.

name: yttrium nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of yttrium(III).

name: dimethylcadmium
definition: An organocadmium compound that is cadmium substituted by two methyl groups.

name: xenon oxytetrafluoride
definition: A xenon molecular entity comprising of a central xenon atom that carries four fluoro groups and one oxo group.

name: thallium(III) nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of thallium(III).

name: icas#12(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of icas#12 resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-trisulfanyl-L-alanine zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion that results from the transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of 3-trisulfanyl-L-alanine; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: N6,2'-O-dimethyladenosine
definition: A methyladenosine compound in which two methyl groups are attached to N6 of the adenine nucleobase and O2 of the sugar.

name: 2-[(2-bromo-6-fluorobenzyl)oxy]-1-methyl-4-(propan-2-yl)-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptane
definition: An oxabicycloalkane that is 1-methyl-4-(propan-2-yl)-7-oxabicyclo[2.2.1]heptan-2-ol in which the hydroxy group is substituted by a (2-bromo-6-fluorophenyl)methoxy group.

name: (1R,2S,4S)-cinflubrolin
definition: The (1R,2S,4S)-isomer of cinflubrolin.

name: (1S,2R,4R)-cinflubrolin
definition: The (1S,2R,4R)-isomer of cinflubrolin.

name: (R)-cybenzoxasulfyl
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of cybenzoxasulfyl.

name: (S)-cybenzoxasulfyl
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of cybenzoxasulfyl.

name: 3-(pyrimidin-2-yl)propanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine substituted by a 2-carboxyethyl group at position 2.

name: 2-[5-cyclopropyl-3-(ethylsulfonyl)pyridin-2-yl]-5-[(trifluoromethyl)sulfinyl]-1,3-benzoxazole
definition: A 1,3-benzoxazole substituted by 5-cyclopropyl-3-(ethylsulfonyl)pyridin-2-yl and (trifluoromethyl)sulfinyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively.

name: 3-trisulfanyl-L-alanine
definition: An S-substituted L-cysteine where the S-substituent is specified as trisulfanyl.

name: 2-phenylpropylamine
definition: A phenylalkylamine that is propan-1-amine substituted by a phenyl group at position 2. It is classified as a doping agent by the World Anti-Doping Agency.

name: (S)-2-phenylpropylamine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of 2-phenylpropylamine.

name: sparsentan
definition: A biphenyl that is 1,1'-biphenyl substituted by (4,5-dimethyl-1,2-oxazol-3-yl)aminosulfonyl, ethoxymethyl, and (2-butyl-4-oxo-1,3-diazaspiro[4.4]non-1-en-3-yl)methyl groups at positions 2, 2' and 4', respectively. It is a dual antagonist of endothelin and angiotensin II receptors approved for the reduction of proteinuria in adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy at risk of rapid disease progression.

name: 3-naphthalen-2-ylalanine
definition: An alanine derivative that is alanine substituted by a naphthalen-2-yl group at position 3.

name: rebaudioside B
definition: A rebaudioside that is steviol in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→2)-[β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→3)]-β-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: durlobactam
definition: A member of the class of azabicycloalkanes that is (1R,2S,5R)-3-methyl-7-oxo-1,6-diazabicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-ene-2-carboxamide in which the amino hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a sulfooxy group.

name: sulbactam(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of sulbactam resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: durlobactam sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the monosodium salt of durlobactam.

name: durlobactam(1−)
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of durlobactam, obtained by deprotonation of the sulfo group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3'-dehydromaltose
definition: A keto-disaccharide that is maltose in which the glucosyl 3'-hydroxy group has been reduced to a keto group.

name: bis(dimethylamino)phospho-L-tyrosine
definition: An L-tyrosine derivative that is L-tyrosine in which the phenolic hydroxy group is substituted by a [bis(dimethylamino)phosphoryl]oxy group.

name: tert-butyloxycarbonyl-Leu-Arg-Arg-7-amino-4-methylcoumarin
definition: A tripeptide consisting of L-Leu-L-Arg-L-Arg carrying a Boc group at the N-terminal and a 7-amino-4-methylcoumarin group at the C-terminal. It is a fluorogenic substrate for detecting trypsin-like activity of the 26S proteasome or the 20S proteasome.

name: Z-Leu-Leu-Glu-AMC
definition: A tripeptide that is L-leu-L-leu-L-Glu with a Cbz group at the N-terminal and a 7-amino-4-methylcoumarin group at the C-terminal. It is a fluorogenic substrate for measuring the peptidylglutamyl peptide-hydrolyzing activity of the 20S proteasome.

name: subrutilene A
definition: A sesterterpene produced in the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: subrutilene B
definition: A sesterterpene produced in the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: subrutilene C
definition: A sesterterpene produced in the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: subrutilene D
definition: A sesterterpene produced in the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: subrutilene E
definition: A sesterterpene produced in the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: subrutilene F
definition: A sesterterpene produced in the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: subrutilene G
definition: A sesterterpene produced in the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: subrutilene H
definition: A sesterterpene produced in the bacterium Streptomyces subrutilus.

name: palmitic acid-d31
definition: A C16 straight-chain saturated fatty acid where the aliphatic hydrogens have been replaced by deuterium atoms.

name: 3-methylbutaneperoxoic acid
definition: The peracid of isovaleric acid where the acidic ‒OH group has been replaced by an ‒OOH group.

name: collinodiene
definition: A diterpene produced by a diterpene synthase from Streptomyces collinus.

name: trofinetide
definition: A tripeptide comprising of glycine, 2-methyl-L-proline, and L-glutamic acid joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is the first and only treatment approved by the FDA specifically indicated for Rett syndrome in adults and pediatric patients two years of age and older.

name: b-AP15
definition: A member of the class of piperidones that is piperidin-4-one substituted by a 3-oxoprop-1-en-3-yl group at position 1 and 4-nitrobenzylidene groups at positions 3 and 5. It is an inhibitor of ubiquitin-specific-processing protease 14 (USP14) and ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase isozyme L5 (UCHL5).

name: ammonium carbonate
definition: An ammonium salt that is the diammonium salt of carbonic acid.

name: 4'-aminoacetanilide
definition: An acetamide that is 1,4-phenylenediamine in which the the amino group at position 4 is replaced by an acetylamino group.

name: ethyl L-phenylalaninate
definition: An L-phenylalanine derivative that is the ethyl ester of L-phenylalanine.

name: 5-methyltryptamine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of 5-methyltryptamine.

name: N-lauryldiethanolamine
definition: An aminodiol that is dodecylamine in which the amino hydrogens are replaced by 2-hydroxyethyl groups.

name: 5-methyltryptaminium
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 5-methyltryptamine obtained by protonation of the primary amino group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: zavegepant
definition: A member of the class of ureas that is urea in which both amino groups are replaced by 4-(2-oxo-1,2-dihydroquinolin-3-yl)piperidin-1-yl and {(2R)-3-(7-methyl-1H-indazol-5-yl)-1-[4-(1-methylpiperidin-4-yl)piperazin-1-yl]-1-oxopropan-2-yl}amino groups. It is a calcitonin gene-related peptide receptor antagonist whose hydrochloride salt has been approved by the FDA for the acute treatment of migraine.

name: zavegepant hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of zavegepant. It is a calcitonin gene-related peptide receptor antagonist administered as a nasal spray for the acute treatment of migraine with or without aura in adults.

name: zavegepant(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of zavegepant resulting from the protonation of the piperidine nitrogen; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: gepirone hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of gepirone. It is a prescription medicine used to treat adults with a certain type of depression called major depressive disorder.

name: gepirone(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is conjugate acid of gepirone resulting from the protonation of the piperazine nitrogen; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: flotufolastat F-18
definition: An 18F radiopharmaceutical which is used as a radioactive diagnostic agent for positron emission tomography (PET) of prostate-specific membrane antigen positive lesions in men with prostate cancer.

name: leniolisib
definition: A pyridopyrimidine that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydropyrido[4,3-d]pyrimidine substituted by [(3S)-1-propanoylpyrrolidin-3-yl]amino and 6-methoxy-5-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-3-yl groups at positions 4 and 6, respectively.

name: leniolisib phosphate
definition: A phosphate salt obtained by reaction leniolisib with one equivalent of phosphoric acid. It is used to treat activated phosphoinositide 3-kinase δ (PI3Kδ) syndrome in adults and children 12 years of age and older.

name: iptacopan
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by [(2S,4S)-2-(4-carboxyphenyl)-4-ethoxypiperidin-1-yl]methyl, methoxy, and methyl groups at positions 4, 5, and 6, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of complement factor B (IC50 = 10nM) with potential immunomodulatory activity.

name: iptacopan hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of iptacopan.

name: iptacopan hydrochloride monohydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of iptacopan hydrochloride. It is a complement factor B inhibitor approved for the treatment of adults with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria.

name: iptacopan(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of iptacopan resulting from the protonation of the piperidine nitrogen; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: lotilaner
definition: A member of the class of isoxazoles that is 4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazole substituted by 4-methyl-5-({2-oxo-2-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethyl)amino]ethyl}carbamoyl)thiophen-2-yl, trifluoromethyl, and 3,4,5-trichlorophenyl groups at positions 3, 5 and 5, respectively (the 5S-stereoisomer). It is a γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA)-gated chloride channel inhibitor selective for mites, approved for the treatment of Demodex blepharitis.

name: perfluorohexyloctane
definition: A fluoroalkane that is tetradecane in which all of the hydrogen atoms at positions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 have been replaced by fluorine atoms. It is an ophthalmic solution used to treat the signs and symptoms of dry eye disease.

name: zilucoplan
definition: A 15 amino-acid, synthetic macrocyclic peptide with formula C172H278N24O55. Its sodium salt is used for the treatment of generalised myasthenia gravis (a disease that leads to muscle weakness and tiredness) in adults whose immune system produces antibodies against acetylcholine receptors.

name: zilucoplan sodium
definition: An organic sodium salt that is the tetrasodium salt of zilucoplan. It is a complement component 5 inhibitor approved for the treatment of generalized myasthenia gravis in adult patients who are anti-acetylcholine receptor antibody positive.

name: omaveloxolone
definition: A semi-synthetic triterpenoid drug. It is an Nrf2 activator that is approved for the treatment of Friedreich's ataxia in adults and adolescents aged 16 years and older.

name: geranylgeranyl acetate
definition: An acetate ester obtained by the formal condensation of acetic acid with (E,E,E)-geranylgeraniol.

name: 3-diazoavenalumate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 3-diazoavenalumic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: zilucoplan(4−)
definition: A peptide anion resulting from the deprotonation of the five carboxy groups and protonation of the L-arginine nitrogen; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: flotufolastat F-18 gallium
definition: An 18F radiopharmaceutical which is used as a radioactive diagnostic agent for positron emission tomography (PET) of prostate-specific membrane antigen positive lesions in men with prostate cancer.

name: flotufolastat F-18(9−)
definition: A nonacarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of all nine carboxy groups of flotufolastat F-18. The major species at pH 7.3.

name: rezafungin
definition: A member of the family of echinocandins that inhibits 1,3-β-D-glucan synthase. It is developed by Cidara Therapeutics and approved for the treatment of candidaemia and invasive candidiasis in patients aged ≥ 18 years who have limited or no alternative treatment options.

name: lynenic acid anion
definition: A docosatetraenoate that is the conjugate base of lynenic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: pentostatin(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of pentostatin arising from protonation of the imine nitrogen; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: chenodeoxycholic acid-3-O-β-D-glucoside
definition: A β-D-glucoside resulting from the formal condensation of the 1R-hydroxy group of β-D-glucose with the 3R-hydroxy group of chenodeoxycholic acid.

name: (9Z)-pentadecenoate
definition: A monounsaturated fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of (9Z)-pentadecenoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (9Z)-18-hydroxyoctadec-9-enoic acid 18-O-sophoroside
definition: A sophoroside resulting from the formal condensation of the alcoholic hydroxy group of 18-hydroxyoleic acid with β-sophorose.

name: cephalot-3(4)-ene
definition: A diterpene that is produced by a diterpene synthase from Cephalotaxus sinensis.

name: verticilla-3,7,12(13)-triene
definition: A diterpene that is produced by a diterpene synthase from Cephalotaxus sinensis.

name: phomacta-1(15),3,7-triene
definition: A diterpene that is produced by a diterpene synthase from Cephalotaxus sinensis.

name: 4-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylate
definition: A cyclohexenecarboxylate that is the conjugate base of 4-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 9-pentadecenoic acid
definition: A pentadecenoic acid having its double bond in the 9-position.

name: (9Z)-pentadecenoic acid
definition: A 9-pentadecenoic acid in which the double bond adopts cis-configuration.

name: (9E)-pentadecenoic acid
definition: A 9-pentadecenoic acid in which the double bond adopts trans-configuration.

name: disuccinimidyl suberate
definition: A N-hydroxysuccinimide ester resulting from the formal condensation of the two carboxy groups of suberic acid with the hydroxy group of 1-hydroxypyrrolidine-2,5-dione. It is a noncleavable and membrane permeable crosslinker.

name: L-arginyl-AMP
definition: A purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate that is adenosine 5'-monophosphate in which one of the hydroxy groups of the phosphate has been condensed with the carboxylic acid group of L-arginine.

name: solasodine 3-β-D-glucoside
definition: A sterol 3-β-D-glucoside having solasodine as the sterol component.

name: S-nitroso-coenzyme A
definition: A nitrosothio compound that is coenzyme A in which the thiol group is replaced by a nitrososulfanediyl group.

name: camonsertib
definition: A pyrazolopyridine that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine substituted by 1H-pyrazol-3-yl, (3-endo)-3-hydroxy-8-oxabicyclo[3.2.1]octan-3-yl, and (3R)-3-methylmorpholin-4-yl groups at positions 1, 4 and 6, respectively. It is a highly potent and selective inhibitor of ATR kinase (IC50 = 1 nM).

name: 3,4-epoxy-1-cyclohexene
