definition: An epoxide that is cyclohexene substituted at positions 3 and 4 by an epoxy group.

name: 3,4-dimethoxy-L-phenylalanine zwitterion
definition: An amino acid zwitterion arising from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of 3,4-dimethoxy-L-phenylalanine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,4-dimethoxy-(E)-cinnamate
definition: A cinnamate that is the conjugate base of 3,4-dimethoxycinnamic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: herquline C(1+)
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of herquline C resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,4-dimethoxy-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-tyrosine derivative that is L-dopa in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 4 of the phenyl ring are replaced by methoxy groups.

name: bentioflumin
definition: An aryl sulfide that is benzene substituted by {[2-(methoxycarbonyl)phenyl]methyl}amino, fluoro, chloro, and (2,2,2-trifluoroethyl)sulfanediyl groups at positions 1, 2, 4 and 5, respectively. It is an acaricide discovered by Shandong Kangqiao Bio-technology Co. Ltd that is highly effective against citrus rust mites, red spider mites, and two-spotted spider mites and has excellent leaf penetration properties.

name: tiapyrachlor
definition: A member of the class of 1,3-thiazoles that is 1,3-thiazole substituted by pyridin-3-yl, chloro, and ethyl[3-(methylsulfonyl)propanoyl]amino groups at positions 2, 4 and 5, respectively. It is an insecticide developed by Corteva that has excellent activity against sap-feeding insects.

name: fenopyramid
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-(difluoromethyl)-1-methyl-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxylic acid with the amino group of 2-[2,4-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy]aniline. It is a fungicide developed by Shandong United Pesticide Industry Co. that demonstrates effective control against soybean rust, corn rust, and wheat powdery mildew.

name: piperflanilide
definition: A benzamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 3-{[(2,2-difluoro-1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl)carbonyl](methyl)amino}-2-fluorobenzoic acid with the amino group of 2-bromo-6-(difluoromethoxy)-4-(1,1,1,2,3,3,3-heptafluoropropan-2-yl)aniline. It is an insecticide developed by Jiangsu Yangnong Chemical Co., Ltd.

name: ambiguine H(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of ambiguine H resulting from the protonation of the isocyano group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: pyraquinate
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is 1-methylquinazoline-2,4(1H,3H)-dione substituted by 3-chlorophenyl, methyl, and {5-[(diethylcarbamoyl)oxy]-1,3-dimethyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl}carbonyl groups at positions 3, 5, and 6, respectively. It is a herbicide developed by Liaoning Cynda Chemical Co. Ltd.

name: etherolenate
definition: A long-chain fatty acid anion that is the conjugate base of etherolenic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: flupyroxystrobin
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine substituted by 2-[(1E)-1,3-dimethoxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-2-yl]phenoxy and trifluoromethyl groups at positions 2 and 4, respectively. It is an insecticide developed by Syngenta Crop Protection AG.

name: indazapyroxamet
definition: A member of the class of indazoles that is 2H-indazole substituted by pyridin-3-yl and N-(1-methylcyclopropyl)aminoacyl groups at positions 2 and 4, respectively. It is an insecticide developed by FMC Corp.

name: eltanexor
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1H-1,2,4-triazole substituted by (1E)-3-amino-3-oxo-2-(pyrimidin-5-yl)prop-1-en-1-yl and 3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl groups at positions 1 and 3, respectively. It is a second-generation exportin 1 inhibitor that is currently in phase II clinical trial for the treatment of patients with higher relapsed/refractory myelodysplastic neoplasms.

name: selinexor
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1H-1,2,4-triazole substituted by (1Z)-3-oxo-3-[2-(pyrazin-2-yl)hydrazinyl]prop-1-en-1-yl and 3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl groups at positions 1 and 3, respectively. It is a prescription medicine approved for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

name: XPO1-IN-1
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1H-1,2,4-triazole substituted by (1E)-3-amino-2-{4-[(methylsulfonyl)amino]phenyl}-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl and 3,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl groups at positions 1 and 3, respectively. It is an exportin 1 inhibitor.

name: triafamone
definition: A methoxy-1,3,5-triazine that is 1,3,5-triazine substituted by 2-{[(difluoromethyl)sulfonyl](methyl)amino}-3-fluorobenzoyl, methoxy and methoxy groups at positions 2, 4, and 6, respectively. It is a herbicide developed by Bayer CropScience AG for weed control in rice and its mode of action is inhibition of the enzyme acetolactate synthase.

name: iofensulfuron
definition: An N-sulfonylurea that is N-carbamoyl-2-iodobenzenesulfonamide bearing a 4-methoxy-6-methyl-1,3,5-triazin-2-yl substituent at position N3.

name: iofensulfuron(1−)
definition: An organic anion that is the conjugate base of iofensulfuron resulting from the deprotonation of the N-sulfonylurea moiety: Major species at pH 7.3.

name: iofensulfuron sodium
definition: The organic sodium salt of iofensulfuron. It is a cross-spectrum herbicide developed by Bayer for use in cereals, corn, soybeans, rice, turf and non-crops.

name: 4-oxocyclohex-2-ene-1-carboxylic acid
definition: A cyclohexenecarboxylic acid that is 4-oxocyclohexanecarboxylic acid carrying a double bond at position 2.

name: pre-putrebactin zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of pre-putrebactin; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: bisucaberin B zwitterion
definition: A tautomer resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of bisucaberin B; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: WZB-117
definition: A diester resulting from the formal condensation of the two hydroxy groups of 3-fluorocatechol with the carboxy groups of 3-hydroxybenzoic acid. It is an inhibitor of glucose transporter 1 (GLUT1) that suppresses tumour growth in mouse xenograft models.

name: pifithrin-α hydrobromide
definition: A hydrobromide salt prepared from 2-(2-imino-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1,3-benzothiazol-3-yl)-1-(4-methylphenyl)ethanone and one equivalent of hydrogen bromide. It is a chemical that inhibits p53-mediated gene activation and apoptosis.

name: GDC-0326
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 5,6-dihydroimidazo[1,2-d][1,4]benzoxazepine substituted by 1-(propan-2-yl)-1H-1,2,4-triazol-5-yl and [(2S)-1-amino-1-oxopropan-2-yl]oxy groups at positions 2 and 9, respectively. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of PI3Kα (Ki = 0.2 nM).

name: 2-propylpiperidine
definition: A member of the class of piperidines that is piperidine substituted by a propyl group at position 2.

name: Asp-Lys zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of protons from the carboxy groups to the amino groups of Asp-Lys; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Lys-Ala(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the amino groups of Lys-Ala; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Arg-Gly(1+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the amino groups of Arg-Gly; major species at pH 7.3.

name: Lys-Lys(2+)
definition: A peptide cation obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy terminus and protonation of the amino groups of Lys-Lys; major species at pH 7.3.

name: His-Gly zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of His-Gly; major species at pH 7.3.

name: LDN-212854
definition: A member of the class of quinolines that is quinoline substituted by a 6-[4-(piperazin-1-yl)phenyl]pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidin-3-yl group at position 5. It is a potent ALK inhibitor (IC50 values of 2.4, 1.3, 85.8, 2,133 and 9,276 nM for ALK1, ALK2, ALK3, ALK4 and ALK5, respectively).

name: DMH4
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine substituted by phenyl and 4-[2-(morpholin-4-yl)ethoxy]phenyl groups at positions 3 and 6, respectively. It is an inhibitor of VEGFR-2 (IC50 = 0.16 μM).

name: Lys-Asp zwitterion
definition: A dipeptide zwitterion resulting from transfer of protons from the carboxy groups to the amino groups of Lys-Asp; major species at pH 7.3.

name: CM-272
definition: A member of the class of aminoquinolines that is is quinoline substituted by 5-methylfuran-2-yl, (1-methylpiperidin-4-yl)amino, methoxy, and 3-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)propoxy groups at positions 2, 4, 6 and 7, respectively. It is a dual G9a/DNA methyltransferases inhibitor with antitumor activity. It inhibits G9a, DNMT1, DNMT3A, DNMT3B and GLP (IC50 = 8 nM, 382 nM, 85 nM, 1200 nM and 2 nM, respectively).

name: DC_517
definition: A member of the class of carbazoles that is 1,3-di(9H-carbazol-9-yl)propan-2-ol in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a 2-hydroxy-3-[(propan-2-yl)amino]propoxy group. It is a DNA methyltransferase 1 inhibitor (IC50 = 1.7 μM).

name: cyclosporin A sulfate
definition: An organosulfate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of cyclosporin A hydrogen sulfate resulting from the deprotonation of the sulfooxy group. It is a metabolite of cyclosporin A found in human bile and plasma.

name: verrucarin A
definition: A trichothecene antibiotic which incorporates a triester macrocyclic structure and an exocyclic methylene epoxide group.

name: cyclosporin A hydrogen sulfate
definition: A cyclosporin A derivative that is cyclosporin A in which the hydroxy group at the MeBmt (butenylmethylthreonine) amino acid is replaced by a sulfooxy group.

name: Ac-Tyr-Val-Ala-Asp-chloromethylketone
definition: A tetrapeptide composed of L-tyrosine, L-valine, L-alanine, and L-aspartic acid joined in sequence by peptide linkages and in which the amino terminus in substituted by an acetyl group and the carboxy terminus is substituted by a chloromethyl group.

name: rezafungin acetate
definition: An acetate salt obtained by combining rezafungin with one molar equivalent of acetic acid. It is an echinocandin antifungal indicated in patients 18 years of age or older who have limited or no alternative options for the treatment of candidemia and invasive candidiasis.

name: (−)-coniine
definition: A 2-propylpiperidine that has R-configuration.

name: THZ1
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 1H-indole substituted by a 5-chloro-2-[3-(4-{[(2E)-4-(dimethylamino)but-2-enoyl]amino}benzamido)anilino]pyrimidin-4-yl group at position 3. It is a selective and potent covalent inhibitor of CDK7 that exhibits anti-proliferative effects in cancer cell lines.

name: L-allylglycine
definition: The L-enantiomer of allylglycine. It is a GABA synthesis inhibitor.

name: hexafluoropropylene oxide trimer acid
definition: A polyfluoroalkyl substance with formula C9HF17O4. It is an environmental contaminant found in drinking water, food, and human blood samples at low levels. It enters the environment through wastewater treatment plants or by atmospheric deposition and causes health effects in laboratory animals and humans leading to changes in thyroid hormone levels, decreased fertility rates, increased cholesterol levels, liver damage, and developmental toxicity.

name: (5Z)-5-[(5-{[(4-chlorophenyl)methyl]sulfanyl}-1-methyl-3-(trifluoromethyl)pyrazol-4-yl)methylidene]-2-sulfanylidene-1,3-thiazolidin-4-one
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1-methyl-1H-pyrazole substituted by trifluoromethyl, (4-oxo-2-sulfanylidene-1,3-thiazolidin-5-ylidene)methyl, and (4-chlorobenzyl)sulfanediyl groups at positions 3, 4 and 5, respectively. It is an ADAMTS-5 inhibitor (IC50 = 1.1 μM) which prevents the degradation of aggrecan, a major component of cartilage that is lost in osteoporosis.

name: PLS-123
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidines that is pyrimidine substituted by (3-{[N-(prop-2-enoyl)glycyl]amino}phenyl)amino and {2-methyl-5-[3-(trifluoromethyl)benzamido]benzoyl}nitrilo groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a covalent BTK inhibitor with potential anti-proliferative activity. It exhibits more potent anti-proliferative effects than ibrutinib in multiple cellular and in vivo preclinical models of B-cell lineage malignancy, including tumor cell lines and mouse xenograft models.

name: SMIP004
definition: A member of the class of N-benzylacetamides that is benzene substituted by acetylnitrilo, methyl, and butyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 4, respectively. It is a SKP2 E3 ligase inhibitor and a selective apoptosis inducer of human prostate cancer cells.

name: MK-2461
definition: A member of the class of benzocycloheptapyridines that is 5H-benzo[4,5]cyclohepta[1,2-b]pyridin-5-one substituted by 1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl and [{[(2R)-1,4-dioxan-2-yl]methyl}(methyl)sulfamoyl]amino groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively. It is a novel ATP-competitive multi-targeted inhibitor of activated c-Met (IC50 = 2.5 nM).

name: 5-hydroxy-L-arginine(1+)
definition: A guanidinium ion resulting from the protonation of both the primary amino and guanidino groups and deprotonation of the carboxy group of 5-hydroxy-L-arginine; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 4-chlorofentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-(4-chlorophenyl)-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with propanoic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: tris(4-chlorophenyl)methanol
definition: A triarylmethane that is tris(4-chlorophenyl)methane in which the hydrogen of the central carbon is replaced by a hydroxy group. It is a byproduct of DDT manufacturing and is a highly persistent contaminant found in the environment and which bio-accumulates in marine species.

name: tris(4-chlorophenyl)methane
definition: A triarylmethane in which the three aryl groups are 4-chlorophenyl. It is a micro-contaminant found in humans and marine environment.

name: givinostat hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of givinostat.

name: givinostat(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of givinostat resulting from the protonation of the tertiary amino group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: givinostat hydrochloride monohydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of givinostat hydrochloride. It is a histone deacetylase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy in patients 6 years of age and older.

name: 5-hydroxy-L-arginine
definition: A hydroxy-L-arginine that is L-arginine substituted by a hydroxy group at position 5.

name: triapine
definition: A thiosemicarbazone resulting from the formal condensation of the formyl group of 3-aminopicolinaldehyde with the non-thioacylated amino group of hydrazinecarbothioamide. It is a ribonucleotide reductase inhibitor that exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: pacritinib
definition: An azamacrocycle with formula C28H32N4O3. It is a Janus kinase inhibitor and its citrate salt is approved for the treatment of intermediate or high risk, primary or secondary myelofibrosis.

name: telatinib
definition: A member of the class of furopyridazines that is furo[2,3-d]pyridazine substituted by (4-chlorophenyl)amino and [2-(methylcarbamoyl)pyridin-4-yl]methoxy groups at positions 4 and 7, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of VEGFR2/3, c-Kit and PDGFRα.

name: resminostat
definition: An enamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2E)-3-[1-({4-[(dimethylamino)methyl]phenyl}sulfonyl)-1H-pyrrol-3-yl]prop-2-enoic acid with the amino group of hydroxylamine. It is an orally bioavailable inhibitor of histone deacetylases with potential antineoplastic activity.

name: orteronel
definition: A member of the class of pyrroloimidazoles that is 6,7-dihydro-5H-pyrrolo[1,2-c]imidazole substituted by hydroxy and 6-(methylcarbamoyl)naphthalen-2-yl groups at position 7 (the 7S-stereoisomer). It is a non-steroidal 17,20-lyase inhibitor that suppresses androgen synthesis. It was previously in clinical development for the treatment of castration-resistant prostate cancer — trial now discontinued.

name: varlitinib
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline substituted by {3-chloro-4-[(1,3-thiazol-2-yl)methoxy]phenyl}amino and [(4R)-4-methyl-4,5-dihydro-1,3-oxazol-2-yl]amino groups at positions 4 and 6, respectively. It is a tyrosine kinase inhibitor of both ErbB-2 (Her-2/neu) and EGFR and has shown significant anti-tumour activity in preclinical models of human breast, lung, and epidermal carcinoma tumours.

name: volasertib
definition: A member of the class of pteridines that is (7R)-7-ethyl-5-methyl-8-(propan-2-yl)-7,8-dihydropteridin-6(5H)-one substituted by a [4-({trans-4-[4-(cyclopropylmethyl)piperazin-1-yl]cyclohexyl}carbamoyl)-2-methoxyphenyl]amino group at position 2. It is as polo-like kinase 1 inhibitor (IC50 = 0.87 nM) with potential antineoplastic activity.

name: riviciclib
definition: A synthetic dihydroxyflavone that is 5,7-dihydroxyflavone which is substituted by a (2R,3S)-2-(hydroxymethyl)-1-methylpyrrolidin-3-yl group at position 8 and by a chlorine at the 2' position. A cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: TAK-733
definition: A member of the class of pyridopyrimidines that is pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidine-4,7(3H,8H)-dione substituted by (2R)-2,3-dihydroxypropyl, (2-fluoro-4-iodophenyl)amino, fluoro, and methyl groups at positions 3, 5, 6, and 8, respectively. It is a non-ATP competitive allosteric inhibitor of MEK1/2.

name: savolitinib
definition: A member of the class of triazolopyrazines that is 1H-[1,2,3]triazolo[4,5-b]pyrazine substituted by (1S)-1-(imidazo[1,2-a]pyridin-6-yl)ethyl and 1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl groups at positions 1 and 6, respectively. It is a highly selective MET tyrosine kinase inhibitor that is approved in China for advanced NSCLC with MET exon 14 skipping mutations.

name: 3-flavene
definition: A member of the class of chromenes that is 2H-chromene substituted by a phenyl group at position 2. It is a metabolite of flavanone found in rat urine.

name: pacritinib(1+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of pacritinib resulting from the protonation of the pyrrolidine nitrogen; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: pacritinib citrate
definition: The citrate salt of pacritinib.

name: sulfopin
definition: A sulfone that is thiolane substituted by two oxo groups at position 1 and by a (chloroacetyl)(2,2-dimethylpropyl)amino group at position 3. It is a covalent inhibitor of Pin1 (Ki = 17 nM) that inhibits Myc-driven tumors in vivo.

name: 2-hexadecenal
definition: A hexadecenal that carries a double bond at position 2.

name: (S)-tolvaptan
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of tolvaptan.

name: N-{4-[(7-chloro-5-hydroxy-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-1-benzazepin-1-yl)carbonyl]-3-methylphenyl}-2-methylbenzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzazepines that is 2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-1-benzazepine substituted by 2-methyl-4-(2-methylbenzamido)benzoyl, hydroxy, and chloro groups at positions 1, 5, and 7, respectively.

name: (R)-tolvaptan
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of tolvaptan.

name: BAY 73-6691
definition: A member of the class of pyrazolopyrimidines that is 4,5-dihydro-1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine substituted by 2-chlorophenyl, oxo, and (2R)-3,3,3-trifluoro-2-methylpropyl groups at positions 1, 4 and 6, respectively. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of phosphodiesterase 9 (PDE9), currently in pre-clinical development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

name: 4-(hydroxyamino)benzoate
definition: A benzoate that is the conjugate base of 4-(hydroxyamino)benzoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2,3-dimethylmalate(2−)
definition: A 2-hydroxydicarboxylate(2−) resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 2,3-dimethylmalic acid; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 4-(hydroxyamino)benzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid substituted by a hydroxyamino group at position 4.

name: NMDI14
definition: A quinoxaline derivative that is 6,7-dimethyl-1,2,3,4-tetrahydroquinoxaline substituted by 2-{[3-(ethoxycarbonyl)-4,5-dimethylthiophen-2-yl]amino}-2-oxoethyl and oxo groups at positions 2 and 3, respectively. It is a nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (NMD) inhibitor.

name: 3-nitrobenzaldehyde
definition: A benzaldehyde carrying a nitro group at the 3-position.

name: 3-nitrobenzoate
definition: A nitrobenzoate that is conjugate base of 3-nitrobenzoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-nitrobenzoic acid
definition: A nitrobenzoic acid having the nitro group at the 3-position.

name: aluminium trinitrate
definition: An inorganic nitrate salt having Al(3+) as the counterion.

name: scandium nitrate
definition: An inorganic nitrate salt having Sc(3+) as the counterion.

name: titanium tetrachloride
definition: A titanium molecular entity that is titanium which carries 4 chlorine atoms.

name: potassium permanganate
definition: An inorganic potassium salt of permanganic acid.

name: zinc nitrate
definition: An inorganic nitrate salt having zinc(2+) as the couterion.

name: gallium nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of gallium.

name: tetramethylgermane
definition: An organogermanium compound that is germanium which carries four methyl groups.

name: indium(III) nitrate
definition: The trinitrate salt of indium.

name: caesium nitrate
definition: The inorganic nitrate salt of caesium.

name: lanthanum trichloride
definition: The trichloride salt of lanthanum.

name: 2,4-dimethylbenzyl alcohol
definition: A methylbenzyl alcohol that is benzyl alcohol substituted by methyl groups at positions 2 and 4.

name: 3,4-dimethylbenzyl alcohol
definition: A methylbenzyl alcohol that is benzyl alcohol substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 4.

name: 3,5-dimethylbenzyl alcohol
definition: A methylbenzyl alcohol that is benzyl alcohol substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: 4-ethylbenzyl alcohol
definition: A member of the class of benzyl alcohols in which the hydrogen at position 4 on the phenyl ring of benzyl alcohol has been replaced by an ethyl group.

name: 3,5-dimethylbenzaldehyde
definition: A member of the class of benzaldehydes that is benzaldehyde substituted by methyl groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively.

name: tetramethylsilane-d12
definition: A deuterated compound that is tetramethylsilane in which the twelve hydrogens are replaced by deuterium.

name: azithromycin(2+)
definition: A tertiary ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the two amino groups of azithromycin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: levofloxacin(1−)
definition: An oxo monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of levofloxacin resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: flumetnicam
definition: A pyridinecarboxamide that is nicotinamide substituted by a trifluoromethyl group at position 4. It is a metabolite of flonicamid.

name: 2,4-dihydroxybenzoate
definition: A dihydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 2,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-Boc-D-phenylalanine
definition: A D-phenylalanine derivative that is D-phenylalanine in which the amino group is replaced by a (tert-butoxycarbonyl)amino group.

name: N-Boc-L-tyrosine
definition: A L-tyrosine derivative that is L-tyrosine in which the amino group is replaced by a (tert-butoxycarbonyl)amino group.

name: 1-hexanesulfonic acid
definition: An alkanesulfonic acid in which the alkyl group directly linked to the sulfo functionality is hexyl.

name: 17-ethynyl-17-hydroxy-18a-homoestr-4-en-3-one
definition: A 3-oxo-Δ4 steroid that is gon-4-en-3-one that carries ethyl, hydroxy, and ethynyl groups at positions 13, 17 and 17, respectively.

name: ITK7
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazolin-4(3H)-one substituted by (pyrimidin-2-ylsulfanyl)methyl, prop-1-yn-1-yl, and methyl groups at positions 2, 7, and 8, respectively. It is a potent PARP11 inhibitor (IC50 = 14 nM).

name: erteberel
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 1,2,3,3a,4,9b-hexahydrocyclopenta[c]chromene substituted by 4-hydroxyphenyl and hydroxy groups at positions 4 and 8, respectively (the 3aS,4R,9bR-stereoisomer). It is an estrogen receptor β agonist and exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: DS-1-38
definition: A 1-benzofuran that is substituted by ethyl, 4-hydroxybenzoyl, and 1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl groups at positions 2, 3, and 5, respectively. It is an EYA1 antagonist that exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: AM6545
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole substituted by 2,4-dichlorophenyl, N-(1,1-dioxidothiomorpholin-4-yl)aminoacyl, methyl, and 4-(4-cyanobut-1-yn-1-yl)phenyl groups at positions 1, 3, 4 and 5, respectively. It is a cannabinoid receptor 1 antagonist and a potential appetite suppressant.

name: XMU-MP-1
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 5,10-dihydro-6H-pyrimido[5,4-b]thieno[3,2-e][1,4]diazepin-6-one substituted by (4-sulfamoylphenyl)amino, methyl and methyl groups at positions 2, 5 and 10, respectively. It is an inhibitor of the Hippo pathway kinases MST1 and MST2 (IC50 = 71.1 and 38.1 nM, respectively).

name: gartisertib
definition: A member of the class of pyrazolopyrimidines that is pyrazolo[1,5-a]pyrimidine substituted by amino, N-[5-fluoro-4-(4-{[4-(oxetan-3-yl)piperazin-1-yl]carbonyl}piperidin-1-yl)pyridin-3-yl]aminoacyl, and fluoro groups at positions 2, 3 and 6, respectively. It is an inhibitor of ataxia telangiectasia and Rad3 related (ATR) kinase that exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: tasisulam
definition: A thiophene substituted by a 2,4-dichlorobenzamide-N-sulfonyl and bromo groups at positions 2 and 4, respectively. It induces tumour cell apoptosis via ROS induction and mitochondrial membrane potential loss and currently in clinical development for the treatment of cancer.

name: 2-chloromaleylacetate
definition: An oxo dicarboxylic acid dianion resulting from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups of 2-chloromaleylacetic acid; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3-iodothyronamine(1+)
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of 3-iodothyronamine resulting from the protonation of the amino group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: vosaroxin
definition: A 1,8-naphthyridine derivative that is 1,8-naphthyridin-4(1H)-one substituted by 1,3-thiazol-2-yl, carboxy, and (3S,4S)-3-methoxy-4-(methylamino)pyrrolidin-1-yl groups at positions 1, 3, and 7, respectively. It targets topoisomerase II and induces site-selective double-strand breaks in DNA, leading to apoptosis in cancer cells.

name: 4,6-dinitroguaiacol
definition: A dinitrophenol that is phenol substituted by a methoxy group at position 2 and nitro groups at positions 4 and 6.

name: 8-methyl-4-methylidenenon-7-en-2-one
definition: An olefinic compound that is 8-methylnon-7-en-2-one substituted by a methylidene group at position 4.

name: 4-sulfanyloctan-1-ol
definition: An alkanethiol that is octane substituted at positions 1 and 4 by hydroxy and sulfanyl groups respectively.

name: 2,11-tetradecadienal
definition: A tetradecadienal with double bonds at positions 2 and 11.

name: PF-06409577
definition: A chloroindole that is 6-chloro-1H-indole substituted by carboxy and 4-(1-hydroxycyclobutyl)phenyl groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is a potent and selective allosteric activator of AMPK and a potential treatment for diabetic nephropathy.

name: SH-1280
definition: A chromene that is 2,2-dimethyl-2H-chromene substituted by methoxy and (2S)-2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)propanoyl groups at positions 5 and 6, respectively. It is a Hsp90 inhibitor that prevents hypoxia-mediated retinal neovascularization and could potentially be used as a treatment for diabetic retinopathy.

name: SH-1242
definition: A chromene that is 2,2-dimethyl-2H-chromene substituted by methoxy and (3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)acetyl groups at positions 5 and 6, respectively. It is a Hsp90 inhibitor that exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: GSK046
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-acetamido-3-fluoro-5-[(1S)-1-phenylethoxy]benzoic acid with the amino group of trans-4-aminocyclohexanol. It is a potent pan-BD2 bromodomain inhibitor.

name: AZD5153
definition: A member of the class of triazolopyridazines that is [1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-b]pyridazine substituted by methoxy and 4-(4-{2-[(2R)-2,4-dimethyl-3-oxopiperazin-1-yl]ethoxy}phenyl)piperidin-1-yl groups at positions 3 and 6, respectively. It is an orally bioavailable bivalent inhibitor of bromodomain-containing protein 4 with potential antineoplastic activity.

name: SF2523
definition: A member of the class of thienopyrans that is 7H-thieno[3,2-b]pyran-7-one substituted by 2,3-dihydro-1,4-benzodioxin-6-yl and morpholin-4-yl groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is a dual inhibitor of PI3K and BRD4 that exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: evofosfamide
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole substituted by methyl, nitro, and ({bis[(2-bromoethyl)amino]phosphoryl}oxy)methyl groups at positions 1, 2 and 5, respectively. It is a hypoxia-activated prodrug that targets hypoxic regions of tumors. The drug was being evaluated for first-line treatment of advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma and advanced soft tissue sarcoma, in combination with chemotherapy (phase 3 trial now discontinued since the drug did not meet primary endpoints).

name: enitociclib
definition: A member of the class of aminopyridines that is pyridine substituted by {4-[(S-methylsulfonimidoyl)methyl]pyridin-2-yl}amino, 4-fluoro-2-methoxyphenyl, and fluoro groups at positions 2, 4, and 5, respectively. It is an inhibitor of cyclin-dependent kinase 9 that exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: MCC950
definition: A member of the class of s-indacenes that is 1,2,3,5,6,7-hexahydro-s-indacene substituted by a ({[4-(2-hydroxypropan-2-yl)furan-2-yl]sulfonyl}carbamoyl)amino group at position 4. It is a potent and selective NLRP3 inhibitor.

name: pluripotin
definition: A member of the class of pyrimidopyrimidines that is 3,4-dihydropyrimido[4,5-d]pyrimidin-2(1H)-one substituted by methyl, 2-methyl-5-[3-(trifluoromethyl)benzamido]phenyl, and (1,3-dimethyl-1H-pyrazol-5-yl)amino group at positions 1, 3, and 7, respectively. It is a dual inhibitor of ERK1 and RasGAP.

name: capmatinib
definition: A member of the class of imidazotriazines that is imidazo[1,2-b][1,2,4]triazine substituted by 3-fluoro-4-(methylcarbamoyl)phenyl and quinolin-6-ylmethyl groups at positions 2 and 7, respectively. It is a c-Met receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor used for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer with MET exon 14 skipping mutation.

name: tirbanibulin
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine substituted by 2-(benzylamino)-2-oxoethyl and 4-[2-(morpholin-4-yl)ethoxy]phenyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a dual inhibitor of Src kinase and tubulin and approved by the FDA for the topical treatment of actinic keratosis on the face or scalp.

name: ramipril(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid monoester(1−) that is the conjugate base of ramipril resulting from the deprotontion of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: ramiprilat(1−)
definition: A dicarboxylic acid dianion that results from the deprotonation of the two carboxy groups and protonation of the secondary amino group of ramiprilat; Major microspecies at pH 7.3

name: SB-743921
definition: A chromone that is 4H-chromen-4-one substituted by (1R)-1-[(3-aminopropyl)(4-methylbenzoyl)amino]-2-methylpropyl, benzyl, and chloro groups at positions 2, 3, and 7, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of kinesin spindle protein (Ki = 0.1 nM) and exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: SNC-80
definition: A member of the class of alkylpiperazines that is piperazine substituted by (R)-[4-(diethylcarbamoyl)phenyl](3-methoxyphenyl)methyl, methyl, prop-1-en-3-yl, and methyl groups at positions 1, 2S, 4, and 5R, respectively. It is a δ-opioid receptor agonist that exhibits antidepressant, anxiolytic, analgesic, and antineoplastic activities.

name: stibavirin
definition: A member of the class of cinnamic acids that is trans-cinnamic acid substituted by a dihydroxy(oxo)-λ5-stibanyl group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-methyl-1-(methyldisulfanyl)but-2-ene
definition: An organic disulfide that is 3-methylbut-2-ene-1-thiol in which the thiol group is replaced by a methyldisulfanediyl group. It is a flavouring agent.

name: HPI-1
definition: A quinolone that is 4,6,7,8-tetrahydroquinolin-5(1H)-one substituted by methyl, (2-methoxyethoxy)carbonyl, 3-hydroxyphenyl, and 2-methoxyphenyl groups at positions 2, 3, 4, and 7, respectively. It is a Hedgehog signaling pathway inhibitor.

name: mescalinium
definition: A primary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of mescaline resulting from the protonation of the primary amino group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: 5,6-dihydroxyindoline-2-carboxylic acid
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is indoline substituted by hydroxy groups at positions C-5 and C-6 and by a carboxy group at position C-2.

name: 5,6-dihydroxyindoline-2-carboxylate
definition: A hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 5,6-dihydroxyindoline-2-carboxylic acid, resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: leucodopachrome zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group of leucodopachrome; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: N-methylmescalinium
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of N-methylmescaline resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: (+)-sativene
definition: A sesquiterpene that is octahydro-1H-1,4-methanoindene bearing methyl, isopropyl and methylidene substituents at positions 4, 7 and 8 respectively (the 1S,3aR,4S,7S,7aS-isomer).

name: CT3
definition: A member of the class of isoindoles that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-isoindole substituted by (3-cyano-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)acetyl and 5-fluoro-2-(trifluoromethyl)pyridin-3-yl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It inhibits Trypanosoma cruzi topoisomerase II and eradicates Trypanosoma cruzi in a mouse model of Chagas disease.

name: S-23142
definition: A member of the class of phthalimides that is phthalimide in which the nitrogen has been substituted by a 4-chloro-2-fluoro-5-(prop-2-yn-1-yloxy)phenyl group. It is used as a herbicide.

name: 2-methoxy-6-all-trans-polyprenyl-1,4-benzoquinone
definition: An all-trans-polyprenylquinone in which the methoxy group is at position C-2 and polyprenyl group is at position C-6.

name: 2-methoxy-5-methyl-6-all-trans-polyprenylbenzoquinone
definition: An all-trans-polyprenylbenzoquinone in which the polyprenyl substituent is at C-2 together with additional methyl and methoxy groups present at C3 and C-6 respectively.

name: 2-(methylaminoethyl)phosphonate zwitterion
definition: A zwitterion resulting from the transfer of a proton from the phosphonic acid group to the amino group of 2-methylaminoethylphosphonic acid; the major species at pH 7.3.

name: ammonium thiocyanate
definition: The organic ammonium salt of thiocyanic acid.

name: ethyl methyl sulfide
definition: A methyl sulfide derivative in which a sulfur atom is substituted by one methyl and one ethyl group.

name: 6-bromo-2-fluoro-3-(hexyloxy)phenol
definition: A member of the class of phenols that is phenol substituted by fluoro, hexyloxy, and bromo groups at positions 2, 3, and 6, respectively.

name: 4-[4-(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-1,3,2-dioxaborolan-2-yl)benzyl]thiomorpholine 1,1-dioxide
definition: A member of the class of thiomorpholines that is benzene substituted by (1,1-dioxidothiomorpholin-4-yl)methyl and 4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-1,3,2-dioxaborolan-2-yl groups at positions 1 and 4, respectively.

name: (5R)-3-(3,4-difluoro-2-methoxyphenyl)-4,5-dimethyl-5-(trifluoromethyl)dihydrofuran-2(3H)-one
definition: A difluorobenzene that is benzene substituted by (5R)-4,5-dimethyl-2-oxo-5-(trifluoromethyl)tetrahydrofuran-3-yl, methoxy, fluoro, and fluoro groups at positions 1, 2, 3 and 4, respectively.

name: fluopsin
definition: A thiocarbonyl compound that is ammonia in which the hydrogens are substituted by methyl, hydroxy, and carbonothioyl groups.

name: fluquinometoate
definition: A quinolone that is quinolin-4(1H)-one bearing cyclopropyl, (2-methoxyethoxy)carbonyl, fluoro and chloro substituents at positions 1, 3, 6 and 7, respectively. It is a bactericide developed by Shandong United Pesticide Industry Co., Ltd that exhibits potent activity against various bacterial pathogens in agriculture.

name: pent-2-enoate
definition: A pentenoate having the double bond at the 2-position.

name: pent-3-enoate
definition: A pentenoate having the double bond at the 3-position.

name: glycerol 1-phosphate(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion that is the dianion of glycerol 1-phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: bifemetstrobin
definition: A biphenyl that is 1,1'-biphenyl substituted by [(1Z)-1,3-dimethoxy-3-oxoprop-1-en-2-yl]oxy and methyl groups at positions 3 and 4, respectively. It is a fungicide from Sumitomo Chemical Co., Ltd.

name: ZG-2291
definition: A member of the class of isoxazoles that is 1,2-oxazole substituted by 3-chlorophenyl and 6-[(carboxymethyl)carbamoyl]-5-hydroxypyridin-3-yl groups at positions 3 and 5, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of factor inhibiting HIF (FIH) and a potential treatment for obesity.

name: danuglipron
definition: A benzimidazolecarboxylic acid that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by (2S)-oxetan-2-ylmethyl, (4-{6-[(4-cyano-2-fluorobenzyl)oxy]pyridin-2-yl}piperidin-1-yl)methyl, and carboxy groups at positions 1, 2, and 6, respectively. It is a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist in development for the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity.

name: vitekwangin B
definition: A member of the class of dihydronaphthalenes that is 3,4-dihydronaphthalene-2-carbaldehyde substituted by hydroxymethyl, 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl, methoxy, and hydroxy groups at positions 3R, 4S, 5, and 6, respectively. It is a natural product isolated from Vitex trifolia that exhibits anti-cancer properties.

name: (Z)-2-aminoethene-1-SO-thioperoxolate
definition: A sulfur oxoanion that is the conjugate base of (Z)-2-aminoethene-1-SO-thioperoxol resulting from the depronation of thioperoxol group.

name: (Z)-2-aminoethene-1-sulfonate
definition: An organosulfonate oxoanion that is the conjugate base of (Z)-2-aminoethene-1-sulfonic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the sulfo group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-oxoethane-1-sulfonamide
definition: An aldehyde that is acetaldehyde substituted by a sulfamoyl group at position 2.

name: (Z)-2-aminoethene-1-sulfonic acid
definition: A 2-aminoethene-1-sulfonic acid in which the double bond adopts (Z)-configuration.

name: 2-aminoethene-1-sulfonic acid
definition: An amino sulfonic acid that is ethenesulfonic acid which is substituted by an amino group at position 2.

name: 2-aminoethene-1-SO-thioperoxol
definition: An SO-thioperoxol that is ethene-SO-thioperoxol substituted by an amino group at position 2.

name: (Z)-2-aminoethene-1-SO-thioperoxol
definition: A 2-aminoethene-1-SO-thioperoxol in which the double bond adopts (Z)-configuration.

name: (2S,5S)-hexanediol
definition: A hexane-2,5-diol with S-configuration at both the C-2 and C-5 centres.

name: allylglycine
definition: A glycine derivative that is glycine substituted by a prop-1-en-3-yl group at position 2.

name: D-allylglycine
definition: The D-enantiomer of allylglycine.

name: 4-(2,4-dihydroxy-6-nonylbenzoyloxy)-2-hydroxy-6-nonylbenzoate
definition: A monohydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of 4-(2,4-dihydroxy-6-nonylbenzoyloxy)-2-hydroxy-6-nonylbenzoic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: exophillate
definition: A monohydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of exophillic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: phaeomoniecin D(1−)
definition: A monohydroxybenzoate that is the conjugate base of phaeomoniecin D resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: N-[2-chloro-2-(naphthalen-2-yl)ethyl]propan-2-amine
definition: A naphthalene substituted by a 1-chloro-2-(propan-2-ylamino)ethyl group at position 2.

name: N-[2-chloro-2-(naphthalen-2-yl)ethyl]propan-2-aminium
definition: A secondary ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of N-[2-chloro-2-(naphthalen-2-yl)ethyl]propan-2-amine resulting from the protonation of the secondary amino group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-[2-chloro-2-(naphthalen-2-yl)ethyl]propan-2-amine hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride obtained by combining N-[2-chloro-2-(naphthalen-2-yl)ethyl]propan-2-amine with one molar equivalent of hydrochloric acid.

name: mogroside IIA1
definition: A mogroside that is mogrol in which the hydroxyl hydrogen at position 24 has been replaced by a 6-O-β-D-glucopyranosyl-β-D-glucopyranosyl group.

name: JHU083
definition: An ethyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of L-leucyl-6-diazo-5-oxo-L-norleucine with ethanol. It is a glutaminase inhibitor and a prodrug of 6-diazo-5-oxo-L-norleucine that exhibits antineoplastic activity.

name: phthalonitrile
definition: A dinitrile that is benzene which is substituted by cyano groups at positions 1 and 2.

name: dCeMM4
definition: A furan that is substituted by {4-[(5-methyl-1,3-thiazol-2-yl)carbamoyl]-1,3-thiazolidin-3-yl}carbonyl and methyl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a glue degrader that induces the ubiquitination and degradation of cyclin K by prompting an interaction between CDK12:cyclin K with a CRL4B ligase complex.

name: 5-adamantyl-IAA
definition: A member of the class of indole-3-acetic acids that is (1H-indol-3-yl)acetic acid substituted by an adamantan-1-yl group at position 5. It is a synthetic auxin that binds to the modified auxin receptor, shows stronger binding affinity than natural auxin, and induces protein degradation.

name: 4-(2,4-dihydroxy-6-nonylbenzoyloxy)-2-hydroxy-6-nonylbenzoic acid
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2,4-dihydroxy-6-nonylbenzoic acid with the 4-hydroxy group of 2,4-dihydroxy-6-nonylbenzoic acid.

name: exophillic acid
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is 4-(2,4-dihydroxy-6-nonylbenzoyloxy)-2-hydroxy-6-nonylbenzoic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 2 is replaced by a β-D-glucopyranosyloxy group.

name: phaeomoniecin D
definition: A monosaccharide derivative that is exophillic acid in which the hydroxy group at position 4 is replaced by a β-D-galactosyloxy group.

name: peramine(1+)
definition: A guanidinium ion resulting from the protonation of the guanidyl group of peramine; Major microspecies at pH 7.3.

name: peramine
definition: A pyrrolopyrazine that is pyrrolo[1,2-a]pyrazin-1(2H)-one substituted by methyl and 3-carbamimidamidopropyl groups at positions 2 and 3, respectively. It is isolated from perennial ryegrass infected with the endophytic fungus Acremonium lolia and exhibits antifeedant activity.

name: 1-phenylimidazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is 1H-imidazole substituted by a phenyl group at position 1.

name: 2-aminobiphenyl
definition: A member of the class of biphenyls that is 1,1'-biphenyl substituted by an amino group at position 2.

name: 7-tricosene
definition: A tricosene that has a double bond at position 7 (unspecified configuration).

name: 1-aminobenzotriazole
definition: A member of the class of benzotriazoles that is 1H-benzotriazole substituted by an amino group at position 1. It is a non-specific and irreversible inhibitor of cytochrome P450 enzymes.

name: muristerone A
definition: A 6-oxo steroid that is 5β-cholest-7-en-6-one substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 2, 3, 5, 11, 14, 20 and 22 respectively (the 2β,3β,5β,11α,14α,20R,22R-stereoisomer). It is a phytoecdysteroid produced by the kaladana plant Ipomoea calonyction.

name: dicyclanil
definition: A member of the class of aminopyrimidines that is pyrimidine-4,6-diamine substituted by cyclopropylamino and cyano groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is an insect growth regulator that prevents blowfly strike in sheep.

name: 2,2,3-triphenyl-1,4-dioxane
definition: A member of the class of dioxanes that is 1,4-dioxane substituted by three phenyl groups at positions 2, 2 and 3.

name: (7E)-tricosene
definition: A 7-tricosene in which the double bond at position 7 has trans-configuration.

name: cholyl-L-tryptophan
definition: A bile acid conjugate resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of cholic acid with the amino group of L-tryptophan. It improves glucose tolerance in diabetic mice.

name: 2-deoxy-4-epi-scyllo-inosose
definition: A tetrahydroxycyclohexanone that is cyclohexanone having four hydroxy groups located at positions 2, 3, 4 and 5 (the 2S,3R,4R,5R-isomer).

name: N1,N5,N10-tris-(E)-caffeoyl spermidine
definition: A N1,N5,N10-tricaffeoyl spermidine in which the three double bonds adopt trans-configuration.

name: N1,N5,N10-tris-(E)-feruloyl spermidine
definition: A N1,N5,N10-triferuloyl spermidine in which the three double bonds adopt trans-configuration.

name: cvxIAA
definition: A member of the class of indole-3-acetic acids that is 1H-indol-3-ylacetic acid substituted by a 3-methoxyphenyl group at position 5. It is a synthetic auxin which binds to the modified TIR1 receptor protein.

name: dordaviprone
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is 2,4,6,7,8,9-hexahydroimidazo[1,2-a]pyrido[3,4-e]pyrimidin-5(1H)-one substituted by 2-methylbenzyl and benzyl groups at positions 4 and 7, respectively. It is a selective antagonist of the dopamine receptor D2 and an allosteric agonist of mitochondrial protease caseinolytic protease P.

name: N1,N5,N10-tri-((E)-5-hydroxyferuloyl)-spermidine
definition: A N1,N5,N10-tri-(5-hydroxyferuloyl)-spermidine in which the three double bonds adopt trans-configuration.

name: N1,N5,N10-(E)-tri-p-coumaroylspermidine
definition: A N1,N5,N10-tri-p-coumaroyl spermidine in which the three double bonds adopt trans-configuration.

name: norcamphor
definition: A cyclic terpene ketone that is bicyclo[2.2.1]heptane substituted by an oxo group at position 2.

name: (−)-CP-55940
definition: The (−)-enantiomer of CP-55940.

name: EVP4593
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline substituted by [2-(4-phenoxyphenyl)ethyl]amino and amino groups at positions 4 and 6, respectively. It is an inhibitor of NF-κB signal transduction pathway and exhibits protective effects in oncology, cardiovascular disease and parasite invasion.

name: 3,3',5'-triiodo-D-thyronine
definition: The D-enantiomer of 3,3',5'-triiodothyronine.

name: SSTC3
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-{methyl[4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl]sulfamoyl}benzoic acid with the amino group of 4-(pyridin-2-yl)-1,3-thiazol-2-amine. It is a casein kinase 1α activator (Kd = 32 nM) that inhibits WNT signaling (EC50 = 30 nM).

name: secretin (porcine)
definition: A naturally occurring 27-amino acid peptide found in swine.

name: L-erythro-neopterin
definition: A neopterin that has 1R,2S-configuration.

name: andilesin D
definition: A meroterpenoid with formula C25H30O6.

name: O-acetylandilesin A
definition: A meroterpenoid that is andilesin A in which the hydroxy group at position 4 is replaced by a acetyloxy group.

name: 4-cyano-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a cyano group at position 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: (+)-CP-55940
definition: The (+)-enantiomer of CP-55940.

name: 5-ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside having eniluracil as the nucleobase.

name: 3-formyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a formyl group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 2-nitro-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a nitro group at position 2 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-bromo-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a bromo group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-(trifluoromethyl)-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a trifluoromethyl group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-diazoavenalumic acid
definition: A diazo compound that is (2E,4E)-5-(cyclohexa-1,5-dien-1-yl)penta-2,4-dienoic acid substituted by diazo and oxo groups at positions 3 and 4, respectively.

name: BI-4020
definition: A macrocycle with formula C30H38N8O2. It is a potent inhibitor of triple mutant EGFRdel19 T790M C797S variant and shows efficacy for regressing tumor xenografts in vivo.

name: 15α-hydroxyandrost-4-ene-3,17-dione
definition: An androstanoid that is androst-4-ene-3,17-dione substituted by an α-hydroxy group at position 15.

name: 4-isopropyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by an isopropyl group at position 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: 4-ethynyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 4-ethynylphenylalanine.

name: 4-(trifluoromethyl)-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a trifluoromethyl group at position 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-acetylphenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine substituted by an acetyl group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: trioxyflanilide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-fluoro-3-[(4-fluorobenzoyl)(2-methoxyethyl)amino]benzoic acid with the amino group of 2-bromo-4-(1,1,1,2,3,3,3-heptafluoropropan-2-yl)-6-(trifluoromethyl)aniline. It is an insecticide developed by Zhejiang Udragon Pesticides and Chemicals Co. Ltd.

name: β-D-GlcpA-(1→2)-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp-(1→3)-[β-D-Xylp-(1→2)]-α-D-Manp
definition: A hexasaccharide consisting of three α-D-mannosyl residues linked sequentially (1→3), with two mannosyl residues also having linked (1→2) to β-D-xylopyranosyl residues and the third mannosyl residue linked ((1→2) to a β-D-glucopyranuronosyl residue. It is a motif found in the capsule of Cryptococcus neoformans.

name: 4-bromo-D-phenylalanine
definition: The D-enantiomer of 4-bromophenylalanine.

name: 4-bromophenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine substituted by a bromo group at position 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: binucleine 2
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole substituted by 3-chloro-4-fluorophenyl, cyano, and N,N-dimethylimidoformamidyl groups at positions 1, 4, and 5, respectively. It is a highly isoform-specific inhibitor of Drosophila Aurora B kinase.

name: RG-2833
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-methylbenzoic acid with the primary amino group of 6-amino-N-(2-aminophenyl)hexanamide. It is a HDAC1 and HDAC3 inhibitor with established brain penetration.

name: 3-ethynyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by an ethynyl group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 2-bromo-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a bromo group at position 2 of the phenyl ring.

name: 2-iodo-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by an iodo group at position 2 of the phenyl ring.

name: 2-methyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a methyl group at position 2 of the phenyl ring.

name: 2-methoxy-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a methoxy group at position 2 of the phenyl ring.

name: 2-cyano-L-phenylalanine
definition: An L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a cyano group at position 2 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-nitro-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a nitro group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-cyano-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a cyano group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-azido-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by an azido group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-iodo-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by an iodo group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-methyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 3-methylphenylalanine.

name: 3-methoxy-L-phenylalanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 3-methoxyphenylalanine.

name: oxaceprol
definition: An L-proline derivative that is L-proline substituted by acetyl and hydroxy groups at positions 1 and 4R, respectively. It is an anti-inflammatory drug used for the management of osteoarthritis.

name: 3-amino-5-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2-thiophenecarboxamide
definition: A member of the class of thiophenes that is thiophene substituted by aminocarbonyl, amino, and 4-methoxyphenyl groups at positions 2, 3, and 5, respectively. It is a small-molecule activator of Nav 1.1 channels.

name: (−)-FR901483(2−)
definition: An organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of (−)-FR901483; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 2-methyl-4-ethylthiazoline
definition: A member of the class of 2-thiazolines that is 4,5-dihydro-1,3-thiazole substituted by methyl and ethyl groups at positions 2 and 4, respectively.

name: 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranosyluronic acid-(1→4)-[2-amino-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranosyl-(1→7)]-3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranonosidonic acid-(2→5)-2-(3-amino)propyl-3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosidonic acid
definition: A branched amino tetrasaccharide comprised of a trisaccharide chain of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranuronic acid, 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid and 3-aminopropyl 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosidonic acid residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (2→5). A 2-amino-2-deoxy-β-D-glucopyranose residue is also linked (1→7) to the 3-deoxy-α-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid residue.

name: fen-G4
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condendation of the carboxy group of 5-oxo-5-[(2-{4-[phenyl(propanoyl)amino]piperidin-1-yl}ethyl)amino]pentanoic acid with the amino group of glycylglycylglycylglycine. It is a fentanyl hapten that could potentially be used in a therapeutic vaccine to counteract toxicity from exposure to fentanyl and its derivatives.

name: fluoroglycofen-ethyl
definition: The ethyl ester of fluoroglycofen. It is a herbicide used for the control of broad-leaf weeds and grasses. The herbicide acts by inhibiting the enzyme protoporphyrinogen oxidase, leading to the damage of cell membranes.

name: MRS4833
definition: A member of the class of naphthoic acids that is 2-naphthoic acid substituted by 4-[(1R,5S,6r)-6-hydroxy-3-azabicyclo[3.1.1]heptan-6-yl]phenyl and 4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl groups at positions 4 and 7, respectively. It is a P2Y14 receptor antagonist that reverses chronic neuropathic pain in a mouse model.

name: zipalertinib
definition: A member of the class of acrylamides that is (8S)-6-methyl-5-(quinolin-3-yl)-8,9-dihydropyrimido[5,4-b]indolizine-4,8-diamine in which the amino group at position 8S is substituted by an acryloyl group. It a covalent epidermal growth factor receptor inhibitor that targets exon 20 insertion mutations.

name: 5-ethynylcytosine
definition: A terminal acetylenic compound that is a derivative of cytosine, having an ethynyl group at the 5-position.

name: (E)-PUGNAc
definition: The (E)-isomer of PUGNAc.

name: 5-ethynyluridine
definition: A terminal acetylenic compound that is uridine substituted by an ethynyl group at position 5. It is a labeling reagent which is used to measure RNA synthesis in proliferating cells.

name: suzetrigine
definition: A member of the class of oxolanes that is oxolane substituted by 4-aminoacyl-pyridine-2-carboxamide, 3,4-difluoro-2-methoxyphenyl, methyl, and trifluoromethyl groups at positions 2, 3, 4, 5, and 5, respectively (the 2R,3S,4S,5R-stereoisomer). It is a selective blocker of the NaV 1.8 voltage-gated sodium channel and has been approved for the treatment of moderate to severe acute pain in adults.

name: 2-methylnaphthalen-1-amine
definition: A naphthalene substituted by an amino group at position 1 and a methyl group at position 2.

name: (1S,2R)-suloctidil
definition: A suloctidil that has (1S,2R)-configuration.

name: (1R,2S)-suloctidil
definition: A suloctidil that has (1R,2S)-configuration.

name: α-D-GlcNAcp-(1→4)-β-D-(2,3-diNAc)ManAp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose and 2,3-diacetamido-2,3-dideoxy-β-D-mannopyranuronic acid joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-GlcNAcp-(1→4)-α-D-(2,3-diNAc)ManAp
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose and 2,3-diacetamido-2,3-dideoxy-α-D-mannopyranuronic acid joined in sequence by a (1→4) glycosidic bond.

name: α-D-GlcNAcp-(1→4)-β-D-(2,3-diNAc)ManAp-(1→3)-β-L-(4NMe)FucNAcp
definition: An amino trisaccharide consisting of 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-glucopyranose, 2,3-diacetamido-2,3-dideoxy-β-D-mannopyranuronic acid, and 2-acetamido-2,4,6-trideoxy-4-(methylamino)-β-L-galactopyranose joined in sequence by a (1→4) and (1→3) glycosidic bonds.

name: prochlorosulfone
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 5-chloro-1,3-dimethyl-1H-pyrazole-4-carboxylic acid with the hydroxy group of 3-{2-chloro-3-[(3-cyclopropyl-5-hydroxy-1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl)carbonyl]-6-(methylsulfonyl)benzyl}-5-methyl-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2(3H)-one. It is a herbicide developed by Shandong Binnong Technology Co. Ltd.

name: 3,4,5-tricaffeoylquinic acid
definition: A carboxylic ester that is the triester obtained by the condensation of the hydroxy groups at positions 3, 4, and 5 of (−)-quinic acid with the carboxy group of caffeic acid.

name: 3,4,5-tri-(E)-caffeoylquinic acid
definition: A 3,4,5-tricaffeoylquinic acid in which the double bonds adopt (E)-configuration.

name: 5-aminopentyl 3,6-dideoxy-α-L-xylo-hexopyranosyl-(1→3)-[3,6-dideoxy-α-L-xylo-hexopyranosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide derivative that consists of two 3,6-dideoxy-α-L-xylo-hexopyranose residues linked (1→3) and (1→6) to a 5-aminopentyl α-D-glucopyranoside residue.

name: 5-aminopentyl 3,6-dideoxy-α-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl-(1→3)-[3,6-dideoxy-α-D-xylo-hexopyranosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide derivative that consists of two 3,6-dideoxy-α-D-xylo-hexopyranose residues linked (1→3) and (1→6) to a 5-aminopentyl α-D-glucopyranoside residue.

name: 5-aminopentyl 6-deoxy-α-L-Galp-(1→3)-[6-deoxy-α-L-Galp-(1→6)]-α-D-Glcp
definition: A trisaccharide derivative that consists of two 6-deoxy-α-L-galactopyranose residues linked (1→3) and (1→6) to a 5-aminopentyl α-D-glucopyranoside residue.

name: 5-aminopentyl 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-4-O-(4,6-dideoxy-4-formamido-β-D-Glcp)-α-D-Galp
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 4,6-dideoxy-4-formamido-β-D-glucopyranose linked 1→4 to a 5-aminopentyl 2-acetamido-2-deoxy-α-D-galactopyranoside residue.

name: 5-aminopentyl 2-O-(2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-β-D-Glcp)-4,6-dideoxy-4-formamido-β-D-Glcp
definition: An amino disaccharide that is 2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-β-D-glucopyranose linked 1→2 to a 5-aminopentyl 4,6-dideoxy-4-formamido-β-D-glucopyranoside residue.

name: D-5-benzylhydantoin
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of 5-benzylhydantoin.

name: 5-benzylhydantoin
definition: An imidazolidine-2,4-dione that is hydantoin substituted by a benzyl group at position 5.

name: acetylfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-phenyl-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with acetic acid. It is a fentanyl analog that has emerged as a drug of abuse and linked to numerous deaths in North America.

name: butyrfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-phenyl-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with butanoic acid. It is a fentanyl analog that is used as a recreational drug.

name: p-tolylfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-(4-methylphenyl)-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with propanoic acid. It is a fentanyl analog that is used as a recreational drug.

name: NCX-4040
definition: A benzoate ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of acetylsalicylic acid with the hydroxy group of (4-hydroxyphenyl)methyl nitrate. It is a nitric oxide donor.

name: 2-methylhexacosane
definition: A long-chain alkane that is hexacosane substituted by a methyl group at position 2.

name: NCC-149
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1H-1,2,3-triazole substituted by (phenylsulfanyl)methyl and 3-(hydroxycarbamoyl)phenyl groups at positions 1 and 4, respectively. It is a potent and selective histone deacetylase 8 inhibitor.

name: BAM15
definition: An organic heterobicyclic compound that is [1,2,5]oxadiazolo[3,4-b]pyrazine substituted by (2-fluorophenyl)amino groups at positions 5 and 6. It is a mitochondrial protonophore uncoupler that is a potential treatment for obesity and sepsis.

name: thiamet G
definition: A pyranothiazole that is (3aR,7aR)-5,6,7,7a-tetrahydro-3aH-pyrano[3,2-d][1,3]thiazole substituted by an ethylamino, hydroxymethyl, hydroxy, and hydroxy groups at positions 2, 5R, 6S, and 7R. It is a potent and selective inhibitor of O-GlcNAcase (Ki = 21 nM).

name: flumatinib
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)methyl]-3-(trifluoromethyl)benzoic acid with the amino group of 2-methyl-N3-[4-(pyridin-3-yl)pyrimidin-2-yl]pyridine-3,5-diamine. It is an inhibitor of the non-receptor tyrosine kinase Bcr-Abl (IC50 = 1.2 nM) and has been approved in China for the treatment of chronic myeloid leukaemia.

name: dimepyrolimet
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidinones that is pyrrolidin-2-one substituted by methyl, (5-chloro-1-methyl-1H-pyrazol-4-yl)aminoacyl, and 3,5-dimethylphenyl groups at positions 1, 3, and 4, respectively (the 3S,4S-stereoisomer). It is a herbicide developed by Qingdao KingAgroot Chemical Compound Co. Ltd, China.

name: flufenazopyr
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine substituted by 3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxy, ethyl, and 3-(trifluoromethyl)-1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl groups at positions 2, 3, and 6, respectively. It is a herbicide developed by Qingdao KingAgroot Chemical Compound Co. Ltd, China.

name: quinaminoprole
definition: A quinazoline that is substituted by a (2-{[1-(4-chlorophenyl)-1H-pyrazol-3-yl]oxy}ethyl)amino group at position 4. It is a fungicide developed by Jiangsu Yangnong Chemical Co. Ltd, China.

name: cyclopropylfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-phenyl-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with cyclopropanecarboxylic acid. It is a fentanyl analog associated with numerous overdose deaths.

name: (2R,3R)-NLD
definition: A [1-methyl-2-(pyridin-3-yl)pyrrolidin-3-yl]methyl 4-(ethylamino)-4-oxobutanoate that has (2R,3R)-configuration.

name: (2S,3S)-NLD
definition: A [1-methyl-2-(pyridin-3-yl)pyrrolidin-3-yl]methyl 4-(ethylamino)-4-oxobutanoate that has (2S,3S)-configuration.

name: [1-methyl-2-(pyridin-3-yl)pyrrolidin-3-yl]methyl 4-(ethylamino)-4-oxobutanoate
definition: An N-alkylpyrrolidine that is 1-methylpyrrolidine substituted by pyridin-3-yl and {[4-(ethylamino)-4-oxobutanoyl]oxy}methyl groups at positions 2 and 3, respectively.

name: 6-nitroparoxetine
definition: A C-nitro compound that is paroxetine substituted by a nitro group at position 6.

name: α-punicalagin
definition: The α-anomer of punicalagin.

name: β-punicalagin
definition: The β-anomer of punicalagin.

name: 1-[(3R)-3-benzylpiperazin-1-yl]-6-sulfanylhexan-1-one
definition: A member of the class of piperazines that is piperazine substituted by sulfanylhexanoyl and benzyl groups at positions 1 and 3R, respectively.

name: 6-{[(2S)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]amino}hexane-1-thiol
definition: A thiol that is 6-aminohexane-1-thiol in which the amino group is substituted by a [(2S)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]amino group.

name: N-{4-[(2S)-2-(methylamino)propyl]phenyl}-6-sulfanylhexanamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 6-sulfanylhexanoic acid with the primary amino group of 4-[(2S)-2-(methylamino)propyl]aniline.

name: dWIZ-2
definition: A member of the class of isoindoles that is 2,3-dihydro-1H-isoindol-1-one substituted by 2,6-dioxopiperidin-3-yl and [(2R)-1-ethylpiperidin-2-yl]methoxy groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a molecular glue degrader of the WIZ transcription factor that induces fetal hemoglobin in eythroblasts, and a potential therapeutic agent for the treatment of Sickle cell disease.

name: UNC0642
definition: A member of the class of quinazolines that is quinazoline substituted by 4,4-difluoropiperidin-1-yl, [1-(propan-2-yl)piperidin-4-yl]amino, methoxy, and 3-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)propoxy groups at positions 2, 4, 6 and 7, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of histone methyltransferases G9a and GLP (IC50 = <2.5 nM).

name: GNE
definition: An azabicycloalkane that is cocaine in which the methoxycarbonyl group at position 2R is replaced by a 6-aminocarbonylhexanoic acid group. It is a cocaine analog that is used as a hapten for the development of an anti-cocaine vaccine.

name: erianin
definition: A diphenylethane that is 1,2-dihydrostilbene substituted by a hydroxy group at position 3 and by methoxy groups at positions 4, 3', 4', and 5'. It is isolated from Dendrobium species.

name: GND
definition: An azabicycloalkane that is cocaine in which the methoxycarbonyl group at position 2R is replaced by a 6-aminocarbonylhexanoic acid group and the benzoyloxy group at position 3S is replaced by a benzoylamino group. It is a cocaine analog that is used as a hapten for the development of an anti-cocaine vaccine.

name: N-(2-{[(2R)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]amino}ethyl)lysinamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of lysine with the primary amino group of N-[(2R)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]ethane-1,2-diamine. It is a hapten used in the development of an anti-methamphetamine vaccine.

name: D-lysyl-N-(2-{[(2R)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]amino}ethyl)glycinamide
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of D-lysylglycine with the primary amino group of N-[(2R)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]ethane-1,2-diamine. It is a hapten used in the development of an anti-methamphetamine vaccine.

name: 2,5-dioxopyrrolidin-1-yl N-[(2S)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]-β-alaninate
definition: An N-hydroxysuccinimide ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of N-[(2S)-1-phenylpropan-2-yl]-β-alanine with pyrrolidine-2,5-dione. It is a hapten used in the development of an anti-methamphetamine vaccine.

name: 3-[2-(4-methylphenyl)-2-oxoethyl]-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1,3-benzothiazol-2(3H)-iminium
definition: An iminium ion that is the conjugate acid of 2-(2-imino-4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1,3-benzothiazol-3-yl)-1-(4-methylphenyl)ethanone resulting from the protonation of the imine group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: acrylfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-phenyl-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with acrylic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: 4-fluoroisobutyrfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-(4-fluorophenyl)-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with 2-methylpropanoic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: furanylfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-phenyl-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with furan-2-carboxylic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: para-AmFenHap
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-{4-[2-(4-anilinopiperidin-1-yl)ethyl]phenyl}-3-sulfanylpropanamide with propanoic acid. It is synthetic analogue of fentanyl that is used as a hapten in the development of a fentanyl vaccine.

name: 3-aminopropyl 2-acetamido-2,3-dideoxy-3-{[(3R)-3-hydroxybutanoyl]amino}-β-D-glucopyranuronosyl-(1→4)-3-O-acetyl-2,6-dideoxy-2-(ethanimidoylamino)-α-L-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucopyranoside
definition: An amino trisaccharide that consists of 2-acetamido-2,3-dideoxy-3-{[(3R)-3-hydroxybutanoyl]amino}-β-D-glucopyranuronic acid, 3-O-acetyl-2,6-dideoxy-2-(ethanimidoylamino)-α-L-galactopyranose, and 3-aminopropyl 2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucopyranoside residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→3). It is a derivative of the trisaccharide repeating unit of Pseudomonas aeruginosa serotype O51 O-antigen that contains an amino propyl linker at the reducing end.

name: 3-aminopropyl 2-acetamido-2,3-dideoxy-3-{[(3R)-3-hydroxybutanoyl]amino}-β-D-glucopyranuronosyl-(1→4)-2-acetamido-3-O-acetyl-2,6-dideoxy-α-L-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucopyranoside
definition: An amino trisaccharide that consists of 2-acetamido-2,3-dideoxy-3-{[(3R)-3-hydroxybutanoyl]amino}-β-D-glucopyranuronic acid, 2-acetamido-3-O-acetyl-2,6-dideoxy-α-L-galactopyranose, and 3-aminopropyl 2-acetamido-2,6-dideoxy-α-D-glucopyranoside residues linked sequentially (1→4) and (1→3). It is a derivative of the trisaccharide repeating unit of Pseudomonas aeruginosa serotype O51 O-antigen that contains an amino propyl linker at the reducing end and and an acetamido group instead of the acetimidamido group.

name: para-methoxyfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-(4-methoxyphenyl)-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with propanoic acid. It is a synthetic analogue of fentanyl.

name: morphine-6-hemisuccinate
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is morphine in which the hydroxy group at position 6 is replaced by a hemisuccinoyl group.

name: 3-O-carboxymethylmorphine
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is morphine in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is replaced by a carboxymethoxy group.

name: 5,6-epoxycholesterol
definition: An epoxy steroid that is cholesterol which has an epoxy group whose oxygen is attached to the 5 and 6-positions.

name: 4-(phenylazo)aniline
definition: Azobenzene substituted at one of the 4-positions by an amino group. It has a role as a dye and an allergen.

name: 3-acetyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: The L-enantiomer of 3-acetylphenylalanine.

name: 3-allyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: An L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by an allyl group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-methoxyphenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine substituted by a methoxy group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-methoxy-D-phenylalanine
definition: The D-enantiomer of 3-methoxyphenylalanine.

name: 3-methylphenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine substituted by a methyl group at position 3 of the phenyl ring.

name: 3-methyl-D-phenylalanine
definition: The D-enantiomer of 3-methylphenylalanine.

name: SBL-398
definition: A member of the class of indoles that is 4,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-indole substituted by 4-(carboxymethyl)-1,3-thiazol-2-yl, phenyl, and 2-methylbutan-2-yl groups at positions 1, 2 and 5, respectively. It is an experimental compound used for the treatment of proximal spinal muscular atrophy.

name: 6,8-bis(benzylsulfanyl)octanoic acid
definition: An organic sulfide that is 6,8-bis(mercapto)octanoic acid in which the two thiol groups at positions 6 and 8 are substituted by benzyl groups.

name: (6R)-6,8-bis(benzylsulfanyl)octanoic acid
definition: The R-enantiomer of 6,8-bis(benzylsulfanyl)octanoic acid.

name: (6S)-6,8-bis(benzylsulfanyl)octanoic acid
definition: The S-enantiomer of 6,8-bis(benzylsulfanyl)octanoic acid.

name: 4-(trifluoroacetyl)-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a trifluoroacetyl group at position 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: 4-formyl-L-phenylalanine
definition: A L-phenylalanine derivative that is L-phenylalanine substituted by a formyl group at position 4 of the phenyl ring.

name: 4-ethynylphenylalanine
definition: A phenylalanine derivative that is phenylalanine substituted by an ethynyl group at position 4 of the phenyl ring. It is an inhibitor of tryptophan hydroxylase.

name: aminotipyr
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-amino-6-methylpyridine-3-carboxylic acid with the hydroxy group of {4-[(5-methyl-1,3-thiazol-2-yl)oxy]phenyl}methanol. It is a fungicide developed by Qingdao KingAgroot Chemical Compound Co., Ltd.

name: vinylfluthrin
definition: A carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (1R,3R)-3-[(Z)-2-cyanoethenyl]-2,2-dimethylcyclopropanecarboxylic acid with the hydroxy group of (2,3,5,6-tetrafluorophenyl)methanol. It is pyrethroid insecticide developed by Jiangsu Yangnong Chemical Co., Ltd.

name: flufenauxirim
definition: An aminopyrimidine that is pyrimidine substituted by 2-fluoro-3-methoxy-4-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl, carboxy, methoxy and amino groups at positions 2, 4, 5, and 6, respectively. It is a herbicide developed by Qingdao KingAgroot Chemical Compound Co., Ltd.

name: AC-4-248
definition: An organochlorine compound that is 2,3,4,9-tetrahydro-1H-β-carboline substituted by 3-butanamidopropyl and chloro groups at positions 2 and 6, respectively. It is a non-competitive inhibitor of dopamine transporter (IC50 = 45.5 μM for human DAT).

name: butylcyclohexane
definition: A cycloalkane that is cyclohexane substituted by a single butyl group.

name: VAS2870
definition: A member of the class of triazolopyrimidines that is 3H-[1,2,3]triazolo[4,5-d]pyrimidine substituted by benzyl and (1,3-benzoxazol-2-yl)sulfanediyl groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively. It is a pan-NADPH oxidase inhibitor.

name: pyroxasulfone
definition: A member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole substituted by methyl, trifluoromethyl, (5,5-dimethyl-4,5-dihydro-1,2-oxazole-3-sulfonyl)methyl, and difluoromethoxy groups at positions 1, 3, 4, and 5, respectively. It is a herbicide that inhibits the biosynthesis of very-long-chain fatty acids and used for the pre-emergent control of annual ryegrass, barley grass, and suppression of specific grass weeds in wheat.

name: questinol(1−)
definition: A phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of questinol arising from selective deprotonation of the 2-hydroxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidine
definition: A pyridopyrimidine in which the 3 nitrogen atoms are at positions 1, 3, and 8.

name: 2-phenyl-1,3-benzoxazole
definition: A 1,3-benzoxazole substituted by a phenyl group at position 2.

name: DS16570511
definition: An indolyl carboxylic acid that is 1H-indole substituted by 3-carboxypropyl and 3-({[3-(2,6-dichlorophenyl)-5-methyl-1,2-oxazol-4-yl]methyl}amino)benzoyl groups at positions 1 and 3, respectively. It is a cell-permeable inhibitor of mitochondrial calcium uniporter.

name: 1-methylpyrrolidine
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidines that is pyrrolidine substituted by a methyl group at position 1.

name: 2-butyl-3,5-dimethylpyrazine
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine substituted by butyl, methyl, and methyl groups at positions 2, 3, and 5, respectively.

name: 2-amino-4-methylpyridin-3-ol
definition: An aminopyridine that is pyridine substituted by amino, hydroxy and methyl groups at positions 2, 3, and 4, respectively.

name: 2,3-dinitrobenzamide
definition: A member of the class of benzamides that is benzamide substituted by nitro groups at positions 2 and 3.

name: madecassate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of madecassic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-phenylpyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine
definition: A pyrazolopyridine that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-b]pyridine substituted by a phenyl group at position 1.

name: CT-179
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is pyridine substituted by [(3,4-dichlorophenyl)carbamoyl]amino, [3-(dimethylamino)propyl]amino, and methyl groups at positions 2, 4 and 6, respectively. It is a small molecule inhibitor of OLIG2 developed by Curtana Pharmaceuticals for the treatment of glioblastoma, medulloblastoma, and other brain cancers.

name: O-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl]-serine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine linked via an α glycosidic bond to the O at position 3 of serine.

name: O-[N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosaminyl]-threonine
definition: A non-proteinogenic α-amino acid that is N-acetyl-α-neuraminyl-(2→6)-N-acetyl-α-D-galactosamine linked via an α glycosidic bond to the O at position 3 of threonine.

name: 1-phenylpyrrole
definition: A member of the class of pyrroles that is 1H-pyrrole substituted by a phenyl group at position 1.

name: 3-phenyl-1,2,4-benzotriazine
definition: A member of the class of benzotriazines that is 1,2,4-benzotriazine substituted by a phenyl group at position 3.

name: urazole
definition: A member of the class of triazolidines that is 1,2,4-triazolidine substituted by oxo groups at positions 3 and 5.

name: (3R)-atrochrysone
definition: An atrochrysone that has R-configuration.

name: (3R)-atrochrysone carboxylate
definition: An atrochrysone carboxylate that has R-configuration.

name: atrochrysone carboxylic acid
definition: An anthracenone that is 1,2,3,4-tetrahydroanthracene substituted by an oxo group at position 1, carboxy group at position 2, methyl group at position 3 and hydroxy groups at positions 3, 6, 8 and 9.

name: (3R)-atrochrysone carboxylic acid
