definition: An atrochrysone carboxylic acid that has R-configuration.

name: WYE-28
definition: A pyrazolopyrimidine that is 1H-pyrazolo[3,4-d]pyrimidine substituted by 1-(methoxycarbonyl)piperidin-4-yl, morpholin-4-yl and 4-({[4-(hydroxymethyl)phenyl]carbamoyl}amino)phenyl groups at positions 1, 4, and 6, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of mTOR (IC50 = 0.08 nM) and PI3Kα (IC50 = 6 nM).

name: ampkinone
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is [1]benzopyrano[3,4-e]isoindole-1,3(2H,4H)-dione substituted by 4-benzoylphenyl, methyl, methyl, hydroxy, and methoxy groups at positions 2, 4, 4, 6 and 7, respectively. It is an indirect small-molecule activator of AMPK and a potential therapeutic agent for the treatment of obesity and type 2 diabetes.

name: nifurstyrenic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid substituted by a 2-(5-nitrofuran-2-yl)ethenyl group at position 4.

name: (E)-nifurstyrenic acid
definition: The (E)-isomer of nifurstyrenic acid.

name: (Z)-nifurstyrenic acid
definition: The (Z)-isomer of nifurstyrenic acid.

name: nifurstyrenate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of nifurstyrenic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: sodium nifurstyrenate
definition: The organic sodium salt of nifurstyrenic acid. It is an antibacterial agent which has been used in Japan for the prevention and treatment of bacterial infections in fish.

name: FE201874
definition: A synthetic nonapeptide comprising cysteinyl, phenylalanyl, isoleucyl, homoglutaminyl, asparaginyl, cysteinyl, prolyl, ornithyl, and glycinamide residues in sequence, with a disulfide bridge joining the two cysteine residues. It is a selective high affinity rat V1A vasopressin receptor agonist.

name: (E)-nifurstyrenate
definition: A nifurstyrenate that is the conjugate base of (E)-nifurstyrenic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: (Z)-nifurstyrenate
definition: A nifurstyrenate that is the conjugate base of (Z)-nifurstyrenic acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: sodium (Z)-nifurstyrenate
definition: The organic sodium salt of (Z)-nifurstyrenic acid.

name: sodium (E)-nifurstyrenate
definition: The organic sodium salt of (E)-nifurstyrenic acid.

name: rafoxanide
definition: A salicylanilide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-hydroxy-3,5-diiodobenzoic acid with the amino group of 3-chloro-4-(4-chlorophenoxy)aniline. It is a broad-spectrum anthelmintic used for the treatment of parasitic infections in cattle and sheep.

name: DADLE
definition: A pentapeptide comprising of L-tyrosine, D-alanine, glycine, L-phenylalanine and D-leucine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is a synthetic δ-opioid agonist that induces hibernation, promotes survival of neurons and glial cells in the CNS, and exerts neuroprotection.

name: TTK21
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-propoxybenzoic acid with the amino group of 4-chloro-3-(trifluoromethyl)aniline. It is an activator of the histone acetyltransferases CBP/p300 that passes the blood-brain barrier, induces no toxicity, and reaches different parts of the brain when conjugated to glucose-based carbon nanospheres.

name: SHP099
definition: A member of the class of pyrazines that is pyrazine substituted by amino, 2,3-dichlorophenyl, and 4-amino-4-methylpiperidin-1-yl groups at positions 2, 3, and 6, respectively. It is an allosteric SHP2 inhibitor, with IC50s of 0.690, 1.241, 0.416, 1.968, and 2.896 μM for SHP2, SHP2D61Y, SHP2E69K, SHP2A72V, and SHP2E76K.

name: 4-phenylfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N,4-diphenyl-1-(2-phenylethyl)piperidin-4-amine with propanoic acid. It is a fentanyl analogue.

name: O-phosphoserine-P-ethyl ester
definition: A serine derivative that is serine in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a [ethoxy(hydroxy)phosphoryl]oxy group.

name: O-phospho-L-serine-P-ethyl ester
definition: An O-phosphoserine-P-ethyl ester that has L-configuration.

name: O-phosphoserine-P-methyl ester
definition: A serine derivative that is serine in which the hydroxy group is replaced by a [hydroxy(methoxy)phosphoryl]oxy group.

name: O-phospho-L-serine-P-methyl ester
definition: An O-phosphoserine-P-methyl ester that has L-configuration.

name: 5-formylcytidine
definition: A nucleoside analogue that is cytidine substituted by a formyl group at position 5.

name: Hexa-His
definition: A hexapeptide formed from six L-histidine residues joined in sequence by peptide linkages. It is an affinity tag used for protein purification.

name: tauro-GM2
definition: A ganglioside derivative that is GM2 ganglioside in which the carboxy group of the N-acetyl-α-neuraminic acid residue undergoes formal condensation with the amino group of taurine. It is found in the brains of patients that have Tay-Sachs disease.

name: methyl (Z)-5-octenoate
definition: A methyl 5-octenoate that has (Z)-configuration.

name: methyl (E)-5-octenoate
definition: A methyl 5-octenoate that has (E)-configuration.

name: methyl 5-octenoate
definition: A fatty acid methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oct-5-enoic acid with the hydroxy group of methanol.

name: 4-hydroxy-4-methyl-7-cis-decenoic acid γ-lactone
definition: A γ-lactone that is γ-butyrolactone substituted by a methyl group and a (3Z)-hex-3-en-1-yl group at position 5.

name: tebanicline
definition: A monochloropyridine that is 2-chloropyridine substituted by a (2R)-azetidin-2-ylmethoxy group at position 5. It is a potent nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist with analgesic and antinociceptive properties.

name: 6-AmHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is morphine in which the hydroxy group at position 3 is replaced by a (3-sulfanylpropanoyl)amino group and the 6S-hydroxy group is replaced by an acetylamino group.

name: 3-hydroxy-11Z-octadecenoyl-L-carnitine
definition: A 3-hydroxy-11Z-octadecenoylcarnitine that has L-configuration.

name: (3R)-hydroxy-11Z-octadecenoyl-L-carnitine
definition: A 3-hydroxy-11Z-octadecenoyl-L-carnitine in which the chiral carbon attached to the hydroxy group adopts (R)-configuration

name: methylthioadenosine-DADMe immucillin-A
definition: A pyrrolopyrimidine that is 5H-pyrrolo[3,2-d]pyrimidin-4-amine substituted by a {(3R,4S)-3-hydroxy-4-[(methylsulfanyl)methyl]pyrrolidin-1-yl}methyl group at position 7. It is a potent inhibitor of human 5'-methylthioadenosine phosphorylase (Ki = 86 pM) with anti-tumour activity.

name: N-cis-sinapoyltyramine
definition: A N-sinapoyltyramine in which the double bond adopts cis-configuration.

name: N-sinapoyltyramine
definition: A member of the class of cinnamamides that is an enamide obtained by the formal condensation of sinapic acid with tyramine.

name: AZD3965
definition: A thienopyrimidine that is thieno[2,3-d]pyrimidine-2,4(1H,3H)-dione substituted by isopropyl, methyl, (4S)-4-hydroxy-4-methyl-1,2-oxazolidine-2-carbonyl, and [5-methyl-3-(trifluoromethyl)-1H-pyrazol-4-yl]methyl groups at positions 1, 3, 5, and 6, respectively. It is an inhibitor of monocarboxylate transporter 1 (Ki = 1.6 nM), and was previously in phase I clinical trials for the treatment of lymphomas and solid tumours.

name: AT-1015 free base
definition: A carbotricyclic compound that is 5H-dibenzo[a,d][7]annulene substituted by a 1-{2-[(1-formylpiperidine-4-carbonyl)amino]ethyl}piperidin-4-ylidene group at position 5.

name: AT-1015(1+)
definition: A piperidinium ion that is the conjugate acid of AT-1015 free base resulting from the protonation of the piperidine nitrogen; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: AT-1015 hydrochloride monohydrate
definition: The monohydrate form of AT-1015 hydrochloride.

name: ombuoside
definition: A glycosyloxyflavone that is ombuin attached to a rutinoside residue at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage.

name: TRULI
definition: A pyrrolopyridine that is 1H-pyrrolo[2,3-b]pyridine substituted by a N-(3-benzyl-1,3-thiazol-2(3H)-ylidene)carboxamide group at position 3. It is a potent and ATP-competitive inhibitor of LATS1 and LATS2 kinases, and a YAP signaling activator.

name: GSK-923295
definition: An imidazopyridine that is imidazo[1,2-a]pyridine substituted by 4-{(2S)-2-[3-chloro-4-(propan-2-yloxy)benzamido]-3-[(N,N-dimethylglycyl)amino]propyl}phenyl, and (1S)-1-hydroxyethyl groups at positions 2 and 8, respectively. It is an allosteric inhibitor of centromere-associated protein-E (CENP-E) kinesin motor ATPase activity (Ki = 3.2 nM and 1.6 nM for human and canine CENP-E motordomains, respectively).

name: AZD-8835
definition: A member of the class of triazoles that is 1H-1,2,4-triazole substituted by ethyl, 1-(3-hydroxypropanoyl)piperidin-4-yl, and 5-amino-6-(5-tert-butyl-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-yl)pyrazin-2-yl groups at positions 1, 3, and 5, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of PI3Kα and PI3Kδ (IC50 = of 6.2 and 5.7 nM, respectively) which was in a phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of advanced solid tumours (trial now discontinued).

name: AZD8186
definition: A member of the class of chromones that is chromone substituted by morpholin-4-yl, dimethylaminoacyl, and (1R)-1-(3,5-difluoroanilino)ethyl groups at positions 2, 6, and 8, respectively. It is a potent inhibitor of PI3K-β (IC50 = 4nM) and PI3K-δ (IC50 = 12nM) with selectivity over PI3K-α (IC50 = 35 nM) and PI3K-γ (IC50 = 675 nM).

name: isotonitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl, 4-(propan-2-yloxy)benzyl, and nitro groups at positions 1, 2, and 5, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: etonitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl, 4-ethoxybenzyl, and nitro groups at positions 1, 2, and 5, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: metonitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl, 4-methoxybenzyl, and nitro groups at positions 1, 2, and 5, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: protonitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl, 4-propoxybenzyl, and nitro groups at positions 1, 2, and 5, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: butonitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl, 4-butoxybenzyl, and nitro groups at positions 1, 2, and 5, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: flunitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl, 4-fluorobenzyl, and nitro groups at positions 1, 2, and 5, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: isotodesnitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl and 4-(propan-2-yloxy)benzyl groups at positions 1 and 2, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: etodesnitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl and 4-ethoxybenzyl groups at positions 1 and 2, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: metodesnitazene
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl and 4-methoxybenzyl groups at positions 1 and 2, respectively. It is a synthetic opioid.

name: HTH-01-015
definition: An organic heterotetracyclic compound that is 5,13-dihydro-6H-naphtho[2,3-e]pyrimido[5,4-b][1,4]diazepin-6-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 4, 5 and 13, and by a [1-(piperidin-4-yl)-1H-pyrazol-4-yl]amino group at position 2. It is a potent NUAK1 inhibitor (IC50 = 100 nM).

name: BRD4884
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of oxane-4-carboxylic acid with the 3-amino group of 4'-fluoro[1,1'-biphenyl]-3,4-diamine. It is a HDAC inhibitor (IC50 = 29 nM, 62 nM, and 1.09 μM for HDAC1, HDAC2, and HDAC3, respectively) and has shown to enhance cognition in mouse models.

name: BRD6688
definition: A pyrrolidinecarboxamide that is N-phenylpyrrolidine-1-carboxamide substituted by amino and pyridin-4-yl groups at positions 2 and 5, respectively. It is a HDAC inhibitor (IC50 = 21 nM, 100 nM, and 11.48 μM for HDAC1, HDAC2, and HDAC3, respectively) and has shown to enhance cognition in mouse models.

name: clonazepam 3-hemisuccinate
definition: A hemisuccinate resulting from the formal condensation of the 3-hydroxy group 3-hydroxyclonazepam with one of the carboxy groups of succinic acid.

name: 3'-AmNic
definition: An N-alkylpyrrolidine that is 1-methylpyrrolidine substituted by pyridin-3-yl and aminomethyl groups at positions 2 and 3, respectively.

name: (+)-3'-AmNic
definition: The (+)-enantiomer of 3'-AmNic.

name: (−)-3'-AmNic
definition: The (−)-enantiomer of 3'-AmNic.

name: eltoprazine
definition: A member of the class of piperazines that is 1,4-benzodioxane substituted by a piperazin-1-yl group at position 5. It exhibits strong antidyskinetic effects and was previously in clinical trials for the management of aggressive behaviours.

name: venerose
definition: A galactosylglycerol derivative that is 1-O-glyceryl β-D-galactopyranoside in which the hydroxy group at position 4R is replaced by a [(2-aminoethoxy)(hydroxy)phosphoryl]oxy group. It is a sexually transmitted sugar found in Drosophila melanogaster.

name: spidoxamat
definition: An oxaspiro compound that is 12-hydroxy-1,4-dioxa-9-azadispiro[4.2.48.25]tetradec-11-en-10-one substituted by a 4-chloro-2,6-dimethylphenyl group at position 11. It is an insecticide developed by Bayer AG which exhibits high efficacy against key sucking pests such as aphids and white flies.

name: (S)-noradrenaline(1+)
definition: An organic cation that is the conjugate acid of (S)-noradrenaline, obtained by protonation of the primary amino group; major species at pH 7.3.

name: 1-AmidoMorHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is morphine substituted at position 1 by a {3-[(triphenylmethyl)sulfanyl]propanoyl}amino group and the hydroxy group at position 3 is subsituted by an acetylamino group.

name: 1-AmidoDihydroMorHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is 1-AmidoMorHap in which the double bond between positions 7 and 8 has been hydrogenated.

name: gardiquimod
definition: An imidazoquinoline that is 1H-imidazo[4,5-c]quinoline substituted by 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropyl, (ethylamino)methyl, and amino groups at positions 1, 2, and 4, respectively. It is an agonist of toll-like receptor 7.

name: (R)-norketamine
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of norketamine.

name: (S)-norketamine
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of norketamine.

name: 6-hydroxynorketamine
definition: A hydroxycyclohexanone that is norketamine in which one of the hydrogens at position 6 is substituted by a hydroxy group. It is a minor metabolite of ketamine.

name: (2R,6R)-6-hydroxynorketamine
definition: The (2R,6R)-stereoisomer of 6-hydroxynorketamine.

definition: The (2S,6S)-stereoisomer of 6-hydroxynorketamine.

definition: The (2R,6S)-stereoisomer of 6-hydroxynorketamine.

name: (2S,6R)-6-hydroxynorketamine
definition: The (2S,6R)-stereoisomer of 6-hydroxynorketamine.

name: 5-(4-((1-(2-(diethylamino)ethyl)-5-nitro-1H-benzo[d]imidazol-2-yl)methyl)phenoxy)pentanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzimidazoles that is 1H-benzimidazole substituted by 2-(diethylamino)ethyl, [4-(4-carboxybutoxy)phenyl]methyl, and nitro groups at positions 1, 2, and 5, respectively. It is a hapten used for the preparation of a vaccine against against isotonitazene and etonitazene opioids.

name: XMD-17-51
definition: A pyrimidobenzodiazepine this is 5,11-dihydro-6H-pyrimido[4,5-b][1,4]benzodiazepin-6-one substituted by methyl groups at positions 5 and 11, and by a [1-(piperidin-4-yl)-1H-pyrazol-4-yl]amino group at position 2. It is an inhibitor of NUAK1.

name: cholyl-L-tryptophan(1−)
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of cholyl-L-tryptophan resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: iptriazopyrid
definition: A triazolopyridine that is [1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a]pyridine substituted by (propane-2-sulfonyl)methyl, trifluoromethyl, and 5-methyl-1,3,4-oxadiazol-2-aminoacyl groups at positions 3, 5, and 8, respectively. It is a herbicide first discovered by Nissan Chemical Corporation, Japan.

name: [(2-{4-[(2S)-2-(pyridin-3-yl)pyrrolidin-1-yl]butanamido}ethyl)sulfanyl]acetic acid
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 4-[(2S)-2-(pyridin-3-yl)pyrrolidin-1-yl]butanoic acid with the amino group of [(2-aminoethyl)sulfanyl]acetic acid. It is a nicotine hapten.

name: 4-({[(2S,3R)-1-methyl-2-(pyridin-3-yl)pyrrolidin-3-yl]methyl}amino)-4-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of succinic acid with the primary amino group of (−)-3'-AmNic. It is a nicotine hapten.

name: 4-[(3-{3-[(2S)-1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl]pyridin-4-yl}propyl)amino]-4-oxobutanoic acid
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of succinic acid with the primary amino group of 3-{3-[(2S)-1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl]pyridin-4-yl}propan-1-amine. It is a nicotine hapten.

name: 6-{5-[(2S)-1-methylpyrrolidin-2-yl]pyridin-2-yl}hexanoic acid
definition: A member of the class of pyridines that is (S)-nicotine substituted by a 5-carboxypentyl group at position 2 of the pyridyl ring. It is a nicotine hapten.

name: α-pyrrolidinopentiophenone
definition: An aromatic ketone that is valerophenone substituted by a pyrrolidin-1-yl at position 2. It is a designer drug.

name: 3',4'-methylenedioxy-α-pyrrolidinobutiophenone
definition: A member of the class of benzodioxoles that is 1,3-benzodioxole substituted by a 2-(pyrrolidin-1-yl)butanoyl group at position 5. It is a designer drug.

name: α-methylfentanyl
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide resulting from the formal condensation of the aryl amino group of N-phenyl-1-(1-phenylpropan-2-yl)piperidin-4-amine with propanoic acid.

name: cannabinolic acid
definition: A benzochromene that is cannabinol substituted by a carboxy group at position 2. It is a precursor in the biosynthesis of cannabinol .

name: 4-({[2-(1H-imidazol-4-yl)ethyl]amino}methyl)benzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid substituted by a {[2-(1H-imidazol-4-yl)ethyl]amino}methyl group at position 4.

name: sterpurene
definition: A sesquiterpene isolated from the fungus Stereum purpureum.

name: africanol

name: 4-hydroxyafricanol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid that is africanol substituted by a hydroxy group at position 4.

name: 4-oxoafricanol

name: ophiocerate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of ophioceric acid resulting from the deprotonation of the carboxy group; Major species at pH 7.3.

name: methoxyacetonitrile
definition: An aliphatic nitrile that is acetonitrile in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a methoxy group.

name: 6,14-AmidoHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is dihydromorphine in which the hydroxy group at position 6S is substituted by an acetamido group and the hydrogen at position 14 is substituted by a 3-(tritylthio)propenamido group. It is a heroin hapten.

name: 14-AmidoMorHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is dihydromorphine in which the hydrogen at position 14 is substituted by a 3-(tritylthio)propenamido group. It is a heroin hapten.

name: 14-AmidoHerHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is dihydromorphine in which the hydroxy group at position 6S is substituted by an acetyloxy group and the hydrogen at position 14 is substituted by a 3-(tritylthio)propenamido group. It is a heroin hapten.

name: N-succinyl norcocaine
definition: A tertiary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of one of the carboxy groups of succinic acid with the amino group of norcocaine. It is a hapten used in the development of a cocaine conjugate vaccine.

name: 2-chloroacetamide
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is acetamide substituted by a chloro group at position 2.

name: [99mTc]TRODAT-1
definition: A technetium coordination entity that consists of TRODAT-1 coordinated to a central technetium-99 oxo complex. It is a selective dopamine transporter imaging agent.

name: dorzagliatin
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-2-[4-(2-chlorophenoxy)-2-oxo-2,5-dihydro-1H-pyrrol-1-yl]-4-methylpentanoic acid with the amino group of (2R)-3-(3-amino-1H-pyrrol-1-yl)propane-1,2-diol. It is an allosteric glucokinase activator developed by Hua Medicine for the treatment of type 1 and 2 diabetes mellitus , and diabetic kidney disease.

name: (4S)-hydroxyafricanol
definition: A 4-hydroxyafricanol that has (S)-configuration at position 4.

name: (4R)-hydroxyafricanol
definition: A 4-hydroxyafricanol that has (R)-configuration at position 4.

name: 3-[4-(2-chlorophenyl)-9-methyl-6H-thieno[3,2-f][1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a][1,4]diazepin-2-yl]propanoic acid
definition: A thienotriazolodiazepine that is brotizolam in which the bromo group at position 2 is replaced by a 2-carboxyethyl group. It is a structural analogue of brotizolam.

name: [2-bromo-4-(2-chlorophenyl)-6H-thieno[3,2-f][1,2,4]triazolo[4,3-a][1,4]diazepin-9-yl]methanol
definition: A thienotriazolodiazepine that is brotizolam in which the methyl group at position 9 is replaced by a hydroxymethyl group. It is a metabolite of brotizolam.

name: 6-hydroxybrotizolam
definition: A thienotriazolodiazepine that is brotizolam carrying a hydroxy group at position 6. It is a metabolite of brotizolam.

name: paynantheine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C23H28N2O4. It is isolated from the plant Mitragyna speciosa.

name: mitraciliatine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C23H30N2O4. It is isolated from the plant Mitragyna speciosa.

name: speciogynine
definition: A monoterpenoid indole alkaloid with formula C23H30N2O4. It is isolated from the plants Mitragyna speciosa and Mitragyna inermis.

name: MorHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is morphine in which the hydroxy group at position 6S is replaced by a {3-[(triphenylmethyl)sulfanyl]propanoyl}amino group. It is a heroin hapten.

name: 6-AcMorHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is dihydromorphine in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6S have been replaced by {3-[(triphenylmethyl)sulfanyl]propanoyl}amino and acetyloxy groups, respectively. It is a heroin hapten.

name: 6-PrOxyHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is dihydromorphine in which the hydroxy groups at positions 3 and 6S have been replaced by {3-[(triphenylmethyl)sulfanyl]propanoyl}amino and 2-oxopropyl groups, respectively. It is a heroin hapten.

name: DiAmHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is dihydromorphine in which the hydroxy groups at position 3 and 6S are replaced by acetamido groups and the methyl group at position 17 is replaced by a 4-{3-[(triphenylmethyl)sulfanyl]propanamido}butyl group. It is a heroin hapten.

name: DiPrOxyHap
definition: A morphinane alkaloid that is dihydromorphine in which the hydroxy groups at position 3 and 6S are replaced by 2-oxopropyl groups and the methyl group at position 17 is replaced by a 4-{3-[(triphenylmethyl)sulfanyl]propanamido}butyl group. It is a heroin hapten.

name: N-(4-aminobutyl)-D-methamphetamine
definition: The D-enantiomer of N-(4-aminobutyl)methamphetamine.

name: N-(4-aminobutyl)-L-methamphetamine
definition: The L-enantiomer of N-(4-aminobutyl)methamphetamine.

name: N-(4-aminobutyl)methamphetamine
definition: A primary amino compound that is methamphetamine in which the NH group is substituted by a 4-aminobutyl group.

name: β-oxymorphamine
definition: A morphinane alkaloid with formula C17H22N2O3.

name: mannoimidazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazopyridines that is 5,6,7,8-tetrahydroimidazo[1,2-a]pyridine substituted by a hydroxymethyl group at position 5 and by hydroxy groups at positions 6, 7, and 8 (the 5R,6R,7S,8R-stereoisomer).

name: (3S,8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-3-hydroxyicosatetraenoyl-CoA(4−)
definition: A 3-hydroxy fatty acyl-CoA(4−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of (3S,8Z,11Z,14Z,17Z)-3-hydroxyicosatetraenoyl-CoA; major species at pH 7.3.

name: fentiazoluron
definition: A member of the class of ureas that is urea which is substituted by a 2-fluoro-4-{1-[4-(trifluoromethoxy)phenyl]-1H-1,2,4-triazol-3-yl}phenyl group at position N1 and a 3-{5-methyl-2-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]phenyl}-4-oxo-1,3-thiazolidin-2-ylidene group at position N3. It is an an insecticide from Corteva Agriscience.

name: (R)-carmeconazole
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of carmeconazole.

name: (S)-carmeconazole
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of carmeconazole.

name: methyl 2-[2-chloro-4-(4-chlorophenoxy)phenyl]-2-hydroxy-3-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)propanoate
definition: A methyl ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of 2-[2-chloro-4-(4-chlorophenoxy)phenyl]-2-hydroxy-3-(1H-1,2,4-triazol-1-yl)propanoic acid with methanol.

name: 6-sulfanylhexyl 3-O-α-D-galactopyranosyl-α-D-mannopyranoside
definition: A glycosylmannose derivative consisting of α-D-galactopyranose and 6-sulfanylhexyl α-D-mannopyranoside residues joined in sequence by a (1→3) glycosidic bond.

name: 6-sulfanylhexyl α-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→6)-α-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→3)-α-D-mannopyranoside
definition: A trisaccharide derivative consisting of α-D-galactopyranose and 6-sulfanylhexyl 3-O-α-D-galactopyranosyl-α-D-mannopyranoside residues joined in sequence by a (1→6) glycosidic bond.

name: 6-sulfanylhexyl α-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→2)-[α-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-D-galactopyranosyl-(1→6)]-α-D-galactopyranoside
definition: A tetrasaccharide derivative consisting of 2-O-α-D-galactopyranosyl-α-D-galactopyranose and α-D-galactopyranose residues joined to a 6-sulfanylhexyl α-D-galactopyranoside residue by (1→6) and (1→2) glycosidic bonds, respectively.

name: 6-sulfanylhexyl 6-O-[(2-aminoethoxy)(hydroxy)phosphoryl]-α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→2)-α-D-mannopyranosyl-(1→6)-α-D-mannopyranoside
definition: A trisaccharide derivative that consists of 6-O-phosphoethanolamine-α-D-mannopyranose, α-D-mannopyranose, and 6-sulfanylhexyl α-D-mannopyranoside residues joined by (1→2) and (1→6) linkages.

name: Wnt-C59
definition: A secondary carboxamide resulting from the formal condensation of the amino group of 4-(pyridin-3-yl)aniline with the carboxy group of [4-(2-methylpyridin-4-yl)phenyl]acetic acid. It is a highly potent inhibitor of porcupine (IC50 = 74 pM), a member of the membrane-bound O-acyltransferase family.

name: D-histidinol
definition: A histidinol that has D-configuration.

name: fenargimine
definition: An L-arginine derivative that is L-arginine in which the α-amino group is substituted by an (E)-[(2E)-3-phenylprop-2-en-1-ylidene]amino group. It is a nematicide discovered by SML Limited, India.

name: PM00104
definition: A synthetic alkaloid with the molecular formula C37H38F3N3O8, the compound exhibits strong efficacy against both solid tumors and haematological cancers. Its chemical structure closely resembles that of marine-derived natural products such as Jorumycin, originally isolated from the sea slug Jorunna funebris.

name: (R)-zacopride
definition: The (R)-enantiomer of zacopride.

name: (S)-zacopride
definition: The (S)-enantiomer of zacopride.

name: 2-methyl-5-isopropylhexa-2,5-dienoyl-CoA
definition: A 2-enoyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 2,6-dimethyl-5-methylenehept-2-enoic acid.

name: bevantolol
definition: A propanolamine that is 3-aminopropane-1,2-diol in which the hydrogen of the primary hydroxy group is substituted by 3-methylphenyl and one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is substituted by 2-(3,4-dimethoxyphenyl)ethyl. A β1 adrenoceptor antagonist, it has been shown to be as effective as other β-blockers for the treatment of angina pectoris and hypertension.

name: salicylanilide
definition: An amide of salicylic acid and of aniline; it is therefore both a salicylamide and an anilide.

name: bromfenac
definition: Amfenac in which the the hydrogen at the 4 position of the benzoyl group is substituted by bromine. It is used for the management of ocular pain and treatment of postoperative inflammation in patients who have undergone cataract extraction. It was withdrawn from the US market in 1998, following concerns over off-label abuse and hepatic failure.

name: dimyristoyl phosphatidylcholine
definition: A phosphatidylcholine where the phosphatidyl acyl groups are specified as tetradecanoyl (myristoyl).

name: dehydrocostus lactone
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound and guaianolide sesquiterpene lactone that is acrylic acid which is substituted at position 2 by a 4-hydroxy-3,8-bis(methylene)decahydoazulen-5-yl group and in which the hydroxy group and the carboxy group have undergone formal condensation to afford the corresponding γ-lactone.

name: 4'-phenyl-2,2':6',3''-terpyridine
definition: 2,2':6',3''-Terpyridine carrying a phenyl substituent at the 4-position of the central pyridine ring.

name: 2,2':6',2''-terpyridine
definition: A tridentate heterocyclic ligand that binds metals at three meridional sites giving two adjacent 5-membered MN2C2 chelate rings.

name: dUMP(2−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate(2−) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of 2'-deoxyuridine 5'-monophosphate (dUMP); major species at pH 7.3.

name: cinchocaine
definition: A monocarboxylic acid amide that is the 2-(diethylamino)ethyl amide of 2-butoxyquinoline-4-carboxylic acid. One of the most potent and toxic of the long-acting local anesthetics, its parenteral use was restricted to spinal anesthesia. It is now generally only used (usually as the hydrochloride) in creams and ointments and in suppositories for temporary relief of pain and itching associated with skin and anorectal conditions.

name: FPL 64176
definition: 1H-Pyrrole substituted at C-2 and -5 by methyl groups, at C-3 by methoxycarbonyl and at C-4 by a 2-benzylbenzoyl group.

name: edrophonium
definition: A quaternary ammonium ion that is N-ethyl-N,N-dimethylanilinium in which one of the meta positions is substituted by a hydroxy group. It is a reversible inhibitor of cholinesterase, with a rapid onset (30-60 seconds after injection) but a short duration of action (5-15 minutes). The chloride salt is used in myasthenia gravis both diagnostically and to distinguish between under- or over-treatment with other anticholinesterases. It has also been used for the reversal of neuromuscular blockade in anaesthesia, and for the management of poisoning due to tetrodotoxin, a neuromuscular blocking toxin found in puffer fish and other marine animals.

name: adinazolam
definition: A triazolo[4,3-a][1,4]benzodiazepine having a dimethylaminomethyl group at the 1-position, a phenyl group at the 6-position and a chloro substituent at the 8-position.

name: alosetron
definition: A pyrido[4,3-b]indole compound having a 5-methyl-1H-imidazol-4-ylmethyl group at the 2-position.

name: 7,12-dimethyltetraphene
definition: A tetraphene having methyl substituents at the 7- and 12-positions. It is a potent carcinogen and is present in tobacco smoke.

name: practolol
definition: N-(4-Hydroxyphenyl)acetamide in which the hydrogen of the phenolic hydroxy group is substituted by a 3-(isopropylaminoamino)-2-hydroxypropyl group. A selective beta blocker, it has been used in the emergency treatment of cardiac arrhythmias.

name: bismuth subsalicylate
definition: A bismuth salt of salicylic acid.

name: 4-nitrobenzoic acid
definition: A nitrobenzoic acid having the nitro group at the 4-position.

name: 4-methoxyphenylethylamine
definition: A primary amino compound consisting of ethylamine having a 4-methoxyphenyl substituent at the 2-position.

name: balsalazide
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid consisting of 5-aminosalicylic acid (mesalazine) linked to 4-aminobenzoyl-β-alanine via an azo bond.

name: abamine
definition: An amino acid ester that is methyl glycine in which one of hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is remplaced by a 4-fluorobenzyl group while the other is replaced by a 3,4-dimethoxycinnamyl group.

name: N,N-dimethylethanolamine
definition: A tertiary amine that is ethanolamine having two N-methyl substituents.

name: ethyltrimethylammonium
definition: A quarternary ammonium cation having one ethyl and three methyl substituents around the central nitrogen.

name: O-hydroxy(phenyl)phosphinoyl ecgonine methyl ester
definition: The O-hydroxy(phenyl)phosphinoyl derivative of ecgonine methyl ester.

name: amphotericin B methyl ester
definition: The methyl ester of amphotericin B.

name: sodium azide
definition: The sodium salt of hydrogen azide (hydrazoic acid).

name: LY-221481
definition: A pyrazolopyrazole that is 6,7-dihydro-1H,5H-pyrazolo[1,2-a]pyrazole-3-carboxylic acid which has been substituted at positions 2, 5 and 6 by methylsulfonyl, oxo, and amino groups, respectively, and in which the amino group has been condensed with the carboxy group of (2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)(oxo)acetic acid, the oxo group of which has been converted to the corresponding oxime O-allyl ether.

name: loracarbef anion
definition: The conjugate base of loracarbef.

name: dihydrodigitoxin
definition: A cardanolide glycoside that is the 20,22-dihydro derivative of digitoxin.

name: dodecyltrimethylammonium bromide
definition: A quarternary ammonium cation having one dodecyl and three methyl substituents around the central nitrogen.

name: 2-iodobenzoic acid
definition: An iodobenzoic acid with a single iodo substituent placed at the 2-position.

name: desloratadine
definition: Loratadine in which the ethoxycarbonyl group attached to the piperidine ring is replaced by hydrogen. The major metabolite of loratidine, desloratadine is an antihistamine which is used for the symptomatic relief of allergic conditions including rhinitis and chronic urticaria. It does not readily enter the central nervous system, so does not cause drowsiness.

name: eptifibatide
definition: A synthetic homodetic cyclic peptide comprising Nα-(3-sulfanylpropanoyl)homoarginyl, glycyl, aspartyl, tryptophyl, prolyl and cysteinamide residues connected in sequence and cyclised via a disulfide bond. Derived from a protein found in the venom of the southeastern pygmy rattlesnake, Sistrurus miliarus barbouri, eptifibatide is an anti-coagulant that inhibits platelet aggregation by selectively blocking the platelet glycoprotein IIb/IIIa receptor, so preventing the binding of fibrinogen, von Willebrand factor, and other adhesive ligands. It is used in the management of unstable angina and in patients undergoing coronary angioplasty and stenting procedures.

name: decyltrimethylammonium bromide
definition: A quarternary ammonium salt whose basic unit comprises a decyltrimethylammonium cation and a bromide anion.

name: choline phosphate(1−)
definition: The organophosphate oxoanion formed from choline by removal of two protons from the phosphate group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: 3,4-dimethoxybenzoic acid
definition: A member of the class of benzoic acids that is benzoic acid substituted by methoxy groups at positions 2 and 3.

name: thyroxine zwitterion
definition: The amino acid zwitterion formed from thyroxine by transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group. Major species at pH 7.3.

name: oxybuprocaine
definition: A benzoate ester in which 4-amino-3-butoxybenzoic acid and 2-(diethylamino)ethanol have combined to form the ester bond; an ester-based local anaesthetic (ester "caine") used especially in ophthalmology and otolaryngology.

name: isoliquiritigenin
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is trans-chalcone hydroxylated at C-2', -4 and -4'.

name: ciprofloxacin hydrochloride (anhydrous)
definition: The anhydrous form of the monohydrochloride salt of ciprofloxacin.

name: profenamine
definition: A member of the class of phenothiazines that is phenothiazine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is substituted by a 2-(diethylamino)propyl group. An antimuscarinic, it is used as the hydrochloride for the symptomatic treatment of Parkinson's disease.

name: echinocandin B
definition: A cyclic hexapeptide echinocandin antibiotic isolated from Aspergillus nidulans var. echinulatus with specific anti-yeast activity.

name: cilofungin
definition: A cyclic hexapeptide echinocandin antibiotic isolated from Aspergillus spp. By inhibiting the conversion of lanosterol to ergosterol, it invades a fungus' ability to synthesize cell walls. A modified form of echinocandin B, it is an antimycotic agent against Candida albicans.

name: methyl β-D-glucopyranoside
definition: A β-D-glucopyranoside having a methyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: methyl α-D-glucopyranoside
definition: An α-D-glucopyranoside having a methyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: fumagillol
definition: A sesquiterpenoid with antimicrobial properties.

name: 1,4-butanediammonium
definition: An alkane-α,ω-diammonium(2+) that is the dication of putrescine (1,4-butanediamine) arising from protonation of both primary amino groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: azetidin-2-one
definition: An unsubstituted β-lactam compound.

name: tyraminium
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of tyramine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: dichloroarcyriaflavin A
definition: An indolocarbazole compound having two chloro substituents and an additijonal fused pyrrole-2,5-dione ring.

name: atomoxetine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of atomoxetine.

name: abarelix
definition: A polypeptide compound composed of ten natural and non-natural amino acid resiudes in a linear sequence.

name: (−)-anisomycin
definition: An antibiotic isolated from various Streptomyces species. It interferes with protein and DNA synthesis by inhibiting peptidyl transferase or the 80S ribosome system.

name: bromohydrin pyrophosphate
definition: An alkyl diphosphate having bromohydrin as the alkyl group.

name: methyl dihydrogen phosphate
definition: A monoalkyl phosphate having methyl as the alkyl group.

name: 2-phospholactic acid
definition: The phosphoric acid monoester resulting from formal condensation of the alcohol group of lactic acid with phosphoric acid.

name: octyltrimethylammonium bromide
definition: A quarternary ammonium salt whose basic unit comprises an octyltrimethylammonium cation and a bromide anion.

name: pentolinium ion
definition: A dication whose structure comprises a pentane backbone linking two 1-methylpyrrolidinium groups; a nicotinic antagonist used as a ganglionic blocking agent in hypertension.

name: thiouracil
definition: A nucleobase analogue that is uracil in which the oxo group at C-2 is replaced by a thioxo group.

name: serotonin(1+)
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of serotonin; major species at pH 7.3.

name: phenethyl isothiocyanate
definition: An isothiocyanate having a phenethyl group attached to the nitrogen. It is a naturally occurring compound found in some cruciferous vegetables (e.g. watercress) and is known to possess anticancer properties.

name: 6-chlorotrimethoprim
definition: An aminopyrimidine, the structure of which is that of trimethoprim (pyrimidine 2,4-diamine and 1,2,3-trimethoxybenzene moieties linked by a methylene bridge) carrying a 6-chloro substituent.

name: cefotiam
definition: A cephalosporin with ({1-[2-(dimethylamino)ethyl]-1H-tetrazol-5-yl}sulfanyl)methyl and (2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)acetamido substituents at positions 3 and 7, respectively, of the cephem skeleton. A third generation beta-lactam cephalosporin antibiotic, it is active against a broad spectrum of both Gram positive and Gram negative bacteria.

name: 4-nitrophenyl-β-D-galactoside
definition: A β-D-galactopyranoside having a 4-nitrophenyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: 5-aminopentanoic acid zwitterion
definition: Zwitterionic form of 5-aminopentanoic acid having an anionic carboxy group and a protonated amino group.

name: 5-ammoniolevulinate
definition: The zwitterion formed from 5-aminolevulinic acid by transfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group. It is the major species present at physiological pH.

name: glycylglycine zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion from the dipeptide glycylglycine formed by proton transfer from the OH of the carboxy group to the terminal amino group.

name: glycinexylidide
definition: A amino acid amide with 2,6-dimethylaniline and glycine components; an active metabolite of lidocaine, formed by oxidative deethylation. Used as an indicator of hepatic function.

name: dibenzo-18-crown-6
definition: A crown ether that is 18-crown-6 ortho-fused to two benzene rings at positions 8-9 and 17-18.

name: 6α,20ξ-murideoxycholic acid
definition: The 6α,20ξ-stereoisomer of murideoxycholic acid.

name: carprofen
definition: Propanoic acid in which one of the methylene hydrogens is substituted by a 6-chloro-9H-carbazol-2-yl group. A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug, it is no longer used in human medicine but is still used for treatment of arthritis in elderly dogs.

name: O-(cyclohexanecarbonyl)lysergol maleate
definition: The hydrogenmaleate salt of O-(cyclohexanecarbonyl)lysergol.

name: darunavir
definition: An N,N-disubstituted benzenesulfonamide bearing an unsubstituted amino group at the 4-position, used for the treatment of HIV infection. A second-generation HIV protease inhibitor, darunavir was designed to form robust interactions with the protease enzyme from many strains of HIV, including those from treatment-experienced patients with multiple resistance mutations to other protease inhibitors.

name: N-benzyloxycarbonylglycinate
definition: An N-acylglycinate that is the conjugate base of N-benzyloxycarbonylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: xylitol 5-phosphate(2−)
definition: Dianion of xylitol 5-phosphate arising from deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups; major species at pH 7.3.

name: (E)-4-nitrostilbene
definition: A stilbenoid with a structure of (E)-stilbene substituted at one of the C-4 positions by a nitro group.

name: L-tryptophan polyoxin C
definition: Polyoxin C in which the primary amino group has been condensed with L-tryptophan to form a peptide bond.

name: 17β-hydroxy-17-methylestra-4,9,11-trien-3-one
definition: A synthetic non-aromatisable androgen and anabolic steroid. It binds strongly to the androgen receptor and has therefore also been used as an affinity label for this receptor in the prostate and in prostatic tumors.

name: 3,6-diamino-10-methylacridinium chloride
definition: The 10-methochloride salt of 3,6-diaminoacridine. Note that a mixture of this compound with 3,6-diaminoacridine (proflavine) is known as acriflavine or neutral acriflavine.

name: [N-(4-cyanophenyl)-N'-(diphenylmethyl)guanidine]acetic acid
definition: A trisubstituted guanidine, carrying 4-cyanophenyl, diphenylmethyl and carboxymethyl substituents, which is known to act as a highly potent sweetening agent.

name: N-acetyl-L-tyrosylglycylglycine
definition: A tripeptide consisting of AcTyrGlyGly.

name: darifenacin
definition: 2-[(3S)-1-Ethylpyrrolidin-3-yl]-2,2-diphenylacetamide in which one of the hydrogens at the 2-position of the ethyl group is substituted by a 2,3-dihydro-1-benzofuran-5-yl group. It is a selective antagonist for the M3 muscarinic acetylcholine receptor, which is primarily responsible for bladder muscle contractions, and is used as the hydrobromide salt in the management of urinary incontinence.

name: 3,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid
definition: A chlorophenoxyacetic acid that is phenoxyacetic acid in which the hydrogens at positions 3 and 4 of the phenyl group are replaced by chlorines.

name: ertapenem
definition: Meropenem in which the one of the two methyl groups attached to the amide nitrogen is replaced by hydrogen while the other is replaced by a 3-carboxyphenyl group. The sodium salt is used for the treatment of moderate to severe susceptible infections including intra-abdominal and acute gynaecological infections, pneumonia, and infections of the skin and of the urinary tract.

name: L-canavanine zwitterion
definition: L-Canavanine in zwitterionic form.

name: cerivastatin(1−)
definition: The anion obtained by removal of a proton from the carboxylic acid group of cerivastatin.

name: arformoterol
definition: An N-[2-hydroxy-5-(1-hydroxy-2-{[1-(4-methoxyphenyl)propan-2-yl]amino}ethyl)phenyl]formamide in which both of the stereocentres have R configuration. The active enantiomer of formoterol, it is administered by inhalation (generally as the tartrate salt) as a direct-acting sympathomimetic and bronchodilator for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (any progressive respiratory disease that makes it harder to breathe over time, such as chronic bronchitis and emphysema).

name: 5-hydroxymethylfurfural
definition: A member of the class of furans that is furan which is substituted at positions 2 and 5 by formyl and hydroxymethyl substituents, respectively. Virtually absent from fresh foods, it is naturally generated in sugar-containing foods during storage, and especially by drying or cooking. It is the causative component in honey that affects the presystemic metabolism and pharmacokinetics of GZ in-vivo.

name: 5-chlorosalicylic acid
definition: A monohydroxybenzoic acid that is 2-hydroxybenzoic acid (salicylic acid) in which the hydrogen at position 5 is replaced by chlorine.

name: abacavir
definition: A 2,6-diaminopurine that is (1S)-cyclopent-2-en-1-ylmethanol in which the pro-R hydrogen at the 4-position is substituted by a 2-amino-6-(cyclopropylamino)-9H-purin-9-yl group. A nucleoside analogue reverse transcriptase inhibitor (NRTI) with antiretroviral activity against HIV, it is used (particularly as the sulfate) with other antiretrovirals in combination therapy of HIV infection.

name: O-methylsalicylic acid
definition: A methoxybenzoic acid that is the methyl ether of salicylic acid.

name: (−)-carbovir
definition: The (active) (−)-enantiomer of the carbocyclic analogue of 2',3'-dideoxy-2',3'-didehydroguanosine.

name: propiophenone
definition: An aromatic ketone in which the two substituents on the carbonyl C atom are phenyl and ethyl.

name: (−)-hinokiresinol
definition: A 1,3-bis(p-hydroxyphenyl)pentane-1,4-diene that has 1E,3S configuration. A natural product found in Chamaecyparis obtusa.

name: (S)-columbianetin
definition: The (S)-(+)-enantiomer of columbianetin.

name: (S)-fenfluramine
definition: The S-enantiomer of fenfluramine. It stimulates the release of serotonin and selectively inhibits its reuptake, but unlike fenfluramine it does not possess catecholamine agonist activity. It was formerly given by mouth as the hydrochloride in the treatment of obesity, but, like fenfluramine, was withdrawn wolrdwide following reports of valvular heart defects.

name: L-α-phenylglycine
definition: The S stereoisomer of α-phenylglycine.

name: fosmidomycin
definition: Propylphosphonic acid in which one of the hydrogens at position 3 is substituted by a formyl(hydroxy)amino group. An antibiotic obtained from Streptomyces lavendulae, it specifically inhibits DXP reductoisomerase (EC 1.1.1.267), a key enzyme in the non-mevalonate pathway of isoprenoid biosynthesis.

name: ciclopirox
definition: A cyclic hydroxamic acid that is 1-hydroxypyridin-2(1H)-one in which the hydrogens at positions 4 and 6 are substituted by methyl and cyclohexyl groups, respectively. A broad spectrum antigfungal agent, it also exhibits antibacterial activity against many Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, and has anti-inflammatory properties. It is used a a topical treatment of fungal skin and nail infections.

name: 3,4,5-trimethoxybenzoic acid
definition: A benzoic acid derivative carrying 3-, 4- and 5-methoxy substituents.

name: adenosine 5'-monophosphate(2−)
definition: A nucleoside 5'-monophosphate(2−) that results from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of adenosine 5'-monophosphate (AMP).

name: ADP(3−)
definition: A nucleoside 5'-diphosphate(3−) arising from deprotonation of all three diphosphate OH groups of adenosine 5'-diphosphate (ADP); major species present at pH 7.3.

name: ganciclovir
definition: An oxopurine that is guanine substituted by a [(1,3-dihydroxypropan-2-yl)oxy]methyl group at position 9. Ganciclovir is an antiviral drug used to treat or prevent AIDS-related cytomegalovirus infections.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactosyl)-N-hexacosanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactosyl residue at the O-1 position and a hexacosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: imipenem
definition: A broad-spectrum, intravenous β-lactam antibiotic of the carbapenem subgroup.

name: 5-bromo-2'-deoxyuridine
definition: A pyrimidine 2'-deoxyribonucleoside compound having 5-bromouracil as the nucleobase.

name: cefixime
definition: A third-generation cephalosporin antibiotic bearing vinyl and (2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-[(carboxymethoxy)imino]acetamido groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively, of the cephem skeleton. It is used in the treatment of gonorrhoea, tonsilitis, pharyngitis, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections.

name: ouabain
definition: A steroid hormone that is a multi-hydroxylated α-L-rhamnosyl cardenoloide. It binds to and inhibits the plasma membrane Na+/K+-ATPase (sodium pump). It has been isolated naturally from Strophanthus gratus .

name: entecavir (anhydrous)
definition: Guanine substituted at the 9 position by a 4-hydroxy-3-(hydroxymethyl)-2-methylidenecyclopentyl group. A synthetic analogue of 2'-deoxyguanosine, it is a nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor with selective antiviral activity against hepatitis B virus. Entecavir is phosphorylated intracellularly to the active triphosphate form, which competes with deoxyguanosine triphosphate, the natural substrate of hepatitis B virus reverse transcriptase, inhibiting every stage of the enzyme's activity, although it has no activity against HIV. It is used for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B.

name: nystatin A1
definition: A polyene macrolide antibiotic; part of the nystatin complex produced by several Streptomyces species. It is an antifungal antibiotic used for the treatment of topical fungal infections caused by a broad spectrum of fungal pathogens comprising yeast-like and filamentous species.

name: dirithromycin
definition: The hemi-aminal resulting from the condensation of the erythromycin derivative (9S)-erythromycyclamine with 2-(2-methoxyethoxy)acetaldehyde. As the oxazine ring containing the hemi-aminal group is unstable under both acidic and alkaline conditions, dirithromycin functions as a more lipid-soluble prodrug for (9S)-erythromycyclamine. Administered as enteric coated tablets to protect it from acid catalysed hydrolysis in the stomach, it is used to treat respiratory tract, skin, and soft tissue infections caused by susceptible organisms.

name: cefazolin
definition: A first-generation cephalosporin compound having [(5-methyl-1,3,4-thiadiazol-2-yl)sulfanyl]methyl and (1H-tetrazol-1-ylacetyl)amino side-groups at positions 3 and 7 respectively.

name: caspofungin
definition: A semisynthetic cyclic hexapeptide echinocandin antibiotic which exerts its effect by inhibiting the synthesis of 1,3-β-D-glucan, an integral component of the fungal cell wall.

name: maleic anhydride
definition: A cyclic dicarboxylic anhydride that is the cyclic anhydride of maleic acid.

name: cefepime
definition: A cephalosporin bearing (1-methylpyrrolidinium-1-yl)methyl and (2Z)-2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetamido groups at positions 3 and 7, respectively, of the cephem skeleton.

name: 2-aminopurine
definition: The parent compound of the 2-aminopurines, comprising a purine core carrying an amino substituent at the 2-position.

name: vinorelbine
definition: A vinca alkaloid with a norvinblastine skeleton.

name: S-(2-acetamidoethyl) (2S,3R)-3-hydroxy-2-methylpentanethioate
definition: A thioester formed by condensation of (2S,3R)-3-hydroxy-2-methylpentanoic acid with N-(2-sulfanylethyl)acetamide.

name: clavulanate
definition: The conjugate base of clavulanic acid.

name: (23S)-methyl-3α,7α,12α-trihydroxy-5β-cholan-24-oic acid
definition: A trihydroxy-5β-cholanic acid in which the three hydroxy groups are located at positions 3α, 7α and 12α together with a methyl substituent, with S-configuration, at position 23.

name: alcuronium bromide
definition: The organic bromide salt of alcuronium.

name: esculetin
definition: A hydroxycoumarin that is umbelliferone in which the hydrogen at position 6 is substituted by a hydroxy group. It is used in filters for absorption of ultraviolet light.

name: didanosine
definition: A purine 2',3'-dideoxyribonucleoside that is inosine in which the hydroxy groups at both the 2' and the 3' positions on the sugar moiety have been replaced by hydrogen. An antiviral drug, it is used as a medication to treat HIV/AIDS.

name: β-cyclodextrin
definition: A cyclodextrin composed of seven α-(1→4) linked D-glucopyranose units.

name: γ-cyclodextrin
definition: A cycloamylose composed of eight α-(1→4) linked D-glucopyranose units.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-tetracosanyl-2-aminononane-1,3,4-triol
definition: A glycophytoceramide comprising (2S,3S,4R)-2-aminononane-1,3,4-triol having an α-D-galctopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an tetracosanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: N-[(2S,3S,4R)-1-(α-D-galactopyranosyloxy)-3,4-dihydroxynonan-2-yl]hexacosanamide
definition: A fatty amide resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of cerotic acid with the amino group of (2S,3S,4R)-2-aminononane-1,3,4-triol and in which the primary hydroxy group of the resulting product has been converted to the corresponding α-D-galactopyranoside.

name: dATP(3−)
definition: A 2'-deoxyribonucleoside triphosphate oxoanion that is the trianion of 2'-deoxyadenosine 5'-triphosphate, arising from deprotonation of three of the four triphosphate OH groups.

name: o-phthalaldehydic acid
definition: A 2-benzofuran having oxo and hydroxy groups at the 1- and 3-positions respectively.

name: L-thialysine
definition: A cysteine derivative that is the S-(2-aminoethyl) analogue of L-cysteine; reported to have cytotoxic effects.

name: aprepitant
definition: A morpholine-based antiemetic, which is or the prevention of acute and delayed nausea and vomiting associated with initial and repeat courses of highly emetogenic cancer chemotherapy. Aprepitant is a selective high-affinity antagonist of human substance P/neurokinin 1 (NK1) receptors.

name: gallamine
definition: A tertiary amine non-depolarising muscle relaxant whose structure comprises a core benzene molecule substituted at each of C-1, C-2 and C-3 by an N,N-diethyl-2-(ethylamino)ethoxy group.

name: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine
definition: The D isomer of N-acetylglucosamine.

name: taurine zwitterion
definition: The zwitterion formed from taurine by transfer of a proton from the sulfonyl to the amino group. It is the major species existing at physiological pH.

name: tricetin
definition: Flavone hydroxylated at positions 3', 4', 5, 5' and 7.

name: bufalin
definition: A 14β-hydroxy steroid that is bufan-20,22-dienolide having hydroxy substituents at the 5β- and 14β-positions. It has been isolated from the skin of the toad Bufo bufo.

name: 2,5-dimethylaniline
definition: A primary arylamine that is aniline in which the hydrogens at the 2- and 5-positions are replaced by methyl groups. It is used in the manufacture of dyes and other chemicals.

name: alverine
definition: A tertiary amine having one ethyl and two 3-phenylprop-1-yl groups attached to the nitrogen. An antispasmodic that acts directly on intestinal and uterine smooth muscle, it is used (particularly as the citrate salt) in the treatment of irritable bowel syndrome.

name: 2'-O-methylisoliquiritigenin
definition: A member of the class of chalcones that is isoliquiritigenin in which one of the hydroxy groups at position 2' is replaced by a methoxy group.

name: 12-epi-scalarin
definition: The 12-epimer of scalarin, a metabolite of marine sponges of the genus Spongia.

name: elephantin
definition: A germacrane sesquiterpenoid tumour inhibitor isolated from Elephantopus elatus.

name: flufenamate
definition: A monocarboxylic acid anion resulting from the removal of a proton from the carboxy group of flufenamic acid.

name: almotriptan
definition: An indole compound having a 2-(dimethylamino)ethyl group at the 3-position and a (pyrrolidin-1-ylsulfonyl)methyl group at the 5-position.

name: 4-(butylamino)benzoic acid
definition: 4-Aminobenzoic acid in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is substituted by a butyl group.

name: dutasteride
definition: An aza-steroid that is inasteride in which the tert-butyl group is replaced by a 2,5-bis(trifluoromethyl)phenyl group. A synthetic 4-azasteroid, dutasteride is a selective inhibitor of both the type 1 and type 2 isoforms of steroid 5α-reductase, an intracellular enzyme that converts testosterone to 5α-dihydrotestosterone. Dutasteride is used for the treatment of symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia in men with an enlarged prostate gland.

name: (R)-fenfluramine
definition: The R-enantiomer of fenfluramine.

name: digitoxigenin 3-O-[β-D-glucosyl-(1→4)-α-L-acofrioside]
definition: A cardenolide glycoside consisting of digitoxigenin having a β-D-glucopyrananosyl-(1→4)-α-L-acofriopyranosyl moiety attached at the 3-position.

name: (R)-nomifensine
definition: The R enantiomer of nomifensine.

name: 3,5-di-O-caffeoyl-muco-quinic acid
definition: muco-Quinic acid in which the hydroxy functions at C-3 and C-5 have been esterified with trans-caffeic acid.

name: cembra-2,7,11-triene-4,6-diol
definition: A cembrane diterpenoid obtained from tobacco and shown to have antitumour-promoting activity.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-octanoylphytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an octanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranuronosyl)-N-tetradecanoyldihydrosphingosine
definition: A glycodihydroceramide having an α-D-galacturonic acid residue at the O-1 position and a tetradecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(10-phenyldecanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 10-phenyldecanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(6-phenylhexanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and a 6-phenylhexanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-(8-phenyloctanoyl)phytosphingosine
definition: A glycophytoceramide having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue at the O-1 position and an 8-phenyloctanoyl group attached to the nitrogen.

name: cytochalasin D
definition: An organic heterotricyclic compound that is a mycotoxin produced by Helminthosporium and other moulds which is cell permeable and a potent inhibitor of actin polymerisation and DNA synthesis.

name: cidofovir(2−)
definition: The dianion obtained by removal of two protons from the phosphonic acid group of cidofovir.

name: 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine zwitterion
definition: The amino acid zwitterion formed from 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine by tranfer of a proton from the carboxy group to the amino group. It is the major species at pH 7.3.

name: L-aspartic acid 4-semialdehyde zwitterion
definition: An L-α-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxylic acid group to the amino group of L-aspartic acid 4-semialdehyde.

name: reynosin
definition: A sesquiterpene lactone of the eudesmanolide group, found particularly in Magnolia grandiflora and Laurus nobilis.

name: epiandrosterone
definition: A 3β-hydroxy steroid that is (5α)-androstane substituted by a β-hydroxy group at position 3 and an oxo group at position 17.

name: minquartynoic acid
definition: A straight-chain, C18 polyunsaturated fatty acid having four conjugated C≡C bonds at positions 9, 11, 13 and 15 as well as an (S)-hydroxy group at position 17.

name: 3',4',5'-O-trimethyltricetin
definition: A trimethoxyflavone that is the 3',4',5'-tri-O-methyl ether of tricetin.

name: dihydrocubebin
definition: A glycol that is butane-1,4-diol substituted at the 2- and 3-positions by (1,3-benzodioxol-5-yl)methyl groups (the R,R-configuration).

name: traumatic acid
definition: A monounsaturated straight-chain dicarboxylic acid with the double bond at C-2; a plant wound-healing hormone.

name: homovanillic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is the 3-O-methyl ether of (3,4-dihydroxyphenyl)acetic acid. It is a catecholamine metabolite.

name: (4-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl)acetic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid that is acetic acid carrying a 2-hydroxy-3-nitrophenyl substituent at C-2.

name: β-D-Galp-(1→3)-D-GalpNAc
definition: An amino disaccharide consisting of D-galactopyranose at the non-reducing end joined by a (1→3) glycosidic linkage to N-acetyl-D-galactopyranosamine.

name: α-D-Gal-(1→4)-D-Gal
definition: A glycosylgalactose consisting of D-galactopyranose having an α-D-galactopyranosyl residue attached at the 4-position.

name: 4-nitrophenyl α-D-galactoside
definition: An α-D-galactopyranoside having a 4-nitrophenyl substituent at the anomeric position.

name: (1R)-1,5-anhydro-1-[(3S,4S,5R)-3-(hexacosanoylamino)-4,5-dihydroxynonadecyl]-D-galactitol
definition: A C-glycosylphytoceramide consisting of 1-O-(α-D-galactopyranosyl)-N-hexacosanylphytosphingosine with the anomeric oxygen replaced by a methylene group.

name: ceftizoxime
definition: A parenteral third-generation cephalosporin, bearing a 2-(2-amino-1,3-thiazol-4-yl)-2-(methoxyimino)acetyl]amino group at the 7β-position.

name: ipratropium chloride
definition: The chloride salt of ipratropium.

name: bambuterol
definition: A carbamate ester that is terbutaline in which both of the phenolic hydroxy groups have been protected as the corresponding N,N-dimethylcarbamates. A long acting beta-adrenoceptor agonist used in the treatment of asthma, it is a prodrug for terbutaline.

name: cephapirin
definition: A cephalosporin with acetoxymethyl and 2(pyridin-4-ylsulfanyl)acetamido substituents at positions 3 and 7, respectively, of the cephem skeleton. It is used (as its sodium salt) as an antibiotic, being effective against gram-negative and gram-positive organisms.

name: radicicol
definition: An antifungal macrolactone antibiotic, obtained from Diheterospora chlamydosporia and Chaetomium chiversii that inhibits protein tyrosine kinase and heat shock protein 90 (Hsp90).

name: fenticlor
definition: An aryl sulfide having two 5-chloro-2-hydroxyphenyl groups attached to sulfur; an antiinfective drug mostly used in veterinary medicine.

name: cefditoren pivoxil
definition: The pivaloyloxymethyl ester prodrug of cefditoren.

name: 2-acetyl-5-methylfuran
definition: A furan carrying acetyl and methyl substituents at the 2- and 5-positions respectively.

name: 6-methylcoumarin
definition: A member of the class of coumarins that is coumarin in which the hydrogen at position 6 is replaced by a methyl group.

name: malonaldehyde
definition: A dialdehyde that is propane substituted by two oxo groups at the terminal carbon atoms respectively. A biomarker of oxidative damage to lipids caused by smoking, it exists in vivo mainly in the enol form.

name: 3,4,5-trimethoxycinnamic acid
definition: A methoxycinnamic acid with three methoxy substituents at the 3-, 4- and 5-positions.

name: ethylaminium
definition: An ammonium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen of ethylamine. The conjugate acid of ethylamine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: propan-1-aminium
definition: An ammonium ion that is the conjugate acid of propylamine.

name: cladribine
definition: 2'-Deoxyadenosine in which the hydrogen at position 2 on the purine ring has been substituted by chlorine. It inhibits the synthesis and repair of DNA, particularly in lymphocytes and monocytes, and is used as an antimetabolite antineoplastic drug for the treatment of lymphoid malignancies including hairy-cell leukaemia and chronic lymphocytic leukaemia.

name: tioxolone
definition: A 1,3-benzoxathiole having a hydroxy substituent at the 6-position.

name: 2-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2-oxoethyl dithiobutyrate
definition: The thioester formed between dithiobutyric acid and 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)-2-sulfanylethanone.

name: papulacandin B
definition: A papulacandin that is papulacandin A in which the (2E,4E)-deca-2,4-dienoyl chain at the O-(6') position is replaced by a (2E,4Z,6E)-8-hydroxydeca-2,4,6-trienoyl chain. It is the major carbohydrate-containing antibiotic from the deuteromycetous fungus Papularia sphaerosperma which shows potent antifungal activity against Candida albicans.

name: atovaquone
definition: A naphthoquinone compound having a 4-(4-chlorophenyl)cyclohexyl group at the 2-position and a hydroxy substituent at the 3-position.

name: 2'-deoxyadenosine 3'-monophosphate
definition: A 2'-deoxyadenosine phosphate having a monophosphate group located at the 3'-position.

name: (R)-ketamine
definition: The R- (less active) enantiomer of ketamine.

name: agrimoniin
definition: A dimeric hydrolysable tannin in which 2 moles of potentillin monomer are linked via a dehydrogalloyl group; an antitumor tannin of Agrimonia pilosa Ledeb., which induces interleukin-1.

name: myriocin
definition: An amino acid-based antibiotic derived from certain thermophilic fungi; acts as a potent inhibitor of serine palmitoyltransferase, the first step in sphingosine biosynthesis. Myriocin also possesses immunosuppressant activity.

name: ent-zingiberene
definition: The enantiomer of zingiberine.

name: 3,4,5-trimethoxydihydrocinnamic acid
definition: A monocarboxylic acid consisting of propionic acid having a 3,4,5-trimethoxyphenyl substituent at the 3-position.

name: methysergide
definition: A synthetic ergot alkaloid, structurally related to the oxytocic agent methylergonovine and to the potent hallucinogen LSD and used prophylactically to reduce the frequency and intensity of severe vascular headaches.

name: felodipine
definition: The mixed (methyl, ethyl) diester of 4-(2,3-dichlorophenyl)-2,6-dimethyl-1,4-dihydropyridine-3,5-dicarboxylic acid. A calcium-channel blocker, it lowers blood pressure by reducing peripheral vascular resistance through a highly selective action on smooth muscle in arteriolar resistance vessels. It is used in the management of hypertension and angina pectoris.

name: piperidinium
definition: The conjugate acid of piperidine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N,N'-bis(pyridin-3-ylmethyl)pyrimidine-4,6-dicarboxamide
definition: A pyrimidinecarboxamide having the amido groups at the 4- and 6-positions and pyridin-3-ylmethyl as the amide N-substituents.

name: 4'-demethylrebeccamycin
definition: An N-glycosyl compound consisting of a heteropolycyclic ring system with a glucosyl group attached to one of the indolic nitrogens.

name: pyridoxal 5'-phosphate(2−)
definition: The dianion resulting from the removal of two protons from the phosphate group of pyridoxal 5'-phosphate.

name: amorolfine
definition: A member of the class of morpholines that is cis-2,6-dimethylmorpholine in which the hydrogen attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a racemic 2-methyl-3-[p-(2-methylbutan-2-yl)phenyl]propyl group. An inhibitor of the action of squalene monooxygenase, Δ14 reductase and D7-D8 isomerase and an antifungal agent, it is used (generally as its hydrochloride salt) for the topical treatment of fungal nail and skin infections.

name: moxalactam
definition: A broad-spectrum oxacephem antibiotic in which the oxazine ring is substituted with a tetrazolylthiomethyl group and the azetidinone ring carries methoxy and 2-carboxy-2-(4-hydroxyphenyl)acetamido substituents.

name: daptomycin
definition: A polypeptide comprising N-decanoyltryptophan, asparagine, aspartic acid, threonine, glycine, ornithine, aspartic acid, D-alanine, aspartic acid, glycine, D-serine, threo-3-methylglutamic acid and 3-anthraniloylalanine (also known as kynurinine) coupled in sequence and lactonised by condensation of the carboxylic acid group of the 3-anthraniloylalanine with the alcohol group of the threonine residue.

name: micafungin
definition: A cyclic hexapeptide echinocandin antibiotic which exerts its effect by inhibiting the synthesis of 1,3-β-D-glucan, an integral component of the fungal cell wall. It is used as the sodium salt for the treatment of invasive candidiasis, and of aspergillosis in patients who are intolerant of other therapy.

name: aliskiren
definition: A monomethoxybenzene compound having a 3-methoxypropoxy group at the 2-position and a multi-substituted branched alkyl substituent at the 4-position.

name: pyrraline
definition: A pyrrole having formyl and hydroxymethyl substituents at positions 2 and 5 respectively; useful as indicator of advanced stages of the Maillard reaction, which produces advanced glycation end-products (AGEs).

name: prostaglandin E2(1−)
definition: The conjugate base of prostaglandin E2; major species at pH 7.3.

name: N-benzoylglycinate
definition: An α-amino-acid anion that is the conjugate base of N-benzoylglycine; major species at pH 7.3.

name: enfuvirtide
definition: A synthetic 36-amino acid peptide consisting of N-acetyltyrosyl, threonyl, seryl, leucyl, isoleucyl, histidyl, seryl, leucyl, isoleucyl, α-glutamyl, α-glutamyl, seryl, glutaminyl, asparaginyl, glutaminyl, glutaminyl, α-glutamyl, lysyl, asparaginyl, α-glutamyl, α-glutamyl, α-glutamyl, leucyl, leucyl, α-glutamyl, leucyl, α-aspartyl, lysyl, tryptophyl, alanyl, seryl, leucyl, tryptophyl, asparaginyl, tryptophyl, and phenylalaninamide residues joined in sequence. An HIV fusion inhibitor, it was the first of a novel class of antiretroviral drugs used in combination therapy for the treatment of HIV-1 infection. It interferes with entry of HIV into cells by binding to the gp41 sub-unit of the viral envelope glycoprotein, so inhibiting fusion of viral and cellular membranes.

name: L-canavanine
definition: A non-proteinogenic L-α-amino acid that is L-homoserine substituted at oxygen with a guanidino (carbamimidamido) group. Although structurally related to L-arginine, it is non-proteinogenic.

name: β-D-Gal-(1→4)-β-D-Glc-OMe
definition: A methyl glycoside comprising methyl β-D-glucoside having an β-D-galactosyl residue at the 4-position.

name: cocaine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of cocaine. It is a local anesthetic and vasoconstrictor and is clinically used for that purpose, particularly in the eye, ear, nose, and throat. It also has powerful central nervous system effects similar to the amphetamines and is a drug of abuse.

name: benzyl chloride
definition: A member of the class of benzyl chlorides that is toluene substituted on the α-carbon with chlorine.

name: carbimazole
definition: A member of the class of imidazoles that is methimazole in which the nitrogen bearing a hydrogen is converted into its ethoxycarbonyl derivative. A prodrug for methimazol, carbimazole is used for the treatment of hyperthyroidism.

name: nikkomycin Z
definition: A uridine-based nucleoside-peptide antibiotic which inhibits fungal chitin biosynthesis by inhibiting chitin synthase.

name: betaxolol hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of betaxolol.

name: diethylpropion hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of diethylpropion. A central stimulant and indirect-acting sympathomimetic, it is an appetite depressant and is used as an anoretic in the short term management of obesity.

name: diltiazem hydrochloride
definition: A hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of diltiazem and hydrogen chloride. A calcium-channel blocker and vasodilator, it is used in the management of angina pectoris and hypertension.

name: ketamine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of ketamine.

name: cyproheptadine hydrochloride sesquihydrate
definition: The sesquihydrate of cyproheptadine hydrochloride. Note that the drug named cyproheptadine hydrochloride generally refers to cyproheptadine hydrochloride sesquihydrate. A sedating antihistamine with antimuscarinic and calcium-channel blocking actions, it is used for the relief of allergic conditions including rhinitis, conjunctivitis due to inhalant allergens and foods, urticaria and angioedema, and in pruritic skin disorders. Unlike other antihistamines, it is also a seratonin receptor antagonist, making it useful in conditions such as vascular headache and anorexia.

name: buprenorphine hydrochloride
definition: The hydrochloride salt of buprenorphine.

name: doxycycline HCl
definition: The hydrochloride salt of doxycycline.

name: clofarabine
definition: A purine nucleoside analogue consisting of a 6-amino-2-chloropurin-9-yl group attached to the 1β position of 2'-deoxy-2'-fluoro-D-arabinofuranose. It is metabolized intracellularly to the active 5'-triphosphate metabolite, which inhibits DNA synthesisis and so stops the growth of cancer cells. Clofarabine is used as an antimetabolite antineoplastic agent in the treatment of relapsed or refractory acute lymphoblastic leukaemia.

name: doxapram
definition: A member of the class of pyrrolidin-2-ones that is N-ethylpyrrolidin-2-one in which both of the hydrogens at the 3 position (adjacent to the carbonyl group) are substituted by phenyl groups, and one of the hydrogens at the 4 position is substituted by a 2-(morpholin-4-yl)ethyl group. A central and respiratory stimulant with a brief duration of action, it is used (generally as the hydrochloride or the hydrochloride hydrate) as a temporary treatment of acute respiratory failure, particularly when superimposed on chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and of postoperative respiratory depression. It has also been used for treatment of postoperative shivering.

name: conivaptan
definition: The amide resulting from the formal condensation of 4-[(biphenyl-2-ylcarbonyl)amino]benzoic acid with the benzazepine nitrogen of 2-methyl-1,4,5,6-tetrahydroimidazo[4,5-d][1]benzazepine. It is an antagonist for two of the three types of arginine vasopressin (AVP) receptors, V1a and V2. It is used as its hydrochloride salt for the treatment of hyponatraemia (low blood sodium levels) caused by syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone (SIADH).

name: desoximetasone
definition: Dexamethasone in which the hydroxy group at the 17α position is substituted by hydrogen. A synthetic corticosteroid with glucocorticoid activity, it is used as an anti-inflammatory and anti-pruritic in the treatment of various skin disorders, including skin allergies and psoriasis.

name: 1,3,7-trimethyluric acid
definition: An oxopurine in which the purine ring is substituted by oxo groups at positions 2, 6, and 8, and the nitrogens at positions 1, 3, and 7 are substituted by methyl groups. It is a metabolite of caffeine.

name: methyl 5-aminolevulinate
definition: The methyl ester of 5-aminolevulinic acid. A prodrug, it is metabolised to protoporphyrin IX, a photosensitizer, and is used in the photodynamic treatment of non-melanoma skin cancer (including basal cell carcinoma). Topical application (often as the hydrochloride salt) results in an accumulation of protoporphyrin IX in the skin lesions to which the cream has been applied. Subsequent illumination with red light results in the generation of toxic singlet oxygen that destroys cell membranes and thereby kills the tumour cells.

name: ethylmalonic acid
definition: A dicarboxylic acid obtained by substitution of one of the methylene hydrogens of malonic acid by an ethyl group.

name: (S)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyrate
definition: The S-enantiomer of 2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyrate. The conjugate base of (S)-2-hydroxy-3-methylbutyric acid, formed by loss of a proton from the carboxy group, it is the major species present at physiological pH.

name: travoprost
definition: The isopropyl ester of prostaglandin F2α in which the pentyl group is replaced by a 3-(trifluoromethyl)phenoxymethyl group. A synthetic analogue of prostaglandin F2α, ophthalmic solutions of travoprost are used as a topical medication for controlling the progression of open-angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension, by reducing intraocular pressure. It is a pro-drug; the isopropyl ester group is hydrolysed by esterases in the cornea to the biologically active free acid, fluprostenol.

name: L-thiocystine
definition: The L-enantiomer of the sulfur-containing amino acid thiocystine.
